question: For each department, what is the maximum number of enrolled students in any course offered by that department in 2019, what is the name of the responsible faculty member for that course, and what is the average number of enrolled students for all such courses in that department, considering only courses where the maximum number of enrolled students is greater than 5, and only including departments of Mathematics (Course 18) and Chemistry (Course 5)? Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "math" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'" "Chemistry" is predicated by "TABLE.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry'" "Course 18" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'" "Course 5" is predicated by "TABLE.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND ( (sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') OR (lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry') ) AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = ( SELECT MAX(lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso2 WHERE lso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND lso2.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 ) ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ic.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, avg_stats.avg_num_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_num_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND (lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = 18 OR lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = 5) GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ) avg_stats ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = avg_stats.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each assignable organization (excluding 'ADMISSIONS' and those with organization IDs '138' and '250'), provide the organization name, the average and variance of the HR department codes for its associated HR org units, and the number of HR org units per organization, considering only those with a non-null HR department code. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "admissions" is predicated by "TABLE.ORGANIZATION_NAME = 'ADMISSIONS'" "exclude organizations '138' and '250'" is predicated by "TABLE.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250')" "admissions" is predicated by "TABLE.ORGANIZATION_NAME = 'ADMISSIONS'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID, HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD IS NOT NULL AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME != 'ADMISSIONS' AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') ) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS avg_dept_code, VARIANCE(inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS dept_code_variance, COUNT(inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS num_hr_org_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY dept_code_variance DESC;

question: For each school, what is the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the department budget codes among its departments, what is the full name of the school, and how many unique subject codes are associated with the departments in that school? Only include schools that have a department named "Political Science". Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "Political Science" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'" "Political Science" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT = '17'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, STDDEV(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS dept_budget_code_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_full_name FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME IN ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' ) GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) > 0 ) SELECT icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.dept_budget_code_stddev, icte.school_full_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS unique_subject_codes FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.SCHOOL_NAME = sd.SCHOOL_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.dept_budget_code_stddev, icte.school_full_name

question: For the top 10 degree-granting departments (excluding Political Science), provide the department name, school name, the total number of unique courses they offer, and indicate whether the department is a 'LARGE_DEPT' (if it offers at least 20% more courses than the average among these departments), 'SMALL_DEPT' (if it offers at least 20% fewer), or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "Political Science" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'" "Course 17" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '17'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY total_courses DESC LIMIT 10 ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(total_courses) AS avg_courses FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.total_courses, CASE WHEN i.total_courses > a.avg_courses * 1.2 THEN 'LARGE_DEPT' WHEN i.total_courses < a.avg_courses * 0.8 THEN 'SMALL_DEPT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS dept_size_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_cte a;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the geometric mean of the total units for subjects offered in terms where the material status is 'U' and the department is Mathematics (Course 18), and only include those academic years where this geometric mean is greater than the overall geometric mean of total units for all such subjects across all years? Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "math" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'" "Course 18" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, geometric_mean_total_units FROM inner_cte WHERE geometric_mean_total_units > ( SELECT EXP(AVG(LN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC;

question: For each department, provide the department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units), and the department phone number. Only include departments that have at least one subject with more than 0 total units, and restrict the results to the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "math" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'" "Course 18" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) / AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: For each academic year, provide the academic year description and the total number of units for all subjects offered in terms with a term status of 'Previous', where the total number of units is greater than 100, and only include subjects offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18). Additionally, for each such academic year, report the number of subjects that are classified as undergraduate (HGN_DESC = 'Undergraduate'), and only include academic years where at least 60% of the subjects are undergraduate. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "math" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'" "Course 18" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 100 ), SubjectCounts AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(*) AS total_subjects, COUNT(CASE WHEN ccso.HGN_DESC = 'Undergraduate' THEN 1 END) AS undergraduate_subjects FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.total_units, sc.undergraduate_subjects, sc.total_subjects FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SubjectCounts sc ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = sc.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC WHERE sc.undergraduate_subjects > 0.6 * sc.total_subjects;

question: For each department in the 2022 academic year, provide the department name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for letter graded subjects, along with the school name and department phone number. Only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Biology department. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "degree-granting" is predicated by "TABLE.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'" "Biology" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '7'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.range_total_units, inner_cte.var_total_units, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each school, what is the geometric mean of the clearing cost collector values for all departments in that school, considering only departments where the clearing cost collector is greater than zero, and excluding the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Show the school name and the geometric mean. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "math" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'" "Course 18" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR))) AS geometric_mean FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(geometric_mean))) AS school_geometric_mean FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY school_geometric_mean DESC;

question: List the subject IDs, the corresponding subject titles from the library, the department names from TIP, and the total number of such subjects per department, for each subject offered in both the library and TIP systems in 2019, where the maximum number of enrolled students in the library offering is greater than 5 and the department name from TIP is 'Chemistry'. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "Chemistry" is predicated by "TABLE.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry'" "Course 5" is predicated by "TABLE.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT, MAX(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_num_enrolled_students, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE AS library_subject_title, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS tip_department_name, lso.SUBJECT_ID AS library_subject_id FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT = tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' GROUP BY lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.SUBJECT_ID HAVING max_num_enrolled_students > 5 ) SELECT inner_cte.library_subject_id, inner_cte.library_subject_title, inner_cte.tip_department_name, dept_counts.total_subjects_per_department FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT tip.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT) AS total_subjects_per_department FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tip ON lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT = tip.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND tip.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' GROUP BY tip.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) dept_counts ON inner_cte.tip_department_name = dept_counts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: For each department that is degree-granting, has a department budget code above 100000, and is not the Political Science department, give the department code, department name, school name, the number of unique courses offered by the department, the total number of units for all those courses, and the number of unique subject codes associated with those courses. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "Political Science" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'" "Political Science" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '17'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_CODE) AS num_unique_courses, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.num_unique_courses, i.total_units, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS num_unique_subject_codes FROM inner_cte i JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON c.SUBJECT_CODE = s.SUBJECT_CODE GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.num_unique_courses, i.total_units ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: For each department (only Chemistry and Biology), what is the average of the range of enrolled students per subject (where each subject has at least one associated course material), grouped by department? Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "biology and chemistry department" is predicated by "TABLE.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')" "Course 5" is predicated by "TABLE.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry'" "Course 7" is predicated by "TABLE.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Biology'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_ID, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(enrolled_range) AS avg_enrolled_range_per_subject FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: For each building type, show the building type name, the ownership type, and calculate the average, range, and variance of the number of rooms in building history records for buildings of that type and ownership type that are located on the MIT site, but exclude buildings that are classified as residential. For each building type, include a grand total for all ownership types in the format of (building type, null, total statistics). Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "residential" is predicated by "TABLE.BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT'" "buildings at MIT" is predicated by "TABLE.SITE = 'MIT'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_TYPE, FCLT_BUILDING.OWNERSHIP_TYPE, FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.NUM_OF_ROOMS FROM FCLT_BUILDING JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST ON FCLT_BUILDING.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.SITE = 'MIT' AND FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_TYPE <> 'RESIDENT' ) SELECT BUILDING_TYPE, OWNERSHIP_TYPE, AVG(NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS avg_num_rooms, MAX(NUM_OF_ROOMS) - MIN(NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS num_rooms_range, VARIANCE(NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS num_rooms_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY BUILDING_TYPE, OWNERSHIP_TYPE WITH ROLLUP HAVING BUILDING_TYPE IS NOT NULL ORDER BY BUILDING_TYPE, OWNERSHIP_TYPE

question: For each department offering Chemistry courses that have at least one library reserve material and are offered in terms with a term status indicator of 'P', what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students, and for each such department, which term had the highest number of enrolled students in these courses, along with the corresponding term code and enrolled student count? Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "Chemistry" is predicated by "TABLE.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry'" "Course 5" is predicated by "TABLE.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.TERM_CODE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm ON tso.TERM_CODE = lrm.TERM_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = lrm.SUBJECT_ID JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' ) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students, STDDEV(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students, tmax.TERM_CODE AS term_with_max_enrollment, tmax.max_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, TERM_CODE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS max_enrolled_students FROM ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, TERM_CODE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte ) ranked WHERE rn = 1 ) tmax ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tmax.OFFER_DEPT_NAME GROUP BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tmax.TERM_CODE, tmax.max_enrolled_students ;

question: For each department, provide the department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units, where the department is degree granting, and excluding the Biology and Chemistry departments), and for each such department, list the subject id and total units for subjects whose total units exceed the average total units for that department. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "biology and chemistry department" is predicated by "TABLE.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')" "Course 7" is predicated by "TABLE.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Biology'" "Course 5" is predicated by "TABLE.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NOT IN ('Biology', 'Chemistry') ) , dept_stats AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.total_units_range, ds.total_units_variance, ds.total_units_stddev, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte s JOIN dept_stats ds ON s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > ds.avg_total_units ORDER BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID ;

question: For each student in the Political Science department, show their first name, last name, email address, department name, school name, the maximum department budget code for each student considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by last name, and also include the department full name, where the student year is 'G' and the department is degree granting. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "Political Science" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'" "Political Science" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY t1.LAST_NAME ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, t1.DEPARTMENT, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' ) SELECT i.FIRST_NAME, i.LAST_NAME, i.EMAIL_ADDRESS, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.MAX_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte i JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON i.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Mathematics), show the department name, each subject code, the subject code description, the graduate level of the subject, and the average and variance of the ASCII values of the course numbers for that department's subject codes. Do not return any rounded answers.

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND at.TERM_START_DATE > '2010-01-01' AND at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_with_max_units, ic.TOTAL_UNITS AS max_total_units, stats.total_units_range, stats.total_units_variance FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ) stats ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND ic.TOTAL_UNITS = stats.max_total_units ORDER BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Political Science), list the department name, the total number of unique subject titles they offered with at least one enrolled student, and the total number of enrolled students in those subjects. Additionally, for each school, include a grand total row showing the total number of unique subject titles and total enrolled students across all its degree-granting departments (excluding Political Science). Show only the top 10 departments by unique subject count within each school. Do not return any rounded answers.

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE != '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, subject_count, total_enrolled FROM ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, subject_count, total_enrolled, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte ) ranked WHERE rn <= 10 UNION ALL SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(subject_count) AS subject_count, SUM(total_enrolled) AS total_enrolled FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: For each academic year, what is the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in courses, considering only courses that are offered in the fall term, have more than zero enrolled students, and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18)? question: For each organization, what is the geometric mean of the old department codes for all associated HR organization units where the old department code is greater than zero, excluding organizations '138' and '250', and only for organizations that are not 'CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST'? question: For each academic year, show the academic year description, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in regular terms by the Mathematics department (Course 18), and the total number of Mathematics subjects offered in those terms. SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SCHOOL_CODE, t2.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' ) SELECT SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY SCHOOL_CODE) AS max_total_units FROM inner_cte ORDER BY SUBJECT_ID;

question: For organizations whose organization name contains 'Facilities', and that are not organizations '138' or '250', show their organization IDs, the dense rank of their HR department names (considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by HR department code), and for each, also show the corresponding HR department name long and the HR org unit title. SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.ORGANIZATION_ID, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME LIKE '%Facilities%' AND t1.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') ) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_ID, inner_cte.window_column, t3.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t3.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE FROM inner_cte JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t3 ON inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t3.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID;

question: For subjects offered in the term '2019FA' by the Chemistry department, show the subject title, the dense rank of each subject considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the number of enrolled students descending, the full name of the offering department, and the school name of the department, but only include courses that have course materials. SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS dense_rank_num_enrolled, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.dense_rank_num_enrolled, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2022 that are printed in the bulletin and belong to the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject title, department name, total units, and the difference between the total units of each subject and the average total units for Mathematics subjects in 2022. Do not return any rounded answers.

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.IS_PRINTED_IN_BULLETIN = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) , avg_units AS ( SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.TOTAL_UNITS, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - a.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg_units FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_units a;

question: For each subject offered by the library in the term "2014FA" with more than 5 enrolled students and offered by the Mathematics department, show the subject ID, subject title, the term description, the department name from the course catalog, and the running sum of enrolled students within each offer department code group ordered by subject ID, but only include those subjects where the total units for the subject (from the course catalog) is at least 9. SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY lso.SUBJECT_ID) AS running_sum_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID AND lso.TERM_CODE = cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, lso.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.running_sum_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso2 ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = cso2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE cso2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 9;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description, the minimum, maximum, and average number of TIP materials per subject offered in that year (for subjects offered in the fall term, with at least one TIP material, and in the Mathematics department), and what is the deviation of each year's average from the overall average number of TIP materials per subject across all such years? Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "math" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'" "Course 18" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH tip_counts AS ( SELECT cca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cca.TERM_CODE, cca.SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS num_tip_materials FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cca JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON cca.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE AND cca.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE cca.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cca.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cca.TERM_CODE, cca.SUBJECT_ID ), per_year_stats AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MIN(tc.num_tip_materials) AS min_tip_materials, MAX(tc.num_tip_materials) AS max_tip_materials, AVG(tc.num_tip_materials) AS avg_tip_materials FROM tip_counts tc JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tc.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE AND tc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, min_tip_materials, max_tip_materials, avg_tip_materials FROM per_year_stats ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.min_tip_materials, i.max_tip_materials, i.avg_tip_materials, (i.avg_tip_materials - (SELECT AVG(avg_tip_materials) FROM inner_cte)) AS deviation_from_overall_avg FROM inner_cte i ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For the top 5 departments with the highest average total units per subject (considering only departments that grant degrees and subjects with more than zero total units), display each department's name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of subjects offered by that department, and the subject with the highest total units in that department along with its total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "math" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'" "Course 18" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'" "Mathematics" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) , dept_avg_units AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME ) , top5_depts AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM dept_avg_units ORDER BY avg_total_units DESC LIMIT 5 ) , dept_stats AS ( SELECT ic.DEPT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ( SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS DEPT_CODE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte JOIN top5_depts t5 ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t5.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) ic GROUP BY ic.DEPT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) , max_subjects AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ( SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte JOIN top5_depts t5 ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t5.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) ic WHERE ic.rn = 1 ) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.total_units_variance, ds.total_units_stddev, ms.SUBJECT_ID AS subject_with_max_units, ms.TOTAL_UNITS AS max_total_units FROM dept_stats ds JOIN max_subjects ms ON ds.DEPT_CODE = ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ds.total_units_variance DESC;

question: For the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the department name, each subject ID, subject title, and the total number of subject enrollments for subjects offered in the current term, only including those subjects where the total number of enrollments is greater than 10. question: Show the building name, building key, and the total area of all rooms in the Stata building (building 32), but only if the total area of rooms is more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean total room area across all MIT buildings, and also include the total assignable area from all floors in that building. Do not return any rounded answers.

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH building_room_areas AS ( SELECT fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, SUM(fr.AREA) AS total_room_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ), stats AS ( SELECT AVG(total_room_area) AS mean_area, STDDEV(total_room_area) AS stddev_area FROM building_room_areas ) SELECT bra.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, bra.total_room_area FROM building_room_areas bra JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON bra.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY CROSS JOIN stats WHERE bra.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = '32' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND bra.total_room_area > stats.mean_area + stats.stddev_area ) SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, inner_cte.total_room_area, COALESCE(SUM(ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA),0) AS total_assignable_area FROM inner_cte JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON inner_cte.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY LEFT JOIN FCLT_FLOOR ff ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, inner_cte.total_room_area

question: For each department, provide the department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students per subject offered by that department (considering only subjects with at least one enrolled student and departments that grant degrees), and also include the full department name from the SIS_DEPARTMENT table, but only for the Mathematics department (Course 18). SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.enrolled_students_range, ic.enrolled_students_variance, ic.enrolled_students_stddev, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each academic year, what is the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the maximum enrollment for IAP activities offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18), considering only years with more than five activities, and what is the corresponding academic year description, along with the department phone number and the school name? question: For each academic year, which subject from the Mathematics department offered in the fall term had the highest number of enrolled students, and by how much did this enrollment exceed the average enrollment for Mathematics fall subjects that year? SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_TITLE, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) , avg_enrollment_per_year AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ) , max_enrollment_per_year AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, (i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS - a.avg_enrollment) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte i JOIN max_enrollment_per_year m ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = m.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = m.max_enrollment JOIN avg_enrollment_per_year a ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

evidence: "Computer Science" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'" "Electrical Engineering and Computer Science" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT = '6'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.STUDENT_YEAR, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT = t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT icte.FIRST_NAME, icte.LAST_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.STUDENT_YEAR, icte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(*) OVER ( PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY icte.FIRST_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_student_count FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 ON icte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME = t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ORDER BY icte.FIRST_NAME;

question: For each academic year, what is the total number of lecture units for all subjects offered in regular terms by the Mathematics department (Course 18), and how does this total compare to the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all years? For each year, also indicate whether it is a 'HIGH_PERFORMER' (total lecture units at least one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean), 'LOW_PERFORMER' (at least one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) below the mean), or 'AVERAGE' (within one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the mean). Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "math" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'" "Course 18" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at_all.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) AS total_lecture_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at_all JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON at_all.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at_all.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.total_lecture_units, stats.avg_lecture_units, stats.stddev_lecture_units, CASE WHEN inner_cte.total_lecture_units >= stats.avg_lecture_units + stats.stddev_lecture_units THEN 'HIGH_PERFORMER' WHEN inner_cte.total_lecture_units <= stats.avg_lecture_units - stats.stddev_lecture_units THEN 'LOW_PERFORMER' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS performance_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(total_lecture_units) AS avg_lecture_units, STDDEV(total_lecture_units) AS stddev_lecture_units FROM inner_cte ) stats;

question: For each department and academic year where the subject enrollment number is greater than 10 and the department is Mathematics, provide the number of unique subjects, the minimum total units offered, and indicate whether the minimum total units is above or below the average total units for that department and year ('ABOVE_AVERAGE' if above, 'BELOW_AVERAGE' if below, otherwise 'AVERAGE'). Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "math" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'" "Course 18" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects, MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), avg_units_cte AS ( SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.num_unique_subjects, i.min_total_units, a.avg_total_units, CASE WHEN i.min_total_units > a.avg_total_units THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.min_total_units < a.avg_total_units THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS min_units_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN avg_units_cte a ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each school and term, provide the term code, school name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of students enrolled in subjects offered in regular terms by the Chemistry or Biology departments. SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(term_code) OVER (ORDER BY term_sort, school_sort) = term_code THEN NULL ELSE term_code END AS term_code, school, avg_enrollment, enrollment_stddev FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME END AS school, CASE WHEN GROUPING(OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME END AS school_sort, TERM_CODE AS term_code, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY TERM_CODE, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY term_sort, school_sort;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY ss.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), SchoolYearStats AS ( SELECT ss.SCHOOL_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY ss.SCHOOL_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT sys.SCHOOL_NAME, sys.ACADEMIC_YEAR, sys.avg_total_units, sys.total_units_variance, sys.total_units_stddev FROM SchoolYearStats sys UNION ALL SELECT sys.SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(sys.avg_total_units) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(sys.avg_total_units) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sys.avg_total_units) AS total_units_stddev FROM SchoolYearStats sys GROUP BY sys.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR ;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, hou.DLC_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS num_hr_org_units FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN (138, 250) AND LOWER(hou.DLC_NAME) = 'biology' GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, hou.DLC_NAME ORDER BY num_hr_org_units DESC, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME LIMIT 3 ) SELECT icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.DLC_NAME, icte.num_hr_org_units, COUNT(DISTINCT hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS num_hr_departments FROM inner_cte icte JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME AND icte.DLC_NAME = fo.DLC_NAME JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE LOWER(hou.DLC_NAME) = 'biology' GROUP BY icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.DLC_NAME, icte.num_hr_org_units ORDER BY icte.num_hr_org_units DESC, icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE NOT IN ('5', '7') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.avg_enrolled_students, ic.var_enrolled_students, ic.stddev_enrolled_students, sso.Most_Offered_School, sso.Subject_Count FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME AS Most_Offered_School, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) sso ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, MAX(Subject_Count) AS Max_Subjects FROM ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) t GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE ) maxs ON sso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = maxs.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND sso.Subject_Count = maxs.Max_Subjects ORDER BY ic.avg_enrolled_students DESC LIMIT 5;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.TERM_CODE = sos.TERM_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.avg_total_units, i.stddev_total_units, CASE WHEN i.avg_total_units > o.overall_avg * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_AVERAGE' WHEN i.avg_total_units < o.overall_avg * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS average_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS overall_avg FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.TERM_CODE = sos.TERM_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') ) o ORDER BY i.stddev_total_units DESC;

question: From the top 10 degree-granting departments (excluding Biology, Course 7) with the highest average total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year, display each department's name, its average and variance of total units, the subject with the highest total units in that department for 2022, and the total units of that subject. SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_total_units, ic.var_total_units, s.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Top_Subject_Title, s.TOTAL_UNITS AS Top_Subject_Total_Units FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ccso.TOTAL_UNITS DESC, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE ASC) AS rn FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 ) s ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND s.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.avg_total_units DESC LIMIT 10;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE AS LIBRARY_TERM_CODE, tso.TERM_CODE AS TIP_TERM_CODE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS LIBRARY_NUM_ENROLLED, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) AS MIN_TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID WHERE ( lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = 928034000 OR tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 ) AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) OVER (ORDER BY MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE) = MASTER_SUBJECT_ID THEN NULL ELSE MASTER_SUBJECT_ID END AS MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, LIBRARY_TERM_CODE, TIP_TERM_CODE, LIBRARY_NUM_ENROLLED, TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, MIN_TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte ORDER BY MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fb.BUILDING_TYPE AS building_type_name, fb.CAMPUS_SECTOR AS campus_sector, VARIANCE(fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS num_of_rooms_variance, STDDEV(fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS num_of_rooms_stddev FROM FCLT_BUILDING fb JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh ON fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE = fbh.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE WHERE fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND (fb.BUILDING_NAME IS NULL OR fb.BUILDING_NAME <> 'ASHDOWN HOUSE') GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_TYPE, fb.CAMPUS_SECTOR ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(building_type_name) OVER (ORDER BY building_type_sort, campus_sector_sort) = building_type_name THEN NULL ELSE building_type_name END AS building_type_name, campus_sector, num_of_rooms_variance, num_of_rooms_stddev FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(building_type_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(campus_sector) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE building_type_name END AS building_type_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(building_type_name) = 0 AND GROUPING(campus_sector) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(building_type_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(campus_sector) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE campus_sector END AS campus_sector, CASE WHEN GROUPING(building_type_name) = 0 AND GROUPING(campus_sector) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE campus_sector END AS campus_sector_sort, building_type_name, VARIANCE(num_of_rooms_variance) AS num_of_rooms_variance, STDDEV(num_of_rooms_stddev) AS num_of_rooms_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY building_type_name, campus_sector WITH ROLLUP ) tbltmp ORDER BY building_type_sort, campus_sector_sort;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ( scd.SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Science') OR scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_enrolled_students, avg_stats.avg_total_enrolled_students AS benchmark, CASE WHEN inner_cte.total_enrolled_students >= avg_stats.avg_total_enrolled_students * 1.5 THEN 'LARGE_DEPARTMENT' WHEN inner_cte.total_enrolled_students <= avg_stats.avg_total_enrolled_students * 0.7 THEN 'SMALL_DEPARTMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS department_size_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(total_enrolled_students) AS avg_total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte ) avg_stats;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Biology, Course 7), give the department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the most recent academic year, the average total units for that department as a benchmark, and classify the department as 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' if the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is at least 10% greater than the average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all such departments, 'LOW_VARIABILITY' if it is at least 10% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.coefficient_of_variation, i.avg_total_units, avg_stats.avg_coefficient_of_variation AS benchmark_coefficient_of_variation, CASE WHEN i.coefficient_of_variation > avg_stats.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN i.coefficient_of_variation < avg_stats.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte ) avg_stats ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ff.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY) AS num_floors FROM FCLT_FLOOR ff JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 50 AND fbh.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND (fb.BUILDING_NAME = 'Ray and Maria Stata Center' OR fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = '32') ) SELECT SUM(ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS total_assignable_area FROM FCLT_FLOOR ff JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 50 AND fbh.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND (fb.BUILDING_NAME = 'Ray and Maria Stata Center' OR fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = '32');

question: For each school, list its name, the number of degree-granting departments in that school (excluding the Mathematics department), and the maximum CIP program code among all courses in those departments, for schools that have at least one department with a maximum CIP program code greater than 120000. SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS max_cip_code, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) > 120000 ), SchoolSummary AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS num_departments, MAX(max_cip_code) AS max_cip_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT ss.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.max_cip_code FROM SchoolSummary ss LEFT JOIN inner_cte ic ON ss.SCHOOL_NAME = ic.SCHOOL_NAME UNION ALL SELECT ss.SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.max_cip_code FROM SchoolSummary ss ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = STUDENT_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.enrolled_stddev, AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.enrolled_stddev ORDER BY inner_cte.enrolled_stddev DESC;

question: For each academic term parameter, provide the term parameter name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of subjects offered in that term parameter (considering only regular terms and where the department is Mathematics), and classify the term as 'HIGH_VARIANCE' if its variance is at least 20% greater than the average variance across all such term parameters, 'LOW_VARIANCE' if at least 20% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "math" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'" "Course 18" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_SUMMARY.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER ) SELECT inner_cte.TERM_PARAMETER, inner_cte.total_units_variance, inner_cte.total_units_stddev, CASE WHEN inner_cte.total_units_variance > avg_stats.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN inner_cte.total_units_variance < avg_stats.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(total_units_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte ) avg_stats ORDER BY inner_cte.total_units_variance DESC;

question: For the Stata building (building 32), list each floor's key, the floor number, the total area of all rooms on that floor, and the deviation of this total from the average total room area per floor in the building, but only include floors where the total area is more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean total room area per floor in building 32, and only include buildings at MIT. SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, SUM(fr.AREA) AS total_room_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ), floor_room_areas AS ( SELECT fr.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ffl.FLOOR, SUM(fr.AREA) AS total_room_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_FLOOR ffl ON fr.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY = ffl.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY WHERE fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = '32' GROUP BY fr.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ffl.FLOOR ), stats AS ( SELECT AVG(total_room_area) AS mean_area, STDDEV(total_room_area) AS stddev_area FROM floor_room_areas ) SELECT fra.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, fra.FLOOR, fra.total_room_area, (fra.total_room_area - stats.mean_area) AS deviation_from_avg FROM floor_room_areas fra CROSS JOIN stats WHERE fra.total_room_area > stats.mean_area + stats.stddev_area

question: For each department, provide the department code, the department name, and the total number of enrolled students in both the library and tip subject offerings, but only for those departments where the total number of enrolled students is more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean total enrolled students across all departments, and restrict your answer to departments whose name is 'Mathematics' (Course 18). SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS + t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS + t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > ( SELECT AVG(total_sum) + STDDEV(total_sum) FROM ( SELECT SUM(l2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS + t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_sum FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l2 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON l2.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t2.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT GROUP BY l2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ) dept_totals ) AND l.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = '18' ) SELECT c.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, c.total_enrolled, l.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS library_faculty, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS tip_faculty FROM inner_cte c JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON c.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = l.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, c.total_enrolled, l.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(su.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON t.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY su ON so.TERM_CODE = su.TERM_CODE WHERE t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(su.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ), DeptSubjectCounts AS ( SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT so.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON t.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY su ON so.TERM_CODE = su.TERM_CODE WHERE t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' AND su.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.total_enrolled, dc.total_subjects FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN DeptSubjectCounts dc ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(total_enrolled) AS total_enrolled, SUM(total_subjects) AS total_subjects FROM RollupResults GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(total_enrolled) > 0 ORDER BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME
