SQL: WITH AcademicYearMathStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ), StataLargeCSRooms AS ( SELECT t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.AREA, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ROOMS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = t1.MEET_PLACE WHERE t0.AREA > 400 AND t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT s.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, s.BUILDING_ROOM, s.AREA, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.window_column, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, a.total_units_range, a.total_units_variance, a.total_units_stddev FROM StataLargeCSRooms s JOIN AcademicYearMathStats a ON s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.FCLT_ROOM_KEY;

SQL: WITH MathStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC ), BioStats AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON tso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Biology' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT MathStats.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MathStats.avg_enrolled, MathStats.enrolled_variance, BioStats.coefficient_of_variation FROM MathStats JOIN BioStats ON MathStats.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = BioStats.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY MathStats.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC;

SQL: WITH MathSubjects AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), NonMathDeptStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS avg_clearing_cost_collector, VARIANCE(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_variance, STDDEV(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE != '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY clearing_cost_collector_variance DESC ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT m.SUBJECT_CODE, m.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.SCHOOL_NAME, m.avg_dept_budget_code, NULL AS avg_clearing_cost_collector, NULL AS clearing_cost_collector_variance, NULL AS clearing_cost_collector_stddev, 'MathematicsSubject' AS Source FROM MathSubjects m UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_CODE, NULL AS SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, n.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS avg_dept_budget_code, n.avg_clearing_cost_collector, n.clearing_cost_collector_variance, n.clearing_cost_collector_stddev, 'NonMathDeptStats' AS Source FROM NonMathDeptStats n ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SQL: WITH ChemistryCourseStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm ON tso.TERM_CODE = lrm.TERM_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = lrm.SUBJECT_ID JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), student_counts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR ), DepartmentStudentStats AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(num_students) AS variance_num_students, STDDEV(num_students) AS stddev_num_students FROM student_counts GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.variance_num_students, d.stddev_num_students, c.avg_enrolled_students, c.var_enrolled_students, c.stddev_enrolled_students FROM DepartmentStudentStats d JOIN ChemistryCourseStats c ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

SQL: WITH DepartmentSubjectVariation AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, (STDDEV(s.SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT) / NULLIF(AVG(s.SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM ( SELECT sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc WHERE sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ), DepartmentClearingCostStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS avg_clearing_cost_collector, STDDEV(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS stddev_clearing_cost_collector FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dsv.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dsv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dsv.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, dsv.coefficient_of_variation, dccs.avg_clearing_cost_collector, dccs.stddev_clearing_cost_collector FROM DepartmentSubjectVariation dsv JOIN DepartmentClearingCostStats dccs ON dsv.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dsv.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

SQL: WITH OrgStats AS ( SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND d.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME != 'ADMISSIONS' AND o.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ), BuildingRoomStats AS ( SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM FCLT_BUILDING b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT' AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY HAVING COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 10 ORDER BY area_range DESC ) SELECT os.DLC_KEY, os.ORGANIZATION_NAME, os.organization_count, os.min_organization_number, brs.BUILDING_NAME, brs.area_range, brs.area_variance, brs.area_stddev FROM OrgStats os JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON os.ORGANIZATION_NAME = o.ORGANIZATION_NAME JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN BuildingRoomStats brs ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = brs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY

SQL: WITH DeptEnrolledStddev AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY enrolled_stddev DESC ), MathSubjectCodes AS ( SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY sd.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND ssc.SCHOOL_CODE = sd.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.enrolled_stddev, m.SUBJECT_CODE, m.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, m.running_sum_dept_budget_code FROM DeptEnrolledStddev d JOIN MathSubjectCodes m ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = m.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d.enrolled_stddev DESC, m.SUBJECT_CODE;

SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS avg_clearing_cost_collector, STDDEV(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS stddev_clearing_cost_collector, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.total_units_variance, s1.total_units_stddev, s2.avg_clearing_cost_collector, s2.stddev_clearing_cost_collector FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE

SQL: WITH OrgGeoMean AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD))) AS geometric_mean, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD > 0 AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME NOT IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST') GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ), BuildingRoomCV AS ( SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, a.POSTAL_CODE, STDDEV(r.AREA)/NULLIF(AVG(r.AREA),0) AS coefficient_of_variation, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS a ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.BUILDING_NAME <> 'ASHDOWN HOUSE' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, a.POSTAL_CODE, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY HAVING AVG(r.AREA) > 0 ) SELECT ogm.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ogm.geometric_mean, brcv.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, brcv.POSTAL_CODE, brcv.coefficient_of_variation FROM OrgGeoMean ogm JOIN BuildingRoomCV brcv ON ogm.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = brcv.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY ogm.geometric_mean DESC, brcv.coefficient_of_variation DESC;

evidence: "degree-granting" is predicated by "TABLE.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'" "biology department" is predicated by "LOWER(TABLE.DLC_NAME) = LOWER('Biology')" "Course 18" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18'" "Biology" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '7'"
SQL: WITH MathSubjects AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sc.COURSE_LEVEL, sc.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_total_units_per_dept, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION sc ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sc.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ORDER BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), SchoolCourseCounts AS ( SELECT scd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS total_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY scd.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY scd.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ms.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ms.COURSE_LEVEL, ms.SCHOOL_NAME, ms.min_total_units_per_dept, scc.total_courses FROM MathSubjects ms LEFT JOIN SchoolCourseCounts scc ON ms.SCHOOL_NAME = scc.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: List, for each department, the department code, department name, average total units, range of total units, variance of total units, minimum number of enrolled students, average department budget code, and the reason for inclusion ('UnitsStats' for departments that are degree granting, not Chemistry or Biology, and have subjects with more than zero enrolled students, and 'MathStats' for Mathematics departments with number of enrolled students between 1 and 10 or department budget code at least 90000, and department budget code between 90000 and 200000). The columns should be shown in the order: department code, department name, average total units, range of total units, variance of total units, minimum number of enrolled students, average department budget code, and reason. Do not return any rounded answers.

SQL: WITH DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), MathDeptStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), CombinedDeptStats AS ( SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.range_total_units, dus.var_total_units, NULL AS min_num_enrolled_students, NULL AS avg_dept_budget_code, 'UnitsStats' AS Reason FROM DeptUnitsStats dus UNION ALL SELECT mds.DEPARTMENT_CODE, mds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_total_units, NULL AS range_total_units, NULL AS var_total_units, mds.min_num_enrolled_students, mds.avg_dept_budget_code, 'MathStats' AS Reason FROM MathDeptStats mds ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, range_total_units, var_total_units, min_num_enrolled_students, avg_dept_budget_code, Reason FROM CombinedDeptStats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Reason;

SQL: WITH DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2008 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), MathSubjects2022 AS ( SELECT cso.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.SUBJECT_ID FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON cso.SUBJECT_ID = ccc.SUBJECT_ID WHERE cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cso.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.SUBJECT_ID HAVING MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.max_total_units, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS math_department_name FROM DeptUnitsStats dus CROSS JOIN MathSubjects2022 ms WHERE dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME

SQL: WITH DeptEnrolledStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), ChemistryCourseMaterials AS ( SELECT t.SUBJECT_TITLE, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_reserved_materials, MIN(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON l.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY t.SUBJECT_TITLE, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, d.avg_enrolled_students, d.stddev_enrolled_students, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.num_reserved_materials, c.min_academic_year FROM DeptEnrolledStats d JOIN ChemistryCourseMaterials c ON d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY c.num_reserved_materials DESC;

SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), subq2 AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND at.TERM_START_DATE > '2010-01-01' AND at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, subq1.total_units_range AS regular_term_units_range, subq1.total_units_variance AS regular_term_units_variance, subq2.total_units_range AS post_2010_units_range, subq2.total_units_variance AS post_2010_units_variance FROM subq1 LEFT JOIN subq2 ON subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = subq2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

SQL: WITH IAPMaxEnrollStats AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS stddev_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON isd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE isd.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), MathSubjectUnits AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, GREATEST( c.TOTAL_UNITS, COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0), COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0) ) AS max_total_units_3rows FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.TERM_CODE ), CombinedMathStats AS ( SELECT ims.ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS SUBJECT_CODE, NULL AS SUBJECT_NUMBER, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS TERM_CODE, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS max_total_units_3rows, ims.avg_max_enrollment, ims.stddev_max_enrollment, 'IAPMaxEnrollStats' AS Source FROM IAPMaxEnrollStats ims UNION ALL SELECT msu.ACADEMIC_YEAR, msu.SUBJECT_CODE, msu.SUBJECT_NUMBER, msu.SUBJECT_TITLE, msu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msu.TERM_CODE, msu.TERM_DESCRIPTION, msu.max_total_units_3rows, NULL AS avg_max_enrollment, NULL AS stddev_max_enrollment, 'MathSubjectUnits' AS Source FROM MathSubjectUnits msu ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, max_total_units_3rows, avg_max_enrollment, stddev_max_enrollment, Source FROM CombinedMathStats ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, Source, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, TERM_CODE;

SQL: WITH DeptEnrolledStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), DeptGeometricMeanUnits AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.ISBN IS NOT NULL AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC ) SELECT d1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, d1.enrolled_range, d1.enrolled_variance, d2.geometric_mean_total_units FROM DeptEnrolledStats d1 JOIN DeptGeometricMeanUnits d2 ON d1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = d2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY d1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

SQL: WITH dept_math_office_phones AS ( SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.OFFICE_PHONE) AS avg_office_phone, STDDEV(MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.OFFICE_PHONE) AS stddev_office_phone, SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY ON SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.DEPARTMENT WHERE MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.OFFICE_PHONE IS NOT NULL AND MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY stddev_office_phone DESC ), dept_units_variation AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dmo.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dmo.avg_office_phone, dmo.stddev_office_phone, duv.coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_math_office_phones dmo JOIN dept_units_variation duv ON dmo.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = duv.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dmo.stddev_office_phone DESC;

question: For each degree-granting department except the Biology department (Course 7), what is the department name and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the most recent academic year, and for subjects in the Mathematics department with a total of 12 units offered in the fall term, what are the subject code, subject number, department name, subject title, total units, whether the subject is offered in the fall term, the offering department name, the subject enrollment number, and the row number within the department ordered by subject code? SQL: WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ), department_variation AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ), math_fall_12units AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dv.coefficient_of_variation, mf12.SUBJECT_CODE, mf12.SUBJECT_NUMBER, mf12.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS math_department_name, mf12.SUBJECT_TITLE, mf12.TOTAL_UNITS, mf12.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM, mf12.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, mf12.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, mf12.window_column FROM department_variation dv LEFT JOIN math_fall_12units mf12 ON dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mf12.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mf12.window_column

question: For each department that is not 'Mathematics' (Course 18), and is degree-granting and not the Biology department (Course 7), and whose total number of subject codes is greater than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean across all departments, what are the department name, the average of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022FA term, the range of total units, the variance of total units, and the total number of subject codes? SQL: WITH dept_units_stats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sos.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT != '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ), dept_code_counts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), stats AS ( SELECT AVG(subject_code_count) AS mean_count, STDDEV(subject_code_count) AS stddev_count FROM dept_code_counts ) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance, dcc.subject_code_count FROM dept_units_stats dus JOIN dept_code_counts dcc ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dcc.DEPARTMENT_NAME CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE dcc.subject_code_count > s.mean_count + s.stddev_count ORDER BY dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each subject title and offering department name in regular terms with more than 5 enrolled students, offered by the Chemistry department (Course 5), and only for courses with materials, provide the subject title, offering department name, the number of reserved course materials, the minimum academic year, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses with at least one associated material record for the department (considering only Chemistry and Biology departments). SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t.SUBJECT_TITLE, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_reserved_materials, MIN(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON l.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY t.SUBJECT_TITLE, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, STDDEV_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) > 0 ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.num_reserved_materials, s1.min_academic_year, s2.coefficient_of_variation FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.department_name;

SQL: WITH LargestRoomPerFloor AS ( SELECT sf.FLOOR_NAME, sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, sd.FLOOR_KEY FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_FLOOR sf ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 100 AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE = ( SELECT MAX(sd2.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd2 WHERE sd2.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd2.FLOOR_KEY = sd.FLOOR_KEY AND sd2.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' ) ORDER BY sf.FLOOR_NAME ), RoomAveragesPerFloor AS ( SELECT sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.ROOM_NUMBER, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, sf.FLOOR_NAME, AVG(sd2.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS AVG_ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE_PER_FLOOR, sd.FLOOR_KEY FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_FLOOR sf ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY JOIN SPACE_DETAIL sd2 ON sd2.FLOOR_KEY = sd.FLOOR_KEY WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 10 GROUP BY sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.ROOM_NUMBER, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, sf.FLOOR_NAME, sd.FLOOR_KEY ORDER BY sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE ) SELECT lrf.FLOOR_NAME, lrf.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME AS LARGEST_ROOM_NAME, lrf.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS LARGEST_ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, raf.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, raf.ROOM_NUMBER, raf.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, raf.AVG_ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE_PER_FLOOR FROM LargestRoomPerFloor lrf JOIN RoomAveragesPerFloor raf ON lrf.FLOOR_NAME = raf.FLOOR_NAME ORDER BY lrf.FLOOR_NAME, raf.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE;

SQL: WITH DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), TopMathDept AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY num_courses DESC LIMIT 1 ) SELECT d.DEPTUNITS_DEPT_NAME, d.avg_total_units, d.stddev_total_units, t.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS top_math_dept_name, t.SCHOOL_NAME, t.num_courses FROM ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPTUNITS_DEPT_NAME, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units, DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM DeptUnitsStats ) d JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN TopMathDept t ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = t.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d.DEPTUNITS_DEPT_NAME;

SQL: WITH MathDeptStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd LEFT JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 OR (sos.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 1 AND 21)) GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptUnitStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT mds.DEPARTMENT_CODE, mds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mds.min_num_enrolled_students, mds.avg_total_units AS math_avg_total_units, dus.avg_total_units AS dept_avg_total_units_2022, dus.var_total_units AS dept_var_total_units_2022 FROM MathDeptStats mds JOIN DeptUnitStats dus ON mds.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dus.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY mds.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

SQL: WITH dept_enrollment_stats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), math_units_stats AS ( SELECT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY.MIT_ID WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY.EMAIL_ADDRESS IS NOT NULL AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.avg_enrolled, des.range_enrolled, des.var_enrolled, mus.avg_units, mus.units_variance FROM dept_enrollment_stats des LEFT JOIN math_units_stats mus ON des.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mus.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SQL: WITH academic_year_term_stats AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND at.TERM_STATUS <> 'Future' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_CODE ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.TERM_CODE ), academic_term_parameter_stats AS ( SELECT atp.TERM_CODE AS academic_term_parameter, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY atp.TERM_CODE ) SELECT ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ays.TERM_CODE, ays.total_units_range, ays.total_units_variance, ays.total_units_stddev, atps.academic_term_parameter, atps.TERM_DESCRIPTION, atps.avg_total_units, atps.var_total_units FROM academic_year_term_stats ays JOIN academic_term_parameter_stats atps ON ays.TERM_CODE = atps.academic_term_parameter;

SQL: WITH DeptEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, MAX(LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE SSC ON SCD.COURSE = SSC.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED LSO ON SSC.COURSE_NUMBER = LSO.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE SCD.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Political Science' GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_range DESC ), TopMathFallSubjects AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON at.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE WHERE ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), CombinedDeptStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR, d.avg_enrollment, d.enrollment_range, d.enrollment_variance, NULL AS subject_count, 'EnrollmentStats' AS Reason FROM DeptEnrollmentStats d UNION ALL SELECT t.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS avg_enrollment, NULL AS enrollment_range, NULL AS enrollment_variance, t.subject_count, 'TopMathFallSubjects' AS Reason FROM TopMathFallSubjects t ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR, avg_enrollment, enrollment_range, enrollment_variance, subject_count, Reason FROM CombinedDeptStats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Reason;

SQL: WITH dept_terms AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, sos.TERM_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' ), subjects_per_term AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE ), dept_max_enroll AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT spt.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(spt.num_subjects) - MIN(spt.num_subjects) AS range_num_subjects, VARIANCE(spt.num_subjects) AS variance_num_subjects, STDDEV(spt.num_subjects) AS stddev_num_subjects, dme.max_enrollment, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM subjects_per_term spt JOIN dept_terms dt ON spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dt.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN dept_max_enroll dme ON spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dme.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON dme.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = dme.max_enrollment GROUP BY spt.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dme.max_enrollment, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY spt.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SQL: WITH ChemistryCourseStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm ON tso.TERM_CODE = lrm.TERM_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = lrm.SUBJECT_ID JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), DepartmentStudentStats AS ( WITH student_counts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(num_students) AS variance_num_students, STDDEV(num_students) AS stddev_num_students FROM student_counts GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.variance_num_students, d.stddev_num_students, c.avg_enrolled_students, c.var_enrolled_students, c.stddev_enrolled_students FROM DepartmentStudentStats d JOIN ChemistryCourseStats c ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

SQL: WITH DepartmentUnitsCV AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), MathematicsUnitsStats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.DEPARTMENT, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ) SELECT duc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, duc.coefficient_of_variation, mus.avg_total_units, mus.stddev_total_units FROM DepartmentUnitsCV duc JOIN MathematicsUnitsStats mus ON duc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY duc.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SQL: WITH DeptWithMostCourses AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY num_courses DESC LIMIT 1 ), MathLetterGradedSubjects AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE, COUNT(c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.num_courses, m.GRADE_TYPE, m.subject_count, m.min_total_units FROM DeptWithMostCourses d JOIN MathLetterGradedSubjects m ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = m.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each department that is degree-granting, is not the Biology department (Course 7), and has a total number of subject codes greater than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean across all departments, and is also not the Mathematics department (Course 18), display the department code, department name, total number of subject codes, the average clearing cost collector value, the variance of the clearing cost collector, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the clearing cost collector for all associated administrative departments, ordering the results by the total number of subject codes in descending order and then by department code. Do not return any rounded answers.

SQL: WITH dept_code_counts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), stats AS ( SELECT AVG(subject_code_count) AS mean_count, STDDEV(subject_code_count) AS stddev_count FROM dept_code_counts ), filtered_depts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.subject_code_count FROM dept_code_counts d CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE d.subject_code_count > s.mean_count + s.stddev_count ), admin_dept_stats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS avg_clearing_cost_collector, VARIANCE(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_variance, STDDEV(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE != '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT f.DEPARTMENT_CODE, f.DEPARTMENT_NAME, f.subject_code_count, a.avg_clearing_cost_collector, a.clearing_cost_collector_variance, a.clearing_cost_collector_stddev FROM filtered_depts f JOIN admin_dept_stats a ON f.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY f.subject_code_count DESC, f.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: For each department that grants degrees, is not the Mathematics department (Course 18), has a maximum CIP program code among its courses greater than 120000, and offers more than five subjects or is the Mathematics department, what is the department name, the maximum CIP program code among its courses, the full name of the department, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department? SQL: WITH MaxCipDepartments AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS max_cip_code, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) > 120000 ), DeptSubjectStddev AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 OR sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT mcd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mcd.max_cip_code, mcd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ds.stddev_total_units FROM MaxCipDepartments mcd JOIN DeptSubjectStddev ds ON mcd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY mcd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SQL: WITH EnrolledStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '6' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(tso.SUBJECT_ID) > 0 ), UnitVariation AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT es.DEPARTMENT_NAME, es.enrolled_range, es.enrolled_variance, es.enrolled_stddev, uv.coefficient_of_variation FROM EnrolledStats es JOIN UnitVariation uv ON es.DEPARTMENT_NAME = uv.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY es.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year, academic year description, the geometric mean of the total units for subjects offered in terms where the material status is 'U' and the department is Mathematics (Course 18), and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects that have at least one associated course material and are offered by the Biology department (Course 7)? SQL: WITH MathUnits AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), BioVariation AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON tso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Biology' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT mu.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mu.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, mu.geometric_mean_total_units, bv.coefficient_of_variation FROM MathUnits mu JOIN BioVariation bv ON mu.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = bv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY mu.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC;

question: For each academic year, list the academic year, the academic year description, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in regular terms by the Mathematics department (Course 18), the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the maximum enrollment for IAP activities that required advance sign-up and are offered by the Mathematics department, and calculate the ratio of the average total units to the average maximum enrollment for that year, rounded to two decimal places. SQL: WITH MathRegularTerms AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), MathIAPActivities AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS stddev_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON isd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE isd.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT mrt.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mrt.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, mrt.avg_total_units, mrt.stddev_total_units, mia.avg_max_enrollment, mia.stddev_max_enrollment, ROUND(mrt.avg_total_units / NULLIF(mia.avg_max_enrollment, 0), 2) AS avg_units_per_max_enrollment_ratio FROM MathRegularTerms mrt JOIN MathIAPActivities mia ON mrt.ACADEMIC_YEAR = mia.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY avg_units_per_max_enrollment_ratio DESC;

SQL: WITH DeptCoeffVar AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) / AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcv.coefficient_of_variation, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev FROM DeptCoeffVar dcv JOIN DeptUnitsStats dus ON dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dus.total_units_variance DESC;

SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), subq2 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.total_units_variance AS year_total_units_variance, subq1.total_units_stddev AS year_total_units_stddev, subq2.total_units_range AS dept_total_units_range, subq2.total_units_variance AS dept_total_units_variance, subq2.total_units_stddev AS dept_total_units_stddev FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC;

question: For each subject where the responsible faculty MIT ID in the library subject offered table is 928034000 or the number of enrolled students in the tip subject offered table is greater than 5, and where the offer department name in the tip subject offered table is either 'Chemistry' or 'Biology', show the subject title from the library subject offered table, the offer department name from the tip subject offered table, the term code from both tables, the number of enrolled students from both tables, and the minimum number of enrolled students in the tip subject offered table over each master subject ID group. SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE AS LIBRARY_TERM_CODE, tso.TERM_CODE AS TIP_TERM_CODE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS LIBRARY_NUM_ENROLLED, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) AS MIN_TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID WHERE ( lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = 928034000 OR tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 ) AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.LIBRARY_TERM_CODE, s1.TIP_TERM_CODE, s1.LIBRARY_NUM_ENROLLED, s1.TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, s1.MIN_TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.enrolled_range, s2.enrolled_variance FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, LIBRARY_TERM_CODE, TIP_TERM_CODE, LIBRARY_NUM_ENROLLED, TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, MIN_TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, DEPARTMENT_NAME, enrolled_range, enrolled_variance FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each combination of DLC key and organization name (where the organization is assignable, the DLC key is not null, the organization name is not 'ADMISSIONS', and the organization ID is not '138' or '250') and each academic building at MIT with more than 10 rooms, provide the DLC key, organization name, number of organizations, minimum organization number, building name, the range of room areas, the variance of room areas, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of room areas, with the columns in this order: DLC key, organization name, organization count, minimum organization number, building name, area range, area variance, and area standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP). SQL: WITH OrgDlcStats AS ( SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND d.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME != 'ADMISSIONS' AND o.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ), BuildingRoomStats AS ( SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_BUILDING b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT' AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 10 ORDER BY area_range DESC ) SELECT ods.DLC_KEY, ods.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ods.organization_count, ods.min_organization_number, brs.BUILDING_NAME, brs.area_range, brs.area_variance, brs.area_stddev FROM OrgDlcStats ods CROSS JOIN BuildingRoomStats brs;

question: For each student in the Political Science department (Course 17), show the student's full name, their department name, the corresponding school name, the SIS administrative department name, the student's dense rank over student year (ordered by student year), and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by their department in the most recent academic year (only for departments that are degree-granting and excluding the Biology department). SQL: WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ), department_cv AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ), political_science_students AS ( SELECT msd.FULL_NAME, msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR) AS student_year_rank FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.DEPARTMENT = '17' AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' ) SELECT ps.FULL_NAME, ps.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ps.SCHOOL_NAME, ps.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ps.student_year_rank, dc.DEPT_CV FROM political_science_students ps LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, coefficient_of_variation AS DEPT_CV FROM department_cv ) dc ON ps.DEPARTMENT = dc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ps.student_year_rank, ps.FULL_NAME;

SQL: WITH DepartmentCourseVariation AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), DepartmentSubjectStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcv.coefficient_of_variation, dss.avg_total_units, dss.var_total_units FROM DepartmentCourseVariation dcv JOIN DepartmentSubjectStats dss ON dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SQL: WITH DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT <> '18' GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ), PoliticalScienceHGNStats AS ( SELECT c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, s.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON c.HGN_CODE = s.HGN_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 AND c.LECTURE_UNITS > 2 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE HAVING MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) > 2 ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_total_units, d.total_units_range, d.total_units_variance, p.HGN_CODE, p.max_lecture_units, p.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM DeptUnitsStats d JOIN PoliticalScienceHGNStats p ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = p.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d.total_units_range DESC, p.max_lecture_units DESC

SQL: WITH AvgStddevStudentsPerCourse AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(course_student_counts.num_students) AS avg_students_per_course, STDDEV(course_student_counts.num_students) AS stddev_students_per_course FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN ( SELECT scd2.DEPARTMENT, scd2.COURSE, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS) AS num_students FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd2 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON scd2.DEPARTMENT = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE scd2.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND scd2.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY scd2.DEPARTMENT, scd2.COURSE ) course_student_counts ON scd.DEPARTMENT = course_student_counts.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), AvgVarianceStddevUnits AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.avg_students_per_course, a.stddev_students_per_course, b.avg_total_units, b.total_units_variance, b.total_units_stddev FROM AvgStddevStudentsPerCourse a JOIN AvgVarianceStddevUnits b ON a.DEPARTMENT_NAME = b.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY a.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SQL: WITH student_info AS ( SELECT msd.FIRST_NAME, msd.LAST_NAME, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME) AS MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME ), school_units_geom_mean AS ( SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, EXP(AVG(LOG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT si.FIRST_NAME, si.LAST_NAME, si.EMAIL_ADDRESS, si.DEPARTMENT_NAME, si.STUDENT_YEAR, si.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, si.SCHOOL_NAME, si.MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, sugm.geometric_mean_total_units FROM student_info si LEFT JOIN school_units_geom_mean sugm ON si.SCHOOL_NAME = sugm.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY si.SCHOOL_NAME

SQL: WITH DeptCourseCounts AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY num_courses DESC LIMIT 1 ), DeptMaxEnrollments AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND ( (sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') OR (lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry') ) AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = ( SELECT MAX(lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso2 WHERE lso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND lso2.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 ) ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dcc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcc.SCHOOL_NAME, dcc.num_courses, dme.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, dme.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM DeptCourseCounts dcc JOIN DeptMaxEnrollments dme ON dcc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dme.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dcc.num_courses DESC;

SQL: WITH DeptUnits AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ), DeptStudents AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MAX(msd.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS latest_student_load FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY student_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT du.DEPARTMENT_NAME, du.avg_total_units, du.stddev_total_units, ds.student_count, ds.latest_student_load FROM DeptUnits du JOIN DeptStudents ds ON du.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SQL: WITH chem_top10 AS ( SELECT tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS num_course_materials, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE HAVING num_course_materials > 0 ORDER BY num_course_materials DESC, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE LIMIT 10 ), dept_cv AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 1 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT chem_top10.SUBJECT_TITLE, chem_top10.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, chem_top10.num_course_materials, dept_cv.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEGREE_DEPT_NAME, dept_cv.coefficient_of_variation FROM chem_top10 LEFT JOIN dept_cv ON chem_top10.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = dept_cv.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY chem_top10.num_course_materials DESC, chem_top10.SUBJECT_TITLE;

SQL: WITH SubjectStats2022 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t2.SUBJECT_ID FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), LibrarySubjectStats2014FA AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY lso.SUBJECT_ID) AS running_sum_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID AND lso.TERM_CODE = cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT s2022.SUBJECT_CODE, s2022.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s2022.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2022.window_column, l2014.SUBJECT_TITLE, l2014.TERM_DESCRIPTION, l2014.running_sum_enrolled_students FROM SubjectStats2022 s2022 JOIN LibrarySubjectStats2014FA l2014 ON s2022.SUBJECT_ID = l2014.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY s2022.SUBJECT_CODE, l2014.SUBJECT_TITLE;

SQL: WITH DeptCoeffVar AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) / AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS coefficient_of_variation, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), DeptUnitStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcv.coefficient_of_variation, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev FROM DeptCoeffVar dcv JOIN DeptUnitStats dus ON dcv.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dus.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SQL: WITH ChemistrySubjects AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.TERM_CODE, t2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, MAX(t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_enrolled_students, t2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_dept_name FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' ), DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ) SELECT cs.SUBJECT_TITLE, cs.TERM_CODE, cs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cs.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, cs.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cs.SUBJECT_CODE, cs.max_enrolled_students, des.enrolled_students_variance, des.enrolled_students_stddev FROM ChemistrySubjects cs JOIN DepartmentEnrollmentStats des ON cs.join_dept_name = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cs.SUBJECT_TITLE, cs.SUBJECT_CODE;

SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_stddev DESC ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.avg_enrollment, s2.enrollment_stddev, ROUND(s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS / NULLIF(s2.avg_enrollment, 0), 2) AS normalized_enrollment_ratio FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY normalized_enrollment_ratio DESC;

SQL: WITH EngineeringYearVariance AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' AND SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ), MathDeptSubjects AS ( SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects, MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT ev.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ev.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ev.enrolled_students_variance, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.num_unique_subjects, ms.min_total_units, ROUND(ev.enrolled_students_variance / NULLIF(ms.num_unique_subjects, 0), 2) AS variance_per_unique_subject FROM EngineeringYearVariance ev JOIN MathDeptSubjects ms ON ev.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ms.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY variance_per_unique_subject DESC

SQL: WITH DeptEnrolled AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ( scd.SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Science') OR scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING total_enrolled_students > 20 ), MathUnits AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT de.DEPARTMENT_NAME, de.total_enrolled_students, mu.DEPARTMENT_CODE, mu.total_units_range, mu.total_units_variance, ROUND(de.total_enrolled_students / NULLIF(mu.total_units_range, 0), 2) AS enrolled_per_unit_range FROM DeptEnrolled de JOIN MathUnits mu ON de.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mu.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_per_unit_range DESC;

SQL: WITH DeptUnitsCV AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), DeptEnrolledStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '6' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(tso.SUBJECT_ID) > 0 ) SELECT dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcv.coefficient_of_variation, des.enrolled_range, des.enrolled_variance, des.enrolled_stddev FROM DeptUnitsCV dcv JOIN DeptEnrolledStats des ON dcv.DEPARTMENT_CODE = des.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
