MIN(spt.num_subjects) AS range_num_subjects, VARIANCE(spt.num_subjects) AS variance_num_subjects, STDDEV(spt.num_subjects) AS stddev_num_subjects FROM subjects_per_term spt WHERE spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE IN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM dept_terms) GROUP BY spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE, spt.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), dept_max_enroll AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), dept_max_subject AS ( SELECT dme.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dme.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dme.max_enrollment, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM dept_max_enroll dme JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON dme.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = dme.max_enrollment ) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.range_num_subjects, ds.variance_num_subjects, ds.stddev_num_subjects, dms.max_enrollment, dms.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM dept_stats ds JOIN dept_max_subject dms ON ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dms.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.TERM_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE != '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.TERM_CODE ), Top10Depts AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(subject_count) AS highest_unique_subjects_in_a_term FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY highest_unique_subjects_in_a_term DESC LIMIT 10 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), MathDeptAgg AS ( SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.COURSE_LEVEL, i.course_count, i.min_total_units FROM inner_cte2 i JOIN dept_avg a ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_enrolled ) SELECT t.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.highest_unique_subjects_in_a_term, m.COURSE_LEVEL, m.course_count, m.min_total_units FROM Top10Depts t LEFT JOIN MathDeptAgg m ON t.DEPARTMENT_NAME = m.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t.highest_unique_subjects_in_a_term DESC, t.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.COURSE_LEVEL;

SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON ic.SUBJECT_CODE = sc.SUBJECT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000) OR (sos.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6) ) AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 6 AND 21 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), cte2 AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.min_dept_budget_code, ic.avg_total_units, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte2 ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(*) AS desc_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000) OR (sos.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6) ) AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 6 AND 21 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION ) scd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND scd.rn = 1 ) SELECT cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1.coefficient_of_variation, cte1.SUBJECT_CODE, cte1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, cte2.min_dept_budget_code, cte2.avg_total_units, cte2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE MAX(lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso2 WHERE lso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND lso2.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 ) ), CourseCounts2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS NUM_COURSES FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND ( (sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') OR (lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry') ) AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT rr1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr1.SCHOOL_NAME, rr1.avg_total_units, rr1.total_units_variance, rr1.total_units_stddev, ic2.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ic2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, cc2.NUM_COURSES FROM RollupResults1 rr1 LEFT JOIN inner_cte2 ic2 ON rr1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic2.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN CourseCounts2 cc2 ON rr1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cc2.DEPARTMENT_NAME UNION ALL SELECT 'Grand Total', rr1.SCHOOL_NAME, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, SQL: WITH math_fall_enrollment_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, VARIANCE(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ORDER BY CASE WHEN ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, enrolled_variance DESC ), engineering_max_units_courses AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, c.SUBJECT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2008' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.SUBJECT_CODE HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.max_total_units, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE = sc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE ) SELECT mfe.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, mfe.avg_enrolled, mfe.enrolled_variance, emu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, emu.max_total_units, emu.SUBJECT_CODE, emu.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, emu.GRADUATE_LEVEL FROM math_fall_enrollment_stats mfe CROSS JOIN engineering_max_units_courses emu;

'7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.coefficient_of_variation, avg_cv.avg_coefficient_of_variation, CASE WHEN ic.coefficient_of_variation > avg_cv.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 1.1 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN ic.coefficient_of_variation < avg_cv.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 0.9 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variation_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte ) avg_cv ), EngineeringMechEngDept AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_program_code, COUNT(DISTINCT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS total_departments, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND (UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' OR inner_cte.total_departments, Total_Courses.Total_Courses FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND (UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' OR scd.DEPARTMENT = '2') GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) AS Total_Courses ON inner_cte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME AND inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT emd.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, emd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, emd.min_cip_program_code, emd.total_departments, emd.Total_Courses, dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dv.coefficient_of_variation, dv.avg_coefficient_of_variation, dv.variation_category FROM SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE NOT IN ('5', '7') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ), subj_counts AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE NOT IN ('5', '7') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), Subquery1 AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.avg_enrolled_students, ic.var_enrolled_students, ic.stddev_enrolled_students, subj_counts.num_unique_subjects FROM inner_cte1 ic JOIN subj_counts ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = subj_counts.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE subj_counts.num_unique_subjects > 5 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects, MIN(e.OFFICE_PHONE) AS min_office_phone, c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY e ON c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = e.MIT_ID WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND e.OFFICE_LOCATION IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID, SUM(num_unique_subjects) AS total_unique_subjects, MIN(min_office_phone) AS min_office_phone FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(num_unique_subjects) > 0 ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.SUBJECT_CODE, ed.FULL_NAME AS responsible_faculty_full_name, ed.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS responsible_faculty_email, rr.total_unique_subjects, rr.min_office_phone, rr.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID FROM RollupResults rr LEFT JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY ed ON rr.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = ed.MIT_ID ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.avg_enrolled_students, s1.var_enrolled_students, s1.stddev_enrolled_students, s1.num_unique_subjects, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.responsible_faculty_full_name, s2.responsible_faculty_email, s2.total_unique_subjects, s2.min_office_phone FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.responsible_faculty_full_name

FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, COURSE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(course_description_count) AS inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN FilteredDepts AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_enrolled_students, ic.stddev_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte2 ic JOIN ( SELECT AVG(avg_enrolled_students) AS overall_avg FROM ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) dept_avgs ) oa ON ic.avg_enrolled_students > oa.overall_avg ) SELECT rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.COURSE, rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.total_course_descriptions, rr.min_cip_program_code, fd.avg_enrolled_students, fd.stddev_enrolled_students FROM RollupResults rr LEFT JOIN SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 OR sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, stddev_total_units, avg_total_units, DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_total_units > ( SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ) ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_total_units, ic.var_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_grad_students FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_total_units, ic.var_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) > 0 OR ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.stddev_total_units, s2.avg_total_units, s2.var_total_units, s2.stddev_total_units AS stddev_total_units_subq2, s2.num_grad_students FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SQL: WITH DeptStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' ) SELECT stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME, stats.total_units_range, stats.total_units_variance, stats.total_units_stddev, top_subject.SUBJECT_ID AS subject_with_max_units, top_subject.max_total_units FROM ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) stats LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, TOTAL_UNITS AS max_total_units FROM ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY TOTAL_UNITS DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte ) ranked WHERE rn = 1 ) top_subject ON stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME = top_subject.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stats.total_units_range DESC LIMIT 10 ), StataRoomsCS AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.AREA, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ROOMS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = t1.MEET_PLACE WHERE t0.AREA > 400 AND t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT inner_cte.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, inner_cte.BUILDING_ROOM, inner_cte.AREA, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE = t1.SUBJECT_TITLE AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.total_units_range, d.total_units_variance, d.total_units_stddev, d.subject_with_max_units, d.max_total_units, s.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, s.BUILDING_ROOM, s.AREA, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS room_department_name, s.window_column FROM DeptStats d JOIN StataRoomsCS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.FCLT_ROOM_KEY;

SQL: WITH DeptEnrolledStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > ( SELECT AVG(total_enrolled) + STDDEV(total_enrolled) FROM ( SELECT SUM(sos2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd2 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos2 ON sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc2 ON ssc2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) t ) ), DegreeGrantingDeptCourses AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '6' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DegreeGrantingDeptUniqueTitles AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS unique_course_titles FROM DegreeGrantingDeptCourses ic JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ic.num_courses >= 5 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.total_enrolled_students, d2.unique_course_titles FROM DeptEnrolledStats d1 JOIN DegreeGrantingDeptUniqueTitles d2 ON d1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d1.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.SCHOOL_NAME, ss.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) SELECT icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, VARIANCE(icte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units, STDDEV(icte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte icte GROUP BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, icte.SCHOOL_NAME ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, EXP(AVG(LOG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.geometric_mean_total_units, s.avg_geometric_mean, CASE WHEN i.geometric_mean_total_units > s.avg_geometric_mean * 1.05 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.geometric_mean_total_units < s.avg_geometric_mean * 0.95 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS comparison_to_average FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_total_units) AS avg_geometric_mean FROM inner_cte) s ) SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.variance_total_units, s1.stddev_total_units, s2.geometric_mean_total_units, s2.avg_geometric_mean, s2.comparison_to_average FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.SCHOOL_NAME = s2.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.SCHOOL_NAME

ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.enrolled_range, inner_cte.enrolled_variance, CASE WHEN inner_cte.enrolled_range > inner_cte.enrolled_variance * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_SPREAD' WHEN inner_cte.enrolled_range < inner_cte.enrolled_variance * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_SPREAD' ELSE 'AVERAGE_SPREAD' END AS spread_category FROM inner_cte ), HighestAvgUnits AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = SQL: WITH dept_stats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS avg_clearing_cost_collector, VARIANCE(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_variance, STDDEV(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE != '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), dept_info AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.avg_clearing_cost_collector, ic.clearing_cost_collector_variance, ic.clearing_cost_collector_stddev, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM dept_stats ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), ee_courses AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ), eng_budget_avg AS ( SELECT AVG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL ) SELECT di.DEPARTMENT_NAME, di.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, di.SCHOOL_NAME, di.avg_clearing_cost_collector, di.clearing_cost_collector_variance, di.clearing_cost_collector_stddev, ec.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ec.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, CASE WHEN ec.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > eba.avg_budget * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_BUDGET' WHEN ec.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE < eba.avg_budget * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_BUDGET' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS budget_category FROM dept_info di LEFT JOIN ee_courses ec ON di.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ec.DEPARTMENT_CODE CROSS JOIN eng_budget_avg eba ORDER BY di.clearing_cost_collector_variance DESC;

SQL: WITH IAP_MaxEnroll_Stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS stddev_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON isd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE isd.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS stddev_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON isd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DegreeDept_SubjectCode_Stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SUBJECT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VARIANCE(inner_cte.subj_count) AS subject_code_count_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.subj_count) AS subject_code_count_stddev, AVG(inner_cte.subj_count) AS avg_subject_code_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY subject_code_count_variance DESC ) SELECT ims.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ims.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ims.avg_max_enrollment, ims.stddev_max_enrollment, dds.subject_code_count_variance, dds.subject_code_count_stddev, dds.avg_subject_code_count FROM IAP_MaxEnroll_Stats ims JOIN DegreeDept_SubjectCode_Stats dds ON ims.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dds.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ims.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ims.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SQL: WITH math_admin_dept_rank AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS admin_dept_dense_rank FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(admin_dept_dense_rank) AS highest_admin_dept_dense_rank FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ), top_departments_2022 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, subject_count FROM ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, subject_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte ) ranked WHERE rn <= 5 UNION ALL SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(subject_count) AS subject_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT t.SCHOOL_NAME, t.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.subject_count, m.highest_admin_dept_dense_rank, ROUND(t.subject_count / NULLIF(m.highest_admin_dept_dense_rank, 0), 2) AS normalized_subjects_per_admin_dept_rank FROM top_departments_2022 t LEFT JOIN math_admin_dept_rank m ON t.SCHOOL_NAME = m.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t.SCHOOL_NAME, t.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SQL: WITH OrgGeoMean AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD))) AS geometric_mean, HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD > 0 AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME NOT IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST') GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID ) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.geometric_mean, HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM inner_cte JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME ), BuildingStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_BUILDING b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT' AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 10 ) SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.area_range, ic.area_variance, ic.area_stddev, b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, b.DATE_BUILT, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM inner_cte ic JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b ON ic.BUILDING_NAME = b.BUILDING_NAME ) SELECT ogm.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ogm.geometric_mean, ogm.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, bs.BUILDING_NAME, bs.area_range, bs.area_variance, bs.area_stddev, bs.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, bs.DATE_BUILT FROM OrgGeoMean ogm JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON ogm.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN BuildingStats bs ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = bs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY ogm.geometric_mean DESC, bs.area_range DESC;

evidence: "math" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'" "degree-granting" is predicated by "TABLE.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'" "Course 18" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'" "Biology" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '7'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > ( SELECT AVG(total_enrolled) + STDDEV(total_enrolled) FROM ( SELECT SUM(sos2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd2 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos2 ON sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc2 ON ssc2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) t ) ), inner_cte2 AS ( WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS, ccs.SUBJECT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, TOTAL_UNITS FROM dept_units ) SELECT ic1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic1.total_enrolled_students, (STDDEV(ic2.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ic2.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM inner_cte1 ic1 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN inner_cte2 ic2 ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic2.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON ic2.SUBJECT_CODE = sc.SUBJECT_CODE GROUP BY ic1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic1.total_enrolled_students, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY ic1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For the Mathematics department (Course 18), what is the department name, the number of subject codes offered, the average subject code count across all degree-granting departments, the deviation of Mathematics from this average, the department code, the full name of the department, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of subjects offered, and the name of the associated administrative department (if any)? Do not return any rounded answers.

SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SUBJECT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), mathematics_subject_codes AS ( SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.subj_count AS mathematics_subject_code_count, AVG(i.subj_count) AS avg_subject_code_count_across_departments, (m.subj_count - AVG(i.subj_count)) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte1 i JOIN inner_cte1 m ON m.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.subj_count ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, (STDDEV(s.SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT) / NULLIF(AVG(s.SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM ( SELECT sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc WHERE sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ), mathematics_variation AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte2.coefficient_of_variation, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte2 LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT msc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msc.mathematics_subject_code_count, msc.avg_subject_code_count_across_departments, msc.deviation_from_avg, mv.DEPARTMENT_CODE, mv.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, mv.coefficient_of_variation, mv.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM mathematics_subject_codes msc JOIN mathematics_variation mv ON msc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mv.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SQL: WITH DeptUnits AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.var_total_units, COUNT(DISTINCT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS num_unique_subject_codes FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.var_total_units ), EngDeptMaxEnroll AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.max_enrollment, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = icte.max_enrollment ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_total_units, d.var_total_units, d.num_unique_subject_codes, e.max_enrollment, e.SUBJECT_TITLE, e.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM DeptUnits d JOIN EngDeptMaxEnroll e ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = e.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_stddev, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE isd.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, SUM(max_enrollment_variance) AS total_variance, SUM(max_enrollment_stddev) AS total_stddev FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(max_enrollment_variance) IS NOT NULL ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, rr.total_variance, rr.total_stddev, CASE WHEN LAG(inner_cte2.TERM_DESCRIPTION) OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME) = inner_cte2.TERM_DESCRIPTION THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte2.TERM_DESCRIPTION END AS term_description, inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS subject_department_name, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte2.window_column AS subject_rank_in_dept FROM RollupResults rr JOIN inner_cte2 ON rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For each degree-granting department with a department budget code above 100000, excluding the Political Science department (Course 17), that also offers a Mathematics subject in 2022 with 12 total units where the number of enrolled students in that subject is greater than the average for its HGN code group, list the department code, department name, school name, the number of unique courses offered by the department, the total number of units for all those courses, the subject code of the course with the highest number of total units in that department and that course's total units, as well as the subject title, department full name, offer school name, and the average number of enrolled students in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the HGN code for the Mathematics subject. SQL: WITH DegreeGrantingDepartments AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_CODE) AS num_unique_courses, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.num_unique_courses, icte.total_units, c.SUBJECT_CODE AS max_units_subject_code, c.TOTAL_UNITS AS max_subject_total_units FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ( SELECT c1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, c1.SUBJECT_CODE, c1.TOTAL_UNITS FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c1 JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_units FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE ) c2 ON c1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c2.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND c1.TOTAL_UNITS = c2.max_units ) c ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), MathSubjects2022 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.HGN_CODE, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.HGN_CODE ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS avg_num_enrolled_students_window, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, i.avg_num_enrolled_students_window, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_CODE FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT HGN_CODE, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_per_hgn FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY GROUP BY HGN_CODE ) a ON i.HGN_CODE = a.HGN_CODE WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_enrolled_per_hgn ) SELECT dgd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dgd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dgd.SCHOOL_NAME, dgd.num_unique_courses, dgd.total_units, dgd.max_units_subject_code, dgd.max_subject_total_units, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ms.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ms.avg_num_enrolled_students_window FROM DegreeGrantingDepartments dgd JOIN MathSubjects2022 ms ON dgd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dgd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE;

SQL: WITH MathGradCourses AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ) SELECT ic.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, adc.Course_Count, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY adc.Course_Count DESC) AS admin_dept_dense_rank FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Course_Count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) adc ON ic.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = adc.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ), HighAvgEnrollmentDepts AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, avg_enrolled_students, stddev_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_enrolled_students > ( SELECT AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ) ) SELECT mgc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, mgc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mgc.SCHOOL_NAME, mgc.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, mgc.Course_Count, mgc.admin_dept_dense_rank, hae.avg_enrolled_students, hae.stddev_enrolled_students FROM MathGradCourses mgc JOIN HighAvgEnrollmentDepts hae ON mgc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = hae.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY mgc.Course_Count DESC, mgc.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each academic building at MIT and each of its floors with total assignable area greater than 5000 and at least one room with access level 1 or 2, provide the building's long name, the floor number, the range and variance of the area of rooms on that floor (considering only rooms with access level 1 or 2), the range and variance of the assignable area of its floors that have at least one room, and the total number of rooms in the building. Do not return any rounded answers.

SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, fr.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, MAX(fr.AREA) - MIN(fr.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(fr.AREA) AS area_variance FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.ACCESS_LEVEL IN (1, 2) AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, fr.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY ) SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, ff.FLOOR, ic.area_range, ic.area_variance, ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM inner_cte ic JOIN FCLT_FLOOR ff ON ic.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY = ff.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY WHERE ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA > 5000 ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH floors_with_rooms AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ff.FLOOR, ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM FCLT_FLOOR ff JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND ff.FLOOR = fr.FLOOR ), academic_buildings AS ( SELECT DISTINCT fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fbh.BUILDING_NAME_LONG FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh WHERE fbh.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fbh.SITE = 'MIT' ) SELECT ab.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ab.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, MAX(fwr.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) - MIN(fwr.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS assignable_area_range, VARIANCE(fwr.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS assignable_area_variance FROM academic_buildings ab JOIN floors_with_rooms fwr ON ab.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fwr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY ab.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ab.BUILDING_NAME_LONG ) SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, ic.assignable_area_range, ic.assignable_area_variance, COUNT(fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS total_room_count, ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY ic.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, ic.assignable_area_range, ic.assignable_area_variance, ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ) SELECT s1.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, s1.FLOOR, s1.area_range, s1.area_variance, s2.assignable_area_range, s2.assignable_area_variance, s2.total_room_count FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.BUILDING_NAME_LONG = s2.BUILDING_NAME_LONG AND s1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = s2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY s1.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, s1.FLOOR

SQL: WITH dept_units_grad_students AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.avg_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_grad_students FROM inner_cte ic JOIN COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) > 0 ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), math_subjects_unit_category AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.cip_code_range, i.cip_code_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS distinct_subject_codes FROM inner_cte i JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = i.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = i.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.cip_code_range, i.cip_code_variance ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.HGN_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.HGN_CODE ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS avg_num_enrolled_students_window FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, i.avg_num_enrolled_students_window, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT HGN_CODE, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_per_hgn FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY GROUP BY HGN_CODE ) a ON i.HGN_CODE = a.HGN_CODE WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_enrolled_per_hgn ORDER BY i.SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.cip_code_range, s1.cip_code_variance, s1.distinct_subject_codes, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS SUBJECT_DEPT_FULL_NAME, s2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s2.avg_num_enrolled_students_window FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For each department that is either Chemistry or Biology, and for subjects offered in the 2019FA term that have at least one associated course material, list the department name, the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in its offered subjects, the department's average total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022 academic year (excluding Political Science and only for degree-granting departments), and the deviation of this average from the overall average total units for all degree-granting departments (excluding Political Science) in 2022. Present the columns in the following order: department name, enrolled student range, enrolled student variance, department average total units, and deviation from overall average. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "biology and chemistry department" is predicated by "TABLE.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')" "degree-granting" is predicated by "TABLE.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'" "Course 5" is predicated by "TABLE.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry'" "Course 7" is predicated by "TABLE.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Biology'" "Political Science" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), subq1 AS ( SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.enrolled_range, inner_cte.enrolled_variance FROM inner_cte JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso2 ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tso2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME WHERE tso2.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.enrolled_range, inner_cte.enrolled_variance ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS dept_avg_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), overall_avg AS ( SELECT AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS overall_avg_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' ) SELECT s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.enrolled_range, s1.enrolled_variance, d.dept_avg_units, (d.dept_avg_units - o.overall_avg_units) AS deviation_from_overall_avg FROM subq1 s1 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN dept_avg d ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME CROSS JOIN overall_avg o ORDER BY s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: For each academic year, list the academic year, the academic year description, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in regular terms by the Mathematics department (Course 18), the earliest and latest term start dates for those regular terms in that academic year, the total number of Mathematics subjects offered with more than 0 enrolled students in regular terms, and for each such subject, show the subject ID, subject title, the subject enrollment number, and the deviation of its enrollment from the average enrollment of Mathematics subjects in that year. Do not return any rounded answers.

SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, (STDDEV_SAMP(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), AcademicYearStats AS ( SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.coefficient_of_variation_total_units, MIN(at.TERM_START_DATE) AS earliest_term_start_date, MAX(at.TERM_START_DATE) AS latest_term_start_date FROM inner_cte1 ic JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.coefficient_of_variation_total_units ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.SUBJECT_ID, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ss.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 0 AND at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ), avg_enrollment AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ), MathSubjectEnrollment AS ( SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(i.SUBJECT_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS num_math_subjects, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, (i.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER - a.avg_enrollment) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte2 i JOIN avg_enrollment a ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ays.coefficient_of_variation_total_units, ays.earliest_term_start_date, ays.latest_term_start_date, mse.num_math_subjects, mse.SUBJECT_ID, mse.SUBJECT_TITLE, mse.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, mse.deviation_from_avg FROM AcademicYearStats ays JOIN MathSubjectEnrollment mse ON ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR = mse.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mse.SUBJECT_ID

question: For each degree-granting department in the School of Engineering (excluding the Department of Management and the Department of Physics) that is among the top 10 by number of unique subjects offered in the 2022 academic year, what is the maximum total units of any course offered by that department in the 2008 academic year, the subject code of that course, the full name of the department, the school name, the number of unique subjects offered in 2022, and the average number of enrolled students per subject for that department? evidence: "degree-granting" is predicated by "TABLE.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'" "Management" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '15'" "Physics" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '8'"
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, c.SUBJECT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2008' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.SUBJECT_CODE HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.max_total_units, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.subject_count, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students_per_subject, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.SCHOOL_NAME = sd.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.subject_count, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.max_total_units, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s2.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.subject_count, s2.avg_enrolled_students_per_subject FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s2.subject_count DESC, s1.max_total_units DESC;

question: For each department (excluding Chemistry) that offered at least 5 subjects in 2021, list the department code, department name, school name, the number of subjects offered, the total number of enrolled students in those subjects, and for each subject, show the subject code, subject code description, and the course number. SQL: WITH dept_subjects_2021 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS num_subjects_offered, SUM(COALESCE(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0)) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' AND (d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry') GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) >= 5 ), dept_subjects_2021_expanded AS ( SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.num_subjects_offered, inner_cte.total_enrolled_students, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s.COURSE_NUMBER FROM dept_subjects_2021 inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = sc.COURSE_NUMBER ), top10_eecs_1unit AS ( SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.subject_rank_in_dept, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM ( SELECT ss.SUBJECT_ID, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_rank_in_dept FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS = 1 AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ORDER BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.SUBJECT_ID ) ic JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID AND ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_ID LIMIT 10 ) SELECT dse.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dse.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dse.SCHOOL_NAME, dse.num_subjects_offered, dse.total_enrolled_students, dse.SUBJECT_CODE, dse.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, dse.COURSE_NUMBER, t10.SUBJECT_ID, t10.SUBJECT_TITLE, t10.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t10.subject_rank_in_dept, t10.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS t10_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM dept_subjects_2021_expanded dse JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON dse.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN top10_eecs_1unit t10 ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = t10.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY dse.num_subjects_offered DESC, dse.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dse.SUBJECT_CODE, t10.subject_rank_in_dept;

question: From the top 10 schools with the highest average total units for subjects offered by departments in that school (considering only subjects that are offered this year, are letter graded, and are in the Mathematics department), display each school's name, average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, as well as the department within that school with the highest number of such subjects and the count of those subjects, and for the department and school, also display the subject code with the highest number of degree-granting undergraduate courses in Mathematics and the count of such courses. The columns should be: school name, average total units, variance of total units, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, most prominent department, subject count, subject code with highest number of degree-granting undergraduate courses in Mathematics, and the count of such courses. SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), cte1_top10 AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, avg_total_units, var_total_units, stddev_total_units, DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte1 ORDER BY avg_total_units DESC LIMIT 10 ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME ), cte2_top1 AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS subject_course_count FROM inner_cte2 ic JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.SCHOOL_NAME = scd.SCHOOL_NAME AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND scd.SCHOOL_NAME = ssc.SCHOOL_NAME GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY subject_course_count DESC LIMIT 1 ) SELECT t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.avg_total_units, t1.var_total_units, t1.stddev_total_units, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Most_Prominent_Department, ds.Subject_Count, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.subject_course_count FROM cte1_top10 t1 LEFT JOIN dept_stats ds ON t1.SCHOOL_NAME = ds.SCHOOL_NAME AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN cte2_top1 t2 ON t1.SCHOOL_NAME = t2.SCHOOL_NAME AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.avg_total_units DESC;

question: For each department that is degree-granting, not the Political Science or Chemistry department, and has offered more than five subjects in the School of Engineering, what is the department name, the average, minimum, and maximum total units for subjects offered by that department (from School of Engineering), the average units category (whether the average total units is above 10, below 6, or otherwise), the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units), and the number of graduate students in that department? List the columns in the following order: department name, average total units (from School of Engineering), minimum total units, maximum total units, average units category, average total units (from all subjects with more than 0 units), standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, and number of graduate students. SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 ) SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, CASE WHEN AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) > 10 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) < 6 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS avg_units_category FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN inner_cte ic ON scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_grad_students FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.avg_total_units, subq1.min_total_units, subq1.max_total_units, subq1.avg_units_category, subq2.avg_total_units AS avg_total_units_subq2, subq2.stddev_total_units, subq2.num_grad_students FROM subq1 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN subq2 ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = subq2.DEPARTMENT_CODE

Present the columns in the following order: full name, email address, department name, subject code, subject code description, total number of such students in the department, average total units for 2022, variance of total units for 2022, and the difference from the 2021 average. Do not return any rounded answers.

SQL: WITH student_cte AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t2.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '17' ) SELECT inner_cte.FULL_NAME, inner_cte.EMAIL_ADDRESS, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS total_students_in_department FROM inner_cte ), units_cte AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units_2022, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units_2022 FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.avg_total_units_2022, inner_cte.var_total_units_2022, (inner_cte.avg_total_units_2022 - prev.avg_total_units_2021) AS avg_diff_from_2021 FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units_2021 FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2021 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) prev ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = prev.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT s.FULL_NAME, s.EMAIL_ADDRESS, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s.total_students_in_department, u.avg_total_units_2022, u.var_total_units_2022, u.avg_diff_from_2021 FROM student_cte s JOIN units_cte u ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = u.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

SQL: WITH Subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ata.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT ic.department, ic.academic_year, ic.subject_count, ic.min_term_start_date, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ic.academic_year ), Subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS admin_dept_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(admin_dept_count) AS max_admin_dept_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ), Combined AS ( SELECT s1.department AS department, s1.academic_year, s1.subject_count, s1.min_term_start_date, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.max_admin_dept_count FROM Subq1 s1 LEFT JOIN Subq2 s2 ON s1.department = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME UNION ALL SELECT s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department, NULL AS academic_year, NULL AS subject_count, NULL AS min_term_start_date, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.max_admin_dept_count FROM Subq2 s2 WHERE s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN (SELECT department FROM Subq1) ) SELECT department, academic_year, subject_count, min_term_start_date, TERM_DESCRIPTION, max_admin_dept_count FROM Combined ORDER BY department, academic_year ;

a.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg FROM subq1_inner_cte i JOIN subq1_avg_units a ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), subq2_inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subq2 AS ( SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_units_variance, inner_cte.total_units_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM subq2_inner_cte inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.TOTAL_UNITS, s1.avg_total_units, s1.deviation_from_avg, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.total_units_variance, s2.total_units_stddev, s2.school_name, s2.department_phone FROM subq1 s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.SUBJECT_ID ;

SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '2' ), DepartmentAdminStats AS ( SELECT inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(inner_cte1.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) - MIN(inner_cte1.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_range, VARIANCE(inner_cte1.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte1.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_stddev, COUNT(*) AS num_admin_departments FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ata.TERM_CODE, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ata.TERM_CODE HAVING SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10 ), DepartmentMathEnrollment AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(total_enrolled) AS highest_term_enrollment FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT das.DEPARTMENT_NAME, das.clearing_cost_collector_range, das.clearing_cost_collector_variance, das.clearing_cost_collector_stddev, das.num_admin_departments, dme.highest_term_enrollment FROM DepartmentAdminStats das LEFT JOIN DepartmentMathEnrollment dme ON das.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dme.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE das.clearing_cost_collector_range IS NOT NULL ORDER BY das.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SQL: WITH top10_academic_buildings AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY room_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ic.room_count, muc.MAJOR_USE_DESC AS Most_Common_Major_Use, muc.Major_Use_Room_Count FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, COUNT(*) AS Major_Use_Room_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM FCLT_ROOMS r GROUP BY r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, r.MAJOR_USE_DESC ) muc ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = muc.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND muc.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.room_count DESC ), academic_building_access2_rooms AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, COUNT(fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS num_rooms FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_FLOOR ff ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND fr.FLOOR = ff.FLOOR JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE ff.ACCESS_LEVEL = 2 AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ) SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ic.num_rooms, (ic.num_rooms - (SELECT AVG(num_rooms) FROM inner_cte)) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte ic ORDER BY ic.BUILDING_NAME ) SELECT t.BUILDING_NAME, t.room_count, t.Most_Common_Major_Use, t.Major_Use_Room_Count, a.num_rooms AS num_rooms_access_level_2, a.deviation_from_avg FROM top10_academic_buildings t LEFT JOIN academic_building_access2_rooms a ON t.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY t.room_count DESC;

SQL: WITH OrgGeometricMean AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD))) AS geometric_mean, HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD > 0 AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME NOT IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST') GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID ) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.geometric_mean, HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM inner_cte JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME ), AcademicBuildingStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_BUILDING b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT' AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 10 ) SELECT inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME, inner_cte.area_range, inner_cte.area_variance, inner_cte.area_stddev, b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM inner_cte JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b ON inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME = b.BUILDING_NAME ) SELECT ogm.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ogm.geometric_mean, ogm.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, abs.BUILDING_NAME, abs.area_range, abs.area_variance, abs.area_stddev, abs.ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM OrgGeometricMean ogm JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON ogm.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN AcademicBuildingStats abs ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = abs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY ogm.geometric_mean DESC, abs.area_range DESC;

MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), enrollment_stats_depts AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.avg_enrolled, inner_cte2.range_enrolled, inner_cte2.var_enrolled, COUNT(tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte2 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.avg_enrolled, inner_cte2.range_enrolled, inner_cte2.var_enrolled ), CombinedDepts AS ( SELECT md.DEPARTMENT_NAME, md.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, md.SCHOOL_NAME, md.MAX_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, NULL AS avg_enrolled, NULL AS range_enrolled, NULL AS var_enrolled, NULL AS total_subjects_offered, 'MaxEnrolled2019' AS Reason FROM max_enrolled_depts md UNION ALL SELECT esd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS MAX_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, esd.avg_enrolled, esd.range_enrolled, esd.var_enrolled, esd.total_subjects_offered, 'EnrollmentStats' AS Reason FROM enrollment_stats_depts esd ) SELECT * FROM CombinedDepts ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Reason;

SQL: WITH dept_variability AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
