cc.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Top_Course_Title, cc.TOTAL_UNITS AS Top_Course_Units FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' ) cc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cc.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND cc.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.total_units DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dv.coefficient_of_variation, SQL: WITH dept_enrollment_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students, inner_cte.var_enrolled_students, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students, inner_cte.var_enrolled_students ), eecs_students_mitid_category AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sp.MIT_ID, sp.FULL_NAME, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR FROM SE_PERSON sp JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = 'Student' AND msd.DEPARTMENT = 6 AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ), avg_mit_id_per_year AS ( SELECT STUDENT_YEAR, AVG(MIT_ID) AS avg_mit_id FROM inner_cte GROUP BY STUDENT_YEAR ) SELECT i.MIT_ID, i.FULL_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.STUDENT_YEAR, CASE WHEN i.MIT_ID > a.avg_mit_id THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.MIT_ID < a.avg_mit_id THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS mit_id_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN avg_mit_id_per_year a ON i.STUDENT_YEAR = a.STUDENT_YEAR ORDER BY i.STUDENT_YEAR, i.MIT_ID ) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.avg_enrolled_students, des.var_enrolled_students, des.max_enrolled_students, esmc.MIT_ID, esmc.FULL_NAME, esmc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS EECS_DEPARTMENT_NAME, esmc.STUDENT_YEAR, esmc.mit_id_category FROM dept_enrollment_stats des CROSS JOIN eecs_students_mitid_category esmc;

SQL: WITH school_department_courses AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS num_departments, SUM(total_courses) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY total_courses DESC LIMIT 10 ), department_units_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Mathematics', 'Chemistry') GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.total_units_variance, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT sdc.SCHOOL_NAME, sdc.num_departments, sdc.total_courses, dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance, dus.SCHOOL_NAME AS department_school_name, dus.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM school_department_courses sdc JOIN department_units_stats dus ON sdc.SCHOOL_NAME = dus.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY sdc.total_courses DESC, dus.total_units_variance DESC;

SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LOG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.geometric_mean_total_units, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte i JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON ccc.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.geometric_mean_total_units ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.COURSE_NUMBER = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS highest_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.geometric_mean_total_units, subq1.avg_enrolled_students, subq2.highest_enrollment FROM subq1 LEFT JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SQL: WITH SchoolCIP AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS max_cip_code, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_CODE HAVING MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) > 120000 ) SELECT i.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK, MAX(i.max_cip_code) AS school_max_cip_code, CASE WHEN MAX(i.max_cip_code) > 150000 THEN 'HIGH_CIP' WHEN MAX(i.max_cip_code) < 130000 THEN 'LOW_CIP' ELSE 'MEDIUM_CIP' END AS cip_category, i.SCHOOL_CODE FROM inner_cte i JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT s ON i.SCHOOL_CODE = s.SCHOOL_CODE GROUP BY i.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK, i.SCHOOL_CODE ), MathIAPStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV_SAMP(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS stddev_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON isd.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING COUNT(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) > 5 ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.stddev_max_enrollment, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, sd.SCHOOL_CODE FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT sc.SCHOOL_NAME, sc.SCHOOL_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK, sc.school_max_cip_code, sc.cip_category, ms.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ms.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ms.stddev_max_enrollment, ms.department_phone FROM SchoolCIP sc JOIN MathIAPStats ms ON sc.SCHOOL_CODE = ms.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY sc.SCHOOL_NAME, ms.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

SQL: WITH DeptBudgetStddev AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS dept_budget_code_stddev, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL AND sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, d1.dept_budget_code_stddev, d1.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d2.avg_total_units, d2.range_total_units, d2.var_total_units, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM DeptBudgetStddev d1 JOIN DeptUnitsStats d2 ON d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME, d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.SCHOOL_NAME, ss.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ), MathUnitsStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING ACADEMIC_YEAR IS NOT NULL AND (SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL OR (SCHOOL_NAME IS NULL AND COUNT(*) > 0)) ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), SchoolStats AS ( SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.coefficient_of_variation, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte2 ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), SchoolAgg AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation, COUNT(DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS num_departments FROM SchoolStats GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT mus.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mus.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, mus.SCHOOL_NAME, mus.total_units_range, mus.total_units_variance, sa.avg_coefficient_of_variation, sa.num_departments FROM MathUnitsStats mus LEFT JOIN SchoolAgg sa ON mus.SCHOOL_NAME = sa.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY mus.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mus.SCHOOL_NAME

SQL: WITH inner_cte_math AS ( SELECT scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS admin_dept_dense_rank FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ), avg_cip_math AS ( SELECT AVG(CAST(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE AS FLOAT)) AS avg_cip FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ), math_courses_filtered AS ( SELECT i.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.admin_dept_dense_rank FROM inner_cte_math i CROSS JOIN avg_cip_math a WHERE i.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE > a.avg_cip ), inner_cte_units AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), units_stats AS ( SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.total_units_variance, inner_cte.total_units_stddev, (inner_cte.avg_total_units - overall.avg_all_departments) AS deviation_from_overall_avg FROM inner_cte_units inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(avg_total_units) AS avg_all_departments FROM ( SELECT AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) dept_avgs ) overall ) SELECT mcf.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, mcf.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mcf.SCHOOL_NAME, mcf.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, mcf.admin_dept_dense_rank, us.avg_total_units, us.total_units_variance, us.total_units_stddev, us.deviation_from_overall_avg FROM math_courses_filtered mcf JOIN units_stats us ON mcf.DEPARTMENT_NAME = us.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY mcf.admin_dept_dense_rank, us.total_units_variance DESC;

SQL: WITH max_cip_per_dept AS ( SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.max_cip_code, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS max_cip_code, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) > 120000 ) inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), dept_enrollment_variance AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, inner_cte.enrolled_students_stddev, CASE WHEN inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance > avg_stats.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance < avg_stats.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(enrolled_students_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte ) avg_stats ) SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.max_cip_code, m.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, m.SCHOOL_NAME, d.enrolled_students_variance, d.enrolled_students_stddev, d.variance_category FROM max_cip_per_dept m JOIN dept_enrollment_variance d ON m.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SQL: WITH dept_units_stats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), dept_contact_info AS ( SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.range_total_units, inner_cte.var_total_units, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM dept_units_stats inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ), eng_subject_counts AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dci.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dci.avg_total_units, dci.range_total_units, dci.var_total_units, dci.SCHOOL_NAME, dci.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, esc.num_subjects FROM dept_contact_info dci LEFT JOIN eng_subject_counts esc ON dci.DEPARTMENT_CODE = esc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dci.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each degree-granting department, what is the title of the subject with the maximum number of students enrolled in any subject offered by that department in the 2019FA term, what is the maximum number of students enrolled, and is the department a 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' department (if the maximum enrollment is at least 20% greater than the average maximum enrollment across all degree-granting departments), a 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' department (if the maximum enrollment is at least 20% less than the average), or 'AVERAGE'? Only include departments where the maximum enrollment is greater than 10. Additionally, for each such department, what is the academic year description, the total variance, and the total standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the maximum enrollment for IAP activities offered in that year by the Mathematics department, considering only activities that require advance sign-up and are not cancelled, and including a grand total for all activities in the format of (department name, null, total variance and stddev)? Present the results as: department name, subject title, maximum number enrolled, enrollment category, academic year description, total variance, and total standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "math" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'" "Course 18" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = ( SELECT MAX(tso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso2 WHERE tso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND tso2.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ) AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10 ), MaxEnrollmentByDept AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED, CASE WHEN ic.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED > avg_stats.avg_max_enrolled * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN ic.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED < avg_stats.avg_max_enrolled * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte1 ic CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(MAX_NUM_ENROLLED) AS avg_max_enrolled FROM inner_cte1 ) avg_stats ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_stddev, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE isd.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, SUM(max_enrollment_variance) AS total_variance, SUM(max_enrollment_stddev) AS total_stddev FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(max_enrollment_variance) IS NOT NULL ) SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.SUBJECT_TITLE, m.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED, m.enrollment_category, r.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, r.total_variance, r.total_stddev FROM MaxEnrollmentByDept m LEFT JOIN RollupResults r ON m.DEPARTMENT_NAME = r.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, r.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ;

question: For students whose department is '6' and whose department name is 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci', show their first name, last name, email address, department name, student year, the corresponding department's full name, school name, the minimum department budget code over each school name group, and the name of the corresponding SIS admin department (if any), along with the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by departments in their school in the 2022 academic year (only including schools where all departments grant degrees and excluding any school that contains the Biology department (Course 7)), ordered by school name. SQL: WITH student_info AS ( SELECT msd.FIRST_NAME, msd.LAST_NAME, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME) AS MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ), student_info_with_admin AS ( SELECT si.FIRST_NAME, si.LAST_NAME, si.EMAIL_ADDRESS, si.DEPARTMENT_NAME, si.STUDENT_YEAR, si.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, si.SCHOOL_NAME, si.MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, si.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM student_info si LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON si.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ), school_units_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_CODE, d.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_CODE, d.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(ic.avg_units) AS school_avg_units, VARIANCE(ic.avg_units) AS school_units_variance FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.SCHOOL_CODE = d.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE d.SCHOOL_CODE NOT IN ( SELECT SCHOOL_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE DEPARTMENT_CODE = '7' ) GROUP BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT s.FIRST_NAME, s.LAST_NAME, s.EMAIL_ADDRESS, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.STUDENT_YEAR, s.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, s.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sus.school_avg_units, sus.school_units_variance FROM student_info_with_admin s LEFT JOIN school_units_stats sus ON s.SCHOOL_NAME = sus.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY s.SCHOOL_NAME;

question: For each department hierarchy level 2 (excluding "Political Science") where the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the organization numbers for organizations in that hierarchy level (excluding organizations with organization IDs '138' and '250') is greater than the overall average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all such hierarchy levels, and where the department hierarchy level 2 is also "Provost Area" (excluding departments named "Political Science" (Course 17)), list the department hierarchy level 2 name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), the maximum number of organizational units found in any department, and the minimum department ID among those departments, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.

SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT mdh.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME AS department_hierarchy_level_2, STDDEV_SAMP(fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) / AVG(fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY mdh JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON mdh.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON hou.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') AND mdh.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY mdh.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME HAVING AVG(fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) > 0 ) SELECT department_hierarchy_level_2, coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte WHERE coefficient_of_variation > (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) FROM inner_cte) ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT h.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(o.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS org_unit_count, MIN(o.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS min_department_id FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY h JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT o ON h.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE h.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND o.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY h.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, MAX(org_unit_count) AS max_org_unit_count, MIN(min_department_id) AS min_department_id FROM inner_cte GROUP BY MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME ) SELECT s1.department_hierarchy_level_2, s1.coefficient_of_variation, s2.max_org_unit_count, s2.min_department_id FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.department_hierarchy_level_2 = s2.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME ORDER BY s1.coefficient_of_variation DESC

question: For each academic year and term, what is the highest total units among all Mathematics department subjects offered that year (considering only subjects offered this year with more than 6 total units), the term description for the corresponding term, and the subject short title, along with, for subjects in the "Engineering" school with a total of 1 unit offered by the "Electrical Engineering and Computer Science" department in the same term, the department name, the maximum number of enrolled students for any such subject in each department, the subject ID, subject title, the term description for the EECS subject, and the rank of each subject within its department name group ordered by subject ID? SQL: WITH math_max_units AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION HAVING MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.max_total_units, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ccso.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, ccso.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION = at.TERM_DESCRIPTION JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS = inner_cte.max_total_units AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 ), eecs_eng_subjects AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.SUBJECT_ID, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_rank_in_dept, ss.TERM_CODE FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS = 1 AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_enrollment, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, subject_rank_in_dept, TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, subject_rank_in_dept, TERM_CODE ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT mmu.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mmu.max_total_units, mmu.TERM_DESCRIPTION, mmu.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, ees.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ees.max_enrollment, ees.SUBJECT_ID, ees.SUBJECT_TITLE, ees.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS EECS_TERM_DESCRIPTION, ees.subject_rank_in_dept FROM math_max_units mmu JOIN eecs_eng_subjects ees ON mmu.TERM_CODE = ees.TERM_CODE;

question: For each subject code in the Political Science department, what is the subject code, subject code description, the geometric mean of the number of students in each department associated with that subject code (considering only degree-granting departments), the total number of students across all such departments for each subject code, the department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022 academic year (for degree-granting departments except Physics with more than one subject in 2022), and the average number of enrolled students for those subjects? SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(student_count))) AS geometric_mean_students, SUM(student_count) AS total_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY GROUP BY DEPARTMENT ) m ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC ) SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, geometric_mean_students, total_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, geometric_mean_students, total_students WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(total_students) > 0 ORDER BY SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 1 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.coefficient_of_variation, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2022%' GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.coefficient_of_variation ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT subq1.SUBJECT_CODE, subq1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, subq1.geometric_mean_students, subq1.total_students, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq2.coefficient_of_variation, subq2.avg_enrolled_students FROM subq1 LEFT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON subq1.SUBJECT_CODE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN subq2 ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subq1.SUBJECT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME

SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.STUDENT_YEAR, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ON MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.DEPARTMENT = SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(student_year) OVER (ORDER BY year_sort, student_year, dept_sort) = student_year THEN NULL ELSE student_year END AS student_year, department_name, avg_budget, budget_range, budget_variance, department_code FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(STUDENT_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE STUDENT_YEAR END AS year_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(STUDENT_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(STUDENT_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE STUDENT_YEAR END AS student_year, CASE WHEN GROUPING(STUDENT_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name, AVG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget, MAX(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) - MIN(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_range, VARIANCE(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_variance, MAX(DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS department_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY STUDENT_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY year_sort, dept_sort ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t2.STUDENT_YEAR, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, MIN(t0.COURSE_LEVEL) OVER (ORDER BY t2.LAST_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.COURSE, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND t2.FIRST_NAME = 'Kevin' AND t2.DEPARTMENT = '6' ) SELECT inner_cte.FULL_NAME, inner_cte.EMAIL_ADDRESS, inner_cte.STUDENT_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.COURSE_LEVEL, inner_cte.window_column, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON inner_cte.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER ) SELECT subq1.student_year, subq1.department_name, subq1.avg_budget, subq1.budget_range, subq1.budget_variance, subq2.FULL_NAME, subq2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, subq2.STUDENT_YEAR AS kevin_student_year, subq2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, subq2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, subq2.COURSE_LEVEL, subq2.window_column, subq2.SUBJECT_CODE, subq2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.department_code = subq2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY subq1.student_year, subq1.department_name, subq2.FULL_NAME;

SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 OR sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_total_units > ( SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ) ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.enrolled_students_range, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, inner_cte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, subj_counts.total_subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) subj_counts ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subj_counts.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.stddev_total_units, s2.enrolled_students_range, s2.enrolled_students_variance, s2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.total_subjects FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ic.num_students) AS variance_num_students, STDDEV(ic.num_students) AS stddev_num_students, COUNT(DISTINCT ssc.COURSE_NUMBER) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS > 9 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.max_total_units, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS = icte.max_total_units AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.variance_num_students, s1.stddev_num_students, s1.total_courses, s2.max_total_units, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.SCHOOL_NAME FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE;

Subquery1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS min_academic_year, NULL AS sum_total_units, s2.avg_total_units, s2.total_units_variance, s2.total_units_stddev, s2.graduate_student_count, 'DegreeGrantingStats' AS Reason FROM Subquery2 s2 ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, min_academic_year, sum_total_units, avg_total_units, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev, graduate_student_count, SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS avg_clearing_cost_collector, VARIANCE(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_variance, STDDEV(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE != '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.avg_clearing_cost_collector, ic.clearing_cost_collector_variance, ic.clearing_cost_collector_stddev FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS total_clearing_cost_collector FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(total_clearing_cost_collector) AS highest_total_clearing_cost_collector FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.avg_clearing_cost_collector, s1.clearing_cost_collector_variance, s1.clearing_cost_collector_stddev, s2.highest_total_clearing_cost_collector FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.SCHOOL_NAME = s2.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY s1.clearing_cost_collector_variance DESC;

SQL: WITH highest_avg_enrollment AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, l.TERM_CODE, AVG(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment_per_term FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, l.TERM_CODE ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(avg_enrollment_per_term) AS highest_avg_enrollment_per_term FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ), course_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.COURSE_LEVEL, icte.course_count, icte.min_total_units, scd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE_OPTION) AS distinct_course_options FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.COURSE_LEVEL = scd.COURSE_LEVEL GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.COURSE_LEVEL, icte.course_count, icte.min_total_units, scd.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cs.COURSE_LEVEL, cs.course_count, cs.min_total_units, cs.SCHOOL_NAME, cs.distinct_course_options, hae.highest_avg_enrollment_per_term FROM course_stats cs JOIN highest_avg_enrollment hae ON cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = hae.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cs.COURSE_LEVEL;

inner_cte1.enrolled_variance * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_SPREAD' WHEN inner_cte1.enrolled_range < inner_cte1.enrolled_variance * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_SPREAD' ELSE 'AVERAGE_SPREAD' END AS spread_category FROM inner_cte1 MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) stats LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, TOTAL_UNITS AS max_total_units FROM ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY TOTAL_UNITS DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte1 ) ranked WHERE rn = 1 ) top_subject ON stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME = top_subject.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stats.total_units_range DESC LIMIT 10 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment, t.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING MAX(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ), DeptEnrollment AS ( SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.max_enrollment, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 i JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT t10.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t10.total_units_range, t10.total_units_variance, t10.total_units_stddev, t10.subject_with_max_units, t10.max_total_units, de.max_enrollment, de.SUBJECT_TITLE, de.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM Top10DeptUnits t10 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON t10.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN DeptEnrollment de ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = de.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t10.total_units_range DESC;

SQL: WITH Top10Departments AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.TERM_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE != '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.TERM_CODE ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(subject_count) AS highest_unique_subjects_in_a_term FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY highest_unique_subjects_in_a_term DESC LIMIT 10 ), ScienceDepartmentsStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE '%Science%' ) SELECT t10.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t10.highest_unique_subjects_in_a_term, sds.enrolled_students_range, sds.enrolled_students_variance, sds.enrolled_students_stddev FROM Top10Departments t10 JOIN ScienceDepartmentsStats sds ON t10.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sds.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t10.highest_unique_subjects_in_a_term DESC;

SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), overall_avg AS ( SELECT AVG(avg_total_units) AS overall_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte1 ), subq1 AS ( SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_total_units, i.stddev_total_units, CASE WHEN i.avg_total_units > o.overall_avg_total_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_AVERAGE' WHEN i.avg_total_units < o.overall_avg_total_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS average_category, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte1 i CROSS JOIN overall_avg o ), inner_cte2 AS ( WITH dept_terms AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, sos.TERM_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' ), subjects_per_term AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE ) SELECT spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE, spt.DEPARTMENT_NAME, spt.TERM_CODE, spt.num_subjects FROM subjects_per_term spt WHERE spt.DEPARTMENT_CODE IN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM dept_terms) ), ranked_terms AS ( SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.TERM_CODE, icte.num_subjects, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.num_subjects DESC, icte.TERM_CODE) AS term_rank FROM inner_cte2 icte ), agg_stats AS ( SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(icte.num_subjects) - MIN(icte.num_subjects) AS range_num_subjects, VARIANCE(icte.num_subjects) AS variance_num_subjects, STDDEV(icte.num_subjects) AS stddev_num_subjects FROM inner_cte2 icte GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subq2 AS ( SELECT a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.range_num_subjects, a.variance_num_subjects, a.stddev_num_subjects, r.TERM_CODE AS term_with_most_subjects, r.num_subjects AS num_subjects_in_term, a.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM agg_stats a JOIN ranked_terms r ON a.DEPARTMENT_CODE = r.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND r.term_rank = 1 ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.avg_total_units, s1.stddev_total_units, s1.average_category, s2.range_num_subjects, s2.variance_num_subjects, s2.stddev_num_subjects, s2.term_with_most_subjects, s2.num_subjects_in_term FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME

MIN(icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM inner_cte icte GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY enrollment_range DESC ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.subject_course_count, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.avg_enrollment, s2.enrollment_range, s2.enrollment_variance FROM subq1 s1 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON s1.SUBJECT_CODE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE AND s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s1.SCHOOL_NAME = ssc.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN subq2 s2 ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s2.enrollment_range DESC;

SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND sos.SUBJECT_ID = ccc.SUBJECT_ID WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND ccc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ), DepartmentStats AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, range_total_units, var_total_units FROM inner_cte1 UNION ALL SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(avg_total_units) AS avg_total_units, MAX(range_total_units) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(var_total_units) AS var_total_units FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(su.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON t.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY su ON so.TERM_CODE = su.TERM_CODE WHERE t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(su.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ), DeptSubjectCounts AS ( SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT so.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON t.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY su ON so.TERM_CODE = su.TERM_CODE WHERE t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' AND su.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.total_enrolled, dc.total_subjects FROM inner_cte2 ic LEFT JOIN DeptSubjectCounts dc ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(total_enrolled) AS total_enrolled, SUM(total_subjects) AS total_subjects FROM RollupResults GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(total_enrolled) > 0 ) SELECT ds.SCHOOL_NAME, ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.avg_total_units, ds.range_total_units, ds.var_total_units, des.total_enrolled, des.total_subjects FROM DepartmentStats ds LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ds.SCHOOL_NAME = sd.SCHOOL_NAME LEFT JOIN DepartmentEnrollmentStats des ON ( (ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME) OR (ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL AND des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IS NULL AND ds.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering') ) ORDER BY ds.SCHOOL_NAME, ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME

SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS MAX_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME HAVING MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10 ), cte1 AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.MAX_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte1 ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t0.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t1.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' ), cte2 AS ( SELECT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.TERM_CODE, sc.Most_Represented_School, sc.Subject_Count, ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME FROM ( SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_CODE, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte2 ORDER BY NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC LIMIT 10 ) ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME AS Most_Represented_School, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY Subject_Count DESC LIMIT 1 ) sc ON ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = sc.Most_Represented_School ORDER BY ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC ) SELECT c1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, c1.SCHOOL_NAME, c1.MAX_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, c2.SUBJECT_TITLE, c2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS CHEM_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, c2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c2.TERM_CODE, c2.Most_Represented_School, c2.Subject_Count FROM cte1 c1 CROSS JOIN cte2 c2 ORDER BY c1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC;

SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '6' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(tso.SUBJECT_ID) > 0 ), DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.enrolled_range, inner_cte1.enrolled_variance, inner_cte1.enrolled_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte1 LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.TERM_CODE = sos.TERM_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), DepartmentCourseMaterialStats AS ( SELECT i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.avg_total_units, i.stddev_total_units, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_courses FROM inner_cte2 i JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.TERM_CODE = sos.TERM_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.avg_total_units, i.stddev_total_units ) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.enrolled_range, des.enrolled_variance, des.enrolled_stddev, des.SCHOOL_NAME, des.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, dcm.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dcm.avg_total_units, dcm.stddev_total_units, dcm.num_courses FROM DepartmentEnrollmentStats des JOIN DepartmentCourseMaterialStats dcm ON des.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dcm.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY des.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrolled, inner_cte.range_enrolled, inner_cte.var_enrolled, COUNT(tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrolled, inner_cte.range_enrolled, inner_cte.var_enrolled ) SELECT subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.avg_total_units, subq1.range_total_units, subq1.var_total_units, subq1.num_unique_subject_titles, subq2.avg_enrolled, subq2.range_enrolled, subq2.var_enrolled, subq2.total_subjects_offered FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE subq1.avg_total_units > 9 AND subq2.avg_enrolled > 20 ORDER BY subq2.avg_enrolled DESC;

SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS variance_num_enrolled_students, tso.COURSE_NUMBER FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.COURSE_NUMBER ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.variance_num_enrolled_students, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON ic.COURSE_NUMBER = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ic.num_students) AS variance_num_students, STDDEV(ic.num_students) AS stddev_num_students, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.variance_num_enrolled_students, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, NULL AS variance_num_students, NULL AS stddev_num_students, NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, 'SubjectsOffered' AS Source FROM Subquery1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS variance_num_enrolled_students, NULL AS SUBJECT_CODE, NULL AS SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s2.variance_num_students, s2.stddev_num_students, s2.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, 'StudentYearStats' AS Source FROM Subquery2 s2 ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Source;

SQL: WITH dept_units_grad_students AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.avg_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_grad_students FROM inner_cte ic JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.avg_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units HAVING COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) > 0 ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), harvard_subject_variance AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, VARIANCE(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON td.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME != 'Chemistry' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.record_count_variance FROM inner_cte JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE = ss.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY inner_cte.record_count_variance DESC ) SELECT dugs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dugs.avg_total_units, dugs.stddev_total_units, dugs.num_grad_students, hsv.SUBJECT_TITLE, hsv.record_count_variance FROM dept_units_grad_students dugs JOIN harvard_subject_variance hsv ON dugs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = hsv.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dugs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, hsv.record_count_variance DESC

SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, d.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ), math_dept_courses AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, dept_course_counts.total_courses, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte1 ic JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte1 WHERE SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ) dept_course_counts ON ic.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME = dept_course_counts.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE ), subjects_above_avg AS ( SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_subjects_above_avg, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 i JOIN dept_avg a ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE i.TOTAL_UNITS > a.avg_units GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT mdc.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, mdc.SUBJECT_TITLE, mdc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, mdc.SCHOOL_NAME, mdc.total_courses, sa.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sa.num_subjects_above_avg FROM math_dept_courses mdc LEFT JOIN subjects_above_avg sa ON mdc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sa.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY mdc.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sa.num_subjects_above_avg DESC

SQL: WITH dept_highest_enrollment AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON tso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2021 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(total_enrolled_students) AS highest_yearly_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), degree_dept_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.enrolled_students_range, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, inner_cte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, subj_counts.total_subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) subj_counts ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subj_counts.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dhe.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dhe.highest_yearly_enrollment, dds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dds.enrolled_students_range, dds.enrolled_students_variance, dds.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dds.total_subjects FROM dept_highest_enrollment dhe CROSS JOIN degree_dept_stats dds;

SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' ), subq1 AS ( SELECT stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME, stats.total_units_range, stats.total_units_variance, stats.total_units_stddev, top_subject.SUBJECT_ID AS subject_with_max_units, top_subject.max_total_units FROM ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) stats LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, TOTAL_UNITS AS max_total_units FROM ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY TOTAL_UNITS DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte1 ) ranked WHERE rn = 1 ) top_subject ON stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME = top_subject.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stats.total_units_range DESC LIMIT 10 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment, t.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING MAX(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ), subq2 AS ( SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.max_enrollment, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 i JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.total_units_range, subq1.total_units_variance, subq1.total_units_stddev, subq1.subject_with_max_units, subq1.max_total_units, subq2.max_enrollment, subq2.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME

SQL: WITH DeptSubjects AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' ) SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptUnitStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT *, MAX(avg_total_units) OVER () AS highest_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.num_subjects, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance, dus.highest_avg_total_units FROM DeptSubjects ds JOIN DeptUnitStats dus ON ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > ( SELECT AVG(total_enrolled) + STDDEV(total_enrolled) FROM ( SELECT SUM(sos2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd2 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos2 ON sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc2 ON ssc2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) t ) ), DepartmentEnrolledStats AS ( SELECT ic1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic1.total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte1 ic1 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Science' ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), DegreeDeptStats AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, avg_enrollment, enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte2 WHERE avg_enrollment > 20 ) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_CODE, des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.total_enrolled_students, dds.avg_enrollment, dds.enrollment_stddev FROM DepartmentEnrolledStats des JOIN DegreeDeptStats dds ON des.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dds.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY des.total_enrolled_students DESC;

SQL: WITH school_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, EXP(AVG(LOG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE))) AS geometric_mean_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT i.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(i.geometric_mean_dept_budget_code) AS school_geometric_mean_dept_budget_code, AVG(dept_subject_counts.subject_count) AS avg_subject_codes_per_department FROM inner_cte i LEFT JOIN ( SELECT d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, Science' GROUP BY d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) dept_subject_counts ON i.SCHOOL_NAME = dept_subject_counts.SCHOOL_NAME AND i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dept_subject_counts.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY i.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY i.SCHOOL_NAME ), math_course_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.COURSE_LEVEL = scd.COURSE_LEVEL GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.COURSE_LEVEL, icte.course_count, icte.min_total_units, scd.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT ss.SCHOOL_NAME, ss.school_geometric_mean_dept_budget_code, ss.avg_subject_codes_per_department, mcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mcs.COURSE_LEVEL, mcs.course_count, mcs.min_total_units, mcs.SCHOOL_NAME AS math_school_name, mcs.distinct_course_options FROM school_stats ss CROSS JOIN math_course_stats mcs;

ccso.SUBJECT_CODE, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subject_ranks AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, SQL: WITH degree_dept_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_program_code, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS range_cip_program_code, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS var_cip_program_code, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_cip_program_code, ic.range_cip_program_code, ic.var_cip_program_code, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ), chemistry_enrollment AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ) SELECT ic.department_name, ic.total_enrolled_students, SUM(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM inner_cte ic JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = ic.department_name JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON tso.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY ic.department_name, ic.total_enrolled_students ) SELECT dds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dds.avg_cip_program_code, dds.range_cip_program_code, dds.var_cip_program_code, dds.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ce.department_name AS chemistry_department_name, ce.total_enrolled_students, ce.total_units FROM degree_dept_stats dds LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON dds.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN chemistry_enrollment ce ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ce.department_name ;

SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE, c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ), dept_benchmark AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_code FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_cip_code, i.COURSE, i.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, CASE WHEN i.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE > d.avg_cip_code * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_CIP' WHEN i.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE < d.avg_cip_code * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_CIP' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS cip_category, ic2.avg_total_units, ic2.var_total_units, ic2.stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte1 i JOIN dept_benchmark d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN inner_cte2 ic2 ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.COURSE;
