evidence: "degree-granting" is predicated by "TABLE.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'" "math" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'" "Course 15" is predicated by "UPPER(TABLE.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MANAGEMENT'" "Physics" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '8'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS num_distinct_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND UPPER(ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MANAGEMENT' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ), cte1 AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, ic.num_distinct_courses FROM inner_cte1 ic JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, ic.num_distinct_courses ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS total_clearing_cost_collector, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), cte2 AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_clearing_cost_collector, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 ic ) SELECT cte1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1.GRADUATE_LEVEL, cte1.num_distinct_courses, cte2.total_clearing_cost_collector, cte2.SCHOOL_NAME FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cte2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY cte1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, cte1.GRADUATE_LEVEL;

question: For each department that grants degrees (excluding the Electrical Engineering and Computer Science department, Course 6, and excluding 'Political Science'), provide the department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students per subject offered by that department in the 2022FA term, the school name, the department phone number, and the average, range, and variance of the subject codes' lengths for subjects offered by that department. Only include departments that offered at least one subject in 2022FA and have a department budget code. Sort the results by department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "degree-granting" is predicated by "TABLE.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'" "Electrical Engineering and Computer Science" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '6'" "Political Science" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '6' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(tso.SUBJECT_ID) > 0 ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.enrolled_range, inner_cte.enrolled_variance, inner_cte.enrolled_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL ), SubjectStats AS ( SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, LENGTH(sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_length FROM inner_cte2 ic JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sc.SUBJECT_CODE IS NOT NULL ), dept_code_stats AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(subject_code_length) AS avg_subject_code_length, MAX(subject_code_length) - MIN(subject_code_length) AS range_subject_code_length, VARIANCE(subject_code_length) AS var_subject_code_length FROM SubjectStats GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL ) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.enrolled_range, ds.enrolled_variance, ds.enrolled_stddev, ds.SCHOOL_NAME, ds.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, dcs.avg_subject_code_length, dcs.range_subject_code_length, dcs.var_subject_code_length FROM dept_stats ds JOIN dept_code_stats dcs ON ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each of the top 10 degree-granting departments (excluding Political Science) that have at least one subject with more than 0 enrolled students, and for each academic year and department combination for the Mathematics department where the total number of units for all subjects offered in terms with term status 'Previous' is more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean, list the department name, the total count of unique subject titles, the total number of enrolled students across all their subjects, the academic year, the Mathematics department name (or null for grand total), and the total units for Mathematics in that year/department. SQL: WITH dept_subjects_enrollment AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE != '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.subject_count ORDER BY ic.subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), math_units_by_year AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > ( SELECT AVG(total_units) + STDDEV(total_units) FROM ( SELECT SUM(ccso2.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso2 ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccso2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) t ) ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(total_units) AS total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(total_units) > ( SELECT AVG(total_units) + STDDEV(total_units) FROM ( SELECT SUM(ccso2.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso2 ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccso2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) t ) ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_units FROM RollupResults ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dse.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dse.subject_count, dse.total_enrolled_students, my.ACADEMIC_YEAR, my.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS MATH_DEPARTMENT_NAME, my.total_units FROM dept_subjects_enrollment dse CROSS JOIN math_units_by_year my;

SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS, scd.DEPARTMENT FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subq1 AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.TOTAL_UNITS, ds.avg_total_units, ds.total_units_variance, (ic.TOTAL_UNITS - ds.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg, ic.DEPARTMENT FROM inner_cte1 ic JOIN dept_stats ds ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' ), subq2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS dept_name2, COUNT(*) AS num_subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.TOTAL_UNITS, s1.avg_total_units, s1.total_units_variance, s1.deviation_from_avg, s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s2.dept_name2, s2.num_subjects FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.deviation_from_avg DESC;

question: For each department and course level in Mathematics (Course 18) where the total number of enrolled students in offered subjects is greater than 10 and considering only degree-granting courses, list the department name, course level, number of unique courses, minimum total units, the corresponding SIS subject code and subject code description, and also provide the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of courses offered by that department (excluding Chemistry and Biology and considering only degree-granting departments and courses with more than 0 total units), along with the number of unique students in each department. The columns should be: department name, course level, number of unique courses, minimum total units, SIS subject code, subject code description, average total units, total units variance, total units standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and number of unique students. SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.COURSE_LEVEL, i.course_count, i.min_total_units, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM inner_cte i JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.COURSE_LEVEL = c.COURSE_LEVEL JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON c.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.total_units_variance, inner_cte.total_units_stddev, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_students FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.total_units_variance, inner_cte.total_units_stddev ORDER BY inner_cte.total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.COURSE_LEVEL, s1.course_count, s1.min_total_units, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s2.avg_total_units, s2.total_units_variance, s2.total_units_stddev, s2.num_students FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.COURSE_LEVEL;

question: For each department that grants degrees, is not the Mathematics department (Course 18), and has a maximum CIP program code among its courses greater than 120000, show the department name, the maximum CIP program code among its courses, the full name of the department, the school name, and the number of degree-granting subjects it offered in the term '2014FA' that had more than 5 students enrolled, in order of decreasing maximum CIP program code. SQL: WITH max_cip_per_dept AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS max_cip_code, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) > 120000 ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.max_cip_code, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subjects_with_5plus_students AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS econ_subjects_with_5plus_students, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, econ_subjects_with_5plus_students FROM inner_cte ) SELECT mcpd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mcpd.max_cip_code, mcpd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, mcpd.SCHOOL_NAME, sw5s.econ_subjects_with_5plus_students FROM max_cip_per_dept mcpd LEFT JOIN subjects_with_5plus_students sw5s ON mcpd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sw5s.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY mcpd.max_cip_code DESC;

SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS variance_num_enrolled_students, tso.COURSE_NUMBER FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.COURSE_NUMBER ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.variance_num_enrolled_students, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON ic.COURSE_NUMBER = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_units_range, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev, DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM dept_stats WHERE avg_total_units > ( SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) FROM inner_cte ) ) SELECT subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.variance_num_enrolled_students, subq1.SUBJECT_CODE, subq1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, subq2.total_units_range, subq2.total_units_variance, subq2.total_units_stddev FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND subq1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = subq2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.SUBJECT_CODE;

SQL: WITH BuildingRoomArea AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME, SUM(fr.AREA) AS total_room_area, fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC IN ('RESIDENT', 'LABS') AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE = 'OWNED' GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY HAVING SUM(fr.AREA) > 1000 ), BuildingPeriods AS ( SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD, ic.total_room_area, ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM inner_cte ic JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ) SELECT bp.BUILDING_NAME, bp.FISCAL_PERIOD, SUM(bp.total_room_area) AS total_room_area, bp.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM BuildingPeriods bp GROUP BY bp.FISCAL_PERIOD, bp.BUILDING_NAME, bp.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(bp.total_room_area) > 0 ), AcademicBuildingArea AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD, SUM(fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) OVER ( PARTITION BY fb.CAMPUS_SECTOR ORDER BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS running_assignable_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING fb JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE = 'OWNED' AND fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY <> '32' ) SELECT icte.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, icte.BUILDING_NAME, icte.FISCAL_PERIOD, icte.running_assignable_area, fb.EXT_GROSS_AREA FROM inner_cte icte JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON icte.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ) SELECT bra.BUILDING_NAME, bra.FISCAL_PERIOD, bra.total_room_area, aba.running_assignable_area, aba.EXT_GROSS_AREA FROM BuildingRoomArea bra JOIN AcademicBuildingArea aba ON bra.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = aba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND bra.FISCAL_PERIOD = aba.FISCAL_PERIOD WHERE bra.BUILDING_NAME IS NOT NULL ORDER BY bra.FISCAL_PERIOD, bra.BUILDING_NAME;

evidence: "biology department" is predicated by "LOWER(TABLE.DLC_NAME) = LOWER('Biology')" "Computer Science" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'" "Biology" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '7'" "Course 6" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'"
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(cip_code_variance) AS max_cip_code_variance, MIN(cip_code_variance) AS min_cip_code_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY t0.COURSE) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte WHERE COURSE IN ( SELECT COURSE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION WHERE COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' ) ) SELECT subq1.SCHOOL_NAME, subq1.max_cip_code_variance, subq1.min_cip_code_variance, subq2.COURSE, subq2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq2.SCHOOL_NAME AS COURSE_SCHOOL_NAME, subq2.window_column FROM subq1 LEFT JOIN subq2 ON subq1.SCHOOL_NAME = subq2.SCHOOL_NAME

question: For each school and each of its departments (including a grand total for all departments in the school), what is the geometric mean of the total units of subjects offered by departments in that school (considering only subjects with more than zero total units and that are offered this year, and only for departments that are degree-granting and not the Department of Management), the overall average geometric mean across all schools, whether the school's geometric mean is 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' (at least 5% greater than the overall average), 'BELOW_AVERAGE' (at least 5% less than the overall average), or 'AVERAGE' otherwise, and for each department, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in offered subjects (considering only degree-granting departments and subjects with more than 0 enrolled students)? Show the school name, its geometric mean, the overall average geometric mean, the comparison to average, the department name (or null for the school total), the average enrollment, the enrollment variance, and the enrollment standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "degree-granting" is predicated by "TABLE.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'" "math" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'" "Course 15" is predicated by "UPPER(TABLE.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MANAGEMENT'" "Management" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '15'" "Course 18" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT = '18'"
SQL: WITH SchoolGeometricMean AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, EXP(AVG(LOG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.geometric_mean_total_units, s.avg_geometric_mean, CASE WHEN i.geometric_mean_total_units > s.avg_geometric_mean * 1.05 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.geometric_mean_total_units < s.avg_geometric_mean * 0.95 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS comparison_to_average FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_total_units) AS avg_geometric_mean FROM inner_cte) s ORDER BY i.SCHOOL_NAME ), DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_enrollment, enrollment_variance, enrollment_stddev FROM ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_enrollment, enrollment_variance, enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(avg_enrollment) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(avg_enrollment) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(avg_enrollment) AS enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ) t ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT sgm.SCHOOL_NAME, sgm.geometric_mean_total_units, sgm.avg_geometric_mean, sgm.comparison_to_average, des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_variance, des.enrollment_stddev FROM SchoolGeometricMean sgm JOIN DepartmentEnrollmentStats des ON sgm.SCHOOL_NAME = des.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY sgm.SCHOOL_NAME, des.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

SQL: WITH dept_enrollment_stats AS ( SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students, inner_cte.var_enrolled_students, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), eecs_students AS ( SELECT inner_cte.FIRST_NAME, inner_cte.LAST_NAME, inner_cte.EMAIL_ADDRESS, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.STUDENT_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM ( SELECT msd.FIRST_NAME, msd.LAST_NAME, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME) AS MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.avg_enrolled_students, des.var_enrolled_students, des.SCHOOL_NAME, es.FIRST_NAME, es.LAST_NAME, es.EMAIL_ADDRESS, es.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS EECS_DEPARTMENT_NAME, es.STUDENT_YEAR, es.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, es.SCHOOL_NAME AS EECS_SCHOOL_NAME, es.MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, es.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM dept_enrollment_stats des JOIN eecs_students es ON des.DEPARTMENT_CODE = es.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY des.SCHOOL_NAME, es.LAST_NAME, es.FIRST_NAME;

question: For each department and its corresponding administrative department name where the department is degree granting and the department is Mathematics (Course 18), provide the number of departments, the minimum department budget code (but only include those results where the minimum department budget code is greater than the average department budget code for all degree granting departments), the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022 academic year (if available), and the average number of enrolled students for those subjects in 2022 (if available). SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS department_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ), avg_budget AS ( SELECT AVG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 1 ), avg_enrolled AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2022%' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i1.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i1.department_count, i1.min_budget_code, i2.coefficient_of_variation, ae.avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte1 i1 JOIN avg_budget ab ON i1.min_budget_code > ab.avg_budget_code LEFT JOIN inner_cte2 i2 ON i1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = i2.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN avg_enrolled ae ON i1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ae.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

stddev_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students, inner_cte.stddev_enrolled_students, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students, inner_cte.stddev_enrolled_students ), dept_budget_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.SCHOOL_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL ), school_avg AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.avg_dept_budget_code, CASE WHEN i.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > s.avg_dept_budget_code * 1.1 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE < s.avg_dept_budget_code * 0.9 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS budget_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN school_avg s ON i.SCHOOL_NAME = s.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.avg_enrolled_students, d1.stddev_enrolled_students, d1.num_unique_subjects, d2.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d2.SCHOOL_NAME, d2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d2.avg_dept_budget_code, d2.budget_category FROM dept_enrollment_stats d1 JOIN dept_budget_stats d2 ON d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d2.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: For each department name and course level where the department is degree granting and the department is Mathematics, provide the number of unique courses, the minimum CIP program code, the number of unique subject codes associated with those courses, the range and variance of the number of students in each subject code offered by that department (considering only subject codes that belong to a school with a non-null name), and also include the department's school name and whether the department is degree granting. SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.COURSE_LEVEL, ic.course_count, ic.min_cip_code, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.COURSE_LEVEL, ic.course_count, ic.min_cip_code ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(subject_count) - MIN(subject_count) AS subject_count_range, VARIANCE(subject_count) AS subject_count_variance FROM ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT m.FULL_NAME) AS subject_count FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY m ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE ) sub JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON sub.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.subject_count_range, inner_cte.subject_count_variance, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.subject_count_range DESC ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.COURSE_LEVEL, s1.course_count, s1.min_cip_code, s1.subject_code_count, s2.subject_count_range, s2.subject_count_variance, s2.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students, inner_cte.stddev_enrolled_students, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students, inner_cte.stddev_enrolled_students ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ic.num_students) AS variance_num_students, STDDEV(ic.num_students) AS stddev_num_students, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.avg_enrolled_students, s1.stddev_enrolled_students, s1.num_unique_subjects, s2.variance_num_students, s2.stddev_num_students, s2.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each organization whose organization level is 5 and is not 'ADMISSIONS', and for each organization and its corresponding HR department where the organization is assignable, the HR organization unit level is 'DEPARTMENTS', the organization is not 'Cambridge-MIT Institute', and the organization is in the 'Provost Area' top-level HR hierarchy, but excluding organizations with organization IDs '138' and '250', show the organization name, description, the corresponding space unit name, the total number of space units associated with each organization, the HR department name, the number of organizations, and the minimum organization number. SQL: WITH org_space_units AS ( SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, DESCRIPTION, SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(SPACE_UNIT) OVER (PARTITION BY ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS total_space_units, DLC_KEY FROM ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.SPACE_UNIT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SPACE_UNIT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' AND t0.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') ) inner_cte ), org_hr_dept AS ( SELECT ic.ORGANIZATION, ic.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.organization_count, ic.min_organization_number, f.DLC_KEY FROM ( SELECT f.ORGANIZATION, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(f.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION f JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS' AND f.ORGANIZATION_NAME NOT IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST') AND f.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY f.ORGANIZATION, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) ic JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h2 ON ic.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = h2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON ic.ORGANIZATION = f.ORGANIZATION WHERE h2.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME = 'Provost Area' ) SELECT osu.ORGANIZATION_NAME, osu.DESCRIPTION, osu.SPACE_UNIT, osu.total_space_units, ohd.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ohd.organization_count, ohd.min_organization_number FROM org_space_units osu JOIN org_hr_dept ohd ON osu.DLC_KEY = ohd.DLC_KEY;

total_units_variance, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2008 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.avg_total_units, ic.total_units_range, ic.total_units_variance FROM inner_cte ic WHERE ic.avg_total_units = (SELECT MAX(avg_total_units) FROM inner_cte) ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, scd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION) AS course_description_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_program_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, scd.SCHOOL_NAME ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, COURSE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(course_description_count) AS total_course_descriptions, MIN(min_cip_program_code) AS min_cip_program_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, COURSE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(course_description_count) > 0 ) SELECT rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.COURSE, rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.DEPARTMENT_CODE, rr.total_course_descriptions, rr.min_cip_program_code FROM RollupResults rr ORDER BY rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.COURSE, rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s1.avg_total_units, s1.total_units_range, s1.total_units_variance, s2.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.COURSE, s2.total_course_descriptions, s2.min_cip_program_code FROM Subquery1 s1 LEFT JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE UNION ALL SELECT s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE, NULL AS avg_total_units, NULL AS total_units_range, NULL AS total_units_variance, s2.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.COURSE, s2.total_course_descriptions, s2.min_cip_program_code FROM Subquery2 s2 LEFT JOIN Subquery1 s1 ON s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NULL ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, avg_total_units, total_units_range, total_units_variance, SCHOOL_NAME, COURSE, total_course_descriptions, min_cip_program_code FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, COURSE;

MIN(subject_code_length) AS range_subject_code_length, VARIANCE(subject_code_length) AS var_subject_code_length FROM SubjectStats GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.enrolled_range, ds.enrolled_variance, ds.enrolled_stddev, ds.SCHOOL_NAME, ds.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, dcs.avg_subject_code_length, dcs.range_subject_code_length, dcs.var_subject_code_length FROM dept_stats ds LEFT JOIN dept_code_stats dcs ON ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME

SQL: WITH cv_cte AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), avg_cv AS ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_cv FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte i JOIN avg_cv a ON 1=1 WHERE i.coefficient_of_variation > a.avg_cv ), materials_cte AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS material_status_description, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS tms ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON td.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID AND td.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE (td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY IS NOT NULL AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY NOT LIKE 'N/ACourse has no materials%') GROUP BY tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(material_count) AS highest_material_count_for_status FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT cv_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cv_cte.coefficient_of_variation, materials_cte.highest_material_count_for_status FROM cv_cte JOIN materials_cte ON cv_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = materials_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cv_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC

SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, window_column, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, window_column WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS total_graduate_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), GraduateProgramSizes AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.total_graduate_students, CASE WHEN inner_cte2.total_graduate_students >= 20 THEN 'LARGE_GRAD_PROGRAM' WHEN inner_cte2.total_graduate_students < 5 THEN 'SMALL_GRAD_PROGRAM' ELSE 'MEDIUM_GRAD_PROGRAM' END AS grad_program_size FROM inner_cte2 ) SELECT rr.SUBJECT_TITLE, rr.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, rr.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, rr.window_column, rr.total_enrolled, gps.total_graduate_students, gps.grad_program_size FROM RollupResults rr JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON rr.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN GraduateProgramSizes gps ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = gps.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY rr.SUBJECT_TITLE, rr.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

SQL: WITH enrolled_variance_cte AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, enrolled_students_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE enrolled_students_variance > ( SELECT AVG(enrolled_students_variance) FROM inner_cte ) ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ), material_count_cte AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS material_status_description, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS tms ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON td.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID AND td.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE (td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY IS NOT NULL AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY NOT LIKE 'N/ACourse has no materials%') GROUP BY tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(material_count) AS highest_material_count_for_status FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT evc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, evc.enrolled_students_variance, mcc.highest_material_count_for_status FROM enrolled_variance_cte evc LEFT JOIN material_count_cte mcc ON evc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mcc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY evc.enrolled_students_variance DESC;

question: For each administrative department named 'Mechanical Engineering' (Course 2) in the School of Engineering whose total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering is greater than 100 and also greater than the average total number of enrolled students across all administrative departments in the School of Engineering, list the administrative department name, the total number of enrolled students, the name of each degree-granting department (except Biology, Course 7) whose department name matches the administrative department name, and the number of subjects offered by that department in the 2022 academic year whose total units are above the average total units for that department in that year. SQL: WITH admin_dept_enrollment AS ( SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_enrolled FROM ( SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' AND sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = '2' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100 ) inner_cte WHERE total_enrolled > ( SELECT AVG(total_enrolled) FROM ( SELECT sad2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sos2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad2 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd2 ON sad2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos2 ON sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd2.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY sad2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) avg_table ) ), dept_subjects_above_avg AS ( SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS num_subjects_above_avg FROM ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' ) i JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' ) inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE ) a ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE i.TOTAL_UNITS > a.avg_units GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), combined AS ( SELECT ade.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ade.total_enrolled, dsa.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dsa.num_subjects_above_avg FROM admin_dept_enrollment ade JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON UPPER(ade.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = UPPER(sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) JOIN dept_subjects_above_avg dsa ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dsa.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_enrolled, DEPARTMENT_NAME, num_subjects_above_avg FROM combined ORDER BY num_subjects_above_avg DESC;

question: For each academic building in Cambridge, MA (excluding the Stata building), with more than 1 room and a non-null building name, and that is also an academic building at MIT with more than 10 rooms, show the building key, building name, building type, the number of historical records, the total assignable area across all historical records, the average number of rooms per historical record, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the areas of its rooms, and the total assignable area of the building at MIT, considering only buildings that satisfy all these criteria. SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, b.BUILDING_NAME, b.BUILDING_TYPE, COUNT(h.FCLT_BUILDING_HIST_KEY) AS hist_record_count, SUM(h.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS total_assignable_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS a JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b ON a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST h ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = h.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE a.CITY = 'CAMBRIDGE' AND a.STATE = 'MA' AND b.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 1 AND b.BUILDING_NAME IS NOT NULL AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY <> 32 GROUP BY b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, b.BUILDING_NAME, b.BUILDING_TYPE ) SELECT ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.BUILDING_TYPE, ic.hist_record_count, ic.total_assignable_area, AVG(h.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS avg_hist_num_of_rooms FROM inner_cte ic JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST h ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = h.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.BUILDING_TYPE, ic.hist_record_count, ic.total_assignable_area ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_BUILDING b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT' AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 10 ) SELECT inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME, inner_cte.area_range, inner_cte.area_variance, inner_cte.area_stddev, b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM inner_cte JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b ON inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME = b.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.area_range DESC ) SELECT s1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, s1.BUILDING_NAME, s1.BUILDING_TYPE, s1.hist_record_count, s1.total_assignable_area, s1.avg_hist_num_of_rooms, s2.area_range, s2.area_variance, s2.area_stddev, s2.ASSIGNABLE_AREA AS mit_assignable_area FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.BUILDING_NAME = s2.BUILDING_NAME;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ), school_dept_stats AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, range_total_units, var_total_units FROM ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, range_total_units, var_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, range_total_units, var_total_units WITH ROLLUP HAVING SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL ) t ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), math_avg AS ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), math_subjects_2024 AS ( SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_NUMBER, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TOTAL_UNITS, i.window_column, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - m.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte2 i JOIN math_avg m ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT sds.SCHOOL_NAME, sds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sds.avg_total_units, sds.range_total_units, sds.var_total_units, ms2024.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ms2024.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS MATH_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms2024.SUBJECT_CODE, ms2024.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms2024.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms2024.TOTAL_UNITS, ms2024.window_column, ms2024.deviation_from_avg FROM school_dept_stats sds LEFT JOIN math_subjects_2024 ms2024 ON sds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ms2024.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sds.SCHOOL_NAME, sds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms2024.SUBJECT_CODE

question: For each department and subject grade type where the subject is offered in the current academic year, is letter graded, and the department is Mathematics (Course 18), and for each department that has more than 5 rooms, is associated with a non-null DLC key, and is not the 'ADMISSIONS' or 'Political Science' department, provide the department (not repeated if same as previous row), grade type, number of subjects, minimum total units, school name, department phone number, the organization name, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the areas of its rooms, and the department's DLC name. SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE, COUNT(c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE ), cte1 AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept, GRADE_TYPE AS grade_type, COUNT(SUBJECT_COUNT) AS subject_count, MIN(min_total_units) AS min_total_units FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, GRADE_TYPE WITH ROLLUP ), DepartmentSubjects AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(dept) OVER (ORDER BY dept_sort, grade_type) = dept THEN NULL ELSE dept END AS department, grade_type, subject_count, min_total_units, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone, sd.DLC_KEY FROM cte1 tbltmp LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tbltmp.dept = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dept_sort, grade_type ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev, o.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE d.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME NOT IN ('ADMISSIONS') AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.DLC_KEY HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ), DepartmentRoomStats AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte2.area_stddev, o2.DLC_NAME, o2.DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte2 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o2 ON inner_cte2.DLC_KEY = o2.DLC_KEY ORDER BY inner_cte2.area_stddev DESC ) SELECT ds.department, ds.grade_type, ds.subject_count, ds.min_total_units, ds.school_name, ds.department_phone, drs.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS organization_name, drs.area_stddev, drs.DLC_NAME AS dlc_name FROM DepartmentSubjects ds JOIN DepartmentRoomStats drs ON ds.DLC_KEY = drs.DLC_KEY ORDER BY ds.department, ds.grade_type, drs.area_stddev DESC;

inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS unique_students, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND msd.FIRST_NAME = 'Zoe' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), cte2 AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.unique_students, avg_stats.avg_unique_students AS benchmark, CASE WHEN inner_cte2.unique_students > avg_stats.avg_unique_students * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN inner_cte2.unique_students < avg_stats.avg_unique_students * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category, inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(unique_students) AS avg_unique_students FROM inner_cte2) avg_stats ) SELECT cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1.avg_total_units, cte1.range_total_units, cte1.var_total_units, cte1.SCHOOL_NAME, cte1.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, cte2.unique_students, cte2.benchmark, cte2.enrollment_category FROM cte1 LEFT JOIN cte2 ON 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte1 i CROSS JOIN avg_enrollment a ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) AS subject_counts ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = subject_counts.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.TERM_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.num_unique_subjects, inner_cte.min_total_units, MAX(at.TERM_END_DATE) AS question: For each department that is degree granting, not the Chemistry department (Course 5), and has offered more than 5 subjects, and for which there exists a degree-granting Mathematics department (Course 18) in the 2008 academic year, what is the department name, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of subjects offered by that department, the number of graduate students in that department, the department's full name, the range and variance of the total units for Mathematics courses in 2008, and the long course description for each Mathematics course? Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "Chemistry" is predicated by "TABLE.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry'" "math" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'" "Course 5" is predicated by "TABLE.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry'" "Course 18" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18'"
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.stddev_total_units, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_grad_students FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.stddev_total_units ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2008' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.total_units_range, i.total_units_variance, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION_LONG FROM inner_cte i JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = 18 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.stddev_total_units, subq1.num_grad_students, subq2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, subq2.total_units_range, subq2.total_units_variance, subq2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION_LONG FROM subq1 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN subq2 ON sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ORDER BY subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION_LONG

question: For each department where the average total units for subjects offered (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units) is greater than the overall average total units across all departments, and for each academic year in which that department is the Mathematics department and has subjects offered in the current term with more than 0 total units, list the department name, the average total units, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, the academic year, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for subjects offered in that year and department, the school name, and the department phone number. Order the results by the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units (descending), then by the variance of total units (descending). Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "math" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'" "Course 18" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT = '18'" "Course 18" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'"
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_total_units > ( SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY WHERE TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_units_variance, inner_cte.total_units_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.avg_total_units, s1.stddev_total_units, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.total_units_variance, s2.total_units_stddev, s2.school_name, s2.department_phone FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.stddev_total_units DESC, s2.total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each department that (1) has more than 5 rooms, (2) is associated with a non-null DLC key, (3) is not the 'ADMISSIONS' or 'Political Science' department, and (4) is among the top 3 organizations by number of distinct HR organizational units (excluding organizations '138' and '250' and only including those whose DLC name is 'Biology'), display the department name, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the areas of its rooms, the department's DLC name, the number of distinct HR organizational units, and the total number of unique HR department names per organization, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "admissions" is predicated by "TABLE.ORGANIZATION_NAME = 'ADMISSIONS'" "exclude organizations '138' and '250'" is predicated by "TABLE.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250')" "biology department" is predicated by "LOWER(TABLE.DLC_NAME) = LOWER('Biology')" "Political Science" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'" "Biology" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT = '7'"
SQL: WITH area_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev, o.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE d.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME NOT IN ('ADMISSIONS') AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.DLC_KEY HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.area_stddev, o2.DLC_NAME, inner_cte.DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o2 ON inner_cte.DLC_KEY = o2.DLC_KEY ORDER BY inner_cte.area_stddev DESC ), hr_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, hou.DLC_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS num_hr_org_units FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN (138, 250) AND LOWER(hou.DLC_NAME) = 'biology' GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, hou.DLC_NAME ORDER BY num_hr_org_units DESC, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME LIMIT 3 ) SELECT icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.DLC_NAME, icte.num_hr_org_units, COUNT(DISTINCT hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS num_hr_departments, fo.DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte icte JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME AND icte.DLC_NAME = fo.DLC_NAME JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE LOWER(hou.DLC_NAME) = 'biology' GROUP BY icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.DLC_NAME, icte.num_hr_org_units, fo.DLC_KEY ORDER BY icte.num_hr_org_units DESC, icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT a.ORGANIZATION_NAME, a.area_stddev, a.DLC_NAME, h.num_hr_org_units, h.num_hr_departments FROM area_stats a JOIN hr_stats h ON a.ORGANIZATION_NAME = h.ORGANIZATION_NAME AND a.DLC_NAME = h.DLC_NAME AND a.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY ORDER BY h.num_hr_org_units DESC, a.area_stddev DESC;

question: For each of the top 10 degree-granting departments (excluding 'Political Science' and Course 17) that have offered at least one subject in the 'Engineering' school and whose average total units for subjects offered (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units) is greater than the overall average total units across all departments, provide the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department, the school name, the subject code description, and the highest number of students ever enrolled in a single subject offered by each department. Order the results by the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "math" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'" "Political Science" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'" "Course 18" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT = '18'" "Course 17" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '17'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DepartmentsWithHighAvgUnits AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte1 WHERE avg_total_units > ( SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY WHERE TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS num_subjects, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY num_subjects DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT dwhau.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dwhau.avg_total_units, dwhau.stddev_total_units, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, MAX(sos.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS highest_single_subject_enrollment FROM DepartmentsWithHighAvgUnits dwhau JOIN inner_cte2 icte ON dwhau.DEPARTMENT_NAME = icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE GROUP BY dwhau.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dwhau.avg_total_units, dwhau.stddev_total_units, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC ORDER BY dwhau.stddev_total_units DESC;

question: For Chemistry department course offerings in the term '2017JA' that have materials, show the responsible faculty name, subject title, offering department name, number of enrolled students, material status key, and the minimum number of enrolled students in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the subject ID from the TIP_DETAIL table, as well as the grand total of enrolled students for all their Chemistry courses with materials in that term for each responsible faculty. Additionally, for each course, show the department name, department code, school name, administrative department name, the average department budget code within each school, and indicate whether the department's budget code is 'ABOVE_AVERAGE', 'BELOW_AVERAGE', or 'AVERAGE', considering only degree granting departments with a non-null department budget code. Present the results ordered by responsible faculty name, subject title, and department code. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "courses with materials" is predicated by "TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N'" "math" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'" "Course 5" is predicated by "TABLE.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry'" "Course 18" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'"
SQL: WITH chemistry_courses_with_materials AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( ORDER BY td.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS min_enrolled_students_window, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' ) SELECT RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_CODE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, min_enrolled_students_window, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME) AS total_enrolled_by_faculty FROM inner_cte ORDER BY RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE ), degree_granting_departments AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.SCHOOL_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL ), school_avg AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.avg_dept_budget_code, CASE WHEN i.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > s.avg_dept_budget_code * 1.1 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE < s.avg_dept_budget_code * 0.9 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS budget_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN school_avg s ON i.SCHOOL_NAME = s.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, c.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, c.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, c.min_enrolled_students_window, c.total_enrolled_by_faculty, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_dept_budget_code, d.budget_category FROM chemistry_courses_with_materials c JOIN degree_granting_departments d ON c.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: Show the first name, last name, email address, department name, student year, the minimum department code in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the student's full name, and the corresponding SIS admin department name for students whose department code is '6', who are in the Electrical Engineering and Computer Science department, and whose first name is 'Benedict', along with the department code, department name, administrative department name, and the total number of undergraduate courses offered by the top 3 degree-granting departments (excluding Management) that offer the most distinct courses, for each matching student and top department pair. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "Benedict" is predicated by "TABLE.FIRST_NAME = 'Benedict'" "degree-granting" is predicated by "TABLE.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'" "Course 6" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'" "Course 15" is predicated by "UPPER(TABLE.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MANAGEMENT'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.STUDENT_YEAR, MIN(t1.DEPARTMENT) OVER (ORDER BY t1.FULL_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t1 JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT t0 ON t0.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND t1.FIRST_NAME = 'Benedict' ), cte_students AS ( SELECT inner_cte1.FIRST_NAME, inner_cte1.LAST_NAME, inner_cte1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.STUDENT_YEAR, inner_cte1.window_column, t0.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT FROM inner_cte1 JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT t0 ON t0.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS num_distinct_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND UPPER(ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MANAGEMENT' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY num_distinct_courses DESC LIMIT 3 ), cte_top_departments AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(c.COURSE) AS num_undergrad_courses FROM inner_cte2 ic JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE c.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY num_undergrad_courses DESC ) SELECT s.FIRST_NAME, s.LAST_NAME, s.EMAIL_ADDRESS, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.STUDENT_YEAR, s.window_column, s.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS TOP_DEPT_NAME, t.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS TOP_ADMIN_DEPT_NAME, t.num_undergrad_courses FROM cte_students s JOIN cte_top_departments t ON s.DEPARTMENT = t.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: For each administrative department in the School of Engineering, specifically for the Mechanical Engineering department, list the administrative department name, the corresponding department code, the minimum CIP program code, the total number of degree-granting departments for courses, and the total number of such courses per administrative department. For each such course, also provide the school name, the average total units for all courses offered by that school, the department name, the average total units for all courses in the same department as the course, and classify the course as 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' if its total units are at least 10% greater than the department average, 'BELOW_AVERAGE' if at least 10% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise, considering only schools that do not offer courses in the Mathematics department (Course 18). The columns should be shown in the following order: administrative department name, department code, minimum CIP program code, total number of degree-granting departments, total number of such courses per administrative department, school name, average total units for all courses in the school, department name, average total units for all courses in the department, and the unit category. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "Mechanical Engineering" is predicated by "UPPER(TABLE.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING'" "math" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'" "Mechanical Engineering" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT = '2'" "Course 18" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_program_code, COUNT(DISTINCT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS total_departments, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND (UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' OR scd.DEPARTMENT = '2') GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), Total_Courses AS ( SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND (UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' OR scd.DEPARTMENT = '2') GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), cte1 AS ( SELECT inner_cte1.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte1.min_cip_program_code, inner_cte1.total_departments, Total_Courses.Total_Courses FROM inner_cte1 JOIN Total_Courses ON inner_cte1.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME AND inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT ssc.SCHOOL_NAME, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS, ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.SUBJECT_CODE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ), schools_with_math AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ssc.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), department_avg AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS dept_avg_units FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG WHERE TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ), cte2 AS ( SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS school_avg_units, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, da.dept_avg_units, CASE WHEN ic.TOTAL_UNITS > da.dept_avg_units * 1.1 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN ic.TOTAL_UNITS < da.dept_avg_units * 0.9 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_category, ic.SUBJECT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 ic LEFT JOIN schools_with_math swm ON ic.SCHOOL_NAME = swm.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN department_avg da ON
