total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.total_units_range, ic.total_units_variance, dept.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS Most_Offered_Department, dept.Subject_Count FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS dept_rank FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) dept ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dept.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND dept.dept_rank = 1 ), DepartmentVarianceStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE SSC ON SCD.COURSE = SSC.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED LSO ON SSC.COURSE_NUMBER = LSO.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE LSO.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND SCD.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.enrolled_students_variance FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(enrolled_students_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte ) avg_cte ON icte.enrolled_students_variance > avg_cte.avg_variance ) SELECT ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ays.total_units_range, ays.total_units_variance, ays.Most_Offered_Department, ays.Subject_Count, dvs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dvs.enrolled_students_variance FROM AcademicYearStats ays JOIN DepartmentVarianceStats dvs ON ays.Most_Offered_Department = dvs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dvs.enrolled_students_variance DESC;

JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), cte1 AS ( SELECT inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.num_courses_offered, inner_cte1.total_enrolled_students, CASE WHEN inner_cte1.num_courses_offered > 0 THEN inner_cte1.total_enrolled_students * 1.0 / inner_cte1.num_courses_offered ELSE NULL END AS avg_enrolled_students_per_course FROM inner_cte1 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), cte2 AS ( SELECT icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_variance, icte.total_units_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 icte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT cte1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1.num_courses_offered, cte1.total_enrolled_students, cte1.avg_enrolled_students_per_course, cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cte2.avg_total_units, cte2.total_units_variance, cte2.total_units_stddev, cte2.SCHOOL_NAME, cte2.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cte2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY cte1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE) OVER (PARTITION BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS num_subjects_above_avg FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg a ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE i.TOTAL_UNITS > a.avg_units GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY num_subjects_above_avg DESC ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.total_courses, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.num_subjects_above_avg FROM subq1 s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, TOTAL_UNITS FROM dept_units ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS highest_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS num_distinct_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND UPPER(ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MANAGEMENT' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, num_distinct_courses FROM inner_cte ORDER BY num_distinct_courses DESC LIMIT 3 ) SELECT s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.num_distinct_courses, s1.coefficient_of_variation, s1.highest_total_units FROM Subquery2 s2 JOIN Subquery1 s1 ON s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s2.num_distinct_courses DESC, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH dept_code_counts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), stats AS ( SELECT AVG(subject_code_count) AS mean_count, STDDEV(subject_code_count) AS stddev_count FROM dept_code_counts ), filtered_depts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.subject_code_count FROM dept_code_counts d CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE d.subject_code_count > s.mean_count + s.stddev_count ), admin_dept_stats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS avg_clearing_cost_collector, VARIANCE(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_variance, STDDEV(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS clearing_cost_collector_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE != '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT f.DEPARTMENT_CODE, f.DEPARTMENT_NAME, f.subject_code_count, a.avg_clearing_cost_collector, a.clearing_cost_collector_variance, a.clearing_cost_collector_stddev FROM filtered_depts f JOIN admin_dept_stats a ON f.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) , overall_avg AS ( SELECT AVG(avg_clearing_cost_collector) AS overall_avg_clearing_cost_collector FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.subject_code_count, i.avg_clearing_cost_collector, i.clearing_cost_collector_variance, i.clearing_cost_collector_stddev FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN overall_avg o WHERE i.avg_clearing_cost_collector > o.overall_avg_clearing_cost_collector ORDER BY i.subject_code_count DESC, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH MaxUnitsPoliticalScience AS ( SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS administrative_department, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS academic_department, t.max_total_units, t.subject_title_with_max_units, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN ( SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, SUBSTRING_INDEX( GROUP_CONCAT(cso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY cso.TOTAL_UNITS DESC, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE ASC), ',', 1 ) AS subject_title_with_max_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso WHERE cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '17' GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) t ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t.max_total_units > 9 ), DeptEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT mup.administrative_department, mup.academic_department, mup.max_total_units, mup.subject_title_with_max_units, des.avg_enrolled_students, des.range_enrolled_students, des.var_enrolled_students, mup.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM MaxUnitsPoliticalScience mup JOIN DeptEnrollmentStats des ON mup.academic_department = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND mup.DEPARTMENT_CODE = des.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT icte.administrative_department, icte.academic_department, icte.max_total_units, icte.subject_title_with_max_units, icte.avg_enrolled_students, icte.range_enrolled_students, icte.var_enrolled_students, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sp.MIT_ID, sp.FULL_NAME, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, SUM(sp.MIT_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR ORDER BY sp.MIT_ID) AS running_sum_mit_id FROM SE_PERSON sp JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = 'Student' AND msd.DEPARTMENT = 6 AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ORDER BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR, sp.MIT_ID ), DepartmentUnitVariation AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), DepartmentCourseCount AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_NUMBER) AS total_courses FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.MIT_ID, icte.FULL_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.STUDENT_YEAR, icte.running_sum_mit_id, duv.coefficient_of_variation, dcc.total_courses FROM inner_cte icte JOIN DepartmentUnitVariation duv ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = duv.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN DepartmentCourseCount dcc ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dcc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.STUDENT_YEAR, icte.MIT_ID;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH GeometricMeanCIP AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE))) AS geometric_mean_cip FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_cip DESC ), DeptSubjectUnitStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT gmc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, gmc.geometric_mean_cip, dsus.avg_total_units, dsus.total_units_range, dsus.total_units_variance FROM GeometricMeanCIP gmc JOIN DeptSubjectUnitStats dsus ON gmc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsus.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY gmc.geometric_mean_cip DESC ) , avg_variance_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(total_units_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.geometric_mean_cip, i.avg_total_units, i.total_units_range, i.total_units_variance, CASE WHEN i.total_units_variance > a.avg_variance * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT_VARIANCE' WHEN i.total_units_variance < a.avg_variance * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_variance_cte a ORDER BY i.geometric_mean_cip DESC;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' ), course_counts AS ( SELECT t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER) AS total_courses FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ), subject_code_stats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM ( SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT ) course_subjects JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON course_subjects.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_CODE != '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, icte.window_column, scs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scs.avg_subject_codes, scs.stddev_subject_codes, cc.total_courses FROM inner_cte icte JOIN subject_code_stats scs ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scs.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN course_counts cc ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, scs.avg_subject_codes DESC

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH GeometricMeanDeptBudget AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, EXP(AVG(LOG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE))) AS geometric_mean_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME ), AvgAndVarianceBudget AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget, VARIANCE(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Mathematics', 'Physics', 'Chemistry', 'Biology') AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY budget_variance DESC ) SELECT g.SCHOOL_NAME, g.geometric_mean_dept_budget_code, a.avg_budget, a.budget_variance FROM GeometricMeanDeptBudget g JOIN AvgAndVarianceBudget a ON g.SCHOOL_NAME = a.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY g.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, geometric_mean_dept_budget_code, avg_budget, budget_variance, CASE WHEN geometric_mean_dept_budget_code > avg_budget * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_BUDGET' WHEN geometric_mean_dept_budget_code < avg_budget * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_BUDGET' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS budget_category FROM inner_cte;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ), Department_CV AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ), Political_Science_Students AS ( SELECT msd.FULL_NAME, msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR) AS student_year_rank FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.DEPARTMENT = '17' AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' ) SELECT dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcv.coefficient_of_variation, pss.FULL_NAME, pss.SCHOOL_NAME, pss.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, pss.student_year_rank, pss.DEPARTMENT FROM Department_CV dcv JOIN Political_Science_Students pss ON dcv.DEPARTMENT_CODE = pss.DEPARTMENT ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, inner_cte.FULL_NAME, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.student_year_rank, sub_count.subjects_offered FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT ccs.SUBJECT_ID) AS subjects_offered FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs WHERE ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ) GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) sub_count ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT = sub_count.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.student_year_rank;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) OVER (ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.window_column) = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME THEN NULL ELSE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS department_name, d.enrolled_students_variance, d.enrolled_students_stddev, m.SUBJECT_CODE, m.SUBJECT_NUMBER, m.SUBJECT_TITLE, m.TERM_DESCRIPTION, m.window_column, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM inner_cte d JOIN ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) m ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.window_column;

question: For each organization (excluding organizations '138' and '250', and those not named 'CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST'), and for each academic building (excluding buildings named "Ashdown House") associated with that organization, what is the organization name, the geometric mean of the old department codes for all associated HR organization units where the old department code is greater than zero, the building's full name, the building's postal code, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of its rooms (only including buildings where the average room area is greater than zero), and the total number of rooms in the building? SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ogm.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ogm.geometric_mean, abs.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, abs.POSTAL_CODE, abs.coefficient_of_variation, abs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD))) AS geometric_mean, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD > 0 AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME NOT IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST') GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) ogm JOIN ( SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, a.POSTAL_CODE, STDDEV(r.AREA)/NULLIF(AVG(r.AREA),0) AS coefficient_of_variation, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS a ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.BUILDING_NAME <> 'ASHDOWN HOUSE' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, a.POSTAL_CODE, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY HAVING AVG(r.AREA) > 0 ) abs ON ogm.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = abs.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.geometric_mean, inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, inner_cte.POSTAL_CODE, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, fb.NUM_OF_ROOMS FROM inner_cte JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON inner_cte.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean DESC, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptCoeffVar AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 1 ) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_variance, dc.coefficient_of_variation, ROUND(des.enrollment_variance / NULLIF(des.avg_enrollment, 0), 2) AS normalized_variance FROM DeptEnrollmentStats des JOIN DeptCoeffVar dc ON des.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_enrollment, icte.enrollment_variance, icte.coefficient_of_variation, icte.normalized_variance, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.normalized_variance DESC;

SQL: WITH DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_variance DESC ), PoliSciHGNStats AS ( SELECT c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, s.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON c.HGN_CODE = s.HGN_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 AND c.LECTURE_UNITS > 2 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE HAVING MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) > 2 ), DeptHGNCount AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.HGN_CODE) AS unique_hgn_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_units, d.units_variance, NULL AS HGN_CODE, NULL AS max_lecture_units, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS unique_hgn_count, 'DeptUnitsStats' AS Source FROM DeptUnitsStats d UNION ALL SELECT p.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_units, NULL AS units_variance, p.HGN_CODE, p.max_lecture_units, p.SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS unique_hgn_count, 'PoliSciHGNStats' AS Source FROM PoliSciHGNStats p UNION ALL SELECT h.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_units, NULL AS units_variance, NULL AS HGN_CODE, NULL AS max_lecture_units, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, h.unique_hgn_count, 'DeptHGNCount' AS Source FROM DeptHGNCount h ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Source;

SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ), DeptEnrolledBudget AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d2.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d2.min_num_enrolled_students, d2.avg_dept_budget_code, d1.avg_total_units, d1.total_units_range, d1.total_units_variance FROM DeptUnitsStats d1 JOIN DeptEnrolledBudget d2 ON d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d1.total_units_range DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.min_num_enrolled_students, inner_cte.avg_dept_budget_code, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.total_units_range, inner_cte.total_units_variance, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.total_units_range DESC;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), student_counts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sc.num_students) AS variance_num_students, STDDEV(sc.num_students) AS stddev_num_students FROM student_counts sc GROUP BY sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subject_with_school AS ( SELECT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.window_column, ds.variance_num_students, ds.stddev_num_students, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte ic JOIN dept_stats ds ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.window_column, s.variance_num_students, s.stddev_num_students, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM subject_with_school s GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.window_column, s.variance_num_students, s.stddev_num_students, s.SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING (s.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS IS NOT NULL) OR (s.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NULL AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS IS NULL) ORDER BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE ;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH Dept_CV AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), Dept_Grade_Stats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE, COUNT(c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE ) SELECT dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcv.coefficient_of_variation, dgs.GRADE_TYPE, dgs.subject_count, dgs.min_total_units FROM Dept_CV dcv JOIN Dept_Grade_Stats dgs ON dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dgs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.coefficient_of_variation, icte.GRADE_TYPE, icte.subject_count, icte.min_total_units, tso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND cso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.coefficient_of_variation, icte.GRADE_TYPE, icte.subject_count, icte.min_total_units, tso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.coefficient_of_variation AS admin_dept_coefficient_of_variation, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.coefficient_of_variation AS dept_coefficient_of_variation, d.subject_count FROM inner_cte icte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation, COUNT(*) AS subject_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) d;

SELECT t.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(*) AS subject_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.TERM_CODE, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.TERM_START_DATE, GREATEST( c.TOTAL_UNITS, COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 1) OVER (ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0), COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 2) OVER (ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0) ) AS max_total_units_3rows FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.TERM_CODE ), DepartmentGeometricMean AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LOG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ms.TERM_CODE, ms.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ms.TERM_START_DATE, ms.max_total_units_3rows, dgm.geometric_mean_total_units, CASE WHEN ms.max_total_units_3rows > dgm.geometric_mean_total_units * 1.2 THEN 'ABOVE_BENCHMARK' WHEN ms.max_total_units_3rows < dgm.geometric_mean_total_units * 0.8 THEN 'BELOW_BENCHMARK' ELSE 'WITHIN_RANGE' END AS benchmark_comparison FROM inner_cte ms JOIN DepartmentGeometricMean dgm ON ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dgm.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE dgm.geometric_mean_total_units > 8 ORDER BY ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.TERM_CODE;

es.SUBJECT_TITLE, es.DEPARTMENT_NAME, es.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, es.subject_rank_in_department, es.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, CASE WHEN es.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > ed.avg_enrollment * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN es.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < ed.avg_enrollment * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM EECSSubjects es JOIN EECSDeptAvgEnroll ed ON SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ), GeometricMeanUnits AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, EXP(AVG(LOG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), AvgEnrolled AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.enrolled_students_variance, ic.enrolled_students_stddev, gm.geometric_mean_total_units, ae.avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte ic JOIN GeometricMeanUnits gm ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = gm.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = gm.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN AvgEnrolled ae ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ae.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ae.DEPARTMENT_CODE

ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), UnitsStats AS ( SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER p ON a.TERM_CODE = p.TERM_CODE WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), DeptSubjectCounts AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER p ON a.TERM_CODE = p.TERM_CODE WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), RollupDeptCounts AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(num_subjects) AS total_subjects FROM DeptSubjectCounts GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(num_subjects) > 0 ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.enrolled_range, i.enrolled_variance, u.total_units_variance, u.total_units_stddev, r.DEPARTMENT_NAME, r.total_subjects FROM inner_cte i JOIN UnitsStats u ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = u.ACADEMIC_YEAR LEFT JOIN RollupDeptCounts r ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = r.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, r.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

MIN(tc.num_tip_materials) AS range_tip_materials, VARIANCE(tc.num_tip_materials) AS var_tip_materials, STDDEV(tc.num_tip_materials) AS stddev_tip_materials FROM tip_counts tc JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tc.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE AND tc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, range_tip_materials, var_tip_materials, stddev_tip_materials FROM per_year_stats ) SELECT e.ACADEMIC_YEAR, e.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, e.enrollment_range, e.enrollment_variance, e.enrollment_stddev, t.range_tip_materials, t.var_tip_materials, t.stddev_tip_materials FROM EnrollmentStats e JOIN TipStats t ON e.ACADEMIC_YEAR = t.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND e.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), MaxUnits AS ( SELECT cca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(cca.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cca WHERE cca.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cca.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cca.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.enrollment_range, ic.enrollment_variance, ic.enrollment_stddev, ic.range_tip_materials, ic.var_tip_materials, ic.stddev_tip_materials, mu.max_total_units FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN MaxUnits mu ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = mu.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

evidence: "math" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'" "biology and chemistry department" is predicated by "TABLE.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')" "Course 18" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'" "Course 7" is predicated by "TABLE.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Biology'" "Course 5" is predicated by "TABLE.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000) ) AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NOT IN ('Biology', 'Chemistry') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS min_num_enrolled_students, NULL AS avg_dept_budget_code, MAX(dus.total_units_range) AS total_units_range, MAX(dus.total_units_variance) AS total_units_variance, MAX(dus.total_units_stddev) AS total_units_stddev FROM DeptUnitsStats dus GROUP BY dus.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ) SELECT COALESCE(ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, rr.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS DEPARTMENT_CODE, COALESCE(ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.min_num_enrolled_students, ic.avg_dept_budget_code, COALESCE(dus.total_units_range, rr.total_units_range) AS total_units_range, COALESCE(dus.total_units_variance, rr.total_units_variance) AS total_units_variance, COALESCE(dus.total_units_stddev, rr.total_units_stddev) AS total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte ic JOIN DeptUnitsStats dus ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dus.DEPARTMENT_CODE RIGHT JOIN RollupResults rr ON dus.DEPARTMENT_CODE = rr.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY COALESCE(ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME), ic.min_num_enrolled_students;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS num_subject_codes, AVG(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS avg_clearing_cost_collector FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.num_subject_codes, icte.avg_clearing_cost_collector, (icte.avg_clearing_cost_collector - overall.avg_all_dept_clearing_cost) AS deviation_from_overall_avg FROM inner_cte icte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(avg_clearing_cost_collector) AS avg_all_dept_clearing_cost FROM ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS avg_clearing_cost_collector FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) dept_avgs ) overall ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING COUNT(*) > 10 ORDER BY enrolled_stddev DESC ), UnitsStats AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON ccso.TERM_CODE = tso.TERM_CODE AND ccso.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.enrolled_stddev, u.avg_total_units, u.total_units_variance, u.avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte i JOIN UnitsStats u ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = u.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = u.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY i.enrolled_stddev DESC, u.total_units_variance DESC;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), LibraryReserveStats AS ( SELECT MIN(at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS sum_total_units, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS count_unique_subjects FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lrd.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, icte.total_units_variance, icte.total_units_stddev, lrs.min_academic_year, lrs.sum_total_units, lrs.count_unique_subjects FROM inner_cte icte CROSS JOIN LibraryReserveStats lrs WHERE icte.total_units_variance > 0 AND lrs.sum_total_units > 0 AND lrs.count_unique_subjects >= 1 ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING total_enrolled_students > 50 ), chem_units_avg AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ss.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.department_name, ic.total_enrolled_students, ss.SUBJECT_ID, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, (ss.TOTAL_UNITS - cua.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte ic JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON ic.department_name = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID AND tso.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE JOIN chem_units_avg cua ON ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cua.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' ORDER BY ss.SUBJECT_ID;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptCourseNumberStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VARIANCE(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY var_course_number_ascii DESC ), DeptCourseUnitsStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d1.avg_course_number_ascii, d1.var_course_number_ascii, d2.avg_total_units, d2.total_units_variance, d2.total_units_stddev FROM DeptCourseNumberStats d1 JOIN DeptCourseUnitsStats d2 ON d1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_course_number_ascii, ic.var_course_number_ascii, ic.avg_total_units, ic.total_units_variance, ic.total_units_stddev, COALESCE(gsc.grad_student_count, 0) AS grad_student_count FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS grad_student_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Mathematics', 'Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) gsc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = gsc.DEPARTMENT_NAME

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.avg_cip_program_code, dcs.range_cip_program_code, dcs.var_cip_program_code, ph.HGN_CODE, ph.max_lecture_units, ph.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_program_code, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS range_cip_program_code, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS var_cip_program_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) dcs JOIN (SELECT c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.SUBJECT_ID FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON c.HGN_CODE = s.HGN_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 AND c.LECTURE_UNITS > 2 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.SUBJECT_ID HAVING MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) > 2 ) ph ON dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ph.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_cip_program_code, inner_cte.range_cip_program_code, inner_cte.var_cip_program_code, inner_cte.HGN_CODE, inner_cte.max_lecture_units, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON so.SUBJECT_TITLE = inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.HGN_CODE;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER ) , Total_Courses AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) , Math_Library_Subjects AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT lso.SUBJECT_ID) AS Math_Library_Subjects FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID AND lso.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, icte.GRADUATE_LEVEL, tc.Total_Courses, mls.Math_Library_Subjects FROM inner_cte icte JOIN Total_Courses tc ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = tc.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN Math_Library_Subjects mls ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mls.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.enrolled_range, icte.enrolled_variance, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = ccc.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18'

MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) urv ON gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR = urv.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = urv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_record_count, inner_cte.units_range, inner_cte.units_variance, MAX(CSO.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ATA ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ATA.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = ATA.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ATP ON ATA.TERM_CODE = ATP.TERM_CODE AND ATP.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED CSO ON CSO.TERM_CODE = ATA.TERM_CODE AND CSO.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_record_count, inner_cte.units_range, inner_cte.units_variance ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean_record_count DESC;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(su.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON t.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY su ON so.TERM_CODE = su.TERM_CODE WHERE t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(su.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ), TopZoeStudents AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS unique_students FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND msd.FIRST_NAME = 'Zoe' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY unique_students DESC LIMIT 10 ), DeptSubjectCount AS ( SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t WHERE t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, d.total_enrolled, t.unique_students, s.num_subjects FROM inner_cte d JOIN TopZoeStudents t ON d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = t.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN DeptSubjectCount s ON d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sp.MIT_ID, sp.FULL_NAME, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, SUM(sp.MIT_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR ORDER BY sp.MIT_ID) AS running_sum_mit_id FROM SE_PERSON sp JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = 'Student' AND msd.DEPARTMENT = 6 AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ORDER BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR, sp.MIT_ID ) SELECT icte.MIT_ID, icte.FULL_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.STUDENT_YEAR, icte.running_sum_mit_id, duv.coefficient_of_variation, alu.avg_lecture_units FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) duv ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = duv.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS avg_lecture_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(c.LECTURE_UNITS) > 0 ) alu ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = alu.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.STUDENT_YEAR, icte.MIT_ID;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.COURSE, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS max_cip_program_code, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.COURSE, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) IS NOT NULL ), DepartmentUnitsStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.COURSE, icte.max_cip_program_code, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.var_total_units, dus.subject_count FROM inner_cte icte JOIN DepartmentUnitsStats dus ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.COURSE

SQL: WITH ChemistrySubjects AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS min_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = '5' ), DepartmentUnitsVariance AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), DepartmentEnrolledAvg AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students_2022 FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE LIKE '2022%' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT cs.SUBJECT_ID, cs.SUBJECT_TITLE, cs.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, cs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cs.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, cs.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, cs.SCHOOL_NAME, cs.min_enrolled_students, duv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, duv.total_units_variance, dea.avg_enrolled_students_2022 FROM ChemistrySubjects cs JOIN DepartmentUnitsVariance duv ON cs.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = duv.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN DepartmentEnrolledAvg dea ON cs.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = dea.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY cs.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, duv.total_units_variance DESC;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH student_counts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR ), department_student_stats AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(num_students) AS variance_num_students, STDDEV(num_students) AS stddev_num_students FROM student_counts GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ), math_subjects_stats AS ( SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects, MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.variance_num_students, dss.stddev_num_students, mss.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mss.num_unique_subjects, mss.min_total_units FROM department_student_stats dss LEFT JOIN math_subjects_stats mss ON dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.variance_num_students, inner_cte.stddev_num_students, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.num_unique_subjects, inner_cte.min_total_units, msc.num_distinct_subject_codes FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT cso.SUBJECT_CODE) AS num_distinct_subject_codes FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) msc ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = msc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = msc.ACADEMIC_YEAR ;

Show the department name, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) for regular non-current terms, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) for 2022, the subject ID, and the count of offerings in 2022. SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ss.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND at.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptStddev2022 AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY total_units_stddev DESC ), MathSubjectOfferings2022 AS ( SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccso.SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(*) AS offerings_2022 FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccso.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.stddev_total_units AS math_stddev_total_units, dsd.total_units_stddev AS dept_stddev_2022, mso.SUBJECT_ID, mso.offerings_2022 FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN DeptStddev2022 dsd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN MathSubjectOfferings2022 mso ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY mso.SUBJECT_ID ;

SQL: WITH max_enrollment_per_dept AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Management' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = ( SELECT MAX(tso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso2 WHERE tso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND tso2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ) AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 15 ), management_subjects_2024 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.LECTURE_UNITS, t0.LAB_UNITS, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.GRADE_TYPE, t0.GRADE_RULE, min(t0.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_total_units_by_dept, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Management' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT max_enrollment_per_dept.DEPARTMENT_NAME, max_enrollment_per_dept.SUBJECT_TITLE AS MAX_ENROLL_SUBJECT_TITLE, max_enrollment_per_dept.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED, ms.SUBJECT_ID, ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS SUBJECT_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.LECTURE_UNITS, ms.LAB_UNITS, ms.TOTAL_UNITS, ms.GRADE_TYPE, ms.GRADE_RULE, ms.min_total_units_by_dept FROM max_enrollment_per_dept JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON max_enrollment_per_dept.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN management_subjects_2024 ms ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.total_units_stddev, cov.coefficient_of_variation, avg_enrolled.avg_num_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) cov ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cov.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_num_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND tso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2022%' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) avg_enrolled ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = avg_enrolled.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.total_units_stddev DESC;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptCIPStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_program_code, STDDEV(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS stddev_cip_program_code, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), EECSStudents AS ( SELECT t1.FULL_NAME, t1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(t1.DEPARTMENT) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY t1.FULL_NAME) AS avg_department_code, t1.DEPARTMENT FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t1 ON t0.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT = 6 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT e.FULL_NAME, e.EMAIL_ADDRESS, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.avg_department_code, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS dept_cip_department_name, d.avg_cip_program_code, d.stddev_cip_program_code, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM EECSStudents e JOIN DeptCIPStats d ON e.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON e.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY e.FULL_NAME ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ), coefficient_variation AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ), math_dept_info AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.SCHOOL_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY d.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT cv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cv.DEPARTMENT_CODE, mdi.SCHOOL_NAME, mdi.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, mdi.avg_dept_budget_code, cv.coefficient_of_variation FROM coefficient_variation cv JOIN math_dept_info mdi ON cv.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mdi.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_dept_budget_code, icte.coefficient_of_variation, ccs.SUBJECT_ID, ccs.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM inner_cte icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ) ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccs.SUBJECT_ID;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS avg_clearing_cost_collector, STDDEV(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS stddev_clearing_cost_collector FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_clearing_cost_collector, icte.stddev_clearing_cost_collector, mes.avg_enrollment, mes.enrollment_stddev, icte.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) mes ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mes.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.avg_clearing_cost_collector DESC LIMIT 10;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_program_code, STDDEV(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS stddev_cip_program_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), PoliSciStudentsWithCourseCount AS ( SELECT msd.FULL_NAME, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY) AS degree_granting_course_count FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = scd.DEPARTMENT AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' WHERE msd.DEPARTMENT = '17' AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY msd.FULL_NAME, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR ORDER BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_cip_program_code, icte.stddev_cip_program_code, NULL AS FULL_NAME, NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS STUDENT_YEAR, NULL AS degree_granting_course_count FROM inner_cte icte UNION ALL SELECT p.FULL_NAME, NULL AS avg_cip_program_code, NULL AS stddev_cip_program_code, p.FULL_NAME, p.SCHOOL_NAME, p.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, p.STUDENT_YEAR, p.degree_granting_course_count FROM PoliSciStudentsWithCourseCount p ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, FULL_NAME

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH CIPStats AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, VARIANCE(SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_program_code_variance, STDDEV(SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_program_code_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE IS NOT NULL AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY cip_program_code_variance DESC ), UnitStats AS ( SELECT scd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ), CombinedStats AS ( SELECT c1.SCHOOL_NAME, c1.cip_program_code_variance, c1.cip_program_code_stddev, u1.avg_total_units, u1.total_units_range, u1.total_units_variance FROM CIPStats c1 JOIN UnitStats u1 ON c1.SCHOOL_NAME = u1.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT cs.SCHOOL_NAME, cs.cip_program_code_variance, cs.cip_program_code_stddev, cs.avg_total_units, cs.total_units_range, cs.total_units_variance FROM CombinedStats cs ) SELECT inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.cip_program_code_variance, inner_cte.cip_program_code_stddev, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.total_units_range, inner_cte.total_units_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS num_unique_math_courses, MAX(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON scd.SCHOOL_NAME = inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.cip_program_code_variance, inner_cte.cip_program_code_stddev, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.total_units_range, inner_cte.total_units_variance ORDER BY inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptCoeffVar AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) / AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev, dcv.coefficient_of_variation FROM DeptCoeffVar dcv JOIN DeptUnitsStats dus ON dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_variance, icte.total_units_stddev, icte.coefficient_of_variation FROM ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY avg_total_units DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte ) icte WHERE icte.rn <= 5 ORDER BY icte.avg_total_units DESC;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), math_office_phone_stats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS avg_office_phone, STDDEV(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS stddev_office_phone FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.OFFICE_PHONE IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY stddev_office_phone DESC ), student_office_phone_counts AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS num_students_with_office_phone FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.OFFICE_PHONE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.subject_count, mos.avg_office_phone, mos.stddev_office_phone, sopc.num_students_with_office_phone FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN math_office_phone_stats mos ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mos.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN student_office_phone_counts sopc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sopc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ic.subject_count DESC;
