evidence: "Chemistry" is predicated by "TABLE.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry'" "math" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'" "Course 5" is predicated by "TABLE.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry'" "Course 18" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING total_enrolled_students > 50 ), dept_units_cv AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), dept_avg_enrollment AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_subject_enrollment FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND ss.TERM_CODE = tso.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.department_name, icte.total_enrolled_students, du.coefficient_of_variation, dae.avg_subject_enrollment FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN dept_units_cv du ON icte.department_name = du.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN dept_avg_enrollment dae ON icte.department_name = dae.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each subject title and offering department name in regular terms with more than 5 enrolled students, offered by the Chemistry department (Course 5), and only for courses with materials, provide the subject title, offering department name, the number of reserved course materials, the minimum academic year, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses with at least one associated material record for the department (considering only Chemistry and Biology departments), and the total number of unique materials associated with each subject and department. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "courses with materials" is predicated by "TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N'" "biology and chemistry department" is predicated by "TABLE.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')" "Course 5" is predicated by "TABLE.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry'" "Course 7" is predicated by "TABLE.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Biology'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t.SUBJECT_TITLE, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_reserved_materials, MIN(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON l.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY t.SUBJECT_TITLE, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.num_reserved_materials, icte.min_academic_year, s2.coefficient_of_variation, COALESCE(s3.num_unique_materials, 0) AS num_unique_materials FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, STDDEV_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) > 0 ) s2 ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.department_name LEFT JOIN ( SELECT t.SUBJECT_TITLE, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS num_unique_materials FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON t.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY t.SUBJECT_TITLE, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) s3 ON icte.SUBJECT_TITLE = s3.SUBJECT_TITLE AND icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s3.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: For each subject title and offering department name in regular terms with more than 5 enrolled students, offered by the Chemistry department (Course 5), and only for courses with materials, provide the subject title, offering department name, the number of reserved course materials, the minimum academic year, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses with at least one associated material record for the department (considering only Chemistry and Biology departments), and the total number of unique course materials associated with each subject. Do not return any rounded answers.

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t.SUBJECT_TITLE, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_reserved_materials, MIN(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON l.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY t.SUBJECT_TITLE, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.num_reserved_materials, ic.min_academic_year, s2.coefficient_of_variation, COALESCE(mat.material_count, 0) AS total_unique_materials FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, STDDEV_SAMP(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) > 0 ) s2 ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.department_name LEFT JOIN ( SELECT t.SUBJECT_TITLE, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON t.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE t.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY t.SUBJECT_TITLE, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) mat ON ic.SUBJECT_TITLE = mat.SUBJECT_TITLE AND ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = mat.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ;

question: For each academic year in which the Mathematics department offered subjects in the current term with more than 0 total units, what is the department name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for those subjects, and what are the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of all courses offered by the Mathematics department (which is degree-granting and has non-null total units), as well as the full department name and school name? List the academic year, department name, variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for current-term subjects, variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for all courses in the department, full department name, and school name, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "math" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'" "Course 18" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'" "Course 18" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), dept_info AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.total_units_variance, icte.total_units_stddev, ds.variance_total_units, ds.stddev_total_units, di.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, di.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte icte JOIN dept_stats ds ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN dept_info di ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = di.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For students whose department is '6' and whose department name is 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci', and who are of employee type 'Student', show their first name, last name, email address, department name, student year, the corresponding department's full name, school name, the minimum department budget code over each school name group, MIT ID, the running sum of MIT IDs within each student year group ordered by MIT ID, and the department phone number. Do not repeat the school name if it is the same as the previous row. Order the results by school name, student year, and MIT ID. Do not return any rounded answers.

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT msd.FIRST_NAME, msd.LAST_NAME, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME) AS MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, msd.FULL_NAME FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME) OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.STUDENT_YEAR, sp.MIT_ID) = inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME END AS SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.FIRST_NAME, inner_cte.LAST_NAME, inner_cte.EMAIL_ADDRESS, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.STUDENT_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, sp.MIT_ID, SUM(sp.MIT_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY inner_cte.STUDENT_YEAR ORDER BY sp.MIT_ID) AS running_sum_mit_id, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte JOIN SE_PERSON sp ON inner_cte.FULL_NAME = sp.FULL_NAME AND sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = 'Student' JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd2 ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd2.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.STUDENT_YEAR, sp.MIT_ID;

question: From the top 10 departments with the highest number of graduate students whose department is degree granting and whose student year is 'G', display each department's name, total graduate student count, the subject offered by the department in the term "2014FA" with the highest number of enrolled students (only considering subjects with more than 5 enrolled students), and for that subject, show the subject ID, subject title, the term description, and the running sum of enrolled students within each offer department code group ordered by subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "math" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'" "Course 18" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS total_graduate_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptSubjectsOffered AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY lso.SUBJECT_ID) AS running_sum_enrolled_students, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID AND lso.TERM_CODE = cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL ), DeptTopSubject AS ( SELECT dso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, dso.SUBJECT_ID, dso.SUBJECT_TITLE, dso.TERM_DESCRIPTION, dso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dso.running_sum_enrolled_students, dso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY dso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC, dso.SUBJECT_ID) AS rn FROM DeptSubjectsOffered dso ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.total_graduate_students, dts.SUBJECT_ID, dts.SUBJECT_TITLE, dts.TERM_DESCRIPTION, dts.running_sum_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN DeptTopSubject dts ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dts.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND dts.rn = 1 ORDER BY icte.total_graduate_students DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each department, what is the department name, the department full name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered by the department (considering only departments that have at least one tip subject offered in the term '2019FA'), the maximum number of enrolled students in any subject offered by the department in the year 2019 (only including departments where the maximum number of enrolled students is greater than 10), and the average course description length (in characters) for all courses offered by the department? List the results ordered by the variance of enrolled students in descending order, then by the maximum number of enrolled students in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DepartmentEnrolledStats AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ), DepartmentMaxEnrolled AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS MAX_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME HAVING MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10 ) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dma.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, des.enrolled_students_variance, des.enrolled_students_stddev, dma.MAX_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM DepartmentEnrolledStats des JOIN DepartmentMaxEnrolled dma ON des.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dma.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY des.enrolled_students_variance DESC, dma.MAX_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, icte.enrolled_students_variance, icte.enrolled_students_stddev, icte.MAX_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, AVG(LENGTH(scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION_LONG)) AS avg_course_description_length FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, icte.enrolled_students_variance, icte.enrolled_students_stddev, icte.MAX_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ORDER BY icte.enrolled_students_variance DESC, icte.MAX_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC;

question: For each department in the School of Engineering (excluding the Department of Management) that grants degrees and is not the Biology department, and for each graduate-level subject offered by that department in the 2021FA term, what is the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in all graduate-level subjects offered by that department, the maximum number of enrolled students in any subject offered by that department in 2021FA, the title of the subject with that maximum enrollment, and the number of enrolled students in that subject? SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), dept_max_enroll AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subject_details AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ic.enrolled_range, ic.enrolled_variance, dme.max_enrollment FROM inner_cte ic JOIN dept_max_enroll dme ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dme.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN subject_details sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE sd.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = dme.max_enrollment ORDER BY ic.enrolled_range DESC, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each course in the Mathematics department that is degree granting and offered this year, show the course description, department name, school name, course level, subject title, total units, grade type, the maximum academic year for each course considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by course in alphabetical order, along with the academic year description, the variance of the total units, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of subjects offered in that academic year (considering only subjects with more than zero total units and offered by the Mathematics department), and for each academic year, include a grand total row for the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units across all Mathematics subjects in that year (in the format of nulls for course-specific columns, but with the academic year, academic year description, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) filled in). Present the columns in the following order: course description, department name, school name, course level, subject title, total units, grade type, maximum academic year, academic year description, variance of total units, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units. Do not return any rounded answers.

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.GRADE_TYPE, MAX(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY t0.COURSE ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), MathYearStats AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT i.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.COURSE_LEVEL, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TOTAL_UNITS, i.GRADE_TYPE, i.MAX_ACADEMIC_YEAR, mys.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mys.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, mys.variance_total_units, mys.stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte i JOIN MathYearStats mys ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = mys.ACADEMIC_YEAR UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS COURSE_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS COURSE_LEVEL, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS TOTAL_UNITS, NULL AS GRADE_TYPE, NULL AS MAX_ACADEMIC_YEAR, mys.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mys.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, mys.variance_total_units, mys.stddev_total_units FROM MathYearStats mys ) SELECT rr.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.COURSE_LEVEL, rr.SUBJECT_TITLE, rr.TOTAL_UNITS, rr.GRADE_TYPE, rr.MAX_ACADEMIC_YEAR, rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, rr.variance_total_units, rr.stddev_total_units FROM RollupResults rr ORDER BY rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, rr.COURSE_DESCRIPTION ;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(student_count))) AS geometric_mean_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY GROUP BY DEPARTMENT ) m ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_students DESC ) , DepartmentCIPStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_program_code, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS range_cip_program_code, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS var_cip_program_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_students, dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.avg_cip_program_code, dcs.range_cip_program_code, dcs.var_cip_program_code FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN DepartmentCIPStats dcs ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean_students DESC, dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptCoeffVar AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), MathDeptStats AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MAX(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ss.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON ss.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE AND ss.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcv.coefficient_of_variation, mds.avg_total_units, mds.var_total_units, mds.stddev_total_units, mds.subject_count, mds.max_total_units FROM DeptCoeffVar dcv LEFT JOIN MathDeptStats mds ON dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mds.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ), department_units_cv AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ), department_cip_stats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_program_code_variance, STDDEV(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_program_code_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' AND scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT cv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cv.coefficient_of_variation, cs.cip_program_code_variance, cs.cip_program_code_stddev, cs.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM department_units_cv cv JOIN department_cip_stats cs ON cv.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cs.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, inner_cte.cip_program_code_variance, inner_cte.cip_program_code_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS num_subjects_offered, SUM(COALESCE(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0)) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' AND (d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry') GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) >= 5 ORDER BY num_subjects_offered DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), AdminDeptCourseStats AS ( SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), DeptMaxEnrolledSubject2021 AS ( SELECT s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, MAX(COALESCE(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0)) AS max_enrolled_in_subject FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s WHERE s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' GROUP BY s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.num_subjects_offered, ic.total_enrolled_students, adcs.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, adcs.avg_total_units, adcs.total_units_variance, adcs.total_units_stddev, dmes.max_enrolled_in_subject FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN AdminDeptCourseStats adcs ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = adcs.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN DeptMaxEnrolledSubject2021 dmes ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dmes.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY ic.num_subjects_offered DESC, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), UnitStatsByTerm AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND sos.SUBJECT_ID = ccc.SUBJECT_ID WHERE sos.TERM_CODE LIKE '2016%' AND ccc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sos.TERM_CODE ), RollupUnitStats AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, TERM_CODE, AVG(avg_total_units) AS avg_total_units, SUM(range_total_units) AS range_total_units, AVG(var_total_units) AS var_total_units, DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM UnitStatsByTerm GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, TERM_CODE WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.enrolled_students_range, i.enrolled_students_variance, i.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, r.TERM_CODE, r.avg_total_units, r.range_total_units, r.var_total_units FROM RollupUnitStats r JOIN inner_cte i ON r.DEPARTMENT_CODE = i.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, r.TERM_CODE ;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH dept_stats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), course_stats AS ( SELECT scd.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY, scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(ccc.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2007' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' GROUP BY scd.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY, scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT cs.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY, cs.COURSE, cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cs.subject_count, cs.total_units, ds.avg_total_units, ds.range_total_units, ds.var_total_units, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_CODE FROM course_stats cs LEFT JOIN dept_stats ds ON cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cs.COURSE ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.DLC_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS assignable_organization_count FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND o.DLC_NAME LIKE '%Office%' AND LOWER(o.DLC_NAME) != LOWER('Biology') GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.DLC_NAME ), Dept_Max_Org_Space AS ( SELECT mdh.DLC_KEY, mdh.DLC_NAME AS department, MAX(fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS max_organization_number, su.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY mdh JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON mdh.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY LEFT JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY WHERE mdh.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER > 50000 AND mdh.DLC_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY mdh.DLC_KEY, mdh.DLC_NAME, su.SPACE_UNIT ), Org_Earliest_Load AS ( SELECT o.DLC_KEY, MIN(o.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS earliest_warehouse_load_date FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION o GROUP BY o.DLC_KEY ) SELECT ic.DLC_KEY, ic.DLC_NAME, ic.organization_count, ic.assignable_organization_count, dmos.department, dmos.max_organization_number, dmos.space_unit_name, oel.earliest_warehouse_load_date FROM inner_cte ic JOIN Dept_Max_Org_Space dmos ON ic.DLC_KEY = dmos.DLC_KEY LEFT JOIN Org_Earliest_Load oel ON ic.DLC_KEY = oel.DLC_KEY;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH MathTermStats AS ( SELECT s.TERM_CODE, MIN(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY s JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a ON s.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND ( a.ACADEMIC_YEAR BETWEEN 2000 AND 2020 OR s.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ) GROUP BY s.TERM_CODE ORDER BY s.TERM_CODE ), ChemistrySubjectStats AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_num_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND t0.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' ) SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.TERM_CODE, c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, c.SCHOOL_NAME, c.max_num_enrolled_students, m.min_academic_year, m.avg_total_units FROM ChemistrySubjectStats c JOIN MathTermStats m ON c.TERM_CODE = m.TERM_CODE ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TERM_CODE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.max_num_enrolled_students, i.min_academic_year, i.avg_total_units, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, a.LAST_DAY_OF_FINAL_EXAM FROM inner_cte i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE ORDER BY i.TERM_CODE, i.SUBJECT_TITLE

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH dept_max_enroll AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), dept_max_subject AS ( SELECT dme.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dme.max_enrollment, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sos.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY FROM dept_max_enroll dme JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON dme.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = dme.max_enrollment ), eecs_courses AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t0.DEPARTMENT, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY t0.COURSE) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT dms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dms.max_enrollment, dms.SUBJECT_TITLE, dms.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY, dms.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ec.COURSE, ec.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ec.SCHOOL_NAME, ec.window_column FROM dept_max_subject dms JOIN eecs_courses ec ON dms.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ec.DEPARTMENT ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.max_enrollment, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, icte.COURSE, icte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.window_column FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON icte.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY = sos.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.COURSE;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.enrolled_range, icte.enrolled_variance, dme.max_enrollment, sos_max.SUBJECT_TITLE, avg_enroll.avg_enrollment_2021fa FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN ( SELECT sd2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd2 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos2 ON sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd2.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd2.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' AND sos2.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' GROUP BY sd2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) dme ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dme.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos_max ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos_max.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND sos_max.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sos_max.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = dme.max_enrollment JOIN ( SELECT sd3.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos3.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment_2021fa FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd3 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos3 ON sd3.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos3.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd3.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd3.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd3.DEPARTMENT_CODE NOT IN ('15', '7') AND sos3.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' GROUP BY sd3.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) avg_enroll ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = avg_enroll.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.enrolled_range DESC, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH OrgStats AS ( SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND d.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME != 'ADMISSIONS' AND o.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ), BuildingRoomStats AS ( SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM FCLT_BUILDING b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT' AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY HAVING COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 10 ) SELECT os.DLC_KEY, os.ORGANIZATION_NAME, os.organization_count, os.min_organization_number, brs.BUILDING_NAME, brs.area_range, brs.area_variance, brs.area_stddev, b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM OrgStats os JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON os.ORGANIZATION_NAME = o.ORGANIZATION_NAME JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN BuildingRoomStats brs ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = brs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b ON brs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ) SELECT inner_cte.DLC_KEY, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.organization_count, inner_cte.min_organization_number, inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME, inner_cte.area_range, inner_cte.area_variance, inner_cte.area_stddev, inner_cte.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, CASE WHEN inner_cte.ASSIGNABLE_AREA >= 100000 THEN 'LARGE' WHEN inner_cte.ASSIGNABLE_AREA >= 50000 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS building_size_category FROM inner_cte;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH avg_stddev_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), max_units_school AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ) SELECT a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.avg_total_units, a.stddev_total_units, m.max_total_units, m.SCHOOL_NAME FROM avg_stddev_units a JOIN max_units_school m ON a.DEPARTMENT_NAME = m.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY a.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_total_units, icte.stddev_total_units, icte.max_total_units, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS grad_student_count FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_total_units, icte.stddev_total_units, icte.max_total_units, icte.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptStddev AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptMaxUnits AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ) SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.stddev_total_units, d2.max_total_units, d2.SCHOOL_NAME FROM DeptStddev d1 JOIN DeptMaxUnits d2 ON d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIMIT 10 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.stddev_total_units, ic.max_total_units, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, sy.Most_Common_Student_Year, sy.Student_Year_Count FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR AS Most_Common_Student_Year, COUNT(*) AS Student_Year_Count FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd WHERE msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR HAVING COUNT(*) = ( SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd2 WHERE msd2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY msd2.STUDENT_YEAR ) t ) ) sy ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sy.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ic.max_total_units DESC;

question: Show the department names, the number of associated administrative departments, the corresponding SIS subject code, subject code descriptions, graduate level, and the total number of courses per department, considering only departments that are degree granting and have a non-null department budget code. SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS admin_dept_count, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY admin_dept_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.admin_dept_count, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, Total_Courses.Total_Courses FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS Total_Courses ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.admin_dept_count DESC, Total_Courses.Total_Courses DESC;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), MathUnitsStats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance, COUNT(*) AS subject_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY e ON c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = e.MIT_ID WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND e.EMAIL_ADDRESS IS NOT NULL AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), MathTopFaculty AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, COUNT(*) AS faculty_subject_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY e ON c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = e.MIT_ID WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND e.EMAIL_ADDRESS IS NOT NULL AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_enrolled, d.range_enrolled, d.var_enrolled, m.avg_units, m.units_variance, m.subject_count, f.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS top_faculty_name FROM inner_cte d LEFT JOIN MathUnitsStats m ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = m.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM MathTopFaculty WHERE rn = 1 ) f ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = f.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Biology and Chemistry), in the most recent academic year, provide the department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (only including departments with more than one subject in that year), the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of courses offered by that department (considering only courses with more than 0 total units), and the total number of subjects offered by that department in that year. List the results ordered by department name. Do not return any rounded answers.

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH most_recent_year AS ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ), dept_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ), coefficient_of_variation_by_dept AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.coefficient_of_variation, d.avg_total_units, d.total_units_variance, d.total_units_stddev FROM coefficient_of_variation_by_dept c JOIN dept_stats d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), subject_count_by_dept AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS subject_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED) GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.coefficient_of_variation, i.avg_total_units, i.total_units_variance, i.total_units_stddev, s.subject_count FROM inner_cte i JOIN subject_count_by_dept s ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each administrative department, provide the administrative department name, the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering, the average number of enrolled students per administrative department as a benchmark, and categorize each department as 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' (if its total is at least 10% greater than the average), 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' (if its total is at least 10% less than the average), or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100 ), benchmark_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(total_enrolled) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_enrolled, b.avg_enrollment, CASE WHEN i.total_enrolled > b.avg_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.total_enrolled < b.avg_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN benchmark_cte b;

question: For each academic year and term, what are the academic year, academic year description, term code, term description, and both the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the record counts of TIP materials associated with that term, considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the TIP material status key is not 'NM'? Also, include subtotals for each academic year (the corresponding term code field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all academic years (the corresponding term code field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the academic year if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by academic year and term code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_DESCRIPTION ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY academic_year_sort, term_code_sort) = ACADEMIC_YEAR THEN NULL ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS academic_year, academic_year_desc, term_code, term_description, record_count_variance, record_count_stddev FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 9999 ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS academic_year_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_code_sort, ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, VARIANCE(record_count_variance) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(record_count_stddev) AS record_count_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY academic_year_sort, term_code_sort;

question: For each subject category and enrollment type where the maximum enrollment is greater than 10, provide the number of activities, the earliest start date of the corresponding academic term, and the latest end date of the corresponding academic term. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS activity_count, MIN(t.START_DATE) AS earliest_start_date FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN TIME_DAY t ON d.TERM_CODE = t.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ) SELECT c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, c.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, c.activity_count, c.earliest_start_date, MAX(t.END_DATE) AS latest_end_date FROM inner_cte c JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d ON c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY AND c.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE JOIN TIME_DAY t ON d.TERM_CODE = t.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE GROUP BY c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, c.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, c.activity_count, c.earliest_start_date;

question: For each academic year, list the academic year description, the term code, and the number of reserved library materials for terms that have a count greater than the average number of reserved materials for regular terms in that year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE, COUNT(*) AS term_material_count FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE ), year_avg AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(term_material_count) AS avg_material_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.TERM_CODE, i.term_material_count FROM inner_cte i JOIN year_avg y ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = y.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC WHERE i.term_material_count > y.avg_material_count ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.term_material_count DESC;

question: For each organization and DLC, what is the range and variance of the space unit codes associated with them? Also, include subtotals for each organization (the corresponding organization field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all organizations (the corresponding organization field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the organization name if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by organization and DLC. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY, MAX(SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) - MIN(SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS code_range, VARIANCE(SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS code_variance FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN SPACE_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = SPACE_UNIT.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(organization) OVER (ORDER BY org_sort, dlc_sort) = organization THEN NULL ELSE organization END AS organization, dlc, code_range, code_variance FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(ORGANIZATION_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(DLC_KEY) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE ORGANIZATION_NAME END AS org_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ORGANIZATION_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(DLC_KEY) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(ORGANIZATION_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(DLC_KEY) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE ORGANIZATION_NAME END AS organization, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ORGANIZATION_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(DLC_KEY) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DLC_KEY END AS dlc_sort, DLC_KEY AS dlc, MAX(code_range) AS code_range, VARIANCE(code_range) AS code_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ORGANIZATION_NAME, DLC_KEY WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY org_sort, dlc_sort;

question: For each department offering subjects, list the department name, the subject title, and the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of reserved materials per subject (where the material status is 'U'), considering only departments with at least one reserved material. For each department, include a grand total for all its subjects in the format of (department name, null, total statistics). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED s JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL d ON s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(material_count) - MIN(material_count) AS reserved_material_range, VARIANCE(material_count) AS reserved_material_variance, STDDEV(material_count) AS reserved_material_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(material_count) > 0 ORDER BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For each subject, show the subject code, subject code description, department name, subject title, and the number of subjects in the same department, for subjects where the school code is not null and the subject title is not null. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_CODE IS NOT NULL AND t1.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, dept_counts.subjects_in_department FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS subjects_in_department FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_CODE IS NOT NULL AND t1.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) dept_counts ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: For each department, list the department name, school name, and the number of unique subject titles with materials offered in regular academic terms. For each school, include a grand total for all departments in the format of (null, school name, total subject titles). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.SCHOOL_NAME FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON td.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND td.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_title_count FROM inner_cte ic GROUP BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE) > 0 ORDER BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each department and academic year, provide the department name, academic year, the number of subjects offered that are not repeatable for credit and are offered in the fall term, and classify the department as 'HIGH_ACTIVITY' if it offers at least 10% more such subjects than the average across all departments for that year, 'LOW_ACTIVITY' if it offers at least 10% fewer, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.GRADE_RULE_DESC = 'Not repeatable for credit' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) , dept_avg AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(subject_count) AS avg_subject_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.subject_count, d.avg_subject_count, CASE WHEN i.subject_count > d.avg_subject_count * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ACTIVITY' WHEN i.subject_count < d.avg_subject_count * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ACTIVITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS activity_level FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each department, what is the geometric mean of the area of rooms assigned to employees in that department, considering only rooms with an area greater than 0, and where the department name starts with 'D' (case insensitive) and the average room area is at least 100? Show the department name and the geometric mean of room area. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ed.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(fr.AREA))) AS geometric_mean_area, AVG(fr.AREA) AS avg_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY ed ON fr.BUILDING_ROOM = ed.OFFICE_LOCATION WHERE fr.AREA > 0 GROUP BY ed.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.geometric_mean_area FROM inner_cte ic WHERE UPPER(ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME) LIKE 'D%' AND ic.avg_area >= 100 ORDER BY ic.geometric_mean_area DESC;

question: For each department, what is the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department in 2017 (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students), along with the total number of such subjects per department? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2017%' ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC;

question: For each department, list the department name, the total number of courses offered by that department, the school name, and for each category code, the minimum warehouse load date from the CIP table for courses in that department, ordered by department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.PROGRAM_CODE, c.PROGRAM_TITLE, c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY c.CATEGORY_CODE) AS min_warehouse_load_date FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION s JOIN CIP c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT = 6 ) SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.COURSE) AS total_courses, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.CATEGORY_CODE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS min_warehouse_load_date FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION s JOIN CIP c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.CATEGORY_CODE;

question: For each department, what is the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department in 2017, along with the school name and department phone number? Only consider subjects with more than 0 enrolled students. Sort the results by variance in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2017%' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.enrolled_students_variance, i.enrolled_students_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte i LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY i.enrolled_students_variance DESC;

question: For each school, list its name, the department name, and calculate the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2022. For each school, include a grand total for all departments in the format of (school name, null, total range, total variance). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCD.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCD.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, units_range, units_variance FROM ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, units_range, units_variance FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(units_range) AS units_range, VARIANCE(units_range) AS units_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ) t ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each department long name and department hierarchy level 3 name where the department hierarchy type is 'Standard Hierarchy' and the organization unit level is 'DEPARTMENTS', provide the number of unique facility organization keys, the minimum organization unit ID, and the most recent warehouse load date. Also, include subtotals for each department long name (the corresponding department long name field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all departments (the corresponding department long name field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the department long name if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by department long name and department hierarchy level 3 name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS min_org_unit_id FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m ON f.DLC_KEY = m.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY WHERE m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS' GROUP BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(dept_long) OVER (ORDER BY dept_long_sort, hier3_sort) = dept_long THEN NULL ELSE dept_long END AS department_long_name, hier3_name, org_count, min_org_unit_id, max_load_date FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG) = 1 AND GROUPING(MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG END AS dept_long_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG) = 0 AND GROUPING(MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG) = 1 AND GROUPING(MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG END AS dept_long, CASE WHEN GROUPING(HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG) = 0 AND GROUPING(MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME END AS hier3_sort, MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME AS hier3_name, COUNT(DISTINCT FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS min_org_unit_id, MAX(h.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS max_load_date FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m ON f.DLC_KEY = m.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY WHERE m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS' GROUP BY HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY dept_long_sort, hier3_sort;

question: For the top 10 departments by the number of unique subjects they offered in terms from academic year 2014 or later, list the department name, the count of unique subject titles, and the total number of enrolled students in those subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2014 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.subject_count, SUM(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollment FROM inner_cte ic JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2014 GROUP BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.subject_count ORDER BY ic.subject_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each academic term in the academic year 2020, provide the term code, term description, the number of unique subjects offered, the total number of tip material records associated with that term, and indicate whether the total tip records for the term are 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' (at least 20% greater than the average across all 2020 terms), 'BELOW_AVERAGE' (at least 20% less than the average), or 'AVERAGE'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT a.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(DISTINCT t.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_records FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2020 GROUP BY a.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(total_tip_records) AS avg_tip_records FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.TERM_CODE, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.subject_count, i.total_tip_records, CASE WHEN i.total_tip_records > a.avg_tip_records * 1.2 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.total_tip_records < a.avg_tip_records * 0.8 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS tip_record_status FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_cte a;

question: For each department, what is the maximum total units of any course offered by that department, what is the name of the school that department belongs to, and what is the subject code of the course with the maximum total units, for departments where the maximum total units is greater than 6? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.max_total_units, i.SCHOOL_NAME, c.SUBJECT_CODE FROM inner_cte i JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.SCHOOL_NAME = s.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = i.max_total_units;

question: Among all instructors who have taught courses in the "18 - Mathematics" department and in the "Hayden" unit, list each instructor's MIT ID, the total number of distinct courses they have taught in that department and unit, and their dense rank among all such instructors based on the number of courses taught (with ties sharing the same rank), ordered from most to least courses taught. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.MIT_ID, t0.COURSE_NAME FROM LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR t0 JOIN SE_PERSON t1 ON t0.INSTRUCTOR_NAME = t1.FULL_NAME WHERE t0.DEPARTMENT = '18 - Mathematics' AND t0.UNIT = 'Hayden' ) SELECT icte.MIT_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT icte.COURSE_NAME) AS Num_Courses_Taught, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT icte.COURSE_NAME) DESC) AS Instructor_Rank FROM inner_cte icte GROUP BY icte.MIT_ID ORDER BY Num_Courses_Taught DESC

question: For all subjects in the 2014FA term with at least one enrolled student, show the subject title, offering department name, responsible faculty name, the TIP material status key, the total number of units, and the minimum total number of units in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the course number, along with the cluster type description and the HGN code description for each subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER ( ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, sos.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.window_column, sos.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC, sos.HGN_CODE_DESC FROM inner_cte JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2014FA'

question: For rooms with a square footage of 150, show the building room, room number, space unit code, space unit name, and, for each space unit code, the number of rooms with a square footage of 150, but only include space unit codes that have at least 2 such rooms. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.BUILDING_ROOM, sd.ROOM_NUMBER, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, su.SPACE_UNIT, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ORDER BY sd.BUILDING_ROOM) AS window_column FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY WHERE sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE = 150 ) SELECT ic.BUILDING_ROOM, ic.ROOM_NUMBER, ic.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, ic.SPACE_UNIT, cnt.ROOM_COUNT FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT SPACE_UNIT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS ROOM_COUNT FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SPACE_UNIT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ) cnt ON ic.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = cnt.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ORDER BY ic.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, ic.BUILDING_ROOM;

question: For each department and school, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in offered subjects, considering only degree-granting departments and subjects with more than 0 enrolled students? Also, include subtotals for each school (the corresponding school field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all schools (the corresponding school field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the school name if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by school and department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(school_name) OVER (ORDER BY school_sort, dept_sort) = school_name THEN NULL ELSE school_name END AS school_name, dept, avg_enrollment, enrollment_variance, enrollment_stddev FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(school_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(dept) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE school_name END AS school_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(school_name) = 0 AND GROUPING(dept) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(school_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(dept) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE school_name END AS school_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(school_name) = 0 AND GROUPING(dept) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE dept END AS dept_sort, dept, AVG(avg_enrollment) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(enrollment_variance) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(enrollment_stddev) AS enrollment_stddev FROM ( SELECT school_name, department_name AS dept, avg_enrollment, enrollment_variance, enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte ) base GROUP BY school_name, dept WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY school_sort, dept_sort;

question: For each subject offered, what is the subject id, the academic year, the number of enrolled students, and the deviation from the average number of enrolled students for that academic year, considering only terms that are not the current term? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, (inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS - avg_stats.avg_enrolled) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) avg_stats ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = avg_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each academic term parameter, provide the term parameter name, the department name, and both the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of subjects offered in that term parameter and department, considering only terms that are regular terms. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER ) SELECT ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER, SUBJECT_SUMMARY.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER, SUBJECT_SUMMARY.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

question: For the top 10 building names with the highest number of historical records, list the building name, the number of historical records, the building type, and the campus sector. Do not repeat the building name if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by the number of historical records in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT f.BUILDING_NAME, COUNT(h.FCLT_BUILDING_HIST_KEY) AS hist_count FROM FCLT_BUILDING f JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST h ON f.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY = h.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY GROUP BY f.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY hist_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME) OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.hist_count DESC, inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME) = inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME END AS building_name, inner_cte.hist_count, f.BUILDING_TYPE, f.CAMPUS_SECTOR FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN FCLT_BUILDING f ON inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME = f.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.hist_count DESC, inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME;
