SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.PERSON_ROLE, AVG(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, MAX(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) - MIN(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_range, VARIANCE(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance FROM IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON p JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d ON p.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY WHERE d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.PERSON_ROLE ) SELECT cte.PERSON_ROLE, cte.avg_max_enrollment, cte.max_enrollment_range, cte.max_enrollment_variance, CASE WHEN cte.avg_max_enrollment > overall.avg_enrollment * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_CAPACITY' WHEN cte.avg_max_enrollment < overall.avg_enrollment * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_CAPACITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS capacity_category FROM inner_cte cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d WHERE d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL ) overall ORDER BY cte.max_enrollment_range DESC;

question: For academic terms where the term status is 'Previous', show the term code from ACADEMIC_TERMS, the term description from ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL, the academic year from ACADEMIC_TERMS, the running sum of academic years within each financial aid year group, and the total number of such terms per financial aid year, ordered by academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ) SELECT inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.window_column, term_counts.Total_Terms FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS Total_Terms FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ) term_counts ON inner_cte.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR = term_counts.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each sponsor, provide the sponsor name, the average and variance of the maximum enrollment for their IAP activities, but only include sponsors whose average maximum enrollment is greater than the overall average maximum enrollment across all sponsors. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SPONSOR_NAME, AVG(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, VARIANCE(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS var_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.SPONSOR_NAME ) SELECT SPONSOR_NAME, avg_max_enrollment, var_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_max_enrollment > ( SELECT AVG(MAX_ENROLLMENT) FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL WHERE MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL ) ORDER BY var_max_enrollment DESC;

question: For each department, what is the department code, department name, and the total number of units for all courses in that department, considering only departments whose total units are more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean total units across all departments? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) > ( SELECT AVG(dept_total) + STDDEV(dept_total) FROM ( SELECT SUM(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS dept_total FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) t ) ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_units FROM inner_cte i JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: For each room with an access level of 1, show the building room, building component, floor, space usage, space unit code, the corresponding organization's name, and the highest floor within each space usage group. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.BUILDING_COMPONENT, t1.FLOOR, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 ) SELECT SPACE_USAGE, MAX(FLOOR) AS highest_floor FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SPACE_USAGE;

question: For each person role and term, provide the person role name, term, the average, range, and variance of the maximum enrollment values for the activities they lead, considering only activities that are not cancelled and have a specified maximum enrollment. Include subtotals for each person role (the corresponding term field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all person roles and terms (the corresponding term field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the person role if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by person role and term. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.PERSON_ROLE, d.TERM_CODE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT FROM IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON p JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d ON p.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY WHERE d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(PERSON_ROLE) OVER (ORDER BY person_role_sort, term_sort) = PERSON_ROLE THEN NULL ELSE PERSON_ROLE END AS person_role, term, avg_max_enrollment, max_enrollment_range, max_enrollment_variance FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(PERSON_ROLE) = 1 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE PERSON_ROLE END AS person_role_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(PERSON_ROLE) = 0 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(PERSON_ROLE) = 1 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(PERSON_ROLE) = 0 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, PERSON_ROLE, TERM_CODE, AVG(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, MAX(MAX_ENROLLMENT) - MIN(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_range, VARIANCE(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY PERSON_ROLE, TERM_CODE WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY person_role_sort, term_sort;

question: For the top 10 subject titles by the number of reserved library materials in the term '2009SP', show each subject's title, offering department name, reserved materials count, and the subject's cluster type description and the number of unique terms in which the subject was offered. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials, s.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY reserved_materials DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.reserved_materials, sos.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC, term_counts.num_terms_offered FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT TERM_CODE) AS num_terms_offered FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY GROUP BY SUBJECT_ID ) term_counts ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = term_counts.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY ic.reserved_materials DESC;

question: For the top 5 departments with the highest total subject units in the academic term with term code '2009SP', show each department's name, the total units for that department, the subject title with the highest units in that department, and the number of subjects offered by that department in that term. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' ) SELECT dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dept_stats.Total_Dept_Units, subj_stats.Max_Unit_Subject_Title, dept_stats.Subject_Count FROM ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(TOTAL_UNITS) AS Total_Dept_Units, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY Total_Dept_Units DESC LIMIT 5 ) dept_stats LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE AS Max_Unit_Subject_Title FROM ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY TOTAL_UNITS DESC, SUBJECT_TITLE ASC) AS rn FROM inner_cte ) ranked WHERE rn = 1 ) subj_stats ON dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subj_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dept_stats.Total_Dept_Units DESC;

question: For organizations with an organization level of 5, show the organization name, organization ID, DLC name, HR org unit title, HR department name, HR org unit level, and assign row numbers within each HR department name group ordered by organization name, but only include those where the HR org unit level is 'DEPARTMENTS'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID, t1.DLC_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte WHERE HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS';

question: For rooms on floor 2 with access level 1, show the building room, space usage, space unit name, and the maximum row number (within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by building room) for each space unit. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t0.SPACE_UNIT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.BUILDING_ROOM ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE FROM SPACE_UNIT t0 JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t1 ON t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE t1.FLOOR = 2 AND t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 ) SELECT SPACE_UNIT, MAX(window_column) AS max_window_row_number FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SPACE_UNIT;

question: For each academic year and offering department, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of students enrolled in library subjects offered during IAP, grouped by academic year and department? Also, for each academic year, include a grand total for all departments in the format of (academic year, null, total statistics). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON isd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON at.TERM_CODE = lso.TERM_CODE WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS IS NOT NULL ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, OFFER_DEPT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING ACADEMIC_YEAR IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, OFFER_DEPT_NAME

question: For each library material status, list the term code, the number of reserve catalog items associated with it for each term, and include a grand total for each material status across all terms (with the term code as null). Show the material status, term code, and the count of reserve catalog items, ordered by material status and term code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, lrmd.TERM_CODE, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserve_count FROM LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS lms JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY GROUP BY lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, lrmd.TERM_CODE ) SELECT LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, TERM_CODE, SUM(reserve_count) AS reserve_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, TERM_CODE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(reserve_count) > 0 ORDER BY LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, TERM_CODE

question: For each department in the School of Engineering during academic terms in 2022, list the department name, term code, term description, term start date, the number of subjects offered, and the total subject enrollment number, but only include departments where the total subject enrollment number is greater than the average total subject enrollment for all departments in the School of Engineering in 2022. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT a.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, a.TERM_START_DATE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY a.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, a.TERM_START_DATE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, TERM_START_DATE, subject_count, total_enrollment FROM inner_cte WHERE total_enrollment > ( SELECT AVG(total_enrollment) FROM inner_cte );

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2012, show the department name, subject IDs, and their dense rank considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the academic year description. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte;

question: For IAP subject activities with a maximum enrollment of 12, show the activity title, the dense rank of each activity considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the academic year, and the term description, including only those where the academic term has a non-null term description and there is at least one associated TIP material. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 12 AND t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL ) SELECT i.ACTIVITY_TITLE, i.window_column, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON i.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE;

question: For each subject offered by the library in the term with code '2014FA', show the subject ID, subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, term description, term start date, term end date, and the minimum number of enrolled students for each offering department. Additionally, for each offering department, include a grand total row showing the total number of enrolled students across all its subjects (with nulls for subject ID and subject title). Order the results by offering department name and subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_per_dept FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(SUBJECT_ID) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE SUBJECT_ID END AS SUBJECT_ID, CASE WHEN GROUPING(SUBJECT_TITLE) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE SUBJECT_TITLE END AS SUBJECT_TITLE, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(TERM_DESCRIPTION) AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, MAX(TERM_START_DATE) AS TERM_START_DATE, MAX(TERM_END_DATE) AS TERM_END_DATE, MIN(min_enrolled_per_dept) AS min_enrolled_per_dept FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE WITH ROLLUP HAVING OFFER_DEPT_NAME IS NOT NULL ORDER BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID

question: For rooms on floor 2, show the building room, space usage, the organization name, the HR org unit title, the department name, and the minimum access level in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the building component. Additionally, for each department, show the average access level for rooms on floor 2 as a benchmark, and classify each room as 'HIGH_ACCESS' (if its access level is at least 10% greater than the department average), 'LOW_ACCESS' (if at least 10% less), or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.SPACE_USAGE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.ACCESS_LEVEL, t0.BUILDING_COMPONENT FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2 ), dept_benchmark AS ( SELECT HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ACCESS_LEVEL) AS benchmark FROM inner_cte GROUP BY HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.BUILDING_ROOM, i.SPACE_USAGE, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(i.ACCESS_LEVEL) OVER (ORDER BY i.BUILDING_COMPONENT ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, d.benchmark, CASE WHEN i.ACCESS_LEVEL > d.benchmark * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ACCESS' WHEN i.ACCESS_LEVEL < d.benchmark * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ACCESS' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS access_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_benchmark d ON i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each academic term in 2022, list the term code, term description, term start date, the number of subjects offered and the total subject enrollment number for subjects in the School of Engineering, and indicate whether the total enrollment for that term is 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% greater than the average total enrollment across all 2022 terms), 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% less than the average), or 'AVERAGE'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT a.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, a.TERM_START_DATE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY a.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, a.TERM_START_DATE ), enrollment_benchmark AS ( SELECT AVG(total_enrollment) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.TERM_CODE, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.TERM_START_DATE, i.subject_count, i.total_enrollment, CASE WHEN i.total_enrollment > e.avg_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.total_enrollment < e.avg_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN enrollment_benchmark e;

question: For each organization, provide the organization name, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the department codes (HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) among its associated HR org units, the average department code as a benchmark, and classify the organization as 'HIGH_VARIANCE' if the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is at least 20% greater than the average, 'LOW_VARIANCE' if at least 20% less than the average, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Only include organizations with more than 3 associated HR org units. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS dept_code_stddev FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 ) SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.dept_code_stddev, AVG(h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS avg_dept_code, CASE WHEN i.dept_code_stddev > AVG(h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN i.dept_code_stddev < AVG(h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON i.ORGANIZATION_NAME = o.ORGANIZATION_NAME JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON o.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = h.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.dept_code_stddev ORDER BY i.dept_code_stddev DESC;

question: For each school, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by departments in that school, considering only schools that have at least one degree-granting department and only subjects with more than 0 total units? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_CODE, d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, s.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each academic year, provide the academic year description, the number of unique library subjects offered in IAP subject terms that were not cancelled, and the average number of enrolled students per subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects, AVG(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment_per_subject FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY num_unique_subjects DESC;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description, the geometric mean of the record counts of required course materials (where the record count is greater than zero) for all subjects offered in that year, and the total number of unique subjects offered in that year? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_record_count, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_record_count ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean_record_count DESC;

question: For each employee type and department name where the student year is 'G', show the number of people, the minimum MIT ID, and the list of unique office locations for those employees. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(sp.MIT_ID) AS person_count, MIN(sp.MIT_ID) AS min_mit_id FROM SE_PERSON sp JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.person_count, inner_cte.min_mit_id, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT sp.OFFICE_LOCATION) AS unique_office_locations FROM inner_cte JOIN SE_PERSON sp ON sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = inner_cte.EMPLOYEE_TYPE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY inner_cte.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.person_count, inner_cte.min_mit_id;

question: For each material status, provide the material status key, the average and variance of the record counter for reserve catalog items associated with that status (considering only records where the catalog year is greater than 2000), and classify the status as 'HIGH_VARIANCE' if its variance is at least 20% greater than the average variance across all statuses, 'LOW_VARIANCE' if at least 20% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, AVG(c.RECORD_COUNTER) AS avg_record_counter, VARIANCE(c.RECORD_COUNTER) AS record_counter_variance FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL d JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG c ON d.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = c.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY WHERE c.CATALOG_YEAR > 2000 GROUP BY d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ) , avg_var AS ( SELECT AVG(record_counter_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, i.avg_record_counter, i.record_counter_variance, CASE WHEN i.record_counter_variance > a.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN i.record_counter_variance < a.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_var a ORDER BY i.record_counter_variance DESC;

question: For rooms with an area of at least 300, show the room key, building room, area, building number, city, and the maximum area for each city. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.AREA, t1.BUILDING_NUMBER, t1.CITY FROM FCLT_ROOMS t0 JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS t1 ON t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE t0.AREA >= 300 ) SELECT CITY, MAX(AREA) AS max_area FROM inner_cte GROUP BY CITY;

question: For rooms on floor 2, show the building room, space usage, the organization name, the HR org unit title, the department name, and the minimum access level in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the building component, and also include the department's long name and the DLC name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.SPACE_USAGE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(t0.ACCESS_LEVEL) OVER ( ORDER BY t0.BUILDING_COMPONENT ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2 ) SELECT inner_cte.BUILDING_ROOM, inner_cte.SPACE_USAGE, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t2.DLC_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID

question: For each department, provide the department name and the total number of organizations associated with that department for organizations whose parent is 'EXECVP' or 'CHNCLR', but only include departments where this total is greater than the average number of such organizations per department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS total_organizations FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON d.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON f.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY WHERE f.ORG_PARENT IN ('EXECVP', 'CHNCLR') GROUP BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_organizations FROM inner_cte WHERE total_organizations > ( SELECT AVG(total_organizations) FROM inner_cte );

question: For each department, what is the department name, the school name, the variance of the total number of units for subjects offered by that department, and the deviation of each subject's total units from the department's average, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and that are degree granting? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ssc.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.total_units_variance, sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, (sos.TOTAL_UNITS - AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE)) AS deviation_from_dept_avg FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN inner_cte ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ORDER BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sos.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For all subjects in the 2014FA term with at least one enrolled student, show the subject title, offering department name, responsible faculty name, the TIP material status key, the total number of units, the minimum total number of units in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the course number, and the cluster type description for each subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, sos.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.window_column, sos.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC FROM inner_cte JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID

question: For each subject category, provide the category name, the average and variance of the maximum enrollment across all activities in that category, and also show the difference between the average and the variance for each category. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, AVG(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, VARIANCE(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS var_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d ON c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ) SELECT i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, i.avg_max_enrollment, i.var_max_enrollment, (i.avg_max_enrollment - i.var_max_enrollment) AS avg_minus_var FROM inner_cte i ORDER BY avg_minus_var DESC;

question: For each organization, provide the organization name, the range and variance of the space unit codes associated with it (considering only organizations with a non-null description and space units with a non-null space unit name), and also show the total number of distinct space units per organization. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAX(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) - MIN(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS code_range, VARIANCE(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS code_variance FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY odk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON odk.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL AND su.SPACE_UNIT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.code_range, inner_cte.code_variance, su_counts.total_space_units FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS total_space_units FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY odk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON odk.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL AND su.SPACE_UNIT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) su_counts ON inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = su_counts.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.code_range DESC;

question: For organizations with an organization level of 5, show their organization names, the dense rank of their corresponding HR department names (considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the HR department code from the HR organization unit table), and the HR organization unit title for each department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ) SELECT i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.window_column, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE FROM inner_cte i JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON i.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID;

question: For each library reserve material detail with material status key 'U' and term code '2009SP', show the course instructor key, reserve catalog key, subject offered key, the responsible faculty name, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the responsible faculty name from the associated subject offered. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, t0.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, t0.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL t0 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND t0.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' ) SELECT inner_cte.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, inner_cte.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, inner_cte.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM inner_cte;

question: Show the activity title, enrollment type, academic year description, term start date, and the total number of IAP subject activities per academic year for IAP subject activities with a maximum enrollment of at least 20 and that are not cancelled. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t2.TERM_START_DATE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' ) SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, Activity_Counts.Total_Activities FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS Total_Activities FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' GROUP BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) AS Activity_Counts ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = Activity_Counts.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC;

question: For subjects offered in 2011 with more than 10 enrolled students, how many had a corresponding TIP subject with more than 5 enrolled students? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_subjects FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON so.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = tso.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2011FA' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_subjects_with_more_than_10_enrolled FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON so.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = tso.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2011FA' AND so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10 AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5;

question: Among the top 5 departments with the highest average number of enrolled students in their subjects in 2017 (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students), show each department's name, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrolled students, and the subject with the highest enrollment in that department along with its enrollment count. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2017%' ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_enrolled_students, d.enrolled_students_variance, d.enrolled_students_stddev, s_max.SUBJECT_ID AS subject_with_max_enrollment, s_max.max_enrollment FROM ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY avg_enrolled_students DESC LIMIT 5 ) d LEFT JOIN ( SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS max_enrollment FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) m ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = m.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = m.max_enrollment ) s_max ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s_max.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d.avg_enrolled_students DESC;

question: For each department, provide the department name, the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in TIP-offered subjects (considering only subjects offered in the year 2011 or later and with more than 0 enrolled students), but only include departments where the average enrollment is greater than the overall average enrollment for such subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON c.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t.TERM_CODE >= '2011' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_enrollment, enrollment_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_enrollment > ( SELECT AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND TERM_CODE >= '2011' ) ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description, the department name, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for all library reserve materials offered in terms that have a material status of 'U'? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For each department, what is the department name, the variance of the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects offered by the School of Engineering in the term '2016SP'), and the department code, for departments where the variance exceeds the average variance across all departments? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.DEPARTMENT, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.DEPARTMENT ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT, i.enrolled_students_variance FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT AVG(enrolled_students_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte ) a ON i.enrolled_students_variance > a.avg_variance ORDER BY i.enrolled_students_variance DESC;

question: For each department, what is the department name, the variance of the total units of subjects offered in the 2022 academic year, and the average number of enrolled students in those subjects? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_units_variance, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.COURSE_NUMBER = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_units_variance ORDER BY inner_cte.total_units_variance DESC;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2012, show the subject key, subject title, offer department name, academic year, term description, and assign row numbers within each offer department name group ordered by subject key. Additionally, for each offer department, show the total number of subjects offered in 2012, and classify each subject as 'POPULAR' if its enrollment is at least 10% higher than the department's average, 'UNPOPULAR' if at least 10% lower, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_KEY) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS total_subjects, AVG(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_enrollment FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_KEY, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.window_column, d.total_subjects, d.avg_enrollment, i.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, CASE WHEN i.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > d.avg_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'POPULAR' WHEN i.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER < d.avg_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'UNPOPULAR' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS popularity_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_stats d ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: For each IAP activity that is not cancelled and is offered in a non-summer academic term, list the activity title, the count of distinct subject titles offered in the same term, and the total number of units for all those subjects in that term. Show only the top 10 activities by the number of distinct subject titles. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT iap.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ata.TERM_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT ccs.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL iap JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON iap.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE WHERE iap.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' GROUP BY iap.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ata.TERM_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.subject_count, SUM(ccs.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE GROUP BY inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.subject_count ORDER BY inner_cte.subject_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each department, what is the department name and the geometric mean of the total units for subjects offered by that department where the geometric mean is greater than the overall geometric mean of total units for all subjects with total units greater than zero? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(s.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, geometric_mean_total_units FROM inner_cte WHERE geometric_mean_total_units > ( SELECT EXP(AVG(LN(TOTAL_UNITS))) FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY WHERE TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC;

question: For rooms with a room number of '21E', show the building room, room square footage, building component, space usage, and the minimum room square footage in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by building key. Also, include the warehouse load date from both the SPACE_DETAIL and SPACE_USAGE tables. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, t0.BUILDING_COMPONENT, t1.SPACE_USAGE, MIN(t0.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) OVER (ORDER BY t0.BUILDING_KEY ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE AS space_detail_load_date, t1.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE AS space_usage_load_date FROM SPACE_DETAIL t0 JOIN SPACE_USAGE t1 ON t0.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = t1.SPACE_USAGE_KEY WHERE t0.ROOM_NUMBER = '21E' ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte;

question: For each department, show the department name, the corresponding SIS subject code, subject code description, graduate level, and the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of courses offered by that department and subject code, considering only courses that are offered this year and have a non-null total units value. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ccc.total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccc.total_units IS NOT NULL ) SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, MAX(inner_cte.total_units) - MIN(inner_cte.total_units) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(inner_cte.total_units) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.total_units) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN inner_cte ON scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

question: For academic term parameters where the term indicator is 'C', show the term parameter, the term code, the academic year, the department name of the offered subject, and the running sum of academic years within each department, ordered by academic year. Additionally, for each result, include the subject title and the total units of the offered subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_PARAMETER, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_INDICATOR = 'C' ) SELECT inner_cte.TERM_PARAMETER, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, t3.SUBJECT_TITLE, t3.TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t3 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t3.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE AND inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = t3.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each degree-granting department, list the department name, the subject code, the subject code description, and the average and variance of the ASCII values of the course numbers for that subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s.COURSE_NUMBER FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, AVG(ASCII(inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VARIANCE(ASCII(inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC ORDER BY var_course_number_ascii DESC;

question: For each academic year where the term status is 'Previous', show the academic year, the number of terms in that year, and the running total of terms across academic years, grouped by financial aid year. For each financial aid year, include a grand total for all terms in the format of (null, null, total terms). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ), YearTermCounts AS ( SELECT t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.TERM_CODE) AS num_terms FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(num_terms) AS total_terms FROM YearTermCounts GROUP BY FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(num_terms) > 0 ) SELECT rr.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR, rr.total_terms FROM RollupResults rr ORDER BY rr.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR

question: For subject offerings in the term '2017FA' with a total number of units greater than 10, show the subject title, department name, and the school name from the subject offered summary, course description, and subject code tables, along with their dense rank considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the department code from the subject code table. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t2.COURSE_NUMBER FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS > 10 ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 ON inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER = t0.COURSE_NUMBER;

question: For subjects offered in the 2012SU term with a cluster type of 'S', show the subject title from the summary table, the dense rank of each subject considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the number of enrolled students in the offered table, and the deviation of the number of enrolled students from the average number of enrolled students for that department in that term. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t1.TERM_CODE FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t2.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t0.CLUSTER_TYPE = 'S' ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, TERM_CODE, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE TERM_CODE = '2012SU' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE, TERM_CODE ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, (i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS - d.avg_enrolled) AS deviation_from_dept_avg FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND i.TERM_CODE = d.TERM_CODE;

question: For subjects with an enrollment type of "Advance sign-up required" and a maximum enrollment of 12, show the subject's activity title, term code, maximum enrollment, term description, term start date, subject title, number of enrolled students, the responsible faculty name, and assign row numbers within each subject title group ordered by activity title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 12 ) SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.MAX_ENROLLMENT, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE = t2.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each department, what is the geometric mean of the space unit codes for all space units associated with that department, considering only space units with a code greater than 0, and what is the deviation of this geometric mean from the average geometric mean across all departments? Provide the department name, the geometric mean, and the deviation from the average geometric mean. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE))) AS geometric_mean FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT s ON o.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY WHERE s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE > 0 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.geometric_mean, (inner_cte.geometric_mean - avg_geometric_mean.avg_geom_mean) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(geometric_mean) AS avg_geom_mean FROM inner_cte ) avg_geometric_mean ORDER BY deviation_from_avg DESC;

question: For each warehouse load date, list the space unit code, organization name, HR department name, the HR org unit title, and the sum of space unit keys within each warehouse load date group, for space units with a space unit key greater than 100000. For each warehouse load date, include a grand total for all space units in the format of (null, null, null, null, total sum). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY FROM SPACE_UNIT t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000 ) SELECT inner_cte.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, SUM(inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS total_space_unit_keys FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) > 0 ORDER BY inner_cte.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT_CODE

question: For IAP subject activities with a maximum enrollment of 12, show the activity title, enrollment type, term description, subject ID, and the earliest create date for each activity within each term description group. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_ID, t0.CREATE_DATE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 12 ) SELECT ACTIVITY_TITLE, ENROLLMENT_TYPE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUBJECT_ID, MIN(CREATE_DATE) AS earliest_create_date FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACTIVITY_TITLE, ENROLLMENT_TYPE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each person role, provide the person role name, the average, range, and variance of the maximum enrollment values for the activities they lead (considering only activities that are not cancelled and have a specified maximum enrollment), and also include the total number of such activities for each role. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.PERSON_ROLE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT FROM IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON p JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d ON p.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY WHERE d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL ) SELECT i.PERSON_ROLE, AVG(i.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, MAX(i.MAX_ENROLLMENT) - MIN(i.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_range, VARIANCE(i.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance, COUNT(*) AS total_activities FROM inner_cte i GROUP BY i.PERSON_ROLE ORDER BY max_enrollment_range DESC;

question: For each course in the "Electrical Eng & Computer Sci" department, show the course description, course level, and for each course level, list the full name and email address of students enrolled, assigning row numbers within each course level group ordered by the student's last name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.COURSE_LEVEL ORDER BY t2.LAST_NAME) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.COURSE_LEVEL, inner_cte.FULL_NAME, inner_cte.EMAIL_ADDRESS, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.COURSE_LEVEL, inner_cte.window_column;

question: For each department and school, provide the department name, school name, and the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department and school, considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and offered in the 'Engineering' school. Also, include subtotals for each department (the corresponding school field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all departments and schools (the corresponding school field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the department if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by department and school. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME, sos.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(department_name) OVER (ORDER BY dept_sort, school_sort) = department_name THEN NULL ELSE department_name END AS department_name, school, total_units_range, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(department_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(school_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE department_name END AS dept_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(department_name) = 0 AND GROUPING(school_name) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(department_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(school_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE school_name END AS school_sort, department_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(department_name) = 0 AND GROUPING(school_name) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(department_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(school_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE school_name END AS school, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY department_name, school_name WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY dept_sort, school_sort;

question: For subjects offered in the 2012SU term with a cluster type of 'S', show the subject title from the summary table, the number of enrolled students, the average number of enrolled students for all such subjects, and classify each subject as 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' if its enrollment is at least 10% greater than the average, 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' if at least 10% less than the average, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t2.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t0.CLUSTER_TYPE = 'S' ), avg_enrollment AS ( SELECT AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, a.avg_enrolled, CASE WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_enrolled * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < a.avg_enrolled * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_enrollment a;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description, the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during terms in that year (considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the number of enrolled students is greater than 0), and whether the range is 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' (at least 20 or more), 'LOW_VARIABILITY' (less than 5), or 'MEDIUM_VARIABILITY' otherwise? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.enrolled_range, inner_cte.enrolled_variance, CASE WHEN inner_cte.enrolled_range >= 20 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN inner_cte.enrolled_range < 5 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'MEDIUM_VARIABILITY' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.enrolled_range DESC;

question: For each organization and its associated space unit where the organization is assignable and the space unit code is greater than 50000, provide the number of space units and the minimum organization number, and also include the DLC name for each organization. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION, s.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS space_unit_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_org_number FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION o JOIN SPACE_UNIT s ON o.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE > 50000 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION, s.SPACE_UNIT ) SELECT i.ORGANIZATION, i.SPACE_UNIT, i.space_unit_count, i.min_org_number, o.DLC_NAME FROM inner_cte i JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON i.ORGANIZATION = o.ORGANIZATION;

question: For each library reserve material detail where the material status key is 'U' and the term status is 'Previous', show the subject ID, the academic year, and the deviation of the academic year from the average academic year for all such materials. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND t1.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ), avg_year AS ( SELECT AVG(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS avg_academic_year FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, (i.ACADEMIC_YEAR - a.avg_academic_year) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_year a;

question: For each DLC, provide the DLC name, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the organization numbers for organizations associated with that DLC, and the number of organizations, considering only DLCs with more than five organizations. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_NAME, STDDEV(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY.DLC_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER IS NOT NULL GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ) SELECT i.DLC_NAME, i.org_number_stddev, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS num_organizations FROM inner_cte i JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON i.DLC_NAME = f.DLC_NAME GROUP BY i.DLC_NAME, i.org_number_stddev ORDER BY i.org_number_stddev DESC;

question: Show the space unit code, organization name, HR department name, the sum of space unit keys within each warehouse load date group, and the HR org unit title for space units with a space unit key greater than 100000, ordered by space unit key. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE ORDER BY t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column, t1.DLC_KEY FROM SPACE_UNIT t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000 ) SELECT inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, t3.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE FROM inner_cte JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t3 ON inner_cte.DLC_KEY = t3.DLC_KEY ORDER BY inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT_CODE;

question: For the top 10 subjects offered in the term with the description "Fall Term 2024-2025" that have the highest number of enrolled students, display each subject's offered key, subject title, offering department name, the term description, the number of enrolled students, and the rank of each subject within its offering department (ordered by subject offered key). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' ) SELECT icte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, icte.window_column FROM inner_cte icte ORDER BY icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each DLC key, list the room key and area for rooms whose area is greater than the average area of rooms (with area > 40) in their DLC key. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fod.DLC_KEY, fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, fr.AREA FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fod JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON fod.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE fr.AREA > 40 ), avg_area_per_dlc AS ( SELECT DLC_KEY, AVG(AREA) AS avg_area FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DLC_KEY ) SELECT i.DLC_KEY, i.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, i.AREA FROM inner_cte i JOIN avg_area_per_dlc a ON i.DLC_KEY = a.DLC_KEY WHERE i.AREA > a.avg_area;

question: For each academic year and department, give the academic year description, department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in regular terms, and show the deviation of each subject's total units from the department's average in that year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ) , dept_stats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.TOTAL_UNITS, d.avg_total_units, d.stddev_total_units, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - d.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_stats d ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AND i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, deviation_from_avg DESC;

question: For each school, provide the school name and calculate the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of unique subject codes associated with its courses that are offered by degree-granting departments. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT ) SELECT d.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(inner_cte.subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(inner_cte.subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY stddev_subject_codes DESC;

question: For each academic year, what is the highest total number of materials recorded in any term within that year, considering only those academic years where the total number of materials is greater than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean total number of materials per academic year? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE, SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(inner_cte.total_materials) AS highest_term_materials FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR IN ( SELECT academic_year FROM ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS year_total FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) year_totals WHERE year_total > ( SELECT AVG(total_count) + STDDEV(total_count) FROM ( SELECT SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_count FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) sub ) ) GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each department in the Engineering school, what is the minimum number of enrolled students in its library subject offerings and the total number of units for subjects that have at least one required material? Also, classify each department as 'HIGH_LOAD' if its total units are at least 20% higher than the average total units across all Engineering departments, 'LOW_LOAD' if at least 20% lower, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students, SUM(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT AVG(total_units) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.min_enrolled_students, i.total_units, d.avg_total_units, CASE WHEN i.total_units > d.avg_total_units * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_LOAD' WHEN i.total_units < d.avg_total_units * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_LOAD' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS load_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN dept_avg d;

question: For rooms on floor 2 with access level 1, show the building room, space usage, space unit name, and, for each, the total number of rooms in the same space unit on floor 2 with access level 1. Only include results where the space unit has more than 1 such room. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t0.SPACE_UNIT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.BUILDING_ROOM ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SPACE_UNIT t0 JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t1 ON t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE t1.FLOOR = 2 AND t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 ) SELECT ic.BUILDING_ROOM, ic.SPACE_USAGE, ic.SPACE_UNIT, su_counts.ROOM_COUNT FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT t0.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(*) AS ROOM_COUNT FROM SPACE_UNIT t0 JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t1 ON t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE t1.FLOOR = 2 AND t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 GROUP BY t0.SPACE_UNIT HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ) su_counts ON ic.SPACE_UNIT = su_counts.SPACE_UNIT;

question: For each building located in the WEST campus sector with an assignable area greater than 10,000 square feet, what is the building name, the total number of rooms in that building, the average room area, and whether the building is classified as 'LARGE_BUILDING' (more than 50 rooms), 'SMALL_BUILDING' (fewer than 10 rooms), or 'MEDIUM_BUILDING' (otherwise)? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_rooms, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, b.BUILDING_NAME FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.CAMPUS_SECTOR = 'WEST' AND b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA > 10000 GROUP BY b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, b.BUILDING_NAME ) SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.num_rooms, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_room_area, CASE WHEN ic.num_rooms > 50 THEN 'LARGE_BUILDING' WHEN ic.num_rooms < 10 THEN 'SMALL_BUILDING' ELSE 'MEDIUM_BUILDING' END AS building_size_category FROM inner_cte ic JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.num_rooms ;

question: For each employee type and department name where the student year is 'G', provide the number of people, the minimum MIT ID, and the maximum MIT ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(sp.MIT_ID) AS person_count, MIN(sp.MIT_ID) AS min_mit_id FROM SE_PERSON sp JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.person_count, ic.min_mit_id, MAX(sp.MIT_ID) AS max_mit_id FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SE_PERSON sp ON sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = ic.EMPLOYEE_TYPE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY ic.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.person_count, ic.min_mit_id;

question: For courses offered by the Mathematics department with at least 5 enrolled students, show the course number, subject title, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, and assign row numbers within each academic year group ordered by course number, but only include those courses where the number of enrolled students exceeds the average number of enrolled students for Mathematics department courses in the same academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 ), avg_enrollment AS ( SELECT t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 GROUP BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT i.COURSE_NUMBER, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.window_column FROM inner_cte i JOIN avg_enrollment a ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_students;

question: For IAP subjects with a maximum enrollment of 12, show the activity title, enrollment type, academic year, term description, subject title, and the HASS attribute description. For each academic year, include a grand total for all HASS attribute descriptions in the format of (activity title, enrollment type, academic year, term description, null, total count). Do not return any rounded answers.
