SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 12 ), HASS_CTE AS ( SELECT ic.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ic.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC FROM inner_cte ic JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON ic.SUBJECT_TITLE = t2.SUBJECT_TITLE AND ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT ACTIVITY_TITLE, ENROLLMENT_TYPE, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_DESCRIPTION, HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC, COUNT(*) AS total_count FROM HASS_CTE GROUP BY ACTIVITY_TITLE, ENROLLMENT_TYPE, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_DESCRIPTION, HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ) SELECT ACTIVITY_TITLE, ENROLLMENT_TYPE, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_DESCRIPTION, HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC, total_count FROM RollupResults ORDER BY ACTIVITY_TITLE, HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC

question: For each access level code, what is the access level name and the variance of the number of rooms in the building history for buildings with a nonzero number of rooms and assignable area greater than 0, where this variance is greater than the overall average variance across all access level codes? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT FCLT_BUILDING.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE, FCLT_BUILDING.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME, VARIANCE(FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS num_rooms_variance FROM FCLT_BUILDING JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST ON FCLT_BUILDING.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE = FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE WHERE FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 0 AND FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.ASSIGNABLE_AREA > 0 GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE, FCLT_BUILDING.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME ) SELECT ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE, ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME, num_rooms_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE num_rooms_variance > (SELECT AVG(num_rooms_variance) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY num_rooms_variance DESC;

question: Show the space unit names, the associated organization's names, the DLC names, the DLC keys from the organization, the minimum space unit code in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the facility organization key, and the total number of space units per organization for space units with a space unit code equal to 97500. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS organization_name, t1.DLC_NAME AS dlc_name, t1.DLC_KEY AS org_dlc_key, MIN(t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_min_space_unit_code FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 97500 ) SELECT inner_cte.space_unit_name, inner_cte.organization_name, inner_cte.dlc_name, inner_cte.org_dlc_key, inner_cte.window_min_space_unit_code, org_unit_counts.total_space_units FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS total_space_units FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY GROUP BY t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) AS org_unit_counts ON inner_cte.organization_name = org_unit_counts.ORGANIZATION_NAME;

question: For each space unit, provide the space unit name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the access level for all rooms associated with that space unit, but only include those space units where the average access level is greater than the overall average access level across all rooms. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, AVG(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS avg_access_level, STDDEV(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_stddev FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD zr ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = zr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT ) SELECT SPACE_UNIT, avg_access_level, access_level_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_access_level > ( SELECT AVG(ACCESS_LEVEL) FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD ) ORDER BY access_level_stddev DESC;

question: For each sponsor type, what is the sponsor type name, sponsor name, and the variance of the maximum enrollment across all activities sponsored by that sponsor, considering only activities that are not cancelled and where the sponsor's type has at least one activity with a non-null maximum enrollment? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SPONSOR_TYPE, s.SPONSOR_NAME, s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, VARIANCE(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY WHERE d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.SPONSOR_TYPE, s.SPONSOR_NAME, s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY ) SELECT i.SPONSOR_TYPE, i.SPONSOR_NAME, i.max_enrollment_variance FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT SPONSOR_TYPE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR GROUP BY SPONSOR_TYPE ) t ON i.SPONSOR_TYPE = t.SPONSOR_TYPE ORDER BY i.max_enrollment_variance DESC;

question: For each subject offered in the same term as a TIP detail record with material status 'RQ', show the subject key, subject title, offer department name, TIP material key, and the rank of each record within each offer department name group ordered by subject key, but only include those records where the offer department name starts with the letter 'H'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_KEY) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ) SELECT SUBJECT_KEY, SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE OFFER_DEPT_NAME LIKE 'H%';

question: For students in the "Electrical Eng & Computer Sci" department, show their full name, email address, department name, course description, course level, and assign row numbers within each course level group ordered by the student's last name, but only include those students whose last name is alphabetically after the average last name (in terms of ASCII value) within their course level group. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, t2.LAST_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ), avg_lastname_cte AS ( SELECT COURSE_LEVEL, AVG(ASCII(SUBSTR(LAST_NAME, 1, 1))) AS avg_ascii FROM inner_cte GROUP BY COURSE_LEVEL ) SELECT i.FULL_NAME, i.EMAIL_ADDRESS, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, i.COURSE_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.COURSE_LEVEL ORDER BY i.LAST_NAME) AS window_column FROM inner_cte i JOIN avg_lastname_cte a ON i.COURSE_LEVEL = a.COURSE_LEVEL WHERE ASCII(SUBSTR(i.LAST_NAME, 1, 1)) > a.avg_ascii

question: For each department that offered subjects in the Fall term of 2022, what is the department name, the highest number of lecture units among its offered subjects, the start date of the term, and the total number of subjects offered by that department in that term, considering only departments where the highest number of lecture units among their subjects is greater than 3? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, at2.TERM_START_DATE FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 ON td.TERM_CODE = at2.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at2.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) > 3 ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.max_lecture_units, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, COUNT(ccs2.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs2 ON ccs2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ccs2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.max_lecture_units, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE;

question: For subjects in the "Engineering" school with total units greater than 1, show the subject title, department name, school name, academic year description from ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL, the minimum total units in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the academic year from ACADEMIC_TERMS, and also include the total number of such subjects per department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS dept_group FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY s JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ata.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON s.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 1 ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.window_column, dept_counts.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Total_Subjects FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY WHERE SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND TOTAL_UNITS > 1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS dept_counts ON inner_cte.dept_group = dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each academic year, which department had the highest average number of enrolled students in library subjects (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students), and what were the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrollments for that department in that year? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ata.TERM_CODE = lso.TERM_CODE WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS Top_Department, AVG(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) DESC) AS dept_rank FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) ranked JOIN inner_cte ic ON ranked.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND ranked.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME WHERE ranked.dept_rank = 1 GROUP BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each department, list the department name and the average, range, and variance of the number of supervisees for all space units associated with that department, but only include departments where the average number of supervisees is greater than 1. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT AS department_name, AVG(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS avg_supervisees, MAX(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) - MIN(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS supervisee_range, VARIANCE(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS supervisee_variance FROM SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE JOIN SPACE_UNIT ON SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.DEPT_NAMES = SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY GROUP BY SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT ) SELECT department_name, avg_supervisees, supervisee_range, supervisee_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_supervisees > 1 ORDER BY supervisee_range DESC;

question: List the full names and email addresses of students in the MIT student directory who are in departments belonging to the School of Engineering and whose department name contains the word "Engineering". Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS engineering_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE '%Engineering%' ) SELECT msd.FULL_NAME, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE '%Engineering%';

question: List each DLC key, the corresponding DLC name, and for each, show the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of organizations associated with that DLC key (considering only DLC keys and organization names that are not null), as well as the total number of unique organizations per DLC key. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fdlk.DLC_KEY, MAX(org_count) - MIN(org_count) AS org_count_range, VARIANCE(org_count) AS org_count_variance, STDDEV(org_count) AS org_count_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fdlk JOIN ( SELECT fo.DLC_KEY, COUNT(*) AS org_count FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fo.DLC_KEY ) org_stats ON fdlk.DLC_KEY = org_stats.DLC_KEY WHERE fdlk.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fdlk.DLC_KEY ) SELECT ic.DLC_KEY, fo.DLC_NAME, ic.org_count_range, ic.org_count_variance, ic.org_count_stddev, org_totals.total_organizations FROM inner_cte ic JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON ic.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN ( SELECT DLC_KEY, COUNT(DISTINCT FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS total_organizations FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION WHERE ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NOT NULL AND DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DLC_KEY ) org_totals ON ic.DLC_KEY = org_totals.DLC_KEY GROUP BY ic.DLC_KEY, fo.DLC_NAME, ic.org_count_range, ic.org_count_variance, ic.org_count_stddev, org_totals.total_organizations ORDER BY org_count_range DESC;

question: For each person role, provide the person role name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the maximum enrollment values for activities led by people with that role, and classify the role as 'HIGH_VARIANCE' if the variance is at least 20% greater than the average variance across all roles, 'LOW_VARIANCE' if at least 20% less than average, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.PERSON_ROLE, VARIANCE(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance, STDDEV(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_stddev FROM IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON p JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d ON p.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.PERSON_ROLE ) , avg_var AS ( SELECT AVG(max_enrollment_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.PERSON_ROLE, i.max_enrollment_variance, i.max_enrollment_stddev, CASE WHEN i.max_enrollment_variance > a.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN i.max_enrollment_variance < a.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_var a ORDER BY i.max_enrollment_variance DESC;

question: For each offering department in the 'Engineering' school, show the department name and the average total units of its courses, but only include departments where the average total units is greater than the average total units of all 'Engineering' school courses. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE AS course_number, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.COURSE) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM ( SELECT t0.COURSE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ) dept_courses GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) > ( SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) FROM ( SELECT t0.COURSE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ) all_courses )

question: For each course in the School of Engineering that is degree granting, show the course description, department name, subject code description, and the difference between the number of characters in the course description and the average number of characters in course descriptions for that department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(LENGTH(COURSE_DESCRIPTION)) AS avg_desc_length FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, (LENGTH(i.COURSE_DESCRIPTION) - d.avg_desc_length) AS desc_length_deviation FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each category, list the category name and the highest maximum enrollment among its activities. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY ) SELECT IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, MAX(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS highest_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY IAP_CATEGORY_NAME;

question: For each space unit, show the space unit name, the average and variance of the HR organization unit IDs associated with it, and also display the most common HR department name among those units along with the count of units in that department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, AVG(hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS avg_org_unit_id, VARIANCE(hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS org_unit_id_variance FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT ) SELECT icte.SPACE_UNIT, icte.avg_org_unit_id, icte.org_unit_id_variance, dept_stats.Most_Common_HR_Department, dept_stats.Department_Unit_Count FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Most_Common_HR_Department, COUNT(*) AS Department_Unit_Count FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID IS NOT NULL AND hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) dept_stats ON icte.SPACE_UNIT = dept_stats.SPACE_UNIT AND dept_stats.Department_Unit_Count = ( SELECT MAX(sub_dept_stats.Department_Unit_Count) FROM ( SELECT su2.SPACE_UNIT, hou2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Department_Unit_Count FROM SPACE_UNIT su2 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo2 ON su2.DLC_KEY = fo2.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou2 ON fo2.DLC_KEY = hou2.DLC_KEY WHERE hou2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID IS NOT NULL AND hou2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY su2.SPACE_UNIT, hou2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) sub_dept_stats WHERE sub_dept_stats.SPACE_UNIT = dept_stats.SPACE_UNIT ) ORDER BY icte.org_unit_id_variance DESC;

question: For each department in the School of Engineering in 2022, list the department name, the number of subjects offered, and the highest total subject enrollment in any academic term for that department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT a.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, a.TERM_START_DATE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY a.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, a.TERM_START_DATE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(total_enrollment) AS highest_term_enrollment, MAX(subject_count) AS max_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each DLC, provide the DLC name, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the organization numbers for organizations associated with that DLC, and the number of organizations, considering only DLCs with more than five organizations. Also, include a subtotal row for each DLC (with DLC name 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total row (with DLC name 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the DLC name if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by DLC name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_NAME, STDDEV(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY.DLC_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER IS NOT NULL GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(DLC_NAME) OVER (ORDER BY dlc_sort, DLC_NAME) = DLC_NAME THEN NULL ELSE DLC_NAME END AS DLC_NAME, org_number_stddev, org_count FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(DLC_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DLC_NAME END AS dlc_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DLC_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE DLC_NAME END AS DLC_NAME, STDDEV(ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev, COUNT(*) AS org_count FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY.DLC_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DLC_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 OR GROUPING(DLC_NAME) = 1 ) tbl ORDER BY dlc_sort, DLC_NAME;

question: Show the department code, department name, the dense rank of each department (considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the department's long name), and the total number of departments in the "Sloan School of Management" area with a hierarchy type of "Standard Hierarchy". Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME = 'Sloan School of Management Area' ) SELECT inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, dept_counts.Total_Departments FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS Total_Departments FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME = 'Sloan School of Management Area' GROUP BY t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME ) dept_counts ON dept_counts.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME = 'Sloan School of Management Area';

question: For each department, list the number of IAP activities in 2021 that had a maximum enrollment of at least 20, were not cancelled, and were associated with subjects offered by that department. For each department, also include a grand total for all such activities in the format of (department, null, total activities). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, isd.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2021 AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20 ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS total_activities FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) > 0 ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For subjects offered in the term 2019FA, show the subject ID, subject title, number of enrolled students, department name, and department full name, but only for those departments where the total number of enrolled students across all their offered subjects in 2019FA is greater than the average number of enrolled students per department for that term. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ), dept_totals AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_totals d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE d.total_enrolled > ( SELECT AVG(total_enrolled) FROM dept_totals )

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description, the geometric mean of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during that year (considering only subjects with more than zero enrolled students), and the number of distinct departments that offered such subjects in that year? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_enrollment, COUNT(DISTINCT LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS num_departments FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_enrollment ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean_enrollment DESC;

question: For each department and school, provide the department name, school name, and the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of course materials per subject offered by that department in the term 2017SP. For each school, include a grand total for all departments in the format of (null, school name, ...). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(material_count) - MIN(material_count) AS material_count_range, VARIANCE(material_count) AS material_count_variance, STDDEV(material_count) AS material_count_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ( SELECT TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM TIP_DETAIL WHERE TERM_CODE = '2017SP' GROUP BY TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ) AS detail_stats ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = detail_stats.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = '2017SP' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(OFFER_DEPT_NAME) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE OFFER_DEPT_NAME END AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(material_count_range) AS material_count_range, VARIANCE(material_count_variance) AS material_count_variance, STDDEV(material_count_stddev) AS material_count_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(material_count_range) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_NAME

question: For each space unit, list its name, the number of rooms it contains, and whether it has more than 5 rooms ('Many Rooms' if more than 5, 'Few Rooms' otherwise). For each space unit, include a grand total of all rooms in the format of (null, null, total rooms). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(sd.BUILDING_ROOM) AS room_count FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT ) , RoomCategory AS ( SELECT SPACE_UNIT, room_count, CASE WHEN room_count > 5 THEN 'Many Rooms' ELSE 'Few Rooms' END AS room_category FROM inner_cte ) SELECT SPACE_UNIT, room_category, SUM(room_count) AS total_rooms FROM RoomCategory GROUP BY SPACE_UNIT, room_category WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(room_count) > 0 ORDER BY SPACE_UNIT, room_category

question: For each department, what is the geometric mean of the space unit codes for all space units associated with that department, considering only space units with a code greater than 0, and what is the department's DLC name? Provide the department name, DLC name, and the geometric mean. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE))) AS geometric_mean FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT s ON o.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY WHERE s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE > 0 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.DLC_NAME, i.geometric_mean FROM inner_cte i JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON i.ORGANIZATION_NAME = o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY i.geometric_mean DESC;

question: For IAP subject activities with a maximum enrollment of 12, show the activity title, enrollment type, maximum enrollment, term description, term start date, calendar date, and the day of the week, and assign row numbers within each enrollment type group ordered by activity title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TERM_START_DATE, t2.CALENDAR_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY t1.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIME_DAY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE WHERE t1.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 12 ) SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.MAX_ENROLLMENT, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.CALENDAR_DATE, t2.DAY_OF_WEEK, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN TIME_DAY t2 ON inner_cte.CALENDAR_DATE = t2.CALENDAR_DATE

question: For each space unit, provide the space unit name and the highest average access level that any floor within that space unit has ever had. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, zr.FLOOR, AVG(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS avg_access_level FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD zr ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = zr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, zr.FLOOR ) SELECT SPACE_UNIT, MAX(avg_access_level) AS highest_avg_access_level_per_floor FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SPACE_UNIT;

question: For each department in the School of Engineering, what is the minimum number of enrolled students in any subject and the total number of material records for subjects in that department, considering only those materials with a status of 'RQ'? Also, provide a grand total for the entire School of Engineering in the format (null, min_enrolled, total_material_records). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled, SUM(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_material_records FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(min_enrolled) AS min_enrolled, SUM(total_material_records) AS total_material_records FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME WITH ROLLUP

question: For each academic year and department, list the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered in regular terms, and for each academic year, include a grand total for all departments in the format of (academic year, null, total values). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(avg_total_units) AS avg_total_units, SUM(var_total_units) AS var_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(var_total_units) > 0 ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each major use description, what is the minimum area and the total number of rooms for rooms where the organization is present in the FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY table, and also indicate whether the total number of rooms is above or below the average number of rooms per major use description? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(r.AREA) AS min_area, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS total_rooms, r.MAJOR_USE_DESC FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY GROUP BY r.MAJOR_USE_DESC ), avg_rooms AS ( SELECT AVG(total_rooms) AS avg_total_rooms FROM ( SELECT COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS total_rooms FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY GROUP BY r.MAJOR_USE_DESC ) t ) SELECT cte.MAJOR_USE_DESC, cte.min_area, cte.total_rooms, CASE WHEN cte.total_rooms > a.avg_total_rooms THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN cte.total_rooms < a.avg_total_rooms THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS room_count_category FROM inner_cte cte CROSS JOIN avg_rooms a;

question: For each offering department name and course number description where the number of enrolled students in the library subject offered is greater than 3, show the number of distinct ISBNs in TIP_DETAIL, the minimum responsible faculty MIT ID from TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED, and the total number of TIP_DETAIL records per offering department name and course number description. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT t.ISBN) AS isbn_count, MIN(ts.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID) AS min_faculty_mit_id FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ts ON t.SUBJECT_ID = ts.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, inner_cte.isbn_count, inner_cte.min_faculty_mit_id, dept_counts.total_tip_detail_records FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, COUNT(t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_tip_detail_records FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC ) AS dept_counts ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_counts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC = dept_counts.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC;

question: For each department in the 2012SU term, list the department name, the variance of the total units for subjects offered, and the average number of enrolled students per subject. Sort the results by variance of total units in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON tso.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_units_variance, AVG(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ss.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_units_variance ORDER BY inner_cte.total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each subject category that had at least 5 activities in the 2021JA term, show the subject category key, the category name, the number of activities, the total maximum enrollment across those activities, and the description of the subject category. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS activity_count, SUM(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS total_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d ON c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE d.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' GROUP BY c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME HAVING COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) >= 5 ) SELECT inner_cte.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, inner_cte.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, inner_cte.activity_count, inner_cte.total_max_enrollment, c.IAP_CATEGORY_DESC FROM inner_cte JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON inner_cte.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY;

question: List the top 10 building names with the highest number of historical records, along with their building type, ownership type, and the total number of historical records for each building. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT f.BUILDING_NAME, COUNT(h.FCLT_BUILDING_HIST_KEY) AS hist_count FROM FCLT_BUILDING f JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST h ON f.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY = h.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY GROUP BY f.BUILDING_NAME ) SELECT f.BUILDING_NAME, f.BUILDING_TYPE, f.OWNERSHIP_TYPE, inner_cte.hist_count FROM FCLT_BUILDING f JOIN inner_cte ON f.BUILDING_NAME = inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.hist_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each organization whose major organization is 'PROVST' or 'CHNCLR' and that has more than 2 distinct space units, provide the organization name, the total number of distinct space units, and the total number of unique DLC keys associated with those space units. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS num_space_units FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fodk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON fodk.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY WHERE fo.MAJOR_ORG IN ('PROVST', 'CHNCLR') GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) > 2 ) SELECT ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.num_space_units, COUNT(DISTINCT su.DLC_KEY) AS num_unique_dlc_keys FROM inner_cte ic JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME = fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY GROUP BY ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.num_space_units;

question: For subjects offered in the term '2016SP' by departments that grant degrees, show the subject IDs, their total units, and their dense rank considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the total number of units, but only include those subjects where the total units is greater than the average total units for all subjects offered in '2016SP' by degree-granting departments. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t2.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT SUBJECT_ID, TOTAL_UNITS, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE TOTAL_UNITS > ( SELECT AVG(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' )

question: For each subject offered in the term '2009SP', list the subject title, the offering department name, the count of reserved library materials, and the total number of enrolled students for that subject. Show only the top 10 subjects by the number of reserved materials. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials, s.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.reserved_materials, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON i.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID AND s.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' ORDER BY i.reserved_materials DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For departments that offered more than 5 unique subjects in terms from the academic year 2014 or later, list the department name, the count of unique subject titles, and the total number of enrolled students in those subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2014 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.subject_count, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2014 GROUP BY inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.subject_count HAVING inner_cte.subject_count > 5 ORDER BY total_enrolled_students DESC;

question: For each term and department, what is the term, department, and the variance of the reserve catalog keys for courses in that department and term where the material status is 'U'? Include subtotals for each term (the corresponding term field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all terms (the corresponding term field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the term if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by term and department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, lrmd.TERM_CODE, VARIANCE(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY lci.DEPARTMENT, lrmd.TERM_CODE ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(term) OVER (ORDER BY term_sort, term, dept_sort) = term THEN NULL ELSE term END AS term, dept, catalog_key_variance FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT END AS dept_sort, DEPARTMENT AS dept, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM ( SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, lrmd.TERM_CODE, lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY FROM LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ) base GROUP BY TERM_CODE, DEPARTMENT WITH ROLLUP ) tbltmp ORDER BY term_sort, dept_sort;

question: For all spaces used as research centers, what is the minimum room square footage and the total number of rooms, along with the building component for each group of building components? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS min_square_footage, SUM(sd.ROOM_COUNTER) AS total_rooms, sd.BUILDING_COMPONENT FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_USAGE su ON sd.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = su.SPACE_USAGE_KEY WHERE su.SPACE_USAGE = 'RESEARCH CENTER' GROUP BY sd.BUILDING_COMPONENT ) SELECT ic.BUILDING_COMPONENT, ic.min_square_footage, ic.total_rooms FROM inner_cte ic;

question: For organizations whose parent is 'EXECVP' and that have at least one associated space unit, what is the minimum organization number, the sum of organization IDs, and the count of distinct space units for each organization? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_org_number, SUM(fo.ORGANIZATION_ID) AS sum_org_id, fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fodk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON fodk.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE fo.ORG_PARENT = 'EXECVP' GROUP BY fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) SELECT inner_cte.min_org_number, inner_cte.sum_org_id, COUNT(DISTINCT su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS space_unit_count FROM inner_cte JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON inner_cte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY GROUP BY inner_cte.min_org_number, inner_cte.sum_org_id

question: For each space unit, provide the space unit name and the average and variance of the HR organization unit IDs associated with it, but only include those space units where the average HR organization unit ID is greater than the overall average HR organization unit ID across all space units. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, AVG(hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS avg_org_unit_id, VARIANCE(hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS org_unit_id_variance FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT ) SELECT SPACE_UNIT, avg_org_unit_id, org_unit_id_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_org_unit_id > ( SELECT AVG(hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID IS NOT NULL ) ORDER BY org_unit_id_variance DESC;

question: Among the top 5 departments with the highest variance in assigned space unit codes (considering only those with a non-null DLC key and at least one associated space unit), show each department's name, the average and variance of its space unit codes, and the name and code of the space unit with the highest code value in that department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, AVG(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS avg_space_unit_code, VARIANCE(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS var_space_unit_code FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fodk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON fodk.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE fodk.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) SELECT icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.avg_space_unit_code, icte.var_space_unit_code, su.SPACE_UNIT AS max_space_unit_name, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE AS max_space_unit_code FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ( SELECT su1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, su1.SPACE_UNIT, su1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE FROM SPACE_UNIT su1 JOIN ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, MAX(SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS max_code FROM SPACE_UNIT GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) su2 ON su1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY AND su1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = su2.max_code ) su ON icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY icte.var_space_unit_code DESC LIMIT 5;

question: For each subject offered by the School of Engineering, what is the subject title, the number of enrolled students, the total number of material records with status 'RQ', and whether the subject is 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% less than the average enrolled students for Engineering subjects), 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% more than the average), or 'AVERAGE'? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, SUM(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_material_records FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ), avg_enrollment AS ( SELECT AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.total_material_records, CASE WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_enrolled * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < a.avg_enrolled * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_enrollment a;

question: List the top 10 subject titles by the number of materials offered, including the subject title, department name, total count of materials, and the academic year, for subjects in regular academic terms. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON td.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND td.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.material_count, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.material_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each subject offered in the term "2005FA", show the subject title from the subject summary, the number of enrolled students from the subject offered table, the department name from the subject summary, the term description from the academic terms table, the school name from the subject summary, and the average number of enrolled students within each subject title group ordered by department name. Do not repeat the department name if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by department name and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ss.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON tso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(DEPARTMENT_NAME) OVER (ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE) = DEPARTMENT_NAME THEN NULL ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS department_name, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, TERM_DESCRIPTION, SCHOOL_NAME, avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For IAP subject activities with a maximum enrollment of 30, show the activity title, enrollment type, prerequisites, term code, term description, term start date, term end date, the minimum term start date over each term code group, and the total number of such activities per term code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t0.PREREQUISITES, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, min(t1.TERM_START_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.TERM_CODE ORDER BY t0.TERM_CODE) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 30 ) SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.PREREQUISITES, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.TERM_END_DATE, inner_cte.window_column, term_counts.total_activities FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, COUNT(*) AS total_activities FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 30 GROUP BY t0.TERM_CODE ) term_counts ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = term_counts.TERM_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.TERM_CODE;

question: From the top 10 subjects offered in the term '2014FA' with the highest number of enrolled students (according to the library subject data), display each subject's title from the library, the number of enrolled students in the library subject, the responsible faculty name and offer department name from the TIP subject, and the minimum number of enrolled students in the library subject within a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the TIP subject's responsible faculty MIT ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( ORDER BY t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Show the department names, academic years, the number of non-repeatable-for-credit subjects offered in the fall term, and the corresponding subject codes and subject titles for those subjects, for the top 10 departments by subject count. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.GRADE_RULE_DESC = 'Not repeatable for credit' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.subject_count, ccso.SUBJECT_CODE, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM inner_cte icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR WHERE ccso.GRADE_RULE_DESC = 'Not repeatable for credit' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' ORDER BY icte.subject_count DESC, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccso.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: Show the building room, space usage, organization name, HR org unit title, department name, and the minimum access level in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the building component for rooms on floor 2, and also include the total number of rooms per department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.SPACE_USAGE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(t0.ACCESS_LEVEL) OVER (ORDER BY t0.BUILDING_COMPONENT ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS dept_name FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2 ) SELECT inner_cte.BUILDING_ROOM, inner_cte.SPACE_USAGE, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, RoomCounts.Total_Rooms FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS dept_name, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.BUILDING_ROOM) AS Total_Rooms FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2 GROUP BY t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS RoomCounts ON inner_cte.dept_name = RoomCounts.dept_name;

question: For each building, what is the building number, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of its rooms, and the number of rooms, considering only buildings that have more than five rooms and where the average room area is greater than 300? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.BUILDING_NUMBER, STDDEV(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA) AS area_stddev, COUNT(*) AS room_count, AVG(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA) AS avg_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.BUILDING_NUMBER HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ) SELECT BUILDING_NUMBER, area_stddev, room_count FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_area > 300 ORDER BY area_stddev DESC;

question: For each administrative department, give the administrative department name and the highest total number of enrolled students in any term for subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering, where the total number of enrolled students in that term is greater than 100. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100 ) SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(total_enrolled) AS highest_term_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For subjects in the "Engineering" school with total units equal to 1, show the subject ID, subject title, department name, academic year, the rank of each subject within its academic year group ordered by subject ID, and also include the term description and term start date for each subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t1.TERM_CODE FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 1 ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.window_column, t3.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t3.TERM_START_DATE FROM inner_cte INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t3 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t3.TERM_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each academic year, which library material status has the highest geometric mean of TIP material record counts (considering only records where the record count is greater than zero), and what is that geometric mean? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, EXP(AVG(LN(td.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON at.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE WHERE td.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ic.geometric_mean_record_count FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(geometric_mean_record_count) AS max_geom_mean FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) max_cte ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = max_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AND ic.geometric_mean_record_count = max_cte.max_geom_mean ORDER BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC;

question: For departments in the "Sloan School of Management" area with a hierarchy type of "Standard Hierarchy", show the department code, department name, the dense rank of each department considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the department's long name, and also include the corresponding DLC name from the MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY table. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME = 'Sloan School of Management Area' ) SELECT i.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.window_column, m.DLC_NAME FROM inner_cte i JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m ON i.DLC_KEY = m.DLC_KEY;

question: For each subject that has at least one enrolled student and a total unit value of at least 9, show the subject title, the number of enrolled students, the term code from the library subject offered table, the tip material status key, the total units from the subject offered summary, and the average number of enrolled students within each subject title group ordered by total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.TERM_CODE, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID INNER JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS >= 9

question: For each DLC, provide the DLC name, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the organization numbers for organizations associated with that DLC, the average organization number as a benchmark, and whether the DLC is a 'HIGH_VARIANCE' (standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) at least 20% greater than the average), 'LOW_VARIANCE' (standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) at least 20% less than the average), or 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE'. Only include DLCs with more than five organizations. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_NAME, STDDEV(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY.DLC_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER IS NOT NULL GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ) SELECT o.DLC_NAME, i.org_number_stddev, AVG(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_avg, CASE WHEN i.org_number_stddev > AVG(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN i.org_number_stddev < AVG(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION o JOIN inner_cte i ON o.DLC_NAME = i.DLC_NAME WHERE o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.DLC_NAME, i.org_number_stddev ORDER BY i.org_number_stddev DESC;

question: For each subject that has at least one enrolled student, show the subject title, the number of enrolled students, the term code from the library subject offered table, the tip material status key, the total units from the subject offered summary, and the maximum number of enrolled students within each subject title group ordered by total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.TERM_CODE, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID INNER JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled_students, TERM_CODE, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_CODE, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TOTAL_UNITS;

question: For subjects offered in the term '2009JA', show the subject title from the library, the number of enrolled students from the tip subject offered table, the library material status key from the reserve material detail, and also include the offer department name from the library subject offered table. Assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the library material status key. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lrd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON lso.TERM_CODE = tso.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrd ON tso.TERM_CODE = lrd.TERM_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2009JA' ) SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lrd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY lrd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON lso.TERM_CODE = tso.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrd ON tso.TERM_CODE = lrd.TERM_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2009JA'

question: For organizations with an organization level of 5, show their organization names, the dense rank of their corresponding HR department names (considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the HR department code from the HR organization unit table), and the HR department's full name and school/area name. Do not repeat the organization name if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by organization name and HR department code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(ORGANIZATION_NAME) OVER (ORDER BY ORGANIZATION_NAME, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = ORGANIZATION_NAME THEN NULL ELSE ORGANIZATION_NAME END AS organization_name, window_column, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME FROM inner_cte ORDER BY organization_name, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each subject category that had at least 5 activities in the 2021JA term, show the subject category key, the category name, the number of activities, the total maximum enrollment across those activities, and classify the category as 'HIGH_CAPACITY' if its total maximum enrollment is at least 20% greater than the average total maximum enrollment across all qualifying categories, 'LOW_CAPACITY' if at least 20% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS activity_count, SUM(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS total_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d ON c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE d.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' GROUP BY c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME HAVING COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) >= 5 ), avg_enrollment AS ( SELECT AVG(total_max_enrollment) AS avg_total_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, i.activity_count, i.total_max_enrollment, CASE WHEN i.total_max_enrollment > a.avg_total_max_enrollment * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_CAPACITY' WHEN i.total_max_enrollment < a.avg_total_max_enrollment * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_CAPACITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS capacity_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_enrollment a;

question: For each subject that has a library material status of 'U' and a tip material status of 'RQ', what is the minimum library material status key, the total record count, and the term code from the library reserve material detail table? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) AS min_material_status, SUM(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_records, lrmd.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lrmd.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY lrmd.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT i.min_material_status, i.total_records, lrmd.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte i JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON i.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each department, what is the highest average total units for subjects it has ever offered in a regular academic term? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.TERM_CODE, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.TERM_CODE ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(avg_total_units) AS highest_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY highest_avg_total_units DESC;

question: For each department hierarchy level 2 name, what is the variance of the organization number for organizations that have a non-null description and are associated with a space unit, and what is the average organization number for each department hierarchy level 2 as a benchmark? Also, for each department, indicate whether its variance is 'HIGH_VARIANCE' (at least 20% greater than the average variance across all departments), 'LOW_VARIANCE' (at least 20% less than the average variance), or 'AVERAGE'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, VARIANCE(f.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT s ON f.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY WHERE f.DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME ) SELECT i.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, i.org_number_variance, avg_stats.avg_org_number, CASE WHEN i.org_number_variance > stats.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN i.org_number_variance < stats.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, AVG(f.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS avg_org_number FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT s ON f.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY WHERE f.DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME ) avg_stats ON i.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = avg_stats.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(org_number_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte ) stats ORDER BY i.org_number_variance DESC;

question: For each subject offered in the term with term code '2012SU', show the subject title, offer department name, offer school name, cluster type description, and the difference between the number of enrolled students for that subject and the average number of enrolled students for all subjects in the same department in that term. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, t1.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE TERM_CODE = '2012SU' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, i.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC, (i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS - d.avg_enrolled) AS deviation_from_dept_avg FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.OFFER_DEPT_CODE;

question: Among all academic years, which academic year and its description had the highest variance in the number of tip detail records for subjects offered in the fall term (with at least one associated tip detail record), and what is the department most represented among those subjects in that year, along with the count of such subjects from that department? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t1.record_count_variance, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Most_Represented_Department, t2.Subject_Count FROM ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(record_count_variance) AS record_count_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC LIMIT 1 ) t1 JOIN ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME ) t2 ON t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND t2.rn = 1 ORDER BY t1.record_count_variance DESC;

question: For each department offering a course, what is the maximum average enrollment among all terms for courses that have at least one associated TIP material and where the total units for the course are greater than 0? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.RECORD_COUNT >= 1 AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(avg_enrollment) AS max_avg_enrollment_per_term FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY max_avg_enrollment_per_term DESC;

question: From the top 10 organizations with the highest average organization key (within each organization key group), display each organization's name, organization key, department name, department code, the average organization key for its group, the HR org unit title, and the HR org unit level. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1 ) SELECT icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, icte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.window_column, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON icte.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID ORDER BY icte.window_column DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Among the top 5 departments with the highest number of 12-unit subjects offered in the Fall Term 2024-2025, list each department's name, the total count of such subjects, the school name, the subject with the highest enrollment in that department (show its subject ID and title), and the enrollment number for that subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SCHOOL_NAME, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(ic.SUBJECT_ID) AS Subject_Count, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic2.SUBJECT_ID AS Top_Subject_ID, ic2.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Top_Subject_Title, ic2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER AS Top_Subject_Enrollment FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER DESC, SUBJECT_ID) AS rn FROM inner_cte ) ic2 ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic2.rn = 1 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic2.SUBJECT_ID, ic2.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER ORDER BY Subject_Count DESC LIMIT 5;

question: For each subject title, what is the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of all subjects with that title, considering only subjects offered in the term '2010FA' and with a library material status of 'U'? Additionally, for each subject title, indicate whether the average total units is 'HIGH_LOAD' (at least 10% greater than the overall average for all such subjects), 'LOW_LOAD' (at least 10% less than the overall average), or 'AVERAGE'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t.TERM_CODE = '2010FA' AND l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.total_units_variance, i.total_units_stddev, i.avg_total_units, CASE WHEN i.avg_total_units > o.overall_avg * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_LOAD' WHEN i.avg_total_units < o.overall_avg * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_LOAD' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS load_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(avg_total_units) AS overall_avg FROM inner_cte ) o ORDER BY i.total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each academic year, what is the geometric mean of the record counts of TIP materials for each library material status, considering only records where the record count is greater than zero, and also show the total number of TIP materials for each group? Do not return any rounded answers.
