SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, EXP(AVG(LN(td.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON at.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE WHERE td.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ic.geometric_mean_record_count, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_tip_materials FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON at.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE WHERE td.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ic.geometric_mean_record_count ORDER BY ic.geometric_mean_record_count DESC;

question: For all subjects in the 2014FA term with at least one enrolled student, show the subject title, offering department name, responsible faculty name, the TIP material status key, the total number of units, the minimum total number of units in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the course number, and the corresponding offer school name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TOTAL_UNITS, window_column, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte;

question: For organizations whose parent is 'S H&SS', show the organization name, description, the HR org unit title, and the HR department name, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the organization name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.ORG_PARENT = 'S H&SS' ) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID

question: For each space unit with a space unit code of 402100, show the space unit key, the organization name, the DLC name, the DLC key from FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY, and the rank of each record within each DLC key group ordered by space unit key. Additionally, for each DLC key, include a grand total count of space units with code 402100 in the format of (null, null, null, DLC key, null, total count). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.DLC_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DLC_KEY ORDER BY t2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 402100 ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT DLC_KEY, COUNT(*) AS total_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DLC_KEY WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ) SELECT CASE WHEN r.DLC_KEY IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE i.SPACE_UNIT_KEY END AS SPACE_UNIT_KEY, CASE WHEN r.DLC_KEY IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE i.ORGANIZATION_NAME END AS ORGANIZATION_NAME, CASE WHEN r.DLC_KEY IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE i.DLC_NAME END AS DLC_NAME, r.DLC_KEY, CASE WHEN r.DLC_KEY IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE i.window_column END AS window_column, r.total_count FROM RollupResults r LEFT JOIN inner_cte i ON r.DLC_KEY = i.DLC_KEY ORDER BY r.DLC_KEY, i.SPACE_UNIT_KEY

question: From the top 10 departments with the highest total number of course materials in the term 2017SP, display each department's name, total course material count, the subject with the most course materials in that department, and the number of materials for that subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = TIP_DETAIL.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = '2017SP' AND TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = '2017SP' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT dept_stats.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dept_stats.total_materials, subj_stats.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Top_Subject, subj_stats.material_count AS Top_Subject_Material_Count FROM ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(material_count) AS total_materials FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) dept_stats LEFT JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, material_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY material_count DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte ) subj_stats ON dept_stats.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = subj_stats.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND subj_stats.rn = 1 ORDER BY dept_stats.total_materials DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each building located on the MIT site with more than 5 rooms, what is the building's long name, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the areas of its rooms, and the name of the organization that occupies the largest number of rooms in that building? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ) SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, ic.area_stddev, org.ORGANIZATION_NAME FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(*) AS org_room_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM FCLT_ROOMS r GROUP BY r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, r.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) org ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = org.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND org.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.area_stddev DESC;

question: For subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering with a total of at least 6 units, show the subject code, subject title, department name, and the maximum total units for each grade type. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.GRADE_TYPE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ) SELECT GRADE_TYPE, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY GRADE_TYPE;

question: For IAP subject activities with a maximum enrollment of at least 20, show the activity title, the dense rank of each activity considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the academic year of the associated term, and the term description. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20 ) SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.window_column, t2.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t2 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE;

question: For subjects in the academic term with term code '2009SP', show the subject title, department name, total units, and the academic year description, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.TERM_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.TOTAL_UNITS, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.window_column FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ic.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE;

question: For each academic term in 2014, provide the term code, term description, the number of unique TIP subjects offered, the total number of students enrolled in all corresponding library subjects where the number of enrolled students in the library subject is greater than 5, and the number of unique departments offering TIP subjects in that term. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT a.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(DISTINCT t.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_tip_subjects, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_library_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON t.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE WHERE a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2014 AND l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY a.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION ) SELECT inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.num_tip_subjects, inner_cte.total_library_enrollment, dept_counts.num_departments FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT a.TERM_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS num_departments FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2014 GROUP BY a.TERM_CODE ) AS dept_counts ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = dept_counts.TERM_CODE;

question: For each department in the Fall Term 2024-2025, what is the highest total units among its subjects with exactly 12 units? Show the department name and the highest total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SCHOOL_NAME, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS highest_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each building on the MIT site with more than 5 rooms, what is the building's long name and the highest area of any of its rooms? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, r.AREA FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT' ) SELECT BUILDING_NAME_LONG, MAX(AREA) AS max_room_area FROM inner_cte GROUP BY BUILDING_NAME_LONG HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY max_room_area DESC;

question: For each department under the 'Provost Area' in the department hierarchy, what is the minimum organization level and the total number of assignable organizations, along with the department name? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(f.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) AS min_org_level, SUM(f.ASSIGNABLE) AS total_assignable, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON h.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME ) SELECT i.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME AS department_name, i.min_org_level, i.total_assignable FROM inner_cte i;

question: For each subject that has a library material status of 'U' and a tip material status of 'RQ', what is the minimum library material status key, the total record count, and the most recent warehouse load date from both the library reserve and tip detail tables? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lrmd.SUBJECT_ID, MIN(lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) AS min_material_status, SUM(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_records FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lrmd.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY lrmd.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.min_material_status, inner_cte.total_records, MAX(lrmd.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS latest_library_warehouse_date, MAX(td.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS latest_tip_warehouse_date FROM inner_cte JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.min_material_status, inner_cte.total_records ORDER BY inner_cte.total_records DESC;

question: For each facility organization, show the research volume, department names, square footage, MIT ID, and the average square footage in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows (grouped by facility organization key and ordered by research volume) for space supervisor usage records where the number of supervisees is 2, and only include those records where the average square footage in the window is greater than 200. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.RESEARCH_VOLUME, t0.DEPT_NAMES, t0.SQFT, t0.MIT_ID, AVG(t0.SQFT) OVER ( PARTITION BY t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t0.RESEARCH_VOLUME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT t1 ON t0.DEPT_NAMES = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES = 2 ) SELECT RESEARCH_VOLUME, DEPT_NAMES, SQFT, MIT_ID, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > 200;

question: For IAP subjects with a maximum enrollment of 12, show the activity title, enrollment type, academic year, term description, subject title, and the difference between the maximum enrollment and the total units for each subject offered in the same term. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 12 ) SELECT i.ACTIVITY_TITLE, i.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, (12 - c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS enrollment_minus_units FROM inner_cte i JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = c.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND i.SUBJECT_TITLE = c.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For each subject offered in the academic term with term code '2006FA', show the subject ID, subject title, department name, the sum of lecture units within each grade type group ordered by subject ID, and the difference between the sum of lecture units for each subject and the average lecture units for its department in that term. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.GRADE_TYPE, t1.LECTURE_UNITS, SUM(t1.LECTURE_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA' ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(t1.LECTURE_UNITS) AS avg_lecture_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA' GROUP BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.window_column, (i.window_column - d.avg_lecture_units) AS diff_from_dept_avg FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY i.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering with a total of at least 6 units, show the subject code, subject title, department name, and the running sum of total units within each grade type, but only include those subjects where the running sum exceeds 12 units within their grade type. Order the results by subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ) SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > 12 ORDER BY SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For each subject category and academic year where the subject has a maximum enrollment greater than 10, list the number of unique subjects, the minimum academic term start date, and the number of unique subject IDs from the TIP_DETAIL table for that term. For each subject category and academic year, include a grand total for all subject IDs in the format of (subject category, academic year, null, null, total subject IDs). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT i.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date, a.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.TERM_CODE ), SubjectIDCounts AS ( SELECT icte.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.subject_count, icte.min_term_start_date, COUNT(DISTINCT t.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_id_count FROM inner_cte icte JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON icte.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE GROUP BY icte.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.subject_count, icte.min_term_start_date ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, ACADEMIC_YEAR, subject_count, min_term_start_date, SUM(subject_id_count) AS total_subject_ids FROM SubjectIDCounts GROUP BY IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, ACADEMIC_YEAR, subject_count, min_term_start_date WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(subject_id_count) > 0 ) SELECT IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, ACADEMIC_YEAR, subject_count, min_term_start_date, total_subject_ids FROM RollupResults ORDER BY IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, ACADEMIC_YEAR, subject_count ;

question: For each Moira list member whose last update date is '18-DEC-24', show the Moira list key, the member's full name, the owner's type, the member's MIT ID, the list owner, the last update date, and whether the member's MIT ID is above or below the average MIT ID for their owner type. If it's above, label as 'ABOVE_AVERAGE', if below, label as 'BELOW_AVERAGE', otherwise 'AVERAGE'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY, d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME, o.OWNER_TYPE, d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID, o.OWNER, d.LAST_UPDATE_DATE FROM MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL d JOIN MOIRA_LIST_OWNER o ON d.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY = o.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY WHERE d.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = '18-DEC-24' ), avg_mit_id AS ( SELECT OWNER_TYPE, AVG(MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID) AS avg_mit_id FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OWNER_TYPE ) SELECT i.MOIRA_LIST_KEY, i.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME, i.OWNER_TYPE, i.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID, i.OWNER, i.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, CASE WHEN i.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID > a.avg_mit_id THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID < a.avg_mit_id THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS mit_id_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN avg_mit_id a ON i.OWNER_TYPE = a.OWNER_TYPE;

question: For each department and school, what is the name of the department, the school name, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least 5 different materials assigned, considering only courses offered in the term '2013FA'? Also include the department phone number from the SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT table. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2013FA' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) >= 5 ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, inner_cte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, inner_cte.enrolled_stddev, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.enrolled_stddev DESC;

question: For each subject in the term "2010FA", show the subject ID, the term description from ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL, the material status key from TIP_DETAIL, the academic year from ACADEMIC_TERMS, and the academic year description from ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL. For each academic year, include a grand total count of subjects in the format of (null, null, null, academic year, academic year description, total subjects). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2010FA' ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_ID, TERM_DESCRIPTION, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(*) AS total_subjects FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_ID, TERM_DESCRIPTION, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ) SELECT SUBJECT_ID, TERM_DESCRIPTION, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, total_subjects FROM RollupResults ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUBJECT_ID

question: List the term codes, subject IDs, minimum record count from TIP_DETAIL, and the total new shelf price from TIP_MATERIAL for each term and subject where the material has a non-null author and a material info source of 'ISBN'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT td.TERM_CODE, td.SUBJECT_ID, MIN(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS min_record_count, SUM(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS total_new_shelf_price FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE tm.AUTHOR IS NOT NULL AND tm.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE = 'ISBN' GROUP BY td.TERM_CODE, td.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.min_record_count, inner_cte.total_new_shelf_price FROM inner_cte;

question: For each activity, list the activity title, enrollment type, and maximum enrollment, along with the category name and the category description, and show the dense rank of each row partitioned by the category name and ordered by the category name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY ) SELECT i.ACTIVITY_TITLE, i.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, i.MAX_ENROLLMENT, i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, c.IAP_CATEGORY_DESC, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) AS window_column FROM inner_cte i JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME;

question: For each academic year, provide the academic year description, the maximum and minimum total units for subjects offered in terms marked as current in the term parameter table, and the difference between these two values. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, (MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS)) AS units_difference FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY units_difference DESC;

question: For each DLC key and organization name where the organization is assignable and the organization level is greater than 4, show the number of organizations and the minimum organization number, and for each such group, also display the major organization name with the highest count of organizations and that count. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND o.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL > 4 GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT ic.DLC_KEY, ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.organization_count, ic.min_organization_number, mo.MAJOR_ORG AS Most_Prominent_Major_Org, mo.Major_Org_Count FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.MAJOR_ORG, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS Major_Org_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) DESC) AS rn FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND o.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL > 4 GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.MAJOR_ORG ) mo ON ic.DLC_KEY = mo.DLC_KEY AND ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME = mo.ORGANIZATION_NAME AND mo.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.organization_count DESC;

question: For IAP subject activities with a maximum enrollment of 12, show the activity title, enrollment type, maximum enrollment, term description, subject title, number of enrolled students, and the name of the department offering the subject. Assign row numbers within each enrollment type group ordered by activity title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 12 ) SELECT ACTIVITY_TITLE, ENROLLMENT_TYPE, MAX_ENROLLMENT, TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, window_column FROM inner_cte;

question: For each academic term in 2014, provide the term code, term description, the number of unique TIP subjects offered, and for each library subject enrollment visibility ('High Enrollment' if the number of enrolled students in the library subject is greater than 20, and 'Low Enrollment' otherwise), the total number of students enrolled in all corresponding library subjects. For each term, also include a grand total for all students enrolled in library subjects in the format of (term code, term description, null, total students). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT a.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(DISTINCT t.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_tip_subjects, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_library_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON t.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE WHERE a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2014 AND l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY a.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION ), LibraryEnrollmentVisibility AS ( SELECT a.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(DISTINCT t.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_tip_subjects, CASE WHEN l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 20 THEN 'High Enrollment' ELSE 'Low Enrollment' END AS enrollment_visibility, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_students FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON t.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE WHERE a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2014 AND l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY a.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, CASE WHEN l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 20 THEN 'High Enrollment' ELSE 'Low Enrollment' END ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, enrollment_visibility, SUM(total_students) AS total_students FROM LibraryEnrollmentVisibility GROUP BY TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, enrollment_visibility WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(total_students) > 0 ) SELECT rr.TERM_CODE, rr.TERM_DESCRIPTION, rr.enrollment_visibility, rr.total_students FROM RollupResults rr ORDER BY rr.TERM_CODE, rr.enrollment_visibility ;

question: For each organization, provide the organization name, the HR department name, the average and variance of the HR department codes (old) for all associated HR org units where the organization is assignable and the HR department name is not null. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS avg_dept_code_old, VARIANCE(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS var_dept_code_old FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = HR_ORG_UNIT.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD, (h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD - i.avg_dept_code_old) AS deviation_from_avg, i.var_dept_code_old FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION o JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON o.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY JOIN inner_cte i ON o.ORGANIZATION_NAME = i.ORGANIZATION_NAME WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL ORDER BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department code and department name, grouped by the department hierarchy level 2 name, where the department belongs to the "Provost Area", provide the number of organizational units, the minimum department ID, and indicate whether the number of organizational units is 'LARGE' (at least 5), 'SMALL' (less than 2), or 'MEDIUM' (otherwise). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT h.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(o.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS org_unit_count, MIN(o.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS min_department_id FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY h JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT o ON h.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE h.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY h.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.org_unit_count, inner_cte.min_department_id, CASE WHEN inner_cte.org_unit_count >= 5 THEN 'LARGE' WHEN inner_cte.org_unit_count < 2 THEN 'SMALL' ELSE 'MEDIUM' END AS org_unit_size_category FROM inner_cte;

question: For each school in the 2019FA term, show the school code, school name, and the highest running sum of total units for any subject within that school (where the subject has more than 1 total unit). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_CODE, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS > 1 ) SELECT SCHOOL_CODE, SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(window_column) AS highest_running_sum_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_CODE, SCHOOL_NAME;

question: For each material information source, provide the material information source, the total number of records for materials published after 2010 and with a new shelf price greater than 10, the average new shelf price for those materials as a benchmark, and categorize the total records as 'HIGH_RECORDS' if at least 20% greater than the benchmark record count across all sources, 'LOW_RECORDS' if at least 20% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE, SUM(d.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_records FROM TIP_DETAIL d JOIN TIP_MATERIAL m ON d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE m.YEAR > 2010 AND m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE > 10 GROUP BY m.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE HAVING SUM(d.RECORD_COUNT) > 0 ), benchmark_cte AS ( SELECT m.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE, AVG(m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS avg_new_shelf_price FROM TIP_DETAIL d JOIN TIP_MATERIAL m ON d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE m.YEAR > 2010 AND m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE > 10 GROUP BY m.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE ), overall_benchmark AS ( SELECT AVG(total_records) AS avg_total_records FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE, i.total_records, b.avg_new_shelf_price, CASE WHEN i.total_records > ob.avg_total_records * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_RECORDS' WHEN i.total_records < ob.avg_total_records * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_RECORDS' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS records_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN benchmark_cte b ON i.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE = b.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE CROSS JOIN overall_benchmark ob;

question: For each department hierarchy level 3, list the number of unique space units with a space unit key equal to 402410, along with the department hierarchy level 3 name, department hierarchy level 2 name, and department code. For each department hierarchy level 3, include a grand total for all space units in the format of (null, null, null, total space units). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS organization_name, t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME AS dept_hier_level_3_name, t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME AS dept_hier_level_2_name, t1.DLC_KEY AS department_code, MIN(t2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) OVER (ORDER BY t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = 402410 ) SELECT dept_hier_level_3_name, dept_hier_level_2_name, department_code, COUNT(DISTINCT space_unit_name) AS total_space_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY dept_hier_level_3_name, dept_hier_level_2_name, department_code WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT space_unit_name) > 0 ORDER BY dept_hier_level_3_name, dept_hier_level_2_name, department_code;

question: For each organization with a non-null description, what is the minimum access level and the total number of unique space usages for its rooms, along with the organization's name? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(z.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS min_access_level, COUNT(DISTINCT z.SPACE_USAGE) AS total_space_usages, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, f.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION f JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD z ON f.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = z.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE f.DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL GROUP BY f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, f.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID ) SELECT i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.min_access_level, i.total_space_usages FROM inner_cte i;

question: For each organization, provide the organization name, the total number of rooms assigned to that organization on floor 2 or higher, and the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the access levels of those rooms. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.BUILDING_ROOM, ACCESS_LEVEL FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE FLOOR >= 2 ) SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT BUILDING_ROOM) AS total_rooms, AVG(ACCESS_LEVEL) AS avg_access_level, STDDEV(ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY total_rooms DESC;

question: For each school, provide the school name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students for subjects offered in both the library and TIP datasets (considering only cases where the average number of enrolled students is greater than zero), and the total number of unique subjects offered in both datasets per school. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, STDDEV(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE GROUP BY l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME HAVING AVG(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, subj_counts.total_unique_subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT l.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_unique_subjects FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE GROUP BY l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) AS subj_counts ON inner_cte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = subj_counts.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: Show the department name, subject ID, subject title, academic year, the rank of each subject within its academic year group ordered by subject ID, and the total number of subjects per department for subjects in the "Engineering" school with total units equal to 1. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 1 ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.window_column, dept_counts.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS Total_Subjects FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY WHERE SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND TOTAL_UNITS = 1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS dept_counts ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each academic year, provide the academic year, the minimum academic year, the average library reserve catalog key, and the count of unique subjects offered for each academic year, where academic years are between 2000 and 2025 or library reserve catalog keys are at least 45000, and library reserve catalog keys are between 47500 and 53000. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, MIN(ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, AVG(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS avg_library_reserve_catalog_key FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON ata.TERM_CODE = lrmd.TERM_CODE WHERE ( (ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR BETWEEN 2000 AND 2025) OR (lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY >= 45000) ) AND lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY BETWEEN 47500 AND 53000 GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT ic.academic_year, ic.min_academic_year, ic.avg_library_reserve_catalog_key, COUNT(DISTINCT lrmd.SUBJECT_ID) AS unique_subject_count FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ic.academic_year = ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON ata.TERM_CODE = lrmd.TERM_CODE WHERE ( (ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR BETWEEN 2000 AND 2025) OR (lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY >= 45000) ) AND lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY BETWEEN 47500 AND 53000 GROUP BY ic.academic_year, ic.min_academic_year, ic.avg_library_reserve_catalog_key ORDER BY ic.academic_year;

question: For each department hierarchy level 2 name, organization name, and organization level where the organization is assignable, give the number of organizations and the minimum organization number for each combination of department hierarchy level 2 name, organization name, and organization level. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(f.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number, f.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 GROUP BY m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, f.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL ) SELECT MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, ORGANIZATION_NAME, ORGANIZATION_LEVEL, organization_count, min_organization_number FROM inner_cte;

question: For IAP subjects in the "Mathematics" category, show the activity title, enrollment type, maximum enrollment, category name, and also include the activity description, assigning row numbers within each enrollment type group ordered by activity title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.MAX_ENROLLMENT, inner_cte.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ACTIVITY_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d ON inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE = d.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE;

question: For each space unit with a space unit code equal to 97500, show the space unit name, the associated organization's name, the DLC name, the DLC key from the organization, and the minimum space unit code in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the facility organization key. Additionally, for each DLC key, include a grand total for all space units in the format of (null, null, DLC name, DLC key, total minimum space unit code). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS organization_name, t1.DLC_NAME AS dlc_name, t1.DLC_KEY AS org_dlc_key, MIN(t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) OVER ( ORDER BY t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_min_space_unit_code FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 97500 ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT dlc_name, org_dlc_key, SUM(window_min_space_unit_code) AS total_min_space_unit_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY dlc_name, org_dlc_key WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(window_min_space_unit_code) > 0 ) SELECT ic.space_unit_name, ic.organization_name, rr.dlc_name, rr.org_dlc_key, rr.total_min_space_unit_code FROM RollupResults rr LEFT JOIN inner_cte ic ON rr.dlc_name = ic.dlc_name AND rr.org_dlc_key = ic.org_dlc_key ORDER BY rr.dlc_name, rr.org_dlc_key

question: For each term and material status, list the term, material status, the minimum record count from TIP_DETAIL, the sum of academic years from ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL, and the number of distinct subjects. Include subtotals for each term (the corresponding term field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all terms (the corresponding term field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the term if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by term and material status. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS min_record_count, SUM(ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS total_academic_years, td.TERM_CODE, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, COUNT(DISTINCT td.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON td.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp ON ata.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM' GROUP BY td.TERM_CODE, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(term) OVER (ORDER BY term_sort, term, status_sort) = term THEN NULL ELSE term END AS term, material_status, min_record_count, total_academic_years, subject_count FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY END AS status_sort, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY AS material_status, MIN(min_record_count) AS min_record_count, SUM(total_academic_years) AS total_academic_years, SUM(subject_count) AS subject_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY TERM_CODE, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY term_sort, status_sort;

question: For degree-granting courses in the School of Engineering, show the course description, department name, subject title, and the subject's grade type description, but only include those courses where the total units for the subject exceed the average total units for that department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.GRADE_TYPE_DESC, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS SUBJECT_DEPT FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) , dept_avg_units AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_DEPT, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_DEPT ) SELECT i.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.GRADE_TYPE_DESC FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg_units d ON i.SUBJECT_DEPT = d.SUBJECT_DEPT WHERE i.TOTAL_UNITS > d.avg_units;

question: For each school, give the school name and the highest average CIP program code among its degree-granting departments for undergraduate courses. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(avg_cip_code) AS highest_avg_cip_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME;

question: For each subject where the school code and subject title are not null, and the subject code description contains the word 'Engineering' (case insensitive), show the subject code, subject code description, department name, subject title, and the dense rank of each row partitioned by the school code and ordered by school code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t0.SCHOOL_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_CODE IS NOT NULL AND t1.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte WHERE UPPER(inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC) LIKE '%ENGINEERING%'

question: For rooms with an access level of 1, show the building-room identifier, the area, the major use description, and the organization name. Assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the major use description. Do not repeat the major use description if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by major use description and organization name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.AREA, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.DESCRIPTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM FCLT_MAJOR_USE t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(DESCRIPTION) OVER (ORDER BY DESCRIPTION, ORGANIZATION_NAME) = DESCRIPTION THEN NULL ELSE DESCRIPTION END AS major_use_description, BUILDING_ROOM, AREA, ORGANIZATION_NAME, window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY DESCRIPTION, ORGANIZATION_NAME;

question: For each subject offered in the same term as a TIP detail record with material status 'RQ', show the subject key, subject title, offer department name, TIP material key, and the rank of each record within each offer department name group ordered by subject key. Additionally, indicate whether the number of subjects in each offer department for that term is above or below the average number of subjects per department for that term. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_KEY) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ), dept_counts AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, TERM_CODE, COUNT(*) AS dept_subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, TERM_CODE ), term_avgs AS ( SELECT TERM_CODE, AVG(dept_subject_count) AS avg_subjects_per_dept FROM dept_counts GROUP BY TERM_CODE ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_KEY, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, i.window_column, CASE WHEN d.dept_subject_count > t.avg_subjects_per_dept THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN d.dept_subject_count < t.avg_subjects_per_dept THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS dept_subjects_status FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_counts d ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND i.TERM_CODE = d.TERM_CODE JOIN term_avgs t ON i.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE;

question: For each academic year and department, provide the academic year description, department name, and both the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in library subjects for that department and year, considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the number of enrolled students in the library subject is greater than 0. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC;

question: Show the department names in the 'Provost Area', the number of faculty organizations associated with each, and the corresponding level 3 area name for each department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.DLC_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DLC_NAME, inner_cte.org_count, inner_cte.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.org_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each subject category, provide the category name, the average and variance of the maximum enrollment across all activities in that category, and also include a grand total row for all categories in the format of (null, total average, total variance). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT FROM IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d ON c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL ) SELECT IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, AVG(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, VARIANCE(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS var_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY IAP_CATEGORY_NAME WITH ROLLUP ORDER BY CASE WHEN IAP_CATEGORY_NAME IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, var_max_enrollment DESC ;

question: For each administrative department and term, provide the administrative department name, term, and the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering, where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 100. Also, include subtotals for each administrative department (the corresponding term field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all administrative departments and terms (the corresponding term field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the administrative department name if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by administrative department and term. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100 ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(admin_dept) OVER (ORDER BY admin_dept_sort, term_sort) = admin_dept THEN NULL ELSE admin_dept END AS admin_dept, term, total_enrolled FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS admin_dept_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS admin_dept, SUM(total_enrolled) AS total_enrolled FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, TERM_CODE WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY admin_dept_sort, term_sort;

question: For each organization, show the organization name, the number of associated space units, and the average space unit key value for that organization. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS space_unit_count FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fok JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON fok.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.space_unit_count, AVG(su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS avg_space_unit_key FROM inner_cte ic JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME = fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY GROUP BY ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.space_unit_count;

question: For each department, provide the department name, and for each school in which the department offers subjects, give the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department in that school, considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and offered in the 'Engineering' school. For each department, also include a grand total for all schools in the format of (department name, null, total units range, total units variance, total units stddev). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, sos.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ) , DepartmentSchoolStats AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, total_units_range, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev FROM DepartmentSchoolStats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME

question: For each building type on the MIT site, what is the building type name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of rooms in building history records for buildings of that type, and whether the current number of rooms for each building is at least 10% greater than the historical average (label as 'HIGH_CAPACITY'), at least 10% less (label as 'LOW_CAPACITY'), or otherwise 'AVERAGE_CAPACITY'? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT f.BUILDING_TYPE, f.BUILDING_NAME, f.NUM_OF_ROOMS AS current_num_rooms, VARIANCE(h.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS num_rooms_variance, STDDEV(h.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS num_rooms_stddev, AVG(h.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS avg_hist_num_rooms FROM FCLT_BUILDING f JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST h ON f.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY = h.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY WHERE f.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY f.BUILDING_TYPE, f.BUILDING_NAME, f.NUM_OF_ROOMS ) SELECT i.BUILDING_TYPE, i.BUILDING_NAME, i.current_num_rooms, i.num_rooms_variance, i.num_rooms_stddev, i.avg_hist_num_rooms, CASE WHEN i.current_num_rooms > i.avg_hist_num_rooms * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_CAPACITY' WHEN i.current_num_rooms < i.avg_hist_num_rooms * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_CAPACITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_CAPACITY' END AS capacity_category FROM inner_cte i ORDER BY i.BUILDING_TYPE, i.BUILDING_NAME;

question: For each department in the Provost Area, what is the average faculty organization key, and which faculty organization keys for that department are above this average? Show the department name, faculty organization key, and the average for that department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' ) , dept_avg AS ( SELECT DLC_NAME, AVG(FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS avg_org_key FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DLC_NAME ) SELECT i.DLC_NAME, i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, d.avg_org_key FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.DLC_NAME = d.DLC_NAME WHERE i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY > d.avg_org_key ORDER BY i.DLC_NAME, i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY DESC;

question: For each building, list its key, the floor key, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of rooms located on that floor, considering only floors where the average room area is greater than zero. For each building, include a grand total for all floors in the format of (building key, null, total coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP)). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT FCLT_FLOOR.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, FCLT_FLOOR.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, STDDEV(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA) / NULLIF(AVG(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM FCLT_FLOOR JOIN FCLT_ROOMS ON FCLT_FLOOR.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY = FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY GROUP BY FCLT_FLOOR.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, FCLT_FLOOR.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY HAVING AVG(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA) > 0 ) SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, SUM(coefficient_of_variation) AS total_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, FCLT_FLOOR_KEY WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(coefficient_of_variation) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, FCLT_FLOOR_KEY

question: Among the top 10 departments with the highest number of unique students enrolled in degree-granting courses, list each department's name, the total number of unique students, the minimum CIP program code among their courses, and the most common course level in that department along with the count of students enrolled at that level. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(ic.student_count) AS total_unique_students, MIN(ic.min_cip_code) AS min_cip_code, cc.Most_Common_Course_Level, cc.Level_Student_Count FROM (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(student_count) AS total_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_students DESC LIMIT 10) top_depts JOIN inner_cte ic ON top_depts.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ic2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic2.COURSE_LEVEL AS Most_Common_Course_Level, ic2.student_count AS Level_Student_Count FROM ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_LEVEL, student_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY student_count DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte ) ic2 WHERE ic2.rn = 1 ) cc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cc.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cc.Most_Common_Course_Level, cc.Level_Student_Count ORDER BY total_unique_students DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units, show the subject code, subject number, subject title, department name, term description, and the rank of each subject within its department ordered by subject code, but only include those subjects where the subject's enrollment number is greater than the average subject enrollment number for all subjects in that academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, TERM_DESCRIPTION, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > ( SELECT AVG(t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 )

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description, the variance of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during terms in that year (considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the number of enrolled students is greater than 0), and for each department, what is the department name and the total number of such library subjects offered per department in that year? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, COUNT(DISTINCT LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS total_library_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance DESC, total_library_subjects_offered DESC;

question: For IAP subject activities with a maximum enrollment of at least 20 and that are not cancelled, show the activity title, enrollment type, the academic year description from the academic terms, the term start date from all academic terms, and the term end date from all academic terms, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by activity title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t2.TERM_START_DATE, t2.TERM_END_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' ) SELECT ACTIVITY_TITLE, ENROLLMENT_TYPE, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TERM_START_DATE, TERM_END_DATE, window_column FROM inner_cte;

question: For the top 5 current academic terms with the highest total subject enrollment, show each term's code, description, academic year, the number of subjects offered, the total subject enrollment, and the department with the most subjects offered in that term along with the count of those subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT ic.TERM_CODE, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.subject_count, ic.total_enrollment, d.DEPT_NAME AS most_subjects_department, d.subjects_in_dept FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ss.TERM_CODE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPT_NAME, COUNT(ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subjects_in_dept, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ss.TERM_CODE ORDER BY COUNT(ss.SUBJECT_ID) DESC) AS dept_rank FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss GROUP BY ss.TERM_CODE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) d ON ic.TERM_CODE = d.TERM_CODE AND d.dept_rank = 1 ORDER BY ic.total_enrollment DESC LIMIT 5;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the highest total units for any subject among all library reserve materials offered in terms that have a material status of 'U'? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS highest_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY highest_total_units DESC;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2012, show the subject key, subject title, offer department name, academic year, term description, and the total number of subjects offered by each department in that year, along with row numbers within each offer department name group ordered by subject key. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_KEY) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_KEY, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, d.dept_subject_count, i.window_column FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS dept_subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) d ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: For each department name and school name, where the number of enrolled students in the offered subject is greater than the average number of enrolled students for that department and school, give the number of offered subjects and the minimum number of enrolled students. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER ) , avg_enrollment AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(i.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS offered_subject_count, MIN(i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte i JOIN avg_enrollment a ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.SCHOOL_NAME = a.SCHOOL_NAME WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_enrolled GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME;

question: For each degree-granting department, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in offered subjects, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students, and only include departments where the average enrollment is greater than the overall average enrollment across all such subjects? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_enrollment, enrollment_variance, enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_enrollment > ( SELECT AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC;

question: Among the top 10 academic years with the highest variance in the number of enrolled students in subjects (considering only terms with a term status indicator of 'P'), display each academic year's description, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrolled students, the department that offered the most subjects in that year, and the count of subjects offered by that department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.enrolled_students_variance, ic.enrolled_students_stddev, dept_stats.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS Most_Active_Department, dept_stats.Subject_Count FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT so_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR, so_stats.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, so_stats.Subject_Count, @rank := IF(@current_year = so_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR, @rank + 1, 1) AS `Rank`, @current_year := so_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) so_stats CROSS JOIN (SELECT @rank := 0, @current_year := 0) vars ORDER BY so_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR, so_stats.Subject_Count DESC ) dept_stats ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dept_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND dept_stats.`Rank` = 1 ORDER BY ic.enrolled_students_variance DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each floor, provide the floor name and list the room number and square footage for rooms whose square footage is greater than the average room square footage for that floor. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sf.FLOOR_NAME, sd.ROOM_NUMBER, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_FLOOR sf ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY ) , avg_sqft AS ( SELECT FLOOR_NAME, AVG(ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS avg_sqft FROM inner_cte GROUP BY FLOOR_NAME ) SELECT i.FLOOR_NAME, i.ROOM_NUMBER, i.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE FROM inner_cte i JOIN avg_sqft a ON i.FLOOR_NAME = a.FLOOR_NAME WHERE i.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > a.avg_sqft ORDER BY i.FLOOR_NAME, i.ROOM_NUMBER;

question: For subjects offered in the term with code '2022FA', show the subject ID, department name, term description, and the running sum of total units within each academic year, along with the subject title and whether the subject is offered in the fall term, ordered by subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.window_column, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM FROM inner_cte icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON icte.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID AND t2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For all subjects offered in the academic year 2022 that have a required textbook (TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ'), show the subject ID, subject title, term description, textbook ISBN, and the difference between the total units of the subject and the average total units for all subjects in the same term description. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_ID, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.ISBN, c.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ), avg_units AS ( SELECT TERM_DESCRIPTION, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY TERM_DESCRIPTION ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.ISBN, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - a.avg_total_units) AS units_deviation FROM inner_cte i JOIN avg_units a ON i.TERM_DESCRIPTION = a.TERM_DESCRIPTION;

question: Show the department names, subject codes, subject titles, term descriptions, and the total number of subjects offered per department for subjects offered in the term with the description "Fall Term 2024-2025". Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, dept_counts.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_CODE) AS Total_Subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS dept_counts ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each organization, show the organization key, organization name, department name, the number of HR org units, the total of their department IDs, and the latest warehouse load date from HR_ORG_UNIT, for organizations that are assignable and have a department code above 100000. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS hr_org_unit_count, SUM(h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS total_department_id FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION f JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID > 100000 GROUP BY f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.hr_org_unit_count, i.total_department_id, MAX(h.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS latest_hr_org_unit_load_date FROM inner_cte i JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.hr_org_unit_count, i.total_department_id;

question: For each department, provide the department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of courses offered by that department (considering only courses that are offered this year and have a non-null total units value), and also indicate whether the department is a 'HIGH_VARIANCE' department (variance at least 20), 'LOW_VARIANCE' (variance less than 5), or 'MEDIUM_VARIANCE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
