SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccc.total_units IS NOT NULL ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(inner_cte.total_units) - MIN(inner_cte.total_units) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(inner_cte.total_units) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.total_units) AS total_units_stddev, CASE WHEN VARIANCE(inner_cte.total_units) >= 20 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN VARIANCE(inner_cte.total_units) < 5 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'MEDIUM_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

question: For each subject category and academic year where the subject has a maximum enrollment greater than 10, what is the highest number of unique subjects offered in any academic year for that category, and what is the earliest academic term start date among those years? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT i.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, MAX(subject_count) AS highest_subject_count, MIN(min_term_start_date) AS earliest_term_start_date FROM inner_cte GROUP BY IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY;

question: For each department, provide the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one associated course material, and indicate whether the department's average enrollment is 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% greater than the overall average), 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% less than the overall average), or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrollment, inner_cte.enrollment_stddev, CASE WHEN inner_cte.avg_enrollment > overall.avg_all_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN inner_cte.avg_enrollment < overall.avg_all_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_all_enrollment FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' ) overall ORDER BY inner_cte.enrollment_stddev DESC;

question: For all active Moira lists that are also Moira mailing lists, show the list key, list name, whether the list is public, the member's full name, the member's MIT ID, the last update date, and the minimum MIT ID value over each list key group. Include subtotals for each list key (the corresponding list key field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all lists (the corresponding list key field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the list key if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by list key and list name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.MOIRA_LIST_KEY, t0.MOIRA_LIST_NAME, t0.IS_PUBLIC, t1.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME, t1.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID, t1.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, min(t1.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.MOIRA_LIST_KEY ORDER BY t0.MOIRA_LIST_KEY) AS min_mit_id FROM MOIRA_LIST t0 JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL t1 ON t0.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = t1.MOIRA_LIST_KEY WHERE t0.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND t0.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST = 'Y' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(list_key) OVER (ORDER BY list_key_sort, list_name_sort) = list_key THEN NULL ELSE list_key END AS list_key, list_name, is_public, member_full_name, member_mit_id, last_update_date, min_mit_id FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(MOIRA_LIST_KEY) = 1 AND GROUPING(MOIRA_LIST_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE MOIRA_LIST_KEY END AS list_key_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(MOIRA_LIST_KEY) = 0 AND GROUPING(MOIRA_LIST_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(MOIRA_LIST_KEY) = 1 AND GROUPING(MOIRA_LIST_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE MOIRA_LIST_KEY END AS list_key, CASE WHEN GROUPING(MOIRA_LIST_KEY) = 0 AND GROUPING(MOIRA_LIST_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE MOIRA_LIST_NAME END AS list_name_sort, MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS list_name, MAX(IS_PUBLIC) AS is_public, MAX(MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME) AS member_full_name, MAX(MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID) AS member_mit_id, MAX(LAST_UPDATE_DATE) AS last_update_date, MIN(min_mit_id) AS min_mit_id FROM inner_cte GROUP BY MOIRA_LIST_KEY, MOIRA_LIST_NAME WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY list_key_sort, list_name_sort;

question: For each academic year, provide the academic year description, the geometric mean of the degree year from all academic terms where the degree year is greater than 1900, and classify the academic year as 'RECENT' if the geometric mean is at least 2010, 'OLD' if it is less than 1980, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(ACADEMIC_TERMS.DEGREE_YEAR))) AS geometric_mean_degree_year FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.DEGREE_YEAR > 1900 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_degree_year, CASE WHEN inner_cte.geometric_mean_degree_year >= 2010 THEN 'RECENT' WHEN inner_cte.geometric_mean_degree_year < 1980 THEN 'OLD' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS year_category FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean_degree_year DESC;

question: For each academic year, among subjects that are not repeatable, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by each department? List the academic year, department name, average enrollment, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), ordered by variance descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_REPEATABLE_SUBJECT = 'N' ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC;

question: For each department, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in offered subjects, as well as the total number of subjects offered and the name of the school, considering only degree-granting departments and subjects with more than 0 enrolled students? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrollment, inner_cte.enrollment_variance, inner_cte.enrollment_stddev, COUNT(lso.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects_offered, MAX(scd.SCHOOL_NAME) AS school_name FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrollment, inner_cte.enrollment_variance, inner_cte.enrollment_stddev ORDER BY inner_cte.enrollment_variance DESC;

question: For all subjects in the 2014FA term with at least one enrolled student, show the subject title, offering department name, responsible faculty name, the TIP material status key, the total number of units, the minimum total number of units in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the course number, and whether the total units are 'HIGH_LOAD' (at least 10% greater than the average total units for that department), 'LOW_LOAD' (at least 10% less than the average), or 'AVERAGE'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, sos.COURSE_NUMBER, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) , dept_avg AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY WHERE TERM_CODE = '2014FA' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, icte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, icte.TOTAL_UNITS, icte.window_column, CASE WHEN icte.TOTAL_UNITS > da.avg_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_LOAD' WHEN icte.TOTAL_UNITS < da.avg_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_LOAD' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_load_category FROM inner_cte icte JOIN dept_avg da ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = da.OFFER_DEPT_CODE;

question: For each organization, provide the organization name, the total number of distinct space units associated with organizations whose major organization is 'PROVST' or 'CHNCLR' and have more than 2 space units, and also show the description of the organization. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS num_space_units FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fodk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON fodk.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY WHERE fo.MAJOR_ORG IN ('PROVST', 'CHNCLR') GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) > 2 ) SELECT ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.num_space_units, fo.DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte ic JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME = fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME;

question: For each room with area greater than 200 and assignable major use, show the building room, floor, room number, space ID, area, major use name, major use description, the minimum area value over each major use group, and whether the room is a 'LARGE_ROOM' (at least 20% greater than the minimum area for its major use), 'SMALL_ROOM' (at least 20% less than the minimum area for its major use), or 'AVERAGE', ordered by major use. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.ROOM, t1.SPACE_ID, t1.AREA, t0.MAJOR_USE, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, min(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY ORDER BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY) AS min_area_per_major_use FROM FCLT_MAJOR_USE t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 200 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1 ) SELECT BUILDING_ROOM, FLOOR, ROOM, SPACE_ID, AREA, MAJOR_USE, DESCRIPTION, min_area_per_major_use, CASE WHEN AREA > min_area_per_major_use * 1.2 THEN 'LARGE_ROOM' WHEN AREA < min_area_per_major_use * 0.8 THEN 'SMALL_ROOM' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS room_size_category FROM inner_cte ORDER BY MAJOR_USE;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2012, show the subject IDs, their dense rank considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the academic year description, and for each subject, include the subject title and the offering department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.window_column, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY ic.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each department, list the top 5 subject titles with the highest number of reserve materials assigned in the most recent term, including the department name, term code, and the number of reserve materials. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_reserve_materials FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.TERM_CODE, ic.num_reserve_materials FROM ( SELECT inner_cte.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.num_reserve_materials DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.TERM_CODE = (SELECT MAX(TERM_CODE) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED) ) ic WHERE ic.rn <= 5 ORDER BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.num_reserve_materials DESC;

question: For each department, provide the department name, the average and variance of the space unit codes assigned to it (considering only departments with a non-null DLC key and at least one associated space unit), and classify the department as 'HIGH_VARIANCE' if its variance is at least 20% greater than the average variance across all such departments, 'LOW_VARIANCE' if at least 20% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS avg_space_unit_code, VARIANCE(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS var_space_unit_code FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fodk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON fodk.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE fodk.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.avg_space_unit_code, icte.var_space_unit_code, CASE WHEN icte.var_space_unit_code > avg_stats.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN icte.var_space_unit_code < avg_stats.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte icte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(var_space_unit_code) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte ) avg_stats ORDER BY icte.var_space_unit_code DESC;

question: For each department, provide the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and at least 1 enrolled student), and show the deviation of each subject's total units from the department's average. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 ) , dept_stats AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.TOTAL_UNITS, d.avg_total_units, d.stddev_total_units, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - d.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_stats d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d.stddev_total_units DESC, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each subject, what is the variance of the record count for TIP materials associated with that subject, considering only records where the library material status is 'U' and the TIP material status is 'RQ', and what is the difference between the maximum and minimum record count for those TIP materials? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID = TIP_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.record_count_variance, (t.max_record_count - t.min_record_count) AS record_count_range FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID, MAX(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS max_record_count, MIN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS min_record_count FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID = TIP_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID ) t ON i.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY i.record_count_variance DESC;

question: For each offering department name and school name where the number of enrolled students is greater than 2, provide the count of distinct subject IDs, the minimum ISBN value for the associated course materials, and the total number of course materials per department and school. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(td.ISBN) AS min_isbn FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, i.subject_count, i.min_isbn, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_materials FROM inner_cte i JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND i.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, i.subject_count, i.min_isbn;

question: For courses in the School of Engineering that are degree granting, show the course description, department name, subject title, and the subject's grade type description. Also, assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.GRADE_TYPE_DESC, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE = t1.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For subjects offered in the term with code '2012SU', show the subject title, subject ID, offer department name, academic year, term description, the minimum number of enrolled students in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the academic year, and classify each subject as 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' if its number of enrolled students is at least 10% greater than the average for that term, 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' if at least 10% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, MIN(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.window_column, avg_stats.avg_enrolled_students, CASE WHEN inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > avg_stats.avg_enrolled_students * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < avg_stats.avg_enrolled_students * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT t1.TERM_CODE, AVG(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' GROUP BY t1.TERM_CODE ) avg_stats ON avg_stats.TERM_CODE = '2012SU';

question: For each subject category and enrollment type where the maximum enrollment is greater than 10, provide the number of activities, the earliest start date of the corresponding academic term, and the latest end date of the corresponding academic term. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS activity_count, MIN(t.START_DATE) AS earliest_start_date FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN TIME_DAY t ON d.TERM_CODE = t.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ) SELECT ic.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, ic.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, ic.activity_count, ic.earliest_start_date, MAX(t.END_DATE) AS latest_end_date FROM inner_cte ic JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d ON ic.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY AND ic.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE JOIN TIME_DAY t ON d.TERM_CODE = t.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE GROUP BY ic.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, ic.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, ic.activity_count, ic.earliest_start_date;

question: For each degree-granting department, what is the highest number of subject codes associated with any subject code in that department, and what is the minimum department budget code for that department? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(subject_code_count) AS highest_subject_code_count, MIN(min_dept_budget_code) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2012 with a cluster type of 'SWE: School-Wide Electives', show for each department the department code and the maximum running sum of the number of enrolled students across all its subjects, as calculated by the running sum within each department ordered by subject key. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, SUM(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_KEY ) AS running_enrollment_sum FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 AND t1.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC = 'SWE: School-Wide Electives' ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, MAX(running_enrollment_sum) AS max_running_enrollment_sum FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE;

question: Among the top 5 departments with the highest average total units for subjects that had library reserve materials in terms with a term status of 'Previous', show each department's name, average total units, variance, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and the subject with the highest total units in that department along with its total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_total_units, ic.total_units_variance, ic.total_units_stddev, ss2.SUBJECT_ID AS Top_Subject, ss2.TOTAL_UNITS AS Top_Subject_Total_Units FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.SUBJECT_ID, ss.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ss.TOTAL_UNITS DESC) AS rn FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ) ss2 ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ss2.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.avg_total_units DESC LIMIT 5;

question: For each department, provide the department name, the average and variance of the ASCII values of its subject codes' course numbers (considering only degree granting departments), and also show the total number of subject codes for each department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VARIANCE(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_course_number_ascii, i.var_course_number_ascii, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS total_subject_codes FROM inner_cte i JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_course_number_ascii, i.var_course_number_ascii ORDER BY i.var_course_number_ascii DESC;

question: For each department, provide the department name, average, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units), but only include departments where the average total units is greater than the overall average total units across all subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_total_units > ( SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY WHERE TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC;

question: For each department, what is the geometric mean of the space unit codes for all space units associated with that department, considering only space units with a code greater than 0? Additionally, for each major organization, provide a grand total geometric mean for all its departments in the format of (major organization name, null, total geometric mean). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.MAJOR_ORG, EXP(AVG(LN(s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE))) AS geometric_mean FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT s ON o.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY WHERE s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE > 0 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.MAJOR_ORG ) SELECT MAJOR_ORG, ORGANIZATION_NAME, geometric_mean FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT MAJOR_ORG, NULL AS ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(geometric_mean))) AS geometric_mean FROM inner_cte GROUP BY MAJOR_ORG ORDER BY MAJOR_ORG, ORGANIZATION_NAME ;

question: Show the minimum library material status key, the total record count, and the earliest warehouse load date for all subjects that have a library material status of 'U' and a tip material status of 'RQ'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) AS min_material_status, SUM(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_records, MIN(lrmd.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS earliest_load_date FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lrmd.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ) SELECT min_material_status, total_records, earliest_load_date FROM inner_cte;

question: For each school, provide the school name and calculate the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2012SU term. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.SCHOOL_NAME, ss.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY units_variance DESC;

question: For each organization, show the organization name, the number of associated space units, and whether the organization is a 'LARGE_HOLDER' (at least 20% more space units than the average), 'SMALL_HOLDER' (at least 20% fewer space units than the average), or 'AVERAGE_HOLDER' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS space_unit_count FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fok JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON fok.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.space_unit_count, avg_stats.avg_space_units, CASE WHEN ic.space_unit_count > avg_stats.avg_space_units * 1.2 THEN 'LARGE_HOLDER' WHEN ic.space_unit_count < avg_stats.avg_space_units * 0.8 THEN 'SMALL_HOLDER' ELSE 'AVERAGE_HOLDER' END AS holder_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(space_unit_count) AS avg_space_units FROM inner_cte ) avg_stats;

question: For each building, give the building key and the highest average total units for any department among all subjects scheduled in rooms of that building during the fall term. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, MAX(avg_total_units) AS highest_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY highest_avg_total_units DESC;

question: For courses in the 'Engineering' school with a total of 12 units, show the course number, course description, subject title, total units, offering department name, and, for each offering department, the course with the highest number of enrolled students. If there are ties, include all such courses. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE AS course_number, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.COURSE) AS window_column, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) SELECT i.course_number, i.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TOTAL_UNITS, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) m ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = m.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = m.max_enrolled

question: For subjects offered in the term '2009JA', show the subject title from the library, the number of enrolled students from the tip subject offered table, the library material status key from the reserve material detail, and the offer department name from the library subject offered table. Only include results where the number of enrolled students is greater than the average number of enrolled students for all subjects in '2009JA'. Assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the library material status key. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lrd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY lrd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON lso.TERM_CODE = tso.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrd ON tso.TERM_CODE = lrd.TERM_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2009JA' ) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > ( SELECT AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE TERM_CODE = '2009JA' );

question: For each department name and school name where the department is degree granting, provide the number of unique courses and the minimum CIP program code from the course descriptions. Additionally, for each school, include a grand total for all departments in that school in the format of (null, school name, total courses, min CIP code). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(course_count) AS total_courses, MIN(min_cip_code) AS min_cip_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(course_count) > 0 ) SELECT rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.total_courses, rr.min_cip_code FROM RollupResults rr ORDER BY rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each subject category name and enrollment type where the maximum enrollment is greater than 10, what is the average fee and the total number of activities for each sponsor? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS activity_count, MIN(d.FEE) AS min_fee FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ) SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, AVG(d.FEE) AS avg_fee, COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS total_activities FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY;

question: For each subject offered in the term "2005FA", show the subject title from the subject summary, the number of enrolled students from the subject offered table, the department name from the subject summary, the term description from the academic terms table, the average number of enrolled students within each subject title group, and classify each subject as 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' if its enrollment is at least 10% greater than the average for its subject title, 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' if at least 10% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON tso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' ) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, DEPARTMENT_NAME, TERM_DESCRIPTION, avg_enrolled_students, CASE WHEN NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > avg_enrolled_students * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < avg_enrolled_students * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte;

question: From the top 10 offering department names and course number descriptions with the highest number of enrolled students (where the number of enrolled students is greater than 3), display each department name, course number description, the number of distinct ISBNs in TIP_DETAIL, the minimum responsible faculty MIT ID from TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED, and the subject title most frequently associated with that department and course number, along with the count of its occurrences. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT t.ISBN) AS isbn_count, MIN(ts.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID) AS min_faculty_mit_id FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ts ON t.SUBJECT_ID = ts.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC ) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, ic.isbn_count, ic.min_faculty_mit_id, stc.Most_Common_Subject_Title, stc.Subject_Title_Count FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, l.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Most_Common_Subject_Title, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Title_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, l.SUBJECT_TITLE ) stc ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = stc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND ic.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC = stc.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC AND stc.rn = 1 ORDER BY ( SELECT SUM(l2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l2 WHERE l2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND l2.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC = ic.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC AND l2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 ) DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For IAP subject activities with a maximum enrollment between 15 and 30 inclusive, that are not cancelled, and that require advance sign-up, show the activity title, enrollment type, the academic year description from the academic terms, the term start date from all academic terms, and the term description from academic terms. Assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by activity title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t2.TERM_START_DATE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT BETWEEN 15 AND 30 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' ) SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC

question: For each material status and publisher where the new shelf price is greater than 50, provide the number of materials and the minimum used shelf price, and also show the average new shelf price for that publisher and status as a benchmark, along with a category indicating if the minimum used shelf price is at least 10% less than the average new shelf price ('LOW_USED_PRICE'), at least 10% more ('HIGH_USED_PRICE'), or otherwise 'AVERAGE_USED_PRICE'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, m.PUBLISHER, COUNT(m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count, MIN(m.USED_SHELF_PRICE) AS min_used_price FROM TIP_DETAIL d JOIN TIP_MATERIAL m ON d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE > 50 GROUP BY d.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, m.PUBLISHER ) SELECT i.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, i.PUBLISHER, i.material_count, i.min_used_price, s.avg_new_shelf_price AS benchmark_new_shelf_price, CASE WHEN i.min_used_price < s.avg_new_shelf_price * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_USED_PRICE' WHEN i.min_used_price > s.avg_new_shelf_price * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_USED_PRICE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_USED_PRICE' END AS used_price_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT d.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, m.PUBLISHER, AVG(m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS avg_new_shelf_price FROM TIP_DETAIL d JOIN TIP_MATERIAL m ON d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE > 50 GROUP BY d.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, m.PUBLISHER ) s ON i.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = s.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY AND i.PUBLISHER = s.PUBLISHER;

question: For space units with a space unit code of 402100, show the organization names and their dense rank considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the organization number, and for each DLC, give the DLC name and the highest dense rank among its organizations. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 402100 ) SELECT t3.DLC_NAME, MAX(inner_cte.window_column) AS highest_dense_rank FROM inner_cte JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t3 ON inner_cte.DLC_KEY = t3.DLC_KEY GROUP BY t3.DLC_NAME;

question: For subjects offered in the term '2019FA' with more than 0 enrolled students, show the subject title, offer department name, department full name, school name, number of enrolled students, and the average number of enrolled students in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the school code, ordered by the subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_CODE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each major use description, list the building-room identifier, area, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the building-room identifier. For each major use description, include a grand total row for all rooms in the format of (null, null, major use description, total rooms). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.AREA, t0.DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.DESCRIPTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM FCLT_MAJOR_USE t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 ), RoomCounts AS ( SELECT DESCRIPTION, COUNT(*) AS total_rooms FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DESCRIPTION ) SELECT ic.BUILDING_ROOM, ic.AREA, ic.DESCRIPTION, ic.window_column FROM inner_cte ic UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS BUILDING_ROOM, NULL AS AREA, rc.DESCRIPTION, rc.total_rooms AS window_column FROM RoomCounts rc ORDER BY DESCRIPTION, BUILDING_ROOM

question: For rooms with a square footage of 150, show the building room, room number, space unit code, space unit name, and the number of rooms for each space unit code. For each space unit code, include a grand total for all rooms in the format of (null, null, space unit code, space unit name, total rooms). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.BUILDING_ROOM, sd.ROOM_NUMBER, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, su.SPACE_UNIT FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY WHERE sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE = 150 ), RoomCounts AS ( SELECT BUILDING_ROOM, ROOM_NUMBER, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(*) AS num_rooms FROM inner_cte GROUP BY BUILDING_ROOM, ROOM_NUMBER, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, SPACE_UNIT ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT BUILDING_ROOM, ROOM_NUMBER, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, SPACE_UNIT, SUM(num_rooms) AS total_rooms FROM RoomCounts GROUP BY BUILDING_ROOM, ROOM_NUMBER, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, SPACE_UNIT WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(num_rooms) > 0 ) SELECT BUILDING_ROOM, ROOM_NUMBER, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, SPACE_UNIT, total_rooms FROM RollupResults ORDER BY SPACE_UNIT_CODE, BUILDING_ROOM, ROOM_NUMBER

question: For subjects offered in the term '2017JA', show the subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, department full name, subject code, subject code description, and the difference between the number of enrolled students and the minimum number of enrolled students over each subject code group, ordered by subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' ) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, (NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS - window_column) AS deviation_from_min FROM inner_cte ORDER BY SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For subjects offered in the term with code '2022SU', show the subject IDs, their department names, and their dense rank considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the total number of units. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2022SU' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each department, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of rooms used for subjects offered by that department (considering only rooms with an area greater than 40), and for each subject in that department, what is the subject title and the area of the room it uses? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(f.AREA) AS avg_area, VARIANCE(f.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(f.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS f JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON f.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = c.MEET_PLACE WHERE f.AREA > 40 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_area, ic.area_variance, ic.area_stddev, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, f.AREA AS room_area FROM inner_cte ic JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN FCLT_ROOMS f ON f.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = c.MEET_PLACE WHERE f.AREA > 40 ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For each library reserve material with material status key 'U', show the subject ID, library course instructor key, term description, academic year, term start date, and the minimum academic year in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by library reserve catalog key, along with the total number of such materials for each academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t2.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, MIN(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.TERM_START_DATE, i.window_column, y.total_materials_per_year FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS total_materials_per_year FROM ( SELECT t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ) sub GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ) y ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = y.ACADEMIC_YEAR

question: For rooms with an area greater than 300 and access level equal to 1, show the building-room identifier, the room's major use description, the organization name, and the total number of such rooms per organization. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.MAJOR_USE_DESC, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 300 AND t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 ) SELECT inner_cte.BUILDING_ROOM, inner_cte.MAJOR_USE_DESC, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, org_counts.Total_Rooms FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT BUILDING_ROOM) AS Total_Rooms FROM ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 300 AND t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 ) sub GROUP BY ORGANIZATION_NAME ) org_counts ON inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = org_counts.ORGANIZATION_NAME;

question: For each organization, give the organization name and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of rooms assigned to that organization, considering only organizations where the average room area is greater than the overall average room area. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA) / NULLIF(AVG(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation, AVG(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA) AS avg_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS GROUP BY FCLT_ROOMS.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_area > (SELECT AVG(AREA) FROM FCLT_ROOMS) ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For each major organization and top-level HR organization name, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the organization numbers, considering only organizations that are assignable and have a non-null organization number, and only include those groups where the average organization number is greater than the overall average organization number for all such organizations? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT F.MAJOR_ORG, H.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME, AVG(F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS avg_org_number, VARIANCE(F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance, STDDEV(F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION F JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT H ON F.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = H.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE F.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER IS NOT NULL GROUP BY F.MAJOR_ORG, H.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME ) SELECT MAJOR_ORG, ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME, avg_org_number, org_number_variance, org_number_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_org_number > ( SELECT AVG(ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION WHERE ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND ORGANIZATION_NUMBER IS NOT NULL ) ORDER BY org_number_variance DESC;

question: For each department, list the department name, the subject ID, subject title, and the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the term '2014JA' with a nonzero total units value. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2014JA' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.SUBJECT_ID, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.total_units_variance, inner_cte.total_units_stddev FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID JOIN inner_cte ON ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2014JA' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ORDER BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each department, list the department name and the total number of reserve materials assigned, but only include departments where the total number of reserve materials is greater than the average number of reserve materials assigned per department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_reserve_materials FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, num_reserve_materials FROM inner_cte WHERE num_reserve_materials > ( SELECT AVG(num_reserve_materials) FROM inner_cte );

question: For each school, provide the school name and the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for all courses offered by departments within that school. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT d.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

question: For each academic year, what is the minimum degree year among regular academic terms that have a current term indicator in the academic term parameter? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, SUM(at.DEGREE_YEAR) AS total_degree_years FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp ON at.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' ) SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MIN(at.DEGREE_YEAR) AS min_degree_year FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp ON at.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each subject offered in the 2012 summer term by the Harvard Cross-Enrollment Program, provide the subject key, subject title, department name, the number of subject offerings, the total number of units for those offerings, and the maximum number of enrolled students in any of those offerings. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT so.SUBJECT_KEY, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS offering_count, SUM(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON sos.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' GROUP BY so.SUBJECT_KEY, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_KEY, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.offering_count, inner_cte.total_units, MAX(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_KEY = so.SUBJECT_KEY JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON so.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_KEY, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.offering_count, inner_cte.total_units;

question: For each department in the "Provost Area" with a non-null department code, show the department name, the department's long name, the corresponding hierarchy level 3 name from the master department hierarchy, and the name of the school area from the HR organization unit. Assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t1.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte ORDER BY HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For subjects in the "Engineering" school with total units equal to 1, show the subject ID, subject title, department name, academic year, and whether the subject's total units are above, below, or equal to the average total units for that academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 1 ), avg_units AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT cte.SUBJECT_ID, cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, CASE WHEN cte.TOTAL_UNITS > a.avg_total_units THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN cte.TOTAL_UNITS < a.avg_total_units THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'EQUAL_TO_AVERAGE' END AS unit_comparison FROM inner_cte cte JOIN avg_units a ON cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each subject offered in the term with the description "Fall Term 2024-2025", show the subject offered key, subject title, offering department name, the term description, and the number of subjects offered by each department in that term. For each department, include a grand total for all subjects offered in the format of (null, null, offering department name, term description, total subjects). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' ), DeptSubjectCounts AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(*) AS num_subjects FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, TERM_DESCRIPTION WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ) SELECT CASE WHEN dsc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE ict.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY END AS TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, CASE WHEN dsc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE ict.SUBJECT_TITLE END AS SUBJECT_TITLE, dsc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dsc.TERM_DESCRIPTION, dsc.num_subjects FROM DeptSubjectCounts dsc LEFT JOIN inner_cte ict ON dsc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = ict.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND dsc.TERM_DESCRIPTION = ict.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY dsc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ict.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY

question: For subjects offered in the term with code '2022SU', show each subject's ID, total units, department name, and their dense rank considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the total number of units. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2022SU' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS DESC;

question: For each subject offered in the term '2017FA', provide the subject title, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the record counts for all tip materials associated with that subject, and also show the total number of enrolled students for each subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(t.RECORD_COUNT) - MIN(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_range, VARIANCE(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev, s.SUBJECT_ID FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON s.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.record_count_range, i.record_count_variance, i.record_count_stddev, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON i.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID AND s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' ORDER BY i.record_count_range DESC;

question: For rooms on floor 2 with access level 1, show the building room, space usage, space unit name, and the total number of such rooms per space unit. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t0.SPACE_UNIT FROM SPACE_UNIT t0 JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t1 ON t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE t1.FLOOR = 2 AND t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 ) SELECT inner_cte.BUILDING_ROOM, inner_cte.SPACE_USAGE, inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT, RoomCounts.Total_Rooms FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(BUILDING_ROOM) AS Total_Rooms FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SPACE_UNIT ) AS RoomCounts ON inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT = RoomCounts.SPACE_UNIT;

question: List the minimum department budget code, the sum of total units, and the number of unique courses for each department whose name includes 'Engineering' and that are degree granting. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_budget_code, SUM(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_sum, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE '%Engineering%' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.min_budget_code, inner_cte.total_units_sum, COUNT(DISTINCT ccc.SUBJECT_NUMBER) AS unique_courses FROM inner_cte JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.min_budget_code, inner_cte.total_units_sum

question: For IAP activities that are not cancelled and are offered in a non-summer academic term, list the top 10 activities by the number of distinct departments whose subjects are offered in the same term. Show the IAP activity title, the count of distinct departments, and the name of the department with the most subjects offered in that term. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT iap.ACTIVITY_TITLE, COUNT(DISTINCT ccs.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count, iap.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL iap JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON iap.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE WHERE iap.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' GROUP BY iap.ACTIVITY_TITLE, iap.TERM_CODE ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), DeptCounts AS ( SELECT icte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, COUNT(DISTINCT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dept_count, icte.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON icte.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE GROUP BY icte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, icte.TERM_CODE ), TopDept AS ( SELECT icte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS subj_in_dept, icte.TERM_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY icte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, icte.TERM_CODE ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON icte.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE GROUP BY icte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.TERM_CODE ) SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.dept_count, t.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS top_department FROM DeptCounts d LEFT JOIN TopDept t ON d.ACTIVITY_TITLE = t.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND d.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND t.rn = 1 ORDER BY d.dept_count DESC, d.ACTIVITY_TITLE LIMIT 10;

question: For each academic year, provide the academic year, the total number of unique TIP subjects offered, and the maximum total number of students enrolled in all corresponding library subjects (where the number of enrolled students in the library subject is greater than 5) for any term within that year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT a.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(DISTINCT t.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_tip_subjects, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_library_enrollment, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON t.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY a.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(num_tip_subjects) AS total_tip_subjects, MAX(total_library_enrollment) AS max_total_library_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each space unit whose name starts with 'A' (case insensitive), and which contains between 5 and 15 rooms inclusive, list the space unit name and the number of rooms it contains. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(sd.BUILDING_ROOM) AS room_count FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT ) SELECT SPACE_UNIT, room_count FROM inner_cte WHERE UPPER(SPACE_UNIT) LIKE 'A%' AND room_count BETWEEN 5 AND 15;

question: For subjects offered in the term 2019FA, show the subject ID, subject title, number of enrolled students, department name, department full name, and indicate whether the number of enrolled students is 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% greater than the average for that department), 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% less than the average for that department), or 'AVERAGE', along with the department's average enrollment. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.avg_enrollment, CASE WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > d.avg_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < d.avg_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For courses in the SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION table with a department code of 6, show the course, course description, department name, school name, program code, program title, category code, category title, four digit code, four digit title, and the minimum warehouse load date from the CIP table over each category code group, ordered by category code. Additionally, for each school name, include a grand total for all courses in that school in the format of (nulls for course-specific fields, school name, nulls for other fields, and the total number of courses in that school). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.PROGRAM_CODE, c.PROGRAM_TITLE, c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY c.CATEGORY_CODE) AS min_warehouse_load_date FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION s JOIN CIP c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT = 6 ), SchoolTotals AS ( SELECT NULL AS COURSE, NULL AS COURSE_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS PROGRAM_CODE, NULL AS PROGRAM_TITLE, NULL AS CATEGORY_CODE, NULL AS CATEGORY_TITLE, NULL AS FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, NULL AS FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, NULL AS min_warehouse_load_date, COUNT(*) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT i.COURSE, i.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.PROGRAM_CODE, i.PROGRAM_TITLE, i.CATEGORY_CODE, i.CATEGORY_TITLE, i.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, i.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, i.min_warehouse_load_date, NULL AS total_courses FROM inner_cte i UNION ALL SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.PROGRAM_CODE, s.PROGRAM_TITLE, s.CATEGORY_CODE, s.CATEGORY_TITLE, s.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, s.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, s.min_warehouse_load_date, s.total_courses FROM SchoolTotals s ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, CATEGORY_CODE, COURSE

question: For each subject offered in the 2022 academic year that is classified as a HASS Elective, provide the subject code, subject number, subject title, the number of units for the subject, the total number of subjects in the same department that are also HASS Electives, and indicate whether the subject has more units than the average number of units for HASS Electives in its department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.TOTAL_UNITS, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE h ON c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = h.HASS_ATTRIBUTE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND h.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM = 'HASS Elective' ) , dept_avg_units AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_NUMBER, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TOTAL_UNITS, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY i.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS num_hass_electives_in_department, CASE WHEN i.TOTAL_UNITS > d.avg_units THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE_UNITS' WHEN i.TOTAL_UNITS < d.avg_units THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE_UNITS' ELSE 'AVERAGE_UNITS' END AS unit_comparison FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg_units d ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: For rooms with an area greater than 300, show the building-room identifier, floor number, major use description, organization name, DLC key, and the average area in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by department code and ordered by area, but only include those department codes where the average area of such rooms is above 400. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.MAJOR_USE_DESC, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, t1.AREA, t1.DEPT_CODE, AVG(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t1.AREA ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_avg_area FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 300 ), DeptAvg AS ( SELECT DEPT_CODE, AVG(AREA) AS dept_avg_area FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPT_CODE HAVING AVG(AREA) > 400 ) SELECT ic.BUILDING_ROOM, ic.FLOOR, ic.MAJOR_USE_DESC, ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.DLC_KEY, ic.window_avg_area FROM inner_cte ic JOIN DeptAvg da ON ic.DEPT_CODE = da.DEPT_CODE

question: For each subject that has at least one enrolled student, show the subject title, the number of enrolled students, the term code from the library subject offered table, the tip material status key, the total units from the subject offered summary, and the average number of enrolled students within each subject title group ordered by total units, but only include those results where the total units is greater than the average total units across all subjects with at least one enrolled student. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.TERM_CODE, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID INNER JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, TERM_CODE, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TOTAL_UNITS, avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte WHERE TOTAL_UNITS > ( SELECT AVG(sos2.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso2 INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL td2 ON lso2.SUBJECT_ID = td2.SUBJECT_ID INNER JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos2 ON td2.SUBJECT_ID = sos2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 )

question: List the department names, the corresponding subject titles, the minimum number of enrolled students in any subject, and the total number of material records for subjects offered by the School of Engineering, considering only those materials with a status of 'RQ'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, td.RECORD_COUNT FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, MIN(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled, SUM(inner_cte.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_material_records FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each building in the city of CAMBRIDGE, show the building name, building number, city, state, and the maximum number of rooms found in any building, ordered by building number. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_NAME, t1.BUILDING_NUMBER, t0.CITY, t0.STATE, AVG(t1.NUM_OF_ROOMS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY t1.BUILDING_NUMBER) AS avg_num_of_rooms FROM FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS t0 JOIN FCLT_BUILDING t1 ON t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE t0.CITY = 'CAMBRIDGE' ) SELECT BUILDING_NAME, BUILDING_NUMBER, CITY, STATE, MAX(avg_num_of_rooms) AS max_avg_num_of_rooms FROM inner_cte GROUP BY BUILDING_NAME, BUILDING_NUMBER, CITY, STATE ORDER BY BUILDING_NUMBER;

question: For the top 10 buildings with the largest range in room areas (among buildings with more than 10 rooms), list each building's name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of its room areas, as well as the most common major use among its rooms and the count of rooms with that major use. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_BUILDING b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY HAVING COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 10 ) SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.area_range, ic.area_variance, ic.area_stddev, muc.MAJOR_USE_DESC AS Most_Common_Major_Use, muc.Room_Count FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS Room_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) DESC) AS rn FROM FCLT_BUILDING b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, r.MAJOR_USE_DESC ) muc ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = muc.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND muc.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.area_range DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each department name, what is the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in the courses that have at least one enrolled student and have a material status of 'U'? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL d JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC;

question: For each department name and school name, show the number of offered subjects and the minimum number of enrolled students (where the number of enrolled students in the offered subject is greater than 3), and classify the department as 'HIGH_ACTIVITY' if the number of offered subjects is at least 20% greater than the average across all departments, 'LOW_ACTIVITY' if at least 20% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS offered_subject_count, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT AVG(offered_subject_count) AS avg_offered_subjects FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.offered_subject_count, i.min_enrolled_students, CASE WHEN i.offered_subject_count > d.avg_offered_subjects * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_ACTIVITY' WHEN i.offered_subject_count < d.avg_offered_subjects * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_ACTIVITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS activity_level FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN dept_avg d;

question: For each organization that has a space unit code of 402100, show the organization name, its dense rank considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the organization number, and the corresponding DLC key. Do not return any rounded answers.
