SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.ROOM_NUMBER, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, sf.FLOOR_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sd.FLOOR_KEY ORDER BY sd.FLOOR_KEY) AS window_column FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_FLOOR sf ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY WHERE sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 10 ) SELECT inner_cte.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, inner_cte.ROOM_NUMBER, inner_cte.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, inner_cte.FLOOR_NAME, Total_Rooms.Total_Rooms FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT sf.FLOOR_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME) AS Total_Rooms FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_FLOOR sf ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY WHERE sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 10 GROUP BY sf.FLOOR_NAME ) AS Total_Rooms ON inner_cte.FLOOR_NAME = Total_Rooms.FLOOR_NAME;

question: For each school, provide the school name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year, and classify each school as 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' if the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is at least 10% greater than the average, 'LOW_VARIABILITY' if the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is at least 10% less than the average, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION d ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = d.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON d.COURSE = c.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units, CASE WHEN stddev_total_units > avg_total_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN stddev_total_units < avg_total_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC;

question: For each organization with a name starting with 'R' (case insensitive), and where the average room area for rooms associated with that organization and having a non-null area is greater than 300, provide the organization name, the number of such rooms, and the average, minimum, and maximum room area. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.AREA FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY o JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA IS NOT NULL ) SELECT ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(ic.AREA) AS room_count, AVG(ic.AREA) AS avg_area, MIN(ic.AREA) AS min_area, MAX(ic.AREA) AS max_area FROM inner_cte ic WHERE UPPER(ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME) LIKE 'R%' GROUP BY ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING AVG(ic.AREA) > 300 ORDER BY avg_area DESC;

question: For each academic term code, what is the minimum calendar month and the sum of calendar years from TIME_MONTH for months that are in the fiscal year 2020 and have a corresponding day in TIME_DAY with that academic term code? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(tm.CALENDAR_MONTH) AS min_calendar_month, SUM(tm.CALENDAR_YEAR) AS total_calendar_years, td.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE FROM TIME_MONTH tm JOIN TIME_DAY td ON tm.FISCAL_PERIOD = td.FISCAL_PERIOD WHERE tm.FISCAL_YEAR = 2020 GROUP BY td.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE ) SELECT ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE, min_calendar_month, total_calendar_years FROM inner_cte;

question: For each academic year, provide the academic year description and the total number of TIP materials for that year, but only include years where the total number of TIP materials exceeds the average total number of TIP materials across all years (considering only terms where the term status is not null and the TIP material status is not 'NM'). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_record_count FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS IS NOT NULL AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.total_record_count FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT AVG(total_record_count) AS avg_total FROM inner_cte ) avg_cte ON i.total_record_count > avg_cte.avg_total ORDER BY i.total_record_count DESC;

question: For each library course instructor, show the instructor key, the total number of unique tip material keys associated with their reserve materials where the library material status key is 'U' and the tip material status key is 'RQ'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, t0.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, AVG(t1.RECORD_COUNT) OVER ( PARTITION BY t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t0.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ) SELECT LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS unique_tip_material_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY;

question: List the subject codes and titles of all subjects offered in the 2022 academic year that are classified as HASS Elective according to the HASS attribute description on form. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_hass_elective_subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE h ON c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = h.HASS_ATTRIBUTE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND h.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM = 'HASS Elective' ) SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE h ON c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = h.HASS_ATTRIBUTE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND h.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM = 'HASS Elective';

question: For each department in the "Provost Area", show the department code, department name, school area name, and the rank of each department within its school area based on department code, and also include the corresponding DLC name from the HR_ORG_UNIT table. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 INNER JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' ) SELECT inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, t2.DLC_NAME FROM inner_cte INNER JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON inner_cte.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the highest geometric mean of the record counts of required course materials (where the record count is greater than zero) for any subject offered in that year? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID = TIP_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(geometric_mean_record_count) AS highest_subject_geometric_mean FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY highest_subject_geometric_mean DESC;

question: For the top 5 departments with the highest average total units for subjects offered in the 2012SU term, display each department's name, the average and variance of total units, and the subject with the highest total units in that department along with its subject title and total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.SUBJECT_ID, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_units, d.units_variance, s.SUBJECT_ID AS Top_Subject_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Top_Subject_Title, s.TOTAL_UNITS AS Top_Subject_Units FROM ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY avg_units DESC LIMIT 5 ) d LEFT JOIN ( SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY TOTAL_UNITS DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte ) i WHERE i.rn = 1 ) s ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d.avg_units DESC;

question: For IAP subject activities with a maximum enrollment of 12, show the activity title, enrollment type, maximum enrollment, term description, subject title, number of enrolled students, and for each enrollment type, the highest number of enrolled students among those activities. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 12 ) SELECT ENROLLMENT_TYPE, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS highest_num_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ENROLLMENT_TYPE;

question: For each academic year, what is the average number of enrolled students in non-repeatable subjects, and for each subject offered in that year, what is its enrollment, the average enrollment for that year as a benchmark, and whether the subject is a 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% greater than average), 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% less than average), or 'AVERAGE'? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_REPEATABLE_SUBJECT = 'N' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT so.SUBJECT_TITLE, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ic.avg_enrollment AS year_avg_enrollment, CASE WHEN so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > ic.avg_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < ic.avg_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN inner_cte ic ON at.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR WHERE so.IS_REPEATABLE_SUBJECT = 'N' ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, so.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description, and what are both the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the record counts of TIP materials associated with that academic year, as well as the total number of unique TIP material keys per academic year, considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the TIP material status key is not 'NM'? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance, inner_cte.record_count_stddev, material_counts.total_materials FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_materials FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) AS material_counts ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = material_counts.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY inner_cte.record_count_variance DESC;

question: For each department hierarchy level 2 name and organization name where the organization is assignable, provide the number of organizations and the minimum organization number. Additionally, for each department hierarchy level 2 name, include a grand total for all organizations in the format of (level 2 name, null, total organizations, minimum organization number). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(f.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 GROUP BY m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, ORGANIZATION_NAME, SUM(organization_count) AS total_organizations, MIN(min_organization_number) AS min_organization_number FROM inner_cte GROUP BY MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, ORGANIZATION_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(organization_count) > 0 ORDER BY MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, ORGANIZATION_NAME

question: For each organization with a DLC key of 'D_MECHE' and an organization level of 5, provide the organization name, the organization ID, and indicate whether the organization number is at least 10% greater than the average organization number for such organizations ('HIGH_NUMBER'), at least 10% less ('LOW_NUMBER'), or otherwise 'AVERAGE'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_ID, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY.DLC_KEY = 'D_MECHE' AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS avg_org_number FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.ORGANIZATION_ID, i.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER, CASE WHEN i.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER > a.avg_org_number * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_NUMBER' WHEN i.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER < a.avg_org_number * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_NUMBER' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS org_number_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_cte a;

question: For subjects offered in the 2012SU term with a cluster type of 'S', show the subject title from SUBJECT_OFFERED, the offer department name, the total units from SUBJECT_SUMMARY, and the school name from SUBJECT_SUMMARY. Also, assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t1.CLUSTER_TYPE = 'S' ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description, and what are both the maximum and minimum of the variance of record counts of TIP materials associated with that academic year, considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the TIP material status key is not 'NM'? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(record_count_variance) AS max_record_count_variance, MIN(record_count_variance) AS min_record_count_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY max_record_count_variance DESC;

question: For each space usage, list the building room, building room name, the number of distinct floors it appears on, and the total room counter for space units with a room square footage greater than 100. For each space usage, include a grand total for all building rooms in the format of (null, null, total floors, total room counter). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.BUILDING_ROOM, sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, su.SPACE_USAGE, sd.FLOOR_KEY, sd.ROOM_COUNTER FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_USAGE su ON sd.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = su.SPACE_USAGE_KEY WHERE sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 100 ) SELECT SPACE_USAGE, BUILDING_ROOM, BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT FLOOR_KEY) AS floor_count, SUM(ROOM_COUNTER) AS total_room_counter FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SPACE_USAGE, BUILDING_ROOM, BUILDING_ROOM_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(ROOM_COUNTER) > 0 ORDER BY SPACE_USAGE, BUILDING_ROOM, BUILDING_ROOM_NAME;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description, the variance of the number of tip detail records for subjects offered in that year (considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term and have at least one associated tip detail record), and the number of unique departments represented among those subjects? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS unique_departments FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance ORDER BY inner_cte.record_count_variance DESC;

question: For each department, provide the department name, the average number of supervisees for all space units associated with that department, and the total square footage for those space units, as well as the difference between the total square footage and the average square footage across all departments. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT AS department_name, AVG(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS avg_supervisees, SUM(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.SQFT) AS total_sqft FROM SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE JOIN SPACE_UNIT ON SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.DEPT_NAMES = SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY GROUP BY SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT ) SELECT inner_cte.department_name, inner_cte.avg_supervisees, inner_cte.total_sqft, (inner_cte.total_sqft - (SELECT AVG(total_sqft) FROM inner_cte)) AS sqft_deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte;

question: Show the department name, the department's long name, the corresponding hierarchy level 3 name from the master department hierarchy, and the total number of departments per hierarchy level 3, for departments in the "Provost Area" with a non-null department code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t1.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL ) SELECT inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, inner_cte.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, dept_counts.Total_Departments FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS Total_Departments FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t1.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME ) dept_counts ON inner_cte.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME = dept_counts.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME

question: For each IAP subject activity with a maximum enrollment of 12, show the activity title, maximum enrollment, term code, term description, subject title, number of enrolled students, and the difference between the number of enrolled students and the average number of enrolled students within each subject title group. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, AVG(t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 12 ) SELECT ACTIVITY_TITLE, MAX_ENROLLMENT, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, (NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS - window_column) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte;

question: For the top 5 departments with the highest total number of reserved materials (status 'U'), list each department's name, the total count of reserved materials, the subject with the most reserved materials in that department, and the count of reserved materials for that subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS reserved_material_count FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED s JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL d ON s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT dept_totals.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dept_totals.total_reserved_materials, dept_subjects.SUBJECT_TITLE AS top_subject, dept_subjects.reserved_material_count AS top_subject_reserved_count FROM (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(reserved_material_count) AS total_reserved_materials FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY total_reserved_materials DESC LIMIT 5) dept_totals JOIN (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, reserved_material_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY reserved_material_count DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte ) dept_subjects ON dept_totals.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_subjects.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND dept_subjects.rn = 1 ORDER BY dept_totals.total_reserved_materials DESC;

question: For each organization, show the organization key, organization name, department name, the number of HR org units, the total of their department IDs, and the corresponding HR org unit title for organizations that are assignable and have a department code above 100000. Also, for each organization and department name, include a grand total for all HR org units in the format of (organization key, organization name, department name, null, total department IDs, null). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS hr_org_unit_count, SUM(h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS total_department_id FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION f JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID > 100000 GROUP BY f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) , OrgUnitDetails AS ( SELECT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION f JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID > 100000 ) , RollupResults AS ( SELECT i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, SUM(i.hr_org_unit_count) AS hr_org_unit_count, SUM(i.total_department_id) AS total_department_id FROM inner_cte i LEFT JOIN OrgUnitDetails o ON i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY AND i.ORGANIZATION_NAME = o.ORGANIZATION_NAME AND i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(i.hr_org_unit_count) > 0 ) SELECT rr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, rr.ORGANIZATION_NAME, rr.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, rr.hr_org_unit_count, rr.total_department_id FROM RollupResults rr ORDER BY rr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, rr.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE

question: For each subject, what is the minimum record count from TIP_DETAIL and the total new shelf price from TIP_MATERIAL for materials with a non-null author and a material info source of 'ISBN'? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS min_record_count, SUM(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS total_new_shelf_price, td.SUBJECT_ID FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE tm.AUTHOR IS NOT NULL AND tm.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE = 'ISBN' GROUP BY td.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT SUBJECT_ID, min_record_count, total_new_shelf_price FROM inner_cte;

question: For each employee type and department name where the student year is 'G', provide the number of people, the minimum MIT ID, and the number of unique office locations for those students. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(sp.MIT_ID) AS person_count, MIN(sp.MIT_ID) AS min_mit_id FROM SE_PERSON sp JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.person_count, ic.min_mit_id, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.OFFICE_LOCATION) AS unique_office_locations FROM inner_cte ic JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY ic.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.person_count, ic.min_mit_id;

question: For each department, what is the department name and the highest variance of the number of enrolled students in its courses (with at least one enrolled student and at least one course material with a material status of 'RQ') across all terms? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.TERM_CODE, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.TERM_CODE ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(enrolled_variance) AS highest_enrolled_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY highest_enrolled_variance DESC;

question: For each department, give the department name and the highest variance of total units for subjects offered in any term. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON tso.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.TERM_CODE ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(total_units_variance) AS highest_total_units_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY highest_total_units_variance DESC;

question: From the top 10 IAP activities with the highest maximum enrollment, display each activity's title, enrollment type, maximum enrollment, the category name, and the number of activities in that category, along with the dense rank of each activity within its category by maximum enrollment. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY ) SELECT ic.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ic.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, ic.MAX_ENROLLMENT, ic.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, cat_stats.Category_Activity_Count, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ic.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY ic.MAX_ENROLLMENT DESC) AS Category_Dense_Rank FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Category_Activity_Count FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY GROUP BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ) cat_stats ON ic.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = cat_stats.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY ic.MAX_ENROLLMENT DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each organization with a DLC key of 'D_MECHE', show the organization key, organization name, DLC name, and the rank of the organization within each DLC name group ordered by organization key, along with the organization description and whether the organization is assignable or not. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.DLC_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DLC_NAME ORDER BY t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.DLC_KEY = 'D_MECHE' ) SELECT inner_cte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.DLC_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, fo.DESCRIPTION, CASE WHEN fo.ASSIGNABLE = 1 THEN 'ASSIGNABLE' ELSE 'NOT_ASSIGNABLE' END AS assignable_status FROM inner_cte JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON inner_cte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY;

question: For each administrative department in the School of Engineering, list the administrative department name, the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by its departments (where the total is greater than 100), and the department with the highest number of enrolled students along with that enrollment count. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ic.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(ic.total_enrolled) AS total_enrolled, ic2.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS top_department, ic2.max_enrolled AS top_department_enrollment FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, total_enrolled AS max_enrolled FROM ( SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, total_enrolled, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_enrolled DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte ) ranked WHERE rn = 1 ) ic2 ON ic.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY ic.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic2.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic2.max_enrolled HAVING SUM(ic.total_enrolled) > 100;

question: For IAP subject activities with a maximum enrollment of 30, show the activity title, the academic year, and the total number of such activities per academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 30 ) SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, Activity_Count.Total_Activities FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE JOIN ( SELECT t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS Total_Activities FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 30 GROUP BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) AS Activity_Count ON t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = Activity_Count.ACADEMIC_YEAR WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 30;

question: For each material status, what is the minimum record count from TIP_DETAIL and the sum of academic years from ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL for materials where the term parameter is 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM'? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS min_record_count, SUM(ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS total_academic_years, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON td.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp ON ata.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM' GROUP BY td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ) SELECT TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, min_record_count, total_academic_years FROM inner_cte;

question: From the top 10 departments with the highest number of organizations whose parent is 'EXECVP' or 'CHNCLR', display each department's name, the total number of such organizations, the DLC name most represented among those organizations, and the count of organizations from that DLC. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS total_organizations, f.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON d.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON f.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY WHERE f.ORG_PARENT IN ('EXECVP', 'CHNCLR') GROUP BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, f.DLC_KEY ) SELECT icte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(icte.total_organizations) AS total_organizations, icte.DLC_KEY AS Most_Represented_DLC, dlc.DLC_NAME, icte.DLC_Org_Count FROM ( SELECT HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DLC_KEY, COUNT(*) AS DLC_Org_Count, SUM(total_organizations) AS total_organizations FROM inner_cte GROUP BY HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DLC_KEY ) icte JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT DLC_KEY, DLC_NAME FROM HR_ORG_UNIT ) dlc ON icte.DLC_KEY = dlc.DLC_KEY JOIN ( SELECT HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(DLC_Org_Count) AS max_count FROM ( SELECT HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DLC_KEY, COUNT(*) AS DLC_Org_Count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DLC_KEY ) sub GROUP BY HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) max_dlc ON icte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = max_dlc.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.DLC_Org_Count = max_dlc.max_count GROUP BY icte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.DLC_KEY, dlc.DLC_NAME, icte.DLC_Org_Count ORDER BY total_organizations DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each school, provide the school name, the average number of enrolled students for subjects offered in both the library and TIP datasets, and the deviation of this average from the overall average number of enrolled students across all such schools, considering only cases where the average number of enrolled students is greater than zero. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE GROUP BY l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME HAVING AVG(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrolled, (inner_cte.avg_enrolled - (SELECT AVG(avg_enrolled) FROM inner_cte)) AS deviation_from_overall_avg FROM inner_cte ORDER BY deviation_from_overall_avg DESC;

question: For each fiscal period, what is the fiscal period description, the variance of the calendar year for all days in that period where the academic year is not null, and whether the variance is 'HIGH_VARIANCE' (at least 20% greater than the average variance across all periods), 'LOW_VARIANCE' (at least 20% less than the average), or 'AVERAGE'? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT TIME_MONTH.FISCAL_PERIOD, TIME_MONTH.FISCAL_PERIOD_DESCRIPTION, VARIANCE(TIME_DAY.CALENDAR_YEAR) AS calendar_year_variance FROM TIME_MONTH JOIN TIME_DAY ON TIME_MONTH.FISCAL_PERIOD = TIME_DAY.FISCAL_PERIOD WHERE TIME_DAY.ACADEMIC_YEAR IS NOT NULL GROUP BY TIME_MONTH.FISCAL_PERIOD, TIME_MONTH.FISCAL_PERIOD_DESCRIPTION ) SELECT inner_cte.FISCAL_PERIOD, inner_cte.FISCAL_PERIOD_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.calendar_year_variance, CASE WHEN inner_cte.calendar_year_variance > avg_stats.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN inner_cte.calendar_year_variance < avg_stats.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(calendar_year_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte ) avg_stats ORDER BY inner_cte.calendar_year_variance DESC;

question: For each subject offered in the academic term with term code '2006FA', show the subject ID, subject title, department name, and the sum of lecture units within each grade type group ordered by subject ID, and also include the total number of subjects per department for that term. Only include departments that offer more than 5 subjects in that term. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.LECTURE_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA' ), DeptCounts AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS SUBJECT_COUNT FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = '2006FA' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.window_column, dc.SUBJECT_COUNT FROM inner_cte ic JOIN DeptCounts dc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ic.SUBJECT_ID

question: For each academic year, show the academic year description, the number of terms, the average number of terms across all academic years as a benchmark, and classify the academic year as 'HIGH_TERM_YEAR' if it has at least 10% more terms than average, 'LOW_TERM_YEAR' if it has at least 10% fewer terms than average, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Only consider terms where the term status indicator in ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL is 'P' and the term status in ACADEMIC_TERMS is not 'Future'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(at.TERM_CODE) AS term_count FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND at.TERM_STATUS <> 'Future' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), benchmark_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(term_count) AS avg_term_count FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.term_count, b.avg_term_count, CASE WHEN i.term_count > b.avg_term_count * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_TERM_YEAR' WHEN i.term_count < b.avg_term_count * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_TERM_YEAR' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS term_year_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN benchmark_cte b ORDER BY i.term_count DESC;

question: For academic terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the term parameter is 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM', show the academic terms key from ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL, the term description from ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER, the academic year description from ACADEMIC_TERMS, the term start date from ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL, the term end date from ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL, the minimum academic year from ACADEMIC_TERMS in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the term code from ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL, and also include the is_current_term flag from ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER and the is_regular_term flag from ACADEMIC_TERMS. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t0.TERM_START_DATE, t0.TERM_END_DATE, MIN(t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TERM_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND t1.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM' ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.TERM_END_DATE, inner_cte.window_column, t1.IS_CURRENT_TERM, t2.IS_REGULAR_TERM FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t1 ON inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION = t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC

question: For each academic year, provide the academic year description, the total number of unique subjects with TIP materials in that year, and the average, range, and variance of the record counts for TIP materials, considering only terms where the term status is not null and the TIP material status is not 'NM'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TIP_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID, TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS IS NOT NULL AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID) AS unique_subject_count, AVG(inner_cte.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_record_count, MAX(inner_cte.RECORD_COUNT) - MIN(inner_cte.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_range, VARIANCE(inner_cte.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY unique_subject_count DESC;

question: For subjects offered in the term with the description "Fall Term 2024-2025", show the subject code, subject title, department name, term description, and the rank of each subject within its department ordered by subject code, but only include those subjects whose total units exceed the average total units for their department in that term. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.window_column FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE i.TOTAL_UNITS > d.avg_units;

question: Show the organization names, organization keys, HR department names, HR org unit titles, HR org unit keys, the average organization key within each organization key group ordered by HR org unit key, and the corresponding HR org unit level and HR department code, for organizations with organization level equal to 5 and assignable equal to 1. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1 ) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, inner_cte.window_column, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY;

question: For subjects offered in the term '2017JA', show the subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, department full name, subject code, subject code description, and the minimum number of enrolled students over each subject code group, as well as the school name and department phone number. Order the results by subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.window_column, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For each department, what is the maximum average total units for subjects that had library reserve materials in any single term with a term status of 'Previous'? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.TERM_CODE, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.TERM_CODE ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(avg_total_units) AS max_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY max_avg_total_units DESC;

question: For each organization, what is the organization name, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the department codes (HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) among its associated HR org units, and the number of unique HR org unit titles, considering only organizations that have more than 3 associated HR org units? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS dept_code_stddev FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 ) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.dept_code_stddev, COUNT(DISTINCT HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE) AS unique_org_unit_titles FROM inner_cte JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID GROUP BY inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.dept_code_stddev ORDER BY inner_cte.dept_code_stddev DESC;

question: For each academic year and department name where the term status is 'Previous', provide the number of unique subjects offered and the minimum total units for those subjects, but only include those departments where the minimum total units is greater than the overall minimum total units across all such departments and years. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, subject_count, min_total_units FROM inner_cte WHERE min_total_units > ( SELECT MIN(min_total_units) FROM inner_cte );

question: For each IAP subject activity that is not cancelled and has a non-null maximum enrollment, provide the activity title, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the academic years in which the activity was offered, and also include the earliest and latest term start dates for those offerings. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, MAX(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) - MIN(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS academic_year_range, VARIANCE(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS academic_year_variance, STDDEV(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS academic_year_stddev FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON d.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL aa ON a.TERM_CODE = aa.TERM_CODE WHERE d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE ) SELECT ic.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ic.academic_year_range, ic.academic_year_variance, ic.academic_year_stddev, MIN(ata.TERM_START_DATE) AS earliest_term_start, MAX(ata.TERM_START_DATE) AS latest_term_start FROM inner_cte ic JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d ON ic.ACTIVITY_TITLE = d.ACTIVITY_TITLE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON d.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON at.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ic.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ic.academic_year_range, ic.academic_year_variance, ic.academic_year_stddev ORDER BY ic.academic_year_range DESC;

question: For each department, provide the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units), and also show the difference between the average total units of each department and the overall average total units across all departments. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units, (inner_cte.avg_total_units - overall.avg_total_units_overall) AS deviation_from_overall_avg FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units_overall FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) overall ORDER BY deviation_from_overall_avg DESC;

question: For the top 10 activity titles with the highest number of associated course materials, provide the activity title, the term description, the count of course materials, and indicate whether the material count is 'HIGH_MATERIAL' (at least 10% greater than the average for that term), 'LOW_MATERIAL' (at least 10% less than the average for that term), or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_DESCRIPTION, IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE, COUNT(TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' GROUP BY IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_DESCRIPTION, IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE ) , term_avg AS ( SELECT TERM_CODE, AVG(material_count) AS avg_material_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY TERM_CODE ) SELECT i.ACTIVITY_TITLE, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.material_count, CASE WHEN i.material_count > t.avg_material_count * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_MATERIAL' WHEN i.material_count < t.avg_material_count * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_MATERIAL' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS material_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN term_avg t ON i.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE ORDER BY i.material_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each academic building with rooms larger than 40 square meters, show the building name, the average, range, and variance of the room areas, and also display the total assignable area of the building and the year the building was built. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_room_area, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS room_area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS room_area_variance FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND r.AREA > 40 GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME ) SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.avg_room_area, ic.room_area_range, ic.room_area_variance, fb.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, fb.DATE_BUILT FROM inner_cte ic JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON ic.BUILDING_NAME = fb.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY ic.room_area_range DESC;

question: For each textbook material in the TIP_DETAIL table with a material status key of 'RQ', show the subject offered key, material key, subject ID, term code, academic year, and term description, along with the number of textbook materials per academic year and the minimum term code for each academic year. Include subtotals for each academic year (the corresponding academic year field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all academic years (the corresponding academic year field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the academic year if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by academic year and term code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_CODE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(academic_year) OVER (ORDER BY academic_year_sort, min_term_code) = academic_year THEN NULL ELSE academic_year END AS academic_year, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, material_count, min_term_code FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS academic_year_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS academic_year, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(*) AS material_count, MIN(TERM_CODE) AS min_term_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY academic_year_sort, min_term_code

question: For each organization whose major organization is 'PROVST' or 'CHNCLR' and has more than 2 distinct space units, show the organization name, the DLC key, the total number of distinct space units, and the most recent warehouse load date for any of its space units. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fo.DLC_KEY, COUNT(DISTINCT su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS num_space_units FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fodk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON fodk.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY WHERE fo.MAJOR_ORG IN ('PROVST', 'CHNCLR') GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fo.DLC_KEY HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) > 2 ) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.DLC_KEY, inner_cte.num_space_units, MAX(su.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS most_recent_load_date FROM inner_cte JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON inner_cte.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY GROUP BY inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.DLC_KEY, inner_cte.num_space_units;

question: For each subject in the term "2010FA", show the subject ID, the term description from ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL, the material status key from TIP_DETAIL, the academic year from ACADEMIC_TERMS, and the department name from SIS_DEPARTMENT. Also, show the rank of each subject within each academic year group ordered by subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.TERM_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2010FA' ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ic.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID AND ic.TERM_CODE = cso.TERM_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each course subject title, what is the highest average number of enrolled students in any term among courses that have at least one reserved library material and at least one course material with a non-null ISBN? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.TERM_CODE, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lrm.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.ISBN IS NOT NULL AND lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.TERM_CODE ) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(avg_enrolled) AS highest_avg_enrolled_per_term FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY highest_avg_enrolled_per_term DESC;

question: For IAP subject activities in the term "2021JA" that are not cancelled, show the activity title, enrollment type, calendar date, and the day of the week, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by activity title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.CALENDAR_DATE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN TIME_DAY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' ) SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.CALENDAR_DATE, t1.DAY_OF_WEEK, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN TIME_DAY t1 ON inner_cte.CALENDAR_DATE = t1.CALENDAR_DATE

question: For the top 5 organizations with the highest variance in room area (among those with a non-null DLC key), show each organization's name, the variance of its room areas, the building with the largest total room area for that organization, and the total area of rooms in that building. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY o JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) SELECT ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.area_variance, br.BUILDING_ROOM AS Largest_Building, br.Total_Building_Area FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, r.BUILDING_ROOM, SUM(r.AREA) AS Total_Building_Area, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY SUM(r.AREA) DESC) AS rn FROM FCLT_ROOMS r GROUP BY r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, r.BUILDING_ROOM ) br ON ic.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = br.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY AND br.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.area_variance DESC LIMIT 5;

question: For each department that is degree-granting and offered at least one subject in the School of Engineering in 2021, provide the department code, department name, department full name, the number of subjects offered, and the total number of enrolled students in those subjects, grouped by whether the total number of enrolled students in the department's subjects is at least 100 ('High Enrollment') or less than 100 ('Low Enrollment'). For each enrollment group, include a grand total for all departments in that group in the format of (null, null, null, null, total enrollment). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ), EnrollmentGroup AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, subject_count, total_enrollment, CASE WHEN total_enrollment >= 100 THEN 'High Enrollment' ELSE 'Low Enrollment' END AS enrollment_group FROM inner_cte ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT enrollment_group, DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, SUM(subject_count) AS subject_count, SUM(total_enrollment) AS total_enrollment FROM EnrollmentGroup GROUP BY enrollment_group, DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(total_enrollment) > 0 ) SELECT rr.enrollment_group, rr.DEPARTMENT_CODE, rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, rr.subject_count, rr.total_enrollment FROM RollupResults rr ORDER BY rr.enrollment_group, rr.DEPARTMENT_CODE

question: Among all organizations with a DLC key of 'D_MECHE' and an organization level of 5, what are the names and descriptions of these organizations, and for each, what is the name and description of their parent organization? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DESCRIPTION, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORG_PARENT_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY.DLC_KEY = 'D_MECHE' AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS Org_Name, inner_cte.DESCRIPTION AS Org_Description, parent_org.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS Parent_Org_Name, parent_org.DESCRIPTION AS Parent_Org_Description FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION parent_org ON inner_cte.FCLT_ORG_PARENT_KEY = parent_org.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY;

question: For each subject offered in the term 2013FA, list the subject offered key, the subject ID, the number of materials assigned, the total new shelf price of those materials (considering only materials with a new shelf price greater than 10), and whether the total new shelf price is 'EXPENSIVE' (if it exceeds 200), 'CHEAP' (if it is less than 50), or 'MODERATE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, d.SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count, SUM(m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS total_new_shelf_price FROM TIP_DETAIL d JOIN TIP_MATERIAL m ON d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE d.TERM_CODE = '2013FA' AND m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE > 10 GROUP BY d.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, d.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT inner_cte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.material_count, inner_cte.total_new_shelf_price, CASE WHEN inner_cte.total_new_shelf_price > 200 THEN 'EXPENSIVE' WHEN inner_cte.total_new_shelf_price < 50 THEN 'CHEAP' ELSE 'MODERATE' END AS price_category FROM inner_cte;

question: For each department in the current academic term, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered? Show the department name, school name, and these statistics. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.SCHOOL_NAME, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON atp.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.SCHOOL_NAME, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_variance, icte.total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte icte ORDER BY icte.total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each academic term, provide the term description, the total number of IAP activities that are not cancelled and have at least one required course material, and for each term, also show the average, range, and variance of the maximum enrollment values for those activities. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_DESCRIPTION, IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE, IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.MAX_ENROLLMENT FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ) SELECT inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(*) AS total_activities, AVG(inner_cte.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, MAX(inner_cte.MAX_ENROLLMENT) - MIN(inner_cte.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_range, VARIANCE(inner_cte.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY total_activities DESC;

question: For each department under the 'Provost Area' in the department hierarchy, what is the minimum organization level and the total number of assignable organizations, and include a grand total for all departments in the format of (null, total assignable, min org level)? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(f.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) AS min_org_level, SUM(f.ASSIGNABLE) AS total_assignable, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME AS dept_name FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON h.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME ) SELECT dept_name, min_org_level, total_assignable FROM inner_cte GROUP BY dept_name, min_org_level, total_assignable WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(total_assignable) > 0 ORDER BY dept_name

question: For space units with a space unit code equal to 97500, show the space unit name, the associated organization's name, the DLC name, the DLC key from the organization, the minimum space unit code in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the facility organization key, and also include the total number of space units for each organization. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS organization_name, t1.DLC_NAME AS dlc_name, t1.DLC_KEY AS org_dlc_key, MIN(t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_min_space_unit_code, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 97500 ) SELECT inner_cte.space_unit_name, inner_cte.organization_name, inner_cte.dlc_name, inner_cte.org_dlc_key, inner_cte.window_min_space_unit_code, COUNT(su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS total_space_units_for_org FROM inner_cte JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON inner_cte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY GROUP BY inner_cte.space_unit_name, inner_cte.organization_name, inner_cte.dlc_name, inner_cte.org_dlc_key, inner_cte.window_min_space_unit_code

question: For each program category in the School of Engineering with a program version after 2000, what is the latest course start term and the highest program version? Also, for each category, which course has the latest start term and what is its course description? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.CATEGORY_TITLE, MAX(s.FROM_TERM) AS latest_start_term, MAX(c.VERSION) AS highest_program_version FROM CIP c JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION s ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND c.VERSION > 2000 GROUP BY c.CATEGORY_TITLE ) SELECT i.CATEGORY_TITLE, i.latest_start_term, i.highest_program_version, s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte i JOIN CIP c ON i.CATEGORY_TITLE = c.CATEGORY_TITLE AND i.highest_program_version = c.VERSION JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION s ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE AND s.FROM_TERM = i.latest_start_term WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering';

question: For each department, what is the highest average total units for degree-granting subjects offered in any academic year, and in which academic year did this occur? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(avg_total_units) AS highest_avg_total_units, ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY avg_total_units DESC) AS rnk FROM inner_cte ) ranked WHERE rnk = 1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY highest_avg_total_units DESC;

question: For each student year, list the student year and the average, range, and variance of department budget codes for students in that year, considering only students whose department code matches both an academic department and an administrative department, and include only those student years where the average department budget code exceeds the overall average department budget code across all student years. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.STUDENT_YEAR, AVG(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget, MAX(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) - MIN(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_range, VARIANCE(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ON MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.DEPARTMENT = SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.STUDENT_YEAR ) SELECT inner_cte.STUDENT_YEAR, inner_cte.avg_budget, inner_cte.budget_range, inner_cte.budget_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.avg_budget > (SELECT AVG(avg_budget) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY inner_cte.budget_range DESC;

question: For each subject offered, show the subject offered key, material key, material status key, subject ID, the term description, academic year, term start date, the maximum term end date for each row and the next two rows in order of subject offered key, and indicate whether the term status indicator is 'P' (past), 'C' (current), or 'F' (future), only for terms that are not the current term and have a material status key of 'RQ'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, MAX(t1.TERM_END_DATE) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_TERM_END_DATE, t1.TERM_CODE FROM TIP_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ) SELECT inner_cte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.MAX_TERM_END_DATE, t1.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE;

question: For each department name and course level where the course is degree granting and the total units are greater than 6, provide the number of unique courses, the minimum total units offered, and the number of courses where the design units are at least 3. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.COURSE_LEVEL, ic.course_count, ic.min_total_units, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ccc.DESIGN_UNITS >= 3 THEN scd.COURSE END) AS courses_with_design_units_3_or_more FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.COURSE_LEVEL = scd.COURSE_LEVEL JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.COURSE_LEVEL, ic.course_count, ic.min_total_units;

question: For each space unit, list the space unit name and the number of rooms it contains, but only include those space units that have more rooms than the average number of rooms per space unit. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(sd.BUILDING_ROOM) AS room_count FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT ) SELECT i.SPACE_UNIT, i.room_count FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT AVG(room_count) AS avg_room_count FROM ( SELECT COUNT(sd.BUILDING_ROOM) AS room_count FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT ) sub ) a ON 1=1 WHERE i.room_count > a.avg_room_count;

question: For rooms with an access level of 1, show the building-room identifier, the area, the major use description, and the average area for each major use description. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.AREA, t0.DESCRIPTION FROM FCLT_MAJOR_USE t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 ) SELECT DESCRIPTION, AVG(AREA) AS avg_area FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DESCRIPTION;

question: For each organization with organization level equal to 5 and assignable equal to 1, show the organization name, organization key, HR department name, HR org unit title, HR org unit key, and the average organization key within each organization key group ordered by HR org unit key, but only include those where the average organization key is greater than the overall average organization key for all such organizations. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1 ) SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > ( SELECT AVG(FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION WHERE ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND ASSIGNABLE = 1 );

question: For buildings with a building type of 'ACADEMIC' and a campus sector of 'MAIN GROUP', show the building name from the current table, the fiscal period from the history table, and the maximum assignable area from the history table for each building, along with their dense rank considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the assignable area from the history table. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.BUILDING_NAME, t1.FISCAL_PERIOD, t1.ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM FCLT_BUILDING t0 JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST t1 ON t0.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY = t1.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY WHERE t0.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND t0.CAMPUS_SECTOR = 'MAIN GROUP' ) SELECT BUILDING_NAME, FISCAL_PERIOD, MAX(ASSIGNABLE_AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY BUILDING_NAME) AS max_assignable_area, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY ASSIGNABLE_AREA ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM inner_cte;

question: For each HASS attribute, what is the maximum row number assigned to any subject offered in the academic year 2022 with that HASS attribute, where row numbers are assigned within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title? Show the HASS attribute, its description, and the maximum row number. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.HASS_ATTRIBUTE, t1.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY t0.HASS_ATTRIBUTE ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE t1 ON t0.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = t1.HASS_ATTRIBUTE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 ) SELECT HASS_ATTRIBUTE, DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM, MAX(window_column) AS max_row_number FROM inner_cte GROUP BY HASS_ATTRIBUTE, DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM;

question: List the subject code, subject code description, and department name for all subject codes that are associated with departments that are degree-granting and belong to the School of Engineering. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS engineering_degree_granting_subject_codes FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering';
