question: For each department, what is the highest number of units among all HASS Elective subjects offered in the 2022 academic year, and which subject(s) have that number of units? Provide the department code, subject code, subject number, subject title, and total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.TOTAL_UNITS, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE h ON c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = h.HASS_ATTRIBUTE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND h.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM = 'HASS Elective' ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_NUMBER, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE ) m ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND i.TOTAL_UNITS = m.max_units

question: What is the minimum CIP program code and the total number of unique school names for courses where the department name is 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci', the subject code description is not null, and the course level is 'G'? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_program_code, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.SCHOOL_NAME) AS total_unique_school_names FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL ) SELECT inner_cte.min_cip_program_code, inner_cte.total_unique_school_names FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd2 ON scd2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND scd2.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc2 ON scd2.COURSE = ssc2.SUBJECT_CODE AND ssc2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL;

question: For each department and academic year where the subject enrollment number is greater than 10, provide the number of unique subjects, the minimum total units offered, the average subject enrollment number as a benchmark, and classify the department-year as 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' if the minimum total units is at least 10% greater than the benchmark, 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' if at least 10% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.subject_count, i.min_total_units, s.benchmark_enrollment, CASE WHEN i.min_total_units > s.benchmark_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.min_total_units < s.benchmark_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS benchmark_enrollment FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) s ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each department, what is the geometric mean of the space unit codes for all space units associated with that department, considering only space units with a code greater than 0? Also, for each department, indicate whether the geometric mean is 'HIGH' (at least 20% greater than the average geometric mean across all departments), 'LOW' (at least 20% less than the average), or 'AVERAGE'. Provide the department name, the geometric mean, the overall average geometric mean, and the category. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE))) AS geometric_mean FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT s ON o.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY WHERE s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE > 0 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.geometric_mean, avg_stats.avg_geometric_mean, CASE WHEN ic.geometric_mean > avg_stats.avg_geometric_mean * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN ic.geometric_mean < avg_stats.avg_geometric_mean * 0.8 THEN 'LOW' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(geometric_mean) AS avg_geometric_mean FROM inner_cte ) avg_stats ORDER BY ic.geometric_mean DESC;

question: List the department codes, department names, and the total number of units for all courses in each department, but only for those departments whose total units are more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean total units across all departments. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) > ( SELECT AVG(dept_total) + STDDEV(dept_total) FROM ( SELECT SUM(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS dept_total FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) t ) ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_units FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: For each DLC, provide the DLC name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the organization numbers for assignable organizations associated with that DLC, but only include DLCs where the average organization number is greater than the overall average organization number for all assignable organizations. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT o.DLC_NAME, AVG(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS avg_org_number, STDDEV(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 GROUP BY o.DLC_NAME ) SELECT DLC_NAME, avg_org_number, org_number_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_org_number > ( SELECT AVG(ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION WHERE ASSIGNABLE = 1 ) ORDER BY org_number_stddev DESC;

question: For each activity title, what is the highest number of associated course materials it has had in any term, including the activity title from IAP subject details and the maximum material count? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' GROUP BY IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_DESCRIPTION ) SELECT ACTIVITY_TITLE, MAX(material_count) AS highest_material_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACTIVITY_TITLE;

question: For organizations with a major organization key of 230, show the organization name, department name, department code, department long name, department level, the average organization number in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the organization parent, and also display the top department (by count of organizations) within each organization parent, along with the count of organizations for that department. Limit the results to the top 10 organization parents with the highest total organization counts. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, t2.ORG_PARENT, t2.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t2.FCLT_MAJOR_ORG_KEY = 230 ) SELECT ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, ic.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, AVG(ic.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) OVER ( PARTITION BY ic.ORG_PARENT ORDER BY ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, dept_stats.Top_Department, dept_stats.Department_Org_Count FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ic2.ORG_PARENT, ic2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Top_Department, COUNT(*) AS Department_Org_Count FROM inner_cte ic2 GROUP BY ic2.ORG_PARENT, ic2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) = ( SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM inner_cte ic3 WHERE ic3.ORG_PARENT = ic2.ORG_PARENT GROUP BY ic3.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) sub ) ) dept_stats ON ic.ORG_PARENT = dept_stats.ORG_PARENT AND ic.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_stats.Top_Department WHERE ic.ORG_PARENT IN ( SELECT org_parent FROM ( SELECT ic4.ORG_PARENT AS org_parent, COUNT(*) AS total_orgs FROM inner_cte ic4 GROUP BY ic4.ORG_PARENT ORDER BY total_orgs DESC LIMIT 10 ) top_parents ) ORDER BY ic.ORG_PARENT, ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME;

question: For each department in the 2022 academic year, list the department code, department name, the HASS Elective attribute description, the number of HASS Elective subjects offered in that department, and a grand total of HASS Elective subjects across all departments. For each department, include a grand total row in the format (null, null, null, total HASS Elective subjects). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.TOTAL_UNITS, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, h.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE h ON c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = h.HASS_ATTRIBUTE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND h.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM = 'HASS Elective' ), DepartmentHassCounts AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM, COUNT(*) AS num_hass_electives FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM, num_hass_electives FROM DepartmentHassCounts ORDER BY CASE WHEN DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, DEPARTMENT_CODE ;

question: For each school, list the school name, the number of departments in that school that offer at least one course with more than 9 total units, and the maximum total units of any course in those departments, but only include schools where at least two such departments exist. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ) SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS num_departments_with_big_courses, MAX(ic.max_total_units) AS max_total_units_in_school FROM inner_cte ic WHERE ic.max_total_units > 9 GROUP BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME) >= 2;

question: For each sponsor, provide the sponsor name, the average and variance of the maximum enrollment for their IAP activities, and also display the sponsor type. Only include sponsors whose average maximum enrollment is among the top 5 highest. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SPONSOR_NAME, s.SPONSOR_TYPE, AVG(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, VARIANCE(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS var_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.SPONSOR_NAME, s.SPONSOR_TYPE ) SELECT icte.SPONSOR_NAME, icte.SPONSOR_TYPE, icte.avg_max_enrollment, icte.var_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte icte ORDER BY icte.avg_max_enrollment DESC LIMIT 5;

question: For subjects offered in the term with the description "Fall Term 2024-2025", show the subject ID, subject title, offering department name, term description, the rank of each subject within its offering department, and the total number of subjects offered by each department in that term, ordered by subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.window_column, dept_counts.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS Total_Subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' GROUP BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) dept_counts ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_counts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For IAP subject activities with a maximum enrollment of at least 10 and that are not cancelled, show the activity title, enrollment type, the academic term description, the subject title from the course catalog, and the department name, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by activity title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 10 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' ) SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE = t2.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For each space unit, list the space unit name and the number of rooms assigned to it, but only include those space units where the number of rooms with an access level of at least 1 is greater than the average number of such rooms per space unit. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(zr.BUILDING_ROOM) AS room_count FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD zr ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = zr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE zr.ACCESS_LEVEL >= 1 GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT ) SELECT SPACE_UNIT, room_count FROM inner_cte WHERE room_count > (SELECT AVG(room_count) FROM inner_cte);

question: For each subject offered in the academic term with term code '2006FA', show the subject ID, subject title, department name, the sum of lecture units within each grade type group ordered by subject ID, and the name of the responsible faculty member for each subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.LECTURE_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID;

question: From the rooms on floor 2, list each building room, its space usage, the organization name, the HR org unit title, the department name, and the department's long name, along with the minimum access level in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the building component. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.SPACE_USAGE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, MIN(t0.ACCESS_LEVEL) OVER (ORDER BY t0.BUILDING_COMPONENT ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2 ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description, the variance of the maximum enrollment for IAP activities that are not cancelled and require advance sign-up, and the deviation of this variance from the average variance across all academic years? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.max_enrollment_variance, (inner_cte.max_enrollment_variance - avg_variance.avg_max_enrollment_variance) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(max_enrollment_variance) AS avg_max_enrollment_variance FROM inner_cte ) avg_variance ORDER BY deviation_from_avg DESC;

question: For each administrative department, provide the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the office phone numbers of students in that department (considering only students with a non-null office phone number), and classify the department as 'HIGH_VARIANCE' if the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is at least 20% greater than the average, 'LOW_VARIANCE' if the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is at least 20% less than the average, or 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.OFFICE_PHONE) AS avg_office_phone, STDDEV(MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.OFFICE_PHONE) AS stddev_office_phone FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY ON SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.DEPARTMENT WHERE MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.OFFICE_PHONE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_office_phone, inner_cte.stddev_office_phone, CASE WHEN inner_cte.stddev_office_phone > inner_cte.avg_office_phone * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN inner_cte.stddev_office_phone < inner_cte.avg_office_phone * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.stddev_office_phone DESC;

question: For each subject offered in the term 2013FA, list the subject offered key, the subject ID, the number of materials assigned, the total new shelf price of those materials (considering only materials with a new shelf price greater than 10), and the average used shelf price of those materials. Do not repeat the subject offered key if it is the same as the previous row. Include subtotals for each subject ID (the corresponding subject offered key field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all subjects (the corresponding subject offered key field is 'TOTAL'). Sort the table by subject ID and subject offered key. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, d.SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count, SUM(m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS total_new_shelf_price FROM TIP_DETAIL d JOIN TIP_MATERIAL m ON d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE d.TERM_CODE = '2013FA' AND m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE > 10 GROUP BY d.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, d.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(subject_offered_key) OVER (ORDER BY subject_id_sort, subject_offered_key_sort) = subject_offered_key THEN NULL ELSE subject_offered_key END AS subject_offered_key, subject_id, material_count, total_new_shelf_price, avg_used_shelf_price FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(SUBJECT_ID) = 1 AND GROUPING(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY END AS subject_offered_key_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(SUBJECT_ID) = 0 AND GROUPING(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(SUBJECT_ID) = 1 AND GROUPING(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY END AS subject_offered_key, CASE WHEN GROUPING(SUBJECT_ID) = 0 AND GROUPING(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE SUBJECT_ID END AS subject_id_sort, SUBJECT_ID AS subject_id, COUNT(DISTINCT d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count, SUM(m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS total_new_shelf_price, AVG(m.USED_SHELF_PRICE) AS avg_used_shelf_price FROM TIP_DETAIL d JOIN TIP_MATERIAL m ON d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE d.TERM_CODE = '2013FA' AND m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE > 10 GROUP BY SUBJECT_ID, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY subject_id_sort, subject_offered_key_sort;

question: For each academic year and department, list the academic year, department name, and the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered in regular terms, but only include those (academic year, department) pairs where the average total units is greater than the overall average total units for all such groups. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_total_units, i.var_total_units FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT AVG(avg_total_units) AS overall_avg FROM ( SELECT AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) sub ) o ON i.avg_total_units > o.overall_avg ORDER BY i.var_total_units DESC;

question: From the top 10 space usage types with the highest number of rooms at access level 1, display each space usage type, the total number of such rooms, the average floor for that space usage, the organization name most frequently associated with that space usage, and the count of rooms for that organization within the space usage. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.BUILDING_COMPONENT, t1.FLOOR, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(t1.FLOOR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SPACE_USAGE ORDER BY t1.FLOOR) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 ) SELECT icte.SPACE_USAGE, COUNT(icte.BUILDING_ROOM) AS Room_Count, AVG(icte.FLOOR) AS Avg_Floor, org_stats.Top_Organization_Name, org_stats.Org_Room_Count FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT icte2.SPACE_USAGE, icte2.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS Top_Organization_Name, COUNT(icte2.BUILDING_ROOM) AS Org_Room_Count, @rank := IF(@current_usage = icte2.SPACE_USAGE, @rank + 1, 1) AS `Rank`, @current_usage := icte2.SPACE_USAGE FROM ( SELECT SPACE_USAGE, ORGANIZATION_NAME, BUILDING_ROOM FROM inner_cte ) icte2 CROSS JOIN (SELECT @rank := 0, @current_usage := '') vars GROUP BY icte2.SPACE_USAGE, icte2.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY icte2.SPACE_USAGE, Org_Room_Count DESC ) org_stats ON icte.SPACE_USAGE = org_stats.SPACE_USAGE AND org_stats.`Rank` = 1 GROUP BY icte.SPACE_USAGE, org_stats.Top_Organization_Name, org_stats.Org_Room_Count ORDER BY Room_Count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each material information source, list the material information source, the total number of records for materials published after 2010 with a new shelf price greater than 10, and the average used shelf price for those materials, but only include sources where the total number of records is greater than 0 and the average used shelf price is above 20. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE, SUM(d.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_records FROM TIP_DETAIL d JOIN TIP_MATERIAL m ON d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE m.YEAR > 2010 AND m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE > 10 GROUP BY m.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE HAVING SUM(d.RECORD_COUNT) > 0 ) SELECT ic.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE, ic.total_records, AVG(m.USED_SHELF_PRICE) AS avg_used_shelf_price FROM inner_cte ic JOIN TIP_MATERIAL m ON ic.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE = m.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE WHERE m.YEAR > 2010 AND m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE > 10 GROUP BY ic.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE, ic.total_records HAVING AVG(m.USED_SHELF_PRICE) > 20

question: Among the top 10 DLCs with the highest average organization numbers (considering only assignable organizations), show each DLC's name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of organization numbers, the major organization most represented within that DLC, and the count of assignable organizations from that major organization. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT o.DLC_NAME, AVG(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS avg_org_number, STDDEV(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 GROUP BY o.DLC_NAME ) SELECT ic.DLC_NAME, ic.avg_org_number, ic.org_number_stddev, mo.MAJOR_ORG AS Most_Represented_Major_Org, mo.Assignable_Org_Count FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT o.DLC_NAME, o.MAJOR_ORG, COUNT(*) AS Assignable_Org_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.DLC_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION o WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 GROUP BY o.DLC_NAME, o.MAJOR_ORG ) mo ON ic.DLC_NAME = mo.DLC_NAME AND mo.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.avg_org_number DESC LIMIT 10;

question: List the top 10 space units by the number of rooms they contain, but only include those space units where the number of rooms is greater than the average number of rooms per space unit. Show the space unit name and the count of rooms for each. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(sd.BUILDING_ROOM) AS room_count FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT ) SELECT SPACE_UNIT, room_count FROM inner_cte WHERE room_count > (SELECT AVG(room_count) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY room_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description, the total number of TIP materials, and the difference between this total and the average number of TIP materials across all academic years, considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the TIP material status key is not 'NM'? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_tip_materials FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.total_tip_materials, (inner_cte.total_tip_materials - (SELECT AVG(total_tip_materials) FROM inner_cte)) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte ORDER BY deviation_from_avg DESC;

question: For each student department, give the department name and the total number of active graduate students who have an office location assigned, but only include departments where this total is greater than the average number of such students per department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS total_active_grad_students FROM SE_PERSON s JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY m ON s.FULL_NAME = m.FULL_NAME WHERE s.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND m.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND m.OFFICE_LOCATION IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_active_grad_students FROM inner_cte WHERE total_active_grad_students > ( SELECT AVG(total_active_grad_students) FROM inner_cte );

question: For each subject offered in the term '2017FA', provide the subject title, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the record counts for all tip materials associated with that subject, and also include the department name and the total number of enrolled students for each subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(t.RECORD_COUNT) - MIN(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_range, VARIANCE(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON s.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.record_count_range, i.record_count_variance, i.record_count_stddev, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON i.SUBJECT_TITLE = s.SUBJECT_TITLE AND s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' ORDER BY i.record_count_range DESC;

question: For subjects offered in the term "2012SU", show the subject title, subject key, offer department name, subject enrollment number, subject offered summary key, the average subject enrollment number within each subject key group ordered by offer department name, and for each offer department name, include a grand total of subject enrollment numbers in the format of (null, null, offer department name, null, null, null, total enrollment). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.SUBJECT_KEY, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY, AVG(t0.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SUBJECT_KEY ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' ), dept_totals AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.SUBJECT_KEY, ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, ic.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY, ic.window_column, NULL AS total_enrollment FROM inner_cte ic UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS SUBJECT_KEY, dt.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NULL AS SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, NULL AS SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY, NULL AS window_column, dt.total_enrollment FROM dept_totals dt ORDER BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For each department and course number where the number of enrolled students in the subject summary is greater than 2, provide the number of unique library subjects offered and the minimum total units for those subjects, grouped by the offering school name. For each department, course number, and offering school name, include a grand total for all subjects in the format of (department, course number, null, total subjects, min total units). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COURSE_NUMBER, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(subject_count) AS total_subjects, MIN(min_total_units) AS min_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COURSE_NUMBER, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(subject_count) > 0 ORDER BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COURSE_NUMBER, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME

question: For subjects offered in the term "2012SU", show the subject title, subject key, offer department name, subject enrollment number, subject offered summary key, the average subject enrollment number within each subject key group, and the deviation of each subject's enrollment number from the average enrollment number for its subject key group, ordered by offer department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.SUBJECT_KEY, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY, AVG(t0.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SUBJECT_KEY ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_KEY, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, inner_cte.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY, inner_cte.window_column AS avg_enrollment_number, (inner_cte.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER - inner_cte.window_column) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: For each department, what is the minimum number of lecture units and the total number of units for all subjects offered in the Fall term of the academic year 2022? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS min_lecture_units, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.TERM_DESCRIPTION LIKE 'Fall Term%' AND c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte;

question: For each department, provide the department name, the geometric mean of the total units for all subjects offered in regular terms with total units greater than zero, the average total units as a benchmark, and classify the department as 'HIGH_UNIT' if the geometric mean is at least 10% greater than the average, 'LOW_UNIT' if at least 10% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units) AS department_geometric_mean, AVG(inner_cte.avg_total_units) AS department_avg_total_units, CASE WHEN AVG(inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units) > AVG(inner_cte.avg_total_units) * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN AVG(inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units) < AVG(inner_cte.avg_total_units) * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY department_geometric_mean DESC;

question: For each HGN code, what is the department name, the maximum number of lecture units among all subjects in the course catalog, and the subject title from the subject offered table, for subjects offered in the year 2012 with more than 2 lecture units, and only include those records where the maximum number of lecture units for that HGN code and department exceeds the average lecture units for that HGN code and department in 2012? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, s.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON c.HGN_CODE = s.HGN_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 AND c.LECTURE_UNITS > 2 GROUP BY c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE HAVING MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) > 2 ), avg_lecture AS ( SELECT HGN_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(LECTURE_UNITS) AS avg_lecture_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 GROUP BY HGN_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.HGN_CODE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.max_lecture_units, i.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM inner_cte i JOIN avg_lecture a ON i.HGN_CODE = a.HGN_CODE AND i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE i.max_lecture_units > a.avg_lecture_units;

question: For each subject offered by the library in the term "2019SP", show the subject title, the number of enrolled students, the term description, the total units for the subject, the average total units within each subject group, the offering department name, and the school name. Do not repeat the subject title if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by the number of enrolled students and department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ss.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY ss.SUBJECT_GROUP_ID ORDER BY lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_total_units, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2019SP' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(SUBJECT_TITLE) OVER (ORDER BY NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, OFFER_DEPT_NAME) = SUBJECT_TITLE THEN NULL ELSE SUBJECT_TITLE END AS subject_title, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, TERM_DESCRIPTION, TOTAL_UNITS, avg_total_units, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte ORDER BY NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: For each subject offered in the term '2017FA', provide the subject title, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the record counts of tip materials for that subject, along with the offering department name and the offering school name. Sort the results by the range of record counts in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(t.RECORD_COUNT) - MIN(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_range, VARIANCE(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.record_count_range, i.record_count_variance, i.record_count_stddev, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON i.SUBJECT_TITLE = s.SUBJECT_TITLE AND s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' ORDER BY i.record_count_range DESC;

question: For each major organization and department, list the major organization name, department name, department code, department long name, department level, and the average organization number in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the organization parent, ordered by the major organization name and department. Include subtotals for each major organization (the corresponding major organization field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all major organizations (the corresponding major organization field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the major organization name if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by major organization and department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, t2.MAJOR_ORG, t2.ORG_PARENT, t2.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(major_org) OVER (ORDER BY major_org_sort, major_org, dept_sort) = major_org THEN NULL ELSE major_org END AS major_org, dept, dept_code, dept_long_name, dept_level, window_column FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(major_org) = 1 AND GROUPING(dept) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE major_org END AS major_org_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(major_org) = 0 AND GROUPING(dept) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(major_org) = 1 AND GROUPING(dept) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE major_org END AS major_org, CASE WHEN GROUPING(major_org) = 0 AND GROUPING(dept) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE dept END AS dept_sort, dept, dept_code, dept_long_name, dept_level, AVG(organization_number) OVER ( PARTITION BY org_parent ORDER BY organization_name ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ( SELECT MAJOR_ORG as major_org, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME as dept, HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE as dept_code, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG as dept_long_name, HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL as dept_level, ORGANIZATION_NAME as organization_name, ORG_PARENT as org_parent, ORGANIZATION_NUMBER as organization_number FROM inner_cte ) base GROUP BY major_org, dept, dept_code, dept_long_name, dept_level, org_parent, organization_name, organization_number WITH ROLLUP ) tbltmp ORDER BY major_org_sort, dept_sort;

question: For subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering, show the subject title, total units, department full name, and the difference between the total units of each subject and the average total units for that department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ) , dept_avg AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TOTAL_UNITS, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - d.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_dept_avg FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: For each department, what is the highest number of enrolled students in any subject offered by that department, considering only departments that grant degrees and subjects with a non-null subject code description? Please provide the department name and the highest number of enrolled students in a single subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS highest_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY highest_enrolled_students DESC;

question: For each tip detail record where the material status key is 'RQ', show the subject ID, term description, term start date, tip material key, and the average record count in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the financial aid year, and then for each subject ID, show the maximum of these windowed averages. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, AVG(t1.RECORD_COUNT) OVER ( PARTITION BY t0.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ) SELECT SUBJECT_ID, MAX(window_column) AS max_windowed_avg_record_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each offering department and school where the course material status is 'RQ', provide the number of unique subjects, the minimum total units for those subjects, and the average number of enrolled students for those subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_num_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte ic JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units;

question: For each DLC, what is the minimum organization number and the sum of organization IDs for organizations whose parent is 'EXECVP' and that have at least one associated space unit? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_org_number, SUM(fo.ORGANIZATION_ID) AS sum_org_id, fo.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fodk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON fodk.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE fo.ORG_PARENT = 'EXECVP' GROUP BY fo.DLC_KEY ) SELECT DLC_KEY, min_org_number, sum_org_id FROM inner_cte;

question: For library reserve materials with material status key 'U', show the subject ID, library course instructor key, term description, academic year, term start date, the minimum academic year in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by library reserve catalog key, and the total number of reserve materials for each subject in the same term. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t2.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, MIN(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.TERM_START_DATE, icte.window_column, sub_counts.total_reserve_materials FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t2.TERM_CODE, COUNT(*) AS total_reserve_materials FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL t2 WHERE t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY t2.SUBJECT_ID, t2.TERM_CODE ) sub_counts ON icte.SUBJECT_ID = sub_counts.SUBJECT_ID AND icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION = ( SELECT TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS WHERE TERM_CODE = sub_counts.TERM_CODE )

question: For each department that offered subjects in the Fall term of 2022, what is the department name, the highest number of lecture units among its offered subjects, the start date of the term, and the total number of subjects offered by that department in that term, considering only departments where the highest number of lecture units is greater than 3? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, at2.TERM_START_DATE FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 ON td.TERM_CODE = at2.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at2.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) > 3 ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.max_lecture_units, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, COUNT(ccs2.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs2 ON ccs2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ccs2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.max_lecture_units, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE;

question: For each department name and course level where the department is degree granting, provide the number of unique students, the minimum CIP program code among their courses, the school name, and the department's full name. Include subtotals for each department (the corresponding department field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all departments (the corresponding department field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the department if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by department and course level. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(dept) OVER (ORDER BY dept_sort, course_level_sort) = dept THEN NULL ELSE dept END AS department, course_level, student_count, min_cip_code, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS department_full_name FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(COURSE_LEVEL) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(COURSE_LEVEL) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(COURSE_LEVEL) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(COURSE_LEVEL) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE COURSE_LEVEL END AS course_level_sort, COURSE_LEVEL AS course_level, SUM(student_count) AS student_count, MIN(min_cip_code) AS min_cip_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_LEVEL WITH ROLLUP ) tbltmp LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tbltmp.dept = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dept_sort, course_level_sort;

question: For each space unit code, show the building room, floor, space usage, space unit code, space unit name, and the average floor within each space unit code group for rooms with an access level of 1. Additionally, for each space unit code, include a grand total average floor for all rooms in that space unit code group, in the format of (null building room, null floor, null space usage, space unit code, space unit name, total average floor). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.SPACE_UNIT, AVG(t1.FLOOR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ORDER BY t1.FLOOR) AS avg_floor FROM SPACE_UNIT t0 JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t1 ON t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT SPACE_UNIT_CODE, SPACE_UNIT, BUILDING_ROOM, FLOOR, SPACE_USAGE, AVG(avg_floor) AS avg_floor FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SPACE_UNIT_CODE, SPACE_UNIT, BUILDING_ROOM, FLOOR, SPACE_USAGE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SPACE_UNIT_CODE IS NOT NULL ) SELECT BUILDING_ROOM, FLOOR, SPACE_USAGE, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, SPACE_UNIT, avg_floor FROM RollupResults ORDER BY SPACE_UNIT_CODE, BUILDING_ROOM, FLOOR

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2012, show the subject key, subject title, offer department name, academic year, term description, the row number within each offer department name group ordered by subject key, the subject code, subject code description, department name, and the dense rank of each row partitioned by the school code and ordered by school code, for subjects where the school code is not null and the subject title is not null. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_KEY) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t0.SCHOOL_CODE) AS window_column, t1.SUBJECT_ID FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_CODE IS NOT NULL AND t1.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_KEY, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.window_column AS dept_row_number, s2.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.window_column AS school_dense_rank FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON s1.SUBJECT_KEY = so.SUBJECT_KEY JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON so.SUBJECT_TITLE = s2.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_KEY, s2.SUBJECT_CODE

question: For each department, what is the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of courses offered by that department (considering only courses that are offered this year and have a non-null total units value), the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only departments that grant degrees and subjects with a non-null subject code description), and the normalized units range by enrollment standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) (the range of total units divided by the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrolled students, rounded to two decimal places)? Please provide the department name, total units range, total units variance, total units standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), enrolled students variance, enrolled students standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and normalized units range by enrollment standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), in that order.
SQL: WITH DepartmentUnitsStats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccc.total_units) - MIN(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccc.total_units IS NOT NULL GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DepartmentEnrolledStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev, des.enrolled_students_variance, des.enrolled_students_stddev, ROUND(dus.total_units_range / NULLIF(des.enrolled_students_stddev, 0), 2) AS normalized_units_range_by_enrollment_stddev FROM DepartmentUnitsStats dus JOIN DepartmentEnrolledStats des ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY normalized_units_range_by_enrollment_stddev DESC;

question: For each department name and course level where the department is degree granting, provide the number of unique students, the minimum CIP program code among their courses, the average number of enrolled students in courses with at least one associated course material, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in such courses, showing the department name, course level, student count, minimum CIP program code, average enrollment, and enrollment standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DepartmentCourseStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL ), DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_stddev DESC ) SELECT dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.COURSE_LEVEL, dcs.student_count, dcs.min_cip_code, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_stddev FROM DepartmentCourseStats dcs JOIN DepartmentEnrollmentStats des ON dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.COURSE_LEVEL;

question: For academic term parameters where the term indicator is 'C' and the variance of the total units of subjects offered in that term parameter (considering only regular terms) is greater than 0, show the term parameter, the term code, the academic year, the department name of the offered subject, the running sum of academic years within each department ordered by academic year, the variance of total units, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, ordered by academic year and department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_PARAMETER, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_INDICATOR = 'C' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT s1.TERM_PARAMETER, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.total_units_variance, s2.total_units_stddev FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.TERM_PARAMETER = s2.TERM_PARAMETER WHERE s2.total_units_variance > 0 ORDER BY s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each major use description and organization name where the room area is greater than 100 and the access level is 1, show the number of rooms, the minimum floor number, the building room, floor, room number, space ID, area, major use name, major use description, and the minimum area value over each major use group for rooms with area greater than 200 and assignable major use, ordered by major use description, organization name, and major use. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count, MIN(r.FLOOR) AS min_floor, r.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 100 AND r.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 GROUP BY r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ), subq2 AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.ROOM, t1.SPACE_ID, t1.AREA, t0.MAJOR_USE, t0.DESCRIPTION, min(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY ORDER BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY) AS min_area_per_major_use, t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_MAJOR_USE t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 200 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1 ) SELECT s1.MAJOR_USE_DESC, s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s1.room_count, s1.min_floor, s2.BUILDING_ROOM, s2.FLOOR, s2.ROOM, s2.SPACE_ID, s2.AREA, s2.MAJOR_USE, s2.DESCRIPTION, s2.min_area_per_major_use FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = s2.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY AND s1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = s2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY s1.MAJOR_USE_DESC, s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s2.MAJOR_USE

question: For each of the top 10 departments by the number of unique subjects they offered in academic years 2014 or later, provide the department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of course materials per subject offered by that department in the term 2017SP, and the count of unique subject titles. List the results ordered by the count of unique subject titles (descending), then by the range of course materials (descending). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DepartmentMaterialStats AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(material_count) - MIN(material_count) AS material_count_range, VARIANCE(material_count) AS material_count_variance, STDDEV(material_count) AS material_count_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ( SELECT TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM TIP_DETAIL WHERE TERM_CODE = '2017SP' GROUP BY TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ) AS detail_stats ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = detail_stats.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = '2017SP' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY material_count_range DESC ), DepartmentSubjectCounts AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2014 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT dms.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dms.material_count_range, dms.material_count_variance, dms.material_count_stddev, dsc.subject_count FROM DepartmentMaterialStats dms JOIN DepartmentSubjectCounts dsc ON dms.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dsc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY dsc.subject_count DESC, dms.material_count_range DESC;

question: For each subject in the "Engineering" school with total units equal to 1, show the academic year, subject ID, subject title, department name, the rank of each subject within its academic year group ordered by subject ID, the academic year description, and the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during terms in that year, considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the number of enrolled students is greater than 0. List the results ordered by academic year and subject rank. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH EnrolledStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), EngineeringSubjects AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 1 ) SELECT es.ACADEMIC_YEAR, es.SUBJECT_ID, es.SUBJECT_TITLE, es.DEPARTMENT_NAME, es.window_column, en.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, en.enrolled_range, en.enrolled_variance FROM EngineeringSubjects es JOIN EnrolledStats en ON es.ACADEMIC_YEAR = en.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY es.ACADEMIC_YEAR, es.window_column;

question: For each department that grants degrees and for each school where that department offers subjects with required course material status, list the department name, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units), the school name, the number of unique subjects with required course material status, and the minimum total units for those subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), DeptMaterialStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev, dms.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, dms.subject_count, dms.min_total_units FROM DeptUnitsStats dus JOIN DeptMaterialStats dms ON dus.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dms.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dms.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME;

question: For each department and subject code where the department is degree granting, and for each building where that subject is scheduled in a room during the fall term, provide the department name, subject code, number of subject codes, minimum department budget code, building key, average total units, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for all subjects scheduled in rooms of that building during the fall term. List the columns in the following order: department name, subject code, number of subject codes, minimum department budget code, building key, average total units, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE ), BuildingSubjectUnits AS ( SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE ) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.SUBJECT_CODE, dss.subject_code_count, dss.min_dept_budget_code, bsu.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, bsu.avg_total_units, bsu.stddev_total_units FROM DeptSubjectStats dss JOIN BuildingSubjectUnits bsu ON dss.SUBJECT_CODE = bsu.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.SUBJECT_CODE, bsu.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY;

question: List all subjects from the term "2010FA" and all subjects offered in the term with code "2025FA", showing for each row: subject ID, term description, material status key, academic year, rank of the subject within each academic year group ordered by subject ID, subject title, offering department name, number of enrolled students, term start date, term end date, term parameter, the minimum number of enrolled students over each offering department, and the source term ("2010FA" or "2025FA"). The columns should appear in the following order: subject ID, term description, material status key, academic year, rank, subject title, offering department name, number of enrolled students, term start date, term end date, term parameter, minimum enrolled students per department, and source term. Order the results by subject ID and source term. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2010FA' ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ), CombinedSubjects AS ( SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.window_column, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, NULL AS TERM_START_DATE, NULL AS TERM_END_DATE, NULL AS TERM_PARAMETER, NULL AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept, '2010FA' AS SOURCE_TERM FROM Subq1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS window_column, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.TERM_START_DATE, s2.TERM_END_DATE, s2.TERM_PARAMETER, s2.min_enrolled_students_per_dept, '2025FA' AS SOURCE_TERM FROM Subq2 s2 ) SELECT * FROM CombinedSubjects ORDER BY SUBJECT_ID, SOURCE_TERM;

question: For each department name and school name, where the department is degree granting and the total number of enrolled students in courses offered by both the library and the TIP system in the term '2019FA' is greater than 10, provide the department name, school name, the number of unique courses, the minimum CIP program code from the course descriptions, and the total number of enrolled students. List the results ordered by department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptCourseStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ), DeptEnrolledStats AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10 ) SELECT dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.SCHOOL_NAME, dcs.course_count, dcs.min_cip_code, des.total_enrolled FROM DeptCourseStats dcs JOIN DeptEnrolledStats des ON dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each space unit with a space unit code of 402100, list the space unit key, the organization name, the DLC name, the DLC key from FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY, the rank of each record within each DLC key group ordered by space unit key, and the geometric mean of the number of supervisees for each organization (considering only departments where the number of supervisees is greater than zero), ordered by DLC key and space unit key. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH OrgGeometricMean AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES))) AS geometric_mean_supervisees FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN SPACE_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ON SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY = SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.DEPT_NAMES WHERE SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES > 0 GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_supervisees DESC ), SpaceUnitRank AS ( SELECT t2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.DLC_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DLC_KEY ORDER BY t2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 402100 ) SELECT s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, s.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s.DLC_NAME, s.DLC_KEY, s.window_column, o.geometric_mean_supervisees FROM SpaceUnitRank s JOIN OrgGeometricMean o ON s.ORGANIZATION_NAME = o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY s.DLC_KEY, s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY

question: For each subject offered in the term with code '2025FA', show the subject ID, subject title, offering department name, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, term start date, term end date, term parameter, and the minimum number of enrolled students over each offering department, along with the academic year description and the variance of the number of tip detail records for subjects offered in that academic year (considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term and have at least one associated tip detail record). Order the results by offering department name and subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH AcademicYearVariance AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC ), SubjectsIn2025FA AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.TERM_START_DATE, s.TERM_END_DATE, s.TERM_PARAMETER, s.min_enrolled_students_per_dept, ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ayv.record_count_variance FROM SubjectsIn2025FA s JOIN AcademicYearVariance ayv ON s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with total units equal to 12 and scheduled in rooms of buildings that have subjects scheduled in the fall term, show the department code, department name, subject code, subject number, subject title, total units, row number within each department ordered by subject code, the building key, the average total units, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for all subjects scheduled in rooms of that building during the fall term. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subjects2024_12Units AS ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), BuildingUnitsStats AS ( SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ) SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS, s.window_column, fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, bus.avg_total_units, bus.stddev_total_units FROM Subjects2024_12Units s JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.SUBJECT_CODE AND s.SUBJECT_NUMBER = c.SUBJECT_NUMBER AND c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON c.MEET_PLACE = fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY JOIN BuildingUnitsStats bus ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = bus.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' ORDER BY s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_NUMBER, fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units, show the subject code, subject number, subject title, department name, term description, and the rank of each subject within its department ordered by subject code, along with the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects in that department that have at least one enrolled student and have required course materials. List the results ordered by department name and subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
