SQL: WITH Subjects2024_12Units AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.window_column, d.avg_total_units, d.total_units_range, d.total_units_variance FROM Subjects2024_12Units s JOIN DeptUnitsStats d ON s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE

question: For each academic year, list either (1) the academic year, academic year description, the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during terms in that year (considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the number of enrolled students is greater than 0), or (2) for subjects in the "Engineering" school with total units equal to 1, the academic year, subject ID, subject title, department name, and the rank of each subject within its academic year group ordered by subject ID. Indicate the reason for inclusion as either 'EnrolledStats' or 'EngineeringSubjects'. The columns should be: academic year, academic year description, enrolled range, enrolled variance, subject ID, subject title, department name, rank, and reason. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH EnrolledStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), EngineeringSubjects AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 1 ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT es.ACADEMIC_YEAR, es.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, es.enrolled_range, es.enrolled_variance, NULL AS SUBJECT_ID, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS window_column, 'EnrolledStats' AS Reason FROM EnrolledStats es UNION ALL SELECT eng.ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS enrolled_range, NULL AS enrolled_variance, eng.SUBJECT_ID, eng.SUBJECT_TITLE, eng.DEPARTMENT_NAME, eng.window_column, 'EngineeringSubjects' AS Reason FROM EngineeringSubjects eng ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, enrolled_range, enrolled_variance, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column, Reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, Reason, SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each department, list the department name, the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2022 and that are also listed in the CIS course catalog, as well as the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for courses offered by that department. Present the columns in the following order: department name, units range, units variance, total units range, total units variance, and total units standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DepartmentSubjectStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC ), DepartmentCourseStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.units_range, dss.units_variance, dcs.total_units_range, dcs.total_units_variance, dcs.total_units_stddev FROM DepartmentSubjectStats dss JOIN DepartmentCourseStats dcs ON dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dss.units_range DESC, dcs.total_units_range DESC;

question: For each IAP subject activity that is not cancelled and has a non-null maximum enrollment and also has a maximum enrollment of 12, provide the activity title, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the academic years (from the academic terms) in which the activity was offered, the enrollment type, the term description, the subject title, the number of enrolled students, and the average number of enrolled students in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the responsible faculty MIT ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, MAX(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) - MIN(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS academic_year_range, VARIANCE(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS academic_year_variance, STDDEV(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS academic_year_stddev FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON d.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL aa ON a.TERM_CODE = aa.TERM_CODE WHERE d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE ORDER BY academic_year_range DESC ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, AVG(t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY t2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ORDER BY t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 12 ) SELECT s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s1.academic_year_range, s1.academic_year_variance, s1.academic_year_stddev, s2.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.window_column FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE = s2.ACTIVITY_TITLE

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year, the academic year description, the geometric mean of the record counts of required course materials (where the record count is greater than zero) for all subjects offered in that year, and the variance of the maximum enrollment for IAP activities that are not cancelled and require advance sign-up? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH geometric_mean_record_count_per_year AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_record_count DESC ), max_enrollment_variance_per_year AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY max_enrollment_variance DESC ) SELECT gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR, gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gmr.geometric_mean_record_count, mev.max_enrollment_variance FROM geometric_mean_record_count_per_year gmr JOIN max_enrollment_variance_per_year mev ON gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR = mev.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = mev.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For the top 10 material statuses by the number of materials, what is the material status description, the count of materials for each status, the associated library material status, and the count of reserve catalog items for each library material status for term code '2009SP'? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH TopMaterialStatuses AS ( SELECT tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS tms ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY GROUP BY tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS ORDER BY material_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), ReserveCounts AS ( SELECT lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserve_count, lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY FROM LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS lms JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY WHERE lrmd.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY reserve_count DESC ) SELECT tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, tms.material_count, rc.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, rc.reserve_count FROM TopMaterialStatuses tms JOIN TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS tms2 ON tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS = tms2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON td.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID AND td.TERM_CODE = lrmd.TERM_CODE JOIN ReserveCounts rc ON lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = rc.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY

question: For each department name and its corresponding facility organization key where the department is in the Provost Area, provide the number of organizations, the minimum department hierarchy level 3 code, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of HR organization units per facility organization (considering only those with a non-null DLC key and where the hierarchy type is 'Standard Hierarchy'), listing the results in order by department name and facility organization key. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH ProvostAreaDepts AS ( SELECT m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_CODE) AS min_level3_code FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ), FacilityOrgStats AS ( SELECT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, MAX(hr_unit_count) - MIN(hr_unit_count) AS org_unit_count_range, VARIANCE(hr_unit_count) AS org_unit_count_variance, STDDEV(hr_unit_count) AS org_unit_count_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m ON f.DLC_KEY = m.DLC_KEY JOIN ( SELECT h.DLC_KEY, COUNT(*) AS hr_unit_count FROM HR_ORG_UNIT h WHERE h.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY h.DLC_KEY ) AS hr_stats ON m.DLC_KEY = hr_stats.DLC_KEY WHERE f.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' GROUP BY f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY org_unit_count_range DESC ), CombinedProvostFacility AS ( SELECT p.DLC_NAME, p.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, p.org_count, p.min_level3_code, f.org_unit_count_range, f.org_unit_count_variance, f.org_unit_count_stddev FROM ProvostAreaDepts p JOIN FacilityOrgStats f ON p.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) SELECT * FROM CombinedProvostFacility ORDER BY DLC_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY;

question: For subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering that are also offered in the term '2017JA', show the subject title, total units, department full name, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, department full name for the term, subject code, subject code description, and the minimum number of enrolled students over each subject code group, ordered by subject title and subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH EngSubjects AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ), TermSubjects AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' ) SELECT es.SUBJECT_TITLE, es.TOTAL_UNITS, es.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, es.window_column AS eng_window_row_number, ts.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ts.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS term_dept_full_name, ts.SUBJECT_CODE, ts.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ts.window_column AS min_enrolled_by_code FROM EngSubjects es JOIN TermSubjects ts ON es.SUBJECT_TITLE = ts.SUBJECT_TITLE AND es.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ts.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY es.SUBJECT_TITLE, ts.SUBJECT_CODE

question: For each department that is degree-granting and offered at least one subject in the School of Engineering in 2021, provide the department code, department name, department full name, the number of subjects offered, the total number of enrolled students in those subjects, and the total number of active graduate students with an office location assigned in that department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptSubjects AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ), DeptActiveGradStudents AS ( SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS total_active_grad_students FROM SE_PERSON s JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY m ON s.FULL_NAME = m.FULL_NAME WHERE s.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND m.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND m.OFFICE_LOCATION IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.DEPARTMENT HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ds.subject_count, ds.total_enrollment, dag.total_active_grad_students FROM DeptSubjects ds LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN DeptActiveGradStudents dag ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dag.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For all subjects in the 2014FA term with at least one enrolled student, show the subject title, offering department name, responsible faculty name, the TIP material status key, the total number of units, and the minimum total number of units in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the course number. Additionally, for the offering department, provide the department name, the average and variance of the department's subject codes' course numbers (using their ASCII values), considering only departments that are degree granting. The results are ordered by offering department name and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), subq2 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VARIANCE(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY var_course_number_ascii DESC ) SELECT subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, subq1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, subq1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, subq1.TOTAL_UNITS, subq1.window_column, subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq2.avg_course_number_ascii, subq2.var_course_number_ascii FROM subq1 LEFT JOIN subq2 ON subq1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = subq2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY subq1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For each department that offers at least one subject in the Fall Term 2024-2025 with a total of 12 units, what is the department name, the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2022, and for each such subject in Fall Term 2024-2025, what are the subject ID, subject title, school name, total units, term description, term start date, and the row number within the department ordered by subject ID? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH department_units_stats AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC ), fall_2024_12unit_subjects AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SCHOOL_NAME, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.units_range, dus.units_variance, f24.SUBJECT_ID, f24.SUBJECT_TITLE, f24.SCHOOL_NAME, f24.TOTAL_UNITS, f24.TERM_DESCRIPTION, f24.TERM_START_DATE, f24.window_column FROM department_units_stats dus JOIN fall_2024_12unit_subjects f24 ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = f24.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, f24.window_column;

question: For library reserve material details with material status key equal to 'U', show the library course instructor key, library reserve catalog key, term code, subject ID, the tip material key, tip material status key, tip ISBN, the subject title from the subject offered table, and the minimum tip material status key in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the number of enrolled students, along with the number of enrolled students, total units from the subject offered summary, and the average number of enrolled students within each subject title group ordered by total units, for subjects that have at least one enrolled student and matching subject title, term code, and tip material status key. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT l.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, l.TERM_CODE, l.SUBJECT_ID, t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t.ISBN, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MIN(t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) OVER (ORDER BY s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.TERM_CODE, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID INNER JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT s1.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, s1.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s1.ISBN, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.window_column, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.TOTAL_UNITS, s2.avg_enrolled_students FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_TITLE = s2.SUBJECT_TITLE AND s1.TERM_CODE = s2.TERM_CODE AND s1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = s2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY

question: For organizations with an organization level of 5, show for each space unit the space unit name, organization name, organization ID, DLC name, HR org unit title, HR department name, HR org unit level, the row number within each HR department name group ordered by organization name, the variance of organization numbers, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of organization numbers, considering only space units with a non-null DLC key and organizations with assignable status. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH OrgLevel5 AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID, t1.DLC_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ), SpaceUnitStats AS ( SELECT s.SPACE_UNIT, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, VARIANCE(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance, STDDEV(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT s ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = s.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE s.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 GROUP BY s.SPACE_UNIT, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY org_number_variance DESC ) SELECT s.SPACE_UNIT, o5.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o5.ORGANIZATION_ID, o5.DLC_NAME, o5.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, o5.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o5.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, o5.window_column, s.org_number_variance, s.org_number_stddev FROM OrgLevel5 o5 JOIN SpaceUnitStats s ON o5.ORGANIZATION_NAME = s.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY s.SPACE_UNIT, o5.ORGANIZATION_NAME

question: For each department hierarchy and its organizations that are assignable and have a department code above 100000, list the department hierarchy name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the organization level for organizations in that hierarchy, the organization key, organization name, department name, the number of HR org units, and the total of their department IDs, ordered by the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of organization level descending and then by the number of HR org units descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptHierarchyStats AS ( SELECT MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME, AVG(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) AS avg_org_level, STDDEV(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) AS org_level_stddev FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL IS NOT NULL GROUP BY MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME ORDER BY org_level_stddev DESC ), OrgHRStats AS ( SELECT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS hr_org_unit_count, SUM(h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS total_department_id FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION f JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID > 100000 GROUP BY f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dhs.DLC_NAME, dhs.avg_org_level, dhs.org_level_stddev, ohr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, ohr.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ohr.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ohr.hr_org_unit_count, ohr.total_department_id FROM DeptHierarchyStats dhs JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON dhs.DLC_NAME = fo.DLC_NAME JOIN OrgHRStats ohr ON fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = ohr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY dhs.org_level_stddev DESC, ohr.hr_org_unit_count DESC;

question: For each subject offered in the Fall term of 2022, show the subject title, department name, term code, academic year, the average academic year within each academic year group ordered by term start date, and for each associated course material detail, provide the material status key, subject ID, ISBN, material key, the course number description, the offering department name, and the maximum number of enrolled students for each row considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by material key. List the results ordered by subject title and material key. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH SubjectStats AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.TERM_CODE, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY a.TERM_START_DATE) AS avg_academic_year FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON ata.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON a.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE WHERE a.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ), MaterialStats AS ( SELECT t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.ISBN, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_num_enrolled_students FROM TIP_DETAIL t0 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL AND t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.TERM_CODE, s.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.avg_academic_year, m.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, m.SUBJECT_ID, m.ISBN, m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, m.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, m.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, m.max_num_enrolled_students FROM SubjectStats s JOIN MaterialStats m ON s.TERM_CODE = m.TERM_CODE AND s.SUBJECT_TITLE = m.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY;

question: For each subject offered in the term with the description "Fall Term 2024-2025" and offered by one of the top 10 departments (by number of unique subjects offered in academic years 2014 or later), show the subject offered key, subject title, offering department name, the term description, the rank of each subject within its offering department ordered by subject offered key, and the count of unique subject titles for that department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH SubjectRanks AS ( SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' ), TopDepartments AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2014 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT sr.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, sr.SUBJECT_TITLE, sr.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sr.TERM_DESCRIPTION, sr.window_column, td.subject_count FROM SubjectRanks sr JOIN TopDepartments td ON sr.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = td.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY sr.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sr.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY;

question: For subjects in the academic term with term code '2009SP', show the subject title, department name, total units, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title. Additionally, for each department name, include the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in library subjects that have a matching master subject ID in the TIP subject offerings, considering only departments with more than 0 enrolled students in both tables. List the subject title, department name, total units, window column, library students variance, and library students standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_students_variance, STDDEV(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_students_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = t.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY library_students_variance DESC ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' ) SELECT s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.TOTAL_UNITS, s2.window_column, s1.library_students_variance, s1.library_students_stddev FROM Subq2 s2 LEFT JOIN Subq1 s1 ON s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY s2.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each department, list the department name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the most recent academic year, followed by the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in regular academic terms, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH MostRecentYearStats AS ( SELECT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.SUBJECT_ID WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ) GROUP BY COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), RegularTermStats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.avg_total_units AS most_recent_year_avg_total_units, m.total_units_range AS most_recent_year_total_units_range, m.total_units_variance AS most_recent_year_total_units_variance, r.avg_total_units AS regular_term_avg_total_units, r.total_units_range AS regular_term_total_units_range, r.total_units_variance AS regular_term_total_units_variance FROM MostRecentYearStats m JOIN RegularTermStats r ON m.DEPARTMENT_NAME = r.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY m.total_units_range DESC, r.total_units_range DESC;

question: For each department, what is the department name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the most recent academic year, and the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in regular academic terms, with the results for both the most recent academic year and regular academic terms shown side by side for each department? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH most_recent_year_stats AS ( SELECT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.SUBJECT_ID WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ) GROUP BY COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ), regular_term_stats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT mry.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mry.avg_total_units AS most_recent_year_avg_total_units, mry.total_units_range AS most_recent_year_total_units_range, mry.total_units_variance AS most_recent_year_total_units_variance, rts.avg_total_units AS regular_term_avg_total_units, rts.total_units_range AS regular_term_total_units_range, rts.total_units_variance AS regular_term_total_units_variance FROM most_recent_year_stats mry JOIN regular_term_stats rts ON mry.DEPARTMENT_NAME = rts.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units that are also offered in the library by the Mathematics department during regular terms, show the subject code, subject number, subject title, department name, term description, the rank of each subject within its department ordered by subject code, the number of enrolled students, offering department name, academic year, subject short title, and the maximum total units for each row and the next two rows in order of subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subjects2024_12Units AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), MathLibrarySubjects AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, MAX(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_total_units, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.window_column, m.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, m.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, m.ACADEMIC_YEAR, m.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, m.max_total_units FROM Subjects2024_12Units s JOIN MathLibrarySubjects m ON s.SUBJECT_ID = m.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, m.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC

question: For the 5 departments that offer the largest number of unique subjects, display for each department its department code, department name, and the total number of unique subjects it offers, and for each subject offered by these departments in the term with code '2025FA', show the subject ID, subject title, offering department name, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, term start date, term end date, term parameter, and the minimum number of enrolled students over each offering department, ordered by the total number of unique subjects, offering department name, and subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH dept_subject_counts AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY num_subjects DESC LIMIT 5 ), subjects_2025fa AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ) SELECT dsc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dsc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dsc.num_subjects, s2025fa.SUBJECT_ID, s2025fa.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2025fa.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2025fa.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2025fa.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2025fa.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2025fa.TERM_START_DATE, s2025fa.TERM_END_DATE, s2025fa.TERM_PARAMETER, s2025fa.min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM dept_subject_counts dsc JOIN subjects_2025fa s2025fa ON dsc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2025fa.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY dsc.num_subjects DESC, s2025fa.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2025fa.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each subject offered in the academic year 2024 with total units equal to 12, where the subject's department also offered at least one HASS Elective in 2022, provide the department code, department name, subject code, subject number, subject title, total units, the row number within the department ordered by subject code, and the total number of HASS Electives in that department in 2022. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH HassElectives2022 AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.TOTAL_UNITS, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS num_hass_electives_in_department FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE h ON c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = h.HASS_ATTRIBUTE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND h.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM = 'HASS Elective' ), TwelveUnitSubjects2024 AS ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) SELECT t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, t2.window_column, h.num_hass_electives_in_department FROM TwelveUnitSubjects2024 t2 JOIN HassElectives2022 h ON t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = h.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t2.window_column;

question: For each department that is degree-granting and offered at least one subject in the School of Engineering in 2021, provide the department code, department name, department full name, the number of subjects offered, the total number of enrolled students in those subjects, the variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with a non-null subject code description), and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in those subjects. List the results ordered by the number of subjects offered in descending order, then by the variance of enrolled students in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptEng2021Stats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ), DeptEnrolledVariance AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ) SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d1.subject_count, d1.total_enrollment, d2.enrolled_students_variance, d2.enrolled_students_stddev FROM DeptEng2021Stats d1 JOIN DeptEnrolledVariance d2 ON d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d1.subject_count DESC, d2.enrolled_students_variance DESC;

question: For organizations whose parent is "S H&SS" and that are assignable and also have organization level equal to 5, show the organization name, description, HR org unit title, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the organization name, the HR department name, the HR org unit title, the HR org unit key, and the average organization key within each organization key group ordered by HR org unit key. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH OrgWindowRows AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORG_PARENT = 'S H&SS' AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1 ), OrgAvgKey AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1 ) SELECT owr.ORGANIZATION_NAME, owr.DESCRIPTION, owr.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, owr.window_column AS org_window_row, oak.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, oak.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE AS avg_hr_org_unit_title, oak.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, oak.window_column AS avg_org_key FROM OrgWindowRows owr JOIN OrgAvgKey oak ON owr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = oak.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY owr.ORGANIZATION_NAME, oak.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY;

question: For each academic year, show the academic year, academic year description, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the record counts of TIP materials associated with that academic year (considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the TIP material status key is not 'NM'), as well as the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered (considering only terms that are not the current term). List the results in order of decreasing record count variance. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH RecordCountStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC ), EnrolledStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC ) SELECT rcs.ACADEMIC_YEAR, rcs.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, rcs.record_count_variance, rcs.record_count_stddev, es.enrolled_range, es.enrolled_variance FROM RecordCountStats rcs JOIN EnrolledStats es ON rcs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = es.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND rcs.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = es.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY rcs.record_count_variance DESC

question: For subjects offered in the term '2016SP' with a total of 12 units that are also among the top 10 subject titles by the number of reserved library materials for subjects offered in the term '2009SP', show the subject title, the department name, the subject description, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the subject title, the offering department name, and the count of reserved materials. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials, s.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY reserved_materials DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT sq1.SUBJECT_TITLE, sq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sq1.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION, sq1.window_column, sq2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sq2.reserved_materials FROM Subquery1 sq1 JOIN Subquery2 sq2 ON sq1.SUBJECT_ID = sq2.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY sq1.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each academic year and department, what is the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered in regular terms, along with the number of unique subjects offered and the minimum start date of the term for departments and academic years where the number of enrolled students in the library subject offered is greater than 3? The results should include academic year, department name, average total units, variance of total units, subject count, and minimum term start date, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH AvgVarUnits AS ( SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY var_total_units DESC ), LibSubjStats AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT so.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(at.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON at.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.avg_total_units, a.var_total_units, l.subject_count, l.min_term_start_date FROM AvgVarUnits a LEFT JOIN LibSubjStats l ON a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = l.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND a.DEPARTMENT_NAME = l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each combination of department and administrative department, what is the department name, the variance of the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects offered by the School of Engineering in the term '2016SP'), the administrative department name, and the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 100? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH department_enrollment_variance AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ), admin_department_total_enrollment AS ( SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100 ) SELECT dev.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dev.enrolled_students_variance, adte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, adte.total_enrolled FROM department_enrollment_variance dev CROSS JOIN admin_department_total_enrollment adte;

question: For each academic year and department name where the number of enrolled students is greater than 5, what is the number of unique subjects offered, the minimum start date of the academic term, and, for that department, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of courses offered by that department (considering only courses that are offered this year and have a non-null total units value)? List the academic year, department name, subject count, minimum start date, total units range, total units variance, and total units standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccc.total_units) - MIN(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccc.total_units IS NOT NULL GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ), DeptYearSubjects AS ( SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT l.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_start_date FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON t.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT dys.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dys.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dys.subject_count, dys.min_start_date, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev FROM DeptYearSubjects dys LEFT JOIN DeptUnitsStats dus ON dys.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dys.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dys.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: For each department where the organization is assignable and the organization level is greater than 4, list the department name, the geometric mean of the space unit codes for all space units associated with that department (considering only space units with a code greater than 0), the number of organizations, and the minimum organization number, ordered by geometric mean descending and then by organization count descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH GeometricMeanByDepartment AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.DLC_KEY, EXP(AVG(LN(s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE))) AS geometric_mean FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT s ON o.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY WHERE s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE > 0 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.DLC_KEY ORDER BY geometric_mean DESC ), OrganizationStats AS ( SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND o.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL > 4 GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT gmd.ORGANIZATION_NAME, gmd.geometric_mean, os.organization_count, os.min_organization_number FROM GeometricMeanByDepartment gmd JOIN OrganizationStats os ON gmd.DLC_KEY = os.DLC_KEY AND gmd.ORGANIZATION_NAME = os.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY gmd.geometric_mean DESC, os.organization_count DESC;

question: For each room with area greater than 200, show the building-room identifier, the organization name, the DLC key, the sum of room areas within each major use description group (ordered by building-room), and for the corresponding DLC key, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of organizations associated with that DLC key (considering only DLC keys that are not null and organizations with a non-null organization name). Present the results ordered by building-room. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH org_dlc_stats AS ( SELECT fdlk.DLC_KEY, MAX(org_count) - MIN(org_count) AS org_count_range, VARIANCE(org_count) AS org_count_variance, STDDEV(org_count) AS org_count_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fdlk JOIN ( SELECT fo.DLC_KEY, COUNT(*) AS org_count FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fo.DLC_KEY ) org_stats ON fdlk.DLC_KEY = org_stats.DLC_KEY WHERE fdlk.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fdlk.DLC_KEY ORDER BY org_count_range DESC ), room_area_stats AS ( SELECT t2.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, SUM(t2.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.MAJOR_USE_DESC ORDER BY t2.BUILDING_ROOM) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.AREA > 200 ) SELECT ras.BUILDING_ROOM, ras.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ras.DLC_KEY, ras.window_column, ods.org_count_range, ods.org_count_variance, ods.org_count_stddev FROM room_area_stats ras LEFT JOIN org_dlc_stats ods ON ras.DLC_KEY = ods.DLC_KEY ORDER BY ras.BUILDING_ROOM;

question: For each department hierarchy and its departments, give the department hierarchy name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the organization level for organizations in that hierarchy, the department's name, and the range and variance of the areas of rooms assigned to that department (considering only rooms with an area greater than 40). Present the results ordered by department hierarchy name and then by area range in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH dept_hierarchy_org_levels AS ( SELECT MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME, AVG(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) AS avg_org_level, STDDEV(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) AS org_level_stddev FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL IS NOT NULL GROUP BY MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME ORDER BY org_level_stddev DESC ), dept_room_area_stats AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 40 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY area_range DESC ) SELECT dhol.DLC_NAME, dhol.avg_org_level, dhol.org_level_stddev, dras.ORGANIZATION_NAME, dras.area_range, dras.area_variance FROM dept_hierarchy_org_levels dhol JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON dhol.DLC_NAME = fo.DLC_NAME JOIN dept_room_area_stats dras ON fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME = dras.ORGANIZATION_NAME GROUP BY dhol.DLC_NAME, dhol.avg_org_level, dhol.org_level_stddev, dras.ORGANIZATION_NAME, dras.area_range, dras.area_variance ORDER BY dhol.DLC_NAME, dras.area_range DESC;

question: List the top 10 department names from the Harvard Cross-Enrollment Program, along with the number of subjects they offered, the average total units, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for subjects offered by those departments, considering only departments that also had at least one subject offered in the same term in the TIP subject offerings, and only subjects with more than 0 total units and at least 1 enrolled student. Present the department name, number of subjects, average total units, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH harvard_cross_enrollment_top10 AS ( SELECT so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS num_subjects FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON so.TERM_CODE = tso.TERM_CODE WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' GROUP BY so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY num_subjects DESC LIMIT 10 ), department_units_stats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ) SELECT hce.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, hce.num_subjects, dus.avg_total_units, dus.stddev_total_units FROM harvard_cross_enrollment_top10 hce JOIN department_units_stats dus ON hce.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department long name and department hierarchy level 3 name where the department hierarchy type is 'Standard Hierarchy' and the organization unit level is 'DEPARTMENTS', and for each space unit with a space unit key greater than 100000 in the same department (matching on DLC_KEY), give the number of unique facility organization keys, the minimum organization unit ID, the space unit code, the organization name, the HR department name, and the sum of space unit keys within each warehouse load date group, ordered by space unit key. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptAgg AS ( SELECT h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS min_org_unit_id, m.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m ON f.DLC_KEY = m.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY WHERE m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS' GROUP BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, m.DLC_KEY ), SpaceAgg AS ( SELECT t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE ORDER BY t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column, t2.DLC_KEY FROM SPACE_UNIT t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000 ) SELECT d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, d.org_count, d.min_org_unit_id, s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, s.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.window_column FROM DeptAgg d JOIN SpaceAgg s ON d.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY

question: For each organization with an organization level of 5 and for rooms on floor 2 belonging to that organization, show the organization name, organization key, description, space unit, space unit key, the average organization key within each organization key group ordered by space unit key, the building room, space usage, the HR org unit title, the department name, and the minimum access level in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the building component, ordered by space unit key and building room. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH OrgStats AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.SPACE_UNIT, t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ), RoomStats AS ( SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.SPACE_USAGE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(t0.ACCESS_LEVEL) OVER (ORDER BY t0.BUILDING_COMPONENT ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2 ) SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.DESCRIPTION, o.SPACE_UNIT, o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, o.window_column AS org_window_avg_key, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.SPACE_USAGE, r.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, r.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, r.window_column AS room_window_min_access FROM OrgStats o JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN RoomStats r ON f.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = r.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID ORDER BY o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, r.BUILDING_ROOM

question: List the top 10 subject titles by the number of materials offered, including the subject title, department name, total count of materials, variance of the number of enrolled students, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students for each subject's department, for subjects in regular academic terms. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH TopSubjects AS ( SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON td.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND td.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY material_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), DeptEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS num_enrolled_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS num_enrolled_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT ts.SUBJECT_TITLE, ts.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ts.material_count, des.num_enrolled_variance, des.num_enrolled_stddev FROM TopSubjects ts LEFT JOIN DeptEnrollmentStats des ON ts.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.department ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY material_count DESC, SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with total units equal to 12 and scheduled in rooms of buildings that have subjects offered in the fall term, show the department code, department name, subject code, subject number, subject title, total units, the row number within each department ordered by subject code, the building key, the average total units, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for all subjects scheduled in rooms of that building during the fall term. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptSubjects AS ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), BuildingStats AS ( SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.SUBJECT_CODE, ds.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ds.SUBJECT_TITLE, ds.TOTAL_UNITS, ds.window_column, fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, bs.avg_total_units, bs.stddev_total_units FROM DeptSubjects ds JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON ds.SUBJECT_CODE = cso.SUBJECT_CODE AND ds.SUBJECT_NUMBER = cso.SUBJECT_NUMBER AND ds.TOTAL_UNITS = cso.TOTAL_UNITS JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON cso.MEET_PLACE = fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY JOIN BuildingStats bs ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = bs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE cso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' ORDER BY ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ds.window_column, fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY

question: For academic years where the term status is 'Previous' and there exists a subject category with maximum enrollment greater than 10, show the term code, term description, academic year, the running sum of academic years within each financial aid year group, the subject category key, the number of unique subjects, and the minimum academic term start date, ordered by academic year and subject category key. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH AcademicTermWindows AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ), SubjectCategoryStats AS ( SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT i.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT atw.TERM_CODE, atw.TERM_DESCRIPTION, atw.ACADEMIC_YEAR, atw.window_column, scs.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, scs.subject_count, scs.min_term_start_date FROM AcademicTermWindows atw JOIN SubjectCategoryStats scs ON atw.ACADEMIC_YEAR = scs.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY atw.ACADEMIC_YEAR, scs.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY

question: List all subjects offered in the academic term with term code '2006FA', showing the subject ID, subject title, department name, and the sum of lecture units within each grade type group, as well as all departments in the current academic term where the maximum subject enrollment number is greater than 5, showing the department name, the maximum subject enrollment number, and the term start date. For each row, include a reason for inclusion: 'SubjectOffered' for subjects and 'DeptEnrollment' for departments. The columns should be: subject ID, subject title, department name, sum of lecture units within each grade type group, maximum subject enrollment number, term start date, and reason, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.LECTURE_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_enrollment, at.TERM_START_DATE FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 5 ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, NULL AS max_enrollment, NULL AS TERM_START_DATE, 'SubjectOffered' AS Reason FROM Subquery1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_ID, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS window_column, s2.max_enrollment, s2.TERM_START_DATE, 'DeptEnrollment' AS Reason FROM Subquery2 s2 ) SELECT SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column, max_enrollment, TERM_START_DATE, Reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID

question: List all subjects that are either offered in the term with code '2025FA' or are offered by departments in the School of Engineering with a total of at least 6 units. For each subject, show the subject ID, subject title, department name, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, term start date, term end date, term parameter, the minimum number of enrolled students over each offering department, the running sum of total units within each school, and the reason for inclusion ('2025FA Subjects' for subjects offered in the term '2025FA' and 'Engineering 6+ Units' for subjects offered by Engineering departments with at least 6 units), ordered by subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ), CombinedSubjects AS ( SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.TERM_START_DATE, s1.TERM_END_DATE, s1.TERM_PARAMETER, s1.min_enrolled_students_per_dept, NULL AS window_column, '2025FA Subjects' AS Reason FROM Subquery1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS TERM_START_DATE, NULL AS TERM_END_DATE, NULL AS TERM_PARAMETER, NULL AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept, s2.window_column, 'Engineering 6+ Units' AS Reason FROM Subquery2 s2 ) SELECT * FROM CombinedSubjects ORDER BY SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each subject in the term "2010FA" and for each department name where the number of enrolled students is greater than 5 in that academic year, show the subject ID, the term description, the material status key, the academic year, the rank of the subject within the academic year group ordered by subject ID, the department name, the number of unique subjects offered by that department in that academic year, and the minimum start date of the academic term. The results are ordered by academic year, department name, and subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2010FA' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT l.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_start_date FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON t.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.window_column, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.subject_count, s2.min_start_date FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = lso.SUBJECT_ID AND lso.TERM_CODE = '2010FA' JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each subject in the Fall Term 2024-2025 with a total of 12 units, list the subject ID, subject title, department name, school name, total units, term description, term start date, and the row number within each department ordered by subject ID. Additionally, for each subject, show the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2022. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DepartmentUnitsStats AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC ), Fall2024Subjects AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SCHOOL_NAME, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) SELECT fus.SUBJECT_ID, fus.SUBJECT_TITLE, fus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, fus.SCHOOL_NAME, fus.TOTAL_UNITS, fus.TERM_DESCRIPTION, fus.TERM_START_DATE, fus.window_column, dus.units_range, dus.units_variance FROM Fall2024Subjects fus LEFT JOIN DepartmentUnitsStats dus ON fus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY fus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, fus.SUBJECT_ID

question: From the top 10 departments with the highest range of room areas (considering only rooms with an area greater than 40), display each department's name, the range and variance of the areas of rooms assigned to it, and, for each department, also show the range and variance of the space unit codes associated with it (considering only organizations with a non-null description and space units with a non-null space unit name). The columns should be: department name, area range, area variance, space unit code range, and space unit code variance. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH room_stats AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 40 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY area_range DESC ), space_unit_stats AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAX(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) - MIN(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS code_range, VARIANCE(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS code_variance FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY odk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON odk.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL AND su.SPACE_UNIT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY code_range DESC ) SELECT rs.ORGANIZATION_NAME, rs.area_range, rs.area_variance, sus.code_range, sus.code_variance FROM room_stats rs LEFT JOIN space_unit_stats sus ON rs.ORGANIZATION_NAME = sus.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY rs.area_range DESC LIMIT 10;

question: List all organizations with organization level 5, showing the organization name, organization ID, DLC name, HR org unit title, HR department name, HR org unit level, and row number within each HR department name group ordered by organization name, as well as all rooms with area greater than 200 and assignable major use, showing the building room, floor, room number, space ID, area, major use name, major use description, and the minimum area value over each major use group ordered by major use. Indicate the source of each row as either 'OrgLevel5' or 'LargeRooms'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH OrgLevel5 AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID, t1.DLC_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS window_column, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ), LargeRooms AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.ROOM, t1.SPACE_ID, t1.AREA, t0.MAJOR_USE, t0.DESCRIPTION, min(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY ORDER BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY) AS min_area_per_major_use, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_MAJOR_USE t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 200 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1 ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.ORGANIZATION_ID, o.DLC_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, o.window_column, NULL AS BUILDING_ROOM, NULL AS FLOOR, NULL AS ROOM, NULL AS SPACE_ID, NULL AS AREA, NULL AS MAJOR_USE, NULL AS MAJOR_USE_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS min_area_per_major_use, 'OrgLevel5' AS Source FROM OrgLevel5 o UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS ORGANIZATION_NAME, NULL AS ORGANIZATION_ID, NULL AS DLC_NAME, NULL AS HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, NULL AS HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, NULL AS window_column, l.BUILDING_ROOM, l.FLOOR, l.ROOM, l.SPACE_ID, l.AREA, l.MAJOR_USE, l.DESCRIPTION AS MAJOR_USE_DESCRIPTION, l.min_area_per_major_use, 'LargeRooms' AS Source FROM LargeRooms l ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY Source, ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAJOR_USE

question: For courses in the School of Engineering with a total of 12 units, display the course number, course description, subject title, total units, offering department name, the row number of the course within its offering department ordered by course number, and the dense rank of the subject (considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by total units) if available. Do not return any rounded answers.
