SQL: WITH course_windowed AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE AS course_number, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.COURSE) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), subject_dense_ranked AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t2.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ) SELECT cw.course_number, cw.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, cw.SUBJECT_TITLE, cw.TOTAL_UNITS, cw.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cw.window_column AS course_row_number, sdr.window_column AS subject_dense_rank FROM course_windowed cw LEFT JOIN subject_dense_ranked sdr ON cw.SUBJECT_TITLE = sdr.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY cw.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cw.course_number;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year, academic year description, the geometric mean of the number of library reserve material details per subject offered (considering only records where the material status is 'U' and the academic term is a regular term), the average total units, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for subjects that are offered in the fall term and have a material status of 'U' in the library reserve? List the results ordered by the geometric mean of materials per subject in descending order, then by the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH GeometricMeanMaterialsPerSubject AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(material_count))) AS geometric_mean_materials_per_subject FROM ( SELECT LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count, LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE ) sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON sub.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), AvgStddevTotalUnitsFallU AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT gmmps.ACADEMIC_YEAR, gmmps.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gmmps.geometric_mean_materials_per_subject, astu.avg_total_units, astu.stddev_total_units FROM GeometricMeanMaterialsPerSubject gmmps JOIN AvgStddevTotalUnitsFallU astu ON gmmps.ACADEMIC_YEAR = astu.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND gmmps.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = astu.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY gmmps.geometric_mean_materials_per_subject DESC, astu.stddev_total_units DESC;

question: List all subject titles that are either offered in the 2012SU term with a cluster type of 'S' (showing the subject title and the dense rank of each subject considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the number of enrolled students, with the reason 'Cluster S Dense Rank') OR are offered in the 2012 summer term by the Harvard Cross-Enrollment Program (showing the subject title, subject key, department name, the number of subject offerings, and the total number of units for those offerings, with the reason 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment'). For each result, include the subject title, subject key, department name, offering count, total units, window column, and the reason for inclusion, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t2.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t0.CLUSTER_TYPE = 'S' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT so.SUBJECT_KEY, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS offering_count, SUM(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units, so.SUBJECT_ID_SORT FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON sos.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' GROUP BY so.SUBJECT_KEY, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, so.SUBJECT_ID_SORT ), CombinedSubjects AS ( SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS SUBJECT_KEY, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS offering_count, NULL AS total_units, s1.window_column, 'Cluster S Dense Rank' AS Reason FROM Subquery1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.SUBJECT_KEY, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.offering_count, s2.total_units, NULL AS window_column, 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment' AS Reason FROM Subquery2 s2 ) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, SUBJECT_KEY, DEPARTMENT_NAME, offering_count, total_units, window_column, Reason FROM CombinedSubjects ORDER BY SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each current academic term, list the term code, term description, academic year, the number of subjects offered, the total subject enrollment number for that term, the academic year description, and for that academic year, the average, range, and variance of the record counts for TIP materials (considering only terms where the term status is not null and the TIP material status is not 'NM'). Present the columns in the following order: term code, term description, academic year, subject count, total enrollment, academic year description, average record count, record count range, and record count variance. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH CurrentTermSubjects AS ( SELECT atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), AcademicYearTipStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_record_count, MAX(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) - MIN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_range, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS IS NOT NULL AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_range DESC ), CombinedAcademicStats AS ( SELECT cts.TERM_CODE, cts.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cts.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cts.subject_count, cts.total_enrollment, ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ays.avg_record_count, ays.record_count_range, ays.record_count_variance FROM CurrentTermSubjects cts JOIN AcademicYearTipStats ays ON cts.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, subject_count, total_enrollment, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, avg_record_count, record_count_range, record_count_variance FROM CombinedAcademicStats ORDER BY TERM_CODE;

question: List all subject titles that are either (a) offered in the term '2022FA' with a total of 12 units, showing the subject title, department name from the course description, and the dense rank of each subject considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the subject code from the course catalog, or (b) for each subject offered, show the subject title, subject ID, offer department name, offer school name, term description, academic year, and the maximum number of enrolled students for each subject considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by subject key. The results should include all these columns in the following order: subject title, department name, window column, offer department name, offer school name, term description, academic year, and maximum number of enrolled students, with NULLs for columns not relevant to each case. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t2.SUBJECT_ID FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_enrolled_students FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.IS_MASTER_SECTION = 'Y' AND t0.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' ), CombinedSubjects AS ( SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, NULL AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NULL AS OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS max_enrolled_students FROM Subq1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS window_column, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.max_enrolled_students FROM Subq2 s2 ) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, max_enrolled_students FROM CombinedSubjects ORDER BY SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each academic year and department, for the top 10 subject titles by the number of reserved library materials in the term '2009SP', list the academic year, department name, average total units, variance of total units, subject title, offering department name, count of reserved materials, and calculate the reserved materials per average total units (rounded), ordering the results by reserved materials per average total units in descending order.
SQL: WITH AvgVarUnits AS ( SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY var_total_units DESC ), TopReservedSubjects AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY reserved_materials DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.avg_total_units, a.var_total_units, t.SUBJECT_TITLE, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t.reserved_materials, ROUND(t.reserved_materials / NULLIF(a.avg_total_units, 0), 2) AS reserved_per_avg_unit FROM AvgVarUnits a JOIN TopReservedSubjects t ON a.DEPARTMENT_NAME = t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY reserved_per_avg_unit DESC;

question: For organizations associated with space units with a space unit code of 402100 and space units that have a non-null DLC key and assignable organizations, give the space unit name, the organization name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the organization numbers for all organizations linked to that space unit, and the dense rank of the organization considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the organization number. List the results in descending order of the variance of the organization numbers. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH SpaceUnitOrgDenseRank AS ( SELECT t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 402100 ), SpaceUnitOrgStats AS ( SELECT s.SPACE_UNIT, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, VARIANCE(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance, STDDEV(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT s ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = s.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE s.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 GROUP BY s.SPACE_UNIT, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY org_number_variance DESC ) SELECT sstats.SPACE_UNIT, sstats.ORGANIZATION_NAME, sstats.org_number_variance, sstats.org_number_stddev, sdr.window_column FROM SpaceUnitOrgStats sstats JOIN SpaceUnitOrgDenseRank sdr ON sstats.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = sdr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY sstats.org_number_variance DESC

question: For subjects offered in the 2019FA term that have total units greater than 1, show the subject title, the dense rank of each subject considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the academic year, the subject ID, the department name, and the running sum of total units within each school ordered by subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ), subq2 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS > 1 ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.window_column AS subject_dense_rank, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.window_column AS running_sum_total_units FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY s2.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each department name and school name where the department is degree granting and the total number of enrolled students in courses offered by both the library and the TIP system in the term '2019FA' is greater than 10, provide the number of unique courses, the minimum CIP program code from the course descriptions, and the total number of enrolled students. The columns should be department name, school name, number of unique courses, minimum CIP program code, and total number of enrolled students, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH dept_course_stats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ), dept_enrollment_stats AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10 ) SELECT dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.SCHOOL_NAME, dcs.course_count, dcs.min_cip_code, des.total_enrolled FROM dept_course_stats dcs JOIN dept_enrollment_stats des ON dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: For each subject that has at least one enrolled student and is offered in the term '2016SP' with a school code of 'E', show the subject title, the number of enrolled students, the term code from the library subject offered table, the tip material status key, the total units from the subject offered summary, the average number of enrolled students within each subject title group ordered by total units, the department name, the course description, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.TERM_CODE, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_enrolled_students, lso.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID INNER JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.SUBJECT_ID FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t0.SCHOOL_CODE = 'E' ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s1.TOTAL_UNITS, s1.avg_enrolled_students, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s2.window_column FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY s1.TOTAL_UNITS, s2.window_column

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year, the academic year description, the geometric mean of the total units for all subjects offered in regular terms with total units greater than zero, the range of the number of enrolled students, and the variance of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during terms in that year where the term status indicator is 'P' and the number of enrolled students is greater than 0? List the results ordered by geometric mean of total units descending, then by enrolled range descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH AcademicYearGeometricMean AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), AcademicYearEnrolledStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT agm.ACADEMIC_YEAR, agm.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, agm.geometric_mean_total_units, aes.enrolled_range, aes.enrolled_variance FROM AcademicYearGeometricMean agm JOIN AcademicYearEnrolledStats aes ON agm.ACADEMIC_YEAR = aes.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND agm.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = aes.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY agm.geometric_mean_total_units DESC, aes.enrolled_range DESC;

question: For each subject offered in the academic term with term code '2006FA', show the subject ID, subject title, department name, and the sum of lecture units within each grade type group, along with the department name, academic year, and number of subjects offered for the top 10 departments by number of subjects offered (including only subjects that are not repeatable for credit and are offered in the fall term), where the subject's department matches one of these top 10 departments. Order the results by subject ID and academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subject_lecture_units AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.LECTURE_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA' ), top_departments_fall AS ( SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.GRADE_RULE_DESC = 'Not repeatable for credit' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT slu.SUBJECT_ID, slu.SUBJECT_TITLE, slu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, slu.window_column, tdf.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS top_department_name, tdf.ACADEMIC_YEAR, tdf.subject_count FROM subject_lecture_units slu JOIN top_departments_fall tdf ON slu.DEPARTMENT_NAME = tdf.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY slu.SUBJECT_ID, tdf.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each department that grants degrees and offers at least one subject with more than 0 total units, and that also offers subjects in regular academic terms, what are the following statistics: the department name, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for all subjects offered by that department, and the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in regular academic terms? List the department name, average total units for all subjects, variance of total units for all subjects, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for all subjects, average total units for regular terms, range of total units for regular terms, and variance of total units for regular terms, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), DeptUnitsRegularTerm AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.avg_total_units AS avg_total_units_all_subjects, d1.total_units_variance AS total_units_variance_all_subjects, d1.total_units_stddev AS total_units_stddev_all_subjects, d2.avg_total_units AS avg_total_units_regular_terms, d2.total_units_range AS total_units_range_regular_terms, d2.total_units_variance AS total_units_variance_regular_terms FROM DeptUnitsStats d1 JOIN DeptUnitsRegularTerm d2 ON d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For library reserve material details with material status key equal to 'U', and for subject offerings in the term '2017FA' with a total number of units greater than 10, show the library course instructor key, library reserve catalog key, term code, subject ID, the tip material key, tip material status key, tip ISBN, the subject title from the library reserve material, the minimum tip material status key in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the number of enrolled students, the subject title from the subject offered summary table, the department name from the course description table, and their dense rank considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the department code from the subject code table, for records where the subject ID matches in both sets. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT l.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, l.TERM_CODE, l.SUBJECT_ID, t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t.ISBN, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MIN(t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) OVER (ORDER BY s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ), subq2 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t2.SUBJECT_ID FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS > 10 ) SELECT subq1.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, subq1.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, subq1.TERM_CODE, subq1.SUBJECT_ID, subq1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, subq1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, subq1.ISBN, subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE AS LIBRARY_SUBJECT_TITLE, subq1.window_column AS LIBRARY_WINDOW_MIN_STATUS, subq2.SUBJECT_TITLE AS SUMMARY_SUBJECT_TITLE, subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq2.window_column AS SUMMARY_DENSE_RANK FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.SUBJECT_ID = subq2.SUBJECT_ID

question: For each course in the School of Engineering that is degree granting, show the course description, department name, subject code description, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by course description, along with the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of rooms used for subjects offered by that department (considering only rooms with an area greater than 40). The columns should be: course description, department name, subject code description, window row number, average area, area variance, and area standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptRoomStats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(f.AREA) AS avg_area, VARIANCE(f.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(f.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS f JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON f.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = c.MEET_PLACE WHERE f.AREA > 40 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY area_variance DESC ), EngDegreeCourses AS ( SELECT t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT e.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, e.window_column, d.avg_area, d.area_variance, d.area_stddev FROM EngDegreeCourses e LEFT JOIN DeptRoomStats d ON e.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY e.COURSE_DESCRIPTION

question: For each department that both grants degrees and offers subjects in the School of Engineering during regular terms with more than 10 total tip materials, what are the department name, the average of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units), the variance of the total units, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units, and the total number of tip materials? List the results ordered by department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), EngineeringTipMaterials AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL t JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) > 10 ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_total_units, d.total_units_variance, d.total_units_stddev, e.total_tip_materials FROM DeptUnitsStats d JOIN EngineeringTipMaterials e ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = e.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department, give the department's name, the range and variance of the access levels of rooms assigned to it, the average number of supervisees, the range of the number of supervisees, and the variance of the number of supervisees for all space units associated with that department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DepartmentAccessLevels AS ( SELECT HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.ACCESS_LEVEL) - MIN(ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_range, VARIANCE(ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_variance FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.ACCESS_LEVEL IS NOT NULL GROUP BY HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY access_level_range DESC ), DepartmentSupervisees AS ( SELECT SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT AS department_name, AVG(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS avg_supervisees, MAX(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) - MIN(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS supervisee_range, VARIANCE(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS supervisee_variance FROM SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE JOIN SPACE_UNIT ON SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.DEPT_NAMES = SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY GROUP BY SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT ORDER BY supervisee_range DESC ) SELECT dal.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dal.access_level_range, dal.access_level_variance, ds.avg_supervisees, ds.supervisee_range, ds.supervisee_variance FROM DepartmentAccessLevels dal JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON dal.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = fo.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY JOIN DepartmentSupervisees ds ON su.SPACE_UNIT = ds.department_name ORDER BY dal.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For organizations with an organization level of 5, show the organization name, organization ID, DLC name, HR org unit title, HR department name, HR org unit level, and assign row numbers within each HR department name group ordered by organization name, and for each such organization, also show the name of the associated space unit, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the organization numbers for all organizations linked to that space unit, considering only space units with a non-null DLC key and organizations with assignable status. Present the results ordered by HR department name and organization name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH OrgLevel5 AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID, t1.DLC_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS window_column, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ), SpaceUnitStats AS ( SELECT s.SPACE_UNIT, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, VARIANCE(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance, STDDEV(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT s ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = s.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE s.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 GROUP BY s.SPACE_UNIT, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY org_number_variance DESC ) SELECT o5.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o5.ORGANIZATION_ID, o5.DLC_NAME, o5.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, o5.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o5.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, o5.window_column, sus.SPACE_UNIT, sus.org_number_variance, sus.org_number_stddev FROM OrgLevel5 o5 JOIN SpaceUnitStats sus ON o5.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = sus.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY o5.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o5.ORGANIZATION_NAME

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year, the academic year description, the geometric mean of the record counts of required course materials (where the record count is greater than zero) for all subjects offered in that year, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for all library reserve materials offered in terms that have a material status of 'U'? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH GeometricMeanRecordCount AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), CoefficientOfVariation AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR, gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gmr.geometric_mean_record_count, cov.coefficient_of_variation FROM GeometricMeanRecordCount gmr JOIN CoefficientOfVariation cov ON gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR = cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For rooms with an area greater than 300 that are associated with departments in the "Provost Area", show the building-room identifier, floor number, major use description, organization name, DLC key, the average area in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by department code and ordered by area, the department code, department name, school area name, and the rank of each department within its school area based on department code. Present the results ordered by building-room identifier and department code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH RoomStats AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.MAJOR_USE_DESC, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, t1.DEPT_CODE, AVG(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t1.AREA ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_avg_area FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 300 ), ProvostDepts AS ( SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, t1.DLC_KEY, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 INNER JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' ) SELECT rs.BUILDING_ROOM, rs.FLOOR, rs.MAJOR_USE_DESC, rs.ORGANIZATION_NAME, rs.DLC_KEY, rs.window_avg_area, pd.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, pd.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, pd.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, pd.window_column FROM RoomStats rs JOIN ProvostDepts pd ON rs.DLC_KEY = pd.DLC_KEY ORDER BY rs.BUILDING_ROOM, pd.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE

question: List the activity title, enrollment type, maximum enrollment, category name, the dense rank of each row partitioned by the category name and ordered by the category name, and the row number within each enrollment type group ordered by activity title for activities in the "Mathematics" category (showing null for activities not in "Mathematics"). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH activity_category_dense_rank AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) AS window_column, d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY ), math_enrollment_row_number AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column, d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT a.ACTIVITY_TITLE, a.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, a.MAX_ENROLLMENT, a.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, a.window_column AS dense_rank_within_category, m.window_column AS row_number_within_enrollment_type_for_math FROM activity_category_dense_rank a LEFT JOIN math_enrollment_row_number m ON a.ACTIVITY_TITLE = m.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND a.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = m.ENROLLMENT_TYPE AND a.MAX_ENROLLMENT = m.MAX_ENROLLMENT AND a.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = m.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME AND a.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = m.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY

question: For courses in the School of Engineering that are degree granting, and for academic term parameters where the term indicator is 'C', show the course description, department name, the dense rank of each course considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the department's budget code, the term parameter, the term code, the academic year, and the running sum of academic years within each department ordered by academic year, for cases where the department matches in both sets. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH EngCourses AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), TermParams AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_PARAMETER, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column, t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_INDICATOR = 'C' ) SELECT ec.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ec.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ec.window_column AS eng_course_dense_rank, tp.TERM_PARAMETER, tp.TERM_CODE, tp.ACADEMIC_YEAR, tp.window_column AS term_param_running_sum FROM EngCourses ec JOIN TermParams tp ON ec.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tp.DEPARTMENT_CODE

question: For each space unit with a space unit code of 97500, show the space unit name, space unit code, associated organization name, department count, number of supervisees, the average department count within each department count group, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the old department codes among its associated HR organization units (only including organizations where the average old department code is greater than zero), ordered by number of supervisees. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH space_unit_info AS ( SELECT t1.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.DEPT_COUNT, t2.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, AVG(t2.DEPT_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPT_COUNT ORDER BY t2.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS avg_dept_count_within_group, t0.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DEPT_NAMES WHERE t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 97500 ), org_coeff_var AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) / NULLIF(AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY HAVING AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT s.space_unit_name, s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, s.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s.DEPT_COUNT, s.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, s.avg_dept_count_within_group, o.coefficient_of_variation FROM space_unit_info s LEFT JOIN org_coeff_var o ON s.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY ORDER BY s.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES

question: For each school where the average number of students enrolled in its offered subjects (considering only subjects offered in regular terms) is greater than 5, provide the school name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of students enrolled in its offered subjects, and for each offering department name in that school where the number of enrolled students is greater than 2, provide the count of distinct subject IDs and the minimum ISBN value for the associated course materials. List the results ordered by the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrollment (descending) and then by the subject count (descending). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH SchoolEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_stddev DESC ), DeptSchoolSubjectMaterialStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(td.ISBN) AS min_isbn FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT ses.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ses.avg_enrollment, ses.enrollment_stddev, dssms.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dssms.subject_count, dssms.min_isbn FROM SchoolEnrollmentStats ses JOIN DeptSchoolSubjectMaterialStats dssms ON ses.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = dssms.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME WHERE ses.avg_enrollment > 5 ORDER BY ses.enrollment_stddev DESC, dssms.subject_count DESC;

question: For each subject offered in the term with the description "Fall Term 2024-2025" that also has more than 0 enrolled students and a material status key of 'U', show the subject offered key, subject title, offering department name, the term description, the rank of each subject within its offering department, the course number, course number description, number of enrolled students, the reserve catalog key, and the dense rank over the material status key ordered by material status key, with the columns listed in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH SubjectOfferedInTerm AS ( SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS window_column, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' ), LibrarySubjectWithReserve AS ( SELECT t1.COURSE_NUMBER, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) AS window_column, t1.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ) SELECT s.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.window_column AS subject_rank_in_dept, l.COURSE_NUMBER, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, l.window_column AS dense_rank_material_status FROM SubjectOfferedInTerm s JOIN LibrarySubjectWithReserve l ON s.SUBJECT_ID = l.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY s.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, l.COURSE_NUMBER;

question: For each subject offered in the library, show the subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, term description, academic year, subject short title, and the maximum total units for each row and the next two rows in order of subject ID, considering only subjects offered in the 'Mathematics' department during regular terms, along with the average, range, and variance of CIP program codes for all courses offered by that department where the department is degree granting and the course level is undergraduate. Present the subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, term description, academic year, subject short title, maximum total units, average CIP program code, CIP program code range, and CIP program code variance in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Sub1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, MAX(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS JOIN_DEPT_NAME FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ), Sub2 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_code, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cip_code_range DESC ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, s1.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, s2.avg_cip_code, s2.cip_code_range, s2.cip_code_variance FROM Sub1 s1 LEFT JOIN Sub2 s2 ON s1.JOIN_DEPT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For rooms with an access level of 1 in building E38, show the building-room identifier, the area, the major use description, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the major use description (for access level 1 rooms), the floor number, the major use description, the organization name, the office location, the full name of the employee, the department name, and the average area of rooms in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by department number and ordered by floor. List the columns in the following order: building-room identifier, area, major use description, access level window row number, floor number, major use description, organization name, office location, full name of the employee, department name, and average area window. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.AREA, t0.DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.DESCRIPTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM FCLT_MAJOR_USE t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.FLOOR, t0.MAJOR_USE_DESC, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.OFFICE_LOCATION, t1.FULL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(t0.AREA) OVER ( PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER ORDER BY t0.FLOOR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ROOMS t0 JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY t1 ON t0.BUILDING_ROOM = t1.OFFICE_LOCATION WHERE t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = 'E38' ) SELECT s1.BUILDING_ROOM, s1.AREA, s1.DESCRIPTION, s1.window_column AS access_level_window_row_number, s2.FLOOR, s2.MAJOR_USE_DESC, s2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s2.OFFICE_LOCATION, s2.FULL_NAME, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.window_column AS avg_area_window FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.BUILDING_ROOM = s2.BUILDING_ROOM ORDER BY s1.BUILDING_ROOM, s2.FLOOR

question: For subjects in the "Engineering" school with total units equal to 1, show the subject ID, subject title, department name, academic year, the rank of each subject within its academic year group ordered by subject ID, and for each academic year, also provide the academic year description, the range, and the variance of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during terms in that year, considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the number of enrolled students is greater than 0. Present the results ordered by academic year and subject rank. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH EnrolledStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), EngineeringSubjects AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 1 ) SELECT es.SUBJECT_ID, es.SUBJECT_TITLE, es.DEPARTMENT_NAME, es.ACADEMIC_YEAR, es.window_column, en.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, en.enrolled_range, en.enrolled_variance FROM EngineeringSubjects es JOIN EnrolledStats en ON es.ACADEMIC_YEAR = en.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY es.ACADEMIC_YEAR, es.window_column

question: For each subject that has at least one enrolled student and is offered in the term '2016SP' with a school code of 'E', show the subject title, the number of enrolled students, the term code from the library subject offered table, the tip material status key, the total units from the subject offered summary, the average number of enrolled students within each subject title group ordered by total units, the department name, the course description, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title, ordered by total units descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.TERM_CODE, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_enrolled_students, lso.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID INNER JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.SUBJECT_ID FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t0.SCHOOL_CODE = 'E' ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s1.TOTAL_UNITS, s1.avg_enrolled_students, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s2.window_column FROM Subq1 s1 JOIN Subq2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY s1.TOTAL_UNITS DESC

question: For each major use description and organization name where the room area is greater than 100 and the access level is 1, list the number of rooms, the minimum floor number, the access level name, and the variance of the number of rooms in the building history for buildings with a nonzero number of rooms and assignable area greater than 0, with the results ordered by major use description and organization name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH RoomStats AS ( SELECT r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count, MIN(r.FLOOR) AS min_floor, b.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 100 AND r.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 GROUP BY r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, b.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE ), AccessLevelStats AS ( SELECT FCLT_BUILDING.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE, FCLT_BUILDING.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME, VARIANCE(FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS num_rooms_variance FROM FCLT_BUILDING JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST ON FCLT_BUILDING.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE = FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE WHERE FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 0 AND FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.ASSIGNABLE_AREA > 0 GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE, FCLT_BUILDING.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME ORDER BY num_rooms_variance DESC ), CombinedStats AS ( SELECT rs.MAJOR_USE_DESC, rs.ORGANIZATION_NAME, rs.room_count, rs.min_floor, als.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME, als.num_rooms_variance FROM RoomStats rs JOIN AccessLevelStats als ON rs.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE = als.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE ) SELECT * FROM CombinedStats ORDER BY MAJOR_USE_DESC, ORGANIZATION_NAME;

question: For each space unit with a space unit code of 97500, show the space unit name, space unit code, associated organization name, department count, number of supervisees, the average department count within each department count group, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the old department codes among its associated HR organization units (only including organizations where the average old department code is greater than zero), ordered by number of supervisees. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH SpaceUnitStats AS ( SELECT t1.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.DEPT_COUNT, t2.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, AVG(t2.DEPT_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPT_COUNT ORDER BY t2.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS avg_dept_count_within_group FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DEPT_NAMES WHERE t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 97500 ), OrgDeptCodeVariation AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) / NULLIF(AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT sus.space_unit_name, sus.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, sus.ORGANIZATION_NAME, sus.DEPT_COUNT, sus.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, sus.avg_dept_count_within_group, odv.coefficient_of_variation FROM SpaceUnitStats sus JOIN OrgDeptCodeVariation odv ON sus.ORGANIZATION_NAME = odv.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY sus.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES

question: For each department hierarchy level 2 name and organization name where the organization is assignable and the organization has organization level 5, give the number of organizations, the minimum organization number, the organization key, the description, the space unit, the space unit key, and the average organization key within each organization key group ordered by space unit key, ordered by department hierarchy level 2 name, organization name, and space unit key. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptOrgStats AS ( SELECT m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(f.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 GROUP BY m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME ), OrgLevel5Details AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.SPACE_UNIT, t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ) SELECT d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, d.ORGANIZATION_NAME, d.organization_count, d.min_organization_number, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.DESCRIPTION, o.SPACE_UNIT, o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, o.window_column FROM DeptOrgStats d JOIN OrgLevel5Details o ON d.ORGANIZATION_NAME = o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, d.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year, academic year description, the variance of the record count of tip details for terms that are current or previous terms, and the geometric mean of the record counts of required course materials (where the record count is greater than zero) for all subjects offered in that year? Display the results ordered by the variance of the record count in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH record_count_variance_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC ), geometric_mean_record_count_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_record_count DESC ) SELECT rcv.ACADEMIC_YEAR, rcv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, rcv.record_count_variance, gmr.geometric_mean_record_count FROM record_count_variance_cte rcv JOIN geometric_mean_record_count_cte gmr ON rcv.ACADEMIC_YEAR = gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND rcv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY rcv.record_count_variance DESC;

question: For each subject code where the department is degree granting, show the subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, rank of the subject code within each school name group ordered by subject code, the number of subject codes for each department and subject code, and the minimum department budget code for each department and subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE ) SELECT sq1.SUBJECT_CODE, sq1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, sq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sq1.SCHOOL_NAME, sq1.window_column, sq2.subject_code_count, sq2.min_dept_budget_code FROM Subquery1 sq1 JOIN Subquery2 sq2 ON sq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND sq1.SUBJECT_CODE = sq2.SUBJECT_CODE

question: For each academic term with status 'Previous' and for each subject category and academic year where the subject has a maximum enrollment greater than 10, show the term code, term description, term start date, calendar date, day of week, the average calendar year within each calendar year group ordered by term start date, the subject category key, academic year, the number of unique subjects, and the minimum academic term start date, where the academic year and minimum term start date match between the term and the subject category. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH TermWindowStats AS ( SELECT t1.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t0.CALENDAR_DATE, t0.DAY_OF_WEEK, AVG(t0.CALENDAR_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.CALENDAR_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_START_DATE) AS window_column FROM TIME_DAY t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.CALENDAR_DATE = t1.TERM_START_DATE WHERE t1.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ), SubjectCategoryStats AS ( SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT i.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT tws.TERM_CODE, tws.TERM_DESCRIPTION, tws.TERM_START_DATE, tws.CALENDAR_DATE, tws.DAY_OF_WEEK, tws.window_column, scs.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, scs.ACADEMIC_YEAR, scs.subject_count, scs.min_term_start_date FROM TermWindowStats tws JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON tws.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SubjectCategoryStats scs ON at.ACADEMIC_YEAR = scs.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND at.TERM_START_DATE = scs.min_term_start_date ORDER BY tws.TERM_START_DATE;

question: For each course offered by the Mathematics department with at least 5 enrolled students, show the course number, subject title, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, the row number within each academic year group ordered by course number, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in offered subjects for that academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH math_courses AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 ), yearly_variation AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT mc.COURSE_NUMBER, mc.SUBJECT_TITLE, mc.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, mc.TERM_DESCRIPTION, mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mc.window_column, yv.coefficient_of_variation FROM math_courses mc LEFT JOIN yearly_variation yv ON mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = yv.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mc.window_column;

question: For rooms with an area of at least 300, list the room key, building room, area, building number, city, and the row number within each city ordered by area, along with the DLC key, the average area, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of rooms by DLC key (considering only rooms with an area greater than 40). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH RoomAreas AS ( SELECT t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.AREA, t1.BUILDING_NUMBER, t1.CITY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.CITY ORDER BY t0.AREA) AS window_column, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ROOMS t0 JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS t1 ON t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE t0.AREA >= 300 ), DlcAreaStats AS ( SELECT fod.DLC_KEY, AVG(fr.AREA) AS avg_area, VARIANCE(fr.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(fr.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fod JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON fod.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE fr.AREA > 40 GROUP BY fod.DLC_KEY ORDER BY area_variance DESC ) SELECT ra.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, ra.BUILDING_ROOM, ra.AREA, ra.BUILDING_NUMBER, ra.CITY, ra.window_column, fod.DLC_KEY, das.avg_area, das.area_variance, das.area_stddev FROM RoomAreas ra JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fod ON ra.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fod.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN DlcAreaStats das ON fod.DLC_KEY = das.DLC_KEY ORDER BY ra.CITY, ra.window_column

question: For subjects offered in the term '2022FA' with a total of 12 units, show the subject title from the summary, the department name from the course description, the dense rank of each subject considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the subject code from the course catalog, the number of offered subjects, and the minimum number of enrolled students for each department name and school name where the number of enrolled students in the offered subject is greater than 3. The columns should be displayed in the following order: subject title, department name, dense rank, number of offered subjects, and minimum number of enrolled students. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), subq2 AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS offered_subject_count, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.window_column, subq2.offered_subject_count, subq2.min_enrolled_students FROM subq1 LEFT JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND subq1.SCHOOL_NAME = subq2.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY subq1.window_column

question: For each course that has more than 0 enrolled students and a material status key of 'U', list the course number, course number description, number of enrolled students, reserve catalog key, and the dense rank over the material status key ordered by material status key, along with the department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of courses offered by that department (considering only courses offered this year with non-null total units). Present the results ordered by course number and course number description. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptStats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccc.total_units) - MIN(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccc.total_units IS NOT NULL GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ), SubjectEnroll AS ( SELECT t1.COURSE_NUMBER, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) AS window_column, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT s.COURSE_NUMBER, s.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, s.window_column, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.total_units_range, d.total_units_variance, d.total_units_stddev FROM SubjectEnroll s JOIN DeptStats d ON s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY COURSE_NUMBER, COURSE_NUMBER_DESC;

question: For Mathematics department courses with at least 5 enrolled students, show the course number, subject title, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, the row number within each academic year group ordered by course number, the term start date, calendar date, day of week, and the average calendar year within each calendar year group ordered by term start date, but only for academic terms where the term status is 'Previous'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH MathCourses AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 ), PreviousTerms AS ( SELECT t1.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t0.CALENDAR_DATE, t0.DAY_OF_WEEK, AVG(t0.CALENDAR_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.CALENDAR_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_START_DATE) AS window_column FROM TIME_DAY t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.CALENDAR_DATE = t1.TERM_START_DATE WHERE t1.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT m.COURSE_NUMBER, m.SUBJECT_TITLE, m.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, m.TERM_DESCRIPTION, m.ACADEMIC_YEAR, m.window_column AS math_window_column, p.TERM_START_DATE, p.CALENDAR_DATE, p.DAY_OF_WEEK, p.window_column AS previous_terms_window_column FROM MathCourses m JOIN PreviousTerms p ON m.TERM_CODE = p.TERM_CODE ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY COURSE_NUMBER, TERM_START_DATE;

question: For each department, provide the department name, the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2022 and that are also listed in the CIS course catalog, as well as the average and variance of the total units for its courses that have a non-null subject title and total units greater than 0. List the department name, units range, variance of units for 2022, average units for all such courses, and variance of units for all such courses, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptUnitsRangeVariance2022 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC ), DeptAvgVarianceNonNullUnits AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_variance DESC ) SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.units_range, d1.units_variance AS units_range_variance_2022, d2.avg_units, d2.units_variance AS avg_units_variance_all FROM DeptUnitsRangeVariance2022 d1 JOIN DeptAvgVarianceNonNullUnits d2 ON d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d1.units_range DESC;

question: For each library reserve material detail with material status key 'U', show the reserve catalog key, subject offered key, term code, the academic year, the term description, the tip material key, the tip material status key, and the average record count in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the tip material status key and ordered by the academic year, along with the department name, the number of unique subjects, and the minimum total units offered for each department and academic year where the subject enrollment number is greater than 10, for all matches on academic year. Present the results ordered by academic year, department name, and reserve catalog key. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH LibraryReserveMaterialDetails AS ( SELECT t0.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, t0.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, AVG(t2.RECORD_COUNT) OVER ( PARTITION BY t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ), DepartmentSubjectStats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, lrm.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, lrm.TERM_CODE, lrm.ACADEMIC_YEAR, lrm.TERM_DESCRIPTION, lrm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, lrm.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, lrm.window_column, dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.subject_count, dss.min_total_units FROM LibraryReserveMaterialDetails lrm JOIN DepartmentSubjectStats dss ON lrm.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY lrm.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY

question: For each room with an access level of 1, provide the building room, building component, floor, space usage, space unit code, the corresponding organization's name, the average floor within each space usage group ordered by floor, the average access level, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of access levels of rooms assigned to that organization (considering only rooms on floor 2 or higher), ordered by organization name and building room. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH OrgAccessStats AS ( SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(ACCESS_LEVEL) AS avg_access_level, STDDEV(ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_stddev, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE FLOOR >= 2 GROUP BY ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID ORDER BY access_level_stddev DESC ), RoomDetails AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.BUILDING_COMPONENT, t1.FLOOR, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID, AVG(t1.FLOOR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SPACE_USAGE ORDER BY t1.FLOOR) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 ) SELECT rd.BUILDING_ROOM, rd.BUILDING_COMPONENT, rd.FLOOR, rd.SPACE_USAGE, rd.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, rd.ORGANIZATION_NAME, rd.window_column, oas.avg_access_level, oas.access_level_stddev FROM RoomDetails rd JOIN OrgAccessStats oas ON rd.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = oas.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID ORDER BY rd.ORGANIZATION_NAME, rd.BUILDING_ROOM

question: For the top 10 academic years by the number of unique course materials assigned (for terms that are not current and where the course material status is 'RQ'), what is the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of reserved library materials per academic term in that year (considering only terms with a regular status), and what is the total count of unique materials? List the academic year description, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of reserved materials per term, and the total count of unique materials, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH MaterialStatsPerYear AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(term_material_count) - MIN(term_material_count) AS material_count_range, VARIANCE(term_material_count) AS material_count_variance, STDDEV(term_material_count) AS material_count_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN ( SELECT LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE, COUNT(*) AS term_material_count FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL GROUP BY LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE ) AS term_stats ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = term_stats.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY material_count_range DESC ), TopYearsByUniqueMaterials AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS unique_materials FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY unique_materials DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT m.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, m.material_count_range, m.material_count_variance, m.material_count_stddev, t.unique_materials FROM MaterialStatsPerYear m JOIN TopYearsByUniqueMaterials t ON m.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY t.unique_materials DESC, m.material_count_range DESC;

question: List all organizations that either have a DLC key of 'D_MECHE' (showing their organization key, organization name, DLC name, and their rank within each DLC name group ordered by organization key) or are assignable with a department code above 100000 (showing their organization key, organization name, department name, the number of HR org units, and the total of their department IDs), along with the reason for inclusion ('DLC_MECHE' for the first group and 'ASSIGNABLE_LARGE_DEPT' for the second group).
