question: For each department where the department name matches an offering department name with more than 2 enrolled students, what is the department name, the variance of the total units of subjects offered in the 2022 academic year, the offering school name, the count of distinct subject IDs, and the minimum ISBN value for the associated course materials? List the results ordered by department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptUnitsVariance AS ( SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), DeptSubjectMaterialStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(td.ISBN) AS min_isbn FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ), CombinedDeptStats AS ( SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.total_units_variance, d2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, d2.subject_count, d2.min_isbn FROM DeptUnitsVariance d1 JOIN DeptSubjectMaterialStats d2 ON d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT * FROM CombinedDeptStats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each IAP subject activity that is not cancelled, has a non-null maximum enrollment, and also has a maximum enrollment of 12, list the activity title, enrollment type, term description, subject title, number of enrolled students, the dense rank over the offer department code ordered by offer department code, the average number of enrolled students in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the responsible faculty MIT ID and ordered by the number of enrolled students, the offer department code, and the responsible faculty MIT ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS window_column, t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, AVG(t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY t2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ORDER BY t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 12 ) SELECT s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.window_column AS dense_rank_over_offer_dept_code, s2.window_column AS avg_num_enrolled_students_window, s1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE = s2.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND s1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = s2.ENROLLMENT_TYPE AND s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION AND s1.SUBJECT_TITLE = s2.SUBJECT_TITLE AND s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AND s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = s2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ORDER BY s1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC

question: For library reserve materials with material status key 'U', show the subject ID, library course instructor key, term description, academic year, term start date, the minimum academic year in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by library reserve catalog key, the course number, course number description, number of enrolled students, and the dense rank over the material status key ordered by material status key, for subjects that have more than 0 enrolled students. List the results ordered by academic year descending and number of enrolled students descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t2.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, MIN(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT t1.COURSE_NUMBER, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) AS window_column, t1.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.TERM_START_DATE, s1.window_column AS min_academic_year_window, s2.COURSE_NUMBER, s2.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.window_column AS dense_rank_material_status FROM Subq1 s1 JOIN Subq2 s2 ON s1.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = s2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY AND s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC;

question: For each department and academic year where the number of enrolled students in a subject is greater than 5, what is the department name, the geometric mean of the total units for subjects offered by that department where the total units are greater than zero, the academic year, the number of unique subjects offered, and the minimum number of total units for those subjects? List the department name, geometric mean of total units, academic year, subject count, and minimum total units in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH GeometricMeanUnits AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(s.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC ), SubjectStats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT g.DEPARTMENT_NAME, g.geometric_mean_total_units, s.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.subject_count, s.min_total_units FROM GeometricMeanUnits g JOIN SubjectStats s ON g.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY g.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each academic year, what is the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in each subject offered, considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term and have more than 0 enrolled students, and what is the minimum academic year and the sum of total units for subjects that are offered in the fall term, considering only library reserve material details with material status 'U'? Please provide the academic year, average enrollment, enrollment variance, minimum academic year, and total units sum in this order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH avg_enrollment_stats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC ), min_year_total_units AS ( SELECT MIN(at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_sum FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' ) SELECT aes.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aes.avg_enrollment, aes.enrollment_variance, mytu.min_academic_year, mytu.total_units_sum FROM avg_enrollment_stats aes CROSS JOIN min_year_total_units mytu;

question: For each space unit and organization name that appear in both (1) the set of space units with a warehouse load date of '19-DEC-24' and HR org units with a warehouse load date of '03-DEC-24', and (2) the set of space units with a space unit code of 402100, what are the space unit name, organization name, average HR department code, range of HR department codes, variance of HR department codes for the HR org units linked to that space unit, as well as the space unit key, DLC name, DLC key from FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY, and the rank of each record within each DLC key group ordered by space unit key? List the results in the order: space unit name, organization name, average HR department code, range of HR department codes, variance of HR department codes, space unit key, DLC name, DLC key, and rank. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH space_unit_hr_stats AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS avg_hr_dept_code, MAX(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) - MIN(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS hr_dept_code_range, VARIANCE(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS hr_dept_code_variance FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE su.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND hou.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '03-DEC-24' GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY hr_dept_code_range DESC ), space_unit_code_402100 AS ( SELECT t2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.DLC_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DLC_KEY ORDER BY t2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 402100 ) SELECT s1.SPACE_UNIT, s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s1.avg_hr_dept_code, s1.hr_dept_code_range, s1.hr_dept_code_variance, s2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, s2.DLC_NAME, s2.DLC_KEY, s2.window_column FROM space_unit_hr_stats s1 JOIN space_unit_code_402100 s2 ON s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME = s2.ORGANIZATION_NAME

question: For departments in the "Sloan School of Management" area with a hierarchy type of "Standard Hierarchy" that are also in the "Provost Area" at hierarchy level 2, show the department code, department name, the dense rank of each department considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the department's long name, the department's name, the range of organization numbers for organizations within that department, and the variance of the organization numbers, with results ordered by department name and then by organization number range in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH SloanStandardDepartments AS ( SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME = 'Sloan School of Management Area' ), ProvostDeptOrgStats AS ( SELECT MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME AS department_name, MAX(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) - MIN(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_range, VARIANCE(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance, MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY WHERE MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME, MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY ) SELECT ssd.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssd.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ssd.window_column, pds.department_name, pds.org_number_range, pds.org_number_variance FROM SloanStandardDepartments ssd JOIN ProvostDeptOrgStats pds ON ssd.DLC_KEY = pds.DLC_KEY ORDER BY ssd.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, pds.org_number_range DESC;

question: List all subjects offered in the 2019FA term that either (a) are offered in 2019FA (showing subject ID, subject title, number of enrolled students, department name, department full name, and row number within each department name group ordered by subject ID), or (b) have total units greater than 1 in 2019FA (showing subject ID, subject title, department name, and the running sum of total units within each school ordered by subject ID), along with a reason for inclusion ('Enrolled' for subjects from the first group and 'Units' for subjects from the second group). The columns returned are subject ID, subject title, number of enrolled students, department name, department full name, row number within department, running sum of total units within school, and reason for inclusion, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t1.SCHOOL_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t1.SCHOOL_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS > 1 ), CombinedSubjects AS ( SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.window_column AS window_column_1, NULL AS window_column_2, 'Enrolled' AS Reason FROM Subq1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, NULL AS window_column_1, s2.window_column AS window_column_2, 'Units' AS Reason FROM Subq2 s2 ) SELECT SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, window_column_1, window_column_2, Reason FROM CombinedSubjects ORDER BY SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each space unit and its associated department, what is the space unit name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the room square footage for all rooms in that space unit where the room square footage is greater than 10, the department name, and the range and variance of the access levels of rooms assigned to that department? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH space_unit_stats AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, VARIANCE(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS square_footage_variance, STDDEV(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS square_footage_stddev, su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY WHERE sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 10 GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY ORDER BY square_footage_variance DESC ), department_access_stats AS ( SELECT HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.ACCESS_LEVEL) - MIN(ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_range, VARIANCE(ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_variance, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.ACCESS_LEVEL IS NOT NULL GROUP BY HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY access_level_range DESC ) SELECT sus.SPACE_UNIT, sus.square_footage_variance, sus.square_footage_stddev, das.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, das.access_level_range, das.access_level_variance FROM space_unit_stats sus JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON sus.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN department_access_stats das ON fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = das.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY;

question: List, for each department, the department code, department name, the range of enrolled students, the variance of enrolled students, and the variance of total units for subjects offered by that department, along with the reason for inclusion ('EnrolledStats' for departments with statistics on enrolled students in graduate-level, degree-granting courses, and 'UnitsVariance' for departments with statistics on the variance of total units for degree-granting subjects with more than 0 enrolled students). The columns should be: department code, department name, range of enrolled students, variance of enrolled students, variance of total units, and reason. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH EnrolledStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), UnitsVariance AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), CombinedStats AS ( SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_CODE, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.enrolled_range, e.enrolled_variance, NULL AS total_units_variance, 'EnrolledStats' AS Reason FROM EnrolledStats e UNION ALL SELECT u.DEPARTMENT_CODE, u.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS enrolled_range, NULL AS enrolled_variance, u.total_units_variance, 'UnitsVariance' AS Reason FROM UnitsVariance u ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, enrolled_range, enrolled_variance, total_units_variance, Reason FROM CombinedStats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Reason;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description, the variance of the record count of tip details for terms that are current or previous terms, and the geometric mean of the record counts of required course materials (where the record count is greater than zero) for all subjects offered in that year? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH RecordCountVariance AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC ), GeometricMeanRecordCount AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_record_count DESC ), CombinedStats AS ( SELECT r.ACADEMIC_YEAR, r.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, r.record_count_variance, g.geometric_mean_record_count FROM RecordCountVariance r JOIN GeometricMeanRecordCount g ON r.ACADEMIC_YEAR = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND r.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT * FROM CombinedStats ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC;

question: List, for each department, the department name, school name, total number of tip materials offered for subjects in the School of Engineering during regular terms where the total number of tip materials is greater than 10, number of offered subjects, and minimum number of enrolled students for each department and school name where the number of enrolled students in the offered subject is greater than 3, along with the reason for inclusion ('TipMaterials' for tip materials and 'EnrolledSubjects' for enrolled subjects). The columns should be: department name, school name, total tip materials, offered subject count, minimum enrolled students, and reason. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH TipMaterials AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL t JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) > 10 ), EnrolledSubjects AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS offered_subject_count, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT t.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME, t.total_tip_materials, NULL AS offered_subject_count, NULL AS min_enrolled_students, 'TipMaterials' AS Reason FROM TipMaterials t UNION ALL SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS total_tip_materials, e.offered_subject_count, e.min_enrolled_students, 'EnrolledSubjects' AS Reason FROM EnrolledSubjects e ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, total_tip_materials, offered_subject_count, min_enrolled_students, Reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Reason;

question: For students in the "Electrical Eng & Computer Sci" department, show their full name, email address, department name, course description, course level, and their row number within each course level group ordered by the student's last name, along with the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by their department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units), including only those departments where the average total units is greater than 0 and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is not null. List the results ordered by course level and row number. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DepartmentUnitsStats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ), EECS_Students AS ( SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.COURSE_LEVEL ORDER BY t2.LAST_NAME) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT eecs.FULL_NAME, eecs.EMAIL_ADDRESS, eecs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, eecs.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, eecs.COURSE_LEVEL, eecs.window_column, dus.avg_total_units, dus.stddev_total_units FROM EECS_Students eecs JOIN DepartmentUnitsStats dus ON eecs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE dus.avg_total_units > 0 AND dus.stddev_total_units IS NOT NULL ORDER BY eecs.COURSE_LEVEL, eecs.window_column;

question: For IAP subject activities with a maximum enrollment of at least 10 and that are not cancelled and also have a maximum enrollment of at least 20, show the activity title, enrollment type, the academic term description, the subject title from the course catalog, the row number of each activity within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by activity title, and the dense rank of each activity considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the academic year of the associated term. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Sub1 AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 10 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' ), Sub2 AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20 ) SELECT s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.window_column AS activity_title_row_number, s2.window_column AS academic_year_dense_rank FROM Sub1 s1 JOIN Sub2 s2 ON s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE = s2.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND s1.TERM_CODE = s2.TERM_CODE

question: For each subject that has at least one enrolled student and is offered in the term '2016SP' with a school code of 'E', show the subject title, the number of enrolled students, the term code from the library subject offered table, the tip material status key, the total units from the subject offered summary, the average number of enrolled students within each subject title group ordered by total units, the department name, the course description, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title, ordered by total units descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.TERM_CODE, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_enrolled_students, lso.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID INNER JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), subq2 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.SUBJECT_ID FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t0.SCHOOL_CODE = 'E' ) SELECT subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, subq1.TERM_CODE, subq1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, subq1.TOTAL_UNITS, subq1.avg_enrolled_students, subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, subq2.window_column FROM subq1 INNER JOIN subq2 ON subq1.SUBJECT_ID = subq2.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY subq1.TOTAL_UNITS DESC

question: For each department code and department name, grouped by the department hierarchy level 2 name, where the department belongs to the "Provost Area", and for each associated organization, give the department hierarchy level 2 name, department code, department name, number of organizational units, minimum department ID, organization name, and the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the room areas for rooms associated with that organization and having a non-null area. List the results ordered by department name and then by area range descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH OrgRoomStats AS ( SELECT r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY o JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY area_range DESC ), ProvostDeptStats AS ( SELECT h.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(o.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS org_unit_count, MIN(o.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS min_department_id, h.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY h JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT o ON h.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE h.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY h.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, h.DLC_KEY ) SELECT p.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, p.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, p.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, p.org_unit_count, p.min_department_id, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.area_range, o.area_variance, o.area_stddev FROM ProvostDeptStats p JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f ON p.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY JOIN OrgRoomStats o ON f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY p.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.area_range DESC;

question: From the top 10 space units with the highest variance in room square footage (for rooms with square footage greater than 10), display each space unit's name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of its room square footage, the name of the department assigned to rooms in that space unit, and for that department, the range and variance of the access levels of rooms assigned to it. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH space_unit_stats AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, VARIANCE(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS square_footage_variance, STDDEV(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS square_footage_stddev, su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY WHERE sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 10 GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY ORDER BY square_footage_variance DESC ), department_access_stats AS ( SELECT HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.ACCESS_LEVEL) - MIN(ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_range, VARIANCE(ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_variance, ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.ACCESS_LEVEL IS NOT NULL GROUP BY HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID ORDER BY access_level_range DESC ) SELECT su_stats.SPACE_UNIT, su_stats.square_footage_variance, su_stats.square_footage_stddev, das.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, das.access_level_range, das.access_level_variance FROM space_unit_stats su_stats JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON su_stats.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD zrl ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = zrl.SPACE_UNIT_CODE JOIN department_access_stats das ON zrl.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = das.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID ORDER BY su_stats.square_footage_variance DESC, das.access_level_range DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each organization that has both rooms on floor 2 or higher and at least one associated space unit with a non-null DLC key, provide the organization name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the access levels of rooms assigned to that organization (considering only rooms on floor 2 or higher), and the average and variance of the space unit codes assigned to it. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH org_access_stats AS ( SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(ACCESS_LEVEL) AS avg_access_level, STDDEV(ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_stddev FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE FLOOR >= 2 GROUP BY ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY access_level_stddev DESC ), dept_spaceunit_stats AS ( SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS avg_space_unit_code, VARIANCE(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS var_space_unit_code FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fodk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON fodk.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE fodk.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY var_space_unit_code DESC ) SELECT oas.ORGANIZATION_NAME, oas.avg_access_level, oas.access_level_stddev, dss.avg_space_unit_code, dss.var_space_unit_code FROM org_access_stats oas JOIN dept_spaceunit_stats dss ON oas.ORGANIZATION_NAME = dss.ORGANIZATION_NAME;

question: For organizations with an organization level of 5, show the organization name, organization ID, DLC name, HR org unit title, HR department name, HR org unit level, and assign row numbers within each HR department name group ordered by organization name, and for each such organization, for each room with area greater than 200 and assignable major use, show the building room, floor, room number, space ID, area, major use name, major use description, and the minimum area value over each major use group, ordered by HR department name, organization name, and major use. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH OrgInfo AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID, t1.DLC_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS window_column, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ), RoomInfo AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.ROOM, t1.SPACE_ID, t1.AREA, t0.MAJOR_USE, t0.DESCRIPTION, min(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY ORDER BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY) AS min_area_per_major_use, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_MAJOR_USE t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 200 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1 ) SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.ORGANIZATION_ID, o.DLC_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, o.window_column, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.FLOOR, r.ROOM, r.SPACE_ID, r.AREA, r.MAJOR_USE, r.DESCRIPTION, r.min_area_per_major_use FROM OrgInfo o JOIN RoomInfo r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.MAJOR_USE

question: For each department where the total number of subject enrollments for subjects offered in the current term is greater than 10, and for each course number in that department where the number of enrolled students in the subject summary is greater than 2, provide the department name, the total number of subject enrollments, the course number, the number of unique library subjects offered, and the minimum total units for those subjects. List the department name, total number of subject enrollments, course number, number of unique library subjects offered, and minimum total units in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DepartmentEnrollments AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollments FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER p JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON p.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 10 ), DepartmentCourseLibraryStats AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER ) SELECT de.DEPARTMENT_NAME, de.total_enrollments, dcls.COURSE_NUMBER, dcls.subject_count, dcls.min_total_units FROM DepartmentEnrollments de JOIN DepartmentCourseLibraryStats dcls ON de.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dcls.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY de.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcls.COURSE_NUMBER;

question: For each Mathematics department course with at least 5 enrolled students, show the course number, subject title, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, the row number within each academic year group ordered by course number, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in offered subjects for that academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH MathCourses AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 ), YearlyEnrolledStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT mc.COURSE_NUMBER, mc.SUBJECT_TITLE, mc.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, mc.TERM_DESCRIPTION, mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mc.window_column, yes.coefficient_of_variation FROM MathCourses mc JOIN YearlyEnrolledStats yes ON mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = yes.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mc.window_column;

question: From the top 10 departments with the highest variance of reserve catalog keys for courses with material status 'U', display each department's name, the variance of reserve catalog keys, the variance of the number of enrolled students in library subjects that have a matching master subject ID in the TIP subject offerings (considering only departments with more than 0 enrolled students in both tables), and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in those library subjects, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH dept_catalog_var AS ( SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, VARIANCE(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY lci.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY catalog_key_variance DESC ), dept_students_var AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_students_variance, STDDEV(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_students_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = t.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY library_students_variance DESC ) SELECT dcv.DEPARTMENT, dcv.catalog_key_variance, dsv.library_students_variance, dsv.library_students_stddev FROM dept_catalog_var dcv JOIN dept_students_var dsv ON dcv.DEPARTMENT = dsv.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY dcv.catalog_key_variance DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering with a total of at least 6 units, show the subject code, subject title, department name, the running sum of total units within each grade type, and for the corresponding department also provide the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and offered in the Engineering school). Present the results ordered by subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.total_units_range, s2.total_units_variance, s2.total_units_stddev FROM Subq1 s1 JOIN Subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_CODE

question: For rooms on floor 2 that are associated with a DLC having more than five organizations, provide the building room, space usage, organization name, HR org unit title, department name, the minimum access level in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the building component, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the organization numbers for organizations associated with that DLC, ordered by the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of organization numbers (descending) and then by building room. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DLCOrgStddev AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_NAME, STDDEV(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY.DLC_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER IS NOT NULL GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY org_number_stddev DESC ), Floor2Rooms AS ( SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.SPACE_USAGE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DLC_NAME, MIN(t0.ACCESS_LEVEL) OVER (ORDER BY t0.BUILDING_COMPONENT ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2 ) SELECT f2r.BUILDING_ROOM, f2r.SPACE_USAGE, f2r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, f2r.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, f2r.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, f2r.window_column, dos.org_number_stddev FROM Floor2Rooms f2r JOIN DLCOrgStddev dos ON f2r.DLC_NAME = dos.DLC_NAME ORDER BY dos.org_number_stddev DESC, f2r.BUILDING_ROOM

question: For subjects in the "Engineering" school during the Fall Term 2024-2025, show the subject title, department name, total units, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title, and for each such department and academic year where the number of enrolled students in a subject is greater than 5, also give the number of unique subjects offered and the minimum number of total units for those subjects. Present the subject title, department name, total units, window row number, subject count, and minimum total units, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH EngineeringSubjects AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS eng_dept_name FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' AND t2.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ), DeptYearSubjectStats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT es.SUBJECT_TITLE, es.DEPARTMENT_NAME, es.TOTAL_UNITS, es.window_column, dys.subject_count, dys.min_total_units FROM EngineeringSubjects es JOIN DeptYearSubjectStats dys ON es.eng_dept_name = dys.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY es.DEPARTMENT_NAME, es.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each subject offered in the Fall term of 2022, show the subject title, department name, term code, academic year, and the average academic year within each academic year group ordered by term start date, along with the department code, subject code, subject number, total units, and the row number within each department ordered by subject code for subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with total units equal to 12, where the department code matches between the two sets. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Sub1 AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.TERM_CODE, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY a.TERM_START_DATE) AS avg_academic_year, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON ata.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON a.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE WHERE a.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ), Sub2 AS ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.avg_academic_year, s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s2.TOTAL_UNITS, s2.window_column FROM Sub1 s1 JOIN Sub2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE

question: For subjects offered in the academic term with term code '2006FA', show the subject title, department name, total units, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title, and the variance of the total units of subjects offered by the same department in the 2022 academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subjects2006FA AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA' ), DepartmentUnitsVariance2022 AS ( SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.TOTAL_UNITS, s.window_column, d.total_units_variance FROM Subjects2006FA s JOIN DepartmentUnitsVariance2022 d ON s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year, the academic year description, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the record counts of TIP materials associated with that academic year (considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the TIP material status key is not 'NM'), the variance of the maximum enrollment for IAP activities that are not cancelled and require advance sign-up, and the normalized variance ratio rounded (variance of TIP material record counts divided by variance of IAP activity maximum enrollment), listing the results in descending order of normalized variance ratio?
SQL: WITH TipMaterialStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), IapActivityStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR, tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, tms.record_count_variance, tms.record_count_stddev, ias.max_enrollment_variance, ROUND(tms.record_count_variance / NULLIF(ias.max_enrollment_variance, 0), 2) AS normalized_variance_ratio FROM TipMaterialStats tms JOIN IapActivityStats ias ON tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ias.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = ias.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY normalized_variance_ratio DESC;

question: For each subject code where the department is degree granting, show the subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, rank of the subject code within each school name group ordered by subject code, the number of subject codes for each department and subject code, and the minimum department budget code, ordered by school name and rank. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.subject_code_count, s2.min_dept_budget_code FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s1.SUBJECT_CODE = s2.SUBJECT_CODE ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, window_column;

question: For each subject code where the department is degree granting and the subject is scheduled in a building during the fall term, show the subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, the rank of the subject code within each school name group ordered by subject code, the building key, and the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for all subjects scheduled in rooms of that building during the fall term. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH SubjectCodes AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), BuildingStats AS ( SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ) SELECT sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SCHOOL_NAME, sc.window_column, bs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, bs.avg_total_units, bs.stddev_total_units FROM SubjectCodes sc JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON sc.SUBJECT_CODE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = cso.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON cso.MEET_PLACE = fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY JOIN BuildingStats bs ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = bs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE cso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y'

question: For each department, list the department name, the variance of the total units of subjects offered in the 2022 academic year, the average CIP program code, the range of CIP program codes, and the variance of CIP program codes for all courses offered by that department where the department is degree granting and the course level is undergraduate. Show the results ordered by the variance of total units in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptUnitsVariance AS ( SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), DeptCIPStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_code, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cip_code_range DESC ) SELECT u.DEPARTMENT_NAME, u.total_units_variance, s.avg_cip_code, s.cip_code_range, s.cip_code_variance FROM DeptUnitsVariance u JOIN DeptCIPStats s ON u.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY u.total_units_variance DESC

question: List, for all organizations, the organization name, department name, department code, department long name, department level, the average organization number in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the organization parent, and the geometric mean of the areas of rooms assigned to that department (considering only rooms with area greater than zero), along with the reason for inclusion ('Window' for the windowed average and 'GeometricMean' for the geometric mean), showing the columns in the following order: organization name, department name, department code, department long name, department level, windowed average organization number, geometric mean area, and reason. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH OrgWindow AS ( SELECT t2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, AVG(t2.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) OVER ( PARTITION BY t2.ORG_PARENT ORDER BY t2.ORGANIZATION_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t2.FCLT_MAJOR_ORG_KEY = 230 ), DeptGeomMean AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(r.AREA))) AS geometric_mean_area, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 0 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY geometric_mean_area DESC ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT ow.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ow.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ow.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, ow.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, ow.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, ow.window_column, NULL AS geometric_mean_area, 'Window' AS Reason FROM OrgWindow ow UNION ALL SELECT dg.ORGANIZATION_NAME, NULL AS HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, NULL AS HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, NULL AS HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, NULL AS window_column, dg.geometric_mean_area, 'GeometricMean' AS Reason FROM DeptGeomMean dg ) SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, window_column, geometric_mean_area, Reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY ORGANIZATION_NAME;

question: For subjects with at least 5 enrolled students that are offered by the library in the term with code '2014FA', show the subject ID, subject title, number of enrolled students, term code, material status key, ISBN, row number within each material status group ordered by subject ID, offering department name, term description, term start date, term end date, and the minimum number of enrolled students for each offering department, ordered by offering department name, material status key, and subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ISBN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_per_dept FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s1.ISBN, s1.window_column, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.TERM_START_DATE, s2.TERM_END_DATE, s2.min_enrolled_per_dept FROM Subq1 s1 JOIN Subq2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s1.SUBJECT_ID

question: For each organization with an organization level of 5, show the organization name, organization key, description, space unit, space unit key, the average organization key within each organization key group ordered by space unit key, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the access levels of rooms assigned to the space unit. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH OrgLevel5 AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.SPACE_UNIT, t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ), SpaceUnitVariation AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, STDDEV(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) / NULLIF(AVG(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD zr ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = zr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE HAVING AVG(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.DESCRIPTION, o.SPACE_UNIT, o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, o.window_column, s.coefficient_of_variation FROM OrgLevel5 o JOIN SpaceUnitVariation s ON o.SPACE_UNIT = s.SPACE_UNIT AND o.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE

question: For each academic year where the total number of materials recorded in TIP_DETAIL is greater than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean total number of materials per academic year, give the academic year, the academic year description, the average record count for TIP materials in that year, the range of record counts, the variance of record counts (considering only terms where the term status is not null and the TIP material status is not 'NM'), and the total number of materials recorded in TIP_DETAIL for that academic year. List the results ordered by the range of record counts in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH YearlyRecordStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_record_count, MAX(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) - MIN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_range, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS IS NOT NULL AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_range DESC ), HighTotalMaterialYears AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) > ( SELECT AVG(total_count) + STDDEV(total_count) FROM ( SELECT SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_count FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) sub ) ) SELECT y.ACADEMIC_YEAR, y.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, y.avg_record_count, y.record_count_range, y.record_count_variance, h.total_materials FROM YearlyRecordStats y JOIN HighTotalMaterialYears h ON y.ACADEMIC_YEAR = h.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY y.record_count_range DESC;

question: For each major use description and organization name where the room area is greater than 100 and the access level is 1, provide the number of rooms, the minimum floor number, the range of the space unit codes, and the variance of the space unit codes associated with the organization, listing the major use description, organization name, number of rooms, minimum floor number, code range, and code variance in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH RoomStats AS ( SELECT r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count, MIN(r.FLOOR) AS min_floor, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 100 AND r.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 GROUP BY r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ), OrgSpaceStats AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAX(SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) - MIN(SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS code_range, VARIANCE(SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS code_variance, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN SPACE_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = SPACE_UNIT.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) SELECT rs.MAJOR_USE_DESC, rs.ORGANIZATION_NAME, rs.room_count, rs.min_floor, os.code_range, os.code_variance FROM RoomStats rs JOIN OrgSpaceStats os ON rs.ORGANIZATION_NAME = os.ORGANIZATION_NAME AND rs.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = os.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY;

question: For each academic year, give the academic year, the academic year description, the average of the total units, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units, and the geometric mean of the total units for subjects offered in terms that are regular terms, where the geometric mean is computed only for subjects with total units greater than zero. Present the results ordered by academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH AvgStddevUnits AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ), GeometricMeanUnits AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC ) SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, a.avg_total_units, a.stddev_total_units, g.geometric_mean_total_units FROM AvgStddevUnits a JOIN GeometricMeanUnits g ON a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each subject offered in the same term as a TIP detail record with material status 'RQ', show the subject key, subject title, offer department name, TIP material key, and the rank of each record within each offer department name group ordered by subject key, along with the subject title, subject ID, offer department name, offer school name, term description, academic year, and the maximum number of enrolled students for each subject considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by subject key, where the subject, term, and offer department name match in both cases. List the columns in the following order: subject key, subject title, offer department name, TIP material key, rank, subject title (from the second subquery), subject ID, offer department name (from the second subquery), offer school name, term description, academic year, and the maximum number of enrolled students. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_KEY) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_enrolled_students, t1.TERM_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.IS_MASTER_SECTION = 'Y' AND t0.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_KEY, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s1.window_column, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE AS s2_SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS s2_OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.max_enrolled_students FROM Subq1 s1 JOIN Subq2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.TERM_CODE = s2.TERM_CODE AND s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_KEY;

question: For each academic year and department where the number of enrolled students in a subject is greater than 5 and the academic year has terms that are current or previous terms, what are the academic year, academic year description, variance of the record count of tip details for those terms, department name, number of unique subjects offered, and the minimum number of total units for those subjects? List the results ordered by academic year and department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH AcademicYearVariance AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC ), DepartmentSubjectStats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ayv.record_count_variance, dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.subject_count, dss.min_total_units FROM AcademicYearVariance ayv JOIN DepartmentSubjectStats dss ON ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For all subject offerings in the academic term with term code '2017FA', show the subject title, the offer department name, the term description, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title. For each of these, also provide the number of unique library subjects offered and the minimum total units for those subjects, considering only departments and course numbers where the number of enrolled students in the subject summary is greater than 2. Show the subject title, offer department name, term description, window column, subject count, and minimum total units in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH SubjectOfferings2017FA AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.COURSE_NUMBER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON s.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' ), DeptCourseLibraryStats AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.window_column, d.subject_count, d.min_total_units FROM SubjectOfferings2017FA s JOIN DeptCourseLibraryStats d ON s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND s.COURSE_NUMBER = d.COURSE_NUMBER ORDER BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For each academic year and department name where the term status is 'Previous', provide the academic year, department name, the number of unique subjects offered, the minimum total units for those subjects, and the variance of the reserve catalog keys for courses in that department where the material status is 'U'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptCatalogVariance AS ( SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, VARIANCE(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY lci.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY catalog_key_variance DESC ), YearDeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT yds.ACADEMIC_YEAR, yds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, yds.subject_count, yds.min_total_units, dcv.catalog_key_variance FROM YearDeptSubjectStats yds JOIN DeptCatalogVariance dcv ON yds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dcv.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY yds.ACADEMIC_YEAR, yds.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each subject with more than 0 enrolled students and a material status key of 'U', list the course number, course number description, number of enrolled students, the reserve catalog key, and the dense rank over the material status key ordered by material status key, along with the department name, the maximum total units of any course offered by that department (for departments where the maximum total units is greater than 6), and the name of the school that department belongs to. Present the results ordered by department name and course number. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH MaxUnitsDepartments AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ), EnrolledSubjects AS ( SELECT t1.COURSE_NUMBER, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ) SELECT e.COURSE_NUMBER, e.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, e.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, e.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, e.window_column, m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.max_total_units, m.SCHOOL_NAME FROM EnrolledSubjects e JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON e.COURSE_NUMBER = s.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN MaxUnitsDepartments m ON s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = m.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.COURSE_NUMBER;

question: For each department and academic year where the subject enrollment number is greater than 10, provide the department name, academic year, number of unique subjects, minimum total units offered, and the variance of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one enrolled student and have course materials with a material status of 'RQ', listing the results in order of descending subject count and then by descending enrolled variance. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), subq2 AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.subject_count, s1.min_total_units, s2.enrolled_variance FROM subq1 s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY s1.subject_count DESC, s2.enrolled_variance DESC

question: For subjects offered in the term '2022FA' with a total of 12 units, show the subject title from the summary, the department name from the course description, the dense rank of each subject considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the subject code from the course catalog, and for each subject's department, also show the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for courses offered by that department. List the subject title, department name, window column, total units range, total units variance, and total units standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH SubjectsWithWindow AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), DepartmentUnitStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT sww.SUBJECT_TITLE, sww.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sww.window_column, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev FROM SubjectsWithWindow sww JOIN DepartmentUnitStats dus ON sww.DEPARTMENT = dus.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY sww.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sww.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For each department where the maximum total units of any course offered by that department is greater than 6, and for each course in that department that has more than 0 enrolled students and a material status key of 'U', provide the department name, the maximum total units, the school name, the course number, the course number description, the number of enrolled students, the reserve catalog key, and the dense rank over the material status key ordered by material status key. Do not return any rounded answers.
