SQL: WITH MaxUnitsPerDept AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ), EnrolledSubjects AS ( SELECT t1.COURSE_NUMBER, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ) SELECT mu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mu.max_total_units, mu.SCHOOL_NAME, es.COURSE_NUMBER, es.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, es.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, es.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, es.window_column FROM MaxUnitsPerDept mu JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON mu.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN EnrolledSubjects es ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = es.COURSE_NUMBER

question: List the top 10 subject titles by the number of reserve materials assigned, including the department name and the term code, and for each of these, provide the average and variance of the department's subject codes' course numbers (using their ASCII values), considering only departments that are degree granting. Show the subject title, department name, term code, number of reserve materials, average course number ASCII value, and variance of course number ASCII value, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH TopSubjects AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_reserve_materials FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE ORDER BY num_reserve_materials DESC LIMIT 10 ), DegreeGrantingDeptStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VARIANCE(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY var_course_number_ascii DESC ) SELECT ts.SUBJECT_TITLE, ts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ts.TERM_CODE, ts.num_reserve_materials, dds.avg_course_number_ascii, dds.var_course_number_ascii FROM TopSubjects ts JOIN DegreeGrantingDeptStats dds ON ts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dds.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ts.num_reserve_materials DESC, ts.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each department and academic year where the subject enrollment number is greater than 10, provide the department name, academic year, number of unique subjects, minimum total units offered, and the variance of the number of enrolled students in courses with at least one enrolled student and course materials with a material status of 'RQ'. Also, for each department that has the variance of enrolled students in such courses but does not appear in the first group, include the department name and the variance, with academic year, number of unique subjects, and minimum total units as null. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), DeptEnrolledVariance AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC ), CombinedDeptStats AS ( SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dss.subject_count, dss.min_total_units, dev.enrolled_variance FROM DeptSubjectStats dss LEFT JOIN DeptEnrolledVariance dev ON dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dev.OFFER_DEPT_NAME UNION ALL SELECT dev.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS subject_count, NULL AS min_total_units, dev.enrolled_variance FROM DeptEnrolledVariance dev LEFT JOIN DeptSubjectStats dss ON dev.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR, subject_count, min_total_units, enrolled_variance FROM CombinedDeptStats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For academic terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the term parameter is 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM', and for each department in those academic years where the subject enrollment number is greater than 10, show the academic terms key, the term description, the academic year description, the term start date, the term end date, the minimum academic year in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the term code, the department name, the number of unique subjects, and the minimum total units offered, ordered by academic terms key and department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH PreviousTerms AS ( SELECT t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t0.TERM_START_DATE, t0.TERM_END_DATE, t0.TERM_CODE, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MIN(t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TERM_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND t1.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM' ), DeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT p.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY, p.TERM_DESCRIPTION, p.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, p.TERM_START_DATE, p.TERM_END_DATE, p.window_column, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.subject_count, d.min_total_units FROM PreviousTerms p JOIN DeptSubjectStats d ON p.ACADEMIC_YEAR = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY p.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For IAP subject activities in the term "2021JA" that are not cancelled and have a maximum enrollment of 30, show the activity title, enrollment type, calendar date, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by activity title, and the dense rank of each activity considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the academic year from the academic terms table, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.CALENDAR_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN TIME_DAY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 30 ) SELECT s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, s1.CALENDAR_DATE, s1.window_column AS row_number_window, s2.window_column AS dense_rank_window FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE = s2.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND s1.TERM_CODE = s2.TERM_CODE;

question: For rooms with an area greater than 300 and located in buildings with more than 100 rooms, show the building's long name, the room's full name, the room's area, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the building's long name, along with the name of the space unit, the associated organization name, and both the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the organization numbers for all organizations linked to that space unit (considering only space units with a non-null DLC key and organizations with assignable status), where the room and the space unit share the same organization key. List the columns in the following order: building's long name, room's full name, room's area, window row number, space unit name, organization name, organization number variance, and organization number standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH rooms_windowed AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, t0.ROOM_FULL_NAME, t0.AREA, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.BUILDING_NAME_LONG ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ROOMS t0 JOIN FCLT_BUILDING t1 ON t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE t0.AREA > 300 AND t1.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 100 ), space_unit_org_stats AS ( SELECT s.SPACE_UNIT, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, VARIANCE(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance, STDDEV(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT s ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = s.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE s.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 GROUP BY s.SPACE_UNIT, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY org_number_variance DESC ) SELECT rw.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, rw.ROOM_FULL_NAME, rw.AREA, rw.window_column, suos.SPACE_UNIT, suos.ORGANIZATION_NAME, suos.org_number_variance, suos.org_number_stddev FROM rooms_windowed rw JOIN space_unit_org_stats suos ON rw.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = suos.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY

question: For courses in the School of Engineering that are degree granting, show the course description, department name, the dense rank of each course considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the department's budget code, the average of the ASCII values of the department's subject codes' course numbers, and the variance of the ASCII values of the department's subject codes' course numbers. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH EngineeringCourses AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), DepartmentStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VARIANCE(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY var_course_number_ascii DESC ) SELECT ec.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ec.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ec.window_column, ds.avg_course_number_ascii, ds.var_course_number_ascii FROM EngineeringCourses ec JOIN DepartmentStats ds ON ec.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: For all subjects in the 2014FA term with at least one enrolled student, show the subject title, offering department name, responsible faculty name, the TIP material status key, the total number of units, and the minimum total number of units in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the course number. Additionally, for the offering department, show the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year that are degree granting. The columns should be: subject title, offering department name, responsible faculty name, TIP material status key, total number of units, windowed minimum total units, average total units for the department, range of total units for the department, and variance of total units for the department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ), SubjectWindowStats AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_dept_name FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s.TOTAL_UNITS, s.window_column, d.avg_total_units, d.total_units_range, d.total_units_variance FROM SubjectWindowStats s LEFT JOIN DeptUnitsStats d ON s.join_dept_name = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2022 with a total of 12 units, in departments in the School of Engineering where the total number of students enrolled in courses offered by that department is greater than 50, show the subject code, subject number, department name, subject title, term description, total units, the average subject enrollment number in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by department code and ordered by total units, and the total number of students enrolled in courses offered by that department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH SubjectStats AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) OVER ( PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), DepartmentEnrollment AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ) SELECT ss.SUBJECT_CODE, ss.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ss.TOTAL_UNITS, ss.window_column, de.total_enrollment FROM SubjectStats ss JOIN DepartmentEnrollment de ON ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = de.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE = de.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.SUBJECT_CODE, ss.SUBJECT_NUMBER

question: For each academic term with status 'Previous' where the term start date is the minimum start date of the term for a department and academic year in which the number of enrolled students in the library subject offered is greater than 3, show the term code, term description, term start date, calendar date, day of week, the average calendar year within each calendar year group ordered by term start date, the department name, the academic year, the number of unique subjects offered, and the minimum start date of the term, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH PreviousTerms AS ( SELECT t1.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t0.CALENDAR_DATE, t0.DAY_OF_WEEK, AVG(t0.CALENDAR_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.CALENDAR_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_START_DATE) AS window_column FROM TIME_DAY t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.CALENDAR_DATE = t1.TERM_START_DATE WHERE t1.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ), DeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT so.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(at.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON at.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT pt.TERM_CODE, pt.TERM_DESCRIPTION, pt.TERM_START_DATE, pt.CALENDAR_DATE, pt.DAY_OF_WEEK, pt.window_column, dss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dss.subject_count, dss.min_term_start_date FROM PreviousTerms pt JOIN DeptSubjectStats dss ON pt.TERM_START_DATE = dss.min_term_start_date ORDER BY pt.TERM_START_DATE;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2012 with a cluster type of 'SWE: School-Wide Electives', show the subject key, subject title, academic year, and the running sum of the number of enrolled students within each department, along with the academic year description, the range, and the variance of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during terms in that year (considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the number of enrolled students is greater than 0), ordered by subject key. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, SUM(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_KEY) AS running_enrollment_sum FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 AND t1.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC = 'SWE: School-Wide Electives' ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_KEY, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.running_enrollment_sum, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.enrolled_range, s2.enrolled_variance FROM Subq1 s1 JOIN Subq2 s2 ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_KEY;

question: For each offering department and school where the course material status is 'RQ', provide the number of unique subjects and the minimum total units for those subjects, along with the subject title from the library, the number of enrolled students in the library subject, the responsible faculty name from the TIP subject, the offer department name from the TIP subject, and the minimum number of enrolled students in the library subject within a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the TIP subject's responsible faculty MIT ID, for subjects offered in the term '2014FA'. The results should include the offering department name, offering school name, subject count, minimum total units, subject title, number of enrolled students, responsible faculty name, offer department name from the library subject, and the windowed minimum number of enrolled students, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( ORDER BY t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' ) SELECT s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s1.subject_count, s1.min_total_units, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS LIB_OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.window_column FROM Subq1 s1 JOIN Subq2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME

question: For each academic term where the term status indicator is 'P', show the term code, the term parameter, the term description, the academic year, the term start date, and the average academic year in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the term indicator and ordered by the term start date. Additionally, for the academic year of each such term, give the academic year description, the average total units, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in regular terms, with the results ordered by term code and by the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH AcademicYearStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ), PreviousTerms AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_PARAMETER, t2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, AVG(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER ( PARTITION BY t1.TERM_INDICATOR ORDER BY t0.TERM_START_DATE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_INDICATOR = 'P' ) SELECT pts.TERM_CODE, pts.TERM_PARAMETER, pts.TERM_DESCRIPTION, pts.ACADEMIC_YEAR, pts.TERM_START_DATE, pts.window_column, ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ays.avg_total_units, ays.stddev_total_units FROM PreviousTerms pts JOIN AcademicYearStats ays ON pts.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY pts.TERM_CODE, ays.stddev_total_units DESC;

question: For subjects offered in the term with code '2022FA' that are also courses offered in the year 2022 with at least one required or optional textbook, show the subject ID, department name, term description, the running sum of total units within each academic year, the course's subject code, subject number, subject title, the textbook material key, the textbook material status key, and the row number within each department ordered by subject code, ordered by subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IN ('RQ', 'EO') ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.window_column AS running_sum_total_units, s2.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2.window_column AS row_number_within_department FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For rooms with an access level of 1 that are also in building E38, show the building-room identifier, the area, the major use description, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the major use description (for access level 1 rooms), the floor number, the major use description (from E38), the organization name, the office location, the full name of the employee, the department name, and the average area of rooms in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by department number and ordered by floor. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.AREA, t0.DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.DESCRIPTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM FCLT_MAJOR_USE t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.FLOOR, t0.MAJOR_USE_DESC, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.OFFICE_LOCATION, t1.FULL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(t0.AREA) OVER ( PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER ORDER BY t0.FLOOR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ROOMS t0 JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY t1 ON t0.BUILDING_ROOM = t1.OFFICE_LOCATION WHERE t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = 'E38' ) SELECT s1.BUILDING_ROOM, s1.AREA, s1.DESCRIPTION, s1.window_column AS access_level_window_row_number, s2.FLOOR, s2.MAJOR_USE_DESC, s2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s2.OFFICE_LOCATION, s2.FULL_NAME, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.window_column AS avg_area_window FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.BUILDING_ROOM = s2.BUILDING_ROOM ORDER BY s1.BUILDING_ROOM, s2.FLOOR;

question: For each academic year, list the academic year, the academic year description, the variance of the total units for subjects offered in terms that are not the current term and have more than 0 total units, and the variance of the record count of tip details for terms that are current or previous terms. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH AcademicYearUnitsVariance AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON atp.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), AcademicYearTipRecordVariance AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC ) SELECT ayuv.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ayuv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ayuv.total_units_variance, aytrv.record_count_variance FROM AcademicYearUnitsVariance ayuv JOIN AcademicYearTipRecordVariance aytrv ON ayuv.ACADEMIC_YEAR = aytrv.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND ayuv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = aytrv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ayuv.total_units_variance DESC, aytrv.record_count_variance DESC;

question: For each department name and course level where the course is degree granting and the total units are greater than 6, provide the number of unique courses, the minimum total units offered, the range of total units, the variance of total units, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for courses offered by that department. The results should include the department name, course level, number of unique courses, minimum total units, total units range, total units variance, and total units standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Sub1 AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL ), Sub2 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.COURSE_LEVEL, s1.course_count, s1.min_total_units, s2.total_units_range, s2.total_units_variance, s2.total_units_stddev FROM Sub1 s1 JOIN Sub2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.COURSE_LEVEL

question: For each department that grants degrees and offers subjects with more than 0 total units, what are the department name, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department, and the total number of tip materials offered for subjects in the School of Engineering during regular terms where the total number of tip materials is greater than 10? List the department name, average total units, total units variance, total units standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and total tip materials in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH dept_units_stats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), eng_tip_materials AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL t JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) > 10 ) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev, etm.total_tip_materials FROM dept_units_stats dus JOIN eng_tip_materials etm ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = etm.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department where the department had library reserve materials in terms with a term status of 'Previous' and also offered courses in the term '2019FA' that are offered by both the library and the TIP system with more than 10 enrolled students, give the department name, the average of the total units, the variance of the total units, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units, and the total number of enrolled students, in that order, ordered by the variance of the total units in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DepartmentUnitsStats AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), DepartmentEnrolledStats AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10 ) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev, des.total_enrolled FROM DepartmentUnitsStats dus JOIN DepartmentEnrolledStats des ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY dus.total_units_variance DESC

question: List the subject title, subject key, offer department name, subject enrollment number, subject offered summary key, and the average subject enrollment number within each subject key group (ordered by offer department name) for subjects offered in the term "2012SU" by the top 10 Harvard Cross-Enrollment Program departments (by number of subjects offered) that also had at least one subject offered in the same term in the TIP subject offerings. Order the results by offer department name and subject key. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH HarvardCrossEnrollmentDepts AS ( SELECT so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS num_subjects FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON so.TERM_CODE = tso.TERM_CODE WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' GROUP BY so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY num_subjects DESC LIMIT 10 ), Subjects2012SU AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.SUBJECT_KEY, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY, AVG(t0.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SUBJECT_KEY ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.SUBJECT_KEY, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY, s.window_column FROM Subjects2012SU s WHERE s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME FROM HarvardCrossEnrollmentDepts) ORDER BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_KEY;

question: For each administrative department and each subject offered by that department in the term '2019FA' with more than 0 enrolled students, give the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the office phone numbers of students in that department (considering only students who have a non-null office phone number), the subject title, offer department name, department full name, number of enrolled students, and the average number of enrolled students in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the school code, ordered by the department name and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptPhoneStats AS ( SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.OFFICE_PHONE) AS avg_office_phone, STDDEV(MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.OFFICE_PHONE) AS stddev_office_phone, SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY ON SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.DEPARTMENT WHERE MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.OFFICE_PHONE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY stddev_office_phone DESC ), SubjectEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT dps.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dps.avg_office_phone, dps.stddev_office_phone, ses.SUBJECT_TITLE, ses.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ses.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ses.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ses.window_column FROM DeptPhoneStats dps JOIN SubjectEnrollmentStats ses ON dps.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = ses.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY dps.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ses.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each material status, publisher, and department in the same academic term where the new shelf price is greater than 50 and the term is a regular academic term, provide the number of materials, the minimum used shelf price, the department name, the average total units, the range of total units, and the variance of total units for subjects offered in that department and term. The results should include TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, PUBLISHER, material_count, min_used_price, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, total_units_range, and total_units_variance, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH MaterialStats AS ( SELECT d.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, m.PUBLISHER, COUNT(m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count, MIN(m.USED_SHELF_PRICE) AS min_used_price, d.TERM_CODE FROM TIP_DETAIL d JOIN TIP_MATERIAL m ON d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE > 50 GROUP BY d.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, m.PUBLISHER, d.TERM_CODE ), DepartmentUnits AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, c.TERM_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.TERM_CODE ) SELECT ms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ms.PUBLISHER, ms.material_count, ms.min_used_price, du.DEPARTMENT_NAME, du.avg_total_units, du.total_units_range, du.total_units_variance FROM MaterialStats ms JOIN DepartmentUnits du ON ms.TERM_CODE = du.TERM_CODE;

question: For each department where the range of total units of courses offered this year (with non-null total units) is greater than 0 and the variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only departments that grant degrees and subjects with a non-null subject code description) is not null, give the department name, the range of total units, the variance of total units, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, the variance of enrolled students, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrolled students, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DepartmentTotalUnitsStats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccc.total_units) - MIN(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccc.total_units IS NOT NULL GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DepartmentEnrolledStudentsStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dtu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dtu.total_units_range, dtu.total_units_variance, dtu.total_units_stddev, des.enrolled_students_variance, des.enrolled_students_stddev FROM DepartmentTotalUnitsStats dtu JOIN DepartmentEnrolledStudentsStats des ON dtu.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE dtu.total_units_range > 0 AND des.enrolled_students_variance IS NOT NULL ORDER BY dtu.total_units_range DESC;

question: For each academic year and department, list the academic year, department name, average total units for subjects offered in regular terms, variance of total units, academic year description, geometric mean of the record counts of required course materials (where the record count is greater than zero) for all subjects offered in that year, and calculate the average total units divided by the geometric mean of required course material record counts rounded to two decimal places, ordered by this ratio in descending order.
SQL: WITH AvgVarUnits AS ( SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY var_total_units DESC ), GeomMeanMaterials AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_record_count DESC ) SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.avg_total_units, a.var_total_units, g.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, g.geometric_mean_record_count, ROUND(a.avg_total_units / NULLIF(g.geometric_mean_record_count, 0), 2) AS avg_units_per_geom_material FROM AvgVarUnits a JOIN GeomMeanMaterials g ON a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY avg_units_per_geom_material DESC;

question: For each of the top 10 department names in the Provost Area (by number of faculty organizations), list the department name, the number of faculty organizations, the organization and its associated space unit (where the organization is assignable and the space unit code is greater than 50000), the number of space units, and the minimum organization number, ordered by the number of faculty organizations and then by the number of space units. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH OrgSpaceUnits AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION, s.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS space_unit_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_org_number, o.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION o JOIN SPACE_UNIT s ON o.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE > 50000 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION, s.SPACE_UNIT, o.DLC_KEY ), TopProvostDepts AS ( SELECT m.DLC_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, m.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME, m.DLC_KEY ORDER BY org_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT tpd.DLC_NAME, tpd.org_count, osu.ORGANIZATION, osu.SPACE_UNIT, osu.space_unit_count, osu.min_org_number FROM TopProvostDepts tpd JOIN OrgSpaceUnits osu ON tpd.DLC_KEY = osu.DLC_KEY ORDER BY tpd.org_count DESC, osu.space_unit_count DESC;

question: For each degree-granting course in the School of Engineering, show the course description, department name, subject code description, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by course description, along with the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2022. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DepartmentUnitsStats AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC ), EngineeringDegreeCourses AS ( SELECT t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT edc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, edc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, edc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, edc.window_column, dus.units_range, dus.units_variance FROM EngineeringDegreeCourses edc JOIN DepartmentUnitsStats dus ON edc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each space unit that has rooms on floor 2 and a space unit key greater than 100000, what is the name of the space unit, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the access levels of its associated rooms on floor 2, the organization name, the HR department name, and the sum of space unit keys within each warehouse load date group, ordered by space unit key? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH space_unit_access_stats AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, VARIANCE(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_variance, STDDEV(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_stddev FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD zr ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = zr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE zr.FLOOR = 2 GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ORDER BY access_level_variance DESC ), space_unit_org_window AS ( SELECT t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE ORDER BY t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM SPACE_UNIT t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000 ) SELECT s1.SPACE_UNIT, s1.access_level_variance, s1.access_level_stddev, s2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.window_column FROM space_unit_access_stats s1 JOIN space_unit_org_window s2 ON s1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = s2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE;

question: For organizations with a major organization key of 230 and space units with a warehouse load date of '19-DEC-24' and HR org units with a warehouse load date of '03-DEC-24', show the organization name, department name, department code, department long name, department level, the average organization number in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the organization parent and ordered by the organization name, the space unit name, and the average, range, and variance of the HR department codes for the HR org units linked to that space unit, ordered by organization name and space unit. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH OrgStats AS ( SELECT t2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, AVG(t2.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) OVER ( PARTITION BY t2.ORG_PARENT ORDER BY t2.ORGANIZATION_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t2.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t2.FCLT_MAJOR_ORG_KEY = 230 ), SpaceUnitStats AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS avg_hr_dept_code, MAX(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) - MIN(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS hr_dept_code_range, VARIANCE(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS hr_dept_code_variance, fo.DLC_KEY FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE su.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND hou.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '03-DEC-24' GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fo.DLC_KEY ORDER BY hr_dept_code_range DESC ) SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, o.window_column, s.SPACE_UNIT, s.avg_hr_dept_code, s.hr_dept_code_range, s.hr_dept_code_variance FROM OrgStats o JOIN SpaceUnitStats s ON o.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY ORDER BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s.SPACE_UNIT

question: For each department, provide the department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students per subject offered by that department in the term 2019FA, as well as the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects that had library reserve materials in terms with a term status of 'Previous'. The columns should be: department name, enrolled student range, enrolled student variance, enrolled student standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), average total units, total units variance, and total units standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH enrolled_stats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC ), units_stats AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.enrolled_range, e.enrolled_variance, e.enrolled_stddev, u.avg_total_units, u.total_units_variance, u.total_units_stddev FROM enrolled_stats e LEFT JOIN units_stats u ON e.DEPARTMENT_NAME = u.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY e.enrolled_range DESC;

question: For each department and cluster type where the total units for the subject are greater than 6, show the department name, cluster type, the number of subjects, the minimum number of enrolled students, the average total units for subjects offered in the 2012SU term in that department, and the variance of total units for those subjects, ordering the results by the number of subjects in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptClusterStats AS ( SELECT so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sos.CLUSTER_TYPE, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON so.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY = sos.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sos.CLUSTER_TYPE ), DeptUnitStats AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_variance DESC ) SELECT dcs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dcs.CLUSTER_TYPE, dcs.subject_count, dcs.min_enrolled_students, dus.avg_units, dus.units_variance FROM DeptClusterStats dcs JOIN DeptUnitStats dus ON dcs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dcs.subject_count DESC;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year, academic year description, the geometric mean of the number of library reserve material details per subject offered (considering only records where the material status is 'U' and the academic term is a regular term), the average of the total units, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects that are offered in the fall term and have a material status of 'U' in the library reserve? Present the results ordered by the geometric mean of materials per subject in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH GeometricMeanMaterialsPerSubject AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(material_count))) AS geometric_mean_materials_per_subject FROM ( SELECT LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count, LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE ) sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON sub.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), AvgStddevTotalUnitsFallU AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT gmmps.ACADEMIC_YEAR, gmmps.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gmmps.geometric_mean_materials_per_subject, astu.avg_total_units, astu.stddev_total_units FROM GeometricMeanMaterialsPerSubject gmmps LEFT JOIN AvgStddevTotalUnitsFallU astu ON gmmps.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = astu.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY gmmps.geometric_mean_materials_per_subject DESC;

question: List all subjects with at least 5 enrolled students, showing the subject ID, subject title, number of enrolled students, term code, material status key, ISBN, and the row number within each material status group ordered by subject ID, as well as all IAP subject activities with a maximum enrollment of 12, showing the subject ID, activity title, enrollment type, term description, and the rank of each record within each term description group ordered by activity title. Indicate the source of each record as either 'LibrarySubject' or 'IAPActivity'. The columns should be: subject ID, subject title, number of enrolled students, term code, material status key, ISBN, window column, activity title, enrollment type, term description, and source. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ISBN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_ID, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 12 ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s1.ISBN, s1.window_column, NULL AS ACTIVITY_TITLE, NULL AS ENROLLMENT_TYPE, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, 'LibrarySubject' AS Source FROM Subquery1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.SUBJECT_ID, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, NULL AS TERM_CODE, NULL AS TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, NULL AS ISBN, s2.window_column, s2.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s2.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, 'IAPActivity' AS Source FROM Subquery2 s2 ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY SUBJECT_ID, Source;

question: For the top 10 academic years by the number of unique course materials assigned (for terms that are not current and where the course material status is 'RQ'), display each academic year description, the total count of unique materials, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of reserved library materials per academic term in that year (considering only terms with a regular status), in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH material_stats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(term_material_count) - MIN(term_material_count) AS material_count_range, VARIANCE(term_material_count) AS material_count_variance, STDDEV(term_material_count) AS material_count_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN ( SELECT LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE, COUNT(*) AS term_material_count FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL GROUP BY LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE ) AS term_stats ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = term_stats.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY material_count_range DESC ), unique_materials_stats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS unique_materials FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY unique_materials DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT um.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, um.unique_materials, ms.material_count_range, ms.material_count_variance, ms.material_count_stddev FROM unique_materials_stats um LEFT JOIN material_stats ms ON um.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = ms.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY um.unique_materials DESC

question: For each department and academic year where the number of enrolled students in a subject is greater than 5, list the department name, academic year, academic year description, the number of unique subjects offered, the minimum number of total units for those subjects, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in library subjects for that year (considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the number of enrolled students in the library subject is greater than 0), and calculate the normalized subject count rounded (the number of unique subjects divided by the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrolled students in library subjects for that year). Order the results by normalized subject count in descending order.
SQL: WITH AcademicYearStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), DepartmentYearStats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, d.subject_count, d.min_total_units, a.enrolled_students_variance, a.enrolled_students_stddev, ROUND(d.subject_count / NULLIF(a.enrolled_students_stddev, 0), 2) AS normalized_subject_count FROM DepartmentYearStats d JOIN AcademicYearStats a ON d.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY normalized_subject_count DESC;

question: For IAP subject activities with a maximum enrollment of at least 10 and that are not cancelled, and for those that are also not cancelled and have a maximum enrollment greater than 10, show the activity title, enrollment type, the academic term description, the subject title from the course catalog, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by activity title, the maximum enrollment, the academic term description from the time day table, the term start date from the academic terms table, and the minimum maximum enrollment value over each term code group, ordered by activity title and term code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 10 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TERM_START_DATE, min(t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.TERM_CODE ORDER BY t0.TERM_CODE) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN TIME_DAY t1 ON t1.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE = t0.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 ) SELECT s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.window_column AS s1_window_column, s2.MAX_ENROLLMENT, s2.ACADEMIC_TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.TERM_START_DATE, s2.window_column AS s2_window_column FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE = s2.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND s1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = s2.ENROLLMENT_TYPE AND s1.TERM_CODE = s2.TERM_CODE ORDER BY s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s2.TERM_CODE;

question: For each subject offered in the term with code '2025FA', show the offering department name, the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2022, the subject ID, subject title, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, term start date, term end date, term parameter, and the minimum number of enrolled students over each offering department, ordered by offering department and subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DepartmentUnitsStats AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC ), TermSubjectOfferings AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dus.units_range, dus.units_variance, tso.SUBJECT_ID, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, tso.TERM_DESCRIPTION, tso.ACADEMIC_YEAR, tso.TERM_START_DATE, tso.TERM_END_DATE, tso.TERM_PARAMETER, tso.min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM TermSubjectOfferings tso JOIN DepartmentUnitsStats dus ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For subjects offered in the term with code '2025FA' that are also offered by departments in the School of Engineering, show the subject ID, subject title, offering department name, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, term start date, term end date, term parameter, the minimum number of enrolled students over each offering department, total units, department full name, and the row number assigned within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH term_2025fa_subjects AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), engineering_subjects_window AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.SUBJECT_ID FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ) SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t1.TERM_PARAMETER, t1.min_enrolled_students_per_dept, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, t2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.window_column FROM term_2025fa_subjects t1 JOIN engineering_subjects_window t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID

question: For each department, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects that had library reserve materials in terms with a term status of 'Previous', as well as the range and variance of the reserve catalog keys for courses in that department? Please provide the department name, average total units, total units variance, total units standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), catalog key range, and catalog key variance, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), DeptCatalogKeyStats AS ( SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, MAX(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) - MIN(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_range, VARIANCE(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY GROUP BY lci.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY catalog_key_range DESC ) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev, dcks.catalog_key_range, dcks.catalog_key_variance FROM DeptUnitsStats dus JOIN DeptCatalogKeyStats dcks ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dcks.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For subjects in the "Engineering" school with total units equal to 1, show the subject ID, subject title, department name, academic year, the rank of each subject within its academic year group ordered by subject ID, and the variance of the total units for subjects offered by the same department in the 2012SU term, ordering the results by the department's total units variance (descending), academic year, and subject rank. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH dept_variance AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON tso.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), eng_subjects AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 1 ) SELECT es.SUBJECT_ID, es.SUBJECT_TITLE, es.DEPARTMENT_NAME, es.ACADEMIC_YEAR, es.window_column, dv.total_units_variance FROM eng_subjects es LEFT JOIN dept_variance dv ON es.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dv.total_units_variance DESC, es.ACADEMIC_YEAR, es.window_column;

question: For each department that is a degree-granting department and also an Engineering department with more than 50 total enrolled students in its offered courses, what is the department name, the average number of enrolled students in offered subjects (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students), the variance of the number of enrolled students, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students, and the total number of students enrolled in courses offered by that department in the School of Engineering? List the results ordered by the variance of the number of enrolled students in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC ), EngineeringDeptTotals AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ) SELECT dts.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dts.avg_enrollment, dts.enrollment_variance, dts.enrollment_stddev, edt.total_enrollment FROM DeptEnrollmentStats dts JOIN EngineeringDeptTotals edt ON dts.DEPARTMENT_NAME = edt.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dts.enrollment_variance DESC;

question: List, for all rooms with an area greater than 300, the building-room identifier, floor number, major use description, organization name, DLC key, and the average area in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by department code and ordered by area, and for each department in the "Provost Area", the department code, department name, school area name, DLC key, and the rank of each department within its school area based on department code. The results are combined and ordered by DLC key, with columns in the following order: building-room identifier, floor number, major use description, organization name, DLC key, window average area, department code, department name, school area name, and department rank. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH RoomStats AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.MAJOR_USE_DESC, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, AVG(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t1.AREA ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_avg_area FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 300 ), ProvostDepts AS ( SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 INNER JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.FLOOR, r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.DLC_KEY, r.window_avg_area, NULL AS HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, NULL AS HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, NULL AS window_column FROM RoomStats r UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS BUILDING_ROOM, NULL AS FLOOR, NULL AS MAJOR_USE_DESC, NULL AS ORGANIZATION_NAME, p.DLC_KEY, NULL AS window_avg_area, p.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, p.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, p.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, p.window_column FROM ProvostDepts p ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DLC_KEY;

question: For subjects offered in the term '2019FA' with more than 0 enrolled students, show the subject title, offer department name, department full name, number of enrolled students, and the average number of enrolled students in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the school code, along with the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses from the same department that have at least one associated course material, ordered by the subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS dept_name_key FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_stddev DESC ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.window_column, s2.avg_enrollment, s2.enrollment_stddev FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.dept_name_key = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For IAP subject activities with a maximum enrollment of at least 10 and that are not cancelled, show the activity title, enrollment type, the academic term description, and the subject title from the course catalog, along with the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by activity title, and also show the dense rank of each activity (if available) considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the academic year of the associated term for activities with a maximum enrollment of at least 20. The columns should be: activity title, enrollment type, academic term description, subject title, activity row number, and activity dense rank. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH iap_activities_windowed AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 10 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' ), iap_activities_dense_ranked AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20 ) SELECT iaw.ACTIVITY_TITLE, iaw.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, iaw.TERM_DESCRIPTION, iaw.SUBJECT_TITLE, iaw.window_column AS activity_row_number, iadr.window_column AS activity_dense_rank FROM iap_activities_windowed iaw LEFT JOIN iap_activities_dense_ranked iadr ON iaw.ACTIVITY_TITLE = iadr.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND iaw.TERM_CODE = iadr.TERM_CODE

question: List, for each department among the top 10 by number of subjects offered (where subjects are not repeatable for credit and are offered in the fall term), the subject ID, subject title, department name, sum of lecture units within each grade type group, academic year, and subject count for each subject offered in the academic term with term code '2006FA', as well as the department name, academic year, and subject count for those top departments and years even if there is no matching subject in '2006FA'. Indicate the source of each row as either 'SubjectInfo' (for subject details) or 'TopDeptYear' (for department-year summary). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.LECTURE_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.GRADE_RULE_DESC = 'Not repeatable for credit' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.subject_count, 'SubjectInfo' AS Source FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_ID, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS window_column, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.subject_count, 'TopDeptYear' AS Source FROM Subquery2 s2 ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUBJECT_ID

question: For subjects in the Engineering school during the Fall Term 2024-2025, show the subject title, department name, total units, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title. For each subject, also show the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in courses offered by the same department, considering only courses that have at least one associated TIP material and where the total units for the course are greater than 0. Present the results ordered by enrollment variance (descending) and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
