List the results ordered by department name and academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH AcademicYearVariance AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC ), DepartmentSubjectStats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, dss.subject_count, dss.min_total_units, ayv.record_count_variance FROM DepartmentSubjectStats dss JOIN AcademicYearVariance ayv ON dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each department that is degree-granting and offered at least one subject in the School of Engineering in 2021, provide the department code, department name, department full name, the number of subjects offered, the total number of enrolled students in those subjects, the average number of unique subject codes associated with its courses that are offered by degree-granting departments, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of unique subject codes associated with its courses that are offered by degree-granting departments. List the results ordered by the number of subjects offered in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptEng2021 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ), DeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes FROM ( SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT ) course_subjects JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON course_subjects.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_subject_codes DESC ) SELECT de.DEPARTMENT_CODE, de.DEPARTMENT_NAME, de.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, de.subject_count, de.total_enrollment, ds.avg_subject_codes, ds.stddev_subject_codes FROM DeptEng2021 de JOIN DeptSubjectStats ds ON de.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY de.subject_count DESC;

question: For each of the top 10 department names and their corresponding academic years by the number of subjects offered (including only subjects that are not repeatable for credit and are offered in the fall term), list the department name, academic year, number of subjects offered, the average and variance of the total units for its courses that have a non-null subject title and total units greater than 0, and calculate the normalized subjects per unit rounded (number of subjects divided by average units in that department and year). Present the results ordered by normalized subjects per unit in descending order.
SQL: WITH TopDepartments AS ( SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.GRADE_RULE_DESC = 'Not repeatable for credit' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), DepartmentUnits AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_variance DESC ) SELECT td.DEPARTMENT_NAME, td.ACADEMIC_YEAR, td.subject_count, du.avg_units, du.units_variance, ROUND(td.subject_count / NULLIF(du.avg_units, 0), 2) AS normalized_subjects_per_unit FROM TopDepartments td JOIN DepartmentUnits du ON td.DEPARTMENT_NAME = du.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY normalized_subjects_per_unit DESC;

question: For each tip detail record where the material status key is 'RQ', and for the top 3 most frequently offered IAP activities (not cancelled), show the subject ID, the tip term description, the term start date, the tip material key, the average record count in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the financial aid year, the IAP activity title, the max enrollment, the IAP term description, and the academic year description, for records where the tip term description matches the IAP term description, ordered by subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH tip_window AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, AVG(t1.RECORD_COUNT) OVER ( PARTITION BY t0.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ), iap_top3 AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON d.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ta ON t.TERM_CODE = ta.TERM_CODE WHERE d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND d.ACTIVITY_TITLE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t.TERM_CODE ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 3 ) SELECT tw.SUBJECT_ID, tw.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS TIP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, tw.TERM_START_DATE, tw.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, tw.window_column, it3.ACTIVITY_TITLE, it3.MAX_ENROLLMENT, it3.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS IAP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, it3.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM tip_window tw JOIN iap_top3 it3 ON tw.TERM_DESCRIPTION = it3.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY tw.SUBJECT_ID

question: For each department and academic year where the department's average total units for subjects with more than 0 total units is greater than 6 and the number of unique subjects offered with more than 5 enrolled students is at least 3, provide the department name, the average total units, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, the academic year, the number of unique subjects offered, and the minimum start date of the academic term, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DepartmentUnitsStats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ), AcademicYearDeptSubjects AS ( SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT l.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_start_date FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON t.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.stddev_total_units, ayds.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ayds.subject_count, ayds.min_start_date FROM DepartmentUnitsStats dus JOIN AcademicYearDeptSubjects ayds ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ayds.OFFER_DEPT_NAME WHERE dus.avg_total_units > 6 AND ayds.subject_count >= 3 ORDER BY dus.stddev_total_units DESC, ayds.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC;

question: For each organization and its associated space unit where the organization is assignable and the space unit code is greater than 50000, and where the organization is linked to a department in the Provost Area, provide the organization, the space unit, the number of space units, the minimum organization number, the department name, the number of organizations for that department, and the minimum department hierarchy level 3 code. List the results ordered by organization and space unit. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH ProvostAreaDepartments AS ( SELECT m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_CODE) AS min_level3_code FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ), AssignableOrgSpaceUnits AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION, s.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS space_unit_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_org_number, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION o JOIN SPACE_UNIT s ON o.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE > 50000 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION, s.SPACE_UNIT, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) SELECT a.ORGANIZATION, a.SPACE_UNIT, a.space_unit_count, a.min_org_number, p.DLC_NAME, p.org_count, p.min_level3_code FROM AssignableOrgSpaceUnits a JOIN ProvostAreaDepartments p ON a.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = p.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY a.ORGANIZATION, a.SPACE_UNIT;

question: For each academic year, what are the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in each subject offered (considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term and have more than 0 enrolled students), together with the minimum academic year and the sum of total units for subjects that are offered in the fall term and have library reserve material details with material status 'U'? Please provide the academic year, average enrollment, enrollment variance, minimum academic year, and total units sum, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH AvgVarEnrollment AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC ), MinYearTotalUnits AS ( SELECT MIN(at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_sum FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' ) SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.avg_enrollment, a.enrollment_variance, m.min_academic_year, m.total_units_sum FROM AvgVarEnrollment a CROSS JOIN MinYearTotalUnits m ORDER BY a.enrollment_variance DESC;

question: For organizations whose parent is "S H&SS" and that are assignable, and for each such organization with organization level equal to 5, show the organization name, description, HR org unit title, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the organization name, the organization key, HR department name, HR org unit title from the organization key stats, HR org unit key, and the average organization key within each organization key group ordered by HR org unit key. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH OrgWindowed AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORG_PARENT = 'S H&SS' AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1 ), OrgKeyStats AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1 ) SELECT ow.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ow.DESCRIPTION, ow.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, ow.window_column AS org_window_row_number, oks.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, oks.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, oks.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE AS oks_HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, oks.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, oks.window_column AS avg_org_key_window FROM OrgWindowed ow JOIN OrgKeyStats oks ON ow.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = oks.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY ow.ORGANIZATION_NAME, oks.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY

question: For each department name and school name that is degree granting and is in the School of Engineering with more than 50 total enrolled students in its courses, provide the department name, school name, the number of unique courses, the minimum CIP program code from the course descriptions, and the total number of students enrolled in courses offered by that department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DegreeGrantingDeptCourses AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ), EngineeringDeptHighEnrollment AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ) SELECT dgc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dgc.SCHOOL_NAME, dgc.course_count, dgc.min_cip_code, ede.total_enrollment FROM DegreeGrantingDeptCourses dgc JOIN EngineeringDeptHighEnrollment ede ON dgc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ede.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dgc.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For subjects with at least 5 enrolled students that also have IAP subject activities with a maximum enrollment of 12, show the subject ID, subject title, number of enrolled students, term code, material status key, ISBN, the row number within each material status group ordered by subject ID, the activity title, enrollment type, term description, and the rank of each record within each term description group ordered by activity title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Sub1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ISBN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 ), Sub2 AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_ID, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 12 ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s1.ISBN, s1.window_column AS material_status_row_number, s2.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s2.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.window_column AS activity_term_rank FROM Sub1 s1 JOIN Sub2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID

question: For each department and academic year where the number of enrolled students in the library subject offered is greater than 3, provide the department name, academic year, number of unique subjects offered, minimum start date of the term, and for each subject offered in the term '2017JA' in that department, show the subject title, number of enrolled students, responsible faculty name, offering department name, department full name, school name, and the minimum number of enrolled students in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the department code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptYearStats AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT so.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(at.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON at.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), TipSubjects2017JA AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_dept_name FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' ) SELECT d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, d.ACADEMIC_YEAR, d.subject_count, d.min_term_start_date, t.SUBJECT_TITLE, t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS TIP_OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t.SCHOOL_NAME, t.window_column FROM DeptYearStats d JOIN TipSubjects2017JA t ON d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = t.join_dept_name

question: For subjects that are both (1) offered in the term '2016SP' with a total of 12 units and (2) among the top 10 subject titles by the number of reserved library materials for subjects offered in the term '2009SP', display the subject title, the department name from the department table, the subject description from the course catalog, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the subject title, the offering department name, and the count of reserved materials, ordered by the count of reserved materials (descending) and then by subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION, t0.SUBJECT_ID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), subq2 AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t.SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY reserved_materials DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION, subq1.window_column, subq2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, subq2.reserved_materials FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.SUBJECT_ID = subq2.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY subq2.reserved_materials DESC, subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For each department name and school name where the department is degree granting, provide the number of unique courses, the minimum CIP program code from the course descriptions, the average number of enrolled students, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrolled students in courses that have at least one associated course material. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH department_course_summary AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ), department_enrollment_stats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_stddev DESC ) SELECT dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.SCHOOL_NAME, dcs.course_count, dcs.min_cip_code, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_stddev FROM department_course_summary dcs JOIN department_enrollment_stats des ON dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: For each department-level organization whose DLC key is not null and which has rooms with area greater than 0, and which also has organization level 5, give the organization name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of rooms assigned to that organization, and the dense rank of its corresponding HR department name considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the HR department code from the HR organization unit table. Show the organization name, area variance, area standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and the dense rank in that order, ordered by area variance descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH OrgRoomStats AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE d.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND r.AREA > 0 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY area_variance DESC ), OrgHRRank AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ) SELECT ors.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ors.area_variance, ors.area_stddev, ohr.window_column FROM OrgRoomStats ors JOIN OrgHRRank ohr ON ors.ORGANIZATION_NAME = ohr.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY ors.area_variance DESC;

question: For each activity, list the activity title, enrollment type, maximum enrollment, category name, the dense rank of the activity within its category (partitioned by category name and ordered by category name), and, if the activity is in the "Mathematics" category, the row number of the activity within its enrollment type group ordered by activity title; otherwise, show null for the row number. Present the results ordered by category name and activity title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH ActivityCategoryRank AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) AS window_column, d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY ), MathEnrollmentRowNum AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column, d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT acr.ACTIVITY_TITLE, acr.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, acr.MAX_ENROLLMENT, acr.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, acr.window_column AS category_dense_rank, mer.window_column AS math_enrollment_row_number FROM ActivityCategoryRank acr LEFT JOIN MathEnrollmentRowNum mer ON acr.ACTIVITY_TITLE = mer.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND acr.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = mer.ENROLLMENT_TYPE AND acr.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = mer.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY ORDER BY acr.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, acr.ACTIVITY_TITLE;

question: For each department, list the department name, the average CIP program code, the range of CIP program codes, the variance of CIP program codes for all undergraduate courses offered by degree-granting departments, and the variance of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one enrolled student and have course materials with a material status of 'RQ'. Present the results ordered by the range of CIP program codes in descending order, then by the variance of enrolled students in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DepartmentCIPStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_code, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cip_code_range DESC ), DepartmentEnrolledVariance AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC ) SELECT dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.avg_cip_code, dcs.cip_code_range, dcs.cip_code_variance, dev.enrolled_variance FROM DepartmentCIPStats dcs JOIN DepartmentEnrolledVariance dev ON dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dev.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY dcs.cip_code_range DESC, dev.enrolled_variance DESC;

question: For each degree-granting course in the School of Engineering, show the course description, department name, subject code description, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by course description, along with the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2022. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH department_units_stats AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC ), engineering_degree_courses AS ( SELECT t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT edc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, edc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, edc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, edc.window_column, dus.units_range, dus.units_variance FROM engineering_degree_courses edc LEFT JOIN department_units_stats dus ON edc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For space units with a space unit code equal to 97500, show the space unit name, the associated organization's name, the DLC name, the DLC key from the organization, the minimum space unit code in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the facility organization key, as well as the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of organizations associated with that DLC key (considering only DLC keys that are not null and organizations that have a non-null organization name), in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH SpaceUnitInfo AS ( SELECT t2.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS organization_name, t1.DLC_NAME AS dlc_name, t1.DLC_KEY AS org_dlc_key, MIN(t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_min_space_unit_code, t1.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 97500 ), DlcOrgStats AS ( SELECT fdlk.DLC_KEY, MAX(org_count) - MIN(org_count) AS org_count_range, VARIANCE(org_count) AS org_count_variance, STDDEV(org_count) AS org_count_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fdlk JOIN ( SELECT fo.DLC_KEY, COUNT(*) AS org_count FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fo.DLC_KEY ) org_stats ON fdlk.DLC_KEY = org_stats.DLC_KEY WHERE fdlk.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fdlk.DLC_KEY ORDER BY org_count_range DESC ) SELECT sui.space_unit_name, sui.organization_name, sui.dlc_name, sui.org_dlc_key, sui.window_min_space_unit_code, dos.org_count_range, dos.org_count_variance, dos.org_count_stddev FROM SpaceUnitInfo sui LEFT JOIN DlcOrgStats dos ON sui.DLC_KEY = dos.DLC_KEY;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2022 with a total of 12 units, show the subject code, subject number, department name, subject title, term description, total units, and the average subject enrollment number in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by department code and ordered by total units, along with the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in library subjects (with a matching master subject ID in the TIP subject offerings and more than 0 enrolled students in both tables) for each department name. List the results ordered by department name, subject code, and subject number. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subject_window AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) OVER ( PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), library_stats AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_students_variance, STDDEV(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_students_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = t.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY library_students_variance DESC ) SELECT sw.SUBJECT_CODE, sw.SUBJECT_NUMBER, sw.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sw.SUBJECT_TITLE, sw.TERM_DESCRIPTION, sw.TOTAL_UNITS, sw.window_column, ls.library_students_variance, ls.library_students_stddev FROM subject_window sw LEFT JOIN library_stats ls ON sw.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ls.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY sw.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sw.SUBJECT_CODE, sw.SUBJECT_NUMBER

question: For each subject offered in the academic year 2022 with a total of 12 units, display the department name, the variance of the reserve catalog keys for courses in that department where the material status is 'U', the subject code, subject number, subject title, term description, total units, and the average subject enrollment number in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by department code and ordered by total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH dept_variance AS ( SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, VARIANCE(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY lci.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY catalog_key_variance DESC ), subject_window AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) OVER ( PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) SELECT sw.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dv.catalog_key_variance, sw.SUBJECT_CODE, sw.SUBJECT_NUMBER, sw.SUBJECT_TITLE, sw.TERM_DESCRIPTION, sw.TOTAL_UNITS, sw.window_column FROM subject_window sw LEFT JOIN dept_variance dv ON sw.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dv.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY dv.catalog_key_variance DESC, sw.TOTAL_UNITS DESC

question: For subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering with a total of at least 6 units, show the subject code, subject title, department name, the running sum of total units within each grade type, and for the corresponding department also provide the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and offered in the 'Engineering' school), ordered by subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.total_units_range, s2.total_units_variance, s2.total_units_stddev FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For each department, provide the department name, school name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students per subject offered by that department in the term 2019FA, as well as the number of offered subjects and the minimum number of enrolled students for subjects where the number of enrolled students is greater than 3. List the columns in the following order: department name, school name, enrolled range, enrolled variance, enrolled standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), offered subject count, and minimum enrolled students. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptEnrolledStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC ), DeptSubjectCounts AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS offered_subject_count, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d2.SCHOOL_NAME, d1.enrolled_range, d1.enrolled_variance, d1.enrolled_stddev, d2.offered_subject_count, d2.min_enrolled_students FROM DeptEnrolledStats d1 JOIN DeptSubjectCounts d2 ON d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each sponsor and each subject offered in the term with code '2022FA', provide the sponsor name, the average and variance of the maximum enrollment for their IAP activities, the subject ID, department name, term description, and the running sum of total units within each academic year, ordered by sponsor and subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH sponsor_enrollment_stats AS ( SELECT s.SPONSOR_NAME, AVG(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, VARIANCE(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS var_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.SPONSOR_NAME ORDER BY var_max_enrollment DESC ), subject_running_sum AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ) SELECT ses.SPONSOR_NAME, ses.avg_max_enrollment, ses.var_max_enrollment, srs.SUBJECT_ID, srs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, srs.TERM_DESCRIPTION, srs.window_column FROM sponsor_enrollment_stats ses CROSS JOIN subject_running_sum srs;

question: For each department, show the department name, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of rooms used for subjects offered by that department (considering only rooms with an area greater than 40), and for each course in the School of Engineering that is degree granting within that department, show the course description, subject code description, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by course description. List the results ordered by department name and course description. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptRoomStats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(f.AREA) AS avg_area, VARIANCE(f.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(f.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS f JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON f.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = c.MEET_PLACE WHERE f.AREA > 40 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY area_variance DESC ), EngDegreeCourses AS ( SELECT t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_area, d.area_variance, d.area_stddev, e.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, e.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, e.window_column FROM DeptRoomStats d JOIN EngDegreeCourses e ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = e.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.COURSE_DESCRIPTION;

question: For each department, give the department name, the variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2012SU term, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for courses offered by that department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptUnitsVariance2012SU AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance_2012su FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON tso.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance_2012su DESC ), DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.total_units_variance_2012su, d2.total_units_range, d2.total_units_variance, d2.total_units_stddev FROM DeptUnitsVariance2012SU d1 JOIN DeptUnitsStats d2 ON d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each building, list the building name, the average room area, the range of room areas, the variance of room areas (for rooms in that building where the building type is 'ACADEMIC' and the room area is greater than 40), the maximum assignable area of any floor, and the fiscal period (for buildings in the MAIN GROUP campus sector with a maximum assignable area greater than 5000). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH BuildingRoomAreaStats AS ( SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_room_area, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS room_area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS room_area_variance FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND r.AREA > 40 GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY room_area_range DESC ), BuildingFloorAreaStats AS ( SELECT bh.BUILDING_NAME, MAX(f.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS max_assignable_area, bh.FISCAL_PERIOD FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST bh JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON bh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_FLOOR f ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = f.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE bh.CAMPUS_SECTOR = 'MAIN GROUP' GROUP BY bh.BUILDING_NAME, bh.FISCAL_PERIOD HAVING MAX(f.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) > 5000 ) SELECT bra.BUILDING_NAME, bra.avg_room_area, bra.room_area_range, bra.room_area_variance, bfs.max_assignable_area, bfs.FISCAL_PERIOD FROM BuildingRoomAreaStats bra JOIN BuildingFloorAreaStats bfs ON bra.BUILDING_NAME = bfs.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY bra.room_area_range DESC, bfs.max_assignable_area DESC;

question: For each department, what is the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of courses offered by that department (considering only courses offered this year with a non-null total units value), as well as the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only departments that grant degrees and subjects with a non-null subject code description)? Please provide the department name, the range of total units, the variance of total units, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, the variance of enrolled students, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrolled students, in that order, sorted by the range of total units in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH total_units_stats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccc.total_units) - MIN(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccc.total_units IS NOT NULL GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), enrolled_students_stats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT t.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.total_units_range, t.total_units_variance, t.total_units_stddev, e.enrolled_students_variance, e.enrolled_students_stddev FROM total_units_stats t JOIN enrolled_students_stats e ON t.DEPARTMENT_NAME = e.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t.total_units_range DESC;

question: For all subject offerings in the academic term with term code '2017FA', show the subject title, the offer department name, the term description, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title. For each of these, also provide the material status key, term code, subject ID, ISBN, material key, the course number description, and the maximum number of enrolled students for each row considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by material key, for course material details where the material status key is not null and the number of enrolled students is at least 0. Present the columns in the following order: subject title, offer department name, term description, window column, material status key, term code, subject ID, ISBN, material key, course number description, and maximum number of enrolled students. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH SubjectOfferings2017FA AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.TERM_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON s.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' ), CourseMaterialDetail AS ( SELECT t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.ISBN, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_enrolled_students FROM TIP_DETAIL t0 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL AND t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.window_column, c.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, c.TERM_CODE, c.SUBJECT_ID, c.ISBN, c.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, c.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, c.max_enrolled_students FROM SubjectOfferings2017FA s JOIN CourseMaterialDetail c ON s.SUBJECT_ID = c.SUBJECT_ID AND s.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY

question: For each space unit with a space unit code of 402100, show the space unit key, the organization name, the DLC name, the DLC key from FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY, the rank of each record within each DLC key group ordered by space unit key, and the geometric mean of the number of supervisees for each organization (considering only departments where the number of supervisees is greater than zero), ordered by organization name and space unit key. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH GeometricMeanSupervisees AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES))) AS geometric_mean_supervisees FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN SPACE_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ON SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY = SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.DEPT_NAMES WHERE SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES > 0 GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_supervisees DESC ), SpaceUnitDetails AS ( SELECT t2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.DLC_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DLC_KEY ORDER BY t2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 402100 ) SELECT s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, s.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s.DLC_NAME, s.DLC_KEY, s.window_column, g.geometric_mean_supervisees FROM SpaceUnitDetails s JOIN GeometricMeanSupervisees g ON s.ORGANIZATION_NAME = g.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY s.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY;

question: For subjects offered in the term with code '2019FA' that have total units greater than 1, show the subject title, the dense rank of each subject considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the academic year, the subject ID, the department name, and the running sum of total units within each school ordered by subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH SubjectDenseRank AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ), SubjectUnitSum AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS > 1 ) SELECT sdr.SUBJECT_TITLE, sdr.window_column AS subject_dense_rank, sus.SUBJECT_ID, sus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sus.window_column AS running_sum_total_units FROM SubjectDenseRank sdr JOIN SubjectUnitSum sus ON sdr.SUBJECT_ID = sus.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY sdr.SUBJECT_TITLE, sus.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each organization that has a space unit with a space unit code of 402100, show the organization name, its dense rank considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the organization number, the average of the HR department codes (old) for all associated HR org units where the organization is assignable and the HR department name is not null, and the variance of the HR department codes (old) for those HR org units. List the results ordered by the dense rank and then by the variance of the HR department codes (old) in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH SpaceUnitRanks AS ( SELECT t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 402100 ), OrgHRStats AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS avg_dept_code_old, VARIANCE(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS var_dept_code_old FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = HR_ORG_UNIT.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY var_dept_code_old DESC ) SELECT s.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s.window_column, o.avg_dept_code_old, o.var_dept_code_old FROM SpaceUnitRanks s JOIN OrgHRStats o ON s.ORGANIZATION_NAME = o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY s.window_column, o.var_dept_code_old DESC

question: For each department, what is the department name, the variance of the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects offered by the School of Engineering in the term '2016SP'), the average number of enrolled students, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrolled students in courses that have at least one associated course material? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptVariance AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ), DeptEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_stddev DESC ) SELECT dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dv.enrolled_students_variance, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_stddev FROM DeptVariance dv JOIN DeptEnrollmentStats des ON dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description, the geometric mean of the total units for all subjects offered in regular terms with total units greater than zero, the range of the number of enrolled students, and the variance of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during terms in that year (considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the number of enrolled students is greater than 0)? Show the academic year, academic year description, geometric mean of total units, enrolled student range, and enrolled student variance, ordered by geometric mean of total units descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH GeometricMeanUnits AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), EnrolledStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT gmu.ACADEMIC_YEAR, gmu.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gmu.geometric_mean_total_units, es.enrolled_range, es.enrolled_variance FROM GeometricMeanUnits gmu JOIN EnrolledStats es ON gmu.ACADEMIC_YEAR = es.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND gmu.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = es.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY gmu.geometric_mean_total_units DESC;

question: For each department, provide the department's name, the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2022 and that are also listed in the CIS course catalog, as well as the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for all courses offered by that department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH dept_units_range_variance_2022 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC ), dept_course_units_stats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.units_range, d1.units_variance, d2.total_units_range, d2.total_units_variance, d2.total_units_stddev FROM dept_units_range_variance_2022 d1 JOIN dept_course_units_stats d2 ON d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For subjects offered in the term '2017JA', show the subject title, the number of enrolled students, the responsible faculty name, the offering department name, the department full name, the school name, the minimum number of enrolled students in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the department code, the subject code, the subject code description, and the minimum number of enrolled students over each subject code group ordered by subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.window_column AS min_enrolled_window_by_dept, s2.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s2.window_column AS min_enrolled_by_subject_code FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_TITLE = s2.SUBJECT_TITLE AND s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AND s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME

question: For each employee type and department name where the student year is 'G', and for each subject offered in the term '2017JA' in that department, provide the employee type, department name, number of people, minimum MIT ID, subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, department full name, subject code, subject code description, and the minimum number of enrolled students over each subject code group, ordered by employee type, department name, and subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH EmployeeTypeDeptStats AS ( SELECT sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(sp.MIT_ID) AS person_count, MIN(sp.MIT_ID) AS min_mit_id FROM SE_PERSON sp JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), SubjectOfferStats AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' ) SELECT e.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.person_count, e.min_mit_id, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s.window_column FROM EmployeeTypeDeptStats e JOIN SubjectOfferStats s ON e.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY e.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE

question: For rooms in building E38, show the building room identifier, floor number, major use description, organization name of the room, office location, full name of the employee, department name, and the average area of rooms in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by department number and ordered by floor, along with the name of the space unit, the associated organization name for the space unit, and both the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the organization numbers for all organizations linked to that space unit (considering only space units with a non-null DLC key and organizations with assignable status), matching on organization key. The columns should be: building room identifier, floor number, major use description, organization name of the room, office location, full name of the employee, department name, average area window, space unit name, space unit organization name, variance of organization numbers, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of organization numbers. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH e38_rooms_window AS ( SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.FLOOR, t0.MAJOR_USE_DESC, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.OFFICE_LOCATION, t1.FULL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, AVG(t0.AREA) OVER ( PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER ORDER BY t0.FLOOR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ROOMS t0 JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY t1 ON t0.BUILDING_ROOM = t1.OFFICE_LOCATION WHERE t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = 'E38' ), space_unit_org_stats AS ( SELECT s.SPACE_UNIT, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, VARIANCE(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance, STDDEV(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT s ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = s.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE s.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 GROUP BY s.SPACE_UNIT, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY org_number_variance DESC ) SELECT e.BUILDING_ROOM, e.FLOOR, e.MAJOR_USE_DESC, e.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS ROOM_ORGANIZATION_NAME, e.OFFICE_LOCATION, e.FULL_NAME, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.window_column, s.SPACE_UNIT, s.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS SPACE_UNIT_ORGANIZATION_NAME, s.org_number_variance, s.org_number_stddev FROM e38_rooms_window e LEFT JOIN space_unit_org_stats s ON e.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = s.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY

question: For each department in the School of Engineering, for subjects with at least 6 total units offered in the most recent academic year, give the department name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the most recent academic year, along with the subject ID, subject title, and the running sum of total units within each school, ordered by the range of total units (descending) and subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DepartmentUnitsStats AS ( SELECT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.SUBJECT_ID WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ) GROUP BY COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ), EngineeringSubjects AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance, es.SUBJECT_ID, es.SUBJECT_TITLE, es.window_column FROM DepartmentUnitsStats dus JOIN EngineeringSubjects es ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = es.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dus.total_units_range DESC, es.SUBJECT_ID

question: For each space unit, provide the space unit name, the average room square footage, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the room square footage, the DLC name, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of rooms assigned to organizations in that DLC, considering only rooms with an area greater than 0. List the results ordered by the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the room square footage in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH SpaceUnitRoomStats AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, su.DLC_KEY, AVG(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS avg_room_sqft, STDDEV(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS stddev_room_sqft FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, su.DLC_KEY ORDER BY stddev_room_sqft DESC ), DLCRoomAreaVariation AS ( SELECT FODK.DLC_KEY, FO.DLC_NAME, STDDEV(FR.AREA)/NULLIF(AVG(FR.AREA),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY FODK JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION FO ON FODK.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS FR ON FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FR.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE FR.AREA > 0 GROUP BY FODK.DLC_KEY, FO.DLC_NAME HAVING AVG(FR.AREA) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT srs.SPACE_UNIT, srs.avg_room_sqft, srs.stddev_room_sqft, drv.DLC_NAME, drv.coefficient_of_variation FROM SpaceUnitRoomStats srs JOIN DLCRoomAreaVariation drv ON srs.DLC_KEY = drv.DLC_KEY ORDER BY srs.stddev_room_sqft DESC;

question: For subjects with at least 5 enrolled students that were also offered in the term '2019FA' with more than 0 enrolled students, show the subject ID, subject title, number of enrolled students, term code, material status key, ISBN, the row number within each material status group ordered by subject ID, offer department name, department full name, and the average number of enrolled students in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the school code, ordered by the subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ISBN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 ), subq2 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s1.ISBN, s1.window_column AS material_status_row_number, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s2.window_column AS avg_enrollment_window FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID

question: For courses in the School of Engineering that are degree granting, show the course description, department name, the dense rank of each course considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the department's budget code, the average of the ASCII values of the department's subject codes' course numbers, and the variance of the ASCII values of the department's subject codes' course numbers. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH EngineeringCourses AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), DepartmentCourseStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VARIANCE(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY var_course_number_ascii DESC ) SELECT ec.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ec.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ec.window_column, dcs.avg_course_number_ascii, dcs.var_course_number_ascii FROM EngineeringCourses ec JOIN DepartmentCourseStats dcs ON ec.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ec.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ec.window_column

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year, the academic year description, the geometric mean of the total units for all subjects offered in regular terms with total units greater than zero, the variance of the number of enrolled students in library subjects for that year (considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the number of enrolled students in the library subject is greater than 0), and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in library subjects for that year (with the same conditions), with the results ordered by academic year? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH GeometricMeanUnits AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC ), EnrolledStudentsStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ) SELECT gmu.ACADEMIC_YEAR, gmu.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gmu.geometric_mean_total_units, ess.enrolled_students_variance, ess.enrolled_students_stddev FROM GeometricMeanUnits gmu JOIN EnrolledStudentsStats ess ON gmu.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ess.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND gmu.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = ess.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY gmu.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each department in the Provost Area with a non-null department code, show the department name, the department's long name, the corresponding hierarchy level 3 name from the master department hierarchy, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the department name, the space unit code for space units with a space unit key greater than 100000, the organization name, the HR department name from the space unit, and the sum of space unit keys within each warehouse load date group ordered by space unit key, for departments and space units that share the same DLC key. The columns should be shown in the following order: department name, department long name, hierarchy level 3 name, department window column, space unit code, organization name, HR department name from the space unit, and space unit window column. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptWindowed AS ( SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t1.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL ), SpaceUnitWindowed AS ( SELECT t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE ORDER BY t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column, t2.DLC_KEY FROM SPACE_UNIT t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000 ) SELECT d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, d.window_column AS dept_window_column, s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, s.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS spaceunit_hr_department_name, s.window_column AS spaceunit_window_column FROM DeptWindowed d JOIN SpaceUnitWindowed s ON d.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY ORDER BY d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE

question: For subjects offered in the term with the description "Fall Term 2024-2025", where the department's average total units for subjects offered in regular terms is greater than 12 and the variance of total units is at least 10, give the department name, subject code, subject title, term description, the rank of each subject within its department ordered by subject code, the academic year, the average total units, and the variance of total units, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH AvgVarUnits AS ( SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY var_total_units DESC ), FallSubjects AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' ) SELECT fs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, fs.SUBJECT_CODE, fs.SUBJECT_TITLE, fs.TERM_DESCRIPTION, fs.window_column, avu.ACADEMIC_YEAR, avu.avg_total_units, avu.var_total_units FROM FallSubjects fs JOIN AvgVarUnits avu ON fs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = avu.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE avu.avg_total_units > 12 AND avu.var_total_units >= 10 ORDER BY avu.var_total_units DESC, fs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, fs.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For organizations with an organization level of 5, show the organization name, organization ID, DLC name, HR org unit title, HR department name, HR org unit level, and assign row numbers within each HR department name group ordered by organization name. For each such organization, also show each room with area greater than 200 and assignable major use that belongs to the organization, including the building room, floor, room number, space ID, area, major use name, major use description, and the minimum area value over each major use group, ordered by HR department name, organization name, and major use. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH OrgLevel5 AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID, t1.DLC_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS window_column, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ), LargeAssignableRooms AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.ROOM, t1.SPACE_ID, t1.AREA, t0.MAJOR_USE, t0.DESCRIPTION, min(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY ORDER BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY) AS min_area_per_major_use, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_MAJOR_USE t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 200 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1 ) SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.ORGANIZATION_ID, o.DLC_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, o.window_column, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.FLOOR, r.ROOM, r.SPACE_ID, r.AREA, r.MAJOR_USE, r.DESCRIPTION, r.min_area_per_major_use FROM OrgLevel5 o JOIN LargeAssignableRooms r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.MAJOR_USE

question: For each subject offered by departments in the School of Engineering with a total of at least 6 units, show the subject ID, subject title, department name, and the running sum of total units within each school, along with the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the most recent academic year. Present the results ordered by subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH dept_stats AS ( SELECT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.SUBJECT_ID WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ) GROUP BY COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ), eng_subjects AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ) SELECT eng_subjects.SUBJECT_ID, eng_subjects.SUBJECT_TITLE, eng_subjects.DEPARTMENT_NAME, eng_subjects.window_column, dept_stats.avg_total_units, dept_stats.total_units_range, dept_stats.total_units_variance FROM eng_subjects LEFT JOIN dept_stats ON eng_subjects.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY eng_subjects.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each department where the maximum total units of any course offered by that department is greater than 6 and the department grants degrees and offers graduate-level courses, what is the department name, the maximum total units, the name of the school the department belongs to, the range of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department, and the variance of enrolled students? Please provide the department name, maximum total units, school name, range of enrolled students, and variance of enrolled students, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
