SQL: WITH MaxUnitsDepartments AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ), EnrolledStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC ) SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.max_total_units, m.SCHOOL_NAME, e.enrolled_range, e.enrolled_variance FROM MaxUnitsDepartments m JOIN EnrolledStats e ON m.DEPARTMENT_NAME = e.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY m.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each organization with an organization level of 5 and among the top 10 space units by number of rooms, show the organization name, organization key, description, space unit, space unit key, the average organization key within each organization key group ordered by space unit key, and the count of rooms for each space unit, ordered by the count of rooms descending and then by space unit key. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH OrgLevel5 AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.SPACE_UNIT, t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ), TopSpaceUnits AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(sd.BUILDING_ROOM) AS room_count, su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY ORDER BY room_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.DESCRIPTION, o.SPACE_UNIT, o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, o.window_column, t.room_count FROM OrgLevel5 o JOIN TopSpaceUnits t ON o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = t.SPACE_UNIT_KEY ORDER BY t.room_count DESC, o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY

question: For each department and academic year where the number of enrolled students in a subject is greater than 5, what are the number of unique subjects offered and the minimum number of total units for those subjects, and for subjects offered in the term '2014FA' in that department and academic year, what are the subject title from the library, the number of enrolled students in the library subject, the responsible faculty name from the TIP subject, the offer department name from the TIP subject, and the minimum number of enrolled students in the library subject within a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the TIP subject's responsible faculty MIT ID? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH dept_subject_stats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), library_subjects_2014fa AS ( SELECT l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_dept_name, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a ON l.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' ) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dss.subject_count, dss.min_total_units, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.window_column FROM dept_subject_stats dss JOIN library_subjects_2014fa lso ON dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = lso.join_dept_name AND dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR = lso.ACADEMIC_YEAR

question: For organizations whose parent is 'S H&SS', and for each associated space unit with a space unit code of 97500, show the organization name, description, the HR org unit title, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the organization name, the space unit name, space unit code, department count, number of supervisees, and the average department count within each department count group ordered by number of supervisees. List the results ordered by organization name and space unit name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH OrgWindow AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.ORG_PARENT = 'S H&SS' ), SpaceStats AS ( SELECT t1.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.DEPT_COUNT, t2.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, AVG(t2.DEPT_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPT_COUNT ORDER BY t2.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS avg_dept_count_within_group, t1.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DEPT_NAMES WHERE t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 97500 ) SELECT ow.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ow.DESCRIPTION, ow.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, ow.window_column, ss.space_unit_name, ss.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, ss.DEPT_COUNT, ss.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, ss.avg_dept_count_within_group FROM OrgWindow ow JOIN SpaceStats ss ON ow.DLC_KEY = ss.DLC_KEY ORDER BY ow.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ss.space_unit_name

question: For each department, show the department name, the average, range, and variance of the area of rooms assigned to it (considering only rooms with an area greater than 40), as well as the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in regular academic terms, listing the department name, average area, area range, area variance, average total units, total units range, and total units variance in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH RoomAreaStats AS ( SELECT o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_area, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 40 GROUP BY o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY area_range DESC ), SubjectUnitsStats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT ras.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ras.avg_area, ras.area_range, ras.area_variance, sus.avg_total_units, sus.total_units_range, sus.total_units_variance FROM RoomAreaStats ras JOIN SubjectUnitsStats sus ON ras.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = sus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ras.area_range DESC;

question: For each department, give the department's name, the range and variance of the access levels of rooms assigned to it, the average number of supervisees, the range of the number of supervisees, and the variance of the number of supervisees for all space units associated with that department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH department_access_levels AS ( SELECT HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.ACCESS_LEVEL) - MIN(ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_range, VARIANCE(ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_variance FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.ACCESS_LEVEL IS NOT NULL GROUP BY HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY access_level_range DESC ), department_supervisees AS ( SELECT SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT AS department_name, AVG(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS avg_supervisees, MAX(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) - MIN(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS supervisee_range, VARIANCE(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS supervisee_variance FROM SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE JOIN SPACE_UNIT ON SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.DEPT_NAMES = SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY GROUP BY SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT ORDER BY supervisee_range DESC ) SELECT dal.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dal.access_level_range, dal.access_level_variance, ds.avg_supervisees, ds.supervisee_range, ds.supervisee_variance FROM department_access_levels dal JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON dal.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = fo.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN department_supervisees ds ON su.SPACE_UNIT = ds.department_name

question: For the top 10 material statuses by number of materials, what are the corresponding library material statuses and their reserve catalog item counts for term code '2009SP'? List the material status, the material count, the library material status, and the reserve catalog item count, ordered by material count and then reserve catalog item count in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH TopMaterialStatuses AS ( SELECT tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count, tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS tms ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY GROUP BY tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY material_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), ReserveCountsByLibraryStatus AS ( SELECT lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserve_count, lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY FROM LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS lms JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY WHERE lrmd.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY reserve_count DESC ) SELECT tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, tms.material_count, lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, lms.reserve_count FROM TopMaterialStatuses tms JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lrmd.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID AND lrmd.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE JOIN ReserveCountsByLibraryStatus lms ON lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY GROUP BY tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, tms.material_count, lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, lms.reserve_count ORDER BY tms.material_count DESC, lms.reserve_count DESC;

question: For space units with a space unit key equal to 402410, show the space unit name, the organization name, the department hierarchy level 3 name, the department hierarchy level 2 name, the department code, and the minimum space unit key in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the organization key, along with the department hierarchy name, the average organization level, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the organization level for organizations in that hierarchy. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH SpaceUnitInfo AS ( SELECT t2.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS organization_name, t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME AS dept_hier_level_3_name, t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME AS dept_hier_level_2_name, t1.DLC_KEY AS department_code, MIN(t2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) OVER (ORDER BY t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = 402410 ), DeptHierarchyStats AS ( SELECT MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME, AVG(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) AS avg_org_level, STDDEV(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) AS org_level_stddev, MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL IS NOT NULL GROUP BY MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME, MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY ORDER BY org_level_stddev DESC ), CombinedInfo AS ( SELECT s.space_unit_name, s.organization_name, s.dept_hier_level_3_name, s.dept_hier_level_2_name, s.department_code, s.window_column, d.DLC_NAME, d.avg_org_level, d.org_level_stddev FROM SpaceUnitInfo s JOIN DeptHierarchyStats d ON s.department_code = d.DLC_KEY ) SELECT space_unit_name, organization_name, dept_hier_level_3_name, dept_hier_level_2_name, department_code, window_column, DLC_NAME, avg_org_level, org_level_stddev FROM CombinedInfo ORDER BY space_unit_name, DLC_NAME;

question: For each subject offered in the term with the description "Fall Term 2024-2025" that also has more than 0 enrolled students and a material status key of 'U', show the subject offered key, subject title, offering department name, the term description, the rank of each subject within its offering department, the course number, course number description, number of enrolled students, the reserve catalog key, and the dense rank over the material status key, ordered by subject offered key and course number. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH SubjectOfferings AS ( SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS window_column, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' ), LibrarySubjectStats AS ( SELECT t1.COURSE_NUMBER, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) AS window_column, t1.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ) SELECT so.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, so.TERM_DESCRIPTION, so.window_column AS subject_rank_in_dept, lss.COURSE_NUMBER, lss.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, lss.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lss.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, lss.window_column AS dense_rank_material_status FROM SubjectOfferings so JOIN LibrarySubjectStats lss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = lss.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY so.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, lss.COURSE_NUMBER

question: Show, for each subject, the subject code, subject code description, department name, subject title, and the dense rank of each row partitioned by the school code and ordered by school code for subjects where the school code is not null and the subject title is not null; and for subjects offered in the 2012SU term with a cluster type of 'S', show the subject title from SUBJECT_OFFERED, the offer department name, the total units from SUBJECT_SUMMARY, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the subject title. Indicate the source of each row as either 'Subq1' or 'Subq2'. List all results together, showing the columns: subject code, subject code description, department name, subject title, dense rank by school, offer department name, total units, row number window, and source, in that order, ordered by subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t0.SCHOOL_CODE) AS window_column, t1.SUBJECT_ID FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_CODE IS NOT NULL AND t1.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t1.CLUSTER_TYPE = 'S' ), CombinedSubjects AS ( SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.window_column AS dense_rank_by_school, NULL AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NULL AS TOTAL_UNITS, NULL AS row_number_window, 'Subq1' AS Source FROM Subq1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_CODE, NULL AS SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS dense_rank_by_school, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.TOTAL_UNITS, s2.window_column AS row_number_window, 'Subq2' AS Source FROM Subq2 s2 ) SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, dense_rank_by_school, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, TOTAL_UNITS, row_number_window, Source FROM CombinedSubjects ORDER BY SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For courses in the School of Engineering that are degree granting, show the course description, department name, subject code, subject title, the minimum total units in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the course number, as well as the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department in 2017 (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students). List the results by department name and course description. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH EngineeringDegreeCourses AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, MIN(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS join_department_name FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_CODE = t2.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2017%' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ) SELECT edc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, edc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, edc.SUBJECT_CODE, edc.SUBJECT_TITLE, edc.window_column, des.enrolled_students_variance, des.enrolled_students_stddev FROM EngineeringDegreeCourses edc JOIN DepartmentEnrollmentStats des ON edc.join_department_name = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY edc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, edc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION

question: For subjects offered in the term with code '2025FA' that also have offerings in the term '2016SP' by departments that grant degrees, show the subject ID, subject title, offering department name, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, term start date, term end date, term parameter, the minimum number of enrolled students over each offering department, and the dense rank of the subject considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the total number of units, ordered by offering department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t2.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) window_column, t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.TERM_START_DATE, s1.TERM_END_DATE, s1.TERM_PARAMETER, s1.min_enrolled_students_per_dept, s2.window_column FROM Subq1 s1 JOIN Subq2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = s2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2012 with a cluster type of 'SWE: School-Wide Electives', show the subject key, subject title, academic year, and the running sum of the number of enrolled students within each department, along with the academic year description, the range, and the variance of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during terms in that year (considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the number of enrolled students is greater than 0), ordered by subject key. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH SWE_Subjects_2012 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, SUM(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_KEY) AS running_enrollment_sum FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 AND t1.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC = 'SWE: School-Wide Electives' ), Library_Enrolled_Stats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_KEY, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.running_enrollment_sum, l.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, l.enrolled_range, l.enrolled_variance FROM SWE_Subjects_2012 s JOIN Library_Enrolled_Stats l ON s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = l.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_KEY;

question: For rooms in building E38, show the building room identifier, floor number, major use description, organization name, office location, full name of the employee, department name, and the average area of rooms in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by department number and ordered by floor, along with the space unit name, the average HR organization unit ID, and the variance of the HR organization unit IDs associated with the space unit for the organization of the room. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH E38Rooms AS ( SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.FLOOR, t0.MAJOR_USE_DESC, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.OFFICE_LOCATION, t1.FULL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, AVG(t0.AREA) OVER ( PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER ORDER BY t0.FLOOR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ROOMS t0 JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY t1 ON t0.BUILDING_ROOM = t1.OFFICE_LOCATION WHERE t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = 'E38' ), SpaceUnitStats AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, AVG(hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS avg_org_unit_id, VARIANCE(hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS org_unit_id_variance, fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY org_unit_id_variance DESC ) SELECT e.BUILDING_ROOM, e.FLOOR, e.MAJOR_USE_DESC, e.ORGANIZATION_NAME, e.OFFICE_LOCATION, e.FULL_NAME, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.window_column, s.SPACE_UNIT, s.avg_org_unit_id, s.org_unit_id_variance FROM E38Rooms e JOIN SpaceUnitStats s ON e.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = s.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY

question: For all subject offerings in the academic term with term code '2017FA', show the subject title, the offer department name, the term description, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title, and for the corresponding department, provide the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects that are offered this year and are letter graded. List the results ordered by subject title and by variance of total units in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH SubjectOfferings2017FA AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.COURSE_NUMBER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON s.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' ), DepartmentUnitsStats AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT so.SUBJECT_TITLE, so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, so.TERM_DESCRIPTION, so.window_column, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance FROM SubjectOfferings2017FA so JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON so.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN DepartmentUnitsStats dus ON scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY so.SUBJECT_TITLE, dus.total_units_variance DESC

question: For each department name and course level where the number of unique degree granting courses with total units greater than 6 is more than 2 and the department's range of total units is greater than 0, provide the department name, course level, number of unique courses, minimum total units offered, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for courses offered by that department, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DegreeGrantingCourses AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL ), DepartmentUnitStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dgc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dgc.COURSE_LEVEL, dgc.course_count, dgc.min_total_units, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev FROM DegreeGrantingCourses dgc JOIN DepartmentUnitStats dus ON dgc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE dgc.course_count > 2 AND dus.total_units_range > 0 ORDER BY dgc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dgc.COURSE_LEVEL;

question: For all pairs of subjects where one is offered in the term '2019FA' with more than 0 enrolled students and the other is in the term '2009SP', show the 2019FA subject title, offer department name, department full name, number of enrolled students, and the average number of enrolled students in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the school code, along with the 2009SP subject title, department name, total units, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), subq2 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t1.TERM_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_title_2019fa, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.window_column AS avg_enrolled_window, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_title_2009sp, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.TOTAL_UNITS, s2.window_column AS row_number_window FROM subq1 s1 CROSS JOIN subq2 s2;

question: For each department and academic year where the subject enrollment number is greater than 10, provide the department name, academic year, the number of unique subjects, the minimum total units offered, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses offered by that department (considering only courses with at least one associated TIP material), and calculate the normalized subject count rounded (number of unique subjects divided by the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrolled students in that department). List the results in descending order of normalized subject count.
SQL: WITH SubjectStats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), DeptEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS num_enrolled_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS num_enrolled_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ss.subject_count, ss.min_total_units, des.num_enrolled_variance, des.num_enrolled_stddev, ROUND(ss.subject_count / NULLIF(des.num_enrolled_stddev, 0), 2) AS normalized_subject_count_stddev FROM SubjectStats ss JOIN DeptEnrollmentStats des ON ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.department ORDER BY normalized_subject_count_stddev DESC;

question: For each department, provide the department's name, the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2022 and that are also listed in the CIS course catalog, as well as the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in regular academic terms. List the department name, units range for 2022 CIS subjects, units variance for 2022 CIS subjects, average total units in regular terms, total units range in regular terms, and total units variance in regular terms, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH dept_units_2022_cis AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC ), dept_units_regular_terms AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.units_range, d1.units_variance, d2.avg_total_units, d2.total_units_range, d2.total_units_variance FROM dept_units_2022_cis d1 JOIN dept_units_regular_terms d2 ON d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department, list the department name, the variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2012SU term, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for courses offered by that department, and the reason for inclusion ('2012SU Variance' for the 2012SU term variance and 'All Courses Stats' for the overall course statistics). The columns should be shown in the following order: department name, total units variance, total units range, total units standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and reason for inclusion. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptUnitsVariance2012SU AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON tso.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ), CombinedDeptUnits AS ( SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.total_units_variance, NULL AS total_units_range, NULL AS total_units_stddev, '2012SU Variance' AS Reason FROM DeptUnitsVariance2012SU d1 UNION ALL SELECT d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d2.total_units_variance, d2.total_units_range, d2.total_units_stddev, 'All Courses Stats' AS Reason FROM DeptUnitsStats d2 ) SELECT * FROM CombinedDeptUnits ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Reason;

question: For each organization with an organization level of 5, show the organization name, organization key, description, space unit, space unit key, the average organization key within each organization key group ordered by space unit key, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the access levels of rooms assigned to each space unit. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH org_space_window AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.SPACE_UNIT, t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ), space_unit_cv AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, STDDEV(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) / NULLIF(AVG(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD zr ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = zr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE HAVING AVG(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.DESCRIPTION, o.SPACE_UNIT, o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, o.window_column, s.coefficient_of_variation FROM org_space_window o LEFT JOIN space_unit_cv s ON o.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ORDER BY o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY;

question: For each subject offered in the term '2014FA', provide the subject title from the library, the number of enrolled students in the library subject, the responsible faculty name from the TIP subject, the offer department name from the TIP subject, the minimum number of enrolled students in the library subject within a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the TIP subject's responsible faculty MIT ID, the number of unique subjects and the minimum total units for the offering department and school where the course material status is 'RQ'. List the results ordered by offer department name and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptSchoolRQStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ), LibrarySubjects2014FA AS ( SELECT l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( ORDER BY t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' ) SELECT l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, l.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.window_column, d.subject_count, d.min_total_units FROM LibrarySubjects2014FA l JOIN DeptSchoolRQStats d ON l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = d.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description, the average number of enrolled students in subjects offered (considering only subjects that require advance sign-up and are not cancelled), the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students, and the geometric mean of the record counts of required course materials (where the record count is greater than zero) for all subjects offered in that year? List the academic year, academic year description, average enrollment, enrollment variance, enrollment standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and geometric mean record count in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH EnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON isd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON at.TERM_CODE = tso.TERM_CODE WHERE isd.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC ), MaterialStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_record_count DESC ) SELECT es.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ms.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, es.avg_enrollment, es.enrollment_variance, es.enrollment_stddev, ms.geometric_mean_record_count FROM EnrollmentStats es JOIN MaterialStats ms ON es.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ms.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY es.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each department, provide the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of unique subject codes associated with its courses that are offered by degree-granting departments, and for each subject offered by that department in the academic year 2024 with total units equal to 12, show the department code, subject code, subject number, subject title, total units, and the row number within the department ordered by subject code. List the results in order by department name and row number. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DepartmentSubjectStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes FROM ( SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT ) course_subjects JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON course_subjects.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY stddev_subject_codes DESC ), Subjects2024_12Units AS ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.avg_subject_codes, dss.stddev_subject_codes, s24.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s24.SUBJECT_CODE, s24.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s24.SUBJECT_TITLE, s24.TOTAL_UNITS, s24.window_column FROM DepartmentSubjectStats dss JOIN Subjects2024_12Units s24 ON dss.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s24.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s24.window_column

question: For each subject title and department name where the total units are greater than 3, give the number of offered sections and the minimum number of enrolled students for those subjects, as well as the number of offered sections and the minimum number of enrolled students for the same subject title and department name where the total units are greater than 6. Present the results as subject title, department name, section count for total units greater than 3, minimum enrolled students for total units greater than 3, section count for total units greater than 6, and minimum enrolled students for total units greater than 6, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Sub1 AS ( SELECT sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS section_count, MIN(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON sos.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 3 GROUP BY sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), Sub2 AS ( SELECT sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS section_count, MIN(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON sos.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = so.SUBJECT_ID_SORT JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = ss.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.section_count AS section_count_units_gt_3, s1.min_enrolled AS min_enrolled_units_gt_3, s2.section_count AS section_count_units_gt_6, s2.min_enrolled_students AS min_enrolled_units_gt_6 FROM Sub1 s1 LEFT JOIN Sub2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_TITLE = s2.SUBJECT_TITLE AND s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: List all subjects offered in the term '2019FA' with more than 0 enrolled students, showing the subject title, offer department name, department full name, number of enrolled students, and the average number of enrolled students in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the school code, as well as the top 10 departments by the number of unique subjects they offered for terms in the academic year 2014 or later, including the department name and the count of unique subject titles. For each row, also include a reason for inclusion ('2019FA_Subject' for subjects and 'Top10_Dept_2014plus' for departments). The columns should be: subject title, offer department name, department full name, number of enrolled students, windowed average of enrolled students, subject count, and reason, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subjects2019FA AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), Top10Depts2014 AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count, lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2014 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.window_column, NULL AS subject_count, '2019FA_Subject' AS Reason FROM Subjects2019FA s UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, NULL AS window_column, t.subject_count, 'Top10_Dept_2014plus' AS Reason FROM Top10Depts2014 t ) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, window_column, subject_count, Reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each DLC and academic year where the DLC name matches the department name and the term status is 'Previous', provide the DLC key, DLC name, coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of rooms assigned to organizations in that DLC (considering only rooms with an area greater than 0), academic year, department name, the number of unique subjects offered, and the minimum total units for those subjects, listing the columns in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DLC_RoomAreaStats AS ( SELECT FODK.DLC_KEY, FO.DLC_NAME, STDDEV(FR.AREA)/NULLIF(AVG(FR.AREA),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY FODK JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION FO ON FODK.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS FR ON FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FR.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE FR.AREA > 0 GROUP BY FODK.DLC_KEY, FO.DLC_NAME HAVING AVG(FR.AREA) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), AcademicYearDeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT d.DLC_KEY, d.DLC_NAME, d.coefficient_of_variation, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.subject_count, a.min_total_units FROM DLC_RoomAreaStats d JOIN AcademicYearDeptSubjectStats a ON d.DLC_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d.coefficient_of_variation DESC, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC;

question: For each organization that is assignable and has a department code above 100000, show the organization key, organization name, department name, the number of HR org units, the total of their department IDs, and for each of their rooms with area greater than 200, show the building-room identifier, the DLC key, and the sum of room areas within each major use description group ordered by building-room. Present the results ordered by organization key and building-room. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH org_hr_stats AS ( SELECT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS hr_org_unit_count, SUM(h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS total_department_id FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION f JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID > 100000 GROUP BY f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ), room_area_stats AS ( SELECT t2.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, SUM(t2.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.MAJOR_USE_DESC ORDER BY t2.BUILDING_ROOM) AS window_column, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.AREA > 200 ) SELECT org_hr_stats.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, org_hr_stats.ORGANIZATION_NAME, org_hr_stats.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, org_hr_stats.hr_org_unit_count, org_hr_stats.total_department_id, room_area_stats.BUILDING_ROOM, room_area_stats.DLC_KEY, room_area_stats.window_column FROM org_hr_stats JOIN room_area_stats ON org_hr_stats.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = room_area_stats.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY org_hr_stats.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, room_area_stats.BUILDING_ROOM;

question: For each sponsor and each subject in the "Engineering" school with total units greater than 1 in the same academic term, provide the sponsor name, the average and variance of the maximum enrollment for their IAP activities, the subject title, department name, school name, academic year description, and the minimum total units in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH sponsor_stats AS ( SELECT s.SPONSOR_NAME, AVG(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, VARIANCE(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS var_max_enrollment, d.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.SPONSOR_NAME, d.TERM_CODE ), eng_subjects AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s.TERM_CODE, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY s JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ata.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON s.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 1 ) SELECT sponsor_stats.SPONSOR_NAME, sponsor_stats.avg_max_enrollment, sponsor_stats.var_max_enrollment, eng_subjects.SUBJECT_TITLE, eng_subjects.DEPARTMENT_NAME, eng_subjects.SCHOOL_NAME, eng_subjects.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, eng_subjects.window_column FROM sponsor_stats JOIN eng_subjects ON sponsor_stats.TERM_CODE = eng_subjects.TERM_CODE ORDER BY sponsor_stats.var_max_enrollment DESC, eng_subjects.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC

question: For each department in the Provost Area, show the department name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of faculty organization keys associated with that department, and for each room on floor 2 belonging to that department, show the building room, space usage, the organization name, the HR org unit title, the department name, and the minimum access level in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the building component. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptOrgStats AS ( SELECT m.DLC_NAME, VARIANCE(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_key_variance, STDDEV(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_key_stddev, m.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME, m.DLC_KEY ORDER BY org_key_variance DESC ), RoomAccessStats AS ( SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.SPACE_USAGE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(t0.ACCESS_LEVEL) OVER (ORDER BY t0.BUILDING_COMPONENT ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.DLC_KEY FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2 ) SELECT d.DLC_NAME, d.org_key_variance, d.org_key_stddev, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.SPACE_USAGE, r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, r.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, r.window_column FROM DeptOrgStats d JOIN RoomAccessStats r ON d.DLC_KEY = r.DLC_KEY ORDER BY d.DLC_NAME, r.BUILDING_ROOM

question: For each major use description and organization name where the room area is greater than 100 and the access level is 1, display the number of rooms, the minimum floor number, the range of the space unit codes associated with the organization, and the variance of the space unit codes, ordering the results by the number of rooms in descending order and then by the code range in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH room_stats AS ( SELECT r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count, MIN(r.FLOOR) AS min_floor, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 100 AND r.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 GROUP BY r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ), org_code_stats AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAX(SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) - MIN(SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS code_range, VARIANCE(SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS code_variance, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN SPACE_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = SPACE_UNIT.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY code_range DESC ) SELECT rs.MAJOR_USE_DESC, rs.ORGANIZATION_NAME, rs.room_count, rs.min_floor, ocs.code_range, ocs.code_variance FROM room_stats rs JOIN org_code_stats ocs ON rs.ORGANIZATION_NAME = ocs.ORGANIZATION_NAME AND rs.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = ocs.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY rs.room_count DESC, ocs.code_range DESC;

question: For IAP subject activities with a maximum enrollment of 30 and tip details where the material status key is 'RQ', show the activity title, enrollment type, prerequisites, term code, IAP term description, term start date, term end date, the minimum term start date over each term code group, the tip subject offered key, tip material key, subject ID, tip term description, academic year, and the average record count in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by academic year, ordered by term code and academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH IAPActivities AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t0.PREREQUISITES, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, min(t1.TERM_START_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.TERM_CODE ORDER BY t0.TERM_CODE) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 30 ), TipMaterialStats AS ( SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(t0.RECORD_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_START_DATE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM TIP_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ) SELECT ia.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ia.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, ia.PREREQUISITES, ia.TERM_CODE, ia.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS IAP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, ia.TERM_START_DATE, ia.TERM_END_DATE, ia.window_column AS IAP_MIN_TERM_START_DATE, tms.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, tms.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, tms.SUBJECT_ID, tms.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS TIP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR, tms.window_column AS TIP_AVG_RECORD_COUNT FROM IAPActivities ia JOIN TipMaterialStats tms ON ia.TERM_CODE = tms.TERM_CODE ORDER BY ia.TERM_CODE, tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR

question: For each organization with a DLC key of 'D_MECHE' and for each space unit associated with that organization (where the space unit has a warehouse load date of '19-DEC-24' and the HR org units linked to it have a warehouse load date of '03-DEC-24'), show the organization key, organization name, DLC name, the rank of the organization within each DLC name group ordered by organization key, the space unit name, the average, range, and variance of the HR department codes for the HR org units linked to that space unit. The columns should be shown in the following order: organization key, organization name, DLC name, rank, space unit name, average HR department code, HR department code range, and HR department code variance. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.DLC_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DLC_NAME ORDER BY t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.DLC_KEY = 'D_MECHE' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS avg_hr_dept_code, MAX(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) - MIN(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS hr_dept_code_range, VARIANCE(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS hr_dept_code_variance FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE su.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND hou.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '03-DEC-24' GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY hr_dept_code_range DESC ) SELECT s1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s1.DLC_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.SPACE_UNIT, s2.avg_hr_dept_code, s2.hr_dept_code_range, s2.hr_dept_code_variance FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME = s2.ORGANIZATION_NAME

question: For each department that is degree-granting and offered at least one subject in the School of Engineering in 2021, provide the department code, department name, department full name, the number of subjects offered, the total number of enrolled students in those subjects, the average number of unique subject codes associated with its courses that are offered by degree-granting departments, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of that number. List the results ordered by department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptEng2021 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ), DeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes FROM ( SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT ) course_subjects JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON course_subjects.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_subject_codes DESC ), CombinedDepts AS ( SELECT de.DEPARTMENT_CODE, de.DEPARTMENT_NAME, de.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, de.subject_count, de.total_enrollment, ds.avg_subject_codes, ds.stddev_subject_codes FROM DeptEng2021 de JOIN DeptSubjectStats ds ON de.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT * FROM CombinedDepts ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each academic year and department name where the term status is 'Previous' and for subjects in the "Engineering" school with total units greater than 1, provide the academic year, department name, number of unique subjects offered, minimum total units for those subjects, subject title, school name, academic year description, and the minimum total units in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the academic year, showing only rows where the academic year and department name match in both sets. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH AcademicYearDeptStats AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), EngineeringSubjects AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY s JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ata.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON s.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 1 ) SELECT ayds.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ayds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ayds.subject_count, ayds.min_total_units, es.SUBJECT_TITLE, es.SCHOOL_NAME, es.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, es.window_column FROM AcademicYearDeptStats ayds JOIN EngineeringSubjects es ON ayds.ACADEMIC_YEAR = es.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND ayds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = es.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ayds.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC, ayds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, es.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: Show the subject code, subject code description, department name, subject title, and the dense rank of each row partitioned by the school code and ordered by school code for each subject where the school code is not null and the subject title is not null, along with the course description, department name, subject title, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title for courses in the School of Engineering that are degree granting, for all subjects and courses where the subject code matches. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subject_dense_rank AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t0.SCHOOL_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_CODE IS NOT NULL AND t1.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL ), engineering_degree_courses AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.SUBJECT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT sdr.SUBJECT_CODE, sdr.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, sdr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sdr.SUBJECT_TITLE, sdr.window_column AS subject_dense_rank, edc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, edc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS edc_DEPARTMENT_NAME, edc.SUBJECT_TITLE AS edc_SUBJECT_TITLE, edc.window_column AS engineering_row_number FROM subject_dense_rank sdr JOIN engineering_degree_courses edc ON sdr.SUBJECT_CODE = edc.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For each academic year and department name where the number of enrolled students is greater than 5, give the number of unique subjects offered, the minimum start date of the academic term, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of courses offered by that department (considering only courses that are offered this year and have a non-null total units value), and also provide the department name. The columns should be: academic year, department name, subject count, minimum start date, total units range, total units variance, and total units standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccc.total_units) - MIN(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccc.total_units IS NOT NULL GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ), YearDeptSubjects AS ( SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT l.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_start_date FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON t.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT yds.ACADEMIC_YEAR, yds.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, yds.subject_count, yds.min_start_date, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev FROM YearDeptSubjects yds LEFT JOIN DeptUnitsStats dus ON yds.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY yds.ACADEMIC_YEAR, yds.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: For each organization and department code, what is the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of rooms assigned to that organization (considering only rooms with a non-null area and department code), and for rooms with area greater than 200, what is the building-room identifier, the DLC key, and the sum of room areas within each major use description group ordered by building-room? Please provide the organization name, department code, area variance, area standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), building-room, DLC key, and the sum of room areas within each major use description group, with results ordered by area variance descending and building-room. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH OrgRoomStats AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.DEPT_CODE, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA IS NOT NULL AND r.DEPT_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.DEPT_CODE ORDER BY area_variance DESC ), RoomAreaSums AS ( SELECT t2.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, SUM(t2.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.MAJOR_USE_DESC ORDER BY t2.BUILDING_ROOM) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.AREA > 200 ) SELECT ors.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ors.DEPT_CODE, ors.area_variance, ors.area_stddev, ras.BUILDING_ROOM, ras.DLC_KEY, ras.window_column FROM OrgRoomStats ors JOIN RoomAreaSums ras ON ors.ORGANIZATION_NAME = ras.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY ors.area_variance DESC, ras.BUILDING_ROOM;

question: For IAP subject activities with a maximum enrollment of 30, and for tip details where the material status key is 'RQ', show the activity title, enrollment type, prerequisites, term code, IAP term description, term start date, term end date, the minimum term start date over each term code group, the tip subject offered key, tip material key, subject ID, tip term description, academic year, and the average record count in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by academic year, ordered by term code and academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH IAPActivities AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t0.PREREQUISITES, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, min(t1.TERM_START_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.TERM_CODE ORDER BY t0.TERM_CODE) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 30 ), TipRQDetails AS ( SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(t0.RECORD_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_START_DATE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM TIP_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ) SELECT ia.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ia.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, ia.PREREQUISITES, ia.TERM_CODE, ia.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS IAP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, ia.TERM_START_DATE, ia.TERM_END_DATE, ia.window_column AS IAP_MIN_TERM_START_DATE, trd.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, trd.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, trd.SUBJECT_ID, trd.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS TIP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, trd.ACADEMIC_YEAR, trd.window_column AS TIP_AVG_RECORD_COUNT FROM IAPActivities ia JOIN TipRQDetails trd ON ia.TERM_CODE = trd.TERM_CODE ORDER BY ia.TERM_CODE, trd.ACADEMIC_YEAR

question: For each organization with a DLC key of 'D_MECHE', show the organization key, organization name, DLC name, and the rank of the organization within each DLC name group ordered by organization key, along with the space unit, the average, range, and variance of the HR department codes for the HR org units linked to that space unit and organization, considering only space units with a warehouse load date of '19-DEC-24' and HR org units with a warehouse load date of '03-DEC-24'. The results should display the organization key, organization name, DLC name, rank, space unit, average HR department code, HR department code range, and HR department code variance, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH org_ranked AS ( SELECT t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.DLC_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DLC_NAME ORDER BY t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.DLC_KEY = 'D_MECHE' ), space_hr_stats AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS avg_hr_dept_code, MAX(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) - MIN(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS hr_dept_code_range, VARIANCE(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS hr_dept_code_variance FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE su.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND hou.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '03-DEC-24' GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY hr_dept_code_range DESC ) SELECT org_ranked.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, org_ranked.ORGANIZATION_NAME, org_ranked.DLC_NAME, org_ranked.window_column, space_hr_stats.SPACE_UNIT, space_hr_stats.avg_hr_dept_code, space_hr_stats.hr_dept_code_range, space_hr_stats.hr_dept_code_variance FROM org_ranked LEFT JOIN space_hr_stats ON org_ranked.ORGANIZATION_NAME = space_hr_stats.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY org_ranked.DLC_NAME, org_ranked.window_column, space_hr_stats.hr_dept_code_range DESC

question: For each IAP subject that is not cancelled and has a non-null maximum enrollment and also has a maximum enrollment of 12, list the activity title, enrollment type, term description, subject title, number of enrolled students, offer department code, the dense rank over the offer department code ordered by offer department code, the responsible faculty MIT ID, and the average number of enrolled students in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the responsible faculty MIT ID and ordered by the number of enrolled students. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH iap_subjects_not_cancelled AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL ), iap_subjects_max_enrollment_12 AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID, AVG(t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY t2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ORDER BY t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 12 ) SELECT inc.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inc.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inc.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inc.SUBJECT_TITLE, inc.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inc.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, inc.window_column AS dense_rank_over_offer_dept_code, ime12.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID, ime12.window_column AS avg_num_enrolled_students_window FROM iap_subjects_not_cancelled inc JOIN iap_subjects_max_enrollment_12 ime12 ON inc.ACTIVITY_TITLE = ime12.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND inc.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = ime12.ENROLLMENT_TYPE AND inc.TERM_DESCRIPTION = ime12.TERM_DESCRIPTION AND inc.SUBJECT_TITLE = ime12.SUBJECT_TITLE AND inc.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = ime12.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS

question: For each department in the School of Engineering in term '2016SP' that is associated with an administrative department with total enrolled students greater than 100, list the department name, the variance of the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, the administrative department name, and the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering, ordered by the variance of enrolled students (descending) and then by total enrolled students (descending). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DepartmentVariance AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, scd.DEPARTMENT FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ), AdminDeptTotals AS ( SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100 ) SELECT dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dv.enrolled_students_variance, adt.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, adt.total_enrolled FROM DepartmentVariance dv JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON dv.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN AdminDeptTotals adt ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = adt.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dv.enrolled_students_variance DESC, adt.total_enrolled DESC;

question: For each organization that is assignable and has a department code above 100000, list the organization key, organization name, department name, the number of HR org units, the total of their department IDs, the department name, the average number of sub-departments, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of sub-departments associated with the department, ordered by organization key. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH OrgStats AS ( SELECT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS hr_org_unit_count, SUM(h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS total_department_id, f.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION f JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID > 100000 GROUP BY f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, f.DLC_KEY ), DeptSubDeptStats AS ( SELECT m.DLC_NAME, AVG(sub_dept_counts.num_sub_depts) AS avg_num_sub_departments, STDDEV(sub_dept_counts.num_sub_depts) AS stddev_num_sub_departments, m.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY JOIN ( SELECT h2.DLC_KEY, COUNT(*) AS num_sub_depts FROM HR_ORG_UNIT h2 WHERE h2.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'SUB DEPARTMENT' GROUP BY h2.DLC_KEY ) sub_dept_counts ON m.DLC_KEY = sub_dept_counts.DLC_KEY WHERE m.DLC_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME, m.DLC_KEY ORDER BY stddev_num_sub_departments DESC ) SELECT o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.hr_org_unit_count, o.total_department_id, d.DLC_NAME, d.avg_num_sub_departments, d.stddev_num_sub_departments FROM OrgStats o JOIN DeptSubDeptStats d ON o.DLC_KEY = d.DLC_KEY ORDER BY o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY;

question: List the subject title, department name, term code, number of reserve materials assigned, term description, academic year, and the running sum of academic years within each financial aid year group for the top 10 subject titles by number of reserve materials assigned, considering only academic terms where the term status is 'Previous', ordered by number of reserve materials assigned (descending) and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH TopSubjects AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_reserve_materials FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE ORDER BY num_reserve_materials DESC LIMIT 10 ), PreviousTerms AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT ts.SUBJECT_TITLE, ts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ts.TERM_CODE, ts.num_reserve_materials, pt.TERM_DESCRIPTION, pt.ACADEMIC_YEAR, pt.window_column FROM TopSubjects ts JOIN PreviousTerms pt ON ts.TERM_CODE = pt.TERM_CODE ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY num_reserve_materials DESC, SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For subjects offered in the term '2019FA' with more than 0 enrolled students, show the subject title, offer department name, department full name, number of enrolled students, the average number of enrolled students in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the school code, and for each subject's offer department, also show the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one associated course material. Present the results ordered by the subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
