SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_dept_name FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), subq2 AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, subq1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, subq1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, subq1.window_column, subq2.avg_enrollment, subq2.enrollment_stddev FROM subq1 LEFT JOIN subq2 ON subq1.join_dept_name = subq2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each organization with an organization level of 5 and for rooms on floor 2 that are associated via space unit code, show the organization name, organization key, description, space unit, space unit key, the average organization key within each organization key group ordered by space unit key, the building room, space usage, the HR org unit title, the department name, and the minimum access level in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the building component, ordered by organization name and building room. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH OrgLevel5 AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.SPACE_UNIT, t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ), RoomsFloor2 AS ( SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.SPACE_USAGE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(t0.ACCESS_LEVEL) OVER (ORDER BY t0.BUILDING_COMPONENT ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2 ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.DESCRIPTION, o.SPACE_UNIT, o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, o.window_column AS org_window_column, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.SPACE_USAGE, r.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, r.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, r.window_column AS room_window_column FROM OrgLevel5 o JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY JOIN RoomsFloor2 r ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = r.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY ORGANIZATION_NAME, BUILDING_ROOM;

question: For all subject offerings in the academic term with term code '2017FA', show the subject title, the offer department name, the term description, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title. Additionally, for each matching course material detail, provide the material status key, ISBN, material key, the course number description, and the maximum number of enrolled students for each row considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by material key, where the subject and term code match between the subject offering and the course material. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.TERM_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON s.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.ISBN, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_enrolled_students FROM TIP_DETAIL t0 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL AND t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.window_column, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2.ISBN, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s2.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, s2.max_enrolled_students FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.TERM_CODE = s2.TERM_CODE

question: For each department name, provide the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in library subjects that have a matching master subject ID in the TIP subject offerings (considering only departments with more than 0 enrolled students in both tables), along with the administrative department name and the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering (where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 100), for departments where the department name matches and the department code is the same. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH LibraryStats AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_students_variance, STDDEV(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_students_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = t.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY library_students_variance DESC ), EngineeringAdminTotals AS ( SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100 ) SELECT ls.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ls.library_students_variance, ls.library_students_stddev, eat.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, eat.total_enrolled FROM LibraryStats ls JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ls.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN EngineeringAdminTotals eat ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = eat.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: For each academic year where the term status is 'Previous' and for each subject category with maximum enrollment greater than 10 in that year, show the term code, term description, academic year, the running sum of academic years within each financial aid year group, the subject category key, the number of unique subjects, and the minimum academic term start date, ordered by academic year and subject category key. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH AcademicTermWindows AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ), SubjectCategoryStats AS ( SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT i.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT atw.TERM_CODE, atw.TERM_DESCRIPTION, atw.ACADEMIC_YEAR, atw.window_column, scs.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, scs.subject_count, scs.min_term_start_date FROM AcademicTermWindows atw JOIN SubjectCategoryStats scs ON atw.ACADEMIC_YEAR = scs.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY atw.ACADEMIC_YEAR, scs.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY

question: For academic terms where the term status indicator is 'P', show the term code, the term parameter, the term description, the academic year, the term start date, and the average academic year in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the term indicator and ordered by the term start date, along with the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in offered subjects for the corresponding academic year. List the results ordered by academic year and term code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH AcademicTermDetails AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_PARAMETER, t2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, AVG(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER ( PARTITION BY t1.TERM_INDICATOR ORDER BY t0.TERM_START_DATE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_INDICATOR = 'P' ), AcademicYearVariation AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT atd.TERM_CODE, atd.TERM_PARAMETER, atd.TERM_DESCRIPTION, atd.ACADEMIC_YEAR, atd.TERM_START_DATE, atd.window_column, ayv.coefficient_of_variation FROM AcademicTermDetails atd JOIN AcademicYearVariation ayv ON atd.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY atd.ACADEMIC_YEAR, atd.TERM_CODE;

question: For courses in the School of Engineering that are degree granting, show the course description, department name, subject code, subject title, and the minimum total units in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the course number, along with the academic year, the number of unique subjects offered, and the minimum total units for each academic year and department name where the term status is 'Previous', for matching department names. List the course description, department name, subject code, subject title, windowed minimum total units, academic year, subject count, and minimum total units in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, MIN(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_CODE = t2.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT s1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.window_column, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.subject_count, s2.min_total_units FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For subjects offered in the term "2012SU", show the subject title, subject key, offer department name, subject enrollment number, subject offered summary key, the average subject enrollment number within each subject key group, subject ID, academic year, term description, and the minimum number of enrolled students in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row, ordered by offer department name and academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.SUBJECT_KEY, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY, AVG(t0.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SUBJECT_KEY ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, MIN(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.SUBJECT_KEY, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, s1.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY, s1.window_column AS avg_subject_enrollment_number, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.window_column AS min_num_enrolled_students_window FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_TITLE = s2.SUBJECT_TITLE AND s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR

question: For each room with area greater than 200, what are the building-room identifier, the organization name, the DLC key, the sum of room areas within each major use description group (ordered by building-room), and for the corresponding DLC key, what is the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of organizations associated with that DLC key (considering only DLC keys that are not null and organizations that have a non-null organization name)? Present the results ordered by building-room. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH dlc_org_stats AS ( SELECT fdlk.DLC_KEY, MAX(org_count) - MIN(org_count) AS org_count_range, VARIANCE(org_count) AS org_count_variance, STDDEV(org_count) AS org_count_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fdlk JOIN ( SELECT fo.DLC_KEY, COUNT(*) AS org_count FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fo.DLC_KEY ) org_stats ON fdlk.DLC_KEY = org_stats.DLC_KEY WHERE fdlk.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fdlk.DLC_KEY ORDER BY org_count_range DESC ), room_area_stats AS ( SELECT t2.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, SUM(t2.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.MAJOR_USE_DESC ORDER BY t2.BUILDING_ROOM) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.AREA > 200 ) SELECT ras.BUILDING_ROOM, ras.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ras.DLC_KEY, ras.window_column, dos.org_count_range, dos.org_count_variance, dos.org_count_stddev FROM room_area_stats ras LEFT JOIN dlc_org_stats dos ON ras.DLC_KEY = dos.DLC_KEY ORDER BY ras.BUILDING_ROOM;

question: For each department, provide the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of unique subject codes associated with its courses that are offered by degree-granting departments, and for each subject offered in the academic year 2024 with total units equal to 12 in that department, show the subject code, subject number, subject title, total units, and the row number within the department ordered by subject code. The columns should be: department name, average subject codes, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subject codes, subject code, subject number, subject title, total units, and row number within department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes FROM ( SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT ) course_subjects JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON course_subjects.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), Subjects2024 AS ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.avg_subject_codes, dss.stddev_subject_codes, s24.SUBJECT_CODE, s24.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s24.SUBJECT_TITLE, s24.TOTAL_UNITS, s24.window_column FROM DeptSubjectStats dss JOIN Subjects2024 s24 ON dss.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s24.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s24.window_column

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units, and for subjects offered in the term 2019FA from the same department, show the subject code, subject number, subject title, department name, term description, the rank of each 2024 subject within its department ordered by subject code, the 2019FA subject ID, number of enrolled students in 2019FA, department full name, and the row number of each 2019FA subject within its department name group ordered by subject ID. Order the results by department name, subject code, and 2019FA subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subjects2024_12Units AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), Subjects2019FA AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ) SELECT s24.SUBJECT_CODE, s24.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s24.SUBJECT_TITLE, s24.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s24.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s24.window_column AS department_rank_2024, s19.SUBJECT_ID, s19.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s19.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s19.window_column AS department_rownum_2019 FROM Subjects2024_12Units s24 JOIN Subjects2019FA s19 ON s24.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s19.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s24.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s24.SUBJECT_CODE, s19.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each subject category name and enrollment type where the maximum enrollment is greater than 10, and for each school, give the subject category name, enrollment type, number of activities, minimum fee, school name, average total units, variance of total units, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for subjects offered in the current academic term. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH CategoryEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS activity_count, MIN(d.FEE) AS min_fee FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ), SchoolUnitStats AS ( SELECT ss.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON atp.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT ces.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, ces.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, ces.activity_count, ces.min_fee, sus.SCHOOL_NAME, sus.avg_total_units, sus.total_units_variance, sus.total_units_stddev FROM CategoryEnrollmentStats ces JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d ON ces.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = ( SELECT c2.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME FROM IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c2 WHERE c2.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY ) AND ces.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON d.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE JOIN SchoolUnitStats sus ON ss.SCHOOL_NAME = sus.SCHOOL_NAME GROUP BY ces.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, ces.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, ces.activity_count, ces.min_fee, sus.SCHOOL_NAME, sus.avg_total_units, sus.total_units_variance, sus.total_units_stddev ORDER BY ces.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, ces.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, sus.SCHOOL_NAME

question: For the top 10 material statuses by the number of materials, show the material status description, the count of materials for each status, the associated library material status, and the count of reserve catalog items for term code '2009SP', ordered by the material count and then by the reserve count in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH MaterialStatusCounts AS ( SELECT tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count, tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS tms ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY GROUP BY tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY material_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), LibraryReserveCounts AS ( SELECT lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserve_count, lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY FROM LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS lms JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY WHERE lrmd.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY reserve_count DESC ) SELECT msc.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, msc.material_count, lrc.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, lrc.reserve_count FROM MaterialStatusCounts msc JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = msc.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lrmd.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID AND lrmd.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE JOIN LibraryReserveCounts lrc ON lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lrc.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY GROUP BY msc.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, msc.material_count, lrc.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, lrc.reserve_count ORDER BY msc.material_count DESC, lrc.reserve_count DESC;

question: For each department, show the department name, the average number of enrolled students in offered subjects, the variance of the number of enrolled students, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students (considering only degree-granting departments and subjects with more than 0 enrolled students), and the total number of students enrolled in courses offered by that department in the School of Engineering where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 50. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC ), EngineeringDeptTotals AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_variance, des.enrollment_stddev, edt.total_enrollment FROM DeptEnrollmentStats des JOIN EngineeringDeptTotals edt ON des.DEPARTMENT_NAME = edt.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY edt.total_enrollment DESC;

question: For each DLC and academic year where the DLC name matches the department name and the term status is 'Previous', list the DLC key, DLC name, coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of rooms assigned to organizations in that DLC (considering only rooms with an area greater than 0), academic year, department name, number of unique subjects offered, and the minimum total units for those subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DLC_CV AS ( SELECT FODK.DLC_KEY, FO.DLC_NAME, STDDEV(FR.AREA)/NULLIF(AVG(FR.AREA),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY FODK JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION FO ON FODK.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS FR ON FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FR.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE FR.AREA > 0 GROUP BY FODK.DLC_KEY, FO.DLC_NAME HAVING AVG(FR.AREA) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), AY_DEPT_SUBJECTS AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT d.DLC_KEY, d.DLC_NAME, d.coefficient_of_variation, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.subject_count, a.min_total_units FROM DLC_CV d JOIN AY_DEPT_SUBJECTS a ON d.DLC_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d.DLC_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each academic year, show the academic year, academic year description, the variance of the record count of tip details for terms that are current or previous terms, the range of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered for terms that are not the current term, and the variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered for terms that are not the current term. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH RecordCountVariance AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC ), EnrolledStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC ) SELECT rcv.ACADEMIC_YEAR, rcv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, rcv.record_count_variance, es.enrolled_range, es.enrolled_variance FROM RecordCountVariance rcv JOIN EnrolledStats es ON rcv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = es.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY rcv.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC;

question: For subjects offered in the term '2016SP' with a total of 12 units, show the subject title from the offered summary, the department name from the department table, the subject description from the course catalog, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the subject title from the offered summary. Additionally, for each such subject, include the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses from the same department that have at least one associated course material. Present the subject title, department name, subject description, windowed row number, average enrollment, and enrollment standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), in that order, ordered by department name and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_CODE FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_stddev DESC ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION, s1.window_column, s2.avg_enrollment, s2.enrollment_stddev FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2022 with a total of 12 units, show the subject code, subject number, department name, subject title, term description, total units, and the average subject enrollment number in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by department code and ordered by total units, along with the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in library subjects that have a matching master subject ID in the TIP subject offerings for the same department, considering only departments with more than 0 enrolled students in both tables. List the subject code, subject number, department name, subject title, term description, total units, windowed average subject enrollment number, library students variance, and library students standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH SubjectStats AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) OVER ( PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), LibraryStats AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_students_variance, STDDEV(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_students_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = t.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY library_students_variance DESC ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.TOTAL_UNITS, s.window_column, ls.library_students_variance, ls.library_students_stddev FROM SubjectStats s JOIN LibraryStats ls ON s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ls.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_NUMBER

question: For subjects that are offered in the term 2019FA and also have the same subject title and department name as subjects in the academic term 2009SP, show the subject ID, subject title, number of enrolled students, department name, department full name, the row number within each department name group ordered by subject ID for 2019FA, the total units for 2009SP, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title for 2009SP, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subjects2019FA AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ), Subjects2009SP AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' ) SELECT s19.SUBJECT_ID, s19.SUBJECT_TITLE, s19.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s19.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s19.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s19.window_column AS window_column_2019FA, s09.TOTAL_UNITS, s09.window_column AS window_column_2009SP FROM Subjects2019FA s19 JOIN Subjects2009SP s09 ON s19.SUBJECT_TITLE = s09.SUBJECT_TITLE AND s19.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s09.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s19.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s19.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For subjects offered in the 2012SU term with a total of 1 unit, show the subject title from the summary, the course number from the offered table, the subject title from the offered summary, the department name from the summary, the offer department name from the offered summary, the row number within each department name group ordered by subject title from the summary, and for each department, also provide the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and at least 1 enrolled student). List the results ordered by department name and row number. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE AS summary_subject_title, t1.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE AS offered_summary_subject_title, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t2.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS = 1 ), subq2 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ) SELECT subq1.summary_subject_title, subq1.COURSE_NUMBER, subq1.offered_summary_subject_title, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, subq1.window_column, subq2.avg_total_units, subq2.stddev_total_units FROM subq1 LEFT JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.window_column;

question: For academic term parameters where the term indicator is 'C', show the term parameter, the term code, the academic year, the department name of the offered subject, the running sum of academic years within each department, and for each department, also provide the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects that have at least one enrolled student and have required course materials. Present the results ordered by department name and academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ), TermDeptWindow AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_PARAMETER, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_INDICATOR = 'C' ) SELECT tdw.TERM_PARAMETER, tdw.TERM_CODE, tdw.ACADEMIC_YEAR, tdw.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tdw.window_column, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance FROM TermDeptWindow tdw JOIN DeptUnitsStats dus ON tdw.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY tdw.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tdw.ACADEMIC_YEAR

question: For courses in the School of Engineering that are degree granting and belong to departments that, in the Fall term of 2022, offered at least one subject with more than 3 lecture units, show the course description, department name, subject code, subject title, the minimum total units in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the course number, the highest number of lecture units among its offered subjects, and the start date of the term. List the results ordered by department name and subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, MIN(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_CODE = t2.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, at2.TERM_START_DATE FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 ON td.TERM_CODE = at2.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at2.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) > 3 ) SELECT s1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.window_column, s2.max_lecture_units, s2.TERM_START_DATE FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: List all subjects that either have at least 5 enrolled students or are offered in the term 2019FA, showing for each subject: subject ID, subject title, number of enrolled students, term code, material status key, ISBN, row number within each material status group (for subjects with at least 5 enrolled students), department name, department full name, row number within each department name group (for subjects offered in 2019FA), and the reason for inclusion ('AtLeast5Enrolled' for subjects with at least 5 enrolled students and 'Offered2019FA' for subjects offered in 2019FA). The columns are: subject ID, subject title, number of enrolled students, term code, material status key, ISBN, window column, department name, department full name, and reason. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ISBN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ), CombinedSubjects AS ( SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s1.ISBN, s1.window_column, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, 'AtLeast5Enrolled' AS Reason FROM Subq1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, NULL AS TERM_CODE, NULL AS TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, NULL AS ISBN, s2.window_column, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, 'Offered2019FA' AS Reason FROM Subq2 s2 ) SELECT * FROM CombinedSubjects ORDER BY SUBJECT_ID;

question: For subjects with an enrollment type of "Advance sign-up required" and a maximum enrollment of 12, show the subject's activity title, term code, maximum enrollment, term description, term start date, subject title, number of enrolled students, the row number within each subject title group ordered by activity title, and the dense rank of each activity considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the academic year, including only those where the academic term has a non-null term description and there is at least one associated TIP material. List the columns in the following order: activity title, term code, maximum enrollment, term description, term start date, subject title, number of enrolled students, row number within subject title, and dense rank by academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Sub1 AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column, t2.SUBJECT_ID FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 12 ), Sub2 AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 12 AND t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL ) SELECT s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.MAX_ENROLLMENT, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.TERM_START_DATE, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.window_column AS row_number_within_subject_title, s2.window_column AS dense_rank_academic_year FROM Sub1 s1 JOIN Sub2 s2 ON s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE = s2.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND s1.TERM_CODE = s2.TERM_CODE

question: For each academic year and department name where the number of enrolled students is greater than 5, what are the academic year, academic year description, geometric mean of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during that year (considering only subjects with more than zero enrolled students), department name, number of unique subjects offered, and the minimum start date of the academic term? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH GeometricMeanEnrollment AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_enrollment DESC ), SubjectCountMinStartDate AS ( SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT l.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_start_date FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON t.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT gme.ACADEMIC_YEAR, gme.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gme.geometric_mean_enrollment, scmsd.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, scmsd.subject_count, scmsd.min_start_date FROM GeometricMeanEnrollment gme JOIN SubjectCountMinStartDate scmsd ON gme.ACADEMIC_YEAR = scmsd.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY gme.geometric_mean_enrollment DESC, scmsd.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: For subjects offered in the term '2022FA' with a total of 12 units, show the subject title from the summary, the department name from the course description, the dense rank of each subject considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the subject code from the course catalog, and for each such subject's department, provide the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for courses offered by that department. List the results ordered by department name and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subjects2022FA12Units AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), DepartmentUnitsStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.window_column, d.total_units_range, d.total_units_variance, d.total_units_stddev FROM Subjects2022FA12Units s JOIN DepartmentUnitsStats d ON s.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: List, for all subjects, either (1) the activity title, term code, maximum enrollment, term description, term start date, subject title, number of enrolled students, and row number within each subject title group ordered by activity title for subjects with an enrollment type of "Advance sign-up required" and a maximum enrollment of 12, or (2) the subject title, the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one enrolled student and have a material status of 'U'. Indicate the reason for inclusion as 'AdvanceSignUp' for the first case and 'EnrolledStats' for the second case. The columns are: activity title, term code, maximum enrollment, term description, term start date, subject title, number of enrolled students, row number, enrolled range, enrolled variance, and reason. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH AdvanceSignUpSubjects AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 12 ), EnrolledStats AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL d JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC ), CombinedSubjects AS ( SELECT a.ACTIVITY_TITLE, a.TERM_CODE, a.MAX_ENROLLMENT, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, a.TERM_START_DATE, a.SUBJECT_TITLE, a.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, a.window_column, NULL AS enrolled_range, NULL AS enrolled_variance, 'AdvanceSignUp' AS Reason FROM AdvanceSignUpSubjects a UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS ACTIVITY_TITLE, NULL AS TERM_CODE, NULL AS MAX_ENROLLMENT, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS TERM_START_DATE, e.SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, NULL AS window_column, e.enrolled_range, e.enrolled_variance, 'EnrolledStats' AS Reason FROM EnrolledStats e ) SELECT * FROM CombinedSubjects ORDER BY SUBJECT_TITLE, Reason;

question: For each subject that is present in both the term "2010FA" and the term with code "2025FA", show the subject ID, the term description from ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL for 2010FA, the material status key from TIP_DETAIL for 2010FA, the academic year from ACADEMIC_TERMS for 2010FA, the rank of each subject within each academic year group ordered by subject ID for 2010FA, the subject title for 2025FA, the offering department name for 2025FA, the number of enrolled students for 2025FA, the term description for 2025FA, the academic year for 2025FA, the term start date for 2025FA, the term end date for 2025FA, the term parameter for 2025FA, and the minimum number of enrolled students over each offering department for 2025FA, ordered by subject ID and offering department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subject2010FA AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2010FA' ), Subject2025FA AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ) SELECT s10.SUBJECT_ID, s10.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS TERM_DESCRIPTION_2010FA, s10.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s10.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_2010FA, s10.window_column, s25.SUBJECT_TITLE, s25.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s25.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s25.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS TERM_DESCRIPTION_2025FA, s25.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_2025FA, s25.TERM_START_DATE, s25.TERM_END_DATE, s25.TERM_PARAMETER, s25.min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM Subject2010FA s10 JOIN Subject2025FA s25 ON s10.SUBJECT_ID = s25.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY s10.SUBJECT_ID, s25.OFFER_DEPT_NAME

question: For each department name and its corresponding facility organization key in the Provost Area, provide the number of organizations, the minimum department hierarchy level 3 code, and for that facility organization, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of HR organization units per facility organization, considering only those with a non-null DLC key and where the hierarchy type is 'Standard Hierarchy'. The columns should be department name, facility organization key, number of organizations, minimum department hierarchy level 3 code, range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of HR organization units per facility organization, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH provost_area_dept_orgs AS ( SELECT m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_CODE) AS min_level3_code FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ), facility_org_hr_stats AS ( SELECT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, MAX(hr_unit_count) - MIN(hr_unit_count) AS org_unit_count_range, VARIANCE(hr_unit_count) AS org_unit_count_variance, STDDEV(hr_unit_count) AS org_unit_count_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m ON f.DLC_KEY = m.DLC_KEY JOIN ( SELECT h.DLC_KEY, COUNT(*) AS hr_unit_count FROM HR_ORG_UNIT h WHERE h.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY h.DLC_KEY ) AS hr_stats ON m.DLC_KEY = hr_stats.DLC_KEY WHERE f.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' GROUP BY f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY org_unit_count_range DESC ) SELECT p.DLC_NAME, p.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, p.org_count, p.min_level3_code, f.org_unit_count_range, f.org_unit_count_variance, f.org_unit_count_stddev FROM provost_area_dept_orgs p JOIN facility_org_hr_stats f ON p.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY;

question: For each department in the Provost Area, show the department code, department name, school area name, and the rank of each department within its school area based on department code, along with the space unit code, organization name, HR department name from space units with a space unit key greater than 100000, and the sum of space unit keys within each warehouse load date group, for those space units whose HR department name matches the department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptRanks AS ( SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 INNER JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' ), SpaceUnitSums AS ( SELECT t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE ORDER BY t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM SPACE_UNIT t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000 ) SELECT dr.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, dr.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dr.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, dr.window_column AS DEPT_RANK_IN_SCHOOL_AREA, sus.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, sus.ORGANIZATION_NAME, sus.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS SPACE_UNIT_HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sus.window_column AS SPACE_UNIT_KEY_SUM FROM DeptRanks dr JOIN SpaceUnitSums sus ON dr.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = sus.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For IAP subject activities in the term "2021JA" that are not cancelled and have a maximum enrollment of 30, show the activity title, enrollment type, calendar date, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by activity title, and the dense rank of each activity considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the academic year from the academic terms table, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH IAP_Activities_2021JA AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.CALENDAR_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN TIME_DAY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' ), IAP_Activities_Max30 AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 30 ) SELECT a21.ACTIVITY_TITLE, a21.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, a21.CALENDAR_DATE, a21.window_column AS row_number_window, a30.window_column AS dense_rank_window FROM IAP_Activities_2021JA a21 JOIN IAP_Activities_Max30 a30 ON a21.ACTIVITY_TITLE = a30.ACTIVITY_TITLE ORDER BY a21.ACTIVITY_TITLE;

question: For each employee type and department name where the student year is 'G' and the department is in the School of Engineering with more than 50 students enrolled in its courses, provide the employee type, department name, number of people, minimum MIT ID, total number of students enrolled in courses offered by that department, and the normalized person count rounded (number of people divided by total enrollment), listing the results in descending order of normalized person count.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(sp.MIT_ID) AS person_count, MIN(sp.MIT_ID) AS min_mit_id FROM SE_PERSON sp JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ) SELECT sq1.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, sq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sq1.person_count, sq1.min_mit_id, sq2.total_enrollment, ROUND(sq1.person_count / NULLIF(sq2.total_enrollment, 0), 2) AS normalized_person_count FROM Subquery1 sq1 JOIN Subquery2 sq2 ON sq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY normalized_person_count DESC;

question: For subjects offered in the term with code '2025FA' that have at least one reserved material with status 'U', show the subject ID, subject title, offering department name, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, term start date, term end date, term parameter, the minimum number of enrolled students over each offering department, and for each subject, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of reserved materials per subject, ordered by offering department and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH SubjectOfferings2025FA AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), ReservedMaterialStats AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(material_count) - MIN(material_count) AS reserved_material_range, VARIANCE(material_count) AS reserved_material_variance, STDDEV(material_count) AS reserved_material_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED s JOIN ( SELECT LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL WHERE LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ) d ON s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY reserved_material_range DESC ) SELECT so.SUBJECT_ID, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, so.TERM_DESCRIPTION, so.ACADEMIC_YEAR, so.TERM_START_DATE, so.TERM_END_DATE, so.TERM_PARAMETER, so.min_enrolled_students_per_dept, rms.reserved_material_range, rms.reserved_material_variance, rms.reserved_material_stddev FROM SubjectOfferings2025FA so JOIN ReservedMaterialStats rms ON so.SUBJECT_TITLE = rms.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, so.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For library reserve materials with material status key 'U' and subjects that have more than 0 enrolled students, show the subject ID, library course instructor key, term description, academic year, term start date, the minimum academic year in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by library reserve catalog key, the course number, course number description, number of enrolled students, and the dense rank over the material status key ordered by material status key. Present the results ordered by subject ID and academic year descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t2.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, MIN(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT t1.COURSE_NUMBER, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) AS window_column, t1.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.TERM_START_DATE, s1.window_column AS min_academic_year_window, s2.COURSE_NUMBER, s2.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.window_column AS dense_rank_material_status FROM Subq1 s1 JOIN Subq2 s2 ON s1.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = s2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY AND s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC;

question: For each room with access level 1, show the building room, building component, floor, space usage, space unit code, the corresponding organization's name, the average floor within each space usage group ordered by floor, the building name, the average, range, and variance of the room areas for rooms in that building where the building type is 'ACADEMIC' and the room area is greater than 40, and calculate the normalized floor to area ratio (average floor divided by average room area in that building), ordered by the normalized floor to area ratio in descending order.
SQL: WITH BuildingRoomStats AS ( SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_room_area, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS room_area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS room_area_variance FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND r.AREA > 40 GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY room_area_range DESC ), RoomAccessStats AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.BUILDING_COMPONENT, t1.FLOOR, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(t1.FLOOR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SPACE_USAGE ORDER BY t1.FLOOR) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 ) SELECT ras.BUILDING_ROOM, ras.BUILDING_COMPONENT, ras.FLOOR, ras.SPACE_USAGE, ras.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, ras.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ras.window_column, brs.BUILDING_NAME, brs.avg_room_area, brs.room_area_range, brs.room_area_variance, ROUND(ras.window_column / NULLIF(brs.avg_room_area, 0), 2) AS normalized_floor_to_area FROM RoomAccessStats ras JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON ras.BUILDING_ROOM = fr.BUILDING_ROOM JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN BuildingRoomStats brs ON fb.BUILDING_NAME = brs.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY normalized_floor_to_area DESC;

question: For courses in the School of Engineering that are degree granting, and for each subject offered in the term with the description "Fall Term 2024-2025" by the same department, show the course description, department name, the dense rank of each course considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the department's budget code, the subject offered key, subject title, offering department name, the term description, and the rank of each subject within its offering department ordered by subject offered key. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' ) SELECT s1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column AS course_dense_rank, s2.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.window_column AS subject_rank_within_dept FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE

question: For each academic year, list the academic year, the academic year description, the geometric mean of the number of library reserve material details per subject offered (for records where the material status is 'U' and the academic term is a regular term), the geometric mean of the degree year from all academic terms where the degree year is greater than 1900, and the reason for inclusion ('MaterialsPerSubject' for the geometric mean of materials per subject and 'DegreeYear' for the geometric mean of degree year). Show the academic year, academic year description, geometric mean of materials per subject, geometric mean of degree year, and reason, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH GeometricMeanMaterialsPerSubject AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(material_count))) AS geometric_mean_materials_per_subject FROM ( SELECT LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count, LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE ) sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON sub.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), GeometricMeanDegreeYear AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(ACADEMIC_TERMS.DEGREE_YEAR))) AS geometric_mean_degree_year FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.DEGREE_YEAR > 1900 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), CombinedGeometricMeans AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, geometric_mean_materials_per_subject, NULL AS geometric_mean_degree_year, 'MaterialsPerSubject' AS Reason FROM GeometricMeanMaterialsPerSubject UNION ALL SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS geometric_mean_materials_per_subject, geometric_mean_degree_year, 'DegreeYear' AS Reason FROM GeometricMeanDegreeYear ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, geometric_mean_materials_per_subject, geometric_mean_degree_year, Reason FROM CombinedGeometricMeans ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, Reason;

question: List, for each academic year, the subject ID, library course instructor key, term description, academic year, term start date, the minimum academic year in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by library reserve catalog key, the academic year description, the average record count, and the variance of the record count of TIP materials for all terms in that year where the term status is not null and the TIP material status key is not 'NM'. If there are academic years with TIP material statistics but no library reserve materials with material status key 'U', include those years with nulls for the library reserve columns. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH LibraryReserveU AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t2.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, MIN(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER ( ORDER BY t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ), TipMaterialStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_record_count, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS IS NOT NULL AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT lru.SUBJECT_ID, lru.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, lru.TERM_DESCRIPTION, lru.ACADEMIC_YEAR, lru.TERM_START_DATE, lru.window_column, tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, tms.avg_record_count, tms.record_count_variance FROM LibraryReserveU lru LEFT JOIN TipMaterialStats tms ON lru.ACADEMIC_YEAR = tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_ID, NULL AS LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS TERM_START_DATE, NULL AS window_column, tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, tms.avg_record_count, tms.record_count_variance FROM TipMaterialStats tms WHERE tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR NOT IN (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM LibraryReserveU) ) SELECT SUBJECT_ID, LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_START_DATE, window_column, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, avg_record_count, record_count_variance FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each subject that has at least one enrolled student and is offered in the term '2016SP' with a school code of 'E', show the subject title, the number of enrolled students, the term code from the library subject offered table, the tip material status key, the total units from the subject offered summary, the average number of enrolled students within each subject title group ordered by total units, the department name, the course description, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH EnrolledSubjects AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.TERM_CODE, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_enrolled_students, lso.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID INNER JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), Subjects2016SP AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.SUBJECT_ID FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t0.SCHOOL_CODE = 'E' ) SELECT es.SUBJECT_TITLE, es.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, es.TERM_CODE, es.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, es.TOTAL_UNITS, es.avg_enrolled_students, s16.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s16.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s16.window_column FROM EnrolledSubjects es JOIN Subjects2016SP s16 ON es.SUBJECT_ID = s16.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY es.SUBJECT_TITLE, es.TOTAL_UNITS

question: For the top 10 subject titles by the number of reserved library materials for subjects offered in the term '2009SP', display each subject title, the offering department name, the count of reserved materials, the academic year, the department name, the average of the total units, and the variance of the total units for subjects offered in regular terms, with the columns shown in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH avg_var_units AS ( SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY var_total_units DESC ), top_reserved_subjects AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY reserved_materials DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT trs.SUBJECT_TITLE, trs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, trs.reserved_materials, avu.ACADEMIC_YEAR, avu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, avu.avg_total_units, avu.var_total_units FROM top_reserved_subjects trs LEFT JOIN avg_var_units avu ON trs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = avu.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY trs.reserved_materials DESC, avu.var_total_units DESC;

question: For rooms located on floor 2 with an access level of 2, show the building room identifier, the room number, the major use description, the building name, the building type, the city, the state, and the minimum floor number in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the building key, along with, for each academic year in which a course is scheduled in that room and has library reserve materials with a material status of 'U', the academic year, the academic year description, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for all such library reserve materials offered in that year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH RoomInfo AS ( SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.ROOM, t0.MAJOR_USE_DESC, t1.BUILDING_NAME, t1.BUILDING_TYPE, t2.CITY, t2.STATE, MIN(t0.FLOOR) OVER (ORDER BY t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY FROM FCLT_ROOMS t0 JOIN FCLT_BUILDING t1 ON t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS t2 ON t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2 AND t0.ACCESS_LEVEL = 2 ), YearlyLibraryStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE HAVING AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), CombinedRoomLibrary AS ( SELECT RoomInfo.BUILDING_ROOM, RoomInfo.ROOM, RoomInfo.MAJOR_USE_DESC, RoomInfo.BUILDING_NAME, RoomInfo.BUILDING_TYPE, RoomInfo.CITY, RoomInfo.STATE, RoomInfo.window_column, YearlyLibraryStats.ACADEMIC_YEAR, YearlyLibraryStats.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, YearlyLibraryStats.coefficient_of_variation FROM RoomInfo JOIN YearlyLibraryStats ON RoomInfo.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = YearlyLibraryStats.MEET_PLACE ) SELECT * FROM CombinedRoomLibrary ORDER BY BUILDING_ROOM, ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each subject code where the department is degree granting and the subject is scheduled in a building during the fall term, show the subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, the rank of the subject code within each school name group ordered by subject code, the building key, the average total units, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for all subjects scheduled in rooms of that building during the fall term. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DegreeGrantingSubjects AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), BuildingSubjectUnits AS ( SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ) SELECT dgs.SUBJECT_CODE, dgs.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, dgs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dgs.SCHOOL_NAME, dgs.window_column, bsu.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, bsu.avg_total_units, bsu.stddev_total_units FROM DegreeGrantingSubjects dgs JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON dgs.SUBJECT_CODE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON ccso.MEET_PLACE = fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY JOIN BuildingSubjectUnits bsu ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = bsu.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' ORDER BY dgs.SCHOOL_NAME, dgs.window_column, bsu.stddev_total_units DESC

question: For each subject offered in the Fall term of 2022, show the subject title, department name, term code, academic year, the average academic year within each academic year group ordered by term start date, as well as the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department (considering only departments that grant degrees and courses that are at the graduate level). Present the subject title, department name, term code, academic year, average academic year, range of enrolled students, and variance of enrolled students, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Sub1 AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.TERM_CODE, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY a.TERM_START_DATE) AS avg_academic_year FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON ata.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON a.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE WHERE a.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ), Sub2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.avg_academic_year, s2.enrolled_range, s2.enrolled_variance FROM Sub1 s1 LEFT JOIN Sub2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.TERM_CODE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE
