SQL: WITH DegreeGrantingDeptCourses AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ), EngineeringDeptEnrollment AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ) SELECT dgc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dgc.SCHOOL_NAME, dgc.course_count, dgc.min_cip_code, ede.total_enrollment FROM DegreeGrantingDeptCourses dgc JOIN EngineeringDeptEnrollment ede ON dgc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ede.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND dgc.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering';

question: For subjects offered in the term '2016SP' with a total of 12 units, show the subject title from the offered summary, the department name from the department table, the subject description from the course catalog, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the subject title from the offered summary, and for each department, also provide the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students in the year 2017). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptEnrolledStats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2017%' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ), SubjectWindowInfo AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) SELECT swi.SUBJECT_TITLE, swi.DEPARTMENT_NAME, swi.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION, swi.window_column, des.enrolled_students_variance, des.enrolled_students_stddev FROM SubjectWindowInfo swi JOIN DeptEnrolledStats des ON swi.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each course in the SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION table with a department code of 6, and for each academic year and department name where the term status is 'Previous', show the course, course description, department name, school name, program code, program title, category code, category title, four digit code, four digit title, the minimum warehouse load date from the CIP table over each category code group, the academic year, the number of unique subjects offered, and the minimum total units for those subjects, ordered by category code and academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Sub1 AS ( SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.PROGRAM_CODE, c.PROGRAM_TITLE, c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY c.CATEGORY_CODE) AS min_warehouse_load_date FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION s JOIN CIP c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT = 6 ), Sub2 AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT s1.COURSE, s1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.PROGRAM_CODE, s1.PROGRAM_TITLE, s1.CATEGORY_CODE, s1.CATEGORY_TITLE, s1.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, s1.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, s1.min_warehouse_load_date, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.subject_count, s2.min_total_units FROM Sub1 s1 JOIN Sub2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.CATEGORY_CODE, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR

question: For subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering with a total of at least 6 units, show the subject code, subject title, department name, and the running sum of total units within each grade type, along with the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and offered in the 'Engineering' school). Present the results ordered by subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.GRADE_TYPE, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.total_units_range, s2.total_units_variance, s2.total_units_stddev FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For subjects offered in the term '2016SP' with a total of 12 units that are also among the top 10 subject titles by the number of reserved library materials for subjects offered in the term '2009SP', show the subject title from the offered summary, the department name from the department table, the subject description from the course catalog, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the subject title from the offered summary, the offering department name from the top reserved materials, and the count of reserved materials, ordered by the subject title and the count of reserved materials in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subjects2016SP12Units AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION, t0.SUBJECT_ID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), TopSubjects2009SP AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials, s.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY reserved_materials DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT s2016.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2016.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2016.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION, s2016.window_column, t2009.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t2009.reserved_materials FROM Subjects2016SP12Units s2016 JOIN TopSubjects2009SP t2009 ON s2016.SUBJECT_ID = t2009.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY s2016.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2009.reserved_materials DESC;

question: For each academic year where the total number of lecture units for all subjects offered in regular terms is more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean total lecture units across all academic years, list the academic year, the total number of lecture units, the average number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during that year (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students), the variance of the number of enrolled students, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students. Present the results ordered by total lecture units in descending order, then by enrollment variance in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH TotalLectureUnitsStats AS ( SELECT at_all.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) AS total_lecture_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at_all JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON at_all.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at_all.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING SUM(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) > ( SELECT AVG(total_lecture_units) + STDDEV(total_lecture_units) FROM ( SELECT SUM(ccso2.LECTURE_UNITS) AS total_lecture_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at_all2 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 ON at_all2.TERM_CODE = at2.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso2 ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccso2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at_all2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) t ) ), LibrarySubjectEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ata.TERM_CODE = lso.TERM_CODE WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC ) SELECT tlu.ACADEMIC_YEAR, tlu.total_lecture_units, lses.avg_enrollment, lses.enrollment_variance, lses.enrollment_stddev FROM TotalLectureUnitsStats tlu JOIN LibrarySubjectEnrollmentStats lses ON tlu.ACADEMIC_YEAR = lses.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY tlu.total_lecture_units DESC, lses.enrollment_variance DESC;

question: For each organization with an organization level of 5 and for each room on floor 2 belonging to that organization, show the organization name, organization key, description, space unit, space unit key, the average organization key within each organization key group ordered by space unit key, the building room, space usage, the HR org unit title, the department name, and the minimum access level in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the building component, ordered by space unit key and building room. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH OrgLevel5 AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.SPACE_UNIT, t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ), RoomsFloor2 AS ( SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.SPACE_USAGE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(t0.ACCESS_LEVEL) OVER (ORDER BY t0.BUILDING_COMPONENT ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2 ) SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.DESCRIPTION, o.SPACE_UNIT, o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, o.window_column AS org_window_avg_key, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.SPACE_USAGE, r.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, r.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, r.window_column AS room_min_access_level FROM OrgLevel5 o JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN RoomsFloor2 r ON fo.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = r.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID ORDER BY o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, r.BUILDING_ROOM;

question: For courses in the School of Engineering that are degree granting, and for each subject offered in the term with the description "Fall Term 2024-2025" by the same department, show the course description, department name, the dense rank of each course considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the department's budget code, the subject offered key, subject title, offering department name, the term description, and the rank of each subject within its offering department ordered by subject offered key. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH EngineeringDegreeCourses AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), FallSubjects AS ( SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' ) SELECT e.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.window_column AS course_dense_rank, f.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, f.SUBJECT_TITLE, f.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, f.TERM_DESCRIPTION, f.window_column AS subject_rank FROM EngineeringDegreeCourses e JOIN FallSubjects f ON e.DEPARTMENT_CODE = f.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, f.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY

question: For the top 10 activity titles with the highest number of associated course materials, what are the activity title, term description, count of course materials, range of maximum enrollment, variance of maximum enrollment, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of maximum enrollment across all academic terms, considering only activities that are not cancelled and have a non-null maximum enrollment? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH top10_activity_materials AS ( SELECT IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' GROUP BY IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY material_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), activity_enrollment_stats AS ( SELECT ACTIVITY_TITLE, MAX(MAX_ENROLLMENT) - MIN(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS enrollment_stddev FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN TIME_DAY ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = TIME_DAY.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE WHERE IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ACTIVITY_TITLE ORDER BY enrollment_range DESC ) SELECT t10.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t10.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t10.material_count, aes.enrollment_range, aes.enrollment_variance, aes.enrollment_stddev FROM top10_activity_materials t10 LEFT JOIN activity_enrollment_stats aes ON t10.ACTIVITY_TITLE = aes.ACTIVITY_TITLE;

question: For rooms on floor 2 that are associated with departments in the Provost Area, show the building room, space usage, the organization name, the HR org unit title, the department name, the department (DLC) name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of faculty organization keys for that department, and the minimum access level in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the building component. Present the results ordered by department name and building room. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptOrgStats AS ( SELECT m.DLC_NAME, m.DLC_KEY, VARIANCE(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_key_variance, STDDEV(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_key_stddev FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME, m.DLC_KEY ORDER BY org_key_variance DESC ), Floor2Rooms AS ( SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.SPACE_USAGE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID, MIN(t0.ACCESS_LEVEL) OVER (ORDER BY t0.BUILDING_COMPONENT ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2 ) SELECT f2.BUILDING_ROOM, f2.SPACE_USAGE, f2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, f2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, f2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DLC_NAME, d.org_key_variance, d.org_key_stddev, f2.window_column FROM Floor2Rooms f2 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON f2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = fo.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN DeptOrgStats d ON fo.DLC_KEY = d.DLC_KEY ORDER BY d.DLC_NAME, f2.BUILDING_ROOM;

question: For IAP subject activities with a maximum enrollment of at least 10 and that are not cancelled, and that also have a maximum enrollment greater than 10 and are not cancelled, show the activity title, enrollment type, the academic term description, and the subject title from the course catalog, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by activity title, the maximum enrollment, the academic term description from the time day table, the term start date from the academic terms table, and the minimum maximum enrollment value over each term code group, ordered by term code. The columns should be shown in the following order: activity title, enrollment type, academic term description, subject title, row number window column, maximum enrollment, academic term description from time day, term start date, and minimum maximum enrollment window column. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Sub1 AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 10 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' ), Sub2 AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TERM_START_DATE, min(t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.TERM_CODE ORDER BY t0.TERM_CODE) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN TIME_DAY t1 ON t1.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE = t0.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 ) SELECT s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.window_column AS sub1_window_column, s2.MAX_ENROLLMENT, s2.ACADEMIC_TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.TERM_START_DATE, s2.window_column AS sub2_window_column FROM Sub1 s1 JOIN Sub2 s2 ON s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE = s2.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND s1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = s2.ENROLLMENT_TYPE AND s1.TERM_CODE = s2.TERM_CODE

question: For subjects offered in the term '2017JA', show the subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, department full name, subject code, subject code description, and the minimum number of enrolled students over each subject code group, along with the department name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year for the same department, ordered by subject code and by the range of total units in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subjects2017JA AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' ), DepartmentUnits2022 AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s.window_column, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_total_units, d.total_units_range, d.total_units_variance FROM Subjects2017JA s JOIN DepartmentUnits2022 d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_CODE, d.total_units_range DESC;

question: For each department in the "Sloan School of Management" area with a hierarchy type of "Standard Hierarchy" that is also in the "Provost Area" at hierarchy level 2, show the department code, department name, the dense rank of each department considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the department's long name, the department's name, the range of organization numbers for organizations within that department, and the variance of the organization numbers, with results ordered by the dense rank and then by the organization number range in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH SloanDepartments AS ( SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME = 'Sloan School of Management Area' ), ProvostDeptStats AS ( SELECT MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME AS department_name, MAX(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) - MIN(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_range, VARIANCE(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance, MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY WHERE MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME, MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY ORDER BY org_number_range DESC ) SELECT sd.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.window_column, pds.department_name, pds.org_number_range, pds.org_number_variance FROM SloanDepartments sd JOIN ProvostDeptStats pds ON sd.DLC_KEY = pds.DLC_KEY ORDER BY sd.window_column, pds.org_number_range DESC

question: For each department, give the department name, the variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2012SU term, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for courses offered by that department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptUnitsVariance2012SU AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance_2012su FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON tso.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance_2012su DESC ), DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.total_units_variance_2012su, d2.total_units_range, d2.total_units_variance, d2.total_units_stddev FROM DeptUnitsVariance2012SU d1 JOIN DeptUnitsStats d2 ON d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For subjects in the "Engineering" school with total units equal to 1, show the subject ID, subject title, department name, academic year, and the rank of each subject within its academic year group ordered by subject ID. For each such subject, also show the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses from the same department that have at least one associated course material. Present the results ordered by department name, academic year, and rank. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_stddev DESC ), EngineeringSubjects AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 1 ) SELECT es.SUBJECT_ID, es.SUBJECT_TITLE, es.DEPARTMENT_NAME, es.ACADEMIC_YEAR, es.window_column, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_stddev FROM EngineeringSubjects es JOIN DeptEnrollmentStats des ON es.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY es.DEPARTMENT_NAME, es.ACADEMIC_YEAR, es.window_column;

question: For all subjects in the 2014FA term with at least one enrolled student, show the subject title, offering department name, responsible faculty name, the TIP material status key, the total number of units, and the minimum total number of units in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the course number, along with the maximum subject enrollment number and the term start date for the corresponding department in the current academic term, considering only departments where the maximum subject enrollment number is greater than 5. The columns should be shown in the following order: subject title, offering department name, responsible faculty name, TIP material status key, total number of units, the minimum total number of units in the window, maximum subject enrollment number, and term start date. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Sub1 AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_dept_name FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), Sub2 AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_enrollment, at.TERM_START_DATE FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 5 ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s1.TOTAL_UNITS, s1.window_column, s2.max_enrollment, s2.TERM_START_DATE FROM Sub1 s1 JOIN Sub2 s2 ON s1.join_dept_name = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For academic term parameters where the term indicator is 'C', show the term parameter, the term code, the academic year, the department name of the offered subject, the running sum of academic years within each department (ordered by academic year), and, for each such term parameter, also provide the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of subjects offered in that term parameter (considering only terms that are regular terms). Present the results ordered by department name and academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH TermParamsC AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_PARAMETER, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_INDICATOR = 'C' ), TermParamStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT tpc.TERM_PARAMETER, tpc.TERM_CODE, tpc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, tpc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tpc.window_column, tps.total_units_variance, tps.total_units_stddev FROM TermParamsC tpc JOIN TermParamStats tps ON tpc.TERM_PARAMETER = tps.TERM_PARAMETER ORDER BY tpc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tpc.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each department hierarchy, list the department hierarchy name, the average organization level, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the organization level for organizations in that hierarchy, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of rooms assigned to organizations in that department hierarchy, considering only rooms with an area greater than 0. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptHierarchyOrgLevelStats AS ( SELECT MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY, MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME, AVG(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) AS avg_org_level, STDDEV(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) AS org_level_stddev FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL IS NOT NULL GROUP BY MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY, MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME ORDER BY org_level_stddev DESC ), DLCAreaVariation AS ( SELECT FODK.DLC_KEY, FO.DLC_NAME, STDDEV(FR.AREA)/NULLIF(AVG(FR.AREA),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY FODK JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION FO ON FODK.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS FR ON FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FR.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE FR.AREA > 0 GROUP BY FODK.DLC_KEY, FO.DLC_NAME HAVING AVG(FR.AREA) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT dhols.DLC_NAME, dhols.avg_org_level, dhols.org_level_stddev, dlcav.coefficient_of_variation FROM DeptHierarchyOrgLevelStats dhols JOIN DLCAreaVariation dlcav ON dhols.DLC_KEY = dlcav.DLC_KEY ORDER BY dhols.org_level_stddev DESC, dlcav.coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For subjects offered in the term '2019FA' with more than 0 enrolled students, and for courses in the 'Engineering' school with a total of 12 units, show the subject title, offer department name, department full name, number of enrolled students, the average number of enrolled students in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the school code, the course number, course description, course subject title, total units, course offering department name, and the row number within each course offering department ordered by course number, for each pair where the offer department code matches, ordered by subject title and course number. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE AS course_number, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.COURSE) AS window_column, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.window_column AS avg_enrolled_window, s2.course_number, s2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE AS course_subject_title, s2.TOTAL_UNITS, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS course_offer_dept_name, s2.window_column AS course_row_number FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = s2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.course_number

question: List the top 10 subject titles by the number of reserve materials assigned, including the department name and the term code, and for each of these subjects, also provide the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of reserved materials per subject (considering only subjects with at least one reserved material and where the material status is 'U'). Show the subject title, department name, term code, number of reserve materials, reserved material range, reserved material variance, and reserved material standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH TopSubjects AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_reserve_materials FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE ORDER BY num_reserve_materials DESC LIMIT 10 ), SubjectStats AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(material_count) - MIN(material_count) AS reserved_material_range, VARIANCE(material_count) AS reserved_material_variance, STDDEV(material_count) AS reserved_material_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED s JOIN ( SELECT LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL WHERE LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ) d ON s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY reserved_material_range DESC ) SELECT ts.SUBJECT_TITLE, ts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ts.TERM_CODE, ts.num_reserve_materials, ss.reserved_material_range, ss.reserved_material_variance, ss.reserved_material_stddev FROM TopSubjects ts LEFT JOIN SubjectStats ss ON ts.SUBJECT_TITLE = ss.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each department and course number where the number of enrolled students in the subject summary is greater than 2, provide the number of unique library subjects offered, the minimum total units for those subjects, and the total number of tip materials offered for subjects in the School of Engineering during regular terms where the total number of tip materials is greater than 10. The department in the department and course number must match the department in the School of Engineering tip materials. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH dept_course_subjects AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER ), engineering_tip_materials AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL t JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) > 10 ) SELECT dcs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dcs.COURSE_NUMBER, dcs.subject_count, dcs.min_total_units, etm.total_tip_materials FROM dept_course_subjects dcs JOIN engineering_tip_materials etm ON dcs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = etm.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each subject offered in the academic term with term code '2006FA', show the subject ID, subject title, department name, and the sum of lecture units within each grade type group ordered by subject ID, and for the department of each subject, also provide the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2022 and that are also listed in the CIS course catalog. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC ), SubjectsInTerm AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.LECTURE_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA' ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.window_column, d.units_range, d.units_variance FROM SubjectsInTerm s JOIN DeptUnitsStats d ON s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each DLC, give the DLC key, DLC name, coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of rooms assigned to organizations in that DLC (considering only rooms with an area greater than 0), and for each organization in that DLC whose parent is "S H&SS" and that is assignable, show the organization name, description, HR org unit title, and the row number assigned within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the organization name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DLC_CV AS ( SELECT FODK.DLC_KEY, FO.DLC_NAME, STDDEV(FR.AREA)/NULLIF(AVG(FR.AREA),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY FODK JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION FO ON FODK.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS FR ON FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FR.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE FR.AREA > 0 GROUP BY FODK.DLC_KEY, FO.DLC_NAME HAVING AVG(FR.AREA) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), ORG_WINDOW AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t0.DLC_KEY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORG_PARENT = 'S H&SS' AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1 ) SELECT dc.DLC_KEY, dc.DLC_NAME, dc.coefficient_of_variation, ow.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ow.DESCRIPTION, ow.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, ow.window_column FROM DLC_CV dc JOIN ORG_WINDOW ow ON dc.DLC_KEY = ow.DLC_KEY

question: For each department and academic year where the subject enrollment number is greater than 10, provide the department name, the academic year, the number of unique subjects, the minimum total units offered, and the variance of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one enrolled student and have course materials with a material status of 'RQ'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH SubjectStats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), DepartmentEnrolledVariance AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC ) SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ss.subject_count, ss.min_total_units, dev.enrolled_variance FROM SubjectStats ss JOIN DepartmentEnrolledVariance dev ON ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dev.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY ss.subject_count DESC, dev.enrolled_variance DESC;

question: For courses in the School of Engineering that are degree granting, show the course description, department name, the dense rank of each course considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the department's budget code, the subject code description, and the row number of each course within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by course description. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t0.COURSE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.COURSE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT s1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column AS dense_rank_by_budget_code, s2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s2.window_column AS row_number_by_course_description FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.COURSE = s2.COURSE ORDER BY s1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION

question: For each department that offered at least one subject with more than 3 lecture units in the Fall term of 2022, list the department name, the highest number of lecture units among its offered subjects, the start date of the term, the average number of unique subject codes associated with its courses that are offered by degree-granting departments, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of unique subject codes associated with its courses that are offered by degree-granting departments, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Fall2022SubjectStats AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, at2.TERM_START_DATE FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 ON td.TERM_CODE = at2.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at2.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) > 3 ), DepartmentSubjectCodeStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes FROM ( SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT ) course_subjects JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON course_subjects.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_subject_codes DESC ) SELECT fss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, fss.max_lecture_units, fss.TERM_START_DATE, dscs.avg_subject_codes, dscs.stddev_subject_codes FROM Fall2022SubjectStats fss JOIN DepartmentSubjectCodeStats dscs ON fss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dscs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY fss.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For courses in the School of Engineering that are degree granting, show the course description, department name, subject title, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title, along with the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects in that department that had library reserve materials in terms with a term status of 'Previous'. Present the results ordered by department name and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH EngineeringDegreeCourses AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS subject_department_name FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), DepartmentSubjectUnitStats AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT edc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, edc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, edc.SUBJECT_TITLE, edc.window_column, dsu.avg_total_units, dsu.total_units_variance, dsu.total_units_stddev FROM EngineeringDegreeCourses edc JOIN DepartmentSubjectUnitStats dsu ON edc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsu.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY edc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, edc.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For each library reserve material detail with material status key equal to 'U', show the library course instructor key, library reserve catalog key, term code, subject ID, the tip material key, tip material status key, tip ISBN, the subject title from the subject offered table, and the minimum tip material status key in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the number of enrolled students, along with the variance of the record count for TIP materials associated with that subject (considering only records where the library material status is 'U' and the TIP material status is 'RQ'), in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH reserve_material_details AS ( SELECT l.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, l.TERM_CODE, l.SUBJECT_ID, t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t.ISBN, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MIN(t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) OVER (ORDER BY s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ), subject_record_count_variance AS ( SELECT LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID = TIP_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC ) SELECT rmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, rmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, rmd.TERM_CODE, rmd.SUBJECT_ID, rmd.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, rmd.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, rmd.ISBN, rmd.SUBJECT_TITLE, rmd.window_column, srv.record_count_variance FROM reserve_material_details rmd LEFT JOIN subject_record_count_variance srv ON rmd.SUBJECT_ID = srv.SUBJECT_ID

question: For each course offered by the Mathematics department with at least 5 enrolled students, show the course number, subject title, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, the row number within each academic year group ordered by course number, the academic year description, and the geometric mean of the degree year from all academic terms where the degree year is greater than 1900, with the results ordered by academic year and course number. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH MathCourses AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 ), YearDegreeStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(ACADEMIC_TERMS.DEGREE_YEAR))) AS geometric_mean_degree_year FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.DEGREE_YEAR > 1900 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_degree_year DESC ) SELECT mc.COURSE_NUMBER, mc.SUBJECT_TITLE, mc.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, mc.TERM_DESCRIPTION, mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mc.window_column, yds.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, yds.geometric_mean_degree_year FROM MathCourses mc JOIN YearDegreeStats yds ON mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = yds.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mc.COURSE_NUMBER

question: For each subject offered in the term "2005FA", show the subject title from the subject summary, the number of enrolled students from the subject offered table, the department name from the subject summary, the term description from the academic terms table, the average number of enrolled students within each subject title group ordered by department name, and for the corresponding department, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects that had library reserve materials in terms with a term status of 'Previous'. List the results ordered by department name and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH SubjectEnrolledStats AS ( SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON tso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' ), DepartmentLibraryUnitsStats AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT ses.SUBJECT_TITLE, ses.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ses.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ses.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ses.avg_enrolled_students, dlu.avg_total_units, dlu.total_units_variance, dlu.total_units_stddev FROM SubjectEnrolledStats ses LEFT JOIN DepartmentLibraryUnitsStats dlu ON ses.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dlu.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ses.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ses.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each organization that is assignable and has a department code above 100000, show the organization key, organization name, department name, the number of HR org units, and the total of their department IDs. Also, for rooms with area greater than 200, show the building-room identifier, the organization name, the DLC key, and the sum of room areas within each major use description group ordered by building-room. Indicate the source of each row as either 'OrgStats' or 'RoomStats'. The results should include the columns: organization key, organization name, department name, number of HR org units, total department ID, building-room, DLC key, sum of room areas (window column), and source, in that order, ordered by organization name, source, and building-room. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH OrgStats AS ( SELECT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS hr_org_unit_count, SUM(h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS total_department_id FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION f JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID > 100000 GROUP BY f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ), RoomStats AS ( SELECT t2.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, SUM(t2.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.MAJOR_USE_DESC ORDER BY t2.BUILDING_ROOM) AS window_column, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.AREA > 200 ), CombinedStats AS ( SELECT o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.hr_org_unit_count, o.total_department_id, NULL AS BUILDING_ROOM, NULL AS DLC_KEY, NULL AS window_column, 'OrgStats' AS Source FROM OrgStats o UNION ALL SELECT r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, NULL AS HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS hr_org_unit_count, NULL AS total_department_id, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.DLC_KEY, r.window_column, 'RoomStats' AS Source FROM RoomStats r ) SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, ORGANIZATION_NAME, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, hr_org_unit_count, total_department_id, BUILDING_ROOM, DLC_KEY, window_column, Source FROM CombinedStats ORDER BY ORGANIZATION_NAME, Source, BUILDING_ROOM ;

question: For subjects offered in the term 2019FA by departments in the School of Engineering with a total of at least 6 units, show the subject ID, subject title, number of enrolled students, department name, department full name, the row number within each department name group ordered by subject ID, and the running sum of total units within each school ordered by subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.window_column AS dept_row_number, s2.window_column AS running_sum_total_units FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For subjects offered in the term '2017JA', show the subject title, the number of enrolled students, the responsible faculty name, the offering department name, the department full name, the school name, the minimum number of enrolled students in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the department code, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with at least one enrolled student). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DepartmentVariation AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), Subjects2017JA AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.window_column, dv.coefficient_of_variation FROM Subjects2017JA s JOIN DepartmentVariation dv ON s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each department, what are the department name, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects that had library reserve materials in terms with a term status of 'Previous', and the total number of enrolled students in courses that are offered by both the library and the TIP system in the term '2019FA', where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 10? List the results ordered by the variance of total units in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH dept_units_stats AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), dept_enrollment AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10 ) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev, de.total_enrolled FROM dept_units_stats dus JOIN dept_enrollment de ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = de.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY dus.total_units_variance DESC

question: For Mathematics department courses with at least 5 enrolled students, show the course number, subject title, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, the row number within each academic year group ordered by course number, the academic year description, and the geometric mean of the degree year for that academic year (considering only degree years greater than 1900). List the results ordered by academic year and course number. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH MathCourses AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 ), YearDegreeStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(ACADEMIC_TERMS.DEGREE_YEAR))) AS geometric_mean_degree_year FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.DEGREE_YEAR > 1900 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_degree_year DESC ) SELECT mc.COURSE_NUMBER, mc.SUBJECT_TITLE, mc.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, mc.TERM_DESCRIPTION, mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mc.window_column, yds.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, yds.geometric_mean_degree_year FROM MathCourses mc JOIN YearDegreeStats yds ON mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = yds.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mc.COURSE_NUMBER;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2022 with a total of 12 units, show the subject code, subject number, department name, subject title, term description, total units, and the average subject enrollment number in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by department code and ordered by total units, and also include the variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2012SU term for each department. List the subject code, subject number, department name, subject title, term description, total units, average subject enrollment number in window, and total units variance in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) OVER ( PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS join_department_name FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON tso.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.TOTAL_UNITS, s1.window_column, s2.total_units_variance FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.join_department_name = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year, academic year description, the variance of the record count of tip details for terms that are current or previous terms, and the geometric mean of the record counts of required course materials (where the record count is greater than zero) for all subjects offered in that year? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH record_count_variance_per_year AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC ), geometric_mean_record_count_per_year AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_record_count DESC ) SELECT v.ACADEMIC_YEAR, v.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, v.record_count_variance, g.geometric_mean_record_count FROM record_count_variance_per_year v JOIN geometric_mean_record_count_per_year g ON v.ACADEMIC_YEAR = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND v.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY v.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC;

question: For each organization that is assignable and has a department code above 100000, show the organization key, organization name, department name, the number of HR org units, the total of their department IDs, the department name, the average number of sub-departments (where HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL is 'SUB DEPARTMENT') associated with the department, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of sub-departments. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH org_hr_summary AS ( SELECT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS hr_org_unit_count, SUM(h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS total_department_id, f.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION f JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID > 100000 GROUP BY f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, f.DLC_KEY ), dept_subdept_stats AS ( SELECT m.DLC_NAME, AVG(sub_dept_counts.num_sub_depts) AS avg_num_sub_departments, STDDEV(sub_dept_counts.num_sub_depts) AS stddev_num_sub_departments, m.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY JOIN ( SELECT h2.DLC_KEY, COUNT(*) AS num_sub_depts FROM HR_ORG_UNIT h2 WHERE h2.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'SUB DEPARTMENT' GROUP BY h2.DLC_KEY ) sub_dept_counts ON m.DLC_KEY = sub_dept_counts.DLC_KEY WHERE m.DLC_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME, m.DLC_KEY ORDER BY stddev_num_sub_departments DESC ) SELECT o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.hr_org_unit_count, o.total_department_id, d.DLC_NAME, d.avg_num_sub_departments, d.stddev_num_sub_departments FROM org_hr_summary o JOIN dept_subdept_stats d ON o.DLC_KEY = d.DLC_KEY;

question: For subjects offered in the term 2019FA that have total units greater than 1, show the subject ID, subject title, number of enrolled students, department name, department full name, the row number within each department name group ordered by subject ID, and the running sum of total units within each school ordered by subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t1.SCHOOL_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t1.SCHOOL_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS > 1 ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.window_column AS dept_row_number, s2.window_column AS running_sum_total_units FROM Subq1 s1 JOIN Subq2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s1.SCHOOL_CODE = s2.SCHOOL_CODE

question: For each degree-granting department and subject code, and for each building where that subject is scheduled in the fall term, provide the department name, subject code, number of subject codes, minimum department budget code, building key, average total units, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for all subjects scheduled in rooms of that building during the fall term. The columns should be: department name, subject code, subject code count, minimum department budget code, building key, average total units, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH dept_subject_stats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE ), building_units_stats AS ( SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE ) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.SUBJECT_CODE, dss.subject_code_count, dss.min_dept_budget_code, bus.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, bus.avg_total_units, bus.stddev_total_units FROM dept_subject_stats dss JOIN building_units_stats bus ON dss.SUBJECT_CODE = bus.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.SUBJECT_CODE, bus.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY

question: List all subject titles that are either among the top 10 by number of materials offered in regular academic terms or are subjects in the 2014FA term with at least one enrolled student, and for each include: subject title, department name, total count of materials, offering department name, responsible faculty name, TIP material status key, total number of units, the minimum total number of units in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the course number, and the reason for inclusion ('TopSubjects' for top 10 by materials, 'Subjects2014FA' for 2014FA subjects with enrollment). The columns should be: subject title, department name, material count, offering department name, responsible faculty name, TIP material status key, total units, window column, and reason. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH TopSubjects AS ( SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count, ss.SUBJECT_ID FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON td.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND td.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY material_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), Subjects2014FA AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, lso.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), CombinedSubjects AS ( SELECT ts.SUBJECT_TITLE, ts.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ts.material_count, NULL AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NULL AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, NULL AS TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, NULL AS TOTAL_UNITS, NULL AS window_column, 'TopSubjects' AS Reason FROM TopSubjects ts UNION ALL SELECT s2014.SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS material_count, s2014.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2014.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s2014.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2014.TOTAL_UNITS, s2014.window_column, 'Subjects2014FA' AS Reason FROM Subjects2014FA s2014 ) SELECT * FROM CombinedSubjects ORDER BY SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each subject offered by the library in the term with code '2014FA', and for each subject offered in the term with the description "Fall Term 2024-2025" from the same offering department, show the subject ID, library subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, library term description, term start date, term end date, the minimum number of enrolled students for each offering department, TIP subject offered key, TIP subject title, TIP offering department name, TIP term description, and the rank of each TIP subject within its offering department, ordered by offering department name and TIP subject offered key. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH lib_subs AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_per_dept FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' ), tip_subs AS ( SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' ) SELECT lib_subs.SUBJECT_ID, lib_subs.SUBJECT_TITLE AS LIB_SUBJECT_TITLE, lib_subs.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lib_subs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lib_subs.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS LIB_TERM_DESCRIPTION, lib_subs.TERM_START_DATE, lib_subs.TERM_END_DATE, lib_subs.min_enrolled_per_dept, tip_subs.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, tip_subs.SUBJECT_TITLE AS TIP_SUBJECT_TITLE, tip_subs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS TIP_OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tip_subs.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS TIP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, tip_subs.window_column FROM lib_subs JOIN tip_subs ON lib_subs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tip_subs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY lib_subs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tip_subs.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY

question: For each department, display the department name, the average, range, and variance of the area of rooms assigned to it (considering only rooms with an area greater than 40), as well as the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in regular academic terms, with the columns shown in the following order: department name, average area, area range, area variance, average total units, total units range, and total units variance. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: SELECT d1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.avg_area, d1.area_range, d1.area_variance, d2.avg_total_units, d2.total_units_range, d2.total_units_variance FROM (SELECT o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_area, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 40 GROUP BY o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY area_range DESC ) d1 JOIN (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) d2 ON d1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units, show the subject code, subject number, subject title, department name, term description, and the rank of each subject within its department ordered by subject code. Additionally, for each subject's department, include the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects that have at least one enrolled student and have required course materials. Display the results ordered by department name and subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), subq2 AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.window_column, s2.avg_total_units, s2.total_units_range, s2.total_units_variance FROM subq1 s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE

question: For each department with a total number of subject enrollments greater than 10 for subjects offered in the current term, and for each course number in that department where the number of enrolled students in the subject summary is greater than 2, provide the department name, the total number of subject enrollments, the course number, the number of unique library subjects offered, and the minimum total units for those subjects. List the results ordered by total number of subject enrollments descending, then by number of unique library subjects offered descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH dept_enrollments AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollments FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER p JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON p.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 10 ), library_subjects AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.total_enrollments, l.COURSE_NUMBER, l.subject_count, l.min_total_units FROM dept_enrollments d JOIN library_subjects l ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY d.total_enrollments DESC, l.subject_count DESC

question: For each space unit with a space unit code of 402100, list the space unit name, the organization name, the dense rank of the organization considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the organization number, the variance of the organization numbers for all organizations linked to that space unit (considering only space units with a non-null DLC key and organizations with assignable status), and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the organization numbers for all organizations linked to that space unit, showing the results ordered by the variance in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
