SQL: WITH Sub1 AS ( SELECT t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 402100 ), Sub2 AS ( SELECT s.SPACE_UNIT, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, VARIANCE(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance, STDDEV(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT s ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = s.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE s.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 GROUP BY s.SPACE_UNIT, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY org_number_variance DESC ) SELECT s2.SPACE_UNIT, s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.org_number_variance, s2.org_number_stddev FROM Sub1 s1 JOIN Sub2 s2 ON s1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = s2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY s2.org_number_variance DESC

question: For each student in the "Electrical Eng & Computer Sci" department, show their full name, email address, department name, course description, course level, and their row number within each course level group ordered by last name, along with the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by their department (considering only subjects that are offered this year and are letter graded). List the results ordered by course level and row number. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptUnits AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), EECSStudents AS ( SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.COURSE_LEVEL ORDER BY t2.LAST_NAME) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT eecs.FULL_NAME, eecs.EMAIL_ADDRESS, eecs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, eecs.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, eecs.COURSE_LEVEL, eecs.window_column, du.avg_total_units, du.total_units_variance FROM EECSStudents eecs LEFT JOIN DeptUnits du ON eecs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = du.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY eecs.COURSE_LEVEL, eecs.window_column;

question: For each building that has more than five rooms, what is the building number and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of its rooms, and for each room in those buildings with an access level of 1, what are the building room, building component, floor, space usage, space unit code, the corresponding organization's name, and the average floor within each space usage group ordered by floor? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH building_area_stddev AS ( SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.BUILDING_NUMBER, STDDEV(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.BUILDING_NUMBER HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY area_stddev DESC ), rooms_access_level_1 AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.BUILDING_COMPONENT, t1.FLOOR, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(t1.FLOOR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SPACE_USAGE ORDER BY t1.FLOOR) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 ) SELECT bas.BUILDING_NUMBER, bas.area_stddev, ral1.BUILDING_ROOM, ral1.BUILDING_COMPONENT, ral1.FLOOR, ral1.SPACE_USAGE, ral1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, ral1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ral1.window_column FROM building_area_stddev bas JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS fba ON bas.BUILDING_NUMBER = fba.BUILDING_NUMBER JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN rooms_access_level_1 ral1 ON fr.BUILDING_ROOM = ral1.BUILDING_ROOM

question: For each department hierarchy level 2 name and organization name where the organization is assignable, display the number of organizations, the minimum organization number, and the geometric mean of the number of supervisees for each department (considering only departments where the number of supervisees is greater than zero), ordered by the number of organizations descending and then by the geometric mean of supervisees descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH dept_org_stats AS ( SELECT m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(f.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 GROUP BY m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME ), org_geom_supervisees AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES))) AS geometric_mean_supervisees FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN SPACE_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ON SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY = SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.DEPT_NAMES WHERE SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES > 0 GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_supervisees DESC ) SELECT d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, d.ORGANIZATION_NAME, d.organization_count, d.min_organization_number, o.geometric_mean_supervisees FROM dept_org_stats d LEFT JOIN org_geom_supervisees o ON d.ORGANIZATION_NAME = o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY d.organization_count DESC, o.geometric_mean_supervisees DESC;

question: For each department in the 2022 academic year where the department name matches an offering department name with more than 2 enrolled students, what are the department name, the variance of the total units of subjects offered, the offering department name, the offering school name, the count of distinct subject IDs, and the minimum ISBN value for the associated course materials? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH department_units_variance AS ( SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), offering_dept_subjects AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(td.ISBN) AS min_isbn FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT duv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, duv.total_units_variance, ods.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ods.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ods.subject_count, ods.min_isbn FROM department_units_variance duv JOIN offering_dept_subjects ods ON duv.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ods.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: For organizations whose parent is 'S H&SS', show the organization name, description, the HR org unit title, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the organization name, and, for each such organization, also display the range and variance of the space unit codes associated with it (considering only organizations with a non-null description and space units with a non-null space unit name). List the columns in the following order: organization name, description, HR org unit title, window row number, code range, and code variance. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH org_windowed AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.ORG_PARENT = 'S H&SS' ), org_space_stats AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAX(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) - MIN(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS code_range, VARIANCE(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS code_variance FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY odk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON odk.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL AND su.SPACE_UNIT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY code_range DESC ) SELECT ow.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ow.DESCRIPTION, ow.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, ow.window_column, oss.code_range, oss.code_variance FROM org_windowed ow LEFT JOIN org_space_stats oss ON ow.ORGANIZATION_NAME = oss.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY ow.window_column

question: For each department, what is the department name, the range of the number of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department, the variance of the number of enrolled students, and the variance of the total number of units for subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that grant degrees, courses that are at the graduate level, and subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and that are degree granting? Please provide the department name, the range of enrolled students, the variance of enrolled students, and the variance of total units, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH EnrolledStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC ), UnitsVariance AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT es.DEPARTMENT_NAME, es.enrolled_range, es.enrolled_variance, uv.total_units_variance FROM EnrolledStats es JOIN UnitsVariance uv ON es.DEPARTMENT_CODE = uv.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY es.enrolled_range DESC;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year, the academic year description, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the record counts of TIP materials associated with that academic year (considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the TIP material status key is not 'NM'), and the variance of the maximum enrollment for IAP activities that are not cancelled and require advance sign-up? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH TipMaterialStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), IapActivityStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR, tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, tms.record_count_variance, tms.record_count_stddev, ias.max_enrollment_variance FROM TipMaterialStats tms JOIN IapActivityStats ias ON tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ias.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = ias.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each material status and each subject that has at least one enrolled student and a matching TIP material status key, give the material status key, the average and variance of the record counter for reserve catalog items associated with that status (considering only records where the catalog year is greater than 2000), the subject title, the number of enrolled students, the term code from the library subject offered table, the TIP material status key, the total units from the subject offered summary, and the average number of enrolled students within each subject title group ordered by total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH material_status_stats AS ( SELECT d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, AVG(c.RECORD_COUNTER) AS avg_record_counter, VARIANCE(c.RECORD_COUNTER) AS record_counter_variance FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL d JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG c ON d.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = c.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY WHERE c.CATALOG_YEAR > 2000 GROUP BY d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY record_counter_variance DESC ), subject_enrollment_stats AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.TERM_CODE, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_enrolled_students, lso.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID INNER JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT ms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ms.avg_record_counter, ms.record_counter_variance, ses.SUBJECT_TITLE, ses.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ses.TERM_CODE, ses.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ses.TOTAL_UNITS, ses.avg_enrolled_students FROM material_status_stats ms JOIN subject_enrollment_stats ses ON ms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = ses.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY

question: For each department and school, provide the department name, school name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of course materials per subject offered by that department in the term 2017SP, as well as the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of unique subject codes associated with courses offered by degree-granting departments in that school. For each school, include a grand total for all departments in the format of (null, school name, ...). Present the results in the following order: department name, school name, material count range, material count variance, material count standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), average subject codes, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subject codes. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(material_count) - MIN(material_count) AS material_count_range, VARIANCE(material_count) AS material_count_variance, STDDEV(material_count) AS material_count_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ( SELECT TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM TIP_DETAIL WHERE TERM_CODE = '2017SP' GROUP BY TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ) AS detail_stats ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = detail_stats.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = '2017SP' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ), material_stats AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(OFFER_DEPT_NAME) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE OFFER_DEPT_NAME END AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(material_count_range) AS material_count_range, VARIANCE(material_count_variance) AS material_count_variance, STDDEV(material_count_stddev) AS material_count_stddev FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(material_count_range) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT ), subject_code_stats AS ( SELECT d.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(inner_cte2.subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(inner_cte2.subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes FROM inner_cte2 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY stddev_subject_codes DESC ) SELECT m.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, m.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, m.material_count_range, m.material_count_variance, m.material_count_stddev, s.avg_subject_codes, s.stddev_subject_codes FROM material_stats m LEFT JOIN subject_code_stats s ON m.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = s.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY m.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, m.OFFER_DEPT_NAME

question: For each subject category and enrollment type where the maximum enrollment is greater than 10, provide the number of activities, the earliest start date of the corresponding academic term, the latest end date of the corresponding academic term, and for each IAP subject activity with a maximum enrollment of 12 in that enrollment type, show the activity title, maximum enrollment, term description, subject title, number of enrolled students, the academic year description, and the row number within each enrollment type group ordered by activity title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS activity_count, MIN(t.START_DATE) AS earliest_start_date FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN TIME_DAY t ON d.TERM_CODE = t.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ) SELECT c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, c.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, c.activity_count, c.earliest_start_date, MAX(t.END_DATE) AS latest_end_date FROM inner_cte c JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d ON c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY AND c.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE JOIN TIME_DAY t ON d.TERM_CODE = t.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE GROUP BY c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, c.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, c.activity_count, c.earliest_start_date ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 12 ) SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.MAX_ENROLLMENT, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column, inner_cte.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE ) SELECT s1.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, s1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, s1.activity_count, s1.earliest_start_date, s1.latest_end_date, s2.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s2.MAX_ENROLLMENT, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.window_column FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = s2.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY s1.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, s2.window_column;

question: For subjects in the Fall Term 2024-2025 that have at least one tip detail with material status key 'EO', show the subject offered key, material key, material status key, term code, subject ID, term description, academic year, term parameter, the total number of tip details per academic year, subject title, offering department name, the rank of each subject within its offering department, and the total number of subjects offered by each department in that term, ordered by subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS window_column FROM TIP_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'EO' ) SELECT inner_cte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.TERM_PARAMETER, Total_Tip_Details.Total_Tip_Details FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS Total_Tip_Details FROM TIP_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'EO' GROUP BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) AS Total_Tip_Details ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = Total_Tip_Details.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.window_column, dept_counts.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS Total_Subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' GROUP BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) dept_counts ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_counts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT s1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.TERM_PARAMETER, s1.Total_Tip_Details, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.window_column AS SUBJECT_DEPT_RANK, s2.Total_Subjects AS DEPT_TOTAL_SUBJECTS FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For subject offerings in the term '2017FA' with a total number of units greater than 10, display the subject title, department name, school name, and their dense rank considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the department code from the subject code table, along with any matching subject IDs from subjects offered in the term with code '2022SU', their department names, and their dense rank considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the total number of units. Show the subject title, department name, school name, subq1 dense rank, subject ID, subq2 department name, and subq2 dense rank, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t2.COURSE_NUMBER FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS > 10 ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 ON inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER = t0.COURSE_NUMBER ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2022SU' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.SCHOOL_NAME, subq1.window_column AS subq1_dense_rank, subq2.SUBJECT_ID, subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS subq2_DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq2.window_column AS subq2_dense_rank FROM subq1 LEFT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON subq1.COURSE_NUMBER = cso.SUBJECT_CODE LEFT JOIN subq2 ON cso.SUBJECT_ID = subq2.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY subq1.window_column DESC, subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq2.window_column, subq2.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each student whose department is degree-granting and whose student year is 'G', show their full name, email address, department full name, and the difference between the length of their full name and the average length of full names for all such students. For each such student, also show, for each school in which their department offers subjects with at least one required material, the school name, the minimum number of enrolled students in those library subject offerings, and the total number of units for those subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.FULL_NAME, t1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' ) SELECT i.FULL_NAME, i.EMAIL_ADDRESS, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, (LENGTH(i.FULL_NAME) - avg_len.avg_full_name_length) AS diff_from_avg_length FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT AVG(LENGTH(FULL_NAME)) AS avg_full_name_length FROM inner_cte ) avg_len ON 1=1 ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ) SELECT OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_CODE, MIN(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students, SUM(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_CODE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT s1.FULL_NAME, s1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.diff_from_avg_length, s2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s2.min_enrolled_students, s2.total_units FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY s1.FULL_NAME, s2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME

question: For each subject category and for each subject offered in the term with code '2025FA', provide the category name, the average and variance of the maximum enrollment across all activities in that category, the difference between the average and the variance for each category, the subject ID, subject title, offering department name, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, term start date, term end date, term parameter, the minimum number of enrolled students over each offering department, the offering school name, and the responsible faculty name. Order the results by category name and offering department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH category_stats AS ( SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, AVG(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, VARIANCE(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS var_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d ON c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ), category_stats_final AS ( SELECT i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, i.avg_max_enrollment, i.var_max_enrollment, (i.avg_max_enrollment - i.var_max_enrollment) AS avg_minus_var FROM category_stats i ORDER BY avg_minus_var DESC ), subject_offerings AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept, t0.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ) SELECT csf.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, csf.avg_max_enrollment, csf.var_max_enrollment, csf.avg_minus_var, so.SUBJECT_ID, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, so.TERM_DESCRIPTION, so.ACADEMIC_YEAR, so.TERM_START_DATE, so.TERM_END_DATE, so.TERM_PARAMETER, so.min_enrolled_students_per_dept, so.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM category_stats_final csf CROSS JOIN subject_offerings so ORDER BY csf.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: For subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering with a total of at least 6 units, where the running sum of total units within each grade type exceeds 12 units, show the subject code, subject title, department name, and the running sum of total units within each grade type. For each such subject, for each building and floor where the subject is scheduled (based on the room's meet place), show the building key, the floor key, and the total coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of rooms located on that floor (including grand totals for all floors per building). Order the results by subject code, building key, and floor key. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ), cte_subjects AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column FROM inner_cte1 WHERE window_column > 12 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT FCLT_FLOOR.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, FCLT_FLOOR.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, STDDEV(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA) / NULLIF(AVG(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM FCLT_FLOOR JOIN FCLT_ROOMS ON FCLT_FLOOR.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY = FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY GROUP BY FCLT_FLOOR.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, FCLT_FLOOR.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY HAVING AVG(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA) > 0 ), cte_building_floors AS ( SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, SUM(coefficient_of_variation) AS total_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, FCLT_FLOOR_KEY WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(coefficient_of_variation) IS NOT NULL ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.window_column, bf.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, bf.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, bf.total_coefficient_of_variation FROM cte_subjects s JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = cso.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON cso.MEET_PLACE = fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY JOIN FCLT_FLOOR ff ON fr.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY = ff.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY JOIN cte_building_floors bf ON ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = bf.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND ff.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY = bf.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_CODE, bf.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, bf.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY;

question: For departments that offered more than 5 unique subjects in terms from the academic year 2014 or later, list the department name, the count of unique subject titles, the total number of enrolled students in those subjects, and for each such department, show the library course instructor key, library reserve catalog key, term code, subject ID, the tip material key, tip material status key, tip ISBN, the subject title from the subject offered table, the minimum tip material status key in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the number of enrolled students, the responsible faculty name, and the offer department name from the subject offered table for reserve material details with material status key equal to 'U'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH dept_subjects AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2014 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.subject_count, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2014 GROUP BY inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.subject_count HAVING inner_cte.subject_count > 5 ORDER BY total_enrolled_students DESC ), reserve_materials AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT l.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, l.TERM_CODE, l.SUBJECT_ID, t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t.ISBN, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MIN(t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) OVER (ORDER BY s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, s.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ) SELECT inner_cte.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, inner_cte.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, inner_cte.ISBN, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.window_column, s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON inner_cte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = s.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ) SELECT d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, d.subject_count, d.total_enrolled_students, r.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, r.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, r.TERM_CODE, r.SUBJECT_ID, r.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, r.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, r.ISBN, r.SUBJECT_TITLE, r.window_column, r.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, r.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS RES_MAT_OFFER_DEPT_NAME FROM dept_subjects d JOIN reserve_materials r ON d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = r.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: For each department whose name includes 'Engineering' and that is degree granting, show the department name, the minimum department budget code, the sum of total units, the number of unique courses, the total number of courses offered by that department, the school name, and for each category code, the minimum warehouse load date from the CIP table for courses in that department, ordered by department name and category code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_budget_code, SUM(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_sum, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE '%Engineering%' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.min_budget_code, inner_cte.total_units_sum, COUNT(DISTINCT ccc.SUBJECT_NUMBER) AS unique_courses, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.min_budget_code, inner_cte.total_units_sum, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.PROGRAM_CODE, c.PROGRAM_TITLE, c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY c.CATEGORY_CODE) AS min_warehouse_load_date FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION s JOIN CIP c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT = 6 ) SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.COURSE) AS total_courses, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.CATEGORY_CODE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS min_warehouse_load_date, s.DEPARTMENT FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION s JOIN CIP c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.CATEGORY_CODE, s.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.CATEGORY_CODE ) SELECT subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.min_budget_code, subq1.total_units_sum, subq1.unique_courses, subq2.total_courses, subq2.SCHOOL_NAME, subq2.CATEGORY_CODE, subq2.min_warehouse_load_date FROM subq1 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN subq2 ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = subq2.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq2.CATEGORY_CODE;

question: For each subject in a department where the school code and subject title are not null, and for each subject offered in the 2022FA term with total units greater than the average for that term, display the subject code, subject code description, department name, subject title, the number of subjects in the same department, the subject ID, the term description, and the running sum of total units for that academic year, ordered by subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_CODE IS NOT NULL AND t1.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, dept_counts.subjects_in_department, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS subjects_in_department FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_CODE IS NOT NULL AND t1.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) dept_counts ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ) SELECT SUBJECT_ID, DEPARTMENT_NAME, TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUM(TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte WHERE TOTAL_UNITS > ( SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ) ORDER BY SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT subq1.SUBJECT_CODE, subq1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq1.subjects_in_department, subq2.SUBJECT_ID, subq2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, subq2.window_column FROM subq1 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN subq2 ON ccc.SUBJECT_ID = subq2.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY subq2.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each department in the School of Engineering where the total number of students enrolled in courses offered by that department is greater than the average total enrollment across all Engineering departments (and the total enrollment is greater than 50), show the department name and total enrollment, and for each such department, show the library reserve material details with material status key equal to 'U', including the library course instructor key, library reserve catalog key, term code, subject ID, the tip material key, tip material status key, tip ISBN, the subject title, the minimum tip material status key in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the number of enrolled students, as well as the responsible faculty name and the offer department name, for materials offered by that department. The columns should be: department name, total enrollment, library course instructor key, library reserve catalog key, term code, subject ID, tip material key, tip material status key, tip ISBN, subject title, windowed minimum tip material status key, responsible faculty name, and offer department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH engineering_dept_enrollment AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_enrollment FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT AVG(total_enrollment) AS avg_enrollment FROM ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ) sub ) a ON i.total_enrollment > a.avg_enrollment ), library_reserve_materials AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT l.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, l.TERM_CODE, l.SUBJECT_ID, t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t.ISBN, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MIN(t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) OVER ( ORDER BY s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, s.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ) SELECT inner_cte.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, inner_cte.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, inner_cte.ISBN, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.window_column, s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON inner_cte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = s.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ) SELECT ede.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ede.total_enrollment, lrm.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, lrm.TERM_CODE, lrm.SUBJECT_ID, lrm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, lrm.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, lrm.ISBN, lrm.SUBJECT_TITLE, lrm.window_column, lrm.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, lrm.OFFER_DEPT_NAME FROM engineering_dept_enrollment ede JOIN library_reserve_materials lrm ON ede.DEPARTMENT_NAME = lrm.OFFER_DEPT_NAME

question: For each department in the School of Engineering that also offered subjects in the Fall term of 2022 with the highest number of lecture units among its offered subjects greater than 3, list the department name, the total number of tip materials offered for subjects during regular terms (where the total is greater than 10), the average number of units for those subjects, the highest number of lecture units among its offered subjects in Fall 2022, the start date of the Fall 2022 term, and the total number of subjects offered by that department in that term. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH dept_tip_materials AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL t JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) > 10 ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_tip_materials, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_tip_materials ), dept_fall_2022_subjects AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, at2.TERM_START_DATE FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 ON td.TERM_CODE = at2.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at2.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) > 3 ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.max_lecture_units, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, COUNT(ccs2.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs2 ON ccs2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ccs2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.max_lecture_units, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE ) SELECT dtm.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dtm.total_tip_materials, dtm.avg_units, dfs.max_lecture_units, dfs.TERM_START_DATE, dfs.num_subjects_offered FROM dept_tip_materials dtm JOIN dept_fall_2022_subjects dfs ON dtm.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dfs.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For organizations with an organization level of 5, show their organization names (do not repeat the organization name if it is the same as the previous row), the dense rank of their corresponding HR department names (considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the HR department code from the HR organization unit table), the HR department's full name, the school/area name, and the geometric mean of the area of rooms assigned to employees in that department (considering only rooms with an area greater than 0, and where the department name starts with 'D' (case insensitive) and the average room area is at least 100). Sort the table by organization name and HR department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH org_hr_dept_ranked AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(ORGANIZATION_NAME) OVER (ORDER BY ORGANIZATION_NAME, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = ORGANIZATION_NAME THEN NULL ELSE ORGANIZATION_NAME END AS organization_name, window_column, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME FROM ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ) inner_cte ORDER BY organization_name, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ), dept_room_geom_mean AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ed.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(fr.AREA))) AS geometric_mean_area, AVG(fr.AREA) AS avg_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY ed ON fr.BUILDING_ROOM = ed.OFFICE_LOCATION WHERE fr.AREA > 0 GROUP BY ed.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.geometric_mean_area FROM inner_cte ic WHERE UPPER(ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME) LIKE 'D%' AND ic.avg_area >= 100 ORDER BY ic.geometric_mean_area DESC ) SELECT ohr.organization_name, ohr.window_column, ohr.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ohr.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, drg.geometric_mean_area FROM org_hr_dept_ranked ohr LEFT JOIN dept_room_geom_mean drg ON ohr.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = drg.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ohr.organization_name, ohr.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each offering department name and school name where the number of enrolled students is greater than 2, provide the count of distinct subject IDs, the minimum ISBN value for the associated course materials, the total number of course materials per department and school, and for each department and library material status, include the department name, library material status key, the number of subjects with at least 5 enrolled students in both the library and tip subject offerings, the average number of enrolled students in the library subject offered, and the term code from the reserve material detail. Include subtotals for each department (the corresponding department field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all departments (the corresponding department field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the department if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by department and library material status. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(td.ISBN) AS min_isbn FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, i.subject_count, i.min_isbn, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_materials FROM inner_cte i JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND i.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, i.subject_count, i.min_isbn ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS library_num_enrolled, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS tip_num_enrolled, lrd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, lrd.TERM_CODE AS reserve_term_code FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrd ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = lrd.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(dept) OVER (ORDER BY dept_sort, status_sort) = dept THEN NULL ELSE dept END AS department, status, subject_count, avg_library_enrolled, reserve_term_code, dept_sort FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(OFFER_DEPT_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE OFFER_DEPT_NAME END AS dept_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(OFFER_DEPT_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(OFFER_DEPT_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE OFFER_DEPT_NAME END AS dept, CASE WHEN GROUPING(OFFER_DEPT_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY END AS status_sort, LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY AS status, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, AVG(library_num_enrolled) AS avg_library_enrolled, MIN(reserve_term_code) AS reserve_term_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY dept_sort, status_sort ) SELECT s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s1.subject_count, s1.min_isbn, s1.total_materials, s2.department, s2.status, s2.subject_count AS lib_subject_count, s2.avg_library_enrolled, s2.reserve_term_code FROM subq1 s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.department ORDER BY s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.status;

question: For each financial aid year and academic year where the term status is 'Previous', show the financial aid year, academic year, academic year description, department name, the number of terms in that year, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for all library reserve materials offered in terms that have a material status of 'U'. For each financial aid year, include a grand total for all terms in the format of (financial aid year, null, null, null, total terms, null). For each academic year, also include a grand total across all departments in the format of (financial aid year, academic year, academic year description, null, total terms, total coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP)). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH RollupResults AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ), YearTermCounts AS ( SELECT t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.TERM_CODE) AS num_terms FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ) SELECT FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(num_terms) AS total_terms FROM YearTermCounts GROUP BY FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(num_terms) > 0 ), DeptVariation AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE AND LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT rr.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.total_terms, dv.coefficient_of_variation FROM RollupResults rr LEFT JOIN DeptVariation dv ON rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dv.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY rr.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each subject offered in the 2012 summer term by the Harvard Cross-Enrollment Program, provide the subject key, subject title, department name, the number of subject offerings, the total number of units for those offerings, the total number of enrolled students in those offerings, as well as for each offering of that subject in 2012SU, the offer department name, subject enrollment number, subject offered summary key, the average subject enrollment number within each subject key group, and the deviation of each subject's enrollment number from the average enrollment number for its subject key group, ordered by subject key and offer department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT so.SUBJECT_KEY, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS offering_count, SUM(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON sos.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' GROUP BY so.SUBJECT_KEY, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_KEY, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.offering_count, inner_cte.total_units, SUM(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_KEY = so.SUBJECT_KEY GROUP BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_KEY, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.offering_count, inner_cte.total_units ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.SUBJECT_KEY, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY, AVG(t0.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SUBJECT_KEY ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_KEY, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, inner_cte.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY, inner_cte.window_column AS avg_enrollment_number, (inner_cte.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER - inner_cte.window_column) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_KEY, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.offering_count, s1.total_units, s1.total_enrolled_students, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, s2.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY, s2.avg_enrollment_number, s2.deviation_from_avg FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_KEY = s2.SUBJECT_KEY AND s1.SUBJECT_TITLE = s2.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_KEY, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: For each department in the School of Engineering during regular terms that has more than 10 total tip materials offered for its subjects, list the department name, the subject title, the number of enrolled students, the total number of subjects per department that have at least one associated course material, the total number of tip materials offered for its subjects, and the average number of tip materials per subject. Show the results ordered by department name and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, dept_totals.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_TITLE) AS Total_Subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) dept_totals ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_totals.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL t JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) > 10 ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_tip_materials, AVG(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_tip_materials_per_subject FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON s.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_tip_materials ) SELECT s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.Total_Subjects, s2.total_tip_materials, s2.avg_tip_materials_per_subject FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For all subjects in the 2014FA term with at least one enrolled student, show the subject title, offering department name, responsible faculty name, the TIP material status key, the total number of units, the minimum total number of units in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the course number, the corresponding offer school name, the subject code, subject code description, department name, the school name, whether the subject code description is present ('Has Description') or missing ('No Description'), and the number of subject codes per school name and description status. For each school name, include a grand total for all subject codes in the format of (null, null, null, school name, null, total subject codes). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, lso.COURSE_NUMBER FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.COURSE_NUMBER FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), SubjectCodeVisibility AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, CASE WHEN SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND SUBJECT_CODE_DESC <> 'nan' THEN 'Has Description' ELSE 'No Description' END AS description_status, COURSE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte2 ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, description_status, COUNT(*) AS total_subject_codes FROM SubjectCodeVisibility GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, description_status WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ) SELECT ic1.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ic1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ic1.TOTAL_UNITS, ic1.window_column, ic1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, scv.SUBJECT_CODE, scv.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.description_status, rr.total_subject_codes FROM inner_cte1 ic1 JOIN SubjectCodeVisibility scv ON ic1.COURSE_NUMBER = scv.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN RollupResults rr ON scv.SCHOOL_NAME = rr.SCHOOL_NAME AND scv.description_status = rr.description_status ORDER BY ic1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.description_status;

question: For subjects offered in the term with code '2022FA', show the subject ID, department name, term description, and the running sum of total units within each academic year, along with the subject title and whether the subject is offered in the fall term, and for each such subject, include the department's name, total course material count in the top 10 departments with the highest total number of course materials in the term 2017SP, the subject with the most course materials in that department, and the number of materials for that subject, ordered by subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.window_column, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM FROM inner_cte icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON icte.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID AND t2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = TIP_DETAIL.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = '2017SP' AND TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = '2017SP' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT dept_stats.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dept_stats.total_materials, subj_stats.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Top_Subject, subj_stats.material_count AS Top_Subject_Material_Count FROM ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(material_count) AS total_materials FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) dept_stats LEFT JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, material_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY material_count DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte ) subj_stats ON dept_stats.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = subj_stats.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND subj_stats.rn = 1 ORDER BY dept_stats.total_materials DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.window_column, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.total_materials, s2.Top_Subject, s2.Top_Subject_Material_Count FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each department name and school name, where the number of enrolled students in the offered subject is greater than 3, show the number of offered subjects, the minimum number of enrolled students, the subject title with the highest number of enrolled students in that department and school, and the maximum average total units for subjects in that department that had library reserve materials in any single term with a term status of 'Previous'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS offered_subject_count, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME ), subq1 AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.offered_subject_count, ic.min_enrolled_students, ls.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_with_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte1 ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC) AS rn FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 ) ls ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ls.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.SCHOOL_NAME = ls.SCHOOL_NAME AND ls.rn = 1 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.TERM_CODE, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.TERM_CODE ), subq2 AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(avg_total_units) AS max_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY max_avg_total_units DESC ) SELECT subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.SCHOOL_NAME, subq1.offered_subject_count, subq1.min_enrolled_students, subq1.subject_with_max_enrollment, subq2.max_avg_total_units FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each academic year, academic year description, department name, subject ID, total units, average total units, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, and deviation of each subject's total units from the department's average in that year, also provide the course level, number of unique degree-granting courses with total units greater than 6, the minimum total units offered, and the number of courses where the design units are at least 3 for that department and course level. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.COURSE_LEVEL, ic.course_count, ic.min_total_units, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ccc.DESIGN_UNITS >= 3 THEN scd.COURSE END) AS courses_with_design_units_3_or_more FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.COURSE_LEVEL = scd.COURSE_LEVEL JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.COURSE_LEVEL, ic.course_count, ic.min_total_units ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.TOTAL_UNITS, d.avg_total_units, d.stddev_total_units, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - d.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_stats d ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AND i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, deviation_from_avg DESC ) SELECT s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.TOTAL_UNITS, s2.avg_total_units, s2.stddev_total_units, s2.deviation_from_avg, s1.COURSE_LEVEL, s1.course_count, s1.min_total_units, s1.courses_with_design_units_3_or_more FROM subq2 s2 JOIN subq1 s1 ON s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.deviation_from_avg DESC, s1.COURSE_LEVEL;

question: For each academic year, for the department with the highest average number of enrolled students in library subjects (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students), show the academic year, the department name, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrollments for that department in that year, and for each subject offered by that department in the term '2017JA', show the subject title, number of enrolled students, department full name, subject code, subject code description, and whether the number of enrolled students is 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% greater than the average for that subject code), 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% less than the average for that subject code), or 'AVERAGE', ordered by academic year and subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ata.TERM_CODE = lso.TERM_CODE WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), subq1 AS ( SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS Top_Department, AVG(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) DESC) AS dept_rank FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) ranked JOIN inner_cte1 ic ON ranked.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND ranked.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME WHERE ranked.dept_rank = 1 GROUP BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' ), subject_code_avg AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY SUBJECT_CODE ), subq2 AS ( SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, CASE WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < a.avg_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte2 i JOIN subject_code_avg a ON i.SUBJECT_CODE = a.SUBJECT_CODE ) SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.Top_Department, s1.avg_enrollment, s1.enrollment_variance, s1.enrollment_stddev, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s2.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s2.enrollment_category FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.Top_Department = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For each subject offered in the term '2017FA', provide the subject title, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the record counts for all tip materials associated with that subject, the department name, the total number of enrolled students for each subject, and for each matching department and subject, also provide the course number, the offering school name, the total number of unique library subjects offered, and the minimum total units for those subjects where the number of enrolled students is greater than 2. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(t.RECORD_COUNT) - MIN(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_range, VARIANCE(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON s.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.record_count_range, i.record_count_variance, i.record_count_stddev, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.SUBJECT_ID FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON i.SUBJECT_TITLE = s.SUBJECT_TITLE AND s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' ORDER BY i.record_count_range DESC ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, l.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, l.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COURSE_NUMBER, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(subject_count) AS total_subjects, MIN(min_total_units) AS min_total_units, SUBJECT_ID FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COURSE_NUMBER, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, SUBJECT_ID WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(subject_count) > 0 ORDER BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COURSE_NUMBER, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.record_count_range, s1.record_count_variance, s1.record_count_stddev, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.COURSE_NUMBER, s2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s2.total_subjects, s2.min_total_units FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.COURSE_NUMBER, s2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME

question: List, for each academic year, the academic year description, the average total units and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for subjects offered in the fall term with a material status of 'U' in the library reserve (only for those academic years where the average total units is greater than the overall average across all such years), as well as the academic year description, the geometric mean of the number of library reserve material details per subject offered (considering only records where the material status is 'U' and the academic term is a regular term), and the total number of unique subjects offered in that year. For each row, include a reason for inclusion: 'AvgTotalUnitsAboveOverall' for the first case and 'GeometricMeanAndUniqueSubjects' for the second. The columns should be: academic year description, average total units, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, geometric mean of materials per subject, unique subjects offered, and reason. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.avg_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT AVG(avg_total_units) AS overall_avg FROM inner_cte ) oa ON ic.avg_total_units > oa.overall_avg ORDER BY ic.stddev_total_units DESC ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(material_count))) AS geometric_mean_materials_per_subject FROM ( SELECT LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count, LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE ) sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON sub.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_materials_per_subject, COUNT(DISTINCT LRM.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS unique_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AT ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = AT.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND AT.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL LRM ON LRM.TERM_CODE = AT.TERM_CODE AND LRM.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_materials_per_subject ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean_materials_per_subject DESC ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.avg_total_units, s1.stddev_total_units, NULL AS geometric_mean_materials_per_subject, NULL AS unique_subjects_offered, 'AvgTotalUnitsAboveOverall' AS Reason FROM Subquery1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS avg_total_units, NULL AS stddev_total_units, s2.geometric_mean_materials_per_subject, s2.unique_subjects_offered, 'GeometricMeanAndUniqueSubjects' AS Reason FROM Subquery2 s2 ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, Reason;

question: For courses in the School of Engineering that are degree granting and have a minimum total units of at least 12 (in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by course number), and for each department, show the course description, department name, subject code, subject title, the minimum total units in the window, the school name, the variance of the total number of units for subjects offered by that department, the subject ID, the total units for that subject, and the deviation of each subject's total units from the department's average, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and that are degree granting. The columns should be shown in the following order: course description, department name, subject code, subject title, minimum total units in the window, school name, variance of total units, subject ID, total units, and deviation from department average. Do not return any rounded answers.
