SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, MIN(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_CODE = t2.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column >= 12 ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ssc.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.total_units_variance, sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, (sos.TOTAL_UNITS - AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE)) AS deviation_from_dept_avg FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN inner_cte ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ORDER BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sos.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT subq1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.SUBJECT_CODE, subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq1.window_column AS MIN_TOTAL_UNITS_WINDOW, subq2.SCHOOL_NAME, subq2.total_units_variance, subq2.SUBJECT_ID, subq2.TOTAL_UNITS, subq2.deviation_from_dept_avg FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = subq2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.SUBJECT_CODE, subq2.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For subjects in the "Engineering" school with total units equal to 1, show the subject ID, subject title, department name, academic year, the rank of each subject within its academic year group ordered by subject ID, the term description, and the term start date, and for each such subject in a term where there are library subjects offered in '2014FA' with number of enrolled students greater than the average for all library subjects in '2014FA', also show the library subject title, the number of enrolled students in the library subject, the responsible faculty name from the TIP subject, the offer department name from the TIP subject, and the minimum number of enrolled students in the library subject within a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the TIP subject's responsible faculty MIT ID. The results are ordered by academic year, subject ID, and descending number of enrolled students in the library subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t1.TERM_CODE FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 1 ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.window_column, t3.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t3.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t3 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t3.TERM_CODE ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( ORDER BY t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, l.TERM_CODE FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' ) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, window_column, TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte WHERE NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > ( SELECT AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE TERM_CODE = '2014FA' ) ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.window_column AS subject_rank_within_year, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.TERM_START_DATE, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE AS library_subject_title, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.window_column AS min_enrolled_students_window FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.TERM_CODE = s2.TERM_CODE ORDER BY s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.SUBJECT_ID, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC;

question: For the academic year and its description with the highest variance in the number of tip detail records for subjects offered in the fall term (with at least one associated tip detail record), what is the most represented department among those subjects in that year and the count of such subjects from that department, and for each subject code in that department, what is the subject code, the number of subject codes, the minimum department budget code, and the full department name? Please display the academic year, academic year description, record count variance, most represented department, subject count, subject code, subject code count, minimum department budget code, and department full name, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t1.record_count_variance, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Most_Represented_Department, t2.Subject_Count FROM ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(record_count_variance) AS record_count_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC LIMIT 1 ) t1 JOIN ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME ) t2 ON t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND t2.rn = 1 ORDER BY t1.record_count_variance DESC ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.subject_code_count, ic.min_dept_budget_code, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, subq1.record_count_variance, subq1.Most_Represented_Department, subq1.Subject_Count, subq2.SUBJECT_CODE, subq2.subject_code_count, subq2.min_dept_budget_code, subq2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.Most_Represented_Department = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subq1.record_count_variance DESC, subq2.subject_code_count DESC;

question: For each department where the maximum total units of any course offered by that department is greater than 6, what are the department name, the maximum total units, the name of the school that department belongs to, and the subject code of the course with the maximum total units, and for each such course offered in the term with code '2022SU', what are the subject's ID, total units, department name, and their dense rank considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the total number of units? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.max_total_units, i.SCHOOL_NAME, c.SUBJECT_CODE FROM inner_cte i JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.SCHOOL_NAME = s.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = i.max_total_units ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2022SU' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS DESC ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.max_total_units, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.TOTAL_UNITS, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS subq2_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.window_column FROM subq1 s1 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON s1.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE AND s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN subq2 s2 ON ccc.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID ;

question: For courses in the SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION table with a department code of 6, show the course, course description, department name, school name, program code, program title, category code, category title, four digit code, four digit title, and the minimum warehouse load date from the CIP table over each category code group, but only include those courses where the minimum warehouse load date for the category code is after '01-JAN-20' and where the department offered subjects in the Fall term of 2022 with the highest number of lecture units among its offered subjects greater than 3. For these departments, also show the highest number of lecture units among its offered subjects, the start date of the term, and the total number of subjects offered by that department in that term. Order the results by category code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH CourseCIPInfo AS ( SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.PROGRAM_CODE, c.PROGRAM_TITLE, c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY c.CATEGORY_CODE) AS min_warehouse_load_date FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION s JOIN CIP c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT = 6 ), DeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, at2.TERM_START_DATE FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 ON td.TERM_CODE = at2.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at2.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) > 3 ), DeptSubjectCount AS ( SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.max_lecture_units, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, COUNT(ccs2.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_offered FROM DeptSubjectStats inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs2 ON ccs2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ccs2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.max_lecture_units, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE ) SELECT cci.COURSE, cci.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, cci.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cci.SCHOOL_NAME, cci.PROGRAM_CODE, cci.PROGRAM_TITLE, cci.CATEGORY_CODE, cci.CATEGORY_TITLE, cci.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, cci.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, cci.min_warehouse_load_date, dsc.max_lecture_units, dsc.TERM_START_DATE, dsc.num_subjects_offered FROM CourseCIPInfo cci JOIN DeptSubjectCount dsc ON cci.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsc.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE cci.min_warehouse_load_date > '01-JAN-20' ORDER BY cci.CATEGORY_CODE;

question: For IAP subjects with a maximum enrollment of 12, show the activity title, enrollment type, academic year, term description, subject title, the difference between the maximum enrollment and the total units, the subject code, subject code description, department name, and the number of subjects in the same department, for each subject offered in the same term and where the school code and subject title are not null. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH iap_enrollment AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 12 ) SELECT i.ACTIVITY_TITLE, i.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, (12 - c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS enrollment_minus_units FROM inner_cte i JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = c.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND i.SUBJECT_TITLE = c.SUBJECT_TITLE ), subject_department_counts AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_CODE IS NOT NULL AND t1.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, dept_counts.subjects_in_department, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS subjects_in_department FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_CODE IS NOT NULL AND t1.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) dept_counts ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT iap_enrollment.ACTIVITY_TITLE, iap_enrollment.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, iap_enrollment.ACADEMIC_YEAR, iap_enrollment.TERM_DESCRIPTION, iap_enrollment.SUBJECT_TITLE, iap_enrollment.enrollment_minus_units, subject_department_counts.SUBJECT_CODE, subject_department_counts.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, subject_department_counts.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subject_department_counts.subjects_in_department FROM iap_enrollment JOIN subject_department_counts ON iap_enrollment.SUBJECT_TITLE = subject_department_counts.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY iap_enrollment.ACADEMIC_YEAR, iap_enrollment.ACTIVITY_TITLE;

question: For subjects offered in the term with code '2022FA', show the subject ID, department name, term description, the running sum of total units within each academic year, the subject title, and whether the subject is offered in the fall term, along with, for each matching department and grade type in the School of Engineering, the grade type, department name, the number of subjects with at least 6 units, the average total units for those subjects, the school name, and the department full name. The results are ordered by subject ID, grade type, and department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ), cte1 AS ( SELECT icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.window_column, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM, icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte1 icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON icte.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID AND t2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.GRADE_TYPE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ), cte2 AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(grade_type) OVER (ORDER BY grade_type_sort, grade_type, dept_sort) = grade_type THEN NULL ELSE grade_type END AS grade_type, dept, subj_count, avg_units, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS department_full_name, tbltmp.dept_sort, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(GRADE_TYPE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE GRADE_TYPE END AS grade_type_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(GRADE_TYPE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(GRADE_TYPE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE GRADE_TYPE END AS grade_type, CASE WHEN GROUPING(GRADE_TYPE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, DEPARTMENT_NAME AS dept, COUNT(*) AS subj_count, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, MAX(DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY GRADE_TYPE, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP ) tbltmp LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tbltmp.dept = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY grade_type_sort, dept_sort ) SELECT c1.SUBJECT_ID, c1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, c1.window_column, c1.SUBJECT_TITLE, c1.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM, c2.grade_type, c2.dept, c2.subj_count, c2.avg_units, c2.school_name, c2.department_full_name FROM cte1 c1 JOIN cte2 c2 ON c1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY c1.SUBJECT_ID, c2.grade_type, c2.dept_sort;

question: For each academic year and department, what is the academic year, academic year description, department name, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for all library reserve materials offered in terms that have a material status of 'U', and for those departments, what is the total number of reserved library materials for subjects offered in the term '2009SP' where the total number of reserved materials is greater than the average number of reserved materials per department for that term? List the academic year, academic year description, department name, coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), department name for 2009SP, and total reserved materials for 2009SP in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH academic_year_variation AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), dept_reserved_materials_2009sp AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, reserved_materials FROM inner_cte WHERE reserved_materials > ( SELECT AVG(reserved_materials) FROM inner_cte ) ) SELECT ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ayv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ayv.coefficient_of_variation, drm.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, drm.reserved_materials FROM academic_year_variation ayv LEFT JOIN dept_reserved_materials_2009sp drm ON ayv.DEPARTMENT_NAME = drm.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: For each major use description, list the building-room identifier, area, major use description, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the major use description, as well as the organization name, department name, department code, department long name, department level, and the average organization number in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the organization parent, ordered by the organization name, but only include those organizations whose organization number is greater than the average organization number of their parent group. For each major use description, include a grand total row for all rooms in the format of (null, null, major use description, total rooms) and only include rooms whose organization matches the filtered organizations. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.AREA, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.DESCRIPTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM FCLT_MAJOR_USE t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 ), RoomCounts AS ( SELECT DESCRIPTION, COUNT(*) AS total_rooms FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DESCRIPTION ), RoomMajorUse AS ( SELECT ic.BUILDING_ROOM, ic.AREA, ic.DESCRIPTION, ic.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, ic.window_column FROM inner_cte1 ic UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS BUILDING_ROOM, NULL AS AREA, rc.DESCRIPTION, NULL AS FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, rc.total_rooms AS window_column FROM RoomCounts rc ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, t2.ORG_PARENT, t2.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER, t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, AVG(t2.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) OVER ( PARTITION BY t2.ORG_PARENT ORDER BY t2.ORGANIZATION_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t2.FCLT_MAJOR_ORG_KEY = 230 ), FilteredOrgs AS ( SELECT i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, i.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, i.window_column, i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM inner_cte2 i JOIN ( SELECT ORG_PARENT, AVG(ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS avg_org_num FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY ORG_PARENT ) a ON i.ORG_PARENT = a.ORG_PARENT WHERE i.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER > a.avg_org_num ) SELECT rm.BUILDING_ROOM, rm.AREA, rm.DESCRIPTION, rm.window_column AS room_window_column, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fo.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, fo.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, fo.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, fo.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, fo.window_column AS org_window_column FROM RoomMajorUse rm JOIN FilteredOrgs fo ON rm.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY rm.DESCRIPTION, rm.BUILDING_ROOM, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME

question: For each organization, show the organization key, organization name, department name, the corresponding HR org unit title, the number of HR org units, the total of their department IDs, and, if available, the space unit name, space unit code, department count, number of supervisees, and the highest research volume ever recorded for each department count group for space units with a space unit code of 97500. Also, for each organization and department name, include a grand total for all HR org units in the format of (organization key, organization name, department name, null, total department IDs, null, ...). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS hr_org_unit_count, SUM(h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS total_department_id FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION f JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID > 100000 GROUP BY f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ), OrgUnitDetails AS ( SELECT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION f JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID > 100000 ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, SUM(i.hr_org_unit_count) AS hr_org_unit_count, SUM(i.total_department_id) AS total_department_id FROM inner_cte1 i LEFT JOIN OrgUnitDetails o ON i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY AND i.ORGANIZATION_NAME = o.ORGANIZATION_NAME AND i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(i.hr_org_unit_count) > 0 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t1.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.DEPT_COUNT, t2.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, t2.RESEARCH_VOLUME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DEPT_NAMES WHERE t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 97500 ), SpaceUnitAgg AS ( SELECT space_unit_name, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, ORGANIZATION_NAME, DEPT_COUNT, NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, MAX(RESEARCH_VOLUME) AS highest_research_volume, FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY space_unit_name, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, ORGANIZATION_NAME, DEPT_COUNT, NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) SELECT rr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, rr.ORGANIZATION_NAME, rr.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, rr.hr_org_unit_count, rr.total_department_id, sua.space_unit_name, sua.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, sua.DEPT_COUNT, sua.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, sua.highest_research_volume FROM RollupResults rr LEFT JOIN SpaceUnitAgg sua ON rr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = sua.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY rr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, rr.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE

question: For each subject in the 2019FA term with total units greater than 1 and for each category, show the subject ID, subject title, department name, the running sum of total units within each school, the academic year description, the category name, and the highest maximum enrollment among its activities, ordered by subject ID and category name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH SubjectStats AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t1.TERM_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS > 1 ), SubjectStatsWithYear AS ( SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.window_column, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.TERM_CODE FROM SubjectStats ic JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON ic.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE ), CategoryMaxEnrollment AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) AS window_column, d.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY ), CategoryMaxEnrollmentAgg AS ( SELECT IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, MAX(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS highest_max_enrollment FROM CategoryMaxEnrollment GROUP BY IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.window_column AS running_sum_total_units_within_school, s.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, c.highest_max_enrollment FROM SubjectStatsWithYear s JOIN CategoryMaxEnrollmentAgg c ON s.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = s.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_ID, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME;

question: For each subject category, provide the category name, the average and variance of the maximum enrollment across all activities in that category, and the difference between the average and the variance for each category. Additionally, for each subject offered by the library in the term "2019SP" whose offering department name matches the subject category name, show the subject title, the number of enrolled students, the term description, the total units for the subject, the average total units within each subject group, the offering department name, and the school name. Do not repeat the subject title if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the results by the difference between the average and variance in descending order, then by the number of enrolled students and department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH iap_category_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, AVG(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, VARIANCE(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS var_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d ON c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ) SELECT i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, i.avg_max_enrollment, i.var_max_enrollment, (i.avg_max_enrollment - i.var_max_enrollment) AS avg_minus_var FROM inner_cte i ORDER BY avg_minus_var DESC ), library_subjects_2019sp AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ss.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY ss.SUBJECT_GROUP_ID ORDER BY lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_total_units, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, lso.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2019SP' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(SUBJECT_TITLE) OVER (ORDER BY NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, OFFER_DEPT_NAME) = SUBJECT_TITLE THEN NULL ELSE SUBJECT_TITLE END AS subject_title, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, TERM_DESCRIPTION, TOTAL_UNITS, avg_total_units, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, SUBJECT_ID FROM inner_cte ORDER BY NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT ics.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, ics.avg_max_enrollment, ics.var_max_enrollment, ics.avg_minus_var, lso.subject_title, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.TERM_DESCRIPTION, lso.TOTAL_UNITS, lso.avg_total_units, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME FROM iap_category_stats ics LEFT JOIN library_subjects_2019sp lso ON ics.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY ics.avg_minus_var DESC, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: For rooms with a square footage of 150, show the building room, room number, space unit code, space unit name, and the number of rooms for each space unit code (including a grand total for each space unit code in the format of (null, null, space unit code, space unit name, total rooms)), and for each such room, if it is assigned to a department and its area is greater than 40 and above the average area of rooms (with area > 40) assigned to that department, also show the department name and the room area. List the building room, room number, space unit code, space unit name, total rooms, department name, and area in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH RoomRollup AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.BUILDING_ROOM, sd.ROOM_NUMBER, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, su.SPACE_UNIT FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY WHERE sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE = 150 ), RoomCounts AS ( SELECT BUILDING_ROOM, ROOM_NUMBER, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(*) AS num_rooms FROM inner_cte GROUP BY BUILDING_ROOM, ROOM_NUMBER, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, SPACE_UNIT ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT BUILDING_ROOM, ROOM_NUMBER, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, SPACE_UNIT, SUM(num_rooms) AS total_rooms FROM RoomCounts GROUP BY BUILDING_ROOM, ROOM_NUMBER, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, SPACE_UNIT WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(num_rooms) > 0 ) SELECT BUILDING_ROOM, ROOM_NUMBER, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, SPACE_UNIT, total_rooms FROM RollupResults ), DeptRoomAboveAvg AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.AREA FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 40 ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(AREA) AS avg_area FROM inner_cte GROUP BY HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.BUILDING_ROOM, i.AREA FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg a ON i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE i.AREA > a.avg_area ) SELECT rr.BUILDING_ROOM, rr.ROOM_NUMBER, rr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, rr.SPACE_UNIT, rr.total_rooms, d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.AREA FROM RoomRollup rr JOIN DeptRoomAboveAvg d ON rr.BUILDING_ROOM = d.BUILDING_ROOM ORDER BY rr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, rr.BUILDING_ROOM, rr.ROOM_NUMBER, d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.AREA DESC;

question: For each organization and its associated space unit where the organization is assignable and the space unit code is greater than 50000, and for organizations with an organization level of 5 and HR org unit level 'DEPARTMENTS', provide the organization, space unit, number of space units, minimum organization number, DLC name, organization name, organization ID, HR org unit title, HR department name, HR org unit level, and the row number within each HR department name group ordered by organization name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION, s.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS space_unit_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_org_number FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION o JOIN SPACE_UNIT s ON o.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE > 50000 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION, s.SPACE_UNIT ) SELECT i.ORGANIZATION, i.SPACE_UNIT, i.space_unit_count, i.min_org_number, o.DLC_NAME, o.DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte i JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON i.ORGANIZATION = o.ORGANIZATION ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID, t1.DLC_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS window_column, t1.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte WHERE HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS' ) SELECT subq1.ORGANIZATION, subq1.SPACE_UNIT, subq1.space_unit_count, subq1.min_org_number, subq1.DLC_NAME, subq2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, subq2.ORGANIZATION_ID, subq2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, subq2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq2.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, subq2.window_column FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DLC_KEY = subq2.DLC_KEY

question: For each previous academic term and each day of the week, and for each subject that has at least one enrolled student in that term, show the term code (with subtotals and grand total as in the original), day of week, the number of calendar dates that fall on that day of week for the term's start date, the average calendar year for those dates, the term start date, the subject title, the maximum number of enrolled students for that subject, the tip material status key, and the total units for the subject. Do not repeat the term if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by term start date, day of week, and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t0.CALENDAR_DATE, t0.DAY_OF_WEEK, AVG(t0.CALENDAR_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.CALENDAR_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_START_DATE) AS window_column FROM TIME_DAY t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.CALENDAR_DATE = t1.TERM_START_DATE WHERE t1.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(term) OVER (ORDER BY term_sort, day_sort) = term THEN NULL ELSE term END AS term, day_of_week, date_count, avg_calendar_year, term_start_date, term_sort FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DAY_OF_WEEK) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DAY_OF_WEEK) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DAY_OF_WEEK) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DAY_OF_WEEK) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DAY_OF_WEEK END AS day_sort, DAY_OF_WEEK AS day_of_week, COUNT(DISTINCT CALENDAR_DATE) AS date_count, AVG(window_column) AS avg_calendar_year, MIN(TERM_START_DATE) AS term_start_date FROM inner_cte GROUP BY TERM_CODE, DAY_OF_WEEK WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY term_sort, day_sort ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.TERM_CODE, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID INNER JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled_students, TERM_CODE, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_CODE, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TOTAL_UNITS ) SELECT s1.term, s1.day_of_week, s1.date_count, s1.avg_calendar_year, s1.term_start_date, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.max_enrolled_students, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2.TOTAL_UNITS FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.term_sort = s2.TERM_CODE ORDER BY s1.term_start_date, s1.day_of_week, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For each school and department, provide the school name, department name, the average and variance of the total units for its courses with a non-null subject title and total units greater than 0, and for each academic year and subject in that department, give the academic year, academic year description, subject ID, total units, the department's average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for subjects offered in regular terms in that year, and the deviation of the subject's total units from the department's average in that year. Also include a grand total row for all departments in each school in the format of (school name, null, average, variance, ...). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ), SchoolDeptUnits AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance, DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units, DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT sdu.SCHOOL_NAME, sdu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sdu.avg_units, sdu.units_variance, i2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i2.SUBJECT_ID, i2.TOTAL_UNITS, ds.avg_total_units, ds.stddev_total_units, (i2.TOTAL_UNITS - ds.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg FROM SchoolDeptUnits sdu JOIN dept_stats ds ON sdu.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND sdu.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN inner_cte2 i2 ON ds.ACADEMIC_YEAR = i2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND ds.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = i2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AND ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = i2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE = i2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY sdu.SCHOOL_NAME, sdu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, deviation_from_avg DESC;

question: For IAP subject activities with a maximum enrollment of at least 10 and that are not cancelled, show the activity title, enrollment type, the academic term description, the subject title from the course catalog, the department name, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by activity title. Additionally, for each such department name, include the school name, the number of offered subjects where the number of enrolled students in the offered subject is greater than the average number of enrolled students for that department and school, and the minimum number of enrolled students for those subjects. Present the results in the order: activity title, enrollment type, academic term description, subject title, department name, window column, school name, offered subject count, and minimum enrolled students. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 10 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' ), subq1 AS ( SELECT inner_cte1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.window_column, t2.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte1 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON inner_cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE = t2.SUBJECT_TITLE ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER ), avg_enrollment AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME ), subq2 AS ( SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(i.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS offered_subject_count, MIN(i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte2 i JOIN avg_enrollment a ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.SCHOOL_NAME = a.SCHOOL_NAME WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_enrolled GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.offered_subject_count, s2.min_enrolled_students FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each offering department name and school name where the number of enrolled students is greater than 2, provide the count of distinct subject IDs, the minimum ISBN value for the associated course materials, the maximum of these subject counts across all department and school combinations, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses offered by that department (considering only courses that have at least one associated TIP material), and the total number of such courses per department. Show the offering department name, school name, subject count, minimum ISBN, maximum subject count over all, variance of enrolled students, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrolled students, and total courses with TIP material, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte_1 AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(td.ISBN) AS min_isbn FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ), subq1 AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, subject_count, min_isbn, (SELECT MAX(subject_count) FROM inner_cte_1) AS max_subject_count_over_all FROM inner_cte_1 ), inner_cte_2 AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL ), subq2 AS ( SELECT inner_cte_2.department, VARIANCE(inner_cte_2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS num_enrolled_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte_2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS num_enrolled_stddev, COUNT(*) AS total_courses_with_tip_material FROM inner_cte_2 GROUP BY inner_cte_2.department ) SELECT s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s1.subject_count, s1.min_isbn, s1.max_subject_count_over_all, s2.num_enrolled_variance, s2.num_enrolled_stddev, s2.total_courses_with_tip_material FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.department ;

question: For each offering department name and course number description where the number of enrolled students in the library subject offered is greater than 3 and where the department has at least one course material with status 'RQ', show the offering department name, course number description, number of distinct ISBNs in TIP_DETAIL, minimum responsible faculty MIT ID from TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED, total number of TIP_DETAIL records per offering department name and course number description, the offering school name, the number of unique subjects with 'RQ' status, the minimum total units for those subjects, the maximum number of enrolled students for those subjects, the average number of TIP_DETAIL records per subject with 'RQ' status (rounded), and the normalized number of distinct ISBNs per minimum total units (rounded). List the columns in the order: offering department name, course number description, number of distinct ISBNs, minimum responsible faculty MIT ID, total number of TIP_DETAIL records, offering school name, number of unique subjects, minimum total units, maximum number of enrolled students, average number of TIP_DETAIL records per subject, and normalized number of distinct ISBNs per minimum total units.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT t.ISBN) AS isbn_count, MIN(ts.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID) AS min_faculty_mit_id FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ts ON t.SUBJECT_ID = ts.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, inner_cte.isbn_count, inner_cte.min_faculty_mit_id, dept_counts.total_tip_detail_records FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, COUNT(t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_tip_detail_records FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC ) AS dept_counts ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_counts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC = dept_counts.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units, MAX(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_num_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte ic JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units ) SELECT s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, s1.isbn_count, s1.min_faculty_mit_id, s1.total_tip_detail_records, s2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s2.subject_count, s2.min_total_units, s2.max_num_enrolled_students, ROUND(s1.total_tip_detail_records / NULLIF(s2.subject_count, 0), 2) AS avg_tip_detail_records_per_subject, ROUND(s1.isbn_count / NULLIF(s2.min_total_units, 0), 2) AS normalized_isbn_per_unit FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY avg_tip_detail_records_per_subject DESC;

question: For each offer department code in the 2012SU term with total units greater than 0, list the subject title, course number, department name, the dense rank over the offer department code, the course, course description, school name, program code, program title, category code, category title, four digit code, four digit title, and the minimum warehouse load date from the CIP table over each category code group for courses in department 6, and include a grand total of subjects per offer department code and a grand total for all courses in each school in the format (nulls for subject-specific fields, department name, total subjects, course-specific fields, school name, and total courses). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ), dept_counts1 AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS total_subjects FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY WHERE TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.PROGRAM_CODE, c.PROGRAM_TITLE, c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY c.CATEGORY_CODE) AS min_warehouse_load_date FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION s JOIN CIP c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT = 6 ), SchoolTotals2 AS ( SELECT NULL AS COURSE, NULL AS COURSE_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS PROGRAM_CODE, NULL AS PROGRAM_TITLE, NULL AS CATEGORY_CODE, NULL AS CATEGORY_TITLE, NULL AS FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, NULL AS FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, NULL AS min_warehouse_load_date, COUNT(*) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT ic1.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic1.COURSE_NUMBER, ic1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic1.window_column, NULL AS total_subjects, ic2.COURSE, ic2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ic2.SCHOOL_NAME, ic2.PROGRAM_CODE, ic2.PROGRAM_TITLE, ic2.CATEGORY_CODE, ic2.CATEGORY_TITLE, ic2.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, ic2.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, ic2.min_warehouse_load_date, NULL AS total_courses FROM inner_cte1 ic1 LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ic1.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE LEFT JOIN inner_cte2 ic2 ON scd.COURSE = ic2.COURSE UNION ALL SELECT NULL, NULL, dc1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL, dc1.total_subjects, s2.COURSE, s2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s2.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.PROGRAM_CODE, s2.PROGRAM_TITLE, s2.CATEGORY_CODE, s2.CATEGORY_TITLE, s2.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, s2.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, s2.min_warehouse_load_date, s2.total_courses FROM dept_counts1 dc1 LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd2 ON dc1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd2.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SchoolTotals2 s2 ON scd2.SCHOOL_NAME = s2.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, CATEGORY_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE, COURSE

question: For each department that offered subjects in both the 2012SU term and the current academic term, show the department name, the variance of the total units for subjects offered in 2012SU, the average number of enrolled students per subject in 2012SU, the average total units for subjects offered in the current term, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for subjects in the current term, and the school within the department that has the highest average total units in the current term along with its average total units. List the results in order of variance of total units in 2012SU descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON tso.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_units_variance, AVG(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ss.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_units_variance ORDER BY inner_cte.total_units_variance DESC ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.SCHOOL_NAME, ss.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON atp.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, hs.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_with_highest_avg, hs.school_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS school_avg_total_units, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME ) hs ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = hs.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND hs.rn = 1 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, hs.SCHOOL_NAME, hs.school_avg_total_units ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.total_units_variance AS variance_total_units_2012SU, s1.avg_enrolled_students AS avg_enrolled_students_2012SU, s2.avg_total_units AS avg_total_units_current, s2.total_units_variance AS variance_total_units_current, s2.total_units_stddev AS stddev_total_units_current, s2.school_with_highest_avg, s2.school_avg_total_units FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.total_units_variance DESC;

question: For subjects offered in the term with code '2022FA' that also have a library material status of 'U' and a tip material status of 'RQ', show the subject ID, department name, term description, the running sum of total units within each academic year, the subject title, whether the subject is offered in the fall term, the minimum library material status key, the total record count, the most recent warehouse load date from the library reserve table, and the most recent warehouse load date from the tip detail table, ordered by subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.window_column, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM FROM inner_cte icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON icte.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID AND t2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_ID ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lrmd.SUBJECT_ID, MIN(lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) AS min_material_status, SUM(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_records FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lrmd.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY lrmd.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.min_material_status, inner_cte.total_records, MAX(lrmd.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS latest_library_warehouse_date, MAX(td.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS latest_tip_warehouse_date FROM inner_cte JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.min_material_status, inner_cte.total_records ORDER BY inner_cte.total_records DESC ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.window_column, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM, s2.min_material_status, s2.total_records, s2.latest_library_warehouse_date, s2.latest_tip_warehouse_date FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_ID

question: For each subject code where the department is degree granting, show the subject code, subject code description, department name (from subject code), school name, the number of subject codes per school name and whether the subject code description is present ('Has Description') or missing ('No Description'), and for each matching department in subjects offered in the term with code '2022SU', show the subject's ID, total units, department name (from subject offered), and their dense rank considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the total number of units. For each school name, include a grand total for all subject codes in the format of (null, null, null, school name, null, total subject codes, null, null, null, null). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), SubjectCodeVisibility AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, CASE WHEN SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND SUBJECT_CODE_DESC <> 'nan' THEN 'Has Description' ELSE 'No Description' END AS description_status FROM inner_cte1 ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, description_status, COUNT(*) AS total_subject_codes FROM SubjectCodeVisibility GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, description_status WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2022SU' ) SELECT scv.SUBJECT_CODE, scv.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scv.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS SCV_DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.description_status, rr.total_subject_codes, ic2.SUBJECT_ID, ic2.TOTAL_UNITS, ic2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS IC2_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic2.window_column FROM RollupResults rr LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, description_status FROM SubjectCodeVisibility ) scv ON rr.SCHOOL_NAME = scv.SCHOOL_NAME AND rr.description_status = scv.description_status LEFT JOIN inner_cte2 ic2 ON scv.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.description_status, ic2.TOTAL_UNITS DESC

question: For each department, what is the department name, the variance of the total units of subjects offered in the 2022 academic year, the average number of enrolled students in those subjects, and the highest running sum of academic years (within that department) for academic term parameters where the term indicator is 'C'? List the results ordered by the variance of total units in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH dept_units_variance AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_units_variance, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.COURSE_NUMBER = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_units_variance ORDER BY inner_cte.total_units_variance DESC ), dept_highest_running_sum AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_PARAMETER, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_INDICATOR = 'C' ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(window_column) AS highest_running_sum FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.total_units_variance, d1.avg_enrolled_students, d2.highest_running_sum FROM dept_units_variance d1 JOIN dept_highest_running_sum d2 ON d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d1.total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each offering department and school where the course material status is 'RQ' and the department is among the top 5 departments with the highest total subject units in the academic term with term code '2009SP', provide the department name, school name, number of unique subjects, minimum total units for those subjects, average number of enrolled students for those subjects, the total units for that department in 2009SP, the subject title with the highest units in that department in 2009SP, and the number of subjects offered by that department in that term, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ), RQ_Dept_Summary AS ( SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_num_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte1 ic JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' ), Top5DeptStats AS ( SELECT dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dept_stats.Total_Dept_Units, subj_stats.Max_Unit_Subject_Title, dept_stats.Subject_Count FROM ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(TOTAL_UNITS) AS Total_Dept_Units, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY Total_Dept_Units DESC LIMIT 5 ) dept_stats LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE AS Max_Unit_Subject_Title FROM ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY TOTAL_UNITS DESC, SUBJECT_TITLE ASC) AS rn FROM inner_cte2 ) ranked WHERE rn = 1 ) subj_stats ON dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subj_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dept_stats.Total_Dept_Units DESC ) SELECT rqs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, rqs.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, rqs.subject_count, rqs.min_total_units, rqs.avg_num_enrolled_students, t5ds.Total_Dept_Units, t5ds.Max_Unit_Subject_Title, t5ds.Subject_Count FROM RQ_Dept_Summary rqs JOIN Top5DeptStats t5ds ON rqs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = t5ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY rqs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, rqs.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME;

question: For IAP subject activities with a maximum enrollment of 12, show the activity title, enrollment type, maximum enrollment, term description, subject title, number of enrolled students, the academic year description, and the row number within each enrollment type group ordered by activity title. For each such activity, also provide the subject category key, the number of activities in that subject category and enrollment type group (where the maximum enrollment is greater than 10), the earliest start date of the corresponding academic term, and the latest end date of the corresponding academic term. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS activity_count, MIN(t.START_DATE) AS earliest_start_date FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN TIME_DAY t ON d.TERM_CODE = t.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ) SELECT c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, c.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, c.activity_count, c.earliest_start_date, MAX(t.END_DATE) AS latest_end_date FROM inner_cte c JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d ON c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY AND c.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE JOIN TIME_DAY t ON d.TERM_CODE = t.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE GROUP BY c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, c.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, c.activity_count, c.earliest_start_date ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 12 ) SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.MAX_ENROLLMENT, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column, inner_cte.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE ) SELECT s2.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s2.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, s2.MAX_ENROLLMENT, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.window_column, s1.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, s1.activity_count, s1.earliest_start_date, s1.latest_end_date FROM subq2 s2 JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d ON s2.TERM_CODE = d.TERM_CODE AND s2.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE JOIN subq1 s1 ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = s1.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY AND d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = s1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY s2.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, s2.window_column;

question: For each subject offered in the term 2013FA that also has a subject offered in the academic term 2006FA, list the subject offered key, the subject ID, the number of materials assigned, the total new shelf price of those materials (considering only materials with a new shelf price greater than 10), whether the total new shelf price is 'EXPENSIVE' (if it exceeds 200), 'CHEAP' (if it is less than 50), or 'MODERATE' otherwise, the subject title, the department name, the sum of lecture units within each grade type group ordered by subject ID, and the name of the responsible faculty member for each subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, d.SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count, SUM(m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS total_new_shelf_price FROM TIP_DETAIL d JOIN TIP_MATERIAL m ON d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE d.TERM_CODE = '2013FA' AND m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE > 10 GROUP BY d.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, d.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT inner_cte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.material_count, inner_cte.total_new_shelf_price, CASE WHEN inner_cte.total_new_shelf_price > 200 THEN 'EXPENSIVE' WHEN inner_cte.total_new_shelf_price < 50 THEN 'CHEAP' ELSE 'MODERATE' END AS price_category FROM inner_cte ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.LECTURE_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT s1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.material_count, s1.total_new_shelf_price, s1.price_category, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.window_column, s2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID

question: For each department, list the department name, the corresponding subject ID, the subject title, the total number of enrolled students in courses that are offered by both the library and the TIP system in the term '2019FA' (where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 10), along with, for the same subject title and department, the number of enrolled students, department full name, subject code, subject code description, and whether the number of enrolled students is 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% greater than the average for that subject code), 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% less than the average for that subject code), or 'AVERAGE' for subjects offered in the term '2017JA'. Show the results ordered by department name, subject ID, and subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.SUBJECT_ID, l.SUBJECT_TITLE, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.SUBJECT_ID, l.SUBJECT_TITLE HAVING SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10 ), subq1 AS ( SELECT inner_cte1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte1.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte1.total_enrolled FROM inner_cte1 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' ), subject_code_avg AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY SUBJECT_CODE ), subq2 AS ( SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, CASE WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < a.avg_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte2 i JOIN subject_code_avg a ON i.SUBJECT_CODE = a.SUBJECT_CODE ) SELECT s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.total_enrolled, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s2.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s2.enrollment_category FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND s1.SUBJECT_TITLE = s2.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_ID, s2.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For each academic year and department where the average total units for subjects offered in regular terms is greater than the overall average for all such groups, list the academic year, department name, the average and variance of the total units for those subjects, and also provide the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units and the variance category ('HIGH_VARIANCE', 'LOW_VARIANCE', or 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE') for that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and at least 1 enrolled student). Present the results ordered by department name and academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), AcademicYearDeptAboveAvg AS ( SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_total_units, i.var_total_units FROM inner_cte1 i JOIN ( SELECT AVG(avg_total_units) AS overall_avg FROM ( SELECT AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) sub ) o ON i.avg_total_units > o.overall_avg ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DepartmentVarianceCategory AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.avg_total_units, inner_cte2.stddev_total_units, CASE WHEN inner_cte2.stddev_total_units > inner_cte2.avg_total_units * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN inner_cte2.stddev_total_units < inner_cte2.avg_total_units * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte2 ) SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.avg_total_units, a.var_total_units, d.stddev_total_units, d.variance_category FROM AcademicYearDeptAboveAvg a JOIN DepartmentVarianceCategory d ON a.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each subject offered by the library in the term with code '2014FA', show the subject ID, subject title, total number of enrolled students, offering department name, term description, term start date, term end date, and the minimum number of enrolled students for each offering department, as well as the maximum windowed average record count from tip detail records with material status key 'RQ' (using a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by financial aid year). Additionally, for each offering department, include a grand total row showing the total number of enrolled students across all its subjects (with nulls for subject ID and subject title), and the corresponding maximum windowed average record count if available. Order the results by offering department name and subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, AVG(t1.RECORD_COUNT) OVER ( PARTITION BY t0.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ) SELECT SUBJECT_ID, MAX(window_column) AS max_windowed_avg_record_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_ID ), Subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_per_dept FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(SUBJECT_ID) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE SUBJECT_ID END AS SUBJECT_ID, CASE WHEN GROUPING(SUBJECT_TITLE) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE SUBJECT_TITLE END AS SUBJECT_TITLE, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(TERM_DESCRIPTION) AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, MAX(TERM_START_DATE) AS TERM_START_DATE, MAX(TERM_END_DATE) AS TERM_END_DATE, MIN(min_enrolled_per_dept) AS min_enrolled_per_dept FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE WITH ROLLUP HAVING OFFER_DEPT_NAME IS NOT NULL ORDER BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.total_enrolled_students, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.TERM_START_DATE, s2.TERM_END_DATE, s2.min_enrolled_per_dept, s1.max_windowed_avg_record_count FROM Subq2 s2 LEFT JOIN Subq1 s1 ON s2.SUBJECT_ID = s1.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.SUBJECT_ID

question: For each subject code where the department is degree granting, show the subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, the number of subject codes per school name, and whether the subject code description is present ('Has Description') or missing ('No Description'). For each school name, include a grand total for all subject codes in the format of (null, null, null, school name, null, total subject codes). Additionally, for subjects offered in the term with code '2022SU', show each subject's ID, total units, and their dense rank considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the total number of units, matching on department name. The columns should be: subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, description status, total subject codes, subject ID, total units, and window column. Do not return any rounded answers.
