SubjectCodeVisibility GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, description_status WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( ORDER BY t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, l.COURSE_NUMBER, t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' ), FilteredSubjects AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, window_column, COURSE_NUMBER, OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 WHERE NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > ( SELECT AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE TERM_CODE = '2014FA' ) ) SELECT scv.SUBJECT_CODE, scv.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.description_status, rr.total_subject_codes, fs.SUBJECT_TITLE, fs.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, fs.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, fs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, fs.window_column FROM RollupResults rr LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, description_status FROM SubjectCodeVisibility ) scv ON rr.SCHOOL_NAME = scv.SCHOOL_NAME AND rr.description_status = scv.description_status LEFT JOIN FilteredSubjects fs ON scv.SUBJECT_CODE = fs.COURSE_NUMBER ORDER BY rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.description_status, fs.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For each department that is degree-granting and has an average subject enrollment greater than the overall average (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students), list the department name, the subject title, and the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of reserved materials per subject (where the material status is 'U'), considering only departments with at least one reserved material. For each department, include a grand total for all its subjects in the format of (department name, null, total statistics). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH ReservedMaterialStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED s JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL d ON s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(material_count) - MIN(material_count) AS reserved_material_range, VARIANCE(material_count) AS reserved_material_variance, STDDEV(material_count) AS reserved_material_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(material_count) > 0 ORDER BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE ), HighEnrollmentDepartments AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_enrollment, enrollment_variance, enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_enrollment > ( SELECT AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC ) SELECT rms.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, rms.SUBJECT_TITLE, rms.reserved_material_range, rms.reserved_material_variance, rms.reserved_material_stddev FROM ReservedMaterialStats rms WHERE rms.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM HighEnrollmentDepartments) ORDER BY rms.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, rms.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: List the term code, subject ID, minimum record count from TIP_DETAIL, total new shelf price from TIP_MATERIAL, academic year, number of enrolled students, and deviation from the average number of enrolled students for that academic year, for each term and subject where the material has a non-null author and a material info source of 'ISBN', and considering only terms that are not the current term. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT td.TERM_CODE, td.SUBJECT_ID, MIN(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS min_record_count, SUM(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS total_new_shelf_price FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE tm.AUTHOR IS NOT NULL AND tm.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE = 'ISBN' GROUP BY td.TERM_CODE, td.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.min_record_count, inner_cte.total_new_shelf_price FROM inner_cte ), Subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, (inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS - avg_stats.avg_enrolled) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) avg_stats ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = avg_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT s1.TERM_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.min_record_count, s1.total_new_shelf_price, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.deviation_from_avg FROM Subq1 s1 JOIN Subq2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY TERM_CODE, SUBJECT_ID, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC;

question: For each department hierarchy level 2 name and organization name, provide the number of organizations and the minimum organization number where the organization is assignable, including a grand total for each department hierarchy level 2 name. Additionally, for each room on floor 2, list the department hierarchy level 2 name, organization name, building room, space usage, HR org unit title, department name, department's long name, and the minimum access level in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the building component. Indicate the source of each row as either 'DepartmentSummary' or 'RoomDetail'. The results should include the columns: department hierarchy level 2 name, organization name, total organizations, minimum organization number, building room, space usage, HR org unit title, department name, department's long name, windowed minimum access level, and source, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(f.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 GROUP BY m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, ORGANIZATION_NAME, SUM(organization_count) AS total_organizations, MIN(min_organization_number) AS min_organization_number FROM inner_cte GROUP BY MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, ORGANIZATION_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(organization_count) > 0 ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.SPACE_USAGE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, MIN(t0.ACCESS_LEVEL) OVER (ORDER BY t0.BUILDING_COMPONENT ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DLC_KEY, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2 ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT s1.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s1.total_organizations, s1.min_organization_number, NULL AS BUILDING_ROOM, NULL AS SPACE_USAGE, NULL AS HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, NULL AS HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, NULL AS window_column, 'DepartmentSummary' AS Source FROM Subquery1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, s2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, NULL AS total_organizations, NULL AS min_organization_number, s2.BUILDING_ROOM, s2.SPACE_USAGE, s2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, s2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, s2.window_column, 'RoomDetail' AS Source FROM Subquery2 s2 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON s2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = f.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m ON f.DLC_KEY = m.DLC_KEY ) SELECT MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, ORGANIZATION_NAME, total_organizations, min_organization_number, BUILDING_ROOM, SPACE_USAGE, HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, window_column, Source FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, ORGANIZATION_NAME, Source, BUILDING_ROOM;

question: For departments where the average total units for subjects offered this year and letter graded is greater than the overall average total units for such subjects, and for courses in the School of Engineering that are degree granting, provide the department name, the average total units, the variance of total units, the course description, the subject title, the subject's short title, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH dept_units_stats AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), eng_courses_windowed AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance, ecw.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ecw.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, ecw.window_column FROM dept_units_stats dus JOIN eng_courses_windowed ecw ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ecw.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON ecw.SUBJECT_TITLE = t1.SUBJECT_TITLE WHERE dus.avg_total_units > ( SELECT AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' ) ORDER BY dus.total_units_variance DESC;

question: For library reserve material details with material status key equal to 'U', where the offer department has offered more than 5 unique subjects in terms from the academic year 2014 or later, list the library course instructor key, library reserve catalog key, term code, subject ID, the tip material key, tip material status key, tip ISBN, the subject title from the subject offered table, the minimum tip material status key in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the number of enrolled students, the responsible faculty name, the offer department name, the count of unique subject titles offered by the department, and the total number of enrolled students in those subjects. Order the results by the total number of enrolled students in descending order, then by library course instructor key. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH dept_subjects AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2014 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.subject_count, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2014 GROUP BY inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.subject_count HAVING inner_cte.subject_count > 5 ORDER BY total_enrolled_students DESC ), reserve_materials AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT l.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, l.TERM_CODE, l.SUBJECT_ID, t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t.ISBN, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MIN(t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) OVER ( ORDER BY s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, s.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ) SELECT inner_cte.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, inner_cte.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, inner_cte.ISBN, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.window_column, s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON inner_cte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = s.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ) SELECT rm.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, rm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, rm.TERM_CODE, rm.SUBJECT_ID, rm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, rm.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, rm.ISBN, rm.SUBJECT_TITLE, rm.window_column, rm.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, rm.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ds.subject_count, ds.total_enrolled_students FROM reserve_materials rm JOIN dept_subjects ds ON rm.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = ds.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY ds.total_enrolled_students DESC, rm.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY;

question: For subjects offered in the term with code '2022FA' that belong to one of the top 10 departments (by total number of course materials in term 2017SP), show the subject ID, department name, term description, the running sum of total units within each academic year, the subject title, whether the subject is offered in the fall term, the total number of course materials for the department in 2017SP, the subject with the most course materials in that department in 2017SP, and the number of materials for that subject, ordered by subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.window_column, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM FROM inner_cte icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON icte.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID AND t2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = TIP_DETAIL.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = '2017SP' AND TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = '2017SP' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT dept_stats.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dept_stats.total_materials, subj_stats.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Top_Subject, subj_stats.material_count AS Top_Subject_Material_Count FROM ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(material_count) AS total_materials FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) dept_stats LEFT JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, material_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY material_count DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte ) subj_stats ON dept_stats.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = subj_stats.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND subj_stats.rn = 1 ORDER BY dept_stats.total_materials DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.window_column, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM, s2.total_materials, s2.Top_Subject, s2.Top_Subject_Material_Count FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering with a total of at least 6 units, show the subject code, subject title, department name, grade type, and the running sum of total units within each grade type (only including those subjects where the running sum exceeds 12 units within their grade type), and for each such subject, list the building key, floor key, and the total coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of rooms located on that floor where the subject meets, considering only floors where the average room area is greater than zero and including a grand total for all floors per building. Order the results by subject code, building key, and floor key. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.GRADE_TYPE, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.MEET_PLACE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ), subq1 AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, GRADE_TYPE, window_column, MEET_PLACE FROM inner_cte1 WHERE window_column > 12 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT FCLT_FLOOR.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, FCLT_FLOOR.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, STDDEV(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA) / NULLIF(AVG(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM FCLT_FLOOR JOIN FCLT_ROOMS ON FCLT_FLOOR.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY = FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY GROUP BY FCLT_FLOOR.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, FCLT_FLOOR.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY HAVING AVG(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA) > 0 ), subq2 AS ( SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, SUM(coefficient_of_variation) AS total_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, FCLT_FLOOR_KEY WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(coefficient_of_variation) IS NOT NULL ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.GRADE_TYPE, s1.window_column, s2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, s2.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, s2.total_coefficient_of_variation FROM subq1 s1 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON s1.MEET_PLACE = fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY JOIN subq2 s2 ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = s2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND fr.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY = s2.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, s2.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY

question: For each department name and school name where the department is degree granting and the department's budget code is greater than the average budget code of all Engineering school departments, provide the number of unique courses, the minimum CIP program code from the course descriptions, the course description, and the dense rank of each course considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the department's budget code. Additionally, for each school, include a grand total for all departments in that school in the format of (null, school name, total courses, min CIP code, course description, dense rank), but only for departments meeting the budget code condition. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(course_count) AS total_courses, MIN(min_cip_code) AS min_cip_code FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(course_count) > 0 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.total_courses, rr.min_cip_code, ic2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ic2.window_column FROM RollupResults rr JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND rr.SCHOOL_NAME = d.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN inner_cte2 ic2 ON ic2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > ( SELECT AVG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL ) ORDER BY rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic2.window_column

question: For each material status key, provide the material status key, the average and variance of the record counter for reserve catalog items associated with that status (considering only records where the catalog year is greater than 2000), and classify the status as 'HIGH_VARIANCE' if its variance is at least 20% greater than the average variance across all statuses, 'LOW_VARIANCE' if at least 20% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. For each subject in the 2014FA term with at least one enrolled student and whose TIP material status key matches the material status key, show the subject title, offering department name, responsible faculty name, the TIP material status key, the total number of units, the minimum total number of units in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the course number, and whether the total units are 'HIGH_LOAD' (at least 10% greater than the average total units for that department), 'LOW_LOAD' (at least 10% less than the average), or 'AVERAGE'. Present the results with the columns in the following order: material status key, average record counter, record counter variance, variance category, subject title, offering department name, responsible faculty name, TIP material status key, total units, window minimum total units, and unit load category. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, AVG(c.RECORD_COUNTER) AS avg_record_counter, VARIANCE(c.RECORD_COUNTER) AS record_counter_variance FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL d JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG c ON d.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = c.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY WHERE c.CATALOG_YEAR > 2000 GROUP BY d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ), avg_var AS ( SELECT AVG(record_counter_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte ), material_status_stats AS ( SELECT i.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, i.avg_record_counter, i.record_counter_variance, CASE WHEN i.record_counter_variance > a.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN i.record_counter_variance < a.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_var a ORDER BY i.record_counter_variance DESC ), subject_inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, sos.COURSE_NUMBER, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY WHERE TERM_CODE = '2014FA' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE ), subject_stats AS ( SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, icte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, icte.TOTAL_UNITS, icte.window_column, CASE WHEN icte.TOTAL_UNITS > da.avg_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_LOAD' WHEN icte.TOTAL_UNITS < da.avg_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_LOAD' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_load_category, icte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM subject_inner_cte icte JOIN dept_avg da ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = da.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ) SELECT ms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ms.avg_record_counter, ms.record_counter_variance, ms.variance_category, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ss.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ss.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ss.TOTAL_UNITS, ss.window_column, ss.unit_load_category FROM material_status_stats ms JOIN subject_stats ss ON ms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = ss.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY ms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For each subject category and academic year where the maximum enrollment is at least 10, provide the number of unique subjects offered, the minimum total units for those subjects, the average number of lecture units as a benchmark, and indicate whether the minimum total units is at least 10% greater than the average lecture units ('HIGH_UNIT'), at least 10% less ('LOW_UNIT'), or otherwise 'AVERAGE_UNIT'. Also, for each academic year, include the number of regular academic terms that are also present in the ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL table (with null for the grand total), and present all these columns in the following order: subject category key, academic year, subject count, minimum total units, benchmark lecture units, unit category, and total regular terms. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subject_category_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON a.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT ic.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units, s.avg_lecture_units AS benchmark_lecture_units, CASE WHEN ic.min_total_units > s.avg_lecture_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN ic.min_total_units < s.avg_lecture_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE_UNIT' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS avg_lecture_units FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON a.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) s ON ic.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY AND ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), regular_term_counts AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON at.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = ata.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS total_terms FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT scs.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, scs.ACADEMIC_YEAR, scs.subject_count, scs.min_total_units, scs.benchmark_lecture_units, scs.unit_category, rtc.total_terms FROM subject_category_stats scs LEFT JOIN regular_term_counts rtc ON scs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = rtc.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY scs.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, scs.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each department name and course level where the course is degree granting and the total units are greater than 6, and for departments that in 2022 offered at least 5 degree granting subjects, provide the department name, course level, number of unique courses, minimum total units offered, number of courses where the design units are at least 3, the number of subjects offered, the average, range, and variance of the total units for those subjects, and calculate the course-to-subject ratio (number of unique courses divided by number of subjects), ordered by the course-to-subject ratio in descending order.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.COURSE_LEVEL, ic.course_count, ic.min_total_units, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ccc.DESIGN_UNITS >= 3 THEN scd.COURSE END) AS courses_with_design_units_3_or_more FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.COURSE_LEVEL = scd.COURSE_LEVEL JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.COURSE_LEVEL, ic.course_count, ic.min_total_units ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS subject_count, AVG(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY subject_count DESC, total_units_range DESC ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.COURSE_LEVEL, s1.course_count, s1.min_total_units, s1.courses_with_design_units_3_or_more, s2.subject_count, s2.avg_total_units, s2.total_units_range, s2.total_units_variance, ROUND(s1.course_count / NULLIF(s2.subject_count, 0), 2) AS course_to_subject_ratio FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY course_to_subject_ratio DESC;

question: For the top 10 subjects offered in the term '2014FA' with the highest number of enrolled students (according to the library subject data), display each subject's title from the library, the number of enrolled students in the library subject, the responsible faculty name and offer department name from the TIP subject, the minimum number of enrolled students in the library subject within a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the TIP subject's responsible faculty MIT ID, and the highest standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students ever recorded for that department in any term (considering only courses with at least 5 different materials assigned in that term). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH TopSubjects AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( ORDER BY t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_OFFER_DEPT_NAME FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.join_OFFER_DEPT_NAME FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC LIMIT 10 ), DeptStddev AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.TERM_CODE, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.TERM_CODE HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) >= 5 ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(enrolled_stddev) AS highest_enrolled_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY highest_enrolled_stddev DESC ) SELECT ts.SUBJECT_TITLE, ts.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ts.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ts.window_column, ds.highest_enrolled_stddev FROM TopSubjects ts LEFT JOIN DeptStddev ds ON ts.join_OFFER_DEPT_NAME = ds.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY ts.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC;

question: For subjects offered in the 2012SU term with a cluster type of 'S' that are not repeatable, show the subject title, the offer department name, the total units, the department name from SUBJECT_SUMMARY, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the subject title, the academic year, the average number of enrolled students, the variance, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrolled students for each subject and department, ordered by variance descending and then subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t1.CLUSTER_TYPE = 'S' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID FROM inner_cte JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_REPEATABLE_SUBJECT = 'N' ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.TOTAL_UNITS, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.avg_enrollment, s2.enrollment_variance, s2.enrollment_stddev FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY s2.enrollment_variance DESC, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each subject offered in the academic term with term code '2006FA' in departments that offer more than 5 subjects in that term, show the subject ID, subject title, department name, the sum of lecture units within each grade type group, and the total number of subjects per department for that term. Additionally, for each subject offered by the same department in the term '2017JA', show the number of enrolled students, offering department name, department full name, subject code, subject code description, and whether the number of enrolled students is 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% greater than the average for that subject code), 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% less than the average for that subject code), or 'AVERAGE'. Present the results ordered by subject ID and subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(t1.LECTURE_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA' ), DeptCounts AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS SUBJECT_COUNT FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = '2006FA' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' ), subject_code_avg AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY SUBJECT_CODE ) SELECT ic1.SUBJECT_ID, ic1.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic1.window_column, dc.SUBJECT_COUNT, ic2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ic2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ic2.SUBJECT_CODE, ic2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, CASE WHEN ic2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > sca.avg_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN ic2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < sca.avg_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte1 ic1 JOIN DeptCounts dc ON ic1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dc.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN inner_cte2 ic2 ON ic1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ic2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN subject_code_avg sca ON ic2.SUBJECT_CODE = sca.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY ic1.SUBJECT_ID, ic2.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For each academic year, academic year description, department name, subject ID, total units, average total units, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, deviation of the subject's total units from the department's average in that year, course level, number of unique degree-granting courses with total units greater than 6, minimum total units offered, and number of courses with design units at least 3, provide these values for each subject offered in regular terms, joining with department-level course statistics for degree-granting courses with total units greater than 6. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.COURSE_LEVEL, ic.course_count, ic.min_total_units, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ccc.DESIGN_UNITS >= 3 THEN scd.COURSE END) AS courses_with_design_units_3_or_more FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.COURSE_LEVEL = scd.COURSE_LEVEL JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.COURSE_LEVEL, ic.course_count, ic.min_total_units ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.TOTAL_UNITS, d.avg_total_units, d.stddev_total_units, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - d.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_stats d ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AND i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, deviation_from_avg DESC ) SELECT s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.TOTAL_UNITS, s2.avg_total_units, s2.stddev_total_units, s2.deviation_from_avg, s1.COURSE_LEVEL, s1.course_count, s1.min_total_units, s1.courses_with_design_units_3_or_more FROM subq2 s2 JOIN subq1 s1 ON s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.deviation_from_avg DESC;

question: For each department and academic year where the subject enrollment number is greater than 10, provide the department name, academic year, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in offered subjects for that year, the average total units of those subjects for that year, and the maximum number of total units offered for any subject in that department and year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID JOIN inner_cte ic ON c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND t.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, subq1.coefficient_of_variation, subq1.avg_total_units, subq2.max_total_units FROM subq2 JOIN subq1 ON subq2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq2.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each subject that has at least one enrolled student, show the subject title, the term code from the library subject offered table, the tip material status key, the total units from the subject offered summary, the total number of enrolled students, the department name, the subject code, and the geometric mean of the total units for subjects offered by that department where the total units are greater than zero. Additionally, for each subject title, include a grand total of enrolled students across all terms in the format of (subject title, null, null, null, total enrolled students, null, null, null). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.TERM_CODE, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID INNER JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_CODE, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TOTAL_UNITS, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_CODE, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TOTAL_UNITS WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ), GeometricMeanUnits AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE, EXP(AVG(LN(inner_cte2.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT rr.SUBJECT_TITLE, rr.TERM_CODE, rr.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, rr.TOTAL_UNITS, rr.total_enrolled_students, gmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, gmu.SUBJECT_ID, gmu.geometric_mean_total_units FROM RollupResults rr LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON rr.SUBJECT_TITLE = sos.SUBJECT_TITLE AND rr.TOTAL_UNITS = sos.TOTAL_UNITS LEFT JOIN GeometricMeanUnits gmu ON sos.SUBJECT_ID = gmu.SUBJECT_ID AND rr.SUBJECT_TITLE = gmu.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY rr.SUBJECT_TITLE, rr.TERM_CODE, gmu.geometric_mean_total_units DESC

question: For each department and each subject offered in the academic year 2024, show the department name, subject code, subject number, subject title, term code, term description, and the highest minimum total units (in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by academic year) for that subject, along with the course description, subject code description, and the difference between the number of characters in the course description and the average number of characters in course descriptions for that department, for courses in the School of Engineering that are degree granting. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(t0.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 ), cte1 AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, MAX(window_column) AS highest_min_total_units FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t1.COURSE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(LENGTH(COURSE_DESCRIPTION)) AS avg_desc_length FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ), cte2 AS ( SELECT i.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, (LENGTH(i.COURSE_DESCRIPTION) - d.avg_desc_length) AS desc_length_deviation, i.COURSE FROM inner_cte2 i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1.SUBJECT_CODE, cte1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE, cte1.TERM_CODE, cte1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cte1.highest_min_total_units, cte2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, cte2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, cte2.desc_length_deviation FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND cte1.SUBJECT_CODE = cte2.COURSE ORDER BY cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1.SUBJECT_CODE, cte1.SUBJECT_NUMBER;

question: For each department, for each subject title that has at least one associated course material, provide the department name, the subject title, the number of enrolled students in that subject, the total number of such subjects per department with at least one associated course material, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department in 2017 (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students), and the total number of such subjects per department. List the results ordered by department name and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2017%' ), dept_enrollment_stats AS ( SELECT inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(inner_cte1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev, COUNT(*) AS num_subjects FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' ), dept_totals AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_TITLE) AS Total_Subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), dept_subject_materials AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, dept_totals.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte2 JOIN dept_totals ON inner_cte2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_totals.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT dsm.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dsm.SUBJECT_TITLE, dsm.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, dsm.Total_Subjects, des.enrolled_students_variance, des.enrolled_students_stddev, des.num_subjects FROM dept_subject_materials dsm JOIN dept_enrollment_stats des ON dsm.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dsm.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dsm.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each department and academic year, show the department name, academic year, academic year description, the geometric mean of the total units for all subjects offered by the department in regular terms with total units greater than zero, the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in the department's courses that have at least one enrolled student and have a material status of 'U', as well as the subject title with the highest number of enrolled students among those courses and that enrollment count. List the results ordered by department name and academic year descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH geometric_mean_units AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), enrollment_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL d JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, st.SUBJECT_TITLE AS top_subject_title, st.max_enrolled AS top_enrollment FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS max_enrolled FROM ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte ) ranked WHERE rn = 1 ) st ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = st.OFFER_DEPT_NAME GROUP BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, st.SUBJECT_TITLE, st.max_enrolled ) SELECT gmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, gmu.ACADEMIC_YEAR, gmu.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gmu.geometric_mean_total_units, es.enrolled_range, es.enrolled_variance, es.top_subject_title, es.top_enrollment FROM geometric_mean_units gmu LEFT JOIN enrollment_stats es ON gmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME = es.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY gmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, gmu.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC;

question: For each department name and school name, show the number of offered subjects, the minimum number of enrolled students (where the number of enrolled students in the offered subject is greater than 3), and classify the department as 'HIGH_ACTIVITY' if the number of offered subjects is at least 20% greater than the average across all departments, 'LOW_ACTIVITY' if at least 20% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. For subjects offered in the term '2014FA' where the number of enrolled students in the library subject is greater than the average for all library subjects in '2014FA', also show the subject title from the library, the number of enrolled students in the library subject, the responsible faculty name from the TIP subject, the offer department name from the TIP subject, and the minimum number of enrolled students in the library subject within a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the TIP subject's responsible faculty MIT ID. Only include results where the department name matches the offer department name from the TIP subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS offered_subject_count, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT AVG(offered_subject_count) AS avg_offered_subjects FROM inner_cte1 ), DepartmentActivity AS ( SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.offered_subject_count, i.min_enrolled_students, CASE WHEN i.offered_subject_count > d.avg_offered_subjects * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_ACTIVITY' WHEN i.offered_subject_count < d.avg_offered_subjects * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_ACTIVITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS activity_level FROM inner_cte1 i CROSS JOIN dept_avg d ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( ORDER BY t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_OFFER_DEPT_NAME FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' ) SELECT da.DEPARTMENT_NAME, da.SCHOOL_NAME, da.offered_subject_count, da.min_enrolled_students, da.activity_level, ic2.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ic2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ic2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic2.window_column FROM DepartmentActivity da JOIN inner_cte2 ic2 ON da.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic2.join_OFFER_DEPT_NAME WHERE ic2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > ( SELECT AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE TERM_CODE = '2014FA' )

question: For each offering department and school where the course material status is 'RQ', provide the number of unique subjects, the minimum total units for those subjects, the average number of enrolled students for those subjects, and for each such department also show the minimum number of lecture units and the total number of units for all subjects offered in the Fall term of the academic year 2022, including a grand total row for all departments in the format of (null, min_lecture_units, total_units). The columns should be: offering department name, offering school name, number of unique subjects, minimum total units, average number of enrolled students, department name (from Fall 2022), minimum lecture units (Fall 2022), and total units (Fall 2022). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ), RQ_DeptSchool AS ( SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_num_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte1 ic JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS min_lecture_units, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.TERM_DESCRIPTION LIKE 'Fall Term%' AND c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), FallDeptSummary AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, min_lecture_units, total_units FROM inner_cte2 UNION ALL SELECT NULL, MIN(min_lecture_units), SUM(total_units) FROM inner_cte2 ) SELECT rds.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, rds.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, rds.subject_count, rds.min_total_units, rds.avg_num_enrolled_students, fds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, fds.min_lecture_units, fds.total_units FROM RQ_DeptSchool rds LEFT JOIN FallDeptSummary fds ON rds.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = fds.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY rds.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, rds.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, fds.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each department name and course level where the department is degree granting, and for each academic year where the number of enrolled students in a subject is greater than 5, provide the department name, course level, number of unique students, minimum CIP program code among their courses, school name, department's full name, academic year, number of unique subjects offered, minimum number of total units for those subjects, and average number of enrolled students per subject. Include subtotals for each department (the corresponding department field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all departments (the corresponding department field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the department if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by department, course level, and academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL ), DepartmentCourseLevelStats AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(dept) OVER (ORDER BY dept_sort, course_level_sort) = dept THEN NULL ELSE dept END AS department, course_level, student_count, min_cip_code, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS department_full_name, dept AS join_department FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(COURSE_LEVEL) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(COURSE_LEVEL) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(COURSE_LEVEL) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(COURSE_LEVEL) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE COURSE_LEVEL END AS course_level_sort, COURSE_LEVEL AS course_level, SUM(student_count) AS student_count, MIN(min_cip_code) AS min_cip_code FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_LEVEL WITH ROLLUP ) tbltmp LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tbltmp.dept = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dept_sort, course_level_sort ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), DepartmentYearSubjectStats AS ( SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.subject_count, i.min_total_units, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte2 i JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = c.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND t.ACADEMIC_YEAR = i.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.subject_count, i.min_total_units ) SELECT dcls.department, dcls.course_level, dcls.student_count, dcls.min_cip_code, dcls.school_name, dcls.department_full_name, dys.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dys.subject_count, dys.min_total_units, dys.avg_enrolled_students FROM DepartmentCourseLevelStats dcls JOIN DepartmentYearSubjectStats dys ON dcls.join_department = dys.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dcls.department, dcls.course_level, dys.ACADEMIC_YEAR

question: For each organization and its associated space unit where the organization is assignable and the space unit code is greater than 50000, and considering only rooms on floor 2, provide the organization name, the name of the space unit, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the access levels of rooms associated with that space unit, the total number of such rooms per space unit, the number of distinct space units, the minimum organization number, and the total number of organizations that share the same DLC key as the space unit, ordered by the variance of access levels in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH SpaceUnitRoomStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, VARIANCE(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_variance, STDDEV(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_stddev, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD zr ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = zr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE zr.FLOOR = 2 GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT, inner_cte.access_level_variance, inner_cte.access_level_stddev, RoomCounts.total_rooms, inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(*) AS total_rooms FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD zr ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = zr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE zr.FLOOR = 2 GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT ) AS RoomCounts ON inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT = RoomCounts.SPACE_UNIT ), OrgSpaceUnitStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION, su.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(DISTINCT su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS space_unit_count, MIN(fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_org_number, su.DLC_KEY, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fodk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON fodk.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY WHERE fo.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE > 50000 GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION, su.SPACE_UNIT, su.DLC_KEY, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ) SELECT ic.ORGANIZATION, ic.SPACE_UNIT, ic.space_unit_count, ic.min_org_number, d.org_count, ic.SPACE_UNIT_CODE FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT DLC_KEY, COUNT(DISTINCT ORGANIZATION) AS org_count FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION GROUP BY DLC_KEY ) d ON ic.DLC_KEY = d.DLC_KEY ) SELECT oss.ORGANIZATION, srs.SPACE_UNIT, srs.access_level_variance, srs.access_level_stddev, srs.total_rooms, oss.space_unit_count, oss.min_org_number, oss.org_count FROM OrgSpaceUnitStats oss JOIN SpaceUnitRoomStats srs ON oss.SPACE_UNIT = srs.SPACE_UNIT AND oss.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = srs.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ORDER BY srs.access_level_variance DESC;

question: For each department in the School of Engineering and for each academic year, what is the minimum number of enrolled students in any subject in that department, the total number of material records for subjects in that department with a status of 'RQ', the academic year, the academic year description, and both the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in library subjects for that department and year (considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the number of enrolled students in the library subject is greater than 0)? Also, provide a grand total for the entire School of Engineering in the format (null, min_enrolled, total_material_records, academic_year, academic_year_desc, enrolled_students_variance, enrolled_students_stddev). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptMaterialStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled, SUM(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_material_records FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(min_enrolled) AS min_enrolled, SUM(total_material_records) AS total_material_records FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME WITH ROLLUP ), YearDeptEnrolledStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ) SELECT dms.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dms.min_enrolled, dms.total_material_records, ydes.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ydes.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ydes.enrolled_students_variance, ydes.enrolled_students_stddev FROM DeptMaterialStats dms LEFT JOIN YearDeptEnrolledStats ydes ON dms.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = ydes.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY dms.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ydes.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each department that offered subjects in the Fall term of 2022 and has at least one subject with more than 0 enrolled students that is degree granting, show the department code, department name, school name, the variance of the total number of units for subjects offered by that department, the subject ID, the total units for each subject, the deviation of each subject's total units from the department's average, the highest number of lecture units among its offered subjects in Fall 2022, the start date of the term, and the total number of subjects offered by that department in that term, considering only departments where the highest number of lecture units is greater than 3. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ssc.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.total_units_variance, sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, (sos.TOTAL_UNITS - AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE)) AS deviation_from_dept_avg FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN inner_cte ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, at2.TERM_START_DATE FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 ON td.TERM_CODE = at2.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at2.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) > 3 ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.max_lecture_units, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, COUNT(ccs2.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs2 ON ccs2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ccs2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.max_lecture_units, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE ) SELECT subq1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.SCHOOL_NAME, subq1.total_units_variance, subq1.SUBJECT_ID, subq1.TOTAL_UNITS, subq1.deviation_from_dept_avg, subq2.max_lecture_units, subq2.TERM_START_DATE, subq2.num_subjects_offered FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subq1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, subq1.SUBJECT_ID;

question: Show, for each combination of offering department and person role, the offering department name, subject title, responsible faculty name, term description, academic year description, the total number of subjects offered per department, the person role name, the average, range, and variance of the maximum enrollment values for the activities led by that role (considering only activities that are not cancelled and have a specified maximum enrollment), and the total number of such activities for each role. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM' ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, dept_counts.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS Total_Subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM' GROUP BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) dept_counts ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_counts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.PERSON_ROLE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT FROM IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON p JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d ON p.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY WHERE d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL ) SELECT i.PERSON_ROLE, AVG(i.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, MAX(i.MAX_ENROLLMENT) - MIN(i.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_range, VARIANCE(i.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance, COUNT(*) AS total_activities FROM inner_cte i GROUP BY i.PERSON_ROLE ORDER BY max_enrollment_range DESC ) SELECT s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.Total_Subjects, s2.PERSON_ROLE, s2.avg_max_enrollment, s2.max_enrollment_range, s2.max_enrollment_variance, s2.total_activities FROM subq1 s1 CROSS JOIN subq2 s2;

question: For each offering department in the 'Engineering' school where the average total units of its courses is greater than the average total units of all 'Engineering' school courses, what is the department name, the average total units of its courses, the subject code, the subject title, and the geometric mean of the total units for subjects offered by that department where the total units are greater than zero? List the results ordered by department name and then by geometric mean of total units in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH engineering_dept_avg_units AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE AS course_number, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.COURSE) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM ( SELECT t0.COURSE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ) dept_courses GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) > ( SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) FROM ( SELECT t0.COURSE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ) all_courses ) ), dept_subjects_geom_mean AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, EXP(AVG(LN(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC ) SELECT edau.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, edau.avg_total_units, dsgm.SUBJECT_ID, dsgm.SUBJECT_TITLE, dsgm.geometric_mean_total_units FROM engineering_dept_avg_units edau JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON edau.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN dept_subjects_geom_mean dsgm ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsgm.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY edau.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dsgm.geometric_mean_total_units DESC

question: For each academic year where the geometric mean of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during that year (considering only subjects with more than zero enrolled students) is greater than the overall geometric mean across all years, what is the academic year, the academic year description, the geometric mean of enrolled students, the variance of the number of tip detail records for subjects offered in that year (considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term and have at least one associated tip detail record), and the number of unique departments represented among those subjects? List the academic year, academic year description, geometric mean enrollment, record count variance, and unique departments in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH geometric_mean_cte AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, geometric_mean_enrollment FROM inner_cte WHERE geometric_mean_enrollment > ( SELECT EXP(AVG(LN(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) ORDER BY geometric_mean_enrollment DESC ), record_variance_cte AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS unique_departments FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance ORDER BY inner_cte.record_count_variance DESC ) SELECT g.ACADEMIC_YEAR, g.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, g.geometric_mean_enrollment, r.record_count_variance, r.unique_departments FROM geometric_mean_cte g JOIN record_variance_cte r ON g.ACADEMIC_YEAR = r.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND g.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = r.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY g.geometric_mean_enrollment DESC;

question: For each department in the School of Engineering that has a total student enrollment greater than 50 and an average enrollment per course of at least 20, and for each subject offered by that department in the current term, show the offering department name, subject title, responsible faculty name, term description, academic year description, the total number of subjects offered per department, the department name, and the total number of students enrolled in courses offered by that department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM' ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, dept_counts.Total_Subjects, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS Total_Subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM' GROUP BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) dept_counts ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_counts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
