SQL: WITH sponsor_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SPONSOR_NAME, s.SPONSOR_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL ) SELECT SPONSOR_NAME, SPONSOR_TYPE, AVG(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, VARIANCE(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS var_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SPONSOR_NAME, SPONSOR_TYPE ORDER BY var_max_enrollment DESC ), dept_units_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(avg_total_units) AS avg_total_units, SUM(var_total_units) AS var_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(var_total_units) > 0 ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT s.SPONSOR_NAME, s.SPONSOR_TYPE, s.avg_max_enrollment, s.var_max_enrollment, d.ACADEMIC_YEAR, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_total_units, d.var_total_units FROM sponsor_stats s JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR iss ON s.SPONSOR_NAME = iss.SPONSOR_NAME AND s.SPONSOR_TYPE = iss.SPONSOR_TYPE JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd ON iss.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = isd.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON isd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN dept_units_stats d ON at.ACADEMIC_YEAR = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR

question: For each degree-granting department and subject code, list the department name, the subject code, the subject code description, the average and variance of the ASCII values of the course numbers for that subject code, and the maximum average enrollment among all terms for courses offered by that department that have at least one associated TIP material and where the total units for the course are greater than 0. The results should be ordered by department name and subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DegreeGrantingDeptStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s.COURSE_NUMBER FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, AVG(ASCII(inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VARIANCE(ASCII(inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC ), DeptMaxAvgEnrollment AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.RECORD_COUNT >= 1 AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(avg_enrollment) AS max_avg_enrollment_per_term FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT dgs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dgs.SUBJECT_CODE, dgs.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, dgs.avg_course_number_ascii, dgs.var_course_number_ascii, dme.max_avg_enrollment_per_term FROM DegreeGrantingDeptStats dgs LEFT JOIN DeptMaxAvgEnrollment dme ON dgs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dme.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY dgs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dgs.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For each space unit and its associated organization, what is the space unit name, the organization name, the HR org unit title, the deviation of the HR department code from the average HR department code for HR org units linked to that space unit (considering only space units with a warehouse load date of '19-DEC-24' and HR org units with a warehouse load date of '03-DEC-24'), as well as, for each organization with a non-null description, the organization name (not repeated if the same as the previous row), the minimum access level among its rooms, the total number of unique space usages, and the number of rooms assigned to that organization? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE su.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND hou.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '03-DEC-24' ), avg_codes AS ( SELECT SPACE_UNIT, AVG(CAST(HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE AS FLOAT)) AS avg_hr_dept_code FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY SPACE_UNIT ), subq1 AS ( SELECT i.SPACE_UNIT, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, (CAST(i.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE AS FLOAT) - a.avg_hr_dept_code) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte1 i JOIN avg_codes a ON i.SPACE_UNIT = a.SPACE_UNIT ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT MIN(z.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS min_access_level, COUNT(DISTINCT z.SPACE_USAGE) AS total_space_usages, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, f.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION f JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD z ON f.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = z.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE f.DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL GROUP BY f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, f.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID ), subq2 AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(ORGANIZATION_NAME) OVER (ORDER BY ORGANIZATION_NAME) = ORGANIZATION_NAME THEN NULL ELSE ORGANIZATION_NAME END AS organization_name, min_access_level, total_space_usages, COUNT(z.BUILDING_ROOM) AS num_rooms, inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM inner_cte2 inner_cte LEFT JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD z ON inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = z.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID GROUP BY inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, min_access_level, total_space_usages, inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID ORDER BY organization_name ) SELECT s1.SPACE_UNIT, s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, s1.deviation_from_avg, s2.organization_name, s2.min_access_level, s2.total_space_usages, s2.num_rooms FROM subq1 s1 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME = fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME JOIN subq2 s2 ON fo.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = s2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID

question: For each academic year and offering department, what is the total range and total variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered (including a grand total for all departments as (academic year, null, total range, total variance)), considering only terms that are not the current term, and for each matching department in the 2005 Fall term, what are the subject title, number of enrolled students, department name, term description, average number of enrolled students within each subject title group, and the enrollment category ('HIGH_ENROLLMENT', 'LOW_ENROLLMENT', or 'AVERAGE') for each subject? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH enrolled_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(enrolled_range) AS total_enrolled_range, SUM(enrolled_variance) AS total_enrolled_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, OFFER_DEPT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(enrolled_range) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), subject_enrollment_2005fa AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON tso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' ) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, DEPARTMENT_NAME, TERM_DESCRIPTION, avg_enrolled_students, CASE WHEN NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > avg_enrolled_students * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < avg_enrolled_students * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte ) SELECT es.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, es.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, es.total_enrolled_range, es.total_enrolled_variance, se.SUBJECT_TITLE, se.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, se.DEPARTMENT_NAME, se.TERM_DESCRIPTION, se.avg_enrolled_students, se.enrollment_category FROM enrolled_stats es LEFT JOIN subject_enrollment_2005fa se ON es.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = se.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY es.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, es.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, se.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For each academic year, provide the academic year, academic year description, geometric mean of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during that year (considering only subjects with more than zero enrolled students), and classify the year as 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' if the geometric mean is at least 10% greater than the average across all years, 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' if at least 10% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise, along with the reason 'YearlyEnrollment'. Also, for each department and academic year where the number of enrolled students in a subject is greater than 5, provide the academic year, department name, number of unique subjects offered, minimum number of total units for those subjects, and average number of enrolled students per subject, along with the reason 'DepartmentYearStats'. List all these results together, showing the columns: academic year, academic year description, department name, subject count, minimum total units, average enrolled students, geometric mean enrollment, enrollment category, and reason, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH GeometricMeanEnrollment AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_enrollment, CASE WHEN inner_cte.geometric_mean_enrollment > avg_stats.avg_geometric_mean * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN inner_cte.geometric_mean_enrollment < avg_stats.avg_geometric_mean * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_enrollment) AS avg_geometric_mean FROM inner_cte ) avg_stats ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean_enrollment DESC ), DepartmentYearStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.subject_count, i.min_total_units, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte i JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = c.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND t.ACADEMIC_YEAR = i.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.subject_count, i.min_total_units ), CombinedStats AS ( SELECT g.ACADEMIC_YEAR, g.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS subject_count, NULL AS min_total_units, NULL AS avg_enrolled_students, g.geometric_mean_enrollment, g.enrollment_category, 'YearlyEnrollment' AS Reason FROM GeometricMeanEnrollment g UNION ALL SELECT d.ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.subject_count, d.min_total_units, d.avg_enrolled_students, NULL AS geometric_mean_enrollment, NULL AS enrollment_category, 'DepartmentYearStats' AS Reason FROM DepartmentYearStats d ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, subject_count, min_total_units, avg_enrolled_students, geometric_mean_enrollment, enrollment_category, Reason FROM CombinedStats ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC, Reason, DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: For the academic year and description with the highest variance in the number of tip detail records for subjects offered in the fall term (with at least one associated tip detail record), what is the most represented department among those subjects in that year and the count of such subjects from that department, and for that department in the current academic term, what is the school name, average total units, variance of total units, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for subjects offered? List the academic year, academic year description, record count variance, most represented department, subject count, school name, average total units, variance of total units, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units in this order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t1.record_count_variance, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Most_Represented_Department, t2.Subject_Count FROM ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(record_count_variance) AS record_count_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC LIMIT 1 ) t1 JOIN ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME ) t2 ON t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND t2.rn = 1 ORDER BY t1.record_count_variance DESC ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.SCHOOL_NAME, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON atp.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.SCHOOL_NAME, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_variance, icte.total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte icte ORDER BY icte.total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.record_count_variance, s1.Most_Represented_Department, s1.Subject_Count, s2.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.avg_total_units, s2.total_units_variance, s2.total_units_stddev FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.Most_Represented_Department = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For the top 10 subject titles by the number of reserved library materials in the term '2009SP', list the subject title, department name, number of reserved materials, total number of enrolled students for each subject, the academic year, the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in each subject offered by the department (considering only subjects offered in the fall term with more than 0 enrolled students), as well as the department phone number and school name, with the results ordered by the number of reserved materials (descending) and academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH TopSubjects AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials, s.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY reserved_materials DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.reserved_materials, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.SUBJECT_ID, s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON i.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID AND s.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' ), DeptEnrollmentStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ts.SUBJECT_TITLE, ts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ts.reserved_materials, ts.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, des.ACADEMIC_YEAR, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_variance, des.department_phone, des.school_name FROM TopSubjects ts JOIN DeptEnrollmentStats des ON ts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ts.reserved_materials DESC, des.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each subject offered in the term '2017FA', provide the subject title, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the record counts of tip materials for that subject, along with the offering department name and the offering school name, as well as the department name, school name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department and school (including subtotals for each department and a grand total across all departments and schools, where the school field is 'SUBTOTAL' or 'TOTAL'), considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and offered in the 'Engineering' school. Sort the results by the range of record counts in descending order, then by subject title and school. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte_1 AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(t.RECORD_COUNT) - MIN(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_range, VARIANCE(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ), subq1 AS ( SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.record_count_range, i.record_count_variance, i.record_count_stddev, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s.COURSE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte_1 i JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON i.SUBJECT_TITLE = s.SUBJECT_TITLE AND s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' ), inner_cte_2 AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME, sos.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ), subq2 AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(department_name) OVER (ORDER BY dept_sort, school_sort) = department_name THEN NULL ELSE department_name END AS department_name, school, total_units_range, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev, department_name AS join_department_name, school AS join_school FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(department_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(school_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE department_name END AS dept_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(department_name) = 0 AND GROUPING(school_name) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(department_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(school_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE school_name END AS school_sort, department_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(department_name) = 0 AND GROUPING(school_name) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(department_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(school_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE school_name END AS school, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte_2 GROUP BY department_name, school_name WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY dept_sort, school_sort ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.record_count_range, s1.record_count_variance, s1.record_count_stddev, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s2.department_name, s2.school, s2.total_units_range, s2.total_units_variance, s2.total_units_stddev FROM subq1 s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.join_department_name AND s1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = s2.join_school ORDER BY s1.record_count_range DESC, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.school;

question: For organizations with a major organization key of 230, show the organization parent, organization name, HR department name, HR department code, HR department long name, HR org unit level, the average organization number in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the organization parent, the top department (by count of organizations) within each organization parent, and the count of organizations for that department. Also, for each matching HR department name and DLC key, show the organization ID, DLC name, HR org unit title, and the highest HR org unit ID within each HR department name group, considering only organizations with an organization level of 5. Limit the results to the top 10 organization parents with the highest total organization counts. The columns should be: organization parent, organization name, HR department name, HR department code, HR department long name, HR org unit level, the windowed average organization number, top department, department organization count, organization ID, DLC name, HR org unit title, and highest HR org unit ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH orgs_major_230 AS ( SELECT t2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, t2.ORG_PARENT, t2.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER, t2.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t2.FCLT_MAJOR_ORG_KEY = 230 ), orgs_major_230_stats AS ( SELECT ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, ic.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, ic.DLC_KEY, AVG(ic.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) OVER ( PARTITION BY ic.ORG_PARENT ORDER BY ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, dept_stats.Top_Department, dept_stats.Department_Org_Count, ic.ORG_PARENT FROM orgs_major_230 ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ic2.ORG_PARENT, ic2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Top_Department, COUNT(*) AS Department_Org_Count FROM orgs_major_230 ic2 GROUP BY ic2.ORG_PARENT, ic2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) = ( SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orgs_major_230 ic3 WHERE ic3.ORG_PARENT = ic2.ORG_PARENT GROUP BY ic3.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) sub ) ) dept_stats ON ic.ORG_PARENT = dept_stats.ORG_PARENT AND ic.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_stats.Top_Department WHERE ic.ORG_PARENT IN ( SELECT org_parent FROM ( SELECT ic4.ORG_PARENT AS org_parent, COUNT(*) AS total_orgs FROM orgs_major_230 ic4 GROUP BY ic4.ORG_PARENT ORDER BY total_orgs DESC LIMIT 10 ) top_parents ) ), orgs_level_5 AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID, t1.DLC_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID, t0.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ), highest_hr_org_unit AS ( SELECT HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS highest_hr_org_unit_id FROM orgs_level_5 GROUP BY HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT o.ORG_PARENT, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, o.window_column, o.Top_Department, o.Department_Org_Count, ol5.ORGANIZATION_ID, ol5.DLC_NAME, ol5.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, hho.highest_hr_org_unit_id FROM orgs_major_230_stats o LEFT JOIN orgs_level_5 ol5 ON o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = ol5.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AND o.DLC_KEY = ol5.DLC_KEY LEFT JOIN highest_hr_org_unit hho ON o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = hho.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY o.ORG_PARENT, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME;

question: For subjects offered with a section ID of 0 and a cluster type of 'S', show the subject title, the department name, the term description, the term start date, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title, and, for each department name, the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one enrolled student and have a material status of 'U'. Show all columns in this order: subject title, department name, term description, term start date, window row number, enrolled student range, and enrolled student variance. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.SECTION_ID = 0 AND t0.CLUSTER_TYPE = 'S' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t3.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t3 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t3.TERM_CODE ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL d JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC ) SELECT subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, subq1.TERM_START_DATE, subq1.window_column, subq2.enrolled_range, subq2.enrolled_variance FROM subq1 LEFT JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME

question: For each department name and its corresponding organization key in the Provost Area, show the number of organizations, the minimum and maximum department hierarchy level 3 codes, the organization name, the number of associated space units, the average number of space units, and whether the organization is a 'LARGE_HOLDER', 'SMALL_HOLDER', or 'AVERAGE_HOLDER' based on space unit count. List the results ordered by department name and organization name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH OrgSpaceStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fo.DLC_KEY, COUNT(su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS space_unit_count FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fok JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON fok.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fo.DLC_KEY ) SELECT ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.DLC_KEY, ic.space_unit_count, avg_stats.avg_space_units, CASE WHEN ic.space_unit_count > avg_stats.avg_space_units * 1.2 THEN 'LARGE_HOLDER' WHEN ic.space_unit_count < avg_stats.avg_space_units * 0.8 THEN 'SMALL_HOLDER' ELSE 'AVERAGE_HOLDER' END AS holder_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(space_unit_count) AS avg_space_units FROM inner_cte) avg_stats ), ProvostDeptStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.DLC_KEY, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_CODE) AS min_level3_code FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.DLC_KEY ) SELECT i.DLC_NAME, i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.DLC_KEY, i.org_count, i.min_level3_code, MAX(m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_CODE) AS max_level3_code FROM inner_cte i JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m ON i.DLC_NAME = m.DLC_NAME GROUP BY i.DLC_NAME, i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.DLC_KEY, i.org_count, i.min_level3_code ) SELECT pds.DLC_NAME, pds.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, pds.org_count, pds.min_level3_code, pds.max_level3_code, oss.ORGANIZATION_NAME, oss.space_unit_count, oss.avg_space_units, oss.holder_category FROM ProvostDeptStats pds JOIN OrgSpaceStats oss ON pds.DLC_KEY = oss.DLC_KEY ORDER BY pds.DLC_NAME, oss.ORGANIZATION_NAME;

question: For academic term parameters where the term indicator is 'C', show the term parameter, the term code, the academic year, the department name of the offered subject, the running sum of academic years within each department ordered by academic year, the subject title, and the total units of the offered subject. Additionally, for each result, include the total number of active graduate students with an office location assigned in the same department and the average office phone number (as a numeric value) for those students, including subtotals and a grand total as 'SUBTOTAL' and 'TOTAL' for each department, respectively. The results are ordered by department name and academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_PARAMETER, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_INDICATOR = 'C' ) SELECT inner_cte.TERM_PARAMETER, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, t3.SUBJECT_TITLE, t3.TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t3 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t3.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE AND inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = t3.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS total_active_grad_students FROM SE_PERSON s JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY m ON s.FULL_NAME = m.FULL_NAME WHERE s.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND m.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND m.OFFICE_LOCATION IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(department_name) OVER (ORDER BY dept_sort) = department_name THEN NULL ELSE department_name END AS department_name, total_active_grad_students, avg_office_phone FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS department_name, COUNT(*) AS total_active_grad_students, AVG(CASE WHEN OFFICE_PHONE IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE OFFICE_PHONE END) AS avg_office_phone FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY m JOIN SE_PERSON s ON s.FULL_NAME = m.FULL_NAME WHERE s.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND m.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND m.OFFICE_LOCATION IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY dept_sort ) SELECT s1.TERM_PARAMETER, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.TOTAL_UNITS, s2.total_active_grad_students, s2.avg_office_phone FROM subq1 s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.department_name ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR

question: For each subject code where the department is degree granting, show the subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, the number of subject codes per school name and whether the subject code description is present ('Has Description') or missing ('No Description'), the subject title from the library, the number of enrolled students in the library subject, the responsible faculty name from the TIP subject, the offer department name from the TIP subject, and the minimum number of enrolled students in the library subject within a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the TIP subject's responsible faculty MIT ID, but only include results where the number of enrolled students in the library subject is greater than the average number of enrolled students for all library subjects in '2014FA'. For each school name, include a grand total for all subject codes in the format of (null, null, null, school name, null, total subject codes, null, null, null, null, null). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), SubjectCodeVisibility AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, CASE WHEN SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND SUBJECT_CODE_DESC <> 'nan' THEN 'Has Description' ELSE 'No Description' END AS description_status FROM inner_cte1 ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, description_status, COUNT(*) AS total_subject_codes FROM SubjectCodeVisibility GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, description_status WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( ORDER BY t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, l.COURSE_NUMBER, t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' ) SELECT scv.SUBJECT_CODE, scv.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.description_status, rr.total_subject_codes, ic2.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ic2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ic2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic2.window_column FROM RollupResults rr LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, description_status FROM SubjectCodeVisibility ) scv ON rr.SCHOOL_NAME = scv.SCHOOL_NAME AND rr.description_status = scv.description_status LEFT JOIN inner_cte2 ic2 ON scv.SUBJECT_CODE = ic2.COURSE_NUMBER AND scv.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME WHERE ic2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > ( SELECT AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE TERM_CODE = '2014FA' ) ORDER BY rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.description_status;

question: For courses in the 'Engineering' school with a total of 12 units, show the course number, course description, subject title, total units, offering department name, and, for each offering department, the course with the highest number of enrolled students (including ties). Additionally, for the department corresponding to each offering department, show the department name, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in offered subjects, the total number of subjects offered, and the name of the school, considering only degree-granting departments and subjects with more than 0 enrolled students. The columns should be listed in the following order: course number, course description, subject title, total units, offering department name, number of enrolled students, department name, average enrollment, enrollment variance, enrollment standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), total subjects offered, and school name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE AS course_number, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.COURSE) AS window_column, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) SELECT i.course_number, i.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TOTAL_UNITS, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) m ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = m.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = m.max_enrolled ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrollment, inner_cte.enrollment_variance, inner_cte.enrollment_stddev, COUNT(lso.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects_offered, MAX(scd.SCHOOL_NAME) AS school_name FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrollment, inner_cte.enrollment_variance, inner_cte.enrollment_stddev ORDER BY inner_cte.enrollment_variance DESC ) SELECT subq1.course_number, subq1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq1.TOTAL_UNITS, subq1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, subq1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq2.avg_enrollment, subq2.enrollment_variance, subq2.enrollment_stddev, subq2.total_subjects_offered, subq2.school_name FROM subq1 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON subq1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN subq2 ON scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subq1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, subq1.course_number;

question: List, for IAP subject activities with a maximum enrollment of at least 10 and that are not cancelled, the activity title, enrollment type, academic term description, subject title from the course catalog, department name, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by activity title, and for each subject offered in the term '2017FA', the subject title, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the record counts for all tip materials associated with that subject, the department name, and the total number of enrolled students for each subject. Indicate the source of each row as either 'IAP Activity' or 'TIP Material Stats'. The columns should be: activity title, enrollment type, academic term description, subject title, department name, window row number, record count range, record count variance, record count standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), offer department name, number of enrolled students, and source. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 10 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' ) SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE = t2.SUBJECT_TITLE ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(t.RECORD_COUNT) - MIN(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_range, VARIANCE(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON s.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.record_count_range, i.record_count_variance, i.record_count_stddev, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON i.SUBJECT_TITLE = s.SUBJECT_TITLE AND s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' ORDER BY i.record_count_range DESC ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, NULL AS record_count_range, NULL AS record_count_variance, NULL AS record_count_stddev, NULL AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 'IAP Activity' AS Source FROM Subquery1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS ACTIVITY_TITLE, NULL AS ENROLLMENT_TYPE, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS window_column, s2.record_count_range, s2.record_count_variance, s2.record_count_stddev, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 'TIP Material Stats' AS Source FROM Subquery2 s2 ) SELECT ACTIVITY_TITLE, ENROLLMENT_TYPE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column, record_count_range, record_count_variance, record_count_stddev, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, Source FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY SUBJECT_TITLE, Source;

question: For subjects offered in the term '2017JA', show the subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, department full name, subject code, subject code description, and the minimum number of enrolled students over each subject code group, as well as the school name and department phone number. Additionally, for each subject, display the corresponding master subject ID, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in library subjects (with a matching master subject ID in the TIP subject offerings), and the total number of such subjects per department, considering only departments with more than 0 enrolled students in both tables. Order the results by subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.window_column, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, l.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = t.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, VARIANCE(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_students_variance, STDDEV(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_students_stddev, Subject_Counts.Total_Subjects, ic.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) AS Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) AS Subject_Counts ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = Subject_Counts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME GROUP BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, Subject_Counts.Total_Subjects, ic.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s1.window_column, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, s2.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, s2.library_students_variance, s2.library_students_stddev, s2.Total_Subjects FROM subq1 s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND s1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = s2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For each subject in the "Engineering" school with total units equal to 1, show the subject ID, subject title, department name, academic year, the rank of the subject within its academic year group ordered by subject ID, the term description, and the term start date. Additionally, for the academic year of each subject, include the academic year description, the variance of the number of tip detail records for subjects offered in that year (considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term and have at least one associated tip detail record), and the number of unique departments represented among those subjects. Present the results ordered by academic year and subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS unique_departments FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t1.TERM_CODE FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 1 ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.window_column, t3.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t3.TERM_START_DATE FROM inner_cte INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t3 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t3.TERM_CODE ) SELECT subq2.SUBJECT_ID, subq2.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, subq2.window_column, subq2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, subq2.TERM_START_DATE, subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, subq1.record_count_variance, subq1.unique_departments FROM subq2 JOIN subq1 ON subq2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subq2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, subq2.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each department where the average total units for subjects offered this year and letter graded is greater than the overall average for such subjects, and for each degree granting course in the School of Engineering in that department, provide the department name, the average and variance of the total units for such subjects, the course description, the subject title, the subject's short title, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title. Order the results by the variance of total units in descending order and then by the window row number. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, total_units_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_total_units > ( SELECT AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' ) ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE = t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.avg_total_units, subq1.total_units_variance, subq2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, subq2.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq2.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, subq2.window_column FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subq1.total_units_variance DESC, subq2.window_column;

question: For each subject code where the department is degree granting, show the subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, the number of subject codes per school name and whether the subject code description is present ('Has Description') or missing ('No Description'), as well as the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses offered by that department (considering only courses that have at least one associated TIP material), and the total number of such courses per department. For each school name, include a grand total for all subject codes in the format of (null, null, null, school name, null, total subject codes, null, null, null). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), SubjectCodeVisibility AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, CASE WHEN SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND SUBJECT_CODE_DESC <> 'nan' THEN 'Has Description' ELSE 'No Description' END AS description_status FROM inner_cte1 ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, description_status, COUNT(*) AS total_subject_codes FROM SubjectCodeVisibility GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, description_status WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ), SubjectCodeSummary AS ( SELECT scv.SUBJECT_CODE, scv.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.description_status, rr.total_subject_codes FROM RollupResults rr LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, description_status FROM SubjectCodeVisibility ) scv ON rr.SCHOOL_NAME = scv.SCHOOL_NAME AND rr.description_status = scv.description_status ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL ), DepartmentTipStats AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.department, VARIANCE(inner_cte2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS num_enrolled_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS num_enrolled_stddev, COUNT(*) AS total_courses_with_tip_material FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY inner_cte2.department ) SELECT scs.SUBJECT_CODE, scs.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scs.SCHOOL_NAME, scs.description_status, scs.total_subject_codes, dts.num_enrolled_variance, dts.num_enrolled_stddev, dts.total_courses_with_tip_material FROM SubjectCodeSummary scs LEFT JOIN DepartmentTipStats dts ON scs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dts.department ORDER BY scs.SCHOOL_NAME, scs.description_status;

question: List all courses that are either Mathematics department courses in any academic year with at least 5 enrolled students and more enrolled students than the average for Mathematics in that year, or any subject offered in the term "2019SP". For each result, show the course number, subject title, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, row number within academic year group (if applicable), total units (if applicable), average total units within subject group (if applicable), offering department name (if applicable), offering school name (if applicable), and a reason for inclusion ("MathematicsAboveAvg" for the first group, "2019SPSubjects" for the second group). The columns are: course number, subject title, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, row number within academic year group, total units, average total units within subject group, offering department name, offering school name, and reason for inclusion. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 ) SELECT i.COURSE_NUMBER, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.window_column FROM inner_cte i WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > ( SELECT AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = i.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ss.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY ss.SUBJECT_GROUP_ID ORDER BY lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_total_units, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, lso.COURSE_NUMBER FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2019SP' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(SUBJECT_TITLE) OVER (ORDER BY NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, OFFER_DEPT_NAME) = SUBJECT_TITLE THEN NULL ELSE SUBJECT_TITLE END AS subject_title, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, TERM_DESCRIPTION, TOTAL_UNITS, avg_total_units, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COURSE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte ORDER BY NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT s1.COURSE_NUMBER, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.window_column, NULL AS TOTAL_UNITS, NULL AS avg_total_units, NULL AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NULL AS OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, 'MathematicsAboveAvg' AS Reason FROM Subquery1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.COURSE_NUMBER, s2.subject_title, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS window_column, s2.TOTAL_UNITS, s2.avg_total_units, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, '2019SPSubjects' AS Reason FROM Subquery2 s2 ORDER BY COURSE_NUMBER, SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each of the top 10 departments with the highest maximum total units for any course they offer (where this maximum is greater than 6), what is the highest number of subject codes associated with any subject code in that department, what is the minimum department budget code for that department, what is the maximum total units, what is the name of the school the department belongs to, what is the course title with the maximum total units, and what is the subject code of that course? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(subject_code_count) AS highest_subject_code_count, MIN(min_dept_budget_code) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.max_total_units, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.SUBJECT_CODE FROM inner_cte ic JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.max_total_units = c.TOTAL_UNITS ORDER BY ic.max_total_units DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.highest_subject_code_count, s1.min_dept_budget_code, s2.max_total_units, s2.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.SUBJECT_CODE FROM subq2 s2 JOIN subq1 s1 ON s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For subjects offered in the term '2017JA', show the subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, department full name, subject code, subject code description, and the minimum number of enrolled students over each subject code group, as well as the school name and department phone number, and for each, also show the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in library subjects that have a matching master subject ID in the TIP subject offerings, the total number of such subjects per department, and the corresponding master subject ID, considering only departments with more than 0 enrolled students in both tables. Order the results by subject code and then by the variance of library students in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' ), cte1 AS ( SELECT inner_cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte1.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte1.window_column, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, inner_cte1.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID FROM inner_cte1 LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = t.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), cte2 AS ( SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, VARIANCE(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_students_variance, STDDEV(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_students_stddev, Subject_Counts.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte2 ic JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) AS Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) AS Subject_Counts ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = Subject_Counts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME GROUP BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, Subject_Counts.Total_Subjects ) SELECT cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE, cte1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, cte1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cte1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, cte1.SUBJECT_CODE, cte1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, cte1.window_column, cte1.SCHOOL_NAME, cte1.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, cte2.library_students_variance, cte2.library_students_stddev, cte2.Total_Subjects, cte2.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = cte2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND cte1.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = cte2.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY cte1.SUBJECT_CODE, cte2.library_students_variance DESC;

question: For each administrative department and employee type where the department name matches and the student year is 'G', provide the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the office phone numbers of students in that department (considering only students with a non-null office phone number), the variance category (classified as 'HIGH_VARIANCE' if the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is at least 20% greater than the average, 'LOW_VARIANCE' if the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is at least 20% less than the average, or 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' otherwise), the employee type, the number of people, the minimum MIT ID, and the number of unique office locations for those students. List the results ordered by the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of office phone numbers in descending order and then by the number of people in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.OFFICE_PHONE) AS avg_office_phone, STDDEV(MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.OFFICE_PHONE) AS stddev_office_phone FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY ON SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.DEPARTMENT WHERE MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.OFFICE_PHONE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DepartmentVariance AS ( SELECT inner_cte1.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.avg_office_phone, inner_cte1.stddev_office_phone, CASE WHEN inner_cte1.stddev_office_phone > inner_cte1.avg_office_phone * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN inner_cte1.stddev_office_phone < inner_cte1.avg_office_phone * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte1 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(sp.MIT_ID) AS person_count, MIN(sp.MIT_ID) AS min_mit_id FROM SE_PERSON sp JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), EmployeeTypeStats AS ( SELECT ic.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.person_count, ic.min_mit_id, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.OFFICE_LOCATION) AS unique_office_locations FROM inner_cte2 ic JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY ic.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.person_count, ic.min_mit_id ) SELECT dv.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dv.avg_office_phone, dv.stddev_office_phone, dv.variance_category, ets.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, ets.person_count, ets.min_mit_id, ets.unique_office_locations FROM DepartmentVariance dv JOIN EmployeeTypeStats ets ON dv.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = ets.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dv.stddev_office_phone DESC, ets.person_count DESC;

question: For subjects in the term '2017JA' with at least 5 enrolled students, show the subject ID, subject title, number of enrolled students, term code, material status key, ISBN, responsible faculty name, the row number within each material status group ordered by subject ID, the offering department name, department full name, subject code, subject code description, the minimum number of enrolled students over each subject code group, and for each subject code, include a grand total of enrolled students. Order the results by subject code and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ISBN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 ), SubjectMaterialStatus AS ( SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.TERM_CODE, i.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, i.ISBN, l.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, i.window_column FROM inner_cte1 i JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON i.SUBJECT_ID = l.SUBJECT_ID AND i.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' ), SubjectCodeStats AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, window_column, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students, SUBJECT_ID FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, window_column, SUBJECT_ID WITH ROLLUP HAVING (SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL OR SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0) ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.TERM_CODE, s.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s.ISBN, s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s.window_column AS material_status_row_number, scs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, scs.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, scs.SUBJECT_CODE, scs.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scs.window_column AS min_enrolled_students_per_code, scs.total_enrolled_students FROM SubjectMaterialStatus s JOIN SubjectCodeStats scs ON s.SUBJECT_ID = scs.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' ORDER BY scs.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For each department in the Provost Area that is associated with at least one facility organization (with a non-null organization key), list the department name, the total number of such facility organizations, the building room (on floor 2), the organization name, the department name (from HR), and the difference between the access level of the room and the average access level for that department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS provost_area_facility_orgs, m.DLC_NAME FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m ON f.DLC_KEY = m.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME ), provost_dept_facility_orgs AS ( SELECT m.DLC_NAME, inner_cte1.provost_area_facility_orgs FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN inner_cte1 ON m.DLC_NAME = inner_cte1.DLC_NAME WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.ACCESS_LEVEL FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2 ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ACCESS_LEVEL) AS avg_access_level FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT p.DLC_NAME, p.provost_area_facility_orgs, i.BUILDING_ROOM, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, (i.ACCESS_LEVEL - d.avg_access_level) AS access_level_deviation FROM provost_dept_facility_orgs p JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON p.DLC_NAME = fo.DLC_NAME JOIN inner_cte2 i ON fo.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN dept_avg d ON i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY p.DLC_NAME, i.BUILDING_ROOM

question: For subjects offered in the term with code '2025FA' that are in departments whose total number of units for all courses is more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean total units across all departments, show the subject ID, subject title, offering department name, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, term start date, term end date, term parameter, the difference between the number of enrolled students for each subject and the minimum number of enrolled students in its offering department, the department name, and the total number of units for all courses in that department, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH SubjectStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ) SELECT SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_CODE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_START_DATE, TERM_END_DATE, TERM_PARAMETER, (NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS - min_enrolled_students_per_dept) AS deviation_from_min_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte ), HighUnitDepartments AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) > ( SELECT AVG(dept_total) + STDDEV(dept_total) FROM ( SELECT SUM(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS dept_total FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) t ) ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_units FROM inner_cte i JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.TERM_START_DATE, s.TERM_END_DATE, s.TERM_PARAMETER, s.deviation_from_min_enrolled_students, h.DEPARTMENT_NAME, h.total_units FROM SubjectStats s JOIN HighUnitDepartments h ON s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = h.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each department and academic year after 2015, show the department name, the academic year, the academic year description, the number of subject materials with status 'EO' offered and with more than 5 total units, the average total units for those subjects, and classify the department as 'HIGH_ACTIVITY' if the count is at least 50% greater than the average count across all departments for that year, 'LOW_ACTIVITY' if at least 50% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Also, show the geometric mean of the degree year from all academic terms in that academic year where the degree year is greater than 1900, and classify the academic year as 'RECENT' if the geometric mean is at least 2010, 'OLD' if it is less than 1980, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte_dept AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS eo_materials_after_2015_with_high_units, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON td.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND td.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'EO' AND at.ACADEMIC_YEAR > 2015 AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 5 GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), avg_counts_dept AS ( SELECT AVG(eo_materials_after_2015_with_high_units) AS avg_count FROM inner_cte_dept ), dept_activity AS ( SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.eo_materials_after_2015_with_high_units, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, CASE WHEN i.eo_materials_after_2015_with_high_units > a.avg_count * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_ACTIVITY' WHEN i.eo_materials_after_2015_with_high_units < a.avg_count * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_ACTIVITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS activity_level FROM inner_cte_dept i JOIN avg_counts_dept a ON 1=1 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = i.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ss.TERM_CODE IN ( SELECT at2.TERM_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 WHERE at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = i.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.eo_materials_after_2015_with_high_units, a.avg_count ), inner_cte_year AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(ACADEMIC_TERMS.DEGREE_YEAR))) AS geometric_mean_degree_year FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.DEGREE_YEAR > 1900 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), year_category_cte AS ( SELECT inner_cte_year.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte_year.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte_year.geometric_mean_degree_year, CASE WHEN inner_cte_year.geometric_mean_degree_year >= 2010 THEN 'RECENT' WHEN inner_cte_year.geometric_mean_degree_year < 1980 THEN 'OLD' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS year_category FROM inner_cte_year ) SELECT da.DEPARTMENT_NAME, da.ACADEMIC_YEAR, yc.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, da.eo_materials_after_2015_with_high_units, da.avg_total_units, da.activity_level, yc.geometric_mean_degree_year, yc.year_category FROM dept_activity da JOIN year_category_cte yc ON da.ACADEMIC_YEAR = yc.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY da.DEPARTMENT_NAME, da.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each school and department, list the school name, department name, the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2022, the highest number of lecture units among its offered subjects in the Fall term of 2022, the start date of the term, and the total number of subjects offered by that department in that term (including only departments where the highest number of lecture units is greater than 3). For each school, also include a grand total for all departments in the format of (school name, null, total range, total variance, null, null, null). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCD.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCD.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, units_range, units_variance FROM ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, units_range, units_variance FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(units_range) AS units_range, VARIANCE(units_range) AS units_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ) t ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, at2.TERM_START_DATE FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 ON td.TERM_CODE = at2.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at2.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) > 3 ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.max_lecture_units, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, COUNT(ccs2.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs2 ON ccs2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ccs2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.max_lecture_units, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE ) SELECT s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.units_range, s1.units_variance, s2.max_lecture_units, s2.TERM_START_DATE, s2.num_subjects_offered FROM subq1 s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For departments that offered more than 5 unique subjects in terms from the academic year 2014 or later, list the department name, the count of unique subject titles, the total number of enrolled students in those subjects, and for each such department, show for library reserve material details with material status key equal to 'U' the library course instructor key, library reserve catalog key, term code, subject ID, the tip material key, tip material status key, tip ISBN, the subject title from the subject offered table, the minimum tip material status key in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the number of enrolled students, and also include the responsible faculty name. Show the results ordered by total enrolled students descending and then by library course instructor key. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2014 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.subject_count, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2014 GROUP BY inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.subject_count HAVING inner_cte.subject_count > 5 ORDER BY total_enrolled_students DESC ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT l.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, l.TERM_CODE, l.SUBJECT_ID, t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t.ISBN, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MIN(t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) OVER (ORDER BY s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, s.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ) SELECT inner_cte.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, inner_cte.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, inner_cte.ISBN, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.window_column, s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON inner_cte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = s.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ) SELECT subq1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, subq1.subject_count, subq1.total_enrolled_students, subq2.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY,
