subq2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, subq2.TERM_CODE, subq2.SUBJECT_ID, subq2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, subq2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, subq2.ISBN, subq2.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq2.window_column, subq2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = subq2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY subq1.total_enrolled_students DESC, subq2.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY;

question: For each subject with more than 0 total units and at least 1 enrolled student, provide the department name, subject ID, total units, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department, the deviation of the subject's total units from the department's average, and classify the department as 'HIGH_VARIANCE' if its standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is at least 20% greater than the average, 'LOW_VARIANCE' if its standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is at least 20% less than the average, or 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' otherwise. Show the results ordered by the department's standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units (descending), department name, and subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.TOTAL_UNITS, d.avg_total_units, d.stddev_total_units, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - d.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_stats d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units, CASE WHEN inner_cte.stddev_total_units > inner_cte.avg_total_units * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN inner_cte.stddev_total_units < inner_cte.avg_total_units * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.TOTAL_UNITS, s1.avg_total_units, s1.stddev_total_units, s1.deviation_from_avg, s2.variance_category FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.stddev_total_units DESC, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each department, list the department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students per subject offered by that department in the term 2019FA, the total number of subjects offered by each department in that term, the minimum number of lecture units, and the total number of units for all subjects offered in the Fall term of the academic year 2022. Present the results ordered by the range of enrolled students in descending order, then by the total number of units in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH dept_enrollment_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_ID, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev, dept_subject_counts.total_subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects FROM STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS dept_subject_counts ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_subject_counts.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dept_subject_counts.total_subjects ), dept_units_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS min_lecture_units, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.TERM_DESCRIPTION LIKE 'Fall Term%' AND c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte ) SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.enrolled_range, d1.enrolled_variance, d1.enrolled_stddev, d1.total_subjects, d2.min_lecture_units, d2.total_units FROM dept_enrollment_stats d1 JOIN dept_units_stats d2 ON d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d1.enrolled_range DESC, d2.total_units DESC;

question: For each department whose total number of units for all courses is more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean total units across all departments, what is the department code, department name, total number of units, and for each subject offered by that department in the School of Engineering during the term '2016SP', what is the course number, the number of enrolled students, the average number of enrolled students in that department, and the deviation of the subject's enrolled students from this departmental average? List the department code, department name, total number of units, course number, number of enrolled students, average number of enrolled students in the department, and deviation from average, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptUnits AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) > ( SELECT AVG(dept_total) + STDDEV(dept_total) FROM ( SELECT SUM(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS dept_total FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) t ) ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_units FROM inner_cte i JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), DeptEnrollment AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.COURSE_NUMBER, sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.COURSE_NUMBER, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, avg_dept.avg_enrolled_students, (i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS - avg_dept.avg_enrolled_students) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) avg_dept ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = avg_dept.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT du.DEPARTMENT_CODE, du.DEPARTMENT_NAME, du.total_units, de.COURSE_NUMBER, de.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, de.avg_enrolled_students, de.deviation_from_avg FROM DeptUnits du JOIN DeptEnrollment de ON du.DEPARTMENT_NAME = de.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY du.DEPARTMENT_CODE, de.COURSE_NUMBER;

question: For subjects offered in the term with code '2025FA', show the subject ID, subject title, offering department name, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, term start date, term end date, term parameter, the difference between the number of enrolled students for each subject and the minimum number of enrolled students in its offering department, and the highest average total units for subjects ever offered by the department in a regular academic term, ordered by offering department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH SubjectEnrolledStats AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ), DeptHighestAvgUnits AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(avg_total_units) AS highest_avg_total_units FROM ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.TERM_CODE, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.TERM_CODE ) inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY highest_avg_total_units DESC ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.TERM_START_DATE, s.TERM_END_DATE, s.TERM_PARAMETER, (s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS - s.min_enrolled_students_per_dept) AS deviation_from_min_enrolled, d.highest_avg_total_units FROM SubjectEnrolledStats s JOIN DeptHighestAvgUnits d ON s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: For subjects offered in the term 2019FA, show the subject ID, subject title, number of enrolled students, department name, department full name, department code, and the total number of units for all courses in the department, but only for those departments where (1) the total number of enrolled students across all their offered subjects in 2019FA is greater than the average number of enrolled students per department for that term, and (2) the department's total units are more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean total units across all departments. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ), dept_totals AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subquery1 AS ( SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte1 i JOIN dept_totals d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE d.total_enrolled > ( SELECT AVG(total_enrolled) FROM dept_totals ) ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) > ( SELECT AVG(dept_total) + STDDEV(dept_total) FROM ( SELECT SUM(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS dept_total FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) t ) ), subquery2 AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_units FROM inner_cte2 ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s2.total_units FROM subquery1 s1 JOIN subquery2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each subject that has at least one enrolled student, show the subject title, the term code from the library subject offered table, the tip material status key, the total units from the subject offered summary, the total enrolled students (with a grand total row for each subject title), the department name, and the geometric mean of the total units for subjects offered by that department where the total units are greater than zero, ordered by department name, subject title, and term code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.TERM_CODE, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_enrolled_students, lso.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID INNER JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_CODE, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TOTAL_UNITS, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students, SUBJECT_ID FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_CODE, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TOTAL_UNITS, SUBJECT_ID WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ), GeometricMeanUnits AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE, EXP(AVG(LN(inner_cte2.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT rr.SUBJECT_TITLE, rr.TERM_CODE, rr.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, rr.TOTAL_UNITS, rr.total_enrolled_students, gmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, gmu.geometric_mean_total_units FROM RollupResults rr JOIN GeometricMeanUnits gmu ON rr.SUBJECT_TITLE = gmu.SUBJECT_TITLE AND rr.SUBJECT_ID = gmu.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY gmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.SUBJECT_TITLE, rr.TERM_CODE

question: For each of the top 5 departments with the highest total number of students enrolled in library subjects (offered during terms with status 'P' and more than 0 enrolled students), show the offering department name, subject title, responsible faculty name, term description, academic year description, the total number of subjects offered per department for subjects offered in the term with the parameter 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM', the total enrolled students in library subjects, the academic year with the highest enrollment for that department, and the number of students enrolled in that year. Present the results ordered by total enrolled students in library subjects (descending), then by department name and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH cte1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM' ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, dept_counts.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS Total_Subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM' GROUP BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) dept_counts ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_counts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), cte2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT dept_stats.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dept_stats.Total_Enrolled_Students, year_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AS Peak_Year_Desc, year_stats.Year_Enrolled_Students FROM ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS Total_Enrolled_Students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY Total_Enrolled_Students DESC LIMIT 5 ) dept_stats LEFT JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS Year_Enrolled_Students, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) year_stats ON dept_stats.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = year_stats.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND year_stats.rn = 1 ORDER BY dept_stats.Total_Enrolled_Students DESC ) SELECT cte1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE, cte1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, cte1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cte1.Total_Subjects, cte2.Total_Enrolled_Students, cte2.Peak_Year_Desc, cte2.Year_Enrolled_Students FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = cte2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY cte2.Total_Enrolled_Students DESC, cte1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each offering department and school where the course material status is 'RQ', and for each academic year, provide the department name, school name, number of unique subjects, minimum total units for those subjects, average number of enrolled students for those subjects, academic year, academic year description, average total units, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for subjects offered in regular terms. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_num_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte ic JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(avg_total_units) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(stddev_total_units) AS stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s1.subject_count, s1.min_total_units, s1.avg_num_enrolled_students, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.avg_total_units, s2.stddev_total_units FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For academic term parameters where the term indicator is 'C', show the term parameter, the term code, the academic year, the department name of the offered subject, the running sum of academic years within each department, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and at least 1 enrolled student), and classify the department as 'HIGH_VARIANCE' if its standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is at least 20% greater than the average, 'LOW_VARIANCE' if its standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is at least 20% less than the average, or 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' otherwise. Only include departments that offer at least 3 subjects in those terms. Order the results by department name and academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_PARAMETER, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_INDICATOR = 'C' ), DeptCounts AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS subject_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE IN ( SELECT TERM_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER WHERE TERM_INDICATOR = 'C' ) GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 ), cte1_result AS ( SELECT icte.TERM_PARAMETER, icte.TERM_CODE, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.window_column FROM inner_cte1 icte JOIN DeptCounts dc ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), cte2_result AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.avg_total_units, inner_cte2.stddev_total_units, CASE WHEN inner_cte2.stddev_total_units > inner_cte2.avg_total_units * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN inner_cte2.stddev_total_units < inner_cte2.avg_total_units * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte2 ) SELECT c1.TERM_PARAMETER, c1.TERM_CODE, c1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c1.window_column, c2.avg_total_units, c2.stddev_total_units, c2.variance_category FROM cte1_result c1 JOIN cte2_result c2 ON c1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY c1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c1.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each subject offered in the term with the description "Fall Term 2024-2025", show the subject offered key, subject title, offering department name, the term description, the number of subjects offered by each department in that term, the minimum record count from TIP_DETAIL, and the total new shelf price from TIP_MATERIAL for materials with a non-null author and a material info source of 'ISBN'. For each department, include a grand total for all subjects offered in the format of (null, null, offering department name, term description, total subjects, null, null). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' ), DeptSubjectCounts AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(*) AS num_subjects FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, TERM_DESCRIPTION WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ), subject_offered_summary AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN dsc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE ict.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY END AS TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, CASE WHEN dsc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE ict.SUBJECT_TITLE END AS SUBJECT_TITLE, dsc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dsc.TERM_DESCRIPTION, dsc.num_subjects, ict.SUBJECT_ID FROM DeptSubjectCounts dsc LEFT JOIN inner_cte1 ict ON dsc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = ict.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND dsc.TERM_DESCRIPTION = ict.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY dsc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ict.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT MIN(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS min_record_count, SUM(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS total_new_shelf_price, td.SUBJECT_ID FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE tm.AUTHOR IS NOT NULL AND tm.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE = 'ISBN' GROUP BY td.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT sos.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sos.TERM_DESCRIPTION, sos.num_subjects, ic2.min_record_count, ic2.total_new_shelf_price FROM subject_offered_summary sos LEFT JOIN inner_cte2 ic2 ON sos.SUBJECT_ID = ic2.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sos.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2012 that also have a section ID of 0 and a cluster type of 'S', show the subject key, subject title, offer department name, academic year, term description, the total number of subjects offered by each department in that year, the row number within each offer department name group ordered by subject key, the department name from SUBJECT_SUMMARY, the term start date from ACADEMIC_TERMS, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the subject title from SUBJECT_OFFERED. List the results in order by offer department name and subject key. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_KEY) AS window_column, t1.TERM_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_KEY, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, d.dept_subject_count, i.window_column, i.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS dept_subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) d ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.SECTION_ID = 0 AND t0.CLUSTER_TYPE = 'S' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t3.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t3 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t3.TERM_CODE ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_KEY, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.dept_subject_count, s1.window_column AS dept_window_number, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.TERM_START_DATE, s2.window_column AS cluster_window_number FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_TITLE = s2.SUBJECT_TITLE AND s1.TERM_CODE = s2.TERM_CODE ORDER BY s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_KEY;

question: For each department where the maximum total units of any course offered by that department is greater than 6, what are the department name, the maximum total units, the name of the school that department belongs to, and the subject code of the course with the maximum total units, along with, for each grade type and department in the School of Engineering, the grade type, the number of subjects with at least 6 units, the average total units for those subjects, the school name, and the department full name? The results include all these columns in the following order: department name, maximum total units, school name, subject code, grade type, number of subjects with at least 6 units, average total units for those subjects, engineering school name, and department full name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.max_total_units, i.SCHOOL_NAME, c.SUBJECT_CODE FROM inner_cte i JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.SCHOOL_NAME = s.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = i.max_total_units ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.GRADE_TYPE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(grade_type) OVER (ORDER BY grade_type_sort, grade_type, dept_sort) = grade_type THEN NULL ELSE grade_type END AS grade_type, dept, subj_count, avg_units, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS department_full_name FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(GRADE_TYPE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE GRADE_TYPE END AS grade_type_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(GRADE_TYPE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(GRADE_TYPE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE GRADE_TYPE END AS grade_type, CASE WHEN GROUPING(GRADE_TYPE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, DEPARTMENT_NAME AS dept, COUNT(*) AS subj_count, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY GRADE_TYPE, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP ) tbltmp LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tbltmp.dept = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY grade_type_sort, dept_sort ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.max_total_units, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.grade_type, s2.subj_count, s2.avg_units, s2.school_name AS engineering_school_name, s2.department_full_name FROM subq1 s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.dept;

question: For each department that offered subjects in the Fall term of the academic year 2022, what is the minimum number of lecture units and the total number of units for all subjects offered in that term, and for each subject offered by that department in the term with code '2022FA', what are the subject ID, term description, running sum of total units within the academic year, subject title, and whether the subject is offered in the fall term? List the results by department name and subject ID, and include the columns in this order: department name, minimum lecture units, total units, subject ID, term description, running sum of total units, subject title, and whether the subject is offered in the fall term. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT MIN(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS min_lecture_units, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.TERM_DESCRIPTION LIKE 'Fall Term%' AND c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ) SELECT icte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte1.min_lecture_units, icte1.total_units, icte2.SUBJECT_ID, icte2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte2.window_column, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM FROM inner_cte1 icte1 JOIN inner_cte2 icte2 ON icte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = icte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON icte2.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID AND t2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ORDER BY icte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte2.SUBJECT_ID;

question: List, for each department, either (a) the department name, course level, number of unique degree-granting courses with total units greater than 6, minimum total units offered, and number of courses with at least 3 design units (for each department name and course level), or (b) the department name, number of degree-granting subjects offered in 2022, average total units, range of total units, and variance of total units for those subjects (for each department with at least 5 such subjects), along with a reason for inclusion ('CourseStats' for the first case and 'SubjectStats' for the second). The columns are: department name, course level, course count, minimum total units, courses with design units 3 or more, subject count, average total units, total units range, total units variance, and reason. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.COURSE_LEVEL, ic.course_count, ic.min_total_units, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ccc.DESIGN_UNITS >= 3 THEN scd.COURSE END) AS courses_with_design_units_3_or_more FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.COURSE_LEVEL = scd.COURSE_LEVEL JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.COURSE_LEVEL, ic.course_count, ic.min_total_units ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS subject_count, AVG(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY subject_count DESC, total_units_range DESC ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.COURSE_LEVEL, s1.course_count, s1.min_total_units, s1.courses_with_design_units_3_or_more, NULL AS subject_count, NULL AS avg_total_units, NULL AS total_units_range, NULL AS total_units_variance, 'CourseStats' AS Reason FROM Subquery1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS COURSE_LEVEL, NULL AS course_count, NULL AS min_total_units, NULL AS courses_with_design_units_3_or_more, s2.subject_count, s2.avg_total_units, s2.total_units_range, s2.total_units_variance, 'SubjectStats' AS Reason FROM Subquery2 s2 ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Reason;

question: For each department in the School of Engineering that has a total number of students enrolled in its courses greater than both 50 and the average total enrollment across all Engineering departments, and that also offered subjects in the term with code '2022SU' with an average total units for their subjects greater than the average total units for all subjects offered in that term, give the department name, the total number of students enrolled in courses offered by that department, and the average total units for their subjects in '2022SU'. List the results ordered by department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptHighEnrollment AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_enrollment, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT AVG(total_enrollment) AS avg_enrollment FROM ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ) sub ) a ON i.total_enrollment > a.avg_enrollment ), DeptHighAvgUnits AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2022SU' ) SELECT t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2022SU' GROUP BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING AVG(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) > ( SELECT AVG(t3.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t3 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t3.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2022SU' ) ) SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.total_enrollment, u.avg_total_units FROM DeptHighEnrollment e JOIN DeptHighAvgUnits u ON e.DEPARTMENT_CODE = u.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY e.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each room on floor 2, show the building room, space usage, the organization name, the HR org unit title, the department name, the minimum access level in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the building component, the average access level for rooms on floor 2 in the same department as a benchmark, and classify each room as 'HIGH_ACCESS' (if its access level is at least 10% greater than the department average), 'LOW_ACCESS' (if at least 10% less), or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Additionally, for the organization associated with each room, show the range and variance of the space unit codes (considering only organizations with a non-null description and space units with a non-null space unit name), and the total number of distinct space units per organization. The columns are: building room, space usage, organization name, HR org unit title, department name, windowed minimum access level, department access level benchmark, access category, organization space unit code range, organization space unit code variance, and total number of distinct space units per organization. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH room_access AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.SPACE_USAGE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.ACCESS_LEVEL, t0.BUILDING_COMPONENT, t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2 ), dept_benchmark AS ( SELECT HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ACCESS_LEVEL) AS benchmark FROM inner_cte GROUP BY HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.BUILDING_ROOM, i.SPACE_USAGE, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(i.ACCESS_LEVEL) OVER (ORDER BY i.BUILDING_COMPONENT ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, d.benchmark, CASE WHEN i.ACCESS_LEVEL > d.benchmark * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ACCESS' WHEN i.ACCESS_LEVEL < d.benchmark * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ACCESS' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS access_category, i.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_benchmark d ON i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ), org_space_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAX(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) - MIN(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS code_range, VARIANCE(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS code_variance FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY odk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON odk.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL AND su.SPACE_UNIT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.code_range, inner_cte.code_variance, su_counts.total_space_units FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS total_space_units FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY odk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON odk.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL AND su.SPACE_UNIT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) su_counts ON inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = su_counts.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT ra.BUILDING_ROOM, ra.SPACE_USAGE, ra.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ra.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, ra.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ra.window_column, ra.benchmark, ra.access_category, os.code_range, os.code_variance, os.total_space_units FROM room_access ra JOIN org_space_stats os ON ra.ORGANIZATION_NAME = os.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY ra.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ra.BUILDING_ROOM

question: For organizations with an organization level of 5, show their organization names (do not repeat the organization name if it is the same as the previous row), the dense rank of their corresponding HR department names (considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the HR department code from the HR organization unit table), the HR department's full name, and school/area name, and for each matching HR org unit on floor 2, list the building room, its space usage, the HR org unit title, the department's long name, and the minimum access level in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the building component. Sort the table by organization name, HR department name, and building room. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(ORGANIZATION_NAME) OVER (ORDER BY ORGANIZATION_NAME, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = ORGANIZATION_NAME THEN NULL ELSE ORGANIZATION_NAME END AS organization_name, window_column, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM inner_cte ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.SPACE_USAGE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, MIN(t0.ACCESS_LEVEL) OVER (ORDER BY t0.BUILDING_COMPONENT ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2 ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte ) SELECT subq1.organization_name, subq1.window_column AS hr_dept_dense_rank, subq1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, subq2.BUILDING_ROOM, subq2.SPACE_USAGE, subq2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, subq2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, subq2.window_column AS min_access_level_window FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = subq2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID ORDER BY subq1.organization_name, subq1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq2.BUILDING_ROOM

question: For each space unit with a warehouse load date of '19-DEC-24' and each HR org unit linked to that space unit with a warehouse load date of '03-DEC-24', list the space unit name, the associated organization name, the HR org unit title, and the deviation of the HR department code from the average HR department code for HR org units linked to that space unit. Additionally, for each such HR org unit where the associated organization has a non-null description, include the minimum access level among its rooms, the total number of unique space usages, and the number of rooms assigned to that organization. The results are ordered by space unit name, organization name, and HR org unit title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1_inner_cte AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, fo.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE su.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND hou.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '03-DEC-24' ), subq1_avg_codes AS ( SELECT SPACE_UNIT, AVG(CAST(HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE AS FLOAT)) AS avg_hr_dept_code FROM subq1_inner_cte GROUP BY SPACE_UNIT ), subq1 AS ( SELECT i.SPACE_UNIT, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, (CAST(i.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE AS FLOAT) - a.avg_hr_dept_code) AS deviation_from_avg, i.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM subq1_inner_cte i JOIN subq1_avg_codes a ON i.SPACE_UNIT = a.SPACE_UNIT ), subq2_inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(z.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS min_access_level, COUNT(DISTINCT z.SPACE_USAGE) AS total_space_usages, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, f.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION f JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD z ON f.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = z.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE f.DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL GROUP BY f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, f.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID ), subq2_base AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(ORGANIZATION_NAME) OVER (ORDER BY ORGANIZATION_NAME) = ORGANIZATION_NAME THEN NULL ELSE ORGANIZATION_NAME END AS organization_name, min_access_level, total_space_usages, COUNT(z.BUILDING_ROOM) AS num_rooms, inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM subq2_inner_cte inner_cte LEFT JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD z ON inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = z.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID GROUP BY inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, min_access_level, total_space_usages, inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID ), subq2 AS ( SELECT organization_name, min_access_level, total_space_usages, num_rooms, HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM subq2_base ORDER BY organization_name ) SELECT s1.SPACE_UNIT, s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, s1.deviation_from_avg, s2.min_access_level, s2.total_space_usages, s2.num_rooms FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = s2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID ORDER BY s1.SPACE_UNIT, s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE

question: For each degree-granting department that offered at least one subject in the School of Engineering in 2021 and also offered subjects in 2019FA, provide the department code, department name, department full name, the number of subjects offered in 2021, the total number of enrolled students in those 2021 subjects, the average number of enrolled students per subject in 2021, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students per subject offered by that department in the term 2019FA, and the total number of subjects offered by each department in 2019FA. List the results ordered by department code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptEnrolledStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_ID, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev, dept_subject_counts.total_subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects FROM STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE ) AS dept_subject_counts ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_subject_counts.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dept_subject_counts.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dept_subject_counts.total_subjects ), DegreeGrantingEng2021 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.total_enrollment, CASE WHEN inner_cte.subject_count > 0 THEN inner_cte.total_enrollment * 1.0 / inner_cte.subject_count ELSE NULL END AS avg_enrollment_per_subject FROM inner_cte ) SELECT dge.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dge.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dge.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, dge.subject_count, dge.total_enrollment, dge.avg_enrollment_per_subject, des.enrolled_range, des.enrolled_variance, des.enrolled_stddev, des.total_subjects FROM DegreeGrantingEng2021 dge JOIN DeptEnrolledStats des ON dge.DEPARTMENT_CODE = des.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dge.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: Provide a combined report that includes, for each subject category, the category name, the average and variance of the maximum enrollment across all activities in that category (with a grand total row for all categories as (null, total average, total variance)), and, for IAP subjects in the "Mathematics" category, the activity title, enrollment type, maximum enrollment, category name, sponsor key, row number within each enrollment type group ordered by activity title, and the total number of activities per enrollment type in the "Mathematics" category. The report should indicate the source of each row as either 'CategoryStats' or 'MathActivities', and display the columns in the following order: Source, category name, average maximum enrollment, variance of maximum enrollment, activity title, enrollment type, maximum enrollment, sponsor key, row number, and total activities. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH CategoryStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT FROM IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d ON c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL ) SELECT IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, AVG(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, VARIANCE(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS var_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY IAP_CATEGORY_NAME WITH ROLLUP ORDER BY CASE WHEN IAP_CATEGORY_NAME IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, var_max_enrollment DESC ), MathActivities AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.MAX_ENROLLMENT, inner_cte.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, inner_cte.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, inner_cte.window_column, ActivityCounts.Total_Activities FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS Total_Activities FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ) AS ActivityCounts ON inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = ActivityCounts.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT 'CategoryStats' AS Source, cs.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, cs.avg_max_enrollment, cs.var_max_enrollment, NULL AS ACTIVITY_TITLE, NULL AS ENROLLMENT_TYPE, NULL AS MAX_ENROLLMENT, NULL AS IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, NULL AS window_column, NULL AS Total_Activities FROM CategoryStats cs UNION ALL SELECT 'MathActivities' AS Source, ma.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, NULL AS avg_max_enrollment, NULL AS var_max_enrollment, ma.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ma.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, ma.MAX_ENROLLMENT, ma.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, ma.window_column, ma.Total_Activities FROM MathActivities ma ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY Source, IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, ACTIVITY_TITLE ;

question: For each department, show the department name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department in 2017 (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students), the total number of such subjects per department, the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects that are offered this year and are letter graded), and include only those departments where the average total units is greater than the overall average total units for such subjects. List the results ordered by the variance of enrolled students in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH enrollment_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2017%' ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ), unit_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, total_units_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_total_units > ( SELECT AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' ) ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.enrolled_students_variance, e.enrolled_students_stddev, e.total_subjects, u.avg_total_units, u.total_units_variance FROM enrollment_stats e JOIN unit_stats u ON e.DEPARTMENT_NAME = u.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY e.enrolled_students_variance DESC

question: For each department, what is the department name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department in 2017 (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students), the total number of such subjects per department, the course description, the subject title, the subject's grade type description, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title, for courses in the School of Engineering that are degree granting? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2017%' ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.GRADE_TYPE_DESC, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE = t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.enrolled_students_variance, subq1.enrolled_students_stddev, subq1.total_subjects, subq2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, subq2.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq2.GRADE_TYPE_DESC, subq2.window_column FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subq1.enrolled_students_variance DESC, subq2.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For each room with area greater than 200 and assignable major use, show the building room, floor, room number, space ID, area, major use name, major use description, the minimum area value over each major use group, whether the room is a 'LARGE_ROOM' (at least 20% greater than the minimum area for its major use), 'SMALL_ROOM' (at least 20% less than the minimum area for its major use), or 'AVERAGE', and the average area for each major use description (for rooms with access level 1), ordered by major use. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH RoomAreaCategory AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.ROOM, t1.SPACE_ID, t1.AREA, t0.MAJOR_USE, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, min(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY ORDER BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY) AS min_area_per_major_use FROM FCLT_MAJOR_USE t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 200 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1 ) SELECT BUILDING_ROOM, FLOOR, ROOM, SPACE_ID, AREA, MAJOR_USE, DESCRIPTION, min_area_per_major_use, FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, CASE WHEN AREA > min_area_per_major_use * 1.2 THEN 'LARGE_ROOM' WHEN AREA < min_area_per_major_use * 0.8 THEN 'SMALL_ROOM' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS room_size_category FROM inner_cte ), MajorUseAvgArea AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.AREA, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY FROM FCLT_MAJOR_USE t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 ) SELECT DESCRIPTION, FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, AVG(AREA) AS avg_area FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DESCRIPTION, FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY ) SELECT rac.BUILDING_ROOM, rac.FLOOR, rac.ROOM, rac.SPACE_ID, rac.AREA, rac.MAJOR_USE, rac.DESCRIPTION, rac.min_area_per_major_use, rac.room_size_category, mua.avg_area FROM RoomAreaCategory rac LEFT JOIN MajorUseAvgArea mua ON rac.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = mua.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY AND rac.DESCRIPTION = mua.DESCRIPTION ORDER BY rac.MAJOR_USE;

question: For each subject offered by the library in the term "2019SP", show the subject title, the number of enrolled students, the term description, the total units for the subject, the average total units within each subject group, the offering department name, the school name, and the number of unique subject titles with materials offered in regular academic terms for the corresponding department and school. Do not repeat the subject title if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by the number of enrolled students and department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subject_offered_2019sp AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ss.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY ss.SUBJECT_GROUP_ID ORDER BY lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_total_units, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS dept_name, lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2019SP' ), subject_titles_by_dept_school AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_title_count FROM ( SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.SCHOOL_NAME FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON td.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND td.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ) ic GROUP BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE) > 0 ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(so.SUBJECT_TITLE) OVER (ORDER BY so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) = so.SUBJECT_TITLE THEN NULL ELSE so.SUBJECT_TITLE END AS subject_title, so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, so.TERM_DESCRIPTION, so.TOTAL_UNITS, so.avg_total_units, so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, so.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, stds.subject_title_count FROM subject_offered_2019sp so LEFT JOIN subject_titles_by_dept_school stds ON so.dept_name = stds.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND so.school_name = stds.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: For subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering with a total of at least 6 units, show the subject code, subject title, department name, and the running sum of total units within each grade type (only including those subjects where the running sum exceeds 12 units within their grade type), and for each such subject that also has at least one enrolled student, show the maximum number of enrolled students, the term code from the library subject offered table, the tip material status key, and the total units from the subject offered summary. Order the results by subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ) SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > 12 ORDER BY SUBJECT_CODE ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.TERM_CODE, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID INNER JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled_students, TERM_CODE, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_CODE, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TOTAL_UNITS ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.max_enrolled_students, s2.TERM_CODE, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2.TOTAL_UNITS FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_TITLE = s2.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For academic term parameters where the term indicator is 'C', show the term parameter, the term code, the academic year, the department name of the offered subject, the running sum of academic years within each department (ordered by academic year), the subject title, the total units of the offered subject, the total number of active graduate students with an office location assigned in that department, and the average office phone number (as a numeric value) for those students. Do not repeat the department name if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by department and academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_PARAMETER, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_INDICATOR = 'C' ) SELECT inner_cte.TERM_PARAMETER, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, t3.SUBJECT_TITLE, t3.TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t3 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t3.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE AND inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = t3.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS total_active_grad_students FROM SE_PERSON s JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY m ON s.FULL_NAME = m.FULL_NAME WHERE s.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND m.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND m.OFFICE_LOCATION IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(department_name) OVER (ORDER BY dept_sort) = department_name THEN NULL ELSE department_name END AS department_name, total_active_grad_students, avg_office_phone FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS department_name, COUNT(*) AS total_active_grad_students, AVG(CASE WHEN OFFICE_PHONE IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE OFFICE_PHONE END) AS avg_office_phone FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY m JOIN SE_PERSON s ON s.FULL_NAME = m.FULL_NAME WHERE s.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND m.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND m.OFFICE_LOCATION IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY dept_sort ) SELECT s1.TERM_PARAMETER, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.TOTAL_UNITS, s2.total_active_grad_students, s2.avg_office_phone FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.department_name ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR

question: For academic terms where the term status is 'Previous' and the running sum of academic years within each financial aid year group is greater than the average academic year across all previous terms, and for each library reserve material detail with material status key equal to 'U' and number of enrolled students greater than the average across all subjects, show the term code, the term description, the academic year, the running sum of academic years within the financial aid year group, the financial aid year, the library course instructor key, the library reserve catalog key, the subject ID, the tip material key, the tip material status key, the tip ISBN, the subject title, and the minimum tip material status key in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the number of enrolled students, for records where the term code matches in both sets. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ) SELECT TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, window_column, FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > ( SELECT AVG(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS WHERE TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ) ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT l.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, l.TERM_CODE, l.SUBJECT_ID, t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t.ISBN, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, MIN(t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) OVER ( ORDER BY s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ) SELECT LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, TERM_CODE, SUBJECT_ID, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ISBN, SUBJECT_TITLE, window_column, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte WHERE NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > ( SELECT AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ) ) SELECT s1.TERM_CODE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.window_column AS TERM_WINDOW_SUM, s1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, s2.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, s2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2.ISBN, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.window_column AS MATERIAL_WINDOW_MIN FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.TERM_CODE = s2.TERM_CODE ORDER BY s1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS;

question: For each academic term with at least one non-cancelled IAP subject activity that has a non-null maximum enrollment, show the term description, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the maximum enrollment values for IAP subject activities in that term, the academic year description, the number of terms in that academic year, the average number of terms across all academic years as a benchmark, and classify the academic year as 'HIGH_TERM_YEAR' if it has at least 10% more terms than average, 'LOW_TERM_YEAR' if it has at least 10% fewer terms than average, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Only consider terms where the term status indicator in ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL is 'P' and the term status in ACADEMIC_TERMS is not 'Future'. Order the results by the range of maximum enrollment in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte_year AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(at.TERM_CODE) AS term_count FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND at.TERM_STATUS <> 'Future' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), benchmark_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(term_count) AS avg_term_count FROM inner_cte_year ), AcademicYearTermStats AS ( SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.term_count, b.avg_term_count, CASE WHEN i.term_count > b.avg_term_count * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_TERM_YEAR' WHEN i.term_count < b.avg_term_count * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_TERM_YEAR' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS term_year_category FROM inner_cte_year i CROSS JOIN benchmark_cte b ), inner_cte_term AS ( SELECT ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, MAX(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) - MIN(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_range, VARIANCE(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_stddev FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' GROUP BY ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION ), TermEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT inner_cte_term.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte_term.max_enrollment_range, inner_cte_term.max_enrollment_variance, inner_cte_term.max_enrollment_stddev, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM inner_cte_term JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON inner_cte_term.TERM_DESCRIPTION = ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION ) SELECT t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.max_enrollment_range, t.max_enrollment_variance, t.max_enrollment_stddev, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, a.term_count, a.avg_term_count, a.term_year_category FROM TermEnrollmentStats t JOIN AcademicYearTermStats a ON t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY t.max_enrollment_range DESC;

question: For each subject in the Mathematics department during regular terms that has reserve materials with material status key equal to 'U', show the library course instructor key, library reserve catalog key, term code, subject ID, tip material key, tip material status key, tip ISBN, the subject title from the subject offered table, the minimum tip material status key in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the number of enrolled students, the total number of reserve materials with material status key equal to 'U', the number of enrolled students, the offering department name, the term description, the academic year, the subject short title, and the maximum total units for each row and the next two rows in order of subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT l.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, l.TERM_CODE, l.SUBJECT_ID, t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t.ISBN, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MIN(t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) OVER (ORDER BY s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ), ReserveCounts AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(*) AS Total_Reserve_Materials FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL WHERE LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY SUBJECT_ID ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, MAX(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_CODE FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ) SELECT ic1.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, ic1.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, ic1.TERM_CODE, ic1.SUBJECT_ID, ic1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, ic1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ic1.ISBN, ic1.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic1.window_column, rc.Total_Reserve_Materials, ic2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ic2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic2.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, ic2.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte1 ic1 JOIN ReserveCounts rc ON ic1.SUBJECT_ID = rc.SUBJECT_ID JOIN inner_cte2 ic2 ON ic1.SUBJECT_ID = ic2.SUBJECT_ID AND ic1.TERM_CODE = ic2.TERM_CODE ORDER BY ic1.SUBJECT_ID, ic1.TERM_CODE;

question: For each department name and course level where the course is degree granting and the total units are greater than 6, and for each subject code in that degree-granting department, provide the department name, course level, number of unique courses, minimum total units offered, average total units for that department and course level, subject code, number of subject codes, minimum department budget code, and the full department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.COURSE_LEVEL, ic.course_count, ic.min_total_units, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.COURSE_LEVEL, ic.course_count, ic.min_total_units ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.subject_code_count, ic.min_dept_budget_code, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.COURSE_LEVEL, s1.course_count, s1.min_total_units, s1.avg_total_units, s2.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.subject_code_count, s2.min_dept_budget_code, s2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.COURSE_LEVEL, s2.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For each offering department in the School of Engineering where the course material status is 'RQ' and the department has more than 10 total tip materials offered for its subjects during regular terms, provide the department name, the school name, the number of unique subjects, the minimum total units for those subjects, the maximum number of enrolled students for those subjects, the total number of tip materials offered for its subjects, and the average number of tip materials per subject. List the columns in this order: department name, school name, number of unique subjects, minimum total units, maximum number of enrolled students, total tip materials, and average tip materials per subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units, MAX(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_num_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte ic JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL t JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) > 10 ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_tip_materials, AVG(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_tip_materials_per_subject FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON s.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_tip_materials ) SELECT s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s1.subject_count, s1.min_total_units, s1.max_num_enrolled_students, s2.total_tip_materials, s2.avg_tip_materials_per_subject FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ORDER BY s1.subject_count DESC, s2.total_tip_materials DESC;

question: For each department, show the department name, the highest running sum of academic years for academic term parameters where the term indicator is 'C', the course number, the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department in the School of Engineering during the term '2016SP', the average number of enrolled students in that department, and the deviation of each subject's enrolled students from this departmental average.
