List the results ordered by department name and course number. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_PARAMETER, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_INDICATOR = 'C' ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(window_column) AS highest_running_sum FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.COURSE_NUMBER, sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.COURSE_NUMBER, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, avg_dept.avg_enrolled_students, (i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS - avg_dept.avg_enrolled_students) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) avg_dept ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = avg_dept.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.COURSE_NUMBER ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.highest_running_sum, s2.COURSE_NUMBER, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.avg_enrolled_students, s2.deviation_from_avg FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.COURSE_NUMBER;

question: List, for each department name and course level where the department is degree granting, the number of unique students, the minimum CIP program code among their courses, the school name, and the department's full name, including subtotals for each department and a grand total across all departments, with department not repeated if it is the same as the previous row, sorted by department and course level. Also, for each school where at least two departments offer at least one course with more than 9 total units, list the school name, the number of such departments, and the maximum total units of any course in those departments. For each row, indicate whether it is a "Departmental Student Summary" or a "School Big Course Summary" in a reason column. The columns in order are: department, course level, student count, minimum CIP program code, school name, department full name, number of departments with big courses, maximum total units in school, and reason. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(dept) OVER (ORDER BY dept_sort, course_level_sort) = dept THEN NULL ELSE dept END AS department, course_level, student_count, min_cip_code, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS department_full_name FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(COURSE_LEVEL) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(COURSE_LEVEL) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(COURSE_LEVEL) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(COURSE_LEVEL) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE COURSE_LEVEL END AS course_level_sort, COURSE_LEVEL AS course_level, SUM(student_count) AS student_count, MIN(min_cip_code) AS min_cip_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_LEVEL WITH ROLLUP ) tbltmp LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tbltmp.dept = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dept_sort, course_level_sort ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ) SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS num_departments_with_big_courses, MAX(ic.max_total_units) AS max_total_units_in_school FROM inner_cte ic WHERE ic.max_total_units > 9 GROUP BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME) >= 2 ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT department, course_level, student_count, min_cip_code, school_name, department_full_name, NULL AS num_departments_with_big_courses, NULL AS max_total_units_in_school, 'Departmental Student Summary' AS reason FROM Subquery1 UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS department, NULL AS course_level, NULL AS student_count, NULL AS min_cip_code, SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, NULL AS department_full_name, num_departments_with_big_courses, max_total_units_in_school, 'School Big Course Summary' AS reason FROM Subquery2 ) SELECT department, course_level, student_count, min_cip_code, school_name, department_full_name, num_departments_with_big_courses, max_total_units_in_school, reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY COALESCE(department, ''), COALESCE(school_name, ''), COALESCE(course_level, '');

question: For each offering department and school where the course material status is 'RQ', and for each academic year and department (including grand totals across all departments for each academic year), provide the offering department name, offering school name, number of unique subjects, minimum total units for those subjects, average number of enrolled students for those subjects, academic year, academic year description, department name, average total units for subjects offered in regular terms, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for those subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_num_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte ic JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(avg_total_units) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(stddev_total_units) AS stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s1.subject_count, s1.min_total_units, s1.avg_num_enrolled_students, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.avg_total_units, s2.stddev_total_units FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: For subjects in the "Engineering" school with total units equal to 1, show the subject ID, subject title, department name, academic year, the rank of each subject within its academic year group ordered by subject ID, the term description, the term start date, and, for each subject's department, also include the department full name and the highest number of enrolled students in any subject offered by that department during the 2019FA term. List the columns in the following order: subject ID, subject title, department name, academic year, rank, term description, term start date, department full name, and highest enrollment. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH EngineeringSubjects AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t1.TERM_CODE FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 1 ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.window_column, t3.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t3.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t3 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t3.TERM_CODE ), DepartmentEnrollments AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS highest_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ) SELECT es.SUBJECT_ID, es.SUBJECT_TITLE, es.DEPARTMENT_NAME, es.ACADEMIC_YEAR, es.window_column, es.TERM_DESCRIPTION, es.TERM_START_DATE, de.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, de.highest_enrollment FROM EngineeringSubjects es LEFT JOIN DepartmentEnrollments de ON es.DEPARTMENT_NAME = de.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY es.ACADEMIC_YEAR, es.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each subject code where the department is degree granting, show the subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, the number of subject codes per school name, whether the subject code description is present ('Has Description') or missing ('No Description'), and for subjects offered in the term with code '2022SU' that match the subject code, also show the subject's ID, total units, and their dense rank considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the total number of units. For each school name, include a grand total for all subject codes in the format of (null, null, null, school name, null, total subject codes, null, null, null). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), SubjectCodeVisibility AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, CASE WHEN SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND SUBJECT_CODE_DESC <> 'nan' THEN 'Has Description' ELSE 'No Description' END AS description_status FROM inner_cte1 ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, description_status, COUNT(*) AS total_subject_codes FROM SubjectCodeVisibility GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, description_status WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ), SubjectCodeSummary AS ( SELECT scv.SUBJECT_CODE, scv.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.description_status, rr.total_subject_codes FROM RollupResults rr LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, description_status FROM SubjectCodeVisibility ) scv ON rr.SCHOOL_NAME = scv.SCHOOL_NAME AND rr.description_status = scv.description_status ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.SUBJECT_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2022SU' ), SubjectUnitsRank AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte2.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.window_column, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 ) SELECT scs.SUBJECT_CODE, scs.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scs.SCHOOL_NAME, scs.description_status, scs.total_subject_codes, sur.SUBJECT_ID, sur.TOTAL_UNITS, sur.window_column FROM SubjectCodeSummary scs LEFT JOIN SubjectUnitsRank sur ON scs.SUBJECT_CODE = sur.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY scs.SCHOOL_NAME, scs.description_status, sur.TOTAL_UNITS DESC

question: For each of the top 10 academic years by total unique course materials assigned for non-current terms where the course material status is 'RQ' and at least 50% of the unique materials have a non-null ISBN, list the academic year description, the total number of unique course materials assigned, the number of those materials that have a non-null ISBN, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of subjects offered per academic term in that year (considering only terms where at least one subject was offered), and classify the year as 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' if the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is at least 20% greater than the average standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all years, 'LOW_VARIABILITY' if at least 20% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Show the selected columns in this order: academic year description, total unique materials, materials with non-null ISBN, subject count range, subject count variance, subject count standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and variability category. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte_materials AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS unique_materials FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), isbn_counts AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS materials_with_isbn FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND TIP_DETAIL.ISBN IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), materials_summary AS ( SELECT inner_cte_materials.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte_materials.unique_materials, isbn_counts.materials_with_isbn FROM inner_cte_materials JOIN isbn_counts ON inner_cte_materials.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = isbn_counts.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC WHERE isbn_counts.materials_with_isbn >= 0.5 * inner_cte_materials.unique_materials ORDER BY inner_cte_materials.unique_materials DESC LIMIT 10 ), inner_cte_variability AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(term_subject_count) - MIN(term_subject_count) AS subject_count_range, VARIANCE(term_subject_count) AS subject_count_variance, STDDEV(term_subject_count) AS subject_count_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN ( SELECT tso.TERM_CODE, COUNT(*) AS term_subject_count FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso GROUP BY tso.TERM_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ) tsc ON at.TERM_CODE = tsc.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), variability_summary AS ( SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.subject_count_range, ic.subject_count_variance, ic.subject_count_stddev, CASE WHEN ic.subject_count_stddev > avg_stats.avg_stddev * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN ic.subject_count_stddev < avg_stats.avg_stddev * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte_variability ic CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(subject_count_stddev) AS avg_stddev FROM inner_cte_variability ) avg_stats ) SELECT m.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, m.unique_materials, m.materials_with_isbn, v.subject_count_range, v.subject_count_variance, v.subject_count_stddev, v.variability_category FROM materials_summary m JOIN variability_summary v ON m.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = v.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY m.unique_materials DESC;

question: For each subject category and academic year where the maximum enrollment is at least 10, provide the subject category key, academic year, the number of unique subjects offered, the minimum total units for those subjects, the average number of lecture units as a benchmark, and indicate whether the minimum total units is at least 10% greater than the average lecture units ('HIGH_UNIT'), at least 10% less ('LOW_UNIT'), or otherwise 'AVERAGE_UNIT'. Also, include the number of regular academic terms present in the ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL table for that academic year. List the results in order by subject category key and academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON a.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), SubjectCategoryUnits AS ( SELECT ic.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units, s.avg_lecture_units AS benchmark_lecture_units, CASE WHEN ic.min_total_units > s.avg_lecture_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN ic.min_total_units < s.avg_lecture_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE_UNIT' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte1 ic JOIN ( SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS avg_lecture_units FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON a.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) s ON ic.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY AND ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON at.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = ata.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ), AcademicYearTermCounts AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS total_terms FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ) SELECT scu.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, scu.ACADEMIC_YEAR, scu.subject_count, scu.min_total_units, scu.benchmark_lecture_units, scu.unit_category, aytc.total_terms FROM SubjectCategoryUnits scu JOIN AcademicYearTermCounts aytc ON scu.ACADEMIC_YEAR = aytc.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY scu.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, scu.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For all subjects in the 2014FA term with at least one enrolled student, where the offering department is in the School of Engineering in 2022, show the subject title, offering department name, responsible faculty name, the TIP material status key, the total number of units, the maximum total number of units in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows ordered by the course number, and the highest number of students enrolled in any subject in that department in 2022. List the results ordered by offering department name and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_dept_name FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TOTAL_UNITS, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_units_window, join_dept_name FROM inner_cte ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS engineering_subjects_2022 FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ss.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ss.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 ) SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ss.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ss.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s1.TOTAL_UNITS, s1.max_units_window, s2.max_enrollment FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each subject offered by the library in the term "2019SP", show the subject title, the number of enrolled students, the term description, the total units for the subject, the average total units within each subject group, the offering department name, the school name, and the highest variance of total units for subjects offered in any term for the corresponding department. Do not repeat the subject title if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by the number of enrolled students and department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ss.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY ss.SUBJECT_GROUP_ID ORDER BY lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_total_units, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_dept_name FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2019SP' ), SubjectStats AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(SUBJECT_TITLE) OVER (ORDER BY NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, OFFER_DEPT_NAME) = SUBJECT_TITLE THEN NULL ELSE SUBJECT_TITLE END AS subject_title, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, TERM_DESCRIPTION, TOTAL_UNITS, avg_total_units, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, join_dept_name FROM inner_cte ORDER BY NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON tso.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.TERM_CODE ), DeptVariance AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(total_units_variance) AS highest_total_units_variance FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY highest_total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT ss.subject_title, ss.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ss.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ss.TOTAL_UNITS, ss.avg_total_units, ss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ss.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, dv.highest_total_units_variance FROM SubjectStats ss JOIN DeptVariance dv ON ss.join_dept_name = dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ss.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: For organizations with a major organization key of 230 whose organization number is greater than the average organization number of their parent group, and for each space unit associated with those organizations that has more rooms than the average number of rooms per space unit, show the organization name, department name, department code, department long name, department level, the average organization number in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the organization parent, the space unit name, and the number of rooms in the space unit, ordered by organization name and space unit name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH org_windowed AS ( SELECT t2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, t2.ORG_PARENT, t2.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER, AVG(t2.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) OVER ( PARTITION BY t2.ORG_PARENT ORDER BY t2.ORGANIZATION_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t2.FCLT_MAJOR_ORG_KEY = 230 ), org_filtered AS ( SELECT i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, i.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, i.window_column, i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM org_windowed i JOIN ( SELECT ORG_PARENT, AVG(ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS avg_org_num FROM org_windowed GROUP BY ORG_PARENT ) a ON i.ORG_PARENT = a.ORG_PARENT WHERE i.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER > a.avg_org_num ), space_unit_room_counts AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(sd.BUILDING_ROOM) AS room_count, su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ), space_unit_filtered AS ( SELECT i.SPACE_UNIT, i.room_count, i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM space_unit_room_counts i JOIN ( SELECT AVG(room_count) AS avg_room_count FROM ( SELECT COUNT(sd.BUILDING_ROOM) AS room_count FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT ) sub ) a ON 1=1 WHERE i.room_count > a.avg_room_count ) SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, o.window_column, s.SPACE_UNIT, s.room_count FROM org_filtered o JOIN space_unit_filtered s ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = s.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s.SPACE_UNIT;

question: For each department in the School of Engineering where the total number of tip materials offered for subjects during regular terms is greater than 10, list the department name, the total number of tip materials, the average number of units for those subjects, and for each degree granting course in that department, show the course description, subject title, the subject's grade type description, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL t JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) > 10 ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_tip_materials, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_tip_materials ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.GRADE_TYPE_DESC, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE = t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.total_tip_materials, s1.avg_units, s2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.GRADE_TYPE_DESC, s2.window_column FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For rooms with a room number of '21E' and for rooms with an access level of 1 in the same space unit code, show the building room, room square footage, building component, space usage, the minimum room square footage in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by building key, the warehouse load date from both the SPACE_DETAIL and SPACE_USAGE tables, the floor, space unit code, space unit name, the average floor within each space unit code group, and the total number of rooms per space unit code. List the results ordered by building room and floor. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Room21E AS ( SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, t0.BUILDING_COMPONENT, t1.SPACE_USAGE, MIN(t0.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) OVER (ORDER BY t0.BUILDING_KEY ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE AS space_detail_load_date, t1.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE AS space_usage_load_date, t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY FROM SPACE_DETAIL t0 JOIN SPACE_USAGE t1 ON t0.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = t1.SPACE_USAGE_KEY WHERE t0.ROOM_NUMBER = '21E' ), AccessLevel1Rooms AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.SPACE_UNIT, AVG(t1.FLOOR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ORDER BY t1.FLOOR) AS avg_floor FROM SPACE_UNIT t0 JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t1 ON t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 ), RoomCounts AS ( SELECT t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS Total_Rooms FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t1 WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 GROUP BY t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ) SELECT r21.BUILDING_ROOM, r21.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, r21.BUILDING_COMPONENT, r21.SPACE_USAGE, r21.window_column, r21.space_detail_load_date, r21.space_usage_load_date, al1.FLOOR, al1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, al1.SPACE_UNIT, al1.avg_floor, rc.Total_Rooms FROM Room21E r21 JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON r21.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY JOIN AccessLevel1Rooms al1 ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = al1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE JOIN RoomCounts rc ON al1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = rc.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ORDER BY r21.BUILDING_ROOM, al1.FLOOR;

question: For each administrative department in the School of Engineering, provide the administrative department name, the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering, the average number of enrolled students per administrative department as a benchmark, the enrollment category (categorized as 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' if its total is at least 10% greater than the average, 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' if its total is at least 10% less than the average, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise), the total number of tip materials offered for subjects during regular terms (where the total is greater than 10), and the average number of units for those subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100 ), benchmark_cte1 AS ( SELECT AVG(total_enrolled) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte1 ), cte1_final AS ( SELECT i.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_enrolled, b.avg_enrollment, CASE WHEN i.total_enrolled > b.avg_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.total_enrolled < b.avg_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte1 i CROSS JOIN benchmark_cte1 b ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL t JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) > 10 ), cte2_final AS ( SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_tip_materials, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM inner_cte2 i JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_tip_materials ) SELECT c1.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, c1.total_enrolled, c1.avg_enrollment, c1.enrollment_category, c2.total_tip_materials, c2.avg_units FROM cte1_final c1 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON c1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN cte2_final c2 ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c2.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each department where the variance of the number of enrolled students in courses (that have at least one enrolled student and have course materials with a material status of 'RQ') is greater than the overall average variance across all departments, show the department name, the subject code, subject number, subject title, term code, term description, the highest minimum total units (in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by academic year) for subjects offered in the academic year 2024, and the variance of enrolled students, ordered by department name and highest minimum total units descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(t0.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, MAX(window_column) AS highest_min_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, enrolled_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE enrolled_variance > (SELECT AVG(enrolled_variance) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.highest_min_total_units, s2.enrolled_variance FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.highest_min_total_units DESC

question: For each degree granting department and each subject it offers in the term with code '2025FA', provide the department name, the average and variance of the ASCII values of its subject codes' course numbers, the total number of subject codes for the department, the subject ID, subject title, offering department name, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, term start date, term end date, term parameter, and whether the number of enrolled students is 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% greater than the average for that department), 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% less than the average for that department), or 'AVERAGE', ordered by department name and subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VARIANCE(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_course_number_ascii, i.var_course_number_ascii, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS total_subject_codes FROM inner_cte i JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_course_number_ascii, i.var_course_number_ascii ORDER BY i.var_course_number_ascii DESC ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE TERM_CODE = '2025FA' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.TERM_START_DATE, i.TERM_END_DATE, i.TERM_PARAMETER, CASE WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > d.avg_enrolled * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < d.avg_enrolled * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.avg_course_number_ascii, s1.var_course_number_ascii, s1.total_subject_codes, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.TERM_START_DATE, s2.TERM_END_DATE, s2.TERM_PARAMETER, s2.enrollment_category FROM subq1 s1 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN subq2 s2 ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each department that both offers subjects with at least one reserved material (where the material status is 'U') and is a degree-granting department with above-average subject enrollment, list the department name, the subject title, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of reserved materials per subject (including a grand total for all subjects in the department as a row with null subject title), followed by the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in offered subjects (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and only departments where the average enrollment is greater than the overall average enrollment across all such subjects). The columns should appear in the following order: department name, subject title, reserved material range, reserved material variance, reserved material standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), average enrollment, enrollment variance, and enrollment standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED s JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL d ON s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE ), DepartmentReservedMaterialStats AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(material_count) - MIN(material_count) AS reserved_material_range, VARIANCE(material_count) AS reserved_material_variance, STDDEV(material_count) AS reserved_material_stddev FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(material_count) > 0 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DegreeDeptEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_enrollment, enrollment_variance, enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte2 WHERE avg_enrollment > ( SELECT AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) ) SELECT drms.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, drms.SUBJECT_TITLE, drms.reserved_material_range, drms.reserved_material_variance, drms.reserved_material_stddev, ddes.avg_enrollment, ddes.enrollment_variance, ddes.enrollment_stddev FROM DepartmentReservedMaterialStats drms JOIN DegreeDeptEnrollmentStats ddes ON drms.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = ddes.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY drms.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, drms.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For the top 5 current academic terms with the highest total subject enrollment, show each term's code, description, academic year, the number of subjects offered, the total subject enrollment, the department with the most subjects offered in that term along with the count of those subjects, and for that department, the maximum average total units for subjects that had library reserve materials in any single term with a term status of 'Previous'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH TopTerms AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT ic.TERM_CODE, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.subject_count, ic.total_enrollment, d.DEPT_NAME AS most_subjects_department, d.subjects_in_dept FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ss.TERM_CODE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPT_NAME, COUNT(ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subjects_in_dept, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ss.TERM_CODE ORDER BY COUNT(ss.SUBJECT_ID) DESC) AS dept_rank FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss GROUP BY ss.TERM_CODE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) d ON ic.TERM_CODE = d.TERM_CODE AND d.dept_rank = 1 ORDER BY ic.total_enrollment DESC LIMIT 5 ), DeptMaxAvgUnits AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.TERM_CODE, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.TERM_CODE ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(avg_total_units) AS max_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY max_avg_total_units DESC ) SELECT tt.TERM_CODE, tt.TERM_DESCRIPTION, tt.ACADEMIC_YEAR, tt.subject_count, tt.total_enrollment, tt.most_subjects_department, tt.subjects_in_dept, dmu.max_avg_total_units FROM TopTerms tt LEFT JOIN DeptMaxAvgUnits dmu ON tt.most_subjects_department = dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY tt.total_enrollment DESC, dmu.max_avg_total_units DESC;

question: For each degree-granting department and course level where the number of unique degree-granting courses with total units greater than 6 is more than 2 and the average ASCII value of the course numbers for a subject code in that department is greater than 50, list the department name, department code, course level, number of unique degree-granting courses with total units greater than 6, the minimum total units for those courses, the subject code, the subject code description, the average ASCII value of the course numbers for that subject code, and the variance of the ASCII values of the course numbers for that subject code. The results should be ordered by department name, course level, and descending variance of the ASCII values of the course numbers. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL ), subq1 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte1.COURSE_LEVEL, inner_cte1.course_count, inner_cte1.min_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN inner_cte1 ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s.COURSE_NUMBER FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), subq2 AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, AVG(ASCII(inner_cte2.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VARIANCE(ASCII(inner_cte2.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC ) SELECT subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, subq1.COURSE_LEVEL, subq1.course_count, subq1.min_total_units, subq2.SUBJECT_CODE, subq2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, subq2.avg_course_number_ascii, subq2.var_course_number_ascii FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE subq1.course_count > 2 AND subq2.avg_course_number_ascii > 50 ORDER BY subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.COURSE_LEVEL, subq2.var_course_number_ascii DESC;

question: For each previous academic term and each day of the week, show the term code, day of week, the number of calendar dates that fall on that day of week for the term's start date, the average calendar year for those dates, the term start date, the library subject enrollment visibility ('High Enrollment' if the number of enrolled students in the library subject is greater than 20, and 'Low Enrollment' otherwise), and the total number of students enrolled in all corresponding library subjects for academic terms in 2014. Include subtotals for each term (the corresponding term field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all terms (the corresponding term field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the term if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by term start date, day of week, and enrollment visibility. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t1.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t0.CALENDAR_DATE, t0.DAY_OF_WEEK, AVG(t0.CALENDAR_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.CALENDAR_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_START_DATE) AS window_column FROM TIME_DAY t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.CALENDAR_DATE = t1.TERM_START_DATE WHERE t1.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ), term_day_stats AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(term) OVER (ORDER BY term_sort, day_sort) = term THEN NULL ELSE term END AS term, day_of_week, date_count, avg_calendar_year, term_start_date, term_sort FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DAY_OF_WEEK) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DAY_OF_WEEK) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DAY_OF_WEEK) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DAY_OF_WEEK) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DAY_OF_WEEK END AS day_sort, DAY_OF_WEEK AS day_of_week, COUNT(DISTINCT CALENDAR_DATE) AS date_count, AVG(window_column) AS avg_calendar_year, MIN(TERM_START_DATE) AS term_start_date FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY TERM_CODE, DAY_OF_WEEK WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY term_sort, day_sort ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT a.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(DISTINCT t.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_tip_subjects, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_library_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON t.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE WHERE a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2014 AND l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY a.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION ), LibraryEnrollmentVisibility AS ( SELECT a.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(DISTINCT t.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_tip_subjects, CASE WHEN l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 20 THEN 'High Enrollment' ELSE 'Low Enrollment' END AS enrollment_visibility, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_students FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON t.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE WHERE a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2014 AND l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY a.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, CASE WHEN l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 20 THEN 'High Enrollment' ELSE 'Low Enrollment' END ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, enrollment_visibility, SUM(total_students) AS total_students FROM LibraryEnrollmentVisibility GROUP BY TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, enrollment_visibility WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(total_students) > 0 ), term_enrollment_stats AS ( SELECT rr.TERM_CODE, rr.TERM_DESCRIPTION, rr.enrollment_visibility, rr.total_students FROM RollupResults rr ORDER BY rr.TERM_CODE, rr.enrollment_visibility ) SELECT tds.term, tds.day_of_week, tds.date_count, tds.avg_calendar_year, tds.term_start_date, tes.enrollment_visibility, tes.total_students FROM term_day_stats tds LEFT JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON tds.term = at.TERM_CODE LEFT JOIN term_enrollment_stats tes ON tds.term = tes.TERM_CODE ORDER BY tds.term_sort, tds.day_of_week, tes.enrollment_visibility

question: For each grade type and department in the School of Engineering, list the grade type, department name, the number of subjects with at least 6 units, the average total units for those subjects, the school name, and the department full name, along with, for each academic year in that department, the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in each subject offered in the fall term with more than 0 enrolled students, the department phone number, and the school name. Include subtotals for each grade type (the corresponding grade type field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all grade types (the corresponding grade type field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the grade type if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by grade type, department name, and academic year. The columns returned are: grade type, department name, number of subjects with at least 6 units, average total units, school name (from the first subquery), department full name, academic year, average enrollment, enrollment variance, department phone number, and school name (from the second subquery). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.GRADE_TYPE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(grade_type) OVER (ORDER BY grade_type_sort, grade_type, dept_sort) = grade_type THEN NULL ELSE grade_type END AS grade_type, dept, subj_count, avg_units, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS department_full_name, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(GRADE_TYPE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE GRADE_TYPE END AS grade_type_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(GRADE_TYPE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(GRADE_TYPE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE GRADE_TYPE END AS grade_type, CASE WHEN GROUPING(GRADE_TYPE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, DEPARTMENT_NAME AS dept, COUNT(*) AS subj_count, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY GRADE_TYPE, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP ) tbltmp LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tbltmp.dept = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY grade_type_sort, dept_sort ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT s1.grade_type, s1.dept, s1.subj_count, s1.avg_units, s1.school_name AS s1_school_name, s1.department_full_name, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.avg_enrollment, s2.enrollment_variance, s2.department_phone, s2.school_name AS s2_school_name FROM subq1 s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.grade_type, s1.dept, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR

question: List the full names and email addresses of students in the MIT student directory who are in departments belonging to the School of Engineering and whose department name contains the word "Engineering", along with the department name, the minimum number of enrolled students in any subject offered by that department, and the total number of course material records for subjects with required course materials in that department. Present the results ordered by department name and student full name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH engineering_students AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS engineering_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE '%Engineering%' ) SELECT msd.FULL_NAME, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE '%Engineering%' ), dept_materials AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, td.RECORD_COUNT FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_CODE, MIN(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students, SUM(RECORD_COUNT) AS total_material_records FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_CODE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(RECORD_COUNT) > 0 ORDER BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT es.FULL_NAME, es.EMAIL_ADDRESS, dm.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dm.min_enrolled_students, dm.total_material_records FROM engineering_students es JOIN dept_materials dm ON es.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dm.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE dm.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IS NOT NULL ORDER BY dm.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, es.FULL_NAME;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year, the academic year description, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the record counts of TIP materials associated with that academic year (considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the TIP material status key is not 'NM'), whether the variance is above or below the average variance across all academic years, and the highest total units of any subject offered in each academic year for terms that are regular terms? List the results in order of decreasing variance. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH record_count_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance, inner_cte.record_count_stddev, CASE WHEN inner_cte.record_count_variance > (SELECT AVG(record_count_variance) FROM inner_cte) THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN inner_cte.record_count_variance < (SELECT AVG(record_count_variance) FROM inner_cte) THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.record_count_variance DESC ), highest_units AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS highest_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY highest_total_units DESC ) SELECT rcs.ACADEMIC_YEAR, rcs.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, rcs.record_count_variance, rcs.record_count_stddev, rcs.variance_category, hu.highest_total_units FROM record_count_stats rcs JOIN highest_units hu ON rcs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = hu.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND rcs.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = hu.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY rcs.record_count_variance DESC;

question: For each space unit with a space unit code equal to 97500, show the space unit name, the associated organization's name, the DLC name, the DLC key from the organization, and the minimum space unit code in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the facility organization key, as well as a grand total for all space units for each DLC key in the format of (null, null, DLC name, DLC key, total minimum space unit code). Additionally, for each matching DLC key, show each organization and its associated space unit where the organization is assignable and the space unit code is greater than 50000, along with the number of space units, the minimum organization number, and the DLC name for each organization. Present the results in the following order: space unit name, organization name, DLC name, DLC key, total minimum space unit code, organization, space unit, space unit count, minimum organization number, and DLC name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t2.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS organization_name, t1.DLC_NAME AS dlc_name, t1.DLC_KEY AS org_dlc_key, MIN(t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) OVER ( ORDER BY t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_min_space_unit_code, t2.DLC_KEY AS space_unit_dlc_key FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 97500 ), RollupResults1 AS ( SELECT dlc_name, org_dlc_key, SUM(window_min_space_unit_code) AS total_min_space_unit_code FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY dlc_name, org_dlc_key WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(window_min_space_unit_code) > 0 ), cte1_final AS ( SELECT ic.space_unit_name, ic.organization_name, rr.dlc_name, rr.org_dlc_key, rr.total_min_space_unit_code, ic.space_unit_dlc_key FROM RollupResults1 rr LEFT JOIN inner_cte1 ic ON rr.dlc_name = ic.dlc_name AND rr.org_dlc_key = ic.org_dlc_key ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION, s.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS space_unit_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_org_number, o.DLC_KEY AS org_dlc_key FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION o JOIN SPACE_UNIT s ON o.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE > 50000 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION, s.SPACE_UNIT, o.DLC_KEY ), cte2_final AS ( SELECT i.ORGANIZATION, i.SPACE_UNIT, i.space_unit_count, i.min_org_number, o.DLC_NAME, i.org_dlc_key FROM inner_cte2 i JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON i.ORGANIZATION = o.ORGANIZATION ) SELECT c1.space_unit_name, c1.organization_name, c1.dlc_name, c1.org_dlc_key, c1.total_min_space_unit_code, c2.ORGANIZATION, c2.SPACE_UNIT, c2.space_unit_count, c2.min_org_number, c2.DLC_NAME FROM cte1_final c1 JOIN cte2_final c2 ON c1.org_dlc_key = c2.org_dlc_key ORDER BY c1.dlc_name, c1.org_dlc_key, c2.ORGANIZATION, c2.SPACE_UNIT

question: For each academic year description, library material status, and TIP material status (including a grand total across all TIP material statuses with null for TIP material status), what is the geometric mean of the record counts of TIP materials for each TIP material status (considering only records where the record count is greater than zero), along with the academic year, the maximum variance, and the minimum variance of record counts of TIP materials associated with that academic year (considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the TIP material status key is not 'NM')? List the academic year description, library material status, TIP material status, geometric mean record count, academic year, maximum record count variance, and minimum record count variance, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH GeometricMeanRecordCounts AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, EXP(AVG(LN(td.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON at.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE WHERE td.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, EXP(AVG(LN(geometric_mean_record_count))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY WITH ROLLUP HAVING EXP(AVG(LN(geometric_mean_record_count))) IS NOT NULL ), VarianceStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(record_count_variance) AS max_record_count_variance, MIN(record_count_variance) AS min_record_count_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gmr.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, gmr.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, gmr.geometric_mean_record_count, vs.ACADEMIC_YEAR, vs.max_record_count_variance, vs.min_record_count_variance FROM GeometricMeanRecordCounts gmr LEFT JOIN VarianceStats vs ON gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = vs.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gmr.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, gmr.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY;

question: For each academic year and each department, provide the academic year, academic year description, department name, coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for all library reserve materials offered in terms with a material status of 'U', and for each subject offered by that department in the School of Engineering during the term '2016SP', provide the course number, the number of enrolled students, the average number of enrolled students in that department, and the deviation of each subject's enrolled students from this departmental average. List the results ordered by academic year, department name, and course number. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH cte1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), cte2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.COURSE_NUMBER, sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.COURSE_NUMBER, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, avg_dept.avg_enrolled_students, (i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS - avg_dept.avg_enrolled_students) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) avg_dept ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = avg_dept.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.COURSE_NUMBER ) SELECT cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1.coefficient_of_variation, cte2.COURSE_NUMBER, cte2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, cte2.avg_enrolled_students, cte2.deviation_from_avg FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte2.COURSE_NUMBER;

question: For each subject where the school code and subject title are not null and the subject code description contains the word 'Engineering' (case insensitive), show the subject code, subject code description, department name, subject title, and the dense rank of each row partitioned by the school code and ordered by school code, along with the school name, the variance of the total number of units for subjects offered by that department, the subject ID, the total units for that subject, and the deviation of each subject's total units from the department's average, considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and that are degree granting. The results are ordered by department name, subject code, and subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t0.SCHOOL_CODE) AS window_column, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_CODE IS NOT NULL AND t1.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte WHERE UPPER(inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC) LIKE '%ENGINEERING%' ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ssc.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.total_units_variance, sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, (sos.TOTAL_UNITS - AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE)) AS deviation_from_dept_avg FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN inner_cte ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ORDER BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sos.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT subq1.SUBJECT_CODE, subq1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq1.window_column, subq2.SCHOOL_NAME, subq2.total_units_variance, subq2.SUBJECT_ID, subq2.TOTAL_UNITS, subq2.deviation_from_dept_avg FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.SUBJECT_CODE, subq2.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each offering department in the School of Engineering where the course material status is 'RQ' and the department's total subject enrollment in any 2022 academic term is greater than the average for all Engineering departments in 2022, provide the department name, school name, number of unique subjects with 'RQ' status, minimum total units for those subjects, maximum number of enrolled students for those subjects, the 2022 term code, term description, term start date, the number of subjects offered by the department in that term, and the total subject enrollment number for that term. List the results in descending order of total subject enrollment. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ), cte1 AS ( SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units, MAX(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_num_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte1 ic JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT a.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, a.TERM_START_DATE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY a.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, a.TERM_START_DATE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), cte2 AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, TERM_START_DATE, subject_count, total_enrollment FROM inner_cte2 WHERE total_enrollment > (SELECT AVG(total_enrollment) FROM inner_cte2) ) SELECT cte1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cte1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, cte1.subject_count, cte1.min_total_units, cte1.max_num_enrolled_students, cte2.TERM_CODE, cte2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cte2.TERM_START_DATE, cte2.subject_count AS dept_subject_count_2022, cte2.total_enrollment FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND cte1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ORDER BY cte2.total_enrollment DESC;

question: For each offering department name and course number description where the number of enrolled students in the library subject offered is greater than 3, show the number of distinct ISBNs in TIP_DETAIL, the minimum responsible faculty MIT ID from TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED, the total number of TIP_DETAIL records per offering department name and course number description, the total number of unique students enrolled in degree-granting courses in that department (among the top 10 departments with the highest number of unique students), the minimum CIP program code among their courses, and the most common course level in that department along with the count of students enrolled at that level. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT t.ISBN) AS isbn_count, MIN(ts.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID) AS min_faculty_mit_id FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ts ON t.SUBJECT_ID = ts.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC ), subq1 AS ( SELECT inner_cte1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, inner_cte1.isbn_count, inner_cte1.min_faculty_mit_id, dept_counts.total_tip_detail_records FROM inner_cte1 JOIN ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, COUNT(t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_tip_detail_records FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC ) AS dept_counts ON inner_cte1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_counts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND inner_cte1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC = dept_counts.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL ), subq2 AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(ic.student_count) AS total_unique_students, MIN(ic.min_cip_code) AS min_cip_code, cc.Most_Common_Course_Level, cc.Level_Student_Count FROM ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(student_count) AS total_students FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_students DESC LIMIT 10 ) top_depts JOIN inner_cte2 ic ON top_depts.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ic2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic2.COURSE_LEVEL AS Most_Common_Course_Level, ic2.student_count AS Level_Student_Count FROM ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_LEVEL, student_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY student_count DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte2 ) ic2 WHERE ic2.rn = 1 ) cc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cc.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cc.Most_Common_Course_Level, cc.Level_Student_Count ORDER BY total_unique_students DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT subq1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, subq1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, subq1.isbn_count, subq1.min_faculty_mit_id, subq1.total_tip_detail_records, subq2.total_unique_students, subq2.min_cip_code, subq2.Most_Common_Course_Level, subq2.Level_Student_Count FROM subq1 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON subq1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN subq2 ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department where the average total units for subjects offered is greater than the overall average total units across all subjects, and for each course number description in that department where the number of enrolled students in the library subject offered is greater than 3, provide the department name, the average total units, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, the course number description, the number of distinct ISBNs in TIP_DETAIL, the minimum responsible faculty MIT ID from TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED, and the total number of TIP_DETAIL records per offering department name and course number description, ordered by the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT t.ISBN) AS isbn_count, MIN(ts.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID) AS min_faculty_mit_id FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ts ON t.SUBJECT_ID = ts.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC ), dept_counts AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, COUNT(t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_tip_detail_records FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC ) SELECT ic1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic1.avg_total_units, ic1.stddev_total_units, ic2.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, ic2.isbn_count, ic2.min_faculty_mit_id, dc.total_tip_detail_records FROM inner_cte1 ic1 JOIN inner_cte2 ic2 ON ic1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN dept_counts dc ON ic2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND ic2.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC = dc.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC WHERE ic1.avg_total_units > ( SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY WHERE TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) ORDER BY ic1.stddev_total_units DESC;

question: For courses in the SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION table with a department code of 6, show the course, course description, department name, school name, program code, program title, category code, category title, four digit code, four digit title, and the minimum warehouse load date from the CIP table over each category code group (only including those courses where the minimum warehouse load date for the category code is after '01-JAN-20'), and for each such course, also show the highest number of lecture units among subjects offered by the same department in the Fall term of 2022, the start date of that term, and the total number of subjects offered by that department in that term (considering only departments where the highest number of lecture units among their subjects is greater than 3). Order the results by category code and course. Do not return any rounded answers.
