SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.PROGRAM_CODE, c.PROGRAM_TITLE, c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY c.CATEGORY_CODE) AS min_warehouse_load_date FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION s JOIN CIP c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT = 6 ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte WHERE min_warehouse_load_date > '01-JAN-20' ORDER BY CATEGORY_CODE ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, at2.TERM_START_DATE FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 ON td.TERM_CODE = at2.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at2.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) > 3 ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.max_lecture_units, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, COUNT(ccs2.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs2 ON ccs2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ccs2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.max_lecture_units, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE ) SELECT subq1.COURSE, subq1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.SCHOOL_NAME, subq1.PROGRAM_CODE, subq1.PROGRAM_TITLE, subq1.CATEGORY_CODE, subq1.CATEGORY_TITLE, subq1.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, subq1.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, subq1.min_warehouse_load_date, subq2.max_lecture_units, subq2.TERM_START_DATE, subq2.num_subjects_offered FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subq1.CATEGORY_CODE, subq1.COURSE;

question: For IAP subject activities with a maximum enrollment of 30, show the activity title, the academic year, the total number of such activities per academic year, the academic year description, and both the maximum and minimum of the variance of record counts of TIP materials associated with that academic year, considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the TIP material status key is not 'NM'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH IAP_Activities AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 30 ) SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, Activity_Count.Total_Activities FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE JOIN ( SELECT t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS Total_Activities FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 30 GROUP BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) AS Activity_Count ON t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = Activity_Count.ACADEMIC_YEAR WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 30 ), TIP_Variance AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(record_count_variance) AS max_record_count_variance, MIN(record_count_variance) AS min_record_count_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY max_record_count_variance DESC ) SELECT ia.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ia.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ia.Total_Activities, tv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, tv.max_record_count_variance, tv.min_record_count_variance FROM IAP_Activities ia JOIN TIP_Variance tv ON ia.ACADEMIC_YEAR = tv.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering with a total of at least 6 units, show the subject code, subject title, department name, and the running sum of total units within each grade type (only including those subjects where the running sum exceeds 12 units within their grade type), along with the highest number of lecture units among subjects offered by that department in the Fall term of 2022, the start date of that term, and the total number of subjects offered by that department in that term (considering only departments where the highest number of lecture units among their subjects is greater than 3). Order the results by subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ), subq1 AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column FROM inner_cte1 WHERE window_column > 12 ORDER BY SUBJECT_CODE ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, at2.TERM_START_DATE FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 ON td.TERM_CODE = at2.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at2.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) > 3 ), subq2 AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.max_lecture_units, inner_cte2.TERM_START_DATE, COUNT(ccs2.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte2 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs2 ON ccs2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ccs2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.max_lecture_units, inner_cte2.TERM_START_DATE ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.max_lecture_units, s2.TERM_START_DATE, s2.num_subjects_offered FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2012, show the subject key, subject title, offer department name, academic year, term description, row number within each offer department name group ordered by subject key, total number of subjects offered in 2012 for the department, average enrollment for the department, subject enrollment number, and the popularity category of the subject. Additionally, for each subject, show the academic year description, the total number of TIP materials for that academic year (considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the TIP material status key is not 'NM'), and the difference between this total and the average number of TIP materials across all academic years. Present the results ordered by offer department name and row number within the department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte_subjects AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_KEY) AS window_column, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS total_subjects, AVG(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_enrollment FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), subjects_2012 AS ( SELECT i.SUBJECT_KEY, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.window_column, d.total_subjects, d.avg_enrollment, i.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, CASE WHEN i.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > d.avg_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'POPULAR' WHEN i.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER < d.avg_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'UNPOPULAR' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS popularity_category, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte_subjects i JOIN dept_stats d ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), inner_cte_tip AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_tip_materials FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), tip_materials_stats AS ( SELECT inner_cte_tip.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte_tip.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte_tip.total_tip_materials, (inner_cte_tip.total_tip_materials - (SELECT AVG(total_tip_materials) FROM inner_cte_tip)) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte_tip ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_KEY, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.window_column, s.total_subjects, s.avg_enrollment, s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, s.popularity_category, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t.total_tip_materials, t.deviation_from_avg FROM subjects_2012 s JOIN tip_materials_stats t ON s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.window_column;

question: For each department, show the offer department name, the number of distinct subjects offered by the department in the academic year 2012, and for each subject that was offered in the term "2012SU", display the subject key, subject title, academic year, term description, subject enrollment number, subject offered summary key, the average subject enrollment number within each subject key group, and the deviation of each subject's enrollment number from the average enrollment number for its subject key group, ordered by offer department name and subject key. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 ) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dept_counts.num_subjects, ic.SUBJECT_KEY, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_KEY) AS num_subjects FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) dept_counts ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_counts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.SUBJECT_KEY, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY, AVG(t0.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SUBJECT_KEY ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_KEY, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, inner_cte.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY, inner_cte.window_column AS avg_enrollment_number, (inner_cte.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER - inner_cte.window_column) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte ) SELECT s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.num_subjects, s1.SUBJECT_KEY, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, s2.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY, s2.avg_enrollment_number, s2.deviation_from_avg FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_KEY = s2.SUBJECT_KEY AND s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND s1.SUBJECT_TITLE = s2.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_KEY

question: For each academic year and department where the average total units for subjects offered in regular terms is greater than the overall average for all such groups, give the academic year, department name, the average total units and variance of total units for subjects offered in regular terms, as well as the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for subjects with more than 0 total units and at least 1 enrolled student in that department, and classify the department as 'HIGH_VARIANCE' if its standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is at least 20% greater than the average, 'LOW_VARIANCE' if its standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is at least 20% less than the average, or 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' otherwise. List the results ordered by the variance of total units in regular terms in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH cte1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_total_units, i.var_total_units FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT AVG(avg_total_units) AS overall_avg FROM ( SELECT AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) sub ) o ON i.avg_total_units > o.overall_avg ), cte2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units, CASE WHEN inner_cte.stddev_total_units > inner_cte.avg_total_units * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN inner_cte.stddev_total_units < inner_cte.avg_total_units * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte ) SELECT c1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c1.avg_total_units, c1.var_total_units, c2.avg_total_units AS avg_total_units_by_subjects_with_enrollment, c2.stddev_total_units, c2.variance_category FROM cte1 c1 JOIN cte2 c2 ON c1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY c1.var_total_units DESC;

question: For each subject in the Engineering school with total units equal to 1, show the department name, subject ID, subject title, academic year, the rank of the subject within its academic year group ordered by subject ID, the total number of subjects per department, the academic year description, and the maximum average subject enrollment number for subjects offered in terms that are not the current term and have more than 0 total units, matching on academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH max_avg_enrollment AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON atp.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(avg_enrollment) AS max_avg_subject_enrollment FROM ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) subq GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY max_avg_subject_enrollment DESC ), eng_subjects AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 1 ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.window_column, dept_counts.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS Total_Subjects FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY WHERE SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND TOTAL_UNITS = 1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS dept_counts ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT eng_subjects.DEPARTMENT_NAME, eng_subjects.SUBJECT_ID, eng_subjects.SUBJECT_TITLE, eng_subjects.ACADEMIC_YEAR, eng_subjects.window_column, eng_subjects.Total_Subjects, max_avg_enrollment.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, max_avg_enrollment.max_avg_subject_enrollment FROM eng_subjects LEFT JOIN max_avg_enrollment ON eng_subjects.ACADEMIC_YEAR = max_avg_enrollment.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY eng_subjects.ACADEMIC_YEAR, eng_subjects.DEPARTMENT_NAME, eng_subjects.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each academic year and department, show the academic year, department name, department full name, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by each department (considering only subjects that require advance sign-up and are not cancelled), and the highest number of enrolled students in any subject offered by that department during the 2019FA term. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH enrollment_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON isd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON at.TERM_CODE = tso.TERM_CODE WHERE isd.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), dept_max_enrollment AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS highest_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ) SELECT es.ACADEMIC_YEAR, es.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dme.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, es.avg_enrollment, es.enrollment_variance, es.enrollment_stddev, dme.highest_enrollment FROM enrollment_stats es JOIN dept_max_enrollment dme ON es.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dme.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY es.ACADEMIC_YEAR, es.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: For each academic year and department in the School of Engineering, provide the academic year, academic year description, department name, the minimum number of enrolled students in any subject in that department, the total number of material records for subjects in that department with a material status of 'RQ', the variance of the number of enrolled students in library subjects for that department and year, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in library subjects for that department and year, considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the number of enrolled students in the library subject is greater than 0. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptMaterialStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled, SUM(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_material_records FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(min_enrolled) AS min_enrolled, SUM(total_material_records) AS total_material_records FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME WITH ROLLUP ), YearDeptEnrolledStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ) SELECT ydes.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ydes.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ydes.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dms.min_enrolled, dms.total_material_records, ydes.enrolled_students_variance, ydes.enrolled_students_stddev FROM YearDeptEnrolledStats ydes LEFT JOIN DeptMaterialStats dms ON ydes.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dms.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY ydes.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ydes.OFFER_DEPT_NAME

question: For subjects in the "Engineering" school with total units equal to 1, show the subject ID, subject title, department name, academic year, the rank of each subject within its academic year group ordered by subject ID, the term description, and the term start date, and for each such subject also show, for subjects offered in the same term that are in the library and have a number of enrolled students greater than the average for all library subjects in '2014FA', the library subject title, the number of enrolled students in the library subject, the responsible faculty name from the TIP subject, the offer department name from the TIP subject, and the minimum number of enrolled students in the library subject within a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the TIP subject's responsible faculty MIT ID. Results are ordered by academic year, subject ID, and descending number of enrolled students in the library subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t1.TERM_CODE FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 1 ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.window_column, t3.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t3.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t3 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t3.TERM_CODE ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( ORDER BY t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, l.TERM_CODE FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' ) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, window_column, TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte WHERE NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > ( SELECT AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE TERM_CODE = '2014FA' ) ) SELECT subq1.SUBJECT_ID, subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, subq1.window_column AS subject_rank_within_year, subq1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, subq1.TERM_START_DATE, subq2.SUBJECT_TITLE AS library_subject_title, subq2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, subq2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, subq2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, subq2.window_column AS min_enrolled_students_window FROM subq1 INNER JOIN subq2 ON subq1.TERM_CODE = subq2.TERM_CODE ORDER BY subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, subq1.SUBJECT_ID, subq2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC;

question: For the top 10 subjects offered in the term '2014FA' with the highest number of enrolled students (according to the library subject data), display each subject's title from the library, the number of enrolled students in the library subject, the responsible faculty name and offer department name from the TIP subject, the minimum number of enrolled students in the library subject within a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the TIP subject's responsible faculty MIT ID, and the highest standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students that the offer department has ever had in any term (considering only courses that have at least 5 different materials assigned in that term). Present the results in the order of number of enrolled students descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH TopSubjects AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( ORDER BY t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC LIMIT 10 ), DeptStddev AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.TERM_CODE, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.TERM_CODE HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) >= 5 ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(enrolled_stddev) AS highest_enrolled_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY highest_enrolled_stddev DESC ) SELECT ts.SUBJECT_TITLE, ts.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ts.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ts.window_column, ds.highest_enrolled_stddev FROM TopSubjects ts LEFT JOIN DeptStddev ds ON ts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = ds.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY ts.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC;

question: For courses in the School of Engineering that are degree granting and have a minimum total units of at least 12, and for all subjects in the 2014FA term with at least one enrolled student, where the course number matches, show the course description, department name, subject code, the subject title from the engineering course, the minimum total units in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the course number for the engineering course, the subject title from the 2014FA term, the offering department name, the responsible faculty name, the TIP material status key, the total number of units, the minimum total number of units in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the course number for the 2014FA subject, and whether the total units are 'HIGH_LOAD' (at least 10% greater than the average total units for that department), 'LOW_LOAD' (at least 10% less than the average), or 'AVERAGE', in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, MIN(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.COURSE_NUMBER FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_CODE = t2.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), filtered_courses AS ( SELECT * FROM inner_cte1 WHERE window_column >= 12 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, sos.COURSE_NUMBER, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY WHERE TERM_CODE = '2014FA' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE ), filtered_subjects AS ( SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, icte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, icte.TOTAL_UNITS, icte.window_column, icte.COURSE_NUMBER, CASE WHEN icte.TOTAL_UNITS > da.avg_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_LOAD' WHEN icte.TOTAL_UNITS < da.avg_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_LOAD' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_load_category FROM inner_cte2 icte JOIN dept_avg da ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = da.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ) SELECT fc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, fc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, fc.SUBJECT_CODE, fc.SUBJECT_TITLE AS ENGINEERING_SUBJECT_TITLE, fc.window_column AS ENGINEERING_MIN_TOTAL_UNITS_WINDOW, fs.SUBJECT_TITLE AS SUBJECT_TITLE_2014FA, fs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, fs.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, fs.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, fs.TOTAL_UNITS, fs.window_column AS SUBJECT_MIN_TOTAL_UNITS_WINDOW, fs.unit_load_category FROM filtered_courses fc JOIN filtered_subjects fs ON fc.COURSE_NUMBER = fs.COURSE_NUMBER;

question: For subject offerings in the term '2017FA' with a total number of units greater than 10, show the subject title, department name, and the school name from the subject offered summary, course description, and subject code tables, along with their dense rank considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the department code from the subject code table, and for departments that offered more than 5 unique subjects in terms from the academic year 2014 or later, also show the count of unique subject titles and the total number of enrolled students in those subjects, where the department name matches between the two criteria. List the subject title, department name, school name, dense rank, count of unique subject titles, and total number of enrolled students, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t2.COURSE_NUMBER FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS > 10 ), cte1 AS ( SELECT inner_cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte1.window_column, inner_cte1.COURSE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte1 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 ON inner_cte1.COURSE_NUMBER = t0.COURSE_NUMBER ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2014 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), cte2 AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte2.subject_count, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte2 JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON inner_cte2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2014 GROUP BY inner_cte2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte2.subject_count HAVING inner_cte2.subject_count > 5 ORDER BY total_enrolled_students DESC ) SELECT cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE, cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1.SCHOOL_NAME, cte1.window_column, cte2.subject_count, cte2.total_enrolled_students FROM cte1 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON cte1.COURSE_NUMBER = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN cte2 ON cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cte2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: For each department that grants degrees and offered subjects in the term '2016SP', list the department code, department name, the number of subjects offered, the total units for those subjects, the school name, and the number of unique subject titles with materials offered in regular academic terms. For each department, also include a grand total row for the number of subjects and total units in the format (department code, null, total subjects, total units, school name, subject title count). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t2.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), DeptSubjectSummary AS ( SELECT t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects, SUM(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' GROUP BY t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptSubjects2016SP AS ( SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.num_subjects, dss.total_units FROM DeptSubjectSummary dss UNION ALL SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_CODE, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(dss.num_subjects) AS num_subjects, SUM(dss.total_units) AS total_units FROM DeptSubjectSummary dss GROUP BY dss.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.SCHOOL_NAME FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON td.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND td.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ), DeptSubjectTitleSummary AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_title_count FROM inner_cte2 ic GROUP BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE) > 0 ) SELECT d.DEPT2016SP_DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPT2016SP_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.num_subjects, d.total_units, dsts.SCHOOL_NAME, dsts.subject_title_count FROM (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE AS DEPT2016SP_DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPT2016SP_DEPARTMENT_NAME, num_subjects, total_units FROM DeptSubjects2016SP ) d LEFT JOIN DeptSubjectTitleSummary dsts ON d.DEPT2016SP_DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsts.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d.DEPT2016SP_DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPT2016SP_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dsts.SCHOOL_NAME

question: For each subject offered by the library in the term "2019SP", show the subject title, the number of enrolled students, the term description, the total units for the subject, the average total units within each subject group, the offering department name, the school name, and for the corresponding department, the maximum, minimum, and average of the range of total units for subjects offered by that department in each term (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and offered in the 'Engineering' school). Do not repeat the subject title if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by the number of enrolled students, department name, and maximum range of total units across terms in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ss.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY ss.SUBJECT_GROUP_ID ORDER BY lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_total_units, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_dept_name FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2019SP' ), subject_stats AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(SUBJECT_TITLE) OVER (ORDER BY NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, OFFER_DEPT_NAME) = SUBJECT_TITLE THEN NULL ELSE SUBJECT_TITLE END AS subject_title, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, TERM_DESCRIPTION, TOTAL_UNITS, avg_total_units, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, join_dept_name FROM inner_cte1 ORDER BY NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE ), dept_unit_range_stats AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(total_units_range) AS max_range_across_terms, MIN(total_units_range) AS min_range_across_terms, AVG(total_units_range) AS avg_range_across_terms FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY max_range_across_terms DESC ) SELECT s.subject_title, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.TOTAL_UNITS, s.avg_total_units, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, d.max_range_across_terms, d.min_range_across_terms, d.avg_range_across_terms FROM subject_stats s JOIN dept_unit_range_stats d ON s.join_dept_name = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, d.max_range_across_terms DESC

question: For academic terms where the term status is 'Previous', show the term code from ACADEMIC_TERMS, the term description from ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL, the academic year from ACADEMIC_TERMS, the running sum of academic years within each financial aid year group, the total number of such terms per financial aid year, the financial aid year, and the number of regular academic terms for each academic year (including null and grand total if available), ordered by academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ), subq1 AS ( SELECT inner_cte1.TERM_CODE, inner_cte1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte1.window_column, term_counts.Total_Terms, inner_cte1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR FROM inner_cte1 JOIN ( SELECT t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS Total_Terms FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ) term_counts ON inner_cte1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR = term_counts.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY inner_cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON at.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = ata.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ), subq2 AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS total_terms FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT s1.TERM_CODE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.window_column, s1.Total_Terms, s1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, s2.total_terms AS regular_term_count FROM subq1 s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR

question: For each department, list the department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and offered in the 'Engineering' school), the average lecture units for those subjects, and the highest maximum enrollment among IAP activities in 2021 that were not cancelled and were associated with subjects offered by that department. Show the results ordered by the range of total units in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DepartmentUnitsStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, sos.LECTURE_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, AVG(inner_cte.LECTURE_UNITS) AS avg_lecture_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DepartmentIAPMaxEnroll AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS math_iap_activities_2021 FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2021 AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS highest_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2021 AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev, dus.avg_lecture_units, dme.highest_max_enrollment FROM DepartmentUnitsStats dus JOIN DepartmentIAPMaxEnroll dme ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dme.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dus.total_units_range DESC;

question: For each subject offered in the term with term code '2012SU' that also has a cluster type of 'S', show the subject title, offer department name, offer school name, cluster type description, the difference between the number of enrolled students for that subject and the average number of enrolled students for all subjects in the same department in that term, the dense rank of each subject considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the number of enrolled students, and the deviation of the number of enrolled students from the average number of enrolled students for that department in that term as calculated from the summary table. The columns should be shown in the following order: subject title, offer department name, offer school name, cluster type description, deviation from department average (from the first calculation), window column (dense rank), and deviation from department average (from the summary calculation). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, t1.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE TERM_CODE = '2012SU' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, i.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC, (i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS - d.avg_enrolled) AS deviation_from_dept_avg, i.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t1.TERM_CODE FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t2.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t0.CLUSTER_TYPE = 'S' ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, TERM_CODE, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE TERM_CODE = '2012SU' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE, TERM_CODE ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, (i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS - d.avg_enrolled) AS deviation_from_dept_avg, i.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND i.TERM_CODE = d.TERM_CODE ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s1.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC, s1.deviation_from_dept_avg, s2.window_column, s2.deviation_from_dept_avg AS s2_deviation_from_dept_avg FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_TITLE = s2.SUBJECT_TITLE AND s1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = s2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE

question: For subjects offered in the term '2017JA', show the subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, department full name, subject code, subject code description, and the minimum number of enrolled students over each subject code group, as well as the school name and department phone number, and for each, also show the department name, the average and variance of the ASCII values of the course numbers for that subject code, but only for degree-granting departments. Order the results by subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.window_column, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s.COURSE_NUMBER, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, AVG(ASCII(inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VARIANCE(ASCII(inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s1.window_column, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.avg_course_number_ascii, s2.var_course_number_ascii FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND s1.SUBJECT_CODE = s2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For each subject offered in the term 2013FA, list the subject offered key, the subject ID, the number of materials assigned, the total new shelf price of those materials (considering only materials with a new shelf price greater than 10), whether the total new shelf price is 'EXPENSIVE' (if it exceeds 200), 'CHEAP' (if it is less than 50), or 'MODERATE' otherwise, and for each matching subject and academic year and department where the subject is offered as a library reserve material with status 'U', also show the academic year, academic year description, department name, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for that subject in that academic year and department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT d.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, d.SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count, SUM(m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS total_new_shelf_price FROM TIP_DETAIL d JOIN TIP_MATERIAL m ON d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE d.TERM_CODE = '2013FA' AND m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE > 10 GROUP BY d.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, d.SUBJECT_ID ), SubjectMaterialSummary AS ( SELECT inner_cte1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, inner_cte1.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte1.material_count, inner_cte1.total_new_shelf_price, CASE WHEN inner_cte1.total_new_shelf_price > 200 THEN 'EXPENSIVE' WHEN inner_cte1.total_new_shelf_price < 50 THEN 'CHEAP' ELSE 'MODERATE' END AS price_category FROM inner_cte1 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS, LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE AND LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ), DepartmentYearVariation AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation, SUBJECT_ID FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID HAVING AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT s.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.material_count, s.total_new_shelf_price, s.price_category, d.ACADEMIC_YEAR, d.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.coefficient_of_variation FROM SubjectMaterialSummary s JOIN DepartmentYearVariation d ON s.SUBJECT_ID = d.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY s.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, d.ACADEMIC_YEAR, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each subject offered in the term 2019FA, provide the subject ID, subject title, number of enrolled students, department name, department full name, the department's average enrollment, and whether the number of enrolled students is 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% greater than the average for that department), 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% less than the average for that department), or 'AVERAGE'. Additionally, for each subject's department, also provide the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year, and the number of unique subject titles offered by that department in 2022. List the results ordered by department name and subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_total_units, i.total_units_range, i.total_units_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS num_unique_subject_titles FROM inner_cte i JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_total_units, i.total_units_range, i.total_units_variance ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.avg_enrollment, CASE WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > d.avg_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < d.avg_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s2.avg_enrollment, s2.enrollment_category, s1.avg_total_units, s1.total_units_range, s1.total_units_variance, s1.num_unique_subject_titles FROM subq2 s2 JOIN subq1 s1 ON s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each department name and course level where the department is degree granting, and for each subject in that department in the 2022FA term with total units greater than the average for that term, provide the department (not repeated if same as previous row), course level, number of unique students, minimum CIP program code among their courses, school name, department's full name, subject ID, subject department name, term description, the running sum of total units for subjects in the academic year, and the academic year. Sort the table by department, course level, and subject ID. Include subtotals for each department (the corresponding department field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all departments (the corresponding department field is 'TOTAL'). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(dept) OVER (ORDER BY dept_sort, course_level_sort) = dept THEN NULL ELSE dept END AS department, course_level, student_count, min_cip_code, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS department_full_name, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(COURSE_LEVEL) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(COURSE_LEVEL) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(COURSE_LEVEL) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(COURSE_LEVEL) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE COURSE_LEVEL END AS course_level_sort, COURSE_LEVEL AS course_level, SUM(student_count) AS student_count, MIN(min_cip_code) AS min_cip_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_LEVEL WITH ROLLUP ) tbltmp LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tbltmp.dept = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dept_sort, course_level_sort ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ) SELECT SUBJECT_ID, DEPARTMENT_NAME, TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUM(TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte WHERE TOTAL_UNITS > ( SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ) ORDER BY SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT s1.department, s1.course_level, s1.student_count, s1.min_cip_code, s1.school_name, s1.department_full_name, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS subject_department_name, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.window_column AS running_total_units, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.department, s1.course_level, s2.SUBJECT_ID

question: For each department, academic year, and academic year description, show the geometric mean of the total units for all subjects offered by the department in regular terms with total units greater than zero, and for each such department also show the master subject ID, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in library subjects that have a matching master subject ID in the TIP subject offerings, and the total number of such subjects per department, considering only departments with more than 0 enrolled students in both tables. The columns should be: department name, academic year, academic year description, geometric mean total units, master subject ID, library students variance, library students standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and total subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH geometric_mean_units AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), library_variance_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = t.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, VARIANCE(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_students_variance, STDDEV(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_students_stddev, Subject_Counts.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) AS Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) AS Subject_Counts ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = Subject_Counts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME GROUP BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, Subject_Counts.Total_Subjects ) SELECT gmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, gmu.ACADEMIC_YEAR, gmu.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gmu.geometric_mean_total_units, lvs.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, lvs.library_students_variance, lvs.library_students_stddev, lvs.Total_Subjects FROM geometric_mean_units gmu JOIN library_variance_stats lvs ON gmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME = lvs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY gmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, gmu.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC, lvs.library_students_variance DESC;

question: For each room with access level 1 whose area is greater than the average area of rooms in its organization (where the organization has a non-null DLC key), show the major use description (not repeated if the same as the previous row), the building-room identifier, the area, the organization name, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by major use description. Sort the results by major use description and organization name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH org_avg_area AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY o JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY area_variance DESC ), org_avg_area AS ( SELECT r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_area FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY o JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) SELECT r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY o JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN org_avg_area a ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = a.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND r.AREA > a.avg_area ), room_access_major_use AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.AREA, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.DESCRIPTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM FCLT_MAJOR_USE t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(DESCRIPTION) OVER (ORDER BY DESCRIPTION, ORGANIZATION_NAME) = DESCRIPTION THEN NULL ELSE DESCRIPTION END AS major_use_description, BUILDING_ROOM, AREA, ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ROOM_KEY, FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY DESCRIPTION, ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT ramu.major_use_description, ramu.BUILDING_ROOM, ramu.AREA, ramu.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ramu.window_column FROM room_access_major_use ramu JOIN org_avg_area oaa ON ramu.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = oaa.FCLT_ROOM_KEY AND ramu.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = oaa.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY ramu.major_use_description, ramu.ORGANIZATION_NAME

question: For the top 5 current academic terms with the highest total subject enrollment, show each term's code, description, academic year, the number of subjects offered, the total subject enrollment, and the department with the most subjects offered in that term along with the count of those subjects, as well as the maximum average total units for subjects in that department that had library reserve materials in any single term with a term status of 'Previous'. List the columns in the following order: term code, term description, academic year, number of subjects offered, total subject enrollment, department with the most subjects offered, count of those subjects, and the maximum average total units for subjects in that department with library reserve materials in any previous term. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), TopTerms AS ( SELECT ic.TERM_CODE, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.subject_count, ic.total_enrollment, d.DEPT_NAME AS most_subjects_department, d.subjects_in_dept FROM inner_cte1 ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ss.TERM_CODE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPT_NAME, COUNT(ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subjects_in_dept, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ss.TERM_CODE ORDER BY COUNT(ss.SUBJECT_ID) DESC) AS dept_rank FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss GROUP BY ss.TERM_CODE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) d ON ic.TERM_CODE = d.TERM_CODE AND d.dept_rank = 1 ORDER BY ic.total_enrollment DESC LIMIT 5 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.TERM_CODE, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.TERM_CODE ), DeptMaxAvgUnits AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(avg_total_units) AS max_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY max_avg_total_units DESC ) SELECT tt.TERM_CODE, tt.TERM_DESCRIPTION, tt.ACADEMIC_YEAR, tt.subject_count, tt.total_enrollment, tt.most_subjects_department, tt.subjects_in_dept, dmax.max_avg_total_units FROM TopTerms tt LEFT JOIN DeptMaxAvgUnits dmax ON tt.most_subjects_department = dmax.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY tt.total_enrollment DESC, tt.TERM_CODE;

question: For each department, list either (1) the department name and course level where the course is degree granting and the total units are greater than 6, along with the number of unique courses, the minimum total units offered, and the number of courses where the design units are at least 3, or (2) the department name and employee type where the student year is 'G', along with the number of people, the minimum MIT ID, and the number of unique office locations for those students. Indicate the source of each row as either 'CourseStats' or 'StudentStats'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.COURSE_LEVEL, ic.course_count, ic.min_total_units, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ccc.DESIGN_UNITS >= 3 THEN scd.COURSE END) AS courses_with_design_units_3_or_more FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.COURSE_LEVEL = scd.COURSE_LEVEL JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.COURSE_LEVEL, ic.course_count, ic.min_total_units ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(sp.MIT_ID) AS person_count, MIN(sp.MIT_ID) AS min_mit_id FROM SE_PERSON sp JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.person_count, ic.min_mit_id, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.OFFICE_LOCATION) AS unique_office_locations FROM inner_cte ic JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY ic.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.person_count, ic.min_mit_id ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.COURSE_LEVEL, NULL AS EMPLOYEE_TYPE, NULL AS person_count, NULL AS min_mit_id, NULL AS unique_office_locations, s1.course_count, s1.min_total_units, s1.courses_with_design_units_3_or_more, 'CourseStats' AS Source FROM Subquery1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS COURSE_LEVEL, s2.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, s2.person_count, s2.min_mit_id, s2.unique_office_locations, NULL AS course_count, NULL AS min_total_units, NULL AS courses_with_design_units_3_or_more, 'StudentStats' AS Source FROM Subquery2 s2 ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_LEVEL, EMPLOYEE_TYPE, person_count, min_mit_id, unique_office_locations, course_count, min_total_units, courses_with_design_units_3_or_more, Source FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Source;

question: For each department, what is the department name, the highest number of active graduate students with an assigned office location that the department has had on any given warehouse load date, the range of total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2022 and also listed in the CIS course catalog (only for departments where this range exceeds the average range across all departments), and the variance of the total units for those departments? List the department name, highest number of active graduate students, units range, and units variance in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, COUNT(*) AS total_active_grad_students FROM SE_PERSON s JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY m ON s.FULL_NAME = m.FULL_NAME WHERE s.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND m.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND m.OFFICE_LOCATION IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ), Subquery1 AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(total_active_grad_students) AS highest_active_grad_students FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.units_range, i.units_variance FROM inner_cte2 i JOIN ( SELECT AVG(units_range) AS avg_units_range FROM inner_cte2 ) avg_cte ON i.units_range > avg_cte.avg_units_range ORDER BY i.units_range DESC ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.highest_active_grad_students, s2.units_range, s2.units_variance FROM Subquery1 s1 INNER JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department, provide the department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of course materials per subject offered by that department in the term 2017SP, indicate whether the department is a 'HIGH_MATERIAL_VARIANCE', 'LOW_MATERIAL_VARIANCE', or 'AVERAGE' (based on the variance compared to the average across all departments), and also include the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department in 2017, along with the school name and department phone number. List the results ordered by the material count range in descending order, and then by enrolled students variance in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH material_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(material_count) - MIN(material_count) AS material_count_range, VARIANCE(material_count) AS material_count_variance, STDDEV(material_count) AS material_count_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ( SELECT TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM TIP_DETAIL WHERE TERM_CODE = '2017SP' GROUP BY TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ) AS detail_stats ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = detail_stats.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = '2017SP' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.material_count_range, i.material_count_variance, i.material_count_stddev, CASE WHEN i.material_count_variance > s.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_MATERIAL_VARIANCE' WHEN i.material_count_variance < s.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_MATERIAL_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(material_count_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte ) s ), enrollment_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2017%' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.enrolled_students_variance, i.enrolled_students_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte i LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT m.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, m.material_count_range, m.material_count_variance, m.material_count_stddev, m.variance_category, e.enrolled_students_variance, e.enrolled_students_stddev, e.SCHOOL_NAME, e.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM material_stats m LEFT JOIN enrollment_stats e ON m.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = e.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY m.material_count_range DESC, e.enrolled_students_variance DESC;

question: For subjects offered in the term '2016SP' with a school code of 'E', and for subjects offered in the term '2017JA', show the subject title, department name, course description, the number of enrolled students in 2016SP, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title, the number of enrolled students in 2017JA, the offering department name, department full name, subject code, subject code description, the minimum number of enrolled students over each subject code group in 2017JA, the school name, and the department phone number. Order the results by subject title and subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t0.SCHOOL_CODE = 'E' ), cte1 AS ( SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.window_column, t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM inner_cte1 inner_cte JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE = t2.SUBJECT_TITLE AND t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' ), cte2 AS ( SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.window_column, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE, cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, cte1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS_2016SP, cte1.window_column AS WINDOW_COLUMN_2016SP, cte2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS_2017JA, cte2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cte2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, cte2.SUBJECT_CODE, cte2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, cte2.window_column AS MIN_ENROLLED_STUDENTS_OVER_SUBJECT_CODE_2017JA, cte2.SCHOOL_NAME, cte2.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = cte2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE, cte2.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For each academic year and department where the highest average total units for subjects ever offered by the department in a regular academic term is greater than 12, what is the academic year, academic year description, department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for all library reserve materials offered in terms that have a material status of 'U', and the highest average total units for the department? For each academic year, also include a grand total across all departments in the format of (academic year, academic year description, null, total coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), null), but only for departments meeting the highest average total units criterion. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.TERM_CODE, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.TERM_CODE ), DepartmentHighestAvgUnits AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(avg_total_units) AS highest_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE AND LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ), DepartmentYearlyCoeffVar AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT dya.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dya.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, dya.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dya.coefficient_of_variation, dha.highest_avg_total_units FROM DepartmentYearlyCoeffVar dya JOIN DepartmentHighestAvgUnits dha ON dya.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dha.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE dha.highest_avg_total_units > 12 ORDER BY dya.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dya.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: Among all academic years, for the academic year and its description with the highest variance in the number of tip detail records for subjects offered in the fall term (with at least one associated tip detail record), and the department most represented among those subjects in that year (along with the count of such subjects from that department), list for each subject offered in the term '2017JA' the subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, department full name, subject code, subject code description, and whether the number of enrolled students is 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% greater than the average for that subject code), 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% less than the average for that subject code), or 'AVERAGE', ordered by subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), cte1_max_var AS ( SELECT t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t1.record_count_variance, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Most_Represented_Department, t2.Subject_Count FROM ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(record_count_variance) AS record_count_variance FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC LIMIT 1 ) t1 JOIN ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME ) t2 ON t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND t2.rn = 1 ORDER BY t1.record_count_variance DESC ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' ), subject_code_avg AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY SUBJECT_CODE ), cte2_enrollment AS ( SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.SUBJECT_CODE,
