i.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, CASE WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < a.avg_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte2 i JOIN subject_code_avg a ON i.SUBJECT_CODE = a.SUBJECT_CODE ) SELECT cte1_max_var.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cte1_max_var.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cte1_max_var.record_count_variance, cte1_max_var.Most_Represented_Department, cte1_max_var.Subject_Count, cte2_enrollment.SUBJECT_TITLE, cte2_enrollment.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, cte2_enrollment.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cte2_enrollment.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, cte2_enrollment.SUBJECT_CODE, cte2_enrollment.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, cte2_enrollment.enrollment_category FROM cte1_max_var CROSS JOIN cte2_enrollment ORDER BY cte2_enrollment.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For each academic year and department that has a non-null variance of reserve catalog keys for courses with material status 'U' in any term, provide the academic year, academic year description, department name, the average of total units, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for subjects offered in regular terms. Order the results by academic year and department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, lrmd.TERM_CODE, VARIANCE(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY lci.DEPARTMENT, lrmd.TERM_CODE ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(term) OVER (ORDER BY term_sort, term, dept_sort) = term THEN NULL ELSE term END AS term, dept, catalog_key_variance, term_sort FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT END AS dept_sort, DEPARTMENT AS dept, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM ( SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, lrmd.TERM_CODE, lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY FROM LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ) base GROUP BY TERM_CODE, DEPARTMENT WITH ROLLUP ) tbltmp ORDER BY term_sort, dept_sort ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(avg_total_units) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(stddev_total_units) AS stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), DepartmentsWithHighVariance AS ( SELECT DISTINCT dept FROM Subquery1 WHERE catalog_key_variance IS NOT NULL ) SELECT s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.avg_total_units, s2.stddev_total_units FROM Subquery2 s2 WHERE s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN (SELECT dept FROM DepartmentsWithHighVariance) ORDER BY s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each of the top 10 subjects offered in the term '2009SP' by reserved library materials, list the subject title, the offering department name, the number of reserved library materials, the total number of enrolled students, and categorize the subject as 'HIGH_DEMAND' if the number of reserved materials is at least 10% greater than the number of enrolled students, 'LOW_DEMAND' if at least 10% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. For each subject, also show the total number of students enrolled in library subjects for its department among the top 5 departments with the highest total enrollment (across terms with status 'P' and more than 0 enrolled students), the academic year with the highest enrollment for that department, and the number of students enrolled in that year. Show the results ordered by the number of reserved materials in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subject_demand AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials, s.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.reserved_materials, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, CASE WHEN i.reserved_materials > s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_DEMAND' WHEN i.reserved_materials < s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_DEMAND' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS demand_category, i.SUBJECT_ID FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON i.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID AND s.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' ORDER BY i.reserved_materials DESC LIMIT 10 ), top_departments AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT dept_stats.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dept_stats.Total_Enrolled_Students, year_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AS Peak_Year_Desc, year_stats.Year_Enrolled_Students FROM ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS Total_Enrolled_Students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY Total_Enrolled_Students DESC LIMIT 5 ) dept_stats LEFT JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS Year_Enrolled_Students, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) year_stats ON dept_stats.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = year_stats.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND year_stats.rn = 1 ORDER BY dept_stats.Total_Enrolled_Students DESC ) SELECT sd.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sd.reserved_materials, sd.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, sd.demand_category, td.Total_Enrolled_Students, td.Peak_Year_Desc, td.Year_Enrolled_Students FROM subject_demand sd LEFT JOIN top_departments td ON sd.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = td.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY sd.reserved_materials DESC;

question: For all subject offerings in the academic term with term code '2017FA', show the subject title, the offer department name, the term description, the number of enrolled students, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title. Additionally, for each offer department, show the minimum number of enrolled students in any subject and the total number of material records for subjects in that department in the School of Engineering with material status 'RQ'. List the subject title, offer department name, term description, number of enrolled students, window row number, minimum enrolled students in the department, and total material records, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON s.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.window_column, s.SUBJECT_ID FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON i.SUBJECT_TITLE = s.SUBJECT_TITLE AND i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND i.TERM_DESCRIPTION = (SELECT TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS WHERE TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE) WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled, SUM(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_material_records FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(min_enrolled) AS min_enrolled, SUM(total_material_records) AS total_material_records FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME WITH ROLLUP ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.window_column, s2.min_enrolled, s2.total_material_records FROM subq1 s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For each department in the School of Engineering, show the department name, the minimum number of enrolled students in any subject, the total number of material records for subjects in that department with material status 'RQ', the subject code, the subject title, and the geometric mean of the total units for subjects offered by that department where the total units are greater than zero. Also, provide a grand total for the entire School of Engineering in the format (null, min_enrolled, total_material_records, ...). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled, SUM(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_material_records FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), subq1 AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(min_enrolled) AS min_enrolled, SUM(total_material_records) AS total_material_records FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME WITH ROLLUP ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ), subq2 AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE, EXP(AVG(LN(inner_cte2.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.min_enrolled, s1.total_material_records, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.geometric_mean_total_units FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.geometric_mean_total_units DESC

question: For each department name and school name where the number of enrolled students in the offered subject is greater than 3, show the number of offered subjects, the minimum number of enrolled students, the subject title with the highest number of enrolled students in that department and school, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses in that department that have at least one associated course material, and indicate whether the department's average enrollment is 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% greater than the overall average), 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% less than the overall average), or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Present the results in the following order: department name, school name, number of offered subjects, minimum number of enrolled students, subject with the highest enrollment, average enrollment, enrollment standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and enrollment category. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS offered_subject_count, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.offered_subject_count, ic.min_enrolled_students, ls.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_with_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC) AS rn FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 ) ls ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ls.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.SCHOOL_NAME = ls.SCHOOL_NAME AND ls.rn = 1 ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrollment, inner_cte.enrollment_stddev, CASE WHEN inner_cte.avg_enrollment > overall.avg_all_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN inner_cte.avg_enrollment < overall.avg_all_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_all_enrollment FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' ) overall ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.offered_subject_count, s1.min_enrolled_students, s1.subject_with_max_enrollment, s2.avg_enrollment, s2.enrollment_stddev, s2.enrollment_category FROM subq1 s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME

question: For subjects offered in the term '2016SP' with a school code of 'E', show the subject title, department name, course description, the number of enrolled students, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title, and the highest average total units for subjects ever offered by the department in a regular academic term. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS join_department_name FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t0.SCHOOL_CODE = 'E' ), cte1 AS ( SELECT inner_cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte1.window_column, inner_cte1.join_department_name FROM inner_cte1 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON inner_cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE = t2.SUBJECT_TITLE AND t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.TERM_CODE, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.TERM_CODE ), cte2 AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(avg_total_units) AS highest_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY highest_avg_total_units DESC ) SELECT cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE, cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, cte1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, cte1.window_column, cte2.highest_avg_total_units FROM cte1 LEFT JOIN cte2 ON cte1.join_department_name = cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: List the subject code, subject code description, department name, course description, subject code description, and the difference between the number of characters in the course description and the average number of characters in course descriptions for that department for all subject codes that are associated with departments that are degree-granting and belong to the School of Engineering, and for each course in those departments in the School of Engineering that is degree granting. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS engineering_degree_granting_subject_codes FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t1.DEPARTMENT FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(LENGTH(COURSE_DESCRIPTION)) AS avg_desc_length FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, (LENGTH(i.COURSE_DESCRIPTION) - d.avg_desc_length) AS desc_length_deviation, i.DEPARTMENT FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT sq1.SUBJECT_CODE, sq1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, sq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sq2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sq2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, sq2.desc_length_deviation FROM subq1 sq1 JOIN subq2 sq2 ON sq1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sq2.DEPARTMENT

question: For each subject category and academic year where the subject has a maximum enrollment greater than 10, list the subject category, academic year, academic year description, number of unique subjects, minimum academic term start date, number of unique subject IDs from the TIP_DETAIL table for that term, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the record counts of TIP materials associated with that academic year (considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the TIP material status key is not 'NM'), and whether the variance is above or below the average variance across all academic years. For each subject category and academic year, include a grand total for all subject IDs in the format of (subject category, academic year, null, null, total subject IDs, ...). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT i.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date, a.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.TERM_CODE ), SubjectIDCounts AS ( SELECT icte.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.subject_count, icte.min_term_start_date, COUNT(DISTINCT t.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_id_count FROM inner_cte1 icte JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON icte.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE GROUP BY icte.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.subject_count, icte.min_term_start_date ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, ACADEMIC_YEAR, subject_count, min_term_start_date, SUM(subject_id_count) AS total_subject_ids FROM SubjectIDCounts GROUP BY IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, ACADEMIC_YEAR, subject_count, min_term_start_date WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(subject_id_count) > 0 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), VarianceResults AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte2.record_count_variance, inner_cte2.record_count_stddev, CASE WHEN inner_cte2.record_count_variance > (SELECT AVG(record_count_variance) FROM inner_cte2) THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN inner_cte2.record_count_variance < (SELECT AVG(record_count_variance) FROM inner_cte2) THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte2 ) SELECT r.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, r.ACADEMIC_YEAR, v.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, r.subject_count, r.min_term_start_date, r.total_subject_ids, v.record_count_variance, v.record_count_stddev, v.variance_category FROM RollupResults r LEFT JOIN VarianceResults v ON r.ACADEMIC_YEAR = v.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY r.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, r.ACADEMIC_YEAR, r.subject_count;

question: For each textbook material in the TIP_DETAIL table with a material status key of 'RQ' and for subjects offered in the term with code '2025FA', show the subject offered key, material key, subject ID, term code, academic year, term description, row number within each academic year group ordered by term code, subject title, offering department name, number of enrolled students, term start date, term end date, term parameter, and whether the number of enrolled students is 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% greater than the average for that department), 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% less than the average for that department), or 'AVERAGE'. Only include those where the academic year is greater than the average academic year of all such records. List the selected columns in the order: subject offered key, material key, subject ID, term code, academic year, term description, row number, subject title, offering department name, number of enrolled students, term start date, term end date, term parameter, and enrollment category, ordered by academic year, term code, and offering department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_CODE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ) SELECT TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_DESCRIPTION, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE ACADEMIC_YEAR > (SELECT AVG(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM inner_cte) ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE TERM_CODE = '2025FA' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.TERM_START_DATE, i.TERM_END_DATE, i.TERM_PARAMETER, CASE WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > d.avg_enrolled * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < d.avg_enrolled * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT s1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.window_column, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.TERM_START_DATE, s2.TERM_END_DATE, s2.TERM_PARAMETER, s2.enrollment_category FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.TERM_CODE, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME

question: For each academic year and offering department, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of students enrolled in library subjects offered during IAP, and for each subject offered in the term '2017FA' within the same department, what is the subject title, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the record counts for all tip materials associated with that subject, as well as the department name and the total number of enrolled students for each subject? Present the results as academic year, offering department, average enrollment, enrollment variance, enrollment standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), subject title, record count range, record count variance, record count standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), department name for the subject, and total number of enrolled students for the subject, ordered by academic year, offering department, and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH enrollment_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON isd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON at.TERM_CODE = lso.TERM_CODE WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS IS NOT NULL ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, OFFER_DEPT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING ACADEMIC_YEAR IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), tip_material_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(t.RECORD_COUNT) - MIN(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_range, VARIANCE(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON s.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.record_count_range, i.record_count_variance, i.record_count_stddev, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON i.SUBJECT_TITLE = s.SUBJECT_TITLE AND s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' ORDER BY i.record_count_range DESC ) SELECT es.ACADEMIC_YEAR, es.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, es.avg_enrollment, es.enrollment_variance, es.enrollment_stddev, tms.SUBJECT_TITLE, tms.record_count_range, tms.record_count_variance, tms.record_count_stddev, tms.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS tip_offer_dept_name, tms.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS tip_num_enrolled_students FROM enrollment_stats es JOIN tip_material_stats tms ON es.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tms.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY es.ACADEMIC_YEAR, es.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tms.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For each of the top 5 administrative departments with the highest standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) in office phone numbers among students with non-null office phone numbers, list the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the office phone numbers, and the total number of such students in the department. For each of these departments, also show, for each subject offered by the department in the term '2017JA', the subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, department full name, subject code, subject code description, and the total number of distinct subjects offered by the department in that term. Present the results ordered by the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of office phone numbers (descending) and then by offering department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH admin_dept_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.OFFICE_PHONE) AS avg_office_phone, STDDEV(MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.OFFICE_PHONE) AS stddev_office_phone FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY ON SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.DEPARTMENT WHERE MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.OFFICE_PHONE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_office_phone, inner_cte.stddev_office_phone, COUNT(MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ON inner_cte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY ON SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.DEPARTMENT AND MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.OFFICE_PHONE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY inner_cte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_office_phone, inner_cte.stddev_office_phone, SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.stddev_office_phone DESC LIMIT 5 ), subject_offerings AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, dept_counts.Total_Subjects, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME = t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME JOIN ( SELECT t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS Total_Subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' GROUP BY t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ) dept_counts ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME = dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ) SELECT ads.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ads.avg_office_phone, ads.stddev_office_phone, ads.student_count, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, so.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, so.SUBJECT_CODE, so.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, so.Total_Subjects FROM admin_dept_stats ads JOIN subject_offerings so ON ads.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = so.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ads.stddev_office_phone DESC, so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: For subjects offered in the term '2017JA', show the subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, department full name, subject code, subject code description, the minimum number of enrolled students over each subject code group, the school name, department phone number, the average of the ASCII values of the course numbers for that subject code, and the variance of the ASCII values of the course numbers for that subject code, considering only degree-granting departments. Order the results by subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.window_column, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s.COURSE_NUMBER, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, AVG(ASCII(inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VARIANCE(ASCII(inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s1.window_column, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, s2.avg_course_number_ascii, s2.var_course_number_ascii FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND s1.SUBJECT_CODE = s2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For each department and academic year, show the department name, academic year, academic year description, and the geometric mean of the total units for all subjects offered by the department in regular terms with total units greater than zero, and for each academic building with rooms larger than 40 square meters, show the building name, the average, range, and variance of the room areas, as well as the total assignable area of the building and the year the building was built. List all combinations of department-year and building statistics, with the selected columns in the following order: department name, academic year, academic year description, geometric mean total units, building name, average room area, room area range, room area variance, assignable area, and year built. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH department_geometric_mean_units AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), academic_building_room_stats AS ( SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.avg_room_area, ic.room_area_range, ic.room_area_variance, fb.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, fb.DATE_BUILT FROM ( SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_room_area, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS room_area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS room_area_variance FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND r.AREA > 40 GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME ) ic JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON ic.BUILDING_NAME = fb.BUILDING_NAME ) SELECT dgm.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dgm.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dgm.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, dgm.geometric_mean_total_units, abrs.BUILDING_NAME, abrs.avg_room_area, abrs.room_area_range, abrs.room_area_variance, abrs.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, abrs.DATE_BUILT FROM department_geometric_mean_units dgm CROSS JOIN academic_building_room_stats abrs ORDER BY dgm.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dgm.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC, abrs.room_area_range DESC;

question: For the top 10 departments and academic years with the highest number of non-repeatable-for-credit subjects offered in the fall term, display for each: the department name, academic year, subject count, the subject with the highest enrollment in that group, and the enrollment number for that subject. Additionally, for each of these departments, show the school name, term start date, and the total maximum subject enrollment number in the current academic term for that department and school (including grand totals per school as null department, school, null term start date, total max enrollment, where applicable). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH top_departments_fall AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.GRADE_RULE_DESC = 'Not repeatable for credit' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.subject_count, so.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Top_Subject_Title, so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS Top_Subject_Enrollment FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC ) AS rn FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.GRADE_RULE_DESC = 'Not repeatable for credit' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' ) so ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = so.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = so.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND so.rn = 1 ORDER BY icte.subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), current_term_dept_school_enrollment AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_enrollment, at.TERM_START_DATE, ss.SCHOOL_NAME FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_START_DATE, ss.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 5 ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, TERM_START_DATE, SUM(max_enrollment) AS total_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, TERM_START_DATE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(max_enrollment) > 0 ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT tdf.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tdf.ACADEMIC_YEAR, tdf.subject_count, tdf.Top_Subject_Title, tdf.Top_Subject_Enrollment, ctdse.SCHOOL_NAME, ctdse.TERM_START_DATE, ctdse.total_max_enrollment FROM top_departments_fall tdf LEFT JOIN current_term_dept_school_enrollment ctdse ON tdf.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ctdse.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY tdf.subject_count DESC, ctdse.SCHOOL_NAME, ctdse.TERM_START_DATE

question: For each academic year and department, what is the academic year, academic year description, the variance of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during terms in that year (considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the number of enrolled students is greater than 0), the department name, the total number of such library subjects offered per department in that year, and, for that department, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of rooms (with area greater than 40) used for subjects offered by that department (considering only departments that offer at least 5 such subjects)? Present the results ordered by the variance of enrolled students descending, then by total library subjects offered descending, then by area variance descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, COUNT(DISTINCT LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS total_library_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, f.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, f.AREA FROM FCLT_ROOMS f JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON f.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = c.MEET_PLACE WHERE f.AREA > 40 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ic.AREA) AS avg_area, VARIANCE(ic.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(ic.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM inner_cte ic JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON ic.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = cso.MEET_PLACE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cso.SUBJECT_ID) >= 5 ) SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.enrolled_students_variance, s1.department_name, s1.total_library_subjects_offered, s2.avg_area, s2.area_variance, s2.area_stddev FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.department_name = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.enrolled_students_variance DESC, s1.total_library_subjects_offered DESC, s2.area_variance DESC;

question: For each of the top 10 academic years with the highest geometric mean of total units for all subjects offered in regular terms (with total units greater than zero), list the academic year description, the geometric mean of total units, the department with the most subjects offered in those terms, the count of subjects from that department, the average number of enrolled students in offered subjects for that department, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students, the total number of subjects offered by that department, and the name of the school, considering only degree-granting departments and subjects with more than 0 enrolled students. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.geometric_mean_total_units, dmc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Most_Represented_Department, dmc.Subject_Count, dmc.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) dmc JOIN ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(Subject_Count) AS Max_Subject_Count FROM ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) sub GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ) dmax ON dmc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dmax.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND dmc.Subject_Count = dmax.Max_Subject_Count JOIN inner_cte ic ON dmc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ic.geometric_mean_total_units DESC LIMIT 10 ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrollment, inner_cte.enrollment_variance, inner_cte.enrollment_stddev, COUNT(lso.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects_offered, MAX(scd.SCHOOL_NAME) AS school_name FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrollment, inner_cte.enrollment_variance, inner_cte.enrollment_stddev ORDER BY inner_cte.enrollment_variance DESC ) SELECT subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, subq1.geometric_mean_total_units, subq1.Most_Represented_Department, subq1.Subject_Count, subq2.avg_enrollment, subq2.enrollment_variance, subq2.enrollment_stddev, subq2.total_subjects_offered, subq2.school_name FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.Most_Represented_Department = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subq1.geometric_mean_total_units DESC, subq2.enrollment_variance DESC;

question: For each academic year that has both (1) subjects offered in the fall term with at least one associated tip detail record and (2) subject categories with at least one subject having a maximum enrollment greater than 10, what are the academic year, academic year description, the variance of the number of tip detail records for subjects offered in that year (considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term and have at least one associated tip detail record), the number of unique departments represented among those subjects, the subject category key, the number of unique subjects in that category and year, the minimum academic term start date for that category and year, and the total number of TIP materials for that subject category and year? List the results ordered by the variance of the number of tip detail records (descending), then by subject category key. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS unique_departments FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance ), Subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT i.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT inner_cte.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.min_term_start_date, tip_counts.total_tip_materials FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_tip_materials FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) AS tip_counts ON inner_cte.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = tip_counts.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = tip_counts.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.record_count_variance, s1.unique_departments, s2.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, s2.subject_count, s2.min_term_start_date, s2.total_tip_materials FROM Subq1 s1 JOIN Subq2 s2 ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s1.record_count_variance DESC, s2.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY;

question: For each department where the average total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units) is greater than the overall average total units across all subjects, provide the department name, subject ID, total units, the department's average total units (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and at least 1 enrolled student), the department's standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units (for the same set), and the deviation of each subject's total units from the department's average. List the results ordered by the department's standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units (descending), then department name, then subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), dept_avg_above_overall AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte1 WHERE avg_total_units > ( SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY WHERE TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subject_deviation AS ( SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.TOTAL_UNITS, d.avg_total_units, d.stddev_total_units, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - d.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte2 i JOIN dept_stats d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT sdev.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sdev.SUBJECT_ID, sdev.TOTAL_UNITS, sdev.avg_total_units, sdev.stddev_total_units, sdev.deviation_from_avg FROM subject_deviation sdev JOIN dept_avg_above_overall dao ON sdev.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dao.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sdev.stddev_total_units DESC, sdev.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sdev.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For IAP subjects in the "Mathematics" category, show the activity title, enrollment type, maximum enrollment, category name, activity description, and the row number within each enrollment type group ordered by activity title, along with the academic year, department name, average enrollment, enrollment variance, department phone number, and school name for each academic year and department where the IAP subject's term matches a department's fall term subject offering with more than 0 enrolled students. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column, d.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), subq1 AS ( SELECT inner_cte1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte1.MAX_ENROLLMENT, inner_cte1.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ACTIVITY_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte1.window_column, inner_cte1.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte1 JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d ON inner_cte1.ACTIVITY_TITLE = d.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND inner_cte1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), subq2 AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(inner_cte2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(inner_cte2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, inner_cte2.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte2 LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY inner_cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte2.TERM_CODE ) SELECT s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, s1.MAX_ENROLLMENT, s1.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, s1.ACTIVITY_DESCRIPTION, s1.window_column, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.avg_enrollment, s2.enrollment_variance, s2.department_phone, s2.school_name FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.TERM_CODE = s2.TERM_CODE ORDER BY s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each offering department name and school name where the number of enrolled students is greater than 2 and the department grants degrees and has at least one subject with a non-null subject code description, provide the count of distinct subject IDs, the minimum ISBN value for the associated course materials, the total number of course materials per department and school, the highest number of enrolled students in a single subject for that department, and the normalized materials per maximum enrollment (total number of course materials divided by the highest number of enrolled students in a single subject for that department, rounded to two decimal places). List the offering department name, school name, subject count, minimum ISBN, total materials, highest enrolled students, and normalized materials per max enrollment in that order.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(td.ISBN) AS min_isbn FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, i.subject_count, i.min_isbn, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_materials FROM inner_cte i JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND i.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, i.subject_count, i.min_isbn ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS highest_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY highest_enrolled_students DESC ) SELECT s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s1.subject_count, s1.min_isbn, s1.total_materials, s2.highest_enrolled_students, ROUND(s1.total_materials / NULLIF(s2.highest_enrolled_students, 0), 2) AS normalized_materials_per_max_enrollment FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY normalized_materials_per_max_enrollment DESC;

question: For each department that both offered subjects in the current SIS term and is a degree-granting department that offered subjects in the term '2016SP', list the department code, offering department name, subject title, responsible faculty name, term description, academic year description, total number of subjects offered per department in the current term, department name, number of subjects offered in 2016SP, and total units for those subjects in 2016SP. Include all columns in the order: department code, offering department name, subject title, responsible faculty name, term description, academic year description, total number of subjects offered per department in the current term, department name, number of subjects offered in 2016SP, and total units for those subjects in 2016SP. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM' ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, dept_counts.Total_Subjects, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS Total_Subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM' GROUP BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ) dept_counts ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_counts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = dept_counts.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t2.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), DeptSubjectSummary AS ( SELECT t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects, SUM(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' GROUP BY t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.num_subjects, dss.total_units FROM DeptSubjectSummary dss UNION ALL SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_CODE, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(dss.num_subjects) AS num_subjects, SUM(dss.total_units) AS total_units FROM DeptSubjectSummary dss GROUP BY dss.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT s1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.Total_Subjects, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.num_subjects, s2.total_units FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each employee type and department name where the student year is 'G', show the employee type, department name, number of people, minimum MIT ID, and the list of unique office locations for those employees, and label these rows as 'EmployeeTypeDept'. Also, for each of the top 10 departments with the highest number of unique students enrolled in degree-granting courses, show the department name, total number of unique students, minimum CIP program code among their courses, the most common course level in that department, and the count of students enrolled at that level, and label these rows as 'TopDept'. Present all columns in the following order: employee type, department name, number of people, minimum MIT ID, list of unique office locations, total number of unique students, minimum CIP program code, most common course level, count of students at that level, and the source label. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(sp.MIT_ID) AS person_count, MIN(sp.MIT_ID) AS min_mit_id FROM SE_PERSON sp JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.person_count, inner_cte.min_mit_id, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT sp.OFFICE_LOCATION) AS unique_office_locations FROM inner_cte JOIN SE_PERSON sp ON sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = inner_cte.EMPLOYEE_TYPE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY inner_cte.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.person_count, inner_cte.min_mit_id ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(ic.student_count) AS total_unique_students, MIN(ic.min_cip_code) AS min_cip_code, cc.Most_Common_Course_Level, cc.Level_Student_Count FROM ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(student_count) AS total_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_students DESC LIMIT 10 ) top_depts JOIN inner_cte ic ON top_depts.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ic2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic2.COURSE_LEVEL AS Most_Common_Course_Level, ic2.student_count AS Level_Student_Count FROM ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_LEVEL, student_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY student_count DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte ) ic2 WHERE ic2.rn = 1 ) cc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cc.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cc.Most_Common_Course_Level, cc.Level_Student_Count ORDER BY total_unique_students DESC LIMIT 10 ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT s1.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.person_count, s1.min_mit_id, s1.unique_office_locations, NULL AS total_unique_students, NULL AS min_cip_code, NULL AS Most_Common_Course_Level, NULL AS Level_Student_Count, 'EmployeeTypeDept' AS Source FROM Subquery1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS EMPLOYEE_TYPE, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS person_count, NULL AS min_mit_id, NULL AS unique_office_locations, s2.total_unique_students, s2.min_cip_code, s2.Most_Common_Course_Level, s2.Level_Student_Count, 'TopDept' AS Source FROM Subquery2 s2 ) SELECT EMPLOYEE_TYPE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, person_count, min_mit_id, unique_office_locations, total_unique_students, min_cip_code, Most_Common_Course_Level, Level_Student_Count, Source FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Source;

question: Show the department names, subject codes, subject titles, term descriptions, the total number of subjects offered per department, the building key, the floor key, and the total coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of rooms located on that floor (including grand totals per building), for subjects offered in the term with the description "Fall Term 2024-2025". Only include floors where the average room area is greater than zero, and for each building, include a grand total for all floors in the format of (building key, null, total coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP)). The columns should be listed in the following order: department name, subject code, subject title, term description, total number of subjects offered per department, building key, floor key, and total coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, dept_counts.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_CODE) AS Total_Subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS dept_counts ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT FCLT_FLOOR.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, FCLT_FLOOR.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, STDDEV(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA) / NULLIF(AVG(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM FCLT_FLOOR JOIN FCLT_ROOMS ON FCLT_FLOOR.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY = FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY GROUP BY FCLT_FLOOR.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, FCLT_FLOOR.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY HAVING AVG(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA) > 0 ) SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, SUM(coefficient_of_variation) AS total_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, FCLT_FLOOR_KEY WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(coefficient_of_variation) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, FCLT_FLOOR_KEY ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.Total_Subjects, s2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, s2.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, s2.total_coefficient_of_variation FROM Subquery1 s1 LEFT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON s1.SUBJECT_CODE = cso.SUBJECT_CODE AND s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON cso.MEET_PLACE = fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY LEFT JOIN FCLT_FLOOR ff ON fr.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY = ff.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY LEFT JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = s2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND (ff.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY = s2.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY OR s2.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY IS NULL)

question: For each department that grants degrees and offered subjects in the term '2016SP', and is also among the top 5 offering departments in the 'Engineering' school with the most 12-unit courses, list the department code, department name, the number of subjects offered, the total units for those subjects, the offering department name, the number of qualifying 12-unit courses, and the course number and description of the most recently added 12-unit course in each department. For each department, also include a grand total row for the number of subjects and total units in the format (department code, null, total subjects, total units, ...). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t2.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), DeptSubjectSummary AS ( SELECT t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects, SUM(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' GROUP BY t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptSummaryWithName AS ( SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.num_subjects, dss.total_units FROM DeptSubjectSummary dss UNION ALL SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_CODE, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(dss.num_subjects) AS num_subjects, SUM(dss.total_units) AS total_units FROM DeptSubjectSummary dss GROUP BY dss.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE AS course_number, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t0.LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), TopDepts AS ( SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS num_courses, ic_recent.course_number AS most_recent_course_number, ic_recent.COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS most_recent_course_description FROM inner_cte2 ic JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_CODE, course_number, COURSE_DESCRIPTION, LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte2 ) ic_recent ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = ic_recent.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND ic.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = ic_recent.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND ic_recent.rn = 1 GROUP BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, ic_recent.course_number, ic_recent.COURSE_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY num_courses DESC LIMIT 5 ) SELECT dsw.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dsw.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dsw.num_subjects, dsw.total_units, td.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, td.num_courses, td.most_recent_course_number, td.most_recent_course_description FROM DeptSummaryWithName dsw JOIN TopDepts td ON dsw.DEPARTMENT_CODE = td.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY dsw.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dsw.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each administrative department in the School of Engineering, provide the administrative department name, the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering, the average number of enrolled students per administrative department as a benchmark, the enrollment category (categorized as 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' if its total is at least 10% greater than the average, 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' if its total is at least 10% less than the average, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise), the department name, the total number of tip materials offered for subjects during regular terms (where the total is greater than 10), and the average number of units for those subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH admin_enrollment_cte AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100 ), benchmark_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(total_enrolled) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_enrolled, b.avg_enrollment, CASE WHEN i.total_enrolled > b.avg_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.total_enrolled < b.avg_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN benchmark_cte b ), dept_tip_cte AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL t JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) > 10 ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_tip_materials, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_tip_materials ) SELECT a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.total_enrolled, a.avg_enrollment, a.enrollment_category, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.total_tip_materials, d.avg_units FROM admin_enrollment_cte a JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN dept_tip_cte d ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY a.total_enrolled DESC, d.total_tip_materials DESC;

question: For each department, for each subject offered in the academic year 2024 that has at least one associated course material, list the department name, subject code, subject number, subject title, term code, term description, the highest minimum total units (in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by academic year), the number of enrolled students, the total number of subjects per department with at least one associated course material, the ratio of highest minimum total units to total number of such subjects (rounded), and the ratio of enrolled students to highest minimum total units (rounded).
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(t0.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, MAX(window_column) AS highest_min_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, dept_totals.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_TITLE) AS Total_Subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) dept_totals ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_totals.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY dept_totals.Total_Subjects DESC, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.highest_min_total_units, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.Total_Subjects, ROUND(s1.highest_min_total_units / NULLIF(s2.Total_Subjects, 0), 2) AS units_per_subject_with_material, ROUND(s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS / NULLIF(s1.highest_min_total_units, 0), 2) AS enrolled_per_unit FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND s1.SUBJECT_TITLE = s2.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY units_per_subject_with_material DESC, enrolled_per_unit DESC, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each academic year and department, what is the academic year, academic year description, department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for all library reserve materials offered in terms that have a material status of 'U', the school name (for Engineering school departments with subjects having total units greater than 1), and the total minimum units in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by academic year? For each academic year, also include a grand total across all departments in the format of (academic year, academic year description, null, total coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), null, null). For each school and department, include a grand total for all minimum total units in the format of (null, null, department name, null, school name, total minimum units). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE AND LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY s JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ata.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON s.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 1 ), DeptWindowRollup AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, window_column FROM inner_cte ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, SUM(window_column) AS total_min_units FROM DeptWindowRollup GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(window_column) > 0 ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, total_min_units FROM RollupResults ) SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.coefficient_of_variation, s2.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.total_min_units FROM subq1 s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.SCHOOL_NAME

question: For each department, provide the department name, the maximum, minimum, and average of the range of total units for subjects offered by that department in each term (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and offered in the 'Engineering' school), and the highest maximum enrollment among IAP activities in 2021 that were not cancelled and were associated with subjects offered by that department. List the department name, max range across terms, min range across terms, avg range across terms, and highest max enrollment in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
