SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE ), DepartmentUnitsRange AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(total_units_range) AS max_range_across_terms, MIN(total_units_range) AS min_range_across_terms, AVG(total_units_range) AS avg_range_across_terms FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS math_iap_activities_2021 FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2021 AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), DepartmentIAPMaxEnroll AS ( SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS highest_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2021 AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dur.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dur.max_range_across_terms, dur.min_range_across_terms, dur.avg_range_across_terms, diae.highest_max_enrollment FROM DepartmentUnitsRange dur JOIN DepartmentIAPMaxEnroll diae ON dur.DEPARTMENT_NAME = diae.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dur.max_range_across_terms DESC, diae.highest_max_enrollment DESC;

question: For each subject category that had at least 5 activities in the 2021JA term, show the subject category key, the category name, the number of activities, the total maximum enrollment across those activities, classify the category as 'HIGH_CAPACITY' if its total maximum enrollment is at least 20% greater than the average total maximum enrollment across all qualifying categories, 'LOW_CAPACITY' if at least 20% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise, and also provide the average and variance of the maximum enrollment across all activities in that category, as well as the difference between the average and the variance, ordering the results by the difference in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS activity_count, SUM(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS total_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d ON c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE d.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' GROUP BY c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME HAVING COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) >= 5 ), avg_enrollment AS ( SELECT AVG(total_max_enrollment) AS avg_total_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte1 ), subq1 AS ( SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, i.activity_count, i.total_max_enrollment, CASE WHEN i.total_max_enrollment > a.avg_total_max_enrollment * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_CAPACITY' WHEN i.total_max_enrollment < a.avg_total_max_enrollment * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_CAPACITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS capacity_category FROM inner_cte1 i CROSS JOIN avg_enrollment a ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, AVG(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, VARIANCE(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS var_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d ON c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ), subq2 AS ( SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, i.avg_max_enrollment, i.var_max_enrollment, (i.avg_max_enrollment - i.var_max_enrollment) AS avg_minus_var FROM inner_cte2 i ) SELECT s1.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, s1.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, s1.activity_count, s1.total_max_enrollment, s1.capacity_category, s2.avg_max_enrollment, s2.var_max_enrollment, s2.avg_minus_var FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = s2.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY ORDER BY s2.avg_minus_var DESC;

question: For all subjects in the 2014FA term with at least one enrolled student, show the subject title, offering department name, responsible faculty name, the TIP material status key, the total number of units, and the maximum total number of units in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows ordered by the course number, along with the highest number of students enrolled in any subject in 2022 for the same department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS DEPT_NAME_JOIN FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), cte1 AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TOTAL_UNITS, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_units_window, DEPT_NAME_JOIN FROM inner_cte1 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS engineering_subjects_2022 FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ss.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ss.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 ), cte2 AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ss.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ss.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE, cte1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cte1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, cte1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, cte1.TOTAL_UNITS, cte1.max_units_window, cte2.max_enrollment FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.DEPT_NAME_JOIN = cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department name and school name where the number of enrolled students in the offered subject is greater than 3, show the number of offered subjects, the minimum number of enrolled students, and the subject title with the highest number of enrolled students in that department and school, along with, for each subject offered by that department in the term with code '2025FA', the subject ID, subject title, offering department name, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, term start date, term end date, term parameter, and whether the number of enrolled students is 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% greater than the average for that department), 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% less than the average for that department), or 'AVERAGE', ordered by department name and subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS offered_subject_count, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.offered_subject_count, ic.min_enrolled_students, ls.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_with_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC) AS rn FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 ) ls ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ls.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.SCHOOL_NAME = ls.SCHOOL_NAME AND ls.rn = 1 ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE TERM_CODE = '2025FA' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.TERM_START_DATE, i.TERM_END_DATE, i.TERM_PARAMETER, CASE WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > d.avg_enrolled * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < d.avg_enrolled * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.offered_subject_count, s1.min_enrolled_students, s1.subject_with_max_enrollment, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.TERM_START_DATE, s2.TERM_END_DATE, s2.TERM_PARAMETER, s2.enrollment_category FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each department, course number, and offering school name where the number of enrolled students in the subject summary is greater than 2, and for all subject offerings in the academic term with term code '2017FA', provide the department name, course number, offering school name, the number of unique library subjects offered, the minimum total units for those subjects, the subject title, the term description, the number of enrolled students, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title. For each department, course number, and offering school name, include a grand total for all subjects in the format of (department, course number, null, total subjects, min total units, ...). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ), SubjectSummaryByDeptCourseSchool AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COURSE_NUMBER, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(subject_count) AS total_subjects, MIN(min_total_units) AS min_total_units FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COURSE_NUMBER, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(subject_count) > 0 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON s.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' ), SubjectOfferings2017FA AS ( SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.window_column FROM inner_cte2 i JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON i.SUBJECT_TITLE = s.SUBJECT_TITLE AND i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND i.TERM_DESCRIPTION = (SELECT TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS WHERE TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE) WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' ) SELECT sbdcs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sbdcs.COURSE_NUMBER, sbdcs.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, sbdcs.total_subjects, sbdcs.min_total_units, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, so.TERM_DESCRIPTION, so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, so.window_column FROM SubjectSummaryByDeptCourseSchool sbdcs JOIN SubjectOfferings2017FA so ON sbdcs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY sbdcs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sbdcs.COURSE_NUMBER, sbdcs.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, so.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering with a total of at least 6 units, show the subject code, subject title, department name, and the running sum of total units within each grade type (only including those subjects where the running sum exceeds 12 units within their grade type), and for each such subject that also has at least one enrolled student, show the maximum number of enrolled students, the term code from the library subject offered table, the tip material status key, and the total units from the subject offered summary. Order the results by subject code and then by the maximum number of enrolled students in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ) SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > 12 ORDER BY SUBJECT_CODE ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.TERM_CODE, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID INNER JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled_students, TERM_CODE, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_CODE, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TOTAL_UNITS ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.max_enrolled_students, s2.TERM_CODE, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2.TOTAL_UNITS FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_TITLE = s2.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.max_enrolled_students DESC

question: For IAP subject activities with a maximum enrollment of at least 10 and that are not cancelled, and that belong to the top 5 subject categories and enrollment types with the highest number of activities (where the maximum enrollment is greater than 10), show the activity title, enrollment type, the academic term description, the subject title from the course catalog, the department name, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by activity title, the number of activities in the category and enrollment type, the earliest start date of the corresponding academic term, and the activity title that appears most frequently in each group along with its count. List the results ordered by the number of activities in descending order and then by activity title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 10 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' ) SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY FROM inner_cte ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS activity_count, MIN(t.START_DATE) AS earliest_start_date FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN TIME_DAY t ON d.TERM_CODE = t.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ) SELECT ic.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, ic.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, ic.activity_count, ic.earliest_start_date, ac.Most_Common_Activity_Title, ac.Activity_Title_Count FROM (SELECT * FROM inner_cte ORDER BY activity_count DESC LIMIT 5) ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.ACTIVITY_TITLE AS Most_Common_Activity_Title, COUNT(*) AS Activity_Title_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.ACTIVITY_TITLE ) ac ON ic.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = ac.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY AND ic.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = ac.ENROLLMENT_TYPE AND ac.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.activity_count DESC ) SELECT s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.activity_count, s2.earliest_start_date, s2.Most_Common_Activity_Title, s2.Activity_Title_Count FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = s2.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY AND s1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = s2.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY s2.activity_count DESC, s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE;

question: For each IAP subject activity with a maximum enrollment of at least 20 and that is not cancelled, list the activity title, enrollment type, academic year description, term start date, and the total number of IAP subject activities per academic year, along with the subject category name, sponsor key, average fee, and total number of activities for each sponsor and category where the enrollment type matches and the maximum enrollment is greater than 10. The columns should be shown in the following order: activity title, enrollment type, academic year description, term start date, total number of IAP subject activities per academic year, subject category name, sponsor key, average fee, and total number of activities for each sponsor. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH ActivityStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t2.TERM_START_DATE, t0.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' ) SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, Activity_Counts.Total_Activities FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS Total_Activities FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' GROUP BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) AS Activity_Counts ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = Activity_Counts.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), CategorySponsorStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS activity_count, MIN(d.FEE) AS min_fee FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ) SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, AVG(d.FEE) AS avg_fee, COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS total_activities, d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY ) SELECT a.ACTIVITY_TITLE, a.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, a.TERM_START_DATE, a.Total_Activities, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, c.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, c.avg_fee, c.total_activities FROM ActivityStats a JOIN CategorySponsorStats c ON a.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY AND a.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = c.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, a.ACTIVITY_TITLE, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, c.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY

question: For each course in the SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION table with a department code of 6, show the course, course description, department name, school name, program code, program title, category code, category title, four digit code, four digit title, and the minimum warehouse load date from the CIP table over each category code group, as well as the total number of courses in that school (with a grand total row for each school name). Additionally, for each department name, include the highest variance of the total units of subjects offered in any academic year, matching by department name. Present the results ordered by school name, category code, and course. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), Subquery1 AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(total_units_variance) AS highest_units_variance FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY highest_units_variance DESC ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.PROGRAM_CODE, c.PROGRAM_TITLE, c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY c.CATEGORY_CODE) AS min_warehouse_load_date FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION s JOIN CIP c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT = 6 ), SchoolTotals AS ( SELECT NULL AS COURSE, NULL AS COURSE_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS PROGRAM_CODE, NULL AS PROGRAM_TITLE, NULL AS CATEGORY_CODE, NULL AS CATEGORY_TITLE, NULL AS FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, NULL AS FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, NULL AS min_warehouse_load_date, COUNT(*) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT i.COURSE, i.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.PROGRAM_CODE, i.PROGRAM_TITLE, i.CATEGORY_CODE, i.CATEGORY_TITLE, i.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, i.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, i.min_warehouse_load_date, NULL AS total_courses FROM inner_cte2 i UNION ALL SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.PROGRAM_CODE, s.PROGRAM_TITLE, s.CATEGORY_CODE, s.CATEGORY_TITLE, s.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, s.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, s.min_warehouse_load_date, s.total_courses FROM SchoolTotals s ) SELECT s2.COURSE, s2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.PROGRAM_CODE, s2.PROGRAM_TITLE, s2.CATEGORY_CODE, s2.CATEGORY_TITLE, s2.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, s2.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, s2.min_warehouse_load_date, s2.total_courses, s1.highest_units_variance FROM Subquery2 s2 LEFT JOIN Subquery1 s1 ON s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s2.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.CATEGORY_CODE, s2.COURSE

question: For each subject category name and enrollment type where the maximum enrollment is greater than 10 and the highest maximum enrollment among its activities is greater than 20, what is the average fee, the total number of activities for each sponsor, and the highest maximum enrollment for the category? List the subject category name, enrollment type, sponsor key, average fee, total number of activities, and highest maximum enrollment, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS activity_count, MIN(d.FEE) AS min_fee FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ) SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, AVG(d.FEE) AS avg_fee, COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS total_activities FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY ) SELECT IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, MAX(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS highest_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ) SELECT s1.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, s1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, s1.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, s1.avg_fee, s1.total_activities, s2.highest_max_enrollment FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = s2.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME WHERE s2.highest_max_enrollment > 20 ORDER BY s1.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, s1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, s1.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY

question: For each combination of IAP category and top 10 subject titles by number of materials offered in regular academic terms, list the category name, the highest maximum enrollment among its activities, the subject title, the department name, the total count of materials, and the academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH CategoryMaxEnrollment AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY ) SELECT IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, MAX(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS highest_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ), TopSubjectsByMaterials AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON td.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND td.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.material_count, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.material_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT cme.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, cme.highest_max_enrollment, tsbm.SUBJECT_TITLE, tsbm.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tsbm.material_count, tsbm.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM CategoryMaxEnrollment cme CROSS JOIN TopSubjectsByMaterials tsbm;

question: For each department in the School of Engineering, what is the minimum number of enrolled students in any subject, the total number of material records for subjects in that department with a TIP material status of 'RQ', the subject code, the subject title, and the geometric mean of the total units for subjects offered by that department where the total units are greater than zero? Also, provide a grand total for the entire School of Engineering in the format (null, min_enrolled, total_material_records, ...). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled, SUM(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_material_records FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(min_enrolled) AS min_enrolled, SUM(total_material_records) AS total_material_records FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME WITH ROLLUP ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, EXP(AVG(LN(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC ) SELECT s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.min_enrolled, s1.total_material_records, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.geometric_mean_total_units FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.geometric_mean_total_units DESC

question: For each subject offered in the academic term with term code '2006FA' that is also offered by departments in the School of Engineering, show the subject ID, subject title, department name, the sum of lecture units within each grade type group ordered by subject ID, the name of the responsible faculty member for each subject, the total units, the department full name, and the difference between the total units of each subject and the average total units for that department, ordered by subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(t1.LECTURE_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TOTAL_UNITS, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - d.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_dept_avg FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s2.TOTAL_UNITS, s2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s2.deviation_from_dept_avg FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_TITLE = s2.SUBJECT_TITLE AND s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each library material status and term code, list the library material status, term code, the number of reserve catalog items associated with it, the department name for each subject offered in that term, and the highest average total units for subjects ever offered by that department in a regular academic term. Show the library material status, term code, reserve catalog item count, department name, and highest average total units, ordered by library material status, term code, and department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH MaterialStatusReserveCounts AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, lrmd.TERM_CODE, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserve_count FROM LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS lms JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY GROUP BY lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, lrmd.TERM_CODE ) SELECT LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, TERM_CODE, SUM(reserve_count) AS reserve_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, TERM_CODE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(reserve_count) > 0 ORDER BY LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, TERM_CODE ), DepartmentHighestAvgUnits AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.TERM_CODE, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.TERM_CODE ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(avg_total_units) AS highest_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY highest_avg_total_units DESC ) SELECT msr.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, msr.TERM_CODE, msr.reserve_count, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dhu.highest_avg_total_units FROM MaterialStatusReserveCounts msr LEFT JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON msr.TERM_CODE = lrmd.TERM_CODE LEFT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON lrmd.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID AND lrmd.TERM_CODE = cso.TERM_CODE LEFT JOIN DepartmentHighestAvgUnits dhu ON cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dhu.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE msr.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL ORDER BY msr.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, msr.TERM_CODE, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each space unit with a space unit code equal to 97500, show the space unit name, the average and variance of the HR organization unit IDs associated with it, the most common HR department name among those units, the count of units in that department, the associated organization's name, the DLC name, the DLC key from the organization, the minimum space unit code in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the facility organization key, and the total number of space units for each organization. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, AVG(hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS avg_org_unit_id, VARIANCE(hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS org_unit_id_variance FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT ) SELECT icte.SPACE_UNIT, icte.avg_org_unit_id, icte.org_unit_id_variance, dept_stats.Most_Common_HR_Department, dept_stats.Department_Unit_Count FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Most_Common_HR_Department, COUNT(*) AS Department_Unit_Count FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID IS NOT NULL AND hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) dept_stats ON icte.SPACE_UNIT = dept_stats.SPACE_UNIT AND dept_stats.Department_Unit_Count = ( SELECT MAX(sub_dept_stats.Department_Unit_Count) FROM ( SELECT su2.SPACE_UNIT, hou2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Department_Unit_Count FROM SPACE_UNIT su2 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo2 ON su2.DLC_KEY = fo2.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou2 ON fo2.DLC_KEY = hou2.DLC_KEY WHERE hou2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID IS NOT NULL AND hou2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY su2.SPACE_UNIT, hou2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) sub_dept_stats WHERE sub_dept_stats.SPACE_UNIT = dept_stats.SPACE_UNIT ) ORDER BY icte.org_unit_id_variance DESC ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS organization_name, t1.DLC_NAME AS dlc_name, t1.DLC_KEY AS org_dlc_key, MIN(t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_min_space_unit_code, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 97500 ) SELECT inner_cte.space_unit_name, inner_cte.organization_name, inner_cte.dlc_name, inner_cte.org_dlc_key, inner_cte.window_min_space_unit_code, COUNT(su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS total_space_units_for_org, inner_cte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM inner_cte JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON inner_cte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY GROUP BY inner_cte.space_unit_name, inner_cte.organization_name, inner_cte.dlc_name, inner_cte.org_dlc_key, inner_cte.window_min_space_unit_code, inner_cte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) SELECT s1.SPACE_UNIT, s1.avg_org_unit_id, s1.org_unit_id_variance, s1.Most_Common_HR_Department, s1.Department_Unit_Count, s2.organization_name, s2.dlc_name, s2.org_dlc_key, s2.window_min_space_unit_code, s2.total_space_units_for_org FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.SPACE_UNIT = s2.space_unit_name

question: For rooms with an area greater than 300 and access level equal to 1, and for each organization and its associated space unit where the organization is assignable and the space unit code is greater than 50000, show the building-room identifier, the room's major use description, the organization name, the total number of such rooms per organization, the organization, the space unit, the number of distinct space units, the minimum organization number, and the total number of organizations that share the same DLC key as the space unit, for cases where the room's organization and the space unit's organization share the same DLC key. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.MAJOR_USE_DESC, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 300 AND t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 ) SELECT inner_cte.BUILDING_ROOM, inner_cte.MAJOR_USE_DESC, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, org_counts.Total_Rooms, inner_cte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT BUILDING_ROOM) AS Total_Rooms FROM ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 300 AND t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 ) sub GROUP BY ORGANIZATION_NAME ) org_counts ON inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = org_counts.ORGANIZATION_NAME ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION, su.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(DISTINCT su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS space_unit_count, MIN(fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_org_number, su.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fodk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON fodk.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY WHERE fo.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE > 50000 GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION, su.SPACE_UNIT, su.DLC_KEY ) SELECT ic.ORGANIZATION, ic.SPACE_UNIT, ic.space_unit_count, ic.min_org_number, d.org_count, ic.DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT DLC_KEY, COUNT(DISTINCT ORGANIZATION) AS org_count FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION GROUP BY DLC_KEY ) d ON ic.DLC_KEY = d.DLC_KEY ) SELECT s1.BUILDING_ROOM, s1.MAJOR_USE_DESC, s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s1.Total_Rooms, s2.ORGANIZATION, s2.SPACE_UNIT, s2.space_unit_count, s2.min_org_number, s2.org_count FROM subq1 s1 JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fodk ON s1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fodk.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN subq2 s2 ON fodk.DLC_KEY = s2.DLC_KEY;

question: For each space unit code, show the building room, floor, space usage, space unit code, space unit name, and the average floor within each space unit code group for rooms with an access level of 1, including a grand total average floor for all rooms in that space unit code group (with null building room, null floor, and null space usage). Additionally, for each result, include the department name, the minimum organization level, and the total number of assignable organizations for each department under the 'Provost Area' in the department hierarchy, if available. The columns should be: building room, floor, space usage, space unit code, space unit name, average floor, department name, minimum organization level, and total assignable organizations. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.SPACE_UNIT, AVG(t1.FLOOR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ORDER BY t1.FLOOR) AS avg_floor FROM SPACE_UNIT t0 JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t1 ON t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT SPACE_UNIT_CODE, SPACE_UNIT, BUILDING_ROOM, FLOOR, SPACE_USAGE, AVG(avg_floor) AS avg_floor FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY SPACE_UNIT_CODE, SPACE_UNIT, BUILDING_ROOM, FLOOR, SPACE_USAGE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SPACE_UNIT_CODE IS NOT NULL ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT MIN(f.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) AS min_org_level, SUM(f.ASSIGNABLE) AS total_assignable, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON h.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME ) SELECT r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.FLOOR, r.SPACE_USAGE, r.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, r.SPACE_UNIT, r.avg_floor, d.department_name, d.min_org_level, d.total_assignable FROM RollupResults r LEFT JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON r.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE LEFT JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY LEFT JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON fo.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY LEFT JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m ON h.DLC_KEY = m.DLC_KEY LEFT JOIN ( SELECT i.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME AS department_name, i.min_org_level, i.total_assignable FROM inner_cte2 i ) d ON m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME = d.department_name ORDER BY r.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.FLOOR, d.department_name

question: For each department in the Engineering school in the current academic term where the maximum subject enrollment number is greater than 5, what are the department name, school name, term start date, total maximum subject enrollment, subject ID, subject title, academic year, the rank of each subject within its academic year group ordered by subject ID, and the total number of subjects per department for subjects with total units equal to 1? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_enrollment, at.TERM_START_DATE, ss.SCHOOL_NAME FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_START_DATE, ss.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 5 ), cte1 AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, TERM_START_DATE, SUM(max_enrollment) AS total_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, TERM_START_DATE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(max_enrollment) > 0 ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 1 ), cte2 AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte2.window_column, dept_counts.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte2 JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS Total_Subjects FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY WHERE SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND TOTAL_UNITS = 1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS dept_counts ON inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1.SCHOOL_NAME, cte1.TERM_START_DATE, cte1.total_max_enrollment, cte2.SUBJECT_ID, cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE, cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cte2.window_column, cte2.Total_Subjects FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND cte1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' WHERE cte1.total_max_enrollment > 5 ORDER BY cte1.SCHOOL_NAME, cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cte2.window_column;

question: For each subject offered in the Fall term of 2022 within the 5 departments that offer the largest number of unique subjects this year, show the subject title, department name, term code, academic year, the average academic year within each academic year group ordered by term start date, the department code, number of unique subjects, average total units of their offered subjects, and a status indicating whether the department's average total units is 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' (at least 10% higher than the overall average), 'BELOW_AVERAGE' (at least 10% lower), or 'AVERAGE' (otherwise). Additionally, for each of these departments, include a grand total of the average academic year for all subjects in that department in the format of (null subject title, department name, null term code, academic year, total average academic year, department code, number of unique subjects, average total units, unit status). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.TERM_CODE, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY a.TERM_START_DATE) AS avg_academic_year FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON ata.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON a.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE WHERE a.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ), DepartmentRollup1 AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(avg_academic_year) AS total_avg_academic_year FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR WITH ROLLUP HAVING DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL ), cte1_final AS ( SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.TERM_CODE, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.avg_academic_year FROM inner_cte1 i UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS TERM_CODE, d.ACADEMIC_YEAR, d.total_avg_academic_year AS avg_academic_year FROM DepartmentRollup1 d ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY num_subjects DESC LIMIT 5 ), dept_avg_units AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), overall_avg AS ( SELECT AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS overall_avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' ), cte2_final AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.num_subjects, dau.avg_total_units, CASE WHEN dau.avg_total_units > oa.overall_avg_total_units * 1.1 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN dau.avg_total_units < oa.overall_avg_total_units * 0.9 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_status FROM inner_cte2 ic JOIN dept_avg_units dau ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dau.DEPARTMENT_CODE CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa ) SELECT cte1_final.SUBJECT_TITLE, cte1_final.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1_final.TERM_CODE, cte1_final.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cte1_final.avg_academic_year, cte2_final.DEPARTMENT_CODE, cte2_final.num_subjects, cte2_final.avg_total_units, cte2_final.unit_status FROM cte1_final JOIN cte2_final ON cte1_final.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cte2_final.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cte1_final.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1_final.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cte1_final.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For each department whose name starts with 'D' (case insensitive), has an average assigned room area of at least 100, and is at the 'DEPARTMENTS' organization unit level in the 'Standard Hierarchy', show the department long name, department hierarchy level 3 name, number of unique facility organization keys, minimum organization unit ID, department code, department name, and the geometric mean of the area of rooms assigned to employees in that department (considering only rooms with area greater than 0). List the results ordered by department long name and geometric mean of room area (descending). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptRoomGeomMean AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ed.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(fr.AREA))) AS geometric_mean_area, AVG(fr.AREA) AS avg_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY ed ON fr.BUILDING_ROOM = ed.OFFICE_LOCATION WHERE fr.AREA > 0 GROUP BY ed.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.geometric_mean_area FROM inner_cte ic WHERE UPPER(ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME) LIKE 'D%' AND ic.avg_area >= 100 ORDER BY ic.geometric_mean_area DESC ), DeptHierarchyStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS min_org_unit_id FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m ON f.DLC_KEY = m.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY WHERE m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS' GROUP BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, inner_cte.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, inner_cte.org_count, inner_cte.min_org_unit_id, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG AND h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS' ) SELECT dh.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, dh.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, dh.org_count, dh.min_org_unit_id, dh.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, dh.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, drgm.geometric_mean_area FROM DeptHierarchyStats dh JOIN DeptRoomGeomMean drgm ON dh.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = drgm.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dh.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, drgm.geometric_mean_area DESC;

question: For subjects offered in the term with code '2025FA', show the subject ID, subject title, offering department name, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, term start date, term end date, term parameter, the difference between the number of enrolled students for each subject and the minimum number of enrolled students in its offering department, the total units for the subject, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for subjects in the department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and at least 1 enrolled student), and the deviation of the subject's total units from the department's average, ordered by offering department and subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ) SELECT SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_START_DATE, TERM_END_DATE, TERM_PARAMETER, (NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS - min_enrolled_students_per_dept) AS deviation_from_min_enrolled FROM inner_cte ORDER BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.TOTAL_UNITS, d.avg_total_units, d.stddev_total_units, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - d.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_stats d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d.stddev_total_units DESC, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.TERM_START_DATE, s1.TERM_END_DATE, s1.TERM_PARAMETER, s1.deviation_from_min_enrolled, s2.TOTAL_UNITS, s2.avg_total_units, s2.stddev_total_units, s2.deviation_from_avg FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each degree-granting department and subject code, provide the department name, subject code, the number of subject codes, the minimum department budget code, the full department name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses offered by that department (considering only courses that have at least one associated TIP material), and the total number of such courses per department. List the results ordered by department name and subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE ), DegreeGrantingDeptSubjects AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.subject_code_count, ic.min_dept_budget_code, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte1 ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL ), DeptCourseStats AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.department, VARIANCE(inner_cte2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS num_enrolled_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS num_enrolled_stddev, COUNT(*) AS total_courses_with_tip_material FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY inner_cte2.department ) SELECT dds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dds.SUBJECT_CODE, dds.subject_code_count, dds.min_dept_budget_code, dds.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, dcs.num_enrolled_variance, dcs.num_enrolled_stddev, dcs.total_courses_with_tip_material FROM DegreeGrantingDeptSubjects dds JOIN DeptCourseStats dcs ON dds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dcs.department ORDER BY dds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dds.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For each department, list the top 5 subject titles with the highest number of reserve materials assigned in the most recent term, including the department name, term code, subject title, and the number of reserve materials. For each such department, also provide, for every course number and offering school name where the number of enrolled students in the subject summary is greater than 2, the total number of unique library subjects offered and the minimum total units for those subjects, grouped by the offering school name. Present the results as department name, term code, subject title, number of reserve materials, course number, offering school name, total subjects, and minimum total units, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH TopSubjectsByDept AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_reserve_materials FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.TERM_CODE, ic.num_reserve_materials FROM ( SELECT inner_cte.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.num_reserve_materials DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.TERM_CODE = (SELECT MAX(TERM_CODE) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED) ) ic WHERE ic.rn <= 5 ORDER BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.num_reserve_materials DESC ), DeptCourseSubjectStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COURSE_NUMBER, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(subject_count) AS total_subjects, MIN(min_total_units) AS min_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COURSE_NUMBER, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(subject_count) > 0 ORDER BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COURSE_NUMBER, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT tsbd.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tsbd.TERM_CODE, tsbd.SUBJECT_TITLE, tsbd.num_reserve_materials, dcss.COURSE_NUMBER, dcss.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, dcss.total_subjects, dcss.min_total_units FROM TopSubjectsByDept tsbd JOIN DeptCourseSubjectStats dcss ON tsbd.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dcss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY tsbd.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tsbd.num_reserve_materials DESC, dcss.COURSE_NUMBER, dcss.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME

question: For each department, list the top 5 subject titles with the highest number of reserve materials assigned in the most recent term, including the department name, term code, subject title, and the number of reserve materials, and for each department also provide the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of course materials per subject offered by that department in the term 2017SP, as well as whether the department is classified as 'HIGH_MATERIAL_VARIANCE', 'LOW_MATERIAL_VARIANCE', or 'AVERAGE', showing the columns in the following order: department name, term code, subject title, number of reserve materials, material count range, material count variance, material count standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and variance category. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_reserve_materials FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE ), TopSubjects AS ( SELECT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.TERM_CODE, ic.num_reserve_materials FROM ( SELECT inner_cte1.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inner_cte1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte1.num_reserve_materials DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte1 WHERE inner_cte1.TERM_CODE = (SELECT MAX(TERM_CODE) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED) ) ic WHERE ic.rn <= 5 ORDER BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.num_reserve_materials DESC ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(material_count) - MIN(material_count) AS material_count_range, VARIANCE(material_count) AS material_count_variance, STDDEV(material_count) AS material_count_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ( SELECT TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM TIP_DETAIL WHERE TERM_CODE = '2017SP' GROUP BY TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ) AS detail_stats ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = detail_stats.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = '2017SP' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), DeptMaterialVariance AS ( SELECT i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.material_count_range, i.material_count_variance, i.material_count_stddev, CASE WHEN i.material_count_variance > s.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_MATERIAL_VARIANCE' WHEN i.material_count_variance < s.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_MATERIAL_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte2 i CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(material_count_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte2) s ORDER BY i.material_count_range DESC ) SELECT ts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ts.TERM_CODE, ts.SUBJECT_TITLE, ts.num_reserve_materials, dmv.material_count_range, dmv.material_count_variance, dmv.material_count_stddev, dmv.variance_category FROM TopSubjects ts JOIN DeptMaterialVariance dmv ON ts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dmv.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY ts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ts.num_reserve_materials DESC;

question: For all subjects in the 2014FA term with at least one enrolled student, show the subject title, offering department name, responsible faculty name, the TIP material status key, the total number of units, and the minimum total number of units in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the course number, along with the cluster type description and the HGN code description for each subject. Additionally, for each subject's offering department, show the school name, department name, the total number of unique subject codes, and the minimum department budget code for degree-granting departments, including grand totals for each school where department is null. The columns should be shown in the following order: subject title, offering department name, responsible faculty name, TIP material status key, total number of units, windowed minimum total units, cluster type description, HGN code description, school name, department name, total subject codes, and minimum department budget code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, sos.SUBJECT_ID, lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), cte1 AS ( SELECT inner_cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, inner_cte1.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte1.window_column, sos.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC, sos.HGN_CODE_DESC, inner_cte1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM inner_cte1 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON inner_cte1.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(subject_code_count) AS total_subject_codes, MIN(min_dept_budget_code) AS min_dept_budget_code, DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(subject_code_count) > 0 ), cte2 AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_subject_codes, min_dept_budget_code, DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM RollupResults ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE, cte1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cte1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, cte1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, cte1.TOTAL_UNITS, cte1.window_column, cte1.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC, cte1.HGN_CODE_DESC, cte2.SCHOOL_NAME, cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte2.total_subject_codes, cte2.min_dept_budget_code FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE, cte2.SCHOOL_NAME, cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each department, list the department code, department name, and either (a) the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (only including departments where the range of total units is greater than the average range across all departments, considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and offered in the 'Engineering' school), or (b) the number of subjects offered by the department, the minimum number of enrolled students in any subject, and the total number of units for all such subjects (for subjects offered by degree-granting departments in the School of Engineering this year). For each row, include a column indicating the reason for inclusion ('UnitsStats' for the first case, 'SubjectStats' for the second). The columns should be: department code, department name, total units range, total units variance, total units standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), number of subjects offered, minimum enrolled students, total units, and reason. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptUnitsStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.DEPARTMENT AS DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.DEPARTMENT ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, total_units_range, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE total_units_range > (SELECT AVG(total_units_range) FROM inner_cte) ), DeptSubjectStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students, SUM(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' ) SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_offered, inner_cte.min_enrolled_students, inner_cte.total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE CROSS JOIN inner_cte WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.min_enrolled_students, inner_cte.total_units ), CombinedDeptStats AS ( SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev, NULL AS num_subjects_offered, NULL AS min_enrolled_students, NULL AS total_units, 'UnitsStats' AS Reason FROM DeptUnitsStats dus UNION ALL SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS total_units_range, NULL AS total_units_variance, NULL AS total_units_stddev, dss.num_subjects_offered, dss.min_enrolled_students, dss.total_units, 'SubjectStats' AS Reason FROM DeptSubjectStats dss ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_units_range, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev, num_subjects_offered, min_enrolled_students, total_units, Reason FROM CombinedDeptStats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Reason;

question: For each department in the "Provost Area", show the department code, department name, school area name, the rank of each department within its school area based on department code, the corresponding DLC name from the HR_ORG_UNIT table, and, for rooms assigned to it with area greater than 40 and above the department's average (for rooms with area > 40), show the building-room identifier and the room area. List the results ordered by department name and descending room area. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.AREA, o.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 40 ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(AREA) AS avg_area FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ), rooms_above_avg AS ( SELECT i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.BUILDING_ROOM, i.AREA, i.DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte1 i JOIN dept_avg a ON i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE i.AREA > a.avg_area ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 INNER JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' ), provost_depts AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, inner_cte2.window_column, t2.DLC_NAME, inner_cte2.DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte2 INNER JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON inner_cte2.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY ) SELECT p.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, p.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, p.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, p.window_column, p.DLC_NAME, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.AREA FROM provost_depts p JOIN rooms_above_avg r ON p.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = r.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AND p.DLC_KEY = r.DLC_KEY ORDER BY p.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, r.AREA DESC

question: For each department name and school name, list the number of offered subjects, the minimum number of enrolled students for subjects with more than 3 enrolled students, the total student enrollment in offered courses (for the top 5 departments in the School of Engineering), and the course with the highest enrollment (including the course number and its enrollment). Additionally, for each school name, include a grand total for all departments in that school in the format of (null, school name, total offered subjects, minimum enrolled students, null, null, null). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS offered_subject_count, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(offered_subject_count) AS total_offered_subjects, MIN(min_enrolled_students) AS min_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(offered_subject_count) > 0 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.COURSE_NUMBER, t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ), TopDepartments AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_enrollment DESC LIMIT 5 ), TopCourses AS ( SELECT i1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i1.COURSE_NUMBER, i1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte2 i1 JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enroll FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) i2 ON i1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = i2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = i2.max_enroll ) SELECT r.DEPARTMENT_NAME, r.SCHOOL_NAME, r.total_offered_subjects, r.min_enrolled_students, td.total_enrollment, tc.COURSE_NUMBER AS highest_enrolled_course, tc.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS course_enrollment FROM RollupResults r LEFT JOIN TopDepartments td ON r.DEPARTMENT_NAME = td.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN TopCourses tc ON r.DEPARTMENT_NAME = tc.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE r.SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL ORDER BY r.SCHOOL_NAME, r.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each academic year where the running sum of academic years within a financial aid year group for previous terms is greater than the average academic year across all previous terms, what is the academic year, the academic year description, the variance of the number of tip detail records for subjects offered in that year (considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term and have at least one associated tip detail record), the number of unique departments represented among those subjects, the term code, the term description, the running sum of academic years within the financial aid year group, and the financial aid year? List the results ordered by the variance of tip detail record counts (descending), financial aid year, and academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS unique_departments FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance ORDER BY inner_cte.record_count_variance DESC ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ) SELECT TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, window_column, FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > ( SELECT AVG(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS WHERE TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ) ORDER BY FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.record_count_variance, s1.unique_departments, s2.TERM_CODE, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.window_column, s2.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s1.record_count_variance DESC, s2.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each department and academic year, show the department name, academic year, academic year description, the geometric mean of the total units for all subjects offered by the department in regular terms with total units greater than zero, the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in the department's courses that have at least one enrolled student and have a material status of 'U', as well as the subject title with the highest number of enrolled students among those courses and the corresponding enrollment count. List the columns in the following order: department name, academic year, academic year description, geometric mean of total units, enrolled student range, enrolled student variance, top subject title, and top enrollment. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL d JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), enrollment_stats AS ( SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, st.SUBJECT_TITLE AS top_subject_title, st.max_enrolled AS top_enrollment FROM inner_cte2 ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS max_enrolled FROM ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte2 ) ranked WHERE rn = 1 ) st ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = st.OFFER_DEPT_NAME GROUP BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, st.SUBJECT_TITLE, st.max_enrolled ) SELECT inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte1.geometric_mean_total_units, enrollment_stats.enrolled_range, enrollment_stats.enrolled_variance, enrollment_stats.top_subject_title, enrollment_stats.top_enrollment FROM inner_cte1 LEFT JOIN enrollment_stats ON inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = enrollment_stats.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC;

question: For each department where the maximum total units of any course offered by that department is greater than 6, what is the department name, the maximum total units, the name of the school that department belongs to, the subject code of the course with the maximum total units, and for subjects offered in the term with code '2022SU' that match that subject code and department, what is the subject's ID, total units, and their dense rank considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the total number of units? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.max_total_units, i.SCHOOL_NAME, c.SUBJECT_CODE FROM inner_cte i JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.SCHOOL_NAME = s.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = i.max_total_units ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2022SU' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS DESC ) SELECT subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.max_total_units, subq1.SCHOOL_NAME, subq1.SUBJECT_CODE, subq2.SUBJECT_ID, subq2.TOTAL_UNITS, subq2.window_column FROM subq1 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON subq1.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE AND subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN subq2 ON ccc.SUBJECT_ID = subq2.SUBJECT_ID

question: For each department in the Provost Area, show the DLC name, the average and maximum faculty organization key associated with that department, the total number of unique DLC codes at the third hierarchy level for each department, the HR department name, and the highest HR org unit ID within each HR department name group. Do not return any rounded answers.
