COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.COURSE_NUMBER = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_units_variance ORDER BY inner_cte.total_units_variance DESC ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_PARAMETER, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_INDICATOR = 'C' ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(window_column) AS highest_running_sum FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ), CombinedDepartments AS ( SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.total_units_variance, s1.avg_enrolled_students, NULL AS highest_running_sum, 'UnitsVariance' AS Reason FROM Subquery1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS total_units_variance, NULL AS avg_enrolled_students, s2.highest_running_sum, 'HighestRunningSum' AS Reason FROM Subquery2 s2 ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_units_variance, avg_enrolled_students, highest_running_sum, Reason FROM CombinedDepartments ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Reason;

question: List, for all rooms with area greater than 300 and access level equal to 1, the building-room identifier, the room's major use description, the organization name, the total number of such rooms per organization, the building name, the building key, and the reason for inclusion ('Large_Accessible_Room' for these rooms). Also, for the top 10 buildings with the largest range in room areas (among buildings with more than 10 rooms), list the building name, the building key, and the reason for inclusion ('Top_Building_Area_Range' for these buildings). The results should include all these columns in the following order: building-room identifier, major use description, organization name, total number of such rooms per organization, building name, building key, and reason for inclusion, and be ordered by building name and reason. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.MAJOR_USE_DESC, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 300 AND t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 ) SELECT inner_cte.BUILDING_ROOM, inner_cte.MAJOR_USE_DESC, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, org_counts.Total_Rooms, inner_cte.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT BUILDING_ROOM) AS Total_Rooms FROM ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 300 AND t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 ) sub GROUP BY ORGANIZATION_NAME ) org_counts ON inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = org_counts.ORGANIZATION_NAME ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_BUILDING b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY HAVING COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 10 ) SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ic.area_range, ic.area_variance, ic.area_stddev, muc.MAJOR_USE_DESC AS Most_Common_Major_Use, muc.Room_Count FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS Room_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) DESC) AS rn FROM FCLT_BUILDING b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, r.MAJOR_USE_DESC ) muc ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = muc.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND muc.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.area_range DESC LIMIT 10 ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT s1.BUILDING_ROOM, s1.MAJOR_USE_DESC, s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s1.Total_Rooms, b.BUILDING_NAME, s1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, 'Large_Accessible_Room' AS Reason FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b ON s1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS BUILDING_ROOM, NULL AS MAJOR_USE_DESC, NULL AS ORGANIZATION_NAME, NULL AS Total_Rooms, s2.BUILDING_NAME, s2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, 'Top_Building_Area_Range' AS Reason FROM Subquery2 s2 ) SELECT BUILDING_ROOM, MAJOR_USE_DESC, ORGANIZATION_NAME, Total_Rooms, BUILDING_NAME, FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, Reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY BUILDING_NAME, Reason;

question: For the top 10 subject titles by the number of materials offered in regular academic terms, list the subject title, department name, total count of materials, the academic year, and the highest total number of materials recorded in any term within that academic year, considering only those academic years where the total number of materials is greater than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean total number of materials per academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH highest_term_materials_per_year AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE, SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(inner_cte.total_materials) AS highest_term_materials FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR IN ( SELECT academic_year FROM ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS year_total FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) year_totals WHERE year_total > ( SELECT AVG(total_count) + STDDEV(total_count) FROM ( SELECT SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_count FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) sub ) ) GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), top_subjects_by_materials AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON td.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND td.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.material_count, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.material_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT t.SUBJECT_TITLE, t.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.material_count, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, h.highest_term_materials FROM top_subjects_by_materials t JOIN highest_term_materials_per_year h ON t.ACADEMIC_YEAR = h.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t.material_count DESC;

question: For each department name and school name where the number of enrolled students in the offered subject is greater than the average number of enrolled students for that department and school, and for each subject offered in the term "2005FA" within those departments and schools, display the department name, school name, number of offered subjects, minimum number of enrolled students, subject title, number of enrolled students, term description, average number of enrolled students within each subject title group, and classify each subject as 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' if its enrollment is at least 10% greater than the average for its subject title, 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' if at least 10% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER ), avg_enrollment AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(i.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS offered_subject_count, MIN(i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte i JOIN avg_enrollment a ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.SCHOOL_NAME = a.SCHOOL_NAME WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_enrolled GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_enrolled_students, ss.SCHOOL_NAME FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON tso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' ) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, TERM_DESCRIPTION, avg_enrolled_students, CASE WHEN NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > avg_enrolled_students * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < avg_enrolled_students * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.offered_subject_count, s1.min_enrolled_students, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.avg_enrolled_students, s2.enrollment_category FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s1.SCHOOL_NAME = s2.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each department name and course level where the course is degree granting and the total units are greater than 6, and for departments that offered at least 5 degree granting subjects in the 2022 academic year, provide the department name, course level, the number of unique courses, the minimum total units offered, the number of courses where the design units are at least 3, the number of subjects offered in 2022, the average total units for those subjects, the range of total units, and the variance of total units, listing the columns in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.COURSE_LEVEL, ic.course_count, ic.min_total_units, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ccc.DESIGN_UNITS >= 3 THEN scd.COURSE END) AS courses_with_design_units_3_or_more FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.COURSE_LEVEL = scd.COURSE_LEVEL JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.COURSE_LEVEL, ic.course_count, ic.min_total_units ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS subject_count, AVG(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY subject_count DESC, total_units_range DESC ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.COURSE_LEVEL, s1.course_count, s1.min_total_units, s1.courses_with_design_units_3_or_more, s2.subject_count, s2.avg_total_units, s2.total_units_range, s2.total_units_variance FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.COURSE_LEVEL;

question: For all subjects in the 2014FA term with at least one enrolled student, show the subject title, offering department name, responsible faculty name, the TIP material status key, the total number of units, and the minimum total number of units in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the course number, along with the cluster type description and the HGN code description for each subject, and for each subject also show the subject code, subject code description, department name, and the number of subjects in the same department, where the department is matched via the subject's department code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, sos.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.window_column, sos.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC, sos.HGN_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID FROM inner_cte JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_CODE IS NOT NULL AND t1.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, dept_counts.subjects_in_department, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS subjects_in_department FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_CODE IS NOT NULL AND t1.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) dept_counts ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, subq1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, subq1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, subq1.TOTAL_UNITS, subq1.window_column, subq1.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC, subq1.HGN_CODE_DESC, subq2.SUBJECT_CODE, subq2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq2.subjects_in_department FROM subq1 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON subq1.SUBJECT_ID = ccc.SUBJECT_ID JOIN subq2 ON ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = subq2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY subq1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each course offered this year, provide the department name, department code, course code, total units, the department's average total units, and the deviation of the course's total units from the department's average. Also, for each department that grants degrees and offered subjects in the term '2016SP', include the number of subjects offered and the total units for those subjects. List all these columns in the order: department name, department code, course code, total units, department average total units, deviation from average, number of subjects offered, and total units for those subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.SUBJECT_CODE, ccc.total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccc.total_units IS NOT NULL ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(total_units) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subq1 AS ( SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.total_units, d.avg_total_units, (i.total_units - d.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte1 i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_CODE ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t2.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), DeptSubjectSummary AS ( SELECT t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects, SUM(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' GROUP BY t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subq2 AS ( SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.num_subjects, dss.total_units FROM DeptSubjectSummary dss UNION ALL SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_CODE, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(dss.num_subjects) AS num_subjects, SUM(dss.total_units) AS total_units FROM DeptSubjectSummary dss GROUP BY dss.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.total_units, s1.avg_total_units, s1.deviation_from_avg, s2.num_subjects, s2.total_units FROM subq1 s1 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN subq2 s2 ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For the top 10 subjects offered in the term with the description "Fall Term 2024-2025" that have the highest number of enrolled students, display each subject's offered key, subject title, offering department name, the term description, the number of enrolled students, and the rank of each subject within its offering department (ordered by subject offered key), but only include subjects where the offering department is among those that, in the term with code '2022SU', had an average total units for their subjects greater than the average total units for all subjects offered in that term. List the subject offered key, subject title, offering department name, term description, number of enrolled students, and the rank within the department, in that order, and order the results by department name and number of enrolled students descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH TopSubjects AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' ) SELECT icte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, icte.window_column FROM inner_cte icte ORDER BY icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC LIMIT 10 ), HighAvgUnitDepartments AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2022SU' ) SELECT t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2022SU' GROUP BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) > ( SELECT AVG(t3.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t3 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t3.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2022SU' ) ) SELECT ts.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, ts.SUBJECT_TITLE, ts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ts.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ts.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ts.window_column FROM TopSubjects ts WHERE ts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN (SELECT had.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM HighAvgUnitDepartments had) ORDER BY ts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ts.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC;

question: For each degree-granting department, what is the highest number of subject codes associated with any subject code in that department, what is the minimum department budget code for that department, and for IAP subject activities in that department with a maximum enrollment of at least 10 and that are not cancelled, what are the activity title, enrollment type, the academic term description, the subject title from the course catalog, and the total count of such activities for each academic term (including a grand total row for all activities in that term with nulls for activity title, enrollment type, and subject title, and the total count of such activities)? The results should show the department name, highest subject code count, minimum department budget code, term description, activity title, enrollment type, subject title, and activity count, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE ), degree_dept_subject_stats AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(subject_code_count) AS highest_subject_code_count, MIN(min_dept_budget_code) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 10 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' ), rollup_cte AS ( SELECT ACTIVITY_TITLE, ENROLLMENT_TYPE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS activity_count FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACTIVITY_TITLE, ENROLLMENT_TYPE, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ) SELECT dds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dds.highest_subject_code_count, dds.min_dept_budget_code, rc.TERM_DESCRIPTION, rc.ACTIVITY_TITLE, rc.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, rc.SUBJECT_TITLE, rc.activity_count FROM degree_dept_subject_stats dds LEFT JOIN rollup_cte rc ON dds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = rc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rc.TERM_DESCRIPTION, rc.ACTIVITY_TITLE

question: For each subject code associated with a degree-granting department in the School of Engineering, list the subject code, subject code description, department name, the minimum number of enrolled students in any subject offered by that department, and the total number of course material records for subjects with required course materials. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS engineering_degree_granting_subject_codes FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, td.RECORD_COUNT FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_CODE, MIN(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students, SUM(RECORD_COUNT) AS total_material_records FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_CODE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(RECORD_COUNT) > 0 ORDER BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT subq1.SUBJECT_CODE, subq1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq2.min_enrolled_students, subq2.total_material_records FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = subq2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE subq2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE IS NOT NULL ORDER BY subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.SUBJECT_CODE

question: For subjects offered in the term '2017JA', show the subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, department full name, subject code, subject code description, and the minimum number of enrolled students over each subject code group, as well as the school code, school name, department code, school name from department, department phone number, and the highest running sum of total units for any subject within that school in the 2019FA term (where the subject has more than 1 total unit). Order the results by subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.SCHOOL_CODE, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' ), cte1 AS ( SELECT inner_cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte1.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte1.window_column, inner_cte1.SCHOOL_CODE, inner_cte1.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS SCHOOL_NAME_DEPT, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte1 LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_CODE, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS > 1 ), cte2 AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_CODE, SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(window_column) AS highest_running_sum_total_units FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY SCHOOL_CODE, SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE, cte1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, cte1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cte1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, cte1.SUBJECT_CODE, cte1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, cte1.window_column, cte1.SCHOOL_CODE, cte1.SCHOOL_NAME, cte1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, cte1.SCHOOL_NAME_DEPT, cte1.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, cte2.highest_running_sum_total_units FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.SCHOOL_CODE = cte2.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY cte1.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For each academic year and for each of the top 10 departments with the highest maximum total units for any course they offer (where this maximum is greater than 6), what is the academic year, the academic year description, the department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for all library reserve materials offered in terms that have a material status of 'U', the maximum total units for any course in the department, the name of the school the department belongs to, the course title with the maximum total units, and the subject code of that course? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.max_total_units, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.SUBJECT_CODE FROM inner_cte ic JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.max_total_units = c.TOTAL_UNITS ORDER BY ic.max_total_units DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.coefficient_of_variation, subq2.max_total_units, subq2.SCHOOL_NAME, subq2.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq2.SUBJECT_CODE FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subq2.max_total_units DESC, subq1.coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For each subject offered in the term '2017FA', provide the subject title, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the record counts for all tip materials associated with that subject, the department name, the total number of enrolled students for each subject, and for each matching department, course number, and offering school name (if available), include the number of unique library subjects offered and the minimum total units for those subjects, grouped by the offering school name. The results should be ordered by the range of record counts in descending order, then by subject title, course number, and offering school name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(t.RECORD_COUNT) - MIN(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_range, VARIANCE(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON s.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ), subq1 AS ( SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.record_count_range, i.record_count_variance, i.record_count_stddev, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.SUBJECT_ID FROM inner_cte1 i JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON i.SUBJECT_TITLE = s.SUBJECT_TITLE AND s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ), subq2 AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COURSE_NUMBER, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(subject_count) AS total_subjects, MIN(min_total_units) AS min_total_units FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COURSE_NUMBER, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(subject_count) > 0 ORDER BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COURSE_NUMBER, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.record_count_range, s1.record_count_variance, s1.record_count_stddev, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.COURSE_NUMBER, s2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s2.total_subjects, s2.min_total_units FROM subq1 s1 LEFT JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = lso.SUBJECT_ID LEFT JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND lso.COURSE_NUMBER = s2.COURSE_NUMBER AND lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = s2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY s1.record_count_range DESC, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.COURSE_NUMBER, s2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME

question: For each degree-granting department and course level, list the department name, department code, course level, the number of unique degree-granting courses with total units greater than 6, and the minimum total units for those courses. Also, for each subject code in the department, include the subject code, subject code description, and the average and variance of the ASCII values of the course numbers for that subject code. Present the results ordered by department name, course level, and subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL ) SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.COURSE_LEVEL, inner_cte.course_count, inner_cte.min_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN inner_cte ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s.COURSE_NUMBER FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, AVG(ASCII(inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VARIANCE(ASCII(inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s1.COURSE_LEVEL, s1.course_count, s1.min_total_units, s2.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s2.avg_course_number_ascii, s2.var_course_number_ascii FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.COURSE_LEVEL, s2.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For each department in the "Engineering" school with subjects having total units greater than 1, and for each subject offered in the term '2017JA' by that department, list the school name, department name, academic year description, total minimum units in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by academic year, subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, department full name, subject code, subject code description, the minimum number of enrolled students over each subject code group, and the total enrolled students per subject code. For each school and department, include a grand total for all minimum total units, and for each subject code, include a grand total of enrolled students. Order the results by school name, department name, academic year description, subject code, and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY s JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ata.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON s.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 1 ), DeptWindowRollup AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, window_column, DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte1 ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, SUM(window_column) AS total_min_units, DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM DeptWindowRollup GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_CODE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(window_column) > 0 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' ), SubjectRollup AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, window_column, DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, window_column, DEPARTMENT_CODE WITH ROLLUP HAVING (SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL OR SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0) ) SELECT r.SCHOOL_NAME, r.DEPARTMENT_NAME, r.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, r.total_min_units, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s.window_column AS min_enrolled_students_per_code, s.total_enrolled_students FROM RollupResults r JOIN SubjectRollup s ON r.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY r.SCHOOL_NAME, r.DEPARTMENT_NAME, r.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: List all IAP subject activities with activity title, enrollment type, academic year description, term start date, and the total number of IAP subject activities per academic year for activities with a maximum enrollment of at least 20 and that are not cancelled, as well as for each subject category name and enrollment type where the maximum enrollment is greater than 10, show the enrollment type, subject category name, sponsor key, average fee, and total number of activities for each sponsor. Indicate the source of each row as either 'IAP Activity' or 'Category Sponsor'. The columns should be: activity title, enrollment type, subject category name, sponsor key, average fee, total number of activities for sponsor, academic year description, term start date, total number of IAP subject activities per academic year, and source. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t2.TERM_START_DATE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' ) SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, Activity_Counts.Total_Activities FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS Total_Activities FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' GROUP BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) AS Activity_Counts ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = Activity_Counts.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS activity_count, MIN(d.FEE) AS min_fee FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ) SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, AVG(d.FEE) AS avg_fee, COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS total_activities FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, NULL AS IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, NULL AS IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, NULL AS avg_fee, NULL AS total_activities_sponsor, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.TERM_START_DATE, s1.Total_Activities, 'IAP Activity' AS Source FROM Subquery1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS ACTIVITY_TITLE, s2.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, s2.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, s2.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, s2.avg_fee, s2.total_activities AS total_activities_sponsor, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS TERM_START_DATE, NULL AS Total_Activities, 'Category Sponsor' AS Source FROM Subquery2 s2 ) SELECT ACTIVITY_TITLE, ENROLLMENT_TYPE, IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, avg_fee, total_activities_sponsor, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TERM_START_DATE, Total_Activities, Source FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY ENROLLMENT_TYPE, Source, ACTIVITY_TITLE, IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ;

question: For each department in the 'Engineering' school whose average total units of its courses is greater than the average total units of all 'Engineering' school courses, show the department name, the subject code, the subject title, the geometric mean of the total units for subjects offered by that department where the total units are greater than zero, and the average total units of its courses. List the results ordered by department name and then by geometric mean of total units in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptAvgUnits AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE AS course_number, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.COURSE) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM ( SELECT t0.COURSE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ) dept_courses GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) > ( SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) FROM ( SELECT t0.COURSE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ) all_courses ) ), DeptSubjectGeomMean AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, EXP(AVG(LN(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT dsgm.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dsgm.SUBJECT_ID, dsgm.SUBJECT_TITLE, dsgm.geometric_mean_total_units, dau.avg_total_units FROM DeptSubjectGeomMean dsgm JOIN DeptAvgUnits dau ON dsgm.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dau.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY dsgm.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dsgm.geometric_mean_total_units DESC;

question: For each department, provide the department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and offered in the 'Engineering' school), the department's average total units, and whether the department's average total units is above, below, or within 10% of the overall average total units for all such subjects in the 'Engineering' school. For each IAP subject activity with a maximum enrollment of at least 10 and that is not cancelled and is associated with the department, show the activity title, enrollment type, the academic term description, the subject title from the course catalog, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by activity title. The results are ordered by the department's total units range in descending order and then by activity title in ascending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ), overall_stats AS ( SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS overall_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte1 ), dept_units_stats AS ( SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.total_units_range, ds.total_units_variance, ds.total_units_stddev, ds.avg_total_units, CASE WHEN ds.avg_total_units > os.overall_avg_total_units * 1.1 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN ds.avg_total_units < os.overall_avg_total_units * 0.9 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'WITHIN_10_PERCENT' END AS avg_total_units_category FROM dept_stats ds CROSS JOIN overall_stats os ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 10 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' ), iap_activities AS ( SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte2 inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE = t2.SUBJECT_TITLE AND inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev, dus.avg_total_units, dus.avg_total_units_category, ia.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ia.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, ia.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ia.SUBJECT_TITLE, ia.window_column FROM dept_units_stats dus JOIN iap_activities ia ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ia.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dus.total_units_range DESC, ia.ACTIVITY_TITLE ASC;

question: For each academic year and each department, what is the academic year, academic year description, the variance of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during terms in that year (considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the number of enrolled students is greater than 0), the department name, the total number of such library subjects offered per department in that year, and for each degree-granting course in the School of Engineering in that department, what is the course description, department name, subject code description, and the difference between the number of characters in the course description and the average number of characters in course descriptions for that department? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, COUNT(DISTINCT LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS total_library_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t1.COURSE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(LENGTH(COURSE_DESCRIPTION)) AS avg_desc_length FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, (LENGTH(i.COURSE_DESCRIPTION) - d.avg_desc_length) AS desc_length_deviation, i.COURSE FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.enrolled_students_variance, s1.department_name, s1.total_library_subjects_offered, s2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s2.desc_length_deviation FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.department_name = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.department_name, s2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION;

question: For each major organization, top-level HR organization name, and department hierarchy level 2 name, provide the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the organization numbers (for assignable organizations with non-null organization number and where the group average is above the overall average), as well as the variance of the organization number for organizations with non-null description, associated with a space unit, and organization level 5 or higher, listing the results in order of organization number variance (from the first group) and then department level 2 organization number variance (from the second group), and including all selected columns in this order: major organization, top-level HR organization name, average organization number, organization number variance, organization number standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), department hierarchy level 2 name, and department level 2 organization number variance. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT F.MAJOR_ORG, H.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME, AVG(F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS avg_org_number, VARIANCE(F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance, STDDEV(F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION F JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT H ON F.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = H.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE F.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER IS NOT NULL GROUP BY F.MAJOR_ORG, H.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME ) SELECT MAJOR_ORG, ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME, avg_org_number, org_number_variance, org_number_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_org_number > ( SELECT AVG(ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION WHERE ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND ORGANIZATION_NUMBER IS NOT NULL ) ORDER BY org_number_variance DESC ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, VARIANCE(f.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT s ON f.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY WHERE f.DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME ORDER BY org_number_variance DESC ) SELECT ic.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, ic.org_number_variance FROM inner_cte ic JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m2 ON ic.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = m2.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f2 ON m2.DLC_KEY = f2.DLC_KEY WHERE f2.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL >= 5 GROUP BY ic.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, ic.org_number_variance ORDER BY ic.org_number_variance DESC ) SELECT s1.MAJOR_ORG, s1.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME, s1.avg_org_number, s1.org_number_variance, s1.org_number_stddev, s2.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, s2.org_number_variance AS dept_level2_org_number_variance FROM subq1 s1 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON s1.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME = h.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m ON h.DLC_KEY = m.DLC_KEY JOIN subq2 s2 ON m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = s2.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME ORDER BY s1.org_number_variance DESC, s2.org_number_variance DESC;

question: For each department in the 2012SU term that also offers subjects in the School of Engineering with at least one required ('RQ') material, list the department name, the variance of the total units for subjects offered, the average number of enrolled students per subject, the subject title, the minimum number of enrolled students in any subject, the total number of material records for that subject, and calculate the ratio of average enrolled students per subject to the minimum number of enrolled students in that subject (rounded to two decimal places). Sort the results by this ratio in descending order.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON tso.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_units_variance, AVG(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ss.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_units_variance ORDER BY inner_cte.total_units_variance DESC ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, td.RECORD_COUNT FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, MIN(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled, SUM(inner_cte.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_material_records FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.total_units_variance, s1.avg_enrolled_students, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.min_enrolled, s2.total_material_records, ROUND(s1.avg_enrolled_students / NULLIF(s2.min_enrolled, 0), 2) AS avg_to_min_enrollment_ratio FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY avg_to_min_enrollment_ratio DESC;

question: For each organization that is assignable and has a department code above 100000, show the organization key, organization name, department name, the corresponding HR org unit title, the number of HR org units, the total of their department IDs, and, for each associated space unit with a space unit code of 97500, include the space unit name, space unit code, department count, number of supervisees, and the highest research volume ever recorded for each department count group. Also, for each organization and department name, include a grand total for all HR org units in the format of (organization key, organization name, department name, null, total department IDs, null, ...). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS hr_org_unit_count, SUM(h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS total_department_id FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION f JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID > 100000 GROUP BY f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ), OrgUnitDetails AS ( SELECT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION f JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID > 100000 ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, SUM(i.hr_org_unit_count) AS hr_org_unit_count, SUM(i.total_department_id) AS total_department_id FROM inner_cte1 i LEFT JOIN OrgUnitDetails o ON i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY AND i.ORGANIZATION_NAME = o.ORGANIZATION_NAME AND i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(i.hr_org_unit_count) > 0 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t1.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.DEPT_COUNT, t2.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, t2.RESEARCH_VOLUME FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DEPT_NAMES WHERE t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 97500 ), SpaceUnitStats AS ( SELECT space_unit_name, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, ORGANIZATION_NAME, DEPT_COUNT, NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, MAX(RESEARCH_VOLUME) AS highest_research_volume FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY space_unit_name, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, ORGANIZATION_NAME, DEPT_COUNT, NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES ) SELECT rr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, rr.ORGANIZATION_NAME, rr.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, rr.hr_org_unit_count, rr.total_department_id, sus.space_unit_name, sus.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, sus.DEPT_COUNT, sus.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, sus.highest_research_volume FROM RollupResults rr LEFT JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON rr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY LEFT JOIN SpaceUnitStats sus ON fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME = sus.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY rr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, rr.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, sus.space_unit_name

question: For each space unit code, show the building room, floor, space usage, space unit code, space unit name, the average floor within each space unit code group for rooms with an access level of 1, and the highest coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of access levels among its rooms for any given floor. Additionally, for each space unit code, include a grand total average floor for all rooms in that space unit code group (with null building room, null floor, and null space usage), along with the highest coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) for that space unit code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.SPACE_UNIT, AVG(t1.FLOOR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ORDER BY t1.FLOOR) AS avg_floor FROM SPACE_UNIT t0 JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t1 ON t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT SPACE_UNIT_CODE, SPACE_UNIT, BUILDING_ROOM, FLOOR, SPACE_USAGE, AVG(avg_floor) AS avg_floor FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SPACE_UNIT_CODE, SPACE_UNIT, BUILDING_ROOM, FLOOR, SPACE_USAGE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SPACE_UNIT_CODE IS NOT NULL ) SELECT BUILDING_ROOM, FLOOR, SPACE_USAGE, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, SPACE_UNIT, avg_floor FROM RollupResults ORDER BY SPACE_UNIT_CODE, BUILDING_ROOM, FLOOR ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, zr.FLOOR, STDDEV(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) / NULLIF(AVG(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD zr ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = zr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, zr.FLOOR HAVING AVG(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) > 0 ) SELECT SPACE_UNIT, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, MAX(coefficient_of_variation) AS highest_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SPACE_UNIT, SPACE_UNIT_CODE ORDER BY highest_coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT s1.BUILDING_ROOM, s1.FLOOR, s1.SPACE_USAGE, s1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, s1.SPACE_UNIT, s1.avg_floor, s2.highest_coefficient_of_variation FROM subq1 s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = s2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ORDER BY s1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, s1.BUILDING_ROOM, s1.FLOOR

question: For each department name and school name where the department is degree granting, provide the number of unique courses and the minimum CIP program code from the course descriptions, along with the administrative department name, term, and the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 100. Additionally, for each school, include a grand total for all departments in that school in the format of (null, school name, total courses, min CIP code), and for each administrative department, include subtotals (with the term field as 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all administrative departments and terms (with the term field as 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the administrative department name if it is the same as the previous row. Present the columns in the following order: department name, school name, total courses, minimum CIP program code, administrative department name, term, and total enrolled students. Sort the table by school name, department name, administrative department, and term. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(course_count) AS total_courses, MIN(min_cip_code) AS min_cip_code FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(course_count) > 0 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100 ), AdminRollup AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(admin_dept) OVER (ORDER BY admin_dept_sort, term_sort) = admin_dept THEN NULL ELSE admin_dept END AS admin_dept, term, total_enrolled, admin_dept_sort, term_sort FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS admin_dept_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS admin_dept, SUM(total_enrolled) AS total_enrolled FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, TERM_CODE WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ) SELECT rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.total_courses, rr.min_cip_code, ar.admin_dept, ar.term, ar.total_enrolled FROM RollupResults rr LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND rr.SCHOOL_NAME = sd.SCHOOL_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN AdminRollup ar ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = ar.admin_dept ORDER BY rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ar.admin_dept_sort, ar.term_sort

question: For each subject in the term "2010FA", show the subject ID, the term description from ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL, the material status key from TIP_DETAIL, the academic year from ACADEMIC_TERMS, the department name from SIS_DEPARTMENT, and the rank of each subject within each academic year group ordered by subject ID. Additionally, for each department, show the department name, the master subject ID, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in library subjects that have a matching master subject ID in the TIP subject offerings, and the total number of such subjects per department, considering only departments with more than 0 enrolled students in both tables. Present all these columns in the following order: subject ID, term description, material status key, academic year, department name, subject rank, department name (from library stats), master subject ID, variance, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and total number of subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.TERM_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2010FA' ), SubjectDetails AS ( SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ic.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, ic.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte1 ic LEFT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID AND ic.TERM_CODE = cso.TERM_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = t.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), LibraryStats AS ( SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, VARIANCE(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_students_variance, STDDEV(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_students_stddev, Subject_Counts.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte2 ic JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) AS Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) AS Subject_Counts ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = Subject_Counts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME GROUP BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, Subject_Counts.Total_Subjects ) SELECT sd.SUBJECT_ID, sd.TERM_DESCRIPTION, sd.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sd.ACADEMIC_YEAR, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.window_column, ls.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ls.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, ls.library_students_variance, ls.library_students_stddev, ls.Total_Subjects FROM SubjectDetails sd JOIN LibraryStats ls ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ls.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SUBJECT_ID, ls.library_students_variance DESC;

question: For the top 5 departments with the highest total subject units in the academic term with term code '2009SP', show each department's name, the total units for that department, the subject title with the highest units in that department, and the number of subjects offered by that department in that term. For each of these departments, also show for subjects offered in the term with code '2025FA' by that department: the subject ID, subject title, offering department name, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, term start date, term end date, term parameter, and the difference between the number of enrolled students for each subject and the minimum number of enrolled students in its offering department. The results should be ordered by total department units descending, then by offering department name and subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(TOTAL_UNITS) AS Total_Dept_Units, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY Total_Dept_Units DESC LIMIT 5 ), subj_stats AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE AS Max_Unit_Subject_Title FROM ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY TOTAL_UNITS DESC, SUBJECT_TITLE ASC) AS rn FROM inner_cte1 ) ranked WHERE rn = 1 ), Top5Depts AS ( SELECT dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dept_stats.Total_Dept_Units, subj_stats.Max_Unit_Subject_Title, dept_stats.Subject_Count FROM dept_stats LEFT JOIN subj_stats ON dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subj_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dept_stats.Total_Dept_Units DESC ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ) SELECT t5d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t5d.Total_Dept_Units, t5d.Max_Unit_Subject_Title, t5d.Subject_Count, ic2.SUBJECT_ID, ic2.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ic2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic2.TERM_START_DATE, ic2.TERM_END_DATE, ic2.TERM_PARAMETER, (ic2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS - ic2.min_enrolled_students_per_dept) AS deviation_from_min_enrolled_students FROM Top5Depts t5d LEFT JOIN inner_cte2 ic2 ON t5d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t5d.Total_Dept_Units DESC, ic2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic2.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each academic year and subject category where the subject has a maximum enrollment greater than 10, what is the academic year, the academic year description, the variance of the number of tip detail records for subjects offered in that year (considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term and have at least one associated tip detail record), the number of unique departments represented among those subjects, the subject category key, the number of unique subjects, the minimum academic term start date, and the total number of TIP materials per subject category and academic year? List the results ordered by the variance of the number of tip detail records in descending order and then by the number of unique subjects in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS unique_departments FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT i.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT inner_cte.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.min_term_start_date, tip_counts.total_tip_materials FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_tip_materials FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) AS tip_counts ON inner_cte.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = tip_counts.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = tip_counts.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, subq1.record_count_variance, subq1.unique_departments, subq2.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, subq2.subject_count, subq2.min_term_start_date, subq2.total_tip_materials FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = subq2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subq1.record_count_variance DESC, subq2.subject_count DESC;

question: For each academic term that is not cancelled, has at least one IAP subject activity with a non-null maximum enrollment, and where the term status is 'Previous', provide the term description, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the maximum enrollment values for IAP subject activities in that term, the academic year description, the term code, term start date, calendar date, day of week, the average calendar year within each calendar year group ordered by term start date, the academic year, and the last day of final exam, ordered by the range of maximum enrollment in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, MAX(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) - MIN(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_range, VARIANCE(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_stddev FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' GROUP BY ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION ), Subquery1 AS ( SELECT inner_cte1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte1.max_enrollment_range, inner_cte1.max_enrollment_variance, inner_cte1.max_enrollment_stddev, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ata.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte1 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON inner_cte1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t1.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t0.CALENDAR_DATE, t0.DAY_OF_WEEK, AVG(t0.CALENDAR_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.CALENDAR_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_START_DATE) AS window_column FROM TIME_DAY t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.CALENDAR_DATE = t1.TERM_START_DATE WHERE t1.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT icte.TERM_CODE, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.TERM_START_DATE, icte.CALENDAR_DATE, icte.DAY_OF_WEEK, icte.window_column, at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at2.LAST_DAY_OF_FINAL_EXAM FROM inner_cte2 icte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 ON icte.TERM_CODE = at2.TERM_CODE ) SELECT s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.max_enrollment_range, s1.max_enrollment_variance, s1.max_enrollment_stddev, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.TERM_CODE, s2.TERM_START_DATE, s2.CALENDAR_DATE, s2.DAY_OF_WEEK, s2.window_column, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.LAST_DAY_OF_FINAL_EXAM FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.TERM_CODE = s2.TERM_CODE ORDER BY s1.max_enrollment_range DESC

question: For each school and department, list the school name, department name, the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2022 (including a grand total for all departments in each school as a row with department name null), and, for departments that offered subjects in the Fall term of 2022 with the highest number of lecture units greater than 3, also include the highest number of lecture units among its offered subjects, the start date of the term, and the total number of subjects offered by that department in that term. If a department appears in only one of the two sets, include its information with nulls for the missing columns. The columns should be: school name, department name, units range, units variance, max lecture units, term start date, and number of subjects offered. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCD.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCD.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, units_range, units_variance FROM ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, units_range, units_variance FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(units_range) AS units_range, VARIANCE(units_range) AS units_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ) t ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, at2.TERM_START_DATE FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 ON td.TERM_CODE = at2.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at2.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) > 3 ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.max_lecture_units, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, COUNT(ccs2.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs2 ON ccs2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ccs2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.max_lecture_units, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT subq1.SCHOOL_NAME, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.units_range, subq1.units_variance, subq2.max_lecture_units, subq2.TERM_START_DATE, subq2.num_subjects_offered FROM subq1 LEFT JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME UNION ALL SELECT subq1.SCHOOL_NAME, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.units_range, subq1.units_variance, subq2.max_lecture_units, subq2.TERM_START_DATE, subq2.num_subjects_offered FROM subq2 LEFT JOIN subq1 ON subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each school, provide the school name and, for each department within the school, list the department name, the average and variance of the total units for its courses that have a non-null subject title and total units greater than 0, and, for departments in the School of Engineering, the total number of students enrolled in courses offered by that department (only if the department's total enrollment is greater than 50 and the average enrollment per course is at least 20; otherwise, show null). For each school, also include a grand total row for all departments in that school in the format of (school name, null, average, variance, null). Do not return any rounded answers.
