SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ), SchoolDeptUnits AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ), DeptEnrollment AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_enrollment FROM inner_cte2 ic JOIN ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) avg_cte ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = avg_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE avg_cte.avg_enrollment >= 20 ) SELECT sdu.SCHOOL_NAME, sdu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sdu.avg_units, sdu.units_variance, de.total_enrollment FROM SchoolDeptUnits sdu LEFT JOIN DeptEnrollment de ON sdu.DEPARTMENT_NAME = de.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sdu.SCHOOL_NAME, sdu.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each academic year and offering department, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of students enrolled in library subjects offered during IAP, and for the same department, what is the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one associated course material, as well as the enrollment category ('HIGH_ENROLLMENT', 'LOW_ENROLLMENT', or 'AVERAGE') for the department based on its average enrollment compared to the overall average? Also, for each academic year, include a grand total for all departments in the format of (academic year, null, total statistics). The results should show, in order: academic year, offering department name, IAP average enrollment, IAP enrollment variance, IAP enrollment standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), TIP average enrollment, TIP enrollment standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and enrollment category. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH iap_enrollment_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON isd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON at.TERM_CODE = lso.TERM_CODE WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS IS NOT NULL ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_CODE, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_CODE WITH ROLLUP HAVING ACADEMIC_YEAR IS NOT NULL ), tip_enrollment_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, inner_cte.avg_enrollment, inner_cte.enrollment_stddev, CASE WHEN inner_cte.avg_enrollment > overall.avg_all_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN inner_cte.avg_enrollment < overall.avg_all_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_all_enrollment FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' ) overall ) SELECT iap.ACADEMIC_YEAR, iap.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, iap.avg_enrollment AS iap_avg_enrollment, iap.enrollment_variance AS iap_enrollment_variance, iap.enrollment_stddev AS iap_enrollment_stddev, tip.avg_enrollment AS tip_avg_enrollment, tip.enrollment_stddev AS tip_enrollment_stddev, tip.enrollment_category FROM iap_enrollment_stats iap LEFT JOIN tip_enrollment_stats tip ON iap.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = tip.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY iap.ACADEMIC_YEAR, iap.OFFER_DEPT_NAME

question: For each department in the School of Engineering that is among the top 5 departments with the highest total student enrollment in their offered courses, and where the number of subject materials with status 'EO' offered in academic years after 2015 for subjects with more than 5 total units exceeds the average such count across all departments, list the department code, department name, the number of such subject materials, the total enrollment, the course with the highest enrollment (course number), and its enrollment, ordered by total enrollment descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte_1 AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS eo_materials_after_2015_with_high_units, ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON td.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND td.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'EO' AND at.ACADEMIC_YEAR > 2015 AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 5 GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subquery1 AS ( SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.eo_materials_after_2015_with_high_units FROM inner_cte_1 i JOIN ( SELECT AVG(eo_materials_after_2015_with_high_units) AS avg_count FROM inner_cte_1 ) a ON 1=1 WHERE i.eo_materials_after_2015_with_high_units > a.avg_count ), inner_cte_2 AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.COURSE_NUMBER, t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ), subquery2 AS ( SELECT dept_enroll.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dept_enroll.total_enrollment, top_course.COURSE_NUMBER AS highest_enrolled_course, top_course.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS course_enrollment, dept_enroll.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM inner_cte_2 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY total_enrollment DESC LIMIT 5 ) dept_enroll JOIN ( SELECT i1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i1.COURSE_NUMBER, i1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte_2 i1 JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enroll FROM inner_cte_2 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) i2 ON i1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = i2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = i2.max_enroll ) top_course ON dept_enroll.DEPARTMENT_NAME = top_course.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dept_enroll.total_enrollment DESC ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.eo_materials_after_2015_with_high_units, s2.total_enrollment, s2.highest_enrolled_course, s2.course_enrollment FROM subquery1 s1 JOIN subquery2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s2.total_enrollment DESC;

question: For each organization that is assignable and has a department code above 100000, and for which there exists a space unit with space unit code equal to 97500, show the organization key, organization name, department name, the number of HR org units, the total of their department IDs, the latest warehouse load date from HR_ORG_UNIT, the space unit name, the DLC name, the DLC key from the organization, the minimum space unit code in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the facility organization key, and the total number of space units per organization, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH org_hr_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS hr_org_unit_count, SUM(h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS total_department_id FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION f JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID > 100000 GROUP BY f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.hr_org_unit_count, i.total_department_id, MAX(h.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS latest_hr_org_unit_load_date FROM inner_cte i JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.hr_org_unit_count, i.total_department_id ), space_unit_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS organization_name, t1.DLC_NAME AS dlc_name, t1.DLC_KEY AS org_dlc_key, MIN(t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_min_space_unit_code, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 97500 ) SELECT inner_cte.space_unit_name, inner_cte.organization_name, inner_cte.dlc_name, inner_cte.org_dlc_key, inner_cte.window_min_space_unit_code, org_unit_counts.total_space_units, inner_cte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS total_space_units FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY GROUP BY t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) AS org_unit_counts ON inner_cte.organization_name = org_unit_counts.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.hr_org_unit_count, o.total_department_id, o.latest_hr_org_unit_load_date, s.space_unit_name, s.dlc_name, s.org_dlc_key, s.window_min_space_unit_code, s.total_space_units FROM org_hr_stats o JOIN space_unit_stats s ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = s.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY

question: For each department, what is the department name, the variance of the total units of subjects offered in the 2022 academic year, the average number of enrolled students in those subjects, and for each subject offered by that department in the term with code '2025FA', what is the subject ID, subject title, offering department name, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, term start date, term end date, term parameter, and whether the number of enrolled students is 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% greater than the average for that department), 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% less than the average for that department), or 'AVERAGE'? Only include departments where the average number of enrolled students in 2022 is greater than 0. List the results ordered by the variance of total units (descending) and then by offering department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), dept_variance AS ( SELECT inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.total_units_variance, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte1 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.COURSE_NUMBER = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.total_units_variance ORDER BY inner_cte1.total_units_variance DESC ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE TERM_CODE = '2025FA' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dv.total_units_variance, dv.avg_enrolled_students, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.TERM_START_DATE, i.TERM_END_DATE, i.TERM_PARAMETER, CASE WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > d.avg_enrolled * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < d.avg_enrolled * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM dept_variance dv JOIN inner_cte2 i ON dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME = i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN dept_avg d ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME WHERE dv.avg_enrolled_students > 0 ORDER BY dv.total_units_variance DESC, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: Show, in a single list, (1) for each academic year where the term status is 'Previous', the financial aid year, academic year, and total number of terms (including a grand total per financial aid year as a row with nulls for academic year and financial aid year), and (2) for each subject offered in the term '2014FA' where the number of enrolled students in the library subject is greater than the average for all library subjects in '2014FA', the subject title from the library, the number of enrolled students in the library subject, the responsible faculty name from the TIP subject, the offer department name from the TIP subject, and the minimum number of enrolled students in the library subject within a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the TIP subject's responsible faculty MIT ID. The results should include all columns in the order: financial aid year, academic year, total terms, subject title, number of enrolled students, responsible faculty name, offer department name, and the windowed minimum number of enrolled students. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH RollupResults AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ), YearTermCounts AS ( SELECT t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.TERM_CODE) AS num_terms FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ) SELECT FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(num_terms) AS total_terms FROM YearTermCounts GROUP BY FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(num_terms) > 0 ), LibrarySubjects AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( ORDER BY t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, l.TERM_CODE FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' ) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, window_column, TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte WHERE NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > ( SELECT AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE TERM_CODE = '2014FA' ) ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT rr.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR, rr.total_terms, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, NULL AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, NULL AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NULL AS window_column FROM RollupResults rr UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS total_terms, ls.SUBJECT_TITLE, ls.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ls.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ls.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ls.window_column FROM LibrarySubjects ls ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For each department in the current term that is in the School of Engineering and has more than 10 total tip materials offered for its subjects during regular terms, show the offering department name, subject title, responsible faculty name, term description, academic year description, the total number of subjects offered per department, the total number of tip materials offered for its subjects, and the average number of tip materials per subject, listing the columns in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM' ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, dept_counts.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS Total_Subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM' GROUP BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) dept_counts ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_counts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL t JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) > 10 ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_tip_materials, AVG(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_tip_materials_per_subject FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON s.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_tip_materials ) SELECT s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.Total_Subjects, s2.total_tip_materials, s2.avg_tip_materials_per_subject FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each department that grants degrees and offered subjects in the term '2016SP', list the department code, department name, the number of subjects offered, the total units for those subjects, the school name, and the number of unique subject titles with materials offered in regular academic terms. For each department, also include a grand total row for the number of subjects and total units in the format (department code, null, total subjects, total units, school name, subject title count). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t2.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), DeptSubjectSummary AS ( SELECT t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects, SUM(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' GROUP BY t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptSubjects AS ( SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.num_subjects, dss.total_units FROM DeptSubjectSummary dss UNION ALL SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_CODE, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(dss.num_subjects) AS num_subjects, SUM(dss.total_units) AS total_units FROM DeptSubjectSummary dss GROUP BY dss.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.SCHOOL_NAME FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON td.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND td.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ), DeptSchoolSubjects AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_title_count FROM inner_cte2 ic GROUP BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE) > 0 ) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.num_subjects, ds.total_units, dss.SCHOOL_NAME, dss.subject_title_count FROM DeptSubjects ds LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN DeptSchoolSubjects dss ON ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.SCHOOL_NAME

question: For each department name and its corresponding organization key where the department is in the Provost Area and the organization’s parent is 'S H&SS', provide the number of organizations, the minimum department hierarchy level 3 code, the maximum department hierarchy level 3 name, the organization name, the organization description, the HR org unit title, the HR department name, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the organization name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_CODE) AS min_level3_code FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) SELECT ic.DLC_NAME, ic.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, ic.org_count, ic.min_level3_code, MAX(m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) AS max_level3_name FROM inner_cte ic JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m ON ic.DLC_NAME = m.DLC_NAME GROUP BY ic.DLC_NAME, ic.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, ic.org_count, ic.min_level3_code ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.ORG_PARENT = 'S H&SS' ) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM inner_cte JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE ) SELECT s1.DLC_NAME, s1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, s1.org_count, s1.min_level3_code, s1.max_level3_name, s2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s2.DESCRIPTION, s2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, s2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.window_column FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = s2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY;

question: For each department that appears both in the current academic term and in the 2019FA term with subjects having total units greater than 1, show the department name, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in the current term, the school within that department with the highest average total units and its average, and for each matching subject in 2019FA, show the subject ID, subject title, the running sum of total units within each school, and the academic year description, ordered by department name and subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH dept_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.SCHOOL_NAME, ss.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON atp.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, hs.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_with_highest_avg, hs.school_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS school_avg_total_units, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME ) hs ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = hs.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND hs.rn = 1 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, hs.SCHOOL_NAME, hs.school_avg_total_units ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), subject_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t1.TERM_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS > 1 ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.window_column, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON ic.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE ORDER BY ic.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.avg_total_units, ds.total_units_variance, ds.total_units_stddev, ds.school_with_highest_avg, ds.school_avg_total_units, ss.SUBJECT_ID, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.window_column, ss.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM dept_stats ds JOIN subject_stats ss ON ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For IAP subject activities with a maximum enrollment of at least 20 that are associated with academic terms where the term status is 'Previous', show the activity title, the dense rank of each activity considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the academic year of the associated term, the term description from ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL, the term code from ACADEMIC_TERMS, the term description from ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL for the previous term, the academic year from ACADEMIC_TERMS, the running sum of academic years within each financial aid year group, and the academic year description from ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL, ordered by activity title and academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH iap_activities AS ( SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.window_column, t2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.TERM_CODE FROM ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20 ) inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t2 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE ), previous_terms AS ( SELECT inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM ( SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ) inner_cte ) SELECT ia.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ia.window_column AS activity_dense_rank, ia.TERM_DESCRIPTION, pt.TERM_CODE, pt.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS prev_term_description, pt.ACADEMIC_YEAR, pt.window_column AS running_sum_academic_year, pt.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM iap_activities ia JOIN previous_terms pt ON ia.TERM_CODE = pt.TERM_CODE ORDER BY ia.ACTIVITY_TITLE, pt.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each academic year and department, what is the academic year, the academic year description, the variance of the number of tip detail records for subjects offered in that year (considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term and have at least one associated tip detail record), the number of unique departments represented among those subjects, the department name, the average number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects that require advance sign-up and are not cancelled), the variance of the number of enrolled students, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students? List the results ordered by the variance of tip detail records in descending order, then by the variance of enrolled students in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS unique_departments FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON isd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON at.TERM_CODE = tso.TERM_CODE WHERE isd.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, subq1.record_count_variance, subq1.unique_departments, subq2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, subq2.avg_enrollment, subq2.enrollment_variance, subq2.enrollment_stddev FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = subq2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subq1.record_count_variance DESC, subq2.enrollment_variance DESC;

question: For each department and each library reserve material detail with material status key equal to 'U' for subjects offered by that department, what are the department code, department name, the variance of the total number of units for degree-granting subjects with more than 0 enrolled students, the average number of enrolled students for those subjects, the enrollment category (classified as 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' if the average enrolled students is at least 20% higher than the overall average, 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' if at least 20% lower, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise), the library course instructor key, library reserve catalog key, term code, subject ID, the tip material key, tip material status key, tip ISBN, the subject title, the minimum tip material status key in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the number of enrolled students, the responsible faculty name, and the offer department name from the subject offered table? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.total_units_variance, inner_cte1.avg_enrolled_students, CASE WHEN inner_cte1.avg_enrolled_students > overall.avg_all_enrolled * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN inner_cte1.avg_enrolled_students < overall.avg_all_enrolled * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte1 CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_all_enrolled FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) overall ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT l.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, l.TERM_CODE, l.SUBJECT_ID, t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t.ISBN, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MIN(t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) OVER ( ORDER BY s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, s.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.total_units_variance, ds.avg_enrolled_students, ds.enrollment_category, ic2.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, ic2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, ic2.TERM_CODE, ic2.SUBJECT_ID, ic2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, ic2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ic2.ISBN, ic2.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic2.window_column, tso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME FROM dept_stats ds JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN inner_cte2 ic2 ON sos.SUBJECT_ID = ic2.SUBJECT_ID AND sos.TERM_CODE = ic2.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON ic2.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ORDER BY ds.total_units_variance DESC, ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic2.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY;

question: For subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering with a total of at least 6 units, show the subject code, subject title, department name, and the running sum of total units within each grade type (only including those subjects where the running sum exceeds 12 units within their grade type), and for each such subject, list the building key, the floor key, and the total coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of rooms located on that floor (including grand totals for all floors per building, where the average room area is greater than zero). Order the results by subject code, building key, and floor key. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ) SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > 12 ORDER BY SUBJECT_CODE ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT FCLT_FLOOR.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, FCLT_FLOOR.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, STDDEV(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA) / NULLIF(AVG(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM FCLT_FLOOR JOIN FCLT_ROOMS ON FCLT_FLOOR.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY = FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY GROUP BY FCLT_FLOOR.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, FCLT_FLOOR.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY HAVING AVG(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA) > 0 ) SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, SUM(coefficient_of_variation) AS total_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, FCLT_FLOOR_KEY WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(coefficient_of_variation) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, FCLT_FLOOR_KEY ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, s2.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, s2.total_coefficient_of_variation FROM subq1 s1 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON s1.SUBJECT_CODE = cso.SUBJECT_CODE AND s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON cso.MEET_PLACE = fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY JOIN FCLT_FLOOR ff ON fr.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY = ff.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY JOIN subq2 s2 ON ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = s2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND ff.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY = s2.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, s2.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY;

question: For each department where the number of subject materials with status 'EO' offered in academic years after 2015 and with more than 5 total units exceeds the average such count across all departments, list the department code, department name, the number of such EO materials, and for each subject in that department (including a grand total row with null subject title), list the subject title, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of reserved materials per subject (where the material status is 'U'), considering only departments with at least one reserved material. The columns should appear in the following order: department code, department name, number of EO materials after 2015 with high units, subject title, reserved material range, reserved material variance, reserved material standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH eo_materials_cte AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS eo_materials_after_2015_with_high_units, ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON td.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND td.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'EO' AND at.ACADEMIC_YEAR > 2015 AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 5 GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.eo_materials_after_2015_with_high_units FROM inner_cte i JOIN (SELECT AVG(eo_materials_after_2015_with_high_units) AS avg_count FROM inner_cte) a ON 1=1 WHERE i.eo_materials_after_2015_with_high_units > a.avg_count ), reserved_materials_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED s JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL d ON s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(material_count) - MIN(material_count) AS reserved_material_range, VARIANCE(material_count) AS reserved_material_variance, STDDEV(material_count) AS reserved_material_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(material_count) > 0 ORDER BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_CODE, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.eo_materials_after_2015_with_high_units, r.SUBJECT_TITLE, r.reserved_material_range, r.reserved_material_variance, r.reserved_material_stddev FROM eo_materials_cte e JOIN reserved_materials_stats r ON e.DEPARTMENT_NAME = r.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, r.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For subjects offered in the term with code '2022SU', show each subject's ID, total units, department name, their dense rank considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the total number of units, and for departments where the average enrollment in offered subjects with more than 0 enrolled students is greater than the overall average enrollment across all such subjects, also show the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in offered subjects, listing the subject ID, total units, department name, dense rank, average enrollment, enrollment variance, and enrollment standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2022SU' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS DESC ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_enrollment, enrollment_variance, enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_enrollment > ( SELECT AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.TOTAL_UNITS, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.avg_enrollment, s2.enrollment_variance, s2.enrollment_stddev FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.TOTAL_UNITS DESC, s2.enrollment_variance DESC;

question: For each department and academic year, show the department name, academic year, academic year description, the geometric mean of the total units for all subjects offered by the department in regular terms with total units greater than zero, and for each master subject ID in that department that has enrolled students in both the library and TIP subject offerings, show the master subject ID, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in the library subjects, and the total number of such subjects per department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH geometric_mean_units AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), library_variance AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = t.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, VARIANCE(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_students_variance, STDDEV(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_students_stddev, Subject_Counts.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) AS Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) AS Subject_Counts ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = Subject_Counts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME GROUP BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, Subject_Counts.Total_Subjects ) SELECT gmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, gmu.ACADEMIC_YEAR, gmu.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gmu.geometric_mean_total_units, lv.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, lv.library_students_variance, lv.library_students_stddev, lv.Total_Subjects FROM geometric_mean_units gmu JOIN library_variance lv ON gmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME = lv.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY gmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, gmu.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC, lv.library_students_variance DESC;

question: For Mathematics department courses with at least 5 enrolled students, where the number of enrolled students exceeds the average for Mathematics courses in the same academic year, show the course number, subject title, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, and the row number within each academic year group ordered by course number. For each course, also provide the academic year description, the geometric mean of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during that year (considering only subjects with more than zero enrolled students), and classify the year as 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' if the geometric mean is at least 10% greater than the average across all years, 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' if at least 10% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Present the results ordered by academic year and row number. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 ), avg_enrollment AS ( SELECT t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 GROUP BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), math_courses AS ( SELECT i.COURSE_NUMBER, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.window_column FROM inner_cte1 i JOIN avg_enrollment a ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_students ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), enrollment_stats AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte2.geometric_mean_enrollment, CASE WHEN inner_cte2.geometric_mean_enrollment > avg_stats.avg_geometric_mean * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN inner_cte2.geometric_mean_enrollment < avg_stats.avg_geometric_mean * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte2 CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_enrollment) AS avg_geometric_mean FROM inner_cte2) avg_stats ) SELECT mc.COURSE_NUMBER, mc.SUBJECT_TITLE, mc.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, mc.TERM_DESCRIPTION, mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mc.window_column, es.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, es.geometric_mean_enrollment, es.enrollment_category FROM math_courses mc JOIN enrollment_stats es ON mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = es.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mc.window_column;

question: For each academic year and department, what is the academic year, academic year description, the variance of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during terms in that year (considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the number of enrolled students is greater than 0), the department name, and the total number of such library subjects offered per department in that year, and for each sponsor type, what is the sponsor type, sponsor name, and the variance of the maximum enrollment across all activities sponsored by that sponsor (considering only activities that are not cancelled and where the sponsor's type has at least one activity with a non-null maximum enrollment)? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH academic_year_variance AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, COUNT(DISTINCT LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS total_library_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), sponsor_type_variance AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SPONSOR_TYPE, s.SPONSOR_NAME, s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, VARIANCE(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY WHERE d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.SPONSOR_TYPE, s.SPONSOR_NAME, s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY ) SELECT i.SPONSOR_TYPE, i.SPONSOR_NAME, i.max_enrollment_variance FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT SPONSOR_TYPE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR GROUP BY SPONSOR_TYPE ) t ON i.SPONSOR_TYPE = t.SPONSOR_TYPE ) SELECT ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ayv.enrolled_students_variance, ayv.department_name, ayv.total_library_subjects_offered, stv.SPONSOR_TYPE, stv.SPONSOR_NAME, stv.max_enrollment_variance FROM academic_year_variance ayv CROSS JOIN sponsor_type_variance stv ORDER BY ayv.enrolled_students_variance DESC, ayv.total_library_subjects_offered DESC, stv.max_enrollment_variance DESC;

question: For each subject offered in the term '2017FA', provide the subject title, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the record counts for all tip materials associated with that subject, the department name, the total number of enrolled students for each subject, and for each matching department in the "Engineering" school with subjects having total units greater than 1, include the school name, department name, academic year description, and the grand total of minimum total units in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(t.RECORD_COUNT) - MIN(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_range, VARIANCE(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON s.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ), cte1 AS ( SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.record_count_range, i.record_count_variance, i.record_count_stddev, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM inner_cte1 i JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON i.SUBJECT_TITLE = s.SUBJECT_TITLE AND s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY s JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ata.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON s.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 1 ), DeptWindowRollup AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, window_column, DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, SUM(window_column) AS total_min_units, DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM DeptWindowRollup GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_CODE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(window_column) > 0 ) SELECT cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE, cte1.record_count_range, cte1.record_count_variance, cte1.record_count_stddev, cte1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cte1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, rr.total_min_units FROM cte1 JOIN RollupResults rr ON cte1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = rr.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY cte1.record_count_range DESC, rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC

question: For each library reserve material detail with material status key 'U' and term code '2009SP' that matches a subject in the 2014FA term with at least one enrolled student, show the course instructor key, reserve catalog key, reserve subject offered key, the responsible faculty name, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the responsible faculty name from the associated subject offered, the subject title, the offering department name, the TIP material status key, the total number of units, the minimum total number of units in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the course number, and whether the total units are 'HIGH_LOAD', 'LOW_LOAD', or 'AVERAGE', ordered by course instructor key and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, t0.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, t0.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL t0 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND t0.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' ) SELECT inner_cte.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, inner_cte.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, inner_cte.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM inner_cte ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, sos.COURSE_NUMBER, lso.SUBJECT_ID, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY WHERE TERM_CODE = '2014FA' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, icte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, icte.TOTAL_UNITS, icte.window_column, CASE WHEN icte.TOTAL_UNITS > da.avg_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_LOAD' WHEN icte.TOTAL_UNITS < da.avg_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_LOAD' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_load_category, icte.SUBJECT_ID FROM inner_cte icte JOIN dept_avg da ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = da.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ) SELECT s1.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, s1.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, s1.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s1.window_column AS reserve_window_column, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2.TOTAL_UNITS, s2.window_column AS units_window_column, s2.unit_load_category FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY s1.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For departments in the "Sloan School of Management" area with a hierarchy type of "Standard Hierarchy", show the department code, department name, the dense rank of each department considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the department's long name, and the corresponding DLC name from the MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY table, along with the space unit code, organization name, HR department name, the sum of space unit keys within each warehouse load date group, and the HR org unit title for space units with a space unit key greater than 100000, where the department and space unit share the same DLC key. Present the results in the following order: department code, department name, department dense rank, DLC name, space unit code, organization name, space HR department name, sum of space unit keys window, and HR org unit title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME = 'Sloan School of Management Area' ), dept_window AS ( SELECT i.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.window_column, m.DLC_NAME, i.DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte1 i JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m ON i.DLC_KEY = m.DLC_KEY ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE ORDER BY t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column, t1.DLC_KEY FROM SPACE_UNIT t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000 ), space_window AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, inner_cte2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.window_column, t3.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, inner_cte2.DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte2 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t3 ON inner_cte2.DLC_KEY = t3.DLC_KEY ) SELECT d.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.window_column AS dept_dense_rank, d.DLC_NAME, s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, s.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS space_hr_department_name, s.window_column AS space_sum_window, s.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE FROM dept_window d JOIN space_window s ON d.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year, academic year description, the geometric mean of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during that year (considering only subjects with more than zero enrolled students), the number of distinct departments that offered such subjects in that year, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of subjects offered per academic term in that year (considering only terms where at least one subject was offered), and the variability category for the year (classified as 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' if the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is at least 20% greater than the average standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all years, 'LOW_VARIABILITY' if at least 20% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise)? List the results ordered by geometric mean enrollment in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_enrollment, COUNT(DISTINCT LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS num_departments FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_enrollment ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(term_subject_count) - MIN(term_subject_count) AS subject_count_range, VARIANCE(term_subject_count) AS subject_count_variance, STDDEV(term_subject_count) AS subject_count_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN ( SELECT tso.TERM_CODE, COUNT(*) AS term_subject_count FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso GROUP BY tso.TERM_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ) tsc ON at.TERM_CODE = tsc.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.subject_count_range, ic.subject_count_variance, ic.subject_count_stddev, CASE WHEN ic.subject_count_stddev > avg_stats.avg_stddev * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN ic.subject_count_stddev < avg_stats.avg_stddev * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(subject_count_stddev) AS avg_stddev FROM inner_cte ) avg_stats ) SELECT subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, subq1.geometric_mean_enrollment, subq1.num_departments, subq2.subject_count_range, subq2.subject_count_variance, subq2.subject_count_stddev, subq2.variability_category FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = subq2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY subq1.geometric_mean_enrollment DESC;

question: For subjects offered in the term '2017JA', show the subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, department full name, subject code, subject code description, the minimum number of enrolled students over each subject code group, the school name, department phone number, and the highest running sum of total units for any subject within that school in the 2019FA term (where the subject has more than 1 total unit). Order the results by subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.SCHOOL_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.window_column, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, inner_cte.SCHOOL_CODE FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_CODE, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS > 1 ) SELECT SCHOOL_CODE, SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(window_column) AS highest_running_sum_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_CODE, SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s1.window_column AS min_num_enrolled_students_per_subject_code, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, s2.highest_running_sum_total_units FROM subq1 s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.SCHOOL_CODE = s2.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For courses offered by the Mathematics department with at least 5 enrolled students, where the number of enrolled students exceeds the average for Mathematics department courses in the same academic year, show the course number, subject title, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, and the row number within each academic year group ordered by course number. For each such course, also show the name of the degree-granting department, the subject code, the subject code description, and the average and variance of the ASCII values of the course numbers for that subject code, listing the columns in this order: course number, subject title, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, row number, department name, subject code, subject code description, average ASCII value of course number, and variance of ASCII value of course number. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 ), avg_enrollment AS ( SELECT t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 GROUP BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT i.COURSE_NUMBER, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.window_column FROM inner_cte i JOIN avg_enrollment a ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_students ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s.COURSE_NUMBER FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER, AVG(ASCII(inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VARIANCE(ASCII(inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER ) SELECT s1.COURSE_NUMBER, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.window_column, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s2.avg_course_number_ascii, s2.var_course_number_ascii FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.COURSE_NUMBER = s2.COURSE_NUMBER ORDER BY s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.COURSE_NUMBER;

question: For all organizations with a DLC key of 'D_MECHE' and an organization level of 5, what are the organization name, organization description, parent organization name, parent organization description, DLC name, the rank of the organization within each DLC name group ordered by organization key, the organization description (from the ranking subquery), and whether the organization is assignable or not? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH orgs_with_parent AS ( SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS Org_Name, inner_cte.DESCRIPTION AS Org_Description, parent_org.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS Parent_Org_Name, parent_org.DESCRIPTION AS Parent_Org_Description, inner_cte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DESCRIPTION, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORG_PARENT_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY.DLC_KEY = 'D_MECHE' AND FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ) inner_cte LEFT JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION parent_org ON inner_cte.FCLT_ORG_PARENT_KEY = parent_org.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ), orgs_with_rank AS ( SELECT inner_cte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.DLC_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, fo.DESCRIPTION, CASE WHEN fo.ASSIGNABLE = 1 THEN 'ASSIGNABLE' ELSE 'NOT_ASSIGNABLE' END AS assignable_status FROM ( SELECT t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.DLC_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DLC_NAME ORDER BY t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.DLC_KEY = 'D_MECHE' ) inner_cte JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON inner_cte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) SELECT owp.Org_Name, owp.Org_Description, owp.Parent_Org_Name, owp.Parent_Org_Description, owr.DLC_NAME, owr.window_column, owr.DESCRIPTION AS Org_Description_Rank, owr.assignable_status FROM orgs_with_parent owp JOIN orgs_with_rank owr ON owp.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = owr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY;

question: For each organization with organization level equal to 5 and assignable equal to 1, show the organization name, organization key, HR department name, HR org unit title, HR org unit key, the average organization key within each organization key group ordered by HR org unit key, the HR org unit level, HR department code, the school area name (only including departments in the "Provost Area" whose school area name contains the word "Science"), and the rank of each department within its school area based on department code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH dept_ranks AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 INNER JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' ) SELECT HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME LIKE '%Science%' ), org_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1 ) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, inner_cte.window_column, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY ) SELECT org_stats.ORGANIZATION_NAME, org_stats.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, org_stats.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, org_stats.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, org_stats.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, org_stats.window_column AS ORG_KEY_AVG, org_stats.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, org_stats.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, dept_ranks.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, dept_ranks.window_column AS DEPT_RANK FROM org_stats JOIN dept_ranks ON org_stats.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE = dept_ranks.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE

question: For each space unit code, show the building room, floor, space usage, space unit code, space unit name, the average floor within each space unit code group for rooms with an access level of 1, the room category ('Many Rooms' if the space unit has more than 5 rooms, 'Few Rooms' otherwise), and the total number of rooms in the space unit. Additionally, for each space unit code, include a grand total average floor and total rooms in the format of (null building room, null floor, null space usage, space unit code, space unit name, total average floor, room category, total rooms). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.SPACE_UNIT, AVG(t1.FLOOR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ORDER BY t1.FLOOR) AS avg_floor FROM SPACE_UNIT t0 JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t1 ON t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT SPACE_UNIT_CODE, SPACE_UNIT, BUILDING_ROOM, FLOOR, SPACE_USAGE, AVG(avg_floor) AS avg_floor FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY SPACE_UNIT_CODE, SPACE_UNIT, BUILDING_ROOM, FLOOR, SPACE_USAGE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SPACE_UNIT_CODE IS NOT NULL ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(sd.BUILDING_ROOM) AS room_count FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT ), RoomCategory AS ( SELECT SPACE_UNIT, room_count, CASE WHEN room_count > 5 THEN 'Many Rooms' ELSE 'Few Rooms' END AS room_category FROM inner_cte2 ) SELECT rr.BUILDING_ROOM, rr.FLOOR, rr.SPACE_USAGE, rr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, rr.SPACE_UNIT, rr.avg_floor, rc.room_category, rc.total_rooms FROM RollupResults rr JOIN ( SELECT SPACE_UNIT, room_category, SUM(room_count) AS total_rooms FROM RoomCategory GROUP BY SPACE_UNIT, room_category WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(room_count) > 0 ) rc ON rr.SPACE_UNIT = rc.SPACE_UNIT ORDER BY rr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, rr.BUILDING_ROOM, rr.FLOOR, rc.room_category

question: For each subject category, display the category name, the average and variance of the maximum enrollment across all activities in that category, the total number of activities in the category, and for each IAP subject activity in that category with a maximum enrollment of at least 10 and that is not cancelled, show the activity title, enrollment type, the academic term description, the subject title from the course catalog, the department name, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by activity title. Present the results ordered by category name and activity title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT FROM IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d ON c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL ) SELECT ic.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, AVG(ic.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, VARIANCE(ic.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS var_max_enrollment, COUNT(*) AS activity_count FROM inner_cte ic GROUP BY ic.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY var_max_enrollment DESC ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 10 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' ) SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE = t2.SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT s1.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, s1.avg_max_enrollment, s1.var_max_enrollment, s1.activity_count, s2.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s2.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.window_column FROM subq1 s1 JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY cat ON s1.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = cat.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME JOIN subq2 s2 ON cat.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = s2.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY ORDER BY s1.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, s2.ACTIVITY_TITLE;

question: For each department name and course level where the course is degree granting and the total units are greater than 6, and for each academic year in which that department offered subjects, provide the department name, course level, number of unique courses, minimum total units offered, average total units for that department and course level, the academic year, the total range of enrolled students, and the total variance of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department in that academic year (excluding the current term). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.COURSE_LEVEL, ic.course_count, ic.min_total_units, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.COURSE_LEVEL, ic.course_count, ic.min_total_units, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(enrolled_range) AS total_enrolled_range, SUM(enrolled_variance) AS total_enrolled_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, OFFER_DEPT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(enrolled_range) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.COURSE_LEVEL, subq1.course_count, subq1.min_total_units, subq1.avg_total_units, subq2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, subq2.total_enrolled_range, subq2.total_enrolled_variance FROM subq1 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN subq2 ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.COURSE_LEVEL, subq2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC

question: For rooms with an access level of 1, show the building room, floor, space usage, space unit code, space unit name, the average floor within each space unit code group, the total number of rooms per space unit code, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the room square footage for the corresponding space unit, ordered by floor. Do not return any rounded answers.
