SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, AVG(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS avg_room_sqft, STDDEV(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS stddev_room_sqft FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT ), subq1 AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, RoomCounts.total_rooms, inner_cte1.avg_room_sqft, inner_cte1.stddev_room_sqft FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(sd.BUILDING_ROOM) AS total_rooms FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT ) AS RoomCounts ON su.SPACE_UNIT = RoomCounts.SPACE_UNIT JOIN inner_cte1 ON su.SPACE_UNIT = inner_cte1.SPACE_UNIT ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.SPACE_UNIT, AVG(t1.FLOOR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ORDER BY t1.FLOOR) AS avg_floor FROM SPACE_UNIT t0 JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t1 ON t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 ), subq2 AS ( SELECT ic.BUILDING_ROOM, ic.FLOOR, ic.SPACE_USAGE, ic.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, ic.SPACE_UNIT, ic.avg_floor, cnt.total_rooms FROM inner_cte2 ic JOIN ( SELECT SPACE_UNIT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS total_rooms FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD WHERE ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 GROUP BY SPACE_UNIT_CODE ) cnt ON ic.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = cnt.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ) SELECT subq2.BUILDING_ROOM, subq2.FLOOR, subq2.SPACE_USAGE, subq2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, subq2.SPACE_UNIT, subq2.avg_floor, subq2.total_rooms, subq1.avg_room_sqft, subq1.stddev_room_sqft FROM subq2 JOIN subq1 ON subq2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = subq1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ORDER BY subq2.FLOOR;

question: List the subject title, department name, term description, term start date, window column, total enrollment, and reason for inclusion for all subjects offered with a section ID of 0 and a cluster type of 'S' whose department is in the School of Engineering with total enrollment greater than 50 and average enrollment per course at least 20 (reason 'Subject'), as well as all such departments with their department name and total enrollment (reason 'Department'). The columns should be: subject title, department name, term description, term start date, window column, total enrollment, and reason, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS SUBQ1_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.SECTION_ID = 0 AND t0.CLUSTER_TYPE = 'S' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t3.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.SUBQ1_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t3 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t3.TERM_CODE ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_enrollment FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) avg_cte ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = avg_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE avg_cte.avg_enrollment >= 20 ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.TERM_START_DATE, s1.window_column, s2.total_enrollment, 'Subject' AS Reason FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS TERM_START_DATE, NULL AS window_column, s2.total_enrollment, 'Department' AS Reason FROM Subquery2 s2 ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Reason;

question: For each department where the variance of the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects offered by the School of Engineering in the term '2016SP') exceeds the average variance across all departments, provide the department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of courses offered by that department (considering only courses that are offered this year and have a non-null total units value), the variance category of the department (where variance at least 20 is 'HIGH_VARIANCE', less than 5 is 'LOW_VARIANCE', otherwise 'MEDIUM_VARIANCE'), the department code, and the variance of enrolled students, listing the columns in this order: department name, total units range, total units variance, total units standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), variance category, department code, and enrolled students variance. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH dept_units_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccc.total_units IS NOT NULL ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(inner_cte.total_units) - MIN(inner_cte.total_units) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(inner_cte.total_units) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.total_units) AS total_units_stddev, CASE WHEN VARIANCE(inner_cte.total_units) >= 20 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN VARIANCE(inner_cte.total_units) < 5 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'MEDIUM_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), dept_enroll_variance AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.DEPARTMENT, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.DEPARTMENT ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT, i.enrolled_students_variance FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT AVG(enrolled_students_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte ) a ON i.enrolled_students_variance > a.avg_variance ORDER BY i.enrolled_students_variance DESC ) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev, dus.variance_category, dev.DEPARTMENT, dev.enrolled_students_variance FROM dept_units_stats dus JOIN dept_enroll_variance dev ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dev.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department, what is the name of the department, the highest standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students it has ever had in any term (considering only courses that have at least 5 different materials assigned in that term), the range of the number of enrolled students in the courses that have at least one enrolled student and have a material status of 'U', and the variance of the number of enrolled students in those courses? List the department name, highest enrolled students standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), enrolled students range, and enrolled students variance in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH dept_highest_stddev AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.TERM_CODE, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.TERM_CODE HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) >= 5 ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(enrolled_stddev) AS highest_enrolled_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY highest_enrolled_stddev DESC ), dept_enrolled_range_variance AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL d JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC ) SELECT d1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, d1.highest_enrolled_stddev, d2.enrolled_range, d2.enrolled_variance FROM dept_highest_stddev d1 JOIN dept_enrolled_range_variance d2 ON d1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = d2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY d1.highest_enrolled_stddev DESC;

question: For Mathematics department courses with at least 5 enrolled students, show the course number, subject title, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, and the row number within each academic year group ordered by course number, but only include those courses where the number of enrolled students exceeds the average for Mathematics department courses in the same academic year. For each such course, also provide the academic year description, the geometric mean of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during that year (considering only subjects with more than zero enrolled students), and classify the year as 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' if the geometric mean is at least 10% greater than the average across all years, 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' if at least 10% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Show the columns in this order: course number, subject title, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, row number, academic year description, geometric mean enrollment, and enrollment category. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 ), avg_enrollment AS ( SELECT t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 GROUP BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), math_courses AS ( SELECT i.COURSE_NUMBER, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.window_column FROM inner_cte i JOIN avg_enrollment a ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_students ), geom_mean_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), geom_mean_stats AS ( SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_enrollment, CASE WHEN inner_cte.geometric_mean_enrollment > avg_stats.avg_geometric_mean * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN inner_cte.geometric_mean_enrollment < avg_stats.avg_geometric_mean * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM geom_mean_cte inner_cte CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_enrollment) AS avg_geometric_mean FROM geom_mean_cte) avg_stats ) SELECT m.COURSE_NUMBER, m.SUBJECT_TITLE, m.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, m.TERM_DESCRIPTION, m.ACADEMIC_YEAR, m.window_column, g.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, g.geometric_mean_enrollment, g.enrollment_category FROM math_courses m JOIN geom_mean_stats g ON m.ACADEMIC_YEAR = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY m.ACADEMIC_YEAR, m.window_column;

question: For each financial aid year and academic year where the term status is 'Previous', show the financial aid year, academic year, academic year description, department name, the total number of terms in that academic year, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for all library reserve materials offered in terms with a material status of 'U' for that academic year and department. For each financial aid year, include a grand total for all terms in the format of (financial aid year, null, null, null, total terms, null). For each academic year, also include a grand total across all departments in the format of (financial aid year, academic year, academic year description, null, total terms, total coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP)). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH RollupResults AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ), YearTermCounts AS ( SELECT t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.TERM_CODE) AS num_terms FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ) SELECT FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(num_terms) AS total_terms FROM YearTermCounts GROUP BY FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(num_terms) > 0 ), LibraryDeptStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE AND LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT rr.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR, lds.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, lds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.total_terms, lds.coefficient_of_variation FROM RollupResults rr LEFT JOIN LibraryDeptStats lds ON rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR = lds.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY rr.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR, lds.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: Show the library course instructor key, library reserve catalog key, term code, subject ID, tip material key, tip material status key, tip ISBN, the subject title from the subject offered table, the minimum tip material status key in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the number of enrolled students, the total number of reserve materials with material status key equal to 'U' for each subject, and for each matching term, also show the academic year, academic year description, term code, term description, and both the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the record counts of TIP materials associated with that term (considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the TIP material status key is not 'NM'), including subtotals for each academic year (the corresponding term code field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all academic years (the corresponding term code field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the academic year if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by academic year and term code. The columns should be shown in the following order: library course instructor key, library reserve catalog key, term code, subject ID, tip material key, tip material status key, tip ISBN, subject title, minimum tip material status key in window, total reserve materials, academic year, academic year description, term code, term description, variance of record counts, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of record counts. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT l.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, l.TERM_CODE, l.SUBJECT_ID, t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t.ISBN, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MIN(t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) OVER (ORDER BY s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ) SELECT inner_cte.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, inner_cte.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, inner_cte.ISBN, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.window_column, ReserveCounts.Total_Reserve_Materials FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(*) AS Total_Reserve_Materials FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL WHERE LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY SUBJECT_ID ) AS ReserveCounts ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = ReserveCounts.SUBJECT_ID ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_DESCRIPTION ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY academic_year_sort, term_code_sort) = ACADEMIC_YEAR THEN NULL ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS academic_year, academic_year_desc, term_code, term_description, record_count_variance, record_count_stddev FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 9999 ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS academic_year_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_code_sort, ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, VARIANCE(record_count_variance) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(record_count_stddev) AS record_count_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY academic_year_sort, term_code_sort ) SELECT s1.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, s1.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s1.ISBN, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.window_column, s1.Total_Reserve_Materials, s2.academic_year, s2.academic_year_desc, s2.term_code, s2.term_description, s2.record_count_variance, s2.record_count_stddev FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.TERM_CODE = s2.term_code

question: List, in a single table, (1) the academic year, academic year description, variance in the number of tip detail records, most represented department, and count of such subjects from that department for the academic year with the highest variance in the number of tip detail records for subjects offered in the fall term (with at least one associated tip detail record), and (2) for each textbook material in the TIP_DETAIL table with a material status key of 'RQ', the academic year, subject offered key, material key, subject ID, term code, term description, number of textbook materials per academic year, and minimum term code for each academic year, including subtotals for each academic year (the corresponding academic year field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all academic years (the corresponding academic year field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the academic year if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by result type, academic year, and term code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subquery1 AS ( SELECT t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t1.record_count_variance, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Most_Represented_Department, t2.Subject_Count FROM (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(record_count_variance) AS record_count_variance FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC LIMIT 1) t1 JOIN ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME ) t2 ON t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND t2.rn = 1 ORDER BY t1.record_count_variance DESC ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_CODE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ), subquery2 AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(academic_year) OVER (ORDER BY academic_year_sort, min_term_code) = academic_year THEN NULL ELSE academic_year END AS academic_year, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, material_count, min_term_code FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS academic_year_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS academic_year, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(*) AS material_count, MIN(TERM_CODE) AS min_term_code FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY academic_year_sort, min_term_code ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT 'Highest Variance Year' AS Result_Type, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.record_count_variance, s1.Most_Represented_Department, s1.Subject_Count, NULL AS TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, NULL AS TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, NULL AS SUBJECT_ID, NULL AS TERM_CODE, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS material_count, NULL AS min_term_code FROM subquery1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT 'Textbook Materials' AS Result_Type, s2.academic_year, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS record_count_variance, NULL AS Most_Represented_Department, NULL AS Subject_Count, s2.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.TERM_CODE, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.material_count, s2.min_term_code FROM subquery2 s2 ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY Result_Type, academic_year, min_term_code ;

question: For each department, what is the minimum number of lecture units and the total number of units for all subjects offered in the Fall term of the academic year 2022, as well as the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in courses with at least one enrolled student and a material status of 'U'? Also, for each department, what is the subject title with the highest number of enrolled students among those courses, and what is that enrollment count? Include a grand total for all departments in the format of (null, min_lecture_units, total_units, enrolled_range, enrolled_variance, top_subject_title, top_enrollment). Present the columns in the following order: department name, minimum lecture units, total units, enrolled range, enrolled variance, top subject title, and top enrollment. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS min_lecture_units, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.TERM_DESCRIPTION LIKE 'Fall Term%' AND c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, min_lecture_units, total_units FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT NULL, MIN(min_lecture_units), SUM(total_units) FROM inner_cte ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL d JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, st.SUBJECT_TITLE AS top_subject_title, st.max_enrolled AS top_enrollment FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS max_enrolled FROM ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte ) ranked WHERE rn = 1 ) st ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = st.OFFER_DEPT_NAME GROUP BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, st.SUBJECT_TITLE, st.max_enrolled ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.min_lecture_units, s1.total_units, s2.enrolled_range, s2.enrolled_variance, s2.top_subject_title, s2.top_enrollment FROM subq1 s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY CASE WHEN s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each space unit where the number of rooms with an access level of at least 1 is greater than the average number of such rooms per space unit, list the space unit name, the number of rooms assigned to it, the DLC key, the corresponding DLC name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of organizations associated with that DLC key (considering only DLC keys and organization names that are not null), as well as the total number of unique organizations per DLC key. Show the results ordered by the number of rooms (descending), then by the organization count range (descending). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH SpaceUnitRoomCounts AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, su.DLC_KEY, COUNT(zr.BUILDING_ROOM) AS room_count FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD zr ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = zr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE zr.ACCESS_LEVEL >= 1 GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, su.DLC_KEY ) SELECT SPACE_UNIT, DLC_KEY, room_count FROM inner_cte WHERE room_count > (SELECT AVG(room_count) FROM inner_cte) ), DlcOrgStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fdlk.DLC_KEY, MAX(org_count) - MIN(org_count) AS org_count_range, VARIANCE(org_count) AS org_count_variance, STDDEV(org_count) AS org_count_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fdlk JOIN ( SELECT fo.DLC_KEY, COUNT(*) AS org_count FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fo.DLC_KEY ) org_stats ON fdlk.DLC_KEY = org_stats.DLC_KEY WHERE fdlk.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fdlk.DLC_KEY ) SELECT ic.DLC_KEY, fo.DLC_NAME, ic.org_count_range, ic.org_count_variance, ic.org_count_stddev, org_totals.total_organizations FROM inner_cte ic JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON ic.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN ( SELECT DLC_KEY, COUNT(DISTINCT FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS total_organizations FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION WHERE ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NOT NULL AND DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DLC_KEY ) org_totals ON ic.DLC_KEY = org_totals.DLC_KEY GROUP BY ic.DLC_KEY, fo.DLC_NAME, ic.org_count_range, ic.org_count_variance, ic.org_count_stddev, org_totals.total_organizations ORDER BY org_count_range DESC ) SELECT surc.SPACE_UNIT, surc.room_count, dos.DLC_KEY, dos.DLC_NAME, dos.org_count_range, dos.org_count_variance, dos.org_count_stddev, dos.total_organizations FROM SpaceUnitRoomCounts surc JOIN DlcOrgStats dos ON surc.DLC_KEY = dos.DLC_KEY ORDER BY surc.room_count DESC, dos.org_count_range DESC;

question: For each department hierarchy level 3, department hierarchy level 2, and department code, list the number of unique space units with a space unit key equal to 402410, along with the major organization, top-level HR organization name, HR department name, and the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the organization numbers for each HR department name (considering only organizations that are assignable and have a non-null organization number). For each department hierarchy level 3, include a grand total for all space units in the format of (null, null, null, total space units). The results are ordered by department hierarchy level 3 name, department hierarchy level 2 name, department code, and descending organization number variance. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS organization_name, t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME AS dept_hier_level_3_name, t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME AS dept_hier_level_2_name, t1.DLC_KEY AS department_code, MIN(t2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) OVER (ORDER BY t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = 402410 ) SELECT dept_hier_level_3_name, dept_hier_level_2_name, department_code, COUNT(DISTINCT space_unit_name) AS total_space_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY dept_hier_level_3_name, dept_hier_level_2_name, department_code WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT space_unit_name) > 0 ORDER BY dept_hier_level_3_name, dept_hier_level_2_name, department_code ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT F.MAJOR_ORG, H.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME, AVG(F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS avg_org_number, VARIANCE(F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance, STDDEV(F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION F JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT H ON F.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = H.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE F.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER IS NOT NULL GROUP BY F.MAJOR_ORG, H.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME ) SELECT icte.MAJOR_ORG, icte.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME, H.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS avg_org_number, VARIANCE(F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance, STDDEV(F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev FROM inner_cte icte JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION F ON icte.MAJOR_ORG = F.MAJOR_ORG JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT H ON F.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = H.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD AND icte.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME = H.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME WHERE F.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER IS NOT NULL GROUP BY icte.MAJOR_ORG, icte.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME, H.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY org_number_variance DESC ) SELECT s1.dept_hier_level_3_name, s1.dept_hier_level_2_name, s1.department_code, s1.total_space_units, s2.MAJOR_ORG, s2.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME, s2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.avg_org_number, s2.org_number_variance, s2.org_number_stddev FROM subq1 s1 LEFT JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON s1.department_code = fo.DLC_KEY LEFT JOIN subq2 s2 ON fo.MAJOR_ORG = s2.MAJOR_ORG AND s2.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME = s1.dept_hier_level_2_name ORDER BY s1.dept_hier_level_3_name, s1.dept_hier_level_2_name, s1.department_code, s2.org_number_variance DESC;

question: For each subject among the top 10 subjects by number of reserved library materials offered in the term '2009SP', list the subject title, the offering department name, the count of reserved library materials, the total number of enrolled students for that subject, and for each matching department among the top 5 departments with the highest number of 12-unit subjects offered in the Fall Term 2024-2025, also list the department name, the total count of such subjects, the school name, the subject with the highest enrollment in that department (show its subject ID and title), and the enrollment number for that subject. Show only results where the subject's offering department matches one of the top 5 departments by 12-unit subject count in Fall Term 2024-2025, and order the results by the number of reserved materials and then by the subject count. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials, s.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.reserved_materials, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.SUBJECT_ID FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON i.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID AND s.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' ORDER BY i.reserved_materials DESC LIMIT 10 ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SCHOOL_NAME, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(ic.SUBJECT_ID) AS Subject_Count, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic2.SUBJECT_ID AS Top_Subject_ID, ic2.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Top_Subject_Title, ic2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER AS Top_Subject_Enrollment FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER DESC, SUBJECT_ID) AS rn FROM inner_cte ) ic2 ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic2.rn = 1 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic2.SUBJECT_ID, ic2.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER ORDER BY Subject_Count DESC LIMIT 5 ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.reserved_materials, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.Subject_Count, s2.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.Top_Subject_ID, s2.Top_Subject_Title, s2.Top_Subject_Enrollment FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.reserved_materials DESC, s2.Subject_Count DESC

question: For each department, show the department name, academic year, academic year description, and the geometric mean of the total units for all subjects offered by the department in regular terms with total units greater than zero, and for each subject offered by the department in the 2019FA term, show the subject ID, subject title, number of enrolled students, department full name, the department's average enrollment, and indicate whether the number of enrolled students is 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% greater than the average for that department), 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% less than the average for that department), or 'AVERAGE'. The results are ordered by department name, academic year (descending), and subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH geometric_mean_units AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subject_enrollment AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM subject_enrollment GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT gm.DEPARTMENT_NAME, gm.ACADEMIC_YEAR, gm.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gm.geometric_mean_total_units, se.SUBJECT_ID, se.SUBJECT_TITLE, se.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, se.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, da.avg_enrollment, CASE WHEN se.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > da.avg_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN se.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < da.avg_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM geometric_mean_units gm JOIN subject_enrollment se ON gm.DEPARTMENT_NAME = se.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN dept_avg da ON se.DEPARTMENT_NAME = da.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY gm.DEPARTMENT_NAME, gm.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC, se.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each department hierarchy and each major organization, list the department hierarchy name, the number of organizations in that hierarchy, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the organization level for organizations in that hierarchy, the major organization, the top-level HR organization name, the HR department name, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the organization numbers for that major organization and top-level HR organization, including a grand total row for all organizations (with null department hierarchy name). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptHierarchyStats AS ( SELECT MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME, AVG(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) AS avg_org_level, STDDEV(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) AS org_level_stddev, COUNT(*) AS num_organizations FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL IS NOT NULL GROUP BY MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME ), DeptHierarchyResult AS ( SELECT DLC_NAME, num_organizations, avg_org_level, org_level_stddev FROM DeptHierarchyStats UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS DLC_NAME, SUM(num_organizations) AS num_organizations, AVG(avg_org_level) AS avg_org_level, STDDEV(avg_org_level) AS org_level_stddev FROM DeptHierarchyStats ), MajorOrgStats AS ( SELECT F.MAJOR_ORG, H.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME, AVG(F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS avg_org_number, VARIANCE(F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance, STDDEV(F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION F JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT H ON F.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = H.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE F.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER IS NOT NULL GROUP BY F.MAJOR_ORG, H.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME ), MajorOrgResult AS ( SELECT icte.MAJOR_ORG, icte.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME, H.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_org_number, icte.org_number_variance, icte.org_number_stddev FROM MajorOrgStats icte JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT H ON icte.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME = H.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME ) SELECT D.DLC_NAME, D.num_organizations, D.avg_org_level, D.org_level_stddev, M.MAJOR_ORG, M.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME, M.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, M.avg_org_number, M.org_number_variance, M.org_number_stddev FROM DeptHierarchyResult D JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION F ON D.DLC_NAME = F.DLC_NAME OR (D.DLC_NAME IS NULL) JOIN MajorOrgResult M ON F.MAJOR_ORG = M.MAJOR_ORG ORDER BY D.DLC_NAME, M.org_number_variance DESC;

question: For each department in the School of Engineering that offers more than 10 tip materials for subjects during regular terms, list the department name, the total number of tip materials offered, the average number of units for those subjects, and for each degree granting course in that department, show the course description, subject title, the subject's grade type description, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptTipMaterials AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL t JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) > 10 ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_tip_materials, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_tip_materials ), DegreeGrantingCourses AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.GRADE_TYPE_DESC, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE = t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.total_tip_materials, d.avg_units, c.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.GRADE_TYPE_DESC, c.window_column FROM DeptTipMaterials d JOIN DegreeGrantingCourses c ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each offering department and school where the course material status is 'RQ' and the department has subjects offered in the current term, provide the department name, school name, number of unique subjects with 'RQ' status, minimum total units for those subjects, average number of enrolled students for those subjects, subject title, responsible faculty name, term description, academic year description, and the total number of subjects offered per department in the current term. List the columns in the following order: department name, school name, subject count, minimum total units, average number of enrolled students, subject title, responsible faculty name, term description, academic year description, and total number of subjects per department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH rq_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_num_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte ic JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units ), current_term_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM' ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, dept_counts.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS Total_Subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM' GROUP BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) dept_counts ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_counts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT rq.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, rq.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, rq.subject_count, rq.min_total_units, rq.avg_num_enrolled_students, ct.SUBJECT_TITLE, ct.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ct.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ct.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ct.Total_Subjects FROM rq_stats rq JOIN current_term_stats ct ON rq.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = ct.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY rq.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ct.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each department that is both in the Provost Area and in the Sloan School of Management Area with a hierarchy type of "Standard Hierarchy", list the department name, the corresponding organization key, the number of organizations, the minimum department hierarchy level 3 code, the department hierarchy level 3 name, the department code, the department name, the dense rank of each department considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the department's long name, and the corresponding DLC name from the MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY table, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_CODE) AS min_level3_code FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ), provost_dept_stats AS ( SELECT inner_cte1.DLC_NAME, inner_cte1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, inner_cte1.org_count, inner_cte1.min_level3_code, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, m.DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte1 JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m ON inner_cte1.DLC_NAME = m.DLC_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DLC_KEY, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME = 'Sloan School of Management Area' ), sloan_dept_stats AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.window_column, t0.DLC_NAME, inner_cte2.DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte2 JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 ON inner_cte2.DLC_KEY = t0.DLC_KEY ) SELECT pds.DLC_NAME, pds.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, pds.org_count, pds.min_level3_code, pds.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, sds.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, sds.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sds.window_column, sds.DLC_NAME AS SLOAN_DLC_NAME FROM provost_dept_stats pds JOIN sloan_dept_stats sds ON pds.DLC_KEY = sds.DLC_KEY ORDER BY pds.DLC_NAME, sds.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: List, for each department, the department name, academic year, academic year description, number of degree-granting subjects offered in 2022 (if at least 5), average, range, and variance of total units for those subjects, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for all library reserve materials offered in terms with material status 'U', along with a reason for inclusion ('2022 Degree-Granting Subjects' for the first case and 'Library Reserve Materials' for the second). The columns should be: department name, academic year, academic year description, subject count, average total units, total units range, total units variance, coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and reason. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptStats2022 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS subject_count, AVG(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ), LibResMatrlStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), CombinedStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, d.subject_count, d.avg_total_units, d.total_units_range, d.total_units_variance, NULL AS coefficient_of_variation, '2022 Degree-Granting Subjects' AS Reason FROM DeptStats2022 d UNION ALL SELECT l.DEPARTMENT_NAME, l.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS subject_count, NULL AS avg_total_units, NULL AS total_units_range, NULL AS total_units_variance, l.coefficient_of_variation, 'Library Reserve Materials' AS Reason FROM LibResMatrlStats l ) SELECT * FROM CombinedStats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Reason;

question: For departments in the "Sloan School of Management" area with a hierarchy type of "Standard Hierarchy", show the department code, department name, the dense rank of each department considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the department's long name, the corresponding DLC name, and for each such department, show the space unit code, organization name, HR department name from the space unit, the sum of space unit keys within each warehouse load date group, and the HR org unit title for space units with a space unit key greater than 100000, ordered by department code and space unit code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME = 'Sloan School of Management Area' ), subq1 AS ( SELECT i.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.window_column, m.DLC_NAME, i.DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte1 i JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m ON i.DLC_KEY = m.DLC_KEY ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE ORDER BY t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column, t1.DLC_KEY FROM SPACE_UNIT t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000 ), subq2 AS ( SELECT inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, t3.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, inner_cte.DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte2 inner_cte JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t3 ON inner_cte.DLC_KEY = t3.DLC_KEY ) SELECT s1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, s1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column AS dept_dense_rank, s1.DLC_NAME, s2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, s2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS space_hr_dept_name, s2.window_column AS space_sum_within_load_date, s2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DLC_KEY = s2.DLC_KEY ORDER BY s1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, s2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE;

question: For each department, list the department name, the average number of enrolled students in each subject offered in the fall term with more than 0 enrolled students, the variance of the number of enrolled students in these subjects, the minimum number of enrolled students in any subject in the School of Engineering with required materials, and the total number of required material records for subjects in that department. The minimum enrolled students and total material records are shown only for departments in the School of Engineering; for other departments, these values will be null. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC ), EngineeringMaterialStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled, SUM(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_material_records FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(min_enrolled) AS min_enrolled, SUM(total_material_records) AS total_material_records FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME WITH ROLLUP ) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_variance, ems.min_enrolled, ems.total_material_records FROM DepartmentEnrollmentStats des LEFT JOIN EngineeringMaterialStats ems ON des.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ems.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY des.enrollment_variance DESC, des.avg_enrollment DESC

question: For each department name and school name in the School of Engineering, where the number of enrolled students in the offered subject is greater than 3, show the number of offered subjects, the minimum number of enrolled students, the subject title with the highest number of enrolled students in that department and school, the subject title, the number of enrolled students, the total number of material records with status 'RQ', and whether the subject is 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% less than the average enrolled students for Engineering subjects), 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% more than the average), or 'AVERAGE'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS offered_subject_count, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME ), cte1 AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.offered_subject_count, ic.min_enrolled_students, ls.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_with_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte1 ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC) AS rn FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 ) ls ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ls.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.SCHOOL_NAME = ls.SCHOOL_NAME AND ls.rn = 1 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, SUM(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_material_records FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ), avg_enrollment AS ( SELECT AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ), cte2 AS ( SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.total_material_records, CASE WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_enrolled * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < a.avg_enrolled * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte2 i CROSS JOIN avg_enrollment a ) SELECT c1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c1.SCHOOL_NAME, c1.offered_subject_count, c1.min_enrolled_students, c1.subject_with_max_enrollment, c2.SUBJECT_TITLE, c2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, c2.total_material_records, c2.enrollment_category FROM cte1 c1 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON c1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND c1.SCHOOL_NAME = s.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN cte2 c2 ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = c2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE c1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ORDER BY c1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c2.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each academic year where the geometric mean of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during that year (considering only subjects with more than zero enrolled students) is greater than the overall geometric mean across all years, and among the top 10 academic years with the highest coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for all library reserve materials offered in terms that have a material status of 'U', display the academic year description, the geometric mean of enrolled students, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), the department with the highest average total units in those terms, and that average, ordered by geometric mean of enrolled students in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH geometric_mean_enrollment_cte AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, geometric_mean_enrollment FROM inner_cte WHERE geometric_mean_enrollment > ( SELECT EXP(AVG(LN(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) ), coefficient_of_variation_cte AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.coefficient_of_variation, dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Top_Department, dept_stats.avg_total_units AS Department_Avg_Total_Units FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) DESC) AS rn FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) dept_stats ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dept_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND dept_stats.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.coefficient_of_variation DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT gme.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gme.geometric_mean_enrollment, cov.coefficient_of_variation, cov.Top_Department, cov.Department_Avg_Total_Units FROM geometric_mean_enrollment_cte gme JOIN coefficient_of_variation_cte cov ON gme.ACADEMIC_YEAR = cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY gme.geometric_mean_enrollment DESC;

question: For subjects offered in the term with code '2022FA', show the subject ID, department name, term description, the running sum of total units within each academic year, the subject title, whether the subject is offered in the fall term, the minimum record count from TIP_DETAIL, and the total new shelf price from TIP_MATERIAL for each subject (where the material has a non-null author and a material info source of 'ISBN'), ordered by subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.window_column, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM FROM inner_cte icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON icte.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID AND t2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT td.TERM_CODE, td.SUBJECT_ID, MIN(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS min_record_count, SUM(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS total_new_shelf_price FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE tm.AUTHOR IS NOT NULL AND tm.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE = 'ISBN' GROUP BY td.TERM_CODE, td.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.min_record_count, inner_cte.total_new_shelf_price FROM inner_cte ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.window_column, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM, s2.min_record_count, s2.total_new_shelf_price FROM subq1 s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 s2 ON s2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For all subjects in the 2014FA term with at least one enrolled student, show the subject title, offering department name, responsible faculty name, the TIP material status key, the total number of units, and the maximum total number of units in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows ordered by the course number, along with the highest number of students enrolled in any subject in the year 2022 for the same department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, lso.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TOTAL_UNITS, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_units_window, SUBJECT_ID FROM inner_cte ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS engineering_subjects_2022 FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ss.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ss.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 ) SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ss.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ss.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s1.TOTAL_UNITS, s1.max_units_window, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.max_enrollment FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each subject offered in the academic term with term code '2006FA' by departments in the School of Engineering, show the subject ID, subject title, department name, the sum of lecture units within each grade type group ordered by subject ID, the name of the responsible faculty member for each subject, the total units, the department full name, and the difference between the total units of each subject and the average total units for that department, ordered by subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.LECTURE_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA' ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT i1.SUBJECT_ID, i1.SUBJECT_TITLE, i1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i1.window_column, i1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, i2.TOTAL_UNITS, i2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, (i2.TOTAL_UNITS - d.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_dept_avg FROM inner_cte1 i1 JOIN inner_cte2 i2 ON i1.SUBJECT_TITLE = i2.SUBJECT_TITLE AND i1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = i2.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN dept_avg d ON i2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY i1.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For organizations with an organization level of 5, show their organization names (do not repeat the organization name if it is the same as the previous row), the dense rank of their corresponding HR department names (considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the HR department code from the HR organization unit table), the HR department's full name, and school/area name, as well as, for rooms on floor 2 belonging to those departments, the building room, its space usage, the HR org unit title, the department's long name, and the minimum access level in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the building component. Sort the table by organization name, HR department name, and building room. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH org_dept_window AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ), rooms_floor2 AS ( SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.SPACE_USAGE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, MIN(t0.ACCESS_LEVEL) OVER (ORDER BY t0.BUILDING_COMPONENT ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2 ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(odw.ORGANIZATION_NAME) OVER (ORDER BY odw.ORGANIZATION_NAME, odw.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = odw.ORGANIZATION_NAME THEN NULL ELSE odw.ORGANIZATION_NAME END AS organization_name, odw.window_column AS org_dense_rank, odw.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, odw.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, rf2.BUILDING_ROOM, rf2.SPACE_USAGE, rf2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, rf2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, rf2.window_column AS min_access_level_window FROM org_dept_window odw JOIN rooms_floor2 rf2 ON odw.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = rf2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID ORDER BY organization_name, odw.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, rf2.BUILDING_ROOM;

question: For each course in the SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION table with a department code of 6, list the department name, school name, course, course description, program code, program title, category code, category title, four digit code, four digit title, and the minimum warehouse load date from the CIP table over each category code group, as well as the total number of courses in that school (with nulls for course-specific fields in the school total rows). Additionally, for each department, include the highest variance of the total units of subjects offered in any academic year as the highest_units_variance column. The results are ordered by school name, category code, and course. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subq1 AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(total_units_variance) AS highest_units_variance FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.PROGRAM_CODE, c.PROGRAM_TITLE, c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY c.CATEGORY_CODE) AS min_warehouse_load_date FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION s JOIN CIP c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT = 6 ), SchoolTotals AS ( SELECT NULL AS COURSE, NULL AS COURSE_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS PROGRAM_CODE, NULL AS PROGRAM_TITLE, NULL AS CATEGORY_CODE, NULL AS CATEGORY_TITLE, NULL AS FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, NULL AS FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, NULL AS min_warehouse_load_date, COUNT(*) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ), subq2 AS ( SELECT i.COURSE, i.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.PROGRAM_CODE, i.PROGRAM_TITLE, i.CATEGORY_CODE, i.CATEGORY_TITLE, i.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, i.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, i.min_warehouse_load_date, NULL AS total_courses FROM inner_cte2 i UNION ALL SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.PROGRAM_CODE, s.PROGRAM_TITLE, s.CATEGORY_CODE, s.CATEGORY_TITLE, s.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, s.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, s.min_warehouse_load_date, s.total_courses FROM SchoolTotals s ) SELECT subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq2.SCHOOL_NAME, subq2.COURSE, subq2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, subq2.PROGRAM_CODE, subq2.PROGRAM_TITLE, subq2.CATEGORY_CODE, subq2.CATEGORY_TITLE, subq2.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, subq2.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, subq2.min_warehouse_load_date, subq2.total_courses, subq1.highest_units_variance FROM subq2 LEFT JOIN subq1 ON subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subq2.SCHOOL_NAME, subq2.CATEGORY_CODE, subq2.COURSE

question: For each subject offered in the term with the description "Fall Term 2024-2025", show the subject offered key, subject title, offering department name, the term description, the number of subjects offered by each department in that term, the academic year, the number of unique subjects offered by the department in that academic year (where the number of enrolled students in a subject is greater than 5), the minimum number of total units for those subjects, and the average number of enrolled students per subject. For each department, include a grand total for all subjects offered in the format of (null, null, offering department name, term description, total subjects, ...), and only include departments and academic years where the number of enrolled students in a subject is greater than 5. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' ), DeptSubjectCounts AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(*) AS num_subjects FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, TERM_DESCRIPTION WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ), SubjectOfferings AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN dsc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE ict.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY END AS TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, CASE WHEN dsc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE ict.SUBJECT_TITLE END AS SUBJECT_TITLE, dsc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dsc.TERM_DESCRIPTION, dsc.num_subjects, ict.TERM_CODE FROM DeptSubjectCounts dsc LEFT JOIN inner_cte1 ict ON dsc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = ict.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND dsc.TERM_DESCRIPTION = ict.TERM_DESCRIPTION ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), DeptEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.subject_count, i.min_total_units, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte2 i JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = c.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND t.ACADEMIC_YEAR = i.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.subject_count, i.min_total_units ) SELECT so.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, so.TERM_DESCRIPTION, so.num_subjects, des.ACADEMIC_YEAR, des.subject_count, des.min_total_units, des.avg_enrolled_students FROM SubjectOfferings so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN DeptEnrollmentStats des ON so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND at.ACADEMIC_YEAR = des.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, so.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY

question: For rooms with a square footage of 150, and for organizations whose parent is 'S H&SS', show the building room, room number, space unit code, space unit name, the number of rooms for each space unit code (including a grand total for all rooms as (null, null, space unit code, space unit name, total rooms)), the organization name, description, the HR org unit title, the HR department name, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the organization name, for each combination where the space unit's organization matches the organization. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT sd.BUILDING_ROOM, sd.ROOM_NUMBER, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, su.SPACE_UNIT FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY WHERE sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE = 150 ), RoomCounts AS ( SELECT BUILDING_ROOM, ROOM_NUMBER, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(*) AS num_rooms FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY BUILDING_ROOM, ROOM_NUMBER, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, SPACE_UNIT ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT BUILDING_ROOM, ROOM_NUMBER, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, SPACE_UNIT, SUM(num_rooms) AS total_rooms FROM RoomCounts GROUP BY BUILDING_ROOM, ROOM_NUMBER, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, SPACE_UNIT WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(num_rooms) > 0 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.ORG_PARENT = 'S H&SS' ), OrgResults AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte2.DESCRIPTION, inner_cte2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.window_column, inner_cte2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM inner_cte2 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON inner_cte2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE ) SELECT rr.BUILDING_ROOM, rr.ROOM_NUMBER, rr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, rr.SPACE_UNIT, rr.total_rooms, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.DESCRIPTION, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.window_column FROM RollupResults rr JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON rr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE JOIN OrgResults o ON su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY rr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, rr.BUILDING_ROOM, rr.ROOM_NUMBER, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME

question: For each department and academic year, provide the department name, academic year, the number of subjects offered that are not repeatable for credit and are offered in the fall term, the average number of such subjects across all departments for that year, the activity level classification ('HIGH_ACTIVITY', 'LOW_ACTIVITY', or 'AVERAGE'), the school name, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with at least one enrolled student). Do not return any rounded answers.
