SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.GRADE_RULE_DESC = 'Not repeatable for credit' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(subject_count) AS avg_subject_count FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ), dept_activity AS ( SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.subject_count, d.avg_subject_count, CASE WHEN i.subject_count > d.avg_subject_count * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ACTIVITY' WHEN i.subject_count < d.avg_subject_count * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ACTIVITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS activity_level FROM inner_cte1 i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ), dept_enroll_var AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte2 ic JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT da.DEPARTMENT_NAME, da.ACADEMIC_YEAR, da.subject_count, da.avg_subject_count, da.activity_level, dev.SCHOOL_NAME, dev.coefficient_of_variation FROM dept_activity da JOIN dept_enroll_var dev ON da.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dev.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY da.ACADEMIC_YEAR, da.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department in the School of Engineering with total student enrollment in its courses greater than the average total enrollment across all Engineering departments (and with total enrollment greater than 50), display the department name, the total number of students enrolled in its courses, and the highest average total units for subjects it has ever offered in a regular academic term, listing the results in descending order of total enrollment. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH highest_avg_units AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.TERM_CODE, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.TERM_CODE ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(avg_total_units) AS highest_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY highest_avg_total_units DESC ), eng_dept_enrollment AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_enrollment FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT AVG(total_enrollment) AS avg_enrollment FROM ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ) sub ) a ON i.total_enrollment > a.avg_enrollment ) SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.total_enrollment, h.highest_avg_total_units FROM eng_dept_enrollment e LEFT JOIN highest_avg_units h ON e.DEPARTMENT_NAME = h.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY e.total_enrollment DESC;

question: For departments where the number of subjects with more than 0 enrolled students in 2017 is greater than 5 and the number of subjects per department that have at least one associated course material is at least 3, give the department name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department in 2017, the total number of such subjects per department, the subject title, the number of enrolled students for that subject, and the total number of subjects per department that have at least one associated course material, listing the columns in this order: department name, enrolled students variance, enrolled students standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), number of subjects with more than 0 enrolled students in 2017, subject title, number of enrolled students for that subject, and total number of subjects per department with at least one associated course material. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2017%' ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev, COUNT(*) AS num_subjects FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, dept_totals.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_TITLE) AS Total_Subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) dept_totals ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_totals.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.enrolled_students_variance, subq1.enrolled_students_stddev, subq1.num_subjects, subq2.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, subq2.Total_Subjects FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME WHERE subq1.num_subjects > 5 AND subq2.Total_Subjects >= 3 ORDER BY subq1.enrolled_students_variance DESC, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq2.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each offering department name and school name where the number of enrolled students is greater than 2, provide the count of distinct subject IDs, the minimum ISBN value for the associated course materials, and the total number of course materials per department and school, and for each course in that department offered in the year 2022 with at least one required or optional textbook and with total units greater than the average total units of all such courses, show the course's subject code, subject number, department name, subject title, the term description, the textbook material key, the textbook material status key, and the row number within each department ordered by subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(td.ISBN) AS min_isbn FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, i.subject_count, i.min_isbn, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_materials FROM inner_cte i JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND i.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, i.subject_count, i.min_isbn ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IN ('RQ', 'EO') ) SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE TOTAL_UNITS > ( SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IN ('RQ', 'EO') ) ) SELECT s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s1.subject_count, s1.min_isbn, s1.total_materials, s2.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2.window_column FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each department, show the department name, subject code, subject title, term description, total number of subjects offered per department for subjects offered in the term with the description "Fall Term 2024-2025", and for each of these subjects, show the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of rooms used for subjects offered by that department (considering only rooms with an area greater than 40), as well as the area of the room used by each subject. Present the columns in the following order: department name, subject code, subject title, term description, total number of subjects, average area, area variance, area standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and room area. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, dept_counts.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_CODE) AS Total_Subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS dept_counts ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(f.AREA) AS avg_area, VARIANCE(f.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(f.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS f JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON f.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = c.MEET_PLACE WHERE f.AREA > 40 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_area, ic.area_variance, ic.area_stddev, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, f.AREA AS room_area FROM inner_cte ic JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN FCLT_ROOMS f ON f.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = c.MEET_PLACE WHERE f.AREA > 40 ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.Total_Subjects, s2.avg_area, s2.area_variance, s2.area_stddev, s2.room_area FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s1.SUBJECT_TITLE = s2.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For each department, list the department name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department in 2017 (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students), the total number of such subjects per department, the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects that are offered this year and are letter graded), and include only those departments where the average total units is greater than the overall average total units for such subjects. Show the columns in the following order: department name, enrolled students variance, enrolled students standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), total number of subjects, average total units, and total units variance. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH enrollment_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2017%' ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ), units_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, total_units_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_total_units > ( SELECT AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' ) ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), CombinedStats AS ( SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.enrolled_students_variance, e.enrolled_students_stddev, e.total_subjects, u.avg_total_units, u.total_units_variance FROM enrollment_stats e JOIN units_stats u ON e.DEPARTMENT_NAME = u.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, enrolled_students_variance, enrolled_students_stddev, total_subjects, avg_total_units, total_units_variance FROM CombinedStats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each degree-granting department that offered at least one subject in the School of Engineering in 2021, provide the department code, department name, department full name, the number of subjects offered in 2021, the total number of enrolled students in those subjects in 2021, the average number of enrolled students per subject in 2021, and, if available, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students per subject offered by that department in the term 2019FA, along with the total number of subjects offered by each department in 2019FA. List the results ordered by department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptStats2019FA AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_ID, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev, dept_subject_counts.total_subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects FROM STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS dept_subject_counts ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_subject_counts.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dept_subject_counts.total_subjects ), DegreeEng2021 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.total_enrollment, CASE WHEN inner_cte.subject_count > 0 THEN inner_cte.total_enrollment * 1.0 / inner_cte.subject_count ELSE NULL END AS avg_enrollment_per_subject FROM inner_cte ) SELECT d21.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d21.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d21.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d21.subject_count, d21.total_enrollment, d21.avg_enrollment_per_subject, ds19.enrolled_range, ds19.enrolled_variance, ds19.enrolled_stddev, ds19.total_subjects AS total_subjects_2019FA FROM DegreeEng2021 d21 LEFT JOIN DeptStats2019FA ds19 ON d21.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds19.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d21.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department and each space unit with a space unit code equal to 97500 that is associated with the department, provide the department name, the average, range, and variance of the number of supervisees for all space units associated with that department, the total square footage and total research volume for the department, the space unit name, the associated organization's name, the DLC name, the DLC key from the organization, the minimum space unit code in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the facility organization key, and the total number of space units for each organization. List the results ordered by the supervisee range in descending order and then by the total number of space units for the organization in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DepartmentSuperviseeStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT AS department_name, AVG(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS avg_supervisees, MAX(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) - MIN(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS supervisee_range, VARIANCE(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS supervisee_variance FROM SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE JOIN SPACE_UNIT ON SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.DEPT_NAMES = SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY GROUP BY SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT ) SELECT inner_cte.department_name, inner_cte.avg_supervisees, inner_cte.supervisee_range, inner_cte.supervisee_variance, SUM(SSU.SQFT) AS total_sqft, SUM(SSU.RESEARCH_VOLUME) AS total_research_volume, MAX(SU.DLC_KEY) AS department_dlc_key FROM inner_cte JOIN SPACE_UNIT SU ON inner_cte.department_name = SU.SPACE_UNIT JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE SSU ON SU.DLC_KEY = SSU.DEPT_NAMES GROUP BY inner_cte.department_name, inner_cte.avg_supervisees, inner_cte.supervisee_range, inner_cte.supervisee_variance ), SpaceUnitOrgStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS organization_name, t1.DLC_NAME AS dlc_name, t1.DLC_KEY AS org_dlc_key, MIN(t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_min_space_unit_code, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 97500 ) SELECT inner_cte.space_unit_name, inner_cte.organization_name, inner_cte.dlc_name, inner_cte.org_dlc_key, inner_cte.window_min_space_unit_code, COUNT(su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS total_space_units_for_org, inner_cte.org_dlc_key AS join_dlc_key FROM inner_cte JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON inner_cte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY GROUP BY inner_cte.space_unit_name, inner_cte.organization_name, inner_cte.dlc_name, inner_cte.org_dlc_key, inner_cte.window_min_space_unit_code ) SELECT dss.department_name, dss.avg_supervisees, dss.supervisee_range, dss.supervisee_variance, dss.total_sqft, dss.total_research_volume, sus.space_unit_name, sus.organization_name, sus.dlc_name, sus.org_dlc_key, sus.window_min_space_unit_code, sus.total_space_units_for_org FROM DepartmentSuperviseeStats dss JOIN SpaceUnitOrgStats sus ON dss.department_dlc_key = sus.join_dlc_key ORDER BY dss.supervisee_range DESC, sus.total_space_units_for_org DESC;

question: List all departments that either (1) have the highest standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students they have ever had in any term (considering only courses with at least 5 different materials assigned in that term), or (2) are in the School of Engineering during regular terms and have a total number of tip materials for their subjects greater than 10, along with the department name, the highest standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrolled students (if applicable), the total number of tip materials (if applicable), the average number of tip materials per subject (if applicable), and the reason for inclusion ('HighStddev' for the first case and 'EngMaterials' for the second case). The columns should be: department name, highest enrolled students standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), total tip materials, average tip materials per subject, and reason. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptStddev AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.TERM_CODE, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.TERM_CODE HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) >= 5 ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(enrolled_stddev) AS highest_enrolled_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY highest_enrolled_stddev DESC ), EngDeptMaterials AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL t JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) > 10 ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_tip_materials, AVG(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_tip_materials_per_subject FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON s.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_tip_materials ) SELECT d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.highest_enrolled_stddev, NULL AS total_tip_materials, NULL AS avg_tip_materials_per_subject, 'HighStddev' AS Reason FROM DeptStddev d UNION ALL SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS highest_enrolled_stddev, e.total_tip_materials, e.avg_tip_materials_per_subject, 'EngMaterials' AS Reason FROM EngDeptMaterials e ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department name and school name where the department is degree granting, provide the number of unique courses and the minimum CIP program code from the course descriptions, along with the administrative department name, term, and the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 100. Additionally, for each school, include a grand total for all departments in that school in the format of (null, school name, total courses, min CIP code), and for each administrative department, include subtotals (with the term field as 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all administrative departments and terms (with the term field as 'TOTAL'). The columns should be: department name, school name, total courses, minimum CIP program code, administrative department name, term, and total enrolled students, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(course_count) AS total_courses, MIN(min_cip_code) AS min_cip_code FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(course_count) > 0 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100 ), cte2_rollup AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(admin_dept) OVER (ORDER BY admin_dept_sort, term_sort) = admin_dept THEN NULL ELSE admin_dept END AS admin_dept, term, total_enrolled, SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS admin_dept_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS admin_dept, SUM(total_enrolled) AS total_enrolled, MAX(SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, TERM_CODE WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY admin_dept_sort, term_sort ) SELECT rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.total_courses, rr.min_cip_code, cte2_rollup.admin_dept, cte2_rollup.term, cte2_rollup.total_enrolled FROM RollupResults rr LEFT JOIN inner_cte1 ic1 ON rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic1.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND rr.SCHOOL_NAME = ic1.SCHOOL_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN cte2_rollup ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = cte2_rollup.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte2_rollup.admin_dept, cte2_rollup.term

question: For all subjects in the 2014FA term with at least one enrolled student, show the subject title, offering department name, responsible faculty name, the TIP material status key, the total number of units, and the minimum total number of units in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the course number, along with the cluster type description and the HGN code description for each subject, as well as the subject code, subject code description, department name, and the number of subjects in the same department, for subjects where the school code is not null and the subject title is not null. The columns should be shown in the following order: subject title, offering department name, responsible faculty name, TIP material status key, total number of units, minimum total number of units in the window, cluster type description, HGN code description, subject code, subject code description, department name, and number of subjects in the same department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, sos.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.window_column, sos.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC, sos.HGN_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID FROM inner_cte JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_ID FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_CODE IS NOT NULL AND t1.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, dept_counts.subjects_in_department, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS subjects_in_department FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_CODE IS NOT NULL AND t1.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) dept_counts ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, subq1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, subq1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, subq1.TOTAL_UNITS, subq1.window_column, subq1.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC, subq1.HGN_CODE_DESC, subq2.SUBJECT_CODE, subq2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq2.subjects_in_department FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.SUBJECT_ID = subq2.SUBJECT_ID

question: For academic years where the running sum of academic years within each financial aid year group for previous terms is greater than the average academic year across all previous terms, and for each subject in the term "2010FA" that is a regular term, provide the previous term code, previous term description, previous academic year, running sum of academic years within the financial aid year group, financial aid year, subject ID, subject term description, material status key, subject academic year, and the rank of each subject within each academic year group ordered by subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ) SELECT TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, window_column, FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > ( SELECT AVG(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS WHERE TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ) ORDER BY FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2010FA' ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.window_column FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND at2.TERM_CODE = '2010FA' WHERE at2.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ) SELECT s1.TERM_CODE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS PREV_TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS PREV_ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.window_column AS PREV_RUNNING_SUM, s1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS SUBJECT_TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS SUBJECT_ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.window_column AS SUBJECT_RANK FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.SUBJECT_ID

question: For subjects offered in the term with code '2022SU', and for subjects offered in the term '2017JA' that share the same subject code, show each subject's ID, total units, department name, their dense rank considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the total number of units, the subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, department full name, subject code, subject code description, the minimum number of enrolled students over each subject code group, and for each subject code, include a grand total of enrolled students in the format of (null, null, null, null, subject code, subject code description, total enrolled students). Order the results by subject code, total units descending, and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_CODE, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2022SU' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS DESC ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' ) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, window_column, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, window_column WITH ROLLUP HAVING (SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL OR SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0) ORDER BY SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT subq1.SUBJECT_ID, subq1.TOTAL_UNITS, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.window_column AS subject_dense_rank, subq2.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, subq2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, subq2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, subq2.SUBJECT_CODE, subq2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, subq2.window_column AS min_enrolled_students_per_code, subq2.total_enrolled_students FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.SUBJECT_CODE = subq2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY subq1.SUBJECT_CODE, subq1.TOTAL_UNITS DESC, subq2.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each subject offered in the term '2017FA', provide the subject title, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the record counts for all tip materials associated with that subject, the department name, the total number of enrolled students for each subject, the course number, the offering school name, the total number of unique library subjects offered, and the minimum total units for those subjects, where the department and course number have more than 2 enrolled students in the subject summary. Present the results ordered by department name, course number, and descending range of record counts. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(t.RECORD_COUNT) - MIN(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_range, VARIANCE(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON s.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ), subquery1 AS ( SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.record_count_range, i.record_count_variance, i.record_count_stddev, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.SUBJECT_ID FROM inner_cte1 i JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON i.SUBJECT_TITLE = s.SUBJECT_TITLE AND s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ), subquery2 AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COURSE_NUMBER, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(subject_count) AS total_subjects, MIN(min_total_units) AS min_total_units FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COURSE_NUMBER, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(subject_count) > 0 ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.record_count_range, s1.record_count_variance, s1.record_count_stddev, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.COURSE_NUMBER, s2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s2.total_subjects, s2.min_total_units FROM subquery1 s1 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' JOIN subquery2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND sos.COURSE_NUMBER = s2.COURSE_NUMBER ORDER BY s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.COURSE_NUMBER, s1.record_count_range DESC;

question: For each academic year where the running sum of academic years within each financial aid year group for previous terms is greater than the average academic year across all previous terms, and for each subject in the term "2010FA" within that academic year where the term is a regular term, list the term code, the previous term description, the previous academic year, the running sum of academic years, the financial aid year, the subject ID, the subject's term description, the material status key, the subject's academic year, the rank of the subject within the academic year group, and the normalized ratio of the running sum to the subject rank rounded (running sum divided by subject rank), ordered by financial aid year, previous academic year, and subject ID.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ) SELECT TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, window_column, FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > ( SELECT AVG(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS WHERE TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ) ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2010FA' ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.window_column FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND at2.TERM_CODE = '2010FA' WHERE at2.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ) SELECT s1.TERM_CODE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS PREV_TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS PREV_ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.window_column AS PREV_RUNNING_SUM, s1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS SUBJECT_TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS SUBJECT_ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.window_column AS SUBJECT_RANK, ROUND(s1.window_column / NULLIF(s2.window_column, 0), 2) AS Normalized_RunningSum_to_SubjectRank FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.SUBJECT_ID

question: For IAP subject activities in the "Mathematics" category with a maximum enrollment of at least 20, show the activity title, the dense rank of each activity considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the academic year of the associated term, the term description, the enrollment type, maximum enrollment, category name, the sponsor key, the row number within each enrollment type group ordered by activity title, and the total number of activities per enrollment type in the "Mathematics" category. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20 ) SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.window_column, t2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t2 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE ), Subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column, d.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.MAX_ENROLLMENT, inner_cte.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, inner_cte.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, inner_cte.window_column, ActivityCounts.Total_Activities, inner_cte.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS Total_Activities FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ) AS ActivityCounts ON inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = ActivityCounts.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ) SELECT s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s1.window_column AS DENSE_RANK_WINDOW, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, s2.MAX_ENROLLMENT, s2.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, s2.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, s2.window_column AS ROW_NUMBER_WITHIN_ENROLLMENT_TYPE, s2.Total_Activities FROM Subq1 s1 JOIN Subq2 s2 ON s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE = s2.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND s1.TERM_CODE = s2.TERM_CODE;

question: For each DLC key and organization name where the organization is assignable and the organization level is greater than 4, show the number of organizations, the minimum organization number, the major organization name with the highest count of organizations and that count, the DLC name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of organizations associated with that DLC key (considering only DLC keys and organization names that are not null), and the total number of unique organizations per DLC key. Present the results ordered by the number of organizations in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH org_stats_by_dlc_orgname AS ( SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND o.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL > 4 GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ), prominent_major_org AS ( SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.MAJOR_ORG, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS Major_Org_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) DESC) AS rn FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND o.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL > 4 GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.MAJOR_ORG ), dlc_org_stats AS ( SELECT ic.DLC_KEY, fo.DLC_NAME, ic.org_count_range, ic.org_count_variance, ic.org_count_stddev, org_totals.total_organizations FROM ( SELECT fdlk.DLC_KEY, MAX(org_count) - MIN(org_count) AS org_count_range, VARIANCE(org_count) AS org_count_variance, STDDEV(org_count) AS org_count_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fdlk JOIN ( SELECT fo.DLC_KEY, COUNT(*) AS org_count FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fo.DLC_KEY ) org_stats ON fdlk.DLC_KEY = org_stats.DLC_KEY WHERE fdlk.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fdlk.DLC_KEY ) ic JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON ic.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN ( SELECT DLC_KEY, COUNT(DISTINCT FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS total_organizations FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION WHERE ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NOT NULL AND DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DLC_KEY ) org_totals ON ic.DLC_KEY = org_totals.DLC_KEY GROUP BY ic.DLC_KEY, fo.DLC_NAME, ic.org_count_range, ic.org_count_variance, ic.org_count_stddev, org_totals.total_organizations ) SELECT o.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.organization_count, o.min_organization_number, pmo.MAJOR_ORG AS Most_Prominent_Major_Org, pmo.Major_Org_Count, d.DLC_NAME, d.org_count_range, d.org_count_variance, d.org_count_stddev, d.total_organizations FROM org_stats_by_dlc_orgname o LEFT JOIN prominent_major_org pmo ON o.DLC_KEY = pmo.DLC_KEY AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME = pmo.ORGANIZATION_NAME AND pmo.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN dlc_org_stats d ON o.DLC_KEY = d.DLC_KEY ORDER BY o.organization_count DESC;

question: For each subject offered in the current term (as defined by the 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM' parameter), show the offering department name, subject title, responsible faculty name, term description, academic year description, and the total number of subjects offered per department. Additionally, for each department, provide the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one associated course material, and indicate whether the department's average enrollment is classified as 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% greater than the overall average), 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% less than the overall average), or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Present the results with the columns: offering department name, subject title, responsible faculty name, term description, academic year description, total number of subjects offered per department, average enrollment, enrollment standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and enrollment category, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_dept_name FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM' ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, dept_counts.Total_Subjects, inner_cte.join_dept_name FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS Total_Subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM' GROUP BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) dept_counts ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_counts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrollment, inner_cte.enrollment_stddev, CASE WHEN inner_cte.avg_enrollment > overall.avg_all_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN inner_cte.avg_enrollment < overall.avg_all_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_all_enrollment FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' ) overall ) SELECT s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.Total_Subjects, s2.avg_enrollment, s2.enrollment_stddev, s2.enrollment_category FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.join_dept_name = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each of the top 10 activity titles with the largest range in maximum enrollment across all academic terms (considering only activities that are not cancelled and have a non-null maximum enrollment), show the activity's title, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the maximum enrollment, the academic term in which the maximum enrollment occurred, and the corresponding academic term description. Additionally, for each such term, if it is a previous academic term where the running sum of academic years within its financial aid year group is greater than the average academic year across all previous terms, also display the previous term's description, academic year, running sum of academic years within the financial aid year group, and the financial aid year. The results are ordered by the enrollment range (descending), then by financial aid year and academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ACTIVITY_TITLE, MAX(IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.MAX_ENROLLMENT) - MIN(IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS enrollment_stddev, MAX(IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN TIME_DAY ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = TIME_DAY.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE WHERE IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ACTIVITY_TITLE ) SELECT ic.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ic.enrollment_range, ic.enrollment_variance, ic.enrollment_stddev, isd.TERM_CODE AS term_with_max_enrollment, td.ACADEMIC_TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte ic JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd ON ic.ACTIVITY_TITLE = isd.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT = ic.max_enrollment JOIN TIME_DAY td ON isd.TERM_CODE = td.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE WHERE isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ic.enrollment_range DESC LIMIT 10 ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ) SELECT TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, window_column, FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > ( SELECT AVG(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS WHERE TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ) ORDER BY FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT subq1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, subq1.enrollment_range, subq1.enrollment_variance, subq1.enrollment_stddev, subq1.term_with_max_enrollment, subq1.ACADEMIC_TERM_DESCRIPTION, subq2.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS prev_term_description, subq2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS prev_academic_year, subq2.window_column AS prev_running_sum, subq2.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR AS prev_financial_aid_year FROM subq1 LEFT JOIN subq2 ON subq1.term_with_max_enrollment = subq2.TERM_CODE ORDER BY subq1.enrollment_range DESC, subq2.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, subq2.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each combination of activity and department/academic year enrollment statistics, list the activity title, enrollment type, maximum enrollment, category name, category description, and the dense rank of each row partitioned by the category name and ordered by the category name, along with the department name, academic year, number of unique subjects offered (subject count), minimum number of total units for those subjects, and the average number of enrolled students per subject (for departments and academic years where the number of enrolled students in a subject is greater than 5). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH activity_category_rank AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY ) SELECT i.ACTIVITY_TITLE, i.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, i.MAX_ENROLLMENT, i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, c.IAP_CATEGORY_DESC, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) AS window_column FROM inner_cte i JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ), dept_year_enrollment_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.subject_count, i.min_total_units, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte i JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = c.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND t.ACADEMIC_YEAR = i.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.subject_count, i.min_total_units ) SELECT acr.ACTIVITY_TITLE, acr.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, acr.MAX_ENROLLMENT, acr.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, acr.IAP_CATEGORY_DESC, acr.window_column, dys.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dys.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dys.subject_count, dys.min_total_units, dys.avg_enrolled_students FROM activity_category_rank acr CROSS JOIN dept_year_enrollment_stats dys;

question: For each course material detail, provide the material status key, term code, subject ID, ISBN, material key, course number description, subject title, offering department name, the maximum number of enrolled students for each row considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by material key, the average number of enrolled students for the department, the enrollment category (classified as 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' if the number of enrolled students is at least 10% greater than the average for the department, 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' if at least 10% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise), the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and at least 1 enrolled student), and the variance category (classified as 'HIGH_VARIANCE' if the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is at least 20% greater than the average, 'LOW_VARIANCE' if at least 20% less, or 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' otherwise). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), dept_variance AS ( SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units, CASE WHEN inner_cte.stddev_total_units > inner_cte.avg_total_units * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN inner_cte.stddev_total_units < inner_cte.avg_total_units * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.ISBN, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, MAX(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_DETAIL t0 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL AND t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT i.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, i.TERM_CODE, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.ISBN, i.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, i.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.MAX_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, d.avg_enrollment, CASE WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > d.avg_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < d.avg_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dv.avg_total_units, dv.stddev_total_units, dv.variance_category FROM inner_cte2 i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN dept_variance dv ON dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each subject code where the department is degree granting, show the subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, the number of subject codes per school name, and whether the subject code description is present ('Has Description') or missing ('No Description'). For each school name, include a grand total for all subject codes in the format of (null, null, null, school name, null, total subject codes). Additionally, for subjects offered in the term with code '2022SU', show each subject's ID, total units, and their dense rank considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the total number of units. Present all columns in the following order: subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, description status, total subject codes, subject ID, total units, and dense rank. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), SubjectCodeVisibility AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, CASE WHEN SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND SUBJECT_CODE_DESC <> 'nan' THEN 'Has Description' ELSE 'No Description' END AS description_status FROM inner_cte1 ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, description_status, COUNT(*) AS total_subject_codes FROM SubjectCodeVisibility GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, description_status WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ), SubjectCodeSummary AS ( SELECT scv.SUBJECT_CODE, scv.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.description_status, rr.total_subject_codes FROM RollupResults rr LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, description_status FROM SubjectCodeVisibility ) scv ON rr.SCHOOL_NAME = scv.SCHOOL_NAME AND rr.description_status = scv.description_status ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2022SU' ), SubjectUnitsRank AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte2.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.window_column FROM inner_cte2 ) SELECT scs.SUBJECT_CODE, scs.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scs.SCHOOL_NAME, scs.description_status, scs.total_subject_codes, sur.SUBJECT_ID, sur.TOTAL_UNITS, sur.window_column FROM SubjectCodeSummary scs LEFT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON scs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SubjectUnitsRank sur ON cso.SUBJECT_ID = sur.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY scs.SCHOOL_NAME, scs.description_status, sur.TOTAL_UNITS DESC

question: For each of the top 10 subjects by reserved library materials offered in the term '2009SP', list the subject title, the offering department name, the number of reserved library materials, the total number of enrolled students, and categorize the subject as 'HIGH_DEMAND' if the number of reserved materials is at least 10% greater than the number of enrolled students, 'LOW_DEMAND' if at least 10% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Also, for each subject, include the total number of reserved library materials for its department if the department's total is greater than the average number of reserved materials per department for that term; otherwise, show null for the department reserved materials. Show the results ordered by the number of reserved materials for the subject in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH SubjectDemand AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials, s.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.reserved_materials, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, CASE WHEN i.reserved_materials > s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_DEMAND' WHEN i.reserved_materials < s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_DEMAND' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS demand_category, i.SUBJECT_ID FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON i.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID AND s.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' ORDER BY i.reserved_materials DESC LIMIT 10 ), HighReserveDepartments AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, reserved_materials FROM inner_cte WHERE reserved_materials > ( SELECT AVG(reserved_materials) FROM inner_cte ) ) SELECT sd.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sd.reserved_materials, sd.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, sd.demand_category, hd.reserved_materials AS dept_reserved_materials FROM SubjectDemand sd LEFT JOIN HighReserveDepartments hd ON sd.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = hd.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY sd.reserved_materials DESC;

question: For each academic year, list the academic year description, course number, subject title, number of enrolled students, term description, and row number within the academic year group (ordered by course number) for Mathematics department courses with at least 5 enrolled students and with more enrolled students than the average for Mathematics courses in that year, along with the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during terms in that year (considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the number of enrolled students is greater than 0), and the variability category ('HIGH_VARIABILITY' if the range is at least 20, 'LOW_VARIABILITY' if less than 5, or 'MEDIUM_VARIABILITY' otherwise). Show the results ordered by academic year and course number. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH MathCourses AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 ) SELECT i.COURSE_NUMBER, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.window_column FROM inner_cte i WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > ( SELECT AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = i.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) ), YearStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.enrolled_range, inner_cte.enrolled_variance, CASE WHEN inner_cte.enrolled_range >= 20 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN inner_cte.enrolled_range < 5 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'MEDIUM_VARIABILITY' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte ) SELECT m.ACADEMIC_YEAR, y.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, m.COURSE_NUMBER, m.SUBJECT_TITLE, m.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, m.TERM_DESCRIPTION, m.window_column, y.enrolled_range, y.enrolled_variance, y.variability_category FROM MathCourses m JOIN YearStats y ON m.ACADEMIC_YEAR = y.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY m.ACADEMIC_YEAR, m.COURSE_NUMBER;

question: For each academic year and department, what is the academic year, the description of the academic year, the department name, the average total units for all subjects offered by that department in terms that match that academic year and have a term status indicator of 'P', and the deviation of each department's average total units from the overall average total units for that academic year, along with, for each subject offered in the library by that department in that academic year during regular terms, the subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, term description, the academic year of the subject, subject short title, the maximum total units for each row and the next two rows in order of subject ID, and the responsible faculty name, considering only subjects offered in the 'Mathematics' department during regular terms. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS dept_avg_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), cte1 AS ( SELECT inner_cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.dept_avg_total_units, (inner_cte1.dept_avg_total_units - overall.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_overall_avg FROM inner_cte1 JOIN ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(dept_avg_total_units) AS avg_total_units FROM ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS dept_avg_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) dept_avgs GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ) overall ON inner_cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = overall.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, MAX(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_CODE FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ), cte2 AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, inner_cte2.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, t2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte2.TERM_CODE, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_ID FROM inner_cte2 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON inner_cte2.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND inner_cte2.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1.dept_avg_total_units, cte1.deviation_from_overall_avg, cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE, cte2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, cte2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cte2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS SUBJECT_ACADEMIC_YEAR, cte2.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, cte2.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, cte2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cte2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each degree-granting department and subject code, provide the department name, subject code, the number of subject codes, the minimum department budget code, the full department name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses offered by that department (considering only courses that have at least one associated TIP material), and the total number of such courses per department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE ), subq1 AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.subject_code_count, ic.min_dept_budget_code, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte1 ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL ), subq2 AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.department, VARIANCE(inner_cte2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS num_enrolled_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS num_enrolled_stddev, COUNT(*) AS total_courses_with_tip_material FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY inner_cte2.department ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.subject_code_count, s1.min_dept_budget_code, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s2.num_enrolled_variance, s2.num_enrolled_stddev, s2.total_courses_with_tip_material FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.department;

question: For each offering department and school where the course material status is 'RQ' and for subjects offered in the current term, provide the offering department name, offering school name, number of unique subjects, minimum total units for those subjects, average number of enrolled students for those subjects, subject title, responsible faculty name, term description, academic year description, and the total number of subjects offered per department. The columns should be listed in the following order: offering department name, offering school name, number of unique subjects, minimum total units, average number of enrolled students, subject title, responsible faculty name, term description, academic year description, and total number of subjects offered per department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_num_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte ic JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM' ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, dept_counts.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS Total_Subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM' GROUP BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) dept_counts ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_counts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s1.subject_count, s1.min_total_units, s1.avg_num_enrolled_students, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.Total_Subjects FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For subjects with an enrollment type of "Advance sign-up required" and a maximum enrollment of 12, show the subject's activity title, term code, maximum enrollment, term description, term start date, subject title, number of enrolled students, offer department name, responsible faculty name, window column, and, for each activity title, also include the highest number of associated course materials it has had in any term. Only include results where the number of enrolled students is at least 10, and order the results by activity title within each subject title group. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 12 ) SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.MAX_ENROLLMENT, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE = t2.SUBJECT_TITLE WHERE inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 10 ORDER BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' GROUP BY IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_DESCRIPTION ) SELECT ACTIVITY_TITLE, MAX(material_count) AS highest_material_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACTIVITY_TITLE ) SELECT s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.MAX_ENROLLMENT, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.TERM_START_DATE, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.highest_material_count FROM subq1 s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE = s2.ACTIVITY_TITLE ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE;

question: For each academic term where the term status indicator is 'P' and the term parameter is 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM', show the academic terms key, term description, academic year description, term start date, term end date, the minimum academic year in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the term code, the is_current_term flag, the is_regular_term flag, and for each department in that academic year where the subject enrollment number is greater than 10, provide the department name, the number of unique subjects, the minimum total units offered, the average subject enrollment number as a benchmark, and classify the department-year as 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' if the minimum total units is at least 10% greater than the benchmark, 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' if at least 10% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. The columns should be shown in the following order: academic terms key, term description, academic year description, term start date, term end date, minimum academic year in window, is_current_term, is_regular_term, department name, subject count, minimum total units, benchmark enrollment, and enrollment category. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t0.TERM_START_DATE, t0.TERM_END_DATE, MIN(t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TERM_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND t1.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM' ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.TERM_END_DATE, inner_cte.window_column, t1.IS_CURRENT_TERM, t2.IS_REGULAR_TERM FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t1 ON inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION = t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.subject_count,
