i.min_total_units, s.benchmark_enrollment, CASE WHEN i.min_total_units > s.benchmark_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.min_total_units < s.benchmark_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS benchmark_enrollment FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) s ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.TERM_START_DATE, s1.TERM_END_DATE, s1.window_column, s1.IS_CURRENT_TERM, s1.IS_REGULAR_TERM, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.subject_count, s2.min_total_units, s2.benchmark_enrollment, s2.enrollment_category FROM subq1 s1 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC JOIN subq2 s2 ON t.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each of the top 10 departments and academic years with the highest number of non-repeatable-for-credit subjects offered in the fall term, list the department name, academic year, subject count, the subject with the highest enrollment in that group, the enrollment number for that subject, and the maximum average total units for subjects that had library reserve materials in any single term with a term status of 'Previous' for that department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH TopDepartments AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.GRADE_RULE_DESC = 'Not repeatable for credit' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.subject_count, so.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Top_Subject_Title, so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS Top_Subject_Enrollment FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC ) AS rn FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.GRADE_RULE_DESC = 'Not repeatable for credit' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' ) so ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = so.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = so.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND so.rn = 1 ORDER BY icte.subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), DepartmentMaxAvgUnits AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.TERM_CODE, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.TERM_CODE ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(avg_total_units) AS max_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY max_avg_total_units DESC ) SELECT td.DEPARTMENT_NAME, td.ACADEMIC_YEAR, td.subject_count, td.Top_Subject_Title, td.Top_Subject_Enrollment, dmu.max_avg_total_units FROM TopDepartments td LEFT JOIN DepartmentMaxAvgUnits dmu ON td.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY td.subject_count DESC, dmu.max_avg_total_units DESC;

question: For all subject codes associated with departments that are degree-granting and belong to the School of Engineering, list the subject code, subject code description, department name, and the highest variance of the number of enrolled students in its courses (with at least one enrolled student and at least one course material with a material status of 'RQ') across all terms, ordered by the highest variance in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS engineering_degree_granting_subject_codes FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, tso.TERM_CODE, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, tso.TERM_CODE ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_CODE, MAX(enrolled_variance) AS highest_enrolled_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY highest_enrolled_variance DESC ) SELECT subq1.SUBJECT_CODE, subq1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq2.highest_enrolled_variance FROM subq1 LEFT JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY subq2.highest_enrolled_variance DESC

question: List, for each offering department, either (1) the offering school name, number of unique subjects, minimum total units, and average number of enrolled students for departments and schools where the course material status is 'RQ', or (2) the subject title, responsible faculty name, term description, academic year description, and total number of subjects offered per department for subjects offered in the term with the parameter 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM'. Indicate the reason for inclusion as 'MaterialStatusRQ' for the first case and 'CurrentTerm' for the second case. The columns should be: offering department name, offering school name, number of unique subjects, minimum total units, average number of enrolled students, subject title, responsible faculty name, term description, academic year description, total number of subjects, and reason. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_num_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte ic JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM' ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, dept_counts.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS Total_Subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM' GROUP BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) dept_counts ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_counts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s1.subject_count, s1.min_total_units, s1.avg_num_enrolled_students, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS Total_Subjects, 'MaterialStatusRQ' AS Reason FROM subq1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NULL AS OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS subject_count, NULL AS min_total_units, NULL AS avg_num_enrolled_students, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.Total_Subjects, 'CurrentTerm' AS Reason FROM subq2 s2 ORDER BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, Reason;

question: For IAP subject activities with a maximum enrollment of at least 10 and that are not cancelled, show the activity title, enrollment type, the academic term description, the subject title from the course catalog, the department name, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by activity title, and for each enrollment type and term, the highest number of enrolled students among IAP subject activities with a maximum enrollment of 12. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column, t1.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 12 ) SELECT ENROLLMENT_TYPE, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS highest_num_enrolled_students, TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ENROLLMENT_TYPE, TERM_CODE ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 10 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' ) SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE = t2.SUBJECT_TITLE AND inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE ) SELECT s2.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s2.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.window_column, s1.highest_num_enrolled_students FROM subq2 s2 JOIN subq1 s1 ON s2.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = s1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE AND s2.TERM_CODE = s1.TERM_CODE ORDER BY s2.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s2.ENROLLMENT_TYPE

question: For each department offering subjects, list the department name, the subject title, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of reserved materials per subject (where the material status is 'U'), and for each department and school where the course material status is 'RQ', provide the number of unique subjects, the minimum total units for those subjects, and the maximum number of enrolled students for those subjects. For each department, include a grand total for all its subjects in the format of (department name, null, total statistics). Present the results as: department name, subject title, reserved material range, reserved material variance, reserved material standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), school name, subject count, minimum total units, and maximum number of enrolled students, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH reserved_material_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED s JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL d ON s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(material_count) - MIN(material_count) AS reserved_material_range, VARIANCE(material_count) AS reserved_material_variance, STDDEV(material_count) AS reserved_material_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(material_count) > 0 ORDER BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE ), dept_school_subject_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units, MAX(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_num_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte ic JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units ) SELECT rms.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, rms.SUBJECT_TITLE, rms.reserved_material_range, rms.reserved_material_variance, rms.reserved_material_stddev, dsss.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, dsss.subject_count, dsss.min_total_units, dsss.max_num_enrolled_students FROM reserved_material_stats rms JOIN dept_school_subject_stats dsss ON rms.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dsss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME

question: For rooms on floor 2 with access level 1, show the building room, space usage, space unit name, and, for each, the total number of rooms in the same space unit on floor 2 with access level 1 (only including results where the space unit has more than 1 such room), and also show the organization name, department name, and the dense rank of each room considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the department name from HR_ORG_UNIT, but only include rooms where the access level is greater than the average access level for that floor. Present the columns in this order: building room, space usage, space unit, room count, organization name, department name, and department dense rank. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t0.SPACE_UNIT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.BUILDING_ROOM ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE FROM SPACE_UNIT t0 JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t1 ON t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE t1.FLOOR = 2 AND t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 ) SELECT ic.BUILDING_ROOM, ic.SPACE_USAGE, ic.SPACE_UNIT, su_counts.ROOM_COUNT, ic.SPACE_UNIT_CODE FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT t0.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(*) AS ROOM_COUNT FROM SPACE_UNIT t0 JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t1 ON t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE t1.FLOOR = 2 AND t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 GROUP BY t0.SPACE_UNIT HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ) su_counts ON ic.SPACE_UNIT = su_counts.SPACE_UNIT ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.FLOOR, t0.ACCESS_LEVEL, t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2 ), avg_access AS ( SELECT FLOOR, AVG(ACCESS_LEVEL) AS avg_access FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD WHERE FLOOR = 2 GROUP BY FLOOR ) SELECT i.BUILDING_ROOM, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, i.SPACE_UNIT_CODE FROM inner_cte i JOIN avg_access a ON i.FLOOR = a.FLOOR WHERE i.ACCESS_LEVEL > a.avg_access ) SELECT s1.BUILDING_ROOM, s1.SPACE_USAGE, s1.SPACE_UNIT, s1.ROOM_COUNT, s2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.window_column AS DEPT_DENSE_RANK FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.BUILDING_ROOM = s2.BUILDING_ROOM AND s1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = s2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE

question: For each subject category and academic year where the maximum enrollment is at least 10, provide the number of unique subjects offered, the minimum total units for those subjects, the average number of lecture units as a benchmark, and indicate whether the minimum total units is at least 10% greater than the average lecture units ('HIGH_UNIT'), at least 10% less ('LOW_UNIT'), or otherwise 'AVERAGE_UNIT'. Also, include the number of regular academic terms present in the ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL table for that academic year (or null if not available). List the subject category key, academic year, number of unique subjects, minimum total units, benchmark average lecture units, unit category, and total regular terms in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH SubjectCategoryStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON a.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT ic.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units, s.avg_lecture_units AS benchmark_lecture_units, CASE WHEN ic.min_total_units > s.avg_lecture_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN ic.min_total_units < s.avg_lecture_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE_UNIT' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS avg_lecture_units FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON a.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) s ON ic.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY AND ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), RegularTermStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON at.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = ata.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS total_terms FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT scs.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, scs.ACADEMIC_YEAR, scs.subject_count, scs.min_total_units, scs.benchmark_lecture_units, scs.unit_category, rts.total_terms FROM SubjectCategoryStats scs LEFT JOIN RegularTermStats rts ON scs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = rts.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY scs.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, scs.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: Among the top 10 organizations with the largest range of space unit codes (where the organization has a non-null description and the space unit has a non-null name), and which are also departments in the Provost Area, show for each organization: the organization name, the range and variance of its space unit codes, the DLC name associated with the organization, the count of unique space units for that organization, the number of organizations for the department, the minimum department hierarchy level 3 code, and the maximum department hierarchy level 3 code, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH org_space_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAX(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) - MIN(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS code_range, VARIANCE(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS code_variance, o.DLC_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY odk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON odk.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL AND su.SPACE_UNIT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.DLC_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) SELECT ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.code_range, ic.code_variance, ic.DLC_NAME, ic.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, COUNT(DISTINCT su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS unique_space_unit_count FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON ic.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE su.SPACE_UNIT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.code_range, ic.code_variance, ic.DLC_NAME, ic.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY ic.code_range DESC LIMIT 10 ), provost_dept_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_CODE) AS min_level3_code FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) SELECT i.DLC_NAME, i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.org_count, i.min_level3_code, MAX(m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_CODE) AS max_level3_code FROM inner_cte i JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m ON i.DLC_NAME = m.DLC_NAME GROUP BY i.DLC_NAME, i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.org_count, i.min_level3_code ) SELECT oss.ORGANIZATION_NAME, oss.code_range, oss.code_variance, oss.DLC_NAME, oss.unique_space_unit_count, pds.org_count, pds.min_level3_code, pds.max_level3_code FROM org_space_stats oss JOIN provost_dept_stats pds ON oss.DLC_NAME = pds.DLC_NAME AND oss.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = pds.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY oss.code_range DESC, oss.ORGANIZATION_NAME;

question: For each department name and school name in the School of Engineering, where the number of enrolled students in the offered subject is greater than 3, show the number of offered subjects, the minimum number of enrolled students, the subject title with the highest number of enrolled students in that department and school, the subject title, the number of enrolled students, the total number of material records with status 'RQ', and whether the subject is 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% less than the average enrolled students for Engineering subjects), 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% more than the average), or 'AVERAGE'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS offered_subject_count, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME ), cte1 AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.offered_subject_count, ic.min_enrolled_students, ls.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_with_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte1 ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC) AS rn FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 ) ls ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ls.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.SCHOOL_NAME = ls.SCHOOL_NAME AND ls.rn = 1 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, SUM(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_material_records FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ), avg_enrollment AS ( SELECT AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ), cte2 AS ( SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.total_material_records, CASE WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_enrolled * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < a.avg_enrolled * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte2 i CROSS JOIN avg_enrollment a ) SELECT c1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c1.SCHOOL_NAME, c1.offered_subject_count, c1.min_enrolled_students, c1.subject_with_max_enrollment, c2.SUBJECT_TITLE, c2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, c2.total_material_records, c2.enrollment_category FROM cte1 c1 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON c1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND c1.SCHOOL_NAME = s.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN cte2 c2 ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = c2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE c1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ORDER BY c1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC;

question: For each department hierarchy, list the department hierarchy name, the number of organizations in that hierarchy, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the organization level for organizations in that hierarchy, and for each organization in the hierarchy, show the organization name, the number of associated space units, the average number of space units across all organizations, and whether the organization is a 'LARGE_HOLDER' (at least 20% more space units than the average), 'SMALL_HOLDER' (at least 20% fewer space units than the average), or 'AVERAGE_HOLDER' otherwise. Present the columns in the following order: department hierarchy name, number of organizations, average organization level, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of organization level, organization name, number of associated space units, average number of space units, and holder category. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME, AVG(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) AS avg_org_level, STDDEV(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) AS org_level_stddev, COUNT(*) AS num_organizations FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL IS NOT NULL GROUP BY MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME ), dept_hierarchy_stats AS ( SELECT DLC_NAME, num_organizations, avg_org_level, org_level_stddev FROM inner_cte1 UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS DLC_NAME, SUM(num_organizations) AS num_organizations, AVG(avg_org_level) AS avg_org_level, STDDEV(avg_org_level) AS org_level_stddev FROM inner_cte1 ORDER BY DLC_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS space_unit_count FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fok JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON fok.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME ), org_space_stats AS ( SELECT ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.space_unit_count, avg_stats.avg_space_units, CASE WHEN ic.space_unit_count > avg_stats.avg_space_units * 1.2 THEN 'LARGE_HOLDER' WHEN ic.space_unit_count < avg_stats.avg_space_units * 0.8 THEN 'SMALL_HOLDER' ELSE 'AVERAGE_HOLDER' END AS holder_category FROM inner_cte2 ic CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(space_unit_count) AS avg_space_units FROM inner_cte2 ) avg_stats ) SELECT dhs.DLC_NAME, dhs.num_organizations, dhs.avg_org_level, dhs.org_level_stddev, oss.ORGANIZATION_NAME, oss.space_unit_count, oss.avg_space_units, oss.holder_category FROM dept_hierarchy_stats dhs LEFT JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON dhs.DLC_NAME = fo.DLC_NAME LEFT JOIN org_space_stats oss ON fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME = oss.ORGANIZATION_NAME WHERE dhs.DLC_NAME IS NOT NULL ORDER BY dhs.DLC_NAME, oss.ORGANIZATION_NAME

question: For each department in the 2012SU term, list the department name, the variance of the total units for subjects offered, the average number of enrolled students per subject, and for that department, the top 5 subject titles with the highest number of reserve materials assigned in the most recent term, including the subject title, term code, and the number of reserve materials. Sort the results by variance of total units in descending order and, within each department, by number of reserve materials in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH dept_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON tso.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_units_variance, AVG(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ss.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_units_variance ORDER BY inner_cte.total_units_variance DESC ), top_reserve_subjects AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_reserve_materials FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.TERM_CODE, ic.num_reserve_materials FROM ( SELECT inner_cte.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.num_reserve_materials DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.TERM_CODE = (SELECT MAX(TERM_CODE) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED) ) ic WHERE ic.rn <= 5 ORDER BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.num_reserve_materials DESC ) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.total_units_variance, ds.avg_enrolled_students, trs.SUBJECT_TITLE, trs.TERM_CODE, trs.num_reserve_materials FROM dept_stats ds JOIN top_reserve_subjects trs ON ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = trs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY ds.total_units_variance DESC, trs.num_reserve_materials DESC;

question: For each of the top 10 academic years (by total unique course materials assigned for non-current terms where the course material status is 'RQ' and at least 50% of the unique materials have a non-null ISBN), provide the academic year description, the total number of unique course materials assigned, the number of those materials that have a non-null ISBN, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of subjects offered per academic term in that year (considering only terms where at least one subject was offered), and classify the year as 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' if the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is at least 20% greater than the average standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all years, 'LOW_VARIABILITY' if at least 20% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Present the results ordered by the total number of unique materials in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS unique_materials FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), isbn_counts AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS materials_with_isbn FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND TIP_DETAIL.ISBN IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), material_stats AS ( SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.unique_materials, isbn_counts.materials_with_isbn FROM inner_cte JOIN isbn_counts ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = isbn_counts.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC WHERE isbn_counts.materials_with_isbn >= 0.5 * inner_cte.unique_materials ORDER BY inner_cte.unique_materials DESC LIMIT 10 ), subject_variability_inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(term_subject_count) - MIN(term_subject_count) AS subject_count_range, VARIANCE(term_subject_count) AS subject_count_variance, STDDEV(term_subject_count) AS subject_count_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN ( SELECT tso.TERM_CODE, COUNT(*) AS term_subject_count FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso GROUP BY tso.TERM_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ) tsc ON at.TERM_CODE = tsc.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), subject_variability AS ( SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.subject_count_range, ic.subject_count_variance, ic.subject_count_stddev, CASE WHEN ic.subject_count_stddev > avg_stats.avg_stddev * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN ic.subject_count_stddev < avg_stats.avg_stddev * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variability_category FROM subject_variability_inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(subject_count_stddev) AS avg_stddev FROM subject_variability_inner_cte ) avg_stats ORDER BY ic.subject_count_range DESC ) SELECT ms.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ms.unique_materials, ms.materials_with_isbn, sv.subject_count_range, sv.subject_count_variance, sv.subject_count_stddev, sv.variability_category FROM material_stats ms JOIN subject_variability sv ON ms.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = sv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ms.unique_materials DESC;

question: For subjects offered in the term 2019FA, show the subject ID, subject title, number of enrolled students, department name, department full name, the department's average enrollment, whether the number of enrolled students is 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% greater than the average for that department), 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% less than the average for that department), or 'AVERAGE', as well as the variance of the record count for TIP materials associated with that subject (considering only records where the library material status is 'U' and the TIP material status is 'RQ'), and the difference between the maximum and minimum record count for those TIP materials. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ), enrollment_info AS ( SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.avg_enrollment, CASE WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > d.avg_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < d.avg_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte1 i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID = TIP_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID ), record_count_range_cte AS ( SELECT LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID, MAX(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS max_record_count, MIN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS min_record_count FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID = TIP_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID ), material_stats AS ( SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.record_count_variance, (t.max_record_count - t.min_record_count) AS record_count_range FROM inner_cte2 i JOIN record_count_range_cte t ON i.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT e.SUBJECT_ID, e.SUBJECT_TITLE, e.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, e.avg_enrollment, e.enrollment_category, m.record_count_variance, m.record_count_range FROM enrollment_info e LEFT JOIN material_stats m ON e.SUBJECT_ID = m.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.SUBJECT_ID

question: For each academic year and department name where the term status is 'Previous', provide the number of unique subjects offered, the minimum total units for those subjects, the average and variance of the ASCII values of the department's subject codes' course numbers (considering only degree granting departments), and the total number of subject codes for each department, but only include those departments where the minimum total units is greater than the overall minimum total units across all such departments and years. Show the results in the order of academic year and department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, subject_count, min_total_units FROM inner_cte WHERE min_total_units > (SELECT MIN(min_total_units) FROM inner_cte) ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VARIANCE(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_course_number_ascii, i.var_course_number_ascii, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS total_subject_codes FROM inner_cte i JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_course_number_ascii, i.var_course_number_ascii ORDER BY i.var_course_number_ascii DESC ) SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.subject_count, s1.min_total_units, s2.avg_course_number_ascii, s2.var_course_number_ascii, s2.total_subject_codes FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each department in the School of Engineering during regular terms where the total number of tip materials offered for its subjects is greater than 10, display the department name, the total number of tip materials offered, the average number of tip materials per subject, and the highest standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students it has ever had in any term (considering only courses that have at least 5 different materials assigned in that term). List the results in descending order of total tip materials. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.TERM_CODE, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.TERM_CODE HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) >= 5 ), dept_enrolled_stddev AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(enrolled_stddev) AS highest_enrolled_stddev FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL t JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) > 10 ), dept_tip_materials AS ( SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_tip_materials, AVG(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_tip_materials_per_subject FROM inner_cte2 i JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON s.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_tip_materials ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.total_tip_materials, d.avg_tip_materials_per_subject, s.highest_enrolled_stddev FROM dept_tip_materials d LEFT JOIN dept_enrolled_stddev s ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY d.total_tip_materials DESC;

question: For each degree-granting department that offered at least one subject in the School of Engineering in 2021 and for each subject in that department that has a material status key of 'RQ', provide the department code, department name, department full name, the number of subjects offered, the total number of enrolled students in those subjects, the average number of enrolled students per subject, the subject title, the number of enrolled students in the subject, the term code from the library reserve material detail, the offer department name, the responsible faculty name, the tip material key, the total number of subjects per offer department, and the row number within each tip material status key group ordered by the subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH dept_stats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ), dept_stats_final AS ( SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.total_enrollment, CASE WHEN inner_cte.subject_count > 0 THEN inner_cte.total_enrollment * 1.0 / inner_cte.subject_count ELSE NULL END AS avg_enrollment_per_subject FROM dept_stats inner_cte ), subject_materials AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t3.TERM_CODE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS window_column, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS dept_name, t1.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 JOIN TIP_DETAIL t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL t3 ON t2.SUBJECT_ID = t3.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ), subject_materials_final AS ( SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, dept_counts.total_subjects_per_dept, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.dept_name FROM subject_materials inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects_per_dept FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) AS dept_counts ON inner_cte.dept_name = dept_counts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ds.subject_count, ds.total_enrollment, ds.avg_enrollment_per_subject, sm.SUBJECT_TITLE, sm.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, sm.TERM_CODE, sm.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sm.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, sm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, sm.total_subjects_per_dept, sm.window_column FROM dept_stats_final ds JOIN subject_materials_final sm ON ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sm.OFFER_DEPT_NAME

question: List, for each department, the department name, school name, term start date, variance of total units for subjects offered, average number of enrolled students per subject, total maximum subject enrollment, and the reason for inclusion ("2012SU Stats" for 2012SU statistics and "Current Term Max Enrollment" for current term maximum enrollment), combining results for departments in the 2012SU term and for each department and school in the current academic term where the maximum subject enrollment number is greater than 5. The results should include all these columns in the order: department name, school name, term start date, variance of total units, average enrolled students, total maximum enrollment, and reason. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptStats2012SU AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON tso.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_units_variance, AVG(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ss.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_units_variance ORDER BY inner_cte.total_units_variance DESC ), DeptSchoolMaxEnrollCurrent AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_enrollment, at.TERM_START_DATE, ss.SCHOOL_NAME FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_START_DATE, ss.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 5 ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, TERM_START_DATE, SUM(max_enrollment) AS total_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, TERM_START_DATE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(max_enrollment) > 0 ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME ), CombinedDeptStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS TERM_START_DATE, d.total_units_variance, d.avg_enrolled_students, NULL AS total_max_enrollment, '2012SU Stats' AS Reason FROM DeptStats2012SU d UNION ALL SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.SCHOOL_NAME, ds.TERM_START_DATE, NULL AS total_units_variance, NULL AS avg_enrolled_students, ds.total_max_enrollment, 'Current Term Max Enrollment' AS Reason FROM DeptSchoolMaxEnrollCurrent ds ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, TERM_START_DATE, total_units_variance, avg_enrolled_students, total_max_enrollment, Reason FROM CombinedDeptStats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME ;

question: For each subject offered by the library in the term with code '2014FA', show the subject ID, subject title, total number of enrolled students, offering department name, term description, term start date, term end date, the minimum number of enrolled students for each offering department, and the maximum windowed average record count for tip detail records with material status key 'RQ' for that subject. Additionally, for each offering department, include a grand total row showing the total number of enrolled students across all its subjects (with nulls for subject ID and subject title, and the maximum windowed average record count will also be null in these rows). Order the results by offering department name and subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH tip_windowed_max AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_ID, MAX(window_column) AS max_windowed_avg_record_count FROM ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, AVG(t1.RECORD_COUNT) OVER ( PARTITION BY t0.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ) inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_ID ), subject_enrollment_rollup AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(SUBJECT_ID) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE SUBJECT_ID END AS SUBJECT_ID, CASE WHEN GROUPING(SUBJECT_TITLE) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE SUBJECT_TITLE END AS SUBJECT_TITLE, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(TERM_DESCRIPTION) AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, MAX(TERM_START_DATE) AS TERM_START_DATE, MAX(TERM_END_DATE) AS TERM_END_DATE, MIN(min_enrolled_per_dept) AS min_enrolled_per_dept FROM ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_per_dept FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' ) inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE WITH ROLLUP HAVING OFFER_DEPT_NAME IS NOT NULL ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.total_enrolled_students, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.TERM_START_DATE, s.TERM_END_DATE, s.min_enrolled_per_dept, t.max_windowed_avg_record_count FROM subject_enrollment_rollup s LEFT JOIN tip_windowed_max t ON s.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID

question: For each department, provide the department name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year, the number of unique subject titles offered in 2022, and for each subject offered in the term 2019FA in that department, show the subject ID, subject title, number of enrolled students, department full name, the department's average enrollment, and indicate whether the number of enrolled students is 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% greater than the average for that department), 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% less than the average for that department), or 'AVERAGE'. The columns should be: department name, average total units, total units range, total units variance, number of unique subject titles, subject ID, subject title, number of enrolled students, department full name, average enrollment, and enrollment category. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH dept_units_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_total_units, i.total_units_range, i.total_units_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS num_unique_subject_titles FROM inner_cte i JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_total_units, i.total_units_range, i.total_units_variance ), subject_enrollment_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.avg_enrollment, CASE WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > d.avg_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < d.avg_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance, dus.num_unique_subject_titles, ses.SUBJECT_ID, ses.SUBJECT_TITLE, ses.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ses.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ses.avg_enrollment, ses.enrollment_category FROM dept_units_stats dus JOIN subject_enrollment_stats ses ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ses.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dus.total_units_range DESC, ses.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC;

question: For each course material detail, provide the TIP material status key, term code, subject ID, ISBN, material key, course number description, subject title, offering department name, the maximum number of enrolled students for each row considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by material key, the average number of enrolled students for the department, the enrollment category (classified as 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' if the number of enrolled students is at least 10% greater than the average for the department, 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' if at least 10% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise), the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and at least 1 enrolled student), and the variance category for the department (classified as 'HIGH_VARIANCE' if its standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is at least 20% greater than the average, 'LOW_VARIANCE' if at least 20% less, or 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' otherwise). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), dept_variance AS ( SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units, CASE WHEN inner_cte.stddev_total_units > inner_cte.avg_total_units * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN inner_cte.stddev_total_units < inner_cte.avg_total_units * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.stddev_total_units DESC ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.ISBN, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, MAX(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_DETAIL t0 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL AND t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT i.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, i.TERM_CODE, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.ISBN, i.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, i.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.MAX_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, d.avg_enrollment, CASE WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > d.avg_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < d.avg_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category, dv.avg_total_units, dv.stddev_total_units, dv.variance_category FROM inner_cte2 i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN dept_variance dv ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For rooms on floor 2 with access level 1, show the space unit name and the maximum row number (within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by building room) for each space unit, along with the building room, the organization name, the department name, and the difference between the access level of the room and the average access level for that department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t0.SPACE_UNIT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.BUILDING_ROOM ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE FROM SPACE_UNIT t0 JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t1 ON t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE t1.FLOOR = 2 AND t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 ), subq1 AS ( SELECT SPACE_UNIT, MAX(window_column) AS max_window_row_number, SPACE_UNIT_CODE FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY SPACE_UNIT, SPACE_UNIT_CODE ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.ACCESS_LEVEL, t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2 ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ACCESS_LEVEL) AS avg_access_level FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subq2 AS ( SELECT i.BUILDING_ROOM, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, (i.ACCESS_LEVEL - d.avg_access_level) AS access_level_deviation, i.SPACE_UNIT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT s1.SPACE_UNIT, s1.max_window_row_number, s2.BUILDING_ROOM, s2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.access_level_deviation FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = s2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE

question: For each department where the range of total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and offered in the 'Engineering' school) is greater than the average range across all departments, and for each academic year, provide the department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department, the academic year, the academic year description, the variance of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during terms in that year (considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the number of enrolled students is greater than 0), and the total number of such library subjects offered per department in that year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DepartmentUnitsStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_units_range, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE total_units_range > (SELECT AVG(total_units_range) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ), AcademicYearLibraryStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, COUNT(DISTINCT LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS total_library_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance DESC, total_library_subjects_offered DESC ) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev, ayls.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ayls.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ayls.enrolled_students_variance, ayls.total_library_subjects_offered FROM DepartmentUnitsStats dus JOIN AcademicYearLibraryStats ayls ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ayls.department_name ORDER BY dus.total_units_range DESC, ayls.enrolled_students_variance DESC, ayls.total_library_subjects_offered DESC;

question: For each academic year and department where the average total units for subjects offered in regular terms is greater than the overall average for all such groups, list the academic year, academic year description, department name, subject ID, total units, the average and variance of total units for the department in that year, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, and the deviation of each subject's total units from the department's average, ordered by academic year, department name, and deviation from average (descending). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_total_units, i.var_total_units FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT AVG(avg_total_units) AS overall_avg FROM ( SELECT AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) sub ) o ON i.avg_total_units > o.overall_avg ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.TOTAL_UNITS, d.avg_total_units, d.stddev_total_units, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - d.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_stats d ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AND i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.TOTAL_UNITS, s1.avg_total_units, s1.var_total_units, s2.stddev_total_units, s2.deviation_from_avg FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.deviation_from_avg DESC;

question: For each subject offered in the library in the Mathematics department during regular terms, show the subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, term description, academic year, subject short title, the maximum total units for each row and the next two rows in order of subject ID, the responsible faculty name, and for the corresponding academic year, also provide the academic year description, the geometric mean of the degree year from all academic terms where the degree year is greater than 1900, and classify the academic year as 'RECENT' if the geometric mean is at least 2010, 'OLD' if it is less than 1980, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Present the columns in the following order: subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, term description, academic year, subject short title, maximum total units, responsible faculty name, academic year description, geometric mean degree year, and year category. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(ACADEMIC_TERMS.DEGREE_YEAR))) AS geometric_mean_degree_year FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.DEGREE_YEAR > 1900 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), cte1 AS ( SELECT inner_cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte1.geometric_mean_degree_year, CASE WHEN inner_cte1.geometric_mean_degree_year >= 2010 THEN 'RECENT' WHEN inner_cte1.geometric_mean_degree_year < 1980 THEN 'OLD' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS year_category FROM inner_cte1 ORDER BY inner_cte1.geometric_mean_degree_year DESC ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, MAX(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_CODE FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ), cte2 AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, inner_cte2.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, t2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte2.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte2 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON inner_cte2.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND inner_cte2.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE, cte2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, cte2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cte2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cte2.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, cte2.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, cte2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cte1.geometric_mean_degree_year, cte1.year_category FROM cte2 JOIN cte1 ON cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC, cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each department name and school name where the number of enrolled students in the offered subject is greater than 3, show the number of offered subjects, the minimum number of enrolled students, and the subject title with the highest number of enrolled students in that department and school. For each such department, also show, for subjects offered in the term with code '2025FA', the subject ID, subject title, offering department name, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, term start date, term end date, term parameter, and whether the number of enrolled students is 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% greater than the average for that department), 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% less than the average for that department), or 'AVERAGE', ordered by department name and subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS offered_subject_count, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME ), cte1 AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.offered_subject_count, ic.min_enrolled_students, ls.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_with_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte1 ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC) AS rn FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 ) ls ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ls.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.SCHOOL_NAME = ls.SCHOOL_NAME AND ls.rn = 1 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE TERM_CODE = '2025FA' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), cte2 AS ( SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.TERM_START_DATE, i.TERM_END_DATE, i.TERM_PARAMETER, CASE WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > d.avg_enrolled * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < d.avg_enrolled * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte2 i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1.SCHOOL_NAME, cte1.offered_subject_count, cte1.min_enrolled_students, cte1.subject_with_max_enrollment, cte2.SUBJECT_ID, cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE, cte2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cte2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, cte2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cte2.TERM_START_DATE, cte2.TERM_END_DATE, cte2.TERM_PARAMETER, cte2.enrollment_category FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cte2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte2.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For subjects offered in the 2012SU term with a cluster type of 'S', show the subject title, offer department name, total units, department name from SUBJECT_SUMMARY, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title, along with the academic year, average enrollment, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in non-repeatable subjects offered by the same department and subject. Order the results by variance descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t1.CLUSTER_TYPE = 'S' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID FROM inner_cte JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_REPEATABLE_SUBJECT = 'N' ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, subq1.TOTAL_UNITS, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.window_column, subq2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, subq2.avg_enrollment, subq2.enrollment_variance, subq2.enrollment_stddev FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = subq2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND subq1.SUBJECT_ID = subq2.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY subq2.enrollment_variance DESC

question: For each room with an area greater than 300 and access level equal to 1, and for each organization and its associated space unit where the organization is assignable and the space unit code is greater than 50000, show the building-room identifier, the room's major use description, the organization name, the total number of such rooms per organization, the organization, the space unit, the number of distinct space units, the minimum organization number, and the total number of organizations that share the same DLC key as the space unit, where the room's organization and the space unit's organization share the same DLC key. List the results ordered by building-room identifier and space unit. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.MAJOR_USE_DESC, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 300 AND t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 ) SELECT inner_cte.BUILDING_ROOM, inner_cte.MAJOR_USE_DESC, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, org_counts.Total_Rooms, inner_cte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT BUILDING_ROOM) AS Total_Rooms FROM ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 300 AND t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 ) sub GROUP BY ORGANIZATION_NAME ) org_counts ON inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = org_counts.ORGANIZATION_NAME ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION, su.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(DISTINCT su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS space_unit_count, MIN(fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_org_number, su.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fodk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON fodk.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY WHERE fo.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE > 50000 GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION, su.SPACE_UNIT, su.DLC_KEY ) SELECT ic.ORGANIZATION, ic.SPACE_UNIT, ic.space_unit_count, ic.min_org_number, d.org_count, ic.DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT DLC_KEY, COUNT(DISTINCT ORGANIZATION) AS org_count FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION GROUP BY DLC_KEY ) d ON ic.DLC_KEY = d.DLC_KEY ) SELECT s1.BUILDING_ROOM, s1.MAJOR_USE_DESC, s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s1.Total_Rooms, s2.ORGANIZATION, s2.SPACE_UNIT, s2.space_unit_count, s2.min_org_number, s2.org_count FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON s1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON fo.DLC_KEY = s2.DLC_KEY ORDER BY s1.BUILDING_ROOM, s2.SPACE_UNIT;

question: For each degree-granting department that offered at least one subject in the School of Engineering in 2021 and had a total number of enrolled students greater than the average total enrollment across all such departments, provide the department code, department name, department full name, the number of subjects offered, the total number of enrolled students in those subjects, and, for each academic year where the department offered library subjects with at least one enrolled student in a term with status 'P', also provide the academic year, academic year description, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in those library subjects. List the results ordered by total enrollment descending and then by enrolled students variance descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH eng_dept_enrollment AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.subject_count, i.total_enrollment FROM inner_cte i JOIN (SELECT AVG(total_enrollment) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte) a ON 1=1 WHERE i.total_enrollment > a.avg_enrollment ), lib_subj_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT ede.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ede.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ede.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ede.subject_count, ede.total_enrollment, ls.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ls.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ls.enrolled_students_variance, ls.enrolled_students_stddev FROM eng_dept_enrollment ede JOIN lib_subj_stats ls ON ede.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ls.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY ede.total_enrollment DESC, ls.enrolled_students_variance DESC

question: List, for subjects offered in the term '2016SP' with a school code of 'E', the subject title, department name, course description, number of enrolled students, and row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title, and for each department, the highest average total units for subjects it has ever offered in a regular academic term. Indicate the source of each row as either 'Subject' or 'Department'. The columns are: subject title, department name, course description, number of enrolled students, window column, highest average total units, and source. Do not return any rounded answers.
