SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t0.SCHOOL_CODE = 'E' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE = t2.SUBJECT_TITLE AND t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.TERM_CODE, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.TERM_CODE ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(avg_total_units) AS highest_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY highest_avg_total_units DESC ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.window_column, NULL AS highest_avg_total_units, 'Subject' AS Source FROM Subquery1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS COURSE_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, NULL AS window_column, s2.highest_avg_total_units, 'Department' AS Source FROM Subquery2 s2 ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE

question: List, for all subjects that are either offered in the term "2005FA" or have a material status key of 'RQ', the following columns: department name (not repeated if same as previous row), subject title, number of enrolled students, term description, school name, average number of enrolled students within each subject title group (for term "2005FA" subjects), offer department name (for 'RQ' material subjects), responsible faculty name (for 'RQ' material subjects), tip material key (for 'RQ' material subjects), total number of subjects per offer department (for 'RQ' material subjects), row number within each tip material status key group ordered by subject title (for 'RQ' material subjects), and a reason for inclusion ('Term2005FA' for subjects offered in "2005FA", 'MaterialRQ' for subjects with material status key 'RQ'). The columns should be shown in the following order: department name, subject title, number of enrolled students, term description, school name, average number of enrolled students, offer department name, responsible faculty name, tip material key, total number of subjects per offer department, row number within each tip material status key group, and reason. Sort the results by subject title and reason. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ss.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_enrolled_students, ss.SUBJECT_ID FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON tso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(DEPARTMENT_NAME) OVER (ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE) = DEPARTMENT_NAME THEN NULL ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS department_name, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, TERM_DESCRIPTION, SCHOOL_NAME, avg_enrolled_students, SUBJECT_ID FROM inner_cte ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t3.TERM_CODE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS window_column, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS dept_name, t1.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 JOIN TIP_DETAIL t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL t3 ON t2.SUBJECT_ID = t3.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, dept_counts.total_subjects_per_dept, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects_per_dept FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) AS dept_counts ON inner_cte.dept_name = dept_counts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT s1.department_name, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.avg_enrolled_students, NULL AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NULL AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, NULL AS TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, NULL AS total_subjects_per_dept, NULL AS window_column, 'Term2005FA' AS Reason FROM subq1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS department_name, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS avg_enrolled_students, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s2.total_subjects_per_dept, s2.window_column, 'MaterialRQ' AS Reason FROM subq2 s2 ORDER BY SUBJECT_TITLE, Reason;

question: For each department and school in the current academic term that is among the 5 departments offering the largest number of unique subjects this year, what are the department name, school name, term start date, total maximum subject enrollment number (for departments where the maximum subject enrollment number is greater than 5), department code, number of unique subjects, average total units of their offered subjects, and a status indicating whether their average total units is 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' (at least 10% higher than the overall average), 'BELOW_AVERAGE' (at least 10% lower), or 'AVERAGE' (otherwise)? For each school, include a grand total for all such departments in the format of (null department, school, null term start date, total max enrollment, null department code, null number of subjects, null average total units, null status). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptMaxEnroll AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_enrollment, at.TERM_START_DATE, ss.SCHOOL_NAME FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_START_DATE, ss.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 5 ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, TERM_START_DATE, SUM(max_enrollment) AS total_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, TERM_START_DATE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(max_enrollment) > 0 ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME ), TopDeptUnits AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY num_subjects DESC LIMIT 5 ), dept_avg_units AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), overall_avg AS ( SELECT AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS overall_avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.num_subjects, dau.avg_total_units, CASE WHEN dau.avg_total_units > oa.overall_avg_total_units * 1.1 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN dau.avg_total_units < oa.overall_avg_total_units * 0.9 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_status FROM inner_cte ic JOIN dept_avg_units dau ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dau.DEPARTMENT_CODE CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa ) SELECT dme.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dme.SCHOOL_NAME, dme.TERM_START_DATE, dme.total_max_enrollment, tdu.DEPARTMENT_CODE, tdu.num_subjects, tdu.avg_total_units, tdu.unit_status FROM DeptMaxEnroll dme JOIN TopDeptUnits tdu ON dme.DEPARTMENT_NAME = tdu.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dme.SCHOOL_NAME, dme.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: For all subjects in the 2014FA term with at least one enrolled student, where the subject's offering department had a maximum average total units for subjects with library reserve materials in any single previous term greater than 9, show the subject title, offering department name, responsible faculty name, the TIP material status key, the total number of units, the maximum total number of units in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows ordered by the course number, and the maximum average total units for the department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), cte1 AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TOTAL_UNITS, OFFER_DEPT_CODE, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_units_window FROM inner_cte1 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ss.TERM_CODE, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ss.TERM_CODE ), cte2 AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(avg_total_units) AS max_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY max_avg_total_units DESC ) SELECT cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE, cte1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cte1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, cte1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, cte1.TOTAL_UNITS, cte1.max_units_window, cte2.max_avg_total_units FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE cte2.max_avg_total_units > 9 ORDER BY cte2.max_avg_total_units DESC, cte1.TOTAL_UNITS DESC;

question: For courses in the School of Engineering that are degree granting and belong to departments whose total number of units for all courses is more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean total units across all departments, show the department name, subject code, subject title, the minimum total units in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the course number, the department code, and the total number of units for all courses in that department. For each department, include a grand total of the minimum total units in the same window. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, MIN(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_CODE = t2.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE, window_column FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE, window_column WITH ROLLUP HAVING window_column IS NOT NULL ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) > ( SELECT AVG(dept_total) + STDDEV(dept_total) FROM ( SELECT SUM(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS dept_total FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) t ) ) SELECT r.DEPARTMENT_NAME, r.SUBJECT_CODE, r.SUBJECT_TITLE, r.window_column, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.total_units FROM RollupResults r JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON r.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN inner_cte2 d ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY r.DEPARTMENT_NAME, r.SUBJECT_CODE, r.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For each department, show the department name, the highest total units among its subjects with exactly 12 units in the Fall Term 2024-2025, and for each course in that department that was offered in 2022 and has at least one required or optional textbook and has total units greater than the average for such courses, show the course's subject code, subject number, subject title, the term description, the textbook material key, the textbook material status key, and the row number within the department ordered by subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SCHOOL_NAME, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), subq1 AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS highest_total_units FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IN ('RQ', 'EO') ), subq2 AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, window_column FROM inner_cte2 WHERE TOTAL_UNITS > ( SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IN ('RQ', 'EO') ) ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.highest_total_units, s2.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2.window_column FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For all subjects in the 2014FA term with at least one enrolled student, show the subject title, offering department name, responsible faculty name, the TIP material status key, the total number of units, and the maximum total number of units in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows ordered by the course number. Additionally, for each subject, include the offering school name, the total number of unique library subjects offered, and the minimum total units for those subjects, considering only departments and course numbers where the number of enrolled students in the subject summary is greater than 2, and grouping by the offering school name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_dept, sos.COURSE_NUMBER AS join_course FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), cte1 AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TOTAL_UNITS, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_units_window, join_dept, join_course FROM inner_cte1 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ), cte2 AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COURSE_NUMBER, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(subject_count) AS total_subjects, MIN(min_total_units) AS min_total_units FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COURSE_NUMBER, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(subject_count) > 0 ORDER BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COURSE_NUMBER, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE, cte1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cte1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, cte1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, cte1.TOTAL_UNITS, cte1.max_units_window, cte2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, cte2.total_subjects, cte2.min_total_units FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.join_dept = cte2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND cte1.join_course = cte2.COURSE_NUMBER ORDER BY cte1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE, cte2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year, the academic year description, the variance of the number of tip detail records for subjects offered in that year (considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term and have at least one associated tip detail record), the number of unique departments represented among those subjects, and for each matching academic term where the term status is 'Previous' and the running sum of academic years within each financial aid year group is greater than the average academic year across all previous terms, what is the term code, the term description, the academic year of the term, the running sum of academic years within the financial aid year group, and the financial aid year? Present the results ordered by the variance of tip detail record counts (descending), then by financial aid year and term academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS unique_departments FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ) SELECT TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, window_column, FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > ( SELECT AVG(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS WHERE TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ) ) SELECT subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, subq1.record_count_variance, subq1.unique_departments, subq2.TERM_CODE, subq2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, subq2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS TERM_ACADEMIC_YEAR, subq2.window_column, subq2.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = subq2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subq1.record_count_variance DESC, subq2.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, subq2.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: Show, for all organizations with organization level equal to 5 and assignable equal to 1, the organization name, organization key, HR department name, HR org unit title, HR org unit key, the average organization key within each organization key group ordered by HR org unit key, the corresponding HR org unit level, HR department code, the longest department name (by character length) within each organization key group ordered by department code, and the source of the row (either 'Windowed' for windowed average or 'LongestDeptName' for longest department name), listing all columns in the order: organization name, organization key, HR department name, HR org unit title, HR org unit key, windowed average organization key, HR org unit level, HR department code, longest department name length, and source. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1 ) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, inner_cte.window_column, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1 ) SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(LENGTH(HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME)) AS longest_department_name_length FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, s1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, s1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, s1.window_column, s1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, s1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, NULL AS longest_department_name_length, 'Windowed' AS Source FROM Subquery1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, s2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, NULL AS HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, NULL AS window_column, NULL AS HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, s2.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, s2.longest_department_name_length, 'LongestDeptName' AS Source FROM Subquery2 s2 ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, Source;

question: For each department in the "Provost Area" that is associated with a space unit with space unit code 97500, show the department code, department name, school area name, the rank of each department within its school area based on department code, the corresponding DLC name, the space unit name, space unit code, associated organization name, department count, number of supervisees, and the highest research volume ever recorded for each department count group. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 INNER JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' ), DeptRanked AS ( SELECT inner_cte1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, inner_cte1.window_column, t2.DLC_NAME, inner_cte1.DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte1 INNER JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON inner_cte1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t1.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.DEPT_COUNT, t2.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, t2.RESEARCH_VOLUME, t1.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DEPT_NAMES WHERE t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 97500 ), SpaceStats AS ( SELECT space_unit_name, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, ORGANIZATION_NAME, DEPT_COUNT, NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, MAX(RESEARCH_VOLUME) AS highest_research_volume, DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY space_unit_name, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, ORGANIZATION_NAME, DEPT_COUNT, NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, DLC_KEY ) SELECT d.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, d.window_column, d.DLC_NAME, s.space_unit_name, s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, s.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s.DEPT_COUNT, s.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, s.highest_research_volume FROM DeptRanked d JOIN SpaceStats s ON d.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY ORDER BY d.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, s.space_unit_name;

question: For academic term parameters where the term indicator is 'C', show the term parameter, the term code, the academic year, the department name of the offered subject, the running sum of academic years within each department, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and at least 1 enrolled student), and classify the department as 'HIGH_VARIANCE' if its standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is at least 20% greater than the average, 'LOW_VARIANCE' if its standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is at least 20% less than the average, or 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' otherwise, but only include departments that offer at least 3 subjects in those terms. Order the results by department name and academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_PARAMETER, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_INDICATOR = 'C' ), DeptCounts AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS subject_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE IN ( SELECT TERM_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER WHERE TERM_INDICATOR = 'C' ) GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 ), cte1 AS ( SELECT icte.TERM_PARAMETER, icte.TERM_CODE, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.window_column FROM inner_cte1 icte JOIN DeptCounts dc ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), cte2 AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.avg_total_units, inner_cte2.stddev_total_units, CASE WHEN inner_cte2.stddev_total_units > inner_cte2.avg_total_units * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN inner_cte2.stddev_total_units < inner_cte2.avg_total_units * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte2 ) SELECT cte1.TERM_PARAMETER, cte1.TERM_CODE, cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1.window_column, cte2.avg_total_units, cte2.stddev_total_units, cte2.variance_category FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each department, return the department name, the highest number of active graduate students with an assigned office location that the department has had on any given warehouse load date, the range of total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2022 and also listed in the CIS course catalog (only for departments where this range exceeds the average range across all departments), and the variance of the total units for those departments. List the results ordered by the highest number of active graduate students (descending), then by the range of total units (descending). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, COUNT(*) AS total_active_grad_students FROM SE_PERSON s JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY m ON s.FULL_NAME = m.FULL_NAME WHERE s.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND m.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND m.OFFICE_LOCATION IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ), ActiveGradStudentsPerDept AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(total_active_grad_students) AS highest_active_grad_students FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.units_range, i.units_variance FROM inner_cte2 i JOIN ( SELECT AVG(units_range) AS avg_units_range FROM inner_cte2 ) avg_cte ON i.units_range > avg_cte.avg_units_range ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.highest_active_grad_students, dus.units_range, dus.units_variance FROM ActiveGradStudentsPerDept d JOIN DeptUnitsStats dus ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d.highest_active_grad_students DESC, dus.units_range DESC;

question: For each department and each subject offered by that department in the 2014FA term with at least one enrolled student, what is the department name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department in 2017 (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students), the total number of such subjects per department, the subject title, the offering department name, the responsible faculty name, the TIP material status key, the total number of units, the minimum total number of units in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the course number, and whether the total units are 'HIGH_LOAD' (at least 10% greater than the average total units for that department), 'LOW_LOAD' (at least 10% less than the average), or 'AVERAGE'? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2017%' ), DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(inner_cte1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte1.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, sos.COURSE_NUMBER, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY WHERE TERM_CODE = '2014FA' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE ), SubjectUnitStats AS ( SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, icte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, icte.TOTAL_UNITS, icte.window_column, icte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, CASE WHEN icte.TOTAL_UNITS > da.avg_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_LOAD' WHEN icte.TOTAL_UNITS < da.avg_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_LOAD' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_load_category FROM inner_cte2 icte JOIN dept_avg da ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = da.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.enrolled_students_variance, des.enrolled_students_stddev, des.total_subjects, sus.SUBJECT_TITLE, sus.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sus.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, sus.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sus.TOTAL_UNITS, sus.window_column, sus.unit_load_category FROM DepartmentEnrollmentStats des JOIN SubjectUnitStats sus ON des.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sus.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY des.enrolled_students_variance DESC, sus.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each building with a building type of 'ACADEMIC' and a campus sector of 'MAIN GROUP', show the building name from the current table, the fiscal period from the history table, the maximum assignable area from the history table for each building, and their dense rank considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the assignable area from the history table, but only include those results where the assignable area from the history table is greater than the average assignable area for all buildings in the history table. Present the building name, fiscal period, maximum assignable area, and dense rank in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.BUILDING_NAME, t1.FISCAL_PERIOD, t1.ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM FCLT_BUILDING t0 JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST t1 ON t0.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY = t1.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY WHERE t0.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND t0.CAMPUS_SECTOR = 'MAIN GROUP' ) SELECT BUILDING_NAME, FISCAL_PERIOD, MAX(ASSIGNABLE_AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY BUILDING_NAME) AS max_assignable_area, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY ASSIGNABLE_AREA ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM inner_cte ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.BUILDING_NAME, t1.FISCAL_PERIOD, t1.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ASSIGNABLE_AREA ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM FCLT_BUILDING t0 JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST t1 ON t0.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY = t1.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY WHERE t0.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND t0.CAMPUS_SECTOR = 'MAIN GROUP' ) SELECT BUILDING_NAME, FISCAL_PERIOD, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE ASSIGNABLE_AREA > (SELECT AVG(ASSIGNABLE_AREA) FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST) ) SELECT s1.BUILDING_NAME, s1.FISCAL_PERIOD, s1.max_assignable_area, s1.window_column FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.BUILDING_NAME = s2.BUILDING_NAME AND s1.FISCAL_PERIOD = s2.FISCAL_PERIOD AND s1.window_column = s2.window_column ORDER BY s1.BUILDING_NAME, s1.FISCAL_PERIOD;

question: For rooms with a room number of '21E' and an access level of 1, show the building room, room square footage, building component, space usage, the minimum room square footage in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by building key, the warehouse load date from both the SPACE_DETAIL and SPACE_USAGE tables, the floor, space unit code, space unit name, the average floor within each space unit code group, and the total number of rooms per space unit code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, t0.BUILDING_COMPONENT, t1.SPACE_USAGE, MIN(t0.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) OVER (ORDER BY t0.BUILDING_KEY ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE AS space_detail_load_date, t1.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE AS space_usage_load_date, t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY FROM SPACE_DETAIL t0 JOIN SPACE_USAGE t1 ON t0.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = t1.SPACE_USAGE_KEY WHERE t0.ROOM_NUMBER = '21E' ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.SPACE_UNIT, AVG(t1.FLOOR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ORDER BY t1.FLOOR) AS avg_floor FROM SPACE_UNIT t0 JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t1 ON t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 ) SELECT inner_cte.BUILDING_ROOM, inner_cte.FLOOR, inner_cte.SPACE_USAGE, inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT, inner_cte.avg_floor, RoomCounts.Total_Rooms FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS Total_Rooms FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t1 WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 GROUP BY t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ) AS RoomCounts ON inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = RoomCounts.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ) SELECT subq1.BUILDING_ROOM, subq1.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, subq1.BUILDING_COMPONENT, subq1.SPACE_USAGE, subq1.window_column, subq1.space_detail_load_date, subq1.space_usage_load_date, subq2.FLOOR, subq2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, subq2.SPACE_UNIT, subq2.avg_floor, subq2.Total_Rooms FROM subq1 JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON subq1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY JOIN subq2 ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = subq2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE AND subq1.BUILDING_ROOM = subq2.BUILDING_ROOM;

question: For each library reserve material detail with material status key 'U' and term code '2009SP', show the course instructor key, reserve catalog key, subject offered key, the responsible faculty name, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the responsible faculty name from the associated subject offered, and for each matching course in the "Electrical Eng & Computer Sci" department, show the course description, course level, the full name and email address of students enrolled, and the row number within each course level group ordered by the student's last name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, t0.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, t0.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL t0 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND t0.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' ) SELECT inner_cte.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, inner_cte.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, inner_cte.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM inner_cte ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, t2.DEPARTMENT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.COURSE_LEVEL ORDER BY t2.LAST_NAME) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.COURSE_LEVEL, inner_cte.FULL_NAME, inner_cte.EMAIL_ADDRESS, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.COURSE_LEVEL, inner_cte.window_column ) SELECT s1.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, s1.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, s1.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s1.window_column AS faculty_window_column, s2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s2.COURSE_LEVEL, s2.FULL_NAME, s2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, s2.window_column AS student_window_column FROM subq1 s1 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN subq2 s2 ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT

question: For the top 10 departments by the number of non-repeatable-for-credit subjects offered in the fall term, list the department name, academic year, number of such subjects, subject code, subject title, number of enrolled students (for subjects with at least 5 enrolled students), material status key, ISBN, responsible faculty name, and the row number within each material status group ordered by subject ID, for subjects that meet both criteria. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.GRADE_RULE_DESC = 'Not repeatable for credit' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.subject_count, ccso.SUBJECT_CODE, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR WHERE ccso.GRADE_RULE_DESC = 'Not repeatable for credit' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' ORDER BY icte.subject_count DESC, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccso.SUBJECT_CODE ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ISBN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.TERM_CODE, i.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, i.ISBN, l.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, i.window_column FROM inner_cte i JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON i.SUBJECT_ID = l.SUBJECT_ID AND i.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.subject_count, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2.ISBN, s2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s2.window_column FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.TERM_CODE = s2.TERM_CODE ORDER BY s1.subject_count DESC, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.window_column;

question: List, for subject offerings in the term '2017FA' with a total number of units greater than 10, the subject title, department name, school name, and their dense rank considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by department code, and for each academic year and department, the academic year, academic year description, department name, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for all library reserve materials offered in terms that have a material status of 'U' (including a grand total across all departments for each academic year in the format of academic year, academic year description, null, total coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP)). Indicate the source of each row as either 'SubjectOffering' or 'LibraryReserve'. The columns should be: subject title, department name, school name, window column, academic year, academic year description, coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and source. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t2.COURSE_NUMBER FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS > 10 ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 ON inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER = t0.COURSE_NUMBER ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE AND LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.window_column, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS coefficient_of_variation, 'SubjectOffering' AS Source FROM Subquery1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS window_column, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.coefficient_of_variation, 'LibraryReserve' AS Source FROM Subquery2 s2 ) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, window_column, ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, coefficient_of_variation, Source FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, ACADEMIC_YEAR

question: For each school and each department within the school, provide the school name, department name, the average and variance of the total units for its courses that have a non-null subject title and total units greater than 0, and for each academic year and subject in that department, give the academic year, academic year description, subject ID, total units, the department's average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for subjects offered in regular terms in that year, and the deviation of the subject's total units from the department's average in that year. Also include a grand total row for all departments in each school in the format of (school name, null, average, variance, ...). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ), SchoolDeptStats AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance, DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units, DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE ), DeptYearSubjectStats AS ( SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.TOTAL_UNITS, d.avg_total_units, d.stddev_total_units, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - d.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 i JOIN dept_stats d ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AND i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT sds.SCHOOL_NAME, sds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sds.avg_units, sds.units_variance, dys.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dys.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, dys.SUBJECT_ID, dys.TOTAL_UNITS, dys.avg_total_units, dys.stddev_total_units, dys.deviation_from_avg FROM SchoolDeptStats sds JOIN DeptYearSubjectStats dys ON sds.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dys.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY sds.SCHOOL_NAME, sds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dys.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dys.SUBJECT_ID ;

question: For each department name and school name in the School of Engineering where the department is degree granting, provide the number of unique courses, the minimum CIP program code from the course descriptions, the course description, and the dense rank of each course considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the department's budget code, but only include courses where the department's budget code is greater than the average budget code of all Engineering school departments. Additionally, for each school, include a grand total for all departments in that school in the format of (null, school name, total courses, min CIP code, null, null). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(course_count) AS total_courses, MIN(min_cip_code) AS min_cip_code FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(course_count) > 0 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.total_courses, rr.min_cip_code, ic2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ic2.window_column FROM RollupResults rr LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND rr.SCHOOL_NAME = d.SCHOOL_NAME LEFT JOIN inner_cte2 ic2 ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic2.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE rr.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND (rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL OR d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > ( SELECT AVG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL )) ORDER BY rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic2.window_column

question: For each department name and school name, list the number of offered subjects and the minimum number of enrolled students for subjects with more than 3 enrolled students, and for each school name, include a grand total for all departments in that school in the format of (null, school name, total offered subjects, minimum enrolled students). Additionally, for the top 5 departments in the School of Engineering with the highest total student enrollment in their offered courses, also show the total enrollment, the course with the highest enrollment (including the course number and its enrollment). The columns should be: department name, school name, total offered subjects, minimum enrolled students, total enrollment, highest enrolled course, and course enrollment, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS offered_subject_count, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(offered_subject_count) AS total_offered_subjects, MIN(min_enrolled_students) AS min_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(offered_subject_count) > 0 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.COURSE_NUMBER, t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ), TopDepartments AS ( SELECT dept_enroll.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dept_enroll.total_enrollment, top_course.COURSE_NUMBER AS highest_enrolled_course, top_course.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS course_enrollment FROM ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_enrollment DESC LIMIT 5 ) dept_enroll JOIN ( SELECT i1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i1.COURSE_NUMBER, i1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte2 i1 JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enroll FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) i2 ON i1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = i2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = i2.max_enroll ) top_course ON dept_enroll.DEPARTMENT_NAME = top_course.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dept_enroll.total_enrollment DESC ) SELECT r.DEPARTMENT_NAME, r.SCHOOL_NAME, r.total_offered_subjects, r.min_enrolled_students, t.total_enrollment, t.highest_enrolled_course, t.course_enrollment FROM RollupResults r LEFT JOIN TopDepartments t ON r.DEPARTMENT_NAME = t.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND r.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' WHERE r.SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL ORDER BY r.SCHOOL_NAME, r.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each department name and school name where the number of enrolled students in the offered subject is greater than 3, show the number of offered subjects, the minimum number of enrolled students, the subject title with the highest number of enrolled students in that department and school, as well as the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for all courses offered by departments within that school. Present the results ordered by school name and department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS offered_subject_count, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.offered_subject_count, ic.min_enrolled_students, ls.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_with_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC) AS rn FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 ) ls ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ls.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.SCHOOL_NAME = ls.SCHOOL_NAME AND ls.rn = 1 ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT d.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.SCHOOL_NAME, subq1.offered_subject_count, subq1.min_enrolled_students, subq1.subject_with_max_enrollment, subq2.total_units_range, subq2.total_units_variance, subq2.total_units_stddev FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.SCHOOL_NAME = subq2.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY subq1.SCHOOL_NAME, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each subject that has a material status key of 'RQ', show the subject title, the number of enrolled students, the term code from the library reserve material detail, the offer department name, the responsible faculty name, the tip material key, the total number of subjects per offer department, the row number within each tip material status key group ordered by the subject title, the degree-granting department name, the subject code, the subject code description, the average of the ASCII values of the course numbers for that subject code, and the variance of the ASCII values of the course numbers for that subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t3.TERM_CODE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS window_column, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS dept_name, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.COURSE_NUMBER FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 JOIN TIP_DETAIL t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL t3 ON t2.SUBJECT_ID = t3.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, dept_counts.total_subjects_per_dept, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects_per_dept FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) AS dept_counts ON inner_cte.dept_name = dept_counts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s.COURSE_NUMBER FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER, AVG(ASCII(inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VARIANCE(ASCII(inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s1.total_subjects_per_dept, s1.window_column, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s2.avg_course_number_ascii, s2.var_course_number_ascii FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.COURSE_NUMBER = s2.COURSE_NUMBER;

question: For IAP subject activities with a maximum enrollment of 30, show the activity title, the academic year, the total number of such activities per academic year, the academic year description, and both the maximum and minimum of the variance of record counts of TIP materials associated with that academic year (considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the TIP material status key is not 'NM'). List the results ordered by academic year and activity title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH IAP_Activities AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 30 ) SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, Activity_Count.Total_Activities FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE JOIN ( SELECT t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS Total_Activities FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 30 GROUP BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) AS Activity_Count ON t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = Activity_Count.ACADEMIC_YEAR WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 30 ), TIP_MaterialVariance AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(record_count_variance) AS max_record_count_variance, MIN(record_count_variance) AS min_record_count_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY max_record_count_variance DESC ) SELECT ia.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ia.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ia.Total_Activities, tmv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, tmv.max_record_count_variance, tmv.min_record_count_variance FROM IAP_Activities ia JOIN TIP_MaterialVariance tmv ON ia.ACADEMIC_YEAR = tmv.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ia.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ia.ACTIVITY_TITLE;

question: List all building rooms that either have an access level of 1 or are on floor 2. For rooms with access level 1, show the building room, floor, space usage, space unit code, space unit name, the average floor within each space unit code group, and the total number of rooms per space unit code, and indicate 'AccessLevel1' as the reason for inclusion. For rooms on floor 2, show the building room, organization name, department name, and the difference between the access level of the room and the average access level for that department, and indicate 'Floor2' as the reason for inclusion. The results should be ordered by building room. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.SPACE_UNIT, AVG(t1.FLOOR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ORDER BY t1.FLOOR) AS avg_floor FROM SPACE_UNIT t0 JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t1 ON t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 ) SELECT ic.BUILDING_ROOM, ic.FLOOR, ic.SPACE_USAGE, ic.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, ic.SPACE_UNIT, ic.avg_floor, cnt.total_rooms FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT SPACE_UNIT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS total_rooms FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD WHERE ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 GROUP BY SPACE_UNIT_CODE ) cnt ON ic.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = cnt.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.ACCESS_LEVEL FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2 ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ACCESS_LEVEL) AS avg_access_level FROM inner_cte GROUP BY HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.BUILDING_ROOM, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, (i.ACCESS_LEVEL - d.avg_access_level) AS access_level_deviation FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT s1.BUILDING_ROOM, s1.FLOOR, s1.SPACE_USAGE, s1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, s1.SPACE_UNIT, s1.avg_floor, s1.total_rooms, NULL AS ORGANIZATION_NAME, NULL AS HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS access_level_deviation, 'AccessLevel1' AS Reason FROM Subquery1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.BUILDING_ROOM, NULL AS FLOOR, NULL AS SPACE_USAGE, NULL AS SPACE_UNIT_CODE, NULL AS SPACE_UNIT, NULL AS avg_floor, NULL AS total_rooms, s2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.access_level_deviation, 'Floor2' AS Reason FROM Subquery2 s2 ORDER BY BUILDING_ROOM;

question: For each academic year and department, what is the academic year, academic year description, the variance of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during terms in that year (considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the number of enrolled students is greater than 0), the department name, the total number of such library subjects offered per department in that year, and the highest average total units for subjects that department has ever offered in a regular academic term? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, COUNT(DISTINCT LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS total_library_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.TERM_CODE, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.TERM_CODE ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(avg_total_units) AS highest_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.enrolled_students_variance, s1.department_name, s1.total_library_subjects_offered, s2.highest_avg_total_units FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.department_name = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC, s1.enrolled_students_variance DESC, s1.total_library_subjects_offered DESC, s2.highest_avg_total_units DESC

question: For IAP subject activities with a maximum enrollment between 15 and 30 inclusive, that are not cancelled, and that require advance sign-up, show the activity title, enrollment type, the academic year description from the academic terms, the term start date from all academic terms, and the term description from academic terms, as well as the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by activity title. For each such activity, also provide the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during terms in the same academic year (considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the number of enrolled students is greater than 0), and whether the range is categorized as 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' (at least 20 or more), 'LOW_VARIABILITY' (less than 5), or 'MEDIUM_VARIABILITY' otherwise. The columns should be: activity title, enrollment type, academic year description, term start date, term description, window row number, enrolled student range, enrolled student variance, and variability category. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH iap_activities AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t2.TERM_START_DATE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT BETWEEN 15 AND 30 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' ) SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), year_enrollment_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.enrolled_range, inner_cte.enrolled_variance, CASE WHEN inner_cte.enrolled_range >= 20 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN inner_cte.enrolled_range < 5 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'MEDIUM_VARIABILITY' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.enrolled_range DESC ) SELECT iap_activities.ACTIVITY_TITLE, iap_activities.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, iap_activities.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, iap_activities.TERM_START_DATE, iap_activities.TERM_DESCRIPTION, iap_activities.window_column, year_enrollment_stats.enrolled_range, year_enrollment_stats.enrolled_variance, year_enrollment_stats.variability_category FROM iap_activities JOIN year_enrollment_stats ON iap_activities.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = year_enrollment_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC

question: For subjects offered in the term with code '2012SU' that are in academic years where the total number of unique subjects with TIP materials (excluding those with TIP material status key 'NM') for all terms in that year with non-null term status exceeds the average per academic year, provide the subject title, subject ID, offer department name, academic year, term description, the minimum number of enrolled students in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the academic year, the average number of enrolled students for that term, the enrollment category (classified as 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' if the number of enrolled students is at least 10% greater than the average for that term, 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' if at least 10% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise), the academic year description, and the total number of unique subjects with TIP materials for that academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID) AS unique_subject_count FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS IS NOT NULL AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), cte1 AS ( SELECT inner_cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte1.unique_subject_count FROM inner_cte1 JOIN ( SELECT AVG(unique_subject_count) AS avg_unique_subjects FROM inner_cte1 ) avg_cte ON inner_cte1.unique_subject_count > avg_cte.avg_unique_subjects ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, MIN(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' ), cte2 AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte2.window_column, avg_stats.avg_enrolled_students, CASE WHEN inner_cte2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > avg_stats.avg_enrolled_students * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN inner_cte2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < avg_stats.avg_enrolled_students * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte2 JOIN ( SELECT t1.TERM_CODE, AVG(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' GROUP BY t1.TERM_CODE ) avg_stats ON avg_stats.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' ) SELECT cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE, cte2.SUBJECT_ID, cte2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cte2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cte2.window_column, cte2.avg_enrolled_students, cte2.enrollment_category, cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cte1.unique_subject_count FROM cte2 JOIN cte1 ON cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY cte2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each building located on the MIT site with more than 5 rooms, and for each organization with organization level 5 and HR org unit level 'DEPARTMENTS' that has rooms in that building, what is the building's long name, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the areas of its rooms, the average area of its rooms as a benchmark, whether the building is a 'LARGE_VARIANCE' (if the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is at least 20% greater than the average area), 'SMALL_VARIANCE' (if the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is at least 20% less than the average area), or 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' otherwise, the organization name, organization ID, DLC name, HR org unit title, HR department name, HR org unit level, and the row number within each HR department name group ordered by organization name? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH BuildingVariance AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev, AVG(r.AREA) AS area_avg FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ) SELECT i.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, i.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, i.area_stddev, i.area_avg, CASE WHEN i.area_stddev > i.area_avg * 1.2 THEN 'LARGE_VARIANCE' WHEN i.area_stddev < i.area_avg * 0.8 THEN 'SMALL_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte i ), OrgDepartments AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID, t1.DLC_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS window_column, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte WHERE HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS' ), OrgRooms AS ( SELECT r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ROOMS r GROUP BY r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) SELECT bv.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, bv.area_stddev, bv.area_avg, bv.variance_category, od.ORGANIZATION_NAME, od.ORGANIZATION_ID, od.DLC_NAME, od.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, od.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, od.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, od.window_column FROM BuildingVariance bv JOIN OrgRooms orr ON bv.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = orr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN OrgDepartments od ON orr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = od.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY bv.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, od.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, od.ORGANIZATION_NAME

question: List the full names and email addresses of students in the MIT student directory who are in departments belonging to the School of Engineering and whose department name contains the word "Engineering", along with the subject ID, subject title, offering department name, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, term start date, term end date, term parameter, the minimum number of enrolled students over each offering department, the offering school name, and the responsible faculty name for subjects offered in the term with code '2025FA' in their department. Order the results by student full name and offering department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH EngineeringStudents AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS engineering_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE '%Engineering%' ) SELECT msd.FULL_NAME, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE '%Engineering%' ), Subjects2025FA AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept, t0.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ) SELECT SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_START_DATE, TERM_END_DATE, TERM_PARAMETER, min_enrolled_students_per_dept, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM inner_cte ) SELECT es.FULL_NAME, es.EMAIL_ADDRESS, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.TERM_START_DATE, s.TERM_END_DATE, s.TERM_PARAMETER, s.min_enrolled_students_per_dept, s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM EngineeringStudents es JOIN Subjects2025FA s ON es.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY es.FULL_NAME, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: For subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering with a total of at least 6 units, show the subject code, subject title, department name, grade type, and the running sum of total units within each grade type, but only include those subjects where the running sum exceeds 12 units within their grade type. For each such subject, also show, for IAP subject activities with a maximum enrollment of at least 10 and that are not cancelled and are associated with the same subject code, the academic term description, activity title, enrollment type, and the total count of such activities (with a grand total row for all activities in each term, where activity title, enrollment type, and subject title are null and the total count is for all activities in that term).
