Order the results by subject code, academic term description, and activity title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.GRADE_TYPE, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ), subq1 AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, GRADE_TYPE, window_column FROM inner_cte1 WHERE window_column > 12 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 10 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' ), rollup_cte AS ( SELECT ACTIVITY_TITLE, ENROLLMENT_TYPE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUBJECT_TITLE, SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS activity_count FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACTIVITY_TITLE, ENROLLMENT_TYPE, SUBJECT_TITLE, SUBJECT_CODE WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.GRADE_TYPE, s1.window_column, r1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, r1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, r1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, r1.activity_count FROM subq1 s1 JOIN rollup_cte r1 ON s1.SUBJECT_CODE = r1.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_CODE, r1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, r1.ACTIVITY_TITLE

question: For each academic term where the term status indicator is 'P' and the term parameter is 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM', what are the academic terms key, term description, academic year description, term start date, term end date, the minimum academic year in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the term code, the total number of academic terms per academic year, and the maximum average subject enrollment number for subjects offered in terms that are not the current term and have more than 0 total units, with all results grouped and ordered by academic year description and term start date? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH max_avg_enrollment AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON atp.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(avg_enrollment) AS max_avg_subject_enrollment FROM ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) subq GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY max_avg_subject_enrollment DESC ), term_window_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t0.TERM_START_DATE, t0.TERM_END_DATE, MIN(t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TERM_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND t1.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM' ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.TERM_END_DATE, inner_cte.window_column, Total_Terms.Total_Terms_Per_Year, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.TERM_CODE) AS Total_Terms_Per_Year FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 GROUP BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) AS Total_Terms ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = Total_Terms.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT tws.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY, tws.TERM_DESCRIPTION, tws.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, tws.TERM_START_DATE, tws.TERM_END_DATE, tws.window_column, tws.Total_Terms_Per_Year, mae.max_avg_subject_enrollment FROM term_window_stats tws JOIN max_avg_enrollment mae ON tws.ACADEMIC_YEAR = mae.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY tws.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, tws.TERM_START_DATE

question: For each subject offered in the current SIS term, list the offering department name, subject title, responsible faculty name, term description, academic year description, the total number of subjects offered per department, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses with at least one associated course material in that department, and indicate whether the department's average enrollment is 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% greater than the overall average), 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% less than the overall average), or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. The columns should be: offering department name, subject title, responsible faculty name, term description, academic year description, total number of subjects offered per department, average enrollment, enrollment standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and enrollment category. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME as OFFER_DEPT_NAME_JOIN FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM' ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, dept_counts.Total_Subjects, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME_JOIN FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS Total_Subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM' GROUP BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) dept_counts ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_counts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrollment, inner_cte.enrollment_stddev, CASE WHEN inner_cte.avg_enrollment > overall.avg_all_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN inner_cte.avg_enrollment < overall.avg_all_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_all_enrollment FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' ) overall ) SELECT subq1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, subq1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, subq1.Total_Subjects, subq2.avg_enrollment, subq2.enrollment_stddev, subq2.enrollment_category FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = subq2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY subq1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For each department in the 2022 academic year where the average subject enrollment number (in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by department code and ordered by total units for subjects with 12 units) is greater than the overall average subject enrollment number for all subjects in 2022, provide the department name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in 2022, the number of unique subject titles offered in 2022, and the windowed average subject enrollment number, listing the results in descending order of the total units range. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_total_units, i.total_units_range, i.total_units_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS num_unique_subject_titles FROM inner_cte i JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_total_units, i.total_units_range, i.total_units_variance ORDER BY i.total_units_range DESC ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) OVER ( PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(window_column) > ( SELECT AVG(t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 ) ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.avg_total_units, s1.total_units_range, s1.total_units_variance, s1.num_unique_subject_titles, s2.avg_window_enrollment FROM subq1 s1 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN subq2 s2 ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.total_units_range DESC

question: For subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering with a total of at least 6 units, show the subject code, subject title, department name, and the running sum of total units within each grade type (only including those subjects where the running sum exceeds 12 units within their grade type), and for each such department and each employee type where the student year is 'G', show the number of people, the minimum MIT ID, and the list of unique office locations for those employees. Order the results by subject code and employee type. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ) SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > 12 ORDER BY SUBJECT_CODE ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(sp.MIT_ID) AS person_count, MIN(sp.MIT_ID) AS min_mit_id FROM SE_PERSON sp JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.person_count, inner_cte.min_mit_id, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT sp.OFFICE_LOCATION) AS unique_office_locations FROM inner_cte JOIN SE_PERSON sp ON sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = inner_cte.EMPLOYEE_TYPE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY inner_cte.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.person_count, inner_cte.min_mit_id ) SELECT subq1.SUBJECT_CODE, subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.window_column, subq2.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, subq2.person_count, subq2.min_mit_id, subq2.unique_office_locations FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subq1.SUBJECT_CODE, subq2.EMPLOYEE_TYPE;

question: For each subject that is offered by a department with more than 5 subjects in the academic term with term code '2006FA' and is also offered in the term with code '2022FA' where its total units are greater than the average total units for all subjects in that term, show the subject ID, subject title, department name, the sum of lecture units within each grade type group, the total number of subjects per department for the 2006FA term, the term description, the academic year, and the running sum of total units for subjects in the 2022FA term within each academic year. Order the results by subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.LECTURE_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA' ), DeptCounts AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS SUBJECT_COUNT FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = '2006FA' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ), cte1 AS ( SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.window_column, dc.SUBJECT_COUNT FROM inner_cte1 ic JOIN DeptCounts dc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ), cte2 AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_ID, DEPARTMENT_NAME, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column2 FROM inner_cte2 WHERE TOTAL_UNITS > ( SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ) ) SELECT cte1.SUBJECT_ID, cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE, cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1.window_column, cte1.SUBJECT_COUNT, cte2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cte2.window_column2 FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.SUBJECT_ID = cte2.SUBJECT_ID AND cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cte1.SUBJECT_ID

question: For each subject category, academic year, subject count, and minimum academic term start date where the subject has a maximum enrollment greater than 10, list the total number of subject IDs from the TIP_DETAIL table for that term, the academic year description, department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in regular terms. For each subject category and academic year, include a grand total for all subject IDs in the format of (subject category, academic year, null, null, total subject IDs, academic year description, null, total values). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT i.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date, a.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.TERM_CODE ), SubjectIDCounts AS ( SELECT icte.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.subject_count, icte.min_term_start_date, COUNT(DISTINCT t.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_id_count, icte.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte1 icte JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON icte.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE GROUP BY icte.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.subject_count, icte.min_term_start_date, icte.TERM_CODE ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, ACADEMIC_YEAR, subject_count, min_term_start_date, SUM(subject_id_count) AS total_subject_ids, TERM_CODE FROM SubjectIDCounts GROUP BY IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, ACADEMIC_YEAR, subject_count, min_term_start_date, TERM_CODE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(subject_id_count) > 0 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptUnitStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte2 UNION ALL SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(avg_total_units) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(stddev_total_units) AS stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT r.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, r.ACADEMIC_YEAR, r.subject_count, r.min_term_start_date, r.total_subject_ids, d.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_total_units, d.stddev_total_units FROM RollupResults r JOIN DeptUnitStats d ON r.ACADEMIC_YEAR = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY r.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, r.ACADEMIC_YEAR, r.subject_count, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each department, course number, and offering school name where the number of enrolled students in the subject summary is greater than 2, provide the total number of unique library subjects offered and the minimum total units for those subjects, and for each matching subject offering in the academic term with term code '2017FA', show the subject title, the term description, the number of enrolled students, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title. For each department, course number, and offering school name, include a grand total for all subjects in the format of (department, course number, null, total subjects, min total units), and include all columns in the order: department name, course number, offering school name, total subjects, min total units, subject title, term description, number of enrolled students, and window column. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ), subject_summary1 AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COURSE_NUMBER, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(subject_count) AS total_subjects, MIN(min_total_units) AS min_total_units FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COURSE_NUMBER, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(subject_count) > 0 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON s.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' ), subject_summary2 AS ( SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.window_column FROM inner_cte2 i JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON i.SUBJECT_TITLE = s.SUBJECT_TITLE AND i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND i.TERM_DESCRIPTION = (SELECT TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS WHERE TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE) WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' ) SELECT s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.COURSE_NUMBER, s1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s1.total_subjects, s1.min_total_units, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.window_column FROM subject_summary1 s1 JOIN subject_summary2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.COURSE_NUMBER, s1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For each subject offered by the library in the term "2019SP", show the subject title, the number of enrolled students, the term description, the total units for the subject, the average total units within each subject group, the offering department name, the school name, and the number of unique subject titles with materials offered in regular academic terms for the same department and school. Do not repeat the subject title if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by the number of enrolled students and department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ss.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY ss.SUBJECT_GROUP_ID ORDER BY lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_total_units, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_dept_name, lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME AS join_school_name FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2019SP' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(SUBJECT_TITLE) OVER (ORDER BY NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, OFFER_DEPT_NAME) = SUBJECT_TITLE THEN NULL ELSE SUBJECT_TITLE END AS subject_title, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, TERM_DESCRIPTION, TOTAL_UNITS, avg_total_units, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, join_dept_name, join_school_name FROM inner_cte ORDER BY NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.SCHOOL_NAME FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON td.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND td.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_title_count FROM inner_cte ic GROUP BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE) > 0 ORDER BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT s1.subject_title, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.TOTAL_UNITS, s1.avg_total_units, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s2.subject_title_count FROM subq1 s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.join_dept_name = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s1.join_school_name = s2.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME

question: For each organization, list the organization name, the total number of rooms with a non-null area, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the room areas for rooms associated with that organization and having a non-null area, and for each organization also show the major organization, the top-level HR organization name, the HR department name, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the organization numbers for each top-level HR organization name and HR department name, considering only organizations that are assignable and have a non-null organization number. The columns should be: organization name, total number of rooms, area range, area variance, area standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), major organization, top-level HR organization name, HR department name, average organization number, organization number variance, and organization number standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH org_room_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY o JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS total_rooms, ic.area_range, ic.area_variance, ic.area_stddev, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM inner_cte ic JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME = r.ORGANIZATION_NAME WHERE r.AREA IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.area_range, ic.area_variance, ic.area_stddev, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ), major_org_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT F.MAJOR_ORG, H.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME, AVG(F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS avg_org_number, VARIANCE(F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance, STDDEV(F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION F JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT H ON F.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = H.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE F.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER IS NOT NULL GROUP BY F.MAJOR_ORG, H.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME ) SELECT icte.MAJOR_ORG, icte.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME, H.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_org_number, icte.org_number_variance, icte.org_number_stddev, F.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM inner_cte icte JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT H ON icte.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME = H.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION F ON F.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = H.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE F.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND F.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER IS NOT NULL ) SELECT ors.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ors.total_rooms, ors.area_range, ors.area_variance, ors.area_stddev, mos.MAJOR_ORG, mos.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME, mos.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, mos.avg_org_number, mos.org_number_variance, mos.org_number_stddev FROM org_room_stats ors JOIN major_org_stats mos ON ors.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = mos.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY ors.total_rooms DESC, mos.org_number_variance DESC;

question: For each department in the current academic term that has offered more than 5 unique subjects in terms from the academic year 2014 or later, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered, which school within that department has the highest average total units, the average total units for that school, the count of unique subject titles, and the total number of enrolled students in those subjects? Show the department name, average total units, variance of total units, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, school name with the highest average, its average total units, subject count, and total enrolled students, in that order, sorted by total enrolled students descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH dept_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.SCHOOL_NAME, ss.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON atp.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, hs.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_with_highest_avg, hs.school_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS school_avg_total_units, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME ) hs ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = hs.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND hs.rn = 1 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, hs.SCHOOL_NAME, hs.school_avg_total_units ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), dept_subjects AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2014 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.subject_count, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2014 GROUP BY inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.subject_count HAVING inner_cte.subject_count > 5 ORDER BY total_enrolled_students DESC ) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.avg_total_units, ds.total_units_variance, ds.total_units_stddev, ds.school_with_highest_avg, ds.school_avg_total_units, dsub.subject_count, dsub.total_enrolled_students FROM dept_stats ds JOIN dept_subjects dsub ON ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsub.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY dsub.total_enrolled_students DESC;

question: For each department long name and department hierarchy level 3 name where the department hierarchy type is 'Standard Hierarchy' and the organization unit level is 'DEPARTMENTS', provide the number of unique facility organization keys, the minimum organization unit ID, the most recent warehouse load date, the corresponding department code, and the department name. Also, include subtotals for each department long name (the corresponding department long name field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all departments (the corresponding department long name field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the department long name if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by department long name and department hierarchy level 3 name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS min_org_unit_id FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m ON f.DLC_KEY = m.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY WHERE m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS' GROUP BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(dept_long) OVER (ORDER BY dept_long_sort, hier3_sort) = dept_long THEN NULL ELSE dept_long END AS department_long_name, hier3_name, org_count, min_org_unit_id, max_load_date FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG) = 1 AND GROUPING(MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG END AS dept_long_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG) = 0 AND GROUPING(MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG) = 1 AND GROUPING(MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG END AS dept_long, CASE WHEN GROUPING(HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG) = 0 AND GROUPING(MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME END AS hier3_sort, MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME AS hier3_name, COUNT(DISTINCT FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS min_org_unit_id, MAX(h.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS max_load_date FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m ON f.DLC_KEY = m.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY WHERE m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS' GROUP BY HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY dept_long_sort, hier3_sort ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS min_org_unit_id FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m ON f.DLC_KEY = m.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY WHERE m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS' GROUP BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, inner_cte.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, inner_cte.org_count, inner_cte.min_org_unit_id, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG AND h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS' ) SELECT s1.department_long_name, s1.hier3_name, s1.org_count, s1.min_org_unit_id, s1.max_load_date, s2.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, s2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM subq1 s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.department_long_name = s2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG AND s1.hier3_name = s2.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME AND s1.min_org_unit_id = s2.min_org_unit_id ORDER BY s1.department_long_name, s1.hier3_name;

question: For courses in the School of Engineering that are degree granting and belong to departments where the total number of units for all subjects offered in the Fall term of the academic year 2022 is greater than the overall average total units for that term, show the course description, department name, subject title, the subject's grade type description, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title, the minimum number of lecture units for the department, and the total number of units for the department. List the results ordered by department name and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.GRADE_TYPE_DESC, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE = t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS min_lecture_units, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.TERM_DESCRIPTION LIKE 'Fall Term%' AND c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, min_lecture_units, total_units FROM inner_cte WHERE total_units > ( SELECT AVG(total_units) FROM ( SELECT SUM(c2.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c2 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON c2.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_DESCRIPTION LIKE 'Fall Term%' AND c2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY c2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) dept_totals ) ) SELECT s1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.GRADE_TYPE_DESC, s1.window_column, s2.min_lecture_units, s2.total_units FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each school and department, list the school name, department name, the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2022, along with the full names and email addresses of students in the MIT student directory who are in departments belonging to the School of Engineering and whose department name contains the word "Engineering". Only include rows where the school and department match between the subject statistics and the student directory. Present the columns in the following order: school name, department name, units range, units variance, full name, email address. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCD.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCD.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, units_range, units_variance FROM ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, units_range, units_variance FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(units_range) AS units_range, VARIANCE(units_range) AS units_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ) t ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS engineering_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE '%Engineering%' ) SELECT msd.FULL_NAME, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS, msd.DEPARTMENT, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE '%Engineering%' ) SELECT subq1.SCHOOL_NAME, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.units_range, subq1.units_variance, subq2.FULL_NAME, subq2.EMAIL_ADDRESS FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.SCHOOL_NAME = subq2.SCHOOL_NAME AND subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subq1.SCHOOL_NAME, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq2.FULL_NAME

question: For IAP subject activities in the term "2021JA" that are not cancelled, show the activity title, enrollment type, calendar date, the fiscal year of the calendar date, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by activity title, along with the department name, subject ID, subject title, academic year, the rank of each subject within its academic year group ordered by subject ID, and the total number of subjects per department for subjects in the "Engineering" school with total units equal to 1, where the fiscal year of the IAP activity matches the academic year of the subject. Present the columns in the following order: activity title, enrollment type, calendar date, fiscal year, IAP window number, department name, subject ID, subject title, academic year, subject rank, and total number of subjects per department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH iap_activities AS ( SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.CALENDAR_DATE, t1.FISCAL_YEAR, inner_cte.window_column FROM ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.CALENDAR_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN TIME_DAY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' ) inner_cte JOIN TIME_DAY t1 ON inner_cte.CALENDAR_DATE = t1.CALENDAR_DATE ), eng_subjects AS ( SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.window_column, dept_counts.Total_Subjects FROM ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 1 ) inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS Total_Subjects FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY WHERE SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND TOTAL_UNITS = 1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS dept_counts ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT iap_activities.ACTIVITY_TITLE, iap_activities.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, iap_activities.CALENDAR_DATE, iap_activities.FISCAL_YEAR, iap_activities.window_column AS IAP_WINDOW_NUMBER, eng_subjects.DEPARTMENT_NAME, eng_subjects.SUBJECT_ID, eng_subjects.SUBJECT_TITLE, eng_subjects.ACADEMIC_YEAR, eng_subjects.window_column AS SUBJECT_RANK, eng_subjects.Total_Subjects FROM iap_activities JOIN eng_subjects ON iap_activities.FISCAL_YEAR = eng_subjects.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY iap_activities.ACTIVITY_TITLE, eng_subjects.DEPARTMENT_NAME, eng_subjects.SUBJECT_ID

question: For each academic year and offering department, what is the academic year, the academic year description, the variance of the number of tip detail records for subjects offered in that year (considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term and have at least one associated tip detail record), the number of unique departments represented among those subjects, the department name, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered (considering only subjects that are not repeatable and are master sections), the overall average enrollment across all departments in that year, and whether the department's average enrollment is categorized as 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% greater than the overall average), 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% less than the overall average), or 'AVERAGE'? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH cte1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS unique_departments FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance ), cte2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_REPEATABLE_SUBJECT = 'N' AND SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_MASTER_SECTION = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), overall_avg AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(avg_enrollment) AS overall_avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.avg_enrollment, i.enrollment_variance, i.enrollment_stddev, o.overall_avg_enrollment, CASE WHEN i.avg_enrollment > o.overall_avg_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.avg_enrollment < o.overall_avg_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN overall_avg o ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = o.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cte1.record_count_variance, cte1.unique_departments, cte2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cte2.avg_enrollment, cte2.enrollment_variance, cte2.enrollment_stddev, cte2.overall_avg_enrollment, cte2.enrollment_category FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC, cte2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: For each academic year where the geometric mean of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during that year (considering only subjects with more than zero enrolled students) is greater than the overall geometric mean across all years, and which is also among the top 10 academic years with the highest coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for all library reserve materials offered in terms that have a material status of 'U', list the academic year description, the geometric mean of enrolled students, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, the department with the highest average total units in those terms, and that department's average total units, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH geometric_mean_enrollment_cte AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, geometric_mean_enrollment FROM inner_cte WHERE geometric_mean_enrollment > ( SELECT EXP(AVG(LN(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) ), coefficient_of_variation_cte AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.coefficient_of_variation, dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Top_Department, dept_stats.avg_total_units AS Department_Avg_Total_Units FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) DESC) AS rn FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) dept_stats ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dept_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND dept_stats.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.coefficient_of_variation DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT gme.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gme.geometric_mean_enrollment, cov.coefficient_of_variation, cov.Top_Department, cov.Department_Avg_Total_Units FROM geometric_mean_enrollment_cte gme JOIN coefficient_of_variation_cte cov ON gme.ACADEMIC_YEAR = cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY gme.geometric_mean_enrollment DESC;

question: For each subject code where the department is degree granting, show the subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, the number of subject codes per school name, and whether the subject code description is present ('Has Description') or missing ('No Description'). For each school name, include a grand total for all subject codes in the format of (null, null, null, school name, null, total subject codes). Additionally, for subjects offered in the term '2016SP' with a school code of 'E', show the subject title, course description, the offering department name, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title. Present all columns in the following order: subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, description status, total subject codes, subject title, course description, offering department name, and window column. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), SubjectCodeVisibility AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, CASE WHEN SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND SUBJECT_CODE_DESC <> 'nan' THEN 'Has Description' ELSE 'No Description' END AS description_status FROM inner_cte1 ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, description_status, COUNT(*) AS total_subject_codes FROM SubjectCodeVisibility GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, description_status WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ), SubjectCodeSummary AS ( SELECT scv.SUBJECT_CODE, scv.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.description_status, rr.total_subject_codes FROM RollupResults rr LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, description_status FROM SubjectCodeVisibility ) scv ON rr.SCHOOL_NAME = scv.SCHOOL_NAME AND rr.description_status = scv.description_status ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t0.SCHOOL_CODE = 'E' ), SubjectOfferSummary AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte2.window_column FROM inner_cte2 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON inner_cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE = t2.SUBJECT_TITLE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' ) SELECT scs.SUBJECT_CODE, scs.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scs.SCHOOL_NAME, scs.description_status, scs.total_subject_codes, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sos.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sos.window_column FROM SubjectCodeSummary scs LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY so ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = so.OFFER_DEPT_CODE LEFT JOIN SubjectOfferSummary sos ON so.SUBJECT_TITLE = sos.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY scs.SCHOOL_NAME, scs.description_status, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each degree-granting department and each subject it offers in the 2022SU term, list the department name, the subject code, the subject code description, the average and variance of the ASCII values of the course numbers for that subject code, the subject ID, and the dense rank of the subject considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the total number of units. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s.COURSE_NUMBER FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, AVG(ASCII(inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VARIANCE(ASCII(inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2022SU' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.SUBJECT_CODE, subq1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, subq1.avg_course_number_ascii, subq1.var_course_number_ascii, subq2.SUBJECT_ID, subq2.window_column FROM subq1 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN subq2 ON c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq2.window_column, subq2.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For subject offerings in the term '2017FA' with a total number of units greater than 10, show the subject title, department name, school name, and their dense rank considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the department code. For each such department, also show, for each academic year, the academic year and academic year description, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for all library reserve materials offered in terms that have a material status of 'U' for that department. Present the subject title, department name, school name, dense rank, academic year, academic year description, and coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t2.COURSE_NUMBER FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS > 10 ), cte1 AS ( SELECT inner_cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte1.window_column, inner_cte1.COURSE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte1 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 ON inner_cte1.COURSE_NUMBER = t0.COURSE_NUMBER ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE AND LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ), cte2 AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE, cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1.SCHOOL_NAME, cte1.window_column, cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cte2.coefficient_of_variation FROM cte1 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN cte2 ON cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each DLC key that appears among the top 5 departments with the highest variance in assigned space unit codes, show the DLC key, the corresponding DLC name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of organizations associated with that DLC key (considering only DLC keys and organization names that are not null), the total number of unique organizations per DLC key, and for each such department, show the department name, the average and variance of its space unit codes, and the name and code of the space unit with the highest code value in that department. Present the results ordered by the range of organization counts (descending), then by the variance of space unit codes (descending). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH dlc_org_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fdlk.DLC_KEY, MAX(org_count) - MIN(org_count) AS org_count_range, VARIANCE(org_count) AS org_count_variance, STDDEV(org_count) AS org_count_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fdlk JOIN ( SELECT fo.DLC_KEY, COUNT(*) AS org_count FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fo.DLC_KEY ) org_stats ON fdlk.DLC_KEY = org_stats.DLC_KEY WHERE fdlk.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fdlk.DLC_KEY ) SELECT ic.DLC_KEY, fo.DLC_NAME, ic.org_count_range, ic.org_count_variance, ic.org_count_stddev, org_totals.total_organizations FROM inner_cte ic JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON ic.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN ( SELECT DLC_KEY, COUNT(DISTINCT FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS total_organizations FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION WHERE ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NOT NULL AND DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DLC_KEY ) org_totals ON ic.DLC_KEY = org_totals.DLC_KEY GROUP BY ic.DLC_KEY, fo.DLC_NAME, ic.org_count_range, ic.org_count_variance, ic.org_count_stddev, org_totals.total_organizations ), top_dept_space_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, fo.DLC_KEY, AVG(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS avg_space_unit_code, VARIANCE(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS var_space_unit_code FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fodk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON fodk.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE fodk.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, fo.DLC_KEY ) SELECT icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, icte.DLC_KEY, icte.avg_space_unit_code, icte.var_space_unit_code, su.SPACE_UNIT AS max_space_unit_name, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE AS max_space_unit_code FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ( SELECT su1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, su1.SPACE_UNIT, su1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE FROM SPACE_UNIT su1 JOIN ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, MAX(SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS max_code FROM SPACE_UNIT GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) su2 ON su1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY AND su1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = su2.max_code ) su ON icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY icte.var_space_unit_code DESC LIMIT 5 ) SELECT dos.DLC_KEY, dos.DLC_NAME, dos.org_count_range, dos.org_count_variance, dos.org_count_stddev, dos.total_organizations, tds.ORGANIZATION_NAME, tds.avg_space_unit_code, tds.var_space_unit_code, tds.max_space_unit_name, tds.max_space_unit_code FROM dlc_org_stats dos JOIN top_dept_space_stats tds ON dos.DLC_KEY = tds.DLC_KEY ORDER BY dos.org_count_range DESC, tds.var_space_unit_code DESC;

question: For each department in the School of Engineering during regular terms that has more than 10 total tip materials offered for its subjects and at least one term where a course had at least 5 different materials assigned, show the department name, the highest standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students it has ever had in any term (considering only courses with at least 5 different materials assigned in that term), the total number of tip materials offered for its subjects, and the average number of tip materials per subject, with the results ordered by the total number of tip materials in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.TERM_CODE, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.TERM_CODE HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) >= 5 ), Subquery1 AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(enrolled_stddev) AS highest_enrolled_stddev FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL t JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) > 10 ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_tip_materials, AVG(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_tip_materials_per_subject FROM inner_cte2 i JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON s.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_tip_materials ) SELECT s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.highest_enrolled_stddev, s2.total_tip_materials, s2.avg_tip_materials_per_subject FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s2.total_tip_materials DESC;

question: For academic term parameters where the term indicator is 'C', show the term parameter, the term code, the academic year, the department name of the offered subject, and the running sum of academic years within each department, ordered by academic year. Additionally, for each result, include the subject title and the total units of the offered subject. Further, only include departments that are degree-granting and where the average number of enrolled students in offered subjects (with more than 0 enrolled students) is greater than the overall average enrollment across all such subjects, and for these departments, also show the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in offered subjects. Present the results in the order of department name and academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_PARAMETER, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_INDICATOR = 'C' ) SELECT inner_cte.TERM_PARAMETER, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, t3.SUBJECT_TITLE, t3.TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t3 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t3.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE AND inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = t3.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_enrollment, enrollment_variance, enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_enrollment > ( SELECT AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC ) SELECT subq1.TERM_PARAMETER, subq1.TERM_CODE, subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.window_column, subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq1.TOTAL_UNITS, subq2.avg_enrollment, subq2.enrollment_variance, subq2.enrollment_stddev FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For departments in the "Sloan School of Management" area with a hierarchy type of "Standard Hierarchy", show the department code, department name, the dense rank of each department considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the department's long name, and the corresponding DLC name from the MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY table, along with, for each such department, the space unit code, organization name, HR department name from the space unit, the sum of space unit keys within each warehouse load date group, and the HR org unit title for space units with a space unit key greater than 100000, ordered by department code and space unit code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH sloan_departments AS ( SELECT i.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.window_column, m.DLC_NAME, i.DLC_KEY FROM ( SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME = 'Sloan School of Management Area' ) i JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m ON i.DLC_KEY = m.DLC_KEY ), space_unit_summaries AS ( SELECT inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, t3.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, inner_cte.DLC_KEY FROM ( SELECT t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE ORDER BY t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column, t1.DLC_KEY FROM SPACE_UNIT t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000 ) inner_cte JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t3 ON inner_cte.DLC_KEY = t3.DLC_KEY ) SELECT sd.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.window_column AS department_dense_rank, sd.DLC_NAME, sus.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, sus.ORGANIZATION_NAME, sus.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS space_unit_hr_department_name, sus.window_column AS space_unit_sum, sus.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE FROM sloan_departments sd JOIN space_unit_summaries sus ON sd.DLC_KEY = sus.DLC_KEY ORDER BY sd.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, sus.SPACE_UNIT_CODE;

question: For departments that are among both the top 10 by number of non-repeatable-for-credit subjects offered in the fall term (across all academic years) and the top 5 by total subject units in the academic term with term code '2009SP', display for each such department: the department name, academic year, number of non-repeatable-for-credit subjects offered in the fall term, subject code, subject title, the department's total units in '2009SP', the subject title with the highest units in that department in '2009SP', and the number of subjects offered by that department in '2009SP'. List the results ordered by total units in '2009SP' (descending), then department name, academic year, and subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.GRADE_RULE_DESC = 'Not repeatable for credit' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.subject_count, ccso.SUBJECT_CODE, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM inner_cte icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR WHERE ccso.GRADE_RULE_DESC = 'Not repeatable for credit' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' ORDER BY icte.subject_count DESC, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccso.SUBJECT_CODE ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' ) SELECT dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dept_stats.Total_Dept_Units, subj_stats.Max_Unit_Subject_Title, dept_stats.Subject_Count FROM ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(TOTAL_UNITS) AS Total_Dept_Units, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY Total_Dept_Units DESC LIMIT 5 ) dept_stats LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE AS Max_Unit_Subject_Title FROM ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY TOTAL_UNITS DESC, SUBJECT_TITLE ASC) AS rn FROM inner_cte ) ranked WHERE rn = 1 ) subj_stats ON dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subj_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dept_stats.Total_Dept_Units DESC ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.subject_count, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.Total_Dept_Units, s2.Max_Unit_Subject_Title, s2.Subject_Count FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s2.Total_Dept_Units DESC, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For each academic term in 2022, list the term code, term description, term start date, the number of subjects offered and the total subject enrollment number for subjects in the School of Engineering, as well as the department with the highest subject enrollment in each term and the corresponding enrollment number. Additionally, for each top engineering department, provide the academic year and department name for previous terms where the minimum total units for that department is greater than the overall minimum total units across all such departments and years, along with the number of unique subjects offered and the minimum total units for those subjects. The columns should be: term code, term description, term start date, engineering subject count, engineering total enrollment, top engineering department, top engineering department enrollment, previous term academic year, previous term department name, previous term unique subject count, and previous term minimum total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT a.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, a.TERM_START_DATE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY a.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, a.TERM_START_DATE ), dept_enrollment AS ( SELECT a.TERM_CODE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS dept_total_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY a.TERM_CODE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), ranked_dept AS ( SELECT de.TERM_CODE, de.DEPARTMENT_NAME, de.dept_total_enrollment, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY de.TERM_CODE ORDER BY de.dept_total_enrollment DESC) AS rn FROM dept_enrollment de ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), filtered_dept_min_units AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, subject_count, min_total_units FROM inner_cte2 WHERE min_total_units > (SELECT MIN(min_total_units) FROM inner_cte2) ) SELECT ic.TERM_CODE, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.TERM_START_DATE, ic.subject_count AS engineering_subject_count, ic.total_enrollment AS engineering_total_enrollment, rd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS top_engineering_department, rd.dept_total_enrollment AS top_engineering_department_enrollment, fdm.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS prev_term_academic_year, fdm.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS prev_term_department_name, fdm.subject_count AS prev_term_unique_subject_count, fdm.min_total_units AS prev_term_min_total_units FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ranked_dept rd ON ic.TERM_CODE = rd.TERM_CODE AND rd.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN filtered_dept_min_units fdm ON rd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = fdm.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ic.TERM_CODE, fdm.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For IAP subject activities with a maximum enrollment of 12, show the activity title, enrollment type, maximum enrollment, term description, subject title, number of enrolled students, academic year description, and the row number within each enrollment type group ordered by activity title. Additionally, for each activity, include the geometric mean of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during the same academic year (considering only subjects with more than zero enrolled students), and classify the year as 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' if the geometric mean is at least 10% greater than the average across all years, 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' if at least 10% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Present the results ordered by academic year description and row number. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH IAPActivities AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 12 ) SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.MAX_ENROLLMENT, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.window_column, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE ), YearEnrollmentStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_enrollment, CASE WHEN inner_cte.geometric_mean_enrollment > avg_stats.avg_geometric_mean * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN inner_cte.geometric_mean_enrollment < avg_stats.avg_geometric_mean * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_enrollment) AS avg_geometric_mean FROM inner_cte ) avg_stats ) SELECT ia.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ia.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, ia.MAX_ENROLLMENT, ia.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ia.SUBJECT_TITLE, ia.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ia.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ia.window_column, ys.geometric_mean_enrollment, ys.enrollment_category FROM IAPActivities ia JOIN YearEnrollmentStats ys ON ia.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ys.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ia.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ia.window_column;

question: List, for each department and school, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in offered subjects (considering only degree-granting departments and subjects with more than 0 enrolled students, and including subtotals for each school and a grand total), as well as, for each academic year, the number of regular academic terms that are also present in the ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL table (including a grand total for all years). For each row, indicate the source as either 'DeptSchoolStats' or 'YearTermStats'. The columns should be: school name, department, average enrollment, enrollment variance, enrollment standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), academic year, total terms, and source, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptSchoolStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(school_name) OVER (ORDER BY school_sort, dept_sort) = school_name THEN NULL ELSE school_name END AS school_name, dept, avg_enrollment, enrollment_variance, enrollment_stddev FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(school_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(dept) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE school_name END AS school_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(school_name) = 0 AND GROUPING(dept) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(school_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(dept) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE school_name END AS school_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(school_name) = 0 AND GROUPING(dept) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE dept END AS dept_sort, dept, AVG(avg_enrollment) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(enrollment_variance) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(enrollment_stddev) AS enrollment_stddev FROM ( SELECT school_name, department_name AS dept, avg_enrollment, enrollment_variance, enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte ) base GROUP BY school_name, dept WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY school_sort, dept_sort ), YearTermStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON at.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = ata.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS total_terms FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ), CombinedStats AS ( SELECT d.school_name, d.dept, d.avg_enrollment, d.enrollment_variance, d.enrollment_stddev, NULL AS academic_year, NULL AS total_terms, 'DeptSchoolStats' AS Source FROM DeptSchoolStats d UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS school_name, NULL AS dept, NULL AS avg_enrollment, NULL AS enrollment_variance, NULL AS enrollment_stddev, y.ACADEMIC_YEAR, y.total_terms, 'YearTermStats' AS Source FROM YearTermStats y ) SELECT school_name, dept, avg_enrollment, enrollment_variance, enrollment_stddev, academic_year, total_terms, Source FROM CombinedStats ORDER BY Source, school_name, dept, academic_year ;

question: For the top 10 subject titles by the number of materials offered in regular academic terms and for departments that offer courses with at least one associated TIP material, provide for each subject the subject title, department name, total count of materials, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students, and indicate whether the subject is a 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' subject (if its enrollment is at least 10% greater than the department average), 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' (if at least 10% less than the department average), or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH TopSubjects AS ( SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON td.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND td.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY material_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS num_enrolled_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS num_enrolled_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT
