ts.SUBJECT_TITLE, ts.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ts.material_count, des.num_enrolled_variance, des.num_enrolled_stddev FROM TopSubjects ts JOIN DepartmentEnrollmentStats des ON ts.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.department ORDER BY ts.material_count DESC, ts.SUBJECT_TITLE ), DepartmentBenchmarks AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS dept_avg_enrollment FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), SubjectEnrollment AS ( SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS subject_enrollment FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ss.SUBJECT_ID = lso.SUBJECT_ID AND ss.TERM_CODE = lso.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.material_count, icte.num_enrolled_variance, icte.num_enrolled_stddev, se.subject_enrollment, db.dept_avg_enrollment, CASE WHEN se.subject_enrollment > db.dept_avg_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN se.subject_enrollment < db.dept_avg_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SubjectEnrollment se ON icte.SUBJECT_TITLE = se.SUBJECT_TITLE AND icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = se.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN DepartmentBenchmarks db ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = db.department ORDER BY icte.material_count DESC, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each department that is degree-granting, offered at least one subject in the School of Engineering in 2021, and has at least one active graduate student with an office location assigned, provide the department code, department name, department full name, the number of subjects offered, the total number of enrolled students in those subjects, the total number of active graduate students with an office location assigned, and the highest number of enrolled students in a single subject offered by that department in 2021 in the School of Engineering, listing the columns in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptSubjectEnrollment AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ), ActiveGradStudentsByDept AS ( SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS total_active_grad_students, m.DEPARTMENT FROM SE_PERSON s JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY m ON s.FULL_NAME = m.FULL_NAME WHERE s.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND m.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND m.OFFICE_LOCATION IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.DEPARTMENT HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ) SELECT dse.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dse.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dse.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, dse.subject_count, dse.total_enrollment, ags.total_active_grad_students FROM DeptSubjectEnrollment dse JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON dse.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN ActiveGradStudentsByDept ags ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ags.DEPARTMENT ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, icte.subject_count, icte.total_enrollment, icte.total_active_grad_students, MAX(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS highest_single_subject_enrollment FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, icte.subject_count, icte.total_enrollment, icte.total_active_grad_students ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: For each subject, what is the highest average record count (in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by financial aid year) for tip detail records where the material status key is 'RQ', and for each of the top 3 most frequently offered IAP activities (not cancelled) in the same term, show the subject ID, the tip term description, the tip material key, the IAP activity title, and the maximum of these windowed averages per subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, AVG(t1.RECORD_COUNT) OVER ( PARTITION BY t0.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ), TopIAPActivities AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON d.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ta ON t.TERM_CODE = ta.TERM_CODE WHERE d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND d.ACTIVITY_TITLE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t.TERM_CODE ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 3 ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS TIP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, tia.ACTIVITY_TITLE, MAX(icte.window_column) AS highest_windowed_avg_record_count FROM inner_cte icte JOIN TopIAPActivities tia ON icte.TERM_CODE = tia.TERM_CODE GROUP BY icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, tia.ACTIVITY_TITLE ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_ID, tia.ACTIVITY_TITLE;

question: Show the department names, subject IDs, subject titles, the sum of lecture units within each grade type group, the maximum subject enrollment number, the term start date, and the total number of courses per department, for all subjects offered in the academic term with term code '2006FA'. For each row, include a reason for inclusion: 'SubjectOffered' for subjects and 'DeptEnrollment' for departments. The columns should be: department name, subject ID, subject title, sum of lecture units within each grade type group, maximum subject enrollment number, term start date, total courses, and reason, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.LECTURE_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_enrollment, at.TERM_START_DATE FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 5 ), Total_Courses AS ( SELECT t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS Total_Courses FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 WHERE t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = '2006FA' GROUP BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.window_column, NULL AS max_enrollment, NULL AS TERM_START_DATE, tc.Total_Courses, 'SubjectOffered' AS Reason FROM inner_cte s1 LEFT JOIN Total_Courses tc ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = tc.DEPARTMENT_NAME UNION ALL SELECT s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS SUBJECT_ID, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS window_column, s2.max_enrollment, s2.TERM_START_DATE, tc.Total_Courses, 'DeptEnrollment' AS Reason FROM Subquery2 s2 LEFT JOIN Total_Courses tc ON s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = tc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, window_column, max_enrollment, TERM_START_DATE, Total_Courses, Reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID

question: For each subject offered in the term with code '2025FA' by departments in the School of Engineering, show the subject ID, subject title, offering department name, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, term start date, term end date, term parameter, the minimum number of enrolled students over each offering department, total units, department full name, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title, and the responsible faculty name and their MIT ID, ordered by offering department name and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.TERM_START_DATE, s.TERM_END_DATE, s.TERM_PARAMETER, s.min_enrolled_students_per_dept, c.TOTAL_UNITS, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID FROM inner_cte s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND s.SUBJECT_TITLE = c.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For each department that both grants degrees and offers subjects in the School of Engineering during regular terms with more than 10 total tip materials, list the department name, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units), the total number of tip materials, and the total number of unique subjects offered by that department in the School of Engineering during regular terms. For each department, also include a grand total row for all departments in the format of (null, null, null, null, null, total tip materials, total unique subjects). List the results ordered by department name, with rollup totals. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), EngineeringTipMaterials AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL t JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) > 10 ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_total_units, d.total_units_variance, d.total_units_stddev, e.total_tip_materials FROM DeptUnitsStats d JOIN EngineeringTipMaterials e ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = e.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptSubjectCounts AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_unique_subjects FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON s.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_total_units, i.total_units_variance, i.total_units_stddev, i.total_tip_materials, dsc.total_unique_subjects FROM inner_cte i JOIN DeptSubjectCounts dsc ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsc.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_total_units, i.total_units_variance, i.total_units_stddev, i.total_tip_materials, dsc.total_unique_subjects WITH ROLLUP HAVING (i.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL OR (i.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL AND SUM(i.total_tip_materials) > 0)) ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: List the DLC names, the corresponding organization names, the number of rooms assigned to each organization, the average area of those rooms, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the room areas for each organization, considering only rooms with an area greater than 0. Order the results by the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT FODK.DLC_KEY, FO.DLC_NAME, FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, FO.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(FR.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS num_rooms, AVG(FR.AREA) AS avg_area, STDDEV(FR.AREA)/NULLIF(AVG(FR.AREA),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY FODK JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION FO ON FODK.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS FR ON FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FR.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE FR.AREA > 0 GROUP BY FODK.DLC_KEY, FO.DLC_NAME, FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, FO.ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING AVG(FR.AREA) > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.DLC_NAME, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.num_rooms, inner_cte.avg_area, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year, the academic year description, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the record counts of TIP materials associated with that academic year (considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the TIP material status key is not 'NM'), the variance of the maximum enrollment for IAP activities that are not cancelled and require advance sign-up, the number of distinct IAP activities per academic year, and the normalized variance ratio rounded (variance of TIP material record counts divided by variance of IAP activity maximum enrollment), listing the results in descending order of normalized variance ratio?
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR, tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, tms.record_count_variance, tms.record_count_stddev, ias.max_enrollment_variance, ROUND(tms.record_count_variance / NULLIF(ias.max_enrollment_variance, 0), 2) AS normalized_variance_ratio FROM (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) tms JOIN (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) ias ON tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ias.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = ias.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance, inner_cte.record_count_stddev, inner_cte.max_enrollment_variance, iap_counts.num_iap_activities, inner_cte.normalized_variance_ratio FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS num_iap_activities FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) iap_counts ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = iap_counts.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = iap_counts.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY inner_cte.normalized_variance_ratio DESC;

question: For each subject in the "Engineering" school with total units equal to 1, show the academic year, subject ID, subject title, department name, the rank of each subject within its academic year group ordered by subject ID, the academic year description, the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during terms in that year (considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the number of enrolled students is greater than 0), and classify each subject as 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' if its enrollment is at least 10% greater than the average enrollment for Engineering subjects in that academic year, 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' if at least 10% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. List the results ordered by academic year and subject rank. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH EnrolledStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), EngineeringSubjects AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 1 ) SELECT es.ACADEMIC_YEAR, es.SUBJECT_ID, es.SUBJECT_TITLE, es.DEPARTMENT_NAME, es.window_column, en.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, en.enrolled_range, en.enrolled_variance, es.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER FROM EngineeringSubjects es JOIN EnrolledStats en ON es.ACADEMIC_YEAR = en.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) , avg_enrollment AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.window_column, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.enrolled_range, i.enrolled_variance, i.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, a.avg_enrollment, CASE WHEN i.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > a.avg_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER < a.avg_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN avg_enrollment a ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.window_column;

question: For each library reserve material detail with material status key 'U', show the reserve catalog key, subject offered key, term code, the academic year, the term description, the tip material key, the tip material status key, and the average record count in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the tip material status key and ordered by the academic year, along with the department name, the number of unique subjects, the minimum total units offered for each department and academic year where the subject enrollment number is greater than 10, and the maximum subject enrollment number for each department and academic year, for all matches on academic year. Present the results ordered by academic year, department name, and reserve catalog key. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, t0.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, AVG(t2.RECORD_COUNT) OVER ( PARTITION BY t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ), DepartmentSubjectStats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, MAX(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_subject_enrollment FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, lrm.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, lrm.TERM_CODE, lrm.ACADEMIC_YEAR, lrm.TERM_DESCRIPTION, lrm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, lrm.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, lrm.window_column, dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.subject_count, dss.min_total_units, dss.max_subject_enrollment FROM inner_cte lrm JOIN DepartmentSubjectStats dss ON lrm.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY lrm.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY

question: For each subject offered in the academic term with term code '2006FA', and for each department and course number where the number of enrolled students in the subject summary is greater than 2, show the subject ID, subject title, department name, the sum of lecture units within each grade type group, the offer department name, the course number, the number of unique library subjects offered, the minimum total units for those subjects, and the maximum number of enrolled students for those subjects, ordered by subject ID, offer department name, and course number. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.LECTURE_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER ), Subquery3 AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, MAX(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.COURSE_NUMBER, s2.subject_count, s2.min_total_units, s3.max_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte s1 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s2.COURSE_NUMBER = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN Subquery3 s3 ON s3.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s3.COURSE_NUMBER = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_ID, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.COURSE_NUMBER ;

question: For each term parameter and academic year, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of materials per subject for terms that are not upcoming and have a non-null term start date, and for each such term parameter and academic year, for tip details where the material status key is 'EO', show the subject offered key, material key, material status key, term code, subject ID, term description, and the row number within each academic year group ordered by subject offered key? List the columns in the following order: term parameter, academic year, average materials per subject, variance of materials per subject, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of materials per subject, subject offered key, material key, material status key, term code, subject ID, term description, and row number. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT atp.TERM_PARAMETER, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_materials_per_subject, VARIANCE(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS variance_materials_per_subject, STDDEV(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS stddev_materials_per_subject FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON td.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp ON ata.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.TERM_PARAMETER <> 'SIS_UPCOMING_TERM' AND ata.TERM_START_DATE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY atp.TERM_PARAMETER, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY atp.TERM_PARAMETER, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT ict.TERM_PARAMETER, ict.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ict.avg_materials_per_subject, ict.variance_materials_per_subject, ict.stddev_materials_per_subject, t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS window_column FROM inner_cte ict JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp ON ict.TERM_PARAMETER = atp.TERM_PARAMETER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON atp.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE AND ict.ACADEMIC_YEAR = t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN TIP_DETAIL t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'EO' ORDER BY ict.TERM_PARAMETER, ict.ACADEMIC_YEAR, window_column

question: For each subject offered in the term with the description "Fall Term 2024-2025" that also has more than 0 enrolled students and a material status key of 'U', show the subject offered key, subject title, offering department name, the term description, the rank of each subject within its offering department, the course number, course number description, number of enrolled students, the reserve catalog key, the dense rank over the material status key ordered by material status key, and the start and end dates of the term, with the columns listed in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY s.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_rank_in_dept, l.COURSE_NUMBER, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, d.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) AS dense_rank_material_status, s.SUBJECT_ID, t.TERM_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON s.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER p ON t.TERM_CODE = p.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON s.SUBJECT_ID = l.SUBJECT_ID JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL d ON l.SUBJECT_ID = d.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' AND l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ) SELECT i.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.subject_rank_in_dept, i.COURSE_NUMBER, i.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, i.dense_rank_material_status, t.TERM_START_DATE, t.TERM_END_DATE FROM inner_cte i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON i.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE ORDER BY i.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, i.COURSE_NUMBER;

question: For each term and department that grants degrees, list the term, department, the number of graduate-level courses, the average number of enrolled students in graduate-level subjects, the variance of enrolled students in graduate-level subjects, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrolled students in subjects with a non-null subject code description, the school name, and the department phone number. Include subtotals for each term (the corresponding term field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all terms (the corresponding term field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the term if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by term and department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.TERM_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS grad_course_count, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_grad, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_grad FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' GROUP BY tso.TERM_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subjcode_stats AS ( SELECT tso.TERM_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_subjcode, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_subjcode FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL GROUP BY tso.TERM_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), rollup_tbl AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE inner_cte.TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE inner_cte.TERM_CODE END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS dept, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.grad_course_count) AS grad_course_count, AVG(inner_cte.avg_enrolled_grad) AS avg_enrolled_grad, AVG(inner_cte.var_enrolled_grad) AS var_enrolled_grad, AVG(subjcode_stats.var_enrolled_subjcode) AS var_enrolled_subjcode, AVG(subjcode_stats.stddev_enrolled_subjcode) AS stddev_enrolled_subjcode FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN subjcode_stats ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = subjcode_stats.TERM_CODE AND inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subjcode_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(term) OVER (ORDER BY term_sort, term, dept_sort) = term THEN NULL ELSE term END AS term, dept, grad_course_count, avg_enrolled_grad, var_enrolled_grad, var_enrolled_subjcode, stddev_enrolled_subjcode, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM rollup_tbl LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON rollup_tbl.dept = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY term_sort, dept_sort;

question: For each department, academic year, activity title, and sponsor name where the subject enrollment number is greater than 10 and the maximum enrollment for the activity is greater than 10, provide the department name, academic year, number of unique subjects, minimum total units offered, activity title, sponsor name, number of unique activities, minimum fee, and the sponsor type. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), ActivitySponsorStats AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s.SPONSOR_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS activity_count, MIN(d.FEE) AS min_fee FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s.SPONSOR_NAME ), TermJoin AS ( SELECT t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, d.TERM_CODE, d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s.SPONSOR_NAME FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON d.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY GROUP BY t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, d.TERM_CODE, d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s.SPONSOR_NAME ) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dss.subject_count, dss.min_total_units, ass.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ass.SPONSOR_NAME, ass.activity_count, ass.min_fee FROM DeptSubjectStats dss JOIN TermJoin tj ON dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR = tj.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN ActivitySponsorStats ass ON tj.ACTIVITY_TITLE = ass.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND tj.SPONSOR_NAME = ass.SPONSOR_NAME ORDER BY dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ass.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ass.SPONSOR_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.min_total_units, inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.SPONSOR_NAME, inner_cte.activity_count, inner_cte.min_fee, s.SPONSOR_TYPE FROM inner_cte JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR s ON inner_cte.SPONSOR_NAME = s.SPONSOR_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.SPONSOR_NAME;

question: For each department, show the department name and the average number of enrolled students for subjects offered in the term with the description "Fall Term 2024-2025" that have more than 0 enrolled students and a material status key of 'U', but only include departments where this average is greater than the overall average number of enrolled students for such subjects across all departments. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH SubjectRanks AS ( SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.SUBJECT_ID, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' ), CourseEnrollments AS ( SELECT t1.COURSE_NUMBER, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_ID, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ) SELECT sr.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ce.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM SubjectRanks sr JOIN CourseEnrollments ce ON sr.SUBJECT_ID = ce.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > ( SELECT AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM inner_cte );

question: For each department name and school name where the department is degree granting, provide the number of unique courses, the minimum CIP program code from the course descriptions, the subject title from the summary, the dense rank of each subject considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the subject code from the course catalog, and the HASS attribute description from the course catalog, but only for subjects offered in the term '2022FA' with a total of 12 units. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.course_count, inner_cte.min_cip_code, sws.SUBJECT_TITLE, sws.window_column, ccat.HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.TERM_CODE FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) sws ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sws.DEPARTMENT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccat ON sws.SUBJECT_CODE = ccat.SUBJECT_CODE AND sws.TERM_CODE = ccat.TERM_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sws.window_column;

question: For each department, show the department name, the average number of enrolled students in offered subjects, the variance of the number of enrolled students in offered subjects, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in offered subjects (considering only degree-granting departments and subjects with more than 0 enrolled students), and the variance of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one enrolled student and have course materials with a material status of 'RQ'. Also, include the school name and department phone number for each department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC ), DeptMaterialVariance AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC ) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_variance, des.enrollment_stddev, dmv.enrolled_variance FROM DeptEnrollmentStats des JOIN DeptMaterialVariance dmv ON des.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dmv.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY des.enrollment_variance DESC ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_enrollment, icte.enrollment_variance, icte.enrollment_stddev, icte.enrolled_variance, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.enrollment_variance DESC;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2022 with a total of 12 units, in departments in the School of Engineering where the total number of students enrolled in courses offered by that department is greater than 50, show for each department the department name, the highest average subject enrollment number (in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by department code and ordered by total units) among its subjects, and the total number of students enrolled in courses offered by that department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH SubjectStats AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) OVER ( PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), DepartmentEnrollment AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ) SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ss.window_column, de.total_enrollment FROM SubjectStats ss JOIN DepartmentEnrollment de ON ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = de.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE = de.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(window_column) AS highest_avg_window_enrollment, MAX(total_enrollment) AS total_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For subjects offered in the academic term with term code '2006FA', show the subject title, department name, total units, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title. For each such subject, also show the highest number of lecture units among subjects offered by the same department in the Fall term of 2022 (considering only departments with subjects having more than 3 lecture units in 2022FA), the start date of the 2022FA term, and the total number of subjects offered by that department in 2022FA. The columns should be: subject title, department name, total units, window row number, highest lecture units in 2022FA, 2022FA term start date, and subject count in 2022FA. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS dept_name_1 FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA' ), dept_2022fa_stats AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, COUNT(*) AS subject_count, at2.TERM_START_DATE FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 ON td.TERM_CODE = at2.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at2.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) > 3 ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.TOTAL_UNITS, icte.window_column, d22.max_lecture_units, d22.TERM_START_DATE, d22.subject_count FROM inner_cte icte JOIN dept_2022fa_stats d22 ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d22.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For each department, list the department name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the most recent academic year, and for each department also provide the number of subjects offered in regular academic terms and the average number of enrolled students in those subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.SUBJECT_ID WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ) GROUP BY COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_total_units AS most_recent_year_avg_total_units, i.total_units_range AS most_recent_year_total_units_range, i.total_units_variance AS most_recent_year_total_units_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_regular_term_subjects, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students_regular_terms FROM inner_cte i JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID AND c.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_total_units, i.total_units_range, i.total_units_variance ORDER BY i.total_units_range DESC, num_regular_term_subjects DESC;

question: For each subject that is either among the top 10 by number of materials offered in regular academic terms or is a subject in the 2014FA term with at least one enrolled student, list the subject title, department name, total count of materials, offering department name, responsible faculty name, TIP material status key, total number of units, the minimum total number of units in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the course number, the school name, and the department phone number. Also, include the reason for inclusion ('TopSubjects' for top 10 by materials, 'Subjects2014FA' for 2014FA subjects with enrollment). The columns should be: subject title, department name, material count, offering department name, responsible faculty name, TIP material status key, total units, window column, school name, department phone, and reason. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH TopSubjects AS ( SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count, ss.SUBJECT_ID FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON td.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND td.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY material_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), Subjects2014FA AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, lso.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), CombinedSubjects AS ( SELECT ts.SUBJECT_TITLE, ts.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ts.material_count, NULL AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NULL AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, NULL AS TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, NULL AS TOTAL_UNITS, NULL AS window_column, NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_PHONE, 'TopSubjects' AS Reason, ts.SUBJECT_ID FROM TopSubjects ts UNION ALL SELECT s2014.SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS material_count, s2014.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2014.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s2014.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2014.TOTAL_UNITS, s2014.window_column, NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_PHONE, 'Subjects2014FA' AS Reason, s2014.SUBJECT_ID FROM Subjects2014FA s2014 ) SELECT * FROM CombinedSubjects ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.material_count, ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ic.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ic.TOTAL_UNITS, ic.window_column, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS DEPARTMENT_PHONE, ic.Reason FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ic.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each organization, list the organization name and the highest total area of rooms it has ever had in a single building. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, SUM(t0.AREA) AS total_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS t0 JOIN FCLT_BUILDING t2 ON t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ) SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAX(total_area) AS highest_building_total_area FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ORGANIZATION_NAME;

question: For each subject offered in the term '2019FA' with more than 0 enrolled students, show the subject title, offer department name, department full name, number of enrolled students, and the average number of enrolled students in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the school code, but only include those subjects where the number of enrolled students is greater than the average number of enrolled students for their offer department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS dept_avg_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.window_column AS avg_enrolled_window FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > d.dept_avg_enrolled ORDER BY i.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For each department, list the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of unique subject codes associated with its courses that are offered by degree-granting departments, the variance of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one enrolled student and have course materials with a material status of 'RQ', and the total number of such courses per department. For each department, also include a grand total row for all departments in the format of (null, null, null, null, total courses). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM ( SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT ) course_subjects JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON course_subjects.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY stddev_subject_codes DESC ), DeptEnrolledVariance AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC ) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.avg_subject_codes, dss.stddev_subject_codes, dev.enrolled_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS total_courses FROM DeptSubjectStats dss JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN DeptEnrolledVariance dev ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dev.OFFER_DEPT_NAME LEFT JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.avg_subject_codes, dss.stddev_subject_codes, dev.enrolled_variance ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_subject_codes, inner_cte.stddev_subject_codes, inner_cte.enrolled_variance, inner_cte.total_courses FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, SUM(total_courses) FROM inner_cte;

question: For each degree-granting course in the School of Engineering, show the course description, department name, subject code description, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by course description. Also, for each course, display the average total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2022, and classify the course as 'HIGH_UNIT' if its total units are at least 10% greater than the department average, 'LOW_UNIT' if at least 10% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH department_units_stats AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), engineering_degree_courses AS ( SELECT t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON t1.COURSE = ccs.SUBJECT_CODE AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT edc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, edc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, edc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, edc.window_column, edc.TOTAL_UNITS, dus.avg_units FROM engineering_degree_courses edc LEFT JOIN department_units_stats dus ON edc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT COURSE_DESCRIPTION, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, window_column, avg_units, TOTAL_UNITS, CASE WHEN TOTAL_UNITS > avg_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN TOTAL_UNITS < avg_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte;

question: For each department that is degree-granting and offered at least one subject in the School of Engineering in 2021, provide the department code, department name, department full name, the number of subjects offered, the total number of enrolled students in those subjects, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with a non-null subject code description), and, for each subject in 2021 offered by these departments in the School of Engineering, list the subject id, subject title, and the number of enrolled students, but only include subjects where the number of enrolled students exceeds the average enrollment for that department in 2021. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH eng_dept_2021_summary AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ), dept_enrollment_stats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_CODE, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, e.subject_count, e.total_enrollment, d.enrolled_students_variance, d.enrolled_students_stddev FROM eng_dept_2021_summary e JOIN dept_enrollment_stats d ON e.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), dept_avg_enrollment AS ( SELECT s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' GROUP BY s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.subject_count, i.total_enrollment, i.enrolled_students_variance, i.enrolled_students_stddev, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN dept_avg_enrollment a ON s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = a.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_enrollment ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC;

question: For each subject offered in the term with the description "Fall Term 2024-2025" and whose offering department is among the top 10 departments by the number of unique subjects offered in academic years 2014 or later, show the subject offered key, subject title, offering department name, the term description, the rank of each subject within its offering department ordered by subject offered key, the count of unique subject titles offered by the department, the offering school name, and the department phone number. Do not repeat the department if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by the count of unique subject titles (descending), department, and subject offered key. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH subject_ranks AS ( SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' ), top_departments AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2014 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT sr.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, sr.SUBJECT_TITLE, sr.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sr.TERM_DESCRIPTION, sr.window_column, td.subject_count, sr.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME FROM subject_ranks sr JOIN top_departments td ON sr.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = td.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(OFFER_DEPT_NAME) OVER (ORDER BY subject_count DESC, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) = OFFER_DEPT_NAME THEN NULL ELSE OFFER_DEPT_NAME END AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, window_column, subject_count, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY subject_count DESC, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY;

question: For each department, what is the department name, the variance of the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects offered by the School of Engineering in the term '2016SP'), the average number of enrolled students, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrolled students in courses that have at least one associated course material, but only for departments where the average enrollment in such courses is greater than the overall average enrollment across all departments for courses with at least one associated course material? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptVariance AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ), DeptEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_stddev DESC ) SELECT dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dv.enrolled_students_variance, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_stddev FROM DeptVariance dv JOIN DeptEnrollmentStats des ON dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, enrolled_students_variance, avg_enrollment, enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_enrollment > ( SELECT AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' );

question: For each academic year and department name where the term status is 'Previous' and for subjects in the "Engineering" school with total units greater than 1, provide the academic year, department name, number of unique subjects offered, minimum total units for those subjects, subject title, school name, academic year description, the minimum total units in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the academic year, and the subject enrollment number for each subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte.subject_count, cte.min_total_units, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.SCHOOL_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER FROM inner_cte cte JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL WHERE TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE ) AND cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ata.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON s.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 1 ORDER BY cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units, and for subjects offered in the term 2019FA from the same department, show the subject code, subject number, subject title, department name, term description, the rank of each 2024 subject within its department ordered by subject code, the 2019FA subject ID, number of enrolled students in 2019FA, department full name, the row number of each 2019FA subject within its department name group ordered by subject ID, and the school name for each department. Order the results by department name, subject code, and 2019FA subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), Subjects2019FA AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ) SELECT s24.SUBJECT_CODE, s24.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s24.SUBJECT_TITLE, s24.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s24.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s24.window_column AS department_rank_2024, s19.SUBJECT_ID, s19.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s19.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s19.window_column AS department_rownum_2019, s19.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte s24 JOIN Subjects2019FA s19 ON s24.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s19.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s24.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s24.SUBJECT_CODE, s19.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each department in the School of Engineering with a total number of students enrolled in its courses greater than 50, provide the department name, the total number of enrolled students, the average of the total units for its courses that have a non-null subject title and total units greater than 0, and indicate whether the department is a 'HIGH_LOAD' (if its average units is at least 10% greater than the overall average units across all such departments), 'LOW_LOAD' (if its average units is at least 10% less than the overall average), or 'AVERAGE'. List the results ordered by department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptEnrollment AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ), DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.DEPARTMENT_CODE, e.total_enrollment, u.avg_units FROM DeptEnrollment e JOIN DeptUnitsStats u ON e.DEPARTMENT_CODE = u.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) , overall_avg AS ( SELECT AVG(avg_units) AS overall_avg_units FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_enrollment, i.avg_units, CASE WHEN i.avg_units > o.overall_avg_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_LOAD' WHEN i.avg_units < o.overall_avg_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_LOAD' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS load_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN overall_avg o ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department, list the department name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022FA term, as well as the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in courses from that department that have at least one associated TIP material and where the total units for the course are greater than 0. Also, include the school name and department phone number for each department. Show the department name, average total units, total units range, total units variance, average enrollment, enrollment variance, school name, and department phone number, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptUnits AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sos.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ), DeptEnrollment AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.RECORD_COUNT >= 1 AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC ) SELECT du.DEPARTMENT_NAME, du.avg_total_units, du.total_units_range, du.total_units_variance, de.avg_enrollment, de.enrollment_variance FROM DeptUnits du JOIN DeptEnrollment de ON du.DEPARTMENT_NAME = de.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_range, icte.total_units_variance, icte.avg_enrollment, icte.enrollment_variance, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.total_units_range DESC, icte.enrollment_variance DESC;

question: For each department and course number where the number of enrolled students in the subject summary is greater than 2, provide the number of unique library subjects offered, the minimum total units for those subjects, the total number of tip materials offered for subjects in the School of Engineering during regular terms where the total number of tip materials is greater than 10, and classify the department as 'HIGH_RESOURCE' if the total tip materials is at least 20% greater than the average total tip materials across all such departments, 'LOW_RESOURCE' if at least 20% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH dept_course_subjects AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER ), engineering_tip_materials AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL t JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) > 10 ) SELECT dcs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dcs.COURSE_NUMBER, dcs.subject_count, dcs.min_total_units, etm.total_tip_materials FROM dept_course_subjects dcs JOIN engineering_tip_materials etm ON dcs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = etm.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), avg_tip_materials AS ( SELECT AVG(total_tip_materials) AS avg_tip_materials FROM ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL t JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) > 10 ) x ) SELECT i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.COURSE_NUMBER, i.subject_count, i.min_total_units, i.total_tip_materials, CASE WHEN i.total_tip_materials > a.avg_tip_materials * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_RESOURCE' WHEN i.total_tip_materials < a.avg_tip_materials * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_RESOURCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS resource_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_tip_materials a;

question: For each subject in the term "2010FA" and for each department name where the number of enrolled students is greater than 5 in that academic year, show the subject ID, the term description, the material status key, the academic year, the rank of the subject within the academic year group ordered by subject ID, the department name, the number of unique subjects offered by that department in that academic year, the minimum start date of the academic term, and the responsible faculty name for the subject. The results are ordered by academic year, department name, and subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2010FA' ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.window_column, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.subject_count, s2.min_start_date, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte icte JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON icte.SUBJECT_ID = lso.SUBJECT_ID AND lso.TERM_CODE = '2010FA' JOIN ( SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT l.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_start_date FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON t.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) s2 ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each of the 5 departments that offer the largest number of unique subjects, list the department code, department name, the total number of unique subjects they offer, and for each subject offered by that department in the term with code '2025FA', show the subject ID, subject title, offering department name, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, term start date, term end date, term parameter, and the minimum number of enrolled students over each offering department. Additionally, for each subject, provide the course description and the course level from the course catalog, ordered by department name and subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT td.DEPARTMENT_CODE, td.DEPARTMENT_NAME, td.num_subjects, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.TERM_START_DATE, s.TERM_END_DATE, s.TERM_PARAMETER, s.min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY num_subjects DESC LIMIT 5 ) td JOIN ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ) s ON td.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.num_subjects, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.TERM_END_DATE, inner_cte.TERM_PARAMETER, inner_cte.min_enrolled_students_per_dept, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, scd.COURSE_LEVEL FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ccso.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For subjects offered in the term '2019FA' with more than 0 enrolled students, where the offering department is among the top 10 departments by the number of unique subjects they offered for terms in the academic year 2014 or later, show the subject title, offer department name, department full name, number of enrolled students, the average number of enrolled students in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the school code, the count of unique subject titles for the department, and the total units for the subject from the subject summary, ordered by the subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), TopDepts AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2014 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, icte.window_column, td.subject_count, ss.TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte icte JOIN TopDepts td ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = td.OFFER_DEPT_NAME LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON icte.SUBJECT_TITLE = ss.SUBJECT_TITLE AND ss.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For subjects offered in the term '2019FA' with more than 0 enrolled students, and for courses in the 'Engineering' school with a total of 12 units, show for each subject and course pair (where the subject and course are from the same offering department) the subject title, offer department name, department full name, number of enrolled students, the average number of enrolled students in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the school code, the course number, course description, course subject title, total units, course offering department name, the row number of the course within each offering department ordered by course number, and the department's school name. Order the results by subject title and course number. Do not return any rounded answers.
