SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH SubjectStats AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), EngineeringCourses AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE AS course_number, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE AS course_subject_title, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.COURSE) AS window_column, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.window_column AS avg_enrolled_window, e.course_number, e.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, e.course_subject_title, e.TOTAL_UNITS, e.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS course_offer_dept_name, e.window_column AS course_row_number, s_dept.SCHOOL_NAME AS department_school_name FROM SubjectStats s JOIN EngineeringCourses e ON s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = e.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT s_dept ON s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = s_dept.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, e.course_number ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte;

question: For subjects offered in the 2012SU term with a total of 1 unit, show the subject title from the summary, the course number from the offered table, the subject title from the offered summary, the department name from the summary, the offer department name from the offered summary, the row number within each department name group ordered by subject title from the summary, and for each department, also provide the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and at least 1 enrolled student). Additionally, for each result, include the school name from the SIS_DEPARTMENT table. List the results ordered by department name and row number. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE AS summary_subject_title, t1.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE AS offered_summary_subject_title, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t2.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS = 1 ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.summary_subject_title, inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER, inner_cte.offered_summary_subject_title, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, dept_stats.avg_total_units, dept_stats.stddev_total_units, dept_stats.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN dept_stats ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column;

question: For each student in the "Electrical Eng & Computer Sci" department, show their full name, email address, department name, course description, course level, and their row number within each course level group ordered by the student's last name, along with the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by their department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units). Additionally, provide the school name of the department and the number of unique courses offered by the department. List the results ordered by the row number within each course level group. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DepartmentUnits AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ), EECSStudents AS ( SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.COURSE_LEVEL ORDER BY t2.LAST_NAME) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT eecs.FULL_NAME, eecs.EMAIL_ADDRESS, eecs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, eecs.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, eecs.COURSE_LEVEL, eecs.window_column, du.avg_total_units, du.stddev_total_units, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, dc.num_courses FROM EECSStudents eecs JOIN DepartmentUnits du ON eecs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = du.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON eecs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS num_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT ) dc ON eecs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dc.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY eecs.window_column ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte;

question: Among departments in the "Sloan School of Management" area with a "Standard Hierarchy" type and also in the "Provost Area" at hierarchy level 2, which department has the highest number of organizations associated with it? For the top 5 such departments by organization count, show the department code, department name, the dense rank of each department considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the department's long name, the department's name, the total number of organizations, and the average organization number for organizations within that department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH SloanStandardDepartments AS ( SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME = 'Sloan School of Management Area' ), ProvostDeptOrgStats AS ( SELECT MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME AS department_name, COUNT(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_count, AVG(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS avg_org_number, MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY WHERE MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME, MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY ) SELECT ssd.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssd.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ssd.window_column, pds.department_name, pds.org_count, pds.avg_org_number FROM SloanStandardDepartments ssd JOIN ProvostDeptOrgStats pds ON ssd.DLC_KEY = pds.DLC_KEY ) SELECT HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column, department_name, org_count, avg_org_number FROM inner_cte ORDER BY org_count DESC LIMIT 5;

question: For departments where the range of total units for subjects offered in the academic year 2022 is greater than 5 and the variance of total units is greater than 2, give the department name, the range of total units, the variance of total units, and for each subject in the 2019FA term with total units greater than 1 in that department, show the subject ID, subject title, the running sum of total units within each school, and the course description from SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ordered by department range descending and subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC ) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.units_range, dus.units_variance, suw.SUBJECT_ID, suw.SUBJECT_TITLE, suw.window_column, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte dus JOIN ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID_FOR_JOIN, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS > 1 ) suw ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = suw.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND scd.COURSE = SUBSTRING(suw.SUBJECT_ID_FOR_JOIN, 1, POSITION('.' IN suw.SUBJECT_ID_FOR_JOIN) - 1) WHERE dus.units_range > 5 AND dus.units_variance > 2 ORDER BY dus.units_range DESC, suw.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each subject offered in the term with the description "Fall Term 2024-2025" and offered by one of the top 10 departments by the number of unique subjects they offered in academic years 2014 or later, show the subject offered key, subject title, offering department name, the term description, the rank of each subject within its offering department ordered by subject offered key, the count of unique subject titles offered by the department since 2014, and the total number of enrolled students in those subjects in "Fall Term 2024-2025", ordered by the count of unique subject titles (descending), offering department name, and subject offered key. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' ), Top10DeptsSince2014 AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2014 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), SubjectEnrollmentInFall2024 AS ( SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, SUM(COALESCE(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0)) AS total_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' GROUP BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ) SELECT icte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.window_column, tds.subject_count, se.total_enrolled FROM inner_cte icte JOIN Top10DeptsSince2014 tds ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tds.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN SubjectEnrollmentInFall2024 se ON icte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = se.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ORDER BY tds.subject_count DESC, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY;

question: For subjects offered in the term with code '2025FA', show each subject's ID, title, offering department name, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, term start and end dates, term parameter, the minimum number of enrolled students over each offering department, the number of unique subjects offered and the minimum number of total units for each department and academic year (where the number of enrolled students in a subject is greater than 5), as well as the subject's total units, grade type, and responsible faculty name. Present the results ordered by offering department and subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), DeptYearSubjectStats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.TERM_START_DATE, s.TERM_END_DATE, s.TERM_PARAMETER, s.min_enrolled_students_per_dept, d.subject_count, d.min_total_units, c.TOTAL_UNITS, c.GRADE_TYPE, c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte s JOIN DeptYearSubjectStats d ON s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR LEFT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON s.SUBJECT_ID = c.SUBJECT_ID AND s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = c.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID

question: For each department, show the department name, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of rooms used for subjects offered by that department (considering only rooms with an area greater than 40). For each course in the School of Engineering that is degree granting within that department, show the course description, subject code description, and the deviation of the course's total units from the average total units of all subjects in that department. List the results ordered by department name and course description. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(f.AREA) AS avg_area, VARIANCE(f.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(f.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS f JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON f.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = c.MEET_PLACE WHERE f.AREA > 40 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY area_variance DESC ), DeptAvgUnits AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ), EngDegreeCourses AS ( SELECT t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, cso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_area, d.area_variance, d.area_stddev, e.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, e.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, (e.TOTAL_UNITS - dau.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg_units FROM inner_cte d JOIN EngDegreeCourses e ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = e.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN DeptAvgUnits dau ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dau.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_DESCRIPTION;

question: For each IAP subject activity and department, list the activity title, department name, the number of activities, average maximum enrollment, the academic term description, and the subject title. Include subtotals for each activity (the corresponding activity field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all activities (the corresponding activity field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the activity title if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by activity title and department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 10 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(activity_title) OVER (ORDER BY activity_sort, dept_sort) = activity_title THEN NULL ELSE activity_title END AS activity_title, dept, activity_count, avg_max_enrollment, term_description, subject_title FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACTIVITY_TITLE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE ACTIVITY_TITLE END AS activity_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACTIVITY_TITLE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(ACTIVITY_TITLE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE ACTIVITY_TITLE END AS activity_title, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACTIVITY_TITLE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, DEPARTMENT_NAME AS dept, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS activity_count, AVG(t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, MAX(t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION) AS term_description, MAX(t2.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_title FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 10 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' GROUP BY ACTIVITY_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP ) tbltmp ORDER BY activity_sort, dept_sort;

question: For each department and school, where the range of total units for subjects offered in the academic year 2022 is greater than 0 and the average total units for subjects with at least one enrolled student and required course materials is greater than 0, list the department name, school name, the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in 2022, and the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects with at least one enrolled student and required course materials, in that order. Also include the department phone number. Sort the results by school name and department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DepartmentUnits2022 AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCD.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCD.SCHOOL_NAME ), DeptUnitsWithMaterials AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT d2022.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d2022.SCHOOL_NAME, d2022.units_range, d2022.units_variance, dmat.avg_total_units, dmat.total_units_range, dmat.total_units_variance FROM DepartmentUnits2022 d2022 JOIN DeptUnitsWithMaterials dmat ON d2022.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dmat.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND d2022.SCHOOL_NAME = dmat.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME WHERE d2022.units_range > 0 AND dmat.avg_total_units > 0 ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.units_range, icte.units_variance, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_range, icte.total_units_variance, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each assignable organization with a department code above 100000, show the organization key, organization name, department name, the number of HR org units, the total of their department IDs, the department name, the average number of sub-departments (where HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL is 'SUB DEPARTMENT') associated with the department, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of sub-departments, and the top-level area name from the HR org hierarchy. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS hr_org_unit_count, SUM(h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS total_department_id, f.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION f JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID > 100000 GROUP BY f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, f.DLC_KEY ), dept_subdept_stats AS ( SELECT m.DLC_NAME, AVG(sub_dept_counts.num_sub_depts) AS avg_num_sub_departments, STDDEV(sub_dept_counts.num_sub_depts) AS stddev_num_sub_departments, m.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY JOIN ( SELECT h2.DLC_KEY, COUNT(*) AS num_sub_depts FROM HR_ORG_UNIT h2 WHERE h2.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'SUB DEPARTMENT' GROUP BY h2.DLC_KEY ) sub_dept_counts ON m.DLC_KEY = sub_dept_counts.DLC_KEY WHERE m.DLC_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME, m.DLC_KEY ORDER BY stddev_num_sub_departments DESC ) SELECT i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.hr_org_unit_count, i.total_department_id, d.DLC_NAME, d.avg_num_sub_departments, d.stddev_num_sub_departments, h.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_subdept_stats d ON i.DLC_KEY = d.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.hr_org_unit_count, i.total_department_id, d.DLC_NAME, d.avg_num_sub_departments, d.stddev_num_sub_departments, h.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME;

question: For each department that grants degrees, where the range of enrolled students in graduate-level subjects offered by that department is greater than 0 and the variance of the total number of units for subjects with more than 0 enrolled students is available, provide the department name, the range of enrolled students, the variance of enrolled students, the variance of total units, and the average number of enrolled students in those subjects. List the department name, range of enrolled students, variance of enrolled students, variance of total units, and average enrolled students in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH EnrolledStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC ), UnitsVariance AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT es.DEPARTMENT_NAME, es.enrolled_range, es.enrolled_variance, uv.total_units_variance, es.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM EnrolledStats es JOIN UnitsVariance uv ON es.DEPARTMENT_CODE = uv.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE es.enrolled_range > 0 AND uv.total_units_variance IS NOT NULL ORDER BY es.enrolled_range DESC ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.enrolled_range, icte.enrolled_variance, icte.total_units_variance, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte icte JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON tso.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE WHERE scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.enrolled_range, icte.enrolled_variance, icte.total_units_variance ORDER BY icte.enrolled_range DESC;

question: For each employee type and department name where the student year is 'G', the department is in the School of Engineering with more than 50 students enrolled in its courses, and the minimum MIT ID is an even number, provide the employee type, department name, number of people, minimum MIT ID, total number of students enrolled in courses offered by that department, and the normalized person count rounded (number of people divided by total enrollment), listing the results in descending order of normalized person count.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(sp.MIT_ID) AS person_count, MIN(sp.MIT_ID) AS min_mit_id FROM SE_PERSON sp JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ) SELECT icte.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.person_count, icte.min_mit_id, sq2.total_enrollment, ROUND(icte.person_count / NULLIF(sq2.total_enrollment, 0), 2) AS normalized_person_count FROM inner_cte icte JOIN Subquery2 sq2 ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE MOD(icte.min_mit_id, 2) = 0 ORDER BY normalized_person_count DESC;

question: For each department that offers at least one subject in the Fall Term 2024-2025 with a total of 12 units, what is the department name, the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2022, and for each such subject in Fall Term 2024-2025, what are the subject ID, subject title, school name, total units, term description, term start date, the row number within the department ordered by subject ID, and the name of the responsible faculty member for that subject? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC ) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.units_range, dus.units_variance, f24.SUBJECT_ID, f24.SUBJECT_TITLE, f24.SCHOOL_NAME, f24.TOTAL_UNITS, f24.TERM_DESCRIPTION, f24.TERM_START_DATE, f24.window_column, cso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte dus JOIN ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SCHOOL_NAME, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) f24 ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = f24.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON f24.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, f24.window_column;

question: For each department in the School of Engineering with a total number of students enrolled in its courses greater than 50, give the department name, the total number of enrolled students, and for each academic year, the average of the total units for its courses that have a non-null subject title and total units greater than 0. List the results ordered by department name and academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptEnrollment AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ), DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE, CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE, CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.total_enrollment, u.ACADEMIC_YEAR, u.avg_units FROM DeptEnrollment e JOIN DeptUnitsStats u ON e.DEPARTMENT_CODE = u.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_enrollment, ACADEMIC_YEAR, avg_units FROM inner_cte ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each current academic term, list the term code, term description, academic year, the number of subjects offered, the total subject enrollment number for that term, the academic year description, and for that academic year, the department with the highest number of subjects offered and the count of subjects from that department. Present the columns in the following order: term code, term description, academic year, subject count, total enrollment, academic year description, most prominent department, and department subject count. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), AcademicYearDesc AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ), DeptCounts AS ( SELECT at.TERM_CODE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS dept_subject_count FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE GROUP BY at.TERM_CODE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptRanked AS ( SELECT dc.TERM_CODE, dc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dc.dept_subject_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY dc.TERM_CODE ORDER BY dc.dept_subject_count DESC) AS dept_rank FROM DeptCounts dc ) SELECT ict.TERM_CODE, ict.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ict.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ict.subject_count, ict.total_enrollment, ayd.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, dr.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS most_prominent_department, dr.dept_subject_count AS department_subject_count FROM inner_cte ict JOIN AcademicYearDesc ayd ON ict.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ayd.ACADEMIC_YEAR LEFT JOIN DeptRanked dr ON ict.TERM_CODE = dr.TERM_CODE AND dr.dept_rank = 1 ORDER BY ict.TERM_CODE;

question: For the 5 departments that offer the largest number of unique subjects, display for each department its department code, department name, and the total number of unique subjects it offers. For each subject offered by these departments in the term with code '2025FA', show the subject ID, subject title, offering department name, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, term start date, term end date, term parameter, the minimum number of enrolled students over each offering department, and the subject's short title and total units from the course catalog, ordered by the total number of unique subjects, offering department name, and subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH dept_subject_counts AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY num_subjects DESC LIMIT 5 ), subjects_2025fa AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ) SELECT dsc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dsc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dsc.num_subjects, s2025fa.SUBJECT_ID, s2025fa.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2025fa.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2025fa.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2025fa.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2025fa.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2025fa.TERM_START_DATE, s2025fa.TERM_END_DATE, s2025fa.TERM_PARAMETER, s2025fa.min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM dept_subject_counts dsc JOIN subjects_2025fa s2025fa ON dsc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2025fa.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.num_subjects, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.TERM_END_DATE, inner_cte.TERM_PARAMETER, inner_cte.min_enrolled_students_per_dept, ccso.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID AND ccso.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ORDER BY inner_cte.num_subjects DESC, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each subject offered in the library in the Mathematics department during regular terms, show the subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, term description, academic year, subject short title, and the maximum total units for each row and the next two rows in order of subject ID. Additionally, for each such subject, provide the number of unique subjects and the minimum total units for subjects in the same offering department and school where the course material status is 'RQ'. Also, include the responsible faculty name and the HGN code description for each subject. Present the results ordered by offering department name, term description, and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, MAX(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_total_units, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ), DeptSchoolRQStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, icte.max_total_units, ds.subject_count, ds.min_total_units, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, sos.HGN_CODE_DESC FROM inner_cte icte JOIN DeptSchoolRQStats ds ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = ds.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND icte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = ds.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON icte.SUBJECT_ID = lso.SUBJECT_ID AND icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON icte.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each organization and department code, what is the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of rooms assigned to that organization and department code (considering only rooms with a non-null area and department code), as well as the average and variance of the HR department codes (old) for all associated HR org units where the organization is assignable and the HR department name is not null? Additionally, for each such organization and department code, what is the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the HR org unit IDs for the associated HR org units? Please provide the organization name, department code, variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of room areas, average HR department code (old), variance of HR department code (old), average HR org unit ID, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of HR org unit ID, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.DEPT_CODE, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA IS NOT NULL AND r.DEPT_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.DEPT_CODE ORDER BY area_variance DESC ), org_hr_dept_stats AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS avg_dept_code_old, VARIANCE(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS var_dept_code_old FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = HR_ORG_UNIT.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY var_dept_code_old DESC ), org_hr_orgunit_stats AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS avg_hr_org_unit_id, STDDEV(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS stddev_hr_org_unit_id FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = HR_ORG_UNIT.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT a.ORGANIZATION_NAME, a.DEPT_CODE, a.area_variance, a.area_stddev, b.avg_dept_code_old, b.var_dept_code_old, c.avg_hr_org_unit_id, c.stddev_hr_org_unit_id FROM inner_cte a LEFT JOIN org_hr_dept_stats b ON a.ORGANIZATION_NAME = b.ORGANIZATION_NAME LEFT JOIN org_hr_orgunit_stats c ON a.ORGANIZATION_NAME = c.ORGANIZATION_NAME;

question: For each department in the School of Engineering where the total number of students enrolled in courses offered by that department is greater than 50, what is the department name, the total number of enrolled students, the average of the total units for its courses that have a non-null subject title and total units greater than 0, the variance of the total units for those courses, and the number of unique subject titles offered by the department? Please list the department name, total enrollment, average units, units variance, and subject count in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ) SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.total_enrollment, u.avg_units, u.units_variance, u.subject_count FROM inner_cte e JOIN ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) u ON e.DEPARTMENT_NAME = u.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For tip details where the material status key is 'RQ' and for IAP subject activities that are not cancelled and have a maximum enrollment greater than 10, show the tip subject offered key, material key, subject ID, term description, academic year, the average record count in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by academic year (as tip_window_avg_record_count), the activity title, enrollment type, maximum enrollment, academic term description from the time day table, term start date from the academic terms table, the minimum maximum enrollment value over each term code group (as iap_min_max_enrollment), and the academic year description from the academic terms table, ordered by academic year and IAP term code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(t0.RECORD_COUNT) OVER ( PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_START_DATE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM TIP_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ), IAPActivities AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TERM_START_DATE, MIN(t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT) OVER ( PARTITION BY t0.TERM_CODE ORDER BY t0.TERM_CODE ) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN TIME_DAY t1 ON t1.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE = t0.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 ) SELECT icte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, icte.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.window_column AS tip_window_avg_record_count, ia.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ia.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, ia.MAX_ENROLLMENT, ia.ACADEMIC_TERM_DESCRIPTION, ia.TERM_START_DATE, ia.window_column AS iap_min_max_enrollment, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM inner_cte icte JOIN IAPActivities ia ON icte.TERM_CODE = ia.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON icte.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ia.TERM_CODE;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units, show the subject code, subject number, subject title, department name, term description, and the rank of each subject within its department ordered by subject code, along with the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects in that department that have at least one enrolled student and have required course materials. Only include results for departments where the average total units for such subjects is greater than the overall average total units for all such subjects across all departments. List the results ordered by department name and subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), OverallAvg AS ( SELECT AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS overall_avg_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.window_column, d.avg_total_units, d.total_units_range, d.total_units_variance FROM inner_cte s JOIN DeptUnitsStats d ON s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME CROSS JOIN OverallAvg o WHERE d.avg_total_units > o.overall_avg_total_units ORDER BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE

question: For each course in the School of Engineering that is degree granting, show the course description, department name, subject code description, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by course description, along with the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of rooms used for subjects offered by that department (considering only rooms with an area greater than 40). Additionally, for each such course, show the number of unique buildings in which these rooms are located. The columns should be: course description, department name, subject code description, window row number, average area, area variance, area standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and building count, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptRoomStats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(f.AREA) AS avg_area, VARIANCE(f.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(f.AREA) AS area_stddev, COUNT(DISTINCT f.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) AS building_count FROM FCLT_ROOMS f JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON f.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = c.MEET_PLACE WHERE f.AREA > 40 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY area_variance DESC ), EngDegreeCourses AS ( SELECT t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT e.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, e.window_column, d.avg_area, d.area_variance, d.area_stddev, d.building_count FROM EngDegreeCourses e LEFT JOIN DeptRoomStats d ON e.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY e.COURSE_DESCRIPTION ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte;

question: For each department and course level, provide the department name, the average CIP program code, the range of CIP program codes, the variance of CIP program codes for all undergraduate courses offered by degree-granting departments, as well as the course level, the number of unique degree-granting courses with total units greater than 6, the minimum total units offered, and the number of unique subject codes from the course catalog for those courses. Present the results ordered by the range of CIP program codes in descending order and then by the number of unique courses in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptCipStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_code, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cip_code_range DESC ), DeptCourseStats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL ) SELECT dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.avg_cip_code, dcs.cip_code_range, dcs.cip_code_variance, dct.COURSE_LEVEL, dct.course_count, dct.min_total_units FROM DeptCipStats dcs JOIN DeptCourseStats dct ON dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dct.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dcs.cip_code_range DESC, dct.course_count DESC ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_cip_code, icte.cip_code_range, icte.cip_code_variance, icte.COURSE_LEVEL, icte.course_count, icte.min_total_units, COUNT(DISTINCT ccc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS unique_subject_codes FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_cip_code, icte.cip_code_range, icte.cip_code_variance, icte.COURSE_LEVEL, icte.course_count, icte.min_total_units ORDER BY icte.cip_code_range DESC, icte.course_count DESC;

question: For each organization with an organization level of 5 whose space unit is among the top 10 space units by number of rooms, display the organization name, organization key, description, space unit, space unit key, the average organization key within each organization key group ordered by space unit key, the count of rooms for each space unit, and the building with the highest number of rooms in that space unit, along with the count of rooms in that building. Order the results by the count of rooms descending and then by space unit key. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.SPACE_UNIT, t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ), TopSpaceUnits AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(sd.BUILDING_ROOM) AS room_count, su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY ORDER BY room_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), BuildingRoomCounts AS ( SELECT sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, sd.BUILDING_KEY, COUNT(sd.BUILDING_ROOM) AS building_room_count FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd GROUP BY sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, sd.BUILDING_KEY ), MaxBuildingPerSpaceUnit AS ( SELECT brc.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, brc.BUILDING_KEY, brc.building_room_count FROM ( SELECT brc.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY brc.SPACE_UNIT_KEY ORDER BY brc.building_room_count DESC) AS rn FROM BuildingRoomCounts brc ) brc WHERE brc.rn = 1 ) SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.DESCRIPTION, o.SPACE_UNIT, o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, o.window_column, t.room_count, mb.BUILDING_KEY AS top_building_key, mb.building_room_count AS top_building_room_count FROM inner_cte o JOIN TopSpaceUnits t ON o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = t.SPACE_UNIT_KEY LEFT JOIN MaxBuildingPerSpaceUnit mb ON o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = mb.SPACE_UNIT_KEY ORDER BY t.room_count DESC, o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY

question: For each activity, show the activity title, enrollment type, maximum enrollment, category name, and the average maximum enrollment for its category. Only include activities where the average maximum enrollment for the category is greater than 20. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY ) SELECT i.ACTIVITY_TITLE, i.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, i.MAX_ENROLLMENT, i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, cat_avg.avg_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, AVG(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ) cat_avg ON i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = cat_avg.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME WHERE cat_avg.avg_max_enrollment > 20 ;

question: For subjects offered in the 2012SU term with a total of 1 unit, show the subject title from the summary, the course number from the offered table, the subject title from the offered summary, the department name from the summary, the offer department name from the offered summary, the row number within each department name group ordered by subject title from the summary, and for each department, also provide the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and at least 1 enrolled student). Additionally, include the school name for each department from the SIS_DEPARTMENT table. List the results ordered by department name and row number. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE AS summary_subject_title, t1.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE AS offered_summary_subject_title, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t2.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS = 1 ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.summary_subject_title, inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER, inner_cte.offered_summary_subject_title, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, dept_stats.avg_total_units, dept_stats.stddev_total_units, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN dept_stats ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column;

question: For each department and school, show the department name, school name, the average CIP program code, the range of CIP program codes, the variance of CIP program codes for all undergraduate courses offered by degree-granting departments, and the variance of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one enrolled student and have course materials with a material status of 'RQ'. Include subtotals for each school (the corresponding school field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all schools (the corresponding school field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the school name if it is the same as the previous row. List the results in order of decreasing CIP program code range and department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_code, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ) , DeptEnrolledVariance AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) , joined_stats AS ( SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.avg_cip_code, icte.cip_code_range, icte.cip_code_variance, dev.enrolled_variance FROM inner_cte icte JOIN DeptEnrolledVariance dev ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dev.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND icte.SCHOOL_NAME = dev.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(school) OVER (ORDER BY school_sort, dept_sort) = school THEN NULL ELSE school END AS school, dept, avg_cip_code, cip_code_range, cip_code_variance, enrolled_variance FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(SCHOOL_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE SCHOOL_NAME END AS school_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(SCHOOL_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(SCHOOL_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE SCHOOL_NAME END AS school, CASE WHEN GROUPING(SCHOOL_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, DEPARTMENT_NAME AS dept, AVG(avg_cip_code) AS avg_cip_code, MAX(cip_code_range) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(cip_code_variance) AS cip_code_variance, VARIANCE(enrolled_variance) AS enrolled_variance FROM joined_stats GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP ) tbltmp ORDER BY school_sort, dept_sort;

question: For each subject offered in the term with the description "Fall Term 2024-2025" that also has more than 0 enrolled students and a material status key of 'U', show the subject offered key, subject title, offering department name, the term description, the rank of each subject within its offering department, the course number, course number description, number of enrolled students, the reserve catalog key, the dense rank over the material status key, and the academic year description, ordered by subject offered key and course number. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH SubjectOfferings AS ( SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS window_column, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' ), LibrarySubjectStats AS ( SELECT t1.COURSE_NUMBER, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) AS window_column, t1.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ) SELECT so.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, so.TERM_DESCRIPTION, so.window_column AS subject_rank_in_dept, lss.COURSE_NUMBER, lss.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, lss.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lss.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, lss.window_column AS dense_rank_material_status, so.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM SubjectOfferings so JOIN LibrarySubjectStats lss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = lss.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte ORDER BY TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COURSE_NUMBER;

question: For each organization and department in the Provost Area with organization level equal to 5 and assignable equal to 1, list the organization name, organization key, department name, department code, the average organization key within each organization key group ordered by department code, the department's long name, the corresponding hierarchy level 3 name from the master department hierarchy, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the department name. Additionally, include the department's top-level area name from HR_ORG_UNIT. Order the results by department code and department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1 ) SELECT i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.window_column AS org_window_avg_key, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS dept_row_number, h.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME FROM inner_cte i JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m ON h.DLC_KEY = m.DLC_KEY WHERE h.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL ORDER BY i.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each school, provide the school name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year, and for each degree granting course in the School of Engineering, show the course description, department name, and whether the course's total units is at least 10% greater than the average for its school ('HIGH_UNIT'), at least 10% less than the average ('LOW_UNIT'), or otherwise 'AVERAGE_UNIT'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION d ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = d.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON d.COURSE = c.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ) SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.avg_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units, cd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, cd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, CASE WHEN co.TOTAL_UNITS > ic.avg_total_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN co.TOTAL_UNITS < ic.avg_total_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE_UNIT' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd ON ic.SCHOOL_NAME = cd.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT dep ON cd.DEPARTMENT = dep.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED co ON cd.COURSE = co.SUBJECT_CODE AND co.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 WHERE dep.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND dep.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'

question: For each department and school, list the department name, school name, the variance of the total units of subjects offered in the 2022 academic year, the average CIP program code, the range of CIP program codes, and the variance of CIP program codes for all courses offered by that department where the department is degree granting and the course level is undergraduate. For each school, include a grand total for all departments in the format of (null, school name, ...). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DepartmentUnitsVariance AS ( SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), DepartmentCIPStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_code, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY cip_code_range DESC ) SELECT duv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, duv.SCHOOL_NAME, duv.total_units_variance, dcs.avg_cip_code, dcs.cip_code_range, dcs.cip_code_variance FROM DepartmentUnitsVariance duv JOIN DepartmentCIPStats dcs ON duv.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND duv.SCHOOL_NAME = dcs.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_units_variance, ic.avg_cip_code, ic.cip_code_range, ic.cip_code_variance FROM ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_units_variance, avg_cip_code, cip_code_range, cip_code_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_units_variance, avg_cip_code, cip_code_range, cip_code_variance WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(total_units_variance) IS NOT NULL ) ic ORDER BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: For each department where the maximum total units of any course offered by that department is greater than 6, and for students in the "Electrical Eng & Computer Sci" department, show the department name, the maximum total units, the name of the school that department belongs to, the student's full name, email address, course description, course level, and the most common student year among those students for each course level. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptMaxUnits AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ), EECSStudents AS ( SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, t2.STUDENT_YEAR FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dmu.max_total_units, dmu.SCHOOL_NAME, es.FULL_NAME, es.EMAIL_ADDRESS, es.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, es.COURSE_LEVEL, es.STUDENT_YEAR FROM DeptMaxUnits dmu JOIN EECSStudents es ON dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME = es.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.max_total_units, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.FULL_NAME, inner_cte.EMAIL_ADDRESS, inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.COURSE_LEVEL, mode_stats.Most_Common_Student_Year FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT COURSE_LEVEL, STUDENT_YEAR AS Most_Common_Student_Year FROM ( SELECT COURSE_LEVEL, STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY COURSE_LEVEL ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte GROUP BY COURSE_LEVEL, STUDENT_YEAR ) ranked WHERE rn = 1 ) mode_stats ON inner_cte.COURSE_LEVEL = mode_stats.COURSE_LEVEL

question: For each library reserve material detail with material status key 'U', show the reserve catalog key, subject offered key, term code, the academic year, the term description, the tip material key, the tip material status key, and the average record count in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the tip material status key and ordered by the academic year. For each department and academic year where the subject enrollment number is greater than 10, show the department name, the number of unique subjects, and the minimum total units offered. Additionally, for each department and academic year, provide a grand total row for all subjects in the format of (department name, academic year, null, total subjects, min total units). Present the results ordered by academic year, department name, and reserve catalog key. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH LibraryReserveMaterialDetails AS ( SELECT t0.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, t0.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, AVG(t2.RECORD_COUNT) OVER ( PARTITION BY t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ), DepartmentSubjectStats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.SUBJECT_ID, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.SUBJECT_ID ), DepartmentStatsRollup AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(min_total_units) AS min_total_units FROM DepartmentSubjectStats GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUBJECT_ID WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) > 0 OR SUBJECT_ID IS NULL ) SELECT lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, lrm.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, lrm.TERM_CODE, lrm.ACADEMIC_YEAR, lrm.TERM_DESCRIPTION, lrm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, lrm.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, lrm.window_column, dsr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dsr.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS dept_academic_year, dsr.SUBJECT_ID, dsr.subject_count, dsr.min_total_units FROM LibraryReserveMaterialDetails lrm JOIN DepartmentStatsRollup dsr ON lrm.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dsr.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY lrm.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dsr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY

question: For subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering with a total of at least 6 units, show the subject code, subject title, department name, the running sum of total units within each grade type, and for the corresponding department also provide the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and offered in the 'Engineering' school), as well as the average lecture units for those subjects in the department, ordered by subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.window_column, s2.total_units_range, s2.total_units_variance, s2.total_units_stddev, s3.avg_lecture_units FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) s2 ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.LECTURE_UNITS) AS avg_lecture_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) s3 ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s3.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For each DLC, show the DLC name and the average geometric mean of the areas of rooms assigned to organizations under that DLC (considering only rooms with area greater than zero), but only include DLCs where this average geometric mean is greater than the overall average geometric mean across all DLCs. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT o.DLC_KEY, o.DLC_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, EXP(AVG(LN(r.AREA))) AS geometric_mean_area FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION o JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 0 GROUP BY o.DLC_KEY, o.DLC_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) SELECT i.DLC_NAME, AVG(i.geometric_mean_area) AS avg_geometric_mean_area FROM inner_cte i GROUP BY i.DLC_NAME HAVING AVG(i.geometric_mean_area) > ( SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_area) FROM inner_cte ) ;

question: For each department in the "Provost Area" with a non-null department code, show the department name, the department's long name, the corresponding hierarchy level 3 name from the master department hierarchy, and the number of unique space units (with space unit key greater than 100000) associated with the department. For each department, also include a grand total row in the format (department name, department long name, hierarchy level 3 name, null, total unique space units). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t1.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t1.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL ), DeptSpaceUnitCount AS ( SELECT d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS unique_space_units FROM inner_cte d LEFT JOIN SPACE_UNIT s ON d.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY AND s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000 GROUP BY d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, SUM(unique_space_units) AS total_unique_space_units FROM DeptSpaceUnitCount GROUP BY HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, SPACE_UNIT_CODE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(unique_space_units) > 0 ) SELECT HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, total_unique_space_units FROM RollupResults ORDER BY HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SPACE_UNIT_CODE

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units, show the subject code, subject number, subject title, department name, term description, and the rank of each subject within its department ordered by subject code, along with the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects in that department that have at least one enrolled student and have required course materials. Additionally, for each department, include the total number of such subjects and the maximum number of enrolled students in any subject with required course materials. List the results ordered by department name and subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_with_required_materials, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.window_column, d.avg_total_units, d.total_units_range, d.total_units_variance, d.num_subjects_with_required_materials, d.max_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte s JOIN DeptUnitsStats d ON s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE

question: For each academic year and department, list either (1) the academic year, academic year description, department name, the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered by that department during terms in that year (considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the number of enrolled students is greater than 0), or (2) for subjects in the "Engineering" school with total units equal to 1, the academic year, subject ID, subject title, department name, and the rank of each subject within its academic year and department group ordered by subject ID. Indicate the reason for inclusion as either 'EnrolledStatsByDept' or 'EngineeringSubjects'. The columns should be: academic year, academic year description, department name, enrolled range, enrolled variance, subject ID, subject title, rank, and reason. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE AND TIP_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), EngineeringSubjects AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID ) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 1 ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.enrolled_range, icte.enrolled_variance, NULL AS SUBJECT_ID, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS window_column, 'EnrolledStatsByDept' AS Reason FROM inner_cte icte UNION ALL SELECT eng.ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, eng.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS enrolled_range, NULL AS enrolled_variance, eng.SUBJECT_ID, eng.SUBJECT_TITLE, eng.window_column, 'EngineeringSubjects' AS Reason FROM EngineeringSubjects eng ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, enrolled_range, enrolled_variance, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, window_column, Reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, Reason, SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each major use description and organization name where the room area is greater than 100 and the access level is 1, list the number of rooms, the minimum floor number, the access level name, the variance of the number of rooms in the building history for buildings with a nonzero number of rooms and assignable area greater than 0, and the total assignable area of those buildings, with the results ordered by major use description and organization name. Do not return any rounded answers.
