SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count, MIN(r.FLOOR) AS min_floor, b.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 100 AND r.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 GROUP BY r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, b.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE ) SELECT icte.MAJOR_USE_DESC, icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.room_count, icte.min_floor, abs.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME, abs.num_rooms_variance, abs.total_assignable_area FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ( SELECT b.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE, b.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME, VARIANCE(bh.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS num_rooms_variance, SUM(bh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS total_assignable_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING b JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST bh ON b.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE = bh.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE WHERE bh.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 0 AND bh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA > 0 GROUP BY b.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE, b.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME ) abs ON icte.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE = abs.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE ORDER BY icte.MAJOR_USE_DESC, icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME;

question: For each department and cluster type where the average total units for subjects offered in the 2012SU term is greater than 8 and the number of subjects with total units greater than 6 is at least 3, give the department name, cluster type, number of subjects, minimum number of enrolled students, average total units, variance of total units, and the maximum subject enrollment number among those subjects, in that order, ordered by the variance of total units in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptClusterStats AS ( SELECT so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sos.CLUSTER_TYPE, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON so.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY = sos.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sos.CLUSTER_TYPE ), DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_variance DESC ) SELECT dcs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dcs.CLUSTER_TYPE, dcs.subject_count, dcs.min_enrolled_students, dus.avg_units, dus.units_variance FROM DeptClusterStats dcs JOIN DeptUnitsStats dus ON dcs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE dus.avg_units > 8 AND dcs.subject_count >= 3 ORDER BY dus.units_variance DESC ) SELECT icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.CLUSTER_TYPE, icte.subject_count, icte.min_enrolled_students, icte.avg_units, icte.units_variance, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_subject_enrollment FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND ss.CLUSTER_TYPE = icte.CLUSTER_TYPE GROUP BY icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.CLUSTER_TYPE, icte.subject_count, icte.min_enrolled_students, icte.avg_units, icte.units_variance ORDER BY icte.units_variance DESC;

question: For each department and academic year where the subject enrollment number is greater than 10, provide the department name, the academic year, the number of unique subjects, the minimum total units offered, the variance of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one enrolled student and have course materials with a material status of 'RQ', and the total number of such courses per department and academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH SubjectStats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), DepartmentEnrolledVariance AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC ) SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ss.subject_count, ss.min_total_units, dev.enrolled_variance FROM SubjectStats ss JOIN DepartmentEnrolledVariance dev ON ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dev.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY ss.subject_count DESC, dev.enrolled_variance DESC ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.subject_count, icte.min_total_units, icte.enrolled_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS num_courses_with_rq_materials FROM inner_cte icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = t.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON c.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID AND c.TERM_CODE = tso.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.subject_count, icte.min_total_units, icte.enrolled_variance ORDER BY icte.subject_count DESC, icte.enrolled_variance DESC;

question: For organizations with an organization level of 5, show the organization name, organization ID, DLC name, HR org unit title, HR department name, HR org unit level, and assign row numbers within each HR department name group ordered by organization name, along with the name of each associated space unit, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the organization numbers for all organizations linked to that space unit, and the total number of unique HR org unit titles associated with each space unit, considering only space units with a non-null DLC key and organizations with assignable status. Present the results ordered by HR department name, organization name, and descending variance of organization numbers. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH OrgLevel5 AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID, t1.DLC_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS window_column, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ), SpaceUnitStats AS ( SELECT s.SPACE_UNIT, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, VARIANCE(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance, STDDEV(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT s ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = s.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE s.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 GROUP BY s.SPACE_UNIT, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY org_number_variance DESC ) SELECT o5.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o5.ORGANIZATION_ID, o5.DLC_NAME, o5.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, o5.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o5.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, o5.window_column, su.SPACE_UNIT, su.org_number_variance, su.org_number_stddev, o5.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM OrgLevel5 o5 JOIN SpaceUnitStats su ON o5.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY o5.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o5.ORGANIZATION_NAME, su.org_number_variance DESC ) SELECT icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.ORGANIZATION_ID, icte.DLC_NAME, icte.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, icte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, icte.window_column, icte.SPACE_UNIT, icte.org_number_variance, icte.org_number_stddev, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE) AS unique_hr_org_unit_titles_per_space_unit FROM inner_cte icte JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 ON icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT s ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = s.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY AND s.SPACE_UNIT = icte.SPACE_UNIT WHERE s.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1 GROUP BY icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.ORGANIZATION_ID, icte.DLC_NAME, icte.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, icte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, icte.window_column, icte.SPACE_UNIT, icte.org_number_variance, icte.org_number_stddev ORDER BY icte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.org_number_variance DESC;

question: For rooms with area greater than 200, show the building-room identifier, the organization name, the DLC key, the sum of room areas within each major use description group ordered by building-room, the HR department name, the HR org unit title, the HR org unit key, the average organization key within each organization key group ordered by HR org unit key, and the HR org unit level, for organizations with organization level equal to 5 and assignable equal to 1. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, SUM(t2.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.MAJOR_USE_DESC ORDER BY t2.BUILDING_ROOM) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.AREA > 200 ) SELECT icte.BUILDING_ROOM, icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.DLC_KEY, icte.window_column AS room_area_sum, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, AVG(icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS org_key_avg, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL FROM inner_cte icte JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON o.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = h.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE o.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 ORDER BY icte.BUILDING_ROOM, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY;

question: For each department in the "Provost Area", show the department code, department name, school area name, the rank of each department within its school area based on department code, and also provide the average, range, and variance of the area of rooms assigned to the department (considering only rooms with an area greater than 40). Additionally, for each department, show the total number of rooms assigned (with area greater than 40). List the results ordered by school area name and department rank. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptRoomStats AS ( SELECT o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_area, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, o.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 40 GROUP BY o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.DLC_KEY ORDER BY area_range DESC ), ProvostDeptRanks AS ( SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 INNER JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' ) SELECT p.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, p.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, p.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, p.window_column, d.avg_area, d.area_range, d.area_variance, d.DLC_KEY FROM ProvostDeptRanks p JOIN DeptRoomStats d ON p.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AND p.DLC_KEY = d.DLC_KEY ) SELECT inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.avg_area, inner_cte.area_range, inner_cte.area_variance, RoomCounts.total_rooms FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.DLC_KEY, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS total_rooms FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 40 GROUP BY o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.DLC_KEY ) AS RoomCounts ON inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = RoomCounts.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AND inner_cte.DLC_KEY = RoomCounts.DLC_KEY ORDER BY inner_cte.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, inner_cte.window_column;

question: For each library reserve material detail with material status key 'U', show the reserve catalog key, subject offered key, term code, the academic year, the term description, the tip material key, the tip material status key, and the average record count in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the tip material status key and ordered by the academic year, along with the average and variance of the record counter for reserve catalog items associated with that material status key where the catalog year is greater than 2000. Additionally, for each result, include the catalog title and catalog author name from the reserve catalog. Present the results ordered by academic year descending and record counter variance descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, t0.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, AVG(t2.RECORD_COUNT) OVER ( PARTITION BY t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ), MaterialStatusStats AS ( SELECT d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, AVG(c.RECORD_COUNTER) AS avg_record_counter, VARIANCE(c.RECORD_COUNTER) AS record_counter_variance FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL d JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG c ON d.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = c.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY WHERE c.CATALOG_YEAR > 2000 GROUP BY d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY record_counter_variance DESC ) SELECT ic.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, ic.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, ic.TERM_CODE, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, ic.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ic.window_column, mss.avg_record_counter, mss.record_counter_variance, rc.CATALOG_TITLE, rc.CATALOG_AUTHOR_NAME FROM inner_cte ic JOIN MaterialStatusStats mss ON ic.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = mss.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG rc ON ic.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = rc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY ORDER BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC, mss.record_counter_variance DESC

question: For Mathematics department courses with at least 5 enrolled students, show the course number, subject title, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, the row number within each academic year group ordered by course number, the term start date, calendar date, day of week, and the average calendar year within each calendar year group ordered by term start date, but only for academic terms where the term status is 'Previous', and only include results where the number of enrolled students is greater than the average number of enrolled students for that academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column, t1.TERM_START_DATE FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 ), PreviousTerms AS ( SELECT t1.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t0.CALENDAR_DATE, t0.DAY_OF_WEEK, AVG(t0.CALENDAR_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.CALENDAR_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_START_DATE) AS window_column FROM TIME_DAY t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.CALENDAR_DATE = t1.TERM_START_DATE WHERE t1.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ), AvgEnrolled AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT i.COURSE_NUMBER, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.window_column AS math_window_column, p.TERM_START_DATE, p.CALENDAR_DATE, p.DAY_OF_WEEK, p.window_column AS previous_terms_window_column FROM inner_cte i JOIN PreviousTerms p ON i.TERM_CODE = p.TERM_CODE JOIN AvgEnrolled a ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_enrolled ORDER BY i.COURSE_NUMBER, p.TERM_START_DATE;

question: For each department, what is the department name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the most recent academic year, and the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in regular academic terms, with the results for both the most recent academic year and regular academic terms shown side by side for each department? Additionally, for each department, show the total number of subjects offered in the most recent academic year and in regular academic terms, and include a grand total row for all departments. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH most_recent_year_stats AS ( SELECT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.SUBJECT_ID WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ) GROUP BY COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ), regular_term_stats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT mry.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mry.avg_total_units AS most_recent_year_avg_total_units, mry.total_units_range AS most_recent_year_total_units_range, mry.total_units_variance AS most_recent_year_total_units_variance, mry.num_subjects AS most_recent_year_num_subjects, rts.avg_total_units AS regular_term_avg_total_units, rts.total_units_range AS regular_term_total_units_range, rts.total_units_variance AS regular_term_total_units_variance, rts.num_subjects AS regular_term_num_subjects FROM most_recent_year_stats mry JOIN regular_term_stats rts ON mry.DEPARTMENT_NAME = rts.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, most_recent_year_avg_total_units, most_recent_year_total_units_range, most_recent_year_total_units_variance, most_recent_year_num_subjects, regular_term_avg_total_units, regular_term_total_units_range, regular_term_total_units_variance, regular_term_num_subjects FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT 'ALL DEPARTMENTS' AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(most_recent_year_avg_total_units), MAX(most_recent_year_total_units_range), VARIANCE(most_recent_year_total_units_variance), SUM(most_recent_year_num_subjects), AVG(regular_term_avg_total_units), MAX(regular_term_total_units_range), VARIANCE(regular_term_total_units_variance), SUM(regular_term_num_subjects) FROM inner_cte ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department that is degree-granting and offered at least one subject in the School of Engineering in 2021, provide the department code, department name, department full name, the number of subjects offered, the total number of enrolled students in those subjects, the average number of unique subject codes associated with its courses that are offered by degree-granting departments, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of that number, the school name, and the department phone number. Include subtotals for each department (the corresponding department field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all departments (the corresponding department field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the department name if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptEng2021 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ), DeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes FROM ( SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT ) course_subjects JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON course_subjects.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), CombinedDepts AS ( SELECT de.DEPARTMENT_CODE, de.DEPARTMENT_NAME, de.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, de.subject_count, de.total_enrollment, ds.avg_subject_codes, ds.stddev_subject_codes FROM DeptEng2021 de JOIN DeptSubjectStats ds ON de.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, cd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, cd.subject_count, cd.total_enrollment, cd.avg_subject_codes, cd.stddev_subject_codes, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM CombinedDepts cd LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON cd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(department_name) OVER (ORDER BY department_name_sort) = department_name THEN NULL ELSE department_name END AS department_name, department_code, department_full_name, subject_count, total_enrollment, avg_subject_codes, stddev_subject_codes, school_name, department_phone_number FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS department_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS department_name, DEPARTMENT_CODE AS department_code, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS department_full_name, subject_count, total_enrollment, avg_subject_codes, stddev_subject_codes, SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone_number FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, subject_count, total_enrollment, avg_subject_codes, stddev_subject_codes, SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY department_name_sort;

question: For each academic year and department name where the term status is 'Previous', provide the academic year, department name, the number of unique subjects offered, the minimum total units for those subjects, the variance of the reserve catalog keys for courses in that department where the material status is 'U', and the maximum number of lecture units among those subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptCatalogVariance AS ( SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, VARIANCE(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY lci.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY catalog_key_variance DESC ), YearDeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT yds.ACADEMIC_YEAR, yds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, yds.subject_count, yds.min_total_units, dcv.catalog_key_variance FROM YearDeptSubjectStats yds JOIN DeptCatalogVariance dcv ON yds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dcv.DEPARTMENT ) SELECT icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.subject_count, icte.min_total_units, icte.catalog_key_variance, MAX(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units FROM inner_cte icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.subject_count, icte.min_total_units, icte.catalog_key_variance ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each major use description and organization name where the room area is greater than 100 and the access level is 1, provide the number of rooms, the minimum floor number, the geometric mean of the number of supervisees for each department (considering only departments where the number of supervisees is greater than zero), and the total research volume for each organization (considering only research volumes greater than zero), listing the columns in the order: major use description, organization name, number of rooms, minimum floor number, geometric mean of supervisees, and total research volume. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count, MIN(r.FLOOR) AS min_floor FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 100 AND r.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 GROUP BY r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ), OrgSuperviseeStats AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES))) AS geometric_mean_supervisees FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN SPACE_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ON SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY = SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.DEPT_NAMES WHERE SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES > 0 GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME ), OrgResearchVolume AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, SUM(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.RESEARCH_VOLUME) AS total_research_volume FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN SPACE_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ON SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY = SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.DEPT_NAMES WHERE SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.RESEARCH_VOLUME > 0 GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.MAJOR_USE_DESC, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.room_count, inner_cte.min_floor, os.geometric_mean_supervisees, orv.total_research_volume FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN OrgSuperviseeStats os ON inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = os.ORGANIZATION_NAME LEFT JOIN OrgResearchVolume orv ON inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = orv.ORGANIZATION_NAME;

question: For each department, either (a) list the department name, average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in offered subjects (for degree-granting departments and subjects with more than 0 enrolled students), or (b) list the department name and total number of students enrolled in courses offered by that department in the School of Engineering where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 50, and also show the number of unique subjects offered by that department. For each row, include a reason for inclusion ('DegreeGrantingStats' for the first case and 'EngineeringTotals' for the second). Show the department name, average enrollment, enrollment variance, enrollment standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), total enrollment, number of unique subjects, and reason, in that order, sorted by department name and reason. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_enrollment, d.enrollment_variance, d.enrollment_stddev, NULL AS total_enrollment, NULL AS num_unique_subjects, 'DegreeGrantingStats' AS Reason FROM inner_cte d UNION ALL SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_enrollment, NULL AS enrollment_variance, NULL AS enrollment_stddev, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment, COUNT(DISTINCT t.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects, 'EngineeringTotals' AS Reason FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Reason;

question: For organizations with an organization level of 5, show the organization name, organization ID, DLC name, HR org unit title, HR department name, HR org unit level, and assign row numbers within each HR department name group ordered by organization name. For each such organization, for each room with area greater than 200 and assignable major use, show the building room, floor, room number, space ID, area, major use name, major use description, and the minimum area value over each major use group. Additionally, for each such room, show the HR org unit title and HR org unit level from the HR_ORG_UNIT table (joined via DLC_KEY), and the difference between the room's area and the minimum area for its major use. Order the results by HR department name, organization name, and major use. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH OrgInfo AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID, t1.DLC_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS window_column, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t0.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ), RoomInfo AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.ROOM, t1.SPACE_ID, t1.AREA, t0.MAJOR_USE, t0.DESCRIPTION, min(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY ORDER BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY) AS min_area_per_major_use, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY FROM FCLT_MAJOR_USE t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 200 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1 ) SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.ORGANIZATION_ID, o.DLC_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, o.window_column, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.FLOOR, r.ROOM, r.SPACE_ID, r.AREA, r.MAJOR_USE, r.DESCRIPTION, r.min_area_per_major_use, o.DLC_KEY, r.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, (r.AREA - r.min_area_per_major_use) AS area_deviation FROM OrgInfo o JOIN RoomInfo r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_ID, inner_cte.DLC_NAME, inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.BUILDING_ROOM, inner_cte.FLOOR, inner_cte.ROOM, inner_cte.SPACE_ID, inner_cte.AREA, inner_cte.MAJOR_USE, inner_cte.DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.min_area_per_major_use, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE AS HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE_FROM_HR, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL AS HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL_FROM_HR, inner_cte.area_deviation FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON inner_cte.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY ORDER BY inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.MAJOR_USE;

question: List the offering department names, their corresponding subject codes, subject titles, and the total number of unique subjects per department for all departments that have at least one course with TIP material status 'RQ' and where the course has more than 0 total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, dept_counts.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) dept_counts ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_counts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_ID

question: For each term and department in the School of Engineering, list the term, department, the number of subjects offered with at least 6 total units, the average number of enrolled students in those subjects, the school name, and the department full name. Include subtotals for each term (the corresponding term field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all terms (the corresponding term field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the term if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by term and department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.TERM_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ss.TOTAL_UNITS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ss ON s.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID AND s.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(term) OVER (ORDER BY term_sort, dept_sort) = term THEN NULL ELSE term END AS term, dept, subj_cnt, avg_enrolled_students, school_name, department_full_name FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, DEPARTMENT_NAME AS dept, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS department_full_name, SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS subj_cnt, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY TERM_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP ) tbltmp ORDER BY term_sort, dept_sort;

question: For rooms with an area greater than 300 and located in buildings with more than 100 rooms, and for each such room's organization that is associated with a space unit with a non-null DLC key and assignable status, show the building's long name, the room's full name, the room's area, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the building's long name, the name of the space unit, the associated organization name, the variance of the organization numbers, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the organization numbers for all organizations linked to that space unit, and the maximum organization number among those organizations. List the results ordered by the building's long name and descending variance of organization numbers. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH RoomWindow AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, t0.ROOM_FULL_NAME, t0.AREA, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.BUILDING_NAME_LONG ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ROOMS t0 JOIN FCLT_BUILDING t1 ON t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE t0.AREA > 300 AND t1.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 100 ), SpaceUnitStats AS ( SELECT s.SPACE_UNIT, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, VARIANCE(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance, STDDEV(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT s ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = s.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE s.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 GROUP BY s.SPACE_UNIT, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY ORDER BY org_number_variance DESC ) SELECT rw.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, rw.ROOM_FULL_NAME, rw.AREA, rw.window_column, sus.SPACE_UNIT, sus.ORGANIZATION_NAME, sus.org_number_variance, sus.org_number_stddev, sus.SPACE_UNIT_KEY FROM RoomWindow rw JOIN SpaceUnitStats sus ON rw.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = sus.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY rw.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, sus.org_number_variance DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, inner_cte.ROOM_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.AREA, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.org_number_variance, inner_cte.org_number_stddev, MAX(o2.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS max_org_number FROM inner_cte JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o2 ON su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY GROUP BY inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, inner_cte.ROOM_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.AREA, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.org_number_variance, inner_cte.org_number_stddev ORDER BY inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, inner_cte.org_number_variance DESC;

question: For each department-level organization whose DLC key is not null and which has rooms with area greater than 0, and which also has organization level 5, give the organization name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of rooms assigned to that organization, the dense rank of its corresponding HR department name considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the HR department code from the HR organization unit table, and the total number of unique buildings in which the organization's rooms are located. Show the organization name, area variance, area standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), the dense rank, and the building count in that order, ordered by area variance descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ors.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ors.area_variance, ors.area_stddev, ohr.window_column FROM ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE d.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND r.AREA > 0 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY area_variance DESC ) ors JOIN ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ) ohr ON ors.ORGANIZATION_NAME = ohr.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.area_variance, inner_cte.area_stddev, inner_cte.window_column, COUNT(DISTINCT r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) AS building_count FROM inner_cte JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = o.ORGANIZATION_NAME JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.area_variance, inner_cte.area_stddev, inner_cte.window_column ORDER BY inner_cte.area_variance DESC;

question: For each activity, list the activity title, enrollment type, maximum enrollment, category name, and the average maximum enrollment for activities in the same category. Only include activities where the maximum enrollment is greater than the average maximum enrollment for all activities. Present the results ordered by category name and activity title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY ) SELECT i.ACTIVITY_TITLE, i.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, i.MAX_ENROLLMENT, i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, (SELECT AVG(MAX_ENROLLMENT) FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d2 WHERE d2.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY ) AS avg_max_enrollment_in_category FROM inner_cte i WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT > ( SELECT AVG(MAX_ENROLLMENT) FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL ) ORDER BY i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, i.ACTIVITY_TITLE;

question: For each department in the Provost Area with a non-null department code, show the department name, the department's long name, the corresponding hierarchy level 3 name from the master department hierarchy, the average space unit key for space units with a space unit key greater than 100000 and matching DLC key, and classify each department as 'LARGE_SPACE' if the average space unit key is at least 20% greater than the overall average, 'SMALL_SPACE' if at least 20% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Show the columns in this order: department name, department long name, hierarchy level 3 name, average space unit key, and space size category. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, t1.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t1.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL ), space_avg AS ( SELECT s.DLC_KEY, AVG(s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS avg_space_unit_key FROM SPACE_UNIT s WHERE s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000 GROUP BY s.DLC_KEY ), overall_avg AS ( SELECT AVG(SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS overall_avg_space_unit_key FROM SPACE_UNIT WHERE SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000 ) SELECT d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, sa.avg_space_unit_key, CASE WHEN sa.avg_space_unit_key > oa.overall_avg_space_unit_key * 1.2 THEN 'LARGE_SPACE' WHEN sa.avg_space_unit_key < oa.overall_avg_space_unit_key * 0.8 THEN 'SMALL_SPACE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS space_size_category FROM inner_cte d JOIN space_avg sa ON d.DLC_KEY = sa.DLC_KEY CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa ORDER BY d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each department in the School of Engineering where the total number of students enrolled in courses offered by that department is greater than 50, what is the department name, the total number of enrolled students, the average of the total units for its courses that have a non-null subject title and total units greater than 0, the variance of the total units for those courses, and the maximum number of enrolled students in any single course offered by that department? Please list the department name, total enrollment, average units, units variance, and maximum course enrollment in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ) SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.total_enrollment, u.avg_units, u.units_variance, m.max_course_enrollment FROM inner_cte e JOIN ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) u ON e.DEPARTMENT_NAME = u.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_course_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) m ON e.DEPARTMENT_NAME = m.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For rooms in building E38, show the building room identifier, floor number, major use description, organization name, office location, full name of the employee, department name, and the average area of rooms in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by department number and ordered by floor, along with the space unit name, the average HR organization unit ID, the variance of the HR organization unit IDs associated with the space unit for the organization of the room, and the HR organization unit title and HR department name for the organization of the room. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.FLOOR, t0.MAJOR_USE_DESC, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.OFFICE_LOCATION, t1.FULL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, AVG(t0.AREA) OVER ( PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER ORDER BY t0.FLOOR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ROOMS t0 JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY t1 ON t0.BUILDING_ROOM = t1.OFFICE_LOCATION WHERE t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = 'E38' ), SpaceUnitStats AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, AVG(hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS avg_org_unit_id, VARIANCE(hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS org_unit_id_variance, fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY org_unit_id_variance DESC ) SELECT e.BUILDING_ROOM, e.FLOOR, e.MAJOR_USE_DESC, e.ORGANIZATION_NAME, e.OFFICE_LOCATION, e.FULL_NAME, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.window_column, s.SPACE_UNIT, s.avg_org_unit_id, s.org_unit_id_variance, s.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, s.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte e JOIN SpaceUnitStats s ON e.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = s.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY

question: For each academic year and department, list the academic year, department name, average total units, variance of total units for subjects offered in regular terms, the academic year description, the geometric mean of the record counts of required course materials (where the record count is greater than zero) for all subjects offered in that year, and the number of subjects in that department and year that have at least one required course material. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH AvgVarTotalUnits AS ( SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY var_total_units DESC ), GeometricMeanRecordCount AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_record_count DESC ) SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.avg_total_units, a.var_total_units, g.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, g.geometric_mean_record_count FROM AvgVarTotalUnits a JOIN GeometricMeanRecordCount g ON a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY a.var_total_units DESC, g.geometric_mean_record_count DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.var_total_units, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_record_count, COALESCE(s.subjects_with_required_materials, 0) AS subjects_with_required_materials FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subjects_with_required_materials FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND t.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) s ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.var_total_units DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_record_count DESC;

question: For each department, what is the department name, the variance of the total units of subjects offered in the 2022 academic year, the variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only departments that grant degrees and subjects with a non-null subject code description), the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in those subjects, and the total number of subjects offered by the department in 2022? Please provide the department name, the variance of total units, the variance of enrolled students, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrolled students, and the total number of subjects offered, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptUnitsVariance AS ( SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), DeptEnrolledVariance AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ) SELECT duv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, duv.total_units_variance, dev.enrolled_students_variance, dev.enrolled_students_stddev FROM DeptUnitsVariance duv JOIN DeptEnrolledVariance dev ON duv.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dev.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY duv.total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_units_variance, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, inner_cte.enrolled_students_stddev, COALESCE(subject_count.subjects_offered, 0) AS total_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subjects_offered FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) subject_count ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subject_count.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each degree-granting course in the School of Engineering, show the course description, department name, subject code description, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by course description, and, for each course, provide the number of subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2022 that are variable unit subjects, as well as the percentage of such variable unit subjects out of all subjects offered by that department in 2022.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC ), EngDegreeCourses AS ( SELECT t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT edc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, edc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, edc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, edc.window_column, dus.units_range, dus.units_variance FROM EngDegreeCourses edc LEFT JOIN DeptUnitsStats dus ON edc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptVariableUnits AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(CASE WHEN IS_VARIABLE_UNITS = 'Y' THEN 1 END) AS variable_unit_count, COUNT(*) AS total_subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, icte.window_column, dvu.variable_unit_count, ROUND(100.0 * dvu.variable_unit_count / NULLIF(dvu.total_subjects,0), 2) AS percent_variable_unit_subjects FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN DeptVariableUnits dvu ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dvu.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: Show the department full names, subject titles, total units, and the number of unique course materials per subject for subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering. For each subject, also provide the material status key, term code, subject ID, ISBN, material key, course number description, offering department name, and the maximum number of enrolled students for each row considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by material key, where the subject title and department code match between the subject and course material datasets. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.TOTAL_UNITS, mat_count.num_materials, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2.TERM_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.ISBN, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s2.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.max_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ( SELECT t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.ISBN, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_enrolled_students, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_DETAIL t0 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL AND t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 ) s2 ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND icte.SUBJECT_TITLE = s2.SUBJECT_TITLE JOIN ( SELECT t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS num_materials FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t0d ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t0d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_TITLE = t2.SUBJECT_TITLE AND t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t0 ON t2.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE t0d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ) mat_count ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mat_count.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND icte.SUBJECT_TITLE = mat_count.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For each academic year, which department had the highest average number of enrolled students in fall term subjects (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students), and what is the minimum academic year and the sum of total units for subjects that are offered in the fall term and have library reserve material details with material status 'U'? Please provide the academic year, department name, highest average enrollment, minimum academic year, and total units sum, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), MaxDeptAvgEnrollment AS ( SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(avg_enrollment) AS max_avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ) m ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = m.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND i.avg_enrollment = m.max_avg_enrollment ), MinYearTotalUnits AS ( SELECT MIN(at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_sum FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' ) SELECT m.ACADEMIC_YEAR, m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.avg_enrollment, t.min_academic_year, t.total_units_sum FROM MaxDeptAvgEnrollment m CROSS JOIN MinYearTotalUnits t ORDER BY m.ACADEMIC_YEAR, m.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each administrative department and each subject offered by that department in the term '2019FA' with more than 0 enrolled students, provide the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the office phone numbers of students in that department (considering only students who have a non-null office phone number), the subject title, offer department name, department full name, number of enrolled students, the average number of enrolled students in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the school code, and indicate whether the number of enrolled students for the subject is at least 20% above the window average ('ABOVE_AVERAGE'), at least 20% below the window average ('BELOW_AVERAGE'), or otherwise 'AVERAGE'. Order the results by department name and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptPhoneStats AS ( SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.OFFICE_PHONE) AS avg_office_phone, STDDEV(MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.OFFICE_PHONE) AS stddev_office_phone, SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY ON SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.DEPARTMENT WHERE MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.OFFICE_PHONE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY stddev_office_phone DESC ), SubjectEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT dps.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dps.avg_office_phone, dps.stddev_office_phone, ses.SUBJECT_TITLE, ses.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ses.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ses.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ses.window_column FROM DeptPhoneStats dps JOIN SubjectEnrollmentStats ses ON dps.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = ses.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_office_phone, inner_cte.stddev_office_phone, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.window_column, CASE WHEN inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > inner_cte.window_column * 1.2 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < inner_cte.window_column * 0.8 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: From the top 10 department and academic year combinations with the highest number of unique subjects (where the subject enrollment number is greater than 10), display each department name, academic year, number of unique subjects, minimum total units offered, the variance of the number of enrolled students in courses with at least one enrolled student and course materials with a material status of 'RQ', as well as the subject with the highest enrollment in that group and its enrollment number. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), DeptEnrolledVariance AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), DeptMaxEnrolledSubject AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER DESC ) AS rn FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units, dev.enrolled_variance, dms.SUBJECT_ID AS max_enrolled_subject_id, dms.SUBJECT_TITLE AS max_enrolled_subject_title, dms.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER AS max_enrollment FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN DeptEnrolledVariance dev ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dev.OFFER_DEPT_NAME LEFT JOIN DeptMaxEnrolledSubject dms ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dms.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dms.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND dms.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.subject_count DESC, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR LIMIT 10;

question: For each department that had library reserve materials in terms with a term status of 'Previous', and also offered courses in the term '2019FA' that are offered by both the library and the TIP system with more than 10 enrolled students, and where the average total units for the department is greater than 3, provide the department name, the average of the total units, the variance of the total units, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units, and the total number of enrolled students, in that order, ordered by the variance of the total units in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), DepartmentEnrolledStats AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_total_units, ic.total_units_variance, ic.total_units_stddev, des.total_enrolled FROM inner_cte ic JOIN DepartmentEnrolledStats des ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME WHERE ic.avg_total_units > 3 ORDER BY ic.total_units_variance DESC

question: For organizations with an organization level of 5, show the organization name, organization ID, DLC name, HR org unit title, HR department name, HR org unit level, and assign row numbers within each HR department name group ordered by organization name. For each such organization, for each room with area greater than 200 and assignable major use that belongs to the organization, show the building room, floor, room number, space ID, area, major use name, major use description, and the minimum area value over each major use group. Additionally, for each such room, show the HR org unit key and the HR org unit title from the HR_ORG_UNIT table (joined via DLC_KEY). Present the results with the columns: organization name, organization ID, DLC name, HR org unit title, HR department name, HR org unit level, row number, building room, floor, room number, space ID, area, major use name, major use description, minimum area per major use, HR org unit key, and HR org unit title, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID, t1.DLC_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ), LargeAssignableRooms AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.ROOM, t1.SPACE_ID, t1.AREA, t0.MAJOR_USE, t0.DESCRIPTION, min(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY ORDER BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY) AS min_area_per_major_use, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_MAJOR_USE t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 200 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1 ) SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.ORGANIZATION_ID, o.DLC_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, o.window_column, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.FLOOR, r.ROOM, r.SPACE_ID, r.AREA, r.MAJOR_USE, r.DESCRIPTION, r.min_area_per_major_use, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE FROM inner_cte o JOIN LargeAssignableRooms r ON o.ORGANIZATION_ID = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON o.DLC_NAME = h.DLC_NAME

question: For each department, provide the department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students per subject offered by that department in the term 2019FA, as well as the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects that had library reserve materials in terms with a term status of 'Previous', but only include departments where the average total units for such subjects is greater than the overall average total units for all subjects with library reserve materials in 'Previous' terms. The columns should be: department name, enrolled student range, enrolled student variance, enrolled student standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), average total units, total units variance, and total units standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH enrolled_stats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC ), units_stats AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.enrolled_range, e.enrolled_variance, e.enrolled_stddev, u.avg_total_units, u.total_units_variance, u.total_units_stddev FROM enrolled_stats e LEFT JOIN units_stats u ON e.DEPARTMENT_NAME = u.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY e.enrolled_range DESC ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, enrolled_range, enrolled_variance, enrolled_stddev, avg_total_units, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_total_units > ( SELECT AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' );

question: For each department and course number, show the department name, the total number of subject enrollments for subjects offered in the current term (where the total number of subject enrollments is greater than 10), the course number, the number of unique library subjects offered, the minimum total units for those subjects, and the number of unique responsible faculty members for those subjects, but only include department and course number pairs where the number of enrolled students in the subject summary is greater than 2. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollments FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER p JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON p.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 10 ) SELECT de.DEPARTMENT_NAME, de.total_enrollments, lss.COURSE_NUMBER, lss.subject_count, lss.min_total_units, lss.unique_faculty_count FROM inner_cte de JOIN ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, COUNT(DISTINCT so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID) AS unique_faculty_count FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY so ON l.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER ) lss ON de.DEPARTMENT_NAME = lss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY de.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lss.COURSE_NUMBER;

question: For the top 10 subject titles by the number of reserved library materials for subjects offered in the term '2009SP', what are the subject title, the offering department name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only departments that grant degrees and subjects with a non-null subject code description), the count of reserved materials, and the total number of units for each subject? Please provide the subject title, the offering department name, the variance, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), the count of reserved materials, and the total units, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ), TopReservedSubjects AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY reserved_materials DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT trs.SUBJECT_TITLE, trs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, des.enrolled_students_variance, des.enrolled_students_stddev, trs.reserved_materials, soss.TOTAL_UNITS FROM TopReservedSubjects trs JOIN DepartmentEnrollmentStats des ON trs.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = des.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY soss ON trs.SUBJECT_TITLE = soss.SUBJECT_TITLE AND trs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = soss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY trs.reserved_materials DESC ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte;

question: Among all Mathematics department courses with at least 5 enrolled students, list the top 10 courses with the highest enrollment. For each, show the course number, subject title, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, the row number within each academic year group ordered by course number, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in offered subjects for that academic year, and the subject title with the highest enrollment in that academic year along with its enrollment count. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 ), YearlyVariation AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ), MaxEnrolledSubject AS ( SELECT t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC) AS rn FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE ) SELECT ic.COURSE_NUMBER, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.window_column, yv.coefficient_of_variation, mes.SUBJECT_TITLE AS max_enrolled_subject_title, mes.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS max_enrolled_count FROM inner_cte ic JOIN YearlyVariation yv ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = yv.ACADEMIC_YEAR LEFT JOIN MaxEnrolledSubject mes ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = mes.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND mes.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each organization whose parent is 'S H&SS' and that is associated with a space unit with space unit code 97500, list the organization name, description, HR org unit title, row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the organization name, the space unit name, space unit code, department count, number of supervisees, the average department count within each department count group ordered by number of supervisees, and the total square footage for each organization. Include subtotals for each organization (the corresponding organization name field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all organizations (the corresponding organization name field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the organization name if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by organization name and space unit name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH OrgWindowed AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.ORG_PARENT = 'S H&SS' ), SpaceUnitStats AS ( SELECT t1.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.DEPT_COUNT, t2.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, AVG(t2.DEPT_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPT_COUNT ORDER BY t2.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS avg_dept_count_within_group, t2.SQFT, t1.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DEPT_NAMES WHERE t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 97500 ) SELECT ow.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ow.DESCRIPTION, ow.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, ow.window_column, sus.space_unit_name, sus.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, sus.DEPT_COUNT, sus.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, sus.avg_dept_count_within_group, sus.SQFT FROM OrgWindowed ow JOIN SpaceUnitStats sus ON ow.DLC_KEY = sus.DLC_KEY ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(ORGANIZATION_NAME) OVER (ORDER BY org_sort, space_unit_name) = ORGANIZATION_NAME THEN NULL ELSE ORGANIZATION_NAME END AS organization_name, DESCRIPTION, HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, window_column, space_unit_name, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, DEPT_COUNT, NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, avg_dept_count_within_group, SQFT, SUM(SQFT) OVER (PARTITION BY ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS total_sqft_per_org FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(ORGANIZATION_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(space_unit_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE ORGANIZATION_NAME END AS org_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ORGANIZATION_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(space_unit_name) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(ORGANIZATION_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(space_unit_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE ORGANIZATION_NAME END AS ORGANIZATION_NAME, DESCRIPTION, HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, window_column, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ORGANIZATION_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(space_unit_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE space_unit_name END AS space_unit_sort, space_unit_name, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, DEPT_COUNT, NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, avg_dept_count_within_group, SQFT FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ORGANIZATION_NAME, DESCRIPTION, HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, window_column, space_unit_name, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, DEPT_COUNT, NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, avg_dept_count_within_group, SQFT WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY org_sort, space_unit_sort;
