question: For each department, what is the department's name, the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2022 and that are also listed in the CIS course catalog, as well as the average and variance of the total units for its courses that have a non-null subject title and total units greater than 0? Additionally, for each department, provide the number of unique subject codes offered in 2022 that are also in the CIS course catalog. Present the department name, units range, variance of units range, average units, variance of average units, and the count of unique subject codes in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC ), dept_avg_variance_units AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_variance DESC ), dept_subject_code_count AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_CODE) AS unique_subject_codes FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.units_range, inner_cte.units_variance AS range_variance, dau.avg_units, dau.units_variance AS avg_variance, dscc.unique_subject_codes FROM inner_cte JOIN dept_avg_variance_units dau ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dau.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN dept_subject_code_count dscc ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dscc.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department, provide the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of unique subject codes associated with its courses that are offered by degree-granting departments, and the variance of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one enrolled student and have course materials with a material status of 'RQ', but only include departments where the average number of unique subject codes is greater than the overall average across all departments. List the columns in the order: department name, average subject codes, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subject codes, and enrolled variance. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM ( SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT ) course_subjects JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON course_subjects.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY stddev_subject_codes DESC ), DeptEnrolledVariance AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC ) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.avg_subject_codes, dss.stddev_subject_codes, dev.enrolled_variance FROM DeptSubjectStats dss JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN DeptEnrolledVariance dev ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dev.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_subject_codes, stddev_subject_codes, enrolled_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_subject_codes > (SELECT AVG(avg_subject_codes) FROM inner_cte);

question: For each IAP subject that is not cancelled and has a non-null maximum enrollment and also has a maximum enrollment of 12, list the activity title, enrollment type, term description, subject title, number of enrolled students, offer department code, the dense rank over the offer department code ordered by offer department code, the responsible faculty MIT ID, the average number of enrolled students in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the responsible faculty MIT ID and ordered by the number of enrolled students, and for each offer department code, include a grand total of the number of enrolled students in the format of (nulls for all columns except offer department code and total enrolled students). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH iap_subjects_not_cancelled AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL ), iap_subjects_max_enrollment_12 AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID, AVG(t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY t2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ORDER BY t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 12 ) SELECT inc.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inc.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inc.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inc.SUBJECT_TITLE, inc.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inc.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, inc.window_column AS dense_rank_over_offer_dept_code, ime12.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID, ime12.window_column AS avg_num_enrolled_students_window FROM iap_subjects_not_cancelled inc JOIN iap_subjects_max_enrollment_12 ime12 ON inc.ACTIVITY_TITLE = ime12.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND inc.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = ime12.ENROLLMENT_TYPE AND inc.TERM_DESCRIPTION = ime12.TERM_DESCRIPTION AND inc.SUBJECT_TITLE = ime12.SUBJECT_TITLE AND inc.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = ime12.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ) , dept_totals AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ) SELECT i.ACTIVITY_TITLE, i.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, dt.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, i.dense_rank_over_offer_dept_code, i.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID, i.avg_num_enrolled_students_window, dt.total_enrolled_students FROM dept_totals dt LEFT JOIN inner_cte i ON dt.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = i.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY dt.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, i.ACTIVITY_TITLE, i.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2022 with a total of 12 units, show the subject code, subject number, department name, subject title, term description, total units, the average subject enrollment number in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by department code and ordered by total units, the variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2012SU term for each department, and the total number of students enrolled in each subject in the 2012SU term. List the subject code, subject number, department name, subject title, term description, total units, average subject enrollment number in window, total units variance, and total number of students enrolled in 2012SU in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) OVER ( PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS join_department_name FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON tso.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), Subquery3 AS ( SELECT so.SUBJECT_ID, SUM(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_students_2012SU FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' GROUP BY so.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_NUMBER, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.TOTAL_UNITS, icte.window_column, s2.total_units_variance, COALESCE(s3.total_students_2012SU, 0) AS total_students_2012SU FROM inner_cte icte JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON icte.join_department_name = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN Subquery3 s3 ON icte.SUBJECT_CODE = SUBSTRING(s3.SUBJECT_ID, 1, LENGTH(icte.SUBJECT_CODE))

question: From the top 10 DLC and academic year combinations (where the DLC name matches the department name and the term status is 'Previous') with the highest coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of rooms assigned to organizations in that DLC (considering only rooms with an area greater than 0), display the DLC key, DLC name, coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), academic year, department name, the number of unique subjects offered, the minimum total units for those subjects, and the subject with the highest total units along with its subject title and total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DLC_RoomAreaStats AS ( SELECT FODK.DLC_KEY, FO.DLC_NAME, STDDEV(FR.AREA)/NULLIF(AVG(FR.AREA),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY FODK JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION FO ON FODK.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS FR ON FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FR.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE FR.AREA > 0 GROUP BY FODK.DLC_KEY, FO.DLC_NAME HAVING AVG(FR.AREA) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), AcademicYearDeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT d.DLC_KEY, d.DLC_NAME, d.coefficient_of_variation, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.subject_count, a.min_total_units FROM DLC_RoomAreaStats d JOIN AcademicYearDeptSubjectStats a ON d.DLC_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d.coefficient_of_variation DESC, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT icte.DLC_KEY, icte.DLC_NAME, icte.coefficient_of_variation, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.subject_count, icte.min_total_units, s.SUBJECT_ID AS subject_with_max_units, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS AS max_total_units FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ccso.TOTAL_UNITS DESC, ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS rn FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ) s ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s.rn = 1 ORDER BY icte.coefficient_of_variation DESC, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC;

question: For each department in the School of Engineering with a total number of students enrolled in its courses greater than 50, list the department name, the total number of enrolled students, the average and variance of the total units for its courses that have a non-null subject title and total units greater than 0, and the number of unique faculty members responsible for those courses. Order the results by department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ) SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.total_enrollment, u.avg_units, u.units_variance, COALESCE(f.num_faculty, 0) AS num_unique_faculty FROM inner_cte e JOIN ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) u ON e.DEPARTMENT_CODE = u.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN ( SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID) AS num_faculty FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t WHERE t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ) f ON e.DEPARTMENT_CODE = f.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY e.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department that has a maximum total units of any course greater than 6, list the department name, the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2022, the maximum total units of any course offered by that department, the name of the school that department belongs to, and the number of unique subject titles offered by that department in 2022. Order the results by the number of unique subject titles descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH UnitsStats AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC ), MaxUnitsSchool AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ) SELECT us.DEPARTMENT_NAME, us.units_range, us.units_variance, mu.max_total_units, mu.SCHOOL_NAME FROM UnitsStats us JOIN MaxUnitsSchool mu ON us.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mu.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.units_range, icte.units_variance, icte.max_total_units, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT CCSO.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS unique_subject_titles_2022 FROM inner_cte icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED CCSO ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = CCSO.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.units_range, icte.units_variance, icte.max_total_units, icte.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY unique_subject_titles_2022 DESC;

question: For each department that is a degree-granting department and also an Engineering department with more than 50 total enrolled students in its offered courses, what is the department name, the average number of enrolled students in offered subjects (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students), the variance of the number of enrolled students, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students, the total number of students enrolled in courses offered by that department in the School of Engineering, and the maximum number of enrolled students in any single subject offered by that department? List the results ordered by the variance of the number of enrolled students in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC ), EngineeringDeptTotals AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ) SELECT dts.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dts.avg_enrollment, dts.enrollment_variance, dts.enrollment_stddev, edt.total_enrollment FROM DeptEnrollmentStats dts JOIN EngineeringDeptTotals edt ON dts.DEPARTMENT_NAME = edt.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dts.enrollment_variance DESC ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_enrollment, icte.enrollment_variance, icte.enrollment_stddev, icte.total_enrollment, MAX(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment_in_subject FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_enrollment, icte.enrollment_variance, icte.enrollment_stddev, icte.total_enrollment ORDER BY icte.enrollment_variance DESC;

question: For each department name and course level where the course is degree granting and the total units are greater than 6, and for each of the top 10 subject titles by the number of reserved library materials in the term '2009SP' offered by that department, provide the department name, course level, number of unique courses, minimum total units offered, subject title, offering department name, the count of reserved materials, and the average number of enrolled students for those subjects, ordered by department name, course level, reserved materials in descending order, and average enrolled students descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL ) SELECT cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cs.COURSE_LEVEL, cs.course_count, cs.min_total_units, ts.SUBJECT_TITLE, ts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ts.reserved_materials, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte cs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY reserved_materials DESC LIMIT 10 ) ts ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = ts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND sos.SUBJECT_TITLE = ts.SUBJECT_TITLE GROUP BY cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cs.COURSE_LEVEL, cs.course_count, cs.min_total_units, ts.SUBJECT_TITLE, ts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ts.reserved_materials ORDER BY cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cs.COURSE_LEVEL, ts.reserved_materials DESC, avg_enrolled_students DESC;

question: For each of the 5 departments that offer the largest number of unique subjects, list the department code, department name, the total number of unique subjects they offer, and for each subject in the academic term with term code '2009SP' in that department, show the subject title, total units, and whether the subject's total units are 'HIGH_UNIT' (at least 10% greater than the average total units for that department in that term), 'LOW_UNIT' (at least 10% less than the average), or 'AVERAGE_UNIT' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY num_subjects DESC LIMIT 5 ), dept_avg_units AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss WHERE ss.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.num_subjects, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.TOTAL_UNITS, CASE WHEN ss.TOTAL_UNITS > dau.avg_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN ss.TOTAL_UNITS < dau.avg_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE_UNIT' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND ss.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' JOIN dept_avg_units dau ON ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dau.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ic.num_subjects DESC, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: From the top 10 organizations (with a major organization key of 230) that have the highest average HR department code (for HR org units with a warehouse load date of '03-DEC-24' and space units with a warehouse load date of '19-DEC-24'), display each organization's name, department name, department code, department long name, department level, the average organization number in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the organization parent and ordered by the organization name, the space unit name, and for each organization, the space unit with the highest HR department code average, along with the range and variance of the HR department codes for the HR org units linked to that space unit. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH OrgStats AS ( SELECT t2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, AVG(t2.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) OVER ( PARTITION BY t2.ORG_PARENT ORDER BY t2.ORGANIZATION_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t2.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t2.FCLT_MAJOR_ORG_KEY = 230 ), SpaceUnitStats AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS avg_hr_dept_code, MAX(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) - MIN(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS hr_dept_code_range, VARIANCE(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS hr_dept_code_variance, fo.DLC_KEY FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE su.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND hou.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '03-DEC-24' GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fo.DLC_KEY ) SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, o.window_column, s.SPACE_UNIT, s.avg_hr_dept_code, s.hr_dept_code_range, s.hr_dept_code_variance FROM OrgStats o JOIN SpaceUnitStats s ON o.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY ), RankedSpaceUnits AS ( SELECT icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, icte.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, icte.window_column, icte.SPACE_UNIT, icte.avg_hr_dept_code, icte.hr_dept_code_range, icte.hr_dept_code_variance, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY icte.avg_hr_dept_code DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte icte ) SELECT r. ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, r.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, r.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, r.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, r.window_column, r.SPACE_UNIT, r.avg_hr_dept_code, r.hr_dept_code_range, r.hr_dept_code_variance FROM RankedSpaceUnits r WHERE r.rn = 1 ORDER BY r.avg_hr_dept_code DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each academic year, list the academic year, the academic year description, the average, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and geometric mean of the total units for subjects offered in regular terms, and for each year also include the department that offered the most subjects in regular terms along with the count of subjects from that department. Present the results ordered by academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH AvgStddevUnits AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ), GeometricMeanUnits AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC ) SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, a.avg_total_units, a.stddev_total_units, g.geometric_mean_total_units FROM AvgStddevUnits a JOIN GeometricMeanUnits g ON a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), DeptCounts AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS subject_count FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptRanked AS ( SELECT d.ACADEMIC_YEAR, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.subject_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY d.subject_count DESC) AS dept_rank FROM DeptCounts d ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.avg_total_units, i.stddev_total_units, i.geometric_mean_total_units, dr.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS most_subjects_department, dr.subject_count AS department_subject_count FROM inner_cte i LEFT JOIN DeptRanked dr ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dr.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND dr.dept_rank = 1 ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For rooms with an area greater than 100, show the building name, room key, and the dense rank of each room considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the number of rooms in the building, along with the organization name, the average, and the variance of the HR department codes (old) for all associated HR org units where the organization is assignable and the HR department name is not null. Additionally, for each result, indicate whether the average HR department code (old) is at least 10% greater than the overall average (label as 'HIGH_AVG'), at least 10% less than the overall average (label as 'LOW_AVG'), or otherwise 'AVERAGE'. Present the building name, room key, dense rank, organization name, average HR department code (old), variance of HR department code (old), and the average category in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH RoomRanks AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_NAME, t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.NUM_OF_ROOMS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ROOMS t0 JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST t1 ON t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE t0.AREA > 100 ), OrgStats AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS avg_dept_code_old, VARIANCE(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS var_dept_code_old FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = HR_ORG_UNIT.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY var_dept_code_old DESC ) SELECT rr.BUILDING_NAME, rr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, rr.window_column, os.ORGANIZATION_NAME, os.avg_dept_code_old, os.var_dept_code_old FROM RoomRanks rr JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON rr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN OrgStats os ON fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME = os.ORGANIZATION_NAME ), overall_avg AS ( SELECT AVG(avg_dept_code_old) AS overall_avg_dept_code_old FROM ( SELECT AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS avg_dept_code_old FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = HR_ORG_UNIT.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) sub ) SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, ic.window_column, ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.avg_dept_code_old, ic.var_dept_code_old, CASE WHEN ic.avg_dept_code_old > oa.overall_avg_dept_code_old * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_AVG' WHEN ic.avg_dept_code_old < oa.overall_avg_dept_code_old * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_AVG' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS avg_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa

question: For each subject offered in the academic term with term code '2006FA', show the subject ID, subject title, department name, the sum of lecture units within each grade type group, the total number of active graduate students with an office location assigned in that department, and the maximum total units for any subject in that department during the same term, ordered by subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH SubjectLectureUnits AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.LECTURE_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA' ), ActiveGradStudents AS ( SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS total_active_grad_students FROM SE_PERSON s JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY m ON s.FULL_NAME = m.FULL_NAME WHERE s.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND m.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND m.OFFICE_LOCATION IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.window_column, a.total_active_grad_students FROM SubjectLectureUnits s JOIN ActiveGradStudents a ON s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ), DeptMaxTotalUnits AS ( SELECT t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA' GROUP BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.window_column, i.total_active_grad_students, d.max_total_units FROM inner_cte i JOIN DeptMaxTotalUnits d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY i.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For organizations with an organization level of 5, show the organization name, organization ID, DLC name, HR org unit title, HR department name, HR org unit level, and assign row numbers within each HR department name group ordered by organization name. For each such organization, for each room with area greater than 200 and assignable major use that belongs to the organization, show the building room, floor, room number, space ID, area, major use name, major use description, and the minimum area value over each major use group. Additionally, for each such room, show the HR org unit title and HR org unit level from the HR_ORG_UNIT table (joined via DLC_KEY). Present the results with the columns: organization name, organization ID, DLC name, HR org unit title, HR department name, HR org unit level, row number, building room, floor, room number, space ID, area, major use name, major use description, minimum area per major use, HR org unit title (from HR_ORG_UNIT), and HR org unit level (from HR_ORG_UNIT), in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID, t1.DLC_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ) SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.ORGANIZATION_ID, o.DLC_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, o.window_column, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.FLOOR, r.ROOM, r.SPACE_ID, r.AREA, r.MAJOR_USE, r.DESCRIPTION, r.min_area_per_major_use, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE AS hr_org_unit_title_from_hr, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL AS hr_org_unit_level_from_hr FROM inner_cte o JOIN ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.ROOM, t1.SPACE_ID, t1.AREA, t0.MAJOR_USE, t0.DESCRIPTION, min(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY ORDER BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY) AS min_area_per_major_use, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY FROM FCLT_MAJOR_USE t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 200 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1 ) r ON o.ORGANIZATION_ID = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON o.DLC_NAME = h.DLC_NAME

question: For each department hierarchy level 2 name and organization name where the organization is assignable and the organization has organization level 5, give the number of organizations, the minimum organization number, the organization key, the description, the space unit, the space unit key, the average organization key within each organization key group, and the maximum space unit key for each organization, ordered by department hierarchy level 2 name, organization name, and space unit key. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(f.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 GROUP BY m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME ), OrgLevel5Details AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.SPACE_UNIT, t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ), MaxSpaceUnitKey AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, MAX(SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS max_space_unit_key FROM SPACE_UNIT GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) SELECT d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, d.ORGANIZATION_NAME, d.organization_count, d.min_organization_number, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.DESCRIPTION, o.SPACE_UNIT, o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, o.window_column, m.max_space_unit_key FROM inner_cte d JOIN OrgLevel5Details o ON d.ORGANIZATION_NAME = o.ORGANIZATION_NAME JOIN MaxSpaceUnitKey m ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = m.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, d.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY;

question: For each department in the School of Engineering with a total number of students enrolled in its courses greater than 50, list the department name, the total number of enrolled students, the average total units for its courses that have a non-null subject title and total units greater than 0, the variance of the total units for those courses, and the name of the course with the highest total units in that department (among those courses). Present the results ordered by total enrollment descending, then average units descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptEnrollment AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ), DeptUnits AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_variance DESC ) SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.total_enrollment, u.avg_units, u.units_variance FROM DeptEnrollment e JOIN DeptUnits u ON e.DEPARTMENT_NAME = u.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.total_enrollment, icte.avg_units, icte.units_variance, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE AS course_with_max_units FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_TITLE, CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS DESC, CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_TITLE ASC ) AS rn FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) ccc ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ccc.rn = 1 ORDER BY icte.total_enrollment DESC, icte.avg_units DESC;

question: Show the department full names, subject titles, total units, and for each subject, the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one reserved library material and at least one course material with a non-null ISBN, for subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering. Also, include the number of such subjects per department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ), subq2 AS ( SELECT tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lrm.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.ISBN IS NOT NULL AND lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ), dept_counts AS ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, subq2.avg_enrolled, subq2.enrolled_variance, dept_counts.num_subjects FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN subq2 ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE = subq2.SUBJECT_TITLE LEFT JOIN dept_counts ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME = dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For each academic year, display the academic year, academic year description, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in regular terms, and for each such academic year, show the department code, department name, and the deviation of the department's average total units from the academic year's average total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units, dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (dept_stats.dept_avg_total_units - inner_cte.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_year_avg FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS dept_avg_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) dept_stats ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dept_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_CODE

question: For all subjects offered in the 2019FA term, list the subject ID, subject title, number of enrolled students, department name, department full name, and the average number of enrolled students for that department in 2019FA, but only include those subjects where the number of enrolled students is greater than the average for their department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.avg_enrolled FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > d.avg_enrolled ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_ID;

question: List the department hierarchy level 2 names, organization names, number of organizations, minimum organization number, building names, room keys, and the total area of rooms greater than 100 for each building, for organizations that are assignable. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(f.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 GROUP BY m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT icte.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.organization_count, icte.min_organization_number, bh.BUILDING_NAME, r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, BuildingRoomTotals.total_area FROM inner_cte icte JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = f.ORGANIZATION_NAME JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST bh ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = bh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN ( SELECT bh.BUILDING_NAME, SUM(r.AREA) AS total_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST bh ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = bh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 100 GROUP BY bh.BUILDING_NAME ) AS BuildingRoomTotals ON bh.BUILDING_NAME = BuildingRoomTotals.BUILDING_NAME WHERE r.AREA > 100 ORDER BY icte.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, bh.BUILDING_NAME, r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY

question: Show the department names, the corresponding SIS subject code, subject code descriptions, graduate level, the total number of courses per department, and the average total units for courses in each department that have a non-null subject title and total units greater than 0. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, Total_Courses.Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_NUMBER) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS Total_Courses ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ic.GRADUATE_LEVEL, ic.Total_Courses, avg_units.avg_total_units FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) avg_units ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = avg_units.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each subject offered in the term '2019FA' with more than 0 enrolled students, and where the offering department is among the top 10 departments by the number of unique subjects they offered for terms in the academic year 2014 or later, show the subject title, offer department name, department full name, number of enrolled students, the average number of enrolled students in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the school code, the count of unique subject titles for the department, and the total number of enrolled students for each department (as a grand total row with null for subject title and window column), ordered by the offer department name and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_dept_name FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), TopDepts AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2014 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), DeptTotals AS ( SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS window_column, SUM(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte ic GROUP BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ic.window_column, td.subject_count, NULL AS total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte ic JOIN TopDepts td ON ic.join_dept_name = td.OFFER_DEPT_NAME UNION ALL SELECT dt.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dt.SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, dt.window_column, td.subject_count, dt.total_enrolled_students FROM DeptTotals dt JOIN TopDepts td ON dt.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = td.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE ;

question: For each subject title offered in the term with code '2012SU' by the "Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog" department, show the subject title, subject ID, offer department name, academic year, term description, the minimum number of enrolled students in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the academic year, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for that subject (considering only subjects offered by the "Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog" department and with more than 5 offerings), and the average number of enrolled students for that subject across all terms. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH SubjectStddev AS ( SELECT sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON so.COMPOSITE_SUBJECT_KEY = sos.COMPOSITE_SUBJECT_KEY WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' GROUP BY sos.SUBJECT_TITLE HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY total_units_stddev DESC ), SubjectWindow AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, MIN(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' ) SELECT sw.SUBJECT_TITLE, sw.SUBJECT_ID, sw.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sw.ACADEMIC_YEAR, sw.TERM_DESCRIPTION, sw.window_column, ss.total_units_stddev FROM SubjectWindow sw JOIN SubjectStddev ss ON sw.SUBJECT_TITLE = ss.SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.window_column, icte.total_units_stddev, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON icte.SUBJECT_TITLE = so.SUBJECT_TITLE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON so.COMPOSITE_SUBJECT_KEY = sos.COMPOSITE_SUBJECT_KEY WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' GROUP BY icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.window_column, icte.total_units_stddev

question: For all subjects in the 2014FA term with at least one enrolled student and a TIP material status key of 'RQ', show the subject title, offering department name, responsible faculty name, the TIP material status key, the total number of units, and the minimum total number of units in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the course number. Additionally, for the offering department, provide the department name, the average and variance of the department's subject codes' course numbers (using their ASCII values), considering only departments that are degree granting. Also, include the department's full name and school name. The results are ordered by offering department name and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VARIANCE(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.window_column, dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, dept_stats.SCHOOL_NAME, dept_stats.avg_course_number_ascii, dept_stats.var_course_number_ascii FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN dept_stats ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For each department name and its corresponding facility organization key where the department is in the Provost Area, provide the number of organizations, the minimum department hierarchy level 3 code, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of HR organization units per facility organization (considering only those with a non-null DLC key and where the hierarchy type is 'Standard Hierarchy'), and for each such facility organization, list the HR organization unit titles and their HR organization unit IDs. Order the results by department name, facility organization key, and HR organization unit title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH ProvostAreaDepts AS ( SELECT m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_CODE) AS min_level3_code FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ), FacilityOrgStats AS ( SELECT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, MAX(hr_unit_count) - MIN(hr_unit_count) AS org_unit_count_range, VARIANCE(hr_unit_count) AS org_unit_count_variance, STDDEV(hr_unit_count) AS org_unit_count_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m ON f.DLC_KEY = m.DLC_KEY JOIN ( SELECT h.DLC_KEY, COUNT(*) AS hr_unit_count FROM HR_ORG_UNIT h WHERE h.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY h.DLC_KEY ) AS hr_stats ON m.DLC_KEY = hr_stats.DLC_KEY WHERE f.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' GROUP BY f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY org_unit_count_range DESC ), CombinedProvostFacility AS ( SELECT p.DLC_NAME, p.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, p.org_count, p.min_level3_code, f.org_unit_count_range, f.org_unit_count_variance, f.org_unit_count_stddev FROM ProvostAreaDepts p JOIN FacilityOrgStats f ON p.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) SELECT * FROM CombinedProvostFacility ) SELECT i.DLC_NAME, i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.org_count, i.min_level3_code, i.org_unit_count_range, i.org_unit_count_variance, i.org_unit_count_stddev, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE FROM inner_cte i JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f ON i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON f.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY WHERE h.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL ORDER BY i.DLC_NAME, i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE;

question: For each space unit with a space unit code of 402100, what is the space unit key, the organization name, the DLC name, the DLC key from FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY, the rank of each record within each DLC key group ordered by space unit key, and the geometric mean of the number of supervisees for each department in that organization (considering only departments where the number of supervisees is greater than zero), but only include those space units where the geometric mean of supervisees is greater than the overall average number of supervisees across all departments? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH org_geom_mean_supervisees AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES))) AS geometric_mean_supervisees FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN SPACE_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ON SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY = SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.DEPT_NAMES WHERE SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES > 0 GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_supervisees DESC ), space_unit_402100 AS ( SELECT t2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.DLC_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DLC_KEY ORDER BY t2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 402100 ) SELECT s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, s.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s.DLC_NAME, s.DLC_KEY, s.window_column, o.geometric_mean_supervisees FROM space_unit_402100 s LEFT JOIN org_geom_mean_supervisees o ON s.ORGANIZATION_NAME = o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte WHERE geometric_mean_supervisees > ( SELECT AVG(NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) FROM SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE WHERE NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES > 0 );

question: For each subject offered in the term '2017JA', what is the subject title, the number of enrolled students, the responsible faculty name, the offering department name, the department full name, the school name, the minimum number of enrolled students in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the department code, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with at least one enrolled student), and the department's school code? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptVariation AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), Subjects2017JA AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( ORDER BY t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.window_column, dv.coefficient_of_variation, sd.SCHOOL_CODE FROM Subjects2017JA s LEFT JOIN DeptVariation dv ON s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte;

question: Among all academic term parameters with a term indicator of 'C', list the top 5 departments (by the number of unique subjects offered in regular terms) along with each department's name, the total number of unique subjects offered, the earliest and latest academic years in which subjects were offered, and the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of those subjects. Also, show the running total of unique subjects per department ordered by academic year. Order the results by the number of unique subjects (descending) and department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_PARAMETER, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_ID, SUM(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_INDICATOR = 'C' ), dept_subjects AS ( SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT icte.SUBJECT_ID) AS unique_subjects, MIN(icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS earliest_year, MAX(icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS latest_year FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON icte.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), dept_units_stats AS ( SELECT t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON t2.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID AND t2.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON t2.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.unique_subjects, ds.earliest_year, ds.latest_year, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev, SUM(ds.unique_subjects) OVER (ORDER BY ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS running_total_unique_subjects FROM dept_subjects ds LEFT JOIN dept_units_stats dus ON ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ds.unique_subjects DESC, ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIMIT 5;

question: From the top 10 departments and academic years with the highest number of unique subjects (where the subject enrollment number is greater than 10 and the department has at least one course with at least one enrolled student and course materials with a material status of 'RQ'), display each department's name, academic year, number of unique subjects, minimum total units offered, the variance of the number of enrolled students in such courses, the subject with the highest enrollment in that department and year, and the enrollment count for that subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptYearSubjectStats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), DeptEnrolledVariance AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.ACADEMIC_YEAR, d.subject_count, d.min_total_units, v.enrolled_variance FROM DeptYearSubjectStats d JOIN DeptEnrolledVariance v ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = v.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.subject_count, icte.min_total_units, icte.enrolled_variance, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Top_Subject_Title, ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER AS Top_Subject_Enrollment FROM ( SELECT icte.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY icte.subject_count DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte icte ) icte JOIN ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER DESC ) AS subj_rank FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 ) ss ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ss.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND ss.subj_rank = 1 WHERE icte.rn <= 10 ORDER BY icte.subject_count DESC, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For rooms in building E38, show the building room identifier, floor number, major use description, organization name, office location, full name of the employee, department name, and the average area of rooms in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by department number and ordered by floor, along with the space unit name, the average HR organization unit ID, the variance of the HR organization unit IDs associated with the space unit for the organization of the room, and the HR department name and HR org unit title for the HR org unit with the maximum HR org unit ID for the space unit. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH E38Rooms AS ( SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.FLOOR, t0.MAJOR_USE_DESC, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.OFFICE_LOCATION, t1.FULL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, AVG(t0.AREA) OVER ( PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER ORDER BY t0.FLOOR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ROOMS t0 JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY t1 ON t0.BUILDING_ROOM = t1.OFFICE_LOCATION WHERE t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = 'E38' ), SpaceUnitStats AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, AVG(hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS avg_org_unit_id, VARIANCE(hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS org_unit_id_variance, fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, su.DLC_KEY FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, su.DLC_KEY ORDER BY org_unit_id_variance DESC ) SELECT e.BUILDING_ROOM, e.FLOOR, e.MAJOR_USE_DESC, e.ORGANIZATION_NAME, e.OFFICE_LOCATION, e.FULL_NAME, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.window_column, s.SPACE_UNIT, s.avg_org_unit_id, s.org_unit_id_variance, s.DLC_KEY FROM E38Rooms e JOIN SpaceUnitStats s ON e.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = s.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) SELECT ic.BUILDING_ROOM, ic.FLOOR, ic.MAJOR_USE_DESC, ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.OFFICE_LOCATION, ic.FULL_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.window_column, ic.SPACE_UNIT, ic.avg_org_unit_id, ic.org_unit_id_variance, hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DLC_KEY, MAX(HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS max_hr_org_unit_id FROM HR_ORG_UNIT GROUP BY DLC_KEY ) max_hou ON ic.DLC_KEY = max_hou.DLC_KEY LEFT JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON ic.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY AND hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = max_hou.max_hr_org_unit_id ;

question: Show the department hierarchy level 2 name, organization name, the number of organizations, the minimum organization number, the geometric mean of the number of supervisees for each department (considering only departments where the number of supervisees is greater than zero), and the total square footage used by supervisees for each organization where the organization is assignable. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptOrgStats AS ( SELECT m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(f.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 GROUP BY m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME ), OrgSuperviseeGeomMean AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES))) AS geometric_mean_supervisees FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN SPACE_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ON SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY = SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.DEPT_NAMES WHERE SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES > 0 GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, d.ORGANIZATION_NAME, d.organization_count, d.min_organization_number, o.geometric_mean_supervisees FROM DeptOrgStats d JOIN OrgSuperviseeGeomMean o ON d.ORGANIZATION_NAME = o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.organization_count, inner_cte.min_organization_number, inner_cte.geometric_mean_supervisees, COALESCE(SUM(ssu.SQFT), 0) AS total_supervisee_sqft FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME LEFT JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY LEFT JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ssu ON su.DLC_KEY = ssu.DEPT_NAMES GROUP BY inner_cte.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.organization_count, inner_cte.min_organization_number, inner_cte.geometric_mean_supervisees ORDER BY inner_cte.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME;

question: For each department where the total number of organizations associated with that department whose parent is 'EXECVP' or 'CHNCLR' is greater than 5, give the department name, the total number of organizations, the DLC name, the average organization number, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the organization numbers for assignable organizations associated with that DLC, and the HR organization unit title, ordering the results by the total number of organizations in descending order and then by the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the organization numbers in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS total_organizations FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON d.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON f.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY WHERE f.ORG_PARENT IN ('EXECVP', 'CHNCLR') GROUP BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) > 5 ) SELECT inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_organizations, da.DLC_NAME, da.avg_org_number, da.org_number_stddev, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE FROM inner_cte JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON h.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY JOIN ( SELECT o.DLC_NAME, AVG(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS avg_org_number, STDDEV(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 GROUP BY o.DLC_NAME ) da ON f.DLC_NAME = da.DLC_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.total_organizations DESC, da.org_number_stddev DESC;

question: For each DLC with more than five organizations, list the DLC name, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the organization numbers for organizations associated with that DLC, and for rooms on floor 2 associated with that DLC, show the building room, space usage, the organization name, the HR org unit title, the department name, and the difference between the room's access level and the average access level for all rooms on floor 2 for that DLC. Present the results ordered by the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of organization numbers in descending order and then by building room. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_NAME, STDDEV(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY.DLC_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER IS NOT NULL GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY org_number_stddev DESC ), Floor2RoomAvgAccess AS ( SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.SPACE_USAGE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DLC_NAME, t0.ACCESS_LEVEL FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2 ), DLC_AvgAccess AS ( SELECT DLC_NAME, AVG(ACCESS_LEVEL) AS avg_access_level FROM Floor2RoomAvgAccess GROUP BY DLC_NAME ) SELECT i.DLC_NAME, i.org_number_stddev, f.BUILDING_ROOM, f.SPACE_USAGE, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, f.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, f.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, (f.ACCESS_LEVEL - d.avg_access_level) AS access_level_deviation FROM inner_cte i JOIN Floor2RoomAvgAccess f ON i.DLC_NAME = f.DLC_NAME JOIN DLC_AvgAccess d ON f.DLC_NAME = d.DLC_NAME ORDER BY i.org_number_stddev DESC, f.BUILDING_ROOM

question: For subjects offered in the academic term with term code '2006FA', show the subject title, department name, total units, assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title, and for each such subject, also show the highest number of lecture units among subjects offered by the same department in the Fall term of 2022 (considering only departments with subjects having more than 3 lecture units in 2022FA), the start date of the 2022FA term, and the number of distinct subjects offered by the same department in 2022FA. The columns should be: subject title, department name, total units, window row number, highest lecture units in 2022FA, 2022FA term start date, and count of distinct subjects in 2022FA. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS dept_name_1 FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA' ), dept_2022fa_stats AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, at2.TERM_START_DATE, COUNT(DISTINCT ccs.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count_2022fa FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 ON td.TERM_CODE = at2.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at2.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) > 3 ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.TOTAL_UNITS, icte.window_column, d22.max_lecture_units, d22.TERM_START_DATE, d22.subject_count_2022fa FROM inner_cte icte JOIN dept_2022fa_stats d22 ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d22.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For each space unit and its associated organization, list the space unit name, organization name, the average, range, and variance of the HR department codes for the HR org units linked to that space unit (considering only space units with a warehouse load date of '19-DEC-24' and HR org units with a warehouse load date of '03-DEC-24'), as well as the average and variance of the HR department codes (old) for all associated HR org units where the organization is assignable and the HR department name is not null. Additionally, include the HR org unit title and HR org unit level for each HR org unit linked to the space unit. Do not repeat the space unit name if it is the same as the previous row. List the results ordered by the HR department code range (descending), then by the variance of the HR department codes (old) (descending), and then by HR org unit title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS avg_hr_dept_code, MAX(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) - MIN(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS hr_dept_code_range, VARIANCE(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS hr_dept_code_variance, fo.DLC_KEY FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE su.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND hou.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '03-DEC-24' GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fo.DLC_KEY ORDER BY hr_dept_code_range DESC ), OrgStats AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS avg_dept_code_old, VARIANCE(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS var_dept_code_old, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = HR_ORG_UNIT.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY ORDER BY var_dept_code_old DESC ), CombinedStats AS ( SELECT s.SPACE_UNIT, s.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s.avg_hr_dept_code, s.hr_dept_code_range, s.hr_dept_code_variance, o.avg_dept_code_old, o.var_dept_code_old, s.DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte s JOIN OrgStats o ON s.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(cs.SPACE_UNIT) OVER (ORDER BY cs.hr_dept_code_range DESC, cs.var_dept_code_old DESC, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE) = cs.SPACE_UNIT THEN NULL ELSE cs.SPACE_UNIT END AS SPACE_UNIT, cs.ORGANIZATION_NAME, cs.avg_hr_dept_code, cs.hr_dept_code_range, cs.hr_dept_code_variance, cs.avg_dept_code_old, cs.var_dept_code_old, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL FROM CombinedStats cs JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON cs.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY AND hou.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '03-DEC-24' ORDER BY cs.hr_dept_code_range DESC, cs.var_dept_code_old DESC, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE;

question: For each academic year and department where the number of enrolled students in a subject is greater than 5 and the academic year has terms that are current or previous terms, what are the academic year, academic year description, variance of the record count of tip details for those terms, department name, number of unique subjects offered, the minimum number of total units for those subjects, and the average number of enrolled students in those subjects? List the results ordered by academic year and department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH AcademicYearVariance AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC ), DepartmentSubjectStats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ayv.record_count_variance, dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.subject_count, dss.min_total_units FROM AcademicYearVariance ayv JOIN DepartmentSubjectStats dss ON ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.min_total_units, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = c.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON c.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.min_total_units ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
