question: For each degree-granting department that offered at least one subject in the School of Engineering in 2021 and has more than 10 tip materials for subjects in the School of Engineering during regular terms, provide the department code, department name, department full name, the number of subjects offered, the total number of enrolled students in those subjects, the total number of tip materials, the average number of enrolled students per subject (rounded to two decimal places), and the ratio of total enrolled students to total tip materials (rounded to two decimal places), listing the results in descending order of the average number of enrolled students per subject.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, icte.subject_count, icte.total_enrollment, dtm.total_tip_materials, ROUND(icte.total_enrollment / NULLIF(icte.subject_count, 0), 2) AS Avg_Enrollment_per_Subject, ROUND(icte.total_enrollment / NULLIF(dtm.total_tip_materials, 0), 2) AS Enrollment_per_TipMaterial FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL t JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) > 10 ) dtm ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dtm.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY Avg_Enrollment_per_Subject DESC;

question: For each subject offered in the term '2017JA', show the subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, department full name, subject code, subject code description, and the minimum number of enrolled students over each subject code group. Also, for each subject, provide the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year in the same department, and indicate whether the subject is a 'HIGH_LOAD' (if its number of enrolled students is at least 10% greater than the department's average total units), 'LOW_LOAD' (if at least 10% less), or 'AVERAGE_LOAD' otherwise. Order the results by subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, icte.window_column, s2.avg_total_units, s2.total_units_range, s2.total_units_variance, CASE WHEN icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > s2.avg_total_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_LOAD' WHEN icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < s2.avg_total_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_LOAD' ELSE 'AVERAGE_LOAD' END AS load_category FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) s2 ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For each offering department in the School of Engineering, what is the maximum number of enrolled students in any subject offered in the term with code '2025FA'? Show the offering department name and the highest number of enrolled students for that department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t3 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t3.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' AND t3.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS highest_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: For all organizations that either have a DLC key of 'D_MECHE' (showing their organization key, organization name, DLC name, and their rank within each DLC name group ordered by organization key) or are assignable with a department code above 100000 (showing their organization key, organization name, department name, the number of HR org units, and the total of their department IDs), provide, for each, the highest HR department ID among their associated HR org units. The columns should be: organization key, organization name, DLC name, rank, department name, number of HR org units, total of department IDs, reason for inclusion, and highest HR department ID, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DLCMechOrgs AS ( SELECT t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.DLC_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DLC_NAME ORDER BY t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.DLC_KEY = 'D_MECHE' ), AssignableLargeDeptOrgs AS ( SELECT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS hr_org_unit_count, SUM(h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS total_department_id FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION f JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID > 100000 GROUP BY f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ), CombinedOrgs AS ( SELECT d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, d.ORGANIZATION_NAME, d.DLC_NAME, d.window_column, NULL AS HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS hr_org_unit_count, NULL AS total_department_id, 'DLC_MECHE' AS Reason FROM DLCMechOrgs d UNION ALL SELECT a.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, a.ORGANIZATION_NAME, NULL AS DLC_NAME, NULL AS window_column, a.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.hr_org_unit_count, a.total_department_id, 'ASSIGNABLE_LARGE_DEPT' AS Reason FROM AssignableLargeDeptOrgs a ) SELECT * FROM CombinedOrgs ) SELECT i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.DLC_NAME, i.window_column, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.hr_org_unit_count, i.total_department_id, i.Reason, MAX(h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS highest_hr_department_id FROM inner_cte i LEFT JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY LEFT JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD GROUP BY i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.DLC_NAME, i.window_column, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.hr_org_unit_count, i.total_department_id, i.Reason ORDER BY i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.Reason;

question: For each department name and course level, provide the department name, course level, number of unique degree granting courses with total units greater than 6, the minimum total units offered, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for courses offered by that department, as well as the average total units for those courses, but only include results where the number of unique courses is more than 2 and the department's range of total units is greater than 0. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.COURSE_LEVEL, inner_cte.course_count, inner_cte.min_total_units, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev, dus.total_units_avg FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_avg FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) dus ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE inner_cte.course_count > 2 AND dus.total_units_range > 0 ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.COURSE_LEVEL;

question: For each department hierarchy, provide the department hierarchy name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the organization level for organizations in that hierarchy, and for each department in that hierarchy, give the department's name, the maximum and minimum area of rooms assigned to that department (considering only rooms with an area greater than 40), and the difference between the department's average room area and the overall average room area for all such rooms. Present the results ordered by department hierarchy name and then by the difference in average area in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME, AVG(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) AS avg_org_level, STDDEV(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) AS org_level_stddev FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL IS NOT NULL GROUP BY MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME ), dept_room_area_ext AS ( SELECT o.DLC_NAME, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) AS max_area, MIN(r.AREA) AS min_area, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_dept_area FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 40 GROUP BY o.DLC_NAME, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ), overall_avg_area AS ( SELECT AVG(AREA) AS overall_avg_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS WHERE AREA > 40 ) SELECT icte.DLC_NAME, icte.avg_org_level, icte.org_level_stddev, drae.ORGANIZATION_NAME, drae.max_area, drae.min_area, (drae.avg_dept_area - oaa.overall_avg_area) AS diff_from_overall_avg FROM inner_cte icte JOIN dept_room_area_ext drae ON icte.DLC_NAME = drae.DLC_NAME CROSS JOIN overall_avg_area oaa ORDER BY icte.DLC_NAME, diff_from_overall_avg DESC;

question: For each academic year and department, show the academic year, academic year description, department name, the variance of the record count of tip details for terms that are current or previous terms, the range of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered for terms that are not the current term, and the variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered for terms that are not the current term. Include subtotals for each academic year (the corresponding academic year field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all academic years (the corresponding academic year field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the academic year if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by academic year and department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH RecordCountVariance AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON TIP_DETAIL.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), EnrolledStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT rcv.ACADEMIC_YEAR, rcv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, rcv.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS dept, rcv.record_count_variance, es.enrolled_range, es.enrolled_variance FROM RecordCountVariance rcv JOIN EnrolledStats es ON rcv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = es.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AND rcv.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = es.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY academic_year_sort, academic_year, dept_sort) = ACADEMIC_YEAR THEN NULL ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS academic_year, CASE WHEN LAG(ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) OVER (ORDER BY academic_year_sort, academic_year, dept_sort) = ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC THEN NULL ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC END AS academic_year_desc, dept, record_count_variance, enrolled_range, enrolled_variance FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(dept) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS academic_year_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(dept) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(dept) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS ACADEMIC_YEAR, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) = 1 AND GROUPING(dept) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC END AS academic_year_desc_sort, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(dept) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE dept END AS dept_sort, dept, SUM(record_count_variance) AS record_count_variance, MAX(enrolled_range) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(enrolled_variance) AS enrolled_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, dept WITH ROLLUP ) tbltmp ORDER BY academic_year_sort, dept_sort;

question: For each tip detail record where the material status key is 'RQ' and the term description matches one of the top 3 most frequently offered IAP activities (considering only activities that are not cancelled), and where the IAP activity has a maximum enrollment of at least 10, show the subject ID, term description, term start date, tip material key, the average record count in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the financial aid year, the activity title, max enrollment, the IAP activity's term description, the academic year description, and the IAP activity's enrollment type, ordered by the subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, AVG(t1.RECORD_COUNT) OVER ( PARTITION BY t0.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ), TopIAPActivities AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t.TERM_CODE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON d.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ta ON t.TERM_CODE = ta.TERM_CODE WHERE d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND d.ACTIVITY_TITLE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t.TERM_CODE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 3 ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.TERM_START_DATE, icte.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, icte.window_column, tia.ACTIVITY_TITLE, tia.MAX_ENROLLMENT, tia.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS IAP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, tia.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, tia.ENROLLMENT_TYPE FROM inner_cte icte JOIN TopIAPActivities tia ON icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION = tia.TERM_DESCRIPTION WHERE tia.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 10 ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_ID;

question: Show the Mathematics department courses with at least 5 enrolled students, including the course number, subject title, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, the row number within each academic year group ordered by course number, the term start date, calendar date, day of week, the average calendar year within each calendar year group ordered by term start date, and for each course, also display the responsible faculty name and the offer school name, but only for academic terms where the term status is 'Previous'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 ), PreviousTerms AS ( SELECT t1.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t0.CALENDAR_DATE, t0.DAY_OF_WEEK, AVG(t0.CALENDAR_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.CALENDAR_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_START_DATE) AS window_column FROM TIME_DAY t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.CALENDAR_DATE = t1.TERM_START_DATE WHERE t1.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ) SELECT ic.COURSE_NUMBER, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.window_column AS math_window_column, pt.TERM_START_DATE, pt.CALENDAR_DATE, pt.DAY_OF_WEEK, pt.window_column AS previous_terms_window_column, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte ic JOIN PreviousTerms pt ON ic.TERM_CODE = pt.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ic.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER AND ic.TERM_CODE = lso.TERM_CODE ORDER BY ic.COURSE_NUMBER, pt.TERM_START_DATE;

question: For each of the top 10 departments by the number of unique subjects they offered in academic years 2014 or later, show the department name, the count of unique subject titles, and for each department also provide the average, minimum, and maximum number of enrolled students per subject offered by that department in the term 2017SP, with the columns in the following order: department name, count of unique subject titles, average number of enrolled students per subject in 2017SP, minimum number of enrolled students per subject in 2017SP, and maximum number of enrolled students per subject in 2017SP. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2014 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.subject_count, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students_2017SP, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students_2017SP, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled_students_2017SP FROM inner_cte ic JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2017SP' GROUP BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.subject_count ORDER BY ic.subject_count DESC, avg_enrolled_students_2017SP DESC;

question: From the top 10 organizations (by the number of associated space units with code 402100), display each organization's name, the count of such space units, its assignable status, the HR department most frequently associated with its HR org units (where the HR department name is not null), and the count of HR org units for that department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 402100 ), org_space_counts AS ( SELECT t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.ASSIGNABLE, COUNT(t2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS space_unit_count FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 JOIN SPACE_UNIT t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 402100 GROUP BY t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.ASSIGNABLE ), org_hr_dept_counts AS ( SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS hr_unit_count FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ), org_hr_dept_ranked AS ( SELECT ohdc.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ohdc.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ohdc.hr_unit_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ohdc.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY ohdc.hr_unit_count DESC) AS dept_rank FROM org_hr_dept_counts ohdc ) SELECT osc.ORGANIZATION_NAME, osc.space_unit_count, osc.ASSIGNABLE, ohr.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Most_Frequent_HR_Department, ohr.hr_unit_count AS HR_Unit_Count FROM org_space_counts osc LEFT JOIN org_hr_dept_ranked ohr ON osc.ORGANIZATION_NAME = ohr.ORGANIZATION_NAME AND ohr.dept_rank = 1 ORDER BY osc.space_unit_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each department name and course level where the department is degree granting, the number of unique students is at least 10, and the average number of enrolled students in courses with at least one associated course material is greater than 30, provide the department name, course level, number of unique students, minimum CIP program code among their courses, average enrollment, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrollment, and the total number of courses offered by the department at that level, listing the results in descending order of enrollment standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL ), DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.COURSE_LEVEL, icte.student_count, icte.min_cip_code, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_stddev, COUNT(scd2.COURSE) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte icte JOIN DepartmentEnrollmentStats des ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd2 ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.COURSE_LEVEL = scd2.COURSE_LEVEL WHERE des.avg_enrollment > 30 AND icte.student_count >= 10 GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.COURSE_LEVEL, icte.student_count, icte.min_cip_code, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_stddev ORDER BY des.enrollment_stddev DESC;

question: For subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering with a total of at least 6 units, show the subject code, subject title, department name, the running sum of total units within each grade type, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only departments that grant degrees and subjects with more than 0 total units), and also include the number of subjects offered by each department, ordered by subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ), DeptStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), Combined AS ( SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.window_column, d.avg_total_units, d.total_units_variance, d.total_units_stddev, d.num_subjects FROM inner_cte i JOIN DeptStats d ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column, avg_total_units, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev, num_subjects FROM Combined ORDER BY SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For each subject offered in the Fall term of 2022, show the subject title, department name, term code, academic year, and the average academic year within each academic year group ordered by term start date, along with the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses offered by that department (considering only courses that have at least one associated TIP material). Also, include the school name and department phone number for each department. List the results ordered by department name and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.TERM_CODE, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY a.TERM_START_DATE) AS avg_academic_year FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON ata.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON a.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE WHERE a.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ), DeptEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS num_enrolled_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS num_enrolled_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.TERM_CODE, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.avg_academic_year, des.num_enrolled_variance, des.num_enrolled_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM inner_cte ic JOIN DeptEnrollmentStats des ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.department LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each room on floor 2 with access level 2, show the building room identifier, room number, major use description, building name, building type, city, state, and the minimum floor number in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the building key. Additionally, for each academic year in which a course is scheduled in that room and has library reserve materials with a material status of 'U', show the academic year, the academic year description, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for all such library reserve materials offered in that year, and the deviation of the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) from the average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all rooms. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.ROOM, t0.MAJOR_USE_DESC, t1.BUILDING_NAME, t1.BUILDING_TYPE, t2.CITY, t2.STATE, MIN(t0.FLOOR) OVER (ORDER BY t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY FROM FCLT_ROOMS t0 JOIN FCLT_BUILDING t1 ON t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS t2 ON t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2 AND t0.ACCESS_LEVEL = 2 ), YearlyLibraryStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE HAVING AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), AvgCoeffVar AS ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM YearlyLibraryStats ), CombinedRoomLibrary AS ( SELECT inner_cte.BUILDING_ROOM, inner_cte.ROOM, inner_cte.MAJOR_USE_DESC, inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME, inner_cte.BUILDING_TYPE, inner_cte.CITY, inner_cte.STATE, inner_cte.window_column, YearlyLibraryStats.ACADEMIC_YEAR, YearlyLibraryStats.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, YearlyLibraryStats.coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte JOIN YearlyLibraryStats ON inner_cte.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = YearlyLibraryStats.MEET_PLACE ) SELECT c.BUILDING_ROOM, c.ROOM, c.MAJOR_USE_DESC, c.BUILDING_NAME, c.BUILDING_TYPE, c.CITY, c.STATE, c.window_column, c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, c.coefficient_of_variation, (c.coefficient_of_variation - a.avg_coefficient_of_variation) AS deviation_from_avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM CombinedRoomLibrary c CROSS JOIN AvgCoeffVar a ORDER BY c.BUILDING_ROOM, c.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each space unit with a warehouse load date of '19-DEC-24', what is the space unit name, the associated organization name, the average, range, and variance of the HR department codes for the HR org units linked to that space unit (considering only HR org units with a warehouse load date of '03-DEC-24'), as well as the average and variance of the HR department codes (old) for all associated HR org units where the organization is assignable and the HR department name is not null? Additionally, for each result, provide the number of unique HR org unit titles associated with the space unit. List the results ordered by the HR department code range (descending), then by the variance of the HR department codes (old) (descending), and then by the count of unique HR org unit titles (descending). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS avg_hr_dept_code, MAX(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) - MIN(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS hr_dept_code_range, VARIANCE(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS hr_dept_code_variance, fo.DLC_KEY FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE su.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND hou.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '03-DEC-24' GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fo.DLC_KEY ORDER BY hr_dept_code_range DESC ), OrgStats AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS avg_dept_code_old, VARIANCE(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS var_dept_code_old, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = HR_ORG_UNIT.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY ORDER BY var_dept_code_old DESC ), HRUnitTitleCounts AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(DISTINCT hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE) AS unique_hr_org_unit_titles, fo.DLC_KEY FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE su.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND hou.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '03-DEC-24' GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.DLC_KEY ) SELECT icte.SPACE_UNIT, icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.avg_hr_dept_code, icte.hr_dept_code_range, icte.hr_dept_code_variance, ost.avg_dept_code_old, ost.var_dept_code_old, htc.unique_hr_org_unit_titles FROM inner_cte icte JOIN OrgStats ost ON icte.DLC_KEY = ost.DLC_KEY JOIN HRUnitTitleCounts htc ON icte.SPACE_UNIT = htc.SPACE_UNIT AND icte.DLC_KEY = htc.DLC_KEY ORDER BY icte.hr_dept_code_range DESC, ost.var_dept_code_old DESC, htc.unique_hr_org_unit_titles DESC;

question: For each subject code where the department is degree granting and the department budget code is greater than 100000, show the subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, rank of the subject code within each school name group ordered by subject code, the number of subject codes for each department and subject code, and the minimum department budget code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), DepartmentSubjectStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.window_column, dss.subject_code_count, dss.min_dept_budget_code FROM inner_cte ic JOIN DepartmentSubjectStats dss ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.SUBJECT_CODE = dss.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE dss.min_dept_budget_code > 100000 ORDER BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.window_column;

question: For each academic term that is marked as the current term and for each subject offered in the term with the parameter 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM', list the term code, term description, academic year, the number of subjects offered, the total subject enrollment number for that term, the subject title, offering department name, responsible faculty name, academic year description, the minimum number of enrolled students in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the academic year, and the department name and school name for each subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH CurrentTermSummary AS ( SELECT atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), CurrentTermSubjects AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM' ) SELECT cts.TERM_CODE, cts.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cts.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cts.subject_count, cts.total_enrollment, csub.SUBJECT_TITLE, csub.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, csub.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, csub.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, csub.window_column, csub.SUBJECT_ID FROM CurrentTermSummary cts JOIN CurrentTermSubjects csub ON cts.TERM_CODE = csub.TERM_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.total_enrollment, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.window_column, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each subject that has at least 5 TIP materials with status 'RQ' and where the average number of enrolled students for those subjects is greater than 10, list the subject ID, subject title, the number of TIP materials with status 'RQ', and the average number of enrolled students. Only include subjects where at least one associated library reserve material detail has a library material status key of 'U'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT l.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(CASE WHEN ic.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' THEN 1 END) AS rq_material_count, AVG(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte ic WHERE ic.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN ic.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' THEN 1 END) >= 5 AND AVG(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10 ORDER BY rq_material_count DESC, avg_enrolled_students DESC;

question: For each major use description where the total area of rooms is greater than the average room area across all rooms, show the major use description and the total area. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MAJOR_USE_DESC, SUM(AREA) AS total_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS GROUP BY MAJOR_USE_DESC ) SELECT MAJOR_USE_DESC, total_area FROM inner_cte WHERE total_area > ( SELECT AVG(AREA) FROM FCLT_ROOMS );

question: For each organization that has both rooms on floor 2 or higher and at least one associated space unit with a non-null DLC key, and where the average access level of rooms assigned to that organization is greater than the overall average access level across all rooms, list the organization name, the average access level of rooms assigned to that organization, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of those access levels, the average space unit code assigned to the organization, the variance of those space unit codes, and calculate the access to space ratio rounded (average access level divided by average space unit code).
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH OrgAccessStats AS ( SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(ACCESS_LEVEL) AS avg_access_level, STDDEV(ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_stddev FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE FLOOR >= 2 GROUP BY ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY access_level_stddev DESC ), DeptSpaceStats AS ( SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS avg_space_unit_code, VARIANCE(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS var_space_unit_code FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fodk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON fodk.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE fodk.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY var_space_unit_code DESC ) SELECT oas.ORGANIZATION_NAME, oas.avg_access_level, oas.access_level_stddev, dss.avg_space_unit_code, dss.var_space_unit_code, ROUND(oas.avg_access_level / NULLIF(dss.avg_space_unit_code, 0), 2) AS access_to_space_ratio FROM OrgAccessStats oas JOIN DeptSpaceStats dss ON oas.ORGANIZATION_NAME = dss.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY access_to_space_ratio DESC ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_access_level > ( SELECT AVG(ACCESS_LEVEL) FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD );

question: For each department and academic year where the subject enrollment number is greater than 10, and for each activity title and sponsor name where the maximum enrollment is greater than 10 and the activity occurs in the same academic year, provide the department name, academic year, number of unique subjects, minimum total units offered, activity title, sponsor name, number of unique activities, minimum fee, and the number of unique sponsor types for those activities, listing the columns in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), ActivitySponsorStats AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s.SPONSOR_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS activity_count, MIN(d.FEE) AS min_fee, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SPONSOR_TYPE) AS sponsor_type_count, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON d.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s.SPONSOR_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.subject_count, icte.min_total_units, ass.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ass.SPONSOR_NAME, ass.activity_count, ass.min_fee, ass.sponsor_type_count FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ActivitySponsorStats ass ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ass.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ass.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ass.SPONSOR_NAME ;

question: For each school, display the school name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year, and for each degree-granting course in the School of Engineering, show the course description, department name, and the dense rank of each course considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the department's budget code. Additionally, for each department in the School of Engineering, show the total number of degree-granting courses, and include a grand total for all departments in the format of (null, total courses). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION d ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = d.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON d.COURSE = c.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ), engineering_courses AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), DepartmentCourseCounts AS ( SELECT t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.COURSE) AS total_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(total_courses) AS total_courses FROM DepartmentCourseCounts GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(total_courses) > 0 ) SELECT icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.avg_total_units, icte.stddev_total_units, ec.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ec.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ec.window_column, rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS rollup_department_name, rr.total_courses FROM inner_cte icte JOIN engineering_courses ec ON icte.SCHOOL_NAME = ec.SCHOOL_NAME LEFT JOIN RollupResults rr ON ec.DEPARTMENT_NAME = rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.SCHOOL_NAME, ec.window_column, rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: For each department, display the department name, the average, range, and variance of the area of rooms assigned to it (considering only rooms with an area greater than 40), as well as the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in regular academic terms, and classify each department as 'LARGE_ROOM_DEPT' if its average room area is at least 20% greater than the average total units, 'SMALL_UNIT_DEPT' if its average total units is at least 20% less than the average room area, or 'BALANCED' otherwise. Show the columns in the following order: department name, average area, area range, area variance, average total units, total units range, total units variance, and department classification. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.avg_area, d1.area_range, d1.area_variance, d2.avg_total_units, d2.total_units_range, d2.total_units_variance FROM ( SELECT o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_area, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 40 GROUP BY o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY area_range DESC ) d1 JOIN ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) d2 ON d1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_area, inner_cte.area_range, inner_cte.area_variance, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.total_units_range, inner_cte.total_units_variance, CASE WHEN inner_cte.avg_area > inner_cte.avg_total_units * 1.2 THEN 'LARGE_ROOM_DEPT' WHEN inner_cte.avg_total_units < inner_cte.avg_area * 0.8 THEN 'SMALL_UNIT_DEPT' ELSE 'BALANCED' END AS department_classification FROM inner_cte;

question: For each department, display the department's name, the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2022 and that are also listed in the CIS course catalog, as well as the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for all courses offered by that department. Only include departments where the range of total units for subjects in 2022 is greater than the average range across all departments. Show the results ordered by the range of total units for subjects in 2022 in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH dept_subject_stats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), dept_course_stats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.units_range, dss.units_variance, dcs.total_units_range, dcs.total_units_variance, dcs.total_units_stddev FROM dept_subject_stats dss JOIN dept_course_stats dcs ON dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte WHERE units_range > (SELECT AVG(units_range) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY units_range DESC;

question: For each major use description and organization name where the room area is greater than 100 and the access level is 1, display the number of rooms, the minimum floor number, the range of the space unit codes associated with the organization, the variance of the space unit codes, and the total number of unique space units for each organization. For each major use description and organization name, include a grand total for all space units in the format of (major use description, organization name, null, null, null, total space units). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH room_stats AS ( SELECT r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count, MIN(r.FLOOR) AS min_floor, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 100 AND r.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 GROUP BY r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ), org_code_stats AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAX(SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) - MIN(SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS code_range, VARIANCE(SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS code_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS total_space_units, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN SPACE_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = SPACE_UNIT.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) SELECT rs.MAJOR_USE_DESC, rs.ORGANIZATION_NAME, rs.room_count, rs.min_floor, ocs.code_range, ocs.code_variance, ocs.total_space_units FROM room_stats rs JOIN org_code_stats ocs ON rs.ORGANIZATION_NAME = ocs.ORGANIZATION_NAME AND rs.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = ocs.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) , RollupResults AS ( SELECT MAJOR_USE_DESC, ORGANIZATION_NAME, min_floor, code_range, code_variance, SUM(total_space_units) AS total_space_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY MAJOR_USE_DESC, ORGANIZATION_NAME, min_floor, code_range, code_variance WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(total_space_units) > 0 ) SELECT rr.MAJOR_USE_DESC, rr.ORGANIZATION_NAME, rr.min_floor, rr.code_range, rr.code_variance, rr.total_space_units FROM RollupResults rr ORDER BY rr.MAJOR_USE_DESC, rr.ORGANIZATION_NAME, rr.total_space_units DESC ;

question: For each degree-granting department that offers at least one subject with more than 0 total units, show the department name, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units, and, if available, the total number of tip materials and the total number of unique subjects offered by that department in the School of Engineering during regular terms where the total number of tip materials is greater than 10. Order the results by the variance of the total units in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), eng_tip_materials_subjects AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_materials, COUNT(DISTINCT t.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects FROM TIP_DETAIL t JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) > 10 ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_total_units, d.total_units_variance, d.total_units_stddev, e.total_tip_materials, e.total_subjects FROM inner_cte d LEFT JOIN eng_tip_materials_subjects e ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = e.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d.total_units_variance DESC;

question: For subjects offered in the current SIS term, show the subject title, offering department name, responsible faculty name, term description, academic year description, and the minimum number of enrolled students in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the academic year. Additionally, for each person role, show the person role name, the average, range, and variance of the maximum enrollment values for the activities they lead (considering only activities that are not cancelled and have a specified maximum enrollment), and also include the total number of activities led by each person role. Present all these columns together in the result: subject title, offering department name, responsible faculty name, term description, academic year description, windowed minimum enrolled students, person role, average maximum enrollment, maximum enrollment range, maximum enrollment variance, and total activities led. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM' ), person_role_enrollment_stats AS ( SELECT p.PERSON_ROLE, AVG(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, MAX(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) - MIN(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_range, VARIANCE(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance, COUNT(*) AS total_activities_led FROM IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON p JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d ON p.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY WHERE d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.PERSON_ROLE ORDER BY max_enrollment_range DESC ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s.window_column, p.PERSON_ROLE, p.avg_max_enrollment, p.max_enrollment_range, p.max_enrollment_variance, p.total_activities_led FROM inner_cte s CROSS JOIN person_role_enrollment_stats p;

question: For each department, list the department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students per subject offered by that department in the term 2019FA, as well as the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects that had library reserve materials in terms with a term status of 'Previous', and for each department, also include the number of unique subjects offered in 2019FA and the number of unique subjects with library reserve materials in 'Previous' terms, with the columns in the following order: department name, enrolled student range, enrolled student variance, enrolled student standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), number of subjects offered in 2019FA, average total units, total units variance, total units standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), number of subjects with library reserve materials in 'Previous' terms. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DepartmentEnrolledStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_2019FA FROM STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC ), DepartmentUnitsStats AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_with_lib_reserve FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.enrolled_range, des.enrolled_variance, des.enrolled_stddev, des.num_subjects_2019FA, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev, dus.num_subjects_with_lib_reserve FROM DepartmentEnrolledStats des JOIN DepartmentUnitsStats dus ON des.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY des.enrolled_range DESC, dus.total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte;

question: For each organization whose parent is 'S H&SS', show the organization name, description, HR org unit title, the HR department name, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the organization name, and, for each such organization, also display the range and variance of the space unit codes associated with it (considering only organizations with a non-null description and space units with a non-null space unit name). List the columns in the following order: organization name, description, HR org unit title, HR department name, window row number, code range, and code variance. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.ORG_PARENT = 'S H&SS' ), org_space_stats AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAX(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) - MIN(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS code_range, VARIANCE(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS code_variance FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY odk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON odk.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL AND su.SPACE_UNIT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.DESCRIPTION, icte.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, icte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.window_column, oss.code_range, oss.code_variance FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN org_space_stats oss ON icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = oss.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY icte.window_column

question: For each department that is degree-granting and in the School of Engineering with a total number of students enrolled in its offered courses greater than 50, what is the department name, the average number of enrolled students in offered subjects (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students), the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in those subjects, the total number of students enrolled in courses offered by that department, and for each department, include a grand total row for all departments in the format of (null, null, null, null, grand total enrolled students)? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC ), EngineeringDeptTotals AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_enrollment, d.enrollment_variance, d.enrollment_stddev, e.total_enrollment FROM DeptEnrollmentStats d JOIN EngineeringDeptTotals e ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = e.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_enrollment, enrollment_variance, enrollment_stddev, total_enrollment FROM ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_enrollment, enrollment_variance, enrollment_stddev, total_enrollment FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_enrollment, NULL AS enrollment_variance, NULL AS enrollment_stddev, SUM(total_enrollment) AS total_enrollment FROM inner_cte ) t ORDER BY CASE WHEN DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each degree-granting department and course level, provide the number of unique students, the minimum CIP program code among their courses, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrolled students in courses with at least one associated course material, and the number of such courses offered by the department at that level. Show the department name, course level, student count, minimum CIP program code, average enrollment, enrollment standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and course count in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL ), DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS course_count FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL IS NOT NULL WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.COURSE_LEVEL, icte.student_count, icte.min_cip_code, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_stddev, des.course_count FROM inner_cte icte JOIN DepartmentEnrollmentStats des ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND icte.COURSE_LEVEL = des.COURSE_LEVEL ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.COURSE_LEVEL;

question: For IAP subject activities in term '2021JA' that are not cancelled and have a maximum enrollment of at least 20, show the activity title, enrollment type, maximum enrollment, session title, session location, session date, session start time, session end time, the minimum session start time over each session location group, the academic year, and whether the maximum enrollment is 'HIGH_CAPACITY' (at least 50), 'LOW_CAPACITY' (less than 25), or 'MEDIUM_CAPACITY' (otherwise), ordered by session location. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, s.SESSION_TITLE, s.SESSION_LOCATION, s.SESSION_DATE, s.SESSION_START_TIME, s.SESSION_END_TIME, MIN(s.SESSION_START_TIME) OVER (PARTITION BY s.SESSION_LOCATION ORDER BY s.SESSION_LOCATION) AS min_start_time_per_location, d.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY WHERE d.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' AND d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' ) SELECT i.ACTIVITY_TITLE, i.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, i.MAX_ENROLLMENT, i.SESSION_TITLE, i.SESSION_LOCATION, i.SESSION_DATE, i.SESSION_START_TIME, i.SESSION_END_TIME, i.min_start_time_per_location, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, CASE WHEN i.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 50 THEN 'HIGH_CAPACITY' WHEN i.MAX_ENROLLMENT < 25 THEN 'LOW_CAPACITY' ELSE 'MEDIUM_CAPACITY' END AS capacity_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN TIME_DAY t0 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE = i.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON i.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20 ORDER BY i.SESSION_LOCATION;

question: For each department where the total number of subject enrollments for subjects offered in the current term is greater than 10, and for each course number in that department where the number of enrolled students in the subject summary is greater than 2, provide the department name, the total number of subject enrollments, the course number, the number of unique library subjects offered, the minimum total units for those subjects, and the name of the responsible faculty member for each course. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT de.DEPARTMENT_NAME, de.total_enrollments, lss.COURSE_NUMBER, lss.subject_count, lss.min_total_units FROM ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollments FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER p JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON p.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 10 ) de JOIN ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER ) lss ON de.DEPARTMENT_NAME = lss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_enrollments, ic.COURSE_NUMBER, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units, sos.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte ic JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND ic.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_enrollments, ic.COURSE_NUMBER, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units, sos.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME;

question: For each DLC and academic year where the DLC name matches the department name and the term status is 'Previous', provide the DLC key, DLC name, coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of rooms assigned to organizations in that DLC (considering only rooms with an area greater than 0), academic year, department name, the number of unique subjects offered, the minimum total units for those subjects, and the average lecture units for those subjects, listing the columns in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DLC_RoomAreaStats AS ( SELECT FODK.DLC_KEY, FO.DLC_NAME, STDDEV(FR.AREA)/NULLIF(AVG(FR.AREA),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY FODK JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION FO ON FODK.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS FR ON FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FR.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE FR.AREA > 0 GROUP BY FODK.DLC_KEY, FO.DLC_NAME HAVING AVG(FR.AREA) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), AcademicYearDeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT d.DLC_KEY, d.DLC_NAME, d.coefficient_of_variation, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.subject_count, a.min_total_units FROM DLC_RoomAreaStats d JOIN AcademicYearDeptSubjectStats a ON d.DLC_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DLC_KEY, inner_cte.DLC_NAME, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.min_total_units, AVG(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) AS avg_lecture_units FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY inner_cte.DLC_KEY, inner_cte.DLC_NAME, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.min_total_units ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC;

question: For each subject offered in the term with code '2012SU', show the subject title, subject ID, offer department name, academic year, term description, the minimum number of enrolled students in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the academic year, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for that subject (considering only subjects offered by the "Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog" department and with more than 5 offerings), and the highest number of enrolled students that subject has ever had in any term. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH SubjectUnitsStddev AS ( SELECT sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON so.COMPOSITE_SUBJECT_KEY = sos.COMPOSITE_SUBJECT_KEY WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' GROUP BY sos.SUBJECT_TITLE HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY total_units_stddev DESC ), Subjects2012SU AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, MIN(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' ) SELECT s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.window_column, s1.total_units_stddev FROM Subjects2012SU s2 JOIN SubjectUnitsStddev s1 ON s2.SUBJECT_TITLE = s1.SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.window_column, icte.total_units_stddev, max_enroll.max_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ( SELECT so.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled_students FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so GROUP BY so.SUBJECT_TITLE ) max_enroll ON icte.SUBJECT_TITLE = max_enroll.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each academic year, show the academic year, the academic year description, the geometric mean of the number of library reserve material details per subject offered (for records where the material status is 'U' and the academic term is a regular term), the geometric mean of the degree year from all academic terms where the degree year is greater than 1900, and a performance category for the geometric mean of materials per subject: 'HIGH_PERFORMER' if the geometric mean is at least 10% greater than the average across all years, 'LOW_PERFORMER' if at least 10% less, otherwise 'AVERAGE'. Show the academic year, academic year description, geometric mean of materials per subject, geometric mean of degree year, and performance category. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH GeometricMeanMaterialsPerSubject AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(material_count))) AS geometric_mean_materials_per_subject FROM ( SELECT LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count, LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE ) sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON sub.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), GeometricMeanDegreeYear AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(ACADEMIC_TERMS.DEGREE_YEAR))) AS geometric_mean_degree_year FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.DEGREE_YEAR > 1900 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT m.ACADEMIC_YEAR, m.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, m.geometric_mean_materials_per_subject, d.geometric_mean_degree_year FROM GeometricMeanMaterialsPerSubject m LEFT JOIN GeometricMeanDegreeYear d ON m.ACADEMIC_YEAR = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) , avg_materials AS ( SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_materials_per_subject) AS avg_geom_materials FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.geometric_mean_materials_per_subject, i.geometric_mean_degree_year, CASE WHEN i.geometric_mean_materials_per_subject > a.avg_geom_materials * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_PERFORMER' WHEN i.geometric_mean_materials_per_subject < a.avg_geom_materials * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_PERFORMER' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS performance_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_materials a ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year, the academic year description, the geometric mean of the record counts of required course materials (where the record count is greater than zero) for all subjects offered in that year, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for all library reserve materials offered in terms that have a material status of 'U', and the number of unique departments that offered subjects in that year? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH GeometricMeanRecordCount AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), CoefficientOfVariation AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR, gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gmr.geometric_mean_record_count, cov.coefficient_of_variation FROM GeometricMeanRecordCount gmr JOIN CoefficientOfVariation cov ON gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR = cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND gmr.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = cov.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_record_count, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, COUNT(DISTINCT cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS unique_departments FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON ata.TERM_CODE = cso.TERM_CODE GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_record_count, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each space unit with a space unit key greater than 100000 and with rooms on floor 2, what is the name of the space unit, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the access levels of its associated rooms on floor 2, the organization name, the HR department name, the sum of space unit keys within each warehouse load date group, and the HR org unit title of the department associated with the rooms, ordered by access level variance (descending) and the sum of space unit keys (descending)? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH SpaceUnitAccessStats AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, VARIANCE(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_variance, STDDEV(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_stddev FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD zr ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = zr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE zr.FLOOR = 2 GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ORDER BY access_level_variance DESC ), SpaceUnitOrgWindow AS ( SELECT t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE ORDER BY t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM SPACE_UNIT t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000 ) SELECT s.SPACE_UNIT, s.access_level_variance, s.access_level_stddev, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.window_column, zr.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM SpaceUnitAccessStats s JOIN SpaceUnitOrgWindow o ON s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = o.SPACE_UNIT_CODE JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD zr ON s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = zr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE zr.FLOOR = 2 ) SELECT inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT, inner_cte.access_level_variance, inner_cte.access_level_stddev, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE FROM inner_cte JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = h.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID ORDER BY inner_cte.access_level_variance DESC, inner_cte.window_column DESC;

question: For subjects offered in the term with code '2019FA' that have total units greater than 1, show the subject title, the dense rank of each subject considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the academic year, the subject ID, the department name, the running sum of total units within each school ordered by subject ID, and the average number of enrolled students per subject within each department for that term. Do not return any rounded answers.
