SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH SubjectDenseRank AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ), SubjectUnitSum AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS > 1 ) SELECT sdr.SUBJECT_TITLE, sdr.window_column AS subject_dense_rank, sus.SUBJECT_ID, sus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sus.window_column AS running_sum_total_units FROM SubjectDenseRank sdr JOIN SubjectUnitSum sus ON sdr.SUBJECT_ID = sus.SUBJECT_ID ) , DeptAvgEnrolled AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_enrolled FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss WHERE ss.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 1 GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.subject_dense_rank, icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.running_sum_total_units, dae.avg_enrolled AS avg_enrolled_per_subject_in_dept FROM inner_cte icte JOIN DeptAvgEnrolled dae ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dae.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each academic year, which subjects offered in the fall term have an above-average number of enrolled students compared to the average enrollment for that year, and what is the minimum academic year and the sum of total units for subjects that are offered in the fall term, considering only library reserve material details with material status 'U'? Please provide the academic year, subject id, subject title, number of enrolled students, minimum academic year, and total units sum in this order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_TITLE, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), avg_enrollment_per_year AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ), min_year_total_units AS ( SELECT MIN(at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_sum FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, mytu.min_academic_year, mytu.total_units_sum FROM inner_cte i JOIN avg_enrollment_per_year a ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR CROSS JOIN min_year_total_units mytu WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_enrollment ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC;

question: For each department, provide the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one associated course material. Additionally, for subjects in the "Engineering" school with total units equal to 1 in that department, show the subject ID, subject title, department name, academic year, the rank of each subject within its academic year group ordered by subject ID, and the term description for each subject. Present the results ordered by the enrollment standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) in descending order, then by academic year and subject rank. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_stddev DESC ) SELECT des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_stddev, es.SUBJECT_ID, es.SUBJECT_TITLE, es.DEPARTMENT_NAME, es.ACADEMIC_YEAR, es.window_column, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte des JOIN ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t1.TERM_CODE FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 1 ) es ON des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = es.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ata ON es.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE ORDER BY des.enrollment_stddev DESC, es.ACADEMIC_YEAR, es.window_column;

question: For each subject category and academic year where the subject has a maximum enrollment greater than 10, what is the subject category key, academic year, number of unique subjects, minimum academic term start date, the academic year description, the geometric mean of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during that year (considering only subjects with more than zero enrolled students), and the total number of TIP materials assigned in that academic year? List the results ordered by academic year descending and subject category key. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH GeometricMeanEnrollment AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), SubjectCategoryStats AS ( SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT i.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT s.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, s.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.subject_count, s.min_term_start_date, g.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, g.geometric_mean_enrollment FROM SubjectCategoryStats s JOIN GeometricMeanEnrollment g ON s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT inner_cte.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.min_term_start_date, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_enrollment, COALESCE(tip_stats.total_tip_materials, 0) AS total_tip_materials FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS total_tip_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL t JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) tip_stats ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = tip_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC, inner_cte.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY;

question: For each building with more than 100 rooms and each organization with assignable status and a non-null DLC key, list the building's long name, the organization's name, the total number of rooms in that building assigned to the organization with area greater than 300, the average area of those rooms, the name of the space unit, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the organization numbers for all organizations linked to that space unit, and the department code of the room. Include subtotals for each building (the corresponding building name field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all buildings (the corresponding building name field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the building name if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by building name and organization name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, t0.ROOM_FULL_NAME, t0.AREA, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t0.DEPT_CODE, t1.NUM_OF_ROOMS FROM FCLT_ROOMS t0 JOIN FCLT_BUILDING t1 ON t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE t0.AREA > 300 AND t1.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 100 ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(BUILDING_NAME_LONG) OVER (ORDER BY building_sort, org_sort) = BUILDING_NAME_LONG THEN NULL ELSE BUILDING_NAME_LONG END AS building_name_long, ORGANIZATION_NAME, room_count, avg_area, SPACE_UNIT, org_number_variance, org_number_stddev, DEPT_CODE FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(BUILDING_NAME_LONG) = 1 AND GROUPING(ORGANIZATION_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE BUILDING_NAME_LONG END AS building_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(BUILDING_NAME_LONG) = 0 AND GROUPING(ORGANIZATION_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(BUILDING_NAME_LONG) = 1 AND GROUPING(ORGANIZATION_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE BUILDING_NAME_LONG END AS BUILDING_NAME_LONG, CASE WHEN GROUPING(BUILDING_NAME_LONG) = 0 AND GROUPING(ORGANIZATION_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE ORGANIZATION_NAME END AS org_sort, ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ROOM_FULL_NAME) AS room_count, AVG(AREA) AS avg_area, MAX(SPACE_UNIT) AS SPACE_UNIT, VARIANCE(ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance, STDDEV(ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev, MAX(DEPT_CODE) AS DEPT_CODE FROM inner_cte rw JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON rw.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT s ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = s.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND s.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY BUILDING_NAME_LONG, ORGANIZATION_NAME WITH ROLLUP ) tbltmp ORDER BY building_sort, org_sort;

question: For each department in the Provost Area, show the department code, department name, school area name, the rank of each department within its school area based on department code, the space unit code, the organization name, the HR department name from the space unit, the sum of space unit keys within each warehouse load date group for space units with a space unit key greater than 100000, and for each school area, include a grand total of the sum of space unit keys in the format of (nulls for department and space unit columns, school area name, nulls for other columns, total sum). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH ProvostDepartments AS ( SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 INNER JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' ), SpaceUnitStats AS ( SELECT t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE ORDER BY t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column, t2.DLC_KEY, t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY FROM SPACE_UNIT t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000 ) SELECT pd.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, pd.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, pd.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, pd.window_column AS department_rank_within_school_area, sus.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, sus.ORGANIZATION_NAME, sus.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS space_unit_hr_department_name, sus.window_column AS sum_space_unit_key_within_warehouse_load_date, sus.SPACE_UNIT_KEY FROM ProvostDepartments pd JOIN SpaceUnitStats sus ON pd.DLC_KEY = sus.DLC_KEY ) , SchoolAreaTotals AS ( SELECT NULL AS HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, NULL AS HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, NULL AS department_rank_within_school_area, NULL AS SPACE_UNIT_CODE, NULL AS ORGANIZATION_NAME, NULL AS space_unit_hr_department_name, NULL AS sum_space_unit_key_within_warehouse_load_date, SUM(SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS total_space_unit_key FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME ) SELECT HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, department_rank_within_school_area, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, ORGANIZATION_NAME, space_unit_hr_department_name, sum_space_unit_key_within_warehouse_load_date, SPACE_UNIT_KEY FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, department_rank_within_school_area, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, ORGANIZATION_NAME, space_unit_hr_department_name, NULL AS sum_space_unit_key_within_warehouse_load_date, total_space_unit_key AS SPACE_UNIT_KEY FROM SchoolAreaTotals ORDER BY ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, SPACE_UNIT_CODE

question: For each IAP subject activity with a maximum enrollment of 30 and each tip detail where the material status key is 'RQ', show the activity title, enrollment type, prerequisites, term code, IAP term description, term start date, term end date, the minimum term start date over each term code group, the tip subject offered key, tip material key, subject ID, tip term description, academic year, the average record count in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by academic year, and the deviation of the average record count from the average record count for the same academic year across all terms, ordered by term code and academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH IAPActivities AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t0.PREREQUISITES, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, min(t1.TERM_START_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.TERM_CODE ORDER BY t0.TERM_CODE) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 30 ), TipMaterialStats AS ( SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(t0.RECORD_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_START_DATE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM TIP_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ) SELECT ia.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ia.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, ia.PREREQUISITES, ia.TERM_CODE, ia.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS IAP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, ia.TERM_START_DATE, ia.TERM_END_DATE, ia.window_column AS IAP_MIN_TERM_START_DATE, tms.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, tms.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, tms.SUBJECT_ID, tms.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS TIP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR, tms.window_column AS TIP_AVG_RECORD_COUNT FROM IAPActivities ia JOIN TipMaterialStats tms ON ia.TERM_CODE = tms.TERM_CODE ) , avg_across_terms AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(window_column) AS avg_record_count_across_terms FROM ( SELECT t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(t0.RECORD_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_START_DATE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ) sub GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT icte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, icte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, icte.PREREQUISITES, icte.TERM_CODE, icte.IAP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.TERM_START_DATE, icte.TERM_END_DATE, icte.IAP_MIN_TERM_START_DATE, icte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, icte.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.TIP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.TIP_AVG_RECORD_COUNT, (icte.TIP_AVG_RECORD_COUNT - aat.avg_record_count_across_terms) AS deviation_from_academic_year_avg FROM inner_cte icte JOIN avg_across_terms aat ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = aat.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY icte.TERM_CODE, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR

question: For each offering department name and school name where the department has at least one course with at least one enrolled student and at least one course material with a material status of 'RQ', and where the number of enrolled students in a course is greater than 2, provide the offering department name, the offering school name, the count of distinct subject IDs, the minimum ISBN value for the associated course materials, the variance of the number of enrolled students in courses with at least one enrolled student and course materials with a material status of 'RQ', and the maximum number of enrolled students in those courses. List the results ordered by the variance of enrolled students in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptEnrolledVariance AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC ), DeptSubjectCounts AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(td.ISBN) AS min_isbn FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT dsc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dsc.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, dsc.subject_count, dsc.min_isbn, dev.enrolled_variance FROM DeptSubjectCounts dsc JOIN DeptEnrolledVariance dev ON dsc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dev.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY dev.enrolled_variance DESC ) SELECT icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, icte.subject_count, icte.min_isbn, icte.enrolled_variance, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte icte JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, icte.subject_count, icte.min_isbn, icte.enrolled_variance ORDER BY icte.enrolled_variance DESC;

question: For each subject offered in the term with the description "Fall Term 2024-2025" and whose offering department is among the top 10 departments by the number of unique subjects offered in academic years 2014 or later, show the subject offered key, subject title, offering department name, the term description, the rank of each subject within its offering department ordered by subject offered key, the count of unique subject titles offered by the department, and the average number of enrolled students for subjects in that department in the same term. Also, classify each subject as 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' if its number of enrolled students is at least 20% greater than the department average, 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' if at least 20% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH subject_ranks AS ( SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' ), top_departments AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2014 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT sr.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, sr.SUBJECT_TITLE, sr.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sr.TERM_DESCRIPTION, sr.window_column, td.subject_count, sr.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM subject_ranks sr JOIN top_departments td ON sr.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = td.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), dept_avg_enrollment AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT i.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.window_column, i.subject_count, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, d.avg_enrollment, CASE WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > d.avg_enrollment * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < d.avg_enrollment * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg_enrollment d ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY i.subject_count DESC, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY;

question: For each subject offered by departments in the School of Engineering, show the subject title, total units, department full name, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title, as well as the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one reserved library material and at least one course material with a non-null ISBN, and also include the number of unique instructors who have taught these subjects, with the average, variance, and instructor count shown for each subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ), subq2 AS ( SELECT tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID) AS instructor_count FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lrm.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.ISBN IS NOT NULL AND lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY tso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, subq2.avg_enrolled, subq2.enrolled_variance, subq2.instructor_count FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN subq2 ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE = subq2.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For each organization and department code, what is the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of rooms assigned to that organization and department code (considering only rooms with a non-null area and department code), as well as the average and variance of the HR department codes (old) for all associated HR org units where the organization is assignable and the HR department name is not null? Additionally, for each result, include the HR org unit title and the HR department name from the HR_ORG_UNIT table (if available). Please provide the organization name, department code, variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of room areas, average HR department code (old), variance of HR department code (old), HR org unit title, and HR department name, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.DEPT_CODE, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA IS NOT NULL AND r.DEPT_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.DEPT_CODE ORDER BY area_variance DESC ) SELECT a.ORGANIZATION_NAME, a.DEPT_CODE, a.area_variance, a.area_stddev, b.avg_dept_code_old, b.var_dept_code_old, c.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, c.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS avg_dept_code_old, VARIANCE(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS var_dept_code_old, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = HR_ORG_UNIT.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY ORDER BY var_dept_code_old DESC ) b ON a.ORGANIZATION_NAME = b.ORGANIZATION_NAME LEFT JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT c ON b.DLC_KEY = c.DLC_KEY AND c.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL ORDER BY a.area_variance DESC, a.ORGANIZATION_NAME, a.DEPT_CODE

question: For each department where the organization is assignable and the organization level is greater than 4, and where the geometric mean of the space unit codes for all associated space units (with code greater than 0) is above 100000, list the department name, the geometric mean of the space unit codes, the number of organizations, the minimum organization number, and the total number of unique space units, ordered by geometric mean descending and then by organization count descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH GeometricMeanByDepartment AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.DLC_KEY, EXP(AVG(LN(s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE))) AS geometric_mean FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT s ON o.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY WHERE s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE > 0 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.DLC_KEY ORDER BY geometric_mean DESC ), OrganizationStats AS ( SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND o.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL > 4 GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT gmd.ORGANIZATION_NAME, gmd.geometric_mean, os.organization_count, os.min_organization_number, gmd.DLC_KEY FROM GeometricMeanByDepartment gmd JOIN OrganizationStats os ON gmd.DLC_KEY = os.DLC_KEY AND gmd.ORGANIZATION_NAME = os.ORGANIZATION_NAME WHERE gmd.geometric_mean > 100000 ) SELECT icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.geometric_mean, icte.organization_count, icte.min_organization_number, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS unique_space_unit_count FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SPACE_UNIT s ON icte.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY WHERE s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE > 0 GROUP BY icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.geometric_mean, icte.organization_count, icte.min_organization_number ORDER BY icte.geometric_mean DESC, icte.organization_count DESC;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year, academic year description, the geometric mean of the number of library reserve material details per subject offered (considering only records where the material status is 'U' and the academic term is a regular term), the average total units, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, and the average number of design units for subjects that are offered in the fall term and have a material status of 'U' in the library reserve? List the results ordered by the geometric mean of materials per subject in descending order, then by the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH GeometricMeanMaterialsPerSubject AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(material_count))) AS geometric_mean_materials_per_subject FROM ( SELECT LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count, LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE ) sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON sub.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), AvgStddevTotalUnitsFallU AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT gmmps.ACADEMIC_YEAR, gmmps.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gmmps.geometric_mean_materials_per_subject, astu.avg_total_units, astu.stddev_total_units FROM GeometricMeanMaterialsPerSubject gmmps JOIN AvgStddevTotalUnitsFallU astu ON gmmps.ACADEMIC_YEAR = astu.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND gmmps.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = astu.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY gmmps.geometric_mean_materials_per_subject DESC, astu.stddev_total_units DESC ) SELECT icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, icte.geometric_mean_materials_per_subject, icte.avg_total_units, icte.stddev_total_units, avg_design.avg_design_units FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.DESIGN_UNITS) AS avg_design_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) avg_design ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = avg_design.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = avg_design.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY icte.geometric_mean_materials_per_subject DESC, icte.stddev_total_units DESC;

question: For each department whose name starts with 'E' (case insensitive), and which offers between 5 and 15 unique courses, and where at least 60% of those courses are degree-granting, provide the department name, the total number of courses it offers, and the number of degree-granting courses. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.COURSE) AS total_courses, SUM(CASE WHEN cd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS degree_granting_courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cd.DEPARTMENT WHERE UPPER(d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) LIKE 'E%' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cd.COURSE) BETWEEN 5 AND 15 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_courses, ic.degree_granting_courses FROM inner_cte ic WHERE ic.degree_granting_courses >= 0.6 * ic.total_courses;

question: For each city, what is the maximum area of a room with at least 300 area, and for each such city, show the department long name, department hierarchy level 3 name, the number of unique facility organization keys, and the minimum organization unit ID for each department where the department hierarchy type is 'Standard Hierarchy' and the organization unit level is 'DEPARTMENTS'? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.AREA, t1.BUILDING_NUMBER, t1.CITY, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.CITY ORDER BY t0.AREA) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ROOMS t0 JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS t1 ON t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE t0.AREA >= 300 ) SELECT icte.CITY, MAX(icte.AREA) AS max_room_area, d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, d.org_count, d.min_org_unit_id FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ( SELECT h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS min_org_unit_id, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m ON f.DLC_KEY = m.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY WHERE m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS' GROUP BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) d ON icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY GROUP BY icte.CITY, d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, d.org_count, d.min_org_unit_id ORDER BY d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, icte.CITY

question: For each department in the School of Engineering with a total number of students enrolled in its courses greater than 50, list the department name, the total number of enrolled students, and for the term 2019FA, the subject with the highest enrollment offered by that department, including the subject title and the number of enrolled students. Present the results ordered by department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_enrollment, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Highest_Enrolled_Subject, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS Highest_Enrollment FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = ( SELECT MAX(t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 WHERE t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND t2.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ) ) tso ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department in the School of Engineering during the term '2016SP', what is the department name, the variance of the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, the administrative department name, the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 100, and the number of unique courses offered by that department in that term? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ), admin_department_total_enrollment AS ( SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100 ), department_course_count AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT sos.COURSE_NUMBER) AS unique_course_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, adte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, adte.total_enrolled, dcc.unique_course_count FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN admin_department_total_enrollment adte JOIN department_course_count dcc ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dcc.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2012 with a cluster type of 'SWE: School-Wide Electives', show the subject key, subject title, academic year, and the running sum of the number of enrolled students within each department, along with the academic year description, the range, and the variance of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during terms in that year (considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the number of enrolled students is greater than 0), and also include the total number of subjects offered in each department for that year, ordered by subject key. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, SUM(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_KEY) AS running_enrollment_sum FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 AND t1.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC = 'SWE: School-Wide Electives' ), dept_subject_count AS ( SELECT t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.SUBJECT_KEY) AS dept_subjects_count FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 AND t1.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC = 'SWE: School-Wide Electives' GROUP BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), lib_stats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_KEY, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.running_enrollment_sum, l.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, l.enrolled_range, l.enrolled_variance, d.dept_subjects_count FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_subject_count d ON i.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN lib_stats l ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = l.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY i.SUBJECT_KEY;

question: Show the space unit names, the associated organization's name, the DLC name, the DLC key from the organization, the minimum space unit code in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the facility organization key, as well as the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of organizations associated with that DLC key (considering only DLC keys that are not null and organizations that have a non-null organization name), and the total number of space units per DLC key. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS organization_name, t1.DLC_NAME AS dlc_name, t1.DLC_KEY AS org_dlc_key, MIN(t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) OVER ( ORDER BY t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_min_space_unit_code FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 97500 ) SELECT icte.space_unit_name, icte.organization_name, icte.dlc_name, icte.org_dlc_key, icte.window_min_space_unit_code, dos.org_count_range, dos.org_count_variance, dos.org_count_stddev, sus.total_space_units FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ( SELECT fdlk.DLC_KEY, MAX(org_count) - MIN(org_count) AS org_count_range, VARIANCE(org_count) AS org_count_variance, STDDEV(org_count) AS org_count_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fdlk JOIN ( SELECT fo.DLC_KEY, COUNT(*) AS org_count FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fo.DLC_KEY ) org_stats ON fdlk.DLC_KEY = org_stats.DLC_KEY WHERE fdlk.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fdlk.DLC_KEY ) dos ON icte.org_dlc_key = dos.DLC_KEY JOIN ( SELECT DLC_KEY, COUNT(*) AS total_space_units FROM SPACE_UNIT WHERE DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DLC_KEY ) sus ON icte.org_dlc_key = sus.DLC_KEY ;

question: For each department in the School of Engineering with a total number of students enrolled in its courses greater than 50, list the department name, the total number of enrolled students, the average total units for its courses that have a non-null subject title and total units greater than 0, and the variance of the total units for those courses. Additionally, for each such department, provide the maximum number of enrolled students in any single course offered by that department. Present the results ordered by total enrollment descending, then average units descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptEnrollment AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ), DeptUnits AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_variance DESC ) SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.total_enrollment, u.avg_units, u.units_variance FROM DeptEnrollment e JOIN DeptUnits u ON e.DEPARTMENT_NAME = u.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.total_enrollment, icte.avg_units, icte.units_variance, MAX(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_course_enrollment FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT s ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.total_enrollment, icte.avg_units, icte.units_variance ORDER BY icte.total_enrollment DESC, icte.avg_units DESC;

question: For each major use description and organization name where the room area is greater than 100 and the access level is 1, display the number of rooms, the minimum floor number, the access level name, the variance of the number of rooms in the building history for buildings with a nonzero number of rooms and assignable area greater than 0, and the department description. Show the results ordered by the number of rooms in descending order and then by the variance of the number of rooms in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count, MIN(r.FLOOR) AS min_floor, r.ACCESS_LEVEL FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 100 AND r.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 GROUP BY r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.ACCESS_LEVEL ) SELECT icte.MAJOR_USE_DESC, icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.room_count, icte.min_floor, av.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME, av.num_rooms_variance, fo.DESCRIPTION AS department_description FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE, fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME, VARIANCE(fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS num_rooms_variance FROM FCLT_BUILDING fb JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh ON fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE = fbh.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE WHERE fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 0 AND fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA > 0 GROUP BY fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE, fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME ) av ON icte.ACCESS_LEVEL = av.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE LEFT JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY icte.room_count DESC, av.num_rooms_variance DESC;

question: For each department in the Provost Area and each warehouse load date, show the department code, department name, school area name, the rank of each department within its school area based on department code, the space unit code, organization name, HR department name from space units with a space unit key greater than 100000, the sum of space unit keys within each warehouse load date group, and the description of the organization from FCLT_ORGANIZATION, for those space units whose HR department name matches the department name. Do not repeat the warehouse load date if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by warehouse load date and department code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptRanks AS ( SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 INNER JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' ), SpaceUnitSums AS ( SELECT t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, SUM(t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE ORDER BY t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM SPACE_UNIT t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000 ) SELECT dr.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, dr.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dr.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, dr.window_column AS DEPT_RANK_IN_SCHOOL_AREA, sus.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, sus.ORGANIZATION_NAME, sus.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS SPACE_UNIT_HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sus.window_column AS SPACE_UNIT_KEY_SUM, sus.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, fo.DESCRIPTION AS ORGANIZATION_DESCRIPTION FROM DeptRanks dr JOIN SpaceUnitSums sus ON dr.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = sus.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON sus.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) OVER (ORDER BY WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) = WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE THEN NULL ELSE WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE END AS WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, DEPT_RANK_IN_SCHOOL_AREA, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, ORGANIZATION_NAME, SPACE_UNIT_HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SPACE_UNIT_KEY_SUM, ORGANIZATION_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte ORDER BY WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: Show the department names, the corresponding SIS subject code, subject code descriptions, graduate level, the total number of courses per department, and for each department, the minimum number of enrolled students in the term "2025FA" across all subjects offered by that department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, Total_Courses.Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_NUMBER) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS Total_Courses ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, icte.GRADUATE_LEVEL, icte.Total_Courses, min_enroll.min_enrolled_students_2025FA FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students_2025FA FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) min_enroll ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = min_enroll.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ;

question: From the top 10 organizations (with non-null DLC key) whose rooms on floor 2 have the highest total area, display each organization's name, total area of their floor 2 rooms, the HR org unit title, the department name, the minimum access level in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the building component, as well as the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of all rooms assigned to that organization (only including rooms with area greater than 0). Order the results by total area descending and then by organization name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.SPACE_USAGE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(t0.ACCESS_LEVEL) OVER (ORDER BY t0.BUILDING_COMPONENT ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t0.BUILDING_COMPONENT FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2 ), OrgRoomStats AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE d.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND r.AREA > 0 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ), Floor2OrgArea AS ( SELECT i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, SUM(r.AREA) AS total_area FROM inner_cte i JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY AND r.FLOOR = 2 WHERE d.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND r.AREA > 0 GROUP BY i.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY total_area DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT f2o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, f2o.total_area, i.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.window_column, ors.area_variance, ors.area_stddev FROM Floor2OrgArea f2o JOIN inner_cte i ON f2o.ORGANIZATION_NAME = i.ORGANIZATION_NAME JOIN OrgRoomStats ors ON f2o.ORGANIZATION_NAME = ors.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY f2o.total_area DESC, f2o.ORGANIZATION_NAME

question: For each department, show the department name, the average, range, and variance of the area of rooms assigned to it (considering only rooms with an area greater than 40), as well as the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in regular academic terms, but only include departments where the average area of rooms is greater than the overall average area of all rooms with area greater than 40. List the department name, average area, area range, area variance, average total units, total units range, and total units variance in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH RoomAreaStats AS ( SELECT o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_area, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 40 GROUP BY o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY area_range DESC ), SubjectUnitsStats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT ras.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ras.avg_area, ras.area_range, ras.area_variance, sus.avg_total_units, sus.total_units_range, sus.total_units_variance FROM RoomAreaStats ras JOIN SubjectUnitsStats sus ON ras.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = sus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ras.area_range DESC ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_area > ( SELECT AVG(AREA) FROM FCLT_ROOMS WHERE AREA > 40 );

question: For subjects offered in the 2019FA term with total units greater than 1, show the subject title, the dense rank of each subject considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the academic year, the subject ID, the department name, the running sum of total units within each school ordered by subject ID, and the number of enrolled students for each subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ), subq2 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS > 1 ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.window_column AS subject_dense_rank, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.window_column AS running_sum_total_units FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.subject_dense_rank, icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.running_sum_total_units, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte icte JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON icte.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID AND tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each offering department in the 'Engineering' school, show the department name and the highest total units among its courses that have 12 units, along with the number of such courses in that department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE AS course_number, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.COURSE) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS highest_total_units, COUNT(*) AS num_12unit_courses FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: For library reserve materials with material status key 'U' and subjects that have more than 0 enrolled students, show the subject ID, library course instructor key, term description, academic year, term start date, the minimum academic year in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by library reserve catalog key, the course number, course number description, number of enrolled students, the dense rank over the material status key ordered by material status key, and the offer department name. Present the results ordered by subject ID and academic year descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t2.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, MIN(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER ( ORDER BY t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.TERM_START_DATE, icte.window_column AS min_academic_year_window, lso.COURSE_NUMBER, lso.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, DENSE_RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ) AS dense_rank_material_status, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME FROM inner_cte icte JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm ON icte.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY AND icte.SUBJECT_ID = lrm.SUBJECT_ID JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON lrm.SUBJECT_ID = lso.SUBJECT_ID AND lrm.TERM_CODE = lso.TERM_CODE WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC;

question: For each space unit, provide the space unit name, the average room square footage, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the room square footage, the DLC name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of rooms assigned to organizations in that DLC, and the number of organizations in that DLC, considering only rooms with an area greater than 0. List the results ordered by the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the room square footage in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH SpaceUnitRoomStats AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, su.DLC_KEY, AVG(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS avg_room_sqft, STDDEV(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS stddev_room_sqft FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, su.DLC_KEY ORDER BY stddev_room_sqft DESC ), DLCRoomAreaVariation AS ( SELECT FODK.DLC_KEY, FO.DLC_NAME, STDDEV(FR.AREA)/NULLIF(AVG(FR.AREA),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY FODK JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION FO ON FODK.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS FR ON FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FR.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE FR.AREA > 0 GROUP BY FODK.DLC_KEY, FO.DLC_NAME HAVING AVG(FR.AREA) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT srs.SPACE_UNIT, srs.avg_room_sqft, srs.stddev_room_sqft, drv.DLC_NAME, drv.coefficient_of_variation, drv.DLC_KEY FROM SpaceUnitRoomStats srs JOIN DLCRoomAreaVariation drv ON srs.DLC_KEY = drv.DLC_KEY ORDER BY srs.stddev_room_sqft DESC ) SELECT icte.SPACE_UNIT, icte.avg_room_sqft, icte.stddev_room_sqft, icte.DLC_NAME, icte.coefficient_of_variation, COUNT(DISTINCT FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS num_organizations FROM inner_cte icte JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY FODK ON icte.DLC_KEY = FODK.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION FO ON FODK.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY GROUP BY icte.SPACE_UNIT, icte.avg_room_sqft, icte.stddev_room_sqft, icte.DLC_NAME, icte.coefficient_of_variation ORDER BY icte.stddev_room_sqft DESC;

question: For each department, list the department name, the variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2012SU term, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for courses offered by that department, and the number of unique subjects offered by the department in 2012SU. The columns should be shown in the following order: department name, total units variance (2012SU), total units range (all courses), total units variance (all courses), total units standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) (all courses), number of unique 2012SU subjects, and reason for inclusion ('2012SU Variance' for the 2012SU term variance and 'All Courses Stats' for the overall course statistics). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON tso.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ), Dept2012SUCounts AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_2012su_subjects FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss WHERE ss.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_units_variance AS total_units_variance_2012su, NULL AS total_units_range, NULL AS total_units_variance_all, NULL AS total_units_stddev_all, d2.num_2012su_subjects, '2012SU Variance' AS Reason FROM inner_cte i LEFT JOIN Dept2012SUCounts d2 ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME UNION ALL SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS total_units_variance_2012su, d.total_units_range, d.total_units_variance, d.total_units_stddev, d2.num_2012su_subjects, 'All Courses Stats' AS Reason FROM DeptUnitsStats d LEFT JOIN Dept2012SUCounts d2 ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Reason;

question: From the top 10 departments with the highest number of organizations whose parent is 'EXECVP' or 'CHNCLR', display each department's name, the total number of such organizations, the DLC name most represented among assignable organizations in that department, and the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of organization numbers for assignable organizations in that DLC. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS total_organizations FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON d.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON f.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY WHERE f.ORG_PARENT IN ('EXECVP', 'CHNCLR') GROUP BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) > 5 ), dept_dlc_stats AS ( SELECT h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, f.DLC_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS assignable_org_count, AVG(f.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS avg_org_number, STDDEV(f.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON f.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 GROUP BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, f.DLC_NAME ), ranked_dlc AS ( SELECT s.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DLC_NAME, s.assignable_org_count, s.avg_org_number, s.org_number_stddev, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s.assignable_org_count DESC) AS rn FROM dept_dlc_stats s ) SELECT i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_organizations, r.DLC_NAME AS Most_Represented_DLC, r.avg_org_number, r.org_number_stddev FROM inner_cte i LEFT JOIN ranked_dlc r ON i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = r.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AND r.rn = 1 ORDER BY i.total_organizations DESC LIMIT 10;

question: From the top 10 subjects with the highest number of enrolled students that are offered by the library in the term with code '2014FA', display each subject's ID, subject title, total number of enrolled students, the material status key with the most materials for that subject, the count of materials for that status, the offering department name, the term description, term start date, and term end date. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ISBN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 ), material_status_counts AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' GROUP BY t0.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ), ranked_status AS ( SELECT msc.SUBJECT_ID, msc.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, msc.material_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY msc.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY msc.material_count DESC) AS rn FROM material_status_counts msc ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, rs.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY AS Most_Common_Material_Status, rs.material_count AS Material_Status_Count, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.TERM_START_DATE, t.TERM_END_DATE FROM ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' ORDER BY lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC LIMIT 10 ) s LEFT JOIN ranked_status rs ON s.SUBJECT_ID = rs.SUBJECT_ID AND rs.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON s.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE ORDER BY s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC;

question: Show the department names, the corresponding SIS subject code, subject code descriptions, graduate level, the total number of courses per department, and for each department, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department in 2017 (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.GRADUATE_LEVEL, Total_Courses.Total_Courses, dept_stats.enrolled_students_variance, dept_stats.enrolled_students_stddev FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS Total_Courses ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2017%' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS dept_stats ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: For each department and academic year where the subject enrollment number is greater than 10 and the department has at least one course with at least one enrolled student and course materials with a material status of 'RQ', provide the department name, academic year, number of unique subjects, minimum total units offered, the variance of the number of enrolled students in such courses, and the average total units for those subjects, listing the columns in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptYearSubjectStats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), DeptEnrolledVariance AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.ACADEMIC_YEAR, d.subject_count, d.min_total_units, v.enrolled_variance FROM DeptYearSubjectStats d JOIN DeptEnrolledVariance v ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = v.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units, ic.enrolled_variance, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte ic JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND t.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units, ic.enrolled_variance ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For all subject titles that are either offered in the 2012SU term with a cluster type of 'S' (showing the subject title, dense rank of each subject considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the number of enrolled students, and the reason 'Cluster S Dense Rank') OR are offered in the 2012 summer term by the Harvard Cross-Enrollment Program (showing the subject title, subject key, department name, the number of subject offerings, the total number of units for those offerings, and the reason 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment'), list for each result the subject title, subject key, department name, offering count, total units, window column, reason for inclusion, and also include the school name for each subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t2.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t0.CLUSTER_TYPE = 'S' ) , Subquery2 AS ( SELECT so.SUBJECT_KEY, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS offering_count, SUM(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units, so.SUBJECT_ID_SORT, ss.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON sos.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' GROUP BY so.SUBJECT_KEY, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, so.SUBJECT_ID_SORT, ss.SCHOOL_NAME ) , CombinedSubjects AS ( SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS SUBJECT_KEY, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS offering_count, NULL AS total_units, s1.window_column, 'Cluster S Dense Rank' AS Reason, ss.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte s1 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON s1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = ss.SUBJECT_ID_SORT UNION ALL SELECT s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.SUBJECT_KEY, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.offering_count, s2.total_units, NULL AS window_column, 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment' AS Reason, s2.SCHOOL_NAME FROM Subquery2 s2 ) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, SUBJECT_KEY, DEPARTMENT_NAME, offering_count, total_units, window_column, Reason, SCHOOL_NAME FROM CombinedSubjects ORDER BY SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each subject offered in the library in the Mathematics department during regular terms, show the subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, term description, academic year, subject short title, and the maximum total units for each row and the next two rows in order of subject ID. Additionally, for the corresponding offering department and school, provide the number of unique subjects with course material status 'RQ' and the minimum total units for those subjects. Also, include the department phone number and the school name for the offering department, and display the responsible faculty name for each subject. The columns should be shown in the following order: subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, term description, academic year, subject short title, maximum total units for each row and the next two rows, number of unique subjects with course material status 'RQ', minimum total units for those subjects, department phone number, school name, and responsible faculty name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, MAX(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS SUB1_OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME AS SUB1_OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ), Sub2 AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, icte.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, s2.subject_count, s2.min_total_units, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, icte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN Sub2 s2 ON icte.SUB1_OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND icte.SUB1_OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = s2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE

question: For subjects offered in the term with code '2022FA', show the subject ID, department name, term description, and the running sum of total units within each academic year, along with the offering department name, offering school name, the number of unique subjects, the minimum total units, and the average number of enrolled students for each offering department and school where the course material status is 'RQ', ordered by subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t1.TERM_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ), subq2 AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.window_column, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s2.subject_count, s2.min_total_units, s2.avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte s1 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.TERM_CODE = tso.TERM_CODE JOIN subq2 s2 ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = s2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_ID

question: For each department-level organization whose DLC key is not null and which has rooms with area greater than 0, and where the organization level is 5, provide the organization name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of rooms assigned to that organization, the dense rank of its corresponding HR department name (considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the HR department code), and the HR department name and HR department code for that organization. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE d.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND r.AREA > 0 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY area_variance DESC ), OrgHRRanks AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ) SELECT icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.area_variance, icte.area_stddev, ohr.window_column, ohr.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ohr.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte icte JOIN OrgHRRanks ohr ON icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = ohr.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY icte.area_variance DESC

question: For each department in the School of Engineering, show the department name, the average number of enrolled students in offered subjects, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students (considering only degree-granting departments and subjects with more than 0 enrolled students), the total number of students enrolled in courses offered by that department where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 50, and the deviation of the total enrollment from the average total enrollment across all Engineering departments. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC ), EngineeringDeptTotals AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_variance, des.enrollment_stddev, edt.total_enrollment FROM DeptEnrollmentStats des JOIN EngineeringDeptTotals edt ON des.DEPARTMENT_NAME = edt.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) , AvgTotalEnrollment AS ( SELECT AVG(total_enrollment) AS avg_total_enrollment FROM ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ) x ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_enrollment, i.enrollment_variance, i.enrollment_stddev, i.total_enrollment, (i.total_enrollment - a.avg_total_enrollment) AS deviation_from_avg_total_enrollment FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN AvgTotalEnrollment a ORDER BY i.total_enrollment DESC;

question: For each offering department and school where the course material status is 'RQ', provide the number of unique subjects and the minimum total units for those subjects, along with the subject title from the library, the number of enrolled students in the library subject, the responsible faculty name from the TIP subject, the offer department name from the TIP subject, the minimum number of enrolled students in the library subject within a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the TIP subject's responsible faculty MIT ID, and the total units from the subject offered summary, for subjects offered in the term '2014FA'. The results should include the offering department name, offering school name, subject count, minimum total units, subject title, number of enrolled students, responsible faculty name, offer department name from the library subject, the windowed minimum number of enrolled students, and the total units, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
