SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, icte.subject_count, icte.min_total_units, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, tso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS LIB_OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( ORDER BY tso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, sos.TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte icte JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND icte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON lso.TERM_CODE = tso.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID AND tso.TERM_CODE = sos.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA'

question: For each organization with a DLC key of 'D_MECHE' and for each space unit associated with that organization (where the space unit has a warehouse load date of '19-DEC-24' and the HR org units linked to it have a warehouse load date of '03-DEC-24'), show the organization key, organization name, DLC name, the rank of the organization within each DLC name group ordered by organization key, the space unit name, the average, range, and variance of the HR department codes for the HR org units linked to that space unit, as well as the HR department name and the HR org unit title. The columns should be shown in the following order: organization key, organization name, DLC name, rank, space unit name, average HR department code, HR department code range, HR department code variance, HR department name, and HR org unit title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.DLC_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DLC_NAME ORDER BY t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.DLC_KEY = 'D_MECHE' ) SELECT icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.DLC_NAME, icte.window_column, su.SPACE_UNIT, AVG(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS avg_hr_dept_code, MAX(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) - MIN(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS hr_dept_code_range, VARIANCE(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS hr_dept_code_variance, hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE FROM inner_cte icte JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY AND su.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY AND hou.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '03-DEC-24' GROUP BY icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.DLC_NAME, icte.window_column, su.SPACE_UNIT, hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE ORDER BY icte.DLC_NAME, icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, su.SPACE_UNIT ;

question: For each term and department, list the term, department, the number of courses, average number of equivalent subjects, the school name, department phone number, and the number of distinct required or optional textbook materials used in that department and term. Include subtotals for each term (the corresponding term field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all terms (the corresponding term field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the term if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by term and department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, DEPARTMENT_NAME AS dept, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS subcnt, MIN(MEET_TIME) AS mintime, AVG( CASE WHEN equivalent_subjects IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 + LENGTH(equivalent_subjects) - LENGTH(REPLACE(equivalent_subjects, ',', '')) END ) AS avgeqisub FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED GROUP BY TERM_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(term) OVER (ORDER BY term_sort, term, dept_sort) = term THEN NULL ELSE term END AS term, dept, subcnt, avgeqisub, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone, COALESCE(mat.material_count, 0) AS num_required_or_optional_materials FROM inner_cte tbltmp LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tbltmp.dept = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN ( SELECT c.TERM_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON c.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID AND c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IN ('RQ', 'EO') GROUP BY c.TERM_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) mat ON tbltmp.term = mat.TERM_CODE AND tbltmp.dept = mat.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY term_sort, dept_sort;

question: For each department and academic year, give the department name, the academic year, the academic year description, the average of the total units, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units, and the geometric mean of the total units for subjects offered in terms that are regular terms, where the geometric mean is computed only for subjects with total units greater than zero. Present the results ordered by department name and academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH AvgStddevUnits AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ), GeometricMeanUnits AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC ) SELECT a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, a.avg_total_units, a.stddev_total_units, g.geometric_mean_total_units FROM AvgStddevUnits a JOIN GeometricMeanUnits g ON a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AND a.DEPARTMENT_NAME = g.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units, geometric_mean_total_units FROM inner_cte ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each subject that appears both among subjects offered in the term '2017FA' (for which the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the record counts of tip materials are calculated) and among subjects offered in the term '2016SP' with a school code of 'E' (for which the department name, course description, and a row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title are assigned), and for which the department name and course description are further joined to retrieve the school name from the course description table, give the subject title, the range of record counts, the variance of record counts, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of record counts, the department name, the course description, the school name, and the window row number, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(t.RECORD_COUNT) - MIN(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_range, VARIANCE(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY record_count_range DESC ) SELECT sts.SUBJECT_TITLE, sts.record_count_range, sts.record_count_variance, sts.record_count_stddev, sddw.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sddw.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, scd.SCHOOL_NAME, sddw.window_column FROM inner_cte sts JOIN ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.COURSE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t0.SCHOOL_CODE = 'E' ) sddw ON sts.SUBJECT_TITLE = sddw.SUBJECT_TITLE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sddw.COURSE = scd.COURSE ORDER BY sts.record_count_range DESC, sddw.window_column ASC;

question: For all subject offerings in the academic term with term code '2017FA', show the subject title, the offer department name, the term description, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title. Additionally, for each offering department, show the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects that are offered this year and are letter graded. For each subject, also include the department code and the school name from the SIS_SUBJECT_CODE table. Present the subject title, offer department name, department code, school name, term description, window column, average total units, and total units variance in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_dept_name, s.COURSE_NUMBER FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON s.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' ), DepartmentUnitsStats AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.window_column, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance FROM inner_cte icte JOIN DepartmentUnitsStats dus ON icte.join_dept_name = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON icte.COURSE_NUMBER = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER ORDER BY icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: From the top 10 subjects with the highest number of enrolled students (considering only library reserve material details where the material status is 'U'), display each subject's ID, subject title, total number of enrolled students, the instructor key most frequently associated with that subject, and the count of times that instructor appears for that subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT l.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, l.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON l.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ), subject_enrollment AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS TOTAL_ENROLLED FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE ), instructor_counts AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_ID, LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, COUNT(*) AS INSTRUCTOR_COUNT FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_ID, LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY ), ranked_instructors AS ( SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, ic.INSTRUCTOR_COUNT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ic.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY ic.INSTRUCTOR_COUNT DESC) AS rn FROM instructor_counts ic ) SELECT se.SUBJECT_ID, se.SUBJECT_TITLE, se.TOTAL_ENROLLED, ri.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY AS MOST_FREQUENT_INSTRUCTOR, ri.INSTRUCTOR_COUNT AS INSTRUCTOR_OCCURRENCES FROM subject_enrollment se LEFT JOIN ranked_instructors ri ON se.SUBJECT_ID = ri.SUBJECT_ID AND ri.rn = 1 ORDER BY se.TOTAL_ENROLLED DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each department, what is the average and maximum number of enrolled students in library subjects that have a matching master subject ID in the TIP subject offerings (considering only departments with more than 0 enrolled students in both tables), as well as the number of unique degree-granting courses and the maximum total units offered for courses where the total units are at least 9? Please provide the department name, average enrolled students, maximum enrolled students, course count, and maximum total units in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, MAX(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = t.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), course_stats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MAX(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS >= 9 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.avg_enrolled_students, i.max_enrolled_students, cs.course_count, cs.max_total_units FROM inner_cte i JOIN course_stats cs ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: For each subject offered in the term "2005FA", show the subject title from the subject summary, the number of enrolled students from the subject offered table, the department name from the subject summary, the term description from the academic terms table, the average number of enrolled students within each subject title group ordered by department name, and for the corresponding department, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects that had library reserve materials in terms with a term status of 'Previous'. Additionally, for each subject, show the total number of library reserve materials associated with it in the same term. List the results ordered by department name and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON tso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' ), DepartmentLibraryUnitsStats AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), SubjectLibraryReserveCount AS ( SELECT lrm.TERM_CODE, lrm.SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(*) AS num_library_reserves FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm GROUP BY lrm.TERM_CODE, lrm.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.avg_enrolled_students, dlu.avg_total_units, dlu.total_units_variance, dlu.total_units_stddev, COALESCE(slrc.num_library_reserves, 0) AS num_library_reserves FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN DepartmentLibraryUnitsStats dlu ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dlu.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON icte.SUBJECT_TITLE = tso.SUBJECT_TITLE AND tso.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' LEFT JOIN SubjectLibraryReserveCount slrc ON tso.TERM_CODE = slrc.TERM_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = slrc.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each organization and its associated space unit where the organization is assignable and the space unit code is greater than 50000, and where the organization is linked to a department in the Provost Area, provide the organization, the space unit, the number of space units, the minimum organization number, the department name, the number of organizations for that department, the minimum department hierarchy level 3 code, and the total number of unique space units for each department. List the results ordered by organization and space unit. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH ProvostAreaDepartments AS ( SELECT m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_CODE) AS min_level3_code FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ), AssignableOrgSpaceUnits AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION, s.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS space_unit_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_org_number, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION o JOIN SPACE_UNIT s ON o.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE > 50000 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION, s.SPACE_UNIT, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.DLC_KEY ) SELECT a.ORGANIZATION, a.SPACE_UNIT, a.space_unit_count, a.min_org_number, p.DLC_NAME, p.org_count, p.min_level3_code, a.DLC_KEY FROM AssignableOrgSpaceUnits a JOIN ProvostAreaDepartments p ON a.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = p.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) SELECT i.ORGANIZATION, i.SPACE_UNIT, i.space_unit_count, i.min_org_number, i.DLC_NAME, i.org_count, i.min_level3_code, d.total_unique_space_units FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT o.DLC_KEY, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS total_unique_space_units FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION o JOIN SPACE_UNIT s ON o.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE > 50000 GROUP BY o.DLC_KEY ) d ON i.DLC_KEY = d.DLC_KEY ORDER BY i.ORGANIZATION, i.SPACE_UNIT;

question: For each subject offered in the term with the description "Fall Term 2024-2025", show the subject ID, subject title, offering department name, term description, and the rank of the subject within its offering department. For each tip detail record where the material status key is 'RQ', show the subject ID, term description, term start date, tip material key, and the average record count in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the financial aid year. Additionally, for each subject offered in "Fall Term 2024-2025", include the academic year description from the academic terms table. Indicate the source of each row as either 'SubjectOffered' or 'TipDetail'. The results should be ordered by subject ID and source. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' ) , Subquery2 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, AVG(t1.RECORD_COUNT) OVER ( PARTITION BY t0.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ) , SubjectOfferedWithYear AS ( SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.window_column AS subject_rank, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM inner_cte i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON i.TERM_DESCRIPTION = t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION ) , CombinedResults AS ( SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.subject_rank, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS TERM_START_DATE, NULL AS TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, NULL AS avg_record_count, 'SubjectOffered' AS Source FROM SubjectOfferedWithYear s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.SUBJECT_ID, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS subject_rank, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.TERM_START_DATE, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s2.window_column AS avg_record_count, 'TipDetail' AS Source FROM Subquery2 s2 ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY SUBJECT_ID, Source;

question: For each space unit with a space unit key greater than 100000 and with rooms on floor 2, what is the name of the space unit, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the access levels of its associated rooms, the organization name, the HR department name, and the HR org unit title, for each space unit, ordered by access level variance and HR org unit title? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, VARIANCE(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_variance, STDDEV(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_stddev FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD zr ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = zr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE zr.FLOOR = 2 GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ORDER BY access_level_variance DESC ) SELECT icte.SPACE_UNIT, icte.access_level_variance, icte.access_level_stddev, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fo.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON icte.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000 ORDER BY icte.access_level_variance DESC, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE;

question: For each department in the Provost Area, show the department code, department name, school area name, the rank of the department within its school area based on department code, and for each matching space unit with a space unit key greater than 100000, show the space unit code, the organization name, the HR department name from the space unit, the sum of space unit keys within each warehouse load date group, and the description of the organization from the FCLT_ORGANIZATION table, where the department code matches between the department and the space unit. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH provost_departments AS ( SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 INNER JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' ), space_unit_summaries AS ( SELECT t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE ORDER BY t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.DESCRIPTION FROM SPACE_UNIT t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000 ) SELECT pd.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, pd.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, pd.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, pd.window_column AS department_rank_within_school_area, sus.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, sus.ORGANIZATION_NAME, sus.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS space_unit_hr_department_name, sus.window_column AS sum_space_unit_key_within_warehouse_load_date, sus.DESCRIPTION AS organization_description FROM provost_departments pd JOIN space_unit_summaries sus ON pd.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sus.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description, the average number of enrolled students in subjects offered (considering only subjects that require advance sign-up and are not cancelled), the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students, the geometric mean of the record counts of required course materials (where the record count is greater than zero) for all subjects offered in that year, and the total number of unique responsible faculty members teaching those subjects? List the academic year, academic year description, average enrollment, enrollment variance, enrollment standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), geometric mean record count, and total unique responsible faculty in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, tso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID, tso.TERM_CODE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON isd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON at.TERM_CODE = tso.TERM_CODE WHERE isd.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' ) SELECT icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev, ms.geometric_mean_record_count, COUNT(DISTINCT icte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID) AS total_unique_responsible_faculty FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) ms ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ms.ACADEMIC_YEAR GROUP BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ms.geometric_mean_record_count ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: Show the department names, subject codes, subject numbers, subject titles, term descriptions, total units, and the total number of subjects per department for all subjects offered in the academic year 2022 that either (a) have a total of 12 units, or (b) have at least one required or optional textbook. For each row, also include a column indicating the reason for inclusion ('12UnitSubject' for the first case and 'TextbookSubject' for the second case). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IN ('RQ', 'EO') ), CombinedSubjects AS ( SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.TOTAL_UNITS, '12UnitSubject' AS Reason FROM Subquery1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.TOTAL_UNITS, 'TextbookSubject' AS Reason FROM Subquery2 s2 ) SELECT cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cs.SUBJECT_CODE, cs.SUBJECT_NUMBER, cs.SUBJECT_TITLE, cs.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cs.TOTAL_UNITS, cs.Reason FROM CombinedSubjects cs ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_NUMBER, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.TOTAL_UNITS, TotalSubjects.Total_Subjects, icte.Reason FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS Total_Subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS TotalSubjects ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = TotalSubjects.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_NUMBER, icte.Reason;

question: List the department names, their corresponding subject codes, subject code descriptions, graduate level, the total number of courses per department, and the minimum total units for each department and subject code, considering only degree-granting departments and courses with more than 6 total units. Present the results ordered by the total number of courses in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.COURSE_NUMBER) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ic.GRADUATE_LEVEL, ic.Total_Courses, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND ic.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ic.GRADUATE_LEVEL, ic.Total_Courses ORDER BY ic.Total_Courses DESC

question: For IAP subject activities in the term "2021JA" that are not cancelled and have a maximum enrollment of 30, show the activity title, enrollment type, calendar date, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by activity title, the dense rank of each activity considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the academic year from the academic terms table, and the term description from the academic terms table, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.CALENDAR_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN TIME_DAY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 30 ) SELECT s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, s1.CALENDAR_DATE, s1.window_column AS row_number_window, s2.window_column AS dense_rank_window, s1.TERM_CODE FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE = s2.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND s1.TERM_CODE = s2.TERM_CODE ) SELECT i.ACTIVITY_TITLE, i.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, i.CALENDAR_DATE, i.row_number_window, i.dense_rank_window, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON i.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE;

question: Show the department name, subject ID, term description, the running sum of total units within each academic year, subject title, textbook ISBN, subject rank within its term description group ordered by subject ID, and the total number of subjects offered by each department in the term with code '2022FA'. Only subjects in the academic year 2022 with a required textbook will have subject title, ISBN, and rank populated; others will have these fields as null. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_ID, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.ISBN, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.window_column AS running_sum_total_units, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.ISBN, s2.window_column AS subject_rank_within_term FROM Subquery1 s1 LEFT JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.running_sum_total_units, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.ISBN, i.subject_rank_within_term, dept_counts.total_subjects_in_dept FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects_in_dept FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) dept_counts ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_ID

question: For subjects offered in the term with code '2022FA', show the subject ID, department name, term description, and the running sum of total units within each academic year, along with the offering department name, offering school name, the number of unique subjects, the minimum total units, and the total number of enrolled students for each offering department and school where the course material status is 'RQ', ordered by subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t1.TERM_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ), subq2 AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, SUM(COALESCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,0)) AS total_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID AND td.TERM_CODE = sos.TERM_CODE WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.window_column, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s2.subject_count, s2.min_total_units, s2.total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte s1 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.TERM_CODE = tso.TERM_CODE JOIN subq2 s2 ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = s2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_ID

question: For the top 10 subject titles by the number of materials offered in regular academic terms, display each subject title, department name, total count of materials, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses offered by that department (considering only courses with at least one associated TIP material), the school name, and the department phone number, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON td.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND td.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY material_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), dept_enrollment_stats AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS num_enrolled_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS num_enrolled_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.material_count, des.num_enrolled_variance, des.num_enrolled_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN dept_enrollment_stats des ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.department LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.material_count DESC;

question: For the top 10 departments with the highest number of graduate students, list each department's name, total graduate student count, the most frequently offered subject in the 2017JA term for that department, the number of times that subject was offered, the subject code, and the subject code description. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS grad_student_count FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.grad_student_count, so.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Most_Frequent_Subject, so.subject_offer_count, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM ( SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS subject_offer_count FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t WHERE t.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t.SUBJECT_TITLE ) so JOIN inner_cte ic ON so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(subject_offer_count) AS max_count FROM ( SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS subject_offer_count FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t WHERE t.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t.SUBJECT_TITLE ) sub GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) maxsub ON so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = maxsub.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND so.subject_offer_count = maxsub.max_count ORDER BY ic.grad_student_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Show the department names, subject codes, subject code descriptions, graduate level, total number of courses per department, and the corresponding administrative department name for each department in the School of Engineering. For each row, include only departments in the School of Engineering, and join the administrative department name based on the department code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, Total_Courses.Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS Total_Courses ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.GRADUATE_LEVEL, inner_cte.Total_Courses, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For each subject offered in the academic term with term code '2006FA', and for each department and course number where the number of enrolled students in the subject summary is greater than 2, show the subject ID, subject title, department name, the sum of lecture units within each grade type group, the offer department name, the course number, the number of unique library subjects offered, the minimum total units for those subjects, and for each offer department and course number, include a grand total for all subjects in the format of (null, null, null, null, offer department name, course number, total subject count, minimum total units). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.LECTURE_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.COURSE_NUMBER, s2.subject_count, s2.min_total_units FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s2.COURSE_NUMBER = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) , RollupResults AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COURSE_NUMBER, SUM(subject_count) AS total_subject_count, MIN(min_total_units) AS min_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COURSE_NUMBER WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(subject_count) > 0 ) SELECT CASE WHEN rr.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE ic.SUBJECT_ID END AS SUBJECT_ID, CASE WHEN rr.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE ic.SUBJECT_TITLE END AS SUBJECT_TITLE, CASE WHEN rr.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, CASE WHEN rr.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE ic.window_column END AS window_column, rr.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, rr.COURSE_NUMBER, rr.total_subject_count, rr.min_total_units FROM RollupResults rr LEFT JOIN inner_cte ic ON rr.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND rr.COURSE_NUMBER = ic.COURSE_NUMBER ORDER BY rr.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, rr.COURSE_NUMBER, ic.SUBJECT_ID ;

question: For each department where the range of total units for subjects offered in 2022 and listed in the CIS course catalog is greater than 0 and the range of total units for courses offered by that department is also greater than 0, and where the variance of total units for subjects offered in 2022 is greater than the average variance across all departments, provide the department name, the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in 2022 and listed in the CIS course catalog, and the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for courses offered by that department, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DepartmentSubjectUnits2022 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC ), DepartmentCourseUnits AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT dsu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dsu.units_range, dsu.units_variance, dcu.total_units_range, dcu.total_units_variance, dcu.total_units_stddev FROM DepartmentSubjectUnits2022 dsu JOIN DepartmentCourseUnits dcu ON dsu.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dcu.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE dsu.units_range > 0 AND dcu.total_units_range > 0 ORDER BY dsu.units_range DESC ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.units_range, icte.units_variance, icte.total_units_range, icte.total_units_variance, icte.total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte icte WHERE icte.units_variance > ( SELECT AVG(units_variance) FROM ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) dept_var ) ORDER BY icte.units_range DESC

question: For each academic year, list the academic year, the academic year description, the average, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and geometric mean of the total units for subjects offered in regular terms, and for each academic year also include the department that offered the most subjects in regular terms along with the count of subjects from that department. Order the results by academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH AvgStddevUnits AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), GeometricMeanUnits AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, a.avg_total_units, a.stddev_total_units, g.geometric_mean_total_units FROM AvgStddevUnits a JOIN GeometricMeanUnits g ON a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, icte.avg_total_units, icte.stddev_total_units, icte.geometric_mean_total_units, dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Most_Represented_Department, dept_stats.Subject_Count FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.Subject_Count FROM ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC ) AS rn FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) t WHERE t.rn = 1 ) dept_stats ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dept_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = dept_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each department in the School of Engineering, show the department name, school name, the total number of tip materials offered for subjects during regular terms (where the total number of tip materials is greater than 10), the number of offered subjects with more than 3 enrolled students, the minimum number of enrolled students, and the average number of enrolled students for those offered subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH TipMaterialsByDepartment AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL t JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) > 10 ), OfferedSubjectsStats AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS offered_subject_count, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT tmbd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, oss.SCHOOL_NAME, tmbd.total_tip_materials, oss.offered_subject_count, oss.min_enrolled_students FROM TipMaterialsByDepartment tmbd JOIN OfferedSubjectsStats oss ON tmbd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = oss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.total_tip_materials, icte.offered_subject_count, icte.min_enrolled_students, avg_stats.avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) avg_stats ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = avg_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.total_tip_materials DESC;

question: From the top 10 departments with the highest average total units for subjects offered in the most recent academic year, display each department's name, the average total units, the range and variance of total units, the subject with the highest total units in that department (in the most recent year), and the total units for that subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.SUBJECT_ID WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ) GROUP BY COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_total_units, ic.total_units_range, ic.total_units_variance, s.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_with_max_units, s.TOTAL_UNITS AS subject_max_total_units FROM ( SELECT icte.*, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM inner_cte icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON cso.SUBJECT_ID = ccc.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON ccc.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED) GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_range, icte.total_units_variance ORDER BY icte.avg_total_units DESC LIMIT 10 ) ic JOIN ( SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sos.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON cso.SUBJECT_ID = ccc.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON ccc.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED) ) s ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.max_total_units = s.TOTAL_UNITS ORDER BY ic.avg_total_units DESC;

question: For each department, provide the department name, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in offered subjects (for degree-granting departments and subjects with more than 0 enrolled students), and also include the total number of students enrolled in courses offered by that department in the School of Engineering where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 50. For each department, also show the number of unique subjects offered by that department (for both cases). For each row, include a reason for inclusion ('DegreeGrantingStats' for the first case and 'EngineeringTotals' for the second). Show the department name, average enrollment, enrollment variance, enrollment standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), total enrollment, number of unique subjects, and reason, in that order, sorted by department name and reason. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC ) , DegreeGrantingSubjectCounts AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT lso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) , EngineeringDeptTotals AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ) , EngineeringSubjectCounts AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) , CombinedDeptStats AS ( SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_enrollment, i.enrollment_variance, i.enrollment_stddev, NULL AS total_enrollment, dsc.num_unique_subjects, 'DegreeGrantingStats' AS Reason FROM inner_cte i LEFT JOIN DegreeGrantingSubjectCounts dsc ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsc.DEPARTMENT_NAME UNION ALL SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_enrollment, NULL AS enrollment_variance, NULL AS enrollment_stddev, e.total_enrollment, esc.num_unique_subjects, 'EngineeringTotals' AS Reason FROM EngineeringDeptTotals e LEFT JOIN EngineeringSubjectCounts esc ON e.DEPARTMENT_NAME = esc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT * FROM CombinedDeptStats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Reason;

question: Show the department names, the corresponding SIS subject code, subject code descriptions, graduate level, the total number of courses per department, and for each department, the number of subjects offered in the academic year 2022 with a total of 12 units that also have at least one required or optional textbook. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) OVER ( PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, Total_Courses.Total_Courses, COALESCE(SubjectsWithTextbooks.Subjects_With_Textbooks, 0) AS Subjects_With_Textbooks_2022_12units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_NUMBER) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS Total_Courses ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s1.SUBJECT_CODE || '-' || s1.SUBJECT_NUMBER) AS Subjects_With_Textbooks FROM inner_cte s1 JOIN TIP_DETAIL t2 ON s1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND s1.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IN ('RQ', 'EO') GROUP BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS SubjectsWithTextbooks ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = SubjectsWithTextbooks.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: From the top 10 space units with the highest number of associated organizations, display each space unit's name, the total count of associated organizations, the DLC name, the organization most represented in that space unit, and the count of space units associated with that organization. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, su.DLC_KEY, su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, fo.DLC_NAME, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY WHERE su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE IS NOT NULL ), org_counts AS ( SELECT ic.space_unit_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ic.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, ic.DLC_NAME FROM inner_cte ic GROUP BY ic.space_unit_name, ic.DLC_NAME ), org_rank AS ( SELECT ic.space_unit_name, ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(ic.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS space_unit_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ic.space_unit_name ORDER BY COUNT(ic.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) DESC) AS org_rank FROM inner_cte ic WHERE ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ic.space_unit_name, ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT oc.space_unit_name, oc.org_count AS total_organization_count, oc.DLC_NAME, orr.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS most_represented_organization, orr.space_unit_count AS space_unit_count_for_organization FROM org_counts oc LEFT JOIN org_rank orr ON oc.space_unit_name = orr.space_unit_name AND orr.org_rank = 1 ORDER BY oc.org_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each department that grants degrees, where the range of total units of courses offered this year (with non-null total units) is greater than 0 and the variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with a non-null subject code description) is not null, give the department name, the range of total units, the variance of total units, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, the variance of enrolled students, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrolled students, in that order, but only include departments where the range of total units is above the average range across all such departments. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DepartmentTotalUnitsStats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccc.total_units) - MIN(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccc.total_units IS NOT NULL GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DepartmentEnrolledStudentsStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dtu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dtu.total_units_range, dtu.total_units_variance, dtu.total_units_stddev, des.enrolled_students_variance, des.enrolled_students_stddev FROM DepartmentTotalUnitsStats dtu JOIN DepartmentEnrolledStudentsStats des ON dtu.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE dtu.total_units_range > 0 AND des.enrolled_students_variance IS NOT NULL ), avg_range_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(total_units_range) AS avg_total_units_range FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_units_range, i.total_units_variance, i.total_units_stddev, i.enrolled_students_variance, i.enrolled_students_stddev FROM inner_cte i JOIN avg_range_cte a ON 1=1 WHERE i.total_units_range > a.avg_total_units_range ORDER BY i.total_units_range DESC;

question: For each of the 5 departments that offer the largest number of unique subjects, list the department code, department name, the total number of unique subjects they offer, and for each subject offering in the term '2017FA' with a total number of units greater than 10 in that department, show the subject title, the responsible faculty name, and the deviation of the subject's total units from the average total units of all subjects offered by that department in '2017FA'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY num_subjects DESC LIMIT 5 ), dept_avg_units AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), subject_offerings AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sos.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, sos.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 10 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.num_subjects, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, (so.TOTAL_UNITS - dau.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte ic JOIN subject_offerings so ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = so.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN dept_avg_units dau ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dau.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ic.num_subjects DESC, so.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each department where the maximum total units of any course offered by that department is greater than 6, and for students in the "Electrical Eng & Computer Sci" department, show the department name, the maximum total units, the name of the school that department belongs to, the student's full name, email address, course description, course level, and, for each course, whether the course is an undergraduate or graduate course. Also, indicate whether the student's email address ends with 'mit.edu' as 'MIT_EMAIL' or 'NON_MIT_EMAIL' for each row. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dmu.max_total_units, dmu.SCHOOL_NAME, esc.FULL_NAME, esc.EMAIL_ADDRESS, esc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, esc.COURSE_LEVEL, esc.window_column FROM ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ) dmu JOIN ( SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.COURSE_LEVEL ORDER BY t2.LAST_NAME) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) esc ON dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME = esc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.max_total_units, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.FULL_NAME, inner_cte.EMAIL_ADDRESS, inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.COURSE_LEVEL, CASE WHEN inner_cte.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' THEN 'Undergraduate' WHEN inner_cte.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' THEN 'Graduate' ELSE 'Other' END AS COURSE_TYPE, CASE WHEN inner_cte.EMAIL_ADDRESS LIKE '%@mit.edu' THEN 'MIT_EMAIL' ELSE 'NON_MIT_EMAIL' END AS EMAIL_TYPE, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte;

question: For each academic year, provide either (1) the academic year, academic year description, the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during terms in that year (considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the number of enrolled students is greater than 0), or (2) for subjects in the "Engineering" school with total units equal to 1, the academic year, subject ID, subject title, department name, the rank of each subject within its academic year group ordered by subject ID, and the average number of enrolled students for that subject across all terms. Indicate the reason for inclusion as either 'EnrolledStats' or 'EngineeringSubjects'. The columns should be: academic year, academic year description, enrolled range, enrolled variance, subject ID, subject title, department name, rank, average enrolled students, and reason. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), EngineeringSubjectsWithAvg AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE LEFT JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON t1.SUBJECT_ID = lso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 1 GROUP BY t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, icte.enrolled_range, icte.enrolled_variance, NULL AS SUBJECT_ID, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS window_column, NULL AS avg_enrolled_students, 'EnrolledStats' AS Reason FROM inner_cte icte UNION ALL SELECT eng.ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS enrolled_range, NULL AS enrolled_variance, eng.SUBJECT_ID, eng.SUBJECT_TITLE, eng.DEPARTMENT_NAME, eng.window_column, eng.avg_enrolled_students, 'EngineeringSubjects' AS Reason FROM EngineeringSubjectsWithAvg eng ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, enrolled_range, enrolled_variance, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column, avg_enrolled_students, Reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, Reason, SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each organization with organization level equal to 5 and assignable equal to 1, and for each department in the "Provost Area" with a non-null department code, where the organization and department names match, show the organization name, organization key, department name, department code, the average organization key within each organization key group ordered by department code, the department's long name, the corresponding hierarchy level 3 name from the master department hierarchy, and whether the department is classified as 'HIGH_ORG_KEY' (if the organization key is at least 10% greater than the average for its group), 'LOW_ORG_KEY' (if at least 10% less), or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH OrgStats AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1 ), DeptStats AS ( SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t1.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL ) SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, o.window_column AS org_window_column, d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME FROM OrgStats o JOIN DeptStats d ON o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, icte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.org_window_column, icte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, icte.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, CASE WHEN icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY > icte.org_window_column * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ORG_KEY' WHEN icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY < icte.org_window_column * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ORG_KEY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS org_key_category FROM inner_cte icte;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2012 with a cluster type of 'SWE: School-Wide Electives', show the subject key, subject title, academic year, the running sum of the number of enrolled students within each department, the academic year description, the range, and the variance of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during terms in that year (considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the number of enrolled students is greater than 0), and also include the total number of subjects offered in each department for that year, ordered by subject key. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, SUM(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_KEY) AS running_enrollment_sum FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 AND t1.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC = 'SWE: School-Wide Electives' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), DeptSubjectCount AS ( SELECT t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.SUBJECT_KEY) AS dept_subject_count FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 AND t1.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC = 'SWE: School-Wide Electives' GROUP BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_KEY, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.running_enrollment_sum, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.enrolled_range, s2.enrolled_variance, dsc.dept_subject_count FROM inner_cte icte JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR LEFT JOIN DeptSubjectCount dsc ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dsc.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND icte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = dsc.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_KEY;

question: For subjects offered in the term '2022FA' with a total of 12 units, show the subject title from the summary, the department name from the course description, the dense rank of each subject considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the subject code from the course catalog, and for each subject's department, also show the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for courses offered by that department. Additionally, for each subject, show the subject description from the course catalog. List the subject title, department name, window column, total units range, total units variance, total units standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and subject description in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), DepartmentUnitStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.window_column, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev, cso.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte icte JOIN DepartmentUnitStats dus ON icte.DEPARTMENT = dus.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON icte.SUBJECT_TITLE = cso.SUBJECT_TITLE AND dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For each space unit, provide the space unit name, the associated organization name, the average, range, and variance of the HR department codes for the HR org units linked to that space unit (considering only space units with a warehouse load date of '19-DEC-24' and HR org units with a warehouse load date of '03-DEC-24'), as well as the average and variance of the HR department codes (old) for all associated HR org units where the organization is assignable and the HR department name is not null. Additionally, indicate whether the average HR department code for the space unit is at least 10% greater than the average HR department code (old) for the organization ('HIGH_AVG'), at least 10% less ('LOW_AVG'), or otherwise 'AVERAGE'. List the results ordered by the HR department code range (descending) and then by the variance of the HR department codes (old) (descending). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH SpaceUnitStats AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS avg_hr_dept_code, MAX(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) - MIN(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS hr_dept_code_range, VARIANCE(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS hr_dept_code_variance, fo.DLC_KEY FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE su.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND hou.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '03-DEC-24' GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fo.DLC_KEY ORDER BY hr_dept_code_range DESC ), OrgStats AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS avg_dept_code_old, VARIANCE(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS var_dept_code_old, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = HR_ORG_UNIT.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY ORDER BY var_dept_code_old DESC ), CombinedStats AS ( SELECT s.SPACE_UNIT, s.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s.avg_hr_dept_code, s.hr_dept_code_range, s.hr_dept_code_variance, o.avg_dept_code_old, o.var_dept_code_old FROM SpaceUnitStats s JOIN OrgStats o ON s.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY ) SELECT * FROM CombinedStats ORDER BY hr_dept_code_range DESC, var_dept_code_old DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.avg_hr_dept_code, inner_cte.hr_dept_code_range, inner_cte.hr_dept_code_variance, inner_cte.avg_dept_code_old, inner_cte.var_dept_code_old, CASE WHEN inner_cte.avg_hr_dept_code > inner_cte.avg_dept_code_old * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_AVG' WHEN inner_cte.avg_hr_dept_code < inner_cte.avg_dept_code_old * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_AVG' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS avg_code_category FROM inner_cte ORDER BY hr_dept_code_range DESC, var_dept_code_old DESC;

question: Show the department names, academic years, the number of unique subjects, the minimum total units offered, the variance of the number of enrolled students in courses with at least one enrolled student and course materials with a material status of 'RQ', and the total number of courses per department and academic year where the subject enrollment number is greater than 10. Do not return any rounded answers.
