SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), DepartmentEnrolledVariance AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC ), TotalCoursesPerDeptYear AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_courses FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.min_total_units, dev.enrolled_variance, tc.total_courses FROM inner_cte JOIN DepartmentEnrolledVariance dev ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dev.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN TotalCoursesPerDeptYear tc ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = tc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = tc.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY inner_cte.subject_count DESC, dev.enrolled_variance DESC;

question: For each subject offered in the academic term with term code '2006FA', show the subject ID, subject title, department name, the sum of lecture units within each grade type group, the total number of active graduate students with an office location assigned in the same department, and classify the department as 'LARGE' if it has more than 10 such students, 'SMALL' if it has fewer than 5, or 'MEDIUM' otherwise. Order the results by subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.LECTURE_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA' ), ActiveGradStudentStats AS ( SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS total_active_grad_students FROM SE_PERSON s JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY m ON s.FULL_NAME = m.FULL_NAME WHERE s.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND m.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND m.OFFICE_LOCATION IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.window_column, ags.total_active_grad_students, CASE WHEN ags.total_active_grad_students > 10 THEN 'LARGE' WHEN ags.total_active_grad_students < 5 THEN 'SMALL' ELSE 'MEDIUM' END AS department_size_category FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ActiveGradStudentStats ags ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ags.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ic.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For courses in the SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION table with a department code of 6, show the course, course description, department name, school name, program code, program title, category code, category title, four digit code, four digit title, and the minimum warehouse load date from the CIP table over each category code group, along with the building key, average total units, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for all subjects scheduled in rooms of that building during the fall term. Additionally, include the major use description of the building and the organization name associated with the room. Order the results by category code and descending standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.PROGRAM_CODE, c.PROGRAM_TITLE, c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY c.CATEGORY_CODE) AS min_warehouse_load_date FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION s JOIN CIP c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT = 6 ) SELECT ci.COURSE, ci.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ci.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ci.SCHOOL_NAME, ci.PROGRAM_CODE, ci.PROGRAM_TITLE, ci.CATEGORY_CODE, ci.CATEGORY_TITLE, ci.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, ci.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, ci.min_warehouse_load_date, bs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, bs.avg_total_units, bs.stddev_total_units, fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC, fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME FROM inner_cte ci JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON cso.SUBJECT_CODE = ci.COURSE JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = cso.MEET_PLACE JOIN ( SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ) bs ON bs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY ci.CATEGORY_CODE, bs.stddev_total_units DESC

question: For subjects offered in the term '2022FA' with a total of 12 units, show the subject title from the summary, the department name from the course description, the dense rank of each subject considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the subject code from the course catalog, the number of offered subjects, the minimum number of enrolled students for each department name and school name where the number of enrolled students in the offered subject is greater than 3, and the school name from the course description. The columns should be displayed in the following order: subject title, department name, dense rank, number of offered subjects, minimum number of enrolled students, and school name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, subq2.offered_subject_count, subq2.min_enrolled_students, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS offered_subject_count, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME ) subq2 ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME = subq2.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.window_column

question: For each subject that has at least one enrolled student and is offered in the term '2016SP' with a school code of 'E', show the subject title, the number of enrolled students, the term code from the library subject offered table, the tip material status key, the total units from the subject offered summary, the average number of enrolled students within each subject title group ordered by total units, the department name, the course description, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title, and the school name from the SIS_SUBJECT_CODE table, ordered by total units descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.TERM_CODE, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_enrolled_students, lso.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID INNER JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), subq2 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SCHOOL_CODE, t0.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t0.SCHOOL_CODE = 'E' ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s1.TOTAL_UNITS, s1.avg_enrolled_students, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s2.window_column, s2.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY s1.TOTAL_UNITS DESC

question: For each department, what is the department name, the range of enrolled students, the variance of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department (considering only departments that grant degrees and courses at the graduate level), the count of distinct subject IDs, the minimum ISBN value for the associated course materials (considering only offering departments and schools where the number of enrolled students is greater than 2), and the average number of enrolled students for those subjects? Please provide the department name, the range of enrolled students, the variance of enrolled students, the count of distinct subject IDs, the minimum ISBN value, and the average number of enrolled students, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC ), DeptSubjectMaterialStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(td.ISBN) AS min_isbn, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.enrolled_range, inner_cte.enrolled_variance, dsm.subject_count, dsm.min_isbn, dsm.avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte JOIN DeptSubjectMaterialStats dsm ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsm.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.enrolled_range DESC;

question: For subjects offered in the 2012SU term with a cluster type of 'S' and offered by the Harvard Cross-Enrollment Program, provide the subject key, subject title, department name, the number of subject offerings, the total number of units for those offerings, the dense rank of each subject considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the number of enrolled students in the offered table, and the average number of enrolled students for each subject across all its offerings. List the results ordered by the total number of units in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t2.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t0.CLUSTER_TYPE = 'S' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT so.SUBJECT_KEY, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS offering_count, SUM(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units, so.SUBJECT_ID_SORT FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON sos.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' GROUP BY so.SUBJECT_KEY, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, so.SUBJECT_ID_SORT ) SELECT sq2.SUBJECT_KEY, sq2.SUBJECT_TITLE, sq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sq2.offering_count, sq2.total_units, sq1.window_column, sq2.SUBJECT_ID_SORT FROM Subquery2 sq2 JOIN Subquery1 sq1 ON sq2.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = sq1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_KEY, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.offering_count, icte.total_units, icte.window_column, AVG(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON icte.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = so.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' GROUP BY icte.SUBJECT_KEY, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.offering_count, icte.total_units, icte.window_column ORDER BY icte.total_units DESC

question: For each organization with an organization level of 5 and for rooms on floor 2 that are associated via space unit code, show the organization name, organization key, description, space unit, space unit key, the average organization key within each organization key group ordered by space unit key, the building room, space usage, the HR org unit title, the department name, the minimum access level in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the building component, and the HR org unit level and department code for each room, ordered by organization name and building room. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH OrgLevel5 AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.SPACE_UNIT, t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ), RoomsFloor2 AS ( SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.SPACE_USAGE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(t0.ACCESS_LEVEL) OVER (ORDER BY t0.BUILDING_COMPONENT ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2 ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.DESCRIPTION, o.SPACE_UNIT, o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, o.window_column AS org_window_column, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.SPACE_USAGE, r.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, r.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, r.window_column AS room_window_column, r.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM OrgLevel5 o JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY JOIN RoomsFloor2 r ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = r.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ) SELECT cr.ORGANIZATION_NAME, cr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, cr.DESCRIPTION, cr.SPACE_UNIT, cr.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, cr.org_window_column, cr.BUILDING_ROOM, cr.SPACE_USAGE, cr.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, cr.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, cr.room_window_column, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM CombinedResults cr JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON cr.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = h.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte ORDER BY ORGANIZATION_NAME, BUILDING_ROOM;

question: For each degree-granting department that offers at least one subject with more than 0 total units, what is the department name, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for all subjects offered by that department, and for subjects offered in regular academic terms, what is the average, range, and variance of the total units? Additionally, for each department, indicate whether the average total units for regular terms is at least 10% greater than the average for all subjects ('HIGH_LOAD'), at least 10% less ('LOW_LOAD'), or otherwise 'AVERAGE_LOAD'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), DeptUnitsRegularTerm AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units_regular, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range_regular, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance_regular FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range_regular DESC ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_total_units AS avg_total_units_all_subjects, i.total_units_variance AS total_units_variance_all_subjects, i.total_units_stddev AS total_units_stddev_all_subjects, d.avg_total_units_regular, d.total_units_range_regular, d.total_units_variance_regular, CASE WHEN d.avg_total_units_regular > i.avg_total_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_LOAD' WHEN d.avg_total_units_regular < i.avg_total_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_LOAD' ELSE 'AVERAGE_LOAD' END AS load_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN DeptUnitsRegularTerm d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each major use description and organization name where the room area is greater than 100 and the access level is 1, show the number of rooms, the minimum floor number, the building room, floor, room number, space ID, area, major use name, major use description, the minimum area value over each major use group for rooms with area greater than 200 and assignable major use, and the organization description, ordered by major use description, organization name, and major use. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count, MIN(r.FLOOR) AS min_floor, r.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 100 AND r.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 GROUP BY r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ), subq2 AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.ROOM, t1.SPACE_ID, t1.AREA, t0.MAJOR_USE, t0.DESCRIPTION, min(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY ORDER BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY) AS min_area_per_major_use, t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_MAJOR_USE t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 200 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1 ) SELECT s1.MAJOR_USE_DESC, s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s1.room_count, s1.min_floor, s2.BUILDING_ROOM, s2.FLOOR, s2.ROOM, s2.SPACE_ID, s2.AREA, s2.MAJOR_USE, s2.DESCRIPTION, s2.min_area_per_major_use, s1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = s2.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY AND s1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = s2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) SELECT inner_cte.MAJOR_USE_DESC, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.room_count, inner_cte.min_floor, inner_cte.BUILDING_ROOM, inner_cte.FLOOR, inner_cte.ROOM, inner_cte.SPACE_ID, inner_cte.AREA, inner_cte.MAJOR_USE, inner_cte.DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.min_area_per_major_use, fo.DESCRIPTION AS organization_description FROM inner_cte JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON inner_cte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY inner_cte.MAJOR_USE_DESC, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.MAJOR_USE;

question: For rooms with an area greater than 300 that are associated with departments in the "Provost Area", show the building-room identifier, floor number, major use description, organization name, DLC key, the average area in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by department code and ordered by area, the department code, department name, school area name, and the rank of each department within its school area based on department code. Additionally, include the department's full name from the HR organization unit and the department's hierarchy level 3 name from the master department hierarchy. Present the results ordered by building-room identifier and department code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH RoomStats AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.MAJOR_USE_DESC, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, t1.DEPT_CODE, AVG(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t1.AREA ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_avg_area FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 300 ), ProvostDepts AS ( SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, t1.DLC_KEY, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 INNER JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' ) SELECT rs.BUILDING_ROOM, rs.FLOOR, rs.MAJOR_USE_DESC, rs.ORGANIZATION_NAME, rs.DLC_KEY, rs.window_avg_area, pd.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, pd.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, pd.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, pd.window_column FROM RoomStats rs JOIN ProvostDepts pd ON rs.DLC_KEY = pd.DLC_KEY ) SELECT icte.BUILDING_ROOM, icte.FLOOR, icte.MAJOR_USE_DESC, icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.DLC_KEY, icte.window_avg_area, icte.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, icte.window_column, hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, mdh.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME AS DEPT_HIERARCHY_LVL3_NAME FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON icte.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY AND icte.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE = hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY mdh ON icte.DLC_KEY = mdh.DLC_KEY ORDER BY icte.BUILDING_ROOM, icte.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE

question: For each department, provide the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of unique subject codes associated with its courses that are offered by degree-granting departments. Then, for each subject offered in the academic year 2024 with total units equal to 12 in that department, show the subject code, subject number, subject title, total units, and the row number within the department ordered by subject code, but only include those subjects where the total units exceed the average total units for subjects in that department in 2024. The columns should be: department name, average subject codes, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subject codes, subject code, subject number, subject title, total units, and row number within department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes FROM ( SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT ) course_subjects JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON course_subjects.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), Subjects2024 AS ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.avg_subject_codes, dss.stddev_subject_codes, s24.SUBJECT_CODE, s24.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s24.SUBJECT_TITLE, s24.TOTAL_UNITS, s24.window_column, s24.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM DeptSubjectStats dss JOIN Subjects2024 s24 ON dss.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s24.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) , DeptAvgUnits AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_subject_codes, i.stddev_subject_codes, i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_NUMBER, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TOTAL_UNITS, i.window_column FROM inner_cte i JOIN DeptAvgUnits dau ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dau.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE i.TOTAL_UNITS > dau.avg_total_units ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.window_column

question: For each administrative department and each subject offered by that department in the term '2019FA' with more than 0 enrolled students, list the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the office phone numbers of students in that department (considering only students who have a non-null office phone number), the subject title, the offer department name, the department full name, the number of enrolled students, the average number of enrolled students in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the school code, and classify the subject as 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' if the number of enrolled students is at least 10% greater than the window average, 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' if at least 10% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Order by department name and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DepartmentOfficePhoneStats AS ( SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.OFFICE_PHONE) AS avg_office_phone, STDDEV(MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.OFFICE_PHONE) AS stddev_office_phone, SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY ON SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.DEPARTMENT WHERE MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.OFFICE_PHONE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY stddev_office_phone DESC ), SubjectEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT dops.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dops.avg_office_phone, dops.stddev_office_phone, ses.SUBJECT_TITLE, ses.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ses.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ses.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ses.window_column FROM DepartmentOfficePhoneStats dops JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON dops.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SubjectEnrollmentStats ses ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ses.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY dops.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ses.SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT inner_cte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_office_phone, inner_cte.stddev_office_phone, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.window_column, CASE WHEN inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > inner_cte.window_column * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < inner_cte.window_column * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each department in the Provost Area with a non-null department code, show the department name, the department's long name, the corresponding hierarchy level 3 name from the master department hierarchy, and, for each space unit with a space unit key greater than 100000 that shares the same DLC key, show the space unit code, the organization name, the HR department name from the space unit, and the FCLT_ORGANIZATION description. Only include results where the sum of space unit keys within each warehouse load date group (ordered by space unit key) exceeds 200000. The columns should be shown in the following order: department name, department long name, hierarchy level 3 name, space unit code, organization name, HR department name from the space unit, FCLT_ORGANIZATION description, and the space unit window sum. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptWindowed AS ( SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, t1.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t1.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL ), SpaceUnitWindowed AS ( SELECT t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t3.DESCRIPTION, SUM(t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE ORDER BY t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_sum, t2.DLC_KEY, t0.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE FROM SPACE_UNIT t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t3 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t3.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000 ) SELECT d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, s.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS spaceunit_hr_department_name, s.DESCRIPTION AS fclt_org_description, s.window_sum FROM DeptWindowed d JOIN SpaceUnitWindowed s ON d.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte WHERE window_sum > 200000 ORDER BY HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SPACE_UNIT_CODE;

question: For each activity, list its title, enrollment type, maximum enrollment, category name, and the number of activities in that category. For each category, include a grand total for all activities in the format of (null, null, null, category name, total activities). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY ) , CategoryCounts AS ( SELECT IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, COUNT(*) AS total_activities FROM inner_cte GROUP BY IAP_CATEGORY_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ) SELECT CASE WHEN cc.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN ic.ACTIVITY_TITLE ELSE NULL END AS ACTIVITY_TITLE, CASE WHEN cc.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN ic.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ELSE NULL END AS ENROLLMENT_TYPE, CASE WHEN cc.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN ic.MAX_ENROLLMENT ELSE NULL END AS MAX_ENROLLMENT, cc.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, cc.total_activities FROM CategoryCounts cc LEFT JOIN inner_cte ic ON cc.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = ic.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY cc.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, ic.ACTIVITY_TITLE

question: For each department, provide the department's name, the range and variance of the access levels of rooms assigned to it, the average number of supervisees, the range and variance of the number of supervisees for all space units associated with that department, and the total square footage assigned to supervisees in those space units. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DepartmentAccessLevels AS ( SELECT HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.ACCESS_LEVEL) - MIN(ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_range, VARIANCE(ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_variance FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.ACCESS_LEVEL IS NOT NULL GROUP BY HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY access_level_range DESC ), DepartmentSupervisees AS ( SELECT SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT AS department_name, AVG(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS avg_supervisees, MAX(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) - MIN(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS supervisee_range, VARIANCE(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS supervisee_variance FROM SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE JOIN SPACE_UNIT ON SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.DEPT_NAMES = SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY GROUP BY SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT ORDER BY supervisee_range DESC ) SELECT dal.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dal.access_level_range, dal.access_level_variance, ds.avg_supervisees, ds.supervisee_range, ds.supervisee_variance, su_total_sqft.total_sqft FROM DepartmentAccessLevels dal JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON dal.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = fo.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY JOIN DepartmentSupervisees ds ON su.SPACE_UNIT = ds.department_name LEFT JOIN ( SELECT su2.SPACE_UNIT, SUM(ssu.SQFT) AS total_sqft FROM SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ssu JOIN SPACE_UNIT su2 ON ssu.DEPT_NAMES = su2.DLC_KEY GROUP BY su2.SPACE_UNIT ) su_total_sqft ON su.SPACE_UNIT = su_total_sqft.SPACE_UNIT ORDER BY dal.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte;

question: For each department in the Provost Area, provide the department name, its organization key, the number of organizations, the minimum department hierarchy level 3 code, the building-room identifier, the organization name, the DLC key, the sum of room areas within each major use description group for rooms with area greater than 200, and the difference between the sum of room areas for that major use group and the average room area for that major use group across all organizations. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptProvostArea AS ( SELECT m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_CODE) AS min_level3_code FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ), RoomAreaSummary AS ( SELECT t2.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, SUM(t2.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.MAJOR_USE_DESC ORDER BY t2.BUILDING_ROOM) AS window_column, t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t2.MAJOR_USE_DESC FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.AREA > 200 ) SELECT d.DLC_NAME, d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, d.org_count, d.min_level3_code, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.DLC_KEY, r.window_column, r.MAJOR_USE_DESC FROM DeptProvostArea d JOIN RoomAreaSummary r ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) , MajorUseAvg AS ( SELECT MAJOR_USE_DESC, AVG(AREA) AS avg_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS WHERE AREA > 200 GROUP BY MAJOR_USE_DESC ) SELECT i.DLC_NAME, i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.org_count, i.min_level3_code, i.BUILDING_ROOM, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.DLC_KEY, i.window_column, i.MAJOR_USE_DESC, (i.window_column - m.avg_area) AS area_deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte i JOIN MajorUseAvg m ON i.MAJOR_USE_DESC = m.MAJOR_USE_DESC;

question: From the top 10 IAP activities with the highest maximum enrollment, display each activity's title, enrollment type, maximum enrollment, its category name, and the most frequent enrollment type within that category along with the count of activities for that enrollment type. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY ), category_enrollment_counts AS ( SELECT cte.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS EnrollmentType_Count FROM inner_cte cte GROUP BY cte.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ), category_enrollment_ranked AS ( SELECT cec.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, cec.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, cec.EnrollmentType_Count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cec.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY cec.EnrollmentType_Count DESC) AS rnk FROM category_enrollment_counts cec ), most_frequent_enrollment_type AS ( SELECT IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, ENROLLMENT_TYPE AS Most_Frequent_Enrollment_Type, EnrollmentType_Count FROM category_enrollment_ranked WHERE rnk = 1 ) SELECT cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, cte.MAX_ENROLLMENT, cte.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, mfe.Most_Frequent_Enrollment_Type, mfe.EnrollmentType_Count FROM inner_cte cte LEFT JOIN most_frequent_enrollment_type mfe ON cte.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = mfe.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY cte.MAX_ENROLLMENT DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each department in the School of Engineering, for subjects with at least 6 total units offered in the most recent academic year, give the department name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the most recent academic year, along with the subject ID, subject title, the running sum of total units within each school, and the responsible faculty name, ordered by the range of total units (descending) and subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.SUBJECT_ID WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ) GROUP BY COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.total_units_range, inner_cte.total_units_variance, es.SUBJECT_ID, es.SUBJECT_TITLE, es.window_column, sos.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ) es ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = es.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON es.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY inner_cte.total_units_range DESC, es.SUBJECT_ID

question: For each department name, provide the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in library subjects that have a matching master subject ID in the TIP subject offerings (considering only departments with more than 0 enrolled students in both tables), along with the administrative department name, the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering (where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 100), and the total number of enrolled students in all subjects offered by the same department across all schools (where this total is greater than 200), for departments where the department name matches and the department code is the same. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ls.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(ls.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_students_variance, STDDEV(ls.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_students_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ls JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ts ON ls.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = ts.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID WHERE ls.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND ts.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ls.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY library_students_variance DESC ), EngineeringAdminTotals AS ( SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100 ), DepartmentTotalEnrolled AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS dept_total_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 200 ) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.library_students_variance, ic.library_students_stddev, eat.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, eat.total_enrolled, dte.dept_total_enrolled FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN EngineeringAdminTotals eat ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = eat.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN DepartmentTotalEnrolled dte ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dte.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: For each of the top 10 academic years by the number of unique course materials assigned (for terms that are not current and where the course material status is 'RQ'), what is the academic year, the academic year description, the variance of the number of tip detail records for subjects offered in the fall term with at least one associated tip detail record, the total count of unique materials, and the number of unique departments offering subjects in those academic years? List the academic year, academic year description, variance of tip detail record counts, unique material count, and unique department count in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.record_count_variance, s2.unique_materials FROM (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC ) s1 JOIN (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS unique_materials FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY unique_materials DESC LIMIT 10 ) s2 ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY s2.unique_materials DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance, inner_cte.unique_materials, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS unique_departments FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance, inner_cte.unique_materials ORDER BY inner_cte.unique_materials DESC;

question: For each department name and course level where the course is degree granting and the total units are greater than 6, and for each of the top 10 subject titles by the number of reserved library materials in the term '2009SP' offered by that department, provide the department name, course level, number of unique courses, minimum total units offered, subject title, offering department name, the count of reserved materials, and the total number of reserved materials for all subject titles offered by that department in that term (as a grand total row with null subject title), ordered by department name, course level, and reserved materials in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL ), TopSubjects AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY reserved_materials DESC LIMIT 10 ), DeptSubjectReserves AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cs.COURSE_LEVEL, ts.SUBJECT_TITLE, ts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ts.reserved_materials FROM inner_cte cs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN TopSubjects ts ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = ts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND sos.SUBJECT_TITLE = ts.SUBJECT_TITLE ), DeptTotalReserves AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cs.COURSE_LEVEL, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, ts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(ts.reserved_materials) AS reserved_materials FROM inner_cte cs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN TopSubjects ts ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = ts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cs.COURSE_LEVEL, ts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.COURSE_LEVEL, cs.course_count, cs.min_total_units, d.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, d.reserved_materials FROM DeptSubjectReserves d JOIN inner_cte cs ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND d.COURSE_LEVEL = cs.COURSE_LEVEL UNION ALL SELECT t.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.COURSE_LEVEL, cs.course_count, cs.min_total_units, t.SUBJECT_TITLE, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t.reserved_materials FROM DeptTotalReserves t JOIN inner_cte cs ON t.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND t.COURSE_LEVEL = cs.COURSE_LEVEL ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_LEVEL, reserved_materials DESC;

question: For each subject offered in the academic term with term code '2006FA', show the subject ID, subject title, department name, the sum of lecture units within each grade type group, the total number of active graduate students with an office location assigned in that department, and for each department, include a grand total of active graduate students in the format of (null subject ID, null subject title, department name, null, total students), ordered by department name and subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH SubjectLectureSums AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.LECTURE_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA' ), ActiveGradStudents AS ( SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS total_active_grad_students FROM SE_PERSON s JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY m ON s.FULL_NAME = m.FULL_NAME WHERE s.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND m.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND m.OFFICE_LOCATION IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.window_column, a.total_active_grad_students FROM SubjectLectureSums s JOIN ActiveGradStudents a ON s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, SUM(total_active_grad_students) AS total_active_grad_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(total_active_grad_students) > 0 ) SELECT rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.SUBJECT_ID, rr.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.window_column, rr.total_active_grad_students FROM RollupResults rr LEFT JOIN inner_cte ic ON rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND rr.SUBJECT_ID = ic.SUBJECT_ID AND rr.SUBJECT_TITLE = ic.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.SUBJECT_ID ;

question: For each academic year where there is at least one academic term with term status indicator 'P', show the academic year, the academic year description, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in regular terms, and for each such academic term, display the term code, the term parameter, the term description, the term start date, and the windowed average academic year (in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the term indicator and ordered by the term start date). Additionally, for each department, show the department code, department name, and the number of unique subjects offered in these terms. For each academic year and department, include a grand total for all subjects in the format of (academic year, academic year description, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, department code, department name, total subjects). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ), TermInfo AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_PARAMETER, t2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, AVG(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER ( PARTITION BY t1.TERM_INDICATOR ORDER BY t0.TERM_START_DATE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_INDICATOR = 'P' ), DeptSubjects AS ( SELECT t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cco.DEPARTMENT_CODE, cco.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT cco.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cco ON t0.TERM_CODE = cco.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cco.DEPARTMENT_CODE, cco.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.avg_total_units, i.stddev_total_units, t.TERM_CODE, t.TERM_PARAMETER, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.TERM_START_DATE, t.window_column, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.num_subjects FROM inner_cte i JOIN TermInfo t ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = t.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN DeptSubjects d ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR UNION ALL SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(d.num_subjects) FROM inner_cte i JOIN DeptSubjects d ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR GROUP BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT * FROM RollupResults ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_CODE, TERM_START_DATE, TERM_CODE ;

question: For subjects offered in the term '2019FA' with more than 0 enrolled students, and where the offering department is among the top 10 departments by the number of unique subjects they offered for terms in the academic year 2014 or later, show the subject title, offer department name, department full name, number of enrolled students, the average number of enrolled students in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the school code, the count of unique subject titles for the department, and the highest total units for any subject in that department in '2019FA', ordered by the subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_dept_name FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2014 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), DeptMaxUnits AS ( SELECT t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON t0.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_TITLE = ss.SUBJECT_TITLE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, icte.window_column, s2.subject_count, dmu.max_total_units FROM inner_cte icte JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON icte.join_dept_name = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME LEFT JOIN DeptMaxUnits dmu ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dmu.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: List, for each academic year and department name where the number of enrolled students is greater than 5, the academic year, department name, number of unique subjects offered, minimum start date of the academic term, average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units), and also include the total number of courses per department. Show the columns in this order: academic year, department name, subject count, minimum start date, average total units, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, and total courses. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ), YearDeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT l.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_start_date FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON t.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT yds.ACADEMIC_YEAR, yds.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, yds.subject_count, yds.min_start_date, dus.avg_total_units, dus.stddev_total_units FROM YearDeptSubjectStats yds JOIN DeptUnitsStats dus ON yds.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.min_start_date, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units, Total_Courses.Total_Courses FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS Total_Courses ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For the top 10 academic years by the number of unique course materials assigned (for terms that are not current and where the course material status is 'RQ'), display each academic year description, the total count of unique materials, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of reserved library materials per academic term in that year (considering only terms with a regular status), and also show the earliest and latest term start dates for those academic years. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH material_stats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(term_material_count) - MIN(term_material_count) AS material_count_range, VARIANCE(term_material_count) AS material_count_variance, STDDEV(term_material_count) AS material_count_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN ( SELECT LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE, COUNT(*) AS term_material_count FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL GROUP BY LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE ) AS term_stats ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = term_stats.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY material_count_range DESC ), unique_materials_stats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS unique_materials FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY unique_materials DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT um.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, um.unique_materials, ms.material_count_range, ms.material_count_variance, ms.material_count_stddev FROM unique_materials_stats um LEFT JOIN material_stats ms ON um.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = ms.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY um.unique_materials DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.unique_materials, inner_cte.material_count_range, inner_cte.material_count_variance, inner_cte.material_count_stddev, MIN(ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_START_DATE) AS earliest_term_start, MAX(ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_START_DATE) AS latest_term_start FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.unique_materials, inner_cte.material_count_range, inner_cte.material_count_variance, inner_cte.material_count_stddev ORDER BY inner_cte.unique_materials DESC;

question: For courses in the School of Engineering that are degree granting, and for each academic year and department name where the term status is 'Previous', show the course description, department name, subject code, subject title, the minimum total units in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the course number, the academic year, the number of unique subjects offered, the minimum total units for those subjects, and the subject's short title and whether the subject is offered in the current academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, MIN(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.SUBJECT_ID FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_CODE = t2.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT icte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.window_column, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.subject_count, s2.min_total_units, cso.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, ccso.SUBJECT_ID FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccso.SUBJECT_ID ) s2 ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON icte.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID AND s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR

question: For each organization with an organization level of 5, show the organization name, organization key, description, space unit, space unit key, the average organization key within each organization key group ordered by space unit key, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the access levels of rooms assigned to each space unit, and for each space unit, list the building room and its access level if the access level exceeds the average access level for that space unit. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.SPACE_UNIT, t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ), space_unit_cv AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, STDDEV(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) / NULLIF(AVG(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD zr ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = zr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE HAVING AVG(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) > 0 ), room_above_avg AS ( SELECT zr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, zr.BUILDING_ROOM, zr.ACCESS_LEVEL FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD zr JOIN ( SELECT SPACE_UNIT_CODE, AVG(ACCESS_LEVEL) AS avg_access FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD GROUP BY SPACE_UNIT_CODE ) avg_tbl ON zr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = avg_tbl.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE zr.ACCESS_LEVEL > avg_tbl.avg_access ) SELECT i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.DESCRIPTION, i.SPACE_UNIT, i.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, i.window_column, s.coefficient_of_variation, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.ACCESS_LEVEL AS ROOM_ACCESS_LEVEL FROM inner_cte i LEFT JOIN space_unit_cv s ON i.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE LEFT JOIN room_above_avg r ON i.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = r.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ORDER BY i.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, r.BUILDING_ROOM;

question: For each academic year and department name where the number of enrolled students is greater than 5, what is the description of the academic year, the variance of the total units for all subjects offered in terms that match that academic year and have a term status indicator of 'P', the number of unique subjects offered, the minimum start date of the academic term, and the total number of enrolled students in those subjects? Display the academic year, academic year description, variance of total units, department name, subject count, minimum start date, and total enrolled students, ordered by variance of total units descending and then subject count descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH units_variance AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), subject_counts AS ( SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT l.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_start_date, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON t.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT u.ACADEMIC_YEAR, u.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, u.total_units_variance, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.subject_count, s.min_start_date, s.total_enrolled_students FROM units_variance u JOIN subject_counts s ON u.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY u.total_units_variance DESC, s.subject_count DESC ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte;

question: For each degree-granting department that offered at least one subject in the School of Engineering in 2021, provide the department code, department name, department full name, the number of subjects offered, the total number of enrolled students in those subjects, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in those subjects (considering only subjects with a non-null subject code description), and the average number of enrolled students per subject for that department. Only include departments where the average number of enrolled students per subject is greater than the overall average number of enrolled students per subject across all such departments. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH eng_dept_2021_summary AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ), dept_enrollment_stats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_CODE, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, e.subject_count, e.total_enrollment, d.enrolled_students_variance, d.enrolled_students_stddev, (CAST(e.total_enrollment AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(e.subject_count, 0)) AS avg_enrollment_per_subject FROM eng_dept_2021_summary e JOIN dept_enrollment_stats d ON e.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, subject_count, total_enrollment, enrolled_students_variance, enrolled_students_stddev, avg_enrollment_per_subject FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_enrollment_per_subject > ( SELECT AVG(avg_enrollment_per_subject) FROM inner_cte );

question: Show the department names, the corresponding SIS subject code, subject code descriptions, graduate level, the total number of courses per department, and for each department that is degree-granting and offered at least one subject in the School of Engineering in 2021, provide the department code, department full name, the number of subjects offered, and the total number of enrolled students in those subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ) SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, Total_Courses.Total_Courses, icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, icte.subject_count, icte.total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_NUMBER) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS Total_Courses ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN inner_cte icte ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For subjects offered in the 2012SU term with a total of 1 unit, show the subject title from the summary, the course number from the offered table, the subject title from the offered summary, the department name from the summary, the offer department name from the offered summary, the row number within each department name group ordered by subject title from the summary, and for each department, also provide the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and at least 1 enrolled student). Additionally, include the full department name and the school name from the SIS_DEPARTMENT table for each department. List the results ordered by department name and row number. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE AS summary_subject_title, t1.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE AS offered_summary_subject_title, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t2.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS = 1 ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.summary_subject_title, inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER, inner_cte.offered_summary_subject_title, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, dept_stats.avg_total_units, dept_stats.stddev_total_units, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN dept_stats ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column;

question: For each of the top 10 space units by the number of rooms they contain, display the space unit name, the count of rooms, the department hierarchy name associated with the space unit, the average organization level for organizations in that hierarchy, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the organization level for organizations in that hierarchy, and the total square footage of all rooms in the space unit. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH dept_hierarchy_stats AS ( SELECT MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME, AVG(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) AS avg_org_level, STDDEV(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) AS org_level_stddev FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL IS NOT NULL GROUP BY MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME ORDER BY org_level_stddev DESC ), top_space_units AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(sd.BUILDING_ROOM) AS room_count, su.DLC_KEY, su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, su.DLC_KEY, su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY ORDER BY room_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT tsu.SPACE_UNIT, tsu.room_count, dhs.DLC_NAME, dhs.avg_org_level, dhs.org_level_stddev, tsu.SPACE_UNIT_KEY FROM top_space_units tsu LEFT JOIN dept_hierarchy_stats dhs ON tsu.DLC_KEY = (SELECT DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY WHERE DLC_NAME = dhs.DLC_NAME LIMIT 1) ORDER BY tsu.room_count DESC ) SELECT icte.SPACE_UNIT, icte.room_count, icte.DLC_NAME, icte.avg_org_level, icte.org_level_stddev, SUM(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS total_square_footage FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SPACE_DETAIL sd ON icte.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY GROUP BY icte.SPACE_UNIT, icte.room_count, icte.DLC_NAME, icte.avg_org_level, icte.org_level_stddev ORDER BY icte.room_count DESC;

question: For the top 10 activity titles with the highest number of associated course materials, what are the activity title, the term description, the count of course materials, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the maximum enrollment across all academic terms for each activity? Additionally, for each activity title, provide the total number of unique academic years in which the activity was offered. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' GROUP BY IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY material_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), ActivityEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT ACTIVITY_TITLE, MAX(MAX_ENROLLMENT) - MIN(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS enrollment_stddev FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN TIME_DAY ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = TIME_DAY.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE WHERE IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ACTIVITY_TITLE ORDER BY enrollment_range DESC ), ActivityAcademicYears AS ( SELECT IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ACTIVITY_TITLE, COUNT(DISTINCT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS unique_academic_years FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' GROUP BY IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ACTIVITY_TITLE ) SELECT icte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.material_count, aes.enrollment_range, aes.enrollment_variance, aes.enrollment_stddev, aay.unique_academic_years FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN ActivityEnrollmentStats aes ON icte.ACTIVITY_TITLE = aes.ACTIVITY_TITLE LEFT JOIN ActivityAcademicYears aay ON icte.ACTIVITY_TITLE = aay.ACTIVITY_TITLE;

question: For each department and course number where the number of enrolled students in the subject summary is greater than 2, and where the department has more than 10 tip materials offered for subjects in the School of Engineering during regular terms, provide the department name, course number, the number of unique library subjects offered, the minimum total units for those subjects, the total number of tip materials offered for that department, and the average total units for those subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptCourseSubjects AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER ), EngineeringDeptTips AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL t JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) > 10 ) SELECT d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, d.COURSE_NUMBER, d.subject_count, d.min_total_units, e.total_tip_materials FROM DeptCourseSubjects d JOIN EngineeringDeptTips e ON d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = e.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.COURSE_NUMBER, i.subject_count, i.min_total_units, i.total_tip_materials, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte i JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND i.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON l.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.COURSE_NUMBER, i.subject_count, i.min_total_units, i.total_tip_materials ORDER BY i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.COURSE_NUMBER;

question: For each department, show the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2022. For each course in the School of Engineering that is degree granting within those departments, show the course description, department name, and subject code description. Additionally, for each subject code, indicate whether it is associated with an undergraduate or graduate level (based on HGN_DESC in COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED), and count the number of subjects of each level per department. Include a grand total of subjects per department in the format (department name, null, total subjects). Present the results ordered by the units range in descending order and then by course description. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DepartmentUnitsStats AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC ), EngineeringDegreeCourses AS ( SELECT t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), SubjectLevelCounts AS ( SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.SUBJECT_CODE, cso.HGN_DESC AS subject_level, COUNT(*) AS num_subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso WHERE cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.SUBJECT_CODE, cso.HGN_DESC ), RollupSubjectCounts AS ( SELECT slc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, slc.subject_level, SUM(slc.num_subjects) AS total_subjects FROM SubjectLevelCounts slc GROUP BY slc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, slc.subject_level WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(slc.num_subjects) > 0 ) SELECT dus.units_range, dus.units_variance, edc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, edc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, edc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, rsc.subject_level, rsc.total_subjects FROM DepartmentUnitsStats dus JOIN EngineeringDegreeCourses edc ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = edc.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN RollupSubjectCounts rsc ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = rsc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dus.units_range DESC, edc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION

question: For each department hierarchy whose name starts with 'D' (case insensitive), and for departments in that hierarchy that have more than 5 rooms with area greater than 100, provide the department hierarchy name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the organization level for organizations in that hierarchy, the department's name, and the count and average area of rooms assigned to that department (considering only rooms with area greater than 100). Only include results where the average room area for the department is above 200. Present the results ordered by department hierarchy name and then by average room area in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
