SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME, AVG(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) AS avg_org_level, STDDEV(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) AS org_level_stddev FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL IS NOT NULL AND UPPER(MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME) LIKE 'D%' GROUP BY MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME ), DeptRoomStats AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_room_area FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 100 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 5 ) SELECT icte.DLC_NAME, icte.avg_org_level, icte.org_level_stddev, drs.ORGANIZATION_NAME, drs.room_count, drs.avg_room_area FROM inner_cte icte JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON icte.DLC_NAME = fo.DLC_NAME JOIN DeptRoomStats drs ON fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME = drs.ORGANIZATION_NAME WHERE drs.avg_room_area > 200 GROUP BY icte.DLC_NAME, icte.avg_org_level, icte.org_level_stddev, drs.ORGANIZATION_NAME, drs.room_count, drs.avg_room_area ORDER BY icte.DLC_NAME, drs.avg_room_area DESC;

question: For each academic year, list the academic year, the academic year description, the geometric mean of the number of library reserve material details per subject offered (for records where the material status is 'U' and the academic term is a regular term), the geometric mean of the degree year from all academic terms where the degree year is greater than 1900, and the geometric mean of the financial aid year from all academic terms where the financial aid year is greater than 1900. Also, include the reason for inclusion ('MaterialsPerSubject' for the geometric mean of materials per subject, 'DegreeYear' for the geometric mean of degree year, and 'FinancialAidYear' for the geometric mean of financial aid year). Show the academic year, academic year description, geometric mean of materials per subject, geometric mean of degree year, geometric mean of financial aid year, and reason, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH GeometricMeanMaterialsPerSubject AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(material_count))) AS geometric_mean_materials_per_subject FROM ( SELECT LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count, LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE ) sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON sub.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), GeometricMeanDegreeYear AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(ACADEMIC_TERMS.DEGREE_YEAR))) AS geometric_mean_degree_year FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.DEGREE_YEAR > 1900 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), GeometricMeanFinancialAidYear AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(ACADEMIC_TERMS.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR))) AS geometric_mean_financial_aid_year FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR > 1900 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), CombinedGeometricMeans AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, geometric_mean_materials_per_subject, NULL AS geometric_mean_degree_year, NULL AS geometric_mean_financial_aid_year, 'MaterialsPerSubject' AS Reason FROM GeometricMeanMaterialsPerSubject UNION ALL SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS geometric_mean_materials_per_subject, geometric_mean_degree_year, NULL AS geometric_mean_financial_aid_year, 'DegreeYear' AS Reason FROM GeometricMeanDegreeYear UNION ALL SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS geometric_mean_materials_per_subject, NULL AS geometric_mean_degree_year, geometric_mean_financial_aid_year, 'FinancialAidYear' AS Reason FROM GeometricMeanFinancialAidYear ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, geometric_mean_materials_per_subject, geometric_mean_degree_year, geometric_mean_financial_aid_year, Reason FROM CombinedGeometricMeans ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, Reason ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte;

question: For the top 10 academic years with the highest variance in the record count of tip details for current or previous terms, display each academic year's description, the variance of the record count, and the department with the most unique subjects offered in that year, along with the count of those subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC LIMIT 10 ), dept_subjects AS ( SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), ranked_depts AS ( SELECT ds.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.subject_count, @rank := IF(@current_year = ds.ACADEMIC_YEAR, @rank + 1, 1) AS dept_rank, @current_year := ds.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM ( SELECT * FROM dept_subjects ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, subject_count DESC ) ds CROSS JOIN (SELECT @rank := 0, @current_year := 0) vars ) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.record_count_variance, rd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Most_Prominent_Department, rd.subject_count AS Department_Subject_Count FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ranked_depts rd ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = rd.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND rd.dept_rank = 1 ORDER BY ic.record_count_variance DESC;

question: For the top 10 buildings on the MIT site with the highest number of rooms, show each building's long name, total room count, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the areas of its rooms. Additionally, for the top 10 space units (with a warehouse load date of '19-DEC-24') that are associated with the largest number of HR org units (with a warehouse load date of '03-DEC-24'), display the space unit name, the associated organization name, the number of linked HR org units, and the average HR department code for those units. Indicate the reason for inclusion as 'BuildingRoomStats' for building statistics and 'SpaceUnitOrgStats' for space unit and organization statistics. The columns returned are: building long name, room count, area standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), space unit name, organization name, HR org unit count, average HR department code, and reason for inclusion, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST b JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG ORDER BY room_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), SpaceUnitOrgStats AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS hr_org_unit_count, AVG(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS avg_hr_dept_code FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE su.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND hou.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '03-DEC-24' GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY hr_org_unit_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), CombinedStats AS ( SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, b.room_count, b.area_stddev, NULL AS SPACE_UNIT, NULL AS ORGANIZATION_NAME, NULL AS hr_org_unit_count, NULL AS avg_hr_dept_code, 'BuildingRoomStats' AS Reason FROM inner_cte b LEFT JOIN SpaceUnitOrgStats s ON 1=0 UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS BUILDING_NAME_LONG, NULL AS room_count, NULL AS area_stddev, s.SPACE_UNIT, s.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s.hr_org_unit_count, s.avg_hr_dept_code, 'SpaceUnitOrgStats' AS Reason FROM SpaceUnitOrgStats s LEFT JOIN inner_cte b ON 1=0 ) SELECT * FROM CombinedStats ORDER BY Reason, BUILDING_NAME_LONG, SPACE_UNIT;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units, and for subjects offered in the term 2019FA from the same department, show the subject code, subject number, subject title, department name, term description, the rank of each 2024 subject within its department ordered by subject code, the 2019FA subject ID, number of enrolled students in 2019FA, department full name, the row number of each 2019FA subject within its department name group ordered by subject ID, and the school name for each department. Order the results by department name, subject code, and 2019FA subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), Subjects2019FA AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ) SELECT s24.SUBJECT_CODE, s24.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s24.SUBJECT_TITLE, s24.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s24.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s24.window_column AS department_rank_2024, s19.SUBJECT_ID, s19.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s19.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s19.window_column AS department_rownum_2019, s19.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte s24 JOIN Subjects2019FA s19 ON s24.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s19.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s24.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s24.SUBJECT_CODE, s19.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For subjects offered in the term '2019FA' with more than 0 enrolled students, list the subject title, offer department name, department full name, number of enrolled students, and the average number of enrolled students in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the school code, but only include those subjects where the number of enrolled students is greater than the average for their department. Also, for the top 10 departments by the number of unique subjects they offered for terms in the academic year 2014 or later, include the department name, the count of unique subject titles, and the full department name. For each row, add a reason for inclusion ('2019FA_Subject_AboveAvg' for subjects and 'Top10_Dept_2014plus' for departments). The columns should be: subject title, offer department name, department full name, number of enrolled students, windowed average of enrolled students, subject count, and reason, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), DeptAvg AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS dept_avg FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE ), SubjectsAboveDeptAvg AS ( SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.window_column, NULL AS subject_count, '2019FA_Subject_AboveAvg' AS Reason FROM inner_cte i JOIN DeptAvg d ON i.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > d.dept_avg ), Top10Depts2014 AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count, lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_TITLE = ss.SUBJECT_TITLE JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2014 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), Top10Depts2014Formatted AS ( SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, NULL AS window_column, t.subject_count, 'Top10_Dept_2014plus' AS Reason FROM Top10Depts2014 t ) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, window_column, subject_count, Reason FROM ( SELECT * FROM SubjectsAboveDeptAvg UNION ALL SELECT * FROM Top10Depts2014Formatted ) AS CombinedResults ORDER BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each department that offers at least one subject in the academic year 2022 with a total of 12 units, display the department name, the variance of the reserve catalog keys for courses in that department where the material status is 'U', the number of such subjects offered, and the average subject enrollment number for those subjects, but only include departments where the average subject enrollment number for these subjects is greater than the overall average subject enrollment number for all subjects offered in 2022 with 12 units. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH dept_variance AS ( SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, VARIANCE(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY lci.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY catalog_key_variance DESC ), subject_window AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) OVER ( PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) SELECT sw.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dv.catalog_key_variance, COUNT(*) AS num_subjects, AVG(sw.window_column) AS avg_subject_enrollment FROM subject_window sw LEFT JOIN dept_variance dv ON sw.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dv.DEPARTMENT GROUP BY sw.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dv.catalog_key_variance ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, catalog_key_variance, num_subjects, avg_subject_enrollment FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_subject_enrollment > ( SELECT AVG(t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) ORDER BY avg_subject_enrollment DESC, catalog_key_variance DESC ;

question: From the top 10 departments with the highest number of unique courses among degree-granting departments, show each department's name, school name, total unique course count, the minimum CIP program code, the subject title from the summary, the dense rank of each subject considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the subject code from the course catalog, and the total units for each subject, but only for subjects offered in the term '2022FA' with a total of 12 units. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), SubjectWindowStats AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT, t0.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) SELECT dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.SCHOOL_NAME, dcs.course_count, dcs.min_cip_code, sws.SUBJECT_TITLE, sws.window_column, sws.TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte dcs JOIN SubjectWindowStats sws ON dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sws.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY dcs.course_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each academic year and department, what is the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in each subject offered (considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term and have more than 0 enrolled students), as well as the minimum academic year and the sum of total units for subjects that are offered in the fall term and have library reserve material details with material status 'U'? Please provide the academic year, department name, average enrollment, enrollment variance, minimum academic year, and total units sum, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), library_units_stats AS ( SELECT MIN(at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_sum, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrollment, inner_cte.enrollment_variance, library_units_stats.min_academic_year, library_units_stats.total_units_sum FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN library_units_stats ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = library_units_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = library_units_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: From the top 10 combinations of department name, subject code, and course number (where the department is degree granting and the number of enrolled students in the subject summary is greater than 2) with the highest number of unique library subjects offered, display the department name, subject code, number of subject codes, minimum department budget code, course number, number of unique library subjects offered, minimum total units, the subject title with the most enrolled students for that course, and the corresponding number of enrolled students. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE ), DeptCourseStats AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER ) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.SUBJECT_CODE, dss.subject_code_count, dss.min_dept_budget_code, dcs.COURSE_NUMBER, dcs.subject_count, dcs.min_total_units FROM DeptSubjectStats dss JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON dss.SUBJECT_CODE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN DeptCourseStats dcs ON dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dcs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = dcs.COURSE_NUMBER ), SubjectMaxEnroll AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER ORDER BY s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC) AS rn FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.subject_code_count, ic.min_dept_budget_code, ic.COURSE_NUMBER, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units, sme.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Top_Subject_Title, sme.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS Top_Subject_Enrollment FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN SubjectMaxEnroll sme ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sme.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND ic.COURSE_NUMBER = sme.COURSE_NUMBER AND sme.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.subject_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For rooms on floor 2 that are associated with a DLC having more than five organizations, provide the building room, space usage, organization name, HR org unit title, department name, the minimum access level in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the building component, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the organization numbers for organizations associated with that DLC, and the DLC name and HR org unit level. Do not repeat the DLC name if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of organization numbers (descending), DLC name, and then by building room. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DLCOrgStddev AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_NAME, STDDEV(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY.DLC_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER IS NOT NULL GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY org_number_stddev DESC ), Floor2Rooms AS ( SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.SPACE_USAGE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DLC_NAME, MIN(t0.ACCESS_LEVEL) OVER (ORDER BY t0.BUILDING_COMPONENT ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2 ) SELECT f2r.BUILDING_ROOM, f2r.SPACE_USAGE, f2r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, f2r.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, f2r.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, f2r.window_column, dos.org_number_stddev, f2r.DLC_NAME, f2r.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL FROM Floor2Rooms f2r JOIN DLCOrgStddev dos ON f2r.DLC_NAME = dos.DLC_NAME ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(DLC_NAME) OVER (ORDER BY org_number_stddev DESC, DLC_NAME, BUILDING_ROOM) = DLC_NAME THEN NULL ELSE DLC_NAME END AS DLC_NAME, BUILDING_ROOM, SPACE_USAGE, ORGANIZATION_NAME, HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column, org_number_stddev, HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL FROM inner_cte ORDER BY org_number_stddev DESC, DLC_NAME, BUILDING_ROOM;

question: For each space unit with a space unit code of 402100, what is the space unit key, the organization name, the DLC name, the DLC key from FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY, the rank of each record within each DLC key group ordered by space unit key, and the deviation of the geometric mean of the number of supervisees for each department in that organization from the overall average geometric mean across all organizations (considering only departments where the number of supervisees is greater than zero)? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH org_geom_mean_supervisees AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES))) AS geometric_mean_supervisees FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN SPACE_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ON SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY = SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.DEPT_NAMES WHERE SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES > 0 GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_supervisees DESC ), space_unit_402100 AS ( SELECT t2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.DLC_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DLC_KEY ORDER BY t2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 402100 ) SELECT s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, s.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s.DLC_NAME, s.DLC_KEY, s.window_column, o.geometric_mean_supervisees FROM space_unit_402100 s LEFT JOIN org_geom_mean_supervisees o ON s.ORGANIZATION_NAME = o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ), overall_avg_geom_mean AS ( SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_supervisees) AS avg_geom_mean FROM ( SELECT EXP(AVG(LN(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES))) AS geometric_mean_supervisees FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN SPACE_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ON SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY = SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.DEPT_NAMES WHERE SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES > 0 GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) t ) SELECT i.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.DLC_NAME, i.DLC_KEY, i.window_column, i.geometric_mean_supervisees, (i.geometric_mean_supervisees - a.avg_geom_mean) AS deviation_from_overall_avg FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN overall_avg_geom_mean a;

question: For each term and department, list the term, department, the number of library reserve materials with status 'U', the average number of TIP materials per subject, the school name, and the department phone number. Include subtotals for each term (the corresponding term field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all terms (the corresponding term field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the term if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by term and department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT l.TERM_CODE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AS dept_code, l.SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserve_material_count, COUNT(DISTINCT t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS tip_material_count FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY l.TERM_CODE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, l.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(term) OVER (ORDER BY term_sort, dept_sort) = term THEN NULL ELSE term END AS term, department, reserve_materials, avg_tip_materials_per_subject, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(department) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(department) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(department) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(department) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE department END AS dept_sort, department, SUM(reserve_material_count) AS reserve_materials, AVG(tip_material_count) AS avg_tip_materials_per_subject, MAX(school_name) AS school_name, MAX(dept_code) AS dept_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY TERM_CODE, department, school_name, dept_code WITH ROLLUP ) tbltmp LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tbltmp.department = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY term_sort, dept_sort;

question: For each enrollment type, what is the highest maximum enrollment among activities in each category? Show the enrollment type, category name, and the highest maximum enrollment for that enrollment type and category. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY ) SELECT ENROLLMENT_TYPE, IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, MAX(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS highest_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ENROLLMENT_TYPE, IAP_CATEGORY_NAME;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with total units equal to 12 and scheduled in rooms of buildings that have subjects offered in the fall term, show the department code, department name, subject code, subject number, subject title, total units, the row number within each department ordered by subject code, the building key, the average total units, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for all subjects scheduled in rooms of that building during the fall term, and the building's major use description. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), BuildingStats AS ( SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.SUBJECT_CODE, ds.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ds.SUBJECT_TITLE, ds.TOTAL_UNITS, ds.window_column, fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, bs.avg_total_units, bs.stddev_total_units, fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC FROM inner_cte ds JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON ds.SUBJECT_CODE = cso.SUBJECT_CODE AND ds.SUBJECT_NUMBER = cso.SUBJECT_NUMBER AND ds.TOTAL_UNITS = cso.TOTAL_UNITS JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON cso.MEET_PLACE = fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY JOIN BuildingStats bs ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = bs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE cso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' ORDER BY ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ds.window_column, fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY

question: For each department that grants degrees, what is the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in the graduate-level subjects offered by that department, as well as the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department with a non-null subject code description? Additionally, for each school, provide the total number of enrolled students in all subjects offered by departments within that school that grant degrees. Please provide the department name, the range of enrolled students, the variance of enrolled students (graduate-level), the variance of enrolled students (with non-null subject code description), the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrolled students (with non-null subject code description), the school name, and the total number of enrolled students per school, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH dept_enroll_stats_grad AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), dept_enroll_stats_desc AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT g.DEPARTMENT_NAME, g.enrolled_range, g.enrolled_variance, d.enrolled_students_variance, d.enrolled_students_stddev, g.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM dept_enroll_stats_grad g JOIN dept_enroll_stats_desc d ON g.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), school_totals AS ( SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.enrolled_range, i.enrolled_variance, i.enrolled_students_variance, i.enrolled_students_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, st.total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte i JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN school_totals st ON sd.SCHOOL_NAME = st.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: Show the department name, subject title, term code, academic year, and the average academic year within each academic year group ordered by term start date for each subject offered in the Fall term of 2022, along with, for each associated course material detail, the material status key, subject ID, ISBN, material key, the course number description, the offering department name, the maximum number of enrolled students for each row considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by material key, and the responsible faculty name for each course material. The results are ordered by term code, subject title, material key, and responsible faculty name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.TERM_CODE, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY a.TERM_START_DATE) AS avg_academic_year FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON ata.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON a.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE WHERE a.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.avg_academic_year, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.ISBN, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_num_enrolled_students, t1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte s1 JOIN TIP_DETAIL t0 ON s1.TERM_CODE = t0.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL AND t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND s1.SUBJECT_TITLE = t1.SUBJECT_TITLE AND s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY s1.TERM_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME

question: List the department code, department name, department full name, the number of subjects offered, the total number of enrolled students in those subjects, the total number of tip materials, and the total number of unique subject titles for each department that is degree-granting and offered at least one subject in the School of Engineering in 2021, or for each department that offered more than 10 tip materials for subjects in the School of Engineering during regular terms. Show the department code, department name, department full name, number of subjects offered, total number of enrolled students, total number of tip materials, and total unique subject titles in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptSubjects AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ), DeptTipMaterials AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL t JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) > 10 ), CombinedDept AS ( SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ds.subject_count, ds.total_enrollment, dtm.total_tip_materials FROM DeptSubjects ds LEFT JOIN DeptTipMaterials dtm ON ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dtm.DEPARTMENT_NAME UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS DEPARTMENT_CODE, dtm.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, NULL AS subject_count, NULL AS total_enrollment, dtm.total_tip_materials FROM DeptTipMaterials dtm LEFT JOIN DeptSubjects ds ON dtm.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL ) SELECT * FROM CombinedDept ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ic.subject_count, ic.total_enrollment, ic.total_tip_materials, st.unique_subject_titles FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS unique_subject_titles FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) st ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = st.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For academic term parameters where the term indicator is 'C', show the term parameter, the term code, the academic year, the department name of the offered subject, the running sum of academic years within each department, and for each department, also provide the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects that have at least one enrolled student and have required course materials. Additionally, for each department and academic year, show the number of unique subjects offered and whether the department-year combination is a 'HIGH_ACTIVITY' (at least 20% more subjects than the department's average per year), 'LOW_ACTIVITY' (at least 20% fewer), or 'AVERAGE'. Present the results ordered by department name and academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ), TermDeptWindow AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_PARAMETER, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_INDICATOR = 'C' ) SELECT tdw.TERM_PARAMETER, tdw.TERM_CODE, tdw.ACADEMIC_YEAR, tdw.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tdw.window_column, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance FROM TermDeptWindow tdw JOIN DeptUnitsStats dus ON tdw.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), DeptYearSubjectCounts AS ( SELECT t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_INDICATOR = 'C' GROUP BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), DeptAvgSubjectCount AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(subject_count) AS avg_subject_count FROM DeptYearSubjectCounts GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.TERM_PARAMETER, icte.TERM_CODE, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.window_column, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_range, icte.total_units_variance, dysc.subject_count, dasc.avg_subject_count, CASE WHEN dysc.subject_count > dasc.avg_subject_count * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_ACTIVITY' WHEN dysc.subject_count < dasc.avg_subject_count * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_ACTIVITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS activity_category FROM inner_cte icte JOIN DeptYearSubjectCounts dysc ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dysc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dysc.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN DeptAvgSubjectCount dasc ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dasc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR

question: From the top 10 subject titles by the number of reserved library materials for subjects offered in the term '2009SP', display each subject's title, the total reserved materials count, the offering department name, the department full name from the department table, and the subject description from the course catalog. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t.SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY reserved_materials DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.reserved_materials, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, c.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = c.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY inner_cte.reserved_materials DESC, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For subjects offered in the term '2017JA', show the subject title, the number of enrolled students, the responsible faculty name, the offering department name, the department full name, the school name, and the minimum number of enrolled students in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the department code. Then, for subjects offered in the term with code '2022FA' in the same department, show the subject ID, department name, term description, the running sum of total units within each academic year ordered by subject ID, and the subject's short title. Finally, for each department, provide the department name and the maximum running sum of total units for its subjects in '2022FA'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( ORDER BY t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER ( PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID ) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.window_column AS min_enrolled_window, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.window_column AS running_sum_total_units, s2.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM Subq1 s1 JOIN Subq2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(inner_cte.running_sum_total_units) AS max_running_sum_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department in the School of Engineering that grants degrees, show the department name, the number of subjects it offers with at least 6 total units, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for those subjects, and for each grade type, the running sum of total units for subjects in that department and grade type. Also, include a grand total for each department (regardless of grade type) in the format of (department name, null grade type, total subjects, avg, variance, stddev, running sum). Only consider subjects with more than 0 total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ), DeptStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), SubjectCounts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.GRADE_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS num_subjects, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.GRADE_TYPE ), RunningSums AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.GRADE_TYPE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS running_sum FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.GRADE_TYPE, sc.num_subjects, ds.avg_total_units, ds.total_units_variance, ds.total_units_stddev, SUM(rs.running_sum) AS running_sum FROM SubjectCounts sc JOIN DeptStats ds ON sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN RunningSums rs ON sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = rs.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND sc.GRADE_TYPE = rs.GRADE_TYPE GROUP BY sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.GRADE_TYPE, sc.num_subjects, ds.avg_total_units, ds.total_units_variance, ds.total_units_stddev WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(rs.running_sum) IS NOT NULL OR GROUPING(sc.GRADE_TYPE) = 1 ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, GRADE_TYPE, num_subjects, avg_total_units, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev, running_sum FROM RollupResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, GRADE_TYPE ;

question: For space units with a space unit code of 402100, show the organization names, their dense rank considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the organization number, the average of the HR department codes (old), the variance of the HR department codes (old), and the number of unique HR org unit titles for all associated HR org units where the organization is assignable and the HR department name is not null, listing the columns in the order: organization name, dense rank, average HR department code (old), variance of HR department code (old), and count of unique HR org unit titles. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH space_unit_402100_orgs AS ( SELECT t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 402100 ), org_hr_dept_stats AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS avg_dept_code_old, VARIANCE(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS var_dept_code_old, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = HR_ORG_UNIT.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY ) SELECT s.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s.window_column, o.avg_dept_code_old, o.var_dept_code_old, s.DLC_KEY FROM space_unit_402100_orgs s JOIN org_hr_dept_stats o ON s.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY ) SELECT icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.window_column, icte.avg_dept_code_old, icte.var_dept_code_old, COUNT(DISTINCT h.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE) AS unique_hr_org_unit_titles FROM inner_cte icte JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON icte.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY WHERE h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.window_column, icte.avg_dept_code_old, icte.var_dept_code_old

question: For each library reserve material with material status key 'U', list the subject ID, library course instructor key, term description, academic year, term start date, the minimum academic year in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by library reserve catalog key, the library subject offered key, the tip material key, the tip material status key, the average record count in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the tip material status key and ordered by the academic year, and for each, include the academic year description and the last day of final exam from the ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL table, and calculate the normalized year to average record count ratio (academic year divided by average record count in the window), ordered by the normalized year to average record count ratio descending.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t2.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, MIN(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER ( ORDER BY t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, t1.TERM_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT t0.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, t0.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, AVG(t2.RECORD_COUNT) OVER ( PARTITION BY t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.TERM_START_DATE, s1.window_column AS min_academic_year_window, s2.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2.window_column AS avg_record_count_window, s1.TERM_CODE, ROUND(s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR / NULLIF(s2.window_column, 0), 2) AS normalized_year_to_avg_record_count FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = s2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY AND s1.TERM_CODE = s2.TERM_CODE ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.TERM_START_DATE, i.min_academic_year_window, i.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, i.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, i.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, i.avg_record_count_window, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t0.LAST_DAY_OF_FINAL_EXAM, i.normalized_year_to_avg_record_count FROM inner_cte i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 ON i.TERM_CODE = t0.TERM_CODE ORDER BY i.normalized_year_to_avg_record_count DESC

question: Show the department names, the corresponding SIS subject code, subject code descriptions, graduate level, the total number of courses per department, and for each department, the average, range, and variance of subject enrollment numbers for subjects offered by that department in the current academic term. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, Total_Courses.Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_NUMBER) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS Total_Courses ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, i.GRADUATE_LEVEL, i.Total_Courses, stats.avg_enrollment, stats.enrollment_range, stats.enrollment_variance FROM inner_cte i LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_enrollment, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) - MIN(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS enrollment_variance FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ss.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp ON at.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) stats ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For organizations whose parent is 'S H&SS' and that are associated with a space unit with space unit code 97500, show the organization name, description, HR org unit title, row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the organization name, the space unit name, space unit code, department count, number of supervisees, the average department count within each department count group ordered by number of supervisees, and the HR department name for each organization. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.ORG_PARENT = 'S H&SS' ), SpaceUnitStats AS ( SELECT t1.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.DEPT_COUNT, t2.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, AVG(t2.DEPT_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPT_COUNT ORDER BY t2.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS avg_dept_count_within_group, t1.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DEPT_NAMES WHERE t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 97500 ) SELECT icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.DESCRIPTION, icte.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, icte.window_column, sus.space_unit_name, sus.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, sus.DEPT_COUNT, sus.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, sus.avg_dept_count_within_group, hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SpaceUnitStats sus ON icte.DLC_KEY = sus.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON icte.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE = hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE ORDER BY icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, sus.space_unit_name

question: For rooms with area greater than 200, show the building-room identifier, the organization name, the DLC key, the sum of room areas within each major use description group ordered by building-room, the HR department name, the HR org unit title, the HR org unit key, the HR org unit level, and the average organization key within each organization key group ordered by HR org unit key, for organizations with organization level equal to 5 and assignable equal to 1. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, SUM(t2.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.MAJOR_USE_DESC ORDER BY t2.BUILDING_ROOM) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.AREA > 200 ) SELECT ic.BUILDING_ROOM, ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.DLC_KEY, ic.window_column AS room_area_sum, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, AVG(ic.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY ic.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS org_key_avg FROM inner_cte ic JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON ic.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON o.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = h.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE o.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 ORDER BY ic.BUILDING_ROOM, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY;

question: For each of the top 10 department names in the Provost Area (by number of faculty organizations), list the department name, the number of faculty organizations, the organization, its associated space unit (where the organization is assignable and the space unit code is greater than 50000), the number of space units, the minimum organization number, and the department's hierarchy level 3 name, ordered by the number of faculty organizations and then by the number of space units. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH OrgSpaceUnits AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION, s.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS space_unit_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_org_number, o.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION o JOIN SPACE_UNIT s ON o.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE > 50000 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION, s.SPACE_UNIT, o.DLC_KEY ), TopProvostDepts AS ( SELECT m.DLC_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, m.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME, m.DLC_KEY ORDER BY org_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT tpd.DLC_NAME, tpd.org_count, osu.ORGANIZATION, osu.SPACE_UNIT, osu.space_unit_count, osu.min_org_number, tpd.DLC_KEY FROM TopProvostDepts tpd JOIN OrgSpaceUnits osu ON tpd.DLC_KEY = osu.DLC_KEY ) SELECT inner_cte.DLC_NAME, inner_cte.org_count, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION, inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT, inner_cte.space_unit_count, inner_cte.min_org_number, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m ON inner_cte.DLC_KEY = m.DLC_KEY ORDER BY inner_cte.org_count DESC, inner_cte.space_unit_count DESC;

question: For each tip detail record where the material status key is 'RQ' and the term description matches one of the top 3 most frequently offered non-cancelled IAP activities, show the subject ID, term description, term start date, tip material key, the average record count in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the financial aid year, the activity title, max enrollment, the academic year description, and the IAP subject sponsor key, ordered by subject ID and activity title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, AVG(t1.RECORD_COUNT) OVER ( PARTITION BY t0.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ), TopIAPActivities AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t.TERM_CODE, d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON d.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ta ON t.TERM_CODE = ta.TERM_CODE WHERE d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND d.ACTIVITY_TITLE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t.TERM_CODE, d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 3 ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.TERM_START_DATE, icte.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, icte.window_column, tia.ACTIVITY_TITLE, tia.MAX_ENROLLMENT, tia.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, tia.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY FROM inner_cte icte JOIN TopIAPActivities tia ON icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION = tia.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_ID, tia.ACTIVITY_TITLE;

question: For each department name and school name where the department is degree granting, provide the number of unique courses, the minimum CIP program code from the course descriptions, the average number of enrolled students, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrolled students, and the total number of course materials in courses that have at least one associated course material. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ), department_enrollment_stats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), department_material_count AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_materials FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.course_count, icte.min_cip_code, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_stddev, dmc.total_materials FROM inner_cte icte JOIN department_enrollment_stats des ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN department_material_count dmc ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dmc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: For academic terms where the term status indicator is 'P', show the term code, the term parameter, the term description, the academic year, the term start date, the average academic year in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the term indicator and ordered by the term start date, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in offered subjects for the corresponding academic year, and the total number of unique departments offering subjects in those terms. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_PARAMETER, t2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, AVG(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER ( PARTITION BY t1.TERM_INDICATOR ORDER BY t0.TERM_START_DATE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_INDICATOR = 'P' ), AcademicYearVariation AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ), DepartmentCounts AS ( SELECT t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS num_departments FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON t0.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT icte.TERM_CODE, icte.TERM_PARAMETER, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.TERM_START_DATE, icte.window_column, ayv.coefficient_of_variation, dc.num_departments FROM inner_cte icte JOIN AcademicYearVariation ayv ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN DepartmentCounts dc ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dc.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.TERM_CODE

question: For each department, list the department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students per subject offered by that department in the term 2019FA, as well as the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects that had library reserve materials in terms with a term status of 'Previous', and the number of unique subjects with library reserve materials in those terms, with the columns in the following order: department name, enrolled student range, enrolled student variance, enrolled student standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), average total units, total units variance, total units standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and count of unique subjects with library reserve materials. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC ) , DepartmentUnitsStats AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS unique_subjects_with_reserve FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.enrolled_range, icte.enrolled_variance, icte.enrolled_stddev, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev, dus.unique_subjects_with_reserve FROM inner_cte icte JOIN DepartmentUnitsStats dus ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.enrolled_range DESC, dus.total_units_variance DESC;

question: From the top 10 subjects with the highest number of degree-granting courses in the School of Engineering, display each subject's code, subject code description, department name, the total count of such courses, and the course description, department name, and subject title of the most recently updated course for that subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t0.SCHOOL_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_CODE IS NOT NULL AND t1.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL ), eng_degree_courses AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), subject_course_counts AS ( SELECT icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(edc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS degree_course_count FROM inner_cte icte JOIN eng_degree_courses edc ON icte.SUBJECT_CODE = edc.SUBJECT_CODE GROUP BY icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), most_recent_course AS ( SELECT edc.SUBJECT_CODE, edc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, edc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, edc.SUBJECT_TITLE, edc.LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY edc.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY edc.LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE DESC) AS rn FROM eng_degree_courses edc ) SELECT scc.SUBJECT_CODE, scc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scc.degree_course_count, mrc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, mrc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS COURSE_DEPARTMENT_NAME, mrc.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM subject_course_counts scc LEFT JOIN most_recent_course mrc ON scc.SUBJECT_CODE = mrc.SUBJECT_CODE AND mrc.rn = 1 ORDER BY scc.degree_course_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: From the top 10 departments with the highest number of subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units, display each department's name, the total number of such subjects, the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects in that department that have at least one enrolled student and have required course materials, and the subject code, subject number, and subject title of the most frequently offered subject in that department. List the results ordered by the total number of subjects in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), DeptSubjectCounts AS ( SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS subject_count FROM inner_cte icte GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), MostFrequentSubject AS ( SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_NUMBER, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS freq, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, icte.SUBJECT_CODE) AS rn FROM inner_cte icte GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_NUMBER, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT dsc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dsc.subject_count, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance, mfs.SUBJECT_CODE, mfs.SUBJECT_NUMBER, mfs.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM DeptSubjectCounts dsc LEFT JOIN DeptUnitsStats dus ON dsc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.OFFER_DEPT_NAME LEFT JOIN MostFrequentSubject mfs ON dsc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mfs.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND mfs.rn = 1 ORDER BY dsc.subject_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For subjects in the Engineering school during the Fall Term 2024-2025, show the subject title, department name, total units, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title. For each subject, also show the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in courses offered by the same department (considering only courses with at least one associated TIP material and total units greater than 0), and classify each subject as 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' if its enrollment is at least 10% greater than the department average, 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' if at least 10% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Present the results ordered by enrollment variance (descending) and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH EngineeringSubjects AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, t2.TERM_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' AND t2.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ), DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.RECORD_COUNT >= 1 AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC ) SELECT es.SUBJECT_TITLE, es.DEPARTMENT_NAME, es.TOTAL_UNITS, es.window_column, es.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_variance FROM EngineeringSubjects es JOIN DepartmentEnrollmentStats des ON es.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.avg_enrollment, inner_cte.enrollment_variance, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, CASE WHEN inner_cte.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > inner_cte.avg_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN inner_cte.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER < inner_cte.avg_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.enrollment_variance DESC, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For subjects offered in the term with code '2025FA', show the subject ID, subject title, offering department name, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, term start date, term end date, term parameter, and the minimum number of enrolled students over each offering department. Additionally, for each subject, provide the total units from the course catalog, and classify the subject as 'HIGH_LOAD' if its total units are at least 20% greater than the average total units for its department and academic year, 'LOW_LOAD' if at least 20% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), dept_unit_benchmark AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.TERM_START_DATE, s.TERM_END_DATE, s.TERM_PARAMETER, s.min_enrolled_students_per_dept, c.TOTAL_UNITS, d.avg_total_units, CASE WHEN c.TOTAL_UNITS > d.avg_total_units * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_LOAD' WHEN c.TOTAL_UNITS < d.avg_total_units * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_LOAD' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS load_category FROM inner_cte s JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON s.SUBJECT_ID = c.SUBJECT_ID AND s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = c.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN dept_unit_benchmark d ON c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID

question: For each activity, provide the activity title, enrollment type, maximum enrollment, category name, the dense rank of each row partitioned by the category name and ordered by the category name, the row number within each enrollment type group ordered by activity title, and the length of the activity description. For activities in the "Mathematics" category, also include the row number within each enrollment type group ordered by activity title; otherwise, show null. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) AS dense_rank_within_category, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS row_number_within_enrollment_type, d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, LENGTH(d.ACTIVITY_DESCRIPTION) AS activity_description_length FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY ), math_cte AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS row_number_within_enrollment_type_for_mathematics, d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT i.ACTIVITY_TITLE, i.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, i.MAX_ENROLLMENT, i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, i.dense_rank_within_category, i.row_number_within_enrollment_type, i.activity_description_length, m.row_number_within_enrollment_type_for_mathematics FROM inner_cte i LEFT JOIN math_cte m ON i.ACTIVITY_TITLE = m.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND i.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = m.ENROLLMENT_TYPE AND i.MAX_ENROLLMENT = m.MAX_ENROLLMENT AND i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = m.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME AND i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = m.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY;

question: For each department, show the department code, department name, the number of subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with total units equal to 12, and the average number of enrolled students for those subjects. Also, for each offering department and school, show the offering department name, offering school name, the count of distinct subject IDs, and the minimum ISBN value for associated course materials where the number of enrolled students is greater than 2. Do not return any rounded answers.
