SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS join_department_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(icte.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_2024_12units, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(td.ISBN) AS min_isbn FROM inner_cte icte JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND icte.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME

question: For each department, give the department code, department name, the average of the total units, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units, and the geometric mean of the total units for subjects offered in terms that are regular terms, where the geometric mean is calculated only for subjects with total units greater than zero. Present the results ordered by department code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH AvgStddevUnits AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), GeometricMeanUnits AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, a.avg_total_units, a.stddev_total_units, g.geometric_mean_total_units FROM AvgStddevUnits a JOIN GeometricMeanUnits g ON a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units, EXP(AVG(CASE WHEN c.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 THEN LN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) END)) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON t.TERM_CODE = c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: For each space unit with a space unit code of 97500, show the space unit name, space unit code, associated organization name, department count, number of supervisees, the average department count within each department count group, and for each organization, the number of unique HR organization unit titles associated with it. For each organization, also include a grand total for all unique HR organization unit titles in the format of (organization name, null, total unique HR org unit titles). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.DEPT_COUNT, t2.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, AVG(t2.DEPT_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPT_COUNT ORDER BY t2.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS avg_dept_count_within_group FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DEPT_NAMES WHERE t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 97500 ), OrgUnitTitleCounts AS ( SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, COUNT(DISTINCT hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS unique_hr_org_unit_ids FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, SUM(unique_hr_org_unit_ids) AS total_unique_hr_org_unit_ids FROM OrgUnitTitleCounts GROUP BY ORGANIZATION_NAME, HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(unique_hr_org_unit_ids) > 0 ) SELECT ic.space_unit_name, ic.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.DEPT_COUNT, ic.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, ic.avg_dept_count_within_group, rr.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, rr.total_unique_hr_org_unit_ids FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN RollupResults rr ON ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME = rr.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY ic.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, rr.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE ;

question: For courses in the School of Engineering that are degree granting, and for each subject offered in the term with the description "Fall Term 2024-2025" by the same department, show the course description, department name, the dense rank of each course considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the department's budget code, the subject offered key, subject title, offering department name, the term description, the rank of each subject within its offering department ordered by subject offered key, and the number of enrolled students in each subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS course_dense_rank FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT icte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.course_dense_rank, tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_rank_within_dept, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte icte JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON tso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp ON at.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025'

question: For each space unit, what is the space unit name, the associated organization name, the average, range, and variance of the HR department codes for the HR org units linked to that space unit (considering only space units with a warehouse load date of '19-DEC-24' and HR org units with a warehouse load date of '03-DEC-24'), as well as the average and variance of the HR department codes (old) for all associated HR org units where the organization is assignable and the HR department name is not null? Additionally, for each result, include the number of unique HR org unit titles associated with the space unit. List the results ordered by the HR department code range (descending), then by the variance of the HR department codes (old) (descending), and then by the count of unique HR org unit titles (descending). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS avg_hr_dept_code, MAX(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) - MIN(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS hr_dept_code_range, VARIANCE(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS hr_dept_code_variance, fo.DLC_KEY FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE su.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND hou.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '03-DEC-24' GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fo.DLC_KEY ORDER BY hr_dept_code_range DESC ), OrgStats AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS avg_dept_code_old, VARIANCE(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS var_dept_code_old, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = HR_ORG_UNIT.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY ORDER BY var_dept_code_old DESC ), HRUnitTitleCounts AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(DISTINCT hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE) AS unique_hr_org_unit_titles, fo.DLC_KEY FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE su.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND hou.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '03-DEC-24' GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.DLC_KEY ) SELECT icte.SPACE_UNIT, icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.avg_hr_dept_code, icte.hr_dept_code_range, icte.hr_dept_code_variance, ost.avg_dept_code_old, ost.var_dept_code_old, htc.unique_hr_org_unit_titles FROM inner_cte icte JOIN OrgStats ost ON icte.DLC_KEY = ost.DLC_KEY JOIN HRUnitTitleCounts htc ON icte.SPACE_UNIT = htc.SPACE_UNIT AND icte.DLC_KEY = htc.DLC_KEY ORDER BY icte.hr_dept_code_range DESC, ost.var_dept_code_old DESC, htc.unique_hr_org_unit_titles DESC;

question: Show the department names, the corresponding SIS subject code, subject code descriptions, graduate level, the total number of courses per department, and for each department, the number of Mathematics department courses with at least 5 enrolled students that are also offered in the 2014FA term with at least one enrolled student, as well as the average number of enrolled students for those courses. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 ) SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, Total_Courses.Total_Courses, COUNT(DISTINCT icte.COURSE_NUMBER) AS Math_Courses_2014FA, AVG(icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS Avg_Enrolled_Students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_NUMBER) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS Total_Courses ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN inner_cte icte ON scd.COURSE = icte.COURSE_NUMBER AND icte.SUBJECT_ID IN ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, Total_Courses.Total_Courses ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For each Mathematics department course with at least 5 enrolled students, show the course number, subject title, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, the row number within each academic year group ordered by course number, the academic year description, the geometric mean of the degree year for that academic year (considering only degree years greater than 1900), and classify the course as 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' if its enrollment is at least 20% greater than the average for Mathematics courses in that academic year, 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' if at least 20% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. List the results ordered by academic year and course number. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 ), YearDegreeStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(ACADEMIC_TERMS.DEGREE_YEAR))) AS geometric_mean_degree_year FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.DEGREE_YEAR > 1900 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), MathYearAvg AS ( SELECT t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 GROUP BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT mc.COURSE_NUMBER, mc.SUBJECT_TITLE, mc.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, mc.TERM_DESCRIPTION, mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mc.window_column, yds.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, yds.geometric_mean_degree_year, CASE WHEN mc.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > mya.avg_enrollment * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN mc.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < mya.avg_enrollment * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte mc JOIN YearDegreeStats yds ON mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = yds.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN MathYearAvg mya ON mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = mya.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mc.COURSE_NUMBER;

question: For each activity, list its title, enrollment type, maximum enrollment, category name, the dense rank of each row partitioned by the category name and ordered by the category name, and the row number within each enrollment type group ordered by activity title for activities in the "Mathematics" category (showing null for activities not in "Mathematics"). Additionally, for each category, include a grand total row showing the total number of activities in that category (with nulls for activity-specific columns). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH activity_category_dense_rank AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) AS window_column, d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY ), math_enrollment_row_number AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column, d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT a.ACTIVITY_TITLE, a.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, a.MAX_ENROLLMENT, a.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, a.window_column AS dense_rank_within_category, m.window_column AS row_number_within_enrollment_type_for_math FROM activity_category_dense_rank a LEFT JOIN math_enrollment_row_number m ON a.ACTIVITY_TITLE = m.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND a.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = m.ENROLLMENT_TYPE AND a.MAX_ENROLLMENT = m.MAX_ENROLLMENT AND a.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = m.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME AND a.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = m.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY ) SELECT ACTIVITY_TITLE, ENROLLMENT_TYPE, MAX_ENROLLMENT, IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, dense_rank_within_category, row_number_within_enrollment_type_for_math, COUNT(*) AS total_activities_in_category FROM inner_cte GROUP BY IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, ACTIVITY_TITLE, ENROLLMENT_TYPE, MAX_ENROLLMENT, dense_rank_within_category, row_number_within_enrollment_type_for_math WITH ROLLUP HAVING (ACTIVITY_TITLE IS NOT NULL OR ENROLLMENT_TYPE IS NOT NULL OR MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL OR dense_rank_within_category IS NOT NULL OR row_number_within_enrollment_type_for_math IS NOT NULL) OR (ACTIVITY_TITLE IS NULL AND ENROLLMENT_TYPE IS NULL AND MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL AND dense_rank_within_category IS NULL AND row_number_within_enrollment_type_for_math IS NULL) ORDER BY IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, ACTIVITY_TITLE ;

question: For each academic year and department, list the academic year, department name, average total units for subjects offered in regular terms, variance of total units, academic year description, geometric mean of the record counts of required course materials (where the record count is greater than zero) for all subjects offered in that year, and only include those department-year pairs where the average total units is greater than the overall average total units for all departments and years. Show the results ordered by average total units in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), GeomMeanMaterials AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_total_units, i.var_total_units, g.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, g.geometric_mean_record_count FROM inner_cte i JOIN GeomMeanMaterials g ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR WHERE i.avg_total_units > ( SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c2 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON c2.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ) ORDER BY i.avg_total_units DESC;

question: For each DLC and academic year where the DLC name matches the department name and the term status is 'Previous', provide the DLC key, DLC name, coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of rooms assigned to organizations in that DLC (considering only rooms with an area greater than 0), academic year, department name, the number of unique subjects offered, the minimum total units for those subjects, and the average lecture units for those subjects, listing the columns in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DLC_RoomAreaStats AS ( SELECT FODK.DLC_KEY, FO.DLC_NAME, STDDEV(FR.AREA)/NULLIF(AVG(FR.AREA),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY FODK JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION FO ON FODK.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS FR ON FO.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = FR.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE FR.AREA > 0 GROUP BY FODK.DLC_KEY, FO.DLC_NAME HAVING AVG(FR.AREA) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), AcademicYearDeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT d.DLC_KEY, d.DLC_NAME, d.coefficient_of_variation, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.subject_count, a.min_total_units FROM DLC_RoomAreaStats d JOIN AcademicYearDeptSubjectStats a ON d.DLC_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d.coefficient_of_variation DESC, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC ) SELECT icte.DLC_KEY, icte.DLC_NAME, icte.coefficient_of_variation, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.subject_count, icte.min_total_units, AVG(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) AS avg_lecture_units FROM inner_cte icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY icte.DLC_KEY, icte.DLC_NAME, icte.coefficient_of_variation, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.subject_count, icte.min_total_units ORDER BY icte.coefficient_of_variation DESC, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC;

question: For each term parameter, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of materials per subject for terms that are not upcoming and have a non-null term start date, and for each such term parameter, for tip details where the material status key is 'EO', show the subject offered key, material key, material status key, term code, subject ID, term description, academic year, and the row number within each academic year group ordered by subject offered key, and also include only those term parameters where the number of EO materials is greater than 5? List the columns in the following order: term parameter, average materials per subject, variance of materials per subject, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of materials per subject, subject offered key, material key, material status key, term code, subject ID, term description, academic year, and row number. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT atp.TERM_PARAMETER, AVG(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_materials_per_subject, VARIANCE(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS variance_materials_per_subject, STDDEV(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS stddev_materials_per_subject FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON td.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp ON ata.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.TERM_PARAMETER <> 'SIS_UPCOMING_TERM' AND ata.TERM_START_DATE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY atp.TERM_PARAMETER ORDER BY variance_materials_per_subject DESC ), EOMaterialDetails AS ( SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS window_column FROM TIP_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'EO' ), EOCounts AS ( SELECT eomd.TERM_PARAMETER, COUNT(*) AS eo_material_count FROM EOMaterialDetails eomd GROUP BY eomd.TERM_PARAMETER ) SELECT icte.TERM_PARAMETER, icte.avg_materials_per_subject, icte.variance_materials_per_subject, icte.stddev_materials_per_subject, eomd.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, eomd.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, eomd.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, eomd.TERM_CODE, eomd.SUBJECT_ID, eomd.TERM_DESCRIPTION, eomd.ACADEMIC_YEAR, eomd.window_column FROM inner_cte icte JOIN EOMaterialDetails eomd ON icte.TERM_PARAMETER = eomd.TERM_PARAMETER JOIN EOCounts eoc ON icte.TERM_PARAMETER = eoc.TERM_PARAMETER WHERE eoc.eo_material_count > 5 ORDER BY icte.variance_materials_per_subject DESC, eomd.ACADEMIC_YEAR, eomd.window_column;

question: For each department, show the department name, the average, range, and variance of the area of rooms assigned to it (considering only rooms with an area greater than 40), as well as the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in regular academic terms, and classify each department as 'LARGE_AREA' if its average room area is at least 10% greater than the overall average room area, 'SMALL_AREA' if at least 10% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. List the department name, average area, area range, area variance, average total units, total units range, total units variance, and area size category in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH RoomAreaStats AS ( SELECT o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_area, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 40 GROUP BY o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY area_range DESC ), SubjectUnitsStats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT ras.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ras.avg_area, ras.area_range, ras.area_variance, sus.avg_total_units, sus.total_units_range, sus.total_units_variance FROM RoomAreaStats ras JOIN SubjectUnitsStats sus ON ras.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = sus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ras.area_range DESC ), OverallAvgArea AS ( SELECT AVG(r.AREA) AS overall_avg_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS r WHERE r.AREA > 40 ) SELECT i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_area, i.area_range, i.area_variance, i.avg_total_units, i.total_units_range, i.total_units_variance, CASE WHEN i.avg_area > o.overall_avg_area * 1.1 THEN 'LARGE_AREA' WHEN i.avg_area < o.overall_avg_area * 0.9 THEN 'SMALL_AREA' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS area_size_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN OverallAvgArea o ORDER BY i.area_range DESC;

question: For each of the top 10 departments by the number of unique subjects they offered in academic years 2014 or later, provide the department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of course materials per subject offered by that department in the term 2017SP, the count of unique subject titles, and whether the average number of course materials per subject in 2017SP is 'HIGH_MATERIAL' (at least 20% greater than the department's average in 2014 or later), 'LOW_MATERIAL' (at least 20% less), or 'AVERAGE' (otherwise). List the results ordered by the count of unique subject titles (descending), then by the range of course materials (descending). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DepartmentMaterialStats AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(material_count) - MIN(material_count) AS material_count_range, VARIANCE(material_count) AS material_count_variance, STDDEV(material_count) AS material_count_stddev, AVG(material_count) AS avg_materials_2017SP FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ( SELECT TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM TIP_DETAIL WHERE TERM_CODE = '2017SP' GROUP BY TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ) AS detail_stats ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = detail_stats.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = '2017SP' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY material_count_range DESC ), DepartmentSubjectCounts AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2014 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT dms.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dms.material_count_range, dms.material_count_variance, dms.material_count_stddev, dms.avg_materials_2017SP, dsc.subject_count FROM DepartmentMaterialStats dms JOIN DepartmentSubjectCounts dsc ON dms.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dsc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), DeptAvgMaterials_2014plus AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(material_count) AS avg_materials_2014plus FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ( SELECT TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM TIP_DETAIL WHERE TERM_CODE IN ( SELECT TERM_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS WHERE ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2014 ) GROUP BY TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ) AS detail_stats ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = detail_stats.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.TERM_CODE IN ( SELECT TERM_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS WHERE ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2014 ) GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.material_count_range, icte.material_count_variance, icte.material_count_stddev, icte.subject_count, icte.avg_materials_2017SP, dam.avg_materials_2014plus, CASE WHEN icte.avg_materials_2017SP > dam.avg_materials_2014plus * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_MATERIAL' WHEN icte.avg_materials_2017SP < dam.avg_materials_2014plus * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_MATERIAL' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS material_status FROM inner_cte icte JOIN DeptAvgMaterials_2014plus dam ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dam.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY icte.subject_count DESC, icte.material_count_range DESC;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year, the academic year description, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the record counts of TIP materials associated with that academic year (considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the TIP material status key is not 'NM'), the variance of the maximum enrollment for IAP activities that are not cancelled and require advance sign-up, and the highest maximum enrollment for such IAP activities? List the results ordered by the variance of the TIP material record counts in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH TipMaterialStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), IapActivityStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), IapActivityMax AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS highest_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR, tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, tms.record_count_variance, tms.record_count_stddev, ias.max_enrollment_variance, iam.highest_max_enrollment FROM TipMaterialStats tms JOIN IapActivityStats ias ON tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ias.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = ias.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC JOIN IapActivityMax iam ON tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR = iam.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = iam.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC;

question: For each department, provide the department name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022FA term. Additionally, for each course in the School of Engineering that is degree granting in that department, show the course description, subject title, and the number of subjects offered in 2022FA for that course. List the results ordered by the range of total units descending and then by the number of subjects per course descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sos.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_range, icte.total_units_variance, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_2022FA FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_range, icte.total_units_variance, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY icte.total_units_range DESC, num_subjects_2022FA DESC;

question: For IAP subject activities in the term "2021JA" that are not cancelled and have a maximum enrollment of 30, show the activity title, enrollment type, calendar date, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by activity title, the dense rank of each activity considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the academic year from the academic terms table, and the term description from the academic terms table, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.CALENDAR_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN TIME_DAY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' ), subquery2 AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 30 ) SELECT s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, s1.CALENDAR_DATE, s1.window_column AS row_number_window, s2.window_column AS dense_rank_window, t3.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte s1 JOIN subquery2 s2 ON s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE = s2.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND s1.TERM_CODE = s2.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t3 ON s1.TERM_CODE = t3.TERM_CODE;

question: For rooms with an area of at least 300, list the room key, building room, area, building number, city, and the row number within each city ordered by area, along with the DLC key, the average area, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of rooms by DLC key (considering only rooms with an area greater than 40), but only include those rooms whose area is greater than the average area of rooms in their city. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH RoomAreas AS ( SELECT t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.AREA, t1.BUILDING_NUMBER, t1.CITY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.CITY ORDER BY t0.AREA) AS window_column, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ROOMS t0 JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS t1 ON t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE t0.AREA >= 300 ), DlcAreaStats AS ( SELECT fod.DLC_KEY, AVG(fr.AREA) AS avg_area, VARIANCE(fr.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(fr.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fod JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON fod.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE fr.AREA > 40 GROUP BY fod.DLC_KEY ORDER BY area_variance DESC ) SELECT ra.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, ra.BUILDING_ROOM, ra.AREA, ra.BUILDING_NUMBER, ra.CITY, ra.window_column, fod.DLC_KEY, das.avg_area, das.area_variance, das.area_stddev FROM RoomAreas ra JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fod ON ra.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fod.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN DlcAreaStats das ON fod.DLC_KEY = das.DLC_KEY ORDER BY ra.CITY, ra.window_column ), CityAvgArea AS ( SELECT t1.CITY, AVG(t0.AREA) AS city_avg_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS t0 JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS t1 ON t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY t1.CITY ) SELECT i.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, i.BUILDING_ROOM, i.AREA, i.BUILDING_NUMBER, i.CITY, i.window_column, i.DLC_KEY, i.avg_area, i.area_variance, i.area_stddev FROM inner_cte i JOIN CityAvgArea c ON i.CITY = c.CITY WHERE i.AREA > c.city_avg_area ORDER BY i.CITY, i.window_column;

question: Show the subject title, department name, term code, academic year, the average academic year within each academic year group ordered by term start date, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses offered by that department (considering only courses that have at least one associated TIP material), and the total number of such courses per department for each subject offered in the Fall term of 2022. List the results ordered by department name and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.TERM_CODE, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY a.TERM_START_DATE) AS avg_academic_year FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON ata.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON a.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE WHERE a.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ), DeptEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS num_enrolled_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS num_enrolled_stddev, COUNT(DISTINCT lso.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_courses FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.TERM_CODE, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.avg_academic_year, des.num_enrolled_variance, des.num_enrolled_stddev, des.total_courses FROM inner_cte ic JOIN DeptEnrollmentStats des ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.department ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each department, provide the department name, school name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students per subject offered by that department in the term 2019FA, as well as the number of offered subjects and the minimum number of enrolled students for subjects where the number of enrolled students is greater than 3, and also include the total number of subjects offered by each department in the term 2019FA. List the columns in the following order: department name, school name, enrolled range, enrolled variance, enrolled standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), offered subject count, minimum enrolled students, and total subjects offered in 2019FA. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptEnrolledStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC ), DeptSubjectCounts AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS offered_subject_count, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d2.SCHOOL_NAME, d1.enrolled_range, d1.enrolled_variance, d1.enrolled_stddev, d2.offered_subject_count, d2.min_enrolled_students FROM DeptEnrolledStats d1 JOIN DeptSubjectCounts d2 ON d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.enrolled_range, inner_cte.enrolled_variance, inner_cte.enrolled_stddev, inner_cte.offered_subject_count, inner_cte.min_enrolled_students, COALESCE(ts.total_subjects_2019FA, 0) AS total_subjects_2019FA FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS total_subjects_2019FA FROM STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) ts ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ts.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: List the space unit key, organization name, DLC name, DLC key from FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY, the rank of each record within each DLC key group ordered by space unit key, the geometric mean of the number of supervisees for each department in that organization (considering only departments where the number of supervisees is greater than zero), and the total square footage assigned to each organization, for each space unit with a space unit code of 402100. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH org_geom_mean_supervisees AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES))) AS geometric_mean_supervisees FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN SPACE_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ON SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY = SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.DEPT_NAMES WHERE SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES > 0 GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_supervisees DESC ), space_unit_402100 AS ( SELECT t2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.DLC_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DLC_KEY ORDER BY t2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 402100 ) SELECT s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, s.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s.DLC_NAME, s.DLC_KEY, s.window_column, o.geometric_mean_supervisees FROM space_unit_402100 s LEFT JOIN org_geom_mean_supervisees o ON s.ORGANIZATION_NAME = o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.DLC_NAME, inner_cte.DLC_KEY, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.geometric_mean_supervisees, org_sqft.total_sqft FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, SUM(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.SQFT) AS total_sqft FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN SPACE_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ON SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY = SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.DEPT_NAMES GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) org_sqft ON inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = org_sqft.ORGANIZATION_NAME;

question: For organizations with a major organization key of 230 and space units with a warehouse load date of '19-DEC-24' and HR org units with a warehouse load date of '03-DEC-24', show the organization name, department name, department code, department long name, department level, the average organization number in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the organization parent and ordered by the organization name, the space unit name, and the highest, lowest, and sum of the HR department codes for the HR org units linked to that space unit, ordered by organization name and space unit. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, AVG(t2.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) OVER ( PARTITION BY t2.ORG_PARENT ORDER BY t2.ORGANIZATION_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t2.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t2.FCLT_MAJOR_ORG_KEY = 230 ) SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, o.window_column, s.SPACE_UNIT, s.max_hr_dept_code, s.min_hr_dept_code, s.sum_hr_dept_code FROM inner_cte o JOIN ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAX(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS max_hr_dept_code, MIN(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_hr_dept_code, SUM(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS sum_hr_dept_code, fo.DLC_KEY FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE su.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND hou.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '03-DEC-24' GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fo.DLC_KEY ) s ON o.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY ORDER BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s.SPACE_UNIT

question: For each sponsor and each subject offered in the term with code '2022FA', provide the sponsor name, the average and variance of the maximum enrollment for their IAP activities, the subject ID, department name, term description, the running sum of total units within each academic year, and the subject title, but only include those subjects where the total units are greater than the average total units for all subjects in '2022FA'. List the sponsor name, average and variance of max enrollment, subject ID, department name, term description, running sum of total units, and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH sponsor_enrollment_stats AS ( SELECT s.SPONSOR_NAME, AVG(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, VARIANCE(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS var_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.SPONSOR_NAME ORDER BY var_max_enrollment DESC ), subject_running_sum AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ) SELECT ses.SPONSOR_NAME, ses.avg_max_enrollment, ses.var_max_enrollment, srs.SUBJECT_ID, srs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, srs.TERM_DESCRIPTION, srs.window_column, srs.SUBJECT_TITLE, srs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM sponsor_enrollment_stats ses CROSS JOIN subject_running_sum srs ) SELECT SPONSOR_NAME, avg_max_enrollment, var_max_enrollment, SUBJECT_ID, DEPARTMENT_NAME, TERM_DESCRIPTION, window_column, SUBJECT_TITLE FROM inner_cte WHERE TOTAL_UNITS > ( SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE TERM_CODE = '2022FA' );

question: For each academic year and department where the number of enrolled students in the library subject offered is greater than 3, and where at least 60% of the subjects offered in regular terms have more than 6 total units, provide the academic year, department name, average and variance of the total units for subjects offered in regular terms, the number of unique subjects offered, the minimum start date of the term, and the percentage of subjects with more than 6 total units.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH AvgVarUnits AS ( SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY var_total_units DESC ), LibSubjStats AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT so.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(at.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON at.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.avg_total_units, a.var_total_units, l.subject_count, l.min_term_start_date FROM AvgVarUnits a JOIN LibSubjStats l ON a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = l.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND a.DEPARTMENT_NAME = l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), UnitStats AS ( SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS total_subjects, SUM(CASE WHEN c.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subjects_over_6_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_total_units, ic.var_total_units, ic.subject_count, ic.min_term_start_date, ROUND(100.0 * us.subjects_over_6_units / NULLIF(us.total_subjects, 0), 2) AS pct_subjects_over_6_units FROM inner_cte ic JOIN UnitStats us ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = us.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = us.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE us.subjects_over_6_units > 0.6 * us.total_subjects ORDER BY ic.var_total_units DESC;

question: For each academic year and subject category where the subject has a maximum enrollment greater than 10, what are the academic year, academic year description, geometric mean of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during that year (considering only subjects with more than zero enrolled students), subject category key, number of unique subjects, the minimum academic term start date, and the number of TIP_DETAIL records associated with those subjects? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH GeometricMeanEnrollment AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), SubjectCategoryStats AS ( SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT i.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT gm.ACADEMIC_YEAR, gm.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gm.geometric_mean_enrollment, sc.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, sc.subject_count, sc.min_term_start_date FROM GeometricMeanEnrollment gm JOIN SubjectCategoryStats sc ON gm.ACADEMIC_YEAR = sc.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_enrollment, inner_cte.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.min_term_start_date, COUNT(td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS tip_detail_count FROM inner_cte JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd ON inner_cte.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = isd.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON isd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE AND at.ACADEMIC_YEAR = inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR LEFT JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON isd.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_enrollment, inner_cte.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.min_term_start_date ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY;

question: For each subject offered in the Spring term of 2023, show the subject title, department name, term code, academic year, the average academic year within each academic year group ordered by term start date, and for the corresponding department, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses offered by that department considering only courses that have at least one associated TIP material. Additionally, show the deviation of the number of enrolled students in each course from the department's average number of enrolled students (again, only considering courses with at least one associated TIP material). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.TERM_CODE, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY a.TERM_START_DATE) AS avg_academic_year FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON ata.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON a.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE WHERE a.TERM_CODE = '2023SP' ), dept_enrollment_stats AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS num_enrolled_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS num_enrolled_stddev, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_num_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), course_enrollment_deviation AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, (lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS - des.avg_num_enrolled) AS deviation_from_dept_avg FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN dept_enrollment_stats des ON lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = des.department WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.TERM_CODE, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.avg_academic_year, des.num_enrolled_variance, des.num_enrolled_stddev, ced.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ced.deviation_from_dept_avg FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN dept_enrollment_stats des ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.department LEFT JOIN course_enrollment_deviation ced ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ced.department

question: For each department, what is the department name, the variance of the total units of subjects offered in the 2022 academic year, the variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only departments that grant degrees and subjects with a non-null subject code description), the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in those subjects, the school name, and the department phone number? Please provide the department name, the variance of total units, the variance of enrolled students, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrolled students, the school name, and the department phone number, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptUnitsVariance AS ( SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), DeptEnrolledVariance AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ) SELECT duv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, duv.total_units_variance, dev.enrolled_students_variance, dev.enrolled_students_stddev FROM DeptUnitsVariance duv JOIN DeptEnrolledVariance dev ON duv.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dev.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY duv.total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_units_variance, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, inner_cte.enrolled_students_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.total_units_variance DESC;

question: For subjects offered in the term 2019FA that have the same subject title and department name as subjects in the academic term 2009SP, show the subject ID, subject title, number of enrolled students, department name, department full name, the row number within each department name group ordered by subject ID for 2019FA, the total units for 2009SP, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title for 2009SP, and the term description for 2019FA, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH Subjects2019FA AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ), Subjects2009SP AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' ) SELECT s19.SUBJECT_ID, s19.SUBJECT_TITLE, s19.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s19.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s19.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s19.window_column AS window_column_2019FA, s09.TOTAL_UNITS, s09.window_column AS window_column_2009SP, s19.TERM_CODE FROM Subjects2019FA s19 JOIN Subjects2009SP s09 ON s19.SUBJECT_TITLE = s09.SUBJECT_TITLE AND s19.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s09.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.window_column_2019FA, i.TOTAL_UNITS, i.window_column_2009SP, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON i.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For courses in the School of Engineering that are degree granting, show the course description, department name, subject code, subject title, the minimum total units in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the course number, as well as the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students in the year 2017), along with the school name and department phone number. List the columns in the following order: course description, department name, subject code, subject title, minimum total units (windowed), variance of enrolled students, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrolled students, school name, and department phone number. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, MIN(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.SUBJECT_ID FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_CODE = t2.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), enrolled_stats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2017%' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.window_column, es.enrolled_students_variance, es.enrolled_students_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM inner_cte icte JOIN enrolled_stats es ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = es.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE

question: From the top 10 departments with the highest number of subjects offered in the 2016SP term with 12 total units, display each department's name, the count of such subjects, the subject title with the highest total units in that department (for 2016SP, 12 units), the subject description from the course catalog, and the windowed row number (with 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title) for that subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 GROUP BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.Subject_Count, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccat.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM inner_cte icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND s.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccat ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccat.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND s.SUBJECT_TITLE = ccat.SUBJECT_TITLE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS = ( SELECT MAX(s2.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED s2 WHERE s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND s2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND s2.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) ORDER BY icte.Subject_Count DESC, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE LIMIT 10;

question: For each department in the "Engineering" school with subjects having total units equal to 1, list the department name, academic year, the number of such subjects in that year, and the variance of total units for subjects offered by the same department in the 2012SU term. For each department, include a grand total for all academic years in the format of (department name, null, total subjects, variance). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 1 ), dept_variance AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON tso.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptYearCounts AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_subjects FROM inner_cte ic GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT dyc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dyc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dyc.num_subjects, dv.total_units_variance FROM DeptYearCounts dyc LEFT JOIN dept_variance dv ON dyc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME UNION ALL SELECT dyc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(dyc.num_subjects) AS num_subjects, dv.total_units_variance FROM DeptYearCounts dyc LEFT JOIN dept_variance dv ON dyc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY dyc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dv.total_units_variance ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR ;

question: Show the department names, their corresponding HR department codes, the number of unique space units with a space unit key greater than 100000 for each department, and the total sum of those space unit keys per department, for all departments in the Provost Area. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS department_rank_within_school_area, t1.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 INNER JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' ) SELECT icte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS num_space_units_gt_100k, SUM(su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS total_space_unit_key_gt_100k FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON icte.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY WHERE su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000 GROUP BY icte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE

question: For each term and department, list the term, department, the number of subjects offered with more than 0 enrolled students and a material status key of 'U', the average number of enrolled students for these subjects, the school name, and the department phone number. Include subtotals for each term (the corresponding term field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all terms (the corresponding term field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the term if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by term and department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL t3 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t3.SUBJECT_ID AND t3.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(term) OVER (ORDER BY term_sort, term, dept_sort) = term THEN NULL ELSE term END AS term, dept, subj_cnt, avg_enrolled, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(OFFER_DEPT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(OFFER_DEPT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(OFFER_DEPT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(OFFER_DEPT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE OFFER_DEPT_NAME END AS dept_sort, OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS dept, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS subj_cnt, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, MAX(OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) AS school_name FROM inner_cte GROUP BY TERM_CODE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME WITH ROLLUP ) tbltmp LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tbltmp.dept = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY term_sort, dept_sort;

question: For rooms on floor 2 that are associated with a DLC having more than five organizations, provide the building room, space usage, organization name, HR org unit title, department name, the minimum access level in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the building component, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the organization numbers for organizations associated with that DLC, and the HR org unit level, ordered by the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of organization numbers (descending), then by HR org unit level, and then by building room. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DLCOrgStddev AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_NAME, STDDEV(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY.DLC_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER IS NOT NULL GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY org_number_stddev DESC ), Floor2Rooms AS ( SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.SPACE_USAGE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DLC_NAME, MIN(t0.ACCESS_LEVEL) OVER (ORDER BY t0.BUILDING_COMPONENT ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2 ) SELECT f2r.BUILDING_ROOM, f2r.SPACE_USAGE, f2r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, f2r.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, f2r.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, f2r.window_column, dos.org_number_stddev, f2r.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL FROM Floor2Rooms f2r JOIN DLCOrgStddev dos ON f2r.DLC_NAME = dos.DLC_NAME ) SELECT icte.BUILDING_ROOM, icte.SPACE_USAGE, icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, icte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.window_column, icte.org_number_stddev, icte.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL FROM inner_cte icte ORDER BY icte.org_number_stddev DESC, icte.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, icte.BUILDING_ROOM;

question: Show the department names, the corresponding SIS subject code, subject code descriptions, graduate level, the total number of courses per department, and the maximum total units of any course offered by that department, but only for departments where the maximum total units is greater than 6. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ic.GRADUATE_LEVEL, ic.Total_Courses, dmu.max_total_units FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ) dmu ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For all subject offerings in the academic term with term code '2017FA', show the subject title, the offer department name, the term description, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title, and for each, include the course level, the number of unique students, the minimum CIP program code among courses in the corresponding degree-granting department, and the department's school name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON s.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' ), DepartmentStudentStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.window_column, dss.COURSE_LEVEL, dss.student_count, dss.min_cip_code, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte ic JOIN DepartmentStudentStats dss ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = dss.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON dss.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, dss.COURSE_LEVEL

question: For all subject offerings in the academic term with term code '2017FA', show the subject title, the offer department name, the term description, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title, and for each, include the course level, the number of unique students, the minimum CIP program code among courses in the corresponding degree-granting department, and the department's full name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON s.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' ), DepartmentStudentStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.window_column, dss.COURSE_LEVEL, dss.student_count, dss.min_cip_code, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte icte JOIN DepartmentStudentStats dss ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = dss.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON dss.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, dss.COURSE_LEVEL

question: From the top 10 departments in the "Provost Area" with the highest number of associated space units (where the space unit key is greater than 100000), display each department's code, department name, school area name, the department's rank within its school area based on department code, the total count of such space units, and the sum of their space unit keys. Also, for each space unit with a key greater than 100000, show the space unit code, organization name, HR department name (for the space unit), and the sum of space unit keys within each warehouse load date group. Indicate the source of each row as either "TopProvostDepartment" or "SpaceUnit". The columns should be: department code, department name, school area name, department rank within school area, space unit count (for department), sum of space unit keys (for department), space unit code, organization name, HR department name (for space unit), sum of space unit keys within warehouse load date, and source. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS department_rank_within_school_area, t1.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 INNER JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' ), DeptSpaceUnitAgg AS ( SELECT ic.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, ic.department_rank_within_school_area, COUNT(su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS space_unit_count, SUM(su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS sum_space_unit_keys FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON ic.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY WHERE su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000 GROUP BY ic.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, ic.department_rank_within_school_area ), TopDeptSpaceUnitAgg AS ( SELECT * FROM DeptSpaceUnitAgg ORDER BY space_unit_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), SpaceUnits AS ( SELECT t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE ORDER BY t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS sum_space_unit_keys_within_warehouse_load_date, t2.DLC_KEY FROM SPACE_UNIT t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000 ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT td.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, td.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, td.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, td.department_rank_within_school_area, td.space_unit_count, td.sum_space_unit_keys, NULL AS SPACE_UNIT_CODE, NULL AS ORGANIZATION_NAME, NULL AS spaceunit_HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS sum_space_unit_keys_within_warehouse_load_date, 'TopProvostDepartment' AS Source FROM TopDeptSpaceUnitAgg td UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, NULL AS HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, NULL AS department_rank_within_school_area, NULL AS space_unit_count, NULL AS sum_space_unit_keys, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, su.ORGANIZATION_NAME, su.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS spaceunit_HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, su.sum_space_unit_keys_within_warehouse_load_date, 'SpaceUnit' AS Source FROM SpaceUnits su ) SELECT HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, department_rank_within_school_area, space_unit_count, sum_space_unit_keys, SPACE_UNIT_CODE, ORGANIZATION_NAME, spaceunit_HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sum_space_unit_keys_within_warehouse_load_date, Source FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY Source, HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, SPACE_UNIT_CODE;

question: For each subject that is either offered in the 2012SU term with a cluster type of 'S' (showing the subject title, subject key, department name, and the dense rank of each subject considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the number of enrolled students, with the reason 'Cluster S Dense Rank'), or is offered in the 2012 summer term by the Harvard Cross-Enrollment Program (showing the subject title, subject key, department name, the number of subject offerings, and the total number of units for those offerings, with the reason 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment'), also include the total number of lab units for each subject (if available). For each result, include the subject title, subject key, department name, offering count, total units, total lab units, window column, and the reason for inclusion, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t2.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t0.CLUSTER_TYPE = 'S' ) , Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.SUBJECT_KEY, t3.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS offering_count, NULL AS total_units, SUM(t3.LAB_UNITS) AS total_lab_units, s.window_column, 'Cluster S Dense Rank' AS Reason FROM inner_cte s JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON s.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t3 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t3.SUBJECT_ID_SORT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t2.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' GROUP BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.SUBJECT_KEY, t3.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.window_column ) , Subquery2 AS ( SELECT so.SUBJECT_TITLE, so.SUBJECT_KEY, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS offering_count, SUM(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units, SUM(ss.LAB_UNITS) AS total_lab_units, NULL AS window_column, 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment' AS Reason FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON sos.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' GROUP BY so.SUBJECT_TITLE, so.SUBJECT_KEY, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) , CombinedSubjects AS ( SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.SUBJECT_KEY, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.offering_count, s1.total_units, s1.total_lab_units, s1.window_column, s1.Reason FROM Subquery1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.SUBJECT_KEY, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.offering_count, s2.total_units, s2.total_lab_units, s2.window_column, s2.Reason FROM Subquery2 s2 ) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, SUBJECT_KEY, DEPARTMENT_NAME, offering_count, total_units, total_lab_units, window_column, Reason FROM CombinedSubjects ORDER BY SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: From the top 10 departments in the 'Engineering' school with the highest number of 12-unit courses, display each department's name, the total count of such courses, the subject title most frequently offered among those courses, and the count of courses for that subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
