SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE AS course_number, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, dept_course_counts.course_count AS total_12unit_courses, dept_subject_counts.top_subject_title, dept_subject_counts.subject_course_count FROM ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS course_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) dept_course_counts JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE AS top_subject_title, subject_course_count FROM ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS subject_course_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE ) ranked WHERE rn = 1 ) dept_subject_counts ON dept_course_counts.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = dept_subject_counts.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME FROM inner_cte ) ic ON dept_course_counts.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = ic.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY dept_course_counts.course_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each Mathematics department course with at least 5 enrolled students, show the course number, subject title, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, the row number within each academic year group ordered by course number, and the highest number of enrolled students in any Mathematics department course for that academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 ) SELECT icte.COURSE_NUMBER, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.window_column, max_stats.max_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ( SELECT t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) max_stats ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = max_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.window_column;

question: Show the activity titles, enrollment types, maximum enrollments, session titles, session locations, session dates, session start and end times, the minimum session start time per session location, the dense rank (considering the current and 2 preceding rows) ordered by academic year, and the term description for IAP subject activities in term '2021JA' that are not cancelled and have a maximum enrollment of at least 20, ordered by session location. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, s.SESSION_TITLE, s.SESSION_LOCATION, s.SESSION_DATE, s.SESSION_START_TIME, s.SESSION_END_TIME, MIN(s.SESSION_START_TIME) OVER (PARTITION BY s.SESSION_LOCATION ORDER BY s.SESSION_LOCATION) AS min_start_time_per_location, d.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY WHERE d.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' AND d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' ) SELECT cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, cte.MAX_ENROLLMENT, cte.SESSION_TITLE, cte.SESSION_LOCATION, cte.SESSION_DATE, cte.SESSION_START_TIME, cte.SESSION_END_TIME, cte.min_start_time_per_location, dr.window_column, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte cte JOIN ( SELECT t1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.TERM_CODE FROM TIME_DAY t0 JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20 ) dr ON cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE = dr.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND cte.TERM_CODE = dr.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON cte.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE ORDER BY cte.SESSION_LOCATION;

question: For subjects that are both (1) offered in the term '2016SP' with a total of 12 units and (2) among the top 10 subject titles by the number of reserved library materials for subjects offered in the term '2009SP', display the subject title, the department name from the department table, the subject description from the course catalog, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the subject title, the offering department name, the count of reserved materials, the school name from the department table, and the department phone number from the admin department table, ordered by the count of reserved materials (descending) and then by subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION, t0.SUBJECT_ID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), subq2 AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t.SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY reserved_materials DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION, subq1.window_column, subq2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, subq2.reserved_materials, subq1.SUBJECT_ID FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.SUBJECT_ID = subq2.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.reserved_materials, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.reserved_materials DESC, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For courses in the School of Engineering that are degree granting and have a course level of 'G', show the course description, department name, the dense rank of each course considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the department's budget code, the average of the ASCII values of the department's subject codes' course numbers, the variance of the ASCII values of the department's subject codes' course numbers, and the total number of subject codes for each department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' ), DepartmentCourseStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VARIANCE(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS total_subject_codes FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY var_course_number_ascii DESC ) SELECT ic.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.window_column, dcs.avg_course_number_ascii, dcs.var_course_number_ascii, dcs.total_subject_codes FROM inner_cte ic JOIN DepartmentCourseStats dcs ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.window_column

question: For each department name and school name where the department is degree granting, provide the number of unique courses, the minimum CIP program code from the course descriptions, the subject title from the subject offered summary, and the average total units from the course catalog for subjects offered in the term '2022FA' with a total of 12 units. Only include results where the average total units is greater than 6. List the results ordered by department name and average total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.course_count, icte.min_cip_code, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sos.COURSE_NUMBER = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE AND ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.course_count, icte.min_cip_code, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE HAVING AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units;

question: Show the subject IDs that are present in both the term "2010FA" and the term with code "2025FA", along with the term description from ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL for 2010FA, the material status key from TIP_DETAIL for 2010FA, the academic year from ACADEMIC_TERMS for 2010FA, the rank of each subject within each academic year group ordered by subject ID for 2010FA, the subject title for 2025FA, the offering department name for 2025FA, the number of enrolled students for 2025FA, the term description for 2025FA, the academic year for 2025FA, the term start date for 2025FA, the term end date for 2025FA, the term parameter for 2025FA, the minimum number of enrolled students over each offering department for 2025FA, and the responsible faculty name for 2025FA, ordered by subject ID and offering department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2010FA' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS TERM_DESCRIPTION_2010FA, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_2010FA, inner_cte.window_column, t25.SUBJECT_TITLE, t25.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t25.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, tA.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS TERM_DESCRIPTION_2025FA, tA.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_2025FA, tA.TERM_START_DATE, tA.TERM_END_DATE, tP.TERM_PARAMETER, MIN(t25.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t25.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t25.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept, t25.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t25 ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = t25.SUBJECT_ID AND t25.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS tA ON t25.TERM_CODE = tA.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER tP ON tA.TERM_CODE = tP.TERM_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, t25.OFFER_DEPT_NAME

question: For each department, where the range of total units for subjects offered in the academic year 2022 is greater than 0 and the average total units for subjects with at least one enrolled student and required course materials is greater than 0, give the department name, the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in 2022, the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects with at least one enrolled student and required course materials, and the number of unique responsible faculty who taught these subjects with required materials and enrolled students, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DepartmentUnits2022 AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC ), DeptUnitsWithMaterials AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT d2022.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d2022.units_range, d2022.units_variance, dmat.avg_total_units, dmat.total_units_range, dmat.total_units_variance FROM DepartmentUnits2022 d2022 JOIN DeptUnitsWithMaterials dmat ON d2022.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dmat.OFFER_DEPT_NAME WHERE d2022.units_range > 0 AND dmat.avg_total_units > 0 ORDER BY d2022.units_range DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.units_range, inner_cte.units_variance, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.total_units_range, inner_cte.total_units_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME) AS num_unique_faculty FROM inner_cte JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.units_range, inner_cte.units_variance, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.total_units_range, inner_cte.total_units_variance ORDER BY inner_cte.units_range DESC;

question: For each previous academic term where the term start date matches the minimum academic term start date for a subject category and academic year with more than 10 maximum enrollment, show the term code, term description, term start date, calendar date, day of week, the average calendar year within each calendar year group ordered by term start date, the subject category key, academic year, number of unique subjects, minimum academic term start date, the normalized subjects per year rounded (number of unique subjects divided by the average calendar year), and the total number of TIP_DETAIL records for that term.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t0.CALENDAR_DATE, t0.DAY_OF_WEEK, AVG(t0.CALENDAR_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.CALENDAR_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_START_DATE) AS window_column FROM TIME_DAY t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.CALENDAR_DATE = t1.TERM_START_DATE WHERE t1.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ), SubjectCategoryStats AS ( SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT i.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), TipCounts AS ( SELECT TERM_CODE, COUNT(*) AS tip_detail_count FROM TIP_DETAIL GROUP BY TERM_CODE ) SELECT ti.TERM_CODE, ti.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ti.TERM_START_DATE, ti.CALENDAR_DATE, ti.DAY_OF_WEEK, ti.window_column, scs.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, scs.ACADEMIC_YEAR, scs.subject_count, scs.min_term_start_date, ROUND(scs.subject_count / NULLIF(ti.window_column, 0), 2) AS Normalized_Subjects_Per_Year, COALESCE(tc.tip_detail_count, 0) AS tip_detail_count FROM inner_cte ti JOIN SubjectCategoryStats scs ON ti.TERM_START_DATE = scs.min_term_start_date LEFT JOIN TipCounts tc ON ti.TERM_CODE = tc.TERM_CODE ORDER BY Normalized_Subjects_Per_Year DESC;

question: For each department in the school of Engineering, show the department full name, the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered in the term '2017JA', and the maximum total enrolled students for any department in the school of Engineering. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' AND t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, total_enrolled_students, MAX(total_enrolled_students) OVER () AS max_total_enrolled_students_in_engineering FROM inner_cte;

question: For subjects offered in the term '2016SP' with a total of 12 units, show the subject title from the offered summary, the department name from the department table, the subject description from the course catalog, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the subject title from the offered summary. Additionally, for each such subject, include the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses from the same department that have at least one associated course material, and also show the total number of such courses per department. Present the subject title, department name, subject description, windowed row number, average enrollment, enrollment standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and the total number of courses with materials, in that order, ordered by department name and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_CODE FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_courses_with_materials FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION, icte.window_column, ds.avg_enrollment, ds.enrollment_stddev, ds.num_courses_with_materials FROM inner_cte icte JOIN dept_stats ds ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: From the top 10 schools with the highest average total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year, display each school's name, average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, the course description and department name of the highest ranked degree-granting course in the School of Engineering (by department budget code), and the dense rank of that course within its school. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION d ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = d.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON d.COURSE = c.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ), EngineeringDegreeCourses AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.avg_total_units, s.stddev_total_units, e.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.window_column FROM inner_cte s LEFT JOIN ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, COURSE_DESCRIPTION, DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column FROM ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, COURSE_DESCRIPTION, DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY window_column) AS rn FROM EngineeringDegreeCourses ) ranked WHERE rn = 1 ) e ON s.SCHOOL_NAME = e.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY s.avg_total_units DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each academic term parameter, list the term parameter, term code, academic year, department name of the offered subject, the running sum of academic years within each department, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of subjects offered in that term parameter (if available), and the number of unique subjects offered in that term parameter, with all columns shown in the order: term parameter, term code, academic year, department name, running sum of academic years, variance, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), number of subjects, and reason for inclusion ('TermIndicatorC' for term indicator 'C' and 'RegularTermVariance' for regular term variance/statistics). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_PARAMETER, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_INDICATOR = 'C' ), Sub2 AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_SUMMARY.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), Combined AS ( SELECT i.TERM_PARAMETER, i.TERM_CODE, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.window_column, NULL AS total_units_variance, NULL AS total_units_stddev, NULL AS num_subjects, 'TermIndicatorC' AS Reason FROM inner_cte i UNION ALL SELECT s2.TERM_PARAMETER, NULL AS TERM_CODE, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS window_column, s2.total_units_variance, s2.total_units_stddev, s2.num_subjects, 'RegularTermVariance' AS Reason FROM Sub2 s2 ) SELECT TERM_PARAMETER, TERM_CODE, ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev, num_subjects, Reason FROM Combined ORDER BY TERM_PARAMETER, Reason;

question: For each degree-granting course in the School of Engineering, show the course description, department name, subject code description, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by course description, along with the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2022, and also include the subject title and subject description for one subject offered by that department in 2022. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH department_units_stats AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC ), engineering_degree_courses AS ( SELECT t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT edc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, edc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, edc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, edc.window_column, dus.units_range, dus.units_variance FROM engineering_degree_courses edc LEFT JOIN department_units_stats dus ON edc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.units_range, inner_cte.units_variance, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE, cso.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022

question: For subjects offered in the term 2019FA that are also offered by departments in the School of Engineering with a total of at least 6 units, show the subject ID, subject title, number of enrolled students, department name, department full name, the row number within each department name group ordered by subject ID, the running sum of total units within each school ordered by subject ID, and for each department, include a grand total of enrolled students in the format of (null subject ID, null subject title, null row number, null running sum, department name, department full name, total enrolled students). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.window_column AS dept_row_number, s2.window_column AS engineering_running_sum_units FROM Subq1 s1 JOIN Subq2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) , DeptTotals AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.dept_row_number, i.engineering_running_sum_units, NULL AS total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte i UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_ID, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, NULL AS dept_row_number, NULL AS engineering_running_sum_units, d.total_enrolled_students FROM DeptTotals d ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID

question: For each employee type and department name where the student year is 'G', and for each subject offered in the library in the Mathematics department during regular terms, provide the employee type, department name, number of people, minimum MIT ID, subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, term description, academic year, subject short title, the maximum total units for each row and the next two rows in order of subject ID, and the responsible faculty name and their MIT ID for the subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH employee_type_department_g AS ( SELECT sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(sp.MIT_ID) AS person_count, MIN(sp.MIT_ID) AS min_mit_id FROM SE_PERSON sp JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), math_subjects_regular_terms AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, MAX(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_total_units, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_dept_name, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ) SELECT etd.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, etd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, etd.person_count, etd.min_mit_id, msrt.SUBJECT_TITLE, msrt.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, msrt.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, msrt.TERM_DESCRIPTION, msrt.ACADEMIC_YEAR, msrt.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, msrt.max_total_units, msrt.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, msrt.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID FROM employee_type_department_g etd JOIN math_subjects_regular_terms msrt ON etd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = msrt.join_dept_name ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte;

question: For each organization with an organization level of 5, show the organization name, organization key, description, space unit, space unit key, the average organization key within each organization key group ordered by space unit key, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the access levels of rooms assigned to the space unit, and the total number of rooms assigned to each space unit. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.SPACE_UNIT, t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ) SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.DESCRIPTION, o.SPACE_UNIT, o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, o.window_column, s.coefficient_of_variation, s.room_count FROM inner_cte o JOIN ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, STDDEV(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) / NULLIF(AVG(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation, COUNT(zr.BUILDING_ROOM) AS room_count FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD zr ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = zr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE HAVING AVG(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) > 0 ) s ON o.SPACE_UNIT = s.SPACE_UNIT AND o.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE

question: For the top 10 subject titles by the number of reserve materials assigned, including the department name and the term code, also provide the total number of unique instructors who assigned reserve materials for each subject. List the subject title, department name, term code, number of reserve materials, number of unique instructors, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of reserved materials per subject (considering only subjects with at least one reserved material and where the material status is 'U'). Order the results by the number of reserve materials in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_reserve_materials FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE ORDER BY num_reserve_materials DESC LIMIT 10 ), SubjectReserveStats AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(material_count) - MIN(material_count) AS reserved_material_range, VARIANCE(material_count) AS reserved_material_variance, STDDEV(material_count) AS reserved_material_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED s JOIN ( SELECT LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL WHERE LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ) d ON s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY reserved_material_range DESC ), InstructorCounts AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY) AS num_unique_instructors FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.TERM_CODE, icte.num_reserve_materials, ic.num_unique_instructors, srs.reserved_material_range, srs.reserved_material_variance, srs.reserved_material_stddev FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SubjectReserveStats srs ON icte.SUBJECT_TITLE = srs.SUBJECT_TITLE JOIN InstructorCounts ic ON icte.SUBJECT_TITLE = ic.SUBJECT_TITLE AND icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND icte.TERM_CODE = ic.TERM_CODE ORDER BY icte.num_reserve_materials DESC;

question: From the top 10 departments in the Provost Area with the highest number of associated space units (where the department code is not null and the space unit key is greater than 100000), display each department's name, long name, the corresponding hierarchy level 3 name from the master department hierarchy, the total count of space units, the most represented organization name among those space units, and the count of space units for that organization. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, t1.DLC_KEY, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t1.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL ) , DeptSpaceUnitCounts AS ( SELECT d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, d.DLC_KEY, COUNT(su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS SpaceUnit_Count FROM inner_cte d JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON d.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY WHERE su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000 GROUP BY d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, d.DLC_KEY ) , DeptOrgCounts AS ( SELECT d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS Org_SpaceUnit_Count FROM inner_cte d JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON d.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY WHERE su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000 GROUP BY d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) , RankedDeptOrg AS ( SELECT doc.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, doc.ORGANIZATION_NAME, doc.Org_SpaceUnit_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY doc.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY doc.Org_SpaceUnit_Count DESC) AS OrgRank FROM DeptOrgCounts doc ) SELECT dsc.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dsc.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, dsc.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, dsc.SpaceUnit_Count, rdo.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS Most_Represented_Organization, rdo.Org_SpaceUnit_Count AS Org_SpaceUnit_Count FROM DeptSpaceUnitCounts dsc LEFT JOIN RankedDeptOrg rdo ON dsc.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = rdo.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AND rdo.OrgRank = 1 ORDER BY dsc.SpaceUnit_Count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each academic year and department where the number of enrolled students in the library subject offered is greater than 3, provide the academic year, department name, average and variance of the total units for subjects offered in regular terms, the number of unique subjects offered, the minimum start date of the term, and classify the department's average total units as 'HIGH_LOAD' (at least 10% greater than the overall average), 'LOW_LOAD' (at least 10% less than the overall average), or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH AvgVarUnits AS ( SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY var_total_units DESC ), LibSubjStats AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT so.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(at.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON at.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.avg_total_units, a.var_total_units, l.subject_count, l.min_term_start_date FROM AvgVarUnits a JOIN LibSubjStats l ON a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = l.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND a.DEPARTMENT_NAME = l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY a.var_total_units DESC ), overall_avg AS ( SELECT AVG(avg_total_units) AS overall_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_total_units, i.var_total_units, i.subject_count, i.min_term_start_date, CASE WHEN i.avg_total_units > o.overall_avg_total_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_LOAD' WHEN i.avg_total_units < o.overall_avg_total_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_LOAD' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS load_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN overall_avg o ORDER BY i.var_total_units DESC;

question: Show the department names, the geometric mean of the space unit codes for all space units associated with each department (considering only space units with a code greater than 0), the number of organizations, the minimum organization number, and the total number of space units per department, for departments where the organization is assignable and the organization level is greater than 4. Order the results by geometric mean descending and then by organization count descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH GeometricMeanByDepartment AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.DLC_KEY, EXP(AVG(LN(s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE))) AS geometric_mean FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT s ON o.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY WHERE s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE > 0 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.DLC_KEY ORDER BY geometric_mean DESC ), OrganizationStats AS ( SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND o.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL > 4 GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT gmd.ORGANIZATION_NAME, gmd.geometric_mean, os.organization_count, os.min_organization_number, gmd.DLC_KEY FROM GeometricMeanByDepartment gmd JOIN OrganizationStats os ON gmd.DLC_KEY = os.DLC_KEY AND gmd.ORGANIZATION_NAME = os.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY gmd.geometric_mean DESC, os.organization_count DESC ) SELECT icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.geometric_mean, icte.organization_count, icte.min_organization_number, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS total_space_units FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SPACE_UNIT s ON icte.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY GROUP BY icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.geometric_mean, icte.organization_count, icte.min_organization_number ORDER BY icte.geometric_mean DESC, icte.organization_count DESC;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2022 with a total of 12 units, show the subject code, subject number, department name, subject title, term description, total units, and the deviation of the subject's total units from the average total units for its department (considering only departments that grant degrees and subjects with more than 0 total units). The columns should be: subject code, subject number, department name, subject title, term description, total units, and deviation from department average total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) , dept_avg AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_NUMBER, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.TOTAL_UNITS, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - d.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_dept_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ;

question: For each library reserve material detail with material status key equal to 'U', show the library course instructor key, library reserve catalog key, term code, subject ID, the tip material key, tip material status key, tip ISBN, the subject title from the subject offered table, the minimum tip material status key in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the number of enrolled students, the variance of the record count for TIP materials associated with that subject (considering only records where the library material status is 'U' and the TIP material status is 'RQ'), and the offer department name from the subject offered table, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT l.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, l.TERM_CODE, l.SUBJECT_ID, t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t.ISBN, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MIN(t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) OVER ( ORDER BY s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ), SubjectRecordCountVariance AS ( SELECT LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID = TIP_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC ) SELECT ic.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, ic.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, ic.TERM_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, ic.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ic.ISBN, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.window_column, srv.record_count_variance, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN SubjectRecordCountVariance srv ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = srv.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY ic.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, ic.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY;

question: For the top 10 departments with the highest range of room areas (considering only rooms with an area greater than 40), show each department's name, the range and variance of the areas of rooms assigned to it, the range and variance of the space unit codes associated with it (considering only organizations with a non-null description and space units with a non-null space unit name), and the total number of rooms assigned to each department. The columns should be: department name, area range, area variance, space unit code range, space unit code variance, and room count. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 40 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY area_range DESC ), space_unit_stats AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAX(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) - MIN(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS code_range, VARIANCE(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS code_variance FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY odk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON odk.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL AND su.SPACE_UNIT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY code_range DESC ), room_count_stats AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 40 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.area_range, icte.area_variance, sus.code_range, sus.code_variance, rcs.room_count FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN space_unit_stats sus ON icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = sus.ORGANIZATION_NAME LEFT JOIN room_count_stats rcs ON icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = rcs.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY icte.area_range DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each academic year and department name where the number of enrolled students is greater than 5, what is the number of unique subjects offered, the minimum start date of the academic term, and, for that department, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of courses offered by that department (considering only courses that are offered this year and have a non-null total units value)? Additionally, for each such department, include the school name and department phone number. List the academic year, department name, subject count, minimum start date, total units range, total units variance, total units standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), school name, and department phone number, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccc.total_units) - MIN(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccc.total_units IS NOT NULL GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ), DeptYearSubjects AS ( SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT l.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_start_date FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON t.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT dys.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dys.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dys.subject_count, dys.min_start_date, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev FROM DeptYearSubjects dys LEFT JOIN DeptUnitsStats dus ON dys.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.subject_count, icte.min_start_date, icte.total_units_range, icte.total_units_variance, icte.total_units_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: For rooms on floor 2 that are associated with departments in the Provost Area, show the building room, space usage, the organization name, the HR org unit title, the department name, the department (DLC) name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of faculty organization keys for that department, the minimum access level in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the building component, and the long department name from the HR organization unit. Present the results ordered by department name and building room, and categorize each room as 'HIGH_ACCESS' if its access level is at least 10% higher than the average access level for its department, 'LOW_ACCESS' if at least 10% lower, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptOrgStats AS ( SELECT m.DLC_NAME, m.DLC_KEY, VARIANCE(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_key_variance, STDDEV(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_key_stddev FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME, m.DLC_KEY ORDER BY org_key_variance DESC ), Floor2Rooms AS ( SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.SPACE_USAGE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID, t0.ACCESS_LEVEL, MIN(t0.ACCESS_LEVEL) OVER (ORDER BY t0.BUILDING_COMPONENT ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2 ) SELECT f2.BUILDING_ROOM, f2.SPACE_USAGE, f2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, f2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, f2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DLC_NAME, d.org_key_variance, d.org_key_stddev, f2.window_column, f2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID, f2.ACCESS_LEVEL FROM Floor2Rooms f2 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON f2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = fo.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN DeptOrgStats d ON fo.DLC_KEY = d.DLC_KEY ), DeptAccessAvg AS ( SELECT i.DLC_NAME, AVG(i.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS avg_access_level FROM inner_cte i GROUP BY i.DLC_NAME ) SELECT i.BUILDING_ROOM, i.SPACE_USAGE, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DLC_NAME, i.org_key_variance, i.org_key_stddev, i.window_column, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, CASE WHEN i.ACCESS_LEVEL > d.avg_access_level * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ACCESS' WHEN i.ACCESS_LEVEL < d.avg_access_level * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ACCESS' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS access_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN DeptAccessAvg d ON i.DLC_NAME = d.DLC_NAME JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON i.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = h.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID ORDER BY i.DLC_NAME, i.BUILDING_ROOM;

question: For each department in the School of Engineering that both grants degrees and offers subjects during regular terms with more than 10 total tip materials, and where the average total units for subjects offered by that department is at least 6, what are the department name, the average of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units), the variance of the total units, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units, and the total number of tip materials? List the results ordered by department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), EngineeringTipMaterials AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL t JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) > 10 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_total_units, ic.total_units_variance, ic.total_units_stddev, etm.total_tip_materials FROM inner_cte ic JOIN EngineeringTipMaterials etm ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = etm.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND ic.avg_total_units >= 6 ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each room that either has an access level of 1 or is located in building E38, list the building-room identifier, area, major use description, and the deviation of the room's area from the average area for its major use (for access level 1 rooms), as well as the building-room identifier, floor number, major use description, organization name, office location, full name of the employee, department name, and the deviation of the room's area from the average area for its department (for E38 rooms). Also include a column indicating the reason for inclusion ('AccessLevel1' for access level 1 rooms and 'E38Rooms' for E38 rooms). The columns should be: building-room identifier, area, major use description, deviation column, floor, major use description, organization name, office location, full name, department name, and reason for inclusion, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.AREA, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY FROM FCLT_MAJOR_USE t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 ), avg_major_use AS ( SELECT FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, AVG(AREA) AS avg_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS WHERE ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 GROUP BY FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY ), subquery1 AS ( SELECT i.BUILDING_ROOM, i.AREA, i.DESCRIPTION, (i.AREA - a.avg_area) AS deviation_column FROM inner_cte i JOIN avg_major_use a ON i.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = a.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY ), subquery2_base AS ( SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.FLOOR, t0.MAJOR_USE_DESC, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.OFFICE_LOCATION, t1.FULL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER, t0.AREA FROM FCLT_ROOMS t0 JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY t1 ON t0.BUILDING_ROOM = t1.OFFICE_LOCATION WHERE t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = 'E38' ), avg_dept_area AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NUMBER, AVG(AREA) AS avg_area FROM subquery2_base GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NUMBER ), subquery2 AS ( SELECT s2b.BUILDING_ROOM, NULL AS AREA, NULL AS DESCRIPTION, (s2b.AREA - ada.avg_area) AS deviation_column, s2b.FLOOR, s2b.MAJOR_USE_DESC, s2b.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s2b.OFFICE_LOCATION, s2b.FULL_NAME, s2b.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM subquery2_base s2b JOIN avg_dept_area ada ON s2b.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER = ada.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER ), CombinedRooms AS ( SELECT s1.BUILDING_ROOM, s1.AREA, s1.DESCRIPTION, s1.deviation_column, NULL AS FLOOR, NULL AS MAJOR_USE_DESC, NULL AS ORGANIZATION_NAME, NULL AS OFFICE_LOCATION, NULL AS FULL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, 'AccessLevel1' AS Reason FROM subquery1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.BUILDING_ROOM, s2.AREA, s2.DESCRIPTION, s2.deviation_column, s2.FLOOR, s2.MAJOR_USE_DESC, s2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s2.OFFICE_LOCATION, s2.FULL_NAME, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, 'E38Rooms' AS Reason FROM subquery2 s2 ) SELECT * FROM CombinedRooms ORDER BY BUILDING_ROOM;

question: For the top 10 academic years by the number of unique course materials assigned (for terms that are not current and where the course material status is 'RQ'), display each academic year description, the total count of unique materials, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of reserved library materials per academic term in that year (considering only terms with a regular status), and for each academic year, also show the total number of reserved library materials with status 'N' across all its regular terms. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH material_stats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(term_material_count) - MIN(term_material_count) AS material_count_range, VARIANCE(term_material_count) AS material_count_variance, STDDEV(term_material_count) AS material_count_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN ( SELECT LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE, COUNT(*) AS term_material_count FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL GROUP BY LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE ) AS term_stats ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = term_stats.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY material_count_range DESC ), unique_materials_stats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS unique_materials FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY unique_materials DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT um.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, um.unique_materials, ms.material_count_range, ms.material_count_variance, ms.material_count_stddev FROM unique_materials_stats um LEFT JOIN material_stats ms ON um.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = ms.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY um.unique_materials DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.unique_materials, inner_cte.material_count_range, inner_cte.material_count_variance, inner_cte.material_count_stddev, COALESCE(SUM(lrmd_count.total_reserved_n), 0) AS total_reserved_n FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(*) AS total_reserved_n FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm ON at.TERM_CODE = lrm.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'N' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) lrmd_count ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = lrmd_count.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.unique_materials, inner_cte.material_count_range, inner_cte.material_count_variance, inner_cte.material_count_stddev ORDER BY inner_cte.unique_materials DESC;

question: For each term parameter, what are the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of materials per subject for terms that are not upcoming and have a non-null term start date, and for each such term parameter, for tip details where the material status key is 'EO', show the subject offered key, material key, material status key, term code, subject ID, term description, academic year, and the term indicator from the academic term parameter table, as well as the row number within each academic year group ordered by subject offered key? List the columns in the following order: term parameter, average materials per subject, variance of materials per subject, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of materials per subject, subject offered key, material key, material status key, term code, subject ID, term description, academic year, term indicator, and row number. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT atp.TERM_PARAMETER, AVG(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_materials_per_subject, VARIANCE(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS variance_materials_per_subject, STDDEV(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS stddev_materials_per_subject FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON td.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp ON ata.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.TERM_PARAMETER <> 'SIS_UPCOMING_TERM' AND ata.TERM_START_DATE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY atp.TERM_PARAMETER ORDER BY variance_materials_per_subject DESC ) SELECT icte.TERM_PARAMETER, icte.avg_materials_per_subject, icte.variance_materials_per_subject, icte.stddev_materials_per_subject, t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.TERM_INDICATOR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS window_column FROM inner_cte icte JOIN TIP_DETAIL t0 ON t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'EO' JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND icte.TERM_PARAMETER = t2.TERM_PARAMETER ORDER BY icte.variance_materials_per_subject DESC, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, window_column;

question: For each department name and subject code where the department is degree granting, and for each course number where the number of enrolled students in the subject summary is greater than 2, provide the department name, subject code, number of subject codes, minimum department budget code, course number, number of unique library subjects offered, minimum total units for those subjects, and the average number of enrolled students for those course numbers. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE ), DeptCourseStats AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER ) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.SUBJECT_CODE, dss.subject_code_count, dss.min_dept_budget_code, dcs.COURSE_NUMBER, dcs.subject_count, dcs.min_total_units FROM DeptSubjectStats dss JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON dss.SUBJECT_CODE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN DeptCourseStats dcs ON dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dcs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = dcs.COURSE_NUMBER ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.subject_code_count, inner_cte.min_dept_budget_code, inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.min_total_units, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_num_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER = sos.COURSE_NUMBER AND inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.subject_code_count, inner_cte.min_dept_budget_code, inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.min_total_units ;

question: From the top 10 major use descriptions with the highest total room area (for rooms with area greater than 200), display each major use description, the total area, the most common organization name within that group, the DLC key, the HR department name most associated with that major use, and the count of rooms from that department, considering only organizations with organization level equal to 5 and assignable equal to 1. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t2.MAJOR_USE_DESC, t2.AREA FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.AREA > 200 ), org_hr AS ( SELECT t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1 ), room_org_hr AS ( SELECT icte.MAJOR_USE_DESC, icte.AREA, icte.BUILDING_ROOM, icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.DLC_KEY, ohr.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ohr.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY FROM inner_cte icte JOIN org_hr ohr ON icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = ohr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ), major_use_area AS ( SELECT roh.MAJOR_USE_DESC, SUM(roh.AREA) AS total_area FROM room_org_hr roh GROUP BY roh.MAJOR_USE_DESC ), major_use_org AS ( SELECT roh.MAJOR_USE_DESC, roh.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(*) AS org_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roh.MAJOR_USE_DESC ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM room_org_hr roh GROUP BY roh.MAJOR_USE_DESC, roh.ORGANIZATION_NAME ), major_use_hr_dept AS ( SELECT roh.MAJOR_USE_DESC, roh.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS dept_room_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roh.MAJOR_USE_DESC ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM room_org_hr roh GROUP BY roh.MAJOR_USE_DESC, roh.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ), major_use_dlc AS ( SELECT roh.MAJOR_USE_DESC, roh.DLC_KEY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roh.MAJOR_USE_DESC ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM room_org_hr roh GROUP BY roh.MAJOR_USE_DESC, roh.DLC_KEY ) SELECT mua.MAJOR_USE_DESC, mua.total_area, muo.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS Most_Common_Organization, mud.DLC_KEY, muhd.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Most_Common_HR_Department, muhd.dept_room_count AS Room_Count_From_Dept FROM major_use_area mua LEFT JOIN major_use_org muo ON mua.MAJOR_USE_DESC = muo.MAJOR_USE_DESC AND muo.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN major_use_dlc mud ON mua.MAJOR_USE_DESC = mud.MAJOR_USE_DESC AND mud.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN major_use_hr_dept muhd ON mua.MAJOR_USE_DESC = muhd.MAJOR_USE_DESC AND muhd.rn = 1 ORDER BY mua.total_area DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each department in the School of Engineering that offers degree-granting courses, show the department name, the average total units of its subjects, and the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students in the year 2017). Only include departments where the average total units is greater than the overall average total units for all subjects in the School of Engineering. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_CODE = t2.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), subq2 AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2017%' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, subq2.enrolled_students_variance, subq2.enrolled_students_stddev FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN subq2 ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq2.enrolled_students_variance, subq2.enrolled_students_stddev HAVING AVG(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) > ( SELECT AVG(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_CODE = t2.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' )

question: From the top 10 subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering with the highest maximum enrolled students (considering the current and next 2 rows ordered by subject key), display each subject's title, total units, department full name, row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title, subject ID, offer department name, offer school name, term description, academic year, and the department that offered the subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH EngSubjects AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ), SubjectEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_enrolled_students FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.IS_MASTER_SECTION = 'Y' AND t0.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' ) SELECT es.SUBJECT_TITLE, es.TOTAL_UNITS, es.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, es.window_column, ses.SUBJECT_ID, ses.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ses.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ses.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ses.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ses.max_enrolled_students FROM EngSubjects es JOIN SubjectEnrollmentStats ses ON es.SUBJECT_TITLE = ses.SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.TOTAL_UNITS, icte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, icte.window_column, icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.max_enrolled_students, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS OFFERING_DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.max_enrolled_students DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each subject code where the department is degree granting and the subject code description contains the word "Engineering" (case insensitive), show the subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, rank of the subject code within each school name group ordered by subject code, the number of subject codes for each department and subject code, and the minimum department budget code for each department and subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND UPPER(t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC) LIKE '%ENGINEERING%' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND UPPER(s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC) LIKE '%ENGINEERING%' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.window_column, sq2.subject_code_count, sq2.min_dept_budget_code FROM inner_cte icte JOIN Subquery2 sq2 ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.SUBJECT_CODE = sq2.SUBJECT_CODE

question: From the top 10 departments with the highest average area of rooms used for their subjects (considering only rooms with an area greater than 40), display each department's name, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area, the most frequently offered subject in that department, and the number of times it is offered. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(f.AREA) AS avg_area, VARIANCE(f.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(f.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS f JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON f.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = c.MEET_PLACE WHERE f.AREA > 40 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY avg_area DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.avg_area, ic.area_variance, ic.area_stddev, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Most_Frequent_Subject, ms.Subject_Offered_Count FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Offered_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.SUBJECT_TITLE ) ms ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ms.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.avg_area DESC;

question: For each department that both grants degrees and offers subjects in the School of Engineering during regular terms with more than 10 total tip materials, what are the department name, the average of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units), the variance of the total units, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units, the total number of tip materials, and the deviation of the total tip materials from the average total tip materials across all such departments? List the results ordered by department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), EngineeringTipMaterials AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL t JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) > 10 ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_total_units, d.total_units_variance, d.total_units_stddev, e.total_tip_materials FROM DeptUnitsStats d JOIN EngineeringTipMaterials e ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = e.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) , avg_tip_materials_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(total_tip_materials) AS avg_total_tip_materials FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_total_units, i.total_units_variance, i.total_units_stddev, i.total_tip_materials, (i.total_tip_materials - a.avg_total_tip_materials) AS deviation_from_avg_tip_materials FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_tip_materials_cte a ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each subject offered in the academic term with term code '2006FA', show the subject ID, subject title, department name, the sum of lecture units within each grade type group, the maximum subject enrollment number, the term start date, and the total units for each subject, considering only departments in the current academic term where the maximum subject enrollment number is greater than 5. List the results ordered by subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.LECTURE_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA' ), DepartmentMaxEnrollment AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_enrollment, at.TERM_START_DATE FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 5 ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.window_column, dme.max_enrollment, dme.TERM_START_DATE, cso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte ic JOIN DepartmentMaxEnrollment dme ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dme.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID AND cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = '2006FA' ORDER BY ic.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For subjects offered in the term '2016SP' with a total of 12 units, show the subject title from the offered summary, the department name from the department table, the subject description from the course catalog, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the subject title from the offered summary. Additionally, for each such subject, include the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses from the same department that have at least one associated course material, and also provide the count of such courses per department. Present the subject title, department name, subject description, windowed row number, average enrollment, enrollment standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and course count, in that order, ordered by department name and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_CODE FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), DeptCourseStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS course_count FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION, icte.window_column, dcs.avg_enrollment, dcs.enrollment_stddev, dcs.course_count FROM inner_cte icte JOIN DeptCourseStats dcs ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dcs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each building that has more than five rooms, show the building number and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of its rooms, and for each room in that building with an access level of 1, show the building room, building component, floor, space usage, space unit code, the corresponding organization's name, and the average floor within each space usage group ordered by floor, but only include those rooms whose area is greater than the average area for their building. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH BuildingAreaStddev AS ( SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.BUILDING_NUMBER, STDDEV(FCLT_ROOMS.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS.BUILDING_NUMBER HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY area_stddev DESC ), RoomAccessLevel1 AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.BUILDING_COMPONENT, t1.FLOOR, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(t1.FLOOR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SPACE_USAGE ORDER BY t1.FLOOR) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 ) SELECT bal.BUILDING_NUMBER, bal.area_stddev, ral1.BUILDING_ROOM, ral1.BUILDING_COMPONENT, ral1.FLOOR, ral1.SPACE_USAGE, ral1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, ral1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ral1.window_column, fr.AREA, fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM BuildingAreaStddev bal JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON bal.BUILDING_NUMBER = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN RoomAccessLevel1 ral1 ON fr.BUILDING_ROOM = ral1.BUILDING_ROOM ) , BuildingAvgArea AS ( SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, AVG(AREA) AS avg_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ) SELECT i.BUILDING_NUMBER, i.area_stddev, i.BUILDING_ROOM, i.BUILDING_COMPONENT, i.FLOOR, i.SPACE_USAGE, i.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.window_column FROM inner_cte i JOIN BuildingAvgArea baa ON i.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = baa.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE i.AREA > baa.avg_area ORDER BY i.area_stddev DESC, i.FLOOR;
