question: For each department and academic year where the number of enrolled students in a subject is greater than 5 and the academic year is a current or previous term, provide the department name, the academic year, the academic year description, the number of unique subjects offered, the minimum number of total units for those subjects, the variance of the record count of tip details for terms that are current or previous terms, and the average number of enrolled students for those subjects. List the results ordered by department name and academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH AcademicYearVariance AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC ), DepartmentSubjectStats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, dss.subject_count, dss.min_total_units, ayv.record_count_variance FROM DepartmentSubjectStats dss JOIN AcademicYearVariance ayv ON dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, icte.subject_count, icte.min_total_units, icte.record_count_variance, avg_stats.avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp ON t.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND atp.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) avg_stats ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = avg_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = avg_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each department hierarchy level 2 name, organization name, and department hierarchy level 3 name where the organization is assignable, provide the department hierarchy level 2 name, organization name, department hierarchy level 3 name, the number of organizations, the minimum organization number, and the geometric mean of the number of supervisees for each department (considering only departments where the number of supervisees is greater than zero), in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(f.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 GROUP BY m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME ), OrgSuperviseeGeomMean AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES))) AS geometric_mean_supervisees FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN SPACE_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ON SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY = SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.DEPT_NAMES WHERE SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES > 0 GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT i.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, i.organization_count, i.min_organization_number, o.geometric_mean_supervisees FROM inner_cte i JOIN OrgSuperviseeGeomMean o ON i.ORGANIZATION_NAME = o.ORGANIZATION_NAME;

question: List the names of all degree-granting departments, their subject codes, subject code descriptions, the average ASCII value of their course numbers, the variance of those ASCII values, and the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of course materials per subject offered by that department in the term 2017SP. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptCourseStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VARIANCE(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY var_course_number_ascii DESC ), DeptMaterialStats AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_CODE, MAX(material_count) - MIN(material_count) AS material_count_range, VARIANCE(material_count) AS material_count_variance, STDDEV(material_count) AS material_count_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ( SELECT TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM TIP_DETAIL WHERE TERM_CODE = '2017SP' GROUP BY TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ) AS detail_stats ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = detail_stats.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = '2017SP' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY material_count_range DESC ) SELECT dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dcs.avg_course_number_ascii, dcs.var_course_number_ascii, dms.material_count_range, dms.material_count_variance, dms.material_count_stddev FROM DeptCourseStats dcs JOIN DeptMaterialStats dms ON dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dms.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.avg_course_number_ascii, inner_cte.var_course_number_ascii, inner_cte.material_count_range, inner_cte.material_count_variance, inner_cte.material_count_stddev FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2022 with a total of 12 units, show the subject code, subject number, department name, subject title, term description, total units, and the average subject enrollment number in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by department code and ordered by total units, along with the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only departments that grant degrees and subjects with more than 0 total units). Additionally, for each result, include the school name of the department. The columns should be: subject code, subject number, department name, subject title, term description, total units, windowed average subject enrollment number, average total units for the department, variance of total units for the department, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for the department, and the school name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) OVER ( PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_NUMBER, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.TOTAL_UNITS, i.window_column, d.avg_total_units, d.total_units_variance, d.total_units_stddev, d.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_stats d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE

question: For each degree-granting department, provide the department name, the average and variance of the department's subject codes' course numbers (using their ASCII values), the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of course materials per subject offered by that department in the term 2017SP, and classify the department as 'HIGH_MATERIALS' if its average number of course materials per subject is at least 10% greater than the overall average across all degree-granting departments, 'LOW_MATERIALS' if at least 10% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptCourseStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VARIANCE(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY var_course_number_ascii DESC ), DeptMaterialStats AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_CODE, MAX(material_count) - MIN(material_count) AS material_count_range, VARIANCE(material_count) AS material_count_variance, STDDEV(material_count) AS material_count_stddev, AVG(material_count) AS avg_materials_per_subject FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ( SELECT TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM TIP_DETAIL WHERE TERM_CODE = '2017SP' GROUP BY TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ) AS detail_stats ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = detail_stats.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = '2017SP' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY material_count_range DESC ) SELECT dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dcs.avg_course_number_ascii, dcs.var_course_number_ascii, dms.material_count_range, dms.material_count_variance, dms.material_count_stddev, dms.avg_materials_per_subject FROM DeptCourseStats dcs JOIN DeptMaterialStats dms ON dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dms.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ), overall_avg AS ( SELECT AVG(avg_materials_per_subject) AS overall_avg_materials FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_course_number_ascii, i.var_course_number_ascii, i.material_count_range, i.material_count_variance, i.material_count_stddev, i.avg_materials_per_subject, o.overall_avg_materials, CASE WHEN i.avg_materials_per_subject > o.overall_avg_materials * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_MATERIALS' WHEN i.avg_materials_per_subject < o.overall_avg_materials * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_MATERIALS' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS materials_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN overall_avg o ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department, show the department name, the average number of enrolled students in offered subjects, the variance of the number of enrolled students in offered subjects, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in offered subjects (considering only degree-granting departments and subjects with more than 0 enrolled students), and the maximum number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one enrolled student and have course materials with a material status of 'RQ'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_enrollment, icte.enrollment_variance, icte.enrollment_stddev, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled_with_rq_material FROM inner_cte icte JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_enrollment, icte.enrollment_variance, icte.enrollment_stddev ORDER BY icte.enrollment_variance DESC;

question: For subjects offered in the term with code '2025FA' by departments in the School of Engineering, show the subject ID, subject title, offering department name, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, term start date, term end date, term parameter, the minimum number of enrolled students over each offering department, total units, department full name, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title, and the responsible faculty name and MIT ID, ordered by offering department name and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.TERM_START_DATE, s.TERM_END_DATE, s.TERM_PARAMETER, s.min_enrolled_students_per_dept, c.TOTAL_UNITS, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID FROM inner_cte s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON s.SUBJECT_TITLE = c.SUBJECT_TITLE AND s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For rooms located on floor 2 with access level 1, show the building room, building component, floor, space usage, space unit code, access level, organization name, organization, department name, department code, and the minimum access level over each department code group, along with the department long name, department hierarchy level 3 name, the number of unique facility organization keys, the minimum organization unit ID, and the department hierarchy level 2 name for departments where the department hierarchy type is 'Standard Hierarchy' and the organization unit level is 'DEPARTMENTS'. Order the results by department code and department hierarchy level 3 name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.BUILDING_COMPONENT, t0.FLOOR, t0.SPACE_USAGE, t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ACCESS_LEVEL, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.ORGANIZATION, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, MIN(t0.ACCESS_LEVEL) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_access_level, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2 AND t0.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 ) , DeptHierarchyStats AS ( SELECT h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS min_org_unit_id FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m ON f.DLC_KEY = m.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY WHERE m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS' GROUP BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME ) SELECT i.BUILDING_ROOM, i.BUILDING_COMPONENT, i.FLOOR, i.SPACE_USAGE, i.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, i.ACCESS_LEVEL, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.ORGANIZATION, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.min_access_level, d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, d.org_count, d.min_org_unit_id FROM inner_cte i JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON i.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = h.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN DeptHierarchyStats d ON h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG = d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG ORDER BY i.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME;

question: For each department and academic year where the subject enrollment number is greater than 10, provide the department name, academic year, number of unique subjects, minimum total units offered, and for each graduate student in degree-granting departments in that department, show their full name, email address, department full name, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the student's full name. Additionally, for each such student, include the subject title and total units of any subject offered by their department in that academic year with enrollment greater than 10. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), GradStudentInfo AS ( SELECT t1.FULL_NAME, t1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.FULL_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' ) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dss.subject_count, dss.min_total_units, gsi.FULL_NAME, gsi.EMAIL_ADDRESS, gsi.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, gsi.window_column FROM DeptSubjectStats dss JOIN GradStudentInfo gsi ON dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = gsi.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.min_total_units, inner_cte.FULL_NAME, inner_cte.EMAIL_ADDRESS, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND t.ACADEMIC_YEAR = inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.FULL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For each department, either (a) list the department name, average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in offered subjects (for degree-granting departments and subjects with more than 0 enrolled students), or (b) for departments in the School of Engineering with more than 50 total enrolled students, show the department name, total number of students enrolled in courses offered by that department, and the number of unique subjects offered. For each row, include a reason for inclusion ('DegreeGrantingStats' for the first case and 'EngineeringTotals' for the second). Show the department name, average enrollment, enrollment variance, enrollment standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), total enrollment, unique subject count, and reason, in that order, sorted by department name and reason. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC ), EngineeringDeptTotals AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment, COUNT(DISTINCT t.SUBJECT_ID) AS unique_subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ), CombinedDeptStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_enrollment, d.enrollment_variance, d.enrollment_stddev, NULL AS total_enrollment, NULL AS unique_subject_count, 'DegreeGrantingStats' AS Reason FROM inner_cte d UNION ALL SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_enrollment, NULL AS enrollment_variance, NULL AS enrollment_stddev, e.total_enrollment, e.unique_subject_count, 'EngineeringTotals' AS Reason FROM EngineeringDeptTotals e ) SELECT * FROM CombinedDeptStats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Reason;

question: For each department name and school name where the department is degree granting, provide the number of unique courses, the minimum CIP program code from the course descriptions, the subject title from the summary, the dense rank of each subject considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the subject code from the course catalog, and the average number of enrolled students for each subject, but only for subjects offered in the term '2022FA' with a total of 12 units. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), SubjectWindowStats AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 GROUP BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT, t2.SUBJECT_CODE ) SELECT dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.SCHOOL_NAME, dcs.course_count, dcs.min_cip_code, sws.SUBJECT_TITLE, sws.window_column, sws.avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte dcs JOIN SubjectWindowStats sws ON dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sws.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sws.window_column;

question: For each space unit with a space unit key greater than 100000 and with rooms on floor 2, what is the name of the space unit, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the access levels of its associated rooms, the organization name, the HR department name, and the HR org unit title, as well as the sum of space unit keys within each warehouse load date group, ordered by access level variance and sum of space unit keys? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, VARIANCE(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_variance, STDDEV(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_stddev FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD zr ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = zr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE zr.FLOOR = 2 GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ORDER BY access_level_variance DESC ) SELECT icte.SPACE_UNIT, icte.access_level_variance, icte.access_level_stddev, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fo.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, su_sum.window_column FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON icte.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY JOIN ( SELECT t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, SUM(t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE ORDER BY t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM SPACE_UNIT t0 WHERE t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000 ) su_sum ON icte.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = su_sum.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ORDER BY icte.access_level_variance DESC, su_sum.window_column DESC;

question: For each department, list the department name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022FA term, as well as the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in courses from that department that have at least one associated TIP material and where the total units for the course are greater than 0. Additionally, for each department, show the maximum number of enrolled students in any course from that department in the 2022FA term. Show the department name, average total units, total units range, total units variance, average enrollment, enrollment variance, and maximum enrollment, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptUnits AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sos.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ), DeptEnrollment AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.RECORD_COUNT >= 1 AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC ) SELECT du.DEPARTMENT_NAME, du.avg_total_units, du.total_units_range, du.total_units_variance, de.avg_enrollment, de.enrollment_variance FROM DeptUnits du JOIN DeptEnrollment de ON du.DEPARTMENT_NAME = de.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY du.total_units_range DESC, de.enrollment_variance DESC ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_range, icte.total_units_variance, icte.avg_enrollment, icte.enrollment_variance, MAX(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sos.COURSE_NUMBER = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_range, icte.total_units_variance, icte.avg_enrollment, icte.enrollment_variance ORDER BY icte.total_units_range DESC, icte.enrollment_variance DESC, max_enrollment DESC;

question: For each building, what is the building name, the average, range, and variance of the room areas for rooms in that building where the building type is 'ACADEMIC' and the room area is greater than 40, and for each such room with an access level of 1, what are the building room, building component, floor, space usage, space unit code, the corresponding organization's name, the average floor within each space usage group ordered by floor, and the department name of the organization? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_room_area, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS room_area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS room_area_variance FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND r.AREA > 40 GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY room_area_range DESC ) SELECT icte.BUILDING_NAME, icte.avg_room_area, icte.room_area_range, icte.room_area_variance, rai.BUILDING_ROOM, rai.BUILDING_COMPONENT, rai.FLOOR, rai.SPACE_USAGE, rai.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, rai.ORGANIZATION_NAME, rai.window_column, fo.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte icte JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b ON icte.BUILDING_NAME = b.BUILDING_NAME JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD zrl ON r.BUILDING_ROOM = zrl.BUILDING_ROOM AND zrl.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON zrl.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = fo.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.BUILDING_COMPONENT, t1.FLOOR, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(t1.FLOOR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SPACE_USAGE ORDER BY t1.FLOOR) AS window_column, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 ) rai ON r.BUILDING_ROOM = rai.BUILDING_ROOM AND zrl.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = rai.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID

question: For each department that is degree-granting and offered at least one subject in the School of Engineering in 2021, and where at least 60% of the active graduate students with an office location assigned in that department are from the Electrical Engineering & Computer Science department (department code 6), provide the department code, department name, department full name, the number of subjects offered, the total number of enrolled students in those subjects, the total number of active graduate students with an office location assigned, and the number of those who are from Electrical Engineering & Computer Science. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ), DeptActiveGradStudents AS ( SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS total_active_grad_students FROM SE_PERSON s JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY m ON s.FULL_NAME = m.FULL_NAME WHERE s.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND m.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND m.OFFICE_LOCATION IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.DEPARTMENT HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ), EECSGradStudents AS ( SELECT m.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS eecs_grad_students FROM SE_PERSON s JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY m ON s.FULL_NAME = m.FULL_NAME WHERE s.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND m.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND m.OFFICE_LOCATION IS NOT NULL AND m.DEPARTMENT = 6 GROUP BY m.DEPARTMENT ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, icte.subject_count, icte.total_enrollment, dag.total_active_grad_students, COALESCE(eecs.eecs_grad_students, 0) AS eecs_grad_students FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN DeptActiveGradStudents dag ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dag.DEPARTMENT LEFT JOIN EECSGradStudents eecs ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = eecs.DEPARTMENT WHERE dag.total_active_grad_students IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(eecs.eecs_grad_students, 0) >= 0.6 * dag.total_active_grad_students ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department, provide the department's name, the range and variance of the access levels of rooms assigned to it, the average number of supervisees, the range of the number of supervisees, and the variance of the number of supervisees for all space units associated with that department. Additionally, for each department, include the total square footage and the average research volume for all supervisees in that department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT dal.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dal.access_level_range, dal.access_level_variance, ds.avg_supervisees, ds.supervisee_range, ds.supervisee_variance FROM ( SELECT HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.ACCESS_LEVEL) - MIN(ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_range, VARIANCE(ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_variance FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.ACCESS_LEVEL IS NOT NULL GROUP BY HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY access_level_range DESC ) dal JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON dal.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = fo.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY JOIN ( SELECT SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT AS department_name, AVG(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS avg_supervisees, MAX(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) - MIN(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS supervisee_range, VARIANCE(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS supervisee_variance FROM SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE JOIN SPACE_UNIT ON SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.DEPT_NAMES = SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY GROUP BY SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT ORDER BY supervisee_range DESC ) ds ON su.SPACE_UNIT = ds.department_name ORDER BY dal.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.access_level_range, ic.access_level_variance, ic.avg_supervisees, ic.supervisee_range, ic.supervisee_variance, SUM(ssu.SQFT) AS total_sqft, AVG(ssu.RESEARCH_VOLUME) AS avg_research_volume FROM inner_cte ic JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON ic.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = fo.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ssu ON su.DLC_KEY = ssu.DEPT_NAMES GROUP BY ic.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.access_level_range, ic.access_level_variance, ic.avg_supervisees, ic.supervisee_range, ic.supervisee_variance ORDER BY ic.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each tip detail where the material status key is 'EO', show the subject offered key, material key, material status key, term code, subject ID, term description, academic year, term parameter, and the row number within each academic year group ordered by subject offered key, along with the deviation of the number of materials for that subject from the average number of materials per subject for the corresponding term parameter (for terms that are not upcoming and have a non-null term start date). Present the results ordered by academic year and row number. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS window_column, t0.RECORD_COUNT FROM TIP_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'EO' ), avg_per_term_param AS ( SELECT atp.TERM_PARAMETER, AVG(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_materials_per_subject FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON td.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp ON ata.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.TERM_PARAMETER <> 'SIS_UPCOMING_TERM' AND ata.TERM_START_DATE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY atp.TERM_PARAMETER ) SELECT inner_cte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.TERM_PARAMETER, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.RECORD_COUNT, avg_per_term_param.avg_materials_per_subject, (inner_cte.RECORD_COUNT - avg_per_term_param.avg_materials_per_subject) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN avg_per_term_param ON inner_cte.TERM_PARAMETER = avg_per_term_param.TERM_PARAMETER ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.window_column;

question: Show the department names, the corresponding SIS subject code, subject code descriptions, graduate level, the total number of courses per department, and the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in offered subjects for degree-granting departments and subjects with more than 0 enrolled students. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, Total_Courses.Total_Courses, inner_cte.avg_enrollment, inner_cte.enrollment_variance, inner_cte.enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_NUMBER) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS Total_Courses ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN inner_cte ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each subject offered in the term with the description "Fall Term 2024-2025" and whose offering department is among the top 10 departments by the number of unique subjects offered in academic years 2014 or later, show the subject offered key, subject title, offering department name, the term description, the rank of each subject within its offering department ordered by subject offered key, the count of unique subject titles offered by the department, and the total number of enrolled students for each subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH subject_ranks AS ( SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' ), top_departments AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2014 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT sr.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, sr.SUBJECT_TITLE, sr.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sr.TERM_DESCRIPTION, sr.window_column, td.subject_count FROM subject_ranks sr JOIN top_departments td ON sr.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = td.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT ic.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.window_column, ic.subject_count, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte ic JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON ic.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ORDER BY ic.subject_count DESC, ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year, the academic year description, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the record counts of TIP materials associated with that academic year (considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the TIP material status key is not 'NM'), the variance of the maximum enrollment for IAP activities that are not cancelled and require advance sign-up, and the deviation of the maximum enrollment for each IAP activity from the average maximum enrollment for its academic year? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH TipMaterialStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), IapActivityStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR, tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, tms.record_count_variance, tms.record_count_stddev, ias.max_enrollment_variance FROM TipMaterialStats tms JOIN IapActivityStats ias ON tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ias.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND tms.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = ias.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) , IapMaxEnrollmentDeviation AS ( SELECT IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.MAX_ENROLLMENT, AVG(IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.MAX_ENROLLMENT) OVER (PARTITION BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS avg_max_enrollment_per_year FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' ) SELECT icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, icte.record_count_variance, icte.record_count_stddev, icte.max_enrollment_variance, imed.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY, imed.MAX_ENROLLMENT, (imed.MAX_ENROLLMENT - imed.avg_max_enrollment_per_year) AS deviation_from_avg_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte icte JOIN IapMaxEnrollmentDeviation imed ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = imed.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = imed.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, imed.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY;

question: For the top 10 subject titles by the number of reserve materials assigned, list the subject title, department name, term code, number of reserve materials, the term description, the academic year, the running sum of academic years within each financial aid year group for academic terms where the term status is 'Previous', as well as the school name and the number of enrolled students for each subject. Order the results by number of reserve materials and academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_reserve_materials FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE ORDER BY num_reserve_materials DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.TERM_CODE, icte.num_reserve_materials, pt.TERM_DESCRIPTION, pt.ACADEMIC_YEAR, pt.window_column, lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte icte JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON icte.SUBJECT_TITLE = lso.SUBJECT_TITLE AND icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND icte.TERM_CODE = lso.TERM_CODE JOIN ( SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ) pt ON icte.TERM_CODE = pt.TERM_CODE ORDER BY icte.num_reserve_materials DESC, pt.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For all subjects in the 2014FA term with at least one enrolled student, show the subject title, offering department name, responsible faculty name, the TIP material status key, the total number of units, the minimum total number of units in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the course number, the dense rank of each subject (if any) among subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the total number of units, and whether the subject is a 'HIGH_UNIT' (at least 10% greater than the average total units for its department), 'LOW_UNIT' (at least 10% less than the average), or 'AVERAGE'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, lso.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), subq2 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t2.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t2.SUBJECT_ID FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY WHERE TERM_CODE = '2014FA' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, icte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, icte.TOTAL_UNITS, icte.window_column AS min_total_units_window, s2.window_column AS dense_rank_total_units_engineering, d.avg_units AS dept_avg_units, CASE WHEN icte.TOTAL_UNITS > d.avg_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN icte.TOTAL_UNITS < d.avg_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN subq2 s2 ON icte.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID JOIN dept_avg d ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME

question: For rooms with an area greater than 300 that are associated with departments in the "Provost Area", show the building-room identifier, floor number, major use description, organization name, DLC key, the average area in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by department code and ordered by area, the department code, department name, school area name, the rank of each department within its school area based on department code, and the department's long name and top-level organization name. Present the results ordered by building-room identifier and department code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH RoomStats AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.MAJOR_USE_DESC, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, t1.DEPT_CODE, AVG(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t1.AREA ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_avg_area FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 300 ), ProvostDepts AS ( SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, t1.DLC_KEY, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t1.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 INNER JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' ) SELECT rs.BUILDING_ROOM, rs.FLOOR, rs.MAJOR_USE_DESC, rs.ORGANIZATION_NAME, rs.DLC_KEY, rs.window_avg_area, pd.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, pd.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, pd.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, pd.window_column, pd.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, pd.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME FROM RoomStats rs JOIN ProvostDepts pd ON rs.DLC_KEY = pd.DLC_KEY ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte ORDER BY BUILDING_ROOM, HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: For each offering department and school where the course material status is 'RQ', and where the department offers at least 5 unique subjects with at least one associated TIP material and total units greater than 0, provide the offering department name, offering school name, average and variance of the number of enrolled students in those courses, the number of unique subjects, and the minimum total units for those subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.RECORD_COUNT >= 1 AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC ), DeptSchoolSubjectStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT dss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dss.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_variance, dss.subject_count, dss.min_total_units FROM DeptSchoolSubjectStats dss LEFT JOIN DeptEnrollmentStats des ON dss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY dss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dss.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ic.avg_enrollment, ic.enrollment_variance, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units FROM inner_cte ic WHERE ic.subject_count >= 5 ORDER BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME;

question: For each department that offers at least one subject in the academic term with term code '2006FA', show the department name and the total number of subjects offered by that department in that term, but only include departments where the total number of subjects offered is greater than the average number of subjects offered per department in that term. Also, for each such department, show the maximum subject enrollment number and the term start date for the corresponding department in the current academic term (if the department's maximum subject enrollment number is greater than 5). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA' GROUP BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), Sub2 AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_enrollment, at.TERM_START_DATE FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 5 ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.subject_count, s2.max_enrollment, s2.TERM_START_DATE FROM inner_cte i LEFT JOIN Sub2 s2 ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE i.subject_count > ( SELECT AVG(dept_subject_count) FROM ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS dept_subject_count FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA' GROUP BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) sub ) ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each department, provide the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units), and for students in the "Electrical Eng & Computer Sci" department, show their full name, email address, course description, course level, and the row number within each course level group ordered by the student's last name. Additionally, include the school name for each department and the student year for each student. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DepartmentUnitsStats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ), EECSStudentCourses AS ( SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.COURSE_LEVEL ORDER BY t2.LAST_NAME) AS window_column, t2.STUDENT_YEAR FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_total_units, d.stddev_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME, e.FULL_NAME, e.EMAIL_ADDRESS, e.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, e.COURSE_LEVEL, e.window_column, e.STUDENT_YEAR FROM DepartmentUnitsStats d JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT s ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN EECSStudentCourses e ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = e.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.COURSE_LEVEL, e.window_column ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte;

question: From the top 10 space units with the highest geometric mean of supervisees (considering only departments where the number of supervisees is greater than zero), display each space unit's key, organization name, DLC name, DLC key from FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY, the rank of each record within each DLC key group ordered by space unit key, and the geometric mean of supervisees for the organization. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH org_geom_mean_supervisees AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES))) AS geometric_mean_supervisees FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN SPACE_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ON SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY = SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.DEPT_NAMES WHERE SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES > 0 GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_supervisees DESC ), space_unit_info AS ( SELECT t2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.DLC_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DLC_KEY ORDER BY t2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column, o.geometric_mean_supervisees FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY LEFT JOIN org_geom_mean_supervisees o ON t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME = o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, s.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s.DLC_NAME, s.DLC_KEY, s.window_column, s.geometric_mean_supervisees FROM space_unit_info s ) SELECT SPACE_UNIT_KEY, ORGANIZATION_NAME, DLC_NAME, DLC_KEY, window_column, geometric_mean_supervisees FROM inner_cte ORDER BY geometric_mean_supervisees DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each department and academic year where the number of enrolled students in the library subject offered is greater than 3, list the department name, academic year, number of unique subjects offered, and the minimum start date of the term, along with the reason for inclusion ('Subjects' for these rows). Additionally, for each department, provide the department name and the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of course materials per subject offered by that department in the term 2017SP, along with the reason for inclusion ('Materials' for these rows). Finally, for each department, show the department name and the average number of enrolled students per subject in the term 2017SP, along with the reason for inclusion ('Enrollment' for these rows). The columns should be: department name, academic year, subject count, minimum term start date, material count range, material count variance, material count standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), average enrolled students, and reason, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT so.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(at.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON at.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), DeptMaterialStats AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(material_count) - MIN(material_count) AS material_count_range, VARIANCE(material_count) AS material_count_variance, STDDEV(material_count) AS material_count_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ( SELECT TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM TIP_DETAIL WHERE TERM_CODE = '2017SP' GROUP BY TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ) AS detail_stats ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = detail_stats.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = '2017SP' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), DeptEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2017SP' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), CombinedDeptStats AS ( SELECT d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, d.ACADEMIC_YEAR, d.subject_count, d.min_term_start_date, NULL AS material_count_range, NULL AS material_count_variance, NULL AS material_count_stddev, NULL AS avg_enrolled_students, 'Subjects' AS Reason FROM inner_cte d UNION ALL SELECT m.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS subject_count, NULL AS min_term_start_date, m.material_count_range, m.material_count_variance, m.material_count_stddev, NULL AS avg_enrolled_students, 'Materials' AS Reason FROM DeptMaterialStats m UNION ALL SELECT e.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS subject_count, NULL AS min_term_start_date, NULL AS material_count_range, NULL AS material_count_variance, NULL AS material_count_stddev, e.avg_enrolled_students, 'Enrollment' AS Reason FROM DeptEnrollmentStats e ) SELECT * FROM CombinedDeptStats ORDER BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, Reason;

question: Show the organization names, their corresponding HR department names, the total number of rooms assigned to each organization, and the average area of those rooms, for each department-level organization whose DLC key is not null, which has rooms with area greater than 0, and which also has organization level 5. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS total_rooms, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_area FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON o.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY WHERE d.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND r.AREA > 0 AND o.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_rooms, inner_cte.avg_area FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.total_rooms DESC;

question: From the top 10 subject codes with the highest number of associated departments (where the department is degree granting), display each subject code, its description, the total number of associated departments, the school name, the department most frequently associated with the subject code, and the minimum department budget code for that department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), SubjectDeptCounts AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS dept_count, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SCHOOL_NAME ), DeptFrequency AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS dept_freq, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptRanked AS ( SELECT df.SUBJECT_CODE, df.DEPARTMENT_NAME, df.dept_freq, df.min_dept_budget_code, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY df.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY df.dept_freq DESC) AS dept_rank FROM DeptFrequency df ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, sdc.dept_count AS total_departments, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, dr.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS most_frequent_department, dr.min_dept_budget_code FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SubjectDeptCounts sdc ON ic.SUBJECT_CODE = sdc.SUBJECT_CODE AND ic.SCHOOL_NAME = sdc.SCHOOL_NAME LEFT JOIN DeptRanked dr ON ic.SUBJECT_CODE = dr.SUBJECT_CODE AND dr.dept_rank = 1 ORDER BY sdc.dept_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each academic year, list the academic year, academic year description, the total number of subjects offered in all terms of that year, the total subject enrollment for that year, and the average, range, and variance of the record counts for TIP materials in that academic year (considering only terms where the term status is not null and the TIP material status is not 'NM'). The columns should be: academic year, academic year description, subject count, total enrollment, average record count, record count range, and record count variance. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), AcademicYearTipStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_record_count, MAX(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) - MIN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_range, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS IS NOT NULL AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.subject_count, ic.total_enrollment, ayts.avg_record_count, ayts.record_count_range, ayts.record_count_variance FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN AcademicYearTipStats ayts ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ayts.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each department and cluster type where the total units for the subject are greater than 6, show the department name, cluster type, the number of subjects, the minimum number of enrolled students, the average total units for subjects offered in the 2012SU term in that department, the variance of total units for those subjects, and the average number of enrolled students for those subjects, ordering the results by the number of subjects in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sos.CLUSTER_TYPE, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON so.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY = sos.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sos.CLUSTER_TYPE ) SELECT icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.CLUSTER_TYPE, icte.subject_count, icte.min_enrolled_students, dus.avg_units, dus.units_variance, dus.avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance, AVG(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) dus ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.subject_count DESC;

question: For each department that is degree-granting and offered at least one subject in the School of Engineering in 2021, provide the department code, department name, department full name, the number of subjects offered, the total number of enrolled students in those subjects, the average number of unique subject codes associated with its courses that are offered by degree-granting departments, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of unique subject codes associated with its courses that are offered by degree-granting departments, and whether the department's total enrollment is at least 20% higher than the average total enrollment across all such departments ('HIGH_ENROLLMENT'), at least 20% lower ('LOW_ENROLLMENT'), or otherwise 'AVERAGE_ENROLLMENT'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ), DeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes FROM ( SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT ) course_subjects JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON course_subjects.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), EnrollmentBenchmarks AS ( SELECT AVG(total_enrollment) AS avg_total_enrollment FROM inner_cte ) SELECT de.DEPARTMENT_CODE, de.DEPARTMENT_NAME, de.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, de.subject_count, de.total_enrollment, ds.avg_subject_codes, ds.stddev_subject_codes, CASE WHEN de.total_enrollment > eb.avg_total_enrollment * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN de.total_enrollment < eb.avg_total_enrollment * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE_ENROLLMENT' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte de JOIN DeptSubjectStats ds ON de.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME CROSS JOIN EnrollmentBenchmarks eb ORDER BY de.subject_count DESC;

question: For each department, list the department's name, the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2022 and that are also listed in the CIS course catalog, as well as the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for all courses offered by that department. Additionally, for each department, show the number of subjects offered in 2022 that are also in the CIS course catalog, and the average total units for those subjects. Show the results ordered by the range of total units for subjects in 2022 in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), dept_course_stats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subject_counts AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS subject_count, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_subject_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.units_range, inner_cte.units_variance, dept_course_stats.total_units_range, dept_course_stats.total_units_variance, dept_course_stats.total_units_stddev, subject_counts.subject_count, subject_counts.avg_subject_units FROM inner_cte JOIN dept_course_stats ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_course_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN subject_counts ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subject_counts.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.units_range DESC;

question: For each department, provide the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of unique subject codes associated with its courses that are offered by degree-granting departments, the variance of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one enrolled student and have course materials with a material status of 'RQ', and the total number of such courses. List the department name, average subject codes, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subject codes, enrolled variance, and total course count in that order, but only include departments where the total course count is greater than 5. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DepartmentSubjectStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM ( SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT ) course_subjects JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON course_subjects.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY stddev_subject_codes DESC ), DepartmentEnrolledVariance AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS total_course_count FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC ) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.avg_subject_codes, dss.stddev_subject_codes, dev.enrolled_variance, dev.total_course_count FROM DepartmentSubjectStats dss JOIN DepartmentEnrolledVariance dev ON dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dev.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_subject_codes, stddev_subject_codes, enrolled_variance, total_course_count FROM inner_cte WHERE total_course_count > 5;

question: Show the department names, academic years, number of unique subjects, minimum total units offered, variance of the number of enrolled students in courses with at least one enrolled student and course materials with a material status of 'RQ', and the total number of courses per department and academic year, for each department and academic year where the subject enrollment number is greater than 10. List the results in order of descending subject count, then by descending enrolled variance. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), subq2 AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.subject_count, s1.min_total_units, s2.enrolled_variance FROM subq1 s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.subject_count, icte.min_total_units, icte.enrolled_variance, tc.Total_Courses FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS Total_Courses FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) tc ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = tc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = tc.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY icte.subject_count DESC, icte.enrolled_variance DESC;

question: For subjects offered in the term '2016SP' with a total of 12 units, show the subject title from the offered summary, the department name from the department table, the subject description from the course catalog, the school name from the department table, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the subject title from the offered summary. For each such subject, also show the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses from the same department that have at least one associated course material, as well as the department phone number from the SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT table. List the subject title, department name, subject description, school name, window column, average enrollment, enrollment standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and department phone number in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), Sub2 AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.avg_enrollment, s2.enrollment_stddev, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte s1 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN Sub2 s2 ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each academic year where the total number of materials recorded in TIP_DETAIL is greater than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean total number of materials per academic year, show the academic year, academic year description, the average record count for TIP materials in that year (considering only terms where the term status is not null and the TIP material status is not 'NM'), the range of record counts, the variance of record counts, the total number of materials recorded in TIP_DETAIL for that academic year, and the number of unique subjects that had TIP materials in that year. List the results in descending order of the total number of materials. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH YearlyTipStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_record_count, MAX(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) - MIN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_range, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS IS NOT NULL AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), YearlyTotalMaterials AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) > ( SELECT AVG(total_count) + STDDEV(total_count) FROM ( SELECT SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_count FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) sub ) ) SELECT yts.ACADEMIC_YEAR, yts.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, yts.avg_record_count, yts.record_count_range, yts.record_count_variance, ytm.total_materials FROM YearlyTipStats yts JOIN YearlyTotalMaterials ytm ON yts.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ytm.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.avg_record_count, inner_cte.record_count_range, inner_cte.record_count_variance, inner_cte.total_materials, COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID) AS unique_subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.avg_record_count, inner_cte.record_count_range, inner_cte.record_count_variance, inner_cte.total_materials ORDER BY inner_cte.total_materials DESC;
