question: For subjects offered in the term with code '2025FA' and offered by departments in the School of Engineering, show the subject ID, subject title, offering department name, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, term start date, term end date, term parameter, the minimum number of enrolled students over each offering department, total units, department full name, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title, and the responsible faculty name and their MIT ID, ordered by offering department name and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.TERM_START_DATE, s.TERM_END_DATE, s.TERM_PARAMETER, s.min_enrolled_students_per_dept, c.TOTAL_UNITS, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID FROM inner_cte s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND s.SUBJECT_TITLE = c.SUBJECT_TITLE WHERE d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ORDER BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For subjects offered in the term '2022FA' with a total of 12 units, show the subject title from the summary, the department name from the course description, the dense rank of each subject considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the subject code from the course catalog, and for each department, provide the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for courses offered by that department. Additionally, for each subject, include the subject description from the course catalog and the full department name from the department table. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.window_column, s2.total_units_range, s2.total_units_variance, s2.total_units_stddev, icte.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) s2 ON icte.DEPARTMENT = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON icte.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE

question: For the 5 departments that offer the largest number of unique subjects, display for each department its department code, department name, and the total number of unique subjects it offers, and for each subject offered by these departments in the term with code '2025FA', show the subject ID, subject title, offering department name, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, term start date, term end date, term parameter, the minimum number of enrolled students over each offering department, and the subject's short title and total units from the course catalog, ordered by the total number of unique subjects, offering department name, and subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT dsc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dsc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dsc.num_subjects, s2025fa.SUBJECT_ID, s2025fa.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2025fa.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2025fa.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2025fa.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2025fa.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2025fa.TERM_START_DATE, s2025fa.TERM_END_DATE, s2025fa.TERM_PARAMETER, s2025fa.min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY num_subjects DESC LIMIT 5 ) dsc JOIN ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ) s2025fa ON dsc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2025fa.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.num_subjects, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.TERM_END_DATE, inner_cte.TERM_PARAMETER, inner_cte.min_enrolled_students_per_dept, ccso.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID AND ccso.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ORDER BY inner_cte.num_subjects DESC, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each department name and school name, where the department is degree granting and the department has more than 10 total enrolled students in courses offered by both the library and the TIP system in the term '2019FA', and where at least 60% of the enrolled students in these courses are from the School of Engineering, provide the department name, school name, number of unique courses, minimum CIP program code from the course descriptions, total number of enrolled students, and the number of enrolled students from the School of Engineering. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DegreeGrantingDeptCourses AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ), DeptEnrolledStudents AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10 ), CombinedDeptInfo AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.course_count, d.min_cip_code, s.total_enrolled FROM DegreeGrantingDeptCourses d JOIN DeptEnrolledStudents s ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT * FROM CombinedDeptInfo ), EngineeringEnrolled AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS engineering_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.course_count, i.min_cip_code, i.total_enrolled, COALESCE(e.engineering_enrolled, 0) AS engineering_enrolled FROM inner_cte i LEFT JOIN EngineeringEnrolled e ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = e.OFFER_DEPT_NAME WHERE COALESCE(e.engineering_enrolled, 0) > 0.6 * i.total_enrolled ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME;

question: For each subject offered in the library in the Mathematics department during regular terms, where the range of CIP program codes for all undergraduate courses in the department is greater than 1000, show the subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, term description, academic year, subject short title, the maximum total units for each row and the next two rows in order of subject ID, the average CIP program code, the range of CIP program codes, the variance of CIP program codes, and the full department name, with the results ordered by subject title and then by CIP code range descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, MAX(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS DEPT_NAME_JOIN FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ), DepartmentCIPStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, AVG(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_code, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, icte.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, dcs.avg_cip_code, dcs.cip_code_range, dcs.cip_code_variance, dcs.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte icte JOIN DepartmentCIPStats dcs ON icte.DEPT_NAME_JOIN = dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE dcs.cip_code_range > 1000 ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, dcs.cip_code_range DESC;

question: For each department where the total number of subject enrollments for subjects offered in the current term is greater than 10, and for each course number in that department where the number of enrolled students in the subject summary is greater than 2, provide the department name, the total number of subject enrollments, the course number, the number of unique library subjects offered, the minimum total units for those subjects, and the average number of enrolled students for those subjects. List the department name, total number of subject enrollments, course number, number of unique library subjects offered, minimum total units, and average number of enrolled students in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT de.DEPARTMENT_NAME, de.total_enrollments, dcls.COURSE_NUMBER, dcls.subject_count, dcls.min_total_units FROM (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollments FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER p JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON p.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 10 ) de JOIN (SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER ) dcls ON de.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dcls.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_enrollments, inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.min_total_units, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_num_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_enrollments, inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.min_total_units ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER;

question: For each academic year and department where the number of enrolled students in a subject is greater than 5 and the academic year has terms that are current or previous terms, show the department name, subject ID, subject title, the number of enrolled students for each subject, and the variance of the record count of tip details for those terms. List the results ordered by academic year, department name, and subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.SUBJECT_ID, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.record_count_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON c.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID JOIN inner_cte ON c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 ORDER BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.SUBJECT_ID

question: For each department, what are the department name, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects that had library reserve materials in terms with a term status of 'Previous', and the total number of enrolled students in courses that are offered by both the library and the TIP system in the term '2019FA', where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 10, and where at least 60% of the subjects in the department with library reserve materials in 'Previous' terms are also offered by the library in the term '2019FA'? List the results ordered by the variance of total units in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), dept_enrollment AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10 ), dept_subject_counts AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT lrm.SUBJECT_ID) AS prev_term_subjects FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), dept_subjects_in_2019FA AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT lrm.SUBJECT_ID) AS subjects_in_2019FA FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON lrm.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON lrm.SUBJECT_ID = lso.SUBJECT_ID AND lso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_variance, icte.total_units_stddev, de.total_enrolled FROM inner_cte icte JOIN dept_enrollment de ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = de.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN dept_subject_counts dsc ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsc.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN dept_subjects_in_2019FA dsf ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsf.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE dsf.subjects_in_2019FA >= 0.6 * dsc.prev_term_subjects ORDER BY icte.total_units_variance DESC

question: Show the department names, the corresponding SIS subject code, subject code descriptions, graduate level, the total number of courses per department, and for each department, the number of subjects offered in the 2019FA term that are also offered by departments in the School of Engineering with a total of at least 6 units. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, Total_Courses.Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_NUMBER) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS Total_Courses ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, icte.GRADUATE_LEVEL, icte.Total_Courses, COALESCE(eng_subj.Eng_2019FA_Subjects, 0) AS Eng_2019FA_Subjects FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS Eng_2019FA_Subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID AND t0.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 GROUP BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) eng_subj ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = eng_subj.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: For each department name and school name where the department is degree granting and the total number of enrolled students in courses offered by both the library and the TIP system in the term '2019FA' is greater than 10, provide the number of unique courses, the minimum CIP program code from the course descriptions, the total number of enrolled students, and the department phone number. The columns should be department name, school name, number of unique courses, minimum CIP program code, total number of enrolled students, and department phone number, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH dept_course_stats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ), dept_enrollment_stats AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10 ) SELECT dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.SCHOOL_NAME, dcs.course_count, dcs.min_cip_code, des.total_enrolled FROM dept_course_stats dcs JOIN dept_enrollment_stats des ON dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.course_count, inner_cte.min_cip_code, inner_cte.total_enrolled, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: For all pairs of subjects where one is offered in the term '2019FA' with more than 0 enrolled students and the other is in the term '2009SP', show the 2019FA subject title, offer department name, department full name, number of enrolled students, and the average number of enrolled students in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the school code, along with the 2009SP subject title, department name, total units, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title. Additionally, for each pair, include the school name for the 2019FA subject and the academic year description for the 2009SP term. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.SCHOOL_NAME FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), subq2 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t1.TERM_CODE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_title_2019fa, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.window_column AS avg_enrolled_window, s1.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name_2019fa, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_title_2009sp, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.TOTAL_UNITS, s2.window_column AS row_number_window, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AS academic_year_desc_2009sp FROM subq1 s1 CROSS JOIN subq2 s2 ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte;

question: From the top 10 buildings with the highest average total units for subjects scheduled in their rooms during the fall term, display each building key, its average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, the subject code most frequently scheduled in that building during the fall term, and the count of times that subject code is scheduled there. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY avg_total_units DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ic.avg_total_units, ic.stddev_total_units, bsc.SUBJECT_CODE AS Most_Frequent_Subject_Code, bsc.Subject_Count FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, cso.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rnk FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = cso.MEET_PLACE WHERE cso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, cso.SUBJECT_CODE ) bsc ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = bsc.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND bsc.rnk = 1 ORDER BY ic.avg_total_units DESC;

question: Among all subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units, which are also available in the library by the Mathematics department during regular terms, show for each subject: the subject code, subject number, subject title, department name, term description, the rank of each subject within its department ordered by subject code, the number of enrolled students, offering department name, academic year, subject short title, the maximum total units for each row and the next two rows in order of subject ID, and the department with the highest number of enrolled students for that subject along with the corresponding student count. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH Subjects2024_12Units AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), MathLibrarySubjects AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, MAX(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_total_units, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.window_column, m.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, m.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, m.ACADEMIC_YEAR, m.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, m.max_total_units, s.SUBJECT_ID FROM Subjects2024_12Units s JOIN MathLibrarySubjects m ON s.SUBJECT_ID = m.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.window_column, ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, ic.max_total_units, d.Most_Prominent_Department, d.Student_Count FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ss.SUBJECT_ID, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Most_Prominent_Department, ss.Student_Count FROM ( SELECT t.SUBJECT_ID, t.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Student_Count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS dept_rank FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY t GROUP BY t.SUBJECT_ID, t.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) ss WHERE ss.dept_rank = 1 ) d ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = d.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC;

question: For each subject code where the department is degree granting, show the subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, the rank of the subject code within each school name group ordered by subject code, the number of subject codes for each department and subject code, the minimum department budget code, and the maximum department last activity date for each department and subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), DepartmentSubjectStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code, MAX(d.DEPARTMENT_LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE) AS max_dept_last_activity_date FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.window_column, dss.subject_code_count, dss.min_dept_budget_code, dss.max_dept_last_activity_date FROM inner_cte icte JOIN DepartmentSubjectStats dss ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.SUBJECT_CODE = dss.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.window_column;

question: For each department and course level, provide the department name, course level, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department and course level (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units). For students in the "Electrical Eng & Computer Sci" department, show their full name, email address, department name, course description, course level, and row number within each course level group ordered by the student's last name. Present all these columns in the following order: department name, course level, average total units, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, full name, email address, course description, and row number. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL ORDER BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(DEPARTMENT_NAME) OVER (ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_LEVEL) = DEPARTMENT_NAME THEN NULL ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS department_name, COURSE_LEVEL, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units, NULL AS FULL_NAME, NULL AS EMAIL_ADDRESS, NULL AS COURSE_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS window_column FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, NULL AS avg_total_units, NULL AS stddev_total_units, t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.COURSE_LEVEL ORDER BY t2.LAST_NAME) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ORDER BY department_name, COURSE_LEVEL, FULL_NAME

question: For each department in the "Provost Area", grouped by department hierarchy level 2 name, and for each associated organization, list the department hierarchy level 2 name, department code, department name, number of organizational units, minimum department ID, organization name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the room areas for rooms associated with that organization and having a non-null area, and also include the total number of rooms and the average room area for each organization. Order the results by department name and then by area range descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH OrgRoomStats AS ( SELECT r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY o JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY area_range DESC ), ProvostDeptStats AS ( SELECT h.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(o.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS org_unit_count, MIN(o.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS min_department_id, h.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY h JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT o ON h.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE h.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY h.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, h.DLC_KEY ) SELECT p.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, p.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, p.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, p.org_unit_count, p.min_department_id, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.area_range, o.area_variance, o.area_stddev, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM ProvostDeptStats p JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f ON p.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY JOIN OrgRoomStats o ON f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) SELECT i.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.org_unit_count, i.min_department_id, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.area_range, i.area_variance, i.area_stddev, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS total_rooms, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_room_area FROM inner_cte i JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY AND r.AREA IS NOT NULL GROUP BY i.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.org_unit_count, i.min_department_id, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.area_range, i.area_variance, i.area_stddev ORDER BY i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.area_range DESC;

question: For each organization and department in the Provost Area with organization level equal to 5 and assignable equal to 1, list the organization name, organization key, department name, department code, the average organization key within each organization key group ordered by department code, the department's long name, the corresponding hierarchy level 3 name from the master department hierarchy, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the department name, but only include those departments where the average organization key is greater than the overall average organization key for all such departments. Order the results by department code and department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH OrgStats AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1 ), DeptStats AS ( SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t1.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL ) SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, o.window_column AS org_window_avg_key, d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, d.window_column AS dept_row_number FROM OrgStats o JOIN DeptStats d ON o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte WHERE org_window_avg_key > (SELECT AVG(org_window_avg_key) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each academic year and department, show the academic year, department name, average of the total units for subjects offered in regular terms, variance of the total units for subjects offered in regular terms, the academic year description, the geometric mean of the record counts of required course materials (where the record count is greater than zero) for all subjects offered in that year, and the number of unique subjects offered in regular terms for each department and year. For each academic year, include a grand total for all departments in the format of (academic year, null, null, null, academic year description, geometric mean, total unique subjects). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), GeometricMeanMaterials AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), SubjectCounts AS ( SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS unique_subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT COALESCE(i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, g.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_total_units, i.var_total_units, g.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, g.geometric_mean_record_count, s.unique_subjects FROM inner_cte i JOIN GeometricMeanMaterials g ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN SubjectCounts s ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME UNION ALL SELECT g.ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_total_units, NULL AS var_total_units, g.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, g.geometric_mean_record_count, SUM(s.unique_subjects) AS total_unique_subjects FROM GeometricMeanMaterials g JOIN SubjectCounts s ON g.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s.ACADEMIC_YEAR GROUP BY g.ACADEMIC_YEAR, g.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, g.geometric_mean_record_count ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each assignable organization with a department code above 100000, show the organization key, organization name, department name, the number of HR org units, the total of their department IDs, and for each of their rooms in buildings starting with 'E' and with area greater than 50, show the building-room identifier, room key, area, department code, DLC key, and the minimum area value over each DLC key group. Additionally, for each such organization, show the number of unique major use descriptions among their rooms that meet the above criteria. Order the results by organization key and DLC key. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS hr_org_unit_count, SUM(h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS total_department_id FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION f JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID > 100000 GROUP BY f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ), RoomDLCStats AS ( SELECT t2.BUILDING_ROOM, t2.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, t2.AREA, t2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.DEPT_CODE, t1.DLC_KEY, MIN(t2.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DLC_KEY ORDER BY t1.DLC_KEY) AS window_column, t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t2.MAJOR_USE_DESC FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t1 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t2 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.BUILDING_ROOM LIKE 'E%' AND t2.AREA > 50 ), MajorUseCounts AS ( SELECT r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, COUNT(DISTINCT r.MAJOR_USE_DESC) AS unique_major_use_count FROM RoomDLCStats r GROUP BY r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) SELECT o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.hr_org_unit_count, o.total_department_id, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, r.AREA, r.DEPT_CODE, r.DLC_KEY, r.window_column, m.unique_major_use_count FROM inner_cte o JOIN RoomDLCStats r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN MajorUseCounts m ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = m.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, r.DLC_KEY;

question: For each IAP subject activity with a maximum enrollment of 30, and for each tip detail where the material status key is 'RQ', show the activity title, enrollment type, prerequisites, term code, IAP term description, term start date, term end date, the minimum term start date over each term code group, the tip subject offered key, tip material key, subject ID, tip term description, academic year, and the average record count in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by academic year. For each term code, include a grand total for all academic years in the format of (activity title, enrollment type, prerequisites, term code, IAP term description, term start date, term end date, IAP min term start date, tip subject offered key, tip material key, subject ID, tip term description, null, total avg record count). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH IAPActivities AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t0.PREREQUISITES, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, min(t1.TERM_START_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.TERM_CODE ORDER BY t0.TERM_CODE) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 30 ), TipRQDetails AS ( SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(t0.RECORD_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_START_DATE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM TIP_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ) SELECT ia.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ia.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, ia.PREREQUISITES, ia.TERM_CODE, ia.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS IAP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, ia.TERM_START_DATE, ia.TERM_END_DATE, ia.window_column AS IAP_MIN_TERM_START_DATE, trd.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, trd.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, trd.SUBJECT_ID, trd.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS TIP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, trd.ACADEMIC_YEAR, trd.window_column AS TIP_AVG_RECORD_COUNT FROM IAPActivities ia JOIN TipRQDetails trd ON ia.TERM_CODE = trd.TERM_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.PREREQUISITES, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.IAP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.TERM_END_DATE, inner_cte.IAP_MIN_TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.TIP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(inner_cte.TIP_AVG_RECORD_COUNT) AS TOTAL_AVG_RECORD_COUNT FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.PREREQUISITES, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.IAP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.TERM_END_DATE, inner_cte.IAP_MIN_TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.TIP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(inner_cte.TIP_AVG_RECORD_COUNT) > 0 ORDER BY inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR ;

question: From the top 10 offering departments in the term with code '2025FA' with the highest total number of enrolled students, display each department's name, total enrolled students, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only departments that grant degrees and subjects with more than 0 total units), and the subject with the highest enrollment in that department (including its subject ID, title, and number of enrolled students). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), dept_units_stats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), dept_enrollment AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE TERM_CODE = '2025FA' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), subject_max_enrollment AS ( SELECT t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC, t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS rn FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ) SELECT de.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, de.total_enrolled_students, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev, sme.SUBJECT_ID AS max_enrolled_subject_id, sme.SUBJECT_TITLE AS max_enrolled_subject_title, sme.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS max_enrolled_subject_num_students FROM dept_enrollment de JOIN dept_units_stats dus ON de.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = dus.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN subject_max_enrollment sme ON de.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sme.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND sme.rn = 1 ORDER BY de.total_enrolled_students DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each offering department and school where the course material status is 'RQ', provide the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in courses offered by that department (considering only courses that have at least one associated TIP material and where the total units for the course are greater than 0), along with the number of unique subjects and the minimum total units for those subjects, and also include the maximum number of enrolled students in any subject for that department and school. List the offering department name, offering school name, average enrollment, enrollment variance, subject count, minimum total units, and maximum enrolled students in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.RECORD_COUNT >= 1 AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC ), DeptSchoolSubjectStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT dss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dss.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_variance, dss.subject_count, dss.min_total_units FROM DeptSchoolSubjectStats dss LEFT JOIN DeptEnrollmentStats des ON dss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY dss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dss.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, icte.avg_enrollment, icte.enrollment_variance, icte.subject_count, icte.min_total_units, MAX(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte icte JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND icte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, icte.avg_enrollment, icte.enrollment_variance, icte.subject_count, icte.min_total_units ORDER BY icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME;

question: For each library reserve material detail with material status key 'U', show the reserve catalog key, subject offered key, term code, academic year, term description, tip material key, tip material status key, and the average record count in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the tip material status key and ordered by the academic year, along with the corresponding textbook material in the TIP_DETAIL table with material status key 'RQ' that matches on tip material key and academic year, showing the textbook subject offered key, textbook material key, subject ID, textbook academic year, textbook term description, and the row number within each textbook academic year group ordered by term code. Additionally, for each matching textbook material, include the term start date and term end date from the ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL table. Present the results in the order of reserve material academic year descending and textbook row number. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, t0.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, AVG(t2.RECORD_COUNT) OVER ( PARTITION BY t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ) SELECT rmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, rmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, rmd.TERM_CODE, rmd.ACADEMIC_YEAR, rmd.TERM_DESCRIPTION, rmd.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, rmd.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, rmd.window_column AS reserve_window_avg_record_count, tmd.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, tmd.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY AS textbook_material_key, tmd.SUBJECT_ID, tmd.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS textbook_academic_year, tmd.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS textbook_term_description, tmd.window_column AS textbook_row_number, tmd.TERM_START_DATE AS textbook_term_start_date, tmd.TERM_END_DATE AS textbook_term_end_date FROM inner_cte rmd JOIN ( SELECT t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_CODE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_CODE) AS window_column, t0.TERM_START_DATE, t0.TERM_END_DATE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ) tmd ON rmd.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tmd.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY AND rmd.ACADEMIC_YEAR = tmd.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY rmd.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC, tmd.window_column

question: For each DLC key, show the DLC name, the total number of unique space units associated with it, and the highest number of organizations (with non-null organization names) associated with that DLC key. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.DLC_KEY, t1.DLC_NAME, t2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 JOIN SPACE_UNIT t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY ), OrgCounts AS ( SELECT DLC_KEY, COUNT(DISTINCT FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION WHERE ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NOT NULL AND DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DLC_KEY ) SELECT icte.DLC_KEY, icte.DLC_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT icte.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS unique_space_unit_count, MAX(oc.org_count) AS highest_org_count FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN OrgCounts oc ON icte.DLC_KEY = oc.DLC_KEY GROUP BY icte.DLC_KEY, icte.DLC_NAME

question: For each department where the range of total units for subjects offered in 2022 and listed in the CIS course catalog is greater than 0 and the range of total units for courses offered by that department is also greater than 0, provide the department name, the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in 2022 and listed in the CIS course catalog, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for courses offered by that department, the school name, and the department phone number. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DepartmentSubjectUnits2022 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC ), DepartmentCourseUnits AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT dsu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dsu.units_range, dsu.units_variance, dcu.total_units_range, dcu.total_units_variance, dcu.total_units_stddev FROM DepartmentSubjectUnits2022 dsu JOIN DepartmentCourseUnits dcu ON dsu.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dcu.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE dsu.units_range > 0 AND dcu.total_units_range > 0 ORDER BY dsu.units_range DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.units_range, inner_cte.units_variance, inner_cte.total_units_range, inner_cte.total_units_variance, inner_cte.total_units_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.units_range DESC;

question: For each course in the School of Engineering that is degree granting, show the course description, department name, subject code description, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by course description, along with the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of rooms used for subjects offered by that department (considering only rooms with an area greater than 40), and also include the total number of such rooms per department. The columns should be: course description, department name, subject code description, window row number, average area, area variance, area standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and room count, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptRoomStats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(f.AREA) AS avg_area, VARIANCE(f.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(f.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS f JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON f.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = c.MEET_PLACE WHERE f.AREA > 40 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY area_variance DESC ), EngDegreeCourses AS ( SELECT t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT e.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, e.window_column, d.avg_area, d.area_variance, d.area_stddev FROM EngDegreeCourses e LEFT JOIN DeptRoomStats d ON e.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ic.window_column, ic.avg_area, ic.area_variance, ic.area_stddev, COALESCE(r.room_count, 0) AS room_count FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT f.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count FROM FCLT_ROOMS f JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON f.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = c.MEET_PLACE WHERE f.AREA > 40 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) r ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = r.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ic.COURSE_DESCRIPTION

question: For each department, provide the department name, the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2022, the maximum total units of any course offered by that department, the name of the school that department belongs to, and the number of unique subject codes offered by that department in 2022, but only for departments where the maximum total units is greater than 6. List the results ordered by the range of total units in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC ), DeptMaxUnits AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ), DeptSubjectCount AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.units_range, icte.units_variance, dmu.max_total_units, dmu.SCHOOL_NAME, dsc.subject_count FROM inner_cte icte JOIN DeptMaxUnits dmu ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN DeptSubjectCount dsc ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.units_range DESC;

question: For organizations whose parent is 'S H&SS', show the organization name, description, the HR org unit title, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the organization name, and, for each such organization, also display the range and variance of the space unit codes associated with it (considering only organizations with a non-null description and space units with a non-null space unit name), as well as the DLC name from the HR_ORG_UNIT table. List the columns in the following order: organization name, description, HR org unit title, window row number, code range, code variance, and DLC name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.ORG_PARENT = 'S H&SS' ), org_space_stats AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAX(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) - MIN(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS code_range, VARIANCE(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS code_variance FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY odk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON odk.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL AND su.SPACE_UNIT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.DESCRIPTION, icte.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, icte.window_column, oss.code_range, oss.code_variance, h.DLC_NAME FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN org_space_stats oss ON icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = oss.ORGANIZATION_NAME LEFT JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON icte.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE = h.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE ORDER BY icte.window_column

question: For each activity category, list the category name, the total number of activities, the number of activities in the "Mathematics" category, the maximum enrollment of any activity in that category, the ratio of mathematics activities to total activities rounded to two decimal places, and the average maximum enrollment for activities in that category, ordered by the mathematics activity ratio in descending order.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH ActivityCategoryDenseRank AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY ), MathematicsRowNumber AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT acdr.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Total_Activities, COUNT(mrn.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS Mathematics_Activities, MAX(acdr.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS Max_Enrollment_Any_Activity, ROUND(COUNT(mrn.ACTIVITY_TITLE) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS Mathematics_Activity_Ratio FROM ActivityCategoryDenseRank acdr LEFT JOIN MathematicsRowNumber mrn ON acdr.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = mrn.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY GROUP BY acdr.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, inner_cte.Total_Activities, inner_cte.Mathematics_Activities, inner_cte.Max_Enrollment_Any_Activity, inner_cte.Mathematics_Activity_Ratio, ROUND(AVG(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT), 2) AS Avg_Max_Enrollment FROM inner_cte JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON inner_cte.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY GROUP BY inner_cte.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, inner_cte.Total_Activities, inner_cte.Mathematics_Activities, inner_cte.Max_Enrollment_Any_Activity, inner_cte.Mathematics_Activity_Ratio ORDER BY inner_cte.Mathematics_Activity_Ratio DESC;

question: For each organization that has both rooms on floor 2 or higher and at least one associated space unit with a non-null DLC key, list the organization name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the access levels of rooms assigned to that organization (considering only rooms on floor 2 or higher), the average and variance of the space unit codes assigned to it, and the total number of rooms on floor 2 or higher for that organization. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH org_access_stats AS ( SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(ACCESS_LEVEL) AS avg_access_level, STDDEV(ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_stddev FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE FLOOR >= 2 GROUP BY ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY access_level_stddev DESC ), dept_spaceunit_stats AS ( SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS avg_space_unit_code, VARIANCE(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS var_space_unit_code FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fodk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON fodk.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE fodk.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY var_space_unit_code DESC ) SELECT oas.ORGANIZATION_NAME, oas.avg_access_level, oas.access_level_stddev, dss.avg_space_unit_code, dss.var_space_unit_code FROM org_access_stats oas JOIN dept_spaceunit_stats dss ON oas.ORGANIZATION_NAME = dss.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.avg_access_level, inner_cte.access_level_stddev, inner_cte.avg_space_unit_code, inner_cte.var_space_unit_code, COUNT(zrl.BUILDING_ROOM) AS num_rooms_on_floor_2_or_higher FROM inner_cte JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD zrl ON fo.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = zrl.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE zrl.FLOOR >= 2 GROUP BY inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.avg_access_level, inner_cte.access_level_stddev, inner_cte.avg_space_unit_code, inner_cte.var_space_unit_code ORDER BY num_rooms_on_floor_2_or_higher DESC;

question: For each subject offered in the term with the description "Fall Term 2024-2025" and offered by one of the top 10 departments by the number of unique subjects they offered in academic years 2014 or later, show the subject offered key, subject title, offering department name, the term description, the rank of each subject within its offering department ordered by subject offered key, the count of unique subject titles offered by the department since 2014, and the total number of enrolled students in those subjects in Fall Term 2024-2025, ordered by the count of unique subject titles (descending), offering department name, and subject offered key. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT srf.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, srf.SUBJECT_TITLE, srf.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, srf.TERM_DESCRIPTION, srf.window_column, tds.subject_count FROM ( SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' ) srf JOIN ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2014 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) tds ON srf.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tds.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.subject_count, COALESCE(SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON inner_cte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY GROUP BY inner_cte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.subject_count ORDER BY inner_cte.subject_count DESC, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY;

question: Among the top 10 subjects (by number of enrolled students) that were offered in the term '2019FA' with more than 0 enrolled students, display each subject's ID, title, total enrolled students, term code, material status key, ISBN, the row number within each material status group ordered by subject ID, the offer department name, the department full name, and the most represented school among the departments offering these subjects, along with the count of subjects from that school. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ISBN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS material_status_row_number FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), dept_info AS ( SELECT tso.SUBJECT_ID, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), school_counts AS ( SELECT di.SCHOOL_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT di.SUBJECT_ID) AS Subject_Count FROM dept_info di GROUP BY di.SCHOOL_CODE ), school_ranked AS ( SELECT sc.SCHOOL_CODE, sc.Subject_Count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sc.Subject_Count DESC) AS school_rank FROM school_counts sc ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ic.TERM_CODE, ic.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ic.ISBN, ic.material_status_row_number, di.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, di.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sr.SCHOOL_CODE AS Most_Represented_School, sr.Subject_Count AS Subjects_From_School FROM inner_cte ic JOIN dept_info di ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = di.SUBJECT_ID JOIN school_ranked sr ON di.SCHOOL_CODE = sr.SCHOOL_CODE AND sr.school_rank = 1 ORDER BY ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each organization with an organization level of 5 and for rooms on floor 2 that are associated via space unit code, show the organization name, organization key, description, space unit, space unit key, the average organization key within each organization key group ordered by space unit key, the building room, space usage, the HR org unit title, the department name, the minimum access level in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the building component, and for each organization and space unit, include a grand total for all rooms in the format of (organization name, organization key, description, space unit, space unit key, nulls for room-specific columns, total rooms). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH OrgLevel5 AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.SPACE_UNIT, t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ), RoomsFloor2 AS ( SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.SPACE_USAGE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(t0.ACCESS_LEVEL) OVER (ORDER BY t0.BUILDING_COMPONENT ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2 ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.DESCRIPTION, o.SPACE_UNIT, o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, o.window_column AS org_window_column, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.SPACE_USAGE, r.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, r.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, r.window_column AS room_window_column FROM OrgLevel5 o JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY JOIN RoomsFloor2 r ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = r.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ) SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, DESCRIPTION, SPACE_UNIT, SPACE_UNIT_KEY, org_window_column, BUILDING_ROOM, SPACE_USAGE, HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, room_window_column FROM CombinedResults ) , RoomTotals AS ( SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, DESCRIPTION, SPACE_UNIT, SPACE_UNIT_KEY, NULL AS org_window_column, NULL AS BUILDING_ROOM, NULL AS SPACE_USAGE, NULL AS HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, NULL AS HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS room_window_column, COUNT(*) AS total_rooms FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, DESCRIPTION, SPACE_UNIT, SPACE_UNIT_KEY ) SELECT i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.DESCRIPTION, i.SPACE_UNIT, i.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, i.org_window_column, i.BUILDING_ROOM, i.SPACE_USAGE, i.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.room_window_column, NULL AS total_rooms FROM inner_cte i UNION ALL SELECT r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, r.DESCRIPTION, r.SPACE_UNIT, r.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, r.org_window_column, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.SPACE_USAGE, r.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, r.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, r.room_window_column, r.total_rooms FROM RoomTotals r ORDER BY ORGANIZATION_NAME, SPACE_UNIT, BUILDING_ROOM ;

question: For subjects offered in the term with the description "Fall Term 2024-2025", show the subject code, subject title, department name, term description, the rank of each subject within its department ordered by subject code, and for each subject's department also show the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in regular academic terms. Additionally, for each subject, include the subject's total units and indicate whether the subject is offered in the spring term. List the results ordered by department name and subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' ), DepartmentUnitStats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.window_column, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance, cso.TOTAL_UNITS, cso.IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM FROM inner_cte icte JOIN DepartmentUnitStats dus ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON icte.SUBJECT_CODE = cso.SUBJECT_CODE AND icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION = ( SELECT TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at WHERE at.TERM_CODE = cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE ) ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE

question: For each department name and its corresponding organization key in the Provost Area, provide the number of organizations, the minimum department hierarchy level 3 code, the building-room identifier, the organization name, the DLC key, the sum of room areas within each major use description group ordered by building-room, the ratio of the sum of room areas within each major use description group to the number of organizations (rounded), and only include those records where the sum of room areas within each major use description group exceeds the average sum of room areas for that group across all organizations.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptProvostArea AS ( SELECT m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_CODE) AS min_level3_code FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ), RoomAreaWindow AS ( SELECT t2.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, SUM(t2.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.MAJOR_USE_DESC ORDER BY t2.BUILDING_ROOM) AS window_column, t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t2.MAJOR_USE_DESC FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.AREA > 200 ) SELECT dpa.DLC_NAME, dpa.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, dpa.org_count, dpa.min_level3_code, raw.BUILDING_ROOM, raw.ORGANIZATION_NAME, raw.DLC_KEY, raw.window_column, ROUND(raw.window_column / NULLIF(dpa.org_count, 0), 2) AS window_per_org, raw.MAJOR_USE_DESC FROM DeptProvostArea dpa JOIN RoomAreaWindow raw ON dpa.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = raw.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) , avg_window_per_group AS ( SELECT MAJOR_USE_DESC, AVG(window_column) AS avg_window FROM inner_cte GROUP BY MAJOR_USE_DESC ) SELECT i.DLC_NAME, i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.org_count, i.min_level3_code, i.BUILDING_ROOM, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.DLC_KEY, i.window_column, i.window_per_org FROM inner_cte i JOIN avg_window_per_group a ON i.MAJOR_USE_DESC = a.MAJOR_USE_DESC WHERE i.window_column > a.avg_window ORDER BY i.window_per_org DESC;

question: For the top 10 department names and their corresponding academic years by the number of subjects offered (including only subjects that are not repeatable for credit and are offered in the fall term), display each department name, academic year, subject count, the average of the total units for its courses that have a non-null subject title and total units greater than 0, the variance of the total units for those courses, and the number of unique subject codes offered by the department in that academic year, with the columns shown in this order: department name, academic year, subject count, average units, units variance, and unique subject codes count. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.GRADE_RULE_DESC = 'Not repeatable for credit' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), dept_units_stats AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_variance DESC ), unique_subject_codes AS ( SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_CODE) AS unique_subject_codes_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.GRADE_RULE_DESC = 'Not repeatable for credit' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.subject_count, dus.avg_units, dus.units_variance, usc.unique_subject_codes_count FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN dept_units_stats dus ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN unique_subject_codes usc ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = usc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = usc.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY icte.subject_count DESC, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each department name and school name, where the department is degree granting and the department has more than 10 total enrolled students in courses offered by both the library and the TIP system in the term '2019FA', provide the number of unique courses, the minimum CIP program code from the course descriptions, the total number of enrolled students, and classify the department as 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' if the total enrolled students is at least 20% greater than the average total enrolled students across all such departments, 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' if at least 20% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. List the department name, school name, course count, minimum CIP program code, total enrolled students, and enrollment category in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
