SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DegreeGrantingDeptCourses AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ), DeptEnrolledStudents AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10 ), CombinedDeptInfo AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.course_count, d.min_cip_code, s.total_enrolled FROM DegreeGrantingDeptCourses d JOIN DeptEnrolledStudents s ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT * FROM CombinedDeptInfo ), avg_enrollment AS ( SELECT AVG(total_enrolled) AS avg_total_enrolled FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.course_count, i.min_cip_code, i.total_enrolled, CASE WHEN i.total_enrolled > a.avg_total_enrolled * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.total_enrolled < a.avg_total_enrolled * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_enrollment a ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME;

question: For each subject code where the department is degree granting, show the subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, and the rank of the subject code within each school name group ordered by subject code, along with the building key, average total units, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for all subjects scheduled in rooms of that building during the fall term, but only include those subject codes where the average total units for the building is greater than the overall average total units for all buildings in the fall term. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH subject_code_ranks AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), building_units_stats AS ( SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ) SELECT scr.SUBJECT_CODE, scr.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scr.SCHOOL_NAME, scr.window_column, bus.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, bus.avg_total_units, bus.stddev_total_units FROM subject_code_ranks scr JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scr.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON ccso.MEET_PLACE = fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY JOIN building_units_stats bus ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = bus.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_total_units > ( SELECT AVG(avg_total_units) FROM ( SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ) building_avg );

question: For library reserve materials with material status key 'U', show the subject ID, library course instructor key, term description, academic year, term start date, the minimum academic year in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by library reserve catalog key, the course number, course number description, number of enrolled students, the reserve catalog key, the dense rank over the material status key ordered by material status key, and the responsible faculty name, for subjects that have more than 0 enrolled students. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t2.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, MIN(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER ( ORDER BY t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT t1.COURSE_NUMBER, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, DENSE_RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ) AS window_column, t2.SUBJECT_ID, t1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.TERM_START_DATE, s1.window_column AS min_academic_year_window, s2.COURSE_NUMBER, s2.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, s2.window_column AS dense_rank_material_status, s2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM Subq1 s1 JOIN Subq2 s2 ON s1.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = s2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY AND s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_ID, s2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description, the geometric mean of the total units for all subjects offered in regular terms with total units greater than zero, the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during terms in that year where the term status indicator is 'P' and the number of enrolled students is greater than 0, and for each department, the department name and the total number of unique subjects offered in regular terms with total units greater than zero? List the academic year, academic year description, geometric mean total units, enrolled range, enrolled variance, normalized units to range ratio, department name, and total subjects per department, ordered by normalized units to range ratio descending and department name ascending.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH GeometricMeanUnits AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), EnrolledStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT gmu.ACADEMIC_YEAR, gmu.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gmu.geometric_mean_total_units, es.enrolled_range, es.enrolled_variance, ROUND(gmu.geometric_mean_total_units / NULLIF(es.enrolled_range, 0), 2) AS normalized_units_to_range_ratio FROM GeometricMeanUnits gmu JOIN EnrolledStats es ON gmu.ACADEMIC_YEAR = es.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND gmu.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = es.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units, inner_cte.enrolled_range, inner_cte.enrolled_variance, inner_cte.normalized_units_to_range_ratio, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dept_stats.total_subjects_per_department FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE IN ( SELECT TERM_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS WHERE IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ) JOIN ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects_per_department FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE IN ( SELECT TERM_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS WHERE IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ) GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME ) dept_stats ON cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dept_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.normalized_units_to_range_ratio DESC, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ASC;

question: For each academic year and term status, where the total number of materials recorded in TIP_DETAIL is greater than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean total number of materials per academic year, list the academic year, academic year description, term status, the average record count for TIP materials in that year and term status, the range of record counts, the variance of record counts (considering only terms where the term status is not null and the TIP material status is not 'NM'), and the total number of materials recorded in TIP_DETAIL for that academic year and term status. Also, for each academic year, include a grand total for all term statuses in the format of (academic year, academic year description, null, ...). List the results ordered by the range of record counts in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS, AVG(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_record_count, MAX(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) - MIN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_range, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_materials FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS IS NOT NULL AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS ), HighTotalMaterialYears AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) > ( SELECT AVG(total_count) + STDDEV(total_count) FROM ( SELECT SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_count FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) sub ) ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TERM_STATUS, AVG(avg_record_count) AS avg_record_count, MAX(record_count_range) AS record_count_range, VARIANCE(avg_record_count) AS record_count_variance, SUM(total_materials) AS total_materials FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TERM_STATUS WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(total_materials) > 0 ) SELECT rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR, rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, rr.TERM_STATUS, rr.avg_record_count, rr.record_count_range, rr.record_count_variance, rr.total_materials FROM RollupResults rr JOIN HighTotalMaterialYears h ON rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR = h.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY rr.record_count_range DESC ;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units, show the subject code, subject number, subject title, department name, term description, and the rank of each subject within its department ordered by subject code. Also, for each subject, show the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects in that department that have at least one enrolled student and have required course materials, and indicate whether the subject's total units are 'HIGH_UNIT' (at least 10% greater than the department average), 'LOW_UNIT' (at least 10% less than the department average), or 'AVERAGE_UNIT' otherwise. List the results ordered by department name and subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.window_column, d.avg_total_units, d.total_units_range, d.total_units_variance, CASE WHEN s.TOTAL_UNITS > d.avg_total_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN s.TOTAL_UNITS < d.avg_total_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE_UNIT' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte s JOIN DeptUnitsStats d ON s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE

question: For each offering department and school where the course material status is 'RQ', provide the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in courses offered by that department (considering only courses that have at least one associated TIP material and where the total units for the course are greater than 0), along with the number of unique subjects and the minimum total units for those subjects, and also include the total number of TIP materials for each department and school. List the offering department name, offering school name, average enrollment, enrollment variance, subject count, minimum total units, and total TIP materials in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.RECORD_COUNT >= 1 AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC ), DeptSchoolSubjectStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT dss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dss.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_variance, dss.subject_count, dss.min_total_units FROM DeptSchoolSubjectStats dss LEFT JOIN DeptEnrollmentStats des ON dss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY dss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dss.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, icte.avg_enrollment, icte.enrollment_variance, icte.subject_count, icte.min_total_units, COALESCE(tip_counts.total_tip_materials, 0) AS total_tip_materials FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_tip_materials FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) tip_counts ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tip_counts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND icte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = tip_counts.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME;

question: For each subject offered in the term with the description "Fall Term 2024-2025" and offered by one of the top 10 departments by the number of unique subjects they offered in academic years 2014 or later, show the subject offered key, subject title, offering department name, the term description, the rank of each subject within its offering department ordered by subject offered key, the count of unique subject titles offered by the department since 2014, and the total number of enrolled students in each subject, ordered by the count of unique subject titles (descending), offering department name, and subject offered key. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH SubjectRankInFall2024 AS ( SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' ), Top10DeptsSince2014 AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2014 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT srf.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, srf.SUBJECT_TITLE, srf.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, srf.TERM_DESCRIPTION, srf.window_column, tds.subject_count FROM SubjectRankInFall2024 srf JOIN Top10DeptsSince2014 tds ON srf.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tds.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT icte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.window_column, icte.subject_count, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte icte JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON icte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ORDER BY icte.subject_count DESC, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY;

question: For each subject offered in the academic term with term code '2006FA', show the subject ID, subject title, department name, the sum of lecture units within each grade type group, the number of unique library subjects offered, the minimum total units for those subjects, and the average number of enrolled students for those subjects, considering only departments and course numbers where the number of enrolled students in the subject summary is greater than 2. Present the results ordered by subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.LECTURE_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA' ), DeptCourseLibraryStats AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.window_column, dcls.subject_count, dcls.min_total_units, dcls.avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte icte JOIN DeptCourseLibraryStats dcls ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dcls.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2022 with a total of 12 units that also have at least one required or optional textbook, show the subject code, subject number, department name, subject title, term description, total units, the average subject enrollment number in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by department code and ordered by total units, the textbook material key, the textbook material status key, and whether the subject's enrollment is at least 10% greater than, at least 10% less than, or within 10% of the average enrollment for its department and total units (label as 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT', 'LOW_ENROLLMENT', or 'AVERAGE_ENROLLMENT'). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) OVER ( PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.TOTAL_UNITS, ic.window_column AS avg_enrollment_window, td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, CASE WHEN ic.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > ic.window_column * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN ic.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER < ic.window_column * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE_ENROLLMENT' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte ic JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON ic.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE AND ic.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IN ('RQ', 'EO')

question: For the top 10 space units with the highest variance in room square footage (for rooms with square footage greater than 10), show each space unit's name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of its room square footage, the name of the department assigned to rooms in that space unit, and for that department, the range and variance of the access levels of rooms assigned to it, as well as the department's long name and the school/area name it belongs to. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, VARIANCE(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS square_footage_variance, STDDEV(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS square_footage_stddev, su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY WHERE sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 10 GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY ORDER BY square_footage_variance DESC ), department_access_stats AS ( SELECT HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.ACCESS_LEVEL) - MIN(ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_range, VARIANCE(ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_variance, ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.ACCESS_LEVEL IS NOT NULL GROUP BY HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID ORDER BY access_level_range DESC ) SELECT su_stats.SPACE_UNIT, su_stats.square_footage_variance, su_stats.square_footage_stddev, das.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, das.access_level_range, das.access_level_variance, hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, hou.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME FROM inner_cte su_stats JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON su_stats.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD zrl ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = zrl.SPACE_UNIT_CODE JOIN department_access_stats das ON zrl.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = das.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON das.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY su_stats.square_footage_variance DESC, das.access_level_range DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each department and term, list the subject title, the number of reserve materials assigned (where the material status is 'U'), and the number of unique instructors who have assigned reserve materials for that subject in that term. For each department and term, also include a grand total for all subjects in the format of (department name, term code, null, total reserve materials, total unique instructors). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_reserve_materials, COUNT(DISTINCT lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY) AS num_unique_instructors FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE ) , RollupResults AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, TERM_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE, SUM(num_reserve_materials) AS total_reserve_materials, SUM(num_unique_instructors) AS total_unique_instructors FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, TERM_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(num_reserve_materials) > 0 ) SELECT rr.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, rr.TERM_CODE, rr.SUBJECT_TITLE, rr.total_reserve_materials, rr.total_unique_instructors FROM RollupResults rr ORDER BY rr.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, rr.TERM_CODE, rr.SUBJECT_TITLE ;

question: For each subject offered in the term '2017JA', what is the subject title, the number of enrolled students, the responsible faculty name, the offering department name, the department full name, the school name, the minimum number of enrolled students in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the department code, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with at least one enrolled student), as well as the total number of subjects offered by that department in the term '2017JA'? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptVariation AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), Subjects2017JA AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( ORDER BY t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.window_column, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dv.coefficient_of_variation FROM Subjects2017JA s LEFT JOIN DeptVariation dv ON s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.window_column, i.coefficient_of_variation, dept_count.total_subjects_in_dept_2017JA FROM inner_cte i LEFT JOIN ( SELECT t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS total_subjects_in_dept_2017JA FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' GROUP BY t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) dept_count ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dept_count.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: For each department hierarchy level 2 name and organization name where the organization is assignable and the organization has organization level 5, give the number of organizations, the minimum organization number, the organization key, the description, the space unit, the space unit key, the average organization key within each organization key group, and the corresponding department hierarchy level 3 name, ordered by space unit key, department hierarchy level 2 name, organization name, and space unit key. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(f.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 GROUP BY m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME ), OrgLevel5Details AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.SPACE_UNIT, t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column, t0.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ) SELECT d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, d.ORGANIZATION_NAME, d.organization_count, d.min_organization_number, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.DESCRIPTION, o.SPACE_UNIT, o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, o.window_column, m2.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME FROM inner_cte d JOIN OrgLevel5Details o ON d.ORGANIZATION_NAME = o.ORGANIZATION_NAME JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m2 ON o.DLC_KEY = m2.DLC_KEY ORDER BY d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, d.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY;

question: From the top 10 buildings with the largest total area of rooms (where each room has an area greater than 300), display each building's long name, the total area of its qualifying rooms, the number of such rooms, the department hierarchy name most represented among these rooms, and the count of rooms from that department hierarchy. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t0.AREA FROM FCLT_ROOMS t0 JOIN FCLT_BUILDING t1 ON t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE t0.AREA > 300 ), RoomDeptHierarchy AS ( SELECT icte.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, icte.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, mdh.DLC_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Room_Count FROM inner_cte icte JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY mdh ON fo.DLC_KEY = mdh.DLC_KEY GROUP BY icte.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, icte.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, mdh.DLC_NAME ), RankedDept AS ( SELECT rdh.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, rdh.DLC_NAME, rdh.Room_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rdh.BUILDING_NAME_LONG ORDER BY rdh.Room_Count DESC) AS rn FROM RoomDeptHierarchy rdh ), BuildingStats AS ( SELECT icte.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, icte.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, SUM(icte.AREA) AS Total_Area, COUNT(*) AS Num_Rooms FROM inner_cte icte GROUP BY icte.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, icte.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ) SELECT bs.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, bs.Total_Area, bs.Num_Rooms, rd.DLC_NAME AS Most_Represented_Dept_Hierarchy, rd.Room_Count AS Dept_Room_Count FROM BuildingStats bs LEFT JOIN RankedDept rd ON bs.BUILDING_NAME_LONG = rd.BUILDING_NAME_LONG AND rd.rn = 1 ORDER BY bs.Total_Area DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For subjects offered in the term with the description "Fall Term 2024-2025", show the subject code, subject title, department name, term description, the rank of each subject within its department ordered by subject code, and for each department also show the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in regular academic terms. Additionally, for each department, show the highest total units of any subject offered in a regular academic term. List the results ordered by department name and subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.window_column, d.avg_total_units, d.total_units_range, d.total_units_variance, d.max_total_units FROM inner_cte i LEFT JOIN dept_stats d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_CODE

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year, academic year description, the variance of the record count of tip details for terms that are current or previous terms, the geometric mean of the record counts of required course materials (where the record count is greater than zero) for all subjects offered in that year, and the total number of unique departments offering subjects in that year? Display the results ordered by the variance of the record count in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC ), geometric_mean_record_count_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_record_count DESC ), department_count_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS unique_department_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance, geometric_mean_record_count_cte.geometric_mean_record_count, department_count_cte.unique_department_count FROM inner_cte JOIN geometric_mean_record_count_cte ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = geometric_mean_record_count_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = geometric_mean_record_count_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC JOIN department_count_cte ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = department_count_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = department_count_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY inner_cte.record_count_variance DESC;

question: Show the department names, the corresponding SIS subject code, subject code descriptions, graduate level, the total number of courses per department, and for each department, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, Total_Courses.Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.SUBJECT_CODE GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS Total_Courses ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ic.GRADUATE_LEVEL, ic.Total_Courses, stats.avg_total_units, stats.stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) stats ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For each subject offered in the library, show the subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, term description, academic year, subject short title, the maximum total units for each row and the next two rows in order of subject ID, and the average, range, and variance of CIP program codes for all courses offered by that department where the department is degree granting and the course level is undergraduate. Additionally, indicate whether the number of enrolled students is 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' (at least 20% greater than the department's average), 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' (at least 20% less than the department's average), or 'AVERAGE'. Present the subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, term description, academic year, subject short title, maximum total units, average CIP program code, CIP program code range, CIP program code variance, and enrollment category in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, MAX(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS JOIN_DEPT_NAME FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ), dept_cip_stats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_code, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), dept_enrollment_stats AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, i.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, dcs.avg_cip_code, dcs.cip_code_range, dcs.cip_code_variance, CASE WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > des.avg_enrollment * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < des.avg_enrollment * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte i LEFT JOIN dept_cip_stats dcs ON i.JOIN_DEPT_NAME = dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN dept_enrollment_stats des ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME

question: For each department where the maximum total units of any course offered by that department is greater than 6, and for students in the "Electrical Eng & Computer Sci" department, show the department name, the maximum total units, the name of the school that department belongs to, the student's full name, email address, course description, course level, the row number within each course level group ordered by the student's last name, and the subject code and subject code description for each course. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH department_max_units AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ), eecs_students_courses AS ( SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.COURSE_LEVEL ORDER BY t2.LAST_NAME) AS window_column, t0.COURSE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dmu.max_total_units, dmu.SCHOOL_NAME, esc.FULL_NAME, esc.EMAIL_ADDRESS, esc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, esc.COURSE_LEVEL, esc.window_column, esc.COURSE FROM department_max_units dmu JOIN eecs_students_courses esc ON dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME = esc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.max_total_units, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.FULL_NAME, icte.EMAIL_ADDRESS, icte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, icte.COURSE_LEVEL, icte.window_column, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON icte.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER

question: For each department and academic year where the subject enrollment number is greater than 10, provide the number of unique subjects, the minimum total units offered, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses offered by that department (considering only courses that have at least one associated TIP material), and also list the department code and the full department name as found in the COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED table. List the department code, department name, academic year, subject count, minimum total units, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), DeptEnrolledStats AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS num_enrolled_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS num_enrolled_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.min_total_units, des.num_enrolled_variance, des.num_enrolled_stddev FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN DeptEnrolledStats des ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.department GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.min_total_units, des.num_enrolled_variance, des.num_enrolled_stddev ORDER BY cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR ;

question: From the top 10 subjects offered in the term with code '2025FA' (that also have offerings in the term '2016SP' by departments that grant degrees), display each subject's ID, title, offering department name, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, term start and end dates, term parameter, the minimum number of enrolled students over each offering department, and the department with the highest number of enrolled students for that subject, along with the count of students from that department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t2.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) window_column, t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.TERM_START_DATE, s1.TERM_END_DATE, s1.TERM_PARAMETER, s1.min_enrolled_students_per_dept, s2.window_column, s1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM Subq1 s1 JOIN Subq2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = s2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.TERM_START_DATE, icte.TERM_END_DATE, icte.TERM_PARAMETER, icte.min_enrolled_students_per_dept, dept_max.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS Most_Prominent_Department, dept_max.Student_Count FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Student_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY icte.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte icte GROUP BY icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) dept_max ON icte.SUBJECT_ID = dept_max.SUBJECT_ID AND icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_max.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND dept_max.rn = 1 ORDER BY icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each department in the School of Engineering, for subjects with at least 6 total units offered in the most recent academic year, provide the department name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the most recent academic year, along with the subject ID, subject title, the running sum of total units within each school, and the responsible faculty name for each subject, ordered by the range of total units (descending) and subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.SUBJECT_ID WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ) GROUP BY COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ), EngineeringSubjectsWithFaculty AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance, esf.SUBJECT_ID, esf.SUBJECT_TITLE, esf.window_column, esf.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte dus JOIN EngineeringSubjectsWithFaculty esf ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = esf.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dus.total_units_range DESC, esf.SUBJECT_ID

question: For each subject offered in the Spring term of 2023 and for each subject offered in the academic year 2025 with total units equal to 9, show the subject title, department name, term code, academic year, and the average academic year within each academic year group ordered by term start date from the Spring 2023 subjects, and the department code, department name, subject code, subject number, subject title, total units, and the row number within each department ordered by subject code from the 2025 subjects. Additionally, for each department, include the total number of 2025 subjects with 9 units in the format of (department code, department name, null, null, null, null, total subjects). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.TERM_CODE, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY a.TERM_START_DATE) AS avg_academic_year FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON ata.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON a.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE WHERE a.TERM_CODE = '2023SP' ), subjects_2025_9units AS ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2025 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 9 ), dept_totals AS ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS SUBJECT_CODE, NULL AS SUBJECT_NUMBER, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS total_subjects FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2025 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 9 GROUP BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.TERM_CODE, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.avg_academic_year, s25.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s25.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS s25_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s25.SUBJECT_CODE, s25.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s25.SUBJECT_TITLE AS s25_SUBJECT_TITLE, s25.TOTAL_UNITS, s25.window_column FROM inner_cte icte CROSS JOIN subjects_2025_9units s25 UNION ALL SELECT NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, dt.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dt.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dt.SUBJECT_CODE, dt.SUBJECT_NUMBER, dt.SUBJECT_TITLE, dt.total_subjects, NULL FROM dept_totals dt;

question: For the top 10 departments with the highest variance of reserve catalog keys for courses with material status 'U', show each department's name, the variance of reserve catalog keys, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in library subjects that have a matching master subject ID in the TIP subject offerings (considering only departments with more than 0 enrolled students in both tables), and the average number of enrolled students in those TIP subject offerings. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT dcv.DEPARTMENT, dcv.catalog_key_variance, dsv.library_students_variance, dsv.library_students_stddev FROM ( SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, VARIANCE(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY lci.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY catalog_key_variance DESC ) dcv JOIN ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_students_variance, STDDEV(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_students_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = t.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY library_students_variance DESC ) dsv ON dcv.DEPARTMENT = dsv.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY dcv.catalog_key_variance DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT, ic.catalog_key_variance, ic.library_students_variance, ic.library_students_stddev, AVG(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_tip_students FROM inner_cte ic JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON ic.DEPARTMENT = l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = t.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT, ic.catalog_key_variance, ic.library_students_variance, ic.library_students_stddev ORDER BY ic.catalog_key_variance DESC LIMIT 10;

question: List the activity title, enrollment type, maximum enrollment, category name, sponsor key, and window column for all activities, including those in the "Mathematics" category with row numbers within each enrollment type group ordered by activity title, and for all activities with the dense rank partitioned by category name and ordered by category name. Show the activity title, enrollment type, maximum enrollment, category name, sponsor key, and window column for each row, ordered by activity title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY ), MathActivities AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), CombinedActivities AS ( SELECT * FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT * FROM MathActivities ) SELECT ACTIVITY_TITLE, ENROLLMENT_TYPE, MAX_ENROLLMENT, IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, window_column FROM CombinedActivities ORDER BY ACTIVITY_TITLE;

question: For each department in the 'Engineering' school, list the department name, the number of courses in that department with a total of 12 units, and the number of unique subject titles among those courses. For each school, include a grand total for all departments in the format of (null, total courses, total unique subject titles). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE AS course_number, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.COURSE) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), DepartmentCourseCounts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ic.course_number) AS num_courses, COUNT(DISTINCT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS num_subject_titles FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN inner_cte ic ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME WHERE d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT dcc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(dcc.num_courses) AS total_courses, SUM(dcc.num_subject_titles) AS total_unique_subject_titles FROM DepartmentCourseCounts dcc GROUP BY dcc.DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(dcc.num_courses) > 0 ORDER BY dcc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: For each academic year and department name where the term status is 'Previous', provide the academic year, department name, the number of unique subjects offered, the minimum total units for those subjects, and, for each department, the variance of the reserve catalog keys for courses in that department where the material status is 'U', but only include those academic year and department combinations where the number of unique subjects offered exceeds the average number of unique subjects offered across all departments in that academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptCatalogVariance AS ( SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, VARIANCE(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY lci.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY catalog_key_variance DESC ), YearDeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT yds.ACADEMIC_YEAR, yds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, yds.subject_count, yds.min_total_units, dcv.catalog_key_variance FROM YearDeptSubjectStats yds JOIN DeptCatalogVariance dcv ON yds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dcv.DEPARTMENT ), AvgSubjectCountPerYear AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(subject_count) AS avg_subject_count FROM ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) t GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units, ic.catalog_key_variance FROM inner_cte ic JOIN AvgSubjectCountPerYear avgc ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = avgc.ACADEMIC_YEAR WHERE ic.subject_count > avgc.avg_subject_count ORDER BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For all space units that either (a) have a warehouse load date of '19-DEC-24' and are associated with HR org units with a warehouse load date of '03-DEC-24', or (b) have a space unit code of 402100, list the space unit name, organization name, average HR department code, range of HR department codes, variance of HR department codes, space unit key, DLC name, DLC key, the rank of each record within each DLC key group ordered by space unit key, and the source of the record ('HRStats' for the first case and 'SpaceUnitRank' for the second). Additionally, for each record, include the HR department name (from HR_ORG_UNIT) if available. Show the columns in the following order: space unit name, organization name, average HR department code, range of HR department codes, variance of HR department codes, space unit key, DLC name, DLC key, window column, HR department name, and source. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS avg_hr_dept_code, MAX(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) - MIN(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS hr_dept_code_range, VARIANCE(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS hr_dept_code_variance, su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE su.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND hou.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '03-DEC-24' GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY hr_dept_code_range DESC ) , Subquery2 AS ( SELECT t2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.DLC_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DLC_KEY ORDER BY t2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 402100 ) , CombinedResults AS ( SELECT icte.SPACE_UNIT, icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.avg_hr_dept_code, icte.hr_dept_code_range, icte.hr_dept_code_variance, icte.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, NULL AS DLC_NAME, NULL AS DLC_KEY, NULL AS window_column, icte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, 'HRStats' AS Source FROM inner_cte icte UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SPACE_UNIT, s2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, NULL AS avg_hr_dept_code, NULL AS hr_dept_code_range, NULL AS hr_dept_code_variance, s2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, s2.DLC_NAME, s2.DLC_KEY, s2.window_column, NULL AS HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, 'SpaceUnitRank' AS Source FROM Subquery2 s2 ) SELECT SPACE_UNIT, ORGANIZATION_NAME, avg_hr_dept_code, hr_dept_code_range, hr_dept_code_variance, SPACE_UNIT_KEY, DLC_NAME, DLC_KEY, window_column, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, Source FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY ORGANIZATION_NAME, SPACE_UNIT_KEY;

question: For each subject offered in the term with the description "Fall Term 2024-2025", show the subject ID, subject title, offering department name, term description, and the rank of the subject within its offering department. For each tip detail record where the material status key is 'RQ', show the subject ID, term description, term start date, tip material key, and the average record count in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the financial aid year. Additionally, for each offering department, provide a grand total count of subjects offered in "Fall Term 2024-2025" (with nulls for subject-specific columns), and for each financial aid year, provide a grand total average record count for tip detail records with material status key 'RQ' (with nulls for subject-specific columns). Indicate the source of each row as either 'SubjectOffered', 'TipDetail', 'SubjectOfferedTotal', or 'TipDetailTotal'. The results should be ordered by source, offering department name, subject ID, and term description. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, AVG(t1.RECORD_COUNT) OVER ( PARTITION BY t0.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t0.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ), SubjectOfferedTotals AS ( SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_ID, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(*) AS subject_count, 'SubjectOfferedTotal' AS Source FROM Subquery1 s1 GROUP BY s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), TipDetailTotals AS ( SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_ID, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS TERM_START_DATE, NULL AS TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, AVG(window_column) AS avg_record_count, FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, 'TipDetailTotal' AS Source FROM Subquery2 GROUP BY FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.window_column AS subject_rank, NULL AS TERM_START_DATE, NULL AS TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, NULL AS avg_record_count, NULL AS FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, 'SubjectOffered' AS Source FROM Subquery1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.SUBJECT_ID, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS subject_rank, s2.TERM_START_DATE, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s2.window_column AS avg_record_count, s2.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, 'TipDetail' AS Source FROM Subquery2 s2 UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_ID, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, sot.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, sot.subject_count AS subject_rank, NULL AS TERM_START_DATE, NULL AS TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, NULL AS avg_record_count, NULL AS FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, sot.Source FROM SubjectOfferedTotals sot UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_ID, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS subject_rank, NULL AS TERM_START_DATE, NULL AS TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, tdt.avg_record_count, tdt.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, tdt.Source FROM TipDetailTotals tdt ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte ORDER BY Source, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_DESCRIPTION ;

question: For each department, provide the department's name, the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2022 and that are also listed in the CIS course catalog, as well as the average, minimum, and maximum total units for all courses offered by that department, and the deviation of each course's total units from the department's average. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC ), dept_course_units_avg AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), course_deviation AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.SUBJECT_ID, c.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dept_avg_units, (c.TOTAL_UNITS - AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME)) AS deviation_from_avg FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.units_range, i.units_variance, dca.avg_total_units, dca.min_total_units, dca.max_total_units, cd.SUBJECT_ID, cd.TOTAL_UNITS, cd.deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_course_units_avg dca ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dca.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN course_deviation cd ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cd.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each department that grants degrees, what is the department name, the variance of the total units of subjects offered in the 2022 academic year, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with a non-null subject code description), and the average total units of those subjects? Please provide the department name, the variance of total units, the variance of enrolled students, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrolled students, and the average total units, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptUnitsVariance AS ( SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), DeptEnrolledVariance AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ) SELECT duv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, duv.total_units_variance, dev.enrolled_students_variance, dev.enrolled_students_stddev FROM DeptUnitsVariance duv JOIN DeptEnrolledVariance dev ON duv.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dev.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY duv.total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.total_units_variance, icte.enrolled_students_variance, icte.enrolled_students_stddev, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.total_units_variance, icte.enrolled_students_variance, icte.enrolled_students_stddev ORDER BY icte.total_units_variance DESC;

question: For each department, show the department name and the highest number of 12-unit subjects offered in a single academic year, along with the academic year in which this maximum occurred. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_12_unit_subjects FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 GROUP BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(num_12_unit_subjects) AS max_12_unit_subjects_in_a_year, ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, num_12_unit_subjects, ACADEMIC_YEAR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY num_12_unit_subjects DESC, ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS rn FROM inner_cte ) ranked WHERE rn = 1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each subject in the term "2010FA" and for each department name where the number of enrolled students is greater than 5 in that academic year, show the subject ID, the term description, the material status key, the academic year, the rank of the subject within the academic year group ordered by subject ID, the department name, the number of unique subjects offered by that department in that academic year, the minimum start date of the academic term, and the average number of enrolled students for that department in that academic year. The results are ordered by academic year, department name, and subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2010FA' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT l.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_start_date FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON t.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.window_column, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.subject_count, s2.min_start_date FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = lso.SUBJECT_ID AND lso.TERM_CODE = '2010FA' JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.min_start_date, avg_stats.avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON a.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) avg_stats ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = avg_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = avg_stats.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each degree-granting department and subject code, and for each building where that subject is scheduled in the fall term, provide the department name, subject code, number of subject codes, minimum department budget code, building key, the average total units, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, and the total number of subjects scheduled in rooms of that building during the fall term. The columns should be: department name, subject code, subject code count, minimum department budget code, building key, average total units, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, and subject count, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.subject_code_count, inner_cte.min_dept_budget_code, bus.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, bus.avg_total_units, bus.stddev_total_units, bus.subject_count FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units, COUNT(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE ) bus ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE = bus.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, bus.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY

question: List the department name, subject code, subject code description, graduate level, total number of courses per department, building key, and the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for all subjects scheduled in rooms of that building during the fall term, for each degree-granting department and subject code where that subject is scheduled in a building during the fall term. Show the columns in this order: department name, subject code, subject code description, graduate level, total number of courses, building key, average total units, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, Total_Courses.Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_NUMBER) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS Total_Courses ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, icte.GRADUATE_LEVEL, icte.Total_Courses, bsu.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, bsu.avg_total_units, bsu.stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ( SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE ) bsu ON icte.SUBJECT_CODE = bsu.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE, bsu.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY;

question: For each activity in the "Mathematics" category, list the activity title, enrollment type, maximum enrollment, category name, and the average maximum enrollment for all activities in the same category. Only include activities where the maximum enrollment is greater than the average maximum enrollment for the "Mathematics" category. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT i.ACTIVITY_TITLE, i.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, i.MAX_ENROLLMENT, i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, (SELECT AVG(d2.MAX_ENROLLMENT) FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d2 JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c2 ON d2.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c2.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE c2.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) AS avg_max_enrollment_in_category FROM inner_cte i WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT > ( SELECT AVG(d2.MAX_ENROLLMENT) FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d2 JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c2 ON d2.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c2.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE c2.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = 'Mathematics' );

question: For each department that grants degrees, which subjects offered by that department have a total units value greater than the average total units for that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units)? For each such subject, provide the department name, subject id, subject title, and the subject's total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) , dept_avg AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg a ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE i.TOTAL_UNITS > a.avg_total_units
