question: For each department that grants degrees and offers at least one subject with more than 0 total units, and that also offers subjects in regular academic terms, what are the following statistics: the department name, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for all subjects offered by that department, the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in regular academic terms, and the maximum total units for any subject offered in a regular academic term? List the department name, average total units for all subjects, variance of total units for all subjects, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for all subjects, average total units for regular terms, range of total units for regular terms, variance of total units for regular terms, and the maximum total units in regular terms, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), DeptUnitsRegularTerm AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_total_units AS avg_total_units_all_subjects, i.total_units_variance AS total_units_variance_all_subjects, i.total_units_stddev AS total_units_stddev_all_subjects, d.avg_total_units AS avg_total_units_regular_terms, d.total_units_range AS total_units_range_regular_terms, d.total_units_variance AS total_units_variance_regular_terms, d.max_total_units AS max_total_units_regular_terms FROM inner_cte i JOIN DeptUnitsRegularTerm d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department where the total number of organizations associated with that department whose parent is 'EXECVP' or 'CHNCLR' is greater than 5, give the department name, the total number of organizations, the DLC name, the average organization number, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the organization numbers for assignable organizations associated with that DLC, and the HR organization unit title, ordering the results by the total number of organizations in descending order and then by the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the organization numbers in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS total_organizations FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON d.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON f.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY WHERE f.ORG_PARENT IN ('EXECVP', 'CHNCLR') GROUP BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) > 5 ) SELECT inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_organizations, da.DLC_NAME, da.avg_org_number, da.org_number_stddev, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE FROM inner_cte JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON h.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY JOIN ( SELECT o.DLC_NAME, AVG(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS avg_org_number, STDDEV(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 GROUP BY o.DLC_NAME ) da ON f.DLC_NAME = da.DLC_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.total_organizations DESC, da.org_number_stddev DESC;

question: For each department name and school name that is degree granting and is in the School of Engineering with more than 50 total enrolled students in its courses, and where the minimum CIP program code from the course descriptions is less than the average minimum CIP program code across all such departments, provide the department name, school name, the number of unique courses, the minimum CIP program code from the course descriptions, and the total number of students enrolled in courses offered by that department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DegreeGrantingDeptCourses AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ), EngineeringDeptHighEnrollment AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ) SELECT dgc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dgc.SCHOOL_NAME, dgc.course_count, dgc.min_cip_code, ede.total_enrollment FROM DegreeGrantingDeptCourses dgc JOIN EngineeringDeptHighEnrollment ede ON dgc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ede.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), min_cip_avg AS ( SELECT AVG(min_cip_code) AS avg_min_cip_code FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.course_count, i.min_cip_code, i.total_enrollment FROM inner_cte i JOIN min_cip_avg a ON i.min_cip_code < a.avg_min_cip_code ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department and course level, provide the department name, the average CIP program code, the range of CIP program codes, the variance of CIP program codes for all undergraduate courses offered by degree-granting departments, as well as the course level, the number of unique degree-granting courses with total units greater than 6, the minimum total units offered, the school name, and the department phone number. Present the results ordered by the range of CIP program codes in descending order and then by the number of unique courses in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptCipStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_code, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cip_code_range DESC ), DeptCourseStats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL ) SELECT dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.avg_cip_code, dcs.cip_code_range, dcs.cip_code_variance, dct.COURSE_LEVEL, dct.course_count, dct.min_total_units FROM DeptCipStats dcs JOIN DeptCourseStats dct ON dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dct.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dcs.cip_code_range DESC, dct.course_count DESC ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_cip_code, icte.cip_code_range, icte.cip_code_variance, icte.COURSE_LEVEL, icte.course_count, icte.min_total_units, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.cip_code_range DESC, icte.course_count DESC;

question: For each of the top 10 department names in the Provost Area by number of associated faculty organizations, provide the department name, the number of faculty organizations, the variance of faculty organization keys, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of faculty organization keys, and classify each department as 'HIGH_VARIANCE' (if the variance is at least 10% greater than the average variance among these departments), 'LOW_VARIANCE' (if the variance is at least 10% less than the average variance), or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptOrgVariance AS ( SELECT m.DLC_NAME, VARIANCE(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_key_variance, STDDEV(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_key_stddev FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME ORDER BY org_key_variance DESC ), Top10DeptOrgCount AS ( SELECT m.DLC_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME ORDER BY org_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT t.DLC_NAME, t.org_count, d.org_key_variance, d.org_key_stddev FROM Top10DeptOrgCount t JOIN DeptOrgVariance d ON t.DLC_NAME = d.DLC_NAME ORDER BY t.org_count DESC ), avg_variance_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(org_key_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.DLC_NAME, i.org_count, i.org_key_variance, i.org_key_stddev, CASE WHEN i.org_key_variance > a.avg_variance * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN i.org_key_variance < a.avg_variance * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_variance_cte a ORDER BY i.org_count DESC;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year, the academic year description, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of subjects offered in each academic year for terms that are regular terms, and the variance of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during terms in that year, considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the number of enrolled students is greater than 0? Additionally, for each academic year, what is the maximum number of enrolled students in any subject offered (from SUBJECT_OFFERED) during terms in that year? List the academic year, academic year description, total units range, total units variance, total units standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), enrolled students variance, and maximum subject enrollment in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH TotalUnitsStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ), EnrolledStudentsVariance AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ), CombinedStats AS ( SELECT t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t.total_units_range, t.total_units_variance, t.total_units_stddev, e.enrolled_students_variance FROM TotalUnitsStats t JOIN EnrolledStudentsVariance e ON t.ACADEMIC_YEAR = e.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = e.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT cs.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cs.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cs.total_units_range, cs.total_units_variance, cs.total_units_stddev, cs.enrolled_students_variance FROM CombinedStats cs ), MaxSubjectEnrollment AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_subject_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.total_units_range, i.total_units_variance, i.total_units_stddev, i.enrolled_students_variance, m.max_subject_enrollment FROM inner_cte i JOIN MaxSubjectEnrollment m ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = m.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = m.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each department and associated DLC, list the department name, the total number of organizations associated with that department for organizations whose parent is 'EXECVP' or 'CHNCLR' (with the total number of organizations greater than 5), the DLC name, the average organization number for assignable organizations in that DLC, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the organization numbers for assignable organizations in that DLC, and the HR organization unit title for the department, ordered by the total number of organizations and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of organization numbers in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS total_organizations FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON d.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON f.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY WHERE f.ORG_PARENT IN ('EXECVP', 'CHNCLR') GROUP BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) > 5 ), DLCOrgStats AS ( SELECT o.DLC_NAME, AVG(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS avg_org_number, STDDEV(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 GROUP BY o.DLC_NAME ) SELECT icte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.total_organizations, dls.DLC_NAME, dls.avg_org_number, dls.org_number_stddev, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE FROM inner_cte icte JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON icte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON h.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY JOIN DLCOrgStats dls ON f.DLC_NAME = dls.DLC_NAME ORDER BY icte.total_organizations DESC, dls.org_number_stddev DESC;

question: List the subject titles, department names, term codes, term descriptions, academic years, the running sum of academic years within each financial aid year group, and the number of reserve materials assigned for the top 10 subject titles by reserve materials in academic terms with status 'Previous', and also show the corresponding academic year description and the last day of final exam for each term. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH TopSubjects AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_reserve_materials FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE ORDER BY num_reserve_materials DESC LIMIT 10 ), PreviousTerms AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ) SELECT ts.SUBJECT_TITLE, ts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ts.TERM_CODE, pt.TERM_DESCRIPTION, pt.ACADEMIC_YEAR, pt.window_column, ts.num_reserve_materials FROM TopSubjects ts JOIN PreviousTerms pt ON ts.TERM_CODE = pt.TERM_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.num_reserve_materials, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ata.LAST_DAY_OF_FINAL_EXAM FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE;

question: For each subject with at least 5 enrolled students, list the subject ID, subject title, number of enrolled students, term code, material status key, ISBN, the row number within each material status group ordered by subject ID, and the term description. For each IAP subject activity with a maximum enrollment of 12, list the subject ID, activity title, enrollment type, term description, and the rank of each record within each term description group ordered by activity title. For each term description, include a grand total for all IAP activities in the format of (null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, term description, total activities, 'IAPActivityTotal'). Indicate the source of each record as either 'LibrarySubject', 'IAPActivity', or 'IAPActivityTotal'. The columns should be: subject ID, subject title, number of enrolled students, term code, material status key, ISBN, window column, activity title, enrollment type, term description, total activities, and source. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ISBN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t2.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t2 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 ), IAP_Activities AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 12 ), IAP_Totals AS ( SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_ID, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, NULL AS TERM_CODE, NULL AS TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, NULL AS ISBN, NULL AS window_column, NULL AS ACTIVITY_TITLE, NULL AS ENROLLMENT_TYPE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(*) AS total_activities, 'IAPActivityTotal' AS Source FROM IAP_Activities GROUP BY TERM_DESCRIPTION ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.TERM_CODE, i.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, i.ISBN, i.window_column, NULL AS ACTIVITY_TITLE, NULL AS ENROLLMENT_TYPE, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS total_activities, 'LibrarySubject' AS Source FROM inner_cte i UNION ALL SELECT a.SUBJECT_ID, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, NULL AS TERM_CODE, NULL AS TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, NULL AS ISBN, a.window_column, a.ACTIVITY_TITLE, a.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS total_activities, 'IAPActivity' AS Source FROM IAP_Activities a UNION ALL SELECT t.SUBJECT_ID, t.SUBJECT_TITLE, t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t.TERM_CODE, t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t.ISBN, t.window_column, t.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.total_activities, t.Source FROM IAP_Totals t ORDER BY TERM_DESCRIPTION, Source, SUBJECT_ID

question: Show the department names, the corresponding SIS subject code, subject code descriptions, graduate level, the total number of courses per department, and the minimum department budget code for each department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, Total_Courses.Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_NUMBER) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS Total_Courses ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.GRADUATE_LEVEL, inner_cte.Total_Courses, dept_agg.min_dept_budget_code FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS dept_agg ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_agg.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department in the Fall Term 2024-2025, list the department name, subject code, subject title, term description, the rank of each subject within its department ordered by subject code, the academic year, the average total units, the variance of total units, and the number of subjects offered by the department in that term. For each department and academic year, include a grand total for all subjects in the format of (department name, null, null, term description, null, academic year, average total units, variance of total units, total subjects). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH AvgVarUnits AS ( SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY var_total_units DESC ), FallSubjects AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' ) SELECT fs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, fs.SUBJECT_CODE, fs.SUBJECT_TITLE, fs.TERM_DESCRIPTION, fs.window_column, avu.ACADEMIC_YEAR, avu.avg_total_units, avu.var_total_units FROM FallSubjects fs JOIN AvgVarUnits avu ON fs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = avu.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE avu.avg_total_units > 12 AND avu.var_total_units >= 10 ) , SubjectCounts AS ( SELECT fs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, avu.ACADEMIC_YEAR, fs.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(*) AS total_subjects FROM ( SELECT t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' ) fs JOIN ( SELECT c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 12 AND VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) >= 10 ) avu ON fs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = avu.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY fs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, avu.ACADEMIC_YEAR, fs.TERM_DESCRIPTION ) , RollupResults AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.window_column, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.avg_total_units, ic.var_total_units, sc.total_subjects FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN SubjectCounts sc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = sc.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION = sc.TERM_DESCRIPTION UNION ALL SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS SUBJECT_CODE, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS window_column, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.avg_total_units, ic.var_total_units, sc.total_subjects FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_NAME, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, avg_total_units, var_total_units FROM inner_cte ) ic LEFT JOIN SubjectCounts sc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = sc.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION = sc.TERM_DESCRIPTION ) SELECT rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.SUBJECT_CODE, rr.SUBJECT_TITLE, rr.TERM_DESCRIPTION, rr.window_column, rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR, rr.avg_total_units, rr.var_total_units, rr.total_subjects FROM RollupResults rr ORDER BY rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR, rr.SUBJECT_CODE ;

question: For each department name and school name where the department is degree granting, provide the number of unique courses, the minimum CIP program code from the course descriptions, the subject title from the subject offered summary for subjects offered in the term '2022FA' with a total of 12 units, and the dense rank of each subject considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the subject code from the course catalog. Additionally, for each such subject, include the subject's short title and the grade type description from the course catalog for the same term and subject code. List the results ordered by department name and the dense rank. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ), SubjectSummary AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.TERM_CODE, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.course_count, icte.min_cip_code, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccso.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, ccso.GRADE_TYPE_DESC, ss.window_column FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SubjectSummary ss ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ss.SUBJECT_CODE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE AND ss.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.window_column;

question: For all subjects in the 2014FA term with at least one enrolled student and whose offering department in the current academic term has a maximum subject enrollment number greater than 5, show the subject title, offering department name, responsible faculty name, the TIP material status key, the total number of units, the minimum total number of units in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the course number, the maximum subject enrollment number for the department in the current term, the term start date, and the average total units for that department in the 2014FA term as a benchmark, along with a classification of the subject as 'HIGH_UNIT' (if its total units is at least 10% greater than the department average), 'LOW_UNIT' (if at least 10% less), or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH Sub1 AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_dept_name FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), Sub2 AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_enrollment, at.TERM_START_DATE FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 5 ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s1.TOTAL_UNITS, s1.window_column, s2.max_enrollment, s2.TERM_START_DATE, s1.join_dept_name FROM Sub1 s1 JOIN Sub2 s2 ON s1.join_dept_name = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS dept_avg_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, icte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, icte.TOTAL_UNITS, icte.window_column, icte.max_enrollment, icte.TERM_START_DATE, davg.dept_avg_units AS department_avg_units, CASE WHEN icte.TOTAL_UNITS > davg.dept_avg_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN icte.TOTAL_UNITS < davg.dept_avg_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_classification FROM inner_cte icte JOIN dept_avg davg ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = davg.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: For each administrative department with a total number of enrolled students greater than 100 in subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering, and for each subject offered by those departments in the term with code '2025FA', list the administrative department name, the total number of enrolled students, the subject ID, subject title, offering department name, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, term start date, term end date, term parameter, and the minimum number of enrolled students over each offering department. Additionally, for each administrative department, include a grand total for all subjects in the format of (administrative department name, total enrolled, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ade.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ade.total_enrolled, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.TERM_START_DATE, s.TERM_END_DATE, s.TERM_PARAMETER, s.min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM ( SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100 ) ade JOIN ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ) s ON ade.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ) , RollupResults AS ( SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_enrolled, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_START_DATE, TERM_END_DATE, TERM_PARAMETER, min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_enrolled, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_START_DATE, TERM_END_DATE, TERM_PARAMETER, min_enrolled_students_per_dept WITH ROLLUP HAVING SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND total_enrolled IS NOT NULL ) SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_enrolled, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_START_DATE, TERM_END_DATE, TERM_PARAMETER, min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM RollupResults ORDER BY SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID

question: Show the department name, the subject ID, subject title, the number of enrolled students, the minimum TIP material status key in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the number of enrolled students, and the variance of the record count for TIP materials associated with that subject (considering only records where the library material status is 'U' and the TIP material status is 'RQ'), for each library reserve material detail with material status key equal to 'U'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT l.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, l.TERM_CODE, l.SUBJECT_ID, t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t.ISBN, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, MIN(t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) OVER ( ORDER BY s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ), subject_record_count_variance AS ( SELECT l.SUBJECT_ID, VARIANCE(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY l.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.window_column, srv.record_count_variance FROM inner_cte i LEFT JOIN subject_record_count_variance srv ON i.SUBJECT_ID = srv.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For rooms with area greater than 200, show the building-room identifier, the organization name, the DLC key, the sum of room areas within each major use description group ordered by building-room, the HR department name, the HR org unit title, the HR org unit key, the average organization key within each organization key group ordered by HR org unit key, the HR org unit level, and the HR org unit department name, for organizations with organization level equal to 5 and assignable equal to 1. Include subtotals for each HR org unit level (the corresponding HR org unit level field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all HR org unit levels (the corresponding HR org unit level field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the HR org unit level if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by HR org unit level and HR org unit key. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH RoomAreas AS ( SELECT t2.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, SUM(t2.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.MAJOR_USE_DESC ORDER BY t2.BUILDING_ROOM) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.AREA > 200 ), OrgAverages AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE AS HR_ORG_UNIT_DEPT_NAME FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1 ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT ra.BUILDING_ROOM, ra.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ra.DLC_KEY, ra.window_column AS room_area_sum, oa.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, oa.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, oa.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, oa.window_column AS org_key_avg, oa.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, oa.HR_ORG_UNIT_DEPT_NAME FROM RoomAreas ra JOIN OrgAverages oa ON ra.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = oa.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL) OVER (ORDER BY HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) = HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL THEN NULL ELSE HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL END AS hr_org_unit_level, HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, BUILDING_ROOM, ORGANIZATION_NAME, DLC_KEY, room_area_sum, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, org_key_avg, HR_ORG_UNIT_DEPT_NAME FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL) = 1 AND GROUPING(HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL END AS hr_org_unit_level_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL) = 0 AND GROUPING(HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL) = 1 AND GROUPING(HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL END AS HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, CASE WHEN GROUPING(HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL) = 0 AND GROUPING(HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY END AS hr_org_unit_key_sort, HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, BUILDING_ROOM, ORGANIZATION_NAME, DLC_KEY, SUM(room_area_sum) AS room_area_sum, MAX(HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE) AS HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, AVG(org_key_avg) AS org_key_avg, MAX(HR_ORG_UNIT_DEPT_NAME) AS HR_ORG_UNIT_DEPT_NAME FROM CombinedResults GROUP BY HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, BUILDING_ROOM, ORGANIZATION_NAME, DLC_KEY WITH ROLLUP ) tbltmp ORDER BY hr_org_unit_level_sort, hr_org_unit_key_sort ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte;

question: For each academic year, show the academic year, academic year description, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the record counts of TIP materials associated with that academic year (considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the TIP material status key is not 'NM'), as well as the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered (considering only terms that are not the current term), and the total number of unique subjects offered in each academic year. List the results in order of decreasing record count variance. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH RecordCountStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC ), EnrolledStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC ) SELECT rcs.ACADEMIC_YEAR, rcs.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, rcs.record_count_variance, rcs.record_count_stddev, es.enrolled_range, es.enrolled_variance FROM RecordCountStats rcs JOIN EnrolledStats es ON rcs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = es.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND rcs.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = es.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY rcs.record_count_variance DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance, inner_cte.record_count_stddev, inner_cte.enrolled_range, inner_cte.enrolled_variance, subj_stats.num_unique_subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) subj_stats ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = subj_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = subj_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY inner_cte.record_count_variance DESC;

question: For each subject offered in the term with the description "Fall Term 2024-2025" that also has more than 0 enrolled students and a material status key of 'U', show each subject's offered key, subject title, offering department name, the term description, the rank of each subject within its offering department, the course number, course number description, number of enrolled students, the reserve catalog key, the dense rank over the material status key ordered by material status key, and the responsible faculty name, for the top 10 subjects with the highest number of enrolled students. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.window_column AS subject_rank_in_dept, l.COURSE_NUMBER, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, l.window_column AS dense_rank_material_status, s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM (SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS window_column, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' ) s JOIN (SELECT t1.COURSE_NUMBER, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) AS window_column, t1.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ) l ON s.SUBJECT_ID = l.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT inner_cte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.subject_rank_in_dept, inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER, inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, inner_cte.dense_rank_material_status, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For space units with a space unit code equal to 97500, show the space unit name, the associated organization's name, the DLC name, the DLC key from the organization, the minimum space unit code in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the facility organization key, as well as the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of organizations associated with that DLC key (considering only DLC keys that are not null and organizations that have a non-null organization name), and also include the total number of space units for each DLC key. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS organization_name, t1.DLC_NAME AS dlc_name, t1.DLC_KEY AS org_dlc_key, MIN(t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) OVER ( ORDER BY t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_min_space_unit_code, t1.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 97500 ), DlcOrgStats AS ( SELECT fdlk.DLC_KEY, MAX(org_count) - MIN(org_count) AS org_count_range, VARIANCE(org_count) AS org_count_variance, STDDEV(org_count) AS org_count_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fdlk JOIN ( SELECT fo.DLC_KEY, COUNT(*) AS org_count FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fo.DLC_KEY ) org_stats ON fdlk.DLC_KEY = org_stats.DLC_KEY WHERE fdlk.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fdlk.DLC_KEY ORDER BY org_count_range DESC ), DlcSpaceUnitCounts AS ( SELECT DLC_KEY, COUNT(*) AS total_space_units FROM SPACE_UNIT GROUP BY DLC_KEY ) SELECT icte.space_unit_name, icte.organization_name, icte.dlc_name, icte.org_dlc_key, icte.window_min_space_unit_code, dos.org_count_range, dos.org_count_variance, dos.org_count_stddev, dsuc.total_space_units FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN DlcOrgStats dos ON icte.DLC_KEY = dos.DLC_KEY LEFT JOIN DlcSpaceUnitCounts dsuc ON icte.DLC_KEY = dsuc.DLC_KEY;

question: For each department and each DLC associated with that department, where the department has more than 5 organizations whose parent is 'EXECVP' or 'CHNCLR', provide the department name, the total number of such organizations, the DLC name, the average organization number, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of organization numbers for assignable organizations in that DLC, the school/area name, and the department's long name. Include subtotals for each department (the corresponding department field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all departments (the corresponding department field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the department if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by department and DLC name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptOrgCounts AS ( SELECT h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS total_organizations FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON d.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON f.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY WHERE f.ORG_PARENT IN ('EXECVP', 'CHNCLR') GROUP BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) > 5 ), DLCOrgStats AS ( SELECT o.DLC_NAME, AVG(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS avg_org_number, STDDEV(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 GROUP BY o.DLC_NAME ORDER BY org_number_stddev DESC ) SELECT d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.total_organizations, s.DLC_NAME, s.avg_org_number, s.org_number_stddev, h.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME AS school_area_name, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG AS department_long_name FROM DeptOrgCounts d JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON h.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY JOIN DLCOrgStats s ON f.DLC_NAME = s.DLC_NAME GROUP BY d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.total_organizations, s.DLC_NAME, s.avg_org_number, s.org_number_stddev, h.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(department) OVER (ORDER BY dept_sort, dlc_sort) = department THEN NULL ELSE department END AS department, total_organizations, dlc_name, avg_org_number, org_number_stddev, school_area_name, department_long_name FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(DLC_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(DLC_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(DLC_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS department, CASE WHEN GROUPING(HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(DLC_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DLC_NAME END AS dlc_sort, DLC_NAME AS dlc_name, SUM(total_organizations) AS total_organizations, AVG(avg_org_number) AS avg_org_number, STDDEV(org_number_stddev) AS org_number_stddev, MAX(school_area_name) AS school_area_name, MAX(department_long_name) AS department_long_name FROM inner_cte GROUP BY HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DLC_NAME WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY dept_sort, dlc_sort;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units, show the subject code, subject number, subject title, department name, term description, and the rank of each subject within its department ordered by subject code. Additionally, for each subject's department, include the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects that have at least one enrolled student and have required course materials. Also, for each department, display the number of unique instructors who are responsible for these subjects. Display the results ordered by department name and subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), dept_instructors AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT sos.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME) AS num_unique_instructors FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.window_column, ds.avg_total_units, ds.total_units_range, ds.total_units_variance, di.num_unique_instructors FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN dept_stats ds ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.OFFER_DEPT_NAME LEFT JOIN dept_instructors di ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = di.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE

question: For each room with area greater than 200, what are the building-room identifier, the organization name, the DLC key, the sum of room areas within each major use description group (ordered by building-room), and for the corresponding DLC key, what is the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of organizations associated with that DLC key (considering only DLC keys that are not null and organizations that have a non-null organization name)? Additionally, for each such room, what is the total number of rooms assigned to the same organization? Present the results ordered by building-room. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH dlc_org_stats AS ( SELECT fdlk.DLC_KEY, MAX(org_count) - MIN(org_count) AS org_count_range, VARIANCE(org_count) AS org_count_variance, STDDEV(org_count) AS org_count_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fdlk JOIN ( SELECT fo.DLC_KEY, COUNT(*) AS org_count FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fo.DLC_KEY ) org_stats ON fdlk.DLC_KEY = org_stats.DLC_KEY WHERE fdlk.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fdlk.DLC_KEY ORDER BY org_count_range DESC ), room_area_stats AS ( SELECT t2.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, SUM(t2.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.MAJOR_USE_DESC ORDER BY t2.BUILDING_ROOM) AS window_column, t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.AREA > 200 ) SELECT ras.BUILDING_ROOM, ras.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ras.DLC_KEY, ras.window_column, dos.org_count_range, dos.org_count_variance, dos.org_count_stddev, ras.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM room_area_stats ras LEFT JOIN dlc_org_stats dos ON ras.DLC_KEY = dos.DLC_KEY ORDER BY ras.BUILDING_ROOM ) SELECT icte.BUILDING_ROOM, icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.DLC_KEY, icte.window_column, icte.org_count_range, icte.org_count_variance, icte.org_count_stddev, org_room_counts.total_rooms_per_org FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, COUNT(*) AS total_rooms_per_org FROM FCLT_ROOMS GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) org_room_counts ON icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = org_room_counts.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY icte.BUILDING_ROOM;

question: For each major use description and organization name where the room area is greater than 100 and the access level is 1, show the number of rooms, the minimum floor number, the building room, floor, room number, space ID, area, major use name, major use description, the minimum area value over each major use group for rooms with area greater than 200 and assignable major use, and also include the organization description from the organization table, ordered by major use description, organization name, and major use. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count, MIN(r.FLOOR) AS min_floor, r.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 100 AND r.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 GROUP BY r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ), subq2 AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.ROOM, t1.SPACE_ID, t1.AREA, t0.MAJOR_USE, t0.DESCRIPTION, min(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY ORDER BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY) AS min_area_per_major_use, t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_MAJOR_USE t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 200 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1 ) SELECT s1.MAJOR_USE_DESC, s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s1.room_count, s1.min_floor, s2.BUILDING_ROOM, s2.FLOOR, s2.ROOM, s2.SPACE_ID, s2.AREA, s2.MAJOR_USE, s2.DESCRIPTION, s2.min_area_per_major_use, s1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = s2.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY AND s1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = s2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) SELECT inner_cte.MAJOR_USE_DESC, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.room_count, inner_cte.min_floor, inner_cte.BUILDING_ROOM, inner_cte.FLOOR, inner_cte.ROOM, inner_cte.SPACE_ID, inner_cte.AREA, inner_cte.MAJOR_USE, inner_cte.DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.min_area_per_major_use, fo.DESCRIPTION AS ORGANIZATION_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON inner_cte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY inner_cte.MAJOR_USE_DESC, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.MAJOR_USE;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2012 with a cluster type of 'SWE: School-Wide Electives', show the subject key, subject title, academic year, the running sum of the number of enrolled students within each department, and the deviation of each subject's enrolled students from the average number of enrolled students for that department in that year, along with the academic year description, the range, and the variance of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during terms in that year (considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the number of enrolled students is greater than 0), ordered by subject key. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, SUM(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_KEY) AS running_enrollment_sum FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 AND t1.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC = 'SWE: School-Wide Electives' ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, AVG(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 AND t1.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC = 'SWE: School-Wide Electives' GROUP BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ), lib_stats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_KEY, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.running_enrollment_sum, (i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS - d.avg_enrolled_students) AS deviation_from_dept_avg, l.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, l.enrolled_range, l.enrolled_variance FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND i.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN lib_stats l ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = l.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY i.SUBJECT_KEY;

question: For each department, provide the department name, the variance of the reserve catalog keys for courses in that department (if available), the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses with at least 5 different materials assigned in term '2013FA' (if available), and indicate whether the department is a 'HIGH_VARIANCE' department (catalog key variance at least 10% greater than the average variance across all departments), a 'LOW_VARIANCE' department (catalog key variance at least 10% less than the average), or 'AVERAGE'. If the department only has enrolled students standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), indicate 'ENROLLED_STDDEV_ONLY'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, VARIANCE(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY lci.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY catalog_key_variance DESC ), variance_benchmark AS ( SELECT AVG(catalog_key_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte ), DeptEnrolledStddev AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2013FA' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) >= 5 ORDER BY enrolled_stddev DESC ) SELECT COALESCE(ic.DEPARTMENT, des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS DEPT_NAME, ic.catalog_key_variance, des.enrolled_stddev, CASE WHEN ic.catalog_key_variance IS NOT NULL AND vb.avg_variance IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN ic.catalog_key_variance > vb.avg_variance * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN ic.catalog_key_variance < vb.avg_variance * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END WHEN des.enrolled_stddev IS NOT NULL THEN 'ENROLLED_STDDEV_ONLY' ELSE NULL END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN DeptEnrolledStddev des ON ic.DEPARTMENT = des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME CROSS JOIN variance_benchmark vb UNION SELECT des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS DEPT_NAME, NULL AS catalog_key_variance, des.enrolled_stddev, 'ENROLLED_STDDEV_ONLY' AS variance_category FROM DeptEnrolledStddev des LEFT JOIN inner_cte ic ON des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = ic.DEPARTMENT WHERE ic.DEPARTMENT IS NULL ORDER BY DEPT_NAME;

question: For each subject that has at least one enrolled student and is offered in the term '2016SP' with a school code of 'E', show the subject title, the number of enrolled students, the term code from the library subject offered table, the tip material status key, the total units from the subject offered summary, the average number of enrolled students within each subject title group ordered by total units, the department name, the course description, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title, and the school name from the SIS_SUBJECT_CODE table, ordered by total units descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.TERM_CODE, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_enrolled_students, lso.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID INNER JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SCHOOL_CODE, t0.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t0.SCHOOL_CODE = 'E' ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s1.TOTAL_UNITS, s1.avg_enrolled_students, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s2.window_column, s2.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte s1 JOIN Subq2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY s1.TOTAL_UNITS DESC

question: For each subject offered in the term with the description "Fall Term 2024-2025" that also has more than 0 enrolled students and a material status key of 'U', show the subject offered key, subject title, offering department name, the term description, the rank of each subject within its offering department ordered by subject offered key, the course number, course number description, number of enrolled students, the reserve catalog key, the dense rank over the material status key ordered by material status key, and whether the number of enrolled students is 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10 students), 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' (1-2 students), or 'MEDIUM_ENROLLMENT' (otherwise), with the columns listed in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS window_column, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT t1.COURSE_NUMBER, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) AS window_column, t1.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ), CombinedSubjects AS ( SELECT s1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.window_column AS dept_rank, s2.COURSE_NUMBER, s2.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, s2.window_column AS material_status_rank FROM Subq1 s1 JOIN Subq2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, TERM_DESCRIPTION, dept_rank, COURSE_NUMBER, COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, material_status_rank FROM CombinedSubjects ) SELECT TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, TERM_DESCRIPTION, dept_rank, COURSE_NUMBER, COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, material_status_rank, CASE WHEN NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 10 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'MEDIUM_ENROLLMENT' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte ORDER BY TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COURSE_NUMBER;

question: For each space unit with a space unit code of 97500, show the space unit name, space unit code, associated organization name, department count, number of supervisees, the average department count within each department count group, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the old department codes among its associated HR organization units (only including organizations where the average old department code is greater than zero), and the HR organization unit title, ordered by number of supervisees. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.DEPT_COUNT, t2.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, AVG(t2.DEPT_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPT_COUNT ORDER BY t2.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS avg_dept_count_within_group, t0.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DEPT_NAMES WHERE t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 97500 ), org_coeff_var AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) / NULLIF(AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY, HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY, HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE HAVING AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) > 0 ) SELECT s.space_unit_name, s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, s.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s.DEPT_COUNT, s.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, s.avg_dept_count_within_group, o.coefficient_of_variation, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE FROM inner_cte s LEFT JOIN org_coeff_var o ON s.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY ORDER BY s.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES

question: For subjects offered in the term with code '2022FA', show the subject ID, department name, term description, and the running sum of total units within each academic year. Additionally, for each offering department and school where the course material status is 'RQ', show the number of unique subjects and the minimum total units. For each offering department and school, also include a grand total for all subjects in the format of (offering department name, offering school name, null, total subjects, min total units). Order the results by offering department name, offering school name, and subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t1.TERM_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ), DeptSchoolAgg AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_ID, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_ID ), DeptSchoolRollup AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(min_total_units) AS min_total_units FROM DeptSchoolAgg GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, SUBJECT_ID WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) > 0 ) SELECT dsr.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dsr.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, dsr.SUBJECT_ID, dsr.subject_count, dsr.min_total_units, icte.SUBJECT_ID AS cte_subject_id, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.window_column FROM DeptSchoolRollup dsr LEFT JOIN inner_cte icte ON dsr.SUBJECT_ID = icte.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY dsr.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dsr.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, dsr.SUBJECT_ID

question: For each department name and its corresponding organization key where the department is in the Provost Area, and for each organization and its associated space unit where the organization is assignable and the space unit code is greater than 50000, list the department name, organization key, number of organizations, minimum department hierarchy level 3 code, organization, space unit, number of space units, and minimum organization number. Include subtotals for each department (the corresponding department field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all departments (the corresponding department field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the department name if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by department name and organization. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptProvostStats AS ( SELECT m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_CODE) AS min_level3_code FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ), OrgSpaceStats AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION, s.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS space_unit_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_org_number, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION o JOIN SPACE_UNIT s ON o.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE > 50000 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION, s.SPACE_UNIT, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) SELECT dps.DLC_NAME, dps.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, dps.org_count, dps.min_level3_code, oss.ORGANIZATION, oss.SPACE_UNIT, oss.space_unit_count, oss.min_org_number FROM DeptProvostStats dps JOIN OrgSpaceStats oss ON dps.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = oss.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(DLC_NAME) OVER (ORDER BY dlc_sort, org_sort) = DLC_NAME THEN NULL ELSE DLC_NAME END AS department, FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, org_count, min_level3_code, ORGANIZATION, SPACE_UNIT, space_unit_count, min_org_number FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(DLC_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(ORGANIZATION) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DLC_NAME END AS dlc_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DLC_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(ORGANIZATION) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(DLC_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(ORGANIZATION) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE DLC_NAME END AS DLC_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, org_count, min_level3_code, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DLC_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(ORGANIZATION) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE ORGANIZATION END AS org_sort, ORGANIZATION, SPACE_UNIT, space_unit_count, min_org_number FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DLC_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, org_count, min_level3_code, ORGANIZATION, SPACE_UNIT, space_unit_count, min_org_number WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY dlc_sort, org_sort;

question: For each space unit that has rooms on floor 2 and a space unit key greater than 100000, what is the name of the space unit, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the access levels of its associated rooms on floor 2, the organization name, the HR department name, and the HR org unit title, as well as the sum of space unit keys within each warehouse load date group, ordered by space unit key? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH space_unit_access_stats AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, VARIANCE(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_variance, STDDEV(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS access_level_stddev FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD zr ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = zr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE zr.FLOOR = 2 GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ORDER BY access_level_variance DESC ), space_unit_org_window AS ( SELECT t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE ORDER BY t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM SPACE_UNIT t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000 ) SELECT s1.SPACE_UNIT, s1.access_level_variance, s1.access_level_stddev, s2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.window_column, zr.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM space_unit_access_stats s1 JOIN space_unit_org_window s2 ON s1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = s2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD zr ON s1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = zr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE zr.FLOOR = 2 ) SELECT inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT, inner_cte.access_level_variance, inner_cte.access_level_stddev, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID ORDER BY inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2022 with a total of 12 units, show the subject code, subject number, department name, subject title, term description, total units, and the average subject enrollment number in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by department code and ordered by total units, along with the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in library subjects that have a matching master subject ID in the TIP subject offerings for the same department, considering only departments with more than 0 enrolled students in both tables. Additionally, for each result, include the maximum subject enrollment number for that department and total units combination across all terms. List the subject code, subject number, department name, subject title, term description, total units, windowed average subject enrollment number, library students variance, library students standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and the maximum subject enrollment number in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) OVER ( PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), LibraryStats AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_students_variance, STDDEV(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_students_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = t.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY library_students_variance DESC ), MaxEnrollment AS ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, MAX(t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_subject_enrollment FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.TOTAL_UNITS ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.TOTAL_UNITS, s.window_column, ls.library_students_variance, ls.library_students_stddev, me.max_subject_enrollment FROM inner_cte s JOIN LibraryStats ls ON s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ls.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN MaxEnrollment me ON s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = me.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s.TOTAL_UNITS = me.TOTAL_UNITS ORDER BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_NUMBER

question: For each academic term where the term status indicator is 'P', show the term code, the term parameter, the term description, the academic year, the term start date, and the average academic year in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the term indicator and ordered by the term start date. Additionally, for the academic year of each such term, give the academic year description, the average total units, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in regular terms, and for each such subject, show the subject code, subject number, and subject title, with the results ordered by term code and by the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH AcademicYearStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ), PreviousTerms AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_PARAMETER, t2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, AVG(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER ( PARTITION BY t1.TERM_INDICATOR ORDER BY t0.TERM_START_DATE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_INDICATOR = 'P' ) SELECT pts.TERM_CODE, pts.TERM_PARAMETER, pts.TERM_DESCRIPTION, pts.ACADEMIC_YEAR, pts.TERM_START_DATE, pts.window_column, ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ays.avg_total_units, ays.stddev_total_units FROM PreviousTerms pts JOIN AcademicYearStats ays ON pts.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.TERM_PARAMETER, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units, cso.SUBJECT_CODE, cso.SUBJECT_NUMBER, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.stddev_total_units DESC;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2022 with a total of 12 units, show the subject code, subject number, department name, subject title, term description, total units, and the average subject enrollment number in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by department code and ordered by total units, along with the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in library subjects that have a matching master subject ID in the TIP subject offerings for the same department (considering only departments with more than 0 enrolled students in both tables). Additionally, for each such department, show the maximum number of enrolled students in any library subject for that department. List the subject code, subject number, department name, subject title, term description, total units, windowed average subject enrollment number, library students variance, library students standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and the maximum number of enrolled students in library subjects for the department, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
