SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) OVER ( PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS join_dept_name FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), library_stats AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_students_variance, STDDEV(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_students_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = t.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), library_max_enroll AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_library_enrollment FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_NUMBER, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.TOTAL_UNITS, i.window_column, ls.library_students_variance, ls.library_students_stddev, lm.max_library_enrollment FROM inner_cte i JOIN library_stats ls ON i.join_dept_name = ls.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN library_max_enroll lm ON i.join_dept_name = lm.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_NUMBER;

question: For subjects offered in the term 2019FA, and for courses in the 'Engineering' school with a total of 12 units, show the subject ID, subject title (from 2019FA), number of enrolled students, department name, department full name, row number within each department name group ordered by subject ID, course number, course description, subject title (from 12-unit Engineering courses), total units, offering department name, and row number within each offering department ordered by course number, as well as the department's school name, for cases where the offering department code matches between the two sets. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE AS course_number, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.COURSE) AS window_column, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_title_2019fa, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.window_column AS subject_window_column, s2.course_number, s2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_title_12units, s2.TOTAL_UNITS, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.window_column AS course_window_column, s1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = s2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.subject_title_2019fa, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.subject_window_column, inner_cte.course_number, inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.subject_title_12units, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.course_window_column, d.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: For IAP subject activities with a maximum enrollment of 30, and for tip details where the material status key is 'RQ', show the activity title, enrollment type, prerequisites, term code, IAP term description, term start date, term end date, the minimum term start date over each term code group, the tip subject offered key, tip material key, subject ID, tip term description, academic year, the average record count in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by academic year, and the academic year description, ordered by term code and academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH IAPActivities AS ( SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t0.PREREQUISITES, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, min(t1.TERM_START_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.TERM_CODE ORDER BY t0.TERM_CODE) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 30 ), TipRQDetails AS ( SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(t0.RECORD_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_START_DATE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM TIP_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ) SELECT ia.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ia.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, ia.PREREQUISITES, ia.TERM_CODE, ia.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS IAP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, ia.TERM_START_DATE, ia.TERM_END_DATE, ia.window_column AS IAP_MIN_TERM_START_DATE, trd.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, trd.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, trd.SUBJECT_ID, trd.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS TIP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, trd.ACADEMIC_YEAR, trd.window_column AS TIP_AVG_RECORD_COUNT FROM IAPActivities ia JOIN TipRQDetails trd ON ia.TERM_CODE = trd.TERM_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.PREREQUISITES, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.IAP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.TERM_END_DATE, inner_cte.IAP_MIN_TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.TIP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.TIP_AVG_RECORD_COUNT, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each student in the "Electrical Eng & Computer Sci" department, show their full name, email address, department name, course description, course level, and their row number within each course level group ordered by the student's last name, along with the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by their department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units). Additionally, display the name of the school their department belongs to and the number of students in the same department. List the results ordered by the row number within each course level group. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DepartmentUnits AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ), EECSStudents AS ( SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.COURSE_LEVEL ORDER BY t2.LAST_NAME) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT eecs.FULL_NAME, eecs.EMAIL_ADDRESS, eecs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, eecs.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, eecs.COURSE_LEVEL, eecs.window_column, du.avg_total_units, du.stddev_total_units, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, dept_student_counts.student_count FROM EECSStudents eecs JOIN DepartmentUnits du ON eecs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = du.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON eecs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY GROUP BY DEPARTMENT ) dept_student_counts ON eecs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dept_student_counts.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY eecs.window_column ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte;

question: For subjects offered in the 2012SU term with a cluster type of 'S' and offered by the Harvard Cross-Enrollment Program, provide the subject key, subject title, department name, the number of subject offerings, the total number of units for those offerings, the dense rank of each subject considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the number of enrolled students in the offered table, and classify each subject as 'HIGH_UNIT' if its total units are at least 10% greater than the average total units for such subjects, 'LOW_UNIT' if at least 10% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. List the results ordered by the total number of units in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t2.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t0.CLUSTER_TYPE = 'S' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT so.SUBJECT_KEY, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS offering_count, SUM(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units, so.SUBJECT_ID_SORT FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON sos.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' GROUP BY so.SUBJECT_KEY, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, so.SUBJECT_ID_SORT ) SELECT sq2.SUBJECT_KEY, sq2.SUBJECT_TITLE, sq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sq2.offering_count, sq2.total_units, sq1.window_column, sq2.SUBJECT_ID_SORT FROM Subquery2 sq2 JOIN Subquery1 sq1 ON sq2.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = sq1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT ), unit_benchmark AS ( SELECT AVG(total_units) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_KEY, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.offering_count, ic.total_units, ic.window_column, CASE WHEN ic.total_units > ub.avg_total_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN ic.total_units < ub.avg_total_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN unit_benchmark ub ORDER BY ic.total_units DESC

question: For space units with a space unit code equal to 97500, show the space unit name, the associated organization's name, the DLC name, the DLC key from the organization, the minimum space unit code in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the facility organization key, as well as the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of organizations associated with that DLC key (considering only DLC keys that are not null and organizations that have a non-null organization name), and also include the description of the organization and the warehouse load date of the space unit. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS organization_name, t1.DLC_NAME AS dlc_name, t1.DLC_KEY AS org_dlc_key, MIN(t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) OVER ( ORDER BY t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_min_space_unit_code FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 97500 ) SELECT icte.space_unit_name, icte.organization_name, icte.dlc_name, icte.org_dlc_key, icte.window_min_space_unit_code, dos.org_count_range, dos.org_count_variance, dos.org_count_stddev, fo.DESCRIPTION AS organization_description, su.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE AS space_unit_warehouse_load_date FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ( SELECT fdlk.DLC_KEY, MAX(org_count) - MIN(org_count) AS org_count_range, VARIANCE(org_count) AS org_count_variance, STDDEV(org_count) AS org_count_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fdlk JOIN ( SELECT fo.DLC_KEY, COUNT(*) AS org_count FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fo.DLC_KEY ) org_stats ON fdlk.DLC_KEY = org_stats.DLC_KEY WHERE fdlk.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fdlk.DLC_KEY ORDER BY org_count_range DESC ) dos ON icte.org_dlc_key = dos.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON icte.org_dlc_key = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON icte.org_dlc_key = su.DLC_KEY AND su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 97500;

question: For all subjects in the 2014FA term with at least one enrolled student, show the subject title, offering department name, responsible faculty name, the TIP material status key, the total number of units, and the minimum total number of units in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the course number. Additionally, for the offering department, provide the department name, the average and variance of the department's subject codes' course numbers (using their ASCII values), considering only departments that are degree granting. Also, include the department's full name and school name. The results are ordered by offering department name and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.window_column, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, stats.avg_course_number_ascii, stats.var_course_number_ascii FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VARIANCE(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) stats ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = stats.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For each department, list the department name, the range and variance of the areas of rooms assigned to it (considering only rooms with an area greater than 40), the range and variance of the space unit codes associated with it (considering only organizations that have a non-null description and space units with a non-null space unit name), and the total number of unique buildings in which the department has rooms with area greater than 40, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DepartmentRoomStats AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 40 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY area_range DESC ), OrganizationSpaceUnitStats AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAX(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) - MIN(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS code_range, VARIANCE(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS code_variance FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY odk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON odk.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL AND su.SPACE_UNIT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY code_range DESC ) SELECT drs.ORGANIZATION_NAME, drs.area_range, drs.area_variance, oss.code_range, oss.code_variance FROM DepartmentRoomStats drs JOIN OrganizationSpaceUnitStats oss ON drs.ORGANIZATION_NAME = oss.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY drs.area_range DESC, oss.code_range DESC ) SELECT icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.area_range, icte.area_variance, icte.code_range, icte.code_variance, COALESCE(bldg_stats.building_count, 0) AS unique_building_count FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) AS building_count FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 40 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) bldg_stats ON icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = bldg_stats.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY icte.area_range DESC, icte.code_range DESC;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year, academic year description, the geometric mean of the number of library reserve material details per subject offered (considering only records where the material status is 'U' and the academic term is a regular term), the average of the total units, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units, and the average lecture units for subjects that are offered in the fall term and have a material status of 'U' in the library reserve? Present the results ordered by the geometric mean of materials per subject in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH GeometricMeanMaterialsPerSubject AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(material_count))) AS geometric_mean_materials_per_subject FROM ( SELECT LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count, LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE ) sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON sub.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), AvgStddevTotalUnitsFallU AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT gmmps.ACADEMIC_YEAR, gmmps.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gmmps.geometric_mean_materials_per_subject, astu.avg_total_units, astu.stddev_total_units FROM GeometricMeanMaterialsPerSubject gmmps LEFT JOIN AvgStddevTotalUnitsFallU astu ON gmmps.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = astu.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_materials_per_subject, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units, avg_lecture_units.avg_lecture_units FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) AS avg_lecture_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) avg_lecture_units ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = avg_lecture_units.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean_materials_per_subject DESC;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year, the academic year description, the variance of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during terms in that year (considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the number of enrolled students is greater than 0), as well as the minimum academic year and the sum of total units for subjects that are offered in the fall term, have library reserve material details with material status 'U', and are undergraduate subjects (HGN_CODE = 'U')? List the academic year, academic year description, enrolled students variance, minimum academic year, and total units sum in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ), MinYearTotalUnitsUG AS ( SELECT MIN(at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_sum FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.HGN_CODE = 'U' ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, mytu.min_academic_year, mytu.total_units_sum FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN MinYearTotalUnitsUG mytu;

question: For each department in the School of Engineering, for subjects with at least 6 total units offered in the most recent academic year, give the department name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the most recent academic year, along with the subject ID, subject title, the running sum of total units within each school, and the responsible faculty name, ordered by the range of total units (descending) and subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.SUBJECT_ID WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ) GROUP BY COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ), EngineeringSubjectsWithFaculty AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance, esf.SUBJECT_ID, esf.SUBJECT_TITLE, esf.window_column, esf.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte dus JOIN EngineeringSubjectsWithFaculty esf ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = esf.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dus.total_units_range DESC, esf.SUBJECT_ID

question: For the top 10 subject titles by the number of reserve materials assigned, including the department name and the term code, also provide for each subject the total number of unique instructors who have assigned reserved materials (where the material status is 'U'), as well as the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of reserved materials per subject. Show the subject title, department name, term code, number of reserve materials, number of unique instructors, reserved material range, reserved material variance, and reserved material standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_reserve_materials FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE ORDER BY num_reserve_materials DESC LIMIT 10 ), SubjectReserveStats AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(material_count) - MIN(material_count) AS reserved_material_range, VARIANCE(material_count) AS reserved_material_variance, STDDEV(material_count) AS reserved_material_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED s JOIN ( SELECT LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL WHERE LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ) d ON s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY reserved_material_range DESC ), SubjectInstructorStats AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(DISTINCT lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY) AS num_unique_instructors FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.TERM_CODE, icte.num_reserve_materials, sis.num_unique_instructors, srs.reserved_material_range, srs.reserved_material_variance, srs.reserved_material_stddev FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN SubjectReserveStats srs ON icte.SUBJECT_TITLE = srs.SUBJECT_TITLE LEFT JOIN SubjectInstructorStats sis ON icte.SUBJECT_TITLE = sis.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY icte.num_reserve_materials DESC, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For organizations with an organization level of 5, show the organization name, organization ID, DLC name, HR org unit title, HR department name, HR org unit level, and assign row numbers within each HR department name group ordered by organization name. For each such organization, for each room with area greater than 200 and assignable major use that belongs to the organization, show the building room, floor, room number, space ID, area, major use name, major use description, and the minimum area value over each major use group. Additionally, for each such room, show the HR org unit title and HR org unit level from the HR_ORG_UNIT table that matches the DLC_KEY of the organization. Present the results with the columns: organization name, organization ID, DLC name, HR org unit title, HR department name, HR org unit level, row number, building room, floor, room number, space ID, area, major use name, major use description, minimum area per major use, HR org unit title (from HR_ORG_UNIT), and HR org unit level (from HR_ORG_UNIT), in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH OrgLevel5 AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID, t1.DLC_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS window_column, t0.DLC_KEY, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID AS org_id FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ), LargeAssignableRooms AS ( SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.ROOM, t1.SPACE_ID, t1.AREA, t0.MAJOR_USE, t0.DESCRIPTION, min(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY ORDER BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY) AS min_area_per_major_use, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_MAJOR_USE t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 200 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1 ) SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.ORGANIZATION_ID, o.DLC_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, o.window_column, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.FLOOR, r.ROOM, r.SPACE_ID, r.AREA, r.MAJOR_USE, r.DESCRIPTION, r.min_area_per_major_use, o.DLC_KEY FROM OrgLevel5 o JOIN LargeAssignableRooms r ON o.ORGANIZATION_ID = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) SELECT i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.ORGANIZATION_ID, i.DLC_NAME, i.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, i.window_column, i.BUILDING_ROOM, i.FLOOR, i.ROOM, i.SPACE_ID, i.AREA, i.MAJOR_USE, i.DESCRIPTION, i.min_area_per_major_use, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE AS HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE_FROM_HR, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL AS HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL_FROM_HR FROM inner_cte i JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON i.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY

question: For each current academic term, list the term code, term description, academic year, the number of subjects offered, the total subject enrollment number for that term, the academic year description, and for that academic year, the average, range, and variance of the record counts for TIP materials (considering only terms where the term status is not null and the TIP material status is not 'NM'). Additionally, for each department within the current term, include the department code, department name, the number of subjects offered by that department, and the total subject enrollment for that department in that term. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), AcademicYearTipStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_record_count, MAX(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) - MIN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_range, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS IS NOT NULL AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), CurrentTermDepartmentStats AS ( SELECT atp.TERM_CODE, ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS dept_subject_count, SUM(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS dept_total_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY atp.TERM_CODE, ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ict.TERM_CODE, ict.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ict.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ict.subject_count, ict.total_enrollment, ayts.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ayts.avg_record_count, ayts.record_count_range, ayts.record_count_variance, ctds.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ctds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ctds.dept_subject_count, ctds.dept_total_enrollment FROM inner_cte ict JOIN AcademicYearTipStats ayts ON ict.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ayts.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN CurrentTermDepartmentStats ctds ON ict.TERM_CODE = ctds.TERM_CODE ORDER BY ict.TERM_CODE, ctds.DEPARTMENT_CODE

question: From the top 10 organizations with the highest number of associated space units (with warehouse load date '19-DEC-24'), display each organization's key, name, DLC name, the number of space units, the rank of the organization within each DLC name group ordered by organization key, and for each organization, show the HR department name most frequently linked to its space units (considering only HR org units with warehouse load date '03-DEC-24'), along with the count of HR org units for that department. Present the results ordered by the number of space units descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fo.DLC_NAME, COUNT(su.SPACE_UNIT) AS space_unit_count FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY WHERE su.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' GROUP BY fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fo.DLC_NAME ORDER BY space_unit_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), OrgRanks AS ( SELECT icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.DLC_NAME, icte.space_unit_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY icte.DLC_NAME ORDER BY icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_rank FROM inner_cte icte ), HRDeptStats AS ( SELECT fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS hr_org_unit_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY COUNT(hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) DESC) AS dept_rank FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE su.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND hou.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '03-DEC-24' GROUP BY fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.DLC_NAME, o.space_unit_count, o.org_rank, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Most_Frequent_HR_Department, h.hr_org_unit_count FROM OrgRanks o LEFT JOIN HRDeptStats h ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = h.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY AND h.dept_rank = 1 ORDER BY o.space_unit_count DESC;

question: For the top 10 subject titles by the number of materials offered in regular academic terms, provide the subject title, department name, total count of materials, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students, and the average number of enrolled students for each subject, but only for departments that offer courses with at least one associated TIP material and where the average enrollment per subject is greater than 5. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON td.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND td.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY material_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS num_enrolled_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS num_enrolled_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), SubjectEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS subject_enrolled_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS subject_enrolled_stddev FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ss.SUBJECT_ID = lso.SUBJECT_ID AND ss.TERM_CODE = lso.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ict.SUBJECT_TITLE, ict.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ict.material_count, des.num_enrolled_variance, des.num_enrolled_stddev, ses.avg_enrolled_students, ses.subject_enrolled_variance, ses.subject_enrolled_stddev FROM inner_cte ict JOIN DepartmentEnrollmentStats des ON ict.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.department JOIN SubjectEnrollmentStats ses ON ict.SUBJECT_TITLE = ses.SUBJECT_TITLE AND ict.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ses.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE ses.avg_enrolled_students > 5 ORDER BY ict.material_count DESC, des.num_enrolled_variance DESC;

question: For each space unit that belongs to a DLC with more than five organizations, and where the average room square footage in the space unit is greater than the overall average room square footage, provide the space unit name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the room square footage for all rooms in that space unit, the DLC name, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the organization numbers for organizations associated with that DLC. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH SpaceUnitStats AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, su.DLC_KEY, AVG(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS avg_room_sqft, STDDEV(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS stddev_room_sqft FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, su.DLC_KEY ORDER BY stddev_room_sqft DESC ), DLCOrgStats AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY, STDDEV(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY.DLC_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER IS NOT NULL GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY org_number_stddev DESC ) SELECT sus.SPACE_UNIT, sus.avg_room_sqft, sus.stddev_room_sqft, dos.DLC_NAME, dos.org_number_stddev FROM SpaceUnitStats sus JOIN DLCOrgStats dos ON sus.DLC_KEY = dos.DLC_KEY ) SELECT SPACE_UNIT, avg_room_sqft, stddev_room_sqft, DLC_NAME, org_number_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_room_sqft > (SELECT AVG(ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) FROM SPACE_DETAIL);

question: For each of the 5 departments that offer the largest number of unique subjects, show the department code, department name, the total number of unique subjects they offer, and for each subject offering in the term '2017FA' with a total number of units greater than 10 in that department, show the subject title, its dense rank considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the department code, and the number of enrolled students in that subject. For each department, include a grand total of enrolled students for all such subject offerings in the format of (department code, department name, total unique subjects, null, null, total enrolled students). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptSubjectCounts AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY num_subjects DESC LIMIT 5 ), SubjectOfferings AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t2.SUBJECT_ID FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS > 10 ) SELECT dsc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dsc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dsc.num_subjects, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, so.window_column, sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM DeptSubjectCounts dsc JOIN SubjectOfferings so ON dsc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = so.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON so.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' ) , RollupResults AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, num_subjects, SUBJECT_TITLE, window_column, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, num_subjects, SUBJECT_TITLE, window_column WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) IS NOT NULL ) SELECT rr.DEPARTMENT_CODE, rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.num_subjects, rr.SUBJECT_TITLE, rr.window_column, rr.total_enrolled_students FROM RollupResults rr ORDER BY rr.DEPARTMENT_CODE, rr.window_column, rr.SUBJECT_TITLE ;

question: For each department and its associated DLC, provide the department name, the total number of organizations associated with that department for organizations whose parent is 'EXECVP' or 'CHNCLR' (where the total number of organizations is greater than 5), the DLC name, the average organization number, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the organization numbers for assignable organizations associated with that DLC, and the full department name (HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG) from the HR_ORG_UNIT table. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS total_organizations, h.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON d.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON f.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY WHERE f.ORG_PARENT IN ('EXECVP', 'CHNCLR') GROUP BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, h.DLC_KEY HAVING COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) > 5 ) SELECT cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte.total_organizations, s.DLC_NAME, s.avg_org_number, s.org_number_stddev, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG FROM inner_cte cte JOIN ( SELECT o.DLC_NAME, AVG(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS avg_org_number, STDDEV(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev, o.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 GROUP BY o.DLC_NAME, o.DLC_KEY ) s ON cte.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON cte.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY;

question: From the top 10 offering departments and schools with the highest average enrolled students in courses where the course material status is 'RQ', show each department and school name, the average and variance of enrolled students, the number of unique subjects, the minimum total units for those subjects, and the subject with the highest enrollment (including its subject title and enrollment count). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.RECORD_COUNT >= 1 AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC ), DeptSchoolSubjectStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT dss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dss.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_variance, dss.subject_count, dss.min_total_units FROM DeptSchoolSubjectStats dss LEFT JOIN DeptEnrollmentStats des ON dss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY des.avg_enrollment DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, icte.avg_enrollment, icte.enrollment_variance, icte.subject_count, icte.min_total_units, sos.SUBJECT_ID AS top_subject_id, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE AS top_subject_title, sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS top_subject_enrollment FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC ) AS rn FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ) sos ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND icte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME AND sos.rn = 1 ORDER BY icte.avg_enrollment DESC;

question: For subjects offered in the term with code '2025FA' that have at least one reserved material with material status 'U', show the subject ID, subject title, offering department name, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, term start date, term end date, term parameter, the minimum number of enrolled students over each offering department, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of reserved materials per subject, as well as the offering school name and responsible faculty name. Order the results by offering department and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), SubjectReservedMaterialStats AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(material_count) - MIN(material_count) AS reserved_material_range, VARIANCE(material_count) AS reserved_material_variance, STDDEV(material_count) AS reserved_material_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED s JOIN ( SELECT LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL WHERE LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ) d ON s.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY reserved_material_range DESC ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.TERM_START_DATE, icte.TERM_END_DATE, icte.TERM_PARAMETER, icte.min_enrolled_students_per_dept, srms.reserved_material_range, srms.reserved_material_variance, srms.reserved_material_stddev, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, tso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SubjectReservedMaterialStats srms ON icte.SUBJECT_TITLE = srms.SUBJECT_TITLE LEFT JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON icte.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID AND icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION = (SELECT TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL WHERE TERM_CODE = '2025FA') ORDER BY icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For each of the top 10 department names in the Provost Area (by number of faculty organizations), list the department name, the number of faculty organizations, the organization and its associated space unit (where the organization is assignable and the space unit code is greater than 50000), the number of space units, the minimum organization number, and the department's hierarchy level 3 name, ordered by the number of faculty organizations and then by the number of space units. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH OrgSpaceUnits AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION, s.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS space_unit_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_org_number, o.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION o JOIN SPACE_UNIT s ON o.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE > 50000 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION, s.SPACE_UNIT, o.DLC_KEY ), TopProvostDepts AS ( SELECT m.DLC_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, m.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME, m.DLC_KEY ORDER BY org_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT tpd.DLC_NAME, tpd.org_count, osu.ORGANIZATION, osu.SPACE_UNIT, osu.space_unit_count, osu.min_org_number, tpd.DLC_KEY FROM TopProvostDepts tpd JOIN OrgSpaceUnits osu ON tpd.DLC_KEY = osu.DLC_KEY ) SELECT icte.DLC_NAME, icte.org_count, icte.ORGANIZATION, icte.SPACE_UNIT, icte.space_unit_count, icte.min_org_number, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME FROM inner_cte icte JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m ON icte.DLC_KEY = m.DLC_KEY ORDER BY icte.org_count DESC, icte.space_unit_count DESC;

question: For all subjects in the 2014FA term with at least one enrolled student, show the subject title, offering department name, responsible faculty name, the TIP material status key, the total number of units, and the minimum total number of units in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the course number, along with the maximum subject enrollment number and the term start date for the corresponding department in the current academic term, considering only departments where the maximum subject enrollment number is greater than 5. Additionally, for each subject, display the subject's cluster type description and the total number of subjects offered by the same department in 2014FA. The columns should be shown in the following order: subject title, offering department name, responsible faculty name, TIP material status key, total number of units, the minimum total number of units in the window, maximum subject enrollment number, term start date, cluster type description, and department subject count. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_dept_name, sos.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC, sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), Sub2 AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_enrollment, at.TERM_START_DATE FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 5 ), DeptCount AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS department_subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY WHERE TERM_CODE = '2014FA' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, icte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, icte.TOTAL_UNITS, icte.window_column, s2.max_enrollment, s2.TERM_START_DATE, icte.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC, dc.department_subject_count FROM inner_cte icte JOIN Sub2 s2 ON icte.join_dept_name = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN DeptCount dc ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = dc.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each department in the Provost Area, show the department code, department name, school area name, the rank of each department within its school area based on department code, the space unit code, the organization name, the HR department name from the space unit, the sum of space unit keys within each warehouse load date group for space units with a space unit key greater than 100000, and the description of the organization from the facilities organization table. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH ProvostDepartments AS ( SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 INNER JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' ), SpaceUnitStats AS ( SELECT t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE ORDER BY t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column, t2.DLC_KEY, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM SPACE_UNIT t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000 ) SELECT pd.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, pd.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, pd.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, pd.window_column AS department_rank_within_school_area, sus.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, sus.ORGANIZATION_NAME, sus.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS space_unit_hr_department_name, sus.window_column AS sum_space_unit_key_within_warehouse_load_date, sus.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM ProvostDepartments pd JOIN SpaceUnitStats sus ON pd.DLC_KEY = sus.DLC_KEY ) SELECT inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, inner_cte.department_rank_within_school_area, inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.space_unit_hr_department_name, inner_cte.sum_space_unit_key_within_warehouse_load_date, fo.DESCRIPTION AS organization_description FROM inner_cte JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON inner_cte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT_CODE;

question: For library reserve materials with material status key 'U' and subjects that have more than 0 enrolled students, show the subject ID, library course instructor key, term description, academic year, term start date, the minimum academic year in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by library reserve catalog key, the course number, course number description, number of enrolled students, the dense rank over the material status key ordered by material status key, and the responsible faculty name. Present the results ordered by subject ID and academic year descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t2.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, MIN(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.TERM_START_DATE, icte.window_column AS min_academic_year_window, lso.COURSE_NUMBER, lso.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) AS dense_rank_material_status, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte icte JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm ON icte.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY AND icte.SUBJECT_ID = lrm.SUBJECT_ID JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON lrm.SUBJECT_ID = lso.SUBJECT_ID AND lrm.TERM_CODE = lso.TERM_CODE WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC;

question: For each department hierarchy level 3 and department hierarchy level 2, show the department hierarchy level 3 name, department hierarchy level 2 name, the number of unique space units, the minimum and maximum space unit key, the average organization level, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the organization level for organizations in that department. Include subtotals for each department hierarchy level 3 (the corresponding department hierarchy level 3 field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all department hierarchy level 3s (the corresponding department hierarchy level 3 field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the department hierarchy level 3 name if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by department hierarchy level 3 and department hierarchy level 2. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS organization_name, t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME AS dept_hier_level_3_name, t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME AS dept_hier_level_2_name, t1.DLC_KEY AS department_code, MIN(t2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) OVER (ORDER BY t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = 402410 ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(dept_hier_level_3_name) OVER (ORDER BY dept_hier_level_3_sort, dept_hier_level_2_sort) = dept_hier_level_3_name THEN NULL ELSE dept_hier_level_3_name END AS dept_hier_level_3_name, dept_hier_level_2_name, space_unit_count, min_space_unit_key, max_space_unit_key, avg_org_level, org_level_stddev FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME END AS dept_hier_level_3_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME END AS dept_hier_level_3_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME END AS dept_hier_level_2_sort, MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME AS dept_hier_level_2_name, COUNT(DISTINCT SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS space_unit_count, MIN(SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS min_space_unit_key, MAX(SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS max_space_unit_key, AVG(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) AS avg_org_level, STDDEV(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) AS org_level_stddev FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY GROUP BY MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME WITH ROLLUP ) tbltmp ORDER BY dept_hier_level_3_sort, dept_hier_level_2_sort;

question: For each degree-granting department and course level, list the department name, the average number of enrolled students in offered subjects, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in offered subjects (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students), the course level, the number of unique students, the minimum CIP program code among their courses, the average enrollment per student (average enrollment divided by number of unique students, rounded to two decimals), and the name of the school the department belongs to, ordered by average enrollment per student descending.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC ), DeptStudentCIP AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_variance, des.enrollment_stddev, dsc.COURSE_LEVEL, dsc.student_count, dsc.min_cip_code, ROUND(des.avg_enrollment / NULLIF(dsc.student_count, 0), 2) AS avg_enrollment_per_student, dsc.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte des JOIN DeptStudentCIP dsc ON des.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY avg_enrollment_per_student DESC;

question: For each department, list the top 5 departments by the total number of unique reserved materials assigned (where the material status is 'U'), and for each, also provide the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of reserved materials per term within that department. Show the department name, total number of reserved materials, reserved material range per term, reserved material variance per term, and reserved material standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) per term, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS total_reserved_materials FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY total_reserved_materials DESC LIMIT 5 ), DeptTermStats AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(term_material_count) - MIN(term_material_count) AS reserved_material_range_per_term, VARIANCE(term_material_count) AS reserved_material_variance_per_term, STDDEV(term_material_count) AS reserved_material_stddev_per_term FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ( SELECT lso2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso2.TERM_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT lrmd2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS term_material_count FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso2 JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd2 ON lso2.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrmd2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY lso2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso2.TERM_CODE ) t ON lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.total_reserved_materials, dts.reserved_material_range_per_term, dts.reserved_material_variance_per_term, dts.reserved_material_stddev_per_term FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN DeptTermStats dts ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: For academic term parameters where the term indicator is 'C', show the term parameter, the term code, the academic year, the department name of the offered subject, the running sum of academic years within each department, and for each department, also provide the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects that have at least one enrolled student and have required course materials. Additionally, for each department and academic year, show the number of unique subjects offered and the number of subjects with variable units. Present the results ordered by department name and academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ), TermDeptWindow AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_PARAMETER, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_INDICATOR = 'C' ) SELECT tdw.TERM_PARAMETER, tdw.TERM_CODE, tdw.ACADEMIC_YEAR, tdw.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tdw.window_column, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance FROM TermDeptWindow tdw JOIN DeptUnitsStats dus ON tdw.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT icte.TERM_PARAMETER, icte.TERM_CODE, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.window_column, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_range, icte.total_units_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT cso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects, SUM(CASE WHEN cso.IS_VARIABLE_UNITS = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_variable_unit_subjects FROM inner_cte icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON icte.TERM_CODE = cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE AND icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY icte.TERM_PARAMETER, icte.TERM_CODE, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.window_column, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_range, icte.total_units_variance ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR

question: For each employee type and department name where the student year is 'G', and for each subject offered in the term '2017JA' in that department, provide the employee type, department name, number of people, minimum MIT ID, subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, department full name, subject code, subject code description, and the maximum number of enrolled students over each subject code group, as well as the school name of the offering department, ordered by employee type, department name, and subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH EmployeeTypeDeptStats AS ( SELECT sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(sp.MIT_ID) AS person_count, MIN(sp.MIT_ID) AS min_mit_id FROM SE_PERSON sp JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), SubjectOfferStats AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' ) SELECT e.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.person_count, e.min_mit_id, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s.window_column FROM EmployeeTypeDeptStats e JOIN SubjectOfferStats s ON e.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.person_count, inner_cte.min_mit_id, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, MAX(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE) AS max_enrolled_students_per_code, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE

question: For each of the top 10 subjects offered in the term with term code '2012SU' that are also offered in the academic year 2012 with a cluster type of 'SWE: School-Wide Electives', show the subject's title, offer department name, offer school name, cluster type description, the minimum number of enrolled students in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the academic year, the academic year, the running sum of the number of enrolled students within each department ordered by subject key, and the deviation of the subject's current enrolled students from the average enrolled students for that department in 2012, sorted by the running enrollment sum in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, t1.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC, MIN(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.SUBJECT_KEY FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' ), subq2 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_KEY) AS running_enrollment_sum, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 AND t1.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC = 'SWE: School-Wide Electives' ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s1.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC, s1.window_column, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.running_enrollment_sum, s2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.SUBJECT_KEY FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_KEY = s2.SUBJECT_KEY ORDER BY s2.running_enrollment_sum DESC LIMIT 10 ) , dept_avg AS ( SELECT t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, AVG(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t0.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 AND t1.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC = 'SWE: School-Wide Electives' GROUP BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, i.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC, i.window_column, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.running_enrollment_sum, (i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS - d.avg_enrolled_students) AS deviation_from_dept_avg FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY i.running_enrollment_sum DESC;

question: For each department, give the department name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the most recent academic year, and the deviation of each subject's total units from the department's average in that year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.SUBJECT_ID WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ) ) , dept_stats AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_total_units, d.total_units_range, d.total_units_variance, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.TOTAL_UNITS, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - d.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_dept_avg FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_stats d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_ID ;

question: For each previous academic term where the term start date matches the minimum academic term start date for a subject category and academic year with more than 10 maximum enrollment, show the term code, term description, term start date, calendar date, day of week, the average calendar year within each calendar year group ordered by term start date, the subject category key, academic year, number of unique subjects, minimum academic term start date, the normalized subjects per year rounded (number of unique subjects divided by the average calendar year), and for each such term, also list the number of unique subject IDs offered in that term and the earliest preregistration deadline among those subjects.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t0.CALENDAR_DATE, t0.DAY_OF_WEEK, AVG(t0.CALENDAR_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.CALENDAR_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_START_DATE) AS window_column FROM TIME_DAY t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.CALENDAR_DATE = t1.TERM_START_DATE WHERE t1.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ), SubjectCategoryStats AS ( SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT i.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), TermSubjectInfo AS ( SELECT t.TERM_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT td.SUBJECT_ID) AS unique_subject_ids, MIN(i.PREREG_DEADLINE) AS earliest_prereg_deadline FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON t.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL i ON t.TERM_CODE = i.TERM_CODE GROUP BY t.TERM_CODE ) SELECT icte.TERM_CODE, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.TERM_START_DATE, icte.CALENDAR_DATE, icte.DAY_OF_WEEK, icte.window_column, scs.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, scs.ACADEMIC_YEAR, scs.subject_count, scs.min_term_start_date, ROUND(scs.subject_count / NULLIF(icte.window_column, 0), 2) AS Normalized_Subjects_Per_Year, tsi.unique_subject_ids, tsi.earliest_prereg_deadline FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SubjectCategoryStats scs ON icte.TERM_START_DATE = scs.min_term_start_date JOIN TermSubjectInfo tsi ON icte.TERM_CODE = tsi.TERM_CODE ORDER BY Normalized_Subjects_Per_Year DESC;

question: For each degree-granting department that offered at least one subject in the School of Engineering in 2021, and that also has at least one active graduate student with an office location assigned, list the department code, department name, department full name, the number of subjects offered, the total number of enrolled students in those subjects, the total number of active graduate students with an office location assigned, and the average number of enrolled students per subject for that department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH EngDeptSubjects AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ), ActiveGradStudents AS ( SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS total_active_grad_students FROM SE_PERSON s JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY m ON s.FULL_NAME = m.FULL_NAME WHERE s.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND m.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND m.OFFICE_LOCATION IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.DEPARTMENT HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ) SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_CODE, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, e.subject_count, e.total_enrollment, a.total_active_grad_students FROM EngDeptSubjects e JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON e.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN ActiveGradStudents a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.DEPARTMENT ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, subject_count, total_enrollment, total_active_grad_students, CASE WHEN subject_count > 0 THEN CAST(total_enrollment AS FLOAT)/subject_count ELSE NULL END AS avg_enrollment_per_subject FROM inner_cte;

question: For each department, show the department code, department name, and the number of subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with total units equal to 12 and scheduled in rooms of buildings that have subjects offered in the fall term, but only for departments where this count is greater than the average such count across all departments. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), BuildingStats AS ( SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ), DeptSubjectCounts AS ( SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS subject_count FROM inner_cte ds JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON ds.SUBJECT_CODE = cso.SUBJECT_CODE AND ds.SUBJECT_NUMBER = cso.SUBJECT_NUMBER AND ds.TOTAL_UNITS = cso.TOTAL_UNITS JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON cso.MEET_PLACE = fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY JOIN BuildingStats bs ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = bs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE cso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dsc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dsc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dsc.subject_count FROM DeptSubjectCounts dsc WHERE dsc.subject_count > ( SELECT AVG(subject_count) FROM DeptSubjectCounts ) ORDER BY dsc.DEPARTMENT_CODE

question: For each department in the School of Engineering that is degree granting, list the department name, the number of unique courses offered by the department, the number of unique subject code descriptions associated with those courses, and the total number of courses and subject code descriptions for each department. For each school, include a grand total for all courses and subject code descriptions in the format of (school name, null, total courses, total subject code descriptions). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.COURSE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t0.COURSE = t2.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) , DepartmentAggregates AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE) AS unique_courses, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_CODE_DESC) AS unique_subject_code_descs FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME ) , SchoolRollup AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(unique_courses) AS total_courses, SUM(unique_subject_code_descs) AS total_subject_code_descs FROM DepartmentAggregates GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(unique_courses) > 0 ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_courses, total_subject_code_descs FROM SchoolRollup ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: Among organizations at level 5, list the organization name, organization key, description, space unit, space unit key, the average organization key within each organization key group ordered by space unit key, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the access levels of rooms assigned to the space unit, and for each, the space usage type that appears most frequently among its rooms, along with the count of rooms for that usage. Do not return any rounded answers.
