SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.SPACE_UNIT, t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ), SpaceUnitVariation AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, STDDEV(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) / NULLIF(AVG(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD zr ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = zr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE HAVING AVG(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) > 0 ), RoomUsageRanked AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, zr.SPACE_USAGE, COUNT(*) AS usage_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD zr ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = zr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, zr.SPACE_USAGE ) SELECT icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, icte.DESCRIPTION, icte.SPACE_UNIT, icte.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, icte.window_column, suv.coefficient_of_variation, rur.SPACE_USAGE AS most_frequent_space_usage, rur.usage_count AS usage_count_for_space_usage FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SpaceUnitVariation suv ON icte.SPACE_UNIT = suv.SPACE_UNIT AND icte.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = suv.SPACE_UNIT_CODE LEFT JOIN RoomUsageRanked rur ON icte.SPACE_UNIT = rur.SPACE_UNIT AND icte.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = rur.SPACE_UNIT_CODE AND rur.rn = 1

question: For each department, among those that offered subjects in the academic year 2022 and are also listed in the CIS course catalog, what is the department's name, the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department, the average and variance of the total units for its courses that have a non-null subject title and total units greater than 0, and the most common HASS attribute among its offered subjects in 2022? Present the department name, units range, variance of units range, average units, variance of average units, most common HASS attribute, and the count of subjects with that attribute, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH dept_units_range_variance AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC ), dept_avg_variance_units AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_variance DESC ) SELECT dr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dr.units_range, dr.units_variance AS range_variance, da.avg_units, da.units_variance AS avg_variance FROM dept_units_range_variance dr JOIN dept_avg_variance_units da ON dr.DEPARTMENT_NAME = da.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), hass_mode AS ( SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccso.HASS_ATTRIBUTE, COUNT(*) AS hass_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.HASS_ATTRIBUTE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccso.HASS_ATTRIBUTE ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.units_range, icte.range_variance, icte.avg_units, icte.avg_variance, hm.HASS_ATTRIBUTE AS most_common_hass_attribute, hm.hass_count AS hass_attribute_count FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN hass_mode hm ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = hm.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND hm.rn = 1 ORDER BY icte.units_range DESC;

question: For each major use description and organization name where the room area is greater than 100 and the access level is 1, provide the number of rooms, the minimum floor number, the range of the space unit codes, the variance of the space unit codes associated with the organization, and indicate whether the code range is 'LARGE_RANGE' (at least 100000), 'SMALL_RANGE' (less than 10000), or 'MEDIUM_RANGE' (otherwise). List the major use description, organization name, number of rooms, minimum floor number, code range, code variance, and range category in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH RoomStats AS ( SELECT r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count, MIN(r.FLOOR) AS min_floor, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 100 AND r.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 GROUP BY r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ), OrgSpaceStats AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAX(SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) - MIN(SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS code_range, VARIANCE(SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS code_variance, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN SPACE_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = SPACE_UNIT.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) SELECT rs.MAJOR_USE_DESC, rs.ORGANIZATION_NAME, rs.room_count, rs.min_floor, os.code_range, os.code_variance FROM RoomStats rs JOIN OrgSpaceStats os ON rs.ORGANIZATION_NAME = os.ORGANIZATION_NAME AND rs.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = os.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) SELECT inner_cte.MAJOR_USE_DESC, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.room_count, inner_cte.min_floor, inner_cte.code_range, inner_cte.code_variance, CASE WHEN inner_cte.code_range >= 100000 THEN 'LARGE_RANGE' WHEN inner_cte.code_range < 10000 THEN 'SMALL_RANGE' ELSE 'MEDIUM_RANGE' END AS range_category FROM inner_cte;

question: Show the space unit names, their average room square footage, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the room square footage, the DLC name, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the organization numbers for organizations associated with that DLC, and the total number of organizations per DLC for each space unit whose DLC has more than five organizations. List the results ordered by the total number of organizations per DLC in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH SpaceUnitRoomStats AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, su.DLC_KEY, AVG(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS avg_room_sqft, STDDEV(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS stddev_room_sqft FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, su.DLC_KEY ORDER BY stddev_room_sqft DESC ), DLCOrgStddev AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY, STDDEV(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY.DLC_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER IS NOT NULL GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY org_number_stddev DESC ) SELECT srs.SPACE_UNIT, srs.avg_room_sqft, srs.stddev_room_sqft, dos.DLC_NAME, dos.org_number_stddev, dos.DLC_KEY FROM SpaceUnitRoomStats srs JOIN DLCOrgStddev dos ON srs.DLC_KEY = dos.DLC_KEY ) SELECT inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT, inner_cte.avg_room_sqft, inner_cte.stddev_room_sqft, inner_cte.DLC_NAME, inner_cte.org_number_stddev, DLCOrgCount.total_orgs_per_dlc FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT DLC_KEY, COUNT(DISTINCT FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS total_orgs_per_dlc FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY GROUP BY DLC_KEY ) DLCOrgCount ON inner_cte.DLC_KEY = DLCOrgCount.DLC_KEY ORDER BY DLCOrgCount.total_orgs_per_dlc DESC;

question: For subjects offered in the term '2017JA', show the subject title, the number of enrolled students, the responsible faculty name, the offering department name, the department full name, the school name, and the minimum number of enrolled students in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the department code. Additionally, for subjects offered in the term with code '2022FA' in the same department, provide the subject ID, department name, term description, the running sum of total units within each academic year ordered by subject ID, and the subject's short title and responsible faculty name from the course catalog. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS running_sum_total_units, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, t1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS CATALOG_RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.window_column AS min_enrolled_window, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.running_sum_total_units, s2.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, s2.CATALOG_RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte s1 JOIN Subq2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.SUBJECT_ID

question: For subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering that are also offered in the term '2017JA', show the subject title, total units, department full name, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, department full name for the term, subject code, subject code description, and the minimum number of enrolled students over each subject code group, and for each department full name, include a grand total for all subjects in the format of (null, null, department full name, null, null, null, null, null, null, total enrolled students), ordered by department full name and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH EngSubjects AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ), TermSubjects AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' ) SELECT es.SUBJECT_TITLE, es.TOTAL_UNITS, es.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, es.window_column AS eng_window_row_number, ts.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ts.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS term_dept_full_name, ts.SUBJECT_CODE, ts.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ts.window_column AS min_enrolled_by_code FROM EngSubjects es JOIN TermSubjects ts ON es.SUBJECT_TITLE = ts.SUBJECT_TITLE AND es.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ts.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE SUBJECT_TITLE END AS SUBJECT_TITLE, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE TOTAL_UNITS END AS TOTAL_UNITS, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE eng_window_row_number END AS eng_window_row_number, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS END AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE OFFER_DEPT_NAME END AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE term_dept_full_name END AS term_dept_full_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE SUBJECT_CODE END AS SUBJECT_CODE, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE SUBJECT_CODE_DESC END AS SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, TOTAL_UNITS, eng_window_row_number, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, term_dept_full_name, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For each department, display the department's name, the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2022 and that are also listed in the CIS course catalog, as well as the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for all courses offered by that department. Additionally, show the number of subjects in 2022 that have variable units and are listed in the CIS course catalog. Show the results ordered by the range of total units for subjects in 2022 in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC ), dept_course_stats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ), variable_units_count AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS variable_units_subjects_2022 FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.IS_VARIABLE_UNITS = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.units_range, ic.units_variance, dcs.total_units_range, dcs.total_units_variance, dcs.total_units_stddev, COALESCE(vuc.variable_units_subjects_2022, 0) AS variable_units_subjects_2022 FROM inner_cte ic JOIN dept_course_stats dcs ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN variable_units_count vuc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = vuc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ic.units_range DESC;

question: From the top 10 buildings with the highest number of subjects scheduled in rooms during the fall term of 2024, display each building's key, the total number of scheduled subjects, the average total units of those subjects, the department most represented among those subjects, and the count of subjects from that department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS Avg_Total_Units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON c.MEET_PLACE = fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND c.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), BuildingTotals AS ( SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, SUM(Subject_Count) AS Total_Scheduled_Subjects, AVG(Avg_Total_Units) AS Building_Avg_Total_Units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ), DeptRank AS ( SELECT ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.Subject_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY ic.Subject_Count DESC) AS Dept_Rank FROM inner_cte ic ) SELECT bt.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, bt.Total_Scheduled_Subjects, bt.Building_Avg_Total_Units, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Most_Represented_Department, dr.Subject_Count AS Department_Subject_Count FROM BuildingTotals bt LEFT JOIN DeptRank dr ON bt.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = dr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND dr.Dept_Rank = 1 LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON dr.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY bt.Total_Scheduled_Subjects DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Show the department code, department name, the dense rank of each department (considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the department's long name), the department's name, the range and variance of organization numbers for organizations within that department, and the total number of organizations per department, for each department in the "Sloan School of Management" area with a hierarchy type of "Standard Hierarchy" that is also in the "Provost Area" at hierarchy level 2. Order the results by the dense rank and then by the organization number range in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH SloanDepartments AS ( SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column, t1.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME = 'Sloan School of Management Area' ), ProvostDeptStats AS ( SELECT MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME AS department_name, MAX(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) - MIN(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_range, VARIANCE(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance, MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY WHERE MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME, MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY ORDER BY org_number_range DESC ) SELECT sd.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.window_column, pds.department_name, pds.org_number_range, pds.org_number_variance, sd.DLC_KEY FROM SloanDepartments sd JOIN ProvostDeptStats pds ON sd.DLC_KEY = pds.DLC_KEY ) SELECT inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.department_name, inner_cte.org_number_range, inner_cte.org_number_variance, OrgCounts.total_organizations FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY, COUNT(DISTINCT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_ID) AS total_organizations FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY ) AS OrgCounts ON inner_cte.DLC_KEY = OrgCounts.DLC_KEY ORDER BY inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.org_number_range DESC;

question: For each current academic term, list the term code, term description, academic year, the number of subjects offered, the total subject enrollment number for that term, the academic year description, and for that academic year, the average, range, and variance of the record counts for TIP materials (considering only terms where the term status is not null and the TIP material status is not 'NM'), and also include the number of unique departments offering subjects in each current term. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), AcademicYearTipStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_record_count, MAX(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) - MIN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_range, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS IS NOT NULL AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT cts.TERM_CODE, cts.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cts.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cts.subject_count, cts.total_enrollment, ayts.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ayts.avg_record_count, ayts.record_count_range, ayts.record_count_variance, dept_stats.unique_departments FROM inner_cte cts JOIN AcademicYearTipStats ayts ON cts.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ayts.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN ( SELECT ss.TERM_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS unique_departments FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss GROUP BY ss.TERM_CODE ) dept_stats ON cts.TERM_CODE = dept_stats.TERM_CODE ORDER BY cts.TERM_CODE;

question: For each term parameter, what is the maximum number of materials per subject for terms that are not upcoming and have a non-null term start date, and for each such term parameter, for tip details where the material status key is 'EO', show the subject offered key, material key, material status key, term code, subject ID, term description, academic year, and the row number within each academic year group ordered by subject offered key? List the columns in the following order: term parameter, maximum materials per subject, subject offered key, material key, material status key, term code, subject ID, term description, academic year, and row number. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT atp.TERM_PARAMETER, MAX(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS max_materials_per_subject FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON td.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp ON ata.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.TERM_PARAMETER <> 'SIS_UPCOMING_TERM' AND ata.TERM_START_DATE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY atp.TERM_PARAMETER ), EOMaterialDetails AS ( SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS window_column FROM TIP_DETAIL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'EO' ) SELECT ict.TERM_PARAMETER, ict.max_materials_per_subject, eomd.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, eomd.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, eomd.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, eomd.TERM_CODE, eomd.SUBJECT_ID, eomd.TERM_DESCRIPTION, eomd.ACADEMIC_YEAR, eomd.window_column FROM inner_cte ict JOIN EOMaterialDetails eomd ON ict.TERM_PARAMETER = eomd.TERM_PARAMETER ORDER BY ict.max_materials_per_subject DESC, eomd.ACADEMIC_YEAR, eomd.window_column;

question: For subjects in the "Engineering" school during the Fall Term 2024-2025, show the subject title, department name, total units, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title. For each such department and academic year where the number of enrolled students in a subject is greater than 5, also give the number of unique subjects offered and the minimum number of total units for those subjects. Additionally, for each department and academic year, include a grand total for all subjects in the format of (null subject title, department name, total units as null, null window row number, subject count, minimum total units). Present the subject title, department name, total units, window row number, subject count, and minimum total units, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH EngineeringSubjects AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS eng_dept_name, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' AND t2.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ), DeptYearSubjectStats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT es.SUBJECT_TITLE, es.DEPARTMENT_NAME, es.TOTAL_UNITS, es.window_column, dys.subject_count, dys.min_total_units, es.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM EngineeringSubjects es JOIN DeptYearSubjectStats dys ON es.eng_dept_name = dys.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND es.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dys.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT cr.SUBJECT_TITLE, cr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cr.TOTAL_UNITS, cr.window_column, cr.subject_count, cr.min_total_units FROM CombinedResults cr UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, dys.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS TOTAL_UNITS, NULL AS window_column, dys.subject_count, dys.min_total_units FROM DeptYearSubjectStats dys ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE ;

question: For each subject offered by the library in the term with code '2014FA', and for each subject offered in the term with the description "Fall Term 2024-2025" from the same offering department, show the subject ID, library subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, library term description, term start date, term end date, the minimum number of enrolled students for each offering department, TIP subject offered key, TIP subject title, TIP offering department name, TIP term description, the rank of each TIP subject within its offering department, and the total number of TIP subjects per offering department. For each offering department, include a grand total for all TIP subjects in the format of (offering department name, null, total TIP subjects). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH lib_subs AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_per_dept FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' ), tip_subs AS ( SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' ), tip_dept_counts AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS total_tip_subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT ts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ts.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(ts.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS tip_subject_count FROM tip_subs ts GROUP BY ts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ts.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(ts.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) > 0 ) SELECT lib_subs.SUBJECT_ID, lib_subs.SUBJECT_TITLE AS LIB_SUBJECT_TITLE, lib_subs.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lib_subs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lib_subs.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS LIB_TERM_DESCRIPTION, lib_subs.TERM_START_DATE, lib_subs.TERM_END_DATE, lib_subs.min_enrolled_per_dept, tip_subs.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, tip_subs.SUBJECT_TITLE AS TIP_SUBJECT_TITLE, tip_subs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS TIP_OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tip_subs.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS TIP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, tip_subs.window_column, tdc.total_tip_subjects, rr.tip_subject_count FROM lib_subs JOIN tip_subs ON lib_subs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tip_subs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME LEFT JOIN tip_dept_counts tdc ON tip_subs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tdc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME LEFT JOIN RollupResults rr ON tip_subs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = rr.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND (tip_subs.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = rr.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY OR rr.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY IS NULL) ORDER BY lib_subs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tip_subs.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY

question: For each department, list the department name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the most recent academic year, followed by the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in regular academic terms, but only include departments where the average total units in the most recent year is greater than 6 and the variance in regular terms is less than 20. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.SUBJECT_ID WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ( SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ) GROUP BY COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), RegularTermStats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON c.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_total_units AS most_recent_year_avg_total_units, i.total_units_range AS most_recent_year_total_units_range, i.total_units_variance AS most_recent_year_total_units_variance, r.avg_total_units AS regular_term_avg_total_units, r.total_units_range AS regular_term_total_units_range, r.total_units_variance AS regular_term_total_units_variance FROM inner_cte i JOIN RegularTermStats r ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = r.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE i.avg_total_units > 6 AND r.total_units_variance < 20 ORDER BY i.total_units_range DESC, r.total_units_range DESC;

question: For each department-level organization whose DLC key is not null and which has rooms with area greater than 0, and where the organization level is 5, provide the organization name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of rooms assigned to that organization, the dense rank of its corresponding HR department name (considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the HR department code), and the total number of rooms assigned to each organization. For each organization, also include a grand total for the number of rooms in the format of (organization name, null, null, null, total rooms). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH OrgRoomStats AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE d.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND r.AREA > 0 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY area_variance DESC ), OrgHRRanks AS ( SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 ) SELECT ors.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ors.area_variance, ors.area_stddev, ohr.window_column FROM OrgRoomStats ors JOIN OrgHRRanks ohr ON ors.ORGANIZATION_NAME = ohr.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY ors.area_variance DESC ), RoomCounts AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS total_rooms FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE d.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL AND r.AREA > 0 AND o.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.area_variance, ic.area_stddev, ic.window_column, rc.total_rooms FROM inner_cte ic JOIN RoomCounts rc ON ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME = rc.ORGANIZATION_NAME UNION ALL SELECT rc.ORGANIZATION_NAME, NULL AS area_variance, NULL AS area_stddev, NULL AS window_column, rc.total_rooms FROM RoomCounts rc ORDER BY ORGANIZATION_NAME, area_variance DESC

question: For subjects offered in the term '2019FA' with more than 0 enrolled students, and for courses in the 'Engineering' school with a total of 12 units, show the subject title, offer department name, department full name, number of enrolled students, the average number of enrolled students in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the school code, the course number, course description, course subject title, total units, course offering department name, the row number within each course offering department ordered by course number, and whether the number of enrolled students is at least 10% greater than, at least 10% less than, or within 10% of the average windowed enrolled students (as 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT', 'LOW_ENROLLMENT', or 'AVERAGE'), for each pair where the offer department code matches, ordered by subject title and course number. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE AS course_number, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.COURSE) AS window_column, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.window_column AS avg_enrolled_window, s2.course_number, s2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE AS course_subject_title, s2.TOTAL_UNITS, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS course_offer_dept_name, s2.window_column AS course_row_number FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = s2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.avg_enrolled_window, i.course_number, i.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, i.course_subject_title, i.TOTAL_UNITS, i.course_offer_dept_name, i.course_row_number, CASE WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > i.avg_enrolled_window * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < i.avg_enrolled_window * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte i ORDER BY i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.course_number;

question: For subjects offered in the term with code '2025FA' that are also offered by departments in the School of Engineering, show the subject ID, subject title, offering department name, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, term start date, term end date, term parameter, the minimum number of enrolled students over each offering department, total units, department full name, the row number assigned within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title, and the difference between the number of enrolled students and the average number of enrolled students for that offering department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), engineering_subjects_window AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.SUBJECT_ID FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ), dept_avg_enrollment AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE TERM_CODE = '2025FA' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t1.TERM_PARAMETER, t1.min_enrolled_students_per_dept, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, t2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.window_column, (t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS - t3.avg_enrolled_students) AS deviation_from_dept_avg FROM inner_cte t1 JOIN engineering_subjects_window t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID JOIN dept_avg_enrollment t3 ON t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = t3.OFFER_DEPT_NAME

question: For each department in the Provost Area, and for each assignable organization with a space unit code greater than 50000, list the department name, organization key, number of organizations, minimum department hierarchy level 3 code, organization, space unit, number of space units, minimum organization number, and the total number of unique space units associated with the department's organization key. Only include results where the organization key matches between the department and the organization. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptProvostStats AS ( SELECT m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_CODE) AS min_level3_code FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ), OrgSpaceStats AS ( SELECT o.ORGANIZATION, s.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS space_unit_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_org_number, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION o JOIN SPACE_UNIT s ON o.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE > 50000 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION, s.SPACE_UNIT, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) SELECT dps.DLC_NAME, dps.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, dps.org_count, dps.min_level3_code, oss.ORGANIZATION, oss.SPACE_UNIT, oss.space_unit_count, oss.min_org_number FROM DeptProvostStats dps JOIN OrgSpaceStats oss ON dps.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = oss.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) SELECT icte.DLC_NAME, icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, icte.org_count, icte.min_level3_code, icte.ORGANIZATION, icte.SPACE_UNIT, icte.space_unit_count, icte.min_org_number, COUNT(DISTINCT su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS total_unique_space_units FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY GROUP BY icte.DLC_NAME, icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, icte.org_count, icte.min_level3_code, icte.ORGANIZATION, icte.SPACE_UNIT, icte.space_unit_count, icte.min_org_number ORDER BY icte.DLC_NAME, icte.ORGANIZATION, icte.SPACE_UNIT;

question: For each subject code where the department is degree granting, show the subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, whether the department is degree granting ('Degree Granting' if yes, 'Non-Degree Granting' otherwise), and the number of subject codes for each department and subject code. For each department, include a grand total for all subject codes in the format of (department name, null, null, null, degree granting status, total subject codes). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), SubjectCodeCounts AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, SCHOOL_NAME, CASE WHEN IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' THEN 'Degree Granting' ELSE 'Non-Degree Granting' END AS degree_granting_status, COUNT(SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, SCHOOL_NAME, IS_DEGREE_GRANTING WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(SUBJECT_CODE) > 0 ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, SCHOOL_NAME, degree_granting_status, subject_code_count FROM SubjectCodeCounts ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE ;

question: From the top 10 departments and academic years with the highest number of unique subjects (where the subject enrollment number is greater than 10), display each department's name, the academic year, the number of unique subjects, the minimum total units offered, the variance of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one enrolled student and have course materials with a material status of 'RQ', the most represented subject title in that department and year, and the count of students enrolled in that subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), DepartmentEnrolledVariance AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC ), MostPopularSubject AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.SUBJECT_ID, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrolled, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) DESC) AS rn FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.SUBJECT_ID, c.SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.subject_count, icte.min_total_units, dev.enrolled_variance, mps.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Most_Represented_Subject, mps.total_enrolled AS Students_In_Most_Represented_Subject FROM inner_cte icte JOIN DepartmentEnrolledVariance dev ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dev.OFFER_DEPT_NAME LEFT JOIN MostPopularSubject mps ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mps.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = mps.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND mps.rn = 1 ORDER BY icte.subject_count DESC, dev.enrolled_variance DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each department in the "Provost Area" at hierarchy level 2, and for each organization within that department that has a non-null DLC key, provide the department name, the range and variance of the organization numbers for organizations within that department, the organization name, the variance of the area of its rooms, and the total number of rooms assigned to that organization. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH OrgRoomAreaVariance AS ( SELECT r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY o JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY area_variance DESC ), DeptOrgNumberStats AS ( SELECT MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME AS department_name, MAX(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) - MIN(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_range, VARIANCE(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY WHERE MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_NAME ORDER BY org_number_range DESC ) SELECT d.department_name, d.org_number_range, d.org_number_variance, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.area_variance FROM DeptOrgNumberStats d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON d.department_name = fo.DLC_NAME JOIN OrgRoomAreaVariance o ON fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME = o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY d.org_number_range DESC, o.area_variance DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.department_name, inner_cte.org_number_range, inner_cte.org_number_variance, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.area_variance, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS total_room_count FROM inner_cte JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY GROUP BY inner_cte.department_name, inner_cte.org_number_range, inner_cte.org_number_variance, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.area_variance ORDER BY inner_cte.org_number_range DESC, inner_cte.area_variance DESC, total_room_count DESC;

question: For each space unit with a space unit code of 97500, show the space unit name, space unit code, associated organization name, department count, number of supervisees, the average department count within each department count group, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the old department codes among its associated HR organization units (only including organizations where the average old department code is greater than zero), and whether the number of supervisees is 'HIGH_SUPERVISION' (at least 10% greater than the average for its department count group), 'LOW_SUPERVISION' (at least 10% less than the average for its department count group), or 'AVERAGE', ordered by number of supervisees. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH space_unit_info AS ( SELECT t1.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.DEPT_COUNT, t2.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, AVG(t2.DEPT_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPT_COUNT ORDER BY t2.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS avg_dept_count_within_group, t0.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DEPT_NAMES WHERE t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 97500 ), org_coeff_var AS ( SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) / NULLIF(AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY HAVING AVG(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT s.space_unit_name, s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, s.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s.DEPT_COUNT, s.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, s.avg_dept_count_within_group, o.coefficient_of_variation FROM space_unit_info s LEFT JOIN org_coeff_var o ON s.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY ) SELECT inner_cte.space_unit_name, inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.DEPT_COUNT, inner_cte.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES, inner_cte.avg_dept_count_within_group, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, CASE WHEN inner_cte.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES > inner_cte.avg_dept_count_within_group * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_SUPERVISION' WHEN inner_cte.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES < inner_cte.avg_dept_count_within_group * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_SUPERVISION' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS supervision_category FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES;

question: For rooms in building E38, show the building room identifier, floor number, major use description, organization name, office location, full name of the employee, department name, and the average area of rooms in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by department number and ordered by floor, along with the space unit name, the average and variance of the HR organization unit IDs associated with the space unit for the organization of the room, and the HR department name and HR org unit title for the corresponding HR org unit. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.FLOOR, t0.MAJOR_USE_DESC, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.OFFICE_LOCATION, t1.FULL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, AVG(t0.AREA) OVER ( PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER ORDER BY t0.FLOOR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ROOMS t0 JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY t1 ON t0.BUILDING_ROOM = t1.OFFICE_LOCATION WHERE t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = 'E38' ), space_unit_stats AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, AVG(hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS avg_org_unit_id, VARIANCE(hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS org_unit_id_variance, fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID ORDER BY org_unit_id_variance DESC ) SELECT r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.FLOOR, r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.OFFICE_LOCATION, r.FULL_NAME, r.DEPARTMENT_NAME, r.window_column, s.SPACE_UNIT, s.avg_org_unit_id, s.org_unit_id_variance, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE FROM inner_cte r LEFT JOIN space_unit_stats s ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = s.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY LEFT JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT h ON s.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = h.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID ORDER BY r.BUILDING_ROOM, s.org_unit_id_variance DESC

question: For each department, show the department name, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of rooms used for subjects offered by that department (considering only rooms with an area greater than 40). Then, for each course in the School of Engineering that is degree granting within that department, show the course description, subject code description, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by course description. Finally, list only those departments where the average area is greater than the overall average area of all such rooms, ordered by department name and course description. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptRoomStats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(f.AREA) AS avg_area, VARIANCE(f.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(f.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS f JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON f.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = c.MEET_PLACE WHERE f.AREA > 40 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY area_variance DESC ), EngDegreeCourses AS ( SELECT t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_area, d.area_variance, d.area_stddev, e.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, e.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, e.window_column FROM DeptRoomStats d JOIN EngDegreeCourses e ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = e.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_area > ( SELECT AVG(f.AREA) FROM FCLT_ROOMS f WHERE f.AREA > 40 ) ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_DESCRIPTION;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year, academic year description, the variance of the record count of tip details for terms that are current or previous terms, and the geometric mean of the record counts of required course materials (where the record count is greater than zero) for all subjects offered in that year, along with the number of unique departments offering subjects in that year? Display the results ordered by the variance of the record count in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_PARAMETER IN ('SIS_CURRENT_TERM', 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC ), geometric_mean_record_count_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT))) AS geometric_mean_record_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID = TIP_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID WHERE TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_record_count DESC ), department_count_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS department_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance, geometric_mean_record_count_cte.geometric_mean_record_count, department_count_cte.department_count FROM inner_cte JOIN geometric_mean_record_count_cte ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = geometric_mean_record_count_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = geometric_mean_record_count_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC JOIN department_count_cte ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = department_count_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = department_count_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY inner_cte.record_count_variance DESC;

question: For subjects offered in the term '2017JA', and for subjects offered in the term with code '2022FA', show the subject title, the number of enrolled students, the responsible faculty name, the offering department name, the department full name, the school name, the minimum number of enrolled students in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the department code, the subject ID, the department name, the term description, the running sum of total units within each academic year ordered by subject ID, and the subject's short title and grade type, for cases where the offering department name matches the department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( ORDER BY t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER ( PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID ) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.window_column AS min_enrolled_window, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.window_column AS running_sum_total_units FROM Subq1 s1 JOIN Subq2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, icte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.min_enrolled_window, icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.running_sum_total_units, cso.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, cso.GRADE_TYPE FROM inner_cte icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON icte.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each department that grants degrees, where the range of enrolled students in graduate-level subjects offered by that department is greater than 0 and the variance of the total number of units for subjects with more than 0 enrolled students is available, provide the department name, the range of enrolled students, the variance of enrolled students, the variance of total units, and the average number of enrolled students in those subjects. List the department name, range of enrolled students, variance of enrolled students, variance of total units, and average enrolled students in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH EnrolledStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC ), UnitsVariance AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT es.DEPARTMENT_NAME, es.DEPARTMENT_CODE, es.enrolled_range, es.enrolled_variance, uv.total_units_variance FROM EnrolledStats es JOIN UnitsVariance uv ON es.DEPARTMENT_CODE = uv.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE es.enrolled_range > 0 AND uv.total_units_variance IS NOT NULL ORDER BY es.enrolled_range DESC ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.enrolled_range, icte.enrolled_variance, icte.total_units_variance, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte icte JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON tso.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE WHERE scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.enrolled_range, icte.enrolled_variance, icte.total_units_variance ORDER BY icte.enrolled_range DESC;

question: For each department where the maximum total units of any course offered by that department is greater than 6, and for students in the "Electrical Eng & Computer Sci" department, show the department name, the maximum total units, the name of the school that department belongs to, the student's full name, email address, course description, course level, and the department's full name, as well as the row number within each course level group ordered by the student's last name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ) SELECT dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dmu.max_total_units, dmu.SCHOOL_NAME, esc.FULL_NAME, esc.EMAIL_ADDRESS, esc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, esc.COURSE_LEVEL, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, esc.window_column FROM inner_cte dmu JOIN ( SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.COURSE_LEVEL ORDER BY t2.LAST_NAME) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) esc ON dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME = esc.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON esc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE

question: From the top 10 departments in the academic year 2022 with the highest average subject enrollment for 12-unit subjects, display each department's name, the variance of the reserve catalog keys for courses in that department where the material status is 'U', the subject code, subject number, subject title, term description, total units, and the average subject enrollment number in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by department code and ordered by total units. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH dept_variance AS ( SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, VARIANCE(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY lci.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY catalog_key_variance DESC ), subject_window AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) OVER ( PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) SELECT sw.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dv.catalog_key_variance, sw.SUBJECT_CODE, sw.SUBJECT_NUMBER, sw.SUBJECT_TITLE, sw.TERM_DESCRIPTION, sw.TOTAL_UNITS, sw.window_column, sw.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM subject_window sw LEFT JOIN dept_variance dv ON sw.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dv.DEPARTMENT ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.catalog_key_variance, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.TOTAL_UNITS, ic.window_column FROM ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(window_column) AS avg_enrollment, MAX(catalog_key_variance) AS catalog_key_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY avg_enrollment DESC LIMIT 10 ) top_depts JOIN inner_cte ic ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = top_depts.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY top_depts.avg_enrollment DESC, ic.TOTAL_UNITS DESC;

question: List the department names, total subject enrollments for the current term, course numbers in those departments with more than 2 enrolled students, the number of unique library subjects offered, the minimum total units for those subjects, and the corresponding subject titles. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH department_enrollments AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollments FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER p JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON p.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 10 ), library_subjects_summary AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER ) SELECT de.DEPARTMENT_NAME, de.total_enrollments, lss.COURSE_NUMBER, lss.subject_count, lss.min_total_units FROM department_enrollments de JOIN library_subjects_summary lss ON de.DEPARTMENT_NAME = lss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.total_enrollments, icte.COURSE_NUMBER, icte.subject_count, icte.min_total_units, so.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM inner_cte icte JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON icte.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER AND icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY so ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID WHERE so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2;

question: For subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering, show the subject title, total units, department full name, row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title, as well as the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one reserved library material and at least one course material with a non-null ISBN, and also display the number of distinct terms in which these subjects were offered, with the average, variance, and term count shown for each subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ), subq2 AS ( SELECT tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.TERM_CODE) AS num_terms FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lrm.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.ISBN IS NOT NULL AND lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY tso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, subq2.avg_enrolled, subq2.enrolled_variance, subq2.num_terms FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN subq2 ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE = subq2.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For subjects offered in the term with the description "Fall Term 2024-2025", show the subject code, subject title, department name, term description, the rank of each subject within its department ordered by subject code, and for each department also show the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in regular academic terms. Additionally, include the school name and department phone number for each department. List the results ordered by department name and subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.window_column, ds.avg_total_units, ds.total_units_range, ds.total_units_variance, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN dept_stats ds ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE

question: For the top 10 subject titles by the number of reserve materials assigned, including the department name and the term code, and for academic terms where the term status is 'Previous', provide the subject title, department name, term code, term description, academic year, the running sum of academic years within each financial aid year group, the number of reserve materials assigned, and the academic year description from the all-terms table, for terms where both conditions are met. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ts.SUBJECT_TITLE, ts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ts.TERM_CODE, pt.TERM_DESCRIPTION, pt.ACADEMIC_YEAR, pt.window_column, ts.num_reserve_materials FROM ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_reserve_materials FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE ORDER BY num_reserve_materials DESC LIMIT 10 ) ts JOIN ( SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ) pt ON ts.TERM_CODE = pt.TERM_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.num_reserve_materials, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE;

question: For each department that grants degrees, what is the maximum and minimum number of enrolled students in the graduate-level subjects offered by that department, as well as the average and total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department with a non-null subject code description? Please provide the department name, the maximum number of enrolled students (graduate-level), the minimum number of enrolled students (graduate-level), the average number of enrolled students (with non-null subject code description), and the total number of enrolled students (with non-null subject code description), in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled_grad, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_grad, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), dept_enroll_stats_desc AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.max_enrolled_grad, i.min_enrolled_grad, d.avg_enrolled_students, d.total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_enroll_stats_desc d ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY i.max_enrolled_grad DESC;

question: For each subject offered in the library in the Mathematics department during regular terms, show the subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, term description, academic year, subject short title, the maximum total units for each row and the next two rows in order of subject ID, the number of unique subjects, and the minimum total units for those subjects where the course material status is 'RQ', grouped by offering department and school. Additionally, for each offering department and school, include a grand total row for all subjects in the format of (nulls for subject-specific columns, department, school, nulls for subject-specific columns, subject count, min total units). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, MAX(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, i.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, s2.subject_count, s2.min_total_units FROM inner_cte i JOIN Subq2 s2 ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND i.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = s2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, NULL AS MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, s2.subject_count, s2.min_total_units FROM Subq2 s2 ) SELECT * FROM RollupResults ORDER BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, ACADEMIC_YEAR

question: For each department name and its corresponding organization key in the Provost Area, provide the number of organizations, the minimum department hierarchy level 3 code, the building-room identifier, the organization name, the DLC key, the sum of room areas within each major use description group ordered by building-room, and, for each major use description, show only those where the sum of room areas is greater than 1000. Also, calculate the ratio of the sum of room areas within each major use description group to the number of organizations (rounded), ordered by this ratio in descending order.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptProvostArea AS ( SELECT m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_CODE) AS min_level3_code FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ), RoomAreaWindow AS ( SELECT t2.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, t2.MAJOR_USE_DESC, SUM(t2.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.MAJOR_USE_DESC ORDER BY t2.BUILDING_ROOM) AS window_column, t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.AREA > 200 ) SELECT dpa.DLC_NAME, dpa.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, dpa.org_count, dpa.min_level3_code, raw.BUILDING_ROOM, raw.ORGANIZATION_NAME, raw.DLC_KEY, raw.MAJOR_USE_DESC, raw.window_column, ROUND(raw.window_column / NULLIF(dpa.org_count, 0), 2) AS window_per_org FROM DeptProvostArea dpa JOIN RoomAreaWindow raw ON dpa.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = raw.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ) SELECT icte.DLC_NAME, icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, icte.org_count, icte.min_level3_code, icte.BUILDING_ROOM, icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.DLC_KEY, icte.MAJOR_USE_DESC, icte.window_column, icte.window_per_org FROM inner_cte icte WHERE icte.window_column > 1000 ORDER BY icte.window_per_org DESC;

question: For each major use description and organization name where the room area is greater than 100 and the access level is 1, display the number of rooms, the minimum floor number, the access level name, the variance of the number of rooms in the building history for buildings with a nonzero number of rooms and assignable area greater than 0, and whether the current number of rooms is a 'HIGH_PERFORMER' (at least 10% greater than the historical average), 'LOW_PERFORMER' (at least 10% less than the historical average), or 'AVERAGE' compared to the average historical number of rooms for that access level. Show the results ordered by the number of rooms in descending order and then by the variance of the number of rooms in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count, MIN(r.FLOOR) AS min_floor, r.ACCESS_LEVEL FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 100 AND r.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 GROUP BY r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.ACCESS_LEVEL ), access_level_variance AS ( SELECT FCLT_BUILDING.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE, FCLT_BUILDING.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME, VARIANCE(FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS num_rooms_variance FROM FCLT_BUILDING JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST ON FCLT_BUILDING.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE = FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE WHERE FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 0 AND FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.ASSIGNABLE_AREA > 0 GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE, FCLT_BUILDING.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME ), access_level_avg_rooms AS ( SELECT FCLT_BUILDING.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE, AVG(FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS avg_num_rooms FROM FCLT_BUILDING JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST ON FCLT_BUILDING.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE = FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE WHERE FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 0 AND FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.ASSIGNABLE_AREA > 0 GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE ) SELECT icte.MAJOR_USE_DESC, icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.room_count, icte.min_floor, av.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME, av.num_rooms_variance, aavg.avg_num_rooms, CASE WHEN icte.room_count > aavg.avg_num_rooms * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_PERFORMER' WHEN icte.room_count < aavg.avg_num_rooms * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_PERFORMER' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS performance_category FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN access_level_variance av ON icte.ACCESS_LEVEL = av.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE LEFT JOIN access_level_avg_rooms aavg ON icte.ACCESS_LEVEL = aavg.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE ORDER BY icte.room_count DESC, av.num_rooms_variance DESC;
