SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH port_status_owner_sg_summary AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), down_ports_with_ip_window AS ( SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, b.HOST AS host, b.VIF_TYPE AS vif_type, ia.IP_ADDRESS AS ip_address, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY ia.IP_ADDRESS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b JOIN PORTS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' ) SELECT d.port_id, d.tenant_id, d.host, d.vif_type, d.ip_address, d.window_column, s.port_status, s.device_owner, s.port_count, s.min_standard_attr_id FROM down_ports_with_ip_window d JOIN PORTS p ON p.ID = d.port_id JOIN port_status_owner_sg_summary s ON s.port_status = p.STATUS AND s.device_owner = p.DEVICE_OWNER) SELECT i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.host, i.vif_type, i.ip_address, i.window_column, i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.min_standard_attr_id, avg_counts.avg_port_count_across_down_status_owner_groups FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_port_count_across_down_status_owner_groups FROM ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ) AS sub ) AS avg_counts ON 1 = 1;

question: For ports that are DOWN, return the port ID, tenant ID, MAC address, and the running sum of the port’s standard attribute ID within each security group (ordered by standard attribute ID), and for those same MAC addresses also show the administratively up port name, port security enabled status, and the row number ordered by MAC address using a window frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row. Additionally, group the results by whether the port is in an “External” or “Internal” security-group category (treat security groups whose ID starts with '000' as “External”, otherwise “Internal”), and include subtotals per category and a grand total of matched MAC addresses. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH down_ports_sg_running_sum AS ( SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' ), admin_up_ports_rownum AS ( SELECT p.NAME AS port_name, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, psb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED AS port_security_enabled, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY p.MAC_ADDRESS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 ) SELECT d.port_id, d.tenant_id, d.mac_address, d.window_column AS down_ports_running_sum_standard_attr_id_within_security_group, a.port_name, a.port_security_enabled, a.window_column AS admin_up_ports_row_number_by_mac FROM down_ports_sg_running_sum d JOIN admin_up_ports_rownum a ON d.mac_address = a.mac_address), mac_externality AS ( SELECT i.mac_address, CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN sgpb.security_group_id LIKE '000%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'External' ELSE 'Internal' END AS external_status FROM inner_cte i JOIN ports p ON p.mac_address = i.mac_address JOIN securitygroupportbindings sgpb ON sgpb.port_id = p.id GROUP BY i.mac_address ), counts AS ( SELECT me.external_status, COUNT(DISTINCT me.mac_address) AS total_macs FROM mac_externality me GROUP BY me.external_status ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(external_status) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE external_status END AS external_status, SUM(total_macs) AS total_macs FROM counts GROUP BY external_status WITH ROLLUP;

question: For each network, list the network ID, total number of ports that are (1) DOWN with an allocated IP address and a row number within their network (ordered by port ID) and (2) bound to at least one security group with admin_state_up = 1, along with the average number of DNS records per such port. Do not repeat the network ID if it is the same as the previous row. Include a final TOTAL row across all networks. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH AdminUpBoundPorts AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb JOIN PORTS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN PORTDNSES pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name ), DownPortsWithIPs AS ( SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.NAME AS port_name, p.NETWORK_ID AS network_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, ia.IP_ADDRESS AS ip_address, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.NETWORK_ID ORDER BY p.ID) AS window_column FROM PORTS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' ) SELECT d.network_id, d.window_column AS down_port_row_number_in_network, d.port_id, d.tenant_id, d.port_name, d.mac_address, d.device_owner, d.ip_address, a.security_group_binding_count, a.dns_record_count FROM DownPortsWithIPs d JOIN AdminUpBoundPorts a ON d.port_id = a.port_id ORDER BY d.network_id, d.window_column, d.port_id) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(network_id) OVER (ORDER BY network_id_sort, network_id) = network_id THEN NULL ELSE network_id END AS network_id, total_ports, avg_dns_records_per_port FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.network_id) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.network_id END AS network_id_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.network_id) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.network_id END AS network_id, COUNT(DISTINCT i.port_id) AS total_ports, AVG(i.dns_record_count) AS avg_dns_records_per_port FROM inner_cte i GROUP BY i.network_id WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY network_id_sort;

question: For ports whose status is 'DOWN', list each port’s ID, name, MAC address, admin_state_up flag, binding host, VIF type, allocated IP address, and subnet ID, along with (1) the average admin_state_up over a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows partitioned by VIF type ordered by MAC address, and (2) the average port ID within each port ID group ordered by IP address; additionally, for each VIF type show the total number of DOWN ports and the average of these DOWN-port counts across all VIF types. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH down_ports_bindings AS ( SELECT p.NAME, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, AVG(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.MAC_ADDRESS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' ORDER BY p.MAC_ADDRESS ), down_ports_ipallocs AS ( SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.NAME AS port_name, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, ia.IP_ADDRESS AS ip_address, ia.SUBNET_ID AS subnet_id, AVG(p.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY p.ID ORDER BY ia.IP_ADDRESS) AS window_column FROM PORTS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' ORDER BY ia.IP_ADDRESS ) SELECT dpi.port_id, dpi.port_name, dpi.mac_address, dpb.ADMIN_STATE_UP, dpb.HOST, dpb.VIF_TYPE, dpi.ip_address, dpi.subnet_id, dpb.window_column AS avg_admin_state_up_window_2_pre_2_fol_by_vif_type, dpi.window_column AS avg_port_id_by_port_id_ordered_by_ip FROM down_ports_ipallocs dpi JOIN down_ports_bindings dpb ON dpi.port_name = dpb.NAME AND dpi.mac_address = dpb.MAC_ADDRESS ORDER BY dpi.ip_address ) SELECT i.port_id, i.port_name, i.mac_address, i.admin_state_up, i.host, i.vif_type, i.ip_address, i.subnet_id, i.avg_admin_state_up_window_2_pre_2_fol_by_vif_type, i.avg_port_id_by_port_id_ordered_by_ip, vif_stats.total_down_ports_for_vif_type, avg_vif_stats.avg_down_ports_across_vif_types FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN ( SELECT vif_type, COUNT(*) AS total_down_ports_for_vif_type FROM inner_cte GROUP BY vif_type ) AS vif_stats ON i.vif_type = vif_stats.vif_type JOIN ( SELECT AVG(down_port_count) AS avg_down_ports_across_vif_types FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS down_port_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY vif_type ) AS sub ) AS avg_vif_stats ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY i.ip_address;

question: For each RBAC action that is access_as_shared, list the action along with (1) the variance of subnet IP version (IPv4 vs IPv6) across subnets on the referenced networks, and (2) the overall average, range (max minus min), and variance of subnet IP version (considering only subnets with IP version 4 or 6) for networks referenced by RBAC entries with that same action; also include the average DHCP-enabled flag across those same subnets (treating ENABLE_DHCP as 0/1). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH RbacSharedIpVersionVariance AS (SELECT n.ACTION, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC), RbacIpVersionStats AS (SELECT n.ACTION AS rbac_action, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, MAX(s.IP_VERSION) - MIN(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_range, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION IN (4, 6) GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_range DESC) SELECT rs.ACTION AS rbac_action, rs.ip_version_variance AS shared_action_ip_version_variance, ris.avg_ip_version, ris.ip_version_range, ris.ip_version_variance AS overall_ip_version_variance FROM RbacSharedIpVersionVariance rs JOIN RbacIpVersionStats ris ON rs.ACTION = ris.rbac_action ORDER BY rs.ip_version_variance DESC ), dhcp_stats AS ( SELECT n.ACTION AS rbac_action, AVG(CAST(s.ENABLE_DHCP AS FLOAT)) AS avg_enable_dhcp FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ) SELECT i.rbac_action, i.shared_action_ip_version_variance, i.avg_ip_version, i.ip_version_range, i.overall_ip_version_variance, d.avg_enable_dhcp FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dhcp_stats AS d ON i.rbac_action = d.rbac_action ORDER BY i.shared_action_ip_version_variance DESC;

question: For ports with status equal to 'DOWN', return the same port/IP details (port ID, tenant ID, port name, network ID, MAC address, device owner, allocated IP address, subnet ID, the average port ID within each port ID group ordered by IP address, and the row number within each network ordered by port ID), but only for networks whose number of DOWN ports is greater than the average number of DOWN ports per network. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DownPortIpWindow AS ( SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.NAME AS port_name, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, ia.IP_ADDRESS AS ip_address, ia.SUBNET_ID AS subnet_id, AVG(p.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY p.ID ORDER BY ia.IP_ADDRESS) AS window_column FROM PORTS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' ORDER BY ia.IP_ADDRESS ), DownPortNetworkRowNum AS ( SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.NAME AS port_name, p.NETWORK_ID AS network_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, ia.IP_ADDRESS AS ip_address, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.NETWORK_ID ORDER BY p.ID) AS window_column FROM PORTS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' ) SELECT dpiw.port_id, dpnr.tenant_id, dpiw.port_name, dpnr.network_id, dpiw.mac_address, dpnr.device_owner, dpiw.ip_address, dpiw.subnet_id, dpiw.window_column AS avg_port_id_within_port_id_group_by_ip, dpnr.window_column AS row_number_within_network_by_port_id FROM DownPortIpWindow dpiw JOIN DownPortNetworkRowNum dpnr ON dpiw.port_id = dpnr.port_id AND dpiw.ip_address = dpnr.ip_address ORDER BY dpnr.network_id, dpnr.window_column, dpiw.ip_address ), NetworkDownPortCounts AS ( SELECT p.NETWORK_ID AS network_id, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS total_down_ports FROM PORTS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' GROUP BY p.NETWORK_ID ) SELECT i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.port_name, i.network_id, i.mac_address, i.device_owner, i.ip_address, i.subnet_id, i.avg_port_id_within_port_id_group_by_ip, i.row_number_within_network_by_port_id FROM inner_cte i JOIN NetworkDownPortCounts ndpc ON i.network_id = ndpc.network_id WHERE ndpc.total_down_ports > (SELECT AVG(total_down_ports) FROM NetworkDownPortCounts) ORDER BY i.network_id, i.row_number_within_network_by_port_id, i.ip_address;

question: Among the ports returned by the existing “DOWN ports on host drive-59” window/running-sum analysis, list the top 10 tenants with the most such ports, showing each tenant’s ID, the total number of matching ports, and whether any of those ports have a port-security binding. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DownPortsWindow AS ( SELECT p.NAME, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, AVG(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.MAC_ADDRESS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' ORDER BY p.MAC_ADDRESS ), Drive59PortsRunningSum AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, p.TENANT_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE b.HOST = 'drive-59' ), DownDrive59PortDetails AS ( SELECT dpw.NAME, dpw.MAC_ADDRESS, dpw.ADMIN_STATE_UP, dpw.HOST, dpw.VIF_TYPE, dpw.window_column AS down_ports_avg_admin_state_up_window, d59.PORT_ID, d59.TENANT_ID, d59.window_column AS drive59_running_sum_standard_attr_id FROM DownPortsWindow dpw JOIN Drive59PortsRunningSum d59 ON dpw.MAC_ADDRESS = d59.MAC_ADDRESS WHERE dpw.HOST = 'drive-59' ) SELECT * FROM DownDrive59PortDetails ORDER BY VIF_TYPE, MAC_ADDRESS, PORT_ID ) SELECT i.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT i.port_id) AS total_ports, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT psb.port_id) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_port_security_binding FROM inner_cte i LEFT JOIN PORTS p ON p.id = i.port_id LEFT JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS psb ON psb.port_id = p.id GROUP BY i.tenant_id ORDER BY total_ports DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Among the host/port-status groups where a port has an allowed address pair with IP address 10.232.210.41/8 and the maximum standard attribute ID in that group is greater than 1, list the host, the port status, that maximum standard attribute ID, the variance of standard attribute IDs for that status across ports that have an IP allocation, and whether any of the ports in that host/status group have an IP allocation. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH HostPortMaxAttr AS ( SELECT b.HOST, MAX(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS max_standard_attr_id, p.STATUS FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b JOIN PORTS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN ALLOWEDADDRESSPAIRS a ON p.ID = a.PORT_ID WHERE a.IP_ADDRESS = '10.232.210.41/8' GROUP BY b.HOST, p.STATUS HAVING MAX(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) > 1 ), StatusAttrVariance AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, VARIANCE(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS standard_attr_id_variance FROM PORTS AS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.STATUS ORDER BY standard_attr_id_variance DESC ) SELECT hpma.HOST, hpma.STATUS, hpma.max_standard_attr_id, sav.standard_attr_id_variance FROM HostPortMaxAttr hpma JOIN StatusAttrVariance sav ON hpma.STATUS = sav.STATUS ) SELECT i.HOST, i.STATUS, i.max_standard_attr_id, i.standard_attr_id_variance, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT ia.PORT_ID) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_ip_allocation_in_group FROM inner_cte i JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b ON i.HOST = b.HOST JOIN PORTS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID AND p.STATUS = i.STATUS LEFT JOIN IPALLOCATIONS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID GROUP BY i.HOST, i.STATUS, i.max_standard_attr_id, i.standard_attr_id_variance;

question: Among the top 10 tenants with the most ports that appear in the combined set of (a) DOWN ports grouped by security group and (b) ports on host "drive-59" grouped by VIF type, show each tenant’s ID, the total number of distinct ports in that combined set, and whether the tenant has any ports coming from the "Host drive-59 (by VIF Type)" calculation. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DownPortsBySecurityGroup AS ( SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' ), Drive59PortsByVifType AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, p.TENANT_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE b.HOST = 'drive-59' ), CombinedPorts AS ( SELECT port_id, tenant_id, mac_address, window_column, 'DOWN (by Security Group)' AS reason FROM DownPortsBySecurityGroup UNION ALL SELECT PORT_ID AS port_id, TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, window_column, 'Host drive-59 (by VIF Type)' AS reason FROM Drive59PortsByVifType ) SELECT port_id, tenant_id, mac_address, window_column, reason FROM CombinedPorts ORDER BY tenant_id, port_id ) SELECT inner_cte.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.port_id) AS total_ports_in_combined_set, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN inner_cte.reason = 'Host drive-59 (by VIF Type)' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_drive59_ports FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.tenant_id ORDER BY total_ports_in_combined_set DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each binding host, find the host name and the maximum DOWN-status rank (ordered by port ID within the DOWN group) among ports that are DOWN and have port security enabled, where the ports are matched to admin-up ports by MAC address. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DownPortsWithBindings AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.NAME AS port_name, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, b.HOST AS binding_host, b.VIF_TYPE AS vif_type, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.STATUS ORDER BY p.ID) AS window_column FROM PORTS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN'), AdminUpPortsWithSecurity AS (SELECT p.NAME AS port_name, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, psb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED AS port_security_enabled, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY p.MAC_ADDRESS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1) SELECT dpwb.port_id, dpwb.port_name, dpwb.mac_address, dpwb.binding_host, dpwb.vif_type, dpwb.window_column AS down_status_rank, aupws.port_security_enabled, aupws.window_column AS admin_up_row_number FROM DownPortsWithBindings dpwb JOIN AdminUpPortsWithSecurity aupws ON dpwb.mac_address = aupws.mac_address WHERE aupws.port_security_enabled = 1 ORDER BY dpwb.port_id) SELECT binding_host, MAX(down_status_rank) AS max_down_status_rank FROM inner_cte GROUP BY binding_host;

question: For ports that are both (a) bound to security group ID 0008e629-5619-41e0-b86c-4eecfeaacb6c and (b) have status DOWN, produce a report grouped by tenant that lists the tenant ID (do not repeat it if it is the same as the previous row), the number of distinct matching ports, the number of distinct hosts those ports are bound to, and the average of the security-group running-sum window value across the matching rows. Also include a final TOTAL row across all tenants. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH SecurityGroupPorts AS ( SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.STATUS AS port_status, ia.IP_ADDRESS AS ip_address, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY p.NETWORK_ID ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb JOIN PORTS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID = '0008e629-5619-41e0-b86c-4eecfeaacb6c' ), DownPorts AS ( SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, b.HOST AS host, b.VIF_TYPE AS vif_type, ia.IP_ADDRESS AS ip_address, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY ia.IP_ADDRESS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b JOIN PORTS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' ), SecurityGroupDownPorts AS ( SELECT dp.port_id, dp.tenant_id, dp.host, dp.vif_type, dp.ip_address, dp.window_column AS down_ports_rownum_window, sgp.port_status, sgp.window_column AS sg_ports_running_sum_window FROM DownPorts dp JOIN SecurityGroupPorts sgp ON dp.port_id = sgp.port_id AND dp.ip_address = sgp.ip_address ) SELECT port_id, tenant_id, host, vif_type, ip_address, port_status, down_ports_rownum_window, sg_ports_running_sum_window FROM SecurityGroupDownPorts) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(tenant_id) OVER (ORDER BY tenant_id_sort, tenant_id) = tenant_id THEN NULL ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id, matching_ports, distinct_hosts, avg_sg_running_sum_window FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT port_id) AS matching_ports, COUNT(DISTINCT host) AS distinct_hosts, AVG(sg_ports_running_sum_window) AS avg_sg_running_sum_window FROM inner_cte GROUP BY tenant_id WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY tenant_id_sort;

question: For ports that are DOWN, group the results by device owner and whether the port has a security group binding (“Bound” if it has at least one security group, “Unbound” otherwise). For each device owner and binding status, list the device owner, binding status, and the number of distinct DOWN ports. Include subtotals per device owner and a grand total. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DownPortsWithIPs AS ( SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.NAME AS port_name, p.NETWORK_ID AS network_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, ia.IP_ADDRESS AS ip_address, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.NETWORK_ID ORDER BY p.ID) AS window_column FROM PORTS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' ), DownPortsWithSecurityWindow AS ( SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' ) SELECT dpi.port_id, dpi.tenant_id, dpi.port_name, dpi.network_id, dpi.mac_address, dpi.device_owner, dpi.ip_address, dpi.window_column AS row_num_within_network, dpsw.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, dpsw.ADMIN_STATE_UP, dpsw.STATUS, dpsw.window_column AS min_admin_state_up_window FROM DownPortsWithIPs dpi JOIN DownPortsWithSecurityWindow dpsw ON dpi.network_id = dpsw.NETWORK_ID AND dpi.port_name = dpsw.NAME AND dpi.mac_address = dpsw.MAC_ADDRESS AND dpi.device_owner = dpsw.DEVICE_OWNER ORDER BY dpi.network_id, dpi.port_id ), PortOwnerBindingCounts AS ( SELECT ic.device_owner, CASE WHEN ic.SECURITY_GROUP_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'Bound' ELSE 'Unbound' END AS binding_status, COUNT(DISTINCT ic.port_id) AS total_down_ports FROM inner_cte ic GROUP BY ic.device_owner, binding_status ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(device_owner) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE device_owner END AS device_owner, CASE WHEN GROUPING(binding_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(device_owner) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(binding_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(device_owner) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE binding_status END AS binding_status, SUM(total_down_ports) AS total_down_ports FROM PortOwnerBindingCounts GROUP BY device_owner, binding_status WITH ROLLUP;

question: Across all DOWN ports that share a MAC address with an administratively-up port, return the DOWN port’s ID, tenant ID, MAC address, its running sum of standard attribute ID within its security group, plus the administratively-up port’s name, port security enabled flag, and MAC-address-ordered row number; also include the deviation of each DOWN port’s running-sum value from the overall average running-sum across all such matched DOWN ports, and only keep rows where the running-sum value is greater than 0. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DownPortsBySecurityGroup AS ( SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' ), AdminUpPortsWithRowNumbers AS ( SELECT p.NAME AS port_name, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, psb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED AS port_security_enabled, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY p.MAC_ADDRESS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 ) SELECT dpsg.port_id, dpsg.tenant_id, dpsg.mac_address, dpsg.window_column AS down_ports_running_sum_standard_attr_id, aup.port_name, aup.port_security_enabled, aup.window_column AS admin_up_ports_row_number FROM DownPortsBySecurityGroup dpsg JOIN AdminUpPortsWithRowNumbers aup ON dpsg.mac_address = aup.mac_address WHERE dpsg.window_column > 0 ORDER BY dpsg.window_column DESC, dpsg.mac_address ), AverageRunningSum AS ( SELECT AVG(down_ports_running_sum_standard_attr_id) AS avg_running_sum FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.mac_address, i.down_ports_running_sum_standard_attr_id, i.port_name, i.port_security_enabled, i.admin_up_ports_row_number, (i.down_ports_running_sum_standard_attr_id - a.avg_running_sum) AS deviation_from_avg_running_sum FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN AverageRunningSum a ORDER BY i.down_ports_running_sum_standard_attr_id DESC, i.mac_address;

question: For each port status (considering only administratively up ports), return the count of administratively up ports and the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of port security bindings per port (considering only ports that have at least one port security binding), but only include statuses whose administratively up port count is greater than the average administratively up port count across all statuses. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH administratively_up_ports AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 ), port_status_binding_stats AS ( SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC ), up_port_counts_by_status AS ( SELECT aup.STATUS, COUNT(*) AS administratively_up_port_count FROM administratively_up_ports aup GROUP BY aup.STATUS ) SELECT psbs.status, ucs.administratively_up_port_count, psbs.binding_count_range, psbs.binding_count_variance, psbs.binding_count_stddev FROM port_status_binding_stats psbs JOIN up_port_counts_by_status ucs ON psbs.status = ucs.STATUS ORDER BY psbs.binding_count_range DESC ) SELECT status, administratively_up_port_count, binding_count_range, binding_count_variance, binding_count_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE administratively_up_port_count > (SELECT AVG(administratively_up_port_count) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY administratively_up_port_count DESC;

question: Using the RBAC action-level stats from the existing query, list the top 10 actions (ranked by the shared/IPv4 subnet IP-version variance) and show: the action, the shared/IPv4 average/variance/stddev of subnet IP version, the DHCP-enabled non-shared stddev of subnet IP version, and whether any of the shared/IPv4 subnets for that action have DHCP enabled. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "access_as_shared" permission is predicated by "networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared'" "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH RbacSharedIpVersionStats AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC ), RbacDhcpNonSharedStddev AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 AND s.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.ACTION HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY ip_version_stddev DESC ) SELECT rs.ACTION, rs.avg_ip_version, rs.ip_version_variance, rs.ip_version_stddev AS shared_ip_version_stddev, rd.ip_version_stddev AS dhcp_nonshared_ip_version_stddev FROM RbacSharedIpVersionStats rs JOIN RbacDhcpNonSharedStddev rd ON rs.ACTION = rd.ACTION ) SELECT i.ACTION, i.avg_ip_version, i.ip_version_variance, i.shared_ip_version_stddev, i.dhcp_nonshared_ip_version_stddev, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT s2.ID) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS shared_ipv4_has_any_dhcp_enabled_subnet FROM inner_cte i LEFT JOIN NETWORKRBACS n2 ON n2.ACTION = i.ACTION AND n2.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' LEFT JOIN SUBNETS s2 ON s2.NETWORK_ID = n2.OBJECT_ID AND s2.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s2.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 GROUP BY i.ACTION, i.avg_ip_version, i.ip_version_variance, i.shared_ip_version_stddev, i.dhcp_nonshared_ip_version_stddev ORDER BY i.ip_version_variance DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For tenant ID '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7' and ports with status 'DOWN', for each device owner show the port status, the number of distinct ports that are bound to a security group, the minimum standard attribute ID, and (for that same port status) the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of port security bindings per port; additionally, for each device owner report the maximum number of distinct security groups assigned to any single port owned by that device owner. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH PortStatusOwnerSecurityGroupStats AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), PortStatusBindingCountDispersion AS ( SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC ) SELECT psosgs.port_status, psosgs.device_owner, psosgs.port_count, psosgs.min_standard_attr_id, psbcd.binding_count_range, psbcd.binding_count_variance, psbcd.binding_count_stddev FROM PortStatusOwnerSecurityGroupStats psosgs JOIN PortStatusBindingCountDispersion psbcd ON psosgs.port_status = psbcd.status ORDER BY psosgs.port_count DESC) , OwnerPortSecurityGroupCounts AS ( SELECT p.device_owner, p.id AS port_id, COUNT(DISTINCT spb.security_group_id) AS security_group_count FROM ports p JOIN securitygroupportbindings spb ON p.id = spb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.device_owner, p.id ) SELECT i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.min_standard_attr_id, i.binding_count_range, i.binding_count_variance, i.binding_count_stddev, MAX(opsgc.security_group_count) AS max_security_groups_on_any_port_for_owner FROM inner_cte i JOIN OwnerPortSecurityGroupCounts opsgc ON i.device_owner = opsgc.device_owner GROUP BY i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.min_standard_attr_id, i.binding_count_range, i.binding_count_variance, i.binding_count_stddev ORDER BY i.port_count DESC;

question: For ports that are administratively up and belong to tenant ID `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57`, list the port ID, host, VIF type, VNIC type, tenant ID, network ID, MAC address, status, device owner, and the average standard attribute ID over a 2-preceding/2-following window (partitioned by VIF type and ordered by standard attribute ID), and also show (by matching port status) the minimum admin_state_up and average standard_attr_id for ports bound with VIF type `ovs` whose device_id is `da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7`. Do not repeat the status if it is the same as the previous row, and include a final TOTAL row across all statuses. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')" Device ID "da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7" is predicated by "ports.device_id IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) AS min_admin_state_up, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE b.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' AND p.DEVICE_ID IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS ) SELECT s1.PORT_ID, s1.HOST, s1.VIF_TYPE, s1.VNIC_TYPE, s1.TENANT_ID, s1.NETWORK_ID, s1.MAC_ADDRESS, s1.STATUS, s1.DEVICE_OWNER, s1.window_column, s2.min_admin_state_up, s2.avg_standard_attr_id FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.STATUS = s2.STATUS ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(status) OVER (ORDER BY status_sort, status, port_id) = status THEN NULL ELSE status END AS status, port_id, host, vif_type, vnic_type, tenant_id, network_id, mac_address, device_owner, window_column, min_admin_state_up, avg_standard_attr_id FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.status) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.status END AS status_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.status) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.status END AS status, i.port_id, i.host, i.vif_type, i.vnic_type, i.tenant_id, i.network_id, i.mac_address, i.device_owner, i.window_column, i.min_admin_state_up, i.avg_standard_attr_id FROM inner_cte i GROUP BY i.status, i.port_id, i.host, i.vif_type, i.vnic_type, i.tenant_id, i.network_id, i.mac_address, i.device_owner, i.window_column, i.min_admin_state_up, i.avg_standard_attr_id WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY status_sort, status, port_id;

question: Using the same RBAC-action-level results as before, produce a report that lists each RBAC action (suppressing repeated action values on consecutive rows), the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subnet IP versions for DHCP-enabled subnets on non-shared networks (excluding networks that have an `access_as_shared` RBAC entry targeting `'*'` or `9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b`, and only keeping actions with more than 5 matching subnets), the variance of subnet IP versions for publicly shared `access_as_shared` RBAC entries (target tenant `'*'`), and also the total number of distinct subnet tenants contributing to each action’s DHCP-enabled/non-shared calculation. Include a final TOTAL row across all actions. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))" "public access" (wildcard) is predicated by "networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 AND s.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.ACTION HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY ip_version_stddev DESC ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT = '*' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC ) SELECT s1.ACTION, s1.ip_version_stddev, s2.ip_version_variance FROM Subq1 s1 LEFT JOIN Subq2 s2 ON s1.ACTION = s2.ACTION ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(action) OVER (ORDER BY action_sort, action) = action THEN NULL ELSE action END AS action, ip_version_stddev, ip_version_variance, distinct_subnet_tenants FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.action) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.action END AS action_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.action) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.action END AS action, i.ip_version_stddev, i.ip_version_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT s.tenant_id) AS distinct_subnet_tenants FROM inner_cte i LEFT JOIN networkrbacs n ON n.action = i.action LEFT JOIN subnets s ON s.network_id = n.object_id AND s.enable_dhcp = 1 AND s.network_id NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY i.action, i.ip_version_stddev, i.ip_version_variance WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY action_sort;

question: For tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57", for tenants that have at least 2 administratively-up ports, list the tenant ID, the admin-up port count, the number of ACTIVE networks for that tenant, and the latest network standard-attribute updated_at timestamp. Do not repeat the tenant ID if it is the same as the previous row, and include a final TOTAL row across all returned tenants. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "networks.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')" Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH ActiveTenantNetworks AS (SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), AdminUpTenantPorts AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), TenantPortCounts AS ( SELECT ap.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.PORT_ID) AS admin_up_port_count FROM AdminUpTenantPorts ap GROUP BY ap.TENANT_ID ) SELECT an.tenant_id, tpc.admin_up_port_count, COUNT(DISTINCT an.network_id) AS active_network_count, MAX(an.standard_attr_updated_at) AS latest_network_standard_attr_updated_at FROM ActiveTenantNetworks an JOIN TenantPortCounts tpc ON an.tenant_id = tpc.tenant_id WHERE tpc.admin_up_port_count >= 2 GROUP BY an.tenant_id, tpc.admin_up_port_count ORDER BY tpc.admin_up_port_count DESC, active_network_count DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(tenant_id) OVER (ORDER BY tenant_id_sort, tenant_id) = tenant_id THEN NULL ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id, admin_up_port_count, active_network_count, latest_network_standard_attr_updated_at FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id, SUM(admin_up_port_count) AS admin_up_port_count, SUM(active_network_count) AS active_network_count, MAX(latest_network_standard_attr_updated_at) AS latest_network_standard_attr_updated_at FROM inner_cte GROUP BY tenant_id WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY tenant_id_sort, tenant_id;

question: Using the combined port status–level metrics result set (DOWN ports in tenant '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7' that are security-group bound, plus ports on device 'da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7' with VIF type 'ovs'), show for each status/reason row the device owner, port counts/attribute aggregates, and also indicate whether any of the involved ports have an OVS binding and whether any are bound to a security group. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')" Device ID "da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7" is predicated by "ports.device_id IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH SecurityGroupBoundPorts AS (SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER), OvsBoundPorts AS (SELECT p.STATUS, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) AS min_admin_state_up, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE b.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' AND p.DEVICE_ID IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS), CombinedPortStatusMetrics AS ( SELECT sg.port_status AS status, sg.device_owner AS device_owner, sg.port_count AS port_count, sg.min_standard_attr_id AS min_standard_attr_id, NULL AS min_admin_state_up, NULL AS avg_standard_attr_id, 'Security Group Bound Ports' AS reason FROM SecurityGroupBoundPorts sg UNION ALL SELECT ov.STATUS AS status, NULL AS device_owner, NULL AS port_count, NULL AS min_standard_attr_id, ov.min_admin_state_up AS min_admin_state_up, ov.avg_standard_attr_id AS avg_standard_attr_id, 'OVS VIF Bound Ports' AS reason FROM OvsBoundPorts ov ) SELECT * FROM CombinedPortStatusMetrics ORDER BY status, device_owner, reason) SELECT i.status, i.reason, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.min_standard_attr_id, i.min_admin_state_up, i.avg_standard_attr_id, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT b.port_id) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_ovs_binding, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT spb.port_id) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_security_group_binding FROM inner_cte i LEFT JOIN ports p ON p.status = i.status AND (i.device_owner IS NULL OR p.device_owner = i.device_owner) LEFT JOIN ml2_port_bindings b ON p.id = b.port_id AND b.vif_type = 'ovs' LEFT JOIN securitygroupportbindings spb ON p.id = spb.port_id GROUP BY i.status, i.reason, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.min_standard_attr_id, i.min_admin_state_up, i.avg_standard_attr_id ORDER BY i.status, i.device_owner, i.reason;

question: Using the same exclusions for shared networks (i.e., networks with an RBAC entry where action = 'access_as_shared' and target_tenant is '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'), take the combined result set that reports (1) per network status the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED across networks that have at least one security binding, and (2) per port status and device owner (restricted to standard attributes with resource_type = 'ports') the number of ports and the earliest standard attribute updated timestamp. Then, for each network status, return the maximum port_count observed across the combined rows. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH NetworkStatusSecurityStats AS ( SELECT n.STATUS AS network_status, VARIANCE(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_variance, STDDEV(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_stddev FROM NETWORKS AS n JOIN NETWORKSECURITYBINDINGS AS nsb ON n.ID = nsb.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.STATUS ORDER BY port_security_enabled_variance DESC ), PortStatusOwnerStats AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ) SELECT nsss.network_status, nsss.port_security_enabled_variance, nsss.port_security_enabled_stddev, pss.port_status, pss.device_owner, pss.port_count, pss.earliest_standard_attr_update FROM NetworkStatusSecurityStats nsss CROSS JOIN PortStatusOwnerStats pss) SELECT network_status, MAX(port_count) AS max_port_count_across_port_groups FROM inner_cte GROUP BY network_status;

question: For each tenant that has at least one admin-state-up port in tenant ID '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57' which is bound to a security group that also appears on at least one DOWN port in network ID '0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d', list the tenant ID, the number of qualifying ports, the average DNS-per-security-group-binding ratio across those ports (rounded to 2 decimals), and also show the overall average number of qualifying ports per tenant.
evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')" Network ID "0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d" is predicated by "ports.network_id IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH PortSecurityAndDns AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb JOIN PORTS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN PORTDNSES pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name ), DownPortsWithWindow AS ( SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') ), DownPortsAgg AS ( SELECT d.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, COUNT(*) AS down_port_rows, AVG(d.window_column) AS avg_window_min_admin_state_up FROM DownPortsWithWindow d GROUP BY d.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ) SELECT psd.port_id, psd.tenant_id, psd.port_name, psd.security_group_binding_count, psd.dns_record_count, ROUND( psd.dns_record_count / NULLIF(psd.security_group_binding_count, 0), 2 ) AS dns_per_security_group_binding_ratio, dpa.down_port_rows, ROUND(dpa.avg_window_min_admin_state_up, 2) AS avg_window_min_admin_state_up FROM PortSecurityAndDns psd JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb2 ON sgpb2.PORT_ID = psd.port_id JOIN DownPortsAgg dpa ON dpa.SECURITY_GROUP_ID = sgpb2.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY dns_per_security_group_binding_ratio DESC, psd.port_id ), tenant_agg AS ( SELECT i.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT i.port_id) AS qualifying_port_count, ROUND(AVG(i.dns_per_security_group_binding_ratio), 2) AS avg_dns_per_sg_binding_ratio FROM inner_cte i GROUP BY i.tenant_id ), avg_across_tenants AS ( SELECT AVG(qualifying_port_count) AS avg_qualifying_ports_per_tenant FROM tenant_agg ) SELECT ta.tenant_id, ta.qualifying_port_count, ta.avg_dns_per_sg_binding_ratio, aat.avg_qualifying_ports_per_tenant FROM tenant_agg ta JOIN avg_across_tenants aat ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY ta.qualifying_port_count DESC, ta.tenant_id;

question: For the IPv4 subnet with ID '012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48', show the subnet’s name, tenant ID, network ID, IP version, CIDR, gateway IP, DHCP enabled flag, and allocation pool first/last IP, along with each associated subnet route’s destination and next hop. Do not repeat the subnet name if it is the same as the previous row. Also include (1) the maximum subnet standard attribute ID over the current subnet row and the next two rows when ordered by subnet ID, and (2) the dense-rank value for each route within the subnet. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Subnet ID "012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48" is predicated by "subnets.id IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH q1 AS ( SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') ), q2 AS ( SELECT r.DESTINATION, r.NEXTHOP, s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.SUBNET_ID ORDER BY r.SUBNET_ID) AS window_column FROM SUBNETROUTES r JOIN SUBNETS s ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') ) SELECT q1.NAME AS subnet_name, q1.TENANT_ID, q1.NETWORK_ID, q1.IP_VERSION, q1.CIDR, q1.GATEWAY_IP, q1.ENABLE_DHCP, q1.FIRST_IP AS allocation_first_ip, q1.LAST_IP AS allocation_last_ip, q1.max_standard_attr_id_next2, q2.DESTINATION AS route_destination, q2.NEXTHOP AS route_nexthop, q2.window_column AS route_dense_rank_within_subnet FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.NAME = q2.subnet_name AND q1.CIDR = q2.subnet_cidr AND q1.FIRST_IP = q2.FIRST_IP AND q1.LAST_IP = q2.LAST_IP ORDER BY q1.NAME, q2.window_column, q2.DESTINATION ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(subnet_name) OVER (ORDER BY subnet_name, route_dense_rank_within_subnet, route_destination) = subnet_name THEN NULL ELSE subnet_name END AS subnet_name, tenant_id, network_id, ip_version, cidr, gateway_ip, enable_dhcp, allocation_first_ip, allocation_last_ip, max_standard_attr_id_next2, route_destination, route_nexthop, route_dense_rank_within_subnet FROM inner_cte ORDER BY subnet_name, route_dense_rank_within_subnet, route_destination;

question: For each port status and device owner, considering only ports whose standard attribute resource type is 'ports' and excluding shared networks (networks whose IDs appear in networkrbacs with action = 'access_as_shared' and target_tenant = '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'), show the number of ports and the earliest standard attribute updated timestamp, and also include (by port status) the variance of the standard attribute ID across ports that have an IP allocation with IP address 10.150.64.113/8; then return only those (port status, device owner) rows whose port_count is greater than the average port_count across all returned rows. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))" IP Address "10.150.64.113/8" is predicated by "ipallocations.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH sq1 AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), sq2 AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, VARIANCE(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS standard_attr_id_variance FROM PORTS AS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID IS NOT NULL AND ia.IP_ADDRESS IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.STATUS ORDER BY standard_attr_id_variance DESC ) SELECT sq1.port_status, sq1.device_owner, sq1.port_count, sq1.earliest_standard_attr_update, sq2.standard_attr_id_variance FROM sq1 JOIN sq2 ON sq1.port_status = sq2.STATUS ORDER BY sq1.port_count DESC, sq2.standard_attr_id_variance DESC ) SELECT port_status, device_owner, port_count, earliest_standard_attr_update, standard_attr_id_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE port_count > (SELECT AVG(port_count) FROM inner_cte);

question: For each network status (excluding shared networks where RBAC action = 'access_as_shared' and target tenant is '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'), show the status, the number of ACTIVE networks in that status, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED across networks that have at least one security binding, the overall average of those variances across statuses as a benchmark, and categorize each status as 'HIGH_VARIANCE' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_VARIANCE' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE'. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH NetworkStatusSecurityStats AS ( SELECT n.STATUS AS network_status, VARIANCE(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_variance, STDDEV(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_stddev FROM NETWORKS AS n JOIN NETWORKSECURITYBINDINGS AS nsb ON n.ID = nsb.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.STATUS ORDER BY port_security_enabled_variance DESC ), ActiveNetworkRbacDetails AS ( SELECT n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up, r.action, r.target_tenant, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column FROM networksecuritybindings b JOIN networks n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN networkrbacs r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) ), ActiveNetworkCountsByStatus AS ( SELECT status AS network_status, COUNT(DISTINCT name) AS active_network_count FROM ActiveNetworkRbacDetails GROUP BY status ) SELECT nsss.network_status, anc.active_network_count, nsss.port_security_enabled_variance, nsss.port_security_enabled_stddev FROM NetworkStatusSecurityStats nsss JOIN ActiveNetworkCountsByStatus anc ON nsss.network_status = anc.network_status ORDER BY anc.active_network_count DESC, nsss.port_security_enabled_variance DESC ) , VarianceBenchmark AS ( SELECT AVG(port_security_enabled_variance) AS avg_variance_benchmark FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.network_status, i.active_network_count, i.port_security_enabled_variance, i.port_security_enabled_stddev, vb.avg_variance_benchmark AS benchmark, CASE WHEN i.port_security_enabled_variance > vb.avg_variance_benchmark * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN i.port_security_enabled_variance < vb.avg_variance_benchmark * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN VarianceBenchmark vb ORDER BY i.active_network_count DESC, i.port_security_enabled_variance DESC;

question: For tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57", among tenants that have at least 2 administratively-up ports, return the tenant ID, the count of those admin-up ports, the number of ACTIVE networks for that tenant, the most recent (latest) network standard-attribute updated_at timestamp, and whether the tenant has any administratively-up ports that are currently in DOWN status. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "networks.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')" Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH ActiveTenantNetworks AS (SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), AdminUpTenantPorts AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), TenantPortCounts AS ( SELECT ap.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.PORT_ID) AS admin_up_port_count FROM AdminUpTenantPorts ap GROUP BY ap.TENANT_ID ) SELECT an.tenant_id, tpc.admin_up_port_count, COUNT(DISTINCT an.network_id) AS active_network_count, MAX(an.standard_attr_updated_at) AS latest_network_standard_attr_updated_at FROM ActiveTenantNetworks an JOIN TenantPortCounts tpc ON an.tenant_id = tpc.tenant_id WHERE tpc.admin_up_port_count >= 2 GROUP BY an.tenant_id, tpc.admin_up_port_count ORDER BY tpc.admin_up_port_count DESC, active_network_count DESC) SELECT i.tenant_id, i.admin_up_port_count, i.active_network_count, i.latest_network_standard_attr_updated_at, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT p_down.id) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_admin_up_down_ports FROM inner_cte i LEFT JOIN ports p_down ON p_down.tenant_id = i.tenant_id AND p_down.admin_state_up = 1 AND p_down.status = 'DOWN' GROUP BY i.tenant_id, i.admin_up_port_count, i.active_network_count, i.latest_network_standard_attr_updated_at ORDER BY i.admin_up_port_count DESC, i.active_network_count DESC;

question: For tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57", for each ACTIVE network, group results by the network’s admin_state_up flag and by whether the network has any ports (admin_state_up = 1) that are bound to at least one security group (label as 'Has SG-bound ports' vs 'No SG-bound ports'). For each group, show the network admin_state_up value, the SG-bound-port status label, the number of distinct networks in the group, the total number of such SG-bound ports across those networks, and the totals of security-group bindings and DNS records across those ports. Include subtotals per network admin_state_up and a grand total. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "networks.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')" Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH q1 AS ( SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), q2 AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb JOIN PORTS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN PORTDNSES pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name ), port_net AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.network_id FROM PORTS p WHERE p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ) SELECT q1.network_id, q1.network_name, q1.tenant_id, q1.admin_state_up AS network_admin_state_up, q1.mtu, q1.standard_attr_updated_at, q1.window_column AS network_row_number_within_tenant, COUNT(q2.port_id) AS ports_with_security_group_count, COALESCE(SUM(q2.security_group_binding_count), 0) AS total_security_group_bindings_across_ports, COALESCE(SUM(q2.dns_record_count), 0) AS total_dns_records_across_ports FROM q1 LEFT JOIN port_net pn ON pn.network_id = q1.network_id LEFT JOIN q2 ON q2.port_id = pn.port_id AND q2.tenant_id = q1.tenant_id GROUP BY q1.network_id, q1.network_name, q1.tenant_id, q1.admin_state_up, q1.mtu, q1.standard_attr_updated_at, q1.window_column ORDER BY ports_with_security_group_count DESC, q1.network_name ) , NetworkRollup AS ( SELECT ic.network_admin_state_up, CASE WHEN ic.ports_with_security_group_count > 0 THEN 'Has SG-bound ports' ELSE 'No SG-bound ports' END AS sg_bound_port_status, COUNT(DISTINCT ic.network_id) AS total_networks, SUM(ic.ports_with_security_group_count) AS total_sg_bound_ports, SUM(ic.total_security_group_bindings_across_ports) AS total_security_group_bindings, SUM(ic.total_dns_records_across_ports) AS total_dns_records FROM inner_cte ic GROUP BY ic.network_admin_state_up, sg_bound_port_status ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(network_admin_state_up) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE CAST(network_admin_state_up AS CHAR) END AS network_admin_state_up, CASE WHEN GROUPING(sg_bound_port_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(network_admin_state_up) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(sg_bound_port_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(network_admin_state_up) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE sg_bound_port_status END AS sg_bound_port_status, SUM(total_networks) AS total_networks, SUM(total_sg_bound_ports) AS total_sg_bound_ports, SUM(total_security_group_bindings) AS total_security_group_bindings, SUM(total_dns_records) AS total_dns_records FROM NetworkRollup GROUP BY network_admin_state_up, sg_bound_port_status WITH ROLLUP;

question: For port statuses that have ports with an IP allocation of '10.150.64.113/8', list the status, (1) the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) (standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) divided by average) of the allocated IP address string length for ports with port security enabled, and (2) the variance of STANDARD_ATTR_ID, shown side-by-side per status. Do not repeat the status if it is the same as the previous row, and include a grand total row across all statuses. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: IP Address "10.150.64.113/8" is predicated by "ipallocations.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH port_status_ip_length_cov AS ( SELECT p.status, STDDEV(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) / NULLIF(AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM portsecuritybindings psb JOIN ports p ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON p.id = ia.port_id WHERE psb.port_security_enabled = 1 AND ia.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), port_status_standard_attr_id_variance AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, VARIANCE(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS standard_attr_id_variance FROM PORTS AS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID IS NOT NULL AND ia.IP_ADDRESS IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.STATUS ORDER BY standard_attr_id_variance DESC ) SELECT cov.status, cov.coefficient_of_variation, var.standard_attr_id_variance FROM port_status_ip_length_cov cov JOIN port_status_standard_attr_id_variance var ON cov.status = var.status) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(status) OVER (ORDER BY status_sort, status) = status THEN NULL ELSE status END AS status, coefficient_of_variation, standard_attr_id_variance FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(status) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE status END AS status_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(status) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE status END AS status, AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS coefficient_of_variation, AVG(standard_attr_id_variance) AS standard_attr_id_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY status WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY status_sort, status;

question: For each network among ports that are administratively up and belong to tenant ID `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57`, find the network ID and the highest (maximum) value of the per-port windowed average standard attribute ID (computed over a 2-preceding/2-following window partitioned by VIF type and ordered by standard attribute ID), and also include (by matching port status) the minimum admin_state_up and average standard_attr_id for ports bound with VIF type `ovs` whose device_id is `da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7`. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')" Device ID "da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7" is predicated by "ports.device_id IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) AS min_admin_state_up, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE b.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' AND p.DEVICE_ID IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS ) SELECT s1.PORT_ID, s1.HOST, s1.VIF_TYPE, s1.VNIC_TYPE, s1.TENANT_ID, s1.NETWORK_ID, s1.MAC_ADDRESS, s1.STATUS, s1.DEVICE_OWNER, s1.window_column, s2.min_admin_state_up, s2.avg_standard_attr_id FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.STATUS = s2.STATUS ) SELECT network_id, MAX(window_column) AS max_windowed_avg_standard_attr_id, MAX(min_admin_state_up) AS min_admin_state_up_for_matching_status, AVG(avg_standard_attr_id) AS avg_standard_attr_id_for_matching_status FROM inner_cte GROUP BY network_id;

question: For tenant ID '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57', among (network ID, VIF type) groups whose administratively up port count is greater than the average administratively up port count across all (network ID, VIF type) groups for that tenant, show the network ID, VIF type, the number of administratively up ports, the number of DOWN ports that have a security-group-to-port binding, the average of the “average standard attribute ID” window metric, and the best (minimum) security-group rank among those DOWN ports, ordered by the administratively up port count descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), subq2 AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ) SELECT subq2.NETWORK_ID, subq2.VIF_TYPE, COUNT(DISTINCT subq2.PORT_ID) AS total_admin_up_ports, COUNT(DISTINCT subq1.port_id) AS total_down_ports_with_security_group_binding, AVG(subq2.window_column) AS avg_standard_attr_id_window_avg, MIN(subq1.window_column) AS best_rank_within_security_group_for_down_ports FROM subq2 LEFT JOIN subq1 ON subq2.PORT_ID = subq1.port_id AND subq2.TENANT_ID = subq1.tenant_id GROUP BY subq2.NETWORK_ID, subq2.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY total_admin_up_ports DESC ) SELECT network_id, vif_type, total_admin_up_ports, total_down_ports_with_security_group_binding, avg_standard_attr_id_window_avg, best_rank_within_security_group_for_down_ports FROM inner_cte WHERE total_admin_up_ports > (SELECT AVG(total_admin_up_ports) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY total_admin_up_ports DESC;

question: For ports that are DOWN on network ID `0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d`, list the port name, network ID, MAC address, admin state, status, device owner, bound security group ID, and the minimum admin_state_up over a window of 3 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by port ID; additionally, for any of these ports whose MAC address matches an administratively UP port belonging to tenant `17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7`, also show that admin-up port’s ID, tenant ID, number of port security bindings, and total times port security is enabled across those bindings; and for each DOWN port’s tenant, also include the total number of ports that tenant owns and the average number of ports across all tenants. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')" Network ID "0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d" is predicated by "ports.network_id IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH AdminUpTenantPortSecurity AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(psb.port_id) AS binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN psb.port_security_enabled THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS port_security_enabled_total FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address ), DownNetworkPortsWithSecurityGroupWindow AS ( SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') ) SELECT d.NAME, d.NETWORK_ID, d.MAC_ADDRESS, d.ADMIN_STATE_UP, d.STATUS, d.DEVICE_OWNER, d.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, d.window_column, a.port_id AS admin_up_port_id, a.tenant_id AS admin_up_tenant_id, a.binding_count, a.port_security_enabled_total FROM DownNetworkPortsWithSecurityGroupWindow d LEFT JOIN AdminUpTenantPortSecurity a ON d.MAC_ADDRESS = a.mac_address ORDER BY d.NETWORK_ID, d.NAME, d.MAC_ADDRESS ) SELECT inner_cte.NAME, inner_cte.NETWORK_ID, inner_cte.MAC_ADDRESS, inner_cte.ADMIN_STATE_UP, inner_cte.STATUS, inner_cte.DEVICE_OWNER, inner_cte.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.admin_up_port_id, inner_cte.admin_up_tenant_id, inner_cte.binding_count, inner_cte.port_security_enabled_total, tp.total_ports AS down_port_tenant_total_ports, avg_ports.avg_port_count AS avg_ports_across_all_tenants FROM inner_cte JOIN ports p_down ON p_down.network_id = inner_cte.NETWORK_ID AND p_down.mac_address = inner_cte.MAC_ADDRESS LEFT JOIN ( SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(id) AS total_ports FROM ports GROUP BY tenant_id ) AS tp ON tp.tenant_id = p_down.tenant_id JOIN ( SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_port_count FROM ( SELECT COUNT(id) AS port_count FROM ports GROUP BY tenant_id ) AS sub ) AS avg_ports ORDER BY inner_cte.NETWORK_ID, inner_cte.NAME, inner_cte.MAC_ADDRESS;

question: For tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57", for tenants that have at least 2 administratively-up ports, break down the results by port binding VIF type and show the tenant ID, VIF type, the count of admin-up ports of that VIF type, the number of ACTIVE networks for that tenant, and the most recent (latest) network standard-attribute updated_at timestamp. Include subtotals per tenant and a grand total. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "networks.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')" Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH ActiveTenantNetworks AS (SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), AdminUpTenantPorts AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), TenantPortCounts AS ( SELECT ap.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.PORT_ID) AS admin_up_port_count FROM AdminUpTenantPorts ap GROUP BY ap.TENANT_ID ) SELECT an.tenant_id, tpc.admin_up_port_count, COUNT(DISTINCT an.network_id) AS active_network_count, MAX(an.standard_attr_updated_at) AS latest_network_standard_attr_updated_at FROM ActiveTenantNetworks an JOIN TenantPortCounts tpc ON an.tenant_id = tpc.tenant_id WHERE tpc.admin_up_port_count >= 2 GROUP BY an.tenant_id, tpc.admin_up_port_count ORDER BY tpc.admin_up_port_count DESC, active_network_count DESC) , TenantActiveNetworks AS ( SELECT tenant_id, active_network_count, latest_network_standard_attr_updated_at FROM inner_cte ), TenantVifTypePortCounts AS ( SELECT p.tenant_id, b.vif_type, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS admin_up_ports_of_vif_type FROM PORTS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b ON b.port_id = p.id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS psb ON psb.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.tenant_id, b.vif_type ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(tv.tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE tv.tenant_id END AS tenant_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tv.vif_type) = 1 AND GROUPING(tv.tenant_id) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(tv.vif_type) = 1 AND GROUPING(tv.tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE tv.vif_type END AS vif_type, SUM(tv.admin_up_ports_of_vif_type) AS admin_up_ports_of_vif_type, MAX(tan.active_network_count) AS active_network_count, MAX(tan.latest_network_standard_attr_updated_at) AS latest_network_standard_attr_updated_at FROM TenantVifTypePortCounts tv JOIN TenantActiveNetworks tan ON tan.tenant_id = tv.tenant_id GROUP BY tv.tenant_id, tv.vif_type WITH ROLLUP;

question: For each port status and device owner (considering only ports whose standard attribute resource type is 'ports' and excluding shared networks where networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' and target_tenant is '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'), return the number of ports and the earliest standard attribute updated timestamp, along with the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of allocated IP address string length for that same port status among ports with port security enabled and allocated IP address in ('10.150.64.113/8'). Include subtotals per port status and a grand total. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))" IP Address "10.150.64.113/8" is predicated by "ipallocations.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8')"
