SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH PortCountsAndEarliestUpdate AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), PortStatusIpLengthCV AS ( SELECT p.status, STDDEV(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) / NULLIF(AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM portsecuritybindings psb JOIN ports p ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON p.id = ia.port_id WHERE psb.port_security_enabled = 1 AND ia.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT pceu.port_status, pceu.device_owner, pceu.port_count, pceu.earliest_standard_attr_update, psilcv.coefficient_of_variation FROM PortCountsAndEarliestUpdate pceu JOIN PortStatusIpLengthCV psilcv ON psilcv.status = pceu.port_status) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(port_status) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE port_status END AS port_status, CASE WHEN GROUPING(device_owner) = 1 AND GROUPING(port_status) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE device_owner END AS device_owner, SUM(port_count) AS port_count, MIN(earliest_standard_attr_update) AS earliest_standard_attr_update, AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte GROUP BY port_status, device_owner WITH ROLLUP;

question: For tenant ID '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7' and considering only DOWN ports, list each (port status, device owner) combination where the ports are bound to a security group, returning the distinct port count and the minimum standard attribute ID; additionally, for each such combination, include the total number of security-group port bindings across those ports and the average number of security-group bindings per port, while also including (by matching on port status) the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of port security bindings per port for that same tenant. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH PortStatusOwnerSecurityGroupStats AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), PortStatusBindingCountDispersion AS ( SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC ) SELECT psosgs.port_status, psosgs.device_owner, psosgs.port_count, psosgs.min_standard_attr_id, psbcd.binding_count_range, psbcd.binding_count_variance, psbcd.binding_count_stddev FROM PortStatusOwnerSecurityGroupStats psosgs JOIN PortStatusBindingCountDispersion psbcd ON psosgs.port_status = psbcd.status ORDER BY psosgs.port_status, psosgs.device_owner) SELECT i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.min_standard_attr_id, i.binding_count_range, i.binding_count_variance, i.binding_count_stddev, COUNT(spb2.security_group_id) AS total_securitygroup_port_bindings, (COUNT(spb2.security_group_id) * 1.0) / NULLIF(i.port_count, 0) AS avg_securitygroup_bindings_per_port FROM inner_cte i JOIN ports p2 ON p2.status = i.port_status AND p2.device_owner = i.device_owner AND p2.tenant_id = '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7' JOIN securitygroupportbindings spb2 ON spb2.port_id = p2.id WHERE p2.status = 'DOWN' GROUP BY i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.min_standard_attr_id, i.binding_count_range, i.binding_count_variance, i.binding_count_stddev ORDER BY i.port_status, i.device_owner;

question: For administratively up ports owned by tenant `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57`, excluding shared networks (networks listed in `networkrbacs` with action `access_as_shared` and target tenant `*` or `9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b`), show for each VIF type, port status, and device owner: the overall port count and earliest standard-attribute updated timestamp for that status/owner, along with the number of matching tenant port rows and the average of the windowed average standard attribute ID; additionally, include the overall average tenant_port_rows across all groups as a benchmark and categorize each group as 'HIGH_ACTIVITY' (at least 50% above benchmark), 'LOW_ACTIVITY' (at least 50% below benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_ACTIVITY'. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))" Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH sq1 AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), sq2 AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ) SELECT sq2.VIF_TYPE, sq2.STATUS AS port_status, sq2.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, sq1.port_count, sq1.earliest_standard_attr_update, COUNT(sq2.PORT_ID) AS tenant_port_rows, AVG(sq2.window_column) AS avg_window_standard_attr_id FROM sq2 JOIN sq1 ON sq2.STATUS = sq1.port_status AND sq2.DEVICE_OWNER = sq1.device_owner WHERE sq2.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY sq2.VIF_TYPE, sq2.STATUS, sq2.DEVICE_OWNER, sq1.port_count, sq1.earliest_standard_attr_update ORDER BY tenant_port_rows DESC ), benchmark AS ( SELECT AVG(tenant_port_rows) AS avg_tenant_port_rows FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.VIF_TYPE, i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.earliest_standard_attr_update, i.tenant_port_rows, i.avg_window_standard_attr_id, b.avg_tenant_port_rows AS benchmark, CASE WHEN i.tenant_port_rows > b.avg_tenant_port_rows * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_ACTIVITY' WHEN i.tenant_port_rows < b.avg_tenant_port_rows * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_ACTIVITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_ACTIVITY' END AS activity_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN benchmark b ORDER BY i.tenant_port_rows DESC;

question: For the tenant_id '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7', list each port status along with the two stacked coefficient-of-variation metrics from the original analysis, but also include a subtotal row per status (and a grand total) showing the average coefficient_of_variation across the two metrics. SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH StdAttrIdCVByStatus AS ( SELECT p.status, STDDEV(p.standard_attr_id) / NULLIF(AVG(p.standard_attr_id), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM securitygroupportbindings AS sgpb JOIN ports AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN portsecuritybindings AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(p.standard_attr_id) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), IpAddressLengthCVByStatus AS ( SELECT p.status, STDDEV(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) / NULLIF(AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM portsecuritybindings psb JOIN ports p ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON p.id = ia.port_id WHERE psb.port_security_enabled = 1 AND ia.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), CombinedStatusCVs AS ( SELECT status, coefficient_of_variation, 'Standard Attr ID SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH PortStatusOwnerSecurityGroupStats AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), PortStatusBindingCountDispersion AS ( SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC ) SELECT psosgs.port_status, psosgs.device_owner, psosgs.port_count, psosgs.min_standard_attr_id, psbcd.binding_count_range, psbcd.binding_count_variance, psbcd.binding_count_stddev FROM PortStatusOwnerSecurityGroupStats psosgs JOIN PortStatusBindingCountDispersion psbcd ON psosgs.port_status = psbcd.status ORDER BY psosgs.port_status, psosgs.device_owner ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.port_status) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE inner_cte.port_status END AS port_status, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.device_owner) = 1 AND GROUPING(inner_cte.port_status) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.device_owner) = 1 AND GROUPING(inner_cte.port_status) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE inner_cte.device_owner END AS device_owner, SUM(inner_cte.port_count) AS port_count, MIN(inner_cte.min_standard_attr_id) AS min_standard_attr_id, MAX(inner_cte.binding_count_range) AS binding_count_range, MAX(inner_cte.binding_count_variance) AS binding_count_variance, MAX(inner_cte.binding_count_stddev) AS binding_count_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.port_status, inner_cte.device_owner WITH ROLLUP;

question: For network ID `0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d`, compute the ratio of tenant `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57` “admin up with at least one IP allocation” ports (matched to DOWN ports on the same network by MAC address) to the distinct DOWN port names, and return only networks where this ratio is greater than 0.25 (also returning the underlying distinct DOWN port name count, distinct DOWN security group count, and the tenant port/IP totals used in the ratio). evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')" Network ID "0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d" is predicated by "ports.network_id IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH TenantUpPortsWithIPs AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ia.subnet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND ia.ip_address IS NOT NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address), DownPortsOnNetworkWithSG AS (SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d')), TenantUpPortsWithIPsOnNetwork AS ( SELECT t.port_id, t.tenant_id, t.mac_address, t.ip_allocation_count, t.subnet_id_rows FROM TenantUpPortsWithIPs t JOIN PORTS p ON p.ID = t.port_id WHERE p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') ) SELECT d.NETWORK_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT d.NAME) AS down_port_name_count, COUNT(DISTINCT d.SECURITY_GROUP_ID) AS down_port_security_group_count, COUNT(DISTINCT t.port_id) AS tenant_up_port_count_with_ips, SUM(t.ip_allocation_count) AS tenant_up_total_ip_allocations, SUM(t.subnet_id_rows) AS tenant_up_total_subnet_id_rows FROM DownPortsOnNetworkWithSG d LEFT JOIN TenantUpPortsWithIPsOnNetwork t ON t.mac_address = d.MAC_ADDRESS GROUP BY d.NETWORK_ID) SELECT network_id, down_port_name_count, down_port_security_group_count, tenant_up_port_count_with_ips, tenant_up_total_ip_allocations, tenant_up_total_subnet_id_rows, (tenant_up_port_count_with_ips * 1.0 / NULLIF(down_port_name_count, 0)) AS tenant_up_to_down_name_ratio FROM inner_cte WHERE down_port_name_count > 0 AND (tenant_up_port_count_with_ips * 1.0 / down_port_name_count) > 0.25;

question: For tenant ID '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57', among the security groups whose ratio is greater than 75% of (ports that are administratively up and have at least one IP allocation) compared to (ports that are DOWN and bound to that security group), what is the maximum number of distinct IP allocation subnets (SUBNET_ID) observed on any single admin-up port associated with that security group? Return the security group ID and this maximum distinct-subnet count. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DownPortsBySecurityGroup AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), AdminUpPortsWithIPAllocations AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ia.subnet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND ia.ip_address IS NOT NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address ) SELECT dpsg.security_group_id, COUNT(DISTINCT dpsg.port_id) AS down_port_count, COUNT(DISTINCT aup.port_id) AS admin_up_port_with_ip_count FROM DownPortsBySecurityGroup dpsg LEFT JOIN AdminUpPortsWithIPAllocations aup ON aup.tenant_id = dpsg.tenant_id GROUP BY dpsg.security_group_id HAVING (COUNT(DISTINCT aup.port_id) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT dpsg.port_id), 0)) > 0.75) , PortSubnetCounts AS ( SELECT spb.security_group_id, p.id AS port_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.subnet_id) AS distinct_subnet_count FROM ports p JOIN securitygroupportbindings spb ON spb.port_id = p.id JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND ia.ip_address IS NOT NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY spb.security_group_id, p.id ) SELECT i.security_group_id, MAX(psc.distinct_subnet_count) AS max_distinct_subnets_on_any_admin_up_port FROM inner_cte i JOIN PortSubnetCounts psc ON psc.security_group_id = i.security_group_id GROUP BY i.security_group_id;

question: For each port status that appears among administratively up ports for tenant ID `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57`, list the status, the number of distinct ports, the average of the per-port windowed average standard attribute ID (partitioned by VIF type and ordered by standard attribute ID with 2 preceding and 2 following rows), and the minimum admin_state_up value and average standard_attr_id for ports bound with VIF type `ovs` whose device_id is `da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7`, keeping only statuses where the tenant’s distinct-port count is greater than 75% of the distinct-port count for that same status in the `ovs` device subset. SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH TenantAdminUpPorts AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), OvsDeviceStatusStats AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) AS min_admin_state_up, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE b.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' AND p.DEVICE_ID IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS ) SELECT tap.STATUS, COUNT(DISTINCT tap.PORT_ID) AS ports_for_tenant_admin_up, AVG(tap.window_column) AS avg_window_standard_attr_id, ods.min_admin_state_up, ods.avg_standard_attr_id FROM TenantAdminUpPorts tap JOIN OvsDeviceStatusStats ods ON tap.STATUS = ods.STATUS GROUP BY tap.STATUS, ods.min_admin_state_up, ods.avg_standard_attr_id ORDER BY ports_for_tenant_admin_up DESC) SELECT i.STATUS, i.ports_for_tenant_admin_up, i.avg_window_standard_attr_id, i.min_admin_state_up, i.avg_standard_attr_id FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT p.STATUS, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS ovs_device_ports_for_status FROM PORTS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE b.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' AND p.DEVICE_ID IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS ) d ON d.STATUS = i.STATUS WHERE d.ovs_device_ports_for_status > 0 AND (i.ports_for_tenant_admin_up * 1.0 / d.ovs_device_ports_for_status) > 0.75 ORDER BY i.ports_for_tenant_admin_up DESC;

WHEN GROUPING(i.subnet_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.subnet_name END AS subnet_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.subnet_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.subnet_name END AS subnet_name, MAX(i.tenant_id) AS tenant_id, MAX(i.network_id) AS network_id, MAX(i.ip_version) AS ip_version, MAX(i.cidr) AS cidr, MAX(i.gateway_ip) AS gateway_ip, MAX(i.enable_dhcp) AS enable_dhcp, MAX(i.allocation_pool_first_ip) AS SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) AS min_admin_state_up, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE b.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' AND p.DEVICE_ID IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS ) SELECT s1.PORT_ID, s1.HOST, s1.VIF_TYPE, s1.VNIC_TYPE, s1.TENANT_ID, s1.NETWORK_ID, s1.MAC_ADDRESS, s1.STATUS, s1.DEVICE_OWNER, s1.window_column, s2.min_admin_state_up, s2.avg_standard_attr_id FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.STATUS = s2.STATUS ) SELECT i.PORT_ID, i.HOST, i.VIF_TYPE, i.VNIC_TYPE, i.TENANT_ID, i.NETWORK_ID, i.MAC_ADDRESS, i.STATUS, i.DEVICE_OWNER, i.window_column, i.min_admin_state_up, i.avg_standard_attr_id, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT f.ID) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_floating_ip FROM inner_cte i LEFT JOIN FLOATINGIPS f ON i.PORT_ID = f.FIXED_PORT_ID GROUP BY i.PORT_ID, i.HOST, i.VIF_TYPE, i.VNIC_TYPE, i.TENANT_ID, i.NETWORK_ID, i.MAC_ADDRESS, i.STATUS, i.DEVICE_OWNER, i.window_column, i.min_admin_state_up, i.avg_standard_attr_id;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH sq1 AS ( SELECT p.status, STDDEV(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) / NULLIF(AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM portsecuritybindings psb JOIN ports p ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON p.id = ia.port_id WHERE psb.port_security_enabled = 1 AND ia.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), sq2 AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, VARIANCE(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS standard_attr_id_variance FROM PORTS AS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID IS NOT NULL AND ia.IP_ADDRESS IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.STATUS ORDER BY standard_attr_id_variance DESC ) SELECT sq1.status, sq1.coefficient_of_variation, sq2.standard_attr_id_variance FROM sq1 JOIN sq2 ON sq1.status = sq2.status ORDER BY sq1.coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT MAX(coefficient_of_variation) AS max_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH PortStatusOwnerStats AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), AdminUpPortWindowStats AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ) SELECT psos.port_status, psos.device_owner, psos.port_count, psos.min_standard_attr_id, aupws.VIF_TYPE, COUNT(DISTINCT aupws.PORT_ID) AS admin_up_ports, AVG(aupws.window_column) AS avg_window_standard_attr_id FROM PortStatusOwnerStats psos JOIN AdminUpPortWindowStats aupws ON psos.port_status = aupws.STATUS AND psos.device_owner = aupws.DEVICE_OWNER GROUP BY psos.port_status, psos.device_owner, psos.port_count, psos.min_standard_attr_id, aupws.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY psos.port_count DESC) SELECT port_status, device_owner, MAX(avg_window_standard_attr_id) AS max_avg_window_standard_attr_id_across_vif_types FROM inner_cte GROUP BY port_status, device_owner;

question: For each ACTIVE network (excluding shared networks), list the network name, status, and admin_state_up along with its RBAC action and target tenant (including the dense-rank window column), and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subnet IP version for that same RBAC action computed over DHCP-enabled subnets on non-shared networks (only actions with more than 5 matching subnets). SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 AND s.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.ACTION HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY ip_version_stddev DESC ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up, r.action, r.target_tenant, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column FROM networksecuritybindings b JOIN networks n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN networkrbacs r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) ) SELECT s2.name, s2.status, s2.admin_state_up, s2.action, s2.target_tenant, s2.window_column, s1.ip_version_stddev FROM Subq2 s2 JOIN Subq1 s1 ON s2.action = s1.ACTION ), PerNetworkSubnetCounts AS ( SELECT r.action, s.network_id, COUNT(*) AS dhcp_subnet_count FROM networkrbacs r JOIN subnets s ON r.object_id = s.network_id WHERE s.enable_dhcp = 1 AND s.network_id NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY r.action, s.network_id ), MaxSubnetCountsByAction AS ( SELECT action, MAX(dhcp_subnet_count) AS max_dhcp_subnet_count_per_network FROM PerNetworkSubnetCounts GROUP BY action ) SELECT i.name, i.status, i.admin_state_up, i.action, i.target_tenant, i.window_column, i.ip_version_stddev, m.max_dhcp_subnet_count_per_network FROM inner_cte i JOIN MaxSubnetCountsByAction m ON i.action = m.action;

question: For tenant ID `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57`, return the same per-port results as before (each administratively UP port with at least one IP allocation, including the tenant’s total port count, port ID and MAC, IP allocation and subnet-id row counts, the rounded normalized IP-allocations-per-tenant-port ratio, and any matching DOWN-port details on network `0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d`). IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address), DownPortsWithSg AS (SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d')), TenantPortCounts AS ( SELECT p.tenant_id, COUNT(p.id) AS tenant_port_count FROM ports p WHERE p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.tenant_id ) SELECT pis.tenant_id, tpc.tenant_port_count, pis.port_id, pis.mac_address, pis.ip_allocation_count, pis.subnet_id_rows, ROUND(pis.ip_allocation_count / NULLIF(tpc.tenant_port_count, 0), 2) AS ip_allocations_per_tenant_port_ratio, dp.NAME AS down_port_name, dp.NETWORK_ID AS down_port_network_id, dp.STATUS AS down_port_status, dp.DEVICE_OWNER AS down_port_device_owner, dp.SECURITY_GROUP_ID AS down_port_security_group_id, dp.window_column AS down_port_window_min_admin_state_up FROM PortIpStats pis JOIN TenantPortCounts tpc ON tpc.tenant_id = pis.tenant_id LEFT JOIN DownPortsWithSg dp ON dp.MAC_ADDRESS = pis.mac_address ORDER BY ip_allocations_per_tenant_port_ratio DESC, pis.port_id ) SELECT i.tenant_id, i.tenant_port_count, avg_ports.avg_port_count AS avg_port_count_across_all_tenants, ROUND(i.tenant_port_count / NULLIF(avg_ports.avg_port_count, 0), 2) AS tenant_ports_to_global_avg_ratio, i.port_id, i.mac_address, i.ip_allocation_count, i.subnet_id_rows, i.ip_allocations_per_tenant_port_ratio, i.down_port_name, i.down_port_network_id, i.down_port_status, i.down_port_device_owner, i.down_port_security_group_id, i.down_port_window_min_admin_state_up FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_port_count FROM ( SELECT question: For tenant ID '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7' and considering only DOWN ports, for each (port status, device owner) combination where the ports are bound to a security group, return the distinct port count and the minimum standard attribute ID, and also include (by matching on port status) the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of port security bindings per port for that same tenant. Additionally, keep only those (port status, device owner) rows whose distinct port count is greater than the average distinct port count across device owners for the same port status (within that tenant and DOWN ports bound to a security group). evidence: Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH PortStatusOwnerSecurityGroupStats AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), PortStatusBindingCountDispersion AS ( SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC ) SELECT psosgs.port_status, psosgs.device_owner, psosgs.port_count, psosgs.min_standard_attr_id, psbcd.binding_count_range, psbcd.binding_count_variance, psbcd.binding_count_stddev FROM PortStatusOwnerSecurityGroupStats psosgs JOIN PortStatusBindingCountDispersion psbcd ON psosgs.port_status = psbcd.status ORDER BY psosgs.port_status, psosgs.device_owner ), StatusOwnerAverages AS ( SELECT port_status, AVG(port_count) AS avg_port_count_per_owner FROM inner_cte GROUP BY port_status ) SELECT i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.min_standard_attr_id, i.binding_count_range, i.binding_count_variance, i.binding_count_stddev FROM inner_cte i JOIN StatusOwnerAverages soa ON i.port_status = soa.port_status WHERE i.port_count > soa.avg_port_count_per_owner ORDER BY i.port_status, i.device_owner;

question: For tenant ID '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57', for each network, find the network ID and the highest DNS-records-per-max-binding ratio among its security groups (where each security group is computed only from security groups that have DOWN ports, using the ratio of total DNS record count across the tenant’s admin_state_up = 1 ports in that group divided by the maximum number of security-group bindings among those admin_state_up ports, rounded to 2 decimals).
evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DownPortsBySecurityGroup AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), AdminUpPortBindingAndDnsCounts AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb JOIN PORTS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN PORTDNSES pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name ) SELECT dpsg.security_group_id, COUNT(DISTINCT dpsg.port_id) AS down_port_count, MAX(au.security_group_binding_count) AS max_security_group_binding_count_among_admin_up_ports, SUM(au.dns_record_count) AS total_dns_record_count_for_admin_up_ports, ROUND( SUM(au.dns_record_count) / NULLIF(MAX(au.security_group_binding_count), 0), 2 ) AS dns_records_per_max_binding_ratio FROM DownPortsBySecurityGroup dpsg JOIN AdminUpPortBindingAndDnsCounts au ON au.port_id = dpsg.port_id AND au.tenant_id = dpsg.tenant_id WHERE dpsg.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY dpsg.security_group_id ORDER BY dns_records_per_max_binding_ratio DESC) , NetworkSecurityGroupRatios AS ( SELECT p.network_id, i.security_group_id, i.dns_records_per_max_binding_ratio FROM inner_cte i JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb ON sgpb.security_group_id = i.security_group_id JOIN PORTS p ON p.id = sgpb.port_id ) SELECT network_id, MAX(dns_records_per_max_binding_ratio) AS max_dns_records_per_max_binding_ratio FROM NetworkSecurityGroupRatios GROUP BY network_id;

question: Using the existing result set of ACTIVE networks that have an RBAC entry and max MTU greater than 8000 (restricted to the shared RBAC action) along with the IPv4 subnet IP-version statistics for the "access_as_shared" permission, show the same network-level rows but also include subtotals by RBAC action and a grand total, reporting the number of networks and the maximum MTU across each rollup level. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "access_as_shared" permission is predicated by "networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared'" "access_as_external" permission is predicated by "networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_external'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH RbacIpVersionStats AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC ), HighMtuRbacNetworks AS ( SELECT n.name AS network_name, r.action AS rbac_action, MAX(n.mtu) AS max_mtu FROM NETWORKSECURITYBINDINGS nsb JOIN NETWORKS n ON nsb.network_id = n.id JOIN NETWORKRBACS r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.action IN ('access_as_shared', 'access_as_external') GROUP BY n.name, r.action HAVING MAX(n.mtu) > 8000 ), FilteredHighMtuSharedNetworks AS ( SELECT hmn.network_name, hmn.rbac_action, hmn.max_mtu FROM HighMtuRbacNetworks hmn WHERE hmn.rbac_action = 'access_as_shared' ) SELECT f.network_name, f.rbac_action, f.max_mtu, r.avg_ip_version, r.ip_version_variance, r.ip_version_stddev FROM FilteredHighMtuSharedNetworks f JOIN RbacIpVersionStats r ON r.ACTION = f.rbac_action ORDER BY f.max_mtu DESC, f.network_name) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.rbac_action) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE inner_cte.rbac_action END AS rbac_action, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.network_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(inner_cte.rbac_action) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE inner_cte.network_name END AS network_name, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.network_name) AS total_networks, MAX(inner_cte.max_mtu) AS max_mtu, MAX(inner_cte.avg_ip_version) AS avg_ip_version, MAX(inner_cte.ip_version_variance) AS ip_version_variance, MAX(inner_cte.ip_version_stddev) AS ip_version_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.rbac_action, inner_cte.network_name WITH ROLLUP;

MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC), CombinedPortStats AS ( SELECT pso.port_status AS status, pso.device_owner AS device_owner, pso.port_count AS port_count, pso.min_standard_attr_id AS min_standard_attr_id, NULL AS binding_count_range, NULL AS binding_count_variance, NULL AS binding_count_stddev, 'Security Group Bound Port Summary' AS reason FROM PortStatusOwnerStats pso UNION ALL SELECT psbd.status AS status, NULL AS device_owner, NULL AS port_count, NULL AS min_standard_attr_id, psbd.binding_count_range AS binding_count_range, psbd.binding_count_variance AS binding_count_variance, psbd.binding_count_stddev AS binding_count_stddev, 'Port Security Binding Dispersion' AS reason FROM PortSecurityBindingDispersion psbd ) SELECT * FROM CombinedPortStats ORDER BY status, reason, device_owner) SELECT inner_cte.*, tenant_totals.total_ports_for_tenant, avg_ports.avg_port_count_across_tenants FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT p.tenant_id, COUNT(p.id) AS total_ports_for_tenant FROM ports p GROUP BY p.tenant_id) AS tenant_totals ON tenant_totals.tenant_id = '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7' JOIN (SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_port_count_across_tenants FROM (SELECT COUNT(id) AS port_count FROM ports GROUP BY tenant_id) AS sub) AS avg_ports ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY inner_cte.status, inner_cte.reason, inner_cte.device_owner;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH network_status_security_stats AS ( SELECT n.STATUS AS network_status, VARIANCE(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_variance, STDDEV(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_stddev FROM NETWORKS AS n JOIN NETWORKSECURITYBINDINGS AS nsb ON n.ID = nsb.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.STATUS ORDER BY port_security_enabled_variance DESC ), active_network_rbac_details AS ( SELECT n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up, r.action, r.target_tenant, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column FROM networksecuritybindings b JOIN networks n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN networkrbacs r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) ), active_network_rbac_summary AS ( SELECT status AS network_status, COUNT(*) AS active_network_rbac_row_count FROM active_network_rbac_details GROUP BY status ) SELECT nsss.network_status, nsss.port_security_enabled_variance, nsss.port_security_enabled_stddev, anrs.active_network_rbac_row_count FROM network_status_security_stats nsss LEFT JOIN active_network_rbac_summary anrs ON anrs.network_status = nsss.network_status) SELECT i.network_status, i.port_security_enabled_variance, i.port_security_enabled_stddev, i.active_network_rbac_row_count, avg_counts.avg_active_network_rbac_row_count FROM inner_cte i JOIN (SELECT AVG(active_network_rbac_row_count) AS avg_active_network_rbac_row_count FROM inner_cte) AS avg_counts ON 1 = 1;

question: For each ACTIVE network (with a security binding) that has an RBAC action of either 'access_as_shared' or 'access_as_external' and whose maximum MTU is greater than 8000, list the network name, the RBAC action, that maximum MTU, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subnet IP version numbers for that RBAC action considering only DHCP-enabled subnets and excluding shared networks (those with an `access_as_shared` RBAC entry targeting `'*'` or `'9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'`), keeping only RBAC actions with more than 5 matching subnets, and also include the deviation of each network’s maximum MTU from the overall average of these maximum MTUs across all returned networks. evidence: "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))" "access_as_shared" permission is predicated by "networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared'" "access_as_external" permission is predicated by "networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_external'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH RbacActionIpVersionStddev AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 AND s.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.ACTION HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY ip_version_stddev DESC ), ActiveHighMtuNetworksByRbacAction AS ( SELECT n.name AS network_name, r.action AS rbac_action, MAX(n.mtu) AS max_mtu FROM NETWORKSECURITYBINDINGS nsb JOIN NETWORKS n ON nsb.network_id = n.id JOIN NETWORKRBACS r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.action IN ('access_as_shared', 'access_as_external') GROUP BY n.name, r.action HAVING MAX(n.mtu) > 8000 ) SELECT ahmn.network_name, ahmn.rbac_action, ahmn.max_mtu, raivs.ip_version_stddev FROM ActiveHighMtuNetworksByRbacAction ahmn JOIN RbacActionIpVersionStddev raivs ON ahmn.rbac_action = raivs.ACTION ORDER BY ahmn.max_mtu DESC, raivs.ip_version_stddev DESC), AvgMaxMtu AS (SELECT AVG(max_mtu) AS avg_max_mtu FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.network_name, i.rbac_action, i.max_mtu, i.ip_version_stddev, (i.max_mtu - a.avg_max_mtu) AS deviation_from_avg_max_mtu FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN AvgMaxMtu a ORDER BY i.max_mtu DESC, i.ip_version_stddev DESC;

question: For the IPv4 subnet whose ID is `012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48`, return the subnet name, (1) the dense rank of its associated standard attribute when ordered by the standard attribute UPDATED_AT timestamp using a window frame of the current row and the 2 preceding rows, and (2) the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of routes per subnet; additionally, indicate whether the subnet’s standard attribute has a non-empty DESCRIPTION. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Subnet ID "012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48" is predicated by "subnets.id IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH SubnetWindowRanks AS ( SELECT s.NAME, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY sa.UPDATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES AS sa ON sa.ID = s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') ), SubnetRouteStats AS ( SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, MAX(route_count) - MIN(route_count) AS route_count_range, VARIANCE(route_count) AS route_count_variance, STDDEV(route_count) AS route_count_stddev FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN ( SELECT sr.SUBNET_ID, COUNT(*) AS route_count FROM SUBNETROUTES AS sr GROUP BY sr.SUBNET_ID, sr.NEXTHOP ) AS route_stats ON s.ID = route_stats.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY route_count_range DESC ) SELECT swr.NAME AS subnet_name, swr.window_column, srs.route_count_range, srs.route_count_variance, srs.route_count_stddev FROM SubnetWindowRanks AS swr JOIN SubnetRouteStats AS srs ON srs.subnet_name = swr.NAME ORDER BY swr.NAME, swr.window_column) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.window_column, i.route_count_range, i.route_count_variance, i.route_count_stddev, CASE WHEN COALESCE(sa.DESCRIPTION, '') <> '' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_standardattr_description FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON s.NAME = i.subnet_name AND s.IP_VERSION = 4 JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES AS sa ON sa.ID = s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ORDER BY i.subnet_name, i.window_column;

question: For tenant ID '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7', using the counts of (1) administratively up ports with port security bindings and (2) DOWN ports with a standard-attributes running-sum window value, what is the maximum of these two counts? Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH admin_up_port_security AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(psb.port_id) AS binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN psb.port_security_enabled THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS port_security_enabled_total FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address ), down_ports_window AS ( SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(sa.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY sa.RESOURCE_TYPE ORDER BY sa.ID) AS window_column FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') ) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM admin_up_port_security) AS admin_up_ports_with_security_bindings_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM down_ports_window) AS down_ports_with_standardattributes_window_count FROM admin_up_port_security aups CROSS JOIN down_ports_window dpw ) SELECT MAX(cnt) AS max_of_the_two_counts FROM ( SELECT inner_cte.admin_up_ports_with_security_bindings_count AS cnt FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT inner_cte.down_ports_with_standardattributes_window_count AS cnt FROM inner_cte ) t;

question: For the subnet with ID `012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48`, considering only subnet routes whose next hop is `10.30.19.197/8`, return the subnet name, (1) the range and variance of allocation-pool starting IPs (FIRST_IP), and (2) the dense-rank (using a window of the current row and 2 preceding rows) of its associated standard attribute when ordered by the standard attribute’s UPDATED_AT timestamp. evidence: Subnet ID "012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48" is predicated by "subnets.id IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH first_ip_stats AS ( SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, MAX(p.FIRST_IP) - MIN(p.FIRST_IP) AS first_ip_range, VARIANCE(p.FIRST_IP) AS first_ip_variance FROM SUBNETROUTES r JOIN SUBNETS s ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE r.NEXTHOP = '10.30.19.197/8' AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY first_ip_range DESC ), subnet_attr_dense_rank AS ( SELECT s.NAME, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY sa.UPDATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES AS sa ON sa.ID = s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') ) SELECT fis.subnet_name, fis.first_ip_range, fis.first_ip_variance, sadr.window_column FROM first_ip_stats fis JOIN subnet_attr_dense_rank sadr ON sadr.NAME = fis.subnet_name ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.subnet_name) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE i.subnet_name END AS subnet_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.first_ip_range) = 1 AND GROUPING(i.subnet_name) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE CAST(i.first_ip_range AS CHAR) END AS first_ip_range, SUM(i.first_ip_variance) AS summed_first_ip_variance, SUM(i.window_column) AS summed_window_dense_rank FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBNETS s2 ON s2.NAME = i.subnet_name LEFT JOIN SUBNETROUTES r2 ON r2.SUBNET_ID = s2.ID GROUP BY i.subnet_name, i.first_ip_range WITH ROLLUP;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH TenantDownPortsBySecurityGroup AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), NetworkDownPortsWithMinAdminStateWindow AS ( SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') ), SecurityGroupDownPortCounts AS ( SELECT sgpb.security_group_id, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS down_port_count FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') AND p.network_id IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') GROUP BY sgpb.security_group_id ) SELECT tdp.port_id, tdp.tenant_id, ndp.network_id, ndp.name AS port_name, tdp.mac_address, ndp.admin_state_up, ndp.status, ndp.device_owner, tdp.security_group_id, tdp.window_column AS port_rank_within_security_group_by_port_id, ndp.window_column AS min_admin_state_up_in_3_preceding_1_following_window, sgc.down_port_count FROM TenantDownPortsBySecurityGroup AS tdp JOIN NetworkDownPortsWithMinAdminStateWindow AS ndp ON tdp.security_group_id = ndp.security_group_id AND tdp.mac_address = ndp.mac_address JOIN SecurityGroupDownPortCounts AS sgc ON tdp.security_group_id = sgc.security_group_id WHERE sgc.down_port_count >= 2 ORDER BY sgc.down_port_count DESC, tdp.security_group_id, tdp.port_id) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(security_group_id) OVER (ORDER admin_state_up, status, device_owner, port_rank_within_security_group_by_port_id, min_admin_state_up_in_3_preceding_1_following_window, down_port_count FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN question: For each network, return the network ID and the maximum (across DOWN port status and device owner) distinct port count among ports bound to a security group for tenant ID '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7', along with (for the same network) the minimum admin_state_up and average standard_attr_id for ports bound with VIF type 'ovs' whose device_id is 'da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7'. SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH PortSecurityGroupStats AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), OvsBindingPortStats AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) AS min_admin_state_up, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE b.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' AND p.DEVICE_ID IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS ) SELECT psgs.port_status, psgs.device_owner, psgs.port_count, psgs.min_standard_attr_id, obs.min_admin_state_up, obs.avg_standard_attr_id FROM PortSecurityGroupStats psgs JOIN OvsBindingPortStats obs ON psgs.port_status = obs.STATUS) SELECT p.NETWORK_ID AS network_id, MAX(inner_cte.port_count) AS max_distinct_port_count, MIN(inner_cte.min_admin_state_up) AS min_admin_state_up, AVG(inner_cte.avg_standard_attr_id) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM inner_cte JOIN PORTS p ON p.STATUS = inner_cte.port_status GROUP BY p.NETWORK_ID;

question: For the RBAC action **access_as_shared**, return the action name together with the previously computed subnet IP-version statistics, and additionally report (for that same action) the **maximum number of distinct target tenants** associated with any single referenced network (i.e., per network, count distinct `TARGET_TENANT`, then take the maximum across networks). Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))" "access_as_shared" permission is predicated by "networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 AND s.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.ACTION HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY ip_version_stddev DESC ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT n.ACTION AS rbac_action, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, MAX(s.IP_VERSION) - MIN(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_range, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION IN (4, 6) AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_range DESC ) SELECT s2.rbac_action, s2.avg_ip_version, s2.ip_version_range, s2.ip_version_variance, s1.ip_version_stddev FROM Subq2 s2 LEFT JOIN Subq1 s1 ON s1.ACTION = s2.rbac_action ) , TargetTenantCountsPerNetwork AS ( SELECT n.action, n.object_id AS network_id, COUNT(DISTINCT n.target_tenant) AS distinct_target_tenants FROM NETWORKRBACS n JOIN SUBNETS s ON s.network_id = n.object_id WHERE n.action = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.action, n.object_id ), MaxTargetTenantsByAction AS ( SELECT action, MAX(distinct_target_tenants) AS max_distinct_target_tenants_on_any_network FROM TargetTenantCountsPerNetwork GROUP BY action ) SELECT i.rbac_action, i.avg_ip_version, i.ip_version_range, i.ip_version_variance, i.ip_version_stddev, m.max_distinct_target_tenants_on_any_network FROM inner_cte i LEFT JOIN MaxTargetTenantsByAction m ON m.action = i.rbac_action;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH PortStatusOwnerSecurityGroupStats AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), PortStatusBindingCountDispersion AS ( SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC ) SELECT psosgs.port_status, psosgs.device_owner, psosgs.port_count, psosgs.min_standard_attr_id, psbcd.binding_count_range, psbcd.binding_count_variance, psbcd.binding_count_stddev FROM PortStatusOwnerSecurityGroupStats psosgs JOIN PortStatusBindingCountDispersion psbcd ON psosgs.port_status = psbcd.status ORDER BY psosgs.port_count DESC) , StatusAverages AS ( SELECT port_status, AVG(port_count) AS avg_port_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY port_status ) SELECT i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.min_standard_attr_id, i.binding_count_range, i.binding_count_variance, i.binding_count_stddev FROM inner_cte i JOIN StatusAverages sa ON sa.port_status = i.port_status WHERE i.port_count > (SELECT avg_port_count FROM StatusAverages WHERE StatusAverages.port_status = i.port_status) ORDER BY i.port_count DESC;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH PortStatusOwnerStats AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), PortStatusAttrIdVariance AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, VARIANCE(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS standard_attr_id_variance FROM PORTS AS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID IS NOT NULL AND ia.IP_ADDRESS IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.STATUS ORDER BY standard_attr_id_variance DESC ) SELECT psos.port_status, psos.device_owner, psos.port_count, psos.earliest_standard_attr_update, psav.standard_attr_id_variance FROM PortStatusOwnerStats psos JOIN PortStatusAttrIdVariance psav ON psos.port_status = psav.STATUS ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(port_status) OVER (ORDER BY port_status_sort, port_status, device_owner) = port_status THEN NULL ELSE port_status END AS port_status, device_owner, port_count, earliest_standard_attr_update, standard_attr_id_variance FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.port_status) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.port_status END AS port_status_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.port_status) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.port_status END AS port_status, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.device_owner) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE i.device_owner END AS device_owner, SUM(i.port_count) AS port_count, MIN(i.earliest_standard_attr_update) AS earliest_standard_attr_update, MAX(i.standard_attr_id_variance) AS standard_attr_id_variance FROM inner_cte i GROUP BY i.port_status, i.device_owner WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY port_status_sort, port_status, device_owner;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH AllocationPoolFirstIpStats AS ( SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, MAX(p.FIRST_IP) - MIN(p.FIRST_IP) AS first_ip_range, VARIANCE(p.FIRST_IP) AS first_ip_variance FROM SUBNETROUTES r JOIN SUBNETS s ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE r.NEXTHOP = '10.30.19.197/8' AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY first_ip_range DESC ), SubnetStandardAttributeWindowRank AS ( SELECT s.NAME, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY sa.UPDATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES AS sa ON sa.ID = s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') ) SELECT ap.subnet_name, ap.first_ip_range, ap.first_ip_variance, ss.window_column FROM AllocationPoolFirstIpStats ap JOIN SubnetStandardAttributeWindowRank ss ON ap.subnet_name = ss.NAME ORDER BY ap.first_ip_range DESC ) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.first_ip_range, i.first_ip_variance, i.window_column, s.cidr, s.gateway_ip FROM inner_cte i JOIN subnets s ON s.name = i.subnet_name JOIN subnetroutes r ON r.subnet_id = s.id AND r.nexthop = '10.30.19.197/8' WHERE s.ip_version = 4 AND s.id IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') ORDER BY i.first_ip_range DESC;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH PortBindingWindow AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), PortStatusVariance AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, VARIANCE(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS standard_attr_id_variance FROM PORTS AS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID IS NOT NULL AND ia.IP_ADDRESS IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.STATUS ORDER BY standard_attr_id_variance DESC ) SELECT pbw.PORT_ID, pbw.HOST, pbw.VIF_TYPE, pbw.VNIC_TYPE, pbw.TENANT_ID, pbw.NETWORK_ID, pbw.MAC_ADDRESS, pbw.STATUS, pbw.DEVICE_OWNER, pbw.window_column, psv.standard_attr_id_variance FROM PortBindingWindow pbw JOIN PortStatusVariance psv ON pbw.STATUS = psv.STATUS ORDER BY pbw.VIF_TYPE, pbw.PORT_ID ) , NetworkAllocationCounts AS ( SELECT ia.NETWORK_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.IP_ADDRESS) AS allocated_ip_count FROM IPALLOCATIONS ia GROUP BY ia.NETWORK_ID ) SELECT i.PORT_ID, i.HOST, i.VIF_TYPE, i.VNIC_TYPE, i.TENANT_ID, i.NETWORK_ID, i.MAC_ADDRESS, i.STATUS, i.DEVICE_OWNER, i.window_column, i.standard_attr_id_variance, nac.allocated_ip_count FROM inner_cte i JOIN NetworkAllocationCounts nac ON i.NETWORK_ID = nac.NETWORK_ID WHERE nac.allocated_ip_count > 1 ORDER BY nac.allocated_ip_count DESC, i.VIF_TYPE, i.PORT_ID;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH port_sg_dns_summary AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb JOIN PORTS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN PORTDNSES pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name ), port_binding_window_details AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ) SELECT pbwd.PORT_ID, pbwd.TENANT_ID, psds.port_name, pbwd.HOST, pbwd.VIF_TYPE, pbwd.VNIC_TYPE, pbwd.NETWORK_ID, pbwd.MAC_ADDRESS, pbwd.STATUS, pbwd.DEVICE_OWNER, pbwd.window_column, psds.security_group_binding_count, psds.dns_record_count FROM port_binding_window_details pbwd JOIN port_sg_dns_summary psds ON psds.port_id = pbwd.PORT_ID AND psds.tenant_id = pbwd.TENANT_ID ), avg_sg_bindings AS ( SELECT AVG(security_group_binding_count) AS avg_security_group_binding_count FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.PORT_ID, i.TENANT_ID, i.port_name, i.HOST, i.VIF_TYPE, i.VNIC_TYPE, i.NETWORK_ID, i.MAC_ADDRESS, i.STATUS, i.DEVICE_OWNER, i.window_column, i.security_group_binding_count, i.dns_record_count, (i.security_group_binding_count - a.avg_security_group_binding_count) AS deviation_from_avg_security_group_binding_count FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_sg_bindings a;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH AllocationPoolFirstIpStats AS ( SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, MAX(p.FIRST_IP) - MIN(p.FIRST_IP) AS first_ip_range, VARIANCE(p.FIRST_IP) AS first_ip_variance FROM SUBNETROUTES r JOIN SUBNETS s ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE r.NEXTHOP = '10.30.19.197/8' AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY first_ip_range DESC ), SubnetStandardAttributeWindowRank AS ( SELECT s.NAME, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY sa.UPDATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES AS sa ON sa.ID = s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') ) SELECT ap.subnet_name, ap.first_ip_range, ap.first_ip_variance, ss.window_column FROM AllocationPoolFirstIpStats ap JOIN SubnetStandardAttributeWindowRank ss ON ap.subnet_name = ss.NAME ORDER BY ap.first_ip_range DESC ), avg_range_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(sub_ranges.first_ip_range) AS avg_first_ip_range FROM ( SELECT s2.ID AS subnet_id, MAX(p2.FIRST_IP) - MIN(p2.FIRST_IP) AS first_ip_range FROM SUBNETROUTES r2 JOIN SUBNETS s2 ON r2.SUBNET_ID = s2.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS p2 ON s2.ID = p2.SUBNET_ID WHERE r2.NEXTHOP = '10.30.19.197/8' GROUP BY s2.ID ) AS sub_ranges ) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.first_ip_range, i.first_ip_variance, i.window_column, s.TENANT_ID AS subnet_tenant_id, a.avg_first_ip_range FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBNETS s ON s.NAME = i.subnet_name AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') CROSS JOIN avg_range_cte a ORDER BY i.first_ip_range DESC;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), subq2 AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ) SELECT subq2.NETWORK_ID, subq2.VIF_TYPE, COUNT(DISTINCT subq2.PORT_ID) AS total_admin_up_ports, COUNT(DISTINCT subq1.port_id) AS total_down_ports_with_security_group_binding, AVG(subq2.window_column) AS avg_standard_attr_id_window_avg, MIN(subq1.window_column) AS best_rank_within_security_group_for_down_ports FROM subq2 LEFT JOIN subq1 ON subq2.PORT_ID = subq1.port_id AND subq2.TENANT_ID = subq1.tenant_id GROUP BY subq2.NETWORK_ID, subq2.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY total_admin_up_ports DESC) SELECT network_id, MAX(total_admin_up_ports) AS max_admin_up_ports_across_vif_types, AVG(avg_standard_attr_id_window_avg) AS avg_of_viftype_window_avgs, MIN(best_rank_within_security_group_for_down_ports) AS best_rank_among_down_ports_in_network FROM inner_cte GROUP BY network_id ORDER BY max_admin_up_ports_across_vif_types DESC;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH port_security_binding_stats_by_status AS ( SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS down_ports_with_security_groups AS ( SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( ORDER BY p.ID ROWS ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') ), down_ports_with_security_groups_tenant_filtered AS ( SELECT dpsg.NAME, dpsg.NETWORK_ID, dpsg.MAC_ADDRESS, dpsg.ADMIN_STATE_UP, dpsg.STATUS, dpsg.DEVICE_OWNER, dpsg.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, dpsg.window_column FROM down_ports_with_security_groups dpsg JOIN ports p ON p.network_id = dpsg.NETWORK_ID AND p.mac_address = dpsg.MAC_ADDRESS WHERE p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') ) SELECT psbs.status, psbs.binding_count_range, psbs.binding_count_variance, psbs.binding_count_stddev, COUNT(*) AS psbs.binding_count_variance, psbs.binding_count_stddev ORDER BY psbs.binding_count_range DESC) , DownPortSecurityGroups AS ( SELECT p.network_id, p.id AS port_id, COUNT(DISTINCT spb.security_group_id) AS security_group_count FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ports p ON p.status = ic.status JOIN securitygroupportbindings spb ON p.id = spb.port_id WHERE p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') AND p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.network_id IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') GROUP BY p.network_id, p.id ) SELECT ic.status, ic.binding_count_range, ic.binding_count_variance, ic.binding_count_stddev, ic.down_port_rows_for_tenant_and_network, MAX(dpsg.security_group_count) AS max_security_groups_on_any_down_port FROM inner_cte ic JOIN DownPortSecurityGroups dpsg ON question: Among the (port status, device owner) pairs returned by the existing port aggregation (only ports whose standard attribute resource type is 'ports' and excluding shared networks), list only those pairs where more than 25% of the ports are DOWN ports on network ID '0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d' that have a security-group binding. SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH PortStatusOwnerAgg AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), DownPortsWithSG AS ( SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') ), DownPortsSGCounts AS ( SELECT dp.STATUS AS port_status, dp.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(*) AS down_ports_in_network_with_sg FROM DownPortsWithSG dp GROUP BY dp.STATUS, dp.DEVICE_OWNER ) SELECT psoa.port_status, psoa.device_owner, psoa.port_count, psoa.earliest_standard_attr_update, dpsc.down_ports_in_network_with_sg FROM PortStatusOwnerAgg psoa JOIN DownPortsSGCounts dpsc ON psoa.port_status = dpsc.port_status AND psoa.device_owner = dpsc.device_owner ORDER BY psoa.port_count DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.port_status, inner_cte.device_owner, inner_cte.port_count, PORTS p2 ON p2.DEVICE_OWNER = inner_cte.device_owner AND p2.STATUS = inner_cte.port_status WHERE (inner_cte.down_ports_in_network_with_sg * 1.0 / NULLIF(inner_cte.port_count, 0)) > 0.25 GROUP BY inner_cte.port_status, inner_cte.device_owner, inner_cte.port_count, inner_cte.earliest_standard_attr_update, inner_cte.down_ports_in_network_with_sg ORDER BY down_sg_ratio DESC, inner_cte.port_count question: For the RBAC action access_as_shared, list the top 10 RBAC-owning tenants (by number of distinct networks referenced by that action) and show, for each tenant: (1) the number of distinct networks referenced, (2) the average subnet IP version, (3) the subnet IP version range (max minus min), (4) the variance of subnet IP version considering only public RBAC entries where target_tenant = '*', and (5) the overall variance of subnet IP version across all subnets on networks referenced by that tenant’s RBAC entries for the action. Do not return any rounded answers.

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH q1 AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT = '*' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC ), q2 AS ( SELECT n.ACTION AS rbac_action, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, MAX(s.IP_VERSION) - MIN(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_range, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION IN (4, 6) AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_range DESC ) SELECT q1.ACTION AS rbac_action, q2.avg_ip_version, q2.ip_version_range, q1.ip_version_variance AS public_access_ip_version_variance, q2.ip_version_variance AS overall_ip_version_variance FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.ACTION = q2.rbac_action ORDER BY q2.ip_version_range DESC ), tenant_stats AS ( SELECT n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT n.OBJECT_ID) AS distinct_networks_referenced, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, MAX(s.IP_VERSION) - MIN(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_range, VARIANCE(CASE WHEN n.TARGET_TENANT = '*' THEN s.IP_VERSION END) AS public_access_ip_version_variance, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS overall_ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND s.IP_VERSION IN (4, 6) GROUP BY n.TENANT_ID ) SELECT t.tenant_id, t.distinct_networks_referenced, t.avg_ip_version, t.ip_version_range, t.public_access_ip_version_variance, t.overall_ip_version_variance, i.rbac_action AS action_name, i.public_access_ip_version_variance AS action_level_public_access_ip_version_variance, i.overall_ip_version_variance AS action_level_overall_ip_version_variance FROM tenant_stats t CROSS JOIN inner_cte i ORDER BY t.distinct_networks_referenced DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Using the existing result set for tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" (administratively-up ports on ACTIVE networks owned by the same tenant), summarize by tenant and report: the tenant ID, the total number of distinct matching networks, the total number of distinct matching ports, and whether the tenant has any matching ports with VIF type "ovs". SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH ActiveTenantNetworks AS (SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), AdminUpTenantPorts AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')) SELECT n.network_id, n.network_name, n.tenant_id, n.admin_state_up AS network_admin_state_up, n.mtu, n.standard_attr_updated_at AS network_standard_attr_updated_at, n.window_column AS network_row_number_within_tenant, p.PORT_ID AS port_id, p.HOST AS port_host, p.VIF_TYPE AS port_vif_type, p.VNIC_TYPE AS port_vnic_type, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS port_mac_address, p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS port_device_owner, p.window_column AS port_avg_standard_attr_id_window FROM ActiveTenantNetworks n JOIN AdminUpTenantPorts p ON p.NETWORK_ID = n.network_id AND p.TENANT_ID = n.tenant_id ORDER BY n.network_name, p.PORT_ID) SELECT i.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT i.network_id) AS total_networks, COUNT(DISTINCT i.port_id) AS total_ports, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN i.port_vif_type = 'ovs' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_ovs_vif_type FROM inner_cte i GROUP BY i.tenant_id ORDER BY total_ports DESC LIMIT 10;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH RbacActionIpVersionStddev AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 AND s.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.ACTION HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY ip_version_stddev DESC ), ActiveHighMtuNetworksByRbacAction AS ( SELECT n.name AS network_name, r.action AS rbac_action, MAX(n.mtu) AS max_mtu FROM NETWORKSECURITYBINDINGS nsb JOIN NETWORKS n ON nsb.network_id = n.id JOIN NETWORKRBACS r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.action IN ('access_as_shared', 'access_as_external') GROUP BY n.name, r.action HAVING MAX(n.mtu) > 8000 ) SELECT ahmn.network_name, ahmn.rbac_action, ahmn.max_mtu, raivs.ip_version_stddev FROM ActiveHighMtuNetworksByRbacAction ahmn JOIN RbacActionIpVersionStddev raivs ON ahmn.rbac_action = raivs.ACTION ORDER BY ahmn.max_mtu DESC, raivs.ip_version_stddev DESC) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(network_name) OVER (ORDER BY network_name_sort, network_name, rbac_action) = network_name THEN NULL ELSE network_name END AS network_name, rbac_action, max_mtu, ip_version_stddev FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(network_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE network_name END AS network_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(network_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE network_name END AS network_name, rbac_action, MAX(max_mtu) AS max_mtu, AVG(ip_version_stddev) AS ip_version_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY network_name, rbac_action WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY network_name_sort, network_name, rbac_action;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH SecurityGroupAndDnsByPort AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb JOIN PORTS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN PORTDNSES pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name ), IpAllocationsByPort AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ia.subnet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND ia.ip_address IS NOT NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address ) SELECT sgd.port_id, sgd.tenant_id, sgd.port_name, ipa.mac_address, sgd.security_group_binding_count, sgd.dns_record_count, ipa.ip_allocation_count, ipa.subnet_id_rows FROM SecurityGroupAndDnsByPort sgd JOIN IpAllocationsByPort ipa ON ipa.port_id = sgd.port_id AND ipa.tenant_id = sgd.tenant_id) SELECT i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.port_name, i.mac_address, i.security_group_binding_count, i.dns_record_count, i.ip_allocation_count, i.subnet_id_rows, avg_ip.avg_ip_allocations_per_port FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT tenant_id, AVG(ip_allocation_count) AS avg_ip_allocations_per_port FROM inner_cte GROUP BY tenant_id ) AS avg_ip ON avg_ip.tenant_id = i.tenant_id;

s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 AND s.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.ACTION HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY ip_version_stddev DESC ), ActiveNetworkRbacDetails AS ( SELECT n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up, r.action, r.target_tenant, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column FROM networksecuritybindings b JOIN networks n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN networkrbacs r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND anrd.window_column, rais.ip_version_stddev FROM ActiveNetworkRbacDetails anrd JOIN RbacActionIpVersionStddev rais ON anrd.action = rais.action ORDER BY rais.ip_version_stddev DESC, anrd.name) , NetworkDhcpSubnetCounts AS ( SELECT n.id AS network_id, COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS dhcp_subnet_count FROM networks n JOIN subnets s ON s.network_id = n.id WHERE s.enable_dhcp = 1 AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT GROUP BY n.id ), AvgDhcpSubnetCount AS ( SELECT AVG(dhcp_subnet_count * 1.0) AS avg_dhcp_subnet_count FROM NetworkDhcpSubnetCounts ) SELECT i.name, i.status, i.admin_state_up, i.action, i.target_tenant, i.window_column, i.ip_version_stddev, ndsc.dhcp_subnet_count FROM inner_cte i JOIN networks n ON n.name = i.name AND n.status = i.status AND n.admin_state_up = i.admin_state_up JOIN question: For ACTIVE networks that have an RBAC entry with action **access_as_shared** and whose maximum MTU (within each network name and RBAC action group) is greater than 8000, list the network name, RBAC action, and that maximum MTU, along with the average, range (max minus min), and variance of subnet IP version (restricted to IP versions 4 and 6) for subnets whose network is referenced by **access_as_shared** RBAC entries.
