SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH RbacSubnetIpVersionStats AS ( SELECT n.ACTION AS rbac_action, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, MAX(s.IP_VERSION) - MIN(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_range, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION IN (4, 6) AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_range DESC ), HighMtuActiveRbacNetworks AS ( SELECT n.name AS network_name, r.action AS rbac_action, MAX(n.mtu) AS max_mtu FROM NETWORKSECURITYBINDINGS nsb JOIN NETWORKS n ON nsb.network_id = n.id JOIN NETWORKRBACS r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.action IN ('access_as_shared', 'access_as_external') GROUP BY n.name, r.action HAVING MAX(n.mtu) > 8000 ) SELECT hman.network_name, hman.rbac_action, hman.max_mtu, rsivs.avg_ip_version, rsivs.ip_version_range, rsivs.ip_version_variance FROM HighMtuActiveRbacNetworks hman JOIN RbacSubnetIpVersionStats rsivs ON hman.rbac_action = rsivs.rbac_action WHERE hman.rbac_action = 'access_as_shared' ORDER BY hman.max_mtu DESC, hman.network_name ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(network_name) OVER (ORDER BY network_name_sort, network_name) = network_name THEN NULL ELSE network_name END AS network_name, rbac_action, max_mtu, avg_ip_version, ip_version_range, ip_version_variance FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(network_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE network_name END AS network_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(network_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE network_name END AS network_name, MAX(rbac_action) AS rbac_action, MAX(max_mtu) AS max_mtu, AVG(avg_ip_version) AS avg_ip_version, AVG(ip_version_range) AS ip_version_range, AVG(ip_version_variance) AS ip_version_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY network_name WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY network_name_sort, network_name;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH active_networks AS ( SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), admin_up_ports_with_ip_allocs AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ia.subnet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND ia.ip_address IS NOT NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address ), tenant_port_ip_summary AS ( SELECT p.tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS admin_up_port_count, SUM(p.ip_allocation_count) AS total_ip_allocations, SUM(p.subnet_id_rows) AS total_subnet_id_rows FROM admin_up_ports_with_ip_allocs p GROUP BY p.tenant_id ) SELECT an.tenant_id, COUNT(an.network_id) AS active_network_count, MAX(an.standard_attr_updated_at) AS latest_network_standard_attr_updated_at, tps.admin_up_port_count, tps.total_ip_allocations, tps.total_subnet_id_rows FROM active_networks an JOIN tenant_port_ip_summary tps ON tps.tenant_id = an.tenant_id WHERE an.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY an.tenant_id, tps.admin_up_port_count, tps.total_ip_allocations, tps.total_subnet_id_rows ) SELECT tenant_id, active_network_count, latest_network_standard_attr_updated_at, admin_up_port_count, total_ip_allocations, total_subnet_id_rows, (total_subnet_id_rows * 1.0 / NULLIF(total_ip_allocations, 0)) AS subnet_id_row_utilization_pct FROM inner_cte WHERE total_ip_allocations > 0 AND (total_subnet_id_rows * 1.0 / total_ip_allocations) > 0.75;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH PortCountsAndEarliestUpdate AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), PortStatusIpLengthVariation AS ( SELECT p.status, STDDEV(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) / NULLIF(AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM portsecuritybindings psb JOIN ports p ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON p.id = ia.port_id WHERE psb.port_security_enabled = 1 AND ia.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), CombinedPortStatusMetrics AS ( SELECT pc.port_status AS port_status, pc.device_owner AS device_owner, pc.port_count AS port_count, pc.earliest_standard_attr_update AS earliest_standard_attr_update, pv.coefficient_of_variation AS coefficient_of_variation FROM PortCountsAndEarliestUpdate pc JOIN PortStatusIpLengthVariation pv ON pv.status = pc.port_status ) SELECT port_status, device_owner, port_count, earliest_standard_attr_update, coefficient_of_variation FROM CombinedPortStatusMetrics ORDER BY port_status, device_owner) SELECT port_status, MAX(coefficient_of_variation) AS max_coefficient_of_variation_across_device_owners FROM inner_cte GROUP BY port_status ORDER BY port_status;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH PortSecurityGroupStats AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), OvsBindingPortStats AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) AS min_admin_state_up, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE b.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' AND p.DEVICE_ID IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS ) SELECT psgs.port_status, psgs.device_owner, psgs.port_count, psgs.min_standard_attr_id, obs.min_admin_state_up, obs.avg_standard_attr_id FROM PortSecurityGroupStats psgs JOIN OvsBindingPortStats obs ON psgs.port_status = obs.STATUS) SELECT i.device_owner, i.port_status, i.port_count, i.min_standard_attr_id, i.min_admin_state_up, i.avg_standard_attr_id, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT b2.port_id) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_ovs_bound_ports FROM inner_cte i LEFT JOIN PORTS p2 ON p2.DEVICE_OWNER = i.device_owner AND p2.STATUS = i.port_status LEFT JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b2 ON b2.PORT_ID = p2.ID AND b2.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' GROUP BY i.device_owner, i.port_status, i.port_count, i.min_standard_attr_id, i.min_admin_state_up, i.avg_standard_attr_id ORDER BY i.port_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH PortStatusOwnerAgg AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), DownPortsWithSecGroup AS ( SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') ) SELECT psa.port_status, psa.device_owner, psa.port_count, psa.earliest_standard_attr_update, dp.NAME AS down_port_name, dp.NETWORK_ID AS down_port_network_id, dp.MAC_ADDRESS AS down_port_mac_address, dp.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS down_port_admin_state_up, dp.STATUS AS down_port_status, dp.DEVICE_OWNER AS down_port_device_owner, dp.SECURITY_GROUP_ID AS down_port_security_group_id, dp.window_column AS down_port_window_min_admin_state_up FROM PortStatusOwnerAgg psa CROSS JOIN DownPortsWithSecGroup dp) SELECT inner_cte.port_status, inner_cte.device_owner, MAX(inner_cte.port_count) AS port_count, MIN(inner_cte.earliest_standard_attr_update) AS earliest_standard_attr_update, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.down_port_security_group_id) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS any_down_ports_have_security_group FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.port_status, inner_cte.device_owner ORDER BY port_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For the IPv4 subnet with ID '012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48', return the subnet’s name, tenant ID, network ID, IP version, CIDR, gateway IP, DHCP enabled flag, and allocation pool first/last IP, along with each associated subnet route’s destination and next hop. SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH q1 AS ( SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') ), q2 AS ( SELECT r.DESTINATION, r.NEXTHOP, s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.SUBNET_ID ORDER BY r.SUBNET_ID) AS window_column FROM SUBNETROUTES r JOIN SUBNETS s ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') ) SELECT q1.NAME AS subnet_name, q1.TENANT_ID, q1.NETWORK_ID, q1.IP_VERSION, q1.CIDR, q1.GATEWAY_IP, q1.ENABLE_DHCP, q1.FIRST_IP AS allocation_first_ip, q1.LAST_IP AS allocation_last_ip, q1.max_standard_attr_id_next2, q2.DESTINATION AS route_destination, q2.NEXTHOP AS route_nexthop, q2.window_column AS route_dense_rank_within_subnet FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.NAME = q2.subnet_name AND q1.CIDR = q2.subnet_cidr AND q1.FIRST_IP = q2.FIRST_IP AND q1.LAST_IP = q2.LAST_IP ORDER BY q1.NAME, q2.window_column, q2.DESTINATION ), route_stats AS ( SELECT s.id AS subnet_id, COUNT(DISTINCT r.destination || '|' || r.nexthop) AS total_distinct_routes, CASE WHEN COUNT(r.subnet_id) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_any_routes FROM subnets s LEFT JOIN subnetroutes r ON r.subnet_id = s.id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 AND s.id IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.id ) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.tenant_id, i.network_id, i.ip_version, i.cidr, i.gateway_ip, i.enable_dhcp, i.allocation_first_ip, i.allocation_last_ip, i.max_standard_attr_id_next2, i.route_destination, i.route_nexthop, i.route_dense_rank_within_subnet, rs.has_any_routes, rs.total_distinct_routes FROM inner_cte i JOIN subnets s ON s.name = i.subnet_name AND s.cidr = i.cidr AND s.ip_version = i.ip_version JOIN ipallocationpools p ON p.subnet_id = s.id AND p.first_ip = question: For tenant ID '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57', among VIF types where more than 25% of administratively up ports are also in the DOWN-port set (as identified via security-group-to-port bindings), show the VIF type, the number of admin-up ports, the number of those that are DOWN, the DOWN fraction, and whether any of those admin-up ports have at least one security group binding. SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DownTenantPortsBySecurityGroup AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), AdminUpTenantPortsWithVifWindow AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')) SELECT aup.VIF_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS admin_up_port_count, COUNT(dtp.port_id) AS down_port_count, (COUNT(dtp.port_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(*)) AS down_share_of_admin_up_ports FROM AdminUpTenantPortsWithVifWindow aup LEFT JOIN DownTenantPortsBySecurityGroup dtp ON dtp.port_id = aup.PORT_ID GROUP BY aup.VIF_TYPE HAVING (COUNT(dtp.port_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(*)) > 0.25) SELECT i.VIF_TYPE, i.admin_up_port_count, i.down_port_count, i.down_share_of_admin_up_ports, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT sgpb.port_id) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_any_security_group_binding_among_admin_up_ports FROM inner_cte i JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b ON b.VIF_TYPE = i.VIF_TYPE JOIN PORTS p ON p.id = b.port_id AND p.tenant_id = '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57' AND p.admin_state_up = 1 LEFT JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb ON sgpb.port_id = p.id GROUP BY i.VIF_TYPE, i.admin_up_port_count, i.down_port_count, i.down_share_of_admin_up_ports ORDER BY i.down_share_of_admin_up_ports DESC;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH port_security_binding_stats_by_status AS ( SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC ), admin_up_port_windowed_standard_attr AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ) SELECT psbs.status, psbs.binding_count_range, psbs.binding_count_variance, psbs.binding_count_stddev, COUNT(aw.PORT_ID) AS admin_up_ports_count, AVG(aw.window_column) AS avg_window_column FROM port_security_binding_stats_by_status psbs CROSS JOIN admin_up_port_windowed_standard_attr aw GROUP BY psbs.status, psbs.binding_count_range, psbs.binding_count_variance, psbs.binding_count_stddev) SELECT i.status, i.binding_count_range, LEFT JOIN PORTS p_admin ON p_admin.TENANT_ID = '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57' AND p_admin.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 LEFT JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS mb ON mb.PORT_ID = p_admin.ID AND mb.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' GROUP BY i.status, i.binding_count_range, i.binding_count_variance, i.binding_count_stddev, i.admin_up_ports_count, i.avg_window_column;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH TenantAdminUpBoundPorts AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb JOIN PORTS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN PORTDNSES pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name ), DownNetworkPortsWithWindow AS ( SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') ), DownNetworkPortsWithWindowAndId AS ( SELECT p.ID AS port_id, q.NAME, q.NETWORK_ID, q.MAC_ADDRESS, q.ADMIN_STATE_UP, q.STATUS, q.DEVICE_OWNER, q.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, q.window_column FROM DownNetworkPortsWithWindow q JOIN PORTS p ON p.NAME = q.NAME AND p.NETWORK_ID = q.NETWORK_ID AND p.MAC_ADDRESS = q.MAC_ADDRESS AND p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = q.ADMIN_STATE_UP AND p.STATUS = q.STATUS AND p.DEVICE_OWNER = q.DEVICE_OWNER ) SELECT d.port_id, t.tenant_id, t.port_name, d.network_id, d.mac_address, d.admin_state_up, d.status, d.device_owner, d.security_group_id, d.window_column, t.security_group_binding_count, t.dns_record_count FROM DownNetworkPortsWithWindowAndId d JOIN TenantAdminUpBoundPorts t ON d.port_id = t.port_id ORDER BY d.network_id, d.port_id, d.security_group_id) SELECT network_id, MAX(security_group_binding_count) AS max_security_group_bindings_on_any_port FROM inner_cte GROUP BY network_id;

question: For each port status, list the status, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) (standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) divided by average) of allocated IP address string lengths for ports with port security enabled restricted to IP address '10.150.64.113/8', along with the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of port security bindings per port for ports belonging to tenant ID '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7', and also include the total number of distinct ports observed for that status and the average of those per-status port totals across all statuses. SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH PortStatusIPLenCV AS ( SELECT p.status, STDDEV(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) / NULLIF(AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM portsecuritybindings psb JOIN ports p ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON p.id = ia.port_id WHERE psb.port_security_enabled = 1 AND ia.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), PortStatusBindingDispersion AS ( SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC ) SELECT pilcv.status, pilcv.coefficient_of_variation, pbd.binding_count_range, pbd.binding_count_variance, pbd.binding_count_stddev FROM PortStatusIPLenCV pilcv JOIN PortStatusBindingDispersion pbd ON pilcv.status = pbd.status ORDER BY pilcv.coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT i.status, i.coefficient_of_variation, i.binding_count_range, i.binding_count_variance, i.binding_count_stddev, sp.status_port_count, avg_sp.avg_status_port_count FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN ( SELECT p.status, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS status_port_count FROM ports p JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id WHERE psb.port_security_enabled = 1 AND ia.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8') AND p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.status ) AS sp ON sp.status = i.status JOIN ( SELECT AVG(status_port_count) AS avg_status_port_count FROM ( SELECT p2.status, COUNT(DISTINCT p2.id) AS status_port_count FROM ports p2 JOIN ipallocations ia2 ON ia2.port_id = p2.id JOIN portsecuritybindings psb2 ON psb2.port_id = p2.id WHERE psb2.port_security_enabled = 1 AND ia2.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8') AND p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.status ) AS sub ) AS avg_sp ORDER BY i.coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For the IPv4 subnet with subnet ID in ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48'), return the subnet name, tenant ID, network ID, IP version, CIDR, gateway IP, DHCP enabled flag, allocation pool first and last IPs, the maximum subnet standard attribute ID over the current row and next 2 rows (ordered by subnet ID), and the dense-rank window value of its standard attribute when ordered by the standard attribute updated-at timestamp over the current row and 2 preceding rows; also include the tenant’s total number of IPv4 subnets and the average number of IPv4 subnets per tenant across all tenants. SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH SubnetPoolAndMaxAttrNext2 AS (SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')), SubnetAttrDenseRankWindow AS (SELECT s.NAME, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY sa.UPDATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES AS sa ON sa.ID = s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')) SELECT sp.NAME AS subnet_name, sp.TENANT_ID, sp.NETWORK_ID, sp.IP_VERSION, sp.CIDR, sp.GATEWAY_IP, sp.ENABLE_DHCP, sp.FIRST_IP, sp.LAST_IP, sp.max_standard_attr_id_next2, sadr.window_column AS standard_attr_dense_rank_window FROM SubnetPoolAndMaxAttrNext2 sp JOIN SubnetAttrDenseRankWindow sadr ON sp.NAME = sadr.NAME) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.tenant_id, i.network_id, i.ip_version, i.cidr, i.gateway_ip, i.enable_dhcp, i.first_ip, i.last_ip, i.max_standard_attr_id_next2, i.standard_attr_dense_rank_window, tenant_subnets.total_ipv4_subnets, avg_subnets.avg_ipv4_subnets_per_tenant FROM inner_cte i JOIN (SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(id) AS total_ipv4_subnets FROM subnets WHERE ip_version = 4 GROUP BY tenant_id) AS tenant_subnets ON tenant_subnets.tenant_id = i.tenant_id JOIN (SELECT AVG(subnet_count) AS avg_ipv4_subnets_per_tenant FROM (SELECT COUNT(id) AS subnet_count FROM subnets WHERE ip_version = 4 GROUP BY tenant_id) AS per_tenant) AS avg_subnets ON 1 = 1;

question: Using the RBAC/subnet IP-version statistics result as an inner CTE, for each RBAC action show the action-level metrics (average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of IP version for the shared IPv4 set; and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of IP version for the DHCP-enabled not-shared set) and also include a rollup that adds a subtotal row per action and a grand total row across all actions. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "access_as_shared" permission is predicated by "networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared'" "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH rbac_ip_version_stats_shared AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC ), rbac_ip_version_stddev_dhcp_not_shared AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 AND s.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.ACTION HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY ip_version_stddev DESC ) SELECT s1.ACTION, s1.avg_ip_version, s1.ip_version_variance, s1.ip_version_stddev AS shared_ip_version_stddev, s2.ip_version_stddev AS dhcp_not_shared_ip_version_stddev FROM rbac_ip_version_stats_shared s1 JOIN rbac_ip_version_stddev_dhcp_not_shared s2 ON s1.ACTION = s2.ACTION) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.ACTION) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE i.ACTION END AS ACTION, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.avg_ip_version) = 1 AND GROUPING(i.ACTION) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE 'DETAIL' END AS row_level, AVG(i.avg_ip_version) AS avg_ip_version, AVG(i.ip_version_variance) AS ip_version_variance, AVG(i.shared_ip_version_stddev) AS shared_ip_version_stddev, AVG(i.dhcp_not_shared_ip_version_stddev) AS dhcp_not_shared_ip_version_stddev FROM inner_cte i JOIN NETWORKRBACS n ON n.ACTION = i.ACTION GROUP BY i.ACTION, i.avg_ip_version WITH ROLLUP;

question: For tenant_id '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7' and ports with status 'DOWN' that are bound to a security group, list each device owner with the distinct port count and the minimum standard attribute ID, also show (by port status) the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of standard attribute IDs for ports that have both a security group port binding and a port security binding, and additionally indicate whether each device owner has any ports that are associated with a floating IP (via fixed_port_id). Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT p.status, STDDEV(p.standard_attr_id) / NULLIF(AVG(p.standard_attr_id), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM securitygroupportbindings AS sgpb JOIN ports AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN portsecuritybindings AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(p.standard_attr_id) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ) SELECT s2.port_status, s2.device_owner, s2.port_count, s2.min_standard_attr_id, s1.coefficient_of_variation FROM Subq2 s2 JOIN Subq1 s1 ON s2.port_status = s1.status ) SELECT i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.min_standard_attr_id, i.coefficient_of_variation, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT f.id) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_floating_ips FROM inner_cte i JOIN ports p2 ON p2.tenant_id = '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7' AND p2.status = i.port_status AND p2.device_owner = i.device_owner LEFT JOIN floatingips f ON p2.id = f.fixed_port_id GROUP BY i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.min_standard_attr_id, i.coefficient_of_variation;

question: For each port status and device owner (considering only ports whose standard attribute resource type is 'ports' and excluding shared networks where networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' and target_tenant is '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'), return the port status, device owner, number of ports, earliest standard attribute updated timestamp, and (for that same port status) the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of allocated IP address string lengths for ports with port security enabled and allocated IP address '10.150.64.113/8', ordered by the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) descending; additionally, only include (port status, device owner) groups whose port_count is greater than the average port_count across all returned (port status, device owner) groups. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))" IP Address "10.150.64.113/8" is predicated by "ipallocations.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH PortStatusOwnerCounts AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), PortStatusIpLenCV AS ( SELECT p.status, STDDEV(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) / NULLIF(AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM portsecuritybindings psb JOIN ports p ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON p.id = ia.port_id WHERE psb.port_security_enabled = 1 AND ia.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT psoc.port_status, psoc.device_owner, psoc.port_count, psoc.earliest_standard_attr_update, psicv.coefficient_of_variation FROM PortStatusOwnerCounts psoc JOIN PortStatusIpLenCV psicv ON psoc.port_status = psicv.status WHERE psoc.port_count > 0 ORDER BY psicv.coefficient_of_variation DESC, psoc.port_count DESC ) SELECT port_status, device_owner, port_count, earliest_standard_attr_update, coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte WHERE port_count > (SELECT AVG(port_count) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC, port_count DESC;

question: For RBAC actions that (1) are `access_as_shared` and reference IPv4 subnets and (2) also have more than 5 DHCP-enabled subnets on non-shared networks (excluding networks shared to `'*'` or tenant `9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b`), return the action along with the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subnet IP version for the shared/IPv4 case, plus the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subnet IP version for the DHCP-enabled non-shared case; also include the overall average of the shared/IPv4 standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all returned actions as a benchmark and label each action as 'HIGH_VOLATILITY' (at least 50% above benchmark), 'LOW_VOLATILITY' (at least 50% below benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_VOLATILITY'. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "access_as_shared" permission is predicated by "networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared'" "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH RbacSharedIpVersionStats AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC ), RbacDhcpNonSharedStddev AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 AND s.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.ACTION HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY ip_version_stddev DESC ) SELECT rs.ACTION, rs.avg_ip_version, rs.ip_version_variance, rs.ip_version_stddev AS shared_ip_version_stddev, rd.ip_version_stddev AS dhcp_nonshared_ip_version_stddev FROM RbacSharedIpVersionStats rs JOIN RbacDhcpNonSharedStddev rd ON rs.ACTION = rd.ACTION ), SharedStddevBenchmark AS ( SELECT AVG(shared_ip_version_stddev) AS avg_shared_stddev FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.ACTION, i.avg_ip_version, i.ip_version_variance, i.shared_ip_version_stddev, i.dhcp_nonshared_ip_version_stddev, b.avg_shared_stddev AS benchmark_shared_stddev, CASE WHEN i.shared_ip_version_stddev > b.avg_shared_stddev * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VOLATILITY' WHEN i.shared_ip_version_stddev < b.avg_shared_stddev * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VOLATILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VOLATILITY' END AS volatility_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN SharedStddevBenchmark b;

question: Using the same ACTIVE, non-shared network RBAC details and the non-shared port status/device-owner aggregates, compute the overall average port_count across all (port_status, device_owner) groups as a benchmark, and label each group as 'HIGH_USER' (at least 50% above average), 'LOW_USER' (at least 50% below average), or 'AVERAGE_USER'; show the benchmark and category alongside the network RBAC fields and the port aggregate fields. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH PortStatusOwnerStats AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), ActiveNetworkRbacDetails AS ( SELECT n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up, r.action, r.target_tenant, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column FROM networksecuritybindings b JOIN networks n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN networkrbacs r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) ), ActiveNetworkRbacSummary AS ( SELECT name, status, admin_state_up, action, target_tenant, MAX(window_column) AS window_column FROM ActiveNetworkRbacDetails GROUP BY name, status, admin_state_up, action, target_tenant ) SELECT anrs.name AS network_name, anrs.status AS network_status, anrs.admin_state_up, anrs.action AS rbac_action, anrs.target_tenant, anrs.window_column, psos.port_status, psos.device_owner, psos.port_count, psos.earliest_standard_attr_update FROM ActiveNetworkRbacSummary anrs CROSS JOIN PortStatusOwnerStats psos ORDER BY anrs.name, anrs.action, anrs.target_tenant, psos.port_status, psos.device_owner), AvgPortCount AS (SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_port_count FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.network_name, i.network_status, i.admin_state_up, i.rbac_action, i.target_tenant, i.window_column, i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.earliest_standard_attr_update, a.avg_port_count AS benchmark, CASE WHEN i.port_count > a.avg_port_count * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_USER' WHEN i.port_count < a.avg_port_count * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_USER' ELSE 'AVERAGE_USER' END AS user_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN AvgPortCount a;

question: For the IPv4 subnet with subnet ID in ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48'), return the subnet name, tenant ID, network ID, IP version, CIDR, gateway IP, DHCP enabled flag, allocation pool first and last IPs, the maximum subnet standard attribute ID over the current row and next 2 rows (ordered by subnet ID), and the dense-rank window value of its standard attribute when ordered by the standard attribute updated-at timestamp over the current row and 2 preceding rows; additionally, include the standard attribute resource type and updated-at timestamp, and only keep rows whose standard attribute ID is greater than the average standard attribute ID among all IPv4 subnets. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Subnet ID "012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48" is predicated by "subnets.id IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH SubnetPoolAndMaxAttrNext2 AS (SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')), SubnetAttrDenseRankWindow AS (SELECT s.NAME, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY sa.UPDATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES AS sa ON sa.ID = s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')) SELECT sp.NAME AS subnet_name, sp.TENANT_ID, sp.NETWORK_ID, sp.IP_VERSION, sp.CIDR, sp.GATEWAY_IP, sp.ENABLE_DHCP, sp.FIRST_IP, sp.LAST_IP, sp.max_standard_attr_id_next2, sadr.window_column AS standard_attr_dense_rank_window FROM SubnetPoolAndMaxAttrNext2 sp JOIN SubnetAttrDenseRankWindow sadr ON sp.NAME = sadr.NAME) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.TENANT_ID, i.NETWORK_ID, i.IP_VERSION, i.CIDR, i.GATEWAY_IP, i.ENABLE_DHCP, i.FIRST_IP, i.LAST_IP, i.max_standard_attr_id_next2, i.standard_attr_dense_rank_window, sa.RESOURCE_TYPE AS standard_attr_resource_type, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBNETS s ON s.NAME = i.subnet_name AND s.TENANT_ID = i.TENANT_ID AND s.NETWORK_ID = i.NETWORK_ID JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID > ( SELECT AVG(s2.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) FROM SUBNETS s2 WHERE s2.IP_VERSION = 4 );

question: For the tenant ID '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57', group administratively up ports (that are both bound to at least one security group and have at least one IP allocation) by port status and by whether the port has any DNS records ('Has DNS' vs 'No DNS'). For each combination, list the port status, the DNS presence label, and the number of ports. Include subtotals per port status and a grand total. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH SecurityGroupAndDnsByPort AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb JOIN PORTS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN PORTDNSES pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name ), IpAllocationsByPort AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ia.subnet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND ia.ip_address IS NOT NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address ) SELECT sgd.port_id, sgd.tenant_id, sgd.port_name, ipa.mac_address, sgd.security_group_binding_count, sgd.dns_record_count, ipa.ip_allocation_count, ipa.subnet_id_rows FROM SecurityGroupAndDnsByPort sgd JOIN IpAllocationsByPort ipa ON sgd.port_id = ipa.port_id AND sgd.tenant_id = ipa.tenant_id ORDER BY sgd.security_group_binding_count DESC, ipa.ip_allocation_count DESC, sgd.port_id ), PortStatusDnsRollup AS ( SELECT p.status AS port_status, CASE WHEN inner_cte.dns_record_count > 0 THEN 'Has DNS' ELSE 'No DNS' END AS dns_presence, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.port_id) AS total_ports FROM inner_cte JOIN ports p ON p.id = inner_cte.port_id AND p.tenant_id = inner_cte.tenant_id GROUP BY p.status, dns_presence ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(port_status) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE port_status END AS port_status, CASE WHEN GROUPING(dns_presence) = 1 AND GROUPING(port_status) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE dns_presence END AS dns_presence, SUM(total_ports) AS total_ports FROM PortStatusDnsRollup GROUP BY port_status, dns_presence WITH ROLLUP;

question: For each port status and device owner, show the number of ports, the earliest standard-attribute updated timestamp (only for ports whose standard attribute resource type is 'ports' and excluding shared networks), and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of ports’ standard attribute IDs for that same port status (only for ports that have both a security group port binding and a port security binding, restricted to tenant_id '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7'), but return only those (port status, device owner) groups whose port count is greater than the average port count across all (port status, device owner) groups. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')" "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH PortStatusVariation AS ( SELECT p.status, STDDEV(p.standard_attr_id) / NULLIF(AVG(p.standard_attr_id), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM securitygroupportbindings AS sgpb JOIN ports AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN portsecuritybindings AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(p.standard_attr_id) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), PortStatusDeviceOwnerStats AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ) SELECT psdo.port_status, psdo.device_owner, psdo.port_count, psdo.earliest_standard_attr_update, psv.coefficient_of_variation FROM PortStatusDeviceOwnerStats psdo JOIN PortStatusVariation psv ON psdo.port_status = psv.status ORDER BY psdo.port_count DESC, psv.coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT port_status, device_owner, port_count, earliest_standard_attr_update, coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte WHERE port_count > (SELECT AVG(port_count) FROM inner_cte);

question: Using the per-network-status security statistics and ACTIVE-network counts (excluding shared networks where RBAC action = 'access_as_shared' and target tenant is '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'), list each network status along with: the ACTIVE network count, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED (only for networks with at least one security binding), and the deviation of that ACTIVE network count from the average ACTIVE network count across all returned statuses. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH NetworkStatusSecurityStats AS ( SELECT n.STATUS AS network_status, VARIANCE(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_variance, STDDEV(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_stddev FROM NETWORKS AS n JOIN NETWORKSECURITYBINDINGS AS nsb ON n.ID = nsb.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.STATUS ORDER BY port_security_enabled_variance DESC ), ActiveNetworkRbacDetails AS ( SELECT n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up, r.action, r.target_tenant, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column FROM networksecuritybindings b JOIN networks n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN networkrbacs r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) ), ActiveNetworkCountsByStatus AS ( SELECT status AS network_status, COUNT(DISTINCT name) AS active_network_count FROM ActiveNetworkRbacDetails GROUP BY status ) SELECT nsss.network_status, anc.active_network_count, nsss.port_security_enabled_variance, nsss.port_security_enabled_stddev FROM NetworkStatusSecurityStats nsss JOIN ActiveNetworkCountsByStatus anc ON nsss.network_status = anc.network_status ORDER BY anc.active_network_count DESC, nsss.port_security_enabled_variance DESC ), avg_active AS ( SELECT AVG(active_network_count) AS avg_active_network_count FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.network_status, i.active_network_count, i.port_security_enabled_variance, i.port_security_enabled_stddev, (i.active_network_count - a.avg_active_network_count) AS deviation_from_avg_active_network_count FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_active a ORDER BY i.active_network_count DESC, i.port_security_enabled_variance DESC;

question: For DOWN ports in network ID `0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d`, return each port’s name, network ID, MAC address, admin state, status, device owner, bound security group ID, and the minimum admin_state_up over a window of 3 preceding and 1 following rows (ordered by port ID). Also include (for the same port status and device owner) the total number of non-shared ports whose standard attribute resource type is `ports` plus the earliest standard-attribute updated timestamp, but only keep rows where that port_count is greater than the average port_count across all (status, device_owner) groups. SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH sq1 AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), sq2 AS ( SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') ) SELECT sq2.NETWORK_ID, sq2.NAME AS port_name, sq2.MAC_ADDRESS, sq2.ADMIN_STATE_UP, sq2.STATUS AS port_status, sq2.DEVICE_OWNER, sq2.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, sq2.window_column AS min_admin_state_up_window, sq1.port_count, sq1.earliest_standard_attr_update FROM sq2 JOIN sq1 ON sq1.port_status = sq2.STATUS AND sq1.device_owner = sq2.DEVICE_OWNER ORDER BY sq1.port_count DESC, sq2.NAME ) , AvgCounts AS ( SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_port_count FROM ( SELECT port_status, device_owner, MAX(port_count) AS port_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY port_status, device_owner ) grouped_counts ) SELECT inner_cte.NETWORK_ID, inner_cte.port_name, inner_cte.MAC_ADDRESS, inner_cte.ADMIN_STATE_UP, inner_cte.port_status, inner_cte.DEVICE_OWNER, inner_cte.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, inner_cte.min_admin_state_up_window, inner_cte.port_count, inner_cte.earliest_standard_attr_update FROM inner_cte JOIN AvgCounts ON 1 = 1 WHERE inner_cte.port_count > (SELECT avg_port_count FROM AvgCounts) ORDER BY inner_cte.port_count DESC, inner_cte.port_name;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH rbac_ip_version_stats_shared AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC ), rbac_ip_version_stddev_dhcp_not_shared AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 AND s.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.ACTION HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY ip_version_stddev DESC ) SELECT s1.ACTION, s1.avg_ip_version, s1.ip_version_variance, s1.ip_version_stddev AS shared_ip_version_stddev, s2.ip_version_stddev AS dhcp_not_shared_ip_version_stddev FROM rbac_ip_version_stats_shared s1 JOIN rbac_ip_version_stddev_dhcp_not_shared s2 ON s1.ACTION = s2.ACTION) SELECT i.ACTION, i.avg_ip_version, i.ip_version_variance, i.shared_ip_version_stddev, i.dhcp_not_shared_ip_version_stddev, (SUM(CASE WHEN s_all.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) AS dhcp_enabled_subnet_pct FROM inner_cte i JOIN NETWORKRBACS n_all ON n_all.ACTION = i.ACTION JOIN SUBNETS s_all ON s_all.NETWORK_ID = n_all.OBJECT_ID GROUP BY i.ACTION, i.avg_ip_version, i.ip_version_variance, i.shared_ip_version_stddev, i.dhcp_not_shared_ip_version_stddev;

atn.window_column ) SELECT tenant_id, network_id, network_name, admin_state_up, mtu, standard_attr_updated_at, network_row_number_within_tenant, total_admin_up_ports, distinct_vif_types, avg_port_window_avg_standard_attr_id FROM NetworkPortRollup ORDER BY total_admin_up_ports DESC, network_name ASC) , TenantActiveAvg AS ( SELECT tenant_id, AVG(total_admin_up_ports) AS SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH PortStatusOwnerAgg AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), TenantAdminUpPortWindow AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ) SELECT t.PORT_ID, t.HOST, t.VIF_TYPE, t.VNIC_TYPE, t.TENANT_ID, t.NETWORK_ID, t.MAC_ADDRESS, t.STATUS, t.DEVICE_OWNER, t.window_column, a.port_count, a.earliest_standard_attr_update FROM TenantAdminUpPortWindow t JOIN PortStatusOwnerAgg a ON a.port_status = t.STATUS AND a.device_owner = t.DEVICE_OWNER ORDER BY t.NETWORK_ID, t.PORT_ID) SELECT inner_cte.PORT_ID, inner_cte.HOST, inner_cte.VIF_TYPE, inner_cte.VNIC_TYPE, inner_cte.TENANT_ID, inner_cte.NETWORK_ID, inner_cte.MAC_ADDRESS, inner_cte.STATUS, inner_cte.DEVICE_OWNER, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.port_count, inner_cte.earliest_standard_attr_update FROM inner_cte JOIN PORTS p2 ON p2.ID = inner_cte.PORT_ID WHERE inner_cte.port_count > 10 ORDER BY inner_cte.NETWORK_ID, inner_cte.PORT_ID;

question: For tenant ID `17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7`, for each port that is administratively up and also has a binding on host `drive-59`, return the port ID, tenant ID, MAC address, the number of port security bindings on that port, the total number of times port security is enabled across those bindings, and the running sum of the port standard attribute IDs within each VIF type group (ordered by standard attribute ID). Also include subtotals by VIF type and a grand total of ports. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH PortSecurityAgg AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(psb.port_id) AS binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN psb.port_security_enabled THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS port_security_enabled_total FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address), HostWindowSum AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, p.TENANT_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE b.HOST = 'drive-59' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')) SELECT psa.port_id, psa.tenant_id, psa.mac_address, psa.binding_count, psa.port_security_enabled_total, hws.window_column FROM PortSecurityAgg psa JOIN HostWindowSum hws ON psa.port_id = hws.PORT_ID AND psa.tenant_id = hws.TENANT_ID AND psa.mac_address = hws.MAC_ADDRESS ), PortVifType AS ( SELECT i.port_id, b.vif_type FROM inner_cte i JOIN ml2_port_bindings b ON b.port_id = i.port_id AND b.host = 'drive-59' ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(pvt.vif_type) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE pvt.vif_type END AS vif_type, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.port_id) = 1 AND GROUPING(pvt.vif_type) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE i.port_id END AS port_id, MAX(i.tenant_id) AS tenant_id, MAX(i.mac_address) AS mac_address, SUM(i.binding_count) AS binding_count, SUM(i.port_security_enabled_total) AS port_security_enabled_total, MAX(i.window_column) AS window_column, COUNT(*) AS total_ports FROM inner_cte i JOIN PortVifType pvt ON pvt.port_id = i.port_id GROUP BY pvt.vif_type, i.port_id WITH ROLLUP;

question: For the top 10 security groups (ranked by the number of DOWN ports on network ID `0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d`), show each security group ID, the count of such down ports, the average of the per-port windowed minimum `admin_state_up` (computed over 3 preceding and 1 following port IDs), the geometric mean of `standard_attr_id` for ports in tenant `17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7` bound to the same security group, and whether any of those down ports belong to that tenant. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Network ID "0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d" is predicated by "ports.network_id IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d')" Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DownPortsWithWindow AS ( SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') ), SecurityGroupGeomMean AS ( SELECT s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, EXP(AVG(LN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID))) AS geometric_mean_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID > 0 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY geometric_mean_standard_attr_id DESC ) SELECT dpw.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, COUNT(*) AS down_port_count_in_network, AVG(dpw.window_column) AS avg_window_min_admin_state_up, MAX(sgg.geometric_mean_standard_attr_id) AS geometric_mean_standard_attr_id_for_tenant FROM DownPortsWithWindow dpw LEFT JOIN SecurityGroupGeomMean sgg ON dpw.SECURITY_GROUP_ID = sgg.SECURITY_GROUP_ID GROUP BY dpw.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY down_port_count_in_network DESC ), tenant_down_presence AS ( SELECT s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS tenant_down_ports FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ) SELECT i.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, i.down_port_count_in_network, i.avg_window_min_admin_state_up, i.geometric_mean_standard_attr_id_for_tenant, CASE WHEN COALESCE(tdp.tenant_down_ports, 0) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_any_down_ports_in_tenant FROM inner_cte i LEFT JOIN tenant_down_presence tdp ON i.SECURITY_GROUP_ID = tdp.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY i.down_port_count_in_network DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For tenant ID `17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7`, return the same administratively up port-security summary (tenant ID, admin-up port count, total port-security binding count, total enabled count, enabled-to-binding ratio rounded, and the average down-port standard-attribute running-sum window value), and also include the tenant’s total port count and the overall average port count across all tenants.
evidence: Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH PortSecurityStats AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(psb.port_id) AS binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN psb.port_security_enabled THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS port_security_enabled_total FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address), DownPortWindow AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(sa.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY sa.RESOURCE_TYPE ORDER BY sa.ID) AS window_column FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')) SELECT pss.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT pss.port_id) AS admin_up_port_count, SUM(pss.binding_count) AS total_binding_count, SUM(pss.port_security_enabled_total) AS total_port_security_enabled_across_bindings, ROUND( SUM(pss.port_security_enabled_total) / NULLIF(SUM(pss.binding_count), 0), 2 ) AS port_security_enabled_ratio, AVG(dpw.window_column) AS avg_down_port_window_sum FROM PortSecurityStats pss LEFT JOIN DownPortWindow dpw ON dpw.port_id = pss.port_id AND dpw.tenant_id = pss.tenant_id GROUP BY pss.tenant_id ORDER BY port_security_enabled_ratio DESC ) SELECT i.tenant_id, i.admin_up_port_count, i.total_binding_count, i.total_port_security_enabled_across_bindings, i.port_security_enabled_ratio, i.avg_down_port_window_sum, COUNT(p_all.id) AS total_ports_for_tenant, avg_ports.avg_port_count AS avg_ports_across_all_tenants FROM inner_cte i JOIN ports p_all ON p_all.tenant_id = i.tenant_id JOIN ( SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_port_count FROM ( SELECT COUNT(id) AS port_count FROM ports GROUP BY tenant_id ) AS sub ) AS avg_ports GROUP BY i.tenant_id, i.admin_up_port_count, i.total_binding_count, i.total_port_security_enabled_across_bindings, i.port_security_enabled_ratio, i.avg_down_port_window_sum, avg_ports.avg_port_count;

question: For tenant ID `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57`, among administratively up ports that have at least one IP allocation, list only those ports whose IP allocation count is greater than the average IP allocation count for ports with the same VIF type (computed over this tenant’s administratively up ports with at least one IP allocation). Return the port ID, tenant ID, network ID, MAC address, host, VIF type, VNIC type, status, device owner, the average standard attribute ID over a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows partitioned by VIF type, along with the number of IP allocations on the port and the number of those allocations with a non-null subnet ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH PortIpAllocStats AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ia.subnet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND ia.ip_address IS NOT NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address ), PortBindingWindowStats AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ) SELECT pbws.PORT_ID AS port_id, pbws.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, pbws.NETWORK_ID AS network_id, pbws.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, pbws.HOST AS host, pbws.VIF_TYPE AS vif_type, pbws.VNIC_TYPE AS vnic_type, pbws.STATUS AS status, pbws.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, pbws.window_column AS avg_standard_attr_id_window, pias.ip_allocation_count AS ip_allocation_count, pias.subnet_id_rows AS subnet_id_rows FROM PortBindingWindowStats pbws JOIN PortIpAllocStats pias ON pias.port_id = pbws.PORT_ID ORDER BY pbws.VIF_TYPE, pbws.PORT_ID ), VifTypeAverages AS ( SELECT vif_type, AVG(ip_allocation_count) AS avg_ip_allocations FROM inner_cte GROUP BY vif_type ) SELECT i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.network_id, i.mac_address, i.host, i.vif_type, i.vnic_type, i.status, i.device_owner, i.avg_standard_attr_id_window, i.ip_allocation_count, i.subnet_id_rows FROM inner_cte i JOIN VifTypeAverages vta ON vta.vif_type = i.vif_type WHERE i.ip_allocation_count > vta.avg_ip_allocations ORDER BY i.vif_type, i.port_id;

question: For the unified set of DOWN ports that either (a) belong to tenant ID `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57` or (b) belong to network ID `0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d`, compute how many ports appear under each reason label, and return only those reason labels whose port count is greater than the average port count across the reason labels. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')" Network ID "0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d" is predicated by "ports.network_id IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH TenantDownPorts AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), NetworkDownPorts AS (SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d')), CombinedDownPorts AS ( SELECT t.port_id AS port_identifier, t.tenant_id AS scope_id, t.mac_address, t.window_column AS window_metric, 'Tenant Filter' AS reason FROM TenantDownPorts t UNION ALL SELECT n.NAME AS port_identifier, n.NETWORK_ID AS scope_id, n.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, n.window_column AS window_metric, 'Network Filter' AS reason FROM NetworkDownPorts n ) SELECT * FROM CombinedDownPorts ORDER BY reason, scope_id, port_identifier ), ReasonCounts AS ( SELECT reason, COUNT(*) AS total_ports FROM inner_cte GROUP BY reason ) SELECT reason, total_ports FROM ReasonCounts WHERE total_ports > (SELECT AVG(total_ports) FROM ReasonCounts) ORDER BY total_ports DESC, reason;

question: Among the top 10 tenants with the most ACTIVE networks (excluding shared networks where RBAC action = 'access_as_shared' and target tenant is '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'), show each tenant’s ID, total number of ACTIVE networks, and whether they have any RBAC entries at all on those networks. SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH NetworkStatusSecurityStats AS ( SELECT n.STATUS AS network_status, VARIANCE(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_variance, STDDEV(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_stddev FROM NETWORKS AS n JOIN NETWORKSECURITYBINDINGS AS nsb ON n.ID = nsb.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.STATUS ORDER BY port_security_enabled_variance DESC ), ActiveNetworkRbacDetails AS ( SELECT n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up, r.action, r.target_tenant, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column FROM networksecuritybindings b JOIN networks n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN networkrbacs r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id ActiveNetworkCountsByStatus AS ( SELECT status AS network_status, COUNT(DISTINCT name) AS active_network_count FROM ActiveNetworkRbacDetails GROUP BY status ) SELECT nsss.network_status, anc.active_network_count, nsss.port_security_enabled_variance, nsss.port_security_enabled_stddev FROM NetworkStatusSecurityStats nsss JOIN ActiveNetworkCountsByStatus anc ON nsss.network_status = anc.network_status ORDER BY anc.active_network_count DESC, nsss.port_security_enabled_variance DESC ), tenant_active_networks AS ( SELECT n.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id) AS total_active_networks FROM networks n WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.tenant_id ), tenant_rbac_presence AS ( SELECT n.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) AS total_rbac_rows FROM networks n LEFT JOIN networkrbacs r ON r.object_id = n.id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.tenant_id ) SELECT tan.tenant_id, tan.total_active_networks, CASE WHEN tan.total_active_networks, trp.total_rbac_rows ORDER BY tan.total_active_networks DESC LIMIT 10;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH SubnetPoolAndAttrStats AS ( SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') ), SubnetRouteCountDispersion AS ( SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, MAX(route_count) - MIN(route_count) AS route_count_range, VARIANCE(route_count) AS route_count_variance, STDDEV(route_count) AS route_count_stddev FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN ( SELECT sr.SUBNET_ID, COUNT(*) AS route_count FROM SUBNETROUTES AS sr GROUP BY sr.SUBNET_ID, sr.NEXTHOP ) AS route_stats ON s.ID = route_stats.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY route_count_range DESC ) SELECT spa.NAME AS subnet_name, spa.TENANT_ID, spa.NETWORK_ID, spa.IP_VERSION, spa.CIDR, spa.GATEWAY_IP, spa.ENABLE_DHCP, spa.FIRST_IP AS allocation_pool_first_ip, spa.LAST_IP AS allocation_pool_last_ip, spa.max_standard_attr_id_next2, srcd.route_count_range, srcd.route_count_variance, srcd.route_count_stddev FROM SubnetPoolAndAttrStats spa JOIN SubnetRouteCountDispersion srcd ON spa.NAME = srcd.subnet_name ORDER BY spa.NAME) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.TENANT_ID, i.NETWORK_ID, i.IP_VERSION, i.CIDR, i.GATEWAY_IP, i.ENABLE_DHCP, i.allocation_pool_first_ip, i.allocation_pool_last_ip, i.max_standard_attr_id_next2, i.route_count_range, i.route_count_variance, i.route_count_stddev, avg_stats.avg_route_count_range FROM inner_cte i JOIN (SELECT AVG(route_count_range) AS avg_route_count_range FROM (SELECT route_count_range FROM inner_cte) AS sub) AS avg_stats ON 1 = 1;

JOIN networks n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN networkrbacs r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) ), ActiveNetworkRbacSummary AS ( SELECT name, status, admin_state_up, action, target_tenant, MAX(window_column) AS window_column FROM ActiveNetworkRbacDetails GROUP BY name, status, admin_state_up, action, target_tenant ) SELECT anrs.name AS network_name, anrs.status AS network_status, anrs.admin_state_up, anrs.action AS rbac_action, anrs.target_tenant, anrs.window_column, psos.port_status, psos.device_owner, psos.port_count, psos.earliest_standard_attr_update FROM ActiveNetworkRbacSummary anrs CROSS JOIN PortStatusOwnerStats psos ORDER BY anrs.name, anrs.action, anrs.target_tenant, psos.port_status, psos.device_owner), StatusAverages AS ( SELECT port_status, AVG(port_count) AS avg_port_count_for_status FROM inner_cte GROUP BY port_status ) SELECT i.network_name, i.network_status, i.admin_state_up, i.rbac_action, i.target_tenant, i.window_column, i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.earliest_standard_attr_update FROM inner_cte i WHERE i.port_count > ( SELECT sa.avg_port_count_for_status FROM StatusAverages sa WHERE sa.port_status = i.port_status ) ORDER BY i.network_name, i.rbac_action, i.target_tenant, i.port_status, i.device_owner;

question: For tenant_id '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7', list each DOWN port status and device owner (considering only ports bound to a security group, and using the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) computed only from ports that also have both a security group port binding and a port security binding), and additionally indicate whether any of those ports have floating IPs allocated; return the port status, device owner, number of distinct ports, minimum standard attribute ID, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) (keeping only statuses where it is greater than 0), and a Yes/No flag for having floating IPs. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH PortStatusVariation AS ( SELECT p.status, STDDEV(p.standard_attr_id) / NULLIF(AVG(p.standard_attr_id), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM securitygroupportbindings AS sgpb JOIN ports AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN portsecuritybindings AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(p.standard_attr_id) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), PortStatusDeviceOwnerStats AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ) SELECT psds.port_status, psds.device_owner, psds.port_count, psds.min_standard_attr_id, psv.coefficient_of_variation FROM PortStatusDeviceOwnerStats psds JOIN PortStatusVariation psv ON psv.status = psds.port_status WHERE psv.coefficient_of_variation > 0 ORDER BY psv.coefficient_of_variation DESC, psds.port_count DESC) SELECT i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.min_standard_attr_id, i.coefficient_of_variation, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT f.id) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_floating_ips FROM inner_cte i JOIN ports p ON p.tenant_id = '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7' AND p.status = i.port_status AND p.device_owner = i.device_owner JOIN securitygroupportbindings sgpb ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN floatingips f ON f.fixed_port_id = p.id GROUP BY i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.min_standard_attr_id, i.coefficient_of_variation ORDER BY i.coefficient_of_variation DESC, i.port_count DESC;

question: How many (status, device owner) port groups exist when considering only ports whose standard attribute resource type is 'ports', and how many IPv4 subnet/allocation-pool rows have a “max standard attribute id over the current and next 2 subnets” that points to a standard attribute whose resource type is also 'ports'? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH port_status_owner_stats AS (SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER), subnet_pool_window AS (SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4), subnets_matching_ports_standardattrs AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS matching_subnet_rows_count FROM subnet_pool_window spw JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa2 ON sa2.ID = spw.max_standard_attr_id_next2 WHERE sa2.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' ) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM port_status_owner_stats) AS port_status_owner_group_count, smp.matching_subnet_rows_count FROM subnets_matching_ports_standardattrs smp;

question: For each IPv4 subnet that has at least one DNS nameserver entry, show the subnet name, tenant ID, network ID, IP version, CIDR, gateway IP, DHCP enabled flag, allocation pool first IP and last IP, the maximum subnet standard attribute ID over the current subnet and the next 2 subnets by subnet ID, and also the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of IP allocation pools per subnet (grouped by subnet name), ordered by the pool-count range descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH SubnetPoolStatsByName AS ( SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, MAX(pool_count) - MIN(pool_count) AS pool_count_range, VARIANCE(pool_count) AS pool_count_variance, STDDEV(pool_count) AS pool_count_stddev FROM subnets AS s JOIN dnsnameservers AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN ( SELECT s2.id AS subnet_id, COUNT(*) AS pool_count FROM subnets AS s2 JOIN ipallocationpools AS p ON p.subnet_id = s2.id GROUP BY s2.id, p.id ) AS pool_stats ON pool_stats.subnet_id = s.id GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY pool_count_range DESC ), SubnetDetailsWithWindowMax AS ( SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 ), DnsSubnetNames AS ( SELECT DISTINCT s.name AS subnet_name FROM subnets s JOIN dnsnameservers d ON d.subnet_id = s.id ) SELECT sd.NAME AS subnet_name, sd.TENANT_ID, sd.NETWORK_ID, sd.IP_VERSION, sd.CIDR, sd.GATEWAY_IP, sd.ENABLE_DHCP, sd.FIRST_IP, sd.LAST_IP, sd.max_standard_attr_id_next2, sp.pool_count_range, sp.pool_count_variance, sp.pool_count_stddev FROM SubnetDetailsWithWindowMax sd JOIN SubnetPoolStatsByName sp ON sd.NAME = sp.subnet_name JOIN DnsSubnetNames dn ON sd.NAME = dn.subnet_name ORDER BY sp.pool_count_range DESC, sd.NAME;

question: For tenants whose administratively-up ports are in status DOWN, list the tenant ID, the average of the “average standard attribute ID” window metric (partitioned by VIF type with 2 preceding and 2 following rows), the number of distinct security groups that contain DOWN ports for that tenant, and whether the tenant has any DOWN ports; only include tenants where this average window metric is greater than 100. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH AdminUpPorts AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 ), DownPortsBySecurityGroup AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id ) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' ) SELECT aup.TENANT_ID, AVG(aup.window_column) AS Avg_AdminUp_StdAttr_Window, COUNT(DISTINCT dpsg.security_group_id) AS Down_Security_Group_Count, CASE WHEN COUNT(dpsg.port_id) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS Has_Down_Ports FROM AdminUpPorts AS aup LEFT JOIN DownPortsBySecurityGroup AS dpsg ON dpsg.tenant_id = aup.TENANT_ID WHERE aup.STATUS = 'DOWN' GROUP BY aup.TENANT_ID HAVING AVG(aup.window_column) > 100 ORDER BY Avg_AdminUp_StdAttr_Window DESC;

question: For each load balancer operating status that (1) has more than 1 load balancer associated with the “haproxy” provider and (2) has more than 1,000,000 total incoming bytes among load balancers in ACTIVE provisioning status, return the operating status, the total haproxy load balancer count, and the total incoming bytes. Do not return any rounded answers.
