SQL: WITH DownPortsWindowAvg AS ( SELECT p.NAME, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, AVG(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.MAC_ADDRESS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' ORDER BY p.MAC_ADDRESS ), DownPortsRank AS ( SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.NAME AS port_name, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, b.HOST AS binding_host, b.VIF_TYPE AS vif_type, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.STATUS ORDER BY p.ID) AS window_column FROM PORTS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' ), CombinedDownPortAnalytics AS ( SELECT NULL AS port_id, d1.NAME AS port_name, d1.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, d1.HOST AS binding_host, d1.VIF_TYPE AS vif_type, d1.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, d1.window_column AS window_metric, 'VIF-type window avg(admin_state_up)' AS metric_type FROM DownPortsWindowAvg d1 UNION ALL SELECT d2.port_id AS port_id, d2.port_name AS port_name, d2.mac_address AS mac_address, d2.binding_host AS binding_host, d2.vif_type AS vif_type, NULL AS admin_state_up, d2.window_column AS window_metric, 'Status-group rank by port_id' AS metric_type FROM DownPortsRank d2 ) SELECT * FROM CombinedDownPortAnalytics ORDER BY vif_type, mac_address, metric_type, port_id;

question: For ports whose status is DOWN, show the down port name, MAC address, admin_state_up flag, binding host, VIF type, and the average admin_state_up over a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows (partitioned by VIF type and ordered by MAC address), along with the matching administratively up port’s name, MAC address, port security enabled flag, and its row number over a window of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row (ordered by MAC address), matching the two sets by MAC address. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DownPortsWithBindings AS ( SELECT p.NAME, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, AVG(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.MAC_ADDRESS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' ORDER BY p.MAC_ADDRESS ), AdminUpPortsWithSecurity AS ( SELECT p.NAME AS port_name, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, psb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED AS port_security_enabled, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY p.MAC_ADDRESS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 ) SELECT dp.NAME AS down_port_name, dp.MAC_ADDRESS AS down_mac_address, dp.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS down_admin_state_up, dp.HOST AS binding_host, dp.VIF_TYPE AS vif_type, dp.window_column AS avg_admin_state_up_window_2p_2f, au.port_name AS admin_up_port_name, au.mac_address AS admin_up_mac_address, au.port_security_enabled, au.window_column AS row_number_window_2p_1f FROM DownPortsWithBindings dp JOIN AdminUpPortsWithSecurity au ON dp.MAC_ADDRESS = au.mac_address ORDER BY dp.MAC_ADDRESS;

question: For each IPv4 subnet that has an allocation pool, list the subnet name, tenant ID, network ID, IP version, CIDR, gateway IP, DHCP enabled flag, allocation pool first/last IPs, and the maximum subnet standard attribute ID over the current subnet row plus the next two subnets (ordered by subnet ID), but only for subnet name and gateway IP pairs whose network is shared via RBAC action 'access_as_shared' and whose maximum IP version is greater than 3. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH SubnetPoolWindow AS (SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4), SharedNetworkSubnetMaxIP AS (SELECT s.name, MAX(s.ip_version) AS max_ip_version, s.gateway_ip FROM NETWORKRBACS n JOIN SUBNETS s ON n.object_id = s.network_id WHERE n.action = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY s.name, s.gateway_ip HAVING MAX(s.ip_version) > 3) SELECT spw.NAME AS subnet_name, spw.TENANT_ID, spw.NETWORK_ID, spw.IP_VERSION, spw.CIDR, spw.GATEWAY_IP, spw.ENABLE_DHCP, spw.FIRST_IP, spw.LAST_IP, spw.max_standard_attr_id_next2, sns.max_ip_version FROM SubnetPoolWindow spw JOIN SharedNetworkSubnetMaxIP sns ON spw.NAME = sns.name AND spw.GATEWAY_IP = sns.gateway_ip ORDER BY spw.NAME, spw.GATEWAY_IP;

question: For ports that are DOWN, return each port’s ID, tenant ID, port name, network ID, MAC address, admin state, status, device owner, bound security group ID, and allocated IP address, along with (1) the row number of the port within its network ordered by port ID and (2) the minimum admin_state_up over a window of 3 preceding and 1 following port (ordered by port ID). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DownPortsWithIPs AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.NAME AS port_name, p.NETWORK_ID AS network_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, ia.IP_ADDRESS AS ip_address, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.NETWORK_ID ORDER BY p.ID) AS window_column FROM PORTS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN'), DownPortsWithSecurityGroupWindow AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN') SELECT dpi.port_id, dpi.tenant_id, dpi.port_name, dpi.network_id, dpi.mac_address, dpsgw.ADMIN_STATE_UP, dpsgw.STATUS, dpi.device_owner, dpsgw.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, dpi.ip_address, dpi.window_column AS network_row_number, dpsgw.window_column AS admin_state_up_min_window FROM DownPortsWithIPs dpi JOIN DownPortsWithSecurityGroupWindow dpsgw ON dpi.port_id = dpsgw.port_id;

question: For ports that are DOWN and are bound to security group ID 0008e629-5619-41e0-b86c-4eecfeaacb6c, show the port ID, tenant ID, MAC address, port status, and allocated IP address, along with (1) the running sum of the port’s standard attribute ID within each security group (ordered by standard attribute ID) and (2) the running sum of the port’s standard attribute ID within each network (ordered by standard attribute ID). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' ), q2 AS ( SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.STATUS AS port_status, ia.IP_ADDRESS AS ip_address, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY p.NETWORK_ID ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb JOIN PORTS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID = '0008e629-5619-41e0-b86c-4eecfeaacb6c' ) SELECT q2.port_id, q1.tenant_id, q1.mac_address, q2.port_status, q2.ip_address, q1.window_column AS running_sum_standard_attr_id_within_security_group, q2.window_column AS running_sum_standard_attr_id_within_network FROM q2 JOIN q1 ON q2.port_id = q1.port_id ORDER BY q2.port_id;

question: For ports that are administratively up, have at least one IP allocation, and are bound to security group ID 0008e629-5619-41e0-b86c-4eecfeaacb6c, return the port ID, tenant ID, MAC address, port status, allocated IP address, the running sum of the port’s standard attribute ID within each network, the total IP allocation count, and the number of distinct subnets—restricted to ports where more than 75% of their IP-allocation rows have a non-null subnet ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH PortIpAllocationStats AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ia.subnet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND ia.ip_address IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address ), SecurityGroupBoundPortIps AS ( SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.STATUS AS port_status, ia.IP_ADDRESS AS ip_address, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY p.NETWORK_ID ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb JOIN PORTS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID = '0008e629-5619-41e0-b86c-4eecfeaacb6c' ), PortSubnetCoverage AS ( SELECT ia.port_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.subnet_id) AS distinct_subnet_count FROM ipallocations ia JOIN securitygroupportbindings sgpb ON sgpb.port_id = ia.port_id WHERE sgpb.security_group_id = '0008e629-5619-41e0-b86c-4eecfeaacb6c' GROUP BY ia.port_id ) SELECT pis.port_id, pis.tenant_id, pis.mac_address, sgp.port_status, sgp.ip_address, sgp.window_column, pis.ip_allocation_count, psc.distinct_subnet_count FROM PortIpAllocationStats pis JOIN SecurityGroupBoundPortIps sgp ON pis.port_id = sgp.port_id JOIN PortSubnetCoverage psc ON pis.port_id = psc.port_id WHERE (pis.subnet_id_rows * 1.0 / pis.ip_allocation_count) > 0.75;

question: How many administratively up ports belong to tenant ID `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57`, and how many distinct port-status groups have a computed variance of `STANDARD_ATTR_ID` among ports with an IP allocation of `10.150.64.113/8`? Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')" IP Address "10.150.64.113/8" is predicated by "ipallocations.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8')"
SQL: WITH ports_admin_up_tenant_window AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), status_variance_for_ip AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, VARIANCE(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS standard_attr_id_variance FROM PORTS AS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID IS NOT NULL AND ia.IP_ADDRESS IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.STATUS ORDER BY standard_attr_id_variance DESC ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS admin_up_ports_for_tenant_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM status_variance_for_ip) AS ip_filtered_status_groups_count FROM ports_admin_up_tenant_window paw CROSS JOIN status_variance_for_ip svi;

question: For each security group bound to ports that are DOWN on network ID `0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d`, show the security group ID, the number of such down ports, the average of the per-port windowed minimum `admin_state_up` (computed over 3 preceding and 1 following port IDs), and the geometric mean of `standard_attr_id` for ports in tenant `17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7` that are bound to the same security group. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Network ID "0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d" is predicated by "ports.network_id IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d')" Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')"
SQL: WITH DownPortsWithWindow AS ( SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') ), SecurityGroupGeomMean AS ( SELECT s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, EXP(AVG(LN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID))) AS geometric_mean_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID > 0 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY geometric_mean_standard_attr_id DESC ) SELECT dpw.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, COUNT(*) AS down_port_count_in_network, AVG(dpw.window_column) AS avg_window_min_admin_state_up, MAX(sgg.geometric_mean_standard_attr_id) AS geometric_mean_standard_attr_id_for_tenant FROM DownPortsWithWindow dpw LEFT JOIN SecurityGroupGeomMean sgg ON dpw.SECURITY_GROUP_ID = sgg.SECURITY_GROUP_ID GROUP BY dpw.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY down_port_count_in_network DESC;

question: For tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57", list each ACTIVE network and its administratively-up ports on that network, showing the tenant_id, network_id, network_name, network admin_state_up, MTU, the network’s standard attribute updated_at timestamp, the row number of the network within the tenant ordered by network name, plus port details (port_id, host, VIF type, VNIC type, MAC address, port status, device owner) and the average port standard_attr_id computed over a 2-preceding/2-following window partitioned by VIF type. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "networks.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')" Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
SQL: WITH ActiveTenantNetworks AS (SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), AdminUpTenantPorts AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), CombinedNetworkPortView AS ( SELECT n.tenant_id, n.network_id, n.network_name, n.admin_state_up AS network_admin_state_up, n.mtu, n.standard_attr_updated_at, n.window_column AS network_row_number_by_name, p.PORT_ID AS port_id, p.HOST AS host, p.VIF_TYPE AS vif_type, p.VNIC_TYPE AS vnic_type, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, p.window_column AS avg_standard_attr_id_window_2_pre_2_fol_by_vif_type FROM ActiveTenantNetworks n JOIN AdminUpTenantPorts p ON p.TENANT_ID = n.tenant_id AND p.NETWORK_ID = n.network_id ) SELECT * FROM CombinedNetworkPortView ORDER BY tenant_id, network_name, port_id;

question: For the RBAC action "access_as_shared", return the action name along with (1) the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subnet IP version for IP version 4 subnets on networks referenced by RBAC entries, and (2) the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subnet IP version for DHCP-enabled subnets on non-shared networks (excluding networks shared to target tenant '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') where the action has more than 5 matching subnets. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "access_as_shared" permission is predicated by "networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared'" "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))"
SQL: WITH RbacIpVersionStatsShared AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC ), RbacIpVersionStddevDhcpNonShared AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 AND s.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.ACTION HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY ip_version_stddev DESC ) SELECT r1.ACTION, r1.avg_ip_version, r1.ip_version_variance, r1.ip_version_stddev AS shared_access_ip_version_stddev, r2.ip_version_stddev AS dhcp_nonshared_ip_version_stddev FROM RbacIpVersionStatsShared r1 JOIN RbacIpVersionStddevDhcpNonShared r2 ON r1.ACTION = r2.ACTION WHERE r1.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' ORDER BY r1.ip_version_variance DESC;

question: For each ACTIVE network (excluding shared networks where the RBAC action is 'access_as_shared' and the target tenant is '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'), list the network name, status, admin_state_up, RBAC action, target tenant, and its dense-rank-by-network-ID value, and also show (for the 'access_as_shared' RBAC action) the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subnet IP version across referenced subnets restricted to IPv4 (IP_VERSION = 4). Do not return any rounded answers.

SQL: WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up, r.action, r.target_tenant, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column FROM networksecuritybindings b JOIN networks n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN networkrbacs r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) ) SELECT s2.name, s2.status, s2.admin_state_up, s2.action, s2.target_tenant, s2.window_column, s1.avg_ip_version, s1.ip_version_variance, s1.ip_version_stddev FROM Subq2 s2 CROSS JOIN Subq1 s1 WHERE s1.action = 'access_as_shared';

question: For tenant ID `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57`, for each administratively up port that has at least one IP allocation, list the port ID, tenant ID, network ID, MAC address, host, VIF type, VNIC type, status, device owner, the average standard attribute ID computed over a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows partitioned by VIF type, along with the number of IP allocations on the port and the total number of rows with a non-null subnet ID among those IP allocations. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
SQL: WITH PortIpAllocStats AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ia.subnet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND ia.ip_address IS NOT NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address ), PortBindingWindowStats AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ) SELECT pbws.PORT_ID AS port_id, pbws.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, pbws.NETWORK_ID AS network_id, pbws.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, pbws.HOST AS host, pbws.VIF_TYPE AS vif_type, pbws.VNIC_TYPE AS vnic_type, pbws.STATUS AS status, pbws.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, pbws.window_column AS avg_standard_attr_id_window, pias.ip_allocation_count AS ip_allocation_count, pias.subnet_id_rows AS subnet_id_rows FROM PortBindingWindowStats pbws JOIN PortIpAllocStats pias ON pias.port_id = pbws.PORT_ID ORDER BY pbws.VIF_TYPE, pbws.PORT_ID;

question: Give the total count of non-shared default external networks (where IS_DEFAULT = 0 and excluding networks shared via RBAC to target tenant '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'), and also list each ACTIVE non-shared network’s name, status, admin_state_up, RBAC action, target tenant, and its dense-rank within the network. Do not return any rounded answers.

SQL: WITH DefaultExternalNonSharedNetworks AS ( SELECT e.NETWORK_ID, e.IS_DEFAULT, n.TENANT_ID, n.NAME, n.STATUS, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP, n.MTU, n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID, MIN(n.MTU) OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.TENANT_ID) AS window_column FROM EXTERNALNETWORKS e JOIN NETWORKS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND n.ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) ), ActiveNetworksWithRbacNonShared AS ( SELECT n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up, r.action, r.target_tenant, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column FROM networksecuritybindings b JOIN networks n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN networkrbacs r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) ), DefaultExternalNonSharedNetworkCount AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS Default_External_NonShared_Network_Count FROM DefaultExternalNonSharedNetworks ) SELECT c.Default_External_NonShared_Network_Count, a.name, a.status, a.admin_state_up, a.action, a.target_tenant, a.window_column AS Active_Network_Rbac_Dense_Rank FROM DefaultExternalNonSharedNetworkCount c CROSS JOIN ActiveNetworksWithRbacNonShared a;

question: For each port status that appears in both (a) ports bound with VIF type 'ovs' for device_id 'da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7' and (b) ports that have an IP allocation with IP address '10.150.64.113/8', return the status along with the minimum admin_state_up, the average standard_attr_id, and the variance of standard_attr_id (from the IP-allocation-filtered ports), ordered by the variance descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: IP Address "10.150.64.113/8" is predicated by "ipallocations.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8')" Device ID "da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7" is predicated by "ports.device_id IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7')"
SQL: WITH IPAllocStatusVariance AS (SELECT p.STATUS, VARIANCE(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS standard_attr_id_variance FROM PORTS AS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID IS NOT NULL AND ia.IP_ADDRESS IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.STATUS ORDER BY standard_attr_id_variance DESC), OVSDeviceStatusStats AS (SELECT p.STATUS, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) AS min_admin_state_up, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE b.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' AND p.DEVICE_ID IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS) SELECT o.STATUS, o.min_admin_state_up, o.avg_standard_attr_id, i.standard_attr_id_variance FROM OVSDeviceStatusStats o JOIN IPAllocStatusVariance i ON o.STATUS = i.STATUS ORDER BY i.standard_attr_id_variance DESC;

question: For each port status and device owner (considering only ports whose standard attribute resource type is 'ports' and excluding shared networks), list the port status, device owner, number of ports, earliest standard attribute updated timestamp, and the associated network status; also include, for that network status, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED across networks with at least one security binding (excluding shared networks), and compute a derived metric of ports per security standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) (port_count divided by the network-status PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP)), ordered by this derived metric descending.
evidence: "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))"
SQL: WITH NetworkStatusSecurityStats AS ( SELECT n.STATUS AS network_status, VARIANCE(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_variance, STDDEV(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_stddev FROM NETWORKS AS n JOIN NETWORKSECURITYBINDINGS AS nsb ON n.ID = nsb.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.STATUS ORDER BY port_security_enabled_variance DESC ), PortStatusOwnerStats AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), PortStatusOwnerWithNetworkStatus AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, n.STATUS AS network_status FROM PORTS p JOIN NETWORKS n ON n.ID = p.NETWORK_ID JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) ) SELECT psos.port_status, psos.device_owner, psos.port_count, psos.earliest_standard_attr_update, psonws.network_status, nsss.port_security_enabled_variance, nsss.port_security_enabled_stddev, ROUND(psos.port_count / NULLIF(nsss.port_security_enabled_stddev, 0), 2) AS ports_per_security_stddev FROM PortStatusOwnerStats psos JOIN PortStatusOwnerWithNetworkStatus psonws ON psonws.port_status = psos.port_status AND psonws.device_owner = psos.device_owner JOIN NetworkStatusSecurityStats nsss ON nsss.network_status = psonws.network_status ORDER BY ports_per_security_stddev DESC;

question: For tenant ID '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57', list ports that are DOWN and also have admin_state_up = 1 and are bound to a security group, showing the port ID, tenant ID, MAC address, security group ID, the port’s rank within its security group ordered by port ID, the port name, the number of security group bindings for the port, and the total number of DNS records associated with the port. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
SQL: WITH DownPortsBySecurityGroup AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), AdminUpPortsSecurityGroupAndDNSCounts AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb JOIN PORTS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN PORTDNSES pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name) SELECT dp.port_id, dp.tenant_id, dp.mac_address, dp.security_group_id, dp.window_column AS down_port_rank_within_security_group, au.port_name, au.security_group_binding_count, au.dns_record_count FROM DownPortsBySecurityGroup dp JOIN AdminUpPortsSecurityGroupAndDNSCounts au ON au.port_id = dp.port_id AND au.tenant_id = dp.tenant_id;

question: For tenant ID '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57', return the total number of ACTIVE networks, the total number of DOWN ports (from the security-group-to-port bindings), and the average number of DOWN ports per ACTIVE network.

SQL: WITH DownPortsBySecurityGroup AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), ActiveNetworksByTenant AS ( SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ActiveNetworksByTenant) AS total_active_networks, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DownPortsBySecurityGroup) AS total_down_ports, ROUND( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DownPortsBySecurityGroup) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ActiveNetworksByTenant), 0), 2 ) AS avg_down_ports_per_active_network ;

question: For port statuses that also appear among administratively up ports with port security bindings for tenant ID '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57', report each status along with (for tenant ID '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') the number of ports with at least one port security binding and the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of port security bindings per port. SQL: WITH PortStatusBindingStats AS ( SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC ), AdminUpPortWindowDetails AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), PortStatusCounts AS ( SELECT p.status, COUNT(*) AS port_count FROM PORTS p JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.status ) SELECT psbs.status, psc.port_count, psbs.binding_count_range, psbs.binding_count_variance, psbs.binding_count_stddev FROM PortStatusBindingStats psbs JOIN PortStatusCounts psc ON psbs.status = psc.status WHERE psbs.status IN (SELECT STATUS FROM AdminUpPortWindowDetails);

question: For DOWN ports that belong to tenant ID '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57' and are on network ID '0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d', list the port ID, tenant ID, network ID, port name, MAC address, admin state, status, device owner, and security group ID, along with (1) the rank of each port within its security group ordered by port ID and (2) the minimum admin_state_up over a window of 3 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by port ID, but only for security groups that have at least 2 such DOWN ports. SQL: WITH TenantDownPortsBySecurityGroup AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), NetworkDownPortsWithMinAdminStateWindow AS ( SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') ), SecurityGroupDownPortCounts AS ( SELECT sgpb.security_group_id, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS down_port_count FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') AND p.network_id IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') GROUP BY sgpb.security_group_id ) SELECT tdp.port_id, tdp.tenant_id, ndp.network_id, ndp.name AS port_name, tdp.mac_address, ndp.admin_state_up, ndp.status, ndp.device_owner, tdp.security_group_id, tdp.window_column AS port_rank_within_security_group_by_port_id, ndp.window_column AS min_admin_state_up_in_3_preceding_1_following_window, sgc.down_port_count FROM TenantDownPortsBySecurityGroup AS tdp JOIN NetworkDownPortsWithMinAdminStateWindow AS ndp ON tdp.security_group_id = ndp.security_group_id AND tdp.mac_address = ndp.mac_address JOIN SecurityGroupDownPortCounts AS sgc ON tdp.security_group_id = sgc.security_group_id WHERE sgc.down_port_count >= 2 ORDER BY sgc.down_port_count DESC, tdp.security_group_id, tdp.port_id;

SQL: WITH port_security_binding_stats_by_status AS ( SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC ), down_ports_with_security_groups AS ( SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') ), down_ports_with_security_groups_tenant_filtered AS ( SELECT dpsg.NAME, dpsg.NETWORK_ID, dpsg.MAC_ADDRESS, dpsg.ADMIN_STATE_UP, dpsg.STATUS, dpsg.DEVICE_OWNER, dpsg.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, dpsg.window_column FROM down_ports_with_security_groups dpsg JOIN ports p ON p.network_id = dpsg.NETWORK_ID AND p.mac_address = dpsg.MAC_ADDRESS WHERE p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') ) SELECT psbs.status, psbs.binding_count_range, psbs.binding_count_variance, psbs.binding_count_stddev, COUNT(*) AS down_port_rows_for_tenant_and_network FROM port_security_binding_stats_by_status psbs CROSS JOIN down_ports_with_security_groups_tenant_filtered dptf GROUP BY psbs.status, psbs.binding_count_range, psbs.binding_count_variance, psbs.binding_count_stddev ORDER BY psbs.binding_count_range DESC;

question: For the IPv4 subnet with ID '012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48' (and considering only routes whose next hop is '10.30.19.197/8'), list the subnet name, tenant ID, network ID, IP version, CIDR, gateway IP, DHCP enabled flag, each allocation pool’s first and last IP, the maximum subnet standard attribute ID over the current row and next 2 rows (ordered by subnet ID), and the allocation-pool FIRST_IP range and variance for that subnet name. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Subnet ID "012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48" is predicated by "subnets.id IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')"
SQL: WITH SubnetDetails AS ( SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') ), SubnetFirstIpStats AS ( SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, MAX(p.FIRST_IP) - MIN(p.FIRST_IP) AS first_ip_range, VARIANCE(p.FIRST_IP) AS first_ip_variance FROM SUBNETROUTES r JOIN SUBNETS s ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE r.NEXTHOP = '10.30.19.197/8' AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY first_ip_range DESC ) SELECT sd.NAME, sd.TENANT_ID, sd.NETWORK_ID, sd.IP_VERSION, sd.CIDR, sd.GATEWAY_IP, sd.ENABLE_DHCP, sd.FIRST_IP, sd.LAST_IP, sd.max_standard_attr_id_next2, sfs.first_ip_range, sfs.first_ip_variance FROM SubnetDetails sd JOIN SubnetFirstIpStats sfs ON sd.NAME = sfs.subnet_name ORDER BY sfs.first_ip_range DESC, sd.NAME;

question: For the subnet with ID '012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48', for each subnet name, show (1) the range and variance of allocation pool starting IPs (FIRST_IP) considering only routes whose next hop is '10.30.19.197/8', and (2) the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of routes per IPv4 subnet; then join these results by subnet name and list the combined statistics. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Subnet ID "012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48" is predicated by "subnets.id IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')"
SQL: WITH FirstIpPoolStats AS ( SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, MAX(p.FIRST_IP) - MIN(p.FIRST_IP) AS first_ip_range, VARIANCE(p.FIRST_IP) AS first_ip_variance FROM SUBNETROUTES r JOIN SUBNETS s ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE r.NEXTHOP = '10.30.19.197/8' AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY first_ip_range DESC ), RouteCountStats AS ( SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, MAX(route_count) - MIN(route_count) AS route_count_range, VARIANCE(route_count) AS route_count_variance, STDDEV(route_count) AS route_count_stddev FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN ( SELECT sr.SUBNET_ID, COUNT(*) AS route_count FROM SUBNETROUTES AS sr GROUP BY sr.SUBNET_ID, sr.NEXTHOP ) AS route_stats ON s.ID = route_stats.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY route_count_range DESC ) SELECT fips.subnet_name, fips.first_ip_range, fips.first_ip_variance, rcs.route_count_range, rcs.route_count_variance, rcs.route_count_stddev FROM FirstIpPoolStats fips JOIN RouteCountStats rcs ON fips.subnet_name = rcs.subnet_name ORDER BY fips.first_ip_range DESC, rcs.route_count_range DESC;

question: For the IPv4 subnet with ID `012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48` and considering only subnet routes whose next hop is `10.30.19.197/8`, show the subnet name, the range and variance of its allocation pool starting IPs (FIRST_IP), and the dense-rank of its associated standard attribute when ordered by the standard attribute UPDATED_AT timestamp using a window frame of the current row and the 2 preceding rows. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Subnet ID "012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48" is predicated by "subnets.id IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')"
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, MAX(p.FIRST_IP) - MIN(p.FIRST_IP) AS first_ip_range, VARIANCE(p.FIRST_IP) AS first_ip_variance FROM SUBNETROUTES r JOIN SUBNETS s ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE r.NEXTHOP = '10.30.19.197/8' AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY first_ip_range DESC ), q2 AS ( SELECT s.NAME, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY sa.UPDATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES AS sa ON sa.ID = s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') ) SELECT q1.subnet_name, q1.first_ip_range, q1.first_ip_variance, q2.window_column AS standard_attr_updated_at_dense_rank_window FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.subnet_name = q2.NAME ORDER BY q1.first_ip_range DESC;

question: For each port status among ports bound with VIF type 'ovs' for device_id 'da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7', return the minimum admin_state_up and the average standard_attr_id, along with (in the same result) the count of DOWN ports on network '0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d' that have a security group binding and the average of their windowed minimum admin_state_up (3 preceding to 1 following ordered by port ID). Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Device ID "da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7" is predicated by "ports.device_id IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7')" Network ID "0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d" is predicated by "ports.network_id IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d')"
SQL: WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) AS min_admin_state_up, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE b.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' AND p.DEVICE_ID IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') ) SELECT s1.STATUS AS port_status, s1.min_admin_state_up AS ovs_device_min_admin_state_up, s1.avg_standard_attr_id AS ovs_device_avg_standard_attr_id, COUNT(*) AS down_ports_in_network_with_security_group_count, AVG(s2.window_column) AS avg_window_min_admin_state_up_for_down_ports FROM Subq1 s1 CROSS JOIN Subq2 s2 GROUP BY s1.STATUS, s1.min_admin_state_up, s1.avg_standard_attr_id;

question: For each port status, report the port security binding count range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) for ports that have at least one port security binding and belong to tenant ID '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7', along with the variance of STANDARD_ATTR_ID for ports that have an IP allocation with IP address 10.150.64.113/8, and compute the ratio of binding-count variance to STANDARD_ATTR_ID variance.
evidence: Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')" IP Address "10.150.64.113/8" is predicated by "ipallocations.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8')"
SQL: WITH PortSecurityBindingStats AS ( SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC ), StandardAttrIdVarianceByStatus AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, VARIANCE(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS standard_attr_id_variance FROM PORTS AS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID IS NOT NULL AND ia.IP_ADDRESS IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.STATUS ORDER BY standard_attr_id_variance DESC ) SELECT psbs.status, psbs.binding_count_range, psbs.binding_count_variance, psbs.binding_count_stddev, saivs.standard_attr_id_variance, ROUND(psbs.binding_count_variance / NULLIF(saivs.standard_attr_id_variance, 0), 4) AS BindingCountVariance_To_StandardAttrIdVariance_Ratio FROM PortSecurityBindingStats psbs JOIN StandardAttrIdVarianceByStatus saivs ON psbs.status = saivs.status ORDER BY BindingCountVariance_To_StandardAttrIdVariance_Ratio DESC;

question: How many distinct tenants have non-shared networks that are marked as default external networks (IS_DEFAULT = 0), and how many (port status, device owner) groups exist for non-shared ports whose standard attribute resource type is 'ports'? Do not return any rounded answers.

SQL: WITH default_external_networks AS ( SELECT e.NETWORK_ID, e.IS_DEFAULT, n.TENANT_ID, n.NAME, n.STATUS, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP, n.MTU, n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID, MIN(n.MTU) OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.TENANT_ID) AS window_column FROM EXTERNALNETWORKS e JOIN NETWORKS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND n.ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) ), port_status_device_owner_summary AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT den.TENANT_ID) AS tenant_count_with_default_external_networks, COUNT(*) AS port_status_device_owner_group_count FROM default_external_networks den CROSS JOIN port_status_device_owner_summary psdos;

question: For each port status and device owner, considering only ports whose standard attribute resource type is 'ports' and excluding shared networks (networks whose IDs appear in networkrbacs with action = 'access_as_shared' and target_tenant = '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'), list the number of ports and the earliest standard attribute updated timestamp, and also show (by port status) the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of allocated IP address string length for ports with port security enabled restricted to IP address '10.150.64.113/8'. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))" IP Address "10.150.64.113/8" is predicated by "ipallocations.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8')"
SQL: WITH PortOwnerStatusStats AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), PortStatusIPLenCV AS ( SELECT p.status, STDDEV(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) / NULLIF(AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM portsecuritybindings psb JOIN ports p ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON p.id = ia.port_id WHERE psb.port_security_enabled = 1 AND ia.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT pos.port_status, pos.device_owner, pos.port_count, pos.earliest_standard_attr_update, psc.coefficient_of_variation FROM PortOwnerStatusStats pos LEFT JOIN PortStatusIPLenCV psc ON pos.port_status = psc.status ORDER BY pos.port_count DESC;

question: For tenant ID '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57', list each DOWN port along with its security group ID and its rank within that security group (ordered by port ID), and also show (when available) the port’s IP allocation count and the number of subnet-id rows from IP allocations for administratively up ports. evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), subq2 AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ia.subnet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND ia.ip_address IS NOT NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address ) SELECT subq1.security_group_id, subq1.port_id AS down_port_id, subq1.tenant_id, subq1.mac_address, subq1.window_column AS down_port_rank_within_security_group, subq2.ip_allocation_count, subq2.subnet_id_rows FROM subq1 LEFT JOIN subq2 ON subq1.port_id = subq2.port_id ORDER BY subq1.security_group_id, subq1.window_column, subq1.port_id;

question: For tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57", return the total number of ACTIVE networks and the total number of admin_state_up ports that are bound to a security group (including their total DNS record count), along with the average number of such ports per active network and the total number of security group bindings across those ports.
evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "networks.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')" Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
SQL: WITH ActiveNetworks AS ( SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), PortSecurityAndDns AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb JOIN PORTS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN PORTDNSES pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name ) SELECT an.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT an.network_id) AS active_network_count, COUNT(DISTINCT psd.port_id) AS admin_up_sg_bound_port_count, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT psd.port_id) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT an.network_id), 0), 2) AS avg_ports_per_active_network, SUM(psd.security_group_binding_count) AS total_security_group_bindings_across_ports, SUM(psd.dns_record_count) AS total_dns_records_across_ports FROM ActiveNetworks an CROSS JOIN PortSecurityAndDns psd GROUP BY an.tenant_id;

question: For each port that is administratively up and belongs to tenant ID '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57', list the port ID, tenant ID, port name, host, VIF type, VNIC type, network ID, MAC address, status, device owner, the windowed average standard attribute ID (2 preceding to 2 following rows partitioned by VIF type), along with the number of security group bindings for the port and the total number of DNS records associated with the port. evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
SQL: WITH PortSecurityAndDNSStats AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb JOIN PORTS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN PORTDNSES pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name ), PortBindingWindowStats AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ) SELECT pbws.PORT_ID AS port_id, pbws.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, psds.port_name, pbws.HOST, pbws.VIF_TYPE, pbws.VNIC_TYPE, pbws.NETWORK_ID, pbws.MAC_ADDRESS, pbws.STATUS, pbws.DEVICE_OWNER, pbws.window_column, psds.security_group_binding_count, psds.dns_record_count FROM PortBindingWindowStats pbws JOIN PortSecurityAndDNSStats psds ON pbws.PORT_ID = psds.port_id ORDER BY pbws.PORT_ID;

SQL: WITH default_external_networks AS ( SELECT e.NETWORK_ID, e.IS_DEFAULT, n.TENANT_ID, n.NAME, n.STATUS, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP, n.MTU, n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID, MIN(n.MTU) OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.TENANT_ID) AS window_column FROM EXTERNALNETWORKS e JOIN NETWORKS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND n.ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) ), port_status_owner_stats AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), top10_device_owner_port_counts AS ( SELECT device_owner, SUM(port_count) AS total_ports FROM port_status_owner_stats GROUP BY device_owner ORDER BY total_ports DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT t.device_owner, t.total_ports, den.NETWORK_ID, den.IS_DEFAULT, den.TENANT_ID, den.NAME AS network_name, den.STATUS AS network_status, den.ADMIN_STATE_UP, den.MTU, den.STANDARD_ATTR_ID AS network_standard_attr_id, den.window_column AS min_mtu_within_tenant, psos.port_status, psos.port_count, psos.earliest_standard_attr_update FROM top10_device_owner_port_counts t JOIN port_status_owner_stats psos ON psos.device_owner = t.device_owner CROSS JOIN default_external_networks den ORDER BY t.total_ports DESC, t.device_owner, psos.port_status;

SQL: WITH StdAttrIdCVByStatus AS ( SELECT p.status, STDDEV(p.standard_attr_id) / NULLIF(AVG(p.standard_attr_id), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM securitygroupportbindings AS sgpb JOIN ports AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN portsecuritybindings AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(p.standard_attr_id) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), IpAddrLenCVByStatus AS ( SELECT p.status, STDDEV(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) / NULLIF(AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM portsecuritybindings psb JOIN ports p ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON p.id = ia.port_id WHERE psb.port_security_enabled = 1 AND ia.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), FilteredStatusComparison AS ( SELECT s1.status, s1.coefficient_of_variation AS std_attr_id_coefficient_of_variation, s2.coefficient_of_variation AS ip_address_length_coefficient_of_variation FROM StdAttrIdCVByStatus s1 JOIN IpAddrLenCVByStatus s2 ON s1.status = s2.status ) SELECT * FROM FilteredStatusComparison ORDER BY std_attr_id_coefficient_of_variation DESC, ip_address_length_coefficient_of_variation DESC;

SQL: WITH PortStatusOwnerSecurityGroupStats AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), PortStatusOvsBindingStats AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) AS min_admin_state_up, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE b.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' AND p.DEVICE_ID IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS ) SELECT psosgs.port_status, psosgs.device_owner, psosgs.port_count, psosgs.min_standard_attr_id, psobs.min_admin_state_up, psobs.avg_standard_attr_id FROM PortStatusOwnerSecurityGroupStats psosgs JOIN PortStatusOvsBindingStats psobs ON psosgs.port_status = psobs.STATUS ORDER BY psosgs.port_count DESC;

SQL: WITH PortSecurityGroupRanks AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), ActiveTenantNetworks AS ( SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), DownTenantPortsWithNetwork AS ( SELECT psgr.port_id, psgr.tenant_id, psgr.mac_address, psgr.security_group_id, psgr.window_column AS port_rank_within_security_group, p.network_id FROM PortSecurityGroupRanks psgr JOIN PORTS p ON p.id = psgr.port_id WHERE psgr.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ) SELECT atn.tenant_id, atn.network_id, atn.network_name, atn.admin_state_up, atn.mtu, atn.standard_attr_updated_at, atn.window_column AS network_row_number_within_tenant, dtp.port_id, dtp.mac_address, dtp.security_group_id, dtp.port_rank_within_security_group FROM ActiveTenantNetworks atn JOIN DownTenantPortsWithNetwork dtp ON dtp.network_id = atn.network_id AND dtp.tenant_id = atn.tenant_id ORDER BY atn.tenant_id, atn.network_name, dtp.security_group_id, dtp.port_id;

question: For tenant ID `17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7`, summarize the administratively up ports by showing the tenant ID, the number of admin-up ports, the total number of port security bindings on those ports, the total number of times port security is enabled across those bindings, the enabled-to-binding ratio (enabled total divided by binding total, rounded), and the average running-sum standard-attribute window value for any of those ports that are also in DOWN status.

SQL: WITH PortSecurityStats AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(psb.port_id) AS binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN psb.port_security_enabled THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS port_security_enabled_total FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address), DownPortWindow AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(sa.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY sa.RESOURCE_TYPE ORDER BY sa.ID) AS window_column FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')) SELECT pss.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT pss.port_id) AS admin_up_port_count, SUM(pss.binding_count) AS total_binding_count, SUM(pss.port_security_enabled_total) AS total_port_security_enabled_across_bindings, ROUND( SUM(pss.port_security_enabled_total) / NULLIF(SUM(pss.binding_count), 0), 2 ) AS port_security_enabled_ratio, AVG(dpw.window_column) AS avg_down_port_window_sum FROM PortSecurityStats pss LEFT JOIN DownPortWindow dpw ON dpw.port_id = pss.port_id AND dpw.tenant_id = pss.tenant_id GROUP BY pss.tenant_id ORDER BY port_security_enabled_ratio DESC;

SQL: WITH sq1 AS ( SELECT p.status, STDDEV(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) / NULLIF(AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM portsecuritybindings psb JOIN ports p ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON p.id = ia.port_id WHERE psb.port_security_enabled = 1 AND ia.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), sq2 AS ( SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC ) SELECT sq2.status, sq1.coefficient_of_variation, sq2.binding_count_range, sq2.binding_count_variance, sq2.binding_count_stddev FROM sq2 JOIN sq1 ON sq2.status = sq1.status ORDER BY sq2.binding_count_range DESC;

SQL: WITH DownPortsBySecurityGroup AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), AdminUpPortBindingAndDNSCounts AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb JOIN PORTS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN PORTDNSES pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name), DownPortsThatAreAlsoAdminUp AS ( SELECT dpsg.port_id, dpsg.tenant_id, dpsg.mac_address, dpsg.security_group_id, dpsg.window_column, aup.port_name, aup.security_group_binding_count, aup.dns_record_count FROM DownPortsBySecurityGroup dpsg JOIN AdminUpPortBindingAndDNSCounts aup ON dpsg.port_id = aup.port_id AND dpsg.tenant_id = aup.tenant_id ) SELECT port_id, tenant_id, mac_address, security_group_id, window_column AS port_rank_within_security_group_by_port_id, port_name, security_group_binding_count, dns_record_count FROM DownPortsThatAreAlsoAdminUp ORDER BY security_group_id, port_id;

SQL: WITH port_status_owner_summary AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), active_network_rbac_details AS ( SELECT n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up, r.action, r.target_tenant, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column FROM networksecuritybindings b JOIN networks n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN networkrbacs r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) ), active_network_rbac_counts AS ( SELECT action, target_tenant, COUNT(*) AS active_network_rbac_row_count FROM active_network_rbac_details GROUP BY action, target_tenant ) SELECT p.port_status, p.device_owner, p.port_count, p.earliest_standard_attr_update, c.action, c.target_tenant, c.active_network_rbac_row_count FROM port_status_owner_summary p CROSS JOIN active_network_rbac_counts c;

SQL: WITH SubnetAttributeWindow AS ( SELECT s.NAME, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY sa.UPDATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES AS sa ON sa.ID = s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') ), SubnetRouteStats AS ( SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, MAX(route_count) - MIN(route_count) AS route_count_range, VARIANCE(route_count) AS route_count_variance, STDDEV(route_count) AS route_count_stddev FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN ( SELECT sr.SUBNET_ID, COUNT(*) AS route_count FROM SUBNETROUTES AS sr GROUP BY sr.SUBNET_ID, sr.NEXTHOP ) AS route_stats ON s.ID = route_stats.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY route_count_range DESC ), CombinedSubnetMetrics AS ( SELECT saw.NAME AS subnet_name, saw.window_column, NULL AS route_count_range, NULL AS route_count_variance, NULL AS route_count_stddev, 'Standard Attribute Window Rank' AS reason FROM SubnetAttributeWindow AS saw UNION ALL SELECT srs.subnet_name, NULL AS window_column, srs.route_count_range, srs.route_count_variance, srs.route_count_stddev, 'Route Count Stats' AS reason FROM SubnetRouteStats AS srs ) SELECT * FROM CombinedSubnetMetrics ORDER BY subnet_name, reason;

SQL: WITH PortStatusBindingStats AS ( SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC ), AdminUpPortWindowDetails AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ) SELECT aupwd.STATUS, psbs.binding_count_range, psbs.binding_count_variance, psbs.binding_count_stddev, COUNT(DISTINCT aupwd.PORT_ID) AS admin_up_ports_with_security_bindings, AVG(aupwd.window_column) AS avg_window_standard_attr_id FROM AdminUpPortWindowDetails aupwd JOIN PortStatusBindingStats psbs ON aupwd.STATUS = psbs.status GROUP BY aupwd.STATUS, psbs.binding_count_range, psbs.binding_count_variance, psbs.binding_count_stddev ORDER BY admin_up_ports_with_security_bindings DESC;

SQL: WITH PortSecurityAgg AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(psb.port_id) AS binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN psb.port_security_enabled THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS port_security_enabled_total FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address), DownPortsSecurityGroups AS (SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d')) SELECT psa.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT psa.port_id) AS admin_up_ports_with_security_bindings, SUM(psa.binding_count) AS total_port_security_bindings, SUM(psa.port_security_enabled_total) AS total_port_security_enabled_across_bindings, COUNT(DISTINCT dpsg.SECURITY_GROUP_ID) AS distinct_security_groups_on_down_ports_in_network, ROUND( SUM(psa.port_security_enabled_total) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT dpsg.SECURITY_GROUP_ID), 0), 2 ) AS enabled_per_security_group_ratio FROM PortSecurityAgg psa JOIN PORTS p ON p.ID = psa.port_id JOIN DownPortsSecurityGroups dpsg ON dpsg.NETWORK_ID = p.NETWORK_ID WHERE p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') AND psa.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY psa.tenant_id ORDER BY enabled_per_security_group_ratio DESC;

SQL: WITH PortSecurityGroupStats AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), OvsBindingPortStats AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) AS min_admin_state_up, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE b.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' AND p.DEVICE_ID IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS ) SELECT psgs.port_status, psgs.device_owner, psgs.port_count, psgs.min_standard_attr_id, obs.min_admin_state_up, obs.avg_standard_attr_id FROM PortSecurityGroupStats psgs JOIN OvsBindingPortStats obs ON psgs.port_status = obs.STATUS;

SQL: WITH DownPortsBySecurityGroup AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), AdminUpPortBindingAndDnsCounts AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb JOIN PORTS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN PORTDNSES pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name ) SELECT dpsg.security_group_id, COUNT(DISTINCT dpsg.port_id) AS down_port_count, MAX(au.security_group_binding_count) AS max_security_group_binding_count_among_admin_up_ports, SUM(au.dns_record_count) AS total_dns_record_count_for_admin_up_ports, ROUND( SUM(au.dns_record_count) / NULLIF(MAX(au.security_group_binding_count), 0), 2 ) AS dns_records_per_max_binding_ratio FROM DownPortsBySecurityGroup dpsg JOIN AdminUpPortBindingAndDnsCounts au ON au.port_id = dpsg.port_id AND au.tenant_id = dpsg.tenant_id WHERE dpsg.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY dpsg.security_group_id ORDER BY dns_records_per_max_binding_ratio DESC;

SQL: WITH PortIPStats AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ia.subnet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND ia.ip_address IS NOT NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address), PortBindingWindow AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), TenantAvgIPAlloc AS ( SELECT p.tenant_id, AVG(ips.ip_allocation_count) AS avg_ip_allocation_count FROM ports p JOIN PortIPStats ips ON ips.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.tenant_id ) SELECT pbw.PORT_ID, pbw.TENANT_ID, pbw.NETWORK_ID, pbw.MAC_ADDRESS, pbw.HOST, pbw.VIF_TYPE, pbw.VNIC_TYPE, pbw.STATUS, pbw.DEVICE_OWNER, pbw.window_column, pis.ip_allocation_count, pis.subnet_id_rows FROM PortBindingWindow pbw JOIN PortIPStats pis ON pis.port_id = pbw.PORT_ID JOIN TenantAvgIPAlloc ta ON ta.tenant_id = pbw.TENANT_ID WHERE pis.ip_allocation_count > ta.avg_ip_allocation_count;

SQL: WITH PortStatusVariation AS ( SELECT p.status, STDDEV(p.standard_attr_id) / NULLIF(AVG(p.standard_attr_id), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM securitygroupportbindings AS sgpb JOIN ports AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN portsecuritybindings AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(p.standard_attr_id) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), PortStatusDeviceOwnerStats AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ) SELECT psdo.port_status AS status, psdo.device_owner, psdo.port_count, psdo.earliest_standard_attr_update, psv.coefficient_of_variation FROM PortStatusDeviceOwnerStats psdo JOIN PortStatusVariation psv ON psdo.port_status = psv.status ORDER BY psdo.port_count DESC;

SQL: WITH NetworkStatusSecurityBindingStats AS ( SELECT n.STATUS AS network_status, VARIANCE(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_variance, STDDEV(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_stddev FROM NETWORKS AS n JOIN NETWORKSECURITYBINDINGS AS nsb ON n.ID = nsb.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.STATUS ORDER BY port_security_enabled_variance DESC ), DefaultExternalNetworksByTenant AS ( SELECT e.NETWORK_ID, e.IS_DEFAULT, n.TENANT_ID, n.NAME, n.STATUS, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP, n.MTU, n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID, MIN(n.MTU) OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.TENANT_ID) AS window_column FROM EXTERNALNETWORKS e JOIN NETWORKS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND n.ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) ) SELECT den.NETWORK_ID, den.IS_DEFAULT, den.TENANT_ID, den.NAME, den.STATUS, den.ADMIN_STATE_UP, den.MTU, den.STANDARD_ATTR_ID, den.window_column AS min_mtu_within_tenant, nssbs.port_security_enabled_variance, nssbs.port_security_enabled_stddev FROM DefaultExternalNetworksByTenant den JOIN NetworkStatusSecurityBindingStats nssbs ON den.STATUS = nssbs.network_status;

question: For tenant_id '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7' and only DOWN ports that are bound to a security group, list each port status and device owner with the distinct port count and minimum standard attribute ID, also include (by port status) the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of standard attribute IDs for ports that have both a security group port binding and a port security binding, and compute the ratio of minimum standard attribute ID to that coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) (rounded to 2 decimals).
