SQL: WITH PortStatusVariation AS ( SELECT p.status, STDDEV(p.standard_attr_id) / NULLIF(AVG(p.standard_attr_id), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM securitygroupportbindings AS sgpb JOIN ports AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN portsecuritybindings AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(p.standard_attr_id) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), PortStatusDeviceOwnerStats AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ) SELECT psdos.port_status, psdos.device_owner, psdos.port_count, psdos.min_standard_attr_id, psv.coefficient_of_variation, ROUND(psdos.min_standard_attr_id / NULLIF(psv.coefficient_of_variation, 0), 2) AS min_attr_id_per_variation FROM PortStatusDeviceOwnerStats psdos JOIN PortStatusVariation psv ON psdos.port_status = psv.status ORDER BY min_attr_id_per_variation DESC;

question: For subnets whose network is shared via RBAC with target tenant `1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b`, and considering only IPv4 subnets on networks that are not shared to `*` or to tenant `9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b`, return the subnet name, CIDR, RBAC target tenant, the running sum of standard attribute IDs within each IP version group, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of DNS nameserver order values; include only subnets where the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is greater than 0. Do not return any rounded answers.

SQL: WITH SubnetDNSOrderVariation AS ( SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, STDDEV(d.order) / NULLIF(AVG(d.order), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM subnets AS s JOIN dnsnameservers AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN ipallocationpools AS p ON p.subnet_id = s.id JOIN networks AS n ON n.id = s.network_id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT r.object_id FROM networkrbacs AS r WHERE r.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (r.target_tenant = '*' OR r.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY s.name HAVING AVG(d.order) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), SharedSubnetWindowedAttrs AS ( SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, n.TARGET_TENANT AS rbac_target_tenant, SUM(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.IP_VERSION ORDER BY s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN NETWORKRBACS AS n ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT IN ('1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b') ) SELECT sswa.subnet_name, sswa.subnet_cidr, sswa.rbac_target_tenant, sswa.window_column, sdo.coefficient_of_variation FROM SharedSubnetWindowedAttrs sswa JOIN SubnetDNSOrderVariation sdo ON sswa.subnet_name = sdo.subnet_name WHERE sdo.coefficient_of_variation > 0 ORDER BY sdo.coefficient_of_variation DESC;

SQL: WITH network_status_security_stats AS ( SELECT n.STATUS AS network_status, VARIANCE(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_variance, STDDEV(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_stddev FROM NETWORKS AS n JOIN NETWORKSECURITYBINDINGS AS nsb ON n.ID = nsb.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.STATUS ORDER BY port_security_enabled_variance DESC ), default_external_network_details AS ( SELECT e.NETWORK_ID, e.IS_DEFAULT, n.TENANT_ID, n.NAME, n.STATUS, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP, n.MTU, n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID, MIN(n.MTU) OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.TENANT_ID) AS window_column FROM EXTERNALNETWORKS e JOIN NETWORKS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND n.ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) ) SELECT den.NETWORK_ID, den.IS_DEFAULT, den.TENANT_ID, den.NAME, den.STATUS, den.ADMIN_STATE_UP, den.MTU, den.STANDARD_ATTR_ID, den.window_column, nsss.port_security_enabled_variance, nsss.port_security_enabled_stddev FROM default_external_network_details den JOIN network_status_security_stats nsss ON den.STATUS = nsss.network_status;

For the matching security groups, list the port name, network ID, MAC address, admin state, status, device owner, the security group ID, the minimum admin_state_up over a window of 3 preceding and 1 following ports (ordered by port ID), plus the tenant’s port ID, tenant ID, and that port’s rank within its security group when ordered by port ID. SQL: WITH TenantDownPortsBySecurityGroup AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), NetworkDownPortsWithAdminStateWindow AS ( SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') ) SELECT n.NAME, n.NETWORK_ID, n.MAC_ADDRESS, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP, n.STATUS, n.DEVICE_OWNER, n.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, n.window_column AS min_admin_state_up_window_3_preceding_1_following, t.port_id, t.tenant_id, t.window_column AS rank_within_security_group_by_port_id FROM NetworkDownPortsWithAdminStateWindow AS n JOIN TenantDownPortsBySecurityGroup AS t ON n.SECURITY_GROUP_ID = t.security_group_id ORDER BY n.NETWORK_ID, n.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, t.port_id;

SQL: WITH PortStatusVariation AS ( SELECT p.status, STDDEV(p.standard_attr_id) / NULLIF(AVG(p.standard_attr_id), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM securitygroupportbindings AS sgpb JOIN ports AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN portsecuritybindings AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(p.standard_attr_id) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), PortStatusDeviceOwnerStats AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ) SELECT psd.port_status, psd.device_owner, psd.port_count, psd.min_standard_attr_id, psv.coefficient_of_variation FROM PortStatusDeviceOwnerStats psd JOIN PortStatusVariation psv ON psd.port_status = psv.status ORDER BY psd.port_count DESC, psv.coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For RBAC actions that (1) are `access_as_shared` and reference IPv4 subnets and (2) also have more than 5 DHCP-enabled subnets on non-shared networks (excluding networks shared to `'*'` or tenant `9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b`), return the action along with the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subnet IP version for the shared/IPv4 case, plus the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subnet IP version for the DHCP-enabled non-shared case. SQL: WITH RbacSharedIpVersionStats AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC ), RbacDhcpNonSharedStddev AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 AND s.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.ACTION HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY ip_version_stddev DESC ) SELECT rs.ACTION, rs.avg_ip_version, rs.ip_version_variance, rs.ip_version_stddev AS shared_ip_version_stddev, rd.ip_version_stddev AS dhcp_nonshared_ip_version_stddev FROM RbacSharedIpVersionStats rs JOIN RbacDhcpNonSharedStddev rd ON rs.ACTION = rd.ACTION;

SQL: WITH SecurityGroupBoundPorts AS (SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER), OvsBoundPorts AS (SELECT p.STATUS, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) AS min_admin_state_up, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE b.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' AND p.DEVICE_ID IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS), CombinedPortStatusMetrics AS ( SELECT sg.port_status AS status, sg.device_owner AS device_owner, sg.port_count AS port_count, sg.min_standard_attr_id AS min_standard_attr_id, NULL AS min_admin_state_up, NULL AS avg_standard_attr_id, 'Security Group Bound Ports' AS reason FROM SecurityGroupBoundPorts sg UNION ALL SELECT ov.STATUS AS status, NULL AS device_owner, NULL AS port_count, NULL AS min_standard_attr_id, ov.min_admin_state_up AS min_admin_state_up, ov.avg_standard_attr_id AS avg_standard_attr_id, 'OVS VIF Bound Ports' AS reason FROM OvsBoundPorts ov ) SELECT * FROM CombinedPortStatusMetrics ORDER BY status, device_owner, reason;

question: For each RBAC action that (1) has more than 5 matching DHCP-enabled subnets and (2) is not associated with shared networks (networks having an `access_as_shared` RBAC entry targeting `'*'` or `9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b`), show the action name along with the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subnet IP versions; additionally, for the `access_as_shared` action, also display the average, range (max minus min), and variance of subnet IP versions (restricted to IP versions 4 and 6), and order results by the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))" "access_as_shared" permission is predicated by "networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared'"
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 AND s.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.ACTION HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY ip_version_stddev DESC ), subq2 AS ( SELECT n.ACTION AS rbac_action, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, MAX(s.IP_VERSION) - MIN(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_range, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION IN (4, 6) AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_range DESC ) SELECT subq1.ACTION AS action, subq1.ip_version_stddev, subq2.avg_ip_version, subq2.ip_version_range, subq2.ip_version_variance FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.ACTION = subq2.rbac_action ORDER BY subq1.ip_version_stddev DESC;

SQL: WITH TenantUpPortsWithIPs AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ia.subnet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND ia.ip_address IS NOT NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address), DownPortsOnNetworkWithSG AS (SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d')), TenantUpPortsWithIPsOnNetwork AS ( SELECT t.port_id, t.tenant_id, t.mac_address, t.ip_allocation_count, t.subnet_id_rows FROM TenantUpPortsWithIPs t JOIN PORTS p ON p.ID = t.port_id WHERE p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') ) SELECT d.NETWORK_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT d.NAME) AS down_port_name_count, COUNT(DISTINCT d.SECURITY_GROUP_ID) AS down_port_security_group_count, COUNT(DISTINCT t.port_id) AS tenant_up_port_count_with_ips, SUM(t.ip_allocation_count) AS tenant_up_total_ip_allocations, SUM(t.subnet_id_rows) AS tenant_up_total_subnet_id_rows FROM DownPortsOnNetworkWithSG d LEFT JOIN TenantUpPortsWithIPsOnNetwork t ON t.mac_address = d.MAC_ADDRESS GROUP BY d.NETWORK_ID;

question: For tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57", how many ACTIVE networks exist, what is the most recent network standard-attribute updated_at timestamp, and (for administratively up ports with at least one IP allocation) how many such ports are there along with the total IP allocation count and total subnet-id row count? SQL: WITH active_networks AS ( SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), admin_up_ports_with_ip_allocs AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ia.subnet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND ia.ip_address IS NOT NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address ), tenant_port_ip_summary AS ( SELECT p.tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS admin_up_port_count, SUM(p.ip_allocation_count) AS total_ip_allocations, SUM(p.subnet_id_rows) AS total_subnet_id_rows FROM admin_up_ports_with_ip_allocs p GROUP BY p.tenant_id ) SELECT an.tenant_id, COUNT(an.network_id) AS active_network_count, MAX(an.standard_attr_updated_at) AS latest_network_standard_attr_updated_at, tps.admin_up_port_count, tps.total_ip_allocations, tps.total_subnet_id_rows FROM active_networks an JOIN tenant_port_ip_summary tps ON tps.tenant_id = an.tenant_id WHERE an.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY an.tenant_id, tps.admin_up_port_count, tps.total_ip_allocations, tps.total_subnet_id_rows;

question: For the subnet with ID `012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48`, considering only subnet routes whose next hop is `10.30.19.197/8`, what are (1) the range and variance of allocation-pool starting IPs (FIRST_IP) for each subnet name, and (2) the dense-rank (using a window of the current row and 2 preceding rows) of its associated standard attribute when ordered by the standard attribute’s UPDATED_AT timestamp? Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Subnet ID "012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48" is predicated by "subnets.id IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')"
SQL: WITH first_ip_stats AS ( SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, MAX(p.FIRST_IP) - MIN(p.FIRST_IP) AS first_ip_range, VARIANCE(p.FIRST_IP) AS first_ip_variance FROM SUBNETROUTES r JOIN SUBNETS s ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE r.NEXTHOP = '10.30.19.197/8' AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY first_ip_range DESC ), subnet_attr_dense_rank AS ( SELECT s.NAME, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY sa.UPDATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES AS sa ON sa.ID = s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') ) SELECT fis.subnet_name, fis.first_ip_range, fis.first_ip_variance, sadr.window_column FROM first_ip_stats fis JOIN subnet_attr_dense_rank sadr ON sadr.NAME = fis.subnet_name;

question: For tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57", list all administratively-up ports that are on ACTIVE networks owned by the same tenant. Return the network ID and name, network admin_state_up, MTU, and the network standard attribute updated_at timestamp (with a row number per tenant ordered by network name), along with each matching port’s ID, host, VIF type, VNIC type, MAC address, status, device owner, and the VIF-type windowed average of the port standard attribute ID (2 preceding to 2 following rows). Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "networks.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')" Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
SQL: WITH ActiveTenantNetworks AS (SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), AdminUpTenantPorts AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')) SELECT n.network_id, n.network_name, n.tenant_id, n.admin_state_up AS network_admin_state_up, n.mtu, n.standard_attr_updated_at AS network_standard_attr_updated_at, n.window_column AS network_row_number_within_tenant, p.PORT_ID AS port_id, p.HOST AS port_host, p.VIF_TYPE AS port_vif_type, p.VNIC_TYPE AS port_vnic_type, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS port_mac_address, p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS port_device_owner, p.window_column AS port_avg_standard_attr_id_window FROM ActiveTenantNetworks n JOIN AdminUpTenantPorts p ON p.NETWORK_ID = n.network_id AND p.TENANT_ID = n.tenant_id ORDER BY n.network_name, p.PORT_ID;

question: For tenant ID '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7' and ports with status 'DOWN', for each device owner return the distinct port count and minimum standard attribute ID (only for ports bound to a security group), along with the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of port security bindings per port for that same port status. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')"
SQL: WITH port_status_device_owner_summary AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), port_status_binding_stats AS ( SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC ) SELECT psdo.port_status, psdo.device_owner, psdo.port_count, psdo.min_standard_attr_id, psbs.binding_count_range, psbs.binding_count_variance, psbs.binding_count_stddev FROM port_status_device_owner_summary psdo JOIN port_status_binding_stats psbs ON psdo.port_status = psbs.status;

question: For each port status and device owner, considering only ports whose standard attribute resource type is 'ports' and excluding shared networks (networks whose IDs appear in networkrbacs with action = 'access_as_shared' and target_tenant = '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'), list the port count and the earliest standard attribute updated timestamp, and also include (by port status) the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of allocated IP address string lengths for ports with port security enabled restricted to IP address '10.150.64.113/8'. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))" IP Address "10.150.64.113/8" is predicated by "ipallocations.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8')"
SQL: WITH PortCountsAndEarliestUpdate AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), PortStatusIpLengthVariation AS ( SELECT p.status, STDDEV(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) / NULLIF(AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM portsecuritybindings psb JOIN ports p ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON p.id = ia.port_id WHERE psb.port_security_enabled = 1 AND ia.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), CombinedPortStatusMetrics AS ( SELECT pc.port_status AS port_status, pc.device_owner AS device_owner, pc.port_count AS port_count, pc.earliest_standard_attr_update AS earliest_standard_attr_update, pv.coefficient_of_variation AS coefficient_of_variation FROM PortCountsAndEarliestUpdate pc JOIN PortStatusIpLengthVariation pv ON pv.status = pc.port_status ) SELECT port_status, device_owner, port_count, earliest_standard_attr_update, coefficient_of_variation FROM CombinedPortStatusMetrics ORDER BY port_status, device_owner;

question: For each RBAC action that (a) has more than 5 matching DHCP-enabled subnets on its referenced networks and (b) excludes subnets on networks that are shared via an `access_as_shared` RBAC entry with target tenant `'*'` or `'9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'`, show the action name along with the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subnet IP version numbers; additionally, for the same action, show the variance of subnet IP version numbers considering only public `access_as_shared` RBAC entries (where `target_tenant = '*'`). Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))" "public access" (wildcard) is predicated by "networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*'"
SQL: WITH SubnetIpStddevByAction AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 AND s.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.ACTION HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY ip_version_stddev DESC ), SubnetIpVarianceForPublicShared AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT = '*' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC ) SELECT s1.ACTION, s1.ip_version_stddev, s2.ip_version_variance FROM SubnetIpStddevByAction s1 JOIN SubnetIpVarianceForPublicShared s2 ON s1.ACTION = s2.ACTION ORDER BY s1.ip_version_stddev DESC;

question: For the IPv4 subnet with subnet ID '012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48', list the subnet’s name, tenant ID, network ID, IP version, CIDR, gateway IP, DHCP enabled flag, and allocation pool first/last IP, along with each subnet route’s destination and next hop, the route dense-rank within the subnet, and the maximum subnet standard attribute ID over the current and next 2 subnets when ordered by subnet ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Subnet ID "012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48" is predicated by "subnets.id IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')"
SQL: WITH subnet_details AS ( SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') ), subnet_routes AS ( SELECT r.DESTINATION, r.NEXTHOP, s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.SUBNET_ID ORDER BY r.SUBNET_ID) AS window_column FROM SUBNETROUTES r JOIN SUBNETS s ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') ) SELECT sd.NAME, sd.TENANT_ID, sd.NETWORK_ID, sd.IP_VERSION, sd.CIDR, sd.GATEWAY_IP, sd.ENABLE_DHCP, sd.FIRST_IP AS allocation_first_ip, sd.LAST_IP AS allocation_last_ip, sd.max_standard_attr_id_next2, sr.DESTINATION AS route_destination, sr.NEXTHOP AS route_nexthop, sr.window_column AS route_dense_rank_within_subnet FROM subnet_details sd JOIN subnet_routes sr ON sd.NAME = sr.subnet_name AND sd.CIDR = sr.subnet_cidr AND sd.FIRST_IP = sr.FIRST_IP AND sd.LAST_IP = sr.LAST_IP;

question: For each port status and device owner, considering only ports whose standard attribute resource type is 'ports' and excluding shared networks (networks whose IDs appear in networkrbacs with action = 'access_as_shared' and target_tenant = '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'), show the number of ports and the earliest standard attribute updated timestamp, and also include (by port status) the variance of the standard attribute ID across ports that have an IP allocation with IP address 10.150.64.113/8. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))" IP Address "10.150.64.113/8" is predicated by "ipallocations.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8')"
SQL: WITH sq1 AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), sq2 AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, VARIANCE(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS standard_attr_id_variance FROM PORTS AS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID IS NOT NULL AND ia.IP_ADDRESS IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.STATUS ORDER BY standard_attr_id_variance DESC ) SELECT sq1.port_status, sq1.device_owner, sq1.port_count, sq1.earliest_standard_attr_update, sq2.standard_attr_id_variance FROM sq1 JOIN sq2 ON sq1.port_status = sq2.STATUS ORDER BY sq1.port_count DESC, sq2.standard_attr_id_variance DESC;

question: For the RBAC action restricted to the permission value 'access_as_shared', return (1) the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subnet IP version considering only IPv4 subnets, and (2) the average, range (max–min), and variance of subnet IP version considering both IPv4 and IPv6 subnets, for subnets whose network is referenced by a NETWORKRBACS entry. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "access_as_shared" permission is predicated by "networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared'"
SQL: WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT n.ACTION AS rbac_action, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, MAX(s.IP_VERSION) - MIN(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_range, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION IN (4, 6) AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_range DESC ) SELECT s1.ACTION AS rbac_action, s1.avg_ip_version AS avg_ip_version_ipv4_only, s1.ip_version_variance AS ip_version_variance_ipv4_only, s1.ip_version_stddev AS ip_version_stddev_ipv4_only, s2.avg_ip_version AS avg_ip_version_ipv4_or_ipv6, s2.ip_version_range AS ip_version_range_ipv4_or_ipv6, s2.ip_version_variance AS ip_version_variance_ipv4_or_ipv6 FROM Subq1 s1 JOIN Subq2 s2 ON s1.ACTION = s2.rbac_action;

question: For each ACTIVE network (with a security binding) that has an RBAC action of either 'access_as_shared' or 'access_as_external' and whose maximum MTU is greater than 8000, list the network name, the RBAC action, that maximum MTU, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subnet IP version numbers for that RBAC action considering only DHCP-enabled subnets and excluding shared networks (those with an `access_as_shared` RBAC entry targeting `'*'` or `'9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'`), keeping only RBAC actions with more than 5 matching subnets. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))" "access_as_shared" permission is predicated by "networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared'" "access_as_external" permission is predicated by "networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_external'"
SQL: WITH RbacActionIpVersionStddev AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 AND s.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.ACTION HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY ip_version_stddev DESC ), ActiveHighMtuNetworksByRbacAction AS ( SELECT n.name AS network_name, r.action AS rbac_action, MAX(n.mtu) AS max_mtu FROM NETWORKSECURITYBINDINGS nsb JOIN NETWORKS n ON nsb.network_id = n.id JOIN NETWORKRBACS r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.action IN ('access_as_shared', 'access_as_external') GROUP BY n.name, r.action HAVING MAX(n.mtu) > 8000 ) SELECT ahmn.network_name, ahmn.rbac_action, ahmn.max_mtu, raivs.ip_version_stddev FROM ActiveHighMtuNetworksByRbacAction ahmn JOIN RbacActionIpVersionStddev raivs ON ahmn.rbac_action = raivs.ACTION ORDER BY ahmn.max_mtu DESC, raivs.ip_version_stddev DESC;

question: For ACTIVE networks (excluding shared networks where the RBAC action is 'access_as_shared' and the target tenant is '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'), list each network’s name, status, and admin_state_up along with its RBAC action, target tenant, and dense-rank-by-network-ID window column, and also include (for the 'access_as_shared' RBAC action) the average, range (max–min), and variance of subnet IP version (restricted to IP versions 4 and 6) for subnets whose network is referenced by that RBAC entry. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "access_as_shared" permission is predicated by "networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared'" "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))"
SQL: WITH RbacSubnetIpVersionStats AS ( SELECT n.ACTION AS rbac_action, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, MAX(s.IP_VERSION) - MIN(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_range, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION IN (4, 6) AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_range DESC ), ActiveNetworksRbacDetails AS ( SELECT n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up, r.action, r.target_tenant, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column FROM networksecuritybindings b JOIN networks n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN networkrbacs r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT a.name, a.status, a.admin_state_up, a.action, a.target_tenant, a.window_column, s.rbac_action, s.avg_ip_version, s.ip_version_range, s.ip_version_variance FROM ActiveNetworksRbacDetails a JOIN RbacSubnetIpVersionStats s ON a.action = s.rbac_action ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY name, target_tenant;

question: For tenant ID '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57' and ports with admin_state_up = 1, list each port’s ID, tenant ID, port name, host, VIF type, VNIC type, network ID, MAC address, status, device owner, the windowed average standard attribute ID (2 preceding to 2 following rows partitioned by VIF type), along with the port’s security group binding count and total DNS record count. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" is predicated by "ports.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')"
SQL: WITH PortSecurityAndDns AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb JOIN PORTS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN PORTDNSES pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name ), PortBindingWindow AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ) SELECT pbw.PORT_ID, pbw.TENANT_ID, psd.port_name, pbw.HOST, pbw.VIF_TYPE, pbw.VNIC_TYPE, pbw.NETWORK_ID, pbw.MAC_ADDRESS, pbw.STATUS, pbw.DEVICE_OWNER, pbw.window_column, psd.security_group_binding_count, psd.dns_record_count FROM PortBindingWindow pbw JOIN PortSecurityAndDns psd ON pbw.PORT_ID = psd.port_id AND pbw.TENANT_ID = psd.tenant_id;

question: For ACTIVE networks that are not shared (exclude networks whose RBAC action is `access_as_shared` with target tenant `*` or `9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b`), list each network’s name, status, and admin_state_up along with its RBAC action, target tenant, and the dense-rank window value; and alongside that, show (for ports with standard attribute resource type `ports` and also not on shared networks) the port status and device owner aggregates: number of ports and the earliest standard-attribute updated timestamp. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))"
SQL: WITH PortStatusOwnerAgg AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), ActiveNetworkRbacDetails AS ( SELECT n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up, r.action, r.target_tenant, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column FROM networksecuritybindings b JOIN networks n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN networkrbacs r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) ), PortStatusOwnerAggForActiveNetworks AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ( SELECT DISTINCT r.object_id FROM networkrbacs r JOIN networks n ON n.id = r.object_id JOIN networksecuritybindings b ON b.network_id = n.id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) ) AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ) SELECT d.name AS network_name, d.status AS network_status, d.admin_state_up, d.action AS rbac_action, d.target_tenant, d.window_column, a.port_status, a.device_owner, a.port_count, a.earliest_standard_attr_update FROM ActiveNetworkRbacDetails d CROSS JOIN PortStatusOwnerAggForActiveNetworks a ORDER BY d.name, d.action, d.target_tenant, a.port_status, a.device_owner;

question: For ACTIVE networks that are not shared (i.e., excluding networks with an `access_as_shared` RBAC entry targeting `'*'` or `9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b`), list the network name, status, admin_state_up, RBAC action, target tenant, and the per-network dense rank, and also include (for that same RBAC action) the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of IP version across DHCP-enabled subnets on the referenced networks, considering only actions that have more than 5 such subnets. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "exclusion of shared networks" is predicated by "networks.id NOT IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))"
SQL: WITH RbacActionIpVersionStddev AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 AND s.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.ACTION HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY ip_version_stddev DESC ), ActiveNetworkRbacDetails AS ( SELECT n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up, r.action, r.target_tenant, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column FROM networksecuritybindings b JOIN networks n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN networkrbacs r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) ) SELECT anrd.name, anrd.status, anrd.admin_state_up, anrd.action, anrd.target_tenant, anrd.window_column, raivs.ip_version_stddev FROM ActiveNetworkRbacDetails anrd JOIN RbacActionIpVersionStddev raivs ON anrd.action = raivs.ACTION ORDER BY raivs.ip_version_stddev DESC, anrd.name;

question: For the subnet with ID `012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48` (IPv4 only) and considering only routes whose next hop is `10.30.19.197/8`, return the subnet name along with (1) the range and variance of allocation-pool starting IPs (FIRST_IP) across its IP allocation pools and (2) the dense-rank of its associated standard attribute when ordered by the standard attribute UPDATED_AT timestamp using a window frame of the current row and the 2 preceding rows. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Subnet ID "012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48" is predicated by "subnets.id IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')"
SQL: WITH AllocationPoolFirstIpStats AS ( SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, MAX(p.FIRST_IP) - MIN(p.FIRST_IP) AS first_ip_range, VARIANCE(p.FIRST_IP) AS first_ip_variance FROM SUBNETROUTES r JOIN SUBNETS s ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE r.NEXTHOP = '10.30.19.197/8' AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY first_ip_range DESC ), SubnetStandardAttributeWindowRank AS ( SELECT s.NAME, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY sa.UPDATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES AS sa ON sa.ID = s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') ) SELECT ap.subnet_name, ap.first_ip_range, ap.first_ip_variance, ss.window_column FROM AllocationPoolFirstIpStats ap JOIN SubnetStandardAttributeWindowRank ss ON ap.subnet_name = ss.NAME ORDER BY ap.first_ip_range DESC;

question: For non-deleted instances in the “shelved_offloaded” VM state whose display name is in the top 10 display names with the largest MEMORY_MB range among non-deleted instances, list the instance UUID, display name, power state, system metadata key and value, cached network_info JSON, and the per-key row number (ordered by instance UUID). Also show, per metadata key, the total rows and average power state (suppressing repeated metadata keys), along with the display name’s memory range, variance, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and whether it has any non-deleted instance_info_cache record. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH shelved_metadata AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(metadata_key) OVER (ORDER BY metadata_key, instance_uuid) = metadata_key THEN NULL ELSE metadata_key END AS metadata_key, instance_uuid, display_name, power_state, metadata_value, network_info, window_column, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY metadata_key) AS total_rows_per_key, AVG(power_state) OVER (PARTITION BY metadata_key) AS avg_power_state_per_key FROM inner_cte ORDER BY metadata_key, instance_uuid ), top_memory_range_display_names AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb_range, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM instances i2 JOIN instance_info_caches ic2 ON i2.uuid = ic2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.deleted = 0 AND ic2.deleted = 0 AND i2.display_name = inner_cte.display_name ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_info_cache FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_range DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT sm.metadata_key, sm.instance_uuid, sm.display_name, sm.power_state, sm.metadata_value, sm.network_info, sm.window_column, sm.total_rows_per_key, sm.avg_power_state_per_key, tmr.display_name AS top10_display_name, tmr.memory_mb_range, tmr.memory_mb_variance, tmr.memory_mb_stddev, tmr.has_active_info_cache FROM shelved_metadata sm JOIN top_memory_range_display_names tmr ON sm.display_name = tmr.display_name ORDER BY tmr.memory_mb_range DESC, sm.metadata_key, sm.instance_uuid;

question: For instances whose display name is "forge", list each instance’s UUID, hostname, cached network_info JSON, and the running sum of instance IDs within its VM state (ordered by instance ID), along with the total number of "forge" instances per VM state and the average of those per-state totals across VM states; also include the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of memory_mb for the "forge" display name (among non-deleted instances that have system metadata and where the display name has more than 5 such instances) and how far that standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) deviates from the overall average standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across display names. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH forge_instances AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID, i.HOSTNAME, c.NETWORK_INFO, SUM(i.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ) SELECT inner_cte.UUID, inner_cte.HOSTNAME, inner_cte.NETWORK_INFO, inner_cte.window_column, state_counts.total_forge_instances_in_state, avg_state_counts.avg_forge_instances_per_state FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, COUNT(*) AS total_forge_instances_in_state FROM INSTANCES AS i WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ) AS state_counts ON state_counts.VM_STATE = ( SELECT i2.VM_STATE FROM INSTANCES AS i2 WHERE i2.UUID = inner_cte.UUID ) JOIN ( SELECT AVG(state_total) AS avg_forge_instances_per_state FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS state_total FROM INSTANCES WHERE DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' GROUP BY VM_STATE ) AS per_state ) AS avg_state_counts ), display_name_memory_stddev AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC ), avg_stddev AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_stddev) AS avg_memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb_stddev, (ic.memory_mb_stddev - a.avg_memory_mb_stddev) AS deviation_from_avg_stddev FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_stddev a ORDER BY ic.memory_mb_stddev DESC ) SELECT f.UUID, f.HOSTNAME, f.NETWORK_INFO, f.window_column, f.total_forge_instances_in_state, f.avg_forge_instances_per_state, dms.memory_mb_stddev, dms.deviation_from_avg_stddev FROM forge_instances f JOIN display_name_memory_stddev dms ON dms.display_name = 'forge' ORDER BY f.UUID;

question: List each instance display name that either (a) has total memory greater than 20000 MB among instances in VM state 'shelved_offloaded' with at least one system metadata entry where key = 'image_image_type' (including the overall average of these totals as a benchmark and a HIGH/LOW/AVERAGE memory category), or (b) has a memory (MB) standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across its system-metadata-joined rows (only where it has more than 2 such rows) that is greater than the average standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all such display names; include a “reason” column indicating which condition caused the display name to appear. Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each display name as 'HIGH_MEMORY' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_MEMORY' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_MEMORY'. Only include display names whose total memory exceeds 20000 MB.
SQL: WITH MemoryByDisplayName AS (WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > 20000 ), AverageMemory AS ( SELECT AVG(total_memory_mb) AS avg_total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.total_memory_mb, am.avg_total_memory_mb AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.total_memory_mb > am.avg_total_memory_mb * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MEMORY' WHEN ic.total_memory_mb < am.avg_total_memory_mb * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MEMORY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MEMORY' END AS memory_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageMemory am), StddevOutliersByDisplayName AS (WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 2 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC ) SELECT display_name, memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE memory_mb_stddev > (SELECT AVG(memory_mb_stddev) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC), CombinedDisplayNames AS ( SELECT display_name, total_memory_mb, benchmark, memory_category, NULL AS memory_mb_stddev, 'High Total Memory vs Benchmark' AS reason FROM MemoryByDisplayName UNION ALL SELECT display_name, NULL AS total_memory_mb, NULL AS benchmark, NULL AS memory_category, memory_mb_stddev, 'High Memory Stddev vs Average' AS reason FROM StddevOutliersByDisplayName ) SELECT display_name, total_memory_mb, benchmark, memory_category, memory_mb_stddev, reason FROM CombinedDisplayNames ORDER BY display_name, reason;

question: For availability zone 'flare3', for the top 10 instance display names with the most network info cache records, list each display name along with its cache record count, the overall average cache record count across these top-10 display names as a benchmark, its cache category (HIGH_CACHE/LOW_CACHE/AVERAGE_CACHE), and the range/variance/standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of non-deleted system metadata entry counts per non-deleted instance for that same display name. Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each display name as 'HIGH_CACHE' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_CACHE' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_CACHE'.
SQL: WITH CacheTop10 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(iic.id) AS cache_records FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY cache_records DESC LIMIT 10 ), AverageCache AS ( SELECT AVG(cache_records) AS avg_cache_records FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.cache_records, ac.avg_cache_records AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.cache_records > ac.avg_cache_records * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_CACHE' WHEN ic.cache_records < ac.avg_cache_records * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_CACHE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_CACHE' END AS cache_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageCache ac ), MetadataDispersion AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(meta_entry_count) - MIN(meta_entry_count) AS meta_count_range, VARIANCE(meta_entry_count) AS meta_count_variance, STDDEV(meta_entry_count) AS meta_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN ( SELECT i2.uuid AS instance_uuid, COUNT(*) AS meta_entry_count FROM instances AS i2 JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i2.uuid ) AS meta_stats ON meta_stats.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY meta_count_range DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY display_name_sort, display_name) = display_name THEN NULL ELSE display_name END AS display_name, meta_count_range, meta_count_variance, meta_count_stddev FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE display_name END AS display_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, MAX(meta_count_range) AS meta_count_range, AVG(meta_count_variance) AS meta_count_variance, AVG(meta_count_stddev) AS meta_count_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY display_name WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY display_name_sort, display_name ) SELECT ct.display_name, ct.cache_records, ct.benchmark, ct.cache_category, md.meta_count_range, md.meta_count_variance, md.meta_count_stddev FROM CacheTop10 ct LEFT JOIN MetadataDispersion md ON md.display_name = ct.display_name ORDER BY ct.cache_records DESC, ct.display_name;

question: For instances with display name "forge", give (1) the total count of instances whose memory-per-vCPU ratio is greater than 2048 MB per vCPU, (2) the total count of instances whose memory is greater than 75% of the maximum memory among these "forge" instances, and (3) the ratio of (1) to (2).
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.uuid, i.hostname, ie.flavor, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY i.hostname ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name = 'forge' ) SELECT ic.uuid, ic.hostname, ic.flavor, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, (i.memory_mb * 1.0 / NULLIF(i.vcpus, 0)) AS memory_per_vcpu_mb FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON i.uuid = ic.uuid WHERE (i.memory_mb * 1.0 / NULLIF(i.vcpus, 0)) > 2048 ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( ORDER BY ie.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge') SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.hostname, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.instance_extra_id, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE (inner_cte.memory_mb * 1.0 / (SELECT MAX(inner_cte2.memory_mb) FROM inner_cte AS inner_cte2)) > 0.75 ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT q1.uuid) AS Total_Forge_Instances_Meeting_MemoryPerVcpu_Threshold, COUNT(DISTINCT q2.instance_uuid) AS Total_Forge_Instances_Above_75pct_Max_Memory, ROUND( COUNT(DISTINCT q1.uuid) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT q2.instance_uuid), 0), 2 ) AS Ratio_MemoryPerVcpuQualified_To_Above75pctMaxMemory FROM q1 CROSS JOIN q2;

question: How many (VM state, availability zone) groups have total memory (MB) across non-deleted instances that exceeds the overall average memory plus one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and how many instance display names are categorized as SLOWER_THAN_AVG based on days-to-launch for instances that have system metadata KEY = 'image_image_type'? Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each display name as 'SLOWER_THAN_AVG' (at least 50% slower than the benchmark), 'FASTER_THAN_AVG' (at least 50% faster than the benchmark), or 'ABOUT_AVG'.
SQL: WITH mem_rollup AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.vm_state, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.vm_state HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > ( SELECT AVG(i2.memory_mb) + STDDEV(i2.memory_mb) FROM instances AS i2 JOIN instance_extra AS ie2 ON i2.uuid = ie2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.deleted = 0 ) ), StateZoneTotals AS ( SELECT i.vm_state, i.availability_zone, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid JOIN inner_cte ic ON ic.vm_state = i.vm_state WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.vm_state, i.availability_zone ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(vm_state) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state, CASE WHEN GROUPING(availability_zone) = 1 AND GROUPING(vm_state) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE availability_zone END AS availability_zone, SUM(total_memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM StateZoneTotals GROUP BY vm_state, availability_zone WITH ROLLUP ), launch_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.launched_at - i.created_at) AS avg_days_to_launch, STDDEV(i.launched_at - i.created_at) AS days_to_launch_stddev FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY days_to_launch_stddev DESC ), Benchmark AS ( SELECT AVG(avg_days_to_launch) AS benchmark_avg_days_to_launch FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.avg_days_to_launch, ic.days_to_launch_stddev, b.benchmark_avg_days_to_launch AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.avg_days_to_launch > b.benchmark_avg_days_to_launch * 1.5 THEN 'SLOWER_THAN_AVG' WHEN ic.avg_days_to_launch < b.benchmark_avg_days_to_launch * 0.5 THEN 'FASTER_THAN_AVG' ELSE 'ABOUT_AVG' END AS speed_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN Benchmark b ), slow_display_names AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS slower_than_avg_display_name_count FROM launch_stats WHERE speed_category = 'SLOWER_THAN_AVG' ), high_mem_groups AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS high_memory_state_zone_group_count FROM mem_rollup WHERE availability_zone NOT IN ('SUBTOTAL') AND vm_state NOT IN ('GRAND TOTAL') ) SELECT hmg.high_memory_state_zone_group_count, sdn.slower_than_avg_display_name_count FROM high_mem_groups hmg CROSS JOIN slow_display_names sdn;

question: For instances with display name "forge" that are in the "shelved_offloaded" VM state and have memory (MB) greater than the average "forge" memory (MB) in their availability zone, list the instance details (ID, UUID, user ID, project ID, hostname, VM/power state, memory, vCPUs, availability zone, instance-info-cache ID and network info, and the per-project minimum memory window value) along with the "shelved_offloaded" migration summary for completed migrations (minimum instance memory, total migration memory processed, and whether any related instances have a non-deleted network info cache record). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.ID AS instance_id, i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.USER_ID, i.PROJECT_ID, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, i.POWER_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, c.ID AS info_cache_id, c.NETWORK_INFO, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.PROJECT_ID ORDER BY i.PROJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), ZoneAverages AS ( SELECT i2.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, AVG(i2.MEMORY_MB * 1.0) AS avg_zone_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i2 WHERE i2.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' GROUP BY i2.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ) SELECT inner_cte.instance_id, inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.USER_ID, inner_cte.PROJECT_ID, inner_cte.HOSTNAME, inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.POWER_STATE, inner_cte.MEMORY_MB, inner_cte.VCPUS, inner_cte.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, inner_cte.info_cache_id, inner_cte.NETWORK_INFO, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN ZoneAverages za ON za.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = inner_cte.AVAILABILITY_ZONE WHERE inner_cte.MEMORY_MB > za.avg_zone_memory_mb), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_instance_memory_mb, SUM(m.MEMORY_PROCESSED) AS total_migration_memory_processed FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' ) SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, inner_cte.min_instance_memory_mb, inner_cte.total_migration_memory_processed, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MIGRATIONS m2 JOIN INSTANCES i2 ON m2.INSTANCE_UUID = i2.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic2 ON i2.UUID = ic2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m2.STATUS = 'completed' AND i2.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' AND ic2.DELETED = 0 ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_network_info_cache FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES i ON i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, inner_cte.min_instance_memory_mb, inner_cte.total_migration_memory_processed) SELECT q1.instance_id, q1.instance_uuid, q1.user_id, q1.project_id, q1.hostname, q1.vm_state, q1.power_state, q1.memory_mb, q1.vcpus, q1.availability_zone, q1.info_cache_id, q1.network_info, q1.window_column AS min_memory_mb_within_project, q2.min_instance_memory_mb AS shelved_offloaded_min_instance_memory_mb, q2.total_migration_memory_processed, q2.has_network_info_cache FROM q1 LEFT JOIN q2 ON q2.vm_state = q1.vm_state WHERE q1.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' ORDER BY q1.availability_zone, q1.project_id, q1.instance_id;

question: How many instance display names have non-deleted system metadata with KEY = 'image_image_type' and also meet the condition that their average MEMORY_MB is greater than 75% of their maximum MEMORY_MB, and (for instances with display name 'forge') what are the total number of returned metadata rows and the average running-sum of instance IDs across those rows? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH memory_stats_by_display_name AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND ism.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) AS max_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON i.DISPLAY_NAME = inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND ism.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev HAVING (AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) * 1.0 / MAX(i.MEMORY_MB)) > 0.75 ORDER BY avg_memory_mb DESC ), forge_metadata_windowed AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, ism.key AS metadata_key, ism.value AS metadata_value, i.power_state, SUM(i.id) OVER (PARTITION BY i.power_state ORDER BY i.id) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name = 'forge' ) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.metadata_key, inner_cte.metadata_value, inner_cte.power_state, inner_cte.window_column, stats.total_rows, stats.avg_window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rows, AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_column FROM inner_cte ) AS stats ON 1 = 1 ) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM memory_stats_by_display_name) AS qualifying_display_name_count, (SELECT total_rows FROM forge_metadata_windowed LIMIT 1) AS forge_total_rows, (SELECT avg_window_column FROM forge_metadata_windowed LIMIT 1) AS forge_avg_running_sum_id ;

question: Among instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type', find the display names whose average memory (MB) is greater than the overall average memory across such non-deleted instances, and for those display names report (by VM state and display name) the instance count, the minimum memory (MB), the deviation of that minimum memory from the overall average of per-(VM state, display name) minimum memories, plus the minimum instance ID and the average memory (MB). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.ID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(min_memory_mb) AS avg_min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.VM_STATE, ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.instance_count, ic.min_memory_mb, (ic.min_memory_mb - ac.avg_min_memory_mb) AS deviation_from_avg_min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte ac ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(i.ID) AS min_instance_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism JOIN INSTANCES i ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.min_instance_id, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES i ON i.ID = inner_cte.min_instance_id WHERE inner_cte.avg_memory_mb > ( SELECT AVG(inner_cte2.avg_memory_mb) FROM inner_cte AS inner_cte2 ) ) SELECT q1.VM_STATE, q1.DISPLAY_NAME, q1.instance_count, q1.min_memory_mb, q1.deviation_from_avg_min_memory_mb, q2.min_instance_id, q2.avg_memory_mb FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.DISPLAY_NAME = q2.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY q1.VM_STATE, q1.DISPLAY_NAME;

question: For completed migrations (where the instance info cache row is not deleted) and for instances in availability zone “flare3” whose memory_mb is above the overall flare3 average, return the migration ID, source/destination compute, instance display name, the migration’s rank within the completed status group (ordered by migration ID), the instance’s memory (MB) and its deviation from the average memory of instances involved in completed migrations, along with the matching flare3 instance UUID, VM state, memory_mb, cached network_info JSON, and the 2-preceding/2-following windowed average of memory_mb (partitioned by VM state and ordered by memory_mb). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH CompletedMigrations AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND ic.DELETED = 0 ), InstanceMemory AS ( SELECT inner_cte.migration_id, inner_cte.SOURCE_COMPUTE, inner_cte.DEST_COMPUTE, inner_cte.instance_display_name, inner_cte.window_column, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON m.ID = inner_cte.migration_id JOIN INSTANCES i ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID ), AverageMemory AS ( SELECT AVG(instance_memory_mb) AS avg_instance_memory_mb FROM InstanceMemory ) SELECT im.migration_id, im.SOURCE_COMPUTE, im.DEST_COMPUTE, im.instance_display_name, im.window_column AS rank_within_status, im.instance_memory_mb, (im.instance_memory_mb - am.avg_instance_memory_mb) AS deviation_from_avg_instance_memory_mb FROM InstanceMemory im CROSS JOIN AverageMemory am ORDER BY im.migration_id ), Flare3HighMemInstances AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, AVG(i.memory_mb) OVER ( PARTITION BY i.vm_state ORDER BY i.memory_mb ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' ORDER BY i.memory_mb ) SELECT inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.network_info, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(memory_mb) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb ) SELECT cm.migration_id, cm.SOURCE_COMPUTE, cm.DEST_COMPUTE, cm.instance_display_name, cm.rank_within_status, cm.instance_memory_mb, cm.deviation_from_avg_instance_memory_mb, f.uuid AS flare3_instance_uuid, f.vm_state AS flare3_vm_state, f.memory_mb AS flare3_memory_mb, f.network_info AS flare3_network_info, f.window_column AS flare3_windowed_avg_memory_mb FROM CompletedMigrations cm JOIN Flare3HighMemInstances f ON f.display_name = cm.instance_display_name ORDER BY cm.migration_id, f.memory_mb;

question: For confirmed migrations where the source compute is 'ether-60', list each migration’s ID, instance UUID, migration status, source and destination compute, instance display name, instance VM state, instance memory in MB (with row numbers within each migration status ordered by migration ID), the instance’s project ID, whether that project has any other active non-deleted migrations, and also (based on the instance VM state) the geometric mean of total memory migrated (MEMORY_TOTAL) across migrations for instances with non-empty cached NETWORK_INFO (only where MEMORY_TOTAL > 0), the overall geometric-mean benchmark across all VM states, and the VM state’s migration category (HIGH_MIGRATION/LOW_MIGRATION/AVERAGE_MIGRATION). Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each VM state as 'HIGH_MIGRATION' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_MIGRATION' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_MIGRATION'.
SQL: WITH vm_state_migration_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(m.memory_total))) AS geometric_mean_memory_total FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE m.memory_total > 0 AND c.network_info <> '' GROUP BY i.vm_state ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_total DESC ), benchmark AS ( SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_memory_total) AS benchmark_geometric_mean_memory_total FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.vm_state, ic.geometric_mean_memory_total, b.benchmark_geometric_mean_memory_total AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.geometric_mean_memory_total > b.benchmark_geometric_mean_memory_total * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MIGRATION' WHEN ic.geometric_mean_memory_total < b.benchmark_geometric_mean_memory_total * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MIGRATION' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MIGRATION' END AS migration_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN benchmark b ORDER BY ic.geometric_mean_memory_total DESC ), confirmed_ether60_migrations AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID AS instance_uuid, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS source_compute, m.DEST_COMPUTE AS dest_compute, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'confirmed' AND m.SOURCE_COMPUTE = 'ether-60' ) SELECT inner_cte.migration_id, inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.source_compute, inner_cte.dest_compute, inner_cte.instance_display_name, inner_cte.instance_vm_state, inner_cte.instance_memory_mb, inner_cte.window_column, i.project_id AS project_id, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM migrations m2 JOIN instances i2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid WHERE i2.project_id = i.project_id AND m2.deleted = 0 AND m2.status NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error') AND m2.id <> inner_cte.migration_id ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS project_has_other_active_migrations FROM inner_cte JOIN instances i ON inner_cte.instance_uuid = i.uuid ORDER BY inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.migration_id ) SELECT cem.migration_id, cem.instance_uuid, cem.migration_status, cem.source_compute, cem.dest_compute, cem.instance_display_name, cem.instance_vm_state, cem.instance_memory_mb, cem.window_column, cem.project_id, cem.project_has_other_active_migrations, vms.geometric_mean_memory_total AS vm_state_geometric_mean_memory_total, vms.benchmark AS vm_state_benchmark_geometric_mean_memory_total, vms.migration_category AS vm_state_migration_category FROM confirmed_ether60_migrations AS cem LEFT JOIN vm_state_migration_stats AS vms ON cem.instance_vm_state = vms.vm_state ORDER BY cem.migration_status, cem.migration_id;

question: For confirmed migrations and for instances whose display name is 'forge', return a combined report (joined by instance display name) that includes the migration status, source and destination compute hosts, the instance display name and network_info, the dense rank within each migration status plus the overall average dense-rank across confirmed migrations and each row’s deviation from that average; and also includes the forge instance UUID, VM state, memory (MB), vCPUs, instance-extra ID and created timestamp, cached network_info JSON, the minimum instance-extra ID in a 3-preceding/1-following window ordered by memory, and whether the instance has any deleted instance-extra record. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH confirmed_migrations AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, i.display_name, ic.network_info, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.status ORDER BY m.status) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'confirmed'), avg_rank AS ( SELECT AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_column FROM inner_cte ) SELECT c.status, c.source_compute, c.dest_compute, c.display_name, c.network_info, c.window_column, a.avg_window_column, (c.window_column - a.avg_window_column) AS deviation_from_avg_dense_rank FROM inner_cte c CROSS JOIN avg_rank a), forge_instances AS (WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ie.CREATED_AT AS instance_extra_created_at, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, MIN(ie.ID) OVER ( ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.display_name, ic.vm_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.vcpus, ic.instance_extra_id, ic.instance_extra_created_at, ic.network_info, ic.window_column, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie2 JOIN INSTANCES i2 ON i2.UUID = ie2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i2.UUID = ic.instance_uuid AND ie2.DELETED <> 0 ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_deleted_instance_extra FROM inner_cte ic) SELECT cm.status AS migration_status, cm.source_compute, cm.dest_compute, cm.display_name AS migration_instance_display_name, cm.network_info AS migration_network_info, cm.window_column AS migration_dense_rank_within_status, cm.avg_window_column AS avg_migration_dense_rank_across_confirmed, cm.deviation_from_avg_dense_rank, fi.instance_uuid AS forge_instance_uuid, fi.display_name AS forge_display_name, fi.vm_state AS forge_vm_state, fi.memory_mb AS forge_memory_mb, fi.vcpus AS forge_vcpus, fi.instance_extra_id AS forge_instance_extra_id, fi.instance_extra_created_at AS forge_instance_extra_created_at, fi.network_info AS forge_network_info, fi.window_column AS forge_min_instance_extra_id_window, fi.has_deleted_instance_extra FROM confirmed_migrations cm JOIN forge_instances fi ON fi.display_name = cm.display_name;

question: For completed migrations, show the average standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of MEMORY_TOTAL by availability zone and instance display name (including subtotals per availability zone and a grand total), and also return (as overall summary values) the total number of system-metadata rows and the average running-sum of instance IDs for instances whose display name is 'forge'. Do not return any rounded answers.
