inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.metadata_count_range, inner_cte.metadata_count_variance, inner_cte.metadata_count_stddev, overall_avg.avg_migration_metadata_count AS overall_avg_per_migration_metadata_count FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(migration_metadata_count) AS avg_migration_metadata_count FROM ( SELECT m.instance_uuid, m.id AS migration_id, COUNT(ism.id) AS migration_metadata_count FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i2 ON m.instance_uuid = i2.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.id ) AS per_migration_counts ) AS overall_avg ), CombinedInstanceStats AS ( SELECT mv.display_name, 'Memory MB Variance' AS metric_type, mv.memory_mb_variance AS metric_value, mv.benchmark AS benchmark_value, mv.variance_category AS category, NULL AS metadata_count_range, NULL AS metadata_count_variance, NULL AS metadata_count_stddev, NULL AS overall_avg_per_migration_metadata_count FROM memory_variance mv UNION ALL SELECT ms.display_name, 'Per-migration Metadata Count Dispersion' AS metric_type, NULL AS metric_value, NULL AS benchmark_value, NULL AS category, ms.metadata_count_range, ms.metadata_count_variance, ms.metadata_count_stddev, ms.overall_avg_per_migration_metadata_count FROM metadata_stats ms ) SELECT * FROM CombinedInstanceStats ORDER BY display_name, metric_type;

question: For each migration status, what are the geometric mean instance memory (MB) and geometric mean vCPU count for migrations where instance memory is greater than zero, and (for the same status) what is the maximum across projects of the per-project instance-memory range (max minus min, in MB) considering only migrations that are not deleted and whose instances have a non-deleted instance info cache entry? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH geom_means_by_status AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.status, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC ) SELECT m.status, inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb, EXP(AVG(LN(i.vcpus))) AS geometric_mean_vcpus FROM inner_cte JOIN migrations AS m ON m.status = inner_cte.status JOIN instances AS i ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND i.vcpus > 0 GROUP BY m.status, inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC ), max_project_memory_range_by_status AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.status, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND ic.deleted = 0 GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC ), StatusProjectRanges AS ( SELECT m.status, i.project_id, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS project_memory_mb_range FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND ic.deleted = 0 GROUP BY m.status, i.project_id ) SELECT spr.status, MAX(spr.project_memory_mb_range) AS max_project_memory_mb_range FROM StatusProjectRanges AS spr JOIN inner_cte AS base ON base.status = spr.status GROUP BY spr.status ORDER BY max_project_memory_mb_range DESC ) SELECT g.status, g.geometric_mean_memory_mb, g.geometric_mean_vcpus, r.max_project_memory_mb_range FROM geom_means_by_status AS g JOIN max_project_memory_range_by_status AS r ON r.status = g.status ORDER BY g.geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC;

question: For each non-deleted instance display name that has at least one completed migration with a maximum recorded total memory greater than 0, list the display name, the instance’s MEMORY_MB range/variance/standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across its records, how far that range deviates from the overall average range across all display names, the completed migration status and maximum migration memory_total, the instance’s configured memory_mb and vcpus, and compute the max migration memory_total to configured memory_mb ratio (rounded).
SQL: WITH mem_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC ), avg_ranges AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_range) AS avg_memory_mb_range FROM inner_cte ) SELECT c.display_name, c.memory_mb_range, c.memory_mb_variance, c.memory_mb_stddev, (c.memory_mb_range - a.avg_memory_mb_range) AS deviation_from_avg_memory_mb_range FROM inner_cte c CROSS JOIN avg_ranges a ORDER BY c.memory_mb_range DESC ), mig_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(m.memory_total) AS max_memory_total, m.status FROM instances i JOIN migrations m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.display_name, m.status HAVING MAX(m.memory_total) > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.status, inner_cte.max_memory_total, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus FROM inner_cte JOIN instances i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.display_name ) SELECT ms.display_name, ms.memory_mb_range, ms.memory_mb_variance, ms.memory_mb_stddev, ms.deviation_from_avg_memory_mb_range, mg.status AS migration_status, mg.max_memory_total, mg.memory_mb AS configured_memory_mb, mg.vcpus AS configured_vcpus, ROUND(mg.max_memory_total / NULLIF(mg.memory_mb, 0), 2) AS max_migration_memory_to_configured_memory_ratio FROM mem_stats ms JOIN mig_stats mg ON mg.display_name = ms.display_name ORDER BY max_migration_memory_to_configured_memory_ratio DESC;

question: For each of the top 10 (display name, launched-at timestamp) groups with the highest maximum memory among instances launched in 2014 (only keeping groups where that maximum exceeds 16000 MB), show the group’s display name, launched-at timestamp, maximum memory, whether any instance in the group has a non-empty NUMA topology recorded, how many instances in that group are the display name 'forge', and whether any of those 'forge' instances has an instance-extra record marked as deleted. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH top_groups_2014 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) AS max_memory_mb, i.LAUNCHED_AT FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.LAUNCHED_AT) = 2014 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.LAUNCHED_AT HAVING MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) > 16000 ) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.LAUNCHED_AT, inner_cte.max_memory_mb, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM INSTANCES i2 JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA ie2 ON ie2.INSTANCE_UUID = i2.UUID WHERE i2.DISPLAY_NAME = inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME AND i2.LAUNCHED_AT = inner_cte.LAUNCHED_AT AND ie2.NUMA_TOPOLOGY IS NOT NULL AND ie2.NUMA_TOPOLOGY <> '' ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_numa_topology FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.max_memory_mb DESC LIMIT 10 ), forge_instances AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ie.CREATED_AT AS instance_extra_created_at, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, MIN(ie.ID) OVER ( ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.display_name, ic.vm_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.vcpus, ic.instance_extra_id, ic.instance_extra_created_at, ic.network_info, ic.window_column, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie2 JOIN INSTANCES i2 ON i2.UUID = ie2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i2.UUID = ic.instance_uuid AND ie2.DELETED <> 0 ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_deleted_instance_extra FROM inner_cte ic ) SELECT tg.DISPLAY_NAME AS group_display_name, tg.LAUNCHED_AT AS group_launched_at, tg.max_memory_mb AS group_max_memory_mb, tg.has_numa_topology AS group_has_numa_topology, COUNT(fi.instance_uuid) AS forge_instance_count_in_group, MAX(CASE WHEN fi.has_deleted_instance_extra = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS any_forge_instance_has_deleted_instance_extra FROM top_groups_2014 tg LEFT JOIN INSTANCES i ON i.DISPLAY_NAME = tg.DISPLAY_NAME AND i.LAUNCHED_AT = tg.LAUNCHED_AT LEFT JOIN forge_instances fi ON fi.instance_uuid = i.UUID GROUP BY tg.DISPLAY_NAME, tg.LAUNCHED_AT, tg.max_memory_mb, tg.has_numa_topology ORDER BY tg.max_memory_mb DESC;

question: For each instance display name (considering only instances that are not deleted and that have extra metadata), return only those display names whose instance memory (in MB) variance is greater than the average memory variance across all display names, and for those display names also show the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory across their system metadata rows, the number of system metadata rows, and the overall average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all display names. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH variance_above_avg AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb_variance, ic.memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte ic WHERE ic.memory_mb_variance > (SELECT AVG(inner_cte.memory_mb_variance) FROM inner_cte) ), cov_and_meta AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) / NULLIF(AVG(i.memory_mb), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(i.memory_mb) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, meta_counts.system_metadata_rows, avg_cov.avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(ism.id) AS system_metadata_rows FROM instances i JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ) AS meta_counts ON meta_counts.display_name = inner_cte.display_name JOIN ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte ) AS avg_cov ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT v.display_name, v.memory_mb_variance, v.memory_mb_stddev, c.coefficient_of_variation, c.system_metadata_rows, c.avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM variance_above_avg v JOIN cov_and_meta c ON c.display_name = v.display_name ORDER BY c.coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For VM states that (a) are in the top 10 (among non-deleted instances) by variance in migration memory total and (b) also have an instance memory (MB) variance greater than 1000 among instances with system metadata key = 'image_image_type', show the VM state, the migration memory total variance, the number of distinct migrated instances, whether any migrations are currently active, and the instance memory (MB) variance. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.memory_mb_variance > 1000 ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_variance DESC ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, VARIANCE(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS memory_total_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_total_variance DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.memory_total_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT i.uuid) AS migrated_instance_count, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM migrations m2 JOIN instances i2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid WHERE i2.deleted = 0 AND i2.vm_state = inner_cte.vm_state AND m2.deleted = 0 AND m2.status NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error') ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_migrations FROM inner_cte JOIN instances i ON i.vm_state = inner_cte.vm_state AND i.deleted = 0 JOIN migrations m ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid GROUP BY inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_total_variance ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_total_variance DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT q2.VM_STATE, q2.memory_total_variance, q2.migrated_instance_count, q2.has_active_migrations, q1.memory_mb_variance FROM q2 JOIN q1 ON q1.VM_STATE = q2.VM_STATE ORDER BY q2.memory_total_variance DESC;

question: For instances with display name equal to 'forge' that are also non-deleted and in the “shelved_offloaded” VM state with a non-deleted instance info cache record, list the forge instance display name, instance UUID, memory (MB), cached network info, cache record ID, the running average memory (MB) within the display name group ordered by memory, the total number of 'forge' instances and overall average forge memory (MB), plus the instance hostname, vCPUs, cache last-updated timestamp, and the forge-to-shelved-offloaded memory ratio (rounded).
SQL: WITH forge_instances AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, i.uuid, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, c.id AS cache_id, AVG(i.memory_mb) OVER (PARTITION BY i.display_name ORDER BY i.memory_mb) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name = 'forge' ORDER BY i.memory_mb ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.network_info, inner_cte.cache_id, inner_cte.window_column, forge_stats.total_forge_instances, forge_stats.avg_forge_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_forge_instances, AVG(memory_mb) AS avg_forge_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) AS forge_stats ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb ), shelved_offloaded_with_cache AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS shelved_offloaded_instances_with_cache FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' AND i.DELETED = 0 AND ic.DELETED = 0 ) SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ic.UPDATED_AT AS cache_updated_at FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID CROSS JOIN inner_cte WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' AND i.DELETED = 0 AND ic.DELETED = 0 ) SELECT fi.display_name, fi.uuid AS forge_instance_uuid, fi.memory_mb AS forge_memory_mb, fi.network_info AS forge_cached_network_info, fi.cache_id AS forge_cache_id, fi.window_column AS avg_memory_mb_within_display_name_ordered_by_memory, fi.total_forge_instances, fi.avg_forge_memory_mb, so.hostname AS shelved_offloaded_hostname, so.memory_mb AS shelved_offloaded_memory_mb, so.vcpus AS shelved_offloaded_vcpus, so.cache_updated_at AS shelved_offloaded_cache_updated_at, ROUND(fi.memory_mb / NULLIF(so.memory_mb, 0), 2) AS forge_to_shelved_offloaded_memory_ratio FROM forge_instances fi JOIN shelved_offloaded_with_cache so ON so.instance_uuid = fi.uuid ORDER BY fi.memory_mb;

question: For completed migrations, list the migration details (migration id, instance UUID, migration type, source compute, destination compute, destination host, instance display name, VM state, instance memory MB, vCPUs, instance extra id, migration memory total, and the per-migration-type minimum memory total window column), but only for instances in the “shelved_offloaded” VM state whose total instance memory (summed across system metadata entries) is greater than 50000 MB and also greater than the average of those qualifying totals; additionally compute the ratio of migration MEMORY_TOTAL to that instance total memory.
SQL: WITH mem_over_avg AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) AS total_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME HAVING SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) > 50000) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.total_memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(inner_cte.total_memory_mb * 1.0) FROM inner_cte)), completed_migrations AS (WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.MIGRATION_TYPE, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, m.MEMORY_TOTAL, MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) OVER (PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(MIGRATION_TYPE) OVER (ORDER BY MIGRATION_TYPE, migration_id) = MIGRATION_TYPE THEN NULL ELSE MIGRATION_TYPE END AS migration_type, migration_id, INSTANCE_UUID, SOURCE_COMPUTE, DEST_COMPUTE, DEST_HOST, DISPLAY_NAME, VM_STATE, MEMORY_MB, VCPUS, instance_extra_id, MEMORY_TOTAL, window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY MIGRATION_TYPE, migration_id), filtered_completed_migrations AS ( SELECT cm.migration_type, cm.migration_id, cm.INSTANCE_UUID, cm.SOURCE_COMPUTE, cm.DEST_COMPUTE, cm.DEST_HOST, cm.DISPLAY_NAME, cm.VM_STATE, cm.MEMORY_MB, cm.VCPUS, cm.instance_extra_id, cm.MEMORY_TOTAL, cm.window_column, moa.total_memory_mb FROM completed_migrations cm JOIN mem_over_avg moa ON cm.DISPLAY_NAME = moa.DISPLAY_NAME WHERE cm.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' ) SELECT fcm.migration_type, fcm.migration_id, fcm.INSTANCE_UUID, fcm.SOURCE_COMPUTE, fcm.DEST_COMPUTE, fcm.DEST_HOST, fcm.DISPLAY_NAME, fcm.VM_STATE, fcm.MEMORY_MB, fcm.VCPUS, fcm.instance_extra_id, fcm.MEMORY_TOTAL, fcm.window_column, fcm.total_memory_mb, ROUND(fcm.MEMORY_TOTAL / NULLIF(fcm.total_memory_mb, 0), 4) AS migration_memory_to_instance_total_memory_ratio FROM filtered_completed_migrations fcm ORDER BY fcm.migration_type, fcm.migration_id;

question: For instances with display name 'forge', return each instance’s UUID, display name, hostname, availability zone, VM state, memory (MB), vCPUs, instance-extra ID and created timestamp, and cached network_info JSON; also include (1) the minimum instance-extra ID over a window of 3 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by instance memory (MB), (2) the overall average memory (MB) across these 'forge' instances and a memory category (HIGH_MEMORY/LOW_MEMORY/AVERAGE_MEMORY) relative to that average, and (3) the rank of the instance within its availability zone ordered by instance ID plus the deviation of its instance ID from the average instance ID across all 'forge' instances. Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each instance as 'HIGH_MEMORY' (at least 50% above average), 'LOW_MEMORY' (at least 50% below average), or 'AVERAGE_MEMORY'.
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ie.CREATED_AT AS instance_extra_created_at, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, MIN(ie.ID) OVER ( ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ), AverageMemory AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.display_name, ic.vm_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.vcpus, ic.instance_extra_id, ic.instance_extra_created_at, ic.network_info, ic.window_column, am.avg_memory_mb AS benchmark_avg_memory_mb, CASE WHEN ic.memory_mb > am.avg_memory_mb * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MEMORY' WHEN ic.memory_mb < am.avg_memory_mb * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MEMORY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MEMORY' END AS memory_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageMemory am ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.UUID, t0.HOSTNAME, t0.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, t2.NETWORK_INFO, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ORDER BY t0.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS t0 JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS t1 ON t1.INSTANCE_UUID = t0.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t2.INSTANCE_UUID = t0.UUID WHERE t0.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), avg_ids AS (SELECT AVG(t0.ID) AS avg_instance_id FROM INSTANCES AS t0 WHERE t0.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge') SELECT i.UUID, i.HOSTNAME, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, i.NETWORK_INFO, i.window_column AS rank_within_az_by_id, (t0.ID - a.avg_instance_id) AS deviation_from_avg_instance_id FROM inner_cte i JOIN INSTANCES AS t0 ON t0.UUID = i.UUID CROSS JOIN avg_ids a ) SELECT q1.instance_uuid, q1.display_name, q2.hostname, q2.availability_zone, q1.vm_state, q1.memory_mb, q1.vcpus, q1.instance_extra_id, q1.instance_extra_created_at, q1.network_info, q1.window_column AS min_instance_extra_id_window_3_preceding_1_following_by_memory_mb, q1.benchmark_avg_memory_mb, q1.memory_category, q2.rank_within_az_by_id, q2.deviation_from_avg_instance_id FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q2.UUID = q1.instance_uuid;

question: In availability zone 'flare3', for VM states whose total instance memory exceeds 50000 MB, show each VM state and display name (restricted to instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type' and whose group minimum memory is greater than 75% of the overall maximum group minimum), along with the instance count, the group minimum memory (MB), the VM-state total memory (MB), and that VM-state total memory as a percentage of the included total memory. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) AS total_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE HAVING SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) > 50000 ) SELECT inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.total_memory_mb, (inner_cte.total_memory_mb * 1.0 / totals.grand_total_memory_mb) AS pct_of_included_total_memory FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT SUM(total_memory_mb) AS grand_total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) totals ON 1 = 1 ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.ID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT ic.VM_STATE, ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.instance_count, ic.min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ic WHERE ic.min_memory_mb > 0.75 * (SELECT MAX(min_memory_mb) FROM inner_cte) ) SELECT q2.VM_STATE, q2.DISPLAY_NAME, q2.instance_count, q2.min_memory_mb, q1.total_memory_mb, q1.pct_of_included_total_memory FROM q2 JOIN q1 ON q2.VM_STATE = q1.VM_STATE ORDER BY q1.pct_of_included_total_memory DESC, q2.instance_count DESC, q2.DISPLAY_NAME;

question: For instances in VM state "shelved_offloaded", list the availability zone (suppressing repeats and including subtotal rows per zone), instance ID, display name, cached network info, and the instance’s rank within its availability zone by instance ID, and also show (by matching on display name) the variance of instance memory_mb among instances that have a matching row in INSTANCE_EXTRA, the overall average of these per-display-name variances, and each display name’s deviation from that overall average. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH mem_var_by_display_name AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), avg_variance AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb_variance, av.avg_memory_mb_variance, (ic.memory_mb_variance - av.avg_memory_mb_variance) AS deviation_from_avg_variance FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_variance av ORDER BY deviation_from_avg_variance DESC ), shelved_offloaded_instances AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.ID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, c.NETWORK_INFO, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ORDER BY i.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(availability_zone) OVER (ORDER BY az_sort, availability_zone, id) = availability_zone THEN NULL ELSE availability_zone END AS availability_zone, id, display_name, network_info, window_column, total_instances_in_az FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(availability_zone) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE availability_zone END AS az_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(availability_zone) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE availability_zone END AS availability_zone, id, display_name, network_info, window_column, COUNT(*) AS total_instances_in_az FROM inner_cte GROUP BY availability_zone, id, display_name, network_info, window_column WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY az_sort, availability_zone, id ) SELECT soi.availability_zone, soi.id, soi.display_name, soi.network_info, soi.window_column AS rank_in_availability_zone_by_id, soi.total_instances_in_az, mv.memory_mb_variance, mv.avg_memory_mb_variance, mv.deviation_from_avg_variance FROM shelved_offloaded_instances AS soi LEFT JOIN mem_var_by_display_name AS mv ON soi.display_name = mv.display_name ORDER BY soi.availability_zone, soi.id;

question: How many instances in availability zone "flare3" have a VM-state running sum of instance IDs (ordered by instance ID) that is above the average of that running-sum value, and how many "flare3" instances with cached network info have total processed memory across completed migrations that is more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the overall mean processed memory per completed migration? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH az_running_sum_above_avg AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, SUM(i.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' ) SELECT instance_uuid, display_name, vm_state, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > (SELECT AVG(window_column) FROM inner_cte) ), high_migration_memory_instances AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.instance_uuid, SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY m.instance_uuid HAVING SUM(m.memory_processed) > ( SELECT AVG(memory_processed) + STDDEV(memory_processed) FROM migrations WHERE status = 'completed' ) ) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, i.display_name, inner_cte.total_memory_processed FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i ON i.uuid = inner_cte.instance_uuid ), flare3_high_migration_memory_instances AS ( SELECT hmi.instance_uuid, hmi.display_name, hmi.total_memory_processed FROM high_migration_memory_instances hmi JOIN instances i ON i.uuid = hmi.instance_uuid WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' ) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM az_running_sum_above_avg) AS flare3_instances_running_sum_above_avg_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flare3_high_migration_memory_instances) AS flare3_instances_high_migration_memory_count ;

question: For each instance display name that is in the “shelved_offloaded” VM state and has total memory (in MB) across its system metadata entries greater than 50000 MB and also greater than the average total memory of those qualifying instances, return the instance display name, that total memory, the variance of instance memory (in MB) across its system metadata entries for non-deleted instances, and the deviation of that variance from the overall average memory variance. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) AS total_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME HAVING SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) > 50000) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.total_memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(inner_cte.total_memory_mb * 1.0) FROM inner_cte)), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), avg_variance AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.memory_mb_variance, (ic.memory_mb_variance - av.avg_memory_mb_variance) AS deviation_from_avg_variance FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_variance av ORDER BY ic.memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT q1.DISPLAY_NAME, q1.total_memory_mb, q2.memory_mb_variance, q2.deviation_from_avg_variance FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.DISPLAY_NAME = q2.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY q1.total_memory_mb DESC;

question: For each instance display name that (1) has an instance memory (MB) variance higher than the average variance across all non-deleted instances with extra metadata and (2) also has at least 6 “shelved_offloaded” instances with extra metadata, show the display name, its memory variance and overall memory standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), plus its “shelved_offloaded” memory standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), the overall benchmark standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) for “shelved_offloaded” display names, and the resulting variability category. Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each display name as 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_VARIABILITY' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY'.
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb_variance, ic.memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte ic WHERE ic.memory_mb_variance > (SELECT AVG(inner_cte.memory_mb_variance) FROM inner_cte) ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC ), AvgStddev AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_stddev) AS avg_memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb_stddev, a.avg_memory_mb_stddev AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.memory_mb_stddev > a.avg_memory_mb_stddev * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN ic.memory_mb_stddev < a.avg_memory_mb_stddev * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AvgStddev a ) SELECT q2.display_name, q1.memory_mb_variance, q1.memory_mb_stddev AS overall_memory_mb_stddev, q2.memory_mb_stddev AS shelved_offloaded_memory_mb_stddev, q2.benchmark AS shelved_offloaded_stddev_benchmark, q2.variability_category FROM q2 JOIN q1 ON q2.display_name = q1.display_name ORDER BY q1.memory_mb_variance DESC, q2.memory_mb_stddev DESC;

question: For the top 10 instance display names in availability zone 'flare3' with the highest average MEMORY_MB among instances that have system metadata with KEY = 'image_image_type', list the display name, the minimum instance ID, the average memory (MB), whether any instance with that display name has more than one system-metadata row, and also the (non-deleted) memory range, variance, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and deviation from the overall average memory range for that display name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH top10_by_avg_memory AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(i.ID) AS min_instance_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT i.display_name, inner_cte.min_instance_id, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM instances i2 JOIN instance_system_metadata ism2 ON i2.uuid = ism2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.display_name = i.display_name GROUP BY i2.display_name, i2.uuid HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_any_instance_with_multiple_metadata_rows FROM inner_cte JOIN instances i ON i.id = inner_cte.min_instance_id ORDER BY inner_cte.avg_memory_mb DESC LIMIT 10 ), display_name_memory_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC ), avg_ranges AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_range) AS avg_memory_mb_range FROM inner_cte ) SELECT c.display_name, c.memory_mb_range, c.memory_mb_variance, c.memory_mb_stddev, (c.memory_mb_range - a.avg_memory_mb_range) AS deviation_from_avg_memory_mb_range FROM inner_cte c CROSS JOIN avg_ranges a ORDER BY c.memory_mb_range DESC ) SELECT t.display_name, t.min_instance_id, t.avg_memory_mb, t.has_any_instance_with_multiple_metadata_rows, s.memory_mb_range, s.memory_mb_variance, s.memory_mb_stddev, s.deviation_from_avg_memory_mb_range FROM top10_by_avg_memory t JOIN display_name_memory_stats s ON s.display_name = t.display_name ORDER BY t.avg_memory_mb DESC;

question: For instances in availability zone "flare3" that have a migration with status "completed", list each instance’s migration type (suppressing repeats when it matches the previous row), instance UUID, instance display name, migration status, and the running sum of instance memory (MEMORY_MB) within each migration type ordered by instance memory; also include, for that instance display name, the geometric-mean memory across instances with system metadata key = 'image_image_type', the overall benchmark geometric-mean memory, and the resulting memory category (HIGH_MEMORY/LOW_MEMORY/AVERAGE_MEMORY). Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each display name as 'HIGH_MEMORY' (at least 50% above benchmark), 'LOW_MEMORY' (at least 50% below benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_MEMORY'.
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, m.STATUS AS migration_status, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND m.STATUS = 'completed' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(m.MIGRATION_TYPE) OVER (ORDER BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.instance_uuid) = m.MIGRATION_TYPE THEN NULL ELSE m.MIGRATION_TYPE END AS migration_type, inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.instance_display_name, inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = inner_cte.instance_uuid AND m.STATUS = inner_cte.migration_status ORDER BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.instance_uuid ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC ), Benchmark AS ( SELECT EXP(AVG(LN(geometric_mean_memory_mb))) AS benchmark_geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.geometric_mean_memory_mb, b.benchmark_geometric_mean_memory_mb AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.geometric_mean_memory_mb > b.benchmark_geometric_mean_memory_mb * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MEMORY' WHEN ic.geometric_mean_memory_mb < b.benchmark_geometric_mean_memory_mb * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MEMORY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MEMORY' END AS memory_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN Benchmark b ORDER BY ic.geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC ) SELECT q1.migration_type, q1.instance_uuid, q1.instance_display_name, q1.migration_status, q1.window_column AS running_sum_instance_memory_mb_within_migration_type, q2.geometric_mean_memory_mb AS display_name_geometric_mean_memory_mb, q2.benchmark AS benchmark_geometric_mean_memory_mb, q2.memory_category FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q2.display_name = q1.instance_display_name JOIN INSTANCES i ON i.UUID = q1.instance_uuid WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' ORDER BY q1.migration_type, q1.window_column, q1.instance_uuid;

question: For availability zone “flare3”, list only instances that (1) have a completed migration and (2) whose display name belongs to a group of instances with extra metadata and a network info cache entry where the MEMORY_MB standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is greater than 5000 MB; show the migration type (blanked out when it repeats from the previous row), instance UUID, instance display name, migration status, the running sum of instance MEMORY_MB within each migration type ordered by instance memory, and also the display-name-level MEMORY_MB standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) and average MEMORY_MB. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH MigrationWindowedInstances AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, m.STATUS AS migration_status, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND m.STATUS = 'completed' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(m.MIGRATION_TYPE) OVER (ORDER BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.instance_uuid) = m.MIGRATION_TYPE THEN NULL ELSE m.MIGRATION_TYPE END AS migration_type, inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.instance_display_name, inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = inner_cte.instance_uuid AND m.STATUS = inner_cte.migration_status ORDER BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.instance_uuid ), HighVarianceDisplayNames AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN instances i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.display_name JOIN instance_extra ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev HAVING inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev > 5000 ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev DESC ) SELECT mwi.migration_type, mwi.instance_uuid, mwi.instance_display_name, mwi.migration_status, mwi.window_column, hvdn.memory_mb_stddev, hvdn.avg_memory_mb FROM MigrationWindowedInstances mwi JOIN HighVarianceDisplayNames hvdn ON hvdn.display_name = mwi.instance_display_name ORDER BY mwi.migration_type, mwi.window_column, mwi.instance_uuid;

question: In availability zone "flare3", for instances whose vCPU count is greater than the average vCPU count of other instances in the same VM state (and including their system metadata), list each instance UUID, display name, VM state, memory (MB), vCPUs, metadata key/value, and the row number within each metadata-key group; also show (by instance display name) the variance of instance memory (MB) across system-metadata entries for non-deleted instances and how far that variance deviates from the overall average variance. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' ), VmStateAverages AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, AVG(i.VCPUS * 1.0) AS avg_vcpus FROM INSTANCES AS i WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.display_name, ic.vm_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.vcpus, ic.metadata_key, ic.metadata_value, ic.window_column FROM inner_cte AS ic WHERE ic.vcpus > ( SELECT vsa.avg_vcpus FROM VmStateAverages AS vsa WHERE vsa.vm_state = ic.vm_state ) ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), avg_variance AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.memory_mb_variance, (ic.memory_mb_variance - av.avg_memory_mb_variance) AS deviation_from_avg_variance FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_variance av ORDER BY ic.memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT q1.instance_uuid, q1.display_name, q1.vm_state, q1.memory_mb, q1.vcpus, q1.metadata_key, q1.metadata_value, q1.window_column, q2.memory_mb_variance, q2.deviation_from_avg_variance FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.display_name = q2.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY q2.memory_mb_variance DESC, q1.display_name, q1.metadata_key, q1.window_column;

question: For the security group named "aurum-xenon", return only those rules whose from-port is greater than the average from-port for their protocol, and for each such rule show the security group name, description, user ID, project ID, protocol, from port, to port, CIDR, the minimum from port over a window of 3 preceding and 1 following rule rows (ordered by the parent group ID), the rule’s deviation from the overall average from port across all "aurum-xenon" rules, and the running sum of from ports within the same protocol ordered by from port. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sg.NAME, sg.DESCRIPTION, sg.USER_ID, sg.PROJECT_ID, sgr.PROTOCOL, sgr.FROM_PORT, sgr.TO_PORT, sgr.CIDR, MIN(sgr.FROM_PORT) OVER ( ORDER BY sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM SECURITY_GROUPS AS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sg.NAME = 'aurum-xenon'), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(FROM_PORT) AS avg_from_port FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.NAME, i.DESCRIPTION, i.USER_ID, i.PROJECT_ID, i.PROTOCOL, i.FROM_PORT, i.TO_PORT, i.CIDR, i.window_column, (i.FROM_PORT - a.avg_from_port) AS deviation_from_avg_from_port FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_cte a ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sg.NAME AS security_group_name, sgr.PROTOCOL, sgr.FROM_PORT, SUM(sgr.FROM_PORT) OVER ( PARTITION BY sgr.PROTOCOL ORDER BY sgr.FROM_PORT ) AS window_column FROM SECURITY_GROUPS AS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sg.NAME = 'aurum-xenon'), ProtocolAverages AS ( SELECT sgr.PROTOCOL, AVG(sgr.FROM_PORT * 1.0) AS avg_from_port FROM SECURITY_GROUPS AS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sg.NAME = 'aurum-xenon' GROUP BY sgr.PROTOCOL ) SELECT i.security_group_name, i.PROTOCOL, i.FROM_PORT, i.window_column FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN ProtocolAverages AS pa ON pa.PROTOCOL = i.PROTOCOL WHERE i.FROM_PORT > pa.avg_from_port ) SELECT q1.NAME AS security_group_name, q1.DESCRIPTION, q1.USER_ID, q1.PROJECT_ID, q1.PROTOCOL, q1.FROM_PORT, q1.TO_PORT, q1.CIDR, q1.window_column AS min_from_port_window_3_preceding_1_following, q1.deviation_from_avg_from_port, q2.window_column AS running_sum_from_ports_within_protocol FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.NAME = q2.security_group_name AND q1.PROTOCOL = q2.PROTOCOL AND q1.FROM_PORT = q2.FROM_PORT ORDER BY q1.PROTOCOL, q1.FROM_PORT;

question: For availability zone 'flare3', what is the highest migration rank among migrations with status 'completed', and what is the maximum (across key names) of the per-key maximum total vCPUs for any single instance in 'flare3' (where total vCPUs is computed as SUM(vcpus) over joined system metadata rows)? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH completed_migration_rank_by_zone AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE AS instance_availability_zone, m.STATUS AS migration_status, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ) SELECT instance_availability_zone, MAX(window_column) AS max_migration_rank_in_zone FROM inner_cte GROUP BY instance_availability_zone ), max_total_vcpus_per_key_in_flare3 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name, COUNT(ism.id) AS metadata_entry_count, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus FROM instances i JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name) SELECT key_name, MAX(total_vcpus) AS max_total_vcpus_per_instance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY key_name ) SELECT cmrz.max_migration_rank_in_zone, mtv.max_total_vcpus_per_instance FROM completed_migration_rank_by_zone cmrz CROSS JOIN ( SELECT MAX(max_total_vcpus_per_instance) AS max_total_vcpus_per_instance FROM max_total_vcpus_per_key_in_flare3 ) mtv WHERE cmrz.instance_availability_zone = 'flare3';

question: For instance display names that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type' and are categorized as HIGH_VARIABILITY in memory range versus the overall benchmark, show the display name, its memory range and variance (MB) with the benchmark memory range and variability category, along with its average memory and memory variance (MB) with the overall variance benchmark and variance category. Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each display name as 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_VARIABILITY' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY'.
SQL: WITH MemoryRangeVariability AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC ), AverageRange AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_range_mb) AS avg_memory_range_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_range_mb, ic.memory_variance_mb, ar.avg_memory_range_mb AS benchmark_memory_range_mb, CASE WHEN ic.memory_range_mb > ar.avg_memory_range_mb * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN ic.memory_range_mb < ar.avg_memory_range_mb * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageRange ar ), MemoryVarianceByDisplayName AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), VarianceBenchmark AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS avg_variance_benchmark FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.avg_memory_mb, ic.memory_mb_variance, vb.avg_variance_benchmark AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.memory_mb_variance > vb.avg_variance_benchmark * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN ic.memory_mb_variance < vb.avg_variance_benchmark * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN VarianceBenchmark vb ORDER BY ic.memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT mrv.display_name, mrv.memory_range_mb, mrv.memory_variance_mb, mrv.benchmark_memory_range_mb, mrv.variability_category, mvbd.avg_memory_mb, mvbd.memory_mb_variance, mvbd.benchmark AS variance_benchmark, mvbd.variance_category FROM MemoryRangeVariability mrv JOIN MemoryVarianceByDisplayName mvbd ON mrv.display_name = mvbd.display_name WHERE mrv.variability_category = 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' ORDER BY mrv.memory_range_mb DESC;

question: For instances in availability zone 'flare3' that have system metadata with KEY = 'image_image_type', list each instance display name along with (1) the minimum instance ID and its per-display-name average memory (MB) plus the overall benchmark and memory category, and (2) the same display name’s average and variance of memory (MB) for migrations with status = 'completed' (including the overall benchmark and memory category for completed migrations). Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each display name as 'HIGH_MEMORY' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_MEMORY' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_MEMORY'.
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(i.ID) AS min_instance_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ), AverageMemory AS ( SELECT AVG(avg_memory_mb) AS benchmark_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.min_instance_id, ic.avg_memory_mb, am.benchmark_avg_memory_mb AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.avg_memory_mb > am.benchmark_avg_memory_mb * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MEMORY' WHEN ic.avg_memory_mb < am.benchmark_avg_memory_mb * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MEMORY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MEMORY' END AS memory_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageMemory am ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), OverallBenchmark AS ( SELECT AVG(avg_memory_mb) AS benchmark_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT cte.DISPLAY_NAME, cte.avg_memory_mb, cte.memory_mb_variance, ob.benchmark_avg_memory_mb AS benchmark, CASE WHEN cte.avg_memory_mb > ob.benchmark_avg_memory_mb * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MEMORY' WHEN cte.avg_memory_mb < ob.benchmark_avg_memory_mb * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MEMORY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MEMORY' END AS memory_category FROM inner_cte cte CROSS JOIN OverallBenchmark ob ORDER BY cte.memory_mb_variance DESC ), q1_with_display_name AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, q1.min_instance_id, q1.avg_memory_mb AS az_avg_memory_mb, q1.benchmark AS az_benchmark_avg_memory_mb, q1.memory_category AS az_memory_category FROM q1 JOIN INSTANCES i ON i.ID = q1.min_instance_id WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' ) SELECT q1d.DISPLAY_NAME, q1d.min_instance_id, q1d.az_avg_memory_mb, q1d.az_benchmark_avg_memory_mb, q1d.az_memory_category, q2.avg_memory_mb AS completed_migrations_avg_memory_mb, q2.memory_mb_variance AS completed_migrations_memory_mb_variance, q2.benchmark AS completed_migrations_benchmark_avg_memory_mb, q2.memory_category AS completed_migrations_memory_category FROM q1_with_display_name q1d JOIN q2 ON q2.DISPLAY_NAME = q1d.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY q2.memory_mb_variance DESC;

question: For each VM state that appears in both (a) instances with a system metadata entry where key = 'image_image_type' and memory_mb > 0 and (b) instances that have a corresponding network info cache record, show the VM state, the geometric mean of instance memory (MB) and its overall average across VM states, plus the memory variance (MB) with its overall average benchmark and the variance category (HIGH_VARIANCE/LOW_VARIANCE/AVERAGE_VARIANCE), ordered by geometric-mean memory descending. Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each VM state as 'HIGH_VARIANCE' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_VARIANCE' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE'.
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.vm_state ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb, overall_avg.avg_geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_memory_mb) AS avg_geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) AS overall_avg ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.VM_STATE, ic.memory_mb_variance, ac.avg_memory_mb_variance AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.memory_mb_variance > ac.avg_memory_mb_variance * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN ic.memory_mb_variance < ac.avg_memory_mb_variance * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte ac ) SELECT q1.vm_state, q1.geometric_mean_memory_mb, q1.avg_geometric_mean_memory_mb, q2.memory_mb_variance, q2.benchmark AS avg_memory_mb_variance_benchmark, q2.variance_category FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.vm_state = q2.vm_state ORDER BY q1.geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC;

question: For instances in VM state "shelved_offloaded", return the instance ID, display name, availability zone, cached network info, the rank within each availability zone ordered by instance ID, and the deviation of each instance ID from the average instance ID across all such instances, along with the completed migration status, maximum total memory (MEMORY_TOTAL), and migration created timestamp for matching (non-deleted) instances where the completed migration’s memory utilization (MEMORY_PROCESSED divided by MEMORY_TOTAL) is greater than 75%. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.ID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, c.NETWORK_INFO, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ORDER BY i.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded'), avg_ids AS (SELECT AVG(ID) AS avg_instance_id FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.ID, ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, ic.NETWORK_INFO, ic.window_column, (ic.ID - ai.avg_instance_id) AS deviation_from_avg_instance_id FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_ids ai), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, m.status, MAX(m.memory_total) AS max_memory_total, m.created_at FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name, m.status, m.created_at HAVING MAX(m.memory_total) > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.status, inner_cte.max_memory_total, inner_cte.created_at FROM inner_cte JOIN migrations m ON m.created_at = inner_cte.created_at AND m.status = inner_cte.status JOIN instances i ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE m.memory_total > 0 AND (m.memory_processed * 1.0 / m.memory_total) > 0.75) SELECT q1.ID AS instance_id, q1.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, q1.AVAILABILITY_ZONE AS availability_zone, q1.NETWORK_INFO AS cached_network_info, q1.window_column AS rank_within_availability_zone_by_instance_id, q1.deviation_from_avg_instance_id, q2.status AS completed_migration_status, q2.max_memory_total AS completed_migration_max_memory_total, q2.created_at AS migration_created_at FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q2.display_name = q1.DISPLAY_NAME;

question: For each non-deleted instance display name, show (1) the network-info cache-record variability metrics (cache-count range, variance, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP)), including the overall average cache-count range benchmark and its variability category (HIGH_VARIABILITY/LOW_VARIABILITY/AVERAGE_VARIABILITY), and (2) the variance of instance memory (MB) across system metadata entries plus its deviation from the overall average memory variance, ordered by highest cache-count range and then highest memory variance. Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each display name as 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_VARIABILITY' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY'.
SQL: WITH CacheVariability AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(cache_row_count) - MIN(cache_row_count) AS cache_count_range, VARIANCE(cache_row_count) AS cache_count_variance, STDDEV(cache_row_count) AS cache_count_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN ( SELECT iic.INSTANCE_UUID, COUNT(*) AS cache_row_count FROM INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic GROUP BY iic.INSTANCE_UUID, iic.ID ) AS cache_stats ON cache_stats.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY cache_count_range DESC), AverageRange AS (SELECT AVG(cache_count_range) AS avg_cache_count_range FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.cache_count_range, ic.cache_count_variance, ic.cache_count_stddev, ar.avg_cache_count_range AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.cache_count_range > ar.avg_cache_count_range * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN ic.cache_count_range < ar.avg_cache_count_range * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageRange ar), MemoryVariance AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), avg_variance AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.memory_mb_variance, (ic.memory_mb_variance - av.avg_memory_mb_variance) AS deviation_from_avg_variance FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_variance av ORDER BY ic.memory_mb_variance DESC), CombinedDisplayNames AS ( SELECT cv.DISPLAY_NAME, cv.cache_count_range, cv.cache_count_variance, cv.cache_count_stddev, cv.benchmark AS avg_cache_count_range_benchmark, cv.variability_category, mv.memory_mb_variance, mv.deviation_from_avg_variance AS memory_variance_deviation_from_avg FROM CacheVariability cv JOIN MemoryVariance mv ON mv.DISPLAY_NAME = cv.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT * FROM CombinedDisplayNames ORDER BY cache_count_range DESC, memory_mb_variance DESC;

question: For instances whose display name is "forge", return the instance UUID, hostname, cached network_info JSON, and the running sum of instance IDs within each VM state (ordered by instance ID), along with the total number of "forge" instances per VM state and the average of those per-state totals across all VM states; also include (as overall migration context) the source compute, destination compute, memory processed ratio, and the total count of completed migrations for instances in the 'shelved_offloaded' VM state where more than 75% of migration memory has been processed. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH forge_instances AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID, i.HOSTNAME, c.NETWORK_INFO, SUM(i.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ) SELECT inner_cte.UUID, inner_cte.HOSTNAME, inner_cte.NETWORK_INFO, inner_cte.window_column, state_counts.total_forge_instances_in_state, avg_state_counts.avg_forge_instances_per_state FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, COUNT(*) AS total_forge_instances_in_state FROM INSTANCES AS i WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ) AS state_counts ON state_counts.VM_STATE = ( SELECT i2.VM_STATE FROM INSTANCES AS i2 WHERE i2.UUID = inner_cte.UUID ) JOIN ( SELECT AVG(state_total) AS avg_forge_instances_per_state FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS state_total FROM INSTANCES WHERE DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' GROUP BY VM_STATE ) AS per_state ) AS avg_state_counts ), completed_shelved_migrations AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS completed_migrations_for_shelved_instances FROM INSTANCES i JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' ) SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS instance_hostname, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS source_compute, m.DEST_COMPUTE AS dest_compute, (m.MEMORY_PROCESSED * 1.0 / NULLIF(m.MEMORY_TOTAL, 0)) AS memory_processed_ratio, inner_cte.completed_migrations_for_shelved_instances FROM INSTANCES i JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID CROSS JOIN inner_cte WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' AND (m.MEMORY_PROCESSED * 1.0 / NULLIF(m.MEMORY_TOTAL, 0)) > 0.75) SELECT fi.UUID AS forge_instance_uuid, fi.HOSTNAME AS forge_instance_hostname, fi.NETWORK_INFO AS forge_cached_network_info_json, fi.window_column AS running_sum_instance_ids_within_vm_state, fi.total_forge_instances_in_state, fi.avg_forge_instances_per_state, csm.source_compute, csm.dest_compute, csm.memory_processed_ratio, csm.completed_migrations_for_shelved_instances FROM forge_instances fi CROSS JOIN completed_shelved_migrations csm;

question: For completed migrations where the instance VM state is "shelved_offloaded", list (by migration type and VM state) the migration type, VM state, number of completed migrations, total instance memory (MB), and the minimum per-type windowed migration memory_total; also include how many distinct shelved_offloaded instances from the completed-migrations instance-level result set match that VM state and the average deviation of their per-status row number from the overall average row number. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS migration_source_compute, m.DEST_COMPUTE AS migration_dest_compute, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' AND m.STATUS = 'completed'), avg_window AS (SELECT AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_column FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.instance_display_name, ic.instance_vm_state, ic.migration_status, ic.migration_source_compute, ic.migration_dest_compute, ic.window_column, (ic.window_column - aw.avg_window_column) AS deviation_from_avg_row_number FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_window aw ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.MIGRATION_TYPE, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, m.MEMORY_TOTAL, MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) OVER (PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ), TypeStateAgg AS ( SELECT migration_type, vm_state, COUNT(*) AS completed_migrations, SUM(memory_mb) AS total_instance_memory_mb, MIN(window_column) AS min_memory_total_within_type FROM inner_cte GROUP BY migration_type, vm_state ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(migration_type) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE migration_type END AS migration_type, CASE WHEN GROUPING(vm_state) = 1 AND GROUPING(migration_type) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state, SUM(completed_migrations) AS completed_migrations, SUM(total_instance_memory_mb) AS total_instance_memory_mb, MIN(min_memory_total_within_type) AS min_memory_total_within_type FROM TypeStateAgg GROUP BY migration_type, vm_state WITH ROLLUP ) SELECT q2.migration_type, q2.vm_state, q2.completed_migrations, q2.total_instance_memory_mb, q2.min_memory_total_within_type, COUNT(DISTINCT q1.instance_uuid) AS shelved_offloaded_completed_instances, AVG(q1.deviation_from_avg_row_number) AS avg_deviation_from_avg_row_number FROM q2 LEFT JOIN q1 ON q1.instance_vm_state = q2.vm_state WHERE q2.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY q2.migration_type, q2.vm_state, q2.completed_migrations, q2.total_instance_memory_mb, q2.min_memory_total_within_type ORDER BY q2.migration_type, q2.vm_state;

question: For each (non-deleted) instance display name that has system metadata, show the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (MB) and how far it deviates from the overall average standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), along with the memory variance (MB) and how far it deviates from the overall average variance, ordered by the memory standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH stddev_by_display_name AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC ), avg_stddev AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_stddev) AS avg_memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb_stddev, (ic.memory_mb_stddev - a.avg_memory_mb_stddev) AS deviation_from_avg_stddev FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_stddev a ORDER BY ic.memory_mb_stddev DESC ), variance_by_display_name AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), avg_variance AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.memory_mb_variance, (ic.memory_mb_variance - av.avg_memory_mb_variance) AS deviation_from_avg_variance FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_variance av ORDER BY ic.memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT s.display_name, s.memory_mb_stddev, s.deviation_from_avg_stddev, v.memory_mb_variance, v.deviation_from_avg_variance FROM stddev_by_display_name s JOIN variance_by_display_name v ON s.display_name = v.display_name ORDER BY s.memory_mb_stddev DESC;

question: For availability zone 'flare3', among the top 10 instance display names with the most network info cache records (only including instances that are not deleted), which display names also appear in the top 10 by system metadata entries, and for each such display name show the cache record count, average memory (MB), average vCPU count, the metadata activity label (High/Low), and the number of display names in that label (excluding subtotals and the grand total)? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(iic.ID) AS cache_records FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY cache_records DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.cache_records, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, AVG(i.VCPUS) AS avg_vcpus FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES i ON i.DISPLAY_NAME = inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME AND i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.cache_records ORDER BY inner_cte.cache_records DESC ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(ism.id) AS metadata_entries FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY metadata_entries DESC LIMIT 10 ), LabeledTopDisplays AS ( SELECT ic.display_name, CASE WHEN ic.metadata_entries >= 5 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS metadata_activity, COUNT(DISTINCT ic.display_name) AS total_display_names FROM inner_cte ic GROUP BY ic.display_name, metadata_activity ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(metadata_activity) = 1 AND GROUPING(display_name) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE metadata_activity END AS metadata_activity, SUM(total_display_names) AS total_display_names FROM LabeledTopDisplays GROUP BY display_name, metadata_activity WITH ROLLUP ) SELECT q1.DISPLAY_NAME, q1.cache_records, q1.avg_memory_mb, q1.avg_vcpus, q2.metadata_activity, q2.total_display_names FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q2.display_name = q1.DISPLAY_NAME WHERE q2.display_name <> 'GRAND TOTAL' AND q2.metadata_activity <> 'SUBTOTAL' ORDER BY q1.cache_records DESC, q2.metadata_activity;

question: For each VM state and availability zone (including VM-state subtotals and a grand total), list the VM state, availability zone, and the total memory (MB) across non-deleted instances for only those VM states whose total memory exceeds the overall average memory plus one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP); also show, for the same availability zone, the total number of instances in VM state "shelved_offloaded" and the average number of such instances per availability zone. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH az_shelved_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.ID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, c.NETWORK_INFO, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ORDER BY i.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' ) SELECT inner_cte.AVAILABILITY_ZONE AS availability_zone, COUNT(inner_cte.ID) AS total_shelved_offloaded_instances, avg_az.avg_instance_count AS avg_shelved_offloaded_instances_per_az FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(instance_count) AS avg_instance_count FROM ( SELECT COUNT(ID) AS instance_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY AVAILABILITY_ZONE ) AS sub ) AS avg_az GROUP BY inner_cte.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, avg_az.avg_instance_count ), state_zone_memory_rollup AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.vm_state, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.vm_state HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > ( SELECT AVG(i2.memory_mb) + STDDEV(i2.memory_mb) FROM instances AS i2 JOIN instance_extra AS ie2 ON i2.uuid = ie2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.deleted = 0 ) ), StateZoneTotals AS ( SELECT i.vm_state, i.availability_zone, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid JOIN inner_cte ic ON ic.vm_state = i.vm_state WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.vm_state, i.availability_zone ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(vm_state) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state, CASE WHEN GROUPING(availability_zone) = 1 AND GROUPING(vm_state) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE availability_zone END AS availability_zone, SUM(total_memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM StateZoneTotals GROUP BY vm_state, availability_zone WITH ROLLUP ) SELECT szmr.vm_state, szmr.availability_zone, szmr.total_memory_mb, ass.total_shelved_offloaded_instances, ass.avg_shelved_offloaded_instances_per_az FROM state_zone_memory_rollup AS szmr LEFT JOIN az_shelved_stats AS ass ON szmr.availability_zone = ass.availability_zone ORDER BY szmr.vm_state, szmr.availability_zone;

question: How many distinct instance display names (1) have an average memory greater than the overall average among instances in the 'shelved_offloaded' VM state, and (2) have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type' (with variance categorized against the overall variance benchmark)? Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each display name as 'HIGH_VARIANCE' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_VARIANCE' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE'.
SQL: WITH shelved_offloaded_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.avg_memory_mb > ( SELECT AVG(i2.memory_mb) FROM instances AS i2 JOIN instance_extra AS ie2 ON i2.uuid = ie2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' ) ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_variance DESC ), image_image_type_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), VarianceBenchmark AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS avg_variance_benchmark FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.avg_memory_mb, ic.memory_mb_variance, vb.avg_variance_benchmark AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.memory_mb_variance > vb.avg_variance_benchmark * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN ic.memory_mb_variance < vb.avg_variance_benchmark * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN VarianceBenchmark vb ORDER BY ic.memory_mb_variance DESC ), combined_counts AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sos.display_name) AS shelved_offloaded_display_name_count, COUNT(DISTINCT iits.display_name) AS image_image_type_display_name_count FROM shelved_offloaded_stats sos CROSS JOIN image_image_type_stats iits ) SELECT cc.shelved_offloaded_display_name_count, cc.image_image_type_display_name_count FROM combined_counts cc;

question: For instances in availability zone "flare3" that have a migration with status "completed", show the migration type (suppressing repeats), instance UUID, instance display name, migration status, and the running sum of instance memory (MEMORY_MB) within each migration type ordered by instance memory; also include, for each instance display name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (in MB) among instances that have a system metadata entry with KEY = 'image_image_type'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, m.STATUS AS migration_status, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND m.STATUS = 'completed' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(m.MIGRATION_TYPE) OVER (ORDER BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.instance_uuid) = m.MIGRATION_TYPE THEN NULL ELSE m.MIGRATION_TYPE END AS migration_type, inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.instance_display_name, inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = inner_cte.instance_uuid AND m.STATUS = inner_cte.migration_status ORDER BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.instance_uuid), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, AVG(avg_memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, AVG(memory_mb_stddev) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY display_name WITH ROLLUP) SELECT q1.migration_type, q1.instance_uuid, q1.instance_display_name, q1.migration_status, q1.window_column, q2.avg_memory_mb, q2.memory_mb_stddev FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q2.display_name = q1.instance_display_name ORDER BY q1.migration_type, q1.window_column, q1.instance_uuid;

question: For confirmed migrations where the source compute is ether-60, list the migration ID, migration status, source compute, destination compute, destination host, instance UUID, instance display name, instance VM state, cached network info, and the row number within each migration status (ordered by migration ID), along with the total number of such migrations and the average number of such migrations per destination compute; only include rows whose instance display name is also among the “shelved_offloaded” instances with total memory greater than 50000 MB and greater than the average total memory of those qualifying instances, and show that total memory value as well. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH migration_details AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, c.NETWORK_INFO AS cached_network_info, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'confirmed' AND m.SOURCE_COMPUTE = 'ether-60' ) SELECT inner_cte.migration_id, inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.SOURCE_COMPUTE, inner_cte.DEST_COMPUTE, inner_cte.DEST_HOST, inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.instance_display_name, inner_cte.instance_vm_state, inner_cte.cached_network_info, inner_cte.window_column, COUNT(inner_cte.migration_id) OVER () AS total_confirmed_ether60_migrations, avg_by_dest.avg_migrations_per_dest_compute FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(migrations_per_dest) AS avg_migrations_per_dest_compute FROM ( SELECT DEST_COMPUTE, COUNT(*) AS migrations_per_dest FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEST_COMPUTE ) AS per_dest ) AS avg_by_dest ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY inner_cte.migration_id ), high_memory_shelved_instances AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) AS total_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME HAVING SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) > 50000) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.total_memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(inner_cte.total_memory_mb * 1.0) FROM inner_cte) ) SELECT md.migration_id,
