question: For instances whose display name is 'forge' and whose memory (MB) is greater than the overall average memory (MB) among the returned 'forge' rows, list the instance UUID, display name, memory (MB), system metadata key and value, the running average memory (MB) within the 'forge' display-name group ordered by memory, and also include (for the 'forge' display name) the variance of instance memory (MB) across its system metadata entries for non-deleted instances plus the overall average of these per-display-name variances across all display names. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH forge_instances_above_avg AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ) SELECT instance_uuid, display_name, memory_mb, metadata_key, metadata_value, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(memory_mb) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY memory_mb ), display_name_memory_variance AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, avg_variances.avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte ) AS avg_variances ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT f.instance_uuid, f.display_name, f.memory_mb, f.metadata_key, f.metadata_value, f.window_column, d.memory_mb_variance, d.avg_memory_mb_variance FROM forge_instances_above_avg f JOIN display_name_memory_variance d ON f.display_name = d.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY f.memory_mb;

question: Among the top 10 (display name, system-metadata key) groups for instances created in 2014 whose maximum memory is greater than 16000 MB, list all not-deleted instances whose display name matches one of those groups, showing the instance UUID, display name, VM state, power state, memory (MB), vCPUs, the windowed maximum INSTANCE_EXTRA id over the current and next 2 instances (ordered by UUID), the overall average of that windowed maximum and the instance’s deviation from it, along with the group’s metadata key, the group’s maximum memory (MB), and whether any instance in that group has that key with value 'neon'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH TopDisplayNameKeyGroups AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, ism.key, MAX(i.memory_mb) AS max_memory_mb FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.created_at) = 2014 GROUP BY i.display_name, ism.key HAVING MAX(i.memory_mb) > 16000 ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.key, inner_cte.max_memory_mb, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM instances i2 JOIN instance_system_metadata ism2 ON i2.uuid = ism2.instance_uuid WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i2.created_at) = 2014 AND i2.display_name = inner_cte.display_name AND ism2.key = inner_cte.key AND ism2.value = 'neon' ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_neon_value_for_key FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.max_memory_mb DESC LIMIT 10 ), InstanceWindowStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.power_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, MAX(ie.id) OVER (ORDER BY i.uuid ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_extra_id_next2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(max_instance_extra_id_next2) AS avg_max_instance_extra_id_next2 FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.uuid, ic.display_name, ic.vm_state, ic.power_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.vcpus, ic.max_instance_extra_id_next2, ac.avg_max_instance_extra_id_next2, (ic.max_instance_extra_id_next2 - ac.avg_max_instance_extra_id_next2) AS deviation_from_avg_max_next2 FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte ac ) SELECT iws.uuid, iws.display_name, iws.vm_state, iws.power_state, iws.memory_mb, iws.vcpus, iws.max_instance_extra_id_next2, iws.avg_max_instance_extra_id_next2, iws.deviation_from_avg_max_next2, tdkg.key AS system_metadata_key, tdkg.max_memory_mb AS group_max_memory_mb, tdkg.has_neon_value_for_key FROM InstanceWindowStats iws JOIN TopDisplayNameKeyGroups tdkg ON iws.display_name = tdkg.display_name ORDER BY tdkg.max_memory_mb DESC, iws.uuid;

question: In availability zone 'flare3', for instances whose total vCPUs across their system metadata rows is greater than 32, show only those whose display name also has a MEMORY_MB standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) greater than 5000 MB (among instances with extra instance metadata and a network info cache entry), and display the instance UUID, display name, key name, system metadata entry count, total vCPUs, MEMORY_MB standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and average MEMORY_MB. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN instances i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.display_name JOIN instance_extra ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev HAVING inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev > 5000 ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev DESC ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name, COUNT(ism.id) AS metadata_entry_count, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus FROM instances i JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name ) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.key_name, inner_cte.metadata_entry_count, inner_cte.total_vcpus FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.total_vcpus > 32 ) SELECT q2.instance_uuid, q2.display_name, q2.key_name, q2.metadata_entry_count, q2.total_vcpus, q1.memory_mb_stddev, q1.avg_memory_mb FROM q2 JOIN q1 ON q1.display_name = q2.display_name ORDER BY q1.memory_mb_stddev DESC;

question: For instances in availability zone "flare3" whose memory in MB is greater than the average memory in MB of all instances in that availability zone, and that also have display name "forge", list the instance UUID, display name, memory in MB, the instance extra flavor JSON, cached network info, the running average of memory in MB (ordered by memory), the system metadata key and value, the instance power state, the running sum of instance IDs within each power-state group (ordered by instance ID), and the total number of such metadata rows plus the average running-sum value across those rows. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH az_mem AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ie.FLAVOR AS flavor, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ) SELECT instance_uuid, display_name, memory_mb, flavor, network_info, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(memory_mb) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY memory_mb ), forge_metadata AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, ism.key AS metadata_key, ism.value AS metadata_value, i.power_state, SUM(i.id) OVER (PARTITION BY i.power_state ORDER BY i.id) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name = 'forge' ) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.metadata_key, inner_cte.metadata_value, inner_cte.power_state, inner_cte.window_column, stats.total_rows, stats.avg_window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rows, AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_column FROM inner_cte ) AS stats ON 1 = 1 ) SELECT az_mem.instance_uuid, az_mem.display_name, az_mem.memory_mb, az_mem.flavor, az_mem.network_info, az_mem.window_column AS az_running_avg_memory_mb, forge_metadata.metadata_key, forge_metadata.metadata_value, forge_metadata.power_state, forge_metadata.window_column AS forge_running_sum_instance_ids, forge_metadata.total_rows AS forge_total_rows, forge_metadata.avg_window_column AS forge_avg_running_sum_instance_ids FROM az_mem JOIN forge_metadata ON az_mem.instance_uuid = forge_metadata.instance_uuid ORDER BY az_mem.memory_mb;

question: From the top 10 instance display names with the highest number of completed migrations (considering only instances that have an `image_image_type` entry in instance system metadata), display each display name, the completed migration count, the total vCPUs, the total memory (MB), whether any of those instances have a non-completed migration, and also the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of memory remaining (in bytes) across completed migrations plus the deviation of that instance’s average memory remaining from the overall average across all instances. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(m.memory_remaining) AS avg_memory_remaining_bytes, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) AS memory_remaining_stddev_bytes FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_remaining_stddev_bytes DESC ), overall_avg AS ( SELECT AVG(avg_memory_remaining_bytes) AS overall_avg_memory_remaining_bytes FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.avg_memory_remaining_bytes, ic.memory_remaining_stddev_bytes, (ic.avg_memory_remaining_bytes - oa.overall_avg_memory_remaining_bytes) AS deviation_from_overall_avg_bytes FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa ORDER BY ic.memory_remaining_stddev_bytes DESC ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(m.id) AS migrations FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migrations DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.migrations AS completed_migrations, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM migrations m2 JOIN instances i2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism2 ON i2.uuid = ism2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.display_name = inner_cte.display_name AND ism2.key = 'image_image_type' AND m2.status <> 'completed' ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_non_completed_migrations FROM inner_cte JOIN instances i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.display_name JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.migrations ORDER BY inner_cte.migrations DESC ) SELECT q2.display_name, q2.completed_migrations, q2.total_vcpus, q2.total_memory_mb, q2.has_non_completed_migrations, q1.avg_memory_remaining_bytes, q1.memory_remaining_stddev_bytes, q1.deviation_from_overall_avg_bytes FROM q2 JOIN q1 ON q1.display_name = q2.display_name ORDER BY q2.completed_migrations DESC;

question: For the top 10 instance display names in availability zone 'flare3' with the most network info cache records, list the display name and its cache record count, the overall average cache record count across those top 10 and the deviation from that average, and also include the display name’s average and variance of instance memory (MB) for instances that have system metadata key 'image_image_type' (and are not deleted in metadata), plus the deviation of that average memory from the overall average memory across all such instances; finally compute the average memory per cache record (average memory divided by cache record count).
SQL: WITH mem_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND ism.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), overall_avg AS ( SELECT AVG(avg_memory_mb) AS overall_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.avg_memory_mb, ic.memory_mb_variance, (ic.avg_memory_mb - oa.overall_avg_memory_mb) AS deviation_from_overall_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa ORDER BY ic.memory_mb_variance DESC ), net_cache_top10 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(iic.id) AS cache_records FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY cache_records DESC LIMIT 10 ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(cache_records) AS avg_cache_records FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.cache_records, ac.avg_cache_records, (ic.cache_records - ac.avg_cache_records) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte ac ORDER BY ic.cache_records DESC ) SELECT nct.display_name, nct.cache_records, nct.avg_cache_records, nct.deviation_from_avg, ms.avg_memory_mb, ms.memory_mb_variance, ms.deviation_from_overall_avg_memory_mb, ROUND(ms.avg_memory_mb / NULLIF(nct.cache_records, 0), 2) AS avg_memory_mb_per_cache_record FROM net_cache_top10 nct JOIN mem_stats ms ON ms.display_name = nct.display_name ORDER BY nct.cache_records DESC;

question: For each instance display name whose non-deleted instances have an average memory size greater than 16384 MB, and restricting to non-deleted instances in availability zone 'flare3', list the display name along with its memory range and variance (in MB), its average memory (in MB), and summarize the dense-rank-by-memory window metric by reporting the average dense rank for that display name, the overall benchmark dense-rank average, and counts of instances categorized as HIGH_RANK, LOW_RANK, or AVERAGE_RANK. Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each instance as 'HIGH_RANK' (at least 50% above the average), 'LOW_RANK' (at least 50% below the average), or 'AVERAGE_RANK'.
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_range_mb, inner_cte.memory_variance_mb, AVG(i2.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i2 ON i2.display_name = inner_cte.display_name JOIN instance_extra AS ie2 ON i2.uuid = ie2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.deleted = 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_range_mb, inner_cte.memory_variance_mb HAVING AVG(i2.memory_mb) > 16384 ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_range_mb DESC ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.UUID AS instance_uuid, t2.VALUE AS metadata_value, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND t2.KEY = 'image_image_type'), AverageRank AS ( SELECT AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_rank FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.metadata_value, ic.window_column, ar.avg_window_rank AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.window_column > ar.avg_window_rank * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_RANK' WHEN ic.window_column < ar.avg_window_rank * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_RANK' ELSE 'AVERAGE_RANK' END AS rank_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageRank ar ) SELECT q1.display_name, q1.memory_range_mb, q1.memory_variance_mb, q1.avg_memory_mb, AVG(q2.window_column) AS avg_dense_rank_for_display_name, AVG(q2.benchmark) AS overall_rank_benchmark, SUM(CASE WHEN q2.rank_category = 'HIGH_RANK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_rank_instances, SUM(CASE WHEN q2.rank_category = 'LOW_RANK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low_rank_instances, SUM(CASE WHEN q2.rank_category = 'AVERAGE_RANK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS average_rank_instances FROM q1 JOIN instances i ON i.display_name = q1.display_name JOIN q2 ON q2.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY q1.display_name, q1.memory_range_mb, q1.memory_variance_mb, q1.avg_memory_mb ORDER BY q1.memory_range_mb DESC;

question: For non-deleted instances in the VM state “shelved_offloaded”, show the (non-repeated) system metadata key, instance UUID, display name, power state, metadata value, cached network_info JSON, the per-metadata-key row number, plus the total rows and average power state per metadata key; also attach (when available by matching display name and network_info) the non-deleted instance details for instances whose memory_mb is greater than the average memory_mb of all non-deleted instances, including that instance’s display name, VM state, memory_mb, cached network_info JSON, and dense rank by project_id. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(metadata_key) OVER (ORDER BY metadata_key, instance_uuid) = metadata_key THEN NULL ELSE metadata_key END AS metadata_key, instance_uuid, display_name, power_state, metadata_value, network_info, window_column, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY metadata_key) AS total_rows_per_key, AVG(power_state) OVER (PARTITION BY metadata_key) AS avg_power_state_per_key FROM inner_cte ORDER BY metadata_key, instance_uuid), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.project_id ORDER BY i.project_id) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.network_info, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(i2.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb FROM instances AS i2 WHERE i2.deleted = 0 ) AS mem_avg ON 1 = 1 WHERE inner_cte.memory_mb > mem_avg.avg_memory_mb) SELECT q1.metadata_key, q1.instance_uuid, q1.display_name AS shelved_display_name, q1.power_state, q1.metadata_value, q1.network_info AS shelved_network_info, q1.window_column AS per_key_row_number, q1.total_rows_per_key, q1.avg_power_state_per_key, q2.display_name AS high_mem_display_name, q2.vm_state AS high_mem_vm_state, q2.memory_mb AS high_mem_memory_mb, q2.network_info AS high_mem_network_info, q2.window_column AS high_mem_dense_rank FROM q1 LEFT JOIN q2 ON q1.display_name = q2.display_name AND q1.network_info = q2.network_info ORDER BY q1.metadata_key, q1.instance_uuid;

question: For the 10 instance display names with the highest standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of memory remaining (bytes) across completed migrations, show each display name’s average memory remaining, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and deviation from the overall average memory remaining, and also show the variance of instance memory size (MB) for that display name (only where instances have a matching INSTANCE_EXTRA row), along with the overall average of those variances and the display name’s deviation from that overall average. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH mem_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(m.memory_remaining) AS avg_memory_remaining_bytes, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) AS memory_remaining_stddev_bytes FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_remaining_stddev_bytes DESC ), overall_avg AS ( SELECT AVG(avg_memory_remaining_bytes) AS overall_avg_memory_remaining_bytes FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.avg_memory_remaining_bytes, ic.memory_remaining_stddev_bytes, (ic.avg_memory_remaining_bytes - oa.overall_avg_memory_remaining_bytes) AS deviation_from_overall_avg_bytes FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa ORDER BY ic.memory_remaining_stddev_bytes DESC ), mem_variance AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), avg_variance AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb_variance) AS avg_memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb_variance, av.avg_memory_mb_variance, (ic.memory_mb_variance - av.avg_memory_mb_variance) AS deviation_from_avg_variance FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_variance av ORDER BY deviation_from_avg_variance DESC ), HighStddevDisplayNames AS ( SELECT ms.display_name FROM mem_stats ms WHERE ms.memory_remaining_stddev_bytes IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ms.memory_remaining_stddev_bytes DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT ms.display_name, ms.avg_memory_remaining_bytes, ms.memory_remaining_stddev_bytes, ms.deviation_from_overall_avg_bytes, mv.memory_mb_variance, mv.avg_memory_mb_variance, mv.deviation_from_avg_variance FROM mem_stats ms JOIN mem_variance mv ON ms.display_name = mv.display_name WHERE ms.display_name IN (SELECT display_name FROM HighStddevDisplayNames) ORDER BY ms.memory_remaining_stddev_bytes DESC, ms.display_name;

question: For instances that are not deleted and are running on host "prime-35", show (by availability zone and VM state) the instance count and earliest instance creation time, and also include for the same VM state whether migrations are Active or Inactive (using the same active-migration status filter) along with the average variance of migration memory total. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "prime-35" is predicated by "instances.host = 'prime-35'" "Active migrations" is predicated by "migrations.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed')"
SQL: WITH InstanceZoneStateRollup AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, ins.VM_STATE, COUNT(ins.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(ins.CREATED_AT) AS earliest_created_at FROM INSTANCES AS ins JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID WHERE ins.DELETED = 0 AND ins.HOST = 'prime-35' GROUP BY ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, ins.VM_STATE ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(AVAILABILITY_ZONE) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE AVAILABILITY_ZONE END AS AVAILABILITY_ZONE, CASE WHEN GROUPING(VM_STATE) = 1 AND GROUPING(AVAILABILITY_ZONE) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE VM_STATE END AS VM_STATE, SUM(instance_count) AS instance_count, MIN(earliest_created_at) AS earliest_created_at FROM inner_cte GROUP BY AVAILABILITY_ZONE, VM_STATE WITH ROLLUP ), VmStateMigrationActivityRollup AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, VARIANCE(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS memory_total_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND m.STATUS NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_total_variance DESC ), VmStateMigrationActivity AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MIGRATIONS m2 WHERE m2.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID AND m2.STATUS NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') ) THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS migration_activity, AVG(inner_cte.memory_total_variance) AS avg_memory_total_variance FROM INSTANCES i JOIN inner_cte ON inner_cte.VM_STATE = i.VM_STATE WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, migration_activity ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(VM_STATE) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE VM_STATE END AS VM_STATE, CASE WHEN GROUPING(migration_activity) = 1 AND GROUPING(VM_STATE) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE migration_activity END AS migration_activity, AVG(avg_memory_total_variance) AS avg_memory_total_variance FROM VmStateMigrationActivity GROUP BY VM_STATE, migration_activity WITH ROLLUP ) SELECT izs.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, izs.VM_STATE, izs.instance_count, izs.earliest_created_at, vma.migration_activity, vma.avg_memory_total_variance FROM InstanceZoneStateRollup izs JOIN VmStateMigrationActivityRollup vma ON vma.VM_STATE = izs.VM_STATE WHERE izs.AVAILABILITY_ZONE <> 'GRAND TOTAL' AND izs.VM_STATE <> 'SUBTOTAL' AND vma.VM_STATE <> 'GRAND TOTAL' ORDER BY izs.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, izs.VM_STATE, vma.migration_activity;

question: For non-deleted instances running on host "blaze8-12" in availability zone "flare3" whose average memory per linked instance_extra record is greater than 16384 MB and whose memory is above the average memory of all non-deleted instances on that host, list the instance UUID, display name, network_info cache, extra_record_count, total_memory_mb, VM state, the system metadata key and value, and the rank of each metadata row within its metadata key group (ordered by instance UUID). Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"

imr.memory_mb, imr.vcpus, imr.metadata_key, imr.metadata_value, imr.window_column, imr.metadata_rows_per_instance, mic.max_instance_count_across_zones FROM InstanceMetadataRollup imr JOIN MaxInstanceCountByVmStateOnPrime35 mic ON imr.vm_state = mic.VM_STATE ORDER BY imr.instance_uuid, imr.metadata_key;

question: For completed migrations, show the per-row migration/instance/system-metadata details for instances on host “ether-18” (with destination compute suppressed when it repeats), including for each destination compute the total rows returned and the minimum migration memory remaining; also include the host-level metric for host “blaze8-12” (the maximum across instances of each instance’s minimum observed memory remaining) and compute the ratio of the destination-compute minimum memory remaining to that blaze8-12 host metric.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'" Host "ether-18" is predicated by "instances.host = 'ether-18'"
SQL: WITH blaze_host_minmax AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.HOSTNAME AS instance_hostname, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS migration_source_compute, m.DEST_COMPUTE AS migration_dest_compute, m.DEST_HOST AS migration_dest_host, m.MIGRATION_TYPE AS migration_type, m.MEMORY_TOTAL AS memory_total, m.MEMORY_PROCESSED AS memory_processed, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER (PARTITION BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY m.INSTANCE_UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES i JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT i.HOST AS instance_host, MAX(inner_cte.window_column) AS max_of_instance_min_memory_remaining FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES i ON i.UUID = inner_cte.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.HOST), ether_dest_compute_details AS (WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, m.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS instance_vcpus, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS migration_memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ORDER BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'ether-18' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(DEST_COMPUTE) OVER (ORDER BY DEST_COMPUTE, migration_id, metadata_key) = DEST_COMPUTE THEN NULL ELSE DEST_COMPUTE END AS dest_compute, migration_id, migration_status, SOURCE_COMPUTE, DEST_HOST, INSTANCE_UUID, instance_display_name, instance_vm_state, instance_memory_mb, instance_vcpus, metadata_key, metadata_value, migration_memory_remaining, window_column AS min_migration_memory_remaining_in_dest_compute, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY DEST_COMPUTE) AS total_rows_in_dest_compute FROM inner_cte ORDER BY DEST_COMPUTE, migration_id, metadata_key) SELECT ed.dest_compute, ed.total_rows_in_dest_compute, ed.min_migration_memory_remaining_in_dest_compute, bh.instance_host AS blaze_instance_host, bh.max_of_instance_min_memory_remaining, ROUND( ed.min_migration_memory_remaining_in_dest_compute / NULLIF(bh.max_of_instance_min_memory_remaining, 0), 4 ) AS min_dest_compute_memory_remaining_to_blaze_max_instance_min_ratio FROM ether_dest_compute_details ed CROSS JOIN blaze_host_minmax bh ORDER BY ed.dest_compute, ed.migration_id, ed.metadata_key;

question: For each instance display name matching the regular expression 'prime', considering only migrations with STATUS = 'completed', which instance display names have an average instance memory greater than 16384 MB, and what are (1) the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of migration MEMORY_REMAINING for that display name, (2) the overall average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all such display names, and (3) the average and variance of instance MEMORY_MB? Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "Display 'prime'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'prime'"
SQL: WITH cov_results AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), avg_cov AS ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, avg_cov.avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte JOIN avg_cov ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC ), memory_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.avg_memory_mb > 16384 ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT cr.display_name, cr.coefficient_of_variation, cr.avg_coefficient_of_variation, ms.avg_memory_mb, ms.memory_mb_variance FROM cov_results cr JOIN memory_stats ms ON cr.display_name = ms.display_name ORDER BY cr.coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For instances in availability zone "flare3" running on host "blaze8-12", list each instance’s (possibly de-duplicated) VM state, instance UUID, display name, memory (MB), vCPUs, and instance extra ID, along with the instance extra flavor JSON and system metadata key/value; also include the row number within each VM state (ordered by instance UUID) and the row number within each metadata key group (ordered by instance UUID), plus for each metadata key the total number of matching rows for that key and the average number of rows per key across all keys in this filtered set. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH metadata_rows AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.FLAVOR AS flavor, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.vcpus, inner_cte.flavor, inner_cte.metadata_key, inner_cte.metadata_value, inner_cte.window_column, key_counts.total_rows_for_key, avg_counts.avg_rows_per_key FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT metadata_key, COUNT(*) AS total_rows_for_key FROM inner_cte GROUP BY metadata_key ) AS key_counts ON key_counts.metadata_key = inner_cte.metadata_key JOIN ( SELECT AVG(rows_per_key) AS avg_rows_per_key FROM ( SELECT metadata_key, COUNT(*) AS rows_per_key FROM inner_cte GROUP BY metadata_key ) AS per_key ) AS avg_counts ON 1 = 1 ), vmstate_rows AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(vm_state) OVER (ORDER BY vm_state, instance_uuid) = vm_state THEN NULL ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state, instance_uuid, display_name, memory_mb, vcpus, instance_extra_id, window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY vm_state, instance_uuid ) SELECT v.vm_state, v.instance_uuid, v.display_name, v.memory_mb, v.vcpus, v.instance_extra_id, v.window_column AS vm_state_row_number, m.flavor, m.metadata_key, m.metadata_value, m.window_column AS metadata_key_row_number, m.total_rows_for_key, m.avg_rows_per_key FROM vmstate_rows v JOIN metadata_rows m ON m.instance_uuid = v.instance_uuid ORDER BY v.vm_state, v.instance_uuid, m.metadata_key, m.window_column;

question: For the top 10 instances (by range of system-metadata rows per completed migration) whose display name matches the regular expression 'prime', list each instance’s display name, the range/variance/standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of system-metadata rows per completed migration, whether it has any active (non-completed/non-failed/non-error) non-deleted migrations, and also the range/variance/standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of non-deleted system-metadata entries per instance (for instances with a non-deleted network info cache) plus the deviation of that display name’s average metadata-entry count from the overall average across all such 'prime' display names. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "Display 'prime'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'prime'"
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(migration_metadata_count) - MIN(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_range, VARIANCE(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_variance, STDDEV(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN ( SELECT m.instance_uuid, m.id AS migration_id, COUNT(ism.id) AS migration_metadata_count FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i2 ON m.instance_uuid = i2.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i2.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.id ) AS per_migration_stats ON i.uuid = per_migration_stats.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY metadata_count_range DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.metadata_count_range, inner_cte.metadata_count_variance, inner_cte.metadata_count_stddev, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM migrations m2 JOIN instances i3 ON m2.instance_uuid = i3.uuid WHERE i3.display_name = inner_cte.display_name AND m2.deleted = 0 AND m2.status NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error') ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_migrations FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.metadata_count_range DESC LIMIT 10 ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(meta_entry_count) - MIN(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_range, VARIANCE(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_variance, STDDEV(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN ( SELECT i2.DISPLAY_NAME, i2.UUID, COUNT(*) AS meta_entry_count FROM INSTANCES AS i2 JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i2.UUID WHERE ism.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i2.DISPLAY_NAME, i2.UUID ) AS per_instance_meta ON per_instance_meta.UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE iic.DELETED = 0 AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY metadata_count_range DESC ), PerDisplayNameAvg AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, AVG(per_instance_meta.meta_entry_count) AS avg_meta_entries_per_instance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN ( SELECT i2.DISPLAY_NAME, i2.UUID, COUNT(*) AS meta_entry_count FROM INSTANCES AS i2 JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i2.UUID WHERE ism.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i2.DISPLAY_NAME, i2.UUID ) AS per_instance_meta ON per_instance_meta.UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE iic.DELETED = 0 AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ), OverallAvg AS ( SELECT AVG(avg_meta_entries_per_instance) AS overall_avg_meta_entries FROM PerDisplayNameAvg ) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.metadata_count_range, ic.metadata_count_variance, ic.metadata_count_stddev, (pda.avg_meta_entries_per_instance - oa.overall_avg_meta_entries) AS deviation_from_overall_avg FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN PerDisplayNameAvg AS pda ON pda.DISPLAY_NAME = ic.DISPLAY_NAME CROSS JOIN OverallAvg AS oa ORDER BY ic.metadata_count_range DESC ) SELECT q1.display_name, q1.metadata_count_range AS completed_migration_metadata_count_range, q1.metadata_count_variance AS completed_migration_metadata_count_variance, q1.metadata_count_stddev AS completed_migration_metadata_count_stddev, q1.has_active_migrations, q2.metadata_count_range AS per_instance_metadata_count_range, q2.metadata_count_variance AS per_instance_metadata_count_variance, q2.metadata_count_stddev AS per_instance_metadata_count_stddev, q2.deviation_from_overall_avg FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q2.DISPLAY_NAME = q1.display_name ORDER BY q1.metadata_count_range DESC;

question: For instances whose system metadata key is image_image_type, show (by instance display name) the average memory (MB) and memory standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) for display names matching the pattern prime (including subtotals and a grand total), and for those same display names also list the metadata value and cached network info for instances hosted on blaze8-12, including the instance UUID and the instance info cache record ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "Display 'prime'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'prime'" Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH mem_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, AVG(avg_memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, AVG(memory_mb_stddev) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY display_name WITH ROLLUP), host_metadata_network AS (WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.DISPLAY_NAME, t0.VALUE AS metadata_value, t2.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t0.VALUE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND t1.host = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.metadata_value, inner_cte.NETWORK_INFO, inner_cte.window_column, i.UUID AS instance_uuid, iic.ID AS instance_info_cache_id FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON i.DISPLAY_NAME = inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID) SELECT ms.display_name, ms.avg_memory_mb, ms.memory_mb_stddev, hmn.metadata_value, hmn.network_info, hmn.window_column, hmn.instance_uuid, hmn.instance_info_cache_id FROM mem_stats AS ms JOIN host_metadata_network AS hmn ON hmn.display_name = ms.display_name WHERE ms.display_name REGEXP 'prime';

question: For the top 10 instance display names (in availability zone 'flare3' on host 'blaze8-12' with system metadata KEY = 'image_image_type') ranked by average memory (MB), show each display name, its minimum instance ID, its average memory, whether any instance with that display name has system metadata KEY = 'image_image_location', and how many rows of completed migrations on host 'blaze8-12' (keeping only instances whose memory is > 75% of the maximum among those completed migrations) match that same display name. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH sq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(i.ID) AS min_instance_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.min_instance_id, ic.avg_memory_mb, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM INSTANCES i2 JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism2 ON i2.UUID = ism2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i2.DISPLAY_NAME = ic.DISPLAY_NAME AND i2.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i2.HOST = 'blaze8-12' AND ism2.KEY = 'image_image_location' ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_image_location_metadata FROM inner_cte ic ORDER BY ic.avg_memory_mb DESC LIMIT 10 ), sq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.MEMORY_MB, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT inner_cte.migration_id, inner_cte.SOURCE_COMPUTE, inner_cte.DEST_COMPUTE, inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.MEMORY_MB, inner_cte.metadata_key, inner_cte.metadata_value, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT MAX(MEMORY_MB) AS max_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) AS mem_stats WHERE (inner_cte.MEMORY_MB * 1.0 / mem_stats.max_memory_mb) > 0.75 ) SELECT s1.DISPLAY_NAME, s1.min_instance_id, s1.avg_memory_mb, s1.has_image_location_metadata, COUNT(s2.migration_id) AS completed_migration_rows_over_75pct_max_mem FROM sq1 s1 LEFT JOIN sq2 s2 ON s2.DISPLAY_NAME = s1.DISPLAY_NAME GROUP BY s1.DISPLAY_NAME, s1.min_instance_id, s1.avg_memory_mb, s1.has_image_location_metadata ORDER BY s1.avg_memory_mb DESC;

question: For instances running on host 'blaze8-12' (limited to instances with more than 8 VCPUs) and considering only migrations with status 'completed', for each VM state and display name that has a minimum memory at least 75% of the maximum minimum-memory across the returned groups, show the VM state, display name, number of instances, minimum memory (MB) and its ratio vs the maximum minimum-memory, along with that VM state’s migration memory-moved range and variance, the overall average memory-moved range benchmark across VM states, and the VM state’s variability category. Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each VM state as 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_VARIABILITY' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY'.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VCPUS > 8 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.instance_count, inner_cte.min_memory_mb, (inner_cte.min_memory_mb * 1.0 / max_vals.max_min_memory_mb) AS min_memory_vs_max_ratio FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT MAX(min_memory_mb) AS max_min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) AS max_vals ON 1 = 1 WHERE (inner_cte.min_memory_mb * 1.0 / max_vals.max_min_memory_mb) >= 0.75 ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, MAX(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) - MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS memory_total_range, VARIANCE(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS memory_total_variance FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_total_range DESC), AverageRange AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_total_range) AS avg_memory_total_range FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.VM_STATE, ic.memory_total_range, ic.memory_total_variance, ar.avg_memory_total_range AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.memory_total_range > ar.avg_memory_total_range * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN ic.memory_total_range < ar.avg_memory_total_range * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageRange ar ORDER BY ic.memory_total_range DESC ) SELECT q1.VM_STATE, q1.DISPLAY_NAME, q1.instance_count, q1.min_memory_mb, q1.min_memory_vs_max_ratio, q2.memory_total_range, q2.memory_total_variance, q2.benchmark AS avg_memory_total_range_benchmark, q2.variability_category FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.VM_STATE = q2.VM_STATE ORDER BY q2.memory_total_range DESC, q1.instance_count DESC;

question: For instances whose display name matches the pattern 'prime' and that are among the top 10 by standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of completed-migration MEMORY_TOTAL (only including display names with more than 5 completed migration records), show the instance display name, its MEMORY_TOTAL standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), whether it has any active (non-completed/non-failed/non-error) non-deleted migrations, and—restricted to those same instances that are on host blaze8-12 with system metadata key image_image_type—also show the instance UUID, the metadata key/value, cached network info, the rolling average instance memory (MB) over 2 preceding and 2 following rows (partitioned by metadata value and ordered by created-at), and whether the instance has any other non-deleted system metadata keys besides image_image_type. SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_stddev FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_total_stddev DESC ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_total_stddev, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM migrations m2 JOIN instances i2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid JOIN instance_extra ie2 ON i2.uuid = ie2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.display_name = ic.display_name AND m2.deleted = 0 AND m2.status NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error') ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_migrations FROM inner_cte ic ORDER BY ic.memory_total_stddev DESC LIMIT 10 ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY ism.VALUE ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT ) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.instance_display_name, ic.metadata_key, ic.metadata_value, ic.network_info, ic.window_column AS avg_memory_mb_window_2_pre_2_fol, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism2 WHERE ism2.INSTANCE_UUID = ic.instance_uuid AND ism2.KEY <> 'image_image_type' AND ism2.DELETED = 0 ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_other_system_metadata FROM inner_cte ic ORDER BY ic.instance_uuid, ic.metadata_value ) SELECT q1.display_name, q1.memory_total_stddev, q1.has_active_migrations, q2.instance_uuid, q2.metadata_key, q2.metadata_value, q2.network_info, oa.overall_avg_root_gb) AS deviation_from_overall_avg_root_gb FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa ORDER BY ic.root_gb_stddev DESC ), instance_metadata_rows AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.FLAVOR AS flavor, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.vcpus, inner_cte.flavor, inner_cte.metadata_key, inner_cte.metadata_value, inner_cte.window_column, key_counts.total_rows_for_key, avg_counts.avg_rows_per_key FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT metadata_key, COUNT(*) AS total_rows_for_key FROM inner_cte GROUP BY metadata_key ) AS key_counts ON key_counts.metadata_key = inner_cte.metadata_key JOIN ( SELECT AVG(rows_per_key) AS avg_rows_per_key FROM ( SELECT metadata_key, COUNT(*) AS rows_per_key FROM inner_cte GROUP BY metadata_key ) AS per_key ) AS avg_counts ON 1 = 1 ) SELECT imr.instance_uuid, imr.display_name, imr.memory_mb, imr.vcpus, imr.flavor, imr.metadata_key, imr.metadata_value, imr.window_column, imr.total_rows_for_key, imr.avg_rows_per_key, rsbdn.avg_root_gb, rsbdn.root_gb_stddev, rsbdn.deviation_from_overall_avg_root_gb FROM instance_metadata_rows imr JOIN root_stats_by_display_name rsbdn ON rsbdn.display_name = imr.display_name WHERE imr.display_name IN ( SELECT i.display_name FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ) ORDER BY rsbdn.root_gb_stddev DESC, imr.metadata_key, imr.instance_uuid;

question: For each non-deleted instance display name matching the pattern 'prime' (and with a non-deleted network info cache record), show the display name, total number of qualifying instances, average instance memory (MB), variance of instance memory (MB), and the maximum (worst-case) standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the network info cache update lag (in days) for that display name, including a grand total row. SQL: WITH mem_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND ic.deleted = 0 AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY display_sort, display_name) = display_name THEN NULL ELSE display_name END AS display_name, total_instances, avg_memory_mb, memory_mb_variance FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.display_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.display_name END AS display_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.display_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.display_name END AS display_name, COUNT(i.id) AS total_instances, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid JOIN inner_cte ON inner_cte.display_name = i.display_name WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND ic.deleted = 0 AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY display_sort, display_name ), lag_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(c.updated_at - i.created_at) AS avg_cache_update_lag, STDDEV(c.updated_at - i.created_at) AS cache_update_lag_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY cache_update_lag_stddev DESC) SELECT display_name, MAX(cache_update_lag_stddev) AS max_cache_update_lag_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY display_name ) SELECT mem_stats.display_name, mem_stats.total_instances, mem_stats.avg_memory_mb, mem_stats.memory_mb_variance, lag_stats.max_cache_update_lag_stddev FROM mem_stats LEFT JOIN lag_stats ON lag_stats.display_name = mem_stats.display_name ORDER BY mem_stats.display_name;

SQL: WITH root_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, AVG(i.ROOT_GB) AS avg_root_gb, MAX(i.ROOT_GB) - MIN(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_range, VARIANCE(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY root_gb_range DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.avg_root_gb, inner_cte.root_gb_range, inner_cte.root_gb_variance, overall_avg.avg_of_vmstate_avg_root_gb FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(avg_root_gb) AS avg_of_vmstate_avg_root_gb FROM inner_cte ) AS overall_avg ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY inner_cte.root_gb_range DESC ), migration_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, MAX(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) - MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS memory_total_range, VARIANCE(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS memory_total_variance FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_total_range DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.memory_total_range, inner_cte.memory_total_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.memory_total_range > 10000000000 ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_total_range DESC ) SELECT ms.VM_STATE, rs.avg_root_gb, rs.root_gb_range, rs.root_gb_variance, rs.avg_of_vmstate_avg_root_gb, ms.memory_total_range, ms.memory_total_variance FROM migration_stats AS ms JOIN root_stats AS rs ON ms.VM_STATE = rs.VM_STATE ORDER BY ms.memory_total_range DESC;

question: For completed migrations where the instance display name matches the pattern 'prime', show the instance UUID, instance display name, migration status, source compute host, destination compute host, migration memory total, the 2-preceding/2-following window average of migration memory total within the instance availability zone, and the instance project ID, vCPU count, and memory (MB); also indicate whether that same instance UUID has any completed migrations whose instance display name matches the pattern 'flare', and include the overall average migration id across those returned 'flare' migrations. am.avg_migration_id) AS deviation_from_overall_avg_migration_id FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_migration am ORDER BY ic.migration_id ) SELECT pm.instance_uuid, pm.instance_display_name, pm.migration_status, pm.source_compute, pm.dest_compute, pm.memory_total, pm.window_column AS prime_memory_total_window_avg, pm.instance_project_id, pm.instance_vcpus, pm.instance_memory_mb, fm.avg_migration_id AS flare_overall_avg_migration_id, CASE WHEN COUNT(fm.migration_id) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS Has_Completed_Flare_Migrations FROM prime_migrations pm LEFT JOIN flare_migrations fm ON fm.INSTANCE_UUID = pm.instance_uuid WHERE pm.migration_status = 'completed' GROUP BY pm.instance_uuid, pm.instance_display_name, pm.migration_status, pm.source_compute, pm.dest_compute, pm.memory_total, pm.window_column, pm.instance_project_id, pm.instance_vcpus, pm.instance_memory_mb, fm.avg_migration_id ORDER BY pm.memory_total;

avg_counts.avg_completed_migrations_per_state, inner_cte.completed_migrations_for_shelved_instances ) SELECT izsr.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, izsr.VM_STATE, izsr.instance_count, izsr.earliest_created_at, SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'prime-35' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, SUM(memory_range_mb) AS total_memory_range_mb, AVG(memory_variance_mb) AS avg_memory_variance_mb FROM inner_cte GROUP BY display_name WITH ROLLUP ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb, SUM(i.VCPUS) AS total_vcpus FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ), KeyAgg AS ( SELECT ism.KEY AS metadata_key, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb, SUM(i.VCPUS) AS total_vcpus FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY ism.KEY ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(metadata_key) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE metadata_key END AS metadata_key, SUM(min_memory_mb) AS min_memory_mb, SUM(total_vcpus) AS total_vcpus, (SELECT min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte) AS overall_min_memory_mb, (SELECT total_vcpus FROM inner_cte) AS overall_total_vcpus FROM KeyAgg GROUP BY metadata_key WITH ROLLUP ) SELECT q1.display_name, q1.total_memory_range_mb, q1.avg_memory_variance_mb, q2.metadata_key, q2.min_memory_mb, q2.total_vcpus, q2.overall_min_memory_mb, q2.overall_total_vcpus, ROUND(q2.total_vcpus / NULLIF(q2.overall_total_vcpus, 0), 4) AS vcpu_share_of_overall FROM q1 CROSS JOIN q2 ORDER BY q1.display_name, q2.metadata_key;

question: List all instance display names matching the pattern "prime" that either (a) have a 2014-created max memory (MB) over 16000 when grouped by system-metadata key (including subtotals per display name and a grand total), or (b) have completed migrations (with DELETED = 0) whose average instance memory (MB) is above the overall average across such "prime" completed migrations; return the display name, metadata key (when applicable), the metric value, and a reason indicating which condition produced the row. inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT metadata_key, COUNT(*) AS total_rows_for_key FROM inner_cte GROUP BY metadata_key ) AS key_counts ON key_counts.metadata_key = inner_cte.metadata_key JOIN ( SELECT AVG(rows_per_key) AS avg_rows_per_key FROM ( SELECT metadata_key, COUNT(*) AS rows_per_key FROM inner_cte GROUP BY metadata_key ) AS per_key ) AS avg_counts ON 1 = 1 ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT CASE WHEN question: For each instance display name matching the pattern 'prime', return (1) the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total migration memory (MEMORY_TOTAL) across completed migrations along with the overall average of these per-display-name standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP)s as a benchmark and a variability category (HIGH_VARIABILITY/LOW_VARIABILITY/AVERAGE_VARIABILITY), and (2) the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of completed-migration counts per instance (grouped by destination compute), plus the total number of non-deleted instances with that display name and the average number of non-deleted instances per 'prime' display name. SQL: WITH mem_stddev_by_instance AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY memory_total_stddev DESC), avg_stddev AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_total_stddev) AS avg_memory_total_stddev FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_total_stddev, a.avg_memory_total_stddev AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.memory_total_stddev > a.avg_memory_total_stddev * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN ic.memory_total_stddev < a.avg_memory_total_stddev * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_stddev a ), migration_count_stats_by_display_name AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(migration_count) - MIN(migration_count) AS migration_count_range, VARIANCE(migration_count) AS migration_count_variance, STDDEV(migration_count) AS migration_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid JOIN ( SELECT m.instance_uuid, m.dest_compute, COUNT(*) AS migration_count FROM migrations AS m WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.dest_compute ) AS mig_stats ON i.uuid = mig_stats.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migration_count_range DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.migration_count_range, inner_cte.migration_count_variance, inner_cte.migration_count_stddev, COUNT(i2.id) AS total_instances_with_display_name, avg_name_counts.avg_instance_count_per_display_name FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i2 ON i2.display_name = inner_cte.display_name AND i2.deleted = 0 JOIN ( SELECT AVG(instance_count) AS avg_instance_count_per_display_name FROM ( SELECT COUNT(id) AS instance_count FROM instances WHERE deleted = 0 AND display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY display_name ) AS sub ) AS avg_name_counts GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.migration_count_range, inner_cte.migration_count_variance, inner_cte.migration_count_stddev, avg_name_counts.avg_instance_count_per_display_name ORDER BY inner_cte.migration_count_range DESC ) SELECT ms.display_name, ms.memory_total_stddev, ms.benchmark AS avg_memory_total_stddev_benchmark, ms.variability_category, mc.migration_count_range, mc.migration_count_variance, mc.migration_count_stddev, mc.total_instances_with_display_name, mc.avg_instance_count_per_display_name FROM mem_stddev_by_instance ms JOIN migration_count_stats_by_display_name mc ON mc.display_name = ms.display_name ORDER BY ms.memory_total_stddev DESC, mc.migration_count_range DESC, ms.display_name;

question: For instances whose display name matches the regular expression 'prime' and that have completed migrations, return only those instances that (1) have at least one (display name, migration status, created-at) group whose maximum migration MEMORY_TOTAL is greater than the overall average of these per-group maxima (and greater than 0), and (2) have an average instance MEMORY_MB (for completed, not-deleted instances) greater than the overall average of those per-instance averages; show the instance display name, migration status, per-group maximum MEMORY_TOTAL, migration created timestamp, minimum migration ID, and average instance memory (MB). evidence: "Display 'prime'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'prime'"
SQL: WITH Q1_inner_cte AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, m.status, MAX(m.memory_total) AS max_memory_total, m.created_at FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name, m.status, m.created_at HAVING MAX(m.memory_total) > 0 ), AvgOfGroupMax AS ( SELECT AVG(inner_cte.max_memory_total * 1.0) AS avg_group_max_memory_total FROM inner_cte ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.status, inner_cte.max_memory_total, inner_cte.created_at FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.max_memory_total > (SELECT avg_group_max_memory_total FROM AvgOfGroupMax) ), Q2_inner_cte AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(m.ID) AS min_migration_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_instance_memory_mb FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DELETED = 0 AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.min_migration_id, inner_cte.avg_instance_memory_mb FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.avg_instance_memory_mb > ( SELECT AVG(inner_cte2.avg_instance_memory_mb) FROM inner_cte AS inner_cte2 ) ) SELECT q1.display_name, q1.status, q1.max_memory_total, q1.created_at, q2.min_migration_id, q2.avg_instance_memory_mb FROM Q1_inner_cte q1 JOIN Q2_inner_cte q2 ON q1.display_name = q2.DISPLAY_NAME;

SQL: WITH MaxMemoryGroups AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) AS max_memory_mb, i.LAUNCHED_AT FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism JOIN INSTANCES i ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME, ism.KEY, i.LAUNCHED_AT HAVING MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) > 16000), MaxMemoryAverages AS ( SELECT AVG(inner_cte.max_memory_mb * 1.0) AS avg_of_group_max_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.metadata_key, inner_cte.max_memory_mb, inner_cte.LAUNCHED_AT FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.max_memory_mb > (SELECT avg_of_group_max_memory_mb FROM MaxMemoryAverages) ), VcpuMinMemoryStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VCPUS > 8 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME ), OverallMin AS ( SELECT MIN(min_memory_mb) AS overall_min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.VM_STATE, ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.instance_count, ic.min_memory_mb, (ic.min_memory_mb - om.overall_min_memory_mb) AS min_memory_deviation_from_overall_min FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN OverallMin om ), CombinedInstanceInsights AS ( SELECT mmg.DISPLAY_NAME, mmg.metadata_key, mmg.max_memory_mb, mmg.LAUNCHED_AT, NULL AS VM_STATE, NULL AS instance_count, NULL AS min_memory_mb, NULL AS min_memory_deviation_from_overall_min, 'High Max Memory Group' AS Reason FROM MaxMemoryGroups mmg UNION ALL SELECT vms.DISPLAY_NAME, NULL AS metadata_key, NULL AS max_memory_mb, NULL AS LAUNCHED_AT, vms.VM_STATE, vms.instance_count, vms.min_memory_mb, vms.min_memory_deviation_from_overall_min, 'VCPU>8 Min Memory Stats' AS Reason FROM VcpuMinMemoryStats vms ) SELECT * FROM CombinedInstanceInsights ORDER BY DISPLAY_NAME, Reason;

SQL: WITH migration_memory_analysis AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ), avg_window AS ( SELECT AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_column FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.migration_id, ic.instance_display_name, ic.instance_memory_mb, ic.window_column AS running_sum_instance_memory_mb, (ic.window_column - aw.avg_window_column) AS deviation_from_avg_running_sum_instance_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_window aw ), instance_memory_benchmark AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MAX(i.ID) OVER (ORDER BY i.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_id_next_2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ), AverageMemory AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.display_name, ic.vm_state, ic.power_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.vcpus, ic.instance_extra_id, ic.max_instance_id_next_2, am.avg_memory_mb AS benchmark_avg_memory_mb, CASE WHEN ic.memory_mb > am.avg_memory_mb * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MEMORY' WHEN ic.memory_mb < am.avg_memory_mb * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MEMORY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MEMORY' END AS memory_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageMemory am ) SELECT mma.migration_id, mma.instance_display_name, mma.instance_memory_mb, mma.running_sum_instance_memory_mb, mma.deviation_from_avg_running_sum_instance_memory_mb, imb.instance_uuid, imb.display_name, imb.vm_state, imb.power_state, imb.memory_mb, imb.vcpus, imb.instance_extra_id, imb.max_instance_id_next_2, imb.benchmark_avg_memory_mb, imb.memory_category FROM migration_memory_analysis mma JOIN INSTANCES i ON i.DISPLAY_NAME = mma.instance_display_name JOIN instance_memory_benchmark imb ON imb.instance_uuid = i.UUID;

question: For instance display names matching the regular expression 'prime' (and having a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type'), show only those display names whose average instance memory (MB) is greater than the overall average of these per-display-name averages, and for each such display name return its average memory, memory variance, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of migration MEMORY_REMAINING across completed migrations. evidence: "Display 'prime'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'prime'"
SQL: WITH mem_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT display_name, avg_memory_mb, memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(avg_memory_mb) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), mig_cv AS (WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY sort_key, coefficient_of_variation DESC, display_name) = display_name THEN NULL ELSE display_name END AS display_name, coefficient_of_variation FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE display_name END AS sort_key, CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte GROUP BY display_name WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY sort_key, coefficient_of_variation DESC, display_name) SELECT ms.display_name, ms.avg_memory_mb, ms.memory_mb_variance, mc.coefficient_of_variation FROM mem_stats ms JOIN mig_cv mc ON ms.display_name = mc.display_name ORDER BY ms.memory_mb_variance DESC;

question: For completed migrations of instances hosted on 'blaze8-12', show the migration id, instance UUID, source compute, destination compute, instance display name, system metadata key and value, the running average migration id within each instance UUID (ordered by migration id), and (per instance UUID) the total number of system metadata rows and the average of those running-average values; also include the host-level memory rollup fields for the same instance display name on host 'blaze8-12' (memory status label, number of display-name rows, and average geometric-mean memory in MB). ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, AVG(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY m.ID ), instance_rollup AS ( SELECT INSTANCE_UUID, COUNT(*) AS total_metadata_rows, AVG(window_column) AS avg_running_avg_migration_id FROM inner_cte GROUP BY INSTANCE_UUID ) SELECT ic.migration_id, ic.INSTANCE_UUID, ic.SOURCE_COMPUTE, ic.DEST_COMPUTE, ic.instance_display_name, ic.metadata_key, ic.metadata_value, ic.window_column, ir.total_metadata_rows, ir.avg_running_avg_migration_id FROM inner_cte ic JOIN instance_rollup ir ON ic.INSTANCE_UUID = ir.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY ic.migration_id ), memory_rollup AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC), DisplayNameHostAgg AS ( SELECT i.host, ic.display_name, CASE WHEN ic.geometric_mean_memory_mb > 0 THEN 'HasMemory' ELSE 'NoMemory' END AS memory_status, COUNT(*) AS display_name_rows, AVG(ic.geometric_mean_memory_mb) AS avg_geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ic JOIN instances i ON i.display_name = ic.display_name GROUP BY i.host, ic.display_name, memory_status ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(host) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE host END AS host, CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(host) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(host) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(memory_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(display_name) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(memory_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(memory_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(host) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE memory_status END AS memory_status, SUM(display_name_rows) AS display_name_rows, AVG(avg_geometric_mean_memory_mb) AS avg_geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM DisplayNameHostAgg GROUP BY host, display_name, memory_status WITH ROLLUP ) SELECT md.migration_id, md.instance_uuid, md.source_compute, md.dest_compute, md.instance_display_name, md.metadata_key, md.metadata_value, md.window_column AS running_avg_migration_id_within_instance, md.total_metadata_rows, md.avg_running_avg_migration_id, mr.host, mr.memory_status, mr.display_name_rows, mr.avg_geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM migration_details md JOIN memory_rollup mr ON mr.host = 'blaze8-12' AND mr.display_name = md.instance_display_name ORDER BY md.migration_id;

vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), avg_vcpu AS ( SELECT AVG(vcpus) AS avg_vcpus FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.display_name, ic.vm_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.vcpus, 'AVERAGE_VCPU' END AS vcpu_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_vcpu av ) SELECT q1.display_name, q1.completed_migrations, q1.total_vcpus AS total_vcpus_for_display_name, q1.total_memory_mb AS question: How many availability-zone “flare3” instances with display names matching “flare” have cached network info longer than the average for that same set, and how many instances with display names matching “prime” are categorized as HIGH_VARIABILITY based on the memory_total range across their completed migrations (relative to the overall benchmark)? SQL: WITH flare_networkinfo_above_avg AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.DISPLAY_NAME, t1.UUID AS instance_uuid, t2.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.DISPLAY_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND t1.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'flare' ), NetworkInfoAverages AS ( SELECT AVG(LENGTH(inner_cte.NETWORK_INFO) * 1.0) AS avg_network_info_len FROM inner_cte ) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.NETWORK_INFO, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE LENGTH(inner_cte.NETWORK_INFO) > (SELECT avg_network_info_len FROM NetworkInfoAverages) ), prime_migration_variability AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(m.memory_total) - MIN(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_range, VARIANCE(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_variance, STDDEV(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_total_range DESC ), AverageRange AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_total_range) AS avg_memory_total_range FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_total_range, ic.memory_total_variance, ic.memory_total_stddev, ar.avg_memory_total_range AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.memory_total_range > ar.avg_memory_total_range * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN ic.memory_total_range < ar.avg_memory_total_range * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageRange ar ) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flare_networkinfo_above_avg) AS flare_instances_above_avg_network_info_len_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM prime_migration_variability WHERE variability_category = 'HIGH_VARIABILITY') AS prime_high_variability_instance_count;
