ShelvedOffloadedInstances AS ( SELECT i.ID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, c.NETWORK_INFO, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ORDER BY i.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' ) SELECT mcf.instance_uuid, mcf.instance_display_name, mcf.migration_status, mcf.window_column AS migration_type_memory_running_sum, soi.ID AS instance_id, soi.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, soi.NETWORK_INFO, soi.window_column AS az_instance_id_rank FROM MigrationCompletedFlare3 AS mcf JOIN ShelvedOffloadedInstances AS soi ON soi.DISPLAY_NAME = mcf.instance_display_name WHERE soi.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' ORDER BY soi.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, soi.ID, mcf.instance_uuid), MigrationTypeStatus AS ( SELECT m.MIGRATION_TYPE AS migration_type, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MIGRATIONS m2 WHERE m2.MIGRATION_TYPE = m.MIGRATION_TYPE AND m2.DELETED = 0 AND m2.STATUS NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error') ) THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS migration_activity_status, COUNT(DISTINCT ic.instance_uuid) AS total_instances FROM inner_cte ic JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE, migration_activity_status ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(migration_type) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE migration_type END AS migration_type, CASE WHEN GROUPING(migration_activity_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(migration_type) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE migration_activity_status END AS migration_activity_status, SUM(total_instances) AS total_instances FROM MigrationTypeStatus GROUP BY migration_type, migration_activity_status WITH ROLLUP;

question: For instances that are in VM state "shelved_offloaded" and have a migration status of "completed", list the instance UUID, display name, VM state, migration status, source compute host, destination compute host, the row number within the "completed" migration-status group (ordered by instance UUID), and also include the maximum memory (MB) and launched-at timestamp for matching display-name groups where the instance was launched in 2014 and the maximum memory is greater than 16000 MB; only return rows where the maximum memory is greater than the average of these maximum-memory values across all such display-name groups. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH HighMemory2014 AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) AS max_memory_mb, i.LAUNCHED_AT FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.LAUNCHED_AT) = 2014 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.LAUNCHED_AT HAVING MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) > 16000), CompletedShelvedMigrations AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS migration_source_compute, m.DEST_COMPUTE AS migration_dest_compute, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' AND m.STATUS = 'completed'), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT csm.instance_uuid, csm.instance_display_name, csm.instance_vm_state, csm.migration_status, csm.migration_source_compute, csm.migration_dest_compute, csm.window_column, hm.max_memory_mb, hm.LAUNCHED_AT AS launched_at_2014 FROM CompletedShelvedMigrations csm JOIN HighMemory2014 hm ON csm.instance_display_name = hm.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY instance_uuid) SELECT instance_uuid, instance_display_name, instance_vm_state, migration_status, migration_source_compute, migration_dest_compute, window_column, max_memory_mb, launched_at_2014 FROM inner_cte WHERE max_memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(max_memory_mb) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY instance_uuid;

question: For instances in availability zone "flare3" that are in VM state "shelved_offloaded" and also have a migration with status "completed", show the instance UUID and display name, the migration status and the running sum of instance memory (MEMORY_MB) within each migration type ordered by instance memory, along with the instance ID, cached network info, and the instance’s rank within its availability zone ordered by instance ID; additionally, include the average of these per-instance running-sum values across all such matching instances. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH MigrationCompletedFlare3 AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, m.STATUS AS migration_status, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND m.STATUS = 'completed' ), ShelvedOffloadedInstances AS ( SELECT i.ID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, c.NETWORK_INFO, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ORDER BY i.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' ) SELECT mcf.instance_uuid, mcf.instance_display_name, mcf.migration_status, mcf.window_column AS migration_type_memory_running_sum, soi.ID AS instance_id, soi.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, soi.NETWORK_INFO, soi.window_column AS az_instance_id_rank FROM MigrationCompletedFlare3 AS mcf JOIN ShelvedOffloadedInstances AS soi ON soi.DISPLAY_NAME = mcf.instance_display_name WHERE soi.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' ORDER BY soi.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, soi.ID, mcf.instance_uuid ) SELECT i.instance_uuid, i.instance_display_name, i.migration_status, i.migration_type_memory_running_sum, i.instance_id, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, i.NETWORK_INFO, i.az_instance_id_rank, avg_stats.avg_running_sum AS avg_migration_type_memory_running_sum_across_matches FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN ( SELECT AVG(migration_type_memory_running_sum) AS avg_running_sum FROM inner_cte ) AS avg_stats ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, i.instance_id, i.instance_uuid;

question: For destination computes that have at least 2 completed migrations, return the destination compute name, the number of completed migrations, the minimum migration memory remaining within that destination compute group, and whether any of those migrations involve an instance whose display name is one of the “shelved_offloaded” instances (with system metadata key “image_image_type”) whose total memory exceeds 20000 MB. Do not repeat the destination compute name if it is the same as the previous row, and include a final TOTAL row across all destination computes. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH CompletedMigrationsWithMetadata AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, m.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS instance_vcpus, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS migration_memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ORDER BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed'), ShelvedOffloadedHighMemoryDisplayNames AS (SELECT i.display_name, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > 20000) SELECT cmwm.DEST_COMPUTE, COUNT(DISTINCT cmwm.migration_id) AS completed_migration_count, MIN(cmwm.window_column) AS min_migration_memory_remaining_in_dest_compute, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT sohdn.display_name) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS Has_Shelved_Offloaded_High_Memory_DisplayName FROM CompletedMigrationsWithMetadata cmwm LEFT JOIN ShelvedOffloadedHighMemoryDisplayNames sohdn ON cmwm.instance_display_name = sohdn.display_name GROUP BY cmwm.DEST_COMPUTE HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cmwm.migration_id) >= 2 ORDER BY completed_migration_count DESC, cmwm.DEST_COMPUTE ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(dest_compute_name) OVER (ORDER BY dest_compute_sort, dest_compute_name) = dest_compute_name THEN NULL ELSE dest_compute_name END AS dest_compute, completed_migration_count, min_migration_memory_remaining_in_dest_compute, Has_Shelved_Offloaded_High_Memory_DisplayName FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.DEST_COMPUTE) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.DEST_COMPUTE END AS dest_compute_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.DEST_COMPUTE) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.DEST_COMPUTE END AS dest_compute_name, SUM(i.completed_migration_count) AS completed_migration_count, MIN(i.min_migration_memory_remaining_in_dest_compute) AS min_migration_memory_remaining_in_dest_compute, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN i.Has_Shelved_Offloaded_High_Memory_DisplayName = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS Has_Shelved_Offloaded_High_Memory_DisplayName FROM inner_cte i GROUP BY i.DEST_COMPUTE WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY dest_compute_sort, dest_compute_name;

question: For instances whose display name is 'forge' and that have at least 1 completed migration, list the instance UUID, hostname, VM state, memory in MB, the instance extra record ID, the minimum memory (in MB) over a window of 3 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the instance extra ID, along with the completed migration status, the instance flavor JSON from instance extra, the row number over instance display name (with a window frame of 2 preceding and 1 following row), the total count of completed migrations for that instance, and the percentage of memory remaining during completed migrations (memory_remaining divided by memory_total) for that instance. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH ForgeInstancesWindow AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( ORDER BY ie.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ), CompletedMigrationsWindow AS ( SELECT t0.STATUS AS migration_status, t1.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, t2.FLAVOR AS instance_flavor_json, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.DISPLAY_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS t0 JOIN INSTANCES t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.STATUS = 'completed' ), ForgeCompletedMigrationCounts AS ( SELECT m.INSTANCE_UUID AS instance_uuid, COUNT(*) AS completed_migration_count FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' GROUP BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ) SELECT fiw.instance_uuid, fiw.hostname, fiw.vm_state, fiw.memory_mb, fiw.instance_extra_id, fiw.window_column AS forge_min_memory_mb_window, cmw.migration_status, cmw.instance_flavor_json, cmw.window_column AS completed_migrations_row_number_window, fcmc.completed_migration_count FROM ForgeInstancesWindow fiw JOIN ForgeCompletedMigrationCounts fcmc ON fcmc.instance_uuid = fiw.instance_uuid JOIN CompletedMigrationsWindow cmw ON cmw.instance_display_name = 'forge' WHERE fcmc.completed_migration_count >= 1 ORDER BY fiw.instance_extra_id) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.hostname, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.instance_extra_id, inner_cte.forge_min_memory_mb_window, inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.instance_flavor_json, inner_cte.completed_migrations_row_number_window, inner_cte.completed_migration_count, AVG( CASE WHEN m.memory_total IS NOT NULL AND m.memory_total <> 0 THEN (m.memory_remaining * 1.0 / m.memory_total) ELSE NULL END ) AS completed_migrations_memory_remaining_pct FROM inner_cte JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON m.instance_uuid = inner_cte.instance_uuid AND m.status = 'completed' JOIN INSTANCES i2 ON i2.uuid = m.instance_uuid AND i2.display_name = 'forge' GROUP BY inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.hostname, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.instance_extra_id, inner_cte.forge_min_memory_mb_window, inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.instance_flavor_json, inner_cte.completed_migrations_row_number_window, inner_cte.completed_migration_count ORDER BY inner_cte.instance_extra_id;

question: For each VM state among instances in availability zone "flare3", return the VM state and the maximum (across display names in that VM state) of the total vCPUs summed per display name, considering only those instances whose display name’s memory_mb variance is greater than 75% of the maximum memory_mb variance among the "flare3" display names. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH InstanceDetails AS (SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.KEY_NAME, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, min(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VCPUS ORDER BY i.VCPUS) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3'), MemoryVarianceByName AS (SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), MemoryVarianceByNameFlare3 AS ( SELECT mvbn.display_name, mvbn.memory_mb_variance FROM MemoryVarianceByName mvbn WHERE mvbn.display_name IN ( SELECT DISTINCT idt.display_name FROM InstanceDetails idt ) ) SELECT idt.UUID, idt.DISPLAY_NAME, idt.VM_STATE, idt.MEMORY_MB, idt.VCPUS, idt.KEY_NAME, idt.instance_extra_id, idt.window_column AS min_memory_mb_in_vcpu_group, mvbnf3.memory_mb_variance FROM InstanceDetails idt JOIN MemoryVarianceByNameFlare3 mvbnf3 ON idt.DISPLAY_NAME = mvbnf3.display_name WHERE mvbnf3.memory_mb_variance > ( SELECT 0.75 * MAX(memory_mb_variance) FROM MemoryVarianceByNameFlare3 ) ORDER BY mvbnf3.memory_mb_variance DESC, idt.VCPUS, idt.MEMORY_MB ), StateNameVcpuTotals AS ( SELECT ic.VM_STATE, ic.DISPLAY_NAME, SUM(ic.VCPUS) AS total_vcpus_per_display_name FROM inner_cte ic GROUP BY ic.VM_STATE, ic.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT VM_STATE, MAX(total_vcpus_per_display_name) AS max_total_vcpus_per_display_name_in_state FROM StateNameVcpuTotals GROUP BY VM_STATE ORDER BY max_total_vcpus_per_display_name_in_state DESC, VM_STATE;

question: For each reason category (either “Shelved Offloaded VM State” or “Availability Zone flare3”), list the reason, the number of distinct instance display names returned by that category, and include a subtotal per reason plus a grand total. Use the same underlying selection logic that requires a matching INSTANCE_EXTRA row and computes the memory statistics for each display name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH ShelvedOffloadedMemoryStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), Flare3MemoryDispersionStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC), CombinedDisplayNameMemoryStats AS ( SELECT display_name, avg_memory_mb, memory_mb_variance, NULL AS memory_mb_range, NULL AS memory_mb_stddev, 'Shelved Offloaded VM State' AS reason FROM ShelvedOffloadedMemoryStats UNION ALL SELECT display_name, NULL AS avg_memory_mb, memory_mb_variance, memory_mb_range, memory_mb_stddev, 'Availability Zone flare3' AS reason FROM Flare3MemoryDispersionStats ) SELECT * FROM CombinedDisplayNameMemoryStats ORDER BY display_name, reason ), ReasonCounts AS ( SELECT reason, COUNT(DISTINCT display_name) AS total_display_names FROM inner_cte GROUP BY reason ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(reason) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE reason END AS reason, SUM(total_display_names) AS total_display_names FROM ReasonCounts GROUP BY reason WITH ROLLUP;

question: For each inclusion reason (either “Forge Window Rank” or “High Root Disk”), list the reason label, the number of included instances, and the number of distinct projects those instances belong to. Include subtotals per reason and a grand total. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH ForgeWindowRanks AS ( SELECT i.uuid, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY i.memory_mb ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name = 'forge' ), HighRootGBInstances AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, SUM(i.ROOT_GB) AS total_root_gb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.UUID HAVING SUM(i.ROOT_GB) > ( SELECT AVG(ROOT_GB) + STDDEV(ROOT_GB) FROM INSTANCES ) ), CombinedInstances AS ( SELECT fwr.uuid AS instance_uuid, fwr.window_column, NULL AS total_root_gb, 'Forge Window Rank' AS reason FROM ForgeWindowRanks fwr UNION ALL SELECT hri.instance_uuid, NULL AS window_column, hri.total_root_gb, 'High Root Disk' AS reason FROM HighRootGBInstances hri ) SELECT instance_uuid, window_column, total_root_gb, reason FROM CombinedInstances ORDER BY instance_uuid, reason ), ReasonRollup AS ( SELECT inner_cte.reason, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.instance_uuid) AS total_instances, COUNT(DISTINCT i.project_id) AS total_projects FROM inner_cte JOIN instances i ON i.uuid = inner_cte.instance_uuid JOIN instance_info_caches ic ON ic.instance_uuid = i.uuid GROUP BY inner_cte.reason ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(reason) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE reason END AS reason, SUM(total_instances) AS total_instances, SUM(total_projects) AS total_projects FROM ReasonRollup GROUP BY reason WITH ROLLUP;

question: From the top 10 instance display names that (1) have completed migrations with a positive average migration MEMORY_REMAINING and (2) have system metadata with KEY = 'image_image_type', show the instance display name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of migration MEMORY_REMAINING, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of days from created_at to launched_at, the ratio (coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) divided by average days to launch) rounded to 4 decimals, and whether the instance has any non-completed/non-failed active migrations (Yes/No).
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH MigrationMemCV AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), LaunchLagStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.launched_at - i.created_at) AS avg_days_to_launch, STDDEV(i.launched_at - i.created_at) AS days_to_launch_stddev FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY days_to_launch_stddev DESC) SELECT mmcv.display_name, mmcv.coefficient_of_variation, lls.avg_days_to_launch, lls.days_to_launch_stddev, ROUND(mmcv.coefficient_of_variation / NULLIF(lls.avg_days_to_launch, 0), 4) AS cv_to_avg_days_ratio FROM MigrationMemCV mmcv JOIN LaunchLagStats lls ON mmcv.display_name = lls.display_name ORDER BY cv_to_avg_days_ratio DESC ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.coefficient_of_variation, ic.avg_days_to_launch, ic.days_to_launch_stddev, ic.cv_to_avg_days_ratio, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM instances i2 JOIN migrations m2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid WHERE i2.display_name = ic.display_name AND m2.deleted = 0 AND m2.status NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error') ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_migrations FROM inner_cte ic ORDER BY ic.cv_to_avg_days_ratio DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For the top 10 migration statuses with the highest variance in instance memory (MEMORY_MB) among instances that have a non-deleted instance info cache record, list each migration status with its memory variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and also include (for each status) every instance VM state’s memory variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) computed only from instances that have system metadata with KEY = 'image_image_type'. Do not repeat the migration status if it is the same as the previous row. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH q1 AS ( SELECT m.status, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE ic.deleted = 0 GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), q2 AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), top_migration_status AS ( SELECT status FROM q1 LIMIT 10 ) SELECT tms.status AS migration_status, q1.memory_mb_variance AS migration_memory_mb_variance, q1.memory_mb_stddev AS migration_memory_mb_stddev, q2.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, q2.memory_mb_variance AS vm_state_memory_mb_variance, q2.memory_mb_stddev AS vm_state_memory_mb_stddev FROM top_migration_status tms JOIN q1 ON q1.status = tms.status CROSS JOIN q2 ORDER BY q1.memory_mb_variance DESC, q2.memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(migration_status) OVER (ORDER BY migration_memory_mb_variance DESC, vm_state_memory_mb_variance DESC, instance_vm_state) = migration_status THEN NULL ELSE migration_status END AS migration_status, migration_memory_mb_variance, migration_memory_mb_stddev, instance_vm_state, vm_state_memory_mb_variance, vm_state_memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte ORDER BY migration_memory_mb_variance DESC, vm_state_memory_mb_variance DESC, instance_vm_state;

question: For destination computes that have at least 2 completed migrations, return the destination compute name, the number of completed migrations, the minimum migration memory remaining within that destination compute group, whether any of those migrations involve an instance whose display name is one of the “shelved_offloaded” instances (with system metadata key “image_image_type”) whose total memory exceeds 20000 MB, and only keep destination computes whose completed-migration count is greater than the average completed-migration count across all destination computes. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH CompletedMigrationsWithMetadata AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, m.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS instance_vcpus, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS migration_memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ORDER BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed'), ShelvedOffloadedHighMemoryDisplayNames AS (SELECT i.display_name, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > 20000) SELECT cmwm.DEST_COMPUTE, COUNT(DISTINCT cmwm.migration_id) AS completed_migration_count, MIN(cmwm.window_column) AS min_migration_memory_remaining_in_dest_compute, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT sohdn.display_name) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS Has_Shelved_Offloaded_High_Memory_DisplayName FROM CompletedMigrationsWithMetadata cmwm LEFT JOIN ShelvedOffloadedHighMemoryDisplayNames sohdn ON cmwm.instance_display_name = sohdn.display_name GROUP BY cmwm.DEST_COMPUTE HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cmwm.migration_id) >= 2 ORDER BY completed_migration_count DESC, cmwm.DEST_COMPUTE ), DestComputeAgg AS ( SELECT DEST_COMPUTE, completed_migration_count, min_migration_memory_remaining_in_dest_compute, Has_Shelved_Offloaded_High_Memory_DisplayName FROM inner_cte ) SELECT DEST_COMPUTE, completed_migration_count, min_migration_memory_remaining_in_dest_compute, Has_Shelved_Offloaded_High_Memory_DisplayName FROM DestComputeAgg WHERE completed_migration_count > (SELECT AVG(completed_migration_count) FROM DestComputeAgg) ORDER BY completed_migration_count DESC, DEST_COMPUTE;

question: For instances whose display name is 'forge' that also have a migration with status equal to 'completed', show the instance UUID, system metadata key and value, instance power state, the running sum of instance IDs within each power-state group ordered by instance ID, the migration source and destination compute, the migration status, the minimum instance memory (in MB) over a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by migration ID, and the deviation of that windowed minimum memory from the overall average of these windowed minimum-memory values. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH ForgeInstanceMetadata AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, ism.key AS metadata_key, ism.value AS metadata_value, i.power_state, SUM(i.id) OVER (PARTITION BY i.power_state ORDER BY i.id) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name = 'forge' ), CompletedMigrations AS ( SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.status, MIN(i.memory_mb) OVER ( ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' ) SELECT fim.instance_uuid, fim.metadata_key, fim.metadata_value, fim.power_state, fim.window_column AS running_sum_instance_ids_within_power_state, cm.source_compute, cm.dest_compute, cm.status AS migration_status, cm.window_column AS min_instance_memory_mb_window FROM ForgeInstanceMetadata fim JOIN CompletedMigrations cm ON cm.uuid = fim.instance_uuid WHERE cm.display_name = 'forge' ORDER BY fim.instance_uuid, fim.metadata_key ), avg_window_mem AS ( SELECT AVG(min_instance_memory_mb_window) AS avg_min_instance_memory_mb_window FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.metadata_key, ic.metadata_value, ic.power_state, ic.running_sum_instance_ids_within_power_state, ic.source_compute, ic.dest_compute, ic.migration_status, ic.min_instance_memory_mb_window, (ic.min_instance_memory_mb_window - awm.avg_min_instance_memory_mb_window) AS deviation_from_avg_min_instance_memory_mb_window FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_window_mem awm ORDER BY ic.instance_uuid, ic.metadata_key;

question: From the top 10 instance display names with the highest variance in instance memory (considering only non-deleted instance info cache records), display the instance display name, its memory variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and for each matching non-deleted instance that has system metadata key = 'image_image_type' also show the instance UUID, availability zone, metadata entry count, total vCPUs, and whether the instance has a config drive enabled. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH mem_stats AS ( SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE ic.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), meta_vcpu AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone, COUNT(ism.id) AS metadata_entry_count, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone ), top10_by_variance AS ( SELECT display_name, memory_mb_variance, memory_mb_stddev FROM mem_stats ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT t.display_name, t.memory_mb_variance, t.memory_mb_stddev, mv.instance_uuid, mv.availability_zone, mv.metadata_entry_count, mv.total_vcpus FROM top10_by_variance AS t JOIN meta_vcpu AS mv ON t.display_name = mv.display_name ORDER BY t.memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT c.display_name, c.memory_mb_variance, c.memory_mb_stddev, c.instance_uuid, c.availability_zone, c.metadata_entry_count, c.total_vcpus, CASE WHEN i.config_drive IN ('True', 'true', '1', 1) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_config_drive FROM inner_cte AS c JOIN instances AS i ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid ORDER BY c.memory_mb_variance DESC;

question: For each non-deleted security group and rule protocol where the maximum “to” port across its rules is greater than the average of the per-(security group, protocol) maximum “to” ports (computed across all non-deleted security groups), list the security group name, the protocol, that maximum “to” port, and (for tcp rules) the range and variance of the “from” port values for the same security group. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH MaxToPortByGroupProtocol AS ( SELECT sg.NAME, MAX(sgr.TO_PORT) AS max_to_port, sgr.PROTOCOL FROM SECURITY_GROUPS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sg.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY sg.NAME, sgr.PROTOCOL HAVING MAX(sgr.TO_PORT) > 1000 ), TcpFromPortStatsByGroup AS ( SELECT sg.NAME AS security_group_name, MAX(sgr.FROM_PORT) - MIN(sgr.FROM_PORT) AS from_port_range, VARIANCE(sgr.FROM_PORT) AS from_port_variance FROM SECURITY_GROUPS AS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sgr.PROTOCOL = 'tcp' GROUP BY sg.NAME ORDER BY from_port_range DESC ) SELECT mtp.NAME AS security_group_name, mtp.PROTOCOL, mtp.max_to_port, tfs.from_port_range, tfs.from_port_variance FROM MaxToPortByGroupProtocol mtp JOIN TcpFromPortStatsByGroup tfs ON mtp.NAME = tfs.security_group_name ORDER BY mtp.max_to_port DESC ), AvgOfMaxToPortsByProtocol AS ( SELECT i.PROTOCOL, AVG(i.max_to_port * 1.0) AS avg_max_to_port FROM inner_cte i GROUP BY i.PROTOCOL ) SELECT i.security_group_name, i.PROTOCOL, i.max_to_port, i.from_port_range, i.from_port_variance FROM inner_cte i JOIN AvgOfMaxToPortsByProtocol a ON a.PROTOCOL = i.PROTOCOL WHERE i.max_to_port > ( SELECT a2.avg_max_to_port FROM AvgOfMaxToPortsByProtocol a2 WHERE a2.PROTOCOL = i.PROTOCOL ) ORDER BY i.PROTOCOL, i.max_to_port DESC;

question: For each “shelved_offloaded” instance display name that has extra metadata and more than 5 records, show the display name, its computed standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (MB), the total number of completed migrations for instances with that display name, and the average completed-migration count per qualifying display name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH memory_stddev_by_display_name AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC), completed_migrations_with_window_avg AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.UUID, i.MEMORY_MB, m.STATUS, m.DEST_HOST, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.UUID ORDER BY m.DEST_HOST) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ORDER BY m.DEST_HOST) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM memory_stddev_by_display_name) AS display_names_with_memory_stddev_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM completed_migrations_with_window_avg cm JOIN instance_extra ie ON cm.UUID = ie.instance_uuid JOIN instances i ON i.uuid = cm.UUID WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded') AS completed_migrations_shelved_offloaded_with_extra_count ), per_display_name_completed_migrations AS ( SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(m.id) AS completed_migrations_count FROM instances i JOIN instance_extra ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid JOIN migrations m ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid AND m.status = 'completed' WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ), avg_completed_migrations AS ( SELECT AVG(completed_migrations_count) AS avg_completed_migrations_per_display_name FROM per_display_name_completed_migrations ) SELECT ms.display_name, ms.memory_mb_stddev, pdn.completed_migrations_count, acm.avg_completed_migrations_per_display_name, inner_cte.display_names_with_memory_stddev_count, inner_cte.completed_migrations_shelved_offloaded_with_extra_count FROM ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances i JOIN instance_extra ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ) ms JOIN per_display_name_completed_migrations pdn ON pdn.display_name = ms.display_name CROSS JOIN avg_completed_migrations acm CROSS JOIN inner_cte ORDER BY ms.memory_mb_stddev DESC;

question: For migrations with status "completed", return the migration ID, the instance display name, the instance system metadata key and value, the row number ordered by the metadata key using a window frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row, and also include (for that same instance display name) the variance of instance memory size in MB considering only instances that have a matching row in INSTANCE_EXTRA; additionally, only keep rows where the instance’s memory is more than 75% of the maximum memory (in MB) among instances sharing that display name (and having a matching row in INSTANCE_EXTRA). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH CompletedMigrationMetadata AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY ism.KEY ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed'), MemoryVarianceByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT cmm.migration_id, cmm.instance_display_name, cmm.metadata_key, cmm.metadata_value, cmm.window_column, mv.memory_mb_variance FROM CompletedMigrationMetadata AS cmm JOIN MemoryVarianceByDisplayName AS mv ON cmm.instance_display_name = mv.display_name) SELECT ic.migration_id, ic.instance_display_name, ic.metadata_key, ic.metadata_value, ic.window_column, ic.memory_mb_variance FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN INSTANCES AS i2 ON i2.display_name = ic.instance_display_name JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie2 ON i2.uuid = ie2.instance_uuid JOIN ( SELECT i3.display_name, MAX(i3.memory_mb) AS max_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i3 JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie3 ON i3.uuid = ie3.instance_uuid GROUP BY i3.display_name ) AS mx ON mx.display_name = ic.instance_display_name WHERE (i2.memory_mb * 1.0 / mx.max_memory_mb) > 0.75;

question: For the top 10 instance display names with the most instance network info cache records in availability zone 'flare3', show each display name along with its cache record count, the memory range (max minus min, in MB) and memory variance (in MB) computed across non-deleted instances that have a non-empty key name, and also include the average vCPU count for those non-deleted, keyed instances. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH TopCacheByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(iic.id) AS cache_records FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY cache_records DESC LIMIT 10), MemoryStatsByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.key_name <> '' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC) SELECT t.display_name, t.cache_records, m.memory_range_mb, m.memory_variance_mb FROM TopCacheByDisplayName t JOIN MemoryStatsByDisplayName m ON t.display_name = m.display_name ORDER BY t.cache_records DESC) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.cache_records, inner_cte.memory_range_mb, inner_cte.memory_variance_mb, v.avg_vcpus FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.vcpus * 1.0) AS avg_vcpus FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.key_name <> '' GROUP BY i.display_name) AS v ON v.display_name = inner_cte.display_name ORDER BY inner_cte.cache_records DESC;

question: For instances in availability zone "flare3", show the instance UUID, hostname, memory in MB, instance extra record ID, instance extra created timestamp, the average memory in MB in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows partitioned by VM state and ordered by memory in MB, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of memory in MB for that instance’s display name (computed only from instances with a non-deleted instance info cache record, and only for display names that appear more than 5 times). Do not repeat the display name if it is the same as the previous row, and include subtotals and a grand total by display name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH InstanceWindowStats AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ie.CREATED_AT AS instance_extra_created_at, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB), DisplayNameMemoryStddev AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE c.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC) SELECT iws.instance_uuid, iws.hostname, iws.memory_mb, iws.instance_extra_id, iws.instance_extra_created_at, iws.window_column AS avg_memory_mb_window_2_preceding_2_following_by_vm_state, dms.memory_mb_stddev AS display_name_memory_mb_stddev FROM InstanceWindowStats iws JOIN instances i ON i.uuid = iws.instance_uuid JOIN DisplayNameMemoryStddev dms ON dms.display_name = i.display_name WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' ORDER BY iws.memory_mb) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY display_name_sort, memory_mb, instance_uuid) = display_name THEN NULL ELSE display_name END AS display_name, instance_uuid, hostname, memory_mb, instance_extra_id, instance_extra_created_at, avg_memory_mb_window_2_preceding_2_following_by_vm_state, display_name_memory_mb_stddev, total_instances_in_display_name, avg_memory_mb_in_display_name FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.display_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.display_name END AS display_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.display_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.display_name END AS display_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.display_name) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE ic.instance_uuid END AS instance_uuid, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.display_name) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE ic.hostname END AS hostname, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.display_name) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE ic.memory_mb END AS memory_mb, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.display_name) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE ic.instance_extra_id END AS instance_extra_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.display_name) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE ic.instance_extra_created_at END AS instance_extra_created_at, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.display_name) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE ic.avg_memory_mb_window_2_preceding_2_following_by_vm_state END AS avg_memory_mb_window_2_preceding_2_following_by_vm_state, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.display_name) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE ic.display_name_memory_mb_stddev END AS display_name_memory_mb_stddev, COUNT(ic.instance_uuid) AS total_instances_in_display_name, AVG(ic.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb_in_display_name FROM inner_cte ic JOIN instances i ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.display_name, ic.instance_uuid, ic.hostname, ic.memory_mb, ic.instance_extra_id, ic.instance_extra_created_at, ic.avg_memory_mb_window_2_preceding_2_following_by_vm_state, ic.display_name_memory_mb_stddev WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY display_name_sort, memory_mb, instance_uuid;

question: For each non-deleted instance display name, compute the variance-to-range ratio of memory (metadata memory variance divided by overall memory range) as in the base calculation, then for each display name report the maximum of that ratio across all its rows, ordering the results by this maximum ratio descending.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH MemoryVarianceFromMetadata AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), MemoryRangeAndVariance AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC) SELECT mv.DISPLAY_NAME, mv.memory_mb_variance AS metadata_memory_mb_variance, mr.memory_range_mb, mr.memory_variance_mb, ROUND(mv.memory_mb_variance / NULLIF(mr.memory_range_mb, 0), 4) AS variance_to_range_ratio FROM MemoryVarianceFromMetadata mv JOIN MemoryRangeAndVariance mr ON mv.DISPLAY_NAME = mr.display_name ORDER BY variance_to_range_ratio DESC) SELECT DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(variance_to_range_ratio) AS max_variance_to_range_ratio FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY max_variance_to_range_ratio DESC;

question: For the VM state shelved_offloaded, where the instance memory variance (MB) is greater than 0, show the VM state’s average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (for instances that have a matching row in INSTANCE_EXTRA), along with each migration status and the total migration memory processed for migrations of shelved_offloaded instances that have non-null cached network information (only including statuses where total processed memory is greater than 0). Do not repeat the VM state value if it is the same as the previous row. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH InstanceMemoryStatsByState AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), MigrationMemoryProcessedByStatus AS (SELECT m.STATUS, SUM(m.MEMORY_PROCESSED) AS total_memory_processed FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' AND ic.NETWORK_INFO IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.STATUS HAVING SUM(m.MEMORY_PROCESSED) > 0) SELECT ims.VM_STATE, ims.avg_memory_mb, ims.memory_mb_variance, ims.memory_mb_stddev, mmp.STATUS AS migration_status, mmp.total_memory_processed FROM InstanceMemoryStatsByState ims JOIN MigrationMemoryProcessedByStatus mmp ON ims.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' WHERE ims.memory_mb_variance > 0 ORDER BY ims.memory_mb_variance DESC, mmp.total_memory_processed DESC) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(VM_STATE) OVER (ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC, total_memory_processed DESC) = VM_STATE THEN NULL ELSE VM_STATE END AS VM_STATE, avg_memory_mb, memory_mb_variance, memory_mb_stddev, migration_status, total_memory_processed FROM inner_cte ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC, total_memory_processed DESC;

question: For instances whose display name is 'forge', return only those instances whose dense rank by system metadata key (using a window frame of the current row and the 2 preceding rows) is greater than the average dense rank by system metadata key across all such 'forge' instances; list the instance UUID, the dense rank by system metadata key, and the dense rank by instance memory in MB (using a window frame of the current row and the 2 preceding rows). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH MetaKeyDenseRank AS (SELECT i.UUID, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY ism.KEY ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), MemoryDenseRank AS (SELECT i.uuid, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY i.memory_mb ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name = 'forge') SELECT m.UUID AS instance_uuid, m.window_column AS dense_rank_by_system_metadata_key, r.window_column AS dense_rank_by_memory_mb FROM MetaKeyDenseRank AS m JOIN MemoryDenseRank AS r ON m.UUID = r.uuid), AvgMetaKeyRank AS ( SELECT AVG(inner_cte.dense_rank_by_system_metadata_key * 1.0) AS avg_dense_rank_by_system_metadata_key FROM inner_cte ) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.dense_rank_by_system_metadata_key, inner_cte.dense_rank_by_memory_mb FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.dense_rank_by_system_metadata_key > (SELECT avg_dense_rank_by_system_metadata_key FROM AvgMetaKeyRank);

question: For instances that are not deleted (deleted = 0), list each instance UUID, display name, system metadata key and value, the dense rank within each instance UUID, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of root disk size (STDDEV(root_gb)/AVG(root_gb)) computed only for instances that have system metadata key = 'image_image_type' and non-deleted instance info cache rows (instance_info_caches.deleted = 0); additionally, only return rows where the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is greater than 0.75. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH InstanceMetadataWindow AS ( SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, ism.key, ism.value, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.uuid ORDER BY i.uuid) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 ), RootGbVariationByDisplayName AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.root_gb) / NULLIF(AVG(i.root_gb), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND iic.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(i.root_gb) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT imw.uuid, imw.display_name, imw.key, imw.value, imw.window_column, rgv.coefficient_of_variation FROM InstanceMetadataWindow AS imw JOIN RootGbVariationByDisplayName AS rgv ON imw.display_name = rgv.display_name ORDER BY rgv.coefficient_of_variation DESC, imw.uuid, imw.window_column) SELECT inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.key, inner_cte.value, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation > 0.75 ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC, inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.window_column;

question: For each VM state among instances in availability zone "flare3" that also had at least one completed migration with positive memory processed, return the VM state and the maximum total memory processed (in bytes) across those instances, where each instance’s total memory processed is summed over its completed migrations. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH CompletedMigrationsByInstance AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name AS instance_display_name, i.availability_zone AS availability_zone, COUNT(m.id) AS completed_migration_count, SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND m.memory_processed > 0 GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone), AZFlare3InstanceNetworkRank AS (SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, c.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB DESC) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3') SELECT az.UUID AS instance_uuid, az.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, az.VM_STATE, az.MEMORY_MB, az.NETWORK_INFO, az.window_column AS vm_state_memory_rank, cm.completed_migration_count, cm.total_memory_processed FROM AZFlare3InstanceNetworkRank az JOIN CompletedMigrationsByInstance cm ON az.UUID = cm.instance_uuid WHERE cm.availability_zone = 'flare3' ) SELECT inner_cte.VM_STATE AS vm_state, MAX(inner_cte.total_memory_processed) AS max_total_memory_processed_bytes FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.VM_STATE;

question: For each instance display name that has completed migrations and where the ratio of completed migration count to (completed migration count plus the network-info cache count range) is greater than 75%, list the instance display name, completed migration count, the cache count range/variance/stddev, the average completed migration count across all qualifying display names as a benchmark, and categorize each display name as 'HIGH_MIGRATION_ACTIVITY' (at least 50% above benchmark), 'LOW_MIGRATION_ACTIVITY' (at least 50% below benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_MIGRATION_ACTIVITY'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH CompletedMigrations AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, c.ID AS instance_info_cache_id, SUM(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY i.INSTANCE_TYPE_ID ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ), InstanceCacheStats AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(cache_row_count) - MIN(cache_row_count) AS cache_count_range, VARIANCE(cache_row_count) AS cache_count_variance, STDDEV(cache_row_count) AS cache_count_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN ( SELECT iic.INSTANCE_UUID, COUNT(*) AS cache_row_count FROM INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic GROUP BY iic.INSTANCE_UUID, iic.ID ) AS cache_stats ON cache_stats.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY cache_count_range DESC ), CompletedMigrationsPerDisplayName AS ( SELECT cm.instance_display_name, COUNT(*) AS completed_migration_count FROM CompletedMigrations cm GROUP BY cm.instance_display_name ) SELECT cm.instance_display_name, cmpdn.completed_migration_count, ics.cache_count_range, ics.cache_count_variance, ics.cache_count_stddev FROM CompletedMigrationsPerDisplayName cmpdn JOIN InstanceCacheStats ics ON cmpdn.instance_display_name = ics.DISPLAY_NAME JOIN CompletedMigrations cm ON cm.instance_display_name = cmpdn.instance_display_name WHERE (cmpdn.completed_migration_count * 1.0 / (cmpdn.completed_migration_count + ics.cache_count_range)) > 0.75 GROUP BY cm.instance_display_name, cmpdn.completed_migration_count, ics.cache_count_range, ics.cache_count_variance, ics.cache_count_stddev ORDER BY cmpdn.completed_migration_count DESC), Benchmark AS ( SELECT AVG(completed_migration_count) AS avg_completed_migration_count FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.instance_display_name, ic.completed_migration_count, ic.cache_count_range, ic.cache_count_variance, ic.cache_count_stddev, b.avg_completed_migration_count AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.completed_migration_count > b.avg_completed_migration_count * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MIGRATION_ACTIVITY' WHEN ic.completed_migration_count < b.avg_completed_migration_count * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MIGRATION_ACTIVITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MIGRATION_ACTIVITY' END AS migration_activity_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN Benchmark b ORDER BY ic.completed_migration_count DESC;

question: For each security group and rule protocol where the maximum “to” port across its non-deleted rules is greater than 1000, list the security group name, the protocol, that maximum “to” port, and the (for tcp rules) range and variance of the “from” port values for the same security group. Do not repeat the security group name if it is the same as the previous row, and include a subtotal row per security group showing the total number of qualifying protocols and the overall maximum “to” port for that group. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH MaxToPortByGroupProtocol AS ( SELECT sg.NAME, MAX(sgr.TO_PORT) AS max_to_port, sgr.PROTOCOL FROM SECURITY_GROUPS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sg.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY sg.NAME, sgr.PROTOCOL HAVING MAX(sgr.TO_PORT) > 1000 ), TcpFromPortStatsByGroup AS ( SELECT sg.NAME AS security_group_name, MAX(sgr.FROM_PORT) - MIN(sgr.FROM_PORT) AS from_port_range, VARIANCE(sgr.FROM_PORT) AS from_port_variance FROM SECURITY_GROUPS AS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sgr.PROTOCOL = 'tcp' GROUP BY sg.NAME ORDER BY from_port_range DESC ) SELECT mtp.NAME AS security_group_name, mtp.PROTOCOL, mtp.max_to_port, tfs.from_port_range, tfs.from_port_variance FROM MaxToPortByGroupProtocol mtp JOIN TcpFromPortStatsByGroup tfs ON mtp.NAME = tfs.security_group_name ORDER BY mtp.max_to_port DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(security_group_name) OVER (ORDER BY sg_sort, security_group_name, protocol) = security_group_name THEN NULL ELSE security_group_name END AS security_group_name, protocol, max_to_port, from_port_range, from_port_variance, qualifying_protocols FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.security_group_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.security_group_name END AS sg_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.security_group_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.security_group_name END AS security_group_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.security_group_name) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE i.PROTOCOL END AS protocol, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.security_group_name) = 1 THEN MAX(i.max_to_port) ELSE i.max_to_port END AS max_to_port, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.security_group_name) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE i.from_port_range END AS from_port_range, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.security_group_name) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE i.from_port_variance END AS from_port_variance, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.security_group_name) = 1 THEN COUNT(*) ELSE NULL END AS qualifying_protocols FROM inner_cte i GROUP BY i.security_group_name, i.PROTOCOL, i.max_to_port, i.from_port_range, i.from_port_variance WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY sg_sort, security_group_name, protocol;

question: For each instance creation date, find the creation date and the highest coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) (standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) divided by average) in completed-migration memory remaining among the top 10 instances with the highest coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), considering only instances whose maximum completed-migration total memory is greater than 0. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH sq1 AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(m.memory_total) AS max_memory_total, i.created_at FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.display_name, i.created_at, m.status HAVING MAX(m.memory_total) > 0 ), sq2 AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT sq2.display_name, sq1.created_at, sq1.max_memory_total, sq2.coefficient_of_variation FROM sq2 JOIN sq1 ON sq2.display_name = sq1.display_name ORDER BY sq2.coefficient_of_variation DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT DATE(inner_cte.created_at) AS instance_creation_date, MAX(inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation) AS max_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DATE(inner_cte.created_at) ORDER BY max_coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For instances whose display name is "forge", list each instance’s UUID, display name, memory (MB), vCPU count, and instance_extra record ID, along with the running average of memory within the "forge" display-name group (ordered by memory) and the overall average and variance of memory (MB) for that same display name among instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type'. Also include a utilization category for each instance’s memory compared to the overall average for that display name: 'HIGH_MEMORY' (at least 50% above average), 'LOW_MEMORY' (at least 50% below average), or 'AVERAGE_MEMORY'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH ForgeInstances AS (SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, ie.id AS instance_extra_id, AVG(i.memory_mb) OVER ( PARTITION BY i.display_name ORDER BY i.memory_mb ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name = 'forge' ORDER BY i.memory_mb), MemoryStatsByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), Combined AS ( SELECT fi.uuid, fi.display_name, fi.memory_mb, fi.vcpus, fi.instance_extra_id, fi.window_column, ms.avg_memory_mb, ms.memory_mb_variance FROM ForgeInstances fi LEFT JOIN MemoryStatsByDisplayName ms ON fi.display_name = ms.display_name ) SELECT * FROM Combined ORDER BY display_name, memory_mb) SELECT ic.uuid, ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb, ic.vcpus, ic.instance_extra_id, ic.window_column, ic.avg_memory_mb, ic.memory_mb_variance, CASE WHEN ic.memory_mb > ic.avg_memory_mb * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MEMORY' WHEN ic.memory_mb < ic.avg_memory_mb * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MEMORY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MEMORY' END AS memory_utilization_category FROM inner_cte ic ORDER BY ic.display_name, ic.memory_mb;

question: For each project that has at least one instance whose display name is "forge", find the project ID and the highest total vCPUs used by any VM state within that project, where the per-VM-state totals are computed from the full "forge" instance details (including instance-info-cache and the VM-state-matched migration status summary for instances with system metadata key 'image_image_type'). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH ForgeInstances AS (SELECT i.ID AS instance_id, i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.USER_ID, i.PROJECT_ID, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, i.POWER_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, c.ID AS info_cache_id, c.NETWORK_INFO, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.PROJECT_ID ORDER BY i.PROJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), MigrationStats AS (SELECT m.status AS migration_status, i.vm_state AS instance_vm_state, COUNT(m.id) AS migration_count, MIN(i.memory_mb) AS min_instance_memory_mb FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY m.status, i.vm_state), Combined AS ( SELECT fi.instance_id, fi.instance_uuid, fi.user_id, fi.project_id, fi.hostname, fi.vm_state, fi.power_state, fi.memory_mb, fi.vcpus, fi.availability_zone, fi.info_cache_id, fi.network_info, fi.window_column, ms.migration_status, ms.migration_count, ms.min_instance_memory_mb FROM ForgeInstances fi LEFT JOIN MigrationStats ms ON fi.vm_state = ms.instance_vm_state ) SELECT * FROM Combined ORDER BY instance_id, migration_status), ProjectVmStateTotals AS ( SELECT ic.project_id, ic.vm_state, SUM(ic.vcpus) AS total_vcpus_in_vm_state FROM inner_cte ic GROUP BY ic.project_id, ic.vm_state ) SELECT project_id, MAX(total_vcpus_in_vm_state) AS max_total_vcpus_by_vm_state FROM ProjectVmStateTotals GROUP BY project_id ORDER BY project_id;

question: For completed migrations, show the migration ID, the (flare3) instance UUID and display name, the instance system metadata key and value, the row number over metadata key (with a frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row), and the running sum of instance IDs within each metadata key group for flare3 instances, matching records by instance display name and metadata key; then, for each migration ID, return the maximum flare3 running-sum value observed across its matched metadata rows. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH CompletedMigrationsWithMetadata AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY ism.KEY ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed'), Flare3InstancesMetadataRunningSum AS (SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, ism.KEY, SUM(i.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3') SELECT c.migration_id, f.UUID AS instance_uuid, c.instance_display_name, c.metadata_key, c.metadata_value, c.window_column AS completed_migrations_row_number_window, f.window_column AS flare3_instance_id_running_sum_window FROM CompletedMigrationsWithMetadata c JOIN Flare3InstancesMetadataRunningSum f ON c.instance_display_name = f.DISPLAY_NAME AND c.metadata_key = f.KEY ORDER BY c.migration_id, c.metadata_key ) SELECT migration_id, MAX(flare3_instance_id_running_sum_window) AS max_flare3_instance_id_running_sum_window_per_migration FROM inner_cte GROUP BY migration_id ORDER BY migration_id;

question: For 'forge' instances that also appear among instances with system metadata key image_image_type, list only those whose memory (MB) is greater than the average memory (MB) of all 'forge' instances. Return the instance UUID, hostname, VM state, memory (MB), instance extra record ID, the windowed minimum memory (ordered by instance extra ID with 3 preceding and 1 following rows), along with the image_image_type metadata value, cached network info, and the row number ordered by the metadata value (with a window frame of 2 preceding and 1 following rows). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH ImageTypeMetadataInstances AS (SELECT t1.DISPLAY_NAME, t0.VALUE AS metadata_value, t2.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t0.VALUE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.KEY = 'image_image_type'), ForgeInstanceDetails AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( ORDER BY ie.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge') SELECT f.instance_uuid, f.hostname, f.vm_state, f.memory_mb, f.instance_extra_id, f.window_column AS forge_min_memory_window, im.metadata_value, im.NETWORK_INFO, im.window_column AS image_type_row_number_window FROM ForgeInstanceDetails AS f JOIN ImageTypeMetadataInstances AS im ON im.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ORDER BY f.instance_extra_id, f.instance_uuid), ForgeAvgMemory AS (SELECT AVG(i.MEMORY_MB * 1.0) AS avg_forge_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge') SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.hostname, ic.vm_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.instance_extra_id, ic.forge_min_memory_window, ic.metadata_value, ic.NETWORK_INFO, ic.image_type_row_number_window FROM inner_cte AS ic WHERE ic.memory_mb > (SELECT avg_forge_memory_mb FROM ForgeAvgMemory) ORDER BY ic.instance_extra_id, ic.instance_uuid;

question: For migrations where the instance has a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type', show the migration status and instance VM state combinations whose migration count is more than 75% of the total number of such instances in that VM state, along with the migration count and minimum instance memory (MB). Also include subtotals by migration status and a grand total. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH InstanceStateDisplayStats AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.ID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME ), MigrationStatusInstanceStateStats AS ( SELECT m.status AS migration_status, i.vm_state AS instance_vm_state, COUNT(m.id) AS migration_count, MIN(i.memory_mb) AS min_instance_memory_mb FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY m.status, i.vm_state ), InstanceTotalsByVMState AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, COUNT(i.ID) AS total_instance_count FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ) SELECT msiss.migration_status, msiss.instance_vm_state, msiss.migration_count, msiss.min_instance_memory_mb FROM MigrationStatusInstanceStateStats msiss JOIN InstanceTotalsByVMState it ON msiss.instance_vm_state = it.VM_STATE WHERE (msiss.migration_count * 1.0 / it.total_instance_count) > 0.75 ), RollupStats AS ( SELECT inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.instance_vm_state, COUNT(*) AS qualifying_combinations, SUM(inner_cte.migration_count) AS total_migration_count, MIN(inner_cte.min_instance_memory_mb) AS min_instance_memory_mb FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.instance_vm_state ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(migration_status) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE migration_status END AS migration_status, CASE WHEN GROUPING(instance_vm_state) = 1 AND GROUPING(migration_status) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE instance_vm_state END AS instance_vm_state, SUM(qualifying_combinations) AS qualifying_combinations, SUM(total_migration_count) AS total_migration_count, MIN(min_instance_memory_mb) AS min_instance_memory_mb FROM RollupStats GROUP BY migration_status, instance_vm_state WITH ROLLUP;

question: For each instance display name that is not deleted and has a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type', list the instance display name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the time (in days) between instance creation and the last update of its instance info cache, the memory range (in MB), the memory variance (in MB), and the normalized ratio of coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) divided by memory range. Do not repeat the display name if it is the same as the previous row. Include a final TOTAL row that shows the overall average of each metric across all returned display names.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH InstanceCacheTiming AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(c.updated_at - i.created_at) / NULLIF(AVG(c.updated_at - i.created_at), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS e ON e.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON c.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(c.updated_at - i.created_at) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), InstanceMemorySpread AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC) SELECT ict.display_name, ict.coefficient_of_variation, ims.memory_range_mb, ims.memory_variance_mb, ROUND(ict.coefficient_of_variation / NULLIF(ims.memory_range_mb, 0), 6) AS cov_per_mb_range FROM InstanceCacheTiming ict JOIN InstanceMemorySpread ims ON ict.display_name = ims.display_name ORDER BY cov_per_mb_range DESC) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY display_name_sort, cov_per_mb_range DESC) = display_name THEN NULL ELSE display_name END AS display_name, coefficient_of_variation, memory_range_mb, memory_variance_mb, cov_per_mb_range FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.display_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.display_name END AS display_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.display_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.display_name END AS display_name, AVG(i.coefficient_of_variation) AS coefficient_of_variation, AVG(i.memory_range_mb) AS memory_range_mb, AVG(i.memory_variance_mb) AS memory_variance_mb, AVG(i.cov_per_mb_range) AS cov_per_mb_range FROM inner_cte i GROUP BY i.display_name WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY display_name_sort, cov_per_mb_range DESC;

question: For instance display names that have system metadata with key = 'image_image_type', and where an instance has at least 2 completed migrations, list the instance UUID, display name, availability zone, the number of completed migrations, the total memory processed across those completed migrations, and the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (MB) for that display name. Do not repeat the display name if it is the same as the previous row. Include a subtotal row per display name showing the total number of qualifying instances, total completed migrations, and total memory processed. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH InstanceCompletedMigrationStats AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone, COUNT(m.id) AS migration_count, SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM instances i JOIN migrations m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone ), InstanceDisplayNameMemoryStats AS ( SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT icms.instance_uuid, icms.display_name, icms.availability_zone, icms.migration_count, icms.total_memory_processed, idnms.memory_mb_variance, idnms.memory_mb_stddev FROM InstanceCompletedMigrationStats icms JOIN InstanceDisplayNameMemoryStats idnms ON icms.display_name = idnms.display_name WHERE icms.migration_count >= 2 ORDER BY icms.migration_count DESC, icms.total_memory_processed DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY display_name_sort, display_name, instance_uuid) = display_name THEN NULL ELSE display_name END AS display_name, instance_uuid, availability_zone, migration_count, total_memory_processed, memory_mb_variance, memory_mb_stddev, qualifying_instances, total_migrations_for_display_name, total_memory_processed_for_display_name FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.display_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE inner_cte.display_name END AS display_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.display_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE inner_cte.display_name END AS display_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.display_name) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte.instance_uuid END AS instance_uuid, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.display_name) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte.availability_zone END AS availability_zone, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.display_name) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte.migration_count END AS migration_count, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.display_name) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte.total_memory_processed END AS total_memory_processed, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.display_name) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte.memory_mb_variance END AS memory_mb_variance, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.display_name) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev END AS memory_mb_stddev, COUNT(inner_cte.instance_uuid) AS qualifying_instances, SUM(inner_cte.migration_count) AS total_migrations_for_display_name, SUM(inner_cte.total_memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed_for_display_name FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.availability_zone, inner_cte.migration_count, inner_cte.total_memory_processed, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY display_name_sort, display_name, instance_uuid;

question: For instance display names that have completed migrations and where the ratio of completed migration count to (completed migration count plus the network-info cache count range) is greater than 75%, provide the instance display name, the number of completed migrations, the range/variance/standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of network-info cache record counts per (non-deleted) instance, and the deviation of that completed migration count from the overall average completed migration count across all qualifying display names. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH CompletedMigrations AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, c.ID AS instance_info_cache_id, SUM(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY i.INSTANCE_TYPE_ID ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ), InstanceCacheStats AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(cache_row_count) - MIN(cache_row_count) AS cache_count_range, VARIANCE(cache_row_count) AS cache_count_variance, STDDEV(cache_row_count) AS cache_count_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN ( SELECT iic.INSTANCE_UUID, COUNT(*) AS cache_row_count FROM INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic GROUP BY iic.INSTANCE_UUID, iic.ID ) AS cache_stats ON cache_stats.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY cache_count_range DESC ), CompletedMigrationsPerDisplayName AS ( SELECT cm.instance_display_name, COUNT(*) AS completed_migration_count FROM CompletedMigrations cm GROUP BY cm.instance_display_name ) SELECT cm.instance_display_name, cmpdn.completed_migration_count, ics.cache_count_range, ics.cache_count_variance, ics.cache_count_stddev FROM CompletedMigrationsPerDisplayName cmpdn JOIN InstanceCacheStats ics ON cmpdn.instance_display_name = ics.DISPLAY_NAME JOIN CompletedMigrations cm ON cm.instance_display_name = cmpdn.instance_display_name WHERE (cmpdn.completed_migration_count * 1.0 / (cmpdn.completed_migration_count + ics.cache_count_range)) > 0.75 GROUP BY cm.instance_display_name, cmpdn.completed_migration_count, ics.cache_count_range, ics.cache_count_variance, ics.cache_count_stddev ORDER BY cmpdn.completed_migration_count DESC ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(completed_migration_count) AS avg_completed_migration_count FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.instance_display_name, ic.completed_migration_count, ic.cache_count_range, ic.cache_count_variance, ic.cache_count_stddev, (ic.completed_migration_count - ac.avg_completed_migration_count) AS deviation_from_avg_completed_migrations FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte ac ORDER BY ic.completed_migration_count DESC;

question: For availability zone 'flare3', show each instance (display name, UUID, VM state, memory in MB, vCPU count, the max system-metadata ID over the current row through the next 2 rows ordered by instance UUID, and the instance_info_caches ID), and also include (1) the total memory (in MB) across all instances in that same VM state (only for VM states whose total memory exceeds 50000 MB) and (2) the average of those per-VM-state total-memory values across all qualifying VM states. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH VMStateMemory AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) AS total_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE HAVING SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) > 50000), InstanceMetadataWindow AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, i.uuid, MAX(ism.id) OVER ( ORDER BY i.uuid ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_metadata_id_next_2 FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3') SELECT imw.display_name, imw.availability_zone, imw.vm_state, vsm.total_memory_mb, imw.memory_mb, imw.vcpus, imw.uuid, imw.max_metadata_id_next_2 FROM InstanceMetadataWindow imw JOIN VMStateMemory vsm ON imw.vm_state = vsm.VM_STATE) SELECT DISTINCT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.availability_zone, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.total_memory_mb, avg_totals.avg_total_memory_mb_across_states, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.vcpus, inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.max_metadata_id_next_2, ic.id AS instance_info_cache_id FROM inner_cte JOIN instances i ON i.uuid = inner_cte.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches ic ON ic.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN ( SELECT AVG(state_totals.total_memory_mb) AS avg_total_memory_mb_across_states FROM ( SELECT vm_state, total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte GROUP BY vm_state, total_memory_mb ) AS state_totals ) AS avg_totals;

question: For each project, find the project ID and (1) the highest vCPU count among its non-deleted instances that also have a non-deleted instance info cache record and a completed migration, and (2) the total number of such instances in that project. Do not return any rounded answers.
