evidence: "Display 'flare'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'flare'" Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH MigrationWindow AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, m.STATUS AS migration_status, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'flare' ), MetadataWindow AS ( SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, ism.KEY, SUM(i.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ), JoinedInstanceWindows AS ( SELECT mw.instance_uuid, mw.instance_display_name, mw.migration_status, mw.window_column AS migration_memory_running_sum, md.KEY AS system_metadata_key, md.window_column AS instance_id_running_sum_by_key FROM MigrationWindow mw JOIN MetadataWindow md ON mw.instance_uuid = md.UUID ) SELECT instance_uuid, instance_display_name, migration_status, system_metadata_key, migration_memory_running_sum, instance_id_running_sum_by_key FROM JoinedInstanceWindows), Enriched AS ( SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.instance_display_name, ic.migration_status, ic.system_metadata_key, ic.migration_memory_running_sum, ic.instance_id_running_sum_by_key, m.migration_type, MAX(ic.migration_memory_running_sum) OVER (PARTITION BY m.migration_type) AS max_migration_memory_running_sum_in_type FROM inner_cte ic JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON m.instance_uuid = ic.instance_uuid AND m.status = ic.migration_status ) SELECT instance_uuid, instance_display_name, migration_status, system_metadata_key, migration_type, migration_memory_running_sum, instance_id_running_sum_by_key FROM Enriched WHERE (migration_memory_running_sum * 1.0 / NULLIF(max_migration_memory_running_sum_in_type, 0)) > 0.75;

question: For migrations with status "completed" whose instance display name matches the pattern "flare", show the migration id, status, source compute, destination compute, instance UUID, instance display name, instance memory (MB), instance extra record id, and the minimum instance memory (MB) in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by migration id, along with (when available) the memory range (MB) and memory variance (MB) for that same instance display name computed across non-deleted instances with a non-empty key name whose display name matches the pattern "prime"; also include the deviation of each migration’s instance memory (MB) from the average instance memory (MB) across all such completed "flare" migrations. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "Display 'prime'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'prime'" "Display 'flare'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'flare'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH PrimeInstanceMemoryStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.key_name <> '' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC), CompletedFlareMigrations AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( ORDER BY m.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'flare') SELECT cfm.migration_id, cfm.migration_status, cfm.source_compute, cfm.dest_compute, cfm.instance_uuid, cfm.instance_display_name, cfm.instance_memory_mb, cfm.instance_extra_id, cfm.window_column, pims.memory_range_mb, pims.memory_variance_mb FROM CompletedFlareMigrations cfm LEFT JOIN PrimeInstanceMemoryStats pims ON cfm.instance_display_name = pims.display_name ORDER BY cfm.migration_id) , AvgFlareMigrationMemory AS ( SELECT AVG(instance_memory_mb) AS avg_instance_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.migration_id, ic.migration_status, ic.source_compute, ic.dest_compute, ic.instance_uuid, ic.instance_display_name, ic.instance_memory_mb, ic.instance_extra_id, ic.window_column, ic.memory_range_mb, ic.memory_variance_mb, (ic.instance_memory_mb - afmm.avg_instance_memory_mb) AS deviation_from_avg_instance_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AvgFlareMigrationMemory afmm ORDER BY ic.migration_id;

question: For completed migrations whose instances are on host 'blaze8-12' (and with non-deleted instance info cache records), which migration types have at least 2 such migrations, and for each of those migration types return the migration type, the total count of completed migrations, the minimum MEMORY_TOTAL value within that migration type, and the deviation of that minimum MEMORY_TOTAL from the overall average MEMORY_TOTAL across all migrations returned by the base result set? Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH MigrationDetails AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.MIGRATION_TYPE, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, m.MEMORY_TOTAL, MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) OVER (PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), MigrationRanks AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND ic.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT md.MIGRATION_TYPE, COUNT(DISTINCT md.migration_id) AS Completed_Migration_Count, MIN(md.window_column) AS Min_Memory_Total_Within_Migration_Type FROM MigrationDetails md JOIN MigrationRanks mr ON md.migration_id = mr.migration_id GROUP BY md.MIGRATION_TYPE HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT md.migration_id) >= 2 ORDER BY Completed_Migration_Count DESC, md.MIGRATION_TYPE), AverageMemoryTotal AS ( SELECT AVG(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS avg_memory_total FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' AND ic.DELETED = 0 ) SELECT cte.MIGRATION_TYPE, cte.Completed_Migration_Count, cte.Min_Memory_Total_Within_Migration_Type, (cte.Min_Memory_Total_Within_Migration_Type - amt.avg_memory_total) AS deviation_from_overall_avg_memory_total FROM inner_cte cte CROSS JOIN AverageMemoryTotal amt ORDER BY cte.Completed_Migration_Count DESC, cte.MIGRATION_TYPE;

question: For completed migrations of instances hosted on "blaze8-12", show each instance display name, migration status, migration destination compute host, the row number ordered by destination compute using a window frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of migration memory remaining for that instance (restricted to instances with instance system metadata key "image_image_type"). Do not repeat the display name if it is the same as the previous row, and include a subtotal row per destination compute showing the number of instances and the average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP). Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH InstanceMigrationWindow AS (SELECT t0.DISPLAY_NAME, t1.STATUS, t1.DEST_COMPUTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.DEST_COMPUTE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES t0 JOIN MIGRATIONS t1 ON t0.UUID = t1.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.STATUS = 'completed' AND t0.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), InstanceMigrationMemoryCV AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT imw.DISPLAY_NAME, imw.STATUS, imw.DEST_COMPUTE, imw.window_column, imcv.coefficient_of_variation FROM InstanceMigrationWindow imw JOIN InstanceMigrationMemoryCV imcv ON imw.DISPLAY_NAME = imcv.display_name ORDER BY imcv.coefficient_of_variation DESC, imw.DEST_COMPUTE) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY dest_compute_sort, dest_compute, display_name) = display_name THEN NULL ELSE display_name END AS display_name, status, dest_compute, window_column, coefficient_of_variation, instances_in_dest_compute, avg_cv_in_dest_compute FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.dest_compute) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE inner_cte.dest_compute END AS dest_compute_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.dest_compute) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE inner_cte.dest_compute END AS dest_compute, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.status, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, COUNT(*) AS instances_in_dest_compute, AVG(inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_cv_in_dest_compute FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.dest_compute, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.status, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY dest_compute_sort, dest_compute, display_name;

question: For instances on host "blaze8-12" that are not deleted, and whose display name is among the top 10 display names with the most system metadata entries in availability zone 'flare3' matching the pattern 'flare', compute (per display name) the maximum of the per-instance rounded ratio of metadata entries divided by that instance’s dense rank, and return the display name along with that maximum ratio.
evidence: "Display 'flare'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'flare'" Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH TopMetadataDisplayNames AS (SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(ism.id) AS metadata_entries FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'flare' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY metadata_entries DESC LIMIT 10), HostInstanceMetadata AS (SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, ism.key, ism.value, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.uuid ORDER BY i.uuid) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12') SELECT him.uuid, him.display_name, tmdn.metadata_entries, him.key, him.value, him.window_column, ROUND(tmdn.metadata_entries / NULLIF(him.window_column, 0), 2) AS metadata_entries_per_dense_rank FROM HostInstanceMetadata him JOIN TopMetadataDisplayNames tmdn ON him.display_name = tmdn.display_name ORDER BY tmdn.metadata_entries DESC, him.display_name, him.uuid, him.window_column) SELECT display_name, MAX(metadata_entries_per_dense_rank) AS max_metadata_entries_per_dense_rank FROM inner_cte GROUP BY display_name ORDER BY max_metadata_entries_per_dense_rank DESC, display_name;

question: For instances in availability zone 'flare3' running on host 'blaze8-12', list the instance UUID, display name, key name, the number of system metadata entries and total vCPUs (from those metadata rows), along with the minimum instance ID and average memory (MB) for that display name among non-deleted instances on 'blaze8-12' that have system metadata key 'image_image_type', compute the average vCPUs per metadata entry (total vCPUs divided by metadata entry count) rounded to 2 decimals, and also include the overall average of this per-instance ratio across all such instances.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH InstanceMetadataSummary AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name, COUNT(ism.id) AS metadata_entry_count, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus FROM instances i JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name), DisplayNameMemoryStats AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(i.ID) AS min_instance_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT ims.instance_uuid, ims.display_name, ims.key_name, ims.metadata_entry_count, ims.total_vcpus, dms.min_instance_id, dms.avg_memory_mb, ROUND(ims.total_vcpus / NULLIF(ims.metadata_entry_count, 0), 2) AS avg_vcpus_per_metadata_entry FROM InstanceMetadataSummary ims JOIN DisplayNameMemoryStats dms ON ims.display_name = dms.display_name ORDER BY avg_vcpus_per_metadata_entry DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.key_name, inner_cte.metadata_entry_count, inner_cte.total_vcpus, inner_cte.min_instance_id, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.avg_vcpus_per_metadata_entry, overall_avg.avg_avg_vcpus_per_metadata_entry FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(avg_vcpus_per_metadata_entry) AS avg_avg_vcpus_per_metadata_entry FROM inner_cte ) AS overall_avg ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY inner_cte.avg_vcpus_per_metadata_entry DESC;

question: For instances whose display name matches the pattern 'prime', list only those instances where the completed-migration memory processed ratio (memory_processed divided by memory_total) is greater than 75%, and for each such instance show the instance display name, migration count range/variance/standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of completed migrations per instance, the completed migration status, the instance cached network info, the window row number (ordered by instance display name with a frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row), and the memory utilization ratio. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "Display 'prime'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'prime'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH MigrationCountDispersion AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(migration_count) - MIN(migration_count) AS migration_count_range, VARIANCE(migration_count) AS migration_count_variance, STDDEV(migration_count) AS migration_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid JOIN ( SELECT m.instance_uuid, m.dest_compute, COUNT(*) AS migration_count FROM migrations AS m WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.dest_compute ) AS mig_stats ON i.uuid = mig_stats.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migration_count_range DESC ), CompletedPrimeMigrationDetails AS ( SELECT t0.STATUS AS migration_status, t1.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, t2.NETWORK_INFO AS instance_network_info, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.DISPLAY_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS t0 JOIN INSTANCES t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.STATUS = 'completed' AND t1.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' ) SELECT mcd.display_name AS instance_display_name, mcd.migration_count_range, mcd.migration_count_variance, mcd.migration_count_stddev, cpmd.migration_status, cpmd.instance_network_info, cpmd.window_column FROM MigrationCountDispersion AS mcd JOIN CompletedPrimeMigrationDetails AS cpmd ON mcd.display_name = cpmd.instance_display_name ORDER BY mcd.migration_count_range DESC, cpmd.window_column) SELECT ic.instance_display_name, ic.migration_count_range, ic.migration_count_variance, ic.migration_count_stddev, ic.migration_status, ic.instance_network_info, ic.window_column, (m.memory_processed * 1.0 / NULLIF(m.memory_total, 0)) AS memory_processed_ratio FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN instances AS i ON i.display_name = ic.instance_display_name JOIN migrations AS m ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND m.memory_total IS NOT NULL AND m.memory_total <> 0 AND (m.memory_processed * 1.0 / m.memory_total) > 0.75 ORDER BY ic.migration_count_range DESC, ic.window_column, memory_processed_ratio DESC;

question: For each instance display name matching the pattern "prime" (with non-deleted instances and only completed migrations), show the minimum migration ID and the average instance memory in MB. Then, for each such display name, report whether there exist any "flare" instances in availability zone "flare3" whose memory in MB equals that average, along with the count of those matching flare3/flare instances and the average of their windowed memory column. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "Display 'prime'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'prime'" "Display 'flare'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'flare'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH PrimeCompletedMigrationStats AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(m.ID) AS min_migration_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_instance_memory_mb FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DELETED = 0 AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME), Flare3FlareInstanceWindow AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ie.CREATED_AT AS instance_extra_created_at, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'flare' ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB) SELECT pcs.DISPLAY_NAME, pcs.min_migration_id, pcs.avg_instance_memory_mb, CASE WHEN COUNT(fw.instance_uuid) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS Has_Flare3_Flare_Instances, COUNT(fw.instance_uuid) AS Flare3_Flare_Instance_Count FROM PrimeCompletedMigrationStats pcs LEFT JOIN Flare3FlareInstanceWindow fw ON pcs.avg_instance_memory_mb = fw.memory_mb WHERE pcs.avg_instance_memory_mb > 0 GROUP BY pcs.DISPLAY_NAME, pcs.min_migration_id, pcs.avg_instance_memory_mb ORDER BY pcs.avg_instance_memory_mb DESC) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.min_migration_id, inner_cte.avg_instance_memory_mb, inner_cte.Has_Flare3_Flare_Instances, inner_cte.Flare3_Flare_Instance_Count, AVG(fw.window_column) AS avg_flare3_window_memory_mb FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN INSTANCES p ON p.DISPLAY_NAME = inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME AND p.DELETED = 0 LEFT JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism2 ON ism2.INSTANCE_UUID = p.UUID AND ism2.DELETED = 0 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'flare' ) fw ON fw.memory_mb = inner_cte.avg_instance_memory_mb GROUP BY inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.min_migration_id, inner_cte.avg_instance_memory_mb, inner_cte.Has_Flare3_Flare_Instances, inner_cte.Flare3_Flare_Instance_Count ORDER BY inner_cte.avg_instance_memory_mb DESC;

question: For each migration status among instances on host blaze8-12 that have a completed migration, return the migration status and the maximum number of distinct (non-deleted) instances (grouped by display name and VM state) that have the system metadata key image_image_type for any instance participating in that status. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH InstanceImageTypeStats AS ( SELECT ins.DISPLAY_NAME, ins.VM_STATE, COUNT(DISTINCT ins.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(ins.CREATED_AT) AS earliest_created_at FROM INSTANCES AS ins JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID WHERE ins.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND ins.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY ins.DISPLAY_NAME, ins.VM_STATE ), CompletedMigrationsOnHost AS ( SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, m.STATUS, m.DEST_COMPUTE, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ), TotalCompletedMigrationsOnHost AS ( SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, m.STATUS, m.DEST_COMPUTE, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT cmh.UUID AS instance_uuid, cmh.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, cmh.STATUS AS migration_status, cmh.DEST_COMPUTE AS destination_compute_host, cmh.window_column AS migration_status_rank, iits.VM_STATE AS vm_state, iits.instance_count AS distinct_instance_count_for_display_name_and_state, iits.earliest_created_at AS earliest_instance_created_at_for_display_name_and_state FROM CompletedMigrationsOnHost cmh JOIN InstanceImageTypeStats iits ON cmh.DISPLAY_NAME = iits.DISPLAY_NAME WHERE cmh.STATUS = 'completed') SELECT migration_status, MAX(distinct_instance_count_for_display_name_and_state) AS max_distinct_instances_with_image_image_type_per_display_name_and_state FROM inner_cte GROUP BY migration_status;

question: For the combined instance/metadata report, keep the original two-part output exactly as-is, and extend it by adding a third part that lists (for the same “top 10 instance display names with the most system metadata entries where the instance is not deleted, the host is 'prime-35', and the metadata key is 'image_image_type'”) the detailed system-metadata rows for those instances (including instance UUID, display name, memory, vCPUs, flavor JSON, metadata key/value, and a row number per metadata key ordered by instance UUID), with a “reason” column indicating which part of the report each row came from. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "prime-35" is predicated by "instances.host = 'prime-35'" Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH TopImageTypeMetadataByDisplayName AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(ism.ID) AS metadata_entries FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'prime-35' AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY metadata_entries DESC LIMIT 10 ), Flare3Blaze8_12InstanceMetadata AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.FLAVOR AS flavor, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT t.DISPLAY_NAME AS name_or_display_name, t.metadata_entries AS metric_value, 'Top 10 by image_image_type metadata entries on prime-35 (not deleted)' AS reason, NULL AS instance_uuid, NULL AS memory_mb, NULL AS vcpus, NULL AS flavor, NULL AS question: For completed migrations on host "blaze8-12", considering only instances whose display name also appears among instances on "blaze8-12" with non-empty cached network information, list the migration ID, instance display name, the geometric mean of instance memory (MB) for that display name, the instance system metadata key and value, and the row number ordered by the metadata key using a window frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row, but only for display names whose geometric mean memory is greater than the overall average of these geometric means. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH MigrationInstanceMetadataWindow AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY ism.KEY ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), GeometricMeanMemoryByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.display_name, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE iic.network_info <> '[]' AND i.memory_mb > 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC) SELECT mimw.migration_id, mimw.instance_display_name, gmm.geometric_mean_memory_mb, mimw.metadata_key, mimw.metadata_value, mimw.window_column FROM MigrationInstanceMetadataWindow AS mimw JOIN GeometricMeanMemoryByDisplayName AS gmm ON mimw.instance_display_name = gmm.display_name ORDER BY mimw.instance_display_name, mimw.migration_id, mimw.metadata_key ) SELECT migration_id, instance_display_name, geometric_mean_memory_mb, metadata_key, metadata_value, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE geometric_mean_memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_memory_mb) FROM inner_cte);

question: For instances hosted on "blaze8-12" that have completed migrations (and have instance system metadata key "image_image_type"), show each instance’s UUID, display name, migration status, destination compute host, its rank within the completed-status group ordered by instance UUID, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of migration memory remaining for that instance’s completed migrations; additionally, include the instance’s project ID and the total number of non-deleted instances in that same project. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH MigrationMemoryVariation AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), InstanceMigrationRanks AS (SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, m.STATUS, m.DEST_COMPUTE, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12') SELECT imr.UUID, imr.DISPLAY_NAME, imr.STATUS, imr.DEST_COMPUTE, imr.window_column, mmv.coefficient_of_variation FROM InstanceMigrationRanks imr JOIN MigrationMemoryVariation mmv ON imr.DISPLAY_NAME = mmv.display_name ORDER BY mmv.coefficient_of_variation DESC, imr.window_column, imr.UUID) SELECT inner_cte.UUID, inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.STATUS, inner_cte.DEST_COMPUTE, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, i.project_id, proj_counts.total_instances_in_project FROM inner_cte JOIN instances i ON i.uuid = inner_cte.UUID JOIN ( SELECT project_id, COUNT(*) AS total_instances_in_project FROM instances WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY project_id ) AS proj_counts ON proj_counts.project_id = i.project_id ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.UUID;

question: For migrations that are completed and whose instance is on host 'blaze8-12', return the migration ID, source compute, destination compute, instance display name, and the migration’s rank within its status group ordered by migration ID, along with (for any active, not-deleted migrations that share the same instance display name) the active migration status, source compute, destination compute, destination host, instance UUID, instance VM state, system metadata key/value, and the maximum instance memory (MB) over the current row through the next 2 rows ordered by migration ID. Also include the overall average of these “next-2-rows max memory” values as a benchmark, and categorize each joined row as 'HIGH_MEMORY' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_MEMORY' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_MEMORY'. SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH CompletedMigrationsOnHost AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND ic.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ), ActiveNotDeletedMigrations AS ( SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.dest_host, m.instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, ism.key, ism.value, MAX(i.memory_mb) OVER ( ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_memory_mb_next2 FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND m.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') ) SELECT cm.migration_id, cm.source_compute AS completed_source_compute, cm.dest_compute AS completed_dest_compute, cm.instance_display_name, cm.window_column AS completed_status_rank_by_migration_id, anm.status AS active_migration_status, anm.source_compute AS active_source_compute, anm.dest_compute AS active_dest_compute, anm.dest_host AS active_dest_host, anm.instance_uuid AS active_instance_uuid, anm.display_name AS active_instance_display_name, anm.vm_state AS active_instance_vm_state, anm.key AS system_metadata_key, anm.value AS system_metadata_value, anm.max_memory_mb_next2 FROM CompletedMigrationsOnHost cm JOIN ActiveNotDeletedMigrations anm ON cm.instance_display_name = anm.display_name ORDER BY cm.migration_id ), AvgMaxMem AS ( SELECT AVG(max_memory_mb_next2) AS avg_max_memory_mb_next2 FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.migration_id, i.completed_source_compute, i.completed_dest_compute, i.instance_display_name, i.completed_status_rank_by_migration_id, i.active_migration_status, i.active_source_compute, i.active_dest_compute, i.active_dest_host, i.active_instance_uuid, i.active_instance_display_name, i.active_instance_vm_state, i.system_metadata_key, i.system_metadata_value, i.max_memory_mb_next2, a.avg_max_memory_mb_next2 AS benchmark_avg_max_memory_mb_next2, CASE WHEN i.max_memory_mb_next2 > a.avg_max_memory_mb_next2 * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MEMORY' WHEN i.max_memory_mb_next2 < a.avg_max_memory_mb_next2 * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MEMORY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MEMORY' END AS memory_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN AvgMaxMem a ORDER BY i.migration_id;

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH Blaze8_12_Instance_Migration_Summary AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name AS instance_display_name, i.availability_zone AS availability_zone, COUNT(m.id) AS completed_migration_count, SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND m.memory_processed > 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone ), Ether_18_Completed_Migration_Details AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, m.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS instance_instance_vcpus, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS migration_memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ORDER BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'ether-18' ) SELECT b.instance_uuid, b.instance_display_name, b.availability_zone, b.completed_migration_count, b.total_memory_processed, COUNT(e.migration_id) AS ether_18_completed_migration_rows, MIN(e.window_column) AS min_migration_memory_remaining_within_dest_compute FROM Blaze8_12_Instance_Migration_Summary b CROSS JOIN Ether_18_Completed_Migration_Details e GROUP BY b.instance_uuid, b.instance_display_name, b.availability_zone, b.completed_migration_count, b.total_memory_processed) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.instance_display_name, inner_cte.availability_zone, inner_cte.completed_migration_count, inner_cte.total_memory_processed, inner_cte.ether_18_completed_migration_rows, inner_cte.min_migration_memory_remaining_within_dest_compute, avg_min_per_dest_compute.avg_min_memory_remaining_across_dest_compute FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(min_per_dest_compute) AS avg_min_memory_remaining_across_dest_compute FROM ( SELECT m.DEST_COMPUTE, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) AS min_per_dest_compute FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'ether-18' GROUP BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ) AS sub ) AS avg_min_per_dest_compute ON 1 = 1;

question: Using the VM-state variance-per-instance results for non-deleted instances with active (non-terminal) migrations, list each VM state along with its migration memory-total variance, total instance count, and the deviation of its variance-per-instance from the overall average variance-per-instance across the returned VM states; only include VM states where (variance ÷ total instances) is greater than the average standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of migration memory total computed for instance display names matching 'prime' that have more than one 'image_image_type' system-metadata row. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "Display 'prime'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'prime'" "Active migrations" is predicated by "migrations.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed')"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DisplayNameMemoryStddev AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_stddev FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(ism.id) > 1 ORDER BY memory_total_stddev DESC ), VMStateMemoryVariance AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, VARIANCE(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS memory_total_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND m.STATUS NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_total_variance DESC ), VMStateTotalInstances AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, COUNT(*) AS total_instance_count FROM INSTANCES AS i WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ) SELECT vsmv.VM_STATE, vsmv.memory_total_variance, vsti.total_instance_count FROM VMStateMemoryVariance vsmv JOIN VMStateTotalInstances vsti ON vsmv.VM_STATE = vsti.VM_STATE WHERE (vsmv.memory_total_variance * 1.0 / vsti.total_instance_count) > ( SELECT AVG(dnms.memory_total_stddev) FROM DisplayNameMemoryStddev dnms ) ORDER BY (vsmv.memory_total_variance * 1.0 / vsti.total_instance_count) DESC ), AverageVariancePerInstance AS ( SELECT AVG(inner_cte.memory_total_variance * 1.0 / inner_cte.total_instance_count) AS avg_variance_per_instance FROM inner_cte ) SELECT inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.memory_total_variance, inner_cte.total_instance_count, (inner_cte.memory_total_variance * 1.0 / inner_cte.total_instance_count) AS variance_per_instance, ((inner_cte.memory_total_variance * 1.0 / inner_cte.total_instance_count) - avpi.avg_variance_per_instance) AS deviation_from_avg_variance_per_instance FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN AverageVariancePerInstance avpi ORDER BY deviation_from_avg_variance_per_instance DESC;

question: On host "blaze8-12", show the completed migration count and active (non-deleted) instance count, include the average active instance count across all hosts as a benchmark, and classify "blaze8-12" as 'HIGH_UTILIZATION' (at least 50% above average), 'LOW_UTILIZATION' (at least 50% below average), or 'AVERAGE_UTILIZATION'. SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH migration_details AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.MEMORY_MB, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY m.ID ), instance_details AS ( SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, ie.flavor, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.project_id ORDER BY i.project_id) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ), host_summary AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT md.migration_id) AS completed_migration_count, COUNT(DISTINCT id.uuid) AS active_instance_count FROM migration_details md CROSS JOIN instance_details id ) SELECT hs.completed_migration_count, hs.active_instance_count FROM host_summary hs ), HostActiveInstances AS ( SELECT i.host, COUNT(DISTINCT i.uuid) AS active_instance_count FROM instances i JOIN instance_extra ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host IS NOT NULL AND i.host <> '' GROUP BY i.host ), AverageHostInstances AS ( SELECT AVG(active_instance_count) AS avg_active_instances FROM HostActiveInstances ) SELECT 'blaze8-12' AS host, ic.completed_migration_count, ic.active_instance_count, ahi.avg_active_instances AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.active_instance_count > ahi.avg_active_instances * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_UTILIZATION' WHEN ic.active_instance_count < ahi.avg_active_instances * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_UTILIZATION' ELSE 'AVERAGE_UTILIZATION' END AS utilization_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageHostInstances ahi;

question: For instances in availability zone “flare3” on host “blaze8-12” whose display name matches the pattern “flare”, group the results by VM state and a vCPU-per-MB ratio bucket (“High” if vCPUs per MB > 0.001, otherwise “Low”). For each group, list the VM state, ratio bucket, the number of distinct instances, the total of the running sums of instance IDs (within each VM-state group ordered by instance ID), the maximum “max system-metadata ID over the current and next 2 instances” observed in the group, and include subtotals per VM state and a grand total.

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH q1 AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, SUM(i.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), q2 AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, i.uuid, MAX(ism.id) OVER ( ORDER BY i.uuid ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_metadata_id_next_2 FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'flare') SELECT q1.instance_uuid, q1.display_name, q1.vm_state, q2.memory_mb, q2.vcpus, q1.window_column AS running_sum_instance_ids_by_vm_state, q2.max_metadata_id_next_2, ROUND(q2.vcpus / NULLIF(q2.memory_mb, 0), 6) AS vcpus_per_mb_ratio FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.instance_uuid = q2.uuid WHERE q2.availability_zone = 'flare3' ORDER BY vcpus_per_mb_ratio DESC, q1.instance_uuid) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(vm_state) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ratio_bucket) = 1 AND GROUPING(vm_state) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE ratio_bucket END AS ratio_bucket, COUNT(DISTINCT instance_uuid) AS total_instances, SUM(running_sum_instance_ids_by_vm_state) AS sum_running_sums, MAX(max_metadata_id_next_2) AS max_of_max_metadata_id_next_2 FROM ( SELECT ic.*, CASE WHEN ic.vcpus_per_mb_ratio > 0.001 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS ratio_bucket FROM inner_cte ic ) grouped GROUP BY vm_state, ratio_bucket WITH ROLLUP;

Also include the per-(VM state, display name) instance count, minimum memory (MB), and the memory range and variance (MB) for that display name. Do not return any rounded answers.

SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH MemoryStatsByDisplayName AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC ), HostVcpuStatsByStateAndName AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VCPUS > 8 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT hv.VM_STATE, hv.DISPLAY_NAME, hv.instance_count, hv.min_memory_mb, ms.memory_range_mb, ms.memory_variance_mb FROM HostVcpuStatsByStateAndName hv JOIN MemoryStatsByDisplayName ms ON hv.DISPLAY_NAME = ms.display_name ), DisplayNameTotals AS ( SELECT ic.display_name, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ic JOIN instances i ON i.display_name = ic.display_name GROUP BY ic.display_name ), Top10DisplayNames AS ( SELECT dnt.display_name, dnt.total_vcpus, dnt.total_memory_mb FROM DisplayNameTotals dnt ORDER BY dnt.total_vcpus DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT t10.display_name, t10.total_vcpus, t10.total_memory_mb, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM instances i2 JOIN instance_system_metadata ism2 ON ism2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid WHERE i2.display_name = t10.display_name AND ism2.key = 'image_image_location' ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_image_location_metadata, ic.vm_state, ic.instance_count, ic.min_memory_mb, ic.memory_range_mb, ic.memory_variance_mb FROM Top10DisplayNames t10 JOIN inner_cte ic ON ic.display_name = t10.display_name ORDER BY t10.total_vcpus DESC, t10.display_name, ic.vm_state;

question: For host "blaze8-12", show the completed migration count and active (non-deleted) instance count, and also list the average memory (MB) of the active instances. Do not repeat the host name if it is the same as the previous row, and include a TOTAL row. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH migration_details AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.MEMORY_MB, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY m.ID ), instance_details AS ( SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, ie.flavor, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.project_id ORDER BY i.project_id) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ), host_summary AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT md.migration_id) AS completed_migration_count, COUNT(DISTINCT id.uuid) AS active_instance_count FROM migration_details md CROSS JOIN instance_details id ) SELECT hs.completed_migration_count, hs.active_instance_count FROM host_summary hs ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(host_name) OVER (ORDER BY host_sort, host_name) = host_name THEN NULL ELSE host_name END AS host_name, completed_migration_count, active_instance_count, avg_active_instance_memory_mb FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(h.host_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE h.host_name END AS host_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(h.host_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE h.host_name END AS host_name, MAX(ic.completed_migration_count) AS completed_migration_count, MAX(ic.active_instance_count) AS active_instance_count, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_active_instance_memory_mb FROM (SELECT 'blaze8-12' AS host_name) AS h JOIN inner_cte ic ON 1 = 1 LEFT JOIN instances i ON i.host = h.host_name AND i.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN instance_extra ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid GROUP BY h.host_name WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY host_sort;

question: For instances in availability zone 'flare3' that have migrations where the instance memory is greater than zero, list each instance’s display name, availability zone, VM state, memory (MB), vCPU count, instance UUID, and the maximum system-metadata ID over a window of the current row plus the next 2 rows ordered by instance UUID, along with the migration status and the geometric mean migrated-instance memory (MB) for that status. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH sq1 AS ( SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, i.uuid, MAX(ism.id) OVER ( ORDER BY i.uuid ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_metadata_id_next_2 FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' ), sq2 AS ( SELECT m.status, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC ) SELECT sq1.display_name, sq1.availability_zone, sq1.vm_state, sq1.memory_mb, sq1.vcpus, sq1.uuid, sq1.max_metadata_id_next_2, sq2.status AS migration_status, sq2.geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM sq1 JOIN migrations AS m ON m.instance_uuid = sq1.uuid JOIN sq2 ON sq2.status = m.status JOIN instances AS i2 ON i2.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE i2.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i2.memory_mb > 0 ORDER BY sq2.geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC, sq1.uuid;

question: For each non-deleted instance, display the instance ID, UUID, user ID, project ID, display name, VM state, memory (MB), vCPUs, instance info cache record ID, and the maximum instance ID over the current row and the next 2 rows (ordered by instance ID), along with the migration status that has the highest variance in instance memory (MB) among non-deleted migrations and that status’s average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of memory. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH instance_window AS ( SELECT i.id AS instance_id, i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.user_id, i.project_id, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, c.id AS info_cache_id, MAX(i.id) OVER (ORDER BY i.id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_id_next_2 FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND c.deleted = 0 ), migration_memory_stats AS ( SELECT m.status, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.deleted = 0 GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), top_migration_status AS ( SELECT status, avg_memory_mb, memory_mb_variance, memory_mb_stddev FROM migration_memory_stats LIMIT 1 ) SELECT iw.instance_id, iw.instance_uuid, iw.user_id, iw.project_id, iw.display_name, iw.vm_state, iw.memory_mb, iw.vcpus, iw.info_cache_id, iw.max_instance_id_next_2, tms.status AS top_variance_migration_status, tms.avg_memory_mb AS top_status_avg_memory_mb, tms.memory_mb_variance AS top_status_memory_mb_variance, tms.memory_mb_stddev AS top_status_memory_mb_stddev FROM instance_window AS iw CROSS JOIN top_migration_status AS tms ORDER BY iw.instance_id;

question: For non-deleted instances in availability zone “flare3” whose display name is among the top 10 display names by number of completed migrations (counting migrations by migration ID and only for instances with a non-empty key name), list the instance UUID, display name, VM state, power state, memory (MB), vCPUs, the instance extra record ID, the maximum instance ID considering the current row and the next 2 rows when ordered by instance ID, the completed migrations count, and the completed-migrations-per-vCPU ratio rounded.
SQL: WITH InstanceDetails AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MAX(i.ID) OVER (ORDER BY i.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_id_next_2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3'), TopCompletedMigrations AS (SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(m.id) AS completed_migrations FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.key_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY completed_migrations DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT id.instance_uuid, id.display_name, id.vm_state, id.power_state, id.memory_mb, id.vcpus, id.instance_extra_id, id.max_instance_id_next_2, tcm.completed_migrations, ROUND(tcm.completed_migrations / NULLIF(id.vcpus, 0), 2) AS completed_migrations_per_vcpu FROM InstanceDetails id JOIN TopCompletedMigrations tcm ON tcm.display_name = id.display_name ORDER BY completed_migrations_per_vcpu DESC, tcm.completed_migrations DESC;

question: For instances whose display names are in the top 10 by number of system metadata rows where the key is 'image_image_type' (considering only non-deleted instances), list all completed migrations for those instances and return the migration id, instance UUID, migration type, source compute, destination compute, destination host, instance display name, VM state, memory (MB), vCPUs, instance extra record id, migration memory total, the minimum migration memory total within each migration type (windowed by migration type), along with the instance’s metadata entry count and its total number of completed migrations. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH CompletedMigrations AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.MIGRATION_TYPE, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, m.MEMORY_TOTAL, MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) OVER (PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed'), TopMetadataInstances AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(ism.ID) AS metadata_entries FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY metadata_entries DESC LIMIT 10), TotalCompletedMigrations AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(m.ID) AS completed_migration_count FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT cm.migration_id, cm.INSTANCE_UUID, cm.MIGRATION_TYPE, cm.SOURCE_COMPUTE, cm.DEST_COMPUTE, cm.DEST_HOST, cm.DISPLAY_NAME, cm.VM_STATE, cm.MEMORY_MB, cm.VCPUS, cm.instance_extra_id, cm.MEMORY_TOTAL, cm.window_column, tmi.metadata_entries, tcm.completed_migration_count FROM CompletedMigrations cm JOIN TopMetadataInstances tmi ON cm.DISPLAY_NAME = tmi.DISPLAY_NAME JOIN TotalCompletedMigrations tcm ON cm.DISPLAY_NAME = tcm.DISPLAY_NAME;

question: For instances that are not deleted, list the instances (limited to the top 10 by number of network info cache records) that also have a maximum memory greater than 16000 MB, showing the instance display name, the metadata key, the maximum memory (MB), the launched timestamp, and the number of network info cache records. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH HighMemoryByMetadata AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) AS max_memory_mb, i.LAUNCHED_AT FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism JOIN INSTANCES i ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME, ism.KEY, i.LAUNCHED_AT HAVING MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) > 16000), TopNetworkCacheByInstance AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(iic.ID) AS cache_records FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY cache_records DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT hmbm.DISPLAY_NAME, hmbm.metadata_key, hmbm.max_memory_mb, hmbm.LAUNCHED_AT, tnc.cache_records FROM HighMemoryByMetadata hmbm JOIN TopNetworkCacheByInstance tnc ON hmbm.DISPLAY_NAME = tnc.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY tnc.cache_records DESC, hmbm.max_memory_mb DESC;

question: For instances whose display name is 'forge', list the instance UUID, hostname, system metadata key, and the running sum of instance IDs within each metadata key group (ordered by instance ID), along with the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (MB) for the 'forge' display name computed over instances that have system metadata with key = 'image_image_type'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH ForgeInstanceMetadataWindow AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, SUM(i.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), DisplayNameMemoryStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT fimw.instance_uuid, fimw.hostname, fimw.metadata_key, fimw.window_column, dms.memory_mb_variance, dms.memory_mb_stddev FROM ForgeInstanceMetadataWindow fimw JOIN DisplayNameMemoryStats dms ON dms.display_name = 'forge' ORDER BY fimw.metadata_key, fimw.window_column;

question: For the security group named "aurum-xenon" that is also among the top 10 security groups with the most non-deleted rules, show the security group name, its total rule count, each rule’s protocol and from port, and the running sum of from ports within each protocol ordered by from port. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT sg.NAME AS security_group_name, sgr.PROTOCOL, sgr.FROM_PORT, SUM(sgr.FROM_PORT) OVER ( PARTITION BY sgr.PROTOCOL ORDER BY sgr.FROM_PORT ) AS window_column FROM SECURITY_GROUPS AS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sg.NAME = 'aurum-xenon' ), subq2 AS ( SELECT sg.NAME AS security_group_name, COUNT(sgr.ID) AS rule_count FROM SECURITY_GROUPS AS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sg.DELETED = 0 AND sgr.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY sg.NAME ORDER BY rule_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT s1.security_group_name, s2.rule_count, s1.PROTOCOL, s1.FROM_PORT, s1.window_column FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.security_group_name = s2.security_group_name ORDER BY s2.rule_count DESC, s1.PROTOCOL, s1.FROM_PORT;

question: For the VM state shelved_offloaded, where the instance memory variance (MB) is greater than 0, show the VM state’s average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (for instances that have a matching row in INSTANCE_EXTRA), along with each migration status and the total migration memory processed for migrations of shelved_offloaded instances that have non-null cached network information (only including statuses where total processed memory is greater than 0). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH InstanceMemoryStatsByState AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), MigrationMemoryProcessedByStatus AS (SELECT m.STATUS, SUM(m.MEMORY_PROCESSED) AS total_memory_processed FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' AND ic.NETWORK_INFO IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.STATUS HAVING SUM(m.MEMORY_PROCESSED) > 0) SELECT ims.VM_STATE, ims.avg_memory_mb, ims.memory_mb_variance, ims.memory_mb_stddev, mmp.STATUS AS migration_status, mmp.total_memory_processed FROM InstanceMemoryStatsByState ims JOIN MigrationMemoryProcessedByStatus mmp ON ims.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' WHERE ims.memory_mb_variance > 0 ORDER BY ims.memory_mb_variance DESC, mmp.total_memory_processed DESC;

question: For instances whose display name is 'forge', list the instance UUID, system metadata key and value, the instance-extra creation timestamp, and the row number ordered by the system metadata key using a window frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row, and also include (for display name 'forge' considering only completed migrations) the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of system-metadata rows per migration. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH ForgeInstanceMetadataWindow AS (SELECT t1.UUID AS instance_uuid, t2.KEY AS metadata_key, t2.VALUE AS metadata_value, t0.CREATED_AT AS extra_created_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t2.KEY ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), PerDisplayNameMigrationMetadataStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(migration_metadata_count) - MIN(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_range, VARIANCE(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_variance, STDDEV(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN ( SELECT m.instance_uuid, m.id AS migration_id, COUNT(ism.id) AS migration_metadata_count FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i2 ON m.instance_uuid = i2.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.id ) AS per_migration_stats ON i.uuid = per_migration_stats.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY metadata_count_range DESC) SELECT f.instance_uuid, f.metadata_key, f.metadata_value, f.extra_created_at, f.window_column, p.metadata_count_range, p.metadata_count_variance, p.metadata_count_stddev FROM ForgeInstanceMetadataWindow AS f JOIN PerDisplayNameMigrationMetadataStats AS p ON p.display_name = 'forge' ORDER BY f.window_column, f.metadata_key;

question: For instances with display name 'forge' that have system metadata with KEY = 'image_image_type', show each instance UUID and display name along with the display-name-level ROOT_GB range and variance, plus each instance’s system metadata key/value and its row number ordered by metadata key (using a window frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row), ordered by the ROOT_GB range descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(i.ROOT_GB) - MIN(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_range, VARIANCE(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY root_gb_range DESC ), q2 AS ( SELECT i.UUID, ism.KEY, ism.VALUE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ism.KEY ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ) SELECT q2.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME, q1.root_gb_range, q1.root_gb_variance, q2.KEY AS system_metadata_key, q2.VALUE AS system_metadata_value, q2.window_column FROM q2 JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON i.UUID = q2.UUID JOIN q1 ON q1.DISPLAY_NAME = i.DISPLAY_NAME JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism_img ON ism_img.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism_img.KEY = 'image_image_type' ORDER BY q1.root_gb_range DESC, q2.window_column;

question: From the top 10 instance display names with the most system metadata entries where the metadata key is 'image_image_type' and the instance is not deleted, show the completed migrations for those instances, including the migration ID, instance display name, instance availability zone, migration status, the migration’s rank within the 'completed' status group ordered by migration ID, and the instance’s metadata entry count. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH top_metadata AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(ism.ID) AS metadata_entries FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY metadata_entries DESC LIMIT 10 ), completed_migrations AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE AS instance_availability_zone, m.STATUS AS migration_status, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ) SELECT cm.migration_id, cm.instance_display_name, cm.instance_availability_zone, cm.migration_status, cm.window_column, tm.metadata_entries FROM completed_migrations cm JOIN top_metadata tm ON tm.DISPLAY_NAME = cm.instance_display_name ORDER BY tm.metadata_entries DESC, cm.migration_id;

question: For instances in availability zone 'flare3', list each instance UUID, display name, key name, its number of system metadata entries, the total vCPUs summed across those metadata rows, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of memory_mb for that display name (computed only for display names with more than 2 system metadata rows). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH MemoryStddevByDisplayName AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 2 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC ), Flare3InstanceMetadataAndVcpus AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name, COUNT(ism.id) AS metadata_entry_count, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus FROM instances i JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name ) SELECT f.instance_uuid, f.display_name, f.key_name, f.metadata_entry_count, f.total_vcpus, m.memory_mb_stddev FROM Flare3InstanceMetadataAndVcpus f LEFT JOIN MemoryStddevByDisplayName m ON m.display_name = f.display_name;

question: For instances whose display name is 'forge' that also have a migration with status equal to 'completed', show the instance UUID, system metadata key and value, instance power state, the running sum of instance IDs within each power-state group ordered by instance ID, the migration source and destination compute, the migration status, and the minimum instance memory (in MB) over a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by migration ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH ForgeInstanceMetadata AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, ism.key AS metadata_key, ism.value AS metadata_value, i.power_state, SUM(i.id) OVER (PARTITION BY i.power_state ORDER BY i.id) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name = 'forge' ), CompletedMigrations AS ( SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.status, MIN(i.memory_mb) OVER ( ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' ) SELECT fim.instance_uuid, fim.metadata_key, fim.metadata_value, fim.power_state, fim.window_column AS running_sum_instance_ids_within_power_state, cm.source_compute, cm.dest_compute, cm.status AS migration_status, cm.window_column AS min_instance_memory_mb_window FROM ForgeInstanceMetadata fim JOIN CompletedMigrations cm ON cm.uuid = fim.instance_uuid WHERE cm.display_name = 'forge' ORDER BY fim.instance_uuid, fim.metadata_key;

question: For instances in availability zone "flare3" that are in VM state "shelved_offloaded" and also have a migration with status "completed", show the instance UUID and display name, the migration status and the running sum of instance memory (MEMORY_MB) within each migration type ordered by instance memory, along with the instance ID, cached network info, and the instance’s rank within its availability zone ordered by instance ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH MigrationCompletedFlare3 AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, m.STATUS AS migration_status, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND m.STATUS = 'completed' ), ShelvedOffloadedInstances AS ( SELECT i.ID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, c.NETWORK_INFO, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ORDER BY i.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' ) SELECT mcf.instance_uuid, mcf.instance_display_name, mcf.migration_status, mcf.window_column AS migration_type_memory_running_sum, soi.ID AS instance_id, soi.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, soi.NETWORK_INFO, soi.window_column AS az_instance_id_rank FROM MigrationCompletedFlare3 AS mcf JOIN ShelvedOffloadedInstances AS soi ON soi.DISPLAY_NAME = mcf.instance_display_name WHERE soi.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' ORDER BY soi.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, soi.ID, mcf.instance_uuid;

question: For the instance with UUID '0003c04d-211b-4847-8916-102efabca5bc' and for completed migrations on that same instance, list the instance details and each system metadata key/value along with the migration ID, the running sum of migration IDs within each metadata key group, the minimum system metadata ID within each metadata key group, and the ratio (running sum of migration IDs divided by the minimum metadata ID) rounded to 2 decimals.
SQL: WITH MigrationMetadata AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, SUM(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed'), InstanceMetadataDetails AS (SELECT i.ID AS instance_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.USER_ID AS user_id, i.PROJECT_ID AS project_id, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE AS availability_zone, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ism.ID AS metadata_id, MIN(ism.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY ism.KEY) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.UUID = '0003c04d-211b-4847-8916-102efabca5bc') SELECT imd.instance_id, imd.display_name, imd.user_id, imd.project_id, imd.vm_state, imd.power_state, imd.memory_mb, imd.vcpus, imd.availability_zone, imd.metadata_key, imd.metadata_value, imd.metadata_id, imd.window_column AS min_metadata_id_in_key_group, mm.migration_id, mm.instance_display_name AS migration_instance_display_name, mm.window_column AS running_sum_migration_ids_in_key_group, ROUND(mm.window_column / NULLIF(imd.window_column, 0), 2) AS running_sum_to_min_metadata_id_ratio FROM InstanceMetadataDetails imd JOIN MigrationMetadata mm ON mm.metadata_key = imd.metadata_key AND mm.instance_display_name = imd.display_name ORDER BY running_sum_to_min_metadata_id_ratio DESC, mm.migration_id;

question: For instances whose display name is 'forge', list the instance UUID, hostname, VM state, memory in MB, the instance extra record ID, the minimum memory (in MB) over a window of 3 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the instance extra ID, and also include the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of system metadata entries per instance for the 'forge' display name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH ForgeInstanceWindow AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( ORDER BY ie.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), DisplayNameMetaStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(meta_entry_count) - MIN(meta_entry_count) AS meta_count_range, VARIANCE(meta_entry_count) AS meta_count_variance, STDDEV(meta_entry_count) AS meta_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN ( SELECT i2.uuid AS instance_uuid, COUNT(*) AS meta_entry_count FROM instances AS i2 JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i2.uuid ) AS meta_stats ON meta_stats.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY meta_count_range DESC) SELECT fiw.instance_uuid, fiw.hostname, fiw.vm_state, fiw.memory_mb, fiw.instance_extra_id, fiw.window_column, dms.meta_count_range, dms.meta_count_variance, dms.meta_count_stddev FROM ForgeInstanceWindow AS fiw JOIN DisplayNameMetaStats AS dms ON dms.display_name = 'forge' ORDER BY fiw.instance_extra_id;

question: For instances in availability zone 'flare3' that have a migration with status equal to 'completed', list the instance UUID, instance display name, availability zone, VM state, memory in MB, vCPU count, instance hostname, migration source compute, destination compute, destination host, migration type, memory total, memory processed, memory remaining, the minimum memory remaining within each instance UUID, the maximum system-metadata ID over the current row and next 2 rows (ordered by instance UUID), and the memory processed ratio (memory processed divided by memory total) rounded.
SQL: WITH MigrationCompleted AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.HOSTNAME AS instance_hostname, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS migration_source_compute, m.DEST_COMPUTE AS migration_dest_compute, m.DEST_HOST AS migration_dest_host, m.MIGRATION_TYPE AS migration_type, m.MEMORY_TOTAL AS memory_total, m.MEMORY_PROCESSED AS memory_processed, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES i JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed'), InstanceMetadataWindow AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, i.uuid, MAX(ism.id) OVER ( ORDER BY i.uuid ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_metadata_id_next_2 FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3') SELECT mc.instance_uuid, mc.instance_display_name, imw.availability_zone, imw.vm_state, imw.memory_mb, imw.vcpus, mc.instance_hostname, mc.migration_source_compute, mc.migration_dest_compute, mc.migration_dest_host, mc.migration_type, mc.memory_total, mc.memory_processed, mc.memory_remaining, mc.window_column AS min_memory_remaining_per_instance_uuid, imw.max_metadata_id_next_2, ROUND(mc.memory_processed / NULLIF(mc.memory_total, 0), 4) AS memory_processed_ratio FROM MigrationCompleted mc JOIN InstanceMetadataWindow imw ON imw.uuid = mc.instance_uuid ORDER BY memory_processed_ratio DESC;

question: For each instance VM state, list the VM state along with (1) the range and variance of total memory moved during completed migrations and (2) the average, range, and variance of instance memory (in MB) for instances that have a non-empty PCI requests value. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH MigrationMemoryStatsByVMState AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, MAX(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) - MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS memory_total_range, VARIANCE(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS memory_total_variance FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_total_range DESC ), InstanceMemoryStatsWithPCIRequestsByVMState AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) - MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ie.PCI_REQUESTS <> '[]' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC ) SELECT mms.VM_STATE AS vm_state, mms.memory_total_range, mms.memory_total_variance, ims.avg_memory_mb, ims.memory_mb_range, ims.memory_mb_variance FROM MigrationMemoryStatsByVMState AS mms JOIN InstanceMemoryStatsWithPCIRequestsByVMState AS ims ON mms.VM_STATE = ims.vm_state ORDER BY mms.memory_total_range DESC;

question: For instances that are not deleted and have system metadata with the key `image_image_type`, find those whose display name also has at least one completed migration with a positive average `memory_remaining`. Return the instance UUID, display name, the `image_image_type` metadata value, the number of network-info cache records, the total memory (MB) summed across those cache records, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of `memory_remaining` for completed migrations, ordered by the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH InstanceCacheAndImageType AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, ism.value AS image_type_value, COUNT(iic.id) AS cache_record_count, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances i JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, ism.value), InstanceMigrationVariation AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT icait.instance_uuid, icait.display_name, icait.image_type_value, icait.cache_record_count, icait.total_memory_mb, imv.coefficient_of_variation FROM InstanceCacheAndImageType icait JOIN InstanceMigrationVariation imv ON imv.display_name = icait.display_name ORDER BY imv.coefficient_of_variation DESC, icait.instance_uuid;

question: For instances whose display name is 'forge', return the instance UUID, display name, VM state, memory in MB, vCPUs, the instance-extra record ID and created timestamp, the cached network_info JSON, and the minimum instance-extra ID in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by instance memory (MB); also include the overall memory range and variance (in MB) for the 'forge' display name among non-deleted instances and the total count of non-deleted 'forge' instances, but only keep rows where the instance’s memory is more than 75% of the (non-deleted) 'forge' memory range. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH ForgeInstances AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ie.CREATED_AT AS instance_extra_created_at, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, MIN(ie.ID) OVER ( ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ), DisplayNameMemoryStats AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC ), ForgeDisplayNameTotals AS ( SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(*) AS forge_instance_count FROM instances AS i WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.display_name = 'forge' GROUP BY i.display_name ) SELECT fi.instance_uuid, fi.display_name, fi.vm_state, fi.memory_mb, fi.vcpus, fi.instance_extra_id, fi.instance_extra_created_at, fi.network_info, fi.window_column, dms.memory_range_mb, dms.memory_variance_mb, fdt.forge_instance_count FROM ForgeInstances fi JOIN DisplayNameMemoryStats dms ON fi.display_name = dms.display_name JOIN ForgeDisplayNameTotals fdt ON fi.display_name = fdt.display_name WHERE (fi.memory_mb * 1.0 / NULLIF(dms.memory_range_mb, 0)) > 0.75;

question: How many instances are in the “shelved_offloaded” VM state and also belong to a (display name, launched-at) group launched in 2014 whose maximum memory is greater than 16000 MB? Do not return any rounded answers.
