SQL: WITH shelved_offloaded_instances AS (SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.MEMORY_MB, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.MEMORY_MB ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded'), launched_2014_high_memory AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) AS max_memory_mb, i.LAUNCHED_AT FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.LAUNCHED_AT) = 2014 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.LAUNCHED_AT HAVING MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) > 16000) SELECT COUNT(*) AS matching_instance_count FROM shelved_offloaded_instances soi JOIN launched_2014_high_memory lhm ON soi.DISPLAY_NAME = lhm.DISPLAY_NAME;

question: For each instance that has a completed migration, show the instance display name, availability zone, migration status, migration type, instance UUID, and the dense rank of migrations within each instance UUID, along with the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of non-deleted system metadata entries per instance for that same display name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH MetadataStatsByDisplayName AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(meta_entry_count) - MIN(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_range, VARIANCE(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_variance, STDDEV(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN ( SELECT i2.display_name, i2.uuid, COUNT(*) AS meta_entry_count FROM instances AS i2 JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i2.display_name, i2.uuid ) AS per_instance_counts ON i.display_name = per_instance_counts.display_name GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY metadata_count_range DESC ), CompletedMigrationsByInstance AS ( SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, m.status, m.migration_type, i.uuid, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.uuid ORDER BY i.uuid) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' ) SELECT c.display_name, c.availability_zone, c.status, c.migration_type, c.uuid, c.window_column, ms.metadata_count_range, ms.metadata_count_variance, ms.metadata_count_stddev FROM CompletedMigrationsByInstance AS c JOIN MetadataStatsByDisplayName AS ms ON c.display_name = ms.display_name;

question: For each VM state, availability zone, and display name, compare (1) instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type' versus (2) instances with more than 8 VCPUs by listing both instance counts and minimum memory (MB), and compute the ratios of the “>8 VCPU” counts and minimum memory to the metadata-filtered counts and minimum memory (rounded to 2 decimals), ordered by the count ratio descending.
SQL: WITH MetaByStateAZ AS ( SELECT ins.VM_STATE, ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, COUNT(ins.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(ins.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES ins ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON ins.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY ins.VM_STATE, ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ), BigByStateName AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VCPUS > 8 GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT m.VM_STATE, m.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, b.DISPLAY_NAME, m.instance_count AS meta_instance_count, b.instance_count AS big_instance_count, m.min_memory_mb AS meta_min_memory_mb, b.min_memory_mb AS big_min_memory_mb, ROUND(b.instance_count / NULLIF(m.instance_count, 0), 2) AS Big_to_Meta_Instance_Count_Ratio, ROUND(b.min_memory_mb / NULLIF(m.min_memory_mb, 0), 2) AS Big_to_Meta_Min_Memory_Ratio FROM MetaByStateAZ m JOIN BigByStateName b ON m.VM_STATE = b.VM_STATE ORDER BY Big_to_Meta_Instance_Count_Ratio DESC;

question: For shelved_offloaded instances with display name 'forge', list the instance UUID, hostname, VM state, system metadata key/value, the minimum instance memory (MB) in a 2-preceding/2-following window ordered by instance ID, the total memory (MB) across all shelved_offloaded 'forge' instances (only when that total exceeds 20000 MB), and the ratio of the window minimum memory to that total memory.
SQL: WITH ShelvedOffloadedMemory AS ( SELECT i.display_name, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > 20000 ), ForgeInstanceMetadataWindow AS ( SELECT i.UUID, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, ism.KEY, ism.VALUE, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( ORDER BY i.ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ) SELECT f.UUID, f.HOSTNAME, f.VM_STATE, f.KEY, f.VALUE, f.window_column, som.total_memory_mb, ROUND(f.window_column / NULLIF(som.total_memory_mb, 0), 4) AS Window_Min_to_TotalMemory_Ratio FROM ForgeInstanceMetadataWindow AS f JOIN ShelvedOffloadedMemory AS som ON som.display_name = 'forge' WHERE f.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' ORDER BY Window_Min_to_TotalMemory_Ratio DESC, f.UUID, f.KEY;

question: For instances whose display name is "forge" and that are not deleted and have system metadata with the key `image_image_type`, list the instance UUID, hostname, availability zone, cached network_info JSON, the instance’s rank within its availability zone ordered by instance ID, the instance display name, the `image_image_type` metadata value, the number of network-info cache records, and the total memory (in MB) summed across those cache records. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH ForgeInstanceDetails AS (SELECT t0.UUID, t0.HOSTNAME, t0.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, t2.NETWORK_INFO, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ORDER BY t0.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS t0 JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS t1 ON t1.INSTANCE_UUID = t0.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t2.INSTANCE_UUID = t0.UUID WHERE t0.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), ImageTypeCacheMemoryStats AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, ism.value AS image_type_value, COUNT(iic.id) AS cache_record_count, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances i JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, ism.value) SELECT fid.UUID AS instance_uuid, fid.HOSTNAME, fid.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, fid.NETWORK_INFO, fid.window_column AS az_rank_by_instance_id, itcms.display_name, itcms.image_type_value, itcms.cache_record_count, itcms.total_memory_mb FROM ForgeInstanceDetails fid JOIN ImageTypeCacheMemoryStats itcms ON fid.UUID = itcms.instance_uuid ORDER BY fid.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, fid.window_column, fid.UUID;

question: For non-deleted instances where the maximum instance memory (grouped by instance display name, metadata key, and launched timestamp) is greater than 16000 MB, list the instance display name, metadata key, maximum memory in MB, and launched timestamp, along with any completed migration details for that instance (migration status, source compute, destination compute, the instance flavor JSON, and the dense-rank window column). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH HighMemoryInstancesByMetadata AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) AS max_memory_mb, i.LAUNCHED_AT FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism JOIN INSTANCES i ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME, ism.KEY, i.LAUNCHED_AT HAVING MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) > 16000 ), CompletedMigrationsWithFlavor AS ( SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, i.display_name, ie.flavor, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.status ORDER BY m.status) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' ) SELECT hmi.DISPLAY_NAME, hmi.metadata_key, hmi.max_memory_mb, hmi.LAUNCHED_AT, cmwf.status AS migration_status, cmwf.source_compute, cmwf.dest_compute, cmwf.flavor AS instance_flavor_json, cmwf.window_column FROM HighMemoryInstancesByMetadata hmi JOIN CompletedMigrationsWithFlavor cmwf ON hmi.DISPLAY_NAME = cmwf.display_name ORDER BY hmi.max_memory_mb DESC, hmi.DISPLAY_NAME, hmi.metadata_key;

question: For instance display names that are among the top 10 by number of completed migrations (counting only instances that have an `image_image_type` entry in instance system metadata), show the instance display name, the number of completed migrations, and the total memory (in MB) for those display names whose instances are in the `shelved_offloaded` VM state and have total memory greater than 50000 MB. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH TopCompletedMigrations AS (SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(m.id) AS migrations FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migrations DESC LIMIT 10), ShelvedOffloadedHighMemory AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) AS total_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME HAVING SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) > 50000) SELECT tcm.display_name, tcm.migrations AS completed_migrations, sohm.total_memory_mb FROM TopCompletedMigrations tcm JOIN ShelvedOffloadedHighMemory sohm ON tcm.display_name = sohm.display_name ORDER BY tcm.migrations DESC;

question: For instances that are not deleted (deleted = 0) and that also have a completed migration (status = 'completed'), list the instance UUID, display name, memory (MB), vCPU count, and instance flavor JSON, along with the migration status, source compute, destination compute, and the instance system metadata key; also include the dense-rank values from the migration-by-instance window and the instance-by-project window. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH CompletedMigrations AS (SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, i.display_name, ism.key, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.instance_uuid ORDER BY m.instance_uuid) AS window_column FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed'), ActiveInstancesWithFlavor AS (SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, ie.flavor, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.project_id ORDER BY i.project_id) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0), CombinedInstanceDetails AS ( SELECT ai.uuid AS instance_uuid, ai.display_name, ai.memory_mb, ai.vcpus, ai.flavor, cm.status AS migration_status, cm.source_compute, cm.dest_compute, cm.key AS system_metadata_key, cm.window_column AS migration_dense_rank, ai.window_column AS project_dense_rank FROM ActiveInstancesWithFlavor ai JOIN CompletedMigrations cm ON ai.display_name = cm.display_name ) SELECT instance_uuid, display_name, memory_mb, vcpus, flavor, migration_status, source_compute, dest_compute, system_metadata_key, migration_dense_rank, project_dense_rank FROM CombinedInstanceDetails ORDER BY instance_uuid, system_metadata_key;

question: For each instance VM state, list the VM state, the geometric mean of instance memory (in MB) across instances with a system metadata entry where key = 'image_image_type' (and memory_mb > 0), along with the average root disk size (ROOT_GB), the root disk size range, and the variance of ROOT_GB for instances with the same system metadata key. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH MemoryGeoMeanByVMState AS ( SELECT i.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.vm_state ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC ), RootDiskStatsByVMState AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, AVG(i.ROOT_GB) AS avg_root_gb, MAX(i.ROOT_GB) - MIN(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_range, VARIANCE(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY root_gb_range DESC ) SELECT mg.vm_state, mg.geometric_mean_memory_mb, rd.avg_root_gb, rd.root_gb_range, rd.root_gb_variance FROM MemoryGeoMeanByVMState AS mg JOIN RootDiskStatsByVMState AS rd ON mg.vm_state = rd.vm_state ORDER BY mg.geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC;

question: For each migration status and instance VM state where the instance has system metadata key 'image_image_type' and the migration is not hidden, show the migration count, the minimum instance memory (MB), the number of instances involved, and the minimum migration total memory. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( SELECT m.status AS migration_status, i.vm_state AS instance_vm_state, COUNT(m.id) AS migration_count, MIN(i.memory_mb) AS min_instance_memory_mb FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY m.status, i.vm_state ), q2 AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, m.STATUS AS migration_status, COUNT(i.ID) AS instance_count, MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS min_memory_total FROM INSTANCES i JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.HIDDEN = 0 GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, m.STATUS ) SELECT q1.migration_status, q1.instance_vm_state, q1.migration_count, q1.min_instance_memory_mb, q2.instance_count, q2.min_memory_total FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.migration_status = q2.migration_status AND q1.instance_vm_state = q2.vm_state ORDER BY q1.migration_count DESC;

question: For completed migrations, show the migration ID, the (flare3) instance UUID and display name, the instance system metadata key and value, the row number over metadata key (with a frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row), and the running sum of instance IDs within each metadata key group for flare3 instances, matching records by instance display name and metadata key. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH CompletedMigrationsWithMetadata AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY ism.KEY ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed'), Flare3InstancesMetadataRunningSum AS (SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, ism.KEY, SUM(i.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3') SELECT c.migration_id, f.UUID AS instance_uuid, c.instance_display_name, c.metadata_key, c.metadata_value, c.window_column AS completed_migrations_row_number_window, f.window_column AS flare3_instance_id_running_sum_window FROM CompletedMigrationsWithMetadata c JOIN Flare3InstancesMetadataRunningSum f ON c.instance_display_name = f.DISPLAY_NAME AND c.metadata_key = f.KEY ORDER BY c.migration_id, c.metadata_key;

question: For availability zone "flare3", how many instances have non-empty cached NETWORK_INFO and have a VM_STATE that appears in the per-VM-state geometric mean of migrated MEMORY_TOTAL (computed only from migrations with MEMORY_TOTAL > 0 and non-empty cached NETWORK_INFO), and what is the average of those geometric-mean migrated-memory values across the matching VM states? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH vm_state_geom_mean_migrated_mem AS (SELECT i.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(m.memory_total))) AS geometric_mean_memory_total FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE m.memory_total > 0 AND c.network_info <> '' GROUP BY i.vm_state ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_total DESC), flare3_instances_ranked_by_mem AS (SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, c.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB DESC) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3') SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fir.UUID) AS flare3_instance_count_with_geom_mean_migration_mem, AVG(vsgmmm.geometric_mean_memory_total) AS avg_geometric_mean_memory_total_across_matching_vm_states FROM flare3_instances_ranked_by_mem AS fir JOIN vm_state_geom_mean_migrated_mem AS vsgmmm ON fir.VM_STATE = vsgmmm.vm_state WHERE fir.NETWORK_INFO <> '';

question: For instance display names in availability zone 'flare3' that (a) have INSTANCE_EXTRA rows and (b) also have an INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES entry with more than 5 matching instances, show each display name’s memory (MEMORY_MB) range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) (from the INSTANCE_EXTRA population), along with the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) computed only over instances that have both INSTANCE_EXTRA and INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH StddevWithNetworkAndExtra AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC), RangeVarianceStddevWithExtra AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC) SELECT r.display_name, r.memory_mb_range, r.memory_mb_variance, r.memory_mb_stddev AS memory_mb_stddev_with_extra, s.memory_mb_stddev AS memory_mb_stddev_with_extra_and_network_info_cache FROM RangeVarianceStddevWithExtra r JOIN StddevWithNetworkAndExtra s ON r.display_name = s.display_name ORDER BY r.memory_mb_range DESC;

question: For each security group name, return the variance of the TCP rule starting port (FROM_PORT) and the total number of ports covered across its TCP rules (only including security groups whose total TCP ports covered is greater than 100). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH FromPortVariance AS ( SELECT sg.NAME AS security_group_name, VARIANCE(sgr.FROM_PORT) AS from_port_variance FROM SECURITY_GROUPS AS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sgr.PROTOCOL = 'tcp' GROUP BY sg.NAME ORDER BY from_port_variance DESC ), TotalPortsCovered AS ( SELECT sg.NAME AS security_group_name, SUM(sgr.TO_PORT - sgr.FROM_PORT + 1) AS total_ports_covered FROM SECURITY_GROUPS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sgr.PROTOCOL = 'tcp' GROUP BY sg.NAME HAVING SUM(sgr.TO_PORT - sgr.FROM_PORT + 1) > 100 ) SELECT fpv.security_group_name, fpv.from_port_variance, tpc.total_ports_covered FROM FromPortVariance fpv JOIN TotalPortsCovered tpc ON fpv.security_group_name = tpc.security_group_name;

question: For non-deleted instances in availability zone “flare3”, list the instance UUID, display name, VM state, power state, memory (MB), vCPUs, the instance extra record ID, the maximum instance ID over the current row and next 2 rows (ordered by instance ID), and the geometric mean instance memory (MB) for that VM state (computed over instances with a system metadata key of 'image_image_type' and memory greater than 0), keeping only VM states whose geometric mean memory is greater than 0. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH VmStateGeometricMeanMemory AS ( SELECT i.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.vm_state ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC ), Flare3NonDeletedInstances AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MAX(i.ID) OVER (ORDER BY i.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_id_next_2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' ) SELECT f.instance_uuid, f.display_name, f.vm_state, f.power_state, f.memory_mb, f.vcpus, f.instance_extra_id, f.max_instance_id_next_2, v.geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM Flare3NonDeletedInstances f JOIN VmStateGeometricMeanMemory v ON f.vm_state = v.vm_state WHERE v.geometric_mean_memory_mb > 0 ORDER BY v.geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC, f.instance_uuid;

question: For instances in availability zone “flare3” that also appear in migrations with status “completed”, show the migration ID, instance UUID, display name, VM state, memory in MB, cached network_info JSON, the average memory_mb over a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows (partitioned by VM state and ordered by memory_mb), plus the instance system metadata key and value with a row number ordered by the metadata key using a window frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, AVG(i.memory_mb) OVER ( PARTITION BY i.vm_state ORDER BY i.memory_mb ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' ORDER BY i.memory_mb ), q2 AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY ism.KEY ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ) SELECT q2.migration_id, q1.uuid AS instance_uuid, q1.display_name, q1.vm_state, q1.memory_mb, q1.network_info, q1.window_column AS avg_memory_mb_window, q2.metadata_key, q2.metadata_value, q2.window_column AS metadata_row_number_window FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.display_name = q2.instance_display_name ORDER BY q2.migration_id, q1.memory_mb, q2.metadata_key;

question: For instances in the “flare3” availability zone that are in the “shelved_offloaded” VM state, list each instance’s UUID, display name, VM state, the number of matching INSTANCE_EXTRA records, the total of the matching INSTANCE_EXTRA IDs, and (for that display name) the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (in MB), ordered by the memory standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH sq1 AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC ), sq2 AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, COUNT(ie.id) AS extra_record_count, SUM(ie.id) AS extra_id_sum FROM instances i JOIN instance_extra ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state ) SELECT sq2.instance_uuid, sq2.display_name, sq2.vm_state, sq2.extra_record_count, sq2.extra_id_sum, sq1.avg_memory_mb, sq1.memory_mb_stddev FROM sq2 JOIN sq1 ON sq2.display_name = sq1.display_name WHERE sq2.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' ORDER BY sq1.memory_mb_stddev DESC;

question: For migrations with status 'completed', list each migration ID, the instance display name, the instance availability zone, the migration status, the migration’s rank within the 'completed' status group (ordered by migration ID), and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of that instance’s memory_mb across its system metadata rows (considering only instances that are not deleted). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH InstanceMemoryCV AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) / NULLIF(AVG(i.memory_mb), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(i.memory_mb) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), CompletedMigrations AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE AS instance_availability_zone, m.STATUS AS migration_status, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed') SELECT cm.migration_id, cm.instance_display_name, cm.instance_availability_zone, cm.migration_status, cm.window_column, imcv.coefficient_of_variation FROM CompletedMigrations cm JOIN InstanceMemoryCV imcv ON cm.instance_display_name = imcv.display_name;

question: For instances whose display name is "forge", list the instance ID, UUID, user ID, project ID, hostname, VM state, power state, memory (MB), vCPUs, availability zone, the related instance-info-cache record ID and network info, the minimum memory (MB) within each project, and (for that same VM state) the variance of migration memory total for migrations associated with instances that are not deleted. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH VMStateMigrationMemoryVariance AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, VARIANCE(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS memory_total_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_total_variance DESC), ForgeInstanceDetails AS (SELECT i.ID AS instance_id, i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.USER_ID, i.PROJECT_ID, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, i.POWER_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, c.ID AS info_cache_id, c.NETWORK_INFO, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.PROJECT_ID ORDER BY i.PROJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge') SELECT fid.instance_id, fid.instance_uuid, fid.USER_ID, fid.PROJECT_ID, fid.HOSTNAME, fid.VM_STATE, fid.POWER_STATE, fid.MEMORY_MB, fid.VCPUS, fid.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, fid.info_cache_id, fid.NETWORK_INFO, fid.window_column AS min_memory_mb_in_project, vmmv.memory_total_variance FROM ForgeInstanceDetails fid JOIN VMStateMigrationMemoryVariance vmmv ON fid.VM_STATE = vmmv.VM_STATE ORDER BY vmmv.memory_total_variance DESC, fid.PROJECT_ID, fid.instance_id;

question: For each instance VM state and display name (considering only instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type'), list the VM state, display name, number of instances, minimum instance memory (MB), and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of completed-migration MEMORY_TOTAL for that display name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH InstanceStateDisplayStats AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.ID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME), MigrationMemoryStddevByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY memory_total_stddev DESC) SELECT isds.VM_STATE, isds.DISPLAY_NAME, isds.instance_count, isds.min_memory_mb, mms.memory_total_stddev FROM InstanceStateDisplayStats AS isds LEFT JOIN MigrationMemoryStddevByDisplayName AS mms ON isds.DISPLAY_NAME = mms.display_name ORDER BY isds.instance_count DESC;

question: For instances whose display name is 'forge' and that had completed migrations with memory processed greater than 0, list the instance UUID, instance display name, availability zone, the dense rank when ordering by instance memory (in MB) using a window frame of the current row and the 2 preceding rows, the number of completed migrations for that instance, and the total memory processed (in bytes) across those migrations. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH ForgeWindowRanks AS (SELECT i.uuid, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY i.memory_mb ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name = 'forge'), CompletedMigrationStats AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name AS instance_display_name, i.availability_zone AS availability_zone, COUNT(m.id) AS completed_migration_count, SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND m.memory_processed > 0 GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone) SELECT cms.instance_uuid, cms.instance_display_name, cms.availability_zone, fwr.window_column AS dense_rank_by_memory_window, cms.completed_migration_count, cms.total_memory_processed FROM CompletedMigrationStats cms JOIN ForgeWindowRanks fwr ON cms.instance_uuid = fwr.uuid ORDER BY cms.completed_migration_count DESC, cms.total_memory_processed DESC;

question: For instances whose display name appears in confirmed migrations with destination compute set to 'glint-94', provide the instance display name along with the range and variance of MEMORY_MB across instances that have a system metadata entry with KEY = 'image_image_type'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH ConfirmedGlint94Migrations AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, m.STATUS AS migration_status, i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'confirmed' AND m.DEST_COMPUTE = 'glint-94'), MemoryStatsByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC), Glint94ConfirmedMigrationDisplayNames AS ( SELECT DISTINCT instance_display_name FROM ConfirmedGlint94Migrations ) SELECT ms.display_name, ms.memory_range_mb, ms.memory_variance_mb FROM MemoryStatsByDisplayName ms JOIN Glint94ConfirmedMigrationDisplayNames gmd ON ms.display_name = gmd.instance_display_name;

question: For instances whose display name is 'forge', list the instance UUID, hostname, VM state, memory in MB, the instance extra record ID, and the minimum memory (in MB) over a window of 3 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the instance extra ID; also include the display-name-level range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of non-deleted system metadata entries per non-deleted instance for the display name 'forge'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH ForgeInstanceWindow AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( ORDER BY ie.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ), DisplayNameMetaStats AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(meta_entry_count) - MIN(meta_entry_count) AS meta_count_range, VARIANCE(meta_entry_count) AS meta_count_variance, STDDEV(meta_entry_count) AS meta_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN ( SELECT i2.uuid AS instance_uuid, COUNT(*) AS meta_entry_count FROM instances AS i2 JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i2.uuid ) AS meta_stats ON meta_stats.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY meta_count_range DESC ) SELECT f.instance_uuid, f.hostname, f.vm_state, f.memory_mb, f.instance_extra_id, f.window_column, d.meta_count_range, d.meta_count_variance, d.meta_count_stddev FROM ForgeInstanceWindow AS f JOIN DisplayNameMetaStats AS d ON d.display_name = 'forge' ORDER BY f.instance_extra_id, f.instance_uuid;

question: For instances in availability zone “flare3” that also have system metadata entries, list the instance UUID, display name, VM state, memory in MB, cached network_info JSON, the average memory_mb over a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows (partitioned by VM state and ordered by memory_mb), plus the instance key name, metadata entry count, and total vCPUs summed across those metadata rows. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH InstanceNetworkWindow AS ( SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, AVG(i.memory_mb) OVER ( PARTITION BY i.vm_state ORDER BY i.memory_mb ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' ORDER BY i.memory_mb ), InstanceMetadataAgg AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name, COUNT(ism.id) AS metadata_entry_count, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus FROM instances i JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name ) SELECT nw.uuid AS instance_uuid, nw.display_name, nw.vm_state, nw.memory_mb, nw.network_info, nw.window_column AS avg_memory_mb_window, ma.key_name, ma.metadata_entry_count, ma.total_vcpus FROM InstanceNetworkWindow nw JOIN InstanceMetadataAgg ma ON nw.uuid = ma.instance_uuid ORDER BY nw.memory_mb, nw.uuid;

question: For non-deleted instances in availability zone “flare3” whose display name is among the top 10 instance display names with the highest number of completed migrations (considering only instances that have an `image_image_type` entry in instance system metadata), return the instance UUID, display name, VM state, power state, memory (MB), vCPUs, the instance extra record ID, the maximum instance ID over the current row and next 2 rows (ordered by instance ID), and the completed migration count for that display name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH TopMigrationInstances AS (SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(m.id) AS migrations FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migrations DESC LIMIT 10), Flare3InstanceDetails AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MAX(i.ID) OVER (ORDER BY i.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_id_next_2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3') SELECT fid.instance_uuid, fid.display_name, fid.vm_state, fid.power_state, fid.memory_mb, fid.vcpus, fid.instance_extra_id, fid.max_instance_id_next_2, tmi.migrations AS completed_migrations_for_display_name FROM Flare3InstanceDetails AS fid JOIN TopMigrationInstances AS tmi ON fid.display_name = tmi.display_name;

question: For non-deleted instances whose display name is "forge", list each instance’s UUID, hostname, VM state, system metadata key/value, network info, and the windowed minimum memory (MB), and also include (by matching VM state) the geometric mean memory (MB) for instances in that VM state that have a completed migration. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH ForgeInstanceDetails AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( ORDER BY i.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' AND i.DELETED = 0 ), CompletedMigrationMemoryByState AS ( SELECT i.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.memory_mb > 0 GROUP BY i.vm_state ORDER BY geometric_mean DESC ) SELECT f.instance_uuid, f.hostname, f.vm_state, f.metadata_key, f.metadata_value, f.network_info, f.window_column, c.geometric_mean AS completed_migration_geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM ForgeInstanceDetails AS f JOIN CompletedMigrationMemoryByState AS c ON c.vm_state = f.vm_state ORDER BY f.vm_state, f.instance_uuid, f.metadata_key;

question: For each VM state and availability zone (considering only instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type'), list the VM state, availability zone, the number of instances, and the minimum instance memory (MB), along with (for each resize migration status) the migration status and the average, range, and variance of migrated instance memory (MB) for migrations of type 'resize'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH InstanceStateAzStats AS (SELECT ins.VM_STATE, ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, COUNT(ins.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(ins.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES ins ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON ins.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY ins.VM_STATE, ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE), ResizeMigrationMemoryStats AS (SELECT m.status AS migration_status, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_instance_memory_mb, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS instance_memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS instance_memory_mb_variance FROM instances i JOIN migrations m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.migration_type = 'resize' GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY instance_memory_mb_range DESC) SELECT isaz.VM_STATE, isaz.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, isaz.instance_count, isaz.min_memory_mb, rmms.migration_status, rmms.avg_instance_memory_mb, rmms.instance_memory_mb_range, rmms.instance_memory_mb_variance FROM InstanceStateAzStats isaz CROSS JOIN ResizeMigrationMemoryStats rmms ORDER BY isaz.instance_count DESC, rmms.instance_memory_mb_range DESC;

question: For the availability zone 'flare3', which of the top 10 instance display names by number of instance info cache records also have a computed coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) (STDDEV/AVG) for root disk size (GB) among instances with system metadata key 'image_image_type' and non-deleted instance info cache rows, and what are the cache record count and coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) for each? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH top_cache_records AS ( SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(iic.id) AS cache_records FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY cache_records DESC LIMIT 10 ), root_gb_cov AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.root_gb) / NULLIF(AVG(i.root_gb), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND iic.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(i.root_gb) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT tcr.display_name, tcr.cache_records, rgc.coefficient_of_variation FROM top_cache_records tcr JOIN root_gb_cov rgc ON rgc.display_name = tcr.display_name ORDER BY tcr.cache_records DESC;

question: How many completed migrations are there for instances in availability zone 'flare3' that have a system metadata key of 'image_image_type'? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH instance_zone_metadata_rank AS ( SELECT t1.UUID AS instance_uuid, t2.VALUE AS metadata_value, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND t2.KEY = 'image_image_type' ), completed_migrations_memory AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.HOSTNAME AS instance_hostname, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS migration_source_compute, m.DEST_COMPUTE AS migration_dest_compute, m.DEST_HOST AS migration_dest_host, m.MIGRATION_TYPE AS migration_type, m.MEMORY_TOTAL AS memory_total, m.MEMORY_PROCESSED AS memory_processed, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES i JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ), flare3_completed_migrations_with_image_type AS ( SELECT cmm.instance_uuid, cmm.instance_display_name, cmm.instance_hostname, cmm.migration_source_compute, cmm.migration_dest_compute, cmm.migration_dest_host, cmm.migration_type, cmm.memory_total, cmm.memory_processed, cmm.memory_remaining, cmm.window_column AS min_memory_remaining_within_instance_uuid FROM completed_migrations_memory cmm JOIN INSTANCES i ON i.UUID = cmm.instance_uuid JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS flare3_completed_migrations_with_image_type_count FROM flare3_completed_migrations_with_image_type;

question: For completed migrations, list the migration id, migration status, source compute, destination compute, instance display name, instance network info, the average migration id within each status group (ordered by migration id), and the variance of instance memory (MB) for that same migration status (considering only non-deleted migrations with a corresponding instance info cache record). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH CompletedMigrationDetails AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ic.NETWORK_INFO, AVG(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ORDER BY m.ID ), MigrationStatusMemoryVariance AS ( SELECT m.status, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.deleted = 0 GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT cmd.migration_id, cmd.migration_status, cmd.SOURCE_COMPUTE, cmd.DEST_COMPUTE, cmd.instance_display_name, cmd.NETWORK_INFO, cmd.window_column, msmv.memory_mb_variance FROM CompletedMigrationDetails AS cmd JOIN MigrationStatusMemoryVariance AS msmv ON cmd.migration_status = msmv.status ORDER BY cmd.migration_id;

question: For instances whose display name is 'forge' and that have at least 1 completed migration, show the instance UUID, hostname, VM state, memory in MB, the instance extra record ID, the minimum memory (in MB) over a window of 3 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the instance extra ID, along with the completed migration status, the instance flavor JSON from instance extra, the row number over instance display name (with a window frame of 2 preceding and 1 following row), and the total count of completed migrations for that instance. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH ForgeInstancesWindow AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( ORDER BY ie.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ), CompletedMigrationsWindow AS ( SELECT t0.STATUS AS migration_status, t1.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, t2.FLAVOR AS instance_flavor_json, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.DISPLAY_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS t0 JOIN INSTANCES t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.STATUS = 'completed' ), ForgeCompletedMigrationCounts AS ( SELECT m.INSTANCE_UUID AS instance_uuid, COUNT(*) AS completed_migration_count FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' GROUP BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ) SELECT fiw.instance_uuid, fiw.hostname, fiw.vm_state, fiw.memory_mb, fiw.instance_extra_id, fiw.window_column AS forge_min_memory_mb_window, cmw.migration_status, cmw.instance_flavor_json, cmw.window_column AS completed_migrations_row_number_window, fcmc.completed_migration_count FROM ForgeInstancesWindow fiw JOIN ForgeCompletedMigrationCounts fcmc ON fcmc.instance_uuid = fiw.instance_uuid JOIN CompletedMigrationsWindow cmw ON cmw.instance_display_name = 'forge' WHERE fcmc.completed_migration_count >= 1 ORDER BY fiw.instance_extra_id;

question: For instances that are in VM state "shelved_offloaded" and have a migration status of "completed", list the instance UUID, display name, VM state, migration status, source compute host, destination compute host, the row number within the "completed" migration-status group (ordered by instance UUID), and also include the maximum memory (MB) and launched-at timestamp for matching display-name groups where the instance was launched in 2014 and the maximum memory is greater than 16000 MB. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH HighMemory2014 AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) AS max_memory_mb, i.LAUNCHED_AT FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.LAUNCHED_AT) = 2014 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.LAUNCHED_AT HAVING MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) > 16000), CompletedShelvedMigrations AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS migration_source_compute, m.DEST_COMPUTE AS migration_dest_compute, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' AND m.STATUS = 'completed'), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT csm.instance_uuid, csm.instance_display_name, csm.instance_vm_state, csm.migration_status, csm.migration_source_compute, csm.migration_dest_compute, csm.window_column, hm.max_memory_mb, hm.LAUNCHED_AT AS launched_at_2014 FROM CompletedShelvedMigrations csm JOIN HighMemory2014 hm ON csm.instance_display_name = hm.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY instance_uuid;

question: For instances with a completed migration, list the instance UUID, display name, migration status, destination compute host, and the rank within the 'completed' status group, but only for display names whose total summed root disk size across instances that have system metadata key 'image_image_type' is greater than 50 GB (also show that total root disk size). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, SUM(i.ROOT_GB) AS total_root_gb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME HAVING SUM(i.ROOT_GB) > 50 ), subq2 AS ( SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, m.STATUS, m.DEST_COMPUTE, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ) SELECT subq2.UUID, subq2.DISPLAY_NAME, subq1.total_root_gb, subq2.STATUS, subq2.DEST_COMPUTE, subq2.window_column FROM subq2 JOIN subq1 ON subq2.DISPLAY_NAME = subq1.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY subq1.total_root_gb DESC, subq2.window_column ASC;

question: For instances in availability zone 'flare3' that are in the VM state 'shelved_offloaded', find only those whose display name appears among display names with more than 5 instances that have both extra instance metadata and a network info cache entry in 'flare3'. For each such instance, return the instance UUID, display name, memory (MB), instance-extra record ID, its rank within its memory size group (ordered by UUID), and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of MEMORY_MB for that display name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH MemoryStddevByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC), ShelvedOffloadedInstances AS (SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.MEMORY_MB, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.MEMORY_MB ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded') SELECT soi.UUID, soi.DISPLAY_NAME, soi.MEMORY_MB, soi.instance_extra_id, soi.window_column, msbdn.memory_mb_stddev FROM ShelvedOffloadedInstances soi JOIN MemoryStddevByDisplayName msbdn ON soi.DISPLAY_NAME = msbdn.display_name JOIN INSTANCES i ON i.UUID = soi.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' ORDER BY msbdn.memory_mb_stddev DESC, soi.MEMORY_MB, soi.UUID;

question: For instances whose display name is 'forge' that also appear among instances with system metadata key image_image_type, return the instance UUID, hostname, VM state, memory (MB), instance extra record ID, the windowed minimum memory (ordered by instance extra ID with 3 preceding and 1 following rows), along with the image_image_type metadata value, cached network info, and the row number ordered by the metadata value (with a window frame of 2 preceding and 1 following rows). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH ImageTypeMetadataInstances AS (SELECT t1.DISPLAY_NAME, t0.VALUE AS metadata_value, t2.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t0.VALUE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.KEY = 'image_image_type'), ForgeInstanceDetails AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( ORDER BY ie.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge') SELECT f.instance_uuid, f.hostname, f.vm_state, f.memory_mb, f.instance_extra_id, f.window_column AS forge_min_memory_window, im.metadata_value, im.NETWORK_INFO, im.window_column AS image_type_row_number_window FROM ForgeInstanceDetails AS f JOIN ImageTypeMetadataInstances AS im ON im.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ORDER BY f.instance_extra_id, f.instance_uuid;

question: For each instance availability zone and VM state, considering only instances that are not deleted, show the availability zone and VM state, the total number of instances and the earliest instance creation time (using the instance UUID links to include both the instance extra record and the instance network info cache), along with the number of distinct instances that have a completed migration and the average of the migration window minimum instance memory (in MB) for those completed migrations. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH InstanceZoneStateStats AS (SELECT ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, ins.VM_STATE, COUNT(ins.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(ins.CREATED_AT) AS earliest_created_at FROM INSTANCES AS ins JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID WHERE ins.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, ins.VM_STATE), CompletedMigrationWindow AS (SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.status, MIN(i.memory_mb) OVER ( ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed'), CompletedMigrationZoneState AS ( SELECT ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, ins.VM_STATE, COUNT(DISTINCT cmw.uuid) AS completed_migration_instance_count, AVG(cmw.window_column) AS avg_window_min_memory_mb FROM CompletedMigrationWindow cmw JOIN INSTANCES ins ON ins.UUID = cmw.uuid WHERE ins.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, ins.VM_STATE ) SELECT izss.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, izss.VM_STATE, izss.instance_count, izss.earliest_created_at, cmzs.completed_migration_instance_count, cmzs.avg_window_min_memory_mb FROM InstanceZoneStateStats izss JOIN CompletedMigrationZoneState cmzs ON izss.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = cmzs.AVAILABILITY_ZONE AND izss.VM_STATE = cmzs.VM_STATE ORDER BY izss.instance_count DESC;

question: For each instance display name that (1) has a non-deleted network info cache and (2) has a system metadata entry with KEY = 'image_image_type', show the metadata-entry count range/variance/standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) (counting only non-deleted metadata rows) and also the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the days between instance creation and launch. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH MetadataStatsByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(meta_entry_count) - MIN(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_range, VARIANCE(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_variance, STDDEV(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN ( SELECT i2.DISPLAY_NAME, i2.UUID, COUNT(*) AS meta_entry_count FROM INSTANCES AS i2 JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i2.UUID WHERE ism.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i2.DISPLAY_NAME, i2.UUID ) AS per_instance_meta ON per_instance_meta.UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE iic.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY metadata_count_range DESC), DaysToLaunchStatsByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.launched_at - i.created_at) AS avg_days_to_launch, STDDEV(i.launched_at - i.created_at) AS days_to_launch_stddev FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY days_to_launch_stddev DESC), CombinedInstanceDisplayNameStats AS ( SELECT ms.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, ms.metadata_count_range, ms.metadata_count_variance, ms.metadata_count_stddev, dt.avg_days_to_launch, dt.days_to_launch_stddev FROM MetadataStatsByDisplayName ms JOIN DaysToLaunchStatsByDisplayName dt ON ms.DISPLAY_NAME = dt.display_name ) SELECT * FROM CombinedInstanceDisplayNameStats ORDER BY display_name;

question: From the top 10 VM states with the largest range of total memory moved during completed migrations, show each VM state along with (1) the migration memory_total range (max minus min MEMORY_TOTAL), (2) the variance of migration MEMORY_TOTAL, and (3) the variance of instance MEMORY_MB among instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH mig_stats AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, MAX(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) - MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS memory_total_range, VARIANCE(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS memory_total_variance FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_total_range DESC ), inst_mem_var AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT ms.VM_STATE, ms.memory_total_range, ms.memory_total_variance, imv.memory_mb_variance FROM mig_stats AS ms JOIN inst_mem_var AS imv ON ms.VM_STATE = imv.VM_STATE ORDER BY ms.memory_total_range DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type', list each VM state and availability zone (with its instance count and minimum memory in MB) only when that state/zone accounts for more than 10% of all such instances, and for those qualifying rows also show the migration status along with the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (in MB). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH InstanceStateAZStats AS ( SELECT ins.VM_STATE, ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, COUNT(ins.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(ins.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES ins ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON ins.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY ins.VM_STATE, ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ), MigrationMemoryStats AS ( SELECT m.status, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), TotalImageTypeInstances AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ins.UUID) AS total_instance_count FROM INSTANCES ins JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON ins.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' ) SELECT isaz.VM_STATE, isaz.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, isaz.instance_count, isaz.min_memory_mb, mms.status AS migration_status, mms.avg_memory_mb, mms.memory_mb_variance, mms.memory_mb_stddev FROM InstanceStateAZStats isaz CROSS JOIN TotalImageTypeInstances ti JOIN MigrationMemoryStats mms ON (isaz.instance_count * 1.0 / ti.total_instance_count) > 0.10 ORDER BY (isaz.instance_count * 1.0 / ti.total_instance_count) DESC, mms.memory_mb_variance DESC;

question: For non-deleted instances (DELETED = 0) whose display name is among the instance display names in availability zone 'flare3' that have extra instance metadata and a network info cache entry (and have more than 5 such rows), list the instance UUID, display name, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of MEMORY_MB for that display name, and each system metadata key/value along with its dense-rank window column. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH MemoryStddevByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC), InstanceSystemMetadataRanked AS (SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, ism.key, ism.value, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.uuid ORDER BY i.uuid) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0) SELECT ism.uuid AS instance_uuid, ism.display_name, msd.memory_mb_stddev, ism.key AS system_metadata_key, ism.value AS system_metadata_value, ism.window_column FROM InstanceSystemMetadataRanked ism JOIN MemoryStddevByDisplayName msd ON ism.display_name = msd.display_name ORDER BY msd.memory_mb_stddev DESC, ism.uuid, ism.window_column, ism.key;

question: From the top 10 migration statuses with the highest variance in instance memory (MEMORY_MB) among instances that have a non-deleted instance info cache record, display each migration status along with its memory variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and also show (for each status) every instance VM state’s memory variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) computed only from instances that have system metadata with KEY = 'image_image_type'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( SELECT m.status, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE ic.deleted = 0 GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), q2 AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), top_migration_status AS ( SELECT status FROM q1 LIMIT 10 ) SELECT tms.status AS migration_status, q1.memory_mb_variance AS migration_memory_mb_variance, q1.memory_mb_stddev AS migration_memory_mb_stddev, q2.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, q2.memory_mb_variance AS vm_state_memory_mb_variance, q2.memory_mb_stddev AS vm_state_memory_mb_stddev FROM top_migration_status tms JOIN q1 ON q1.status = tms.status CROSS JOIN q2 ORDER BY q1.memory_mb_variance DESC, q2.memory_mb_variance DESC;

question: For instances that are not deleted and have system metadata with key = 'image_image_type', list each instance UUID, instance display name, and the metadata value, along with (a) the number of instance_info_caches records and the total memory (MB) summed across those cache records, and (b) the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (MB) for that same display name across all instances with key = 'image_image_type'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH InstanceCacheAndImageType AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, ism.value AS image_type_value, COUNT(iic.id) AS cache_record_count, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances i JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, ism.value), MemoryStatsByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), CombinedInstanceImageTypeAndMemoryStats AS ( SELECT icait.instance_uuid, icait.display_name, icait.image_type_value, icait.cache_record_count, icait.total_memory_mb, msbdn.memory_mb_variance, msbdn.memory_mb_stddev FROM InstanceCacheAndImageType icait JOIN MemoryStatsByDisplayName msbdn ON msbdn.display_name = icait.display_name ) SELECT * FROM CombinedInstanceImageTypeAndMemoryStats ORDER BY display_name, instance_uuid;

question: For instances named 'forge' that also have completed migrations while in the 'shelved_offloaded' VM state, list the migration status, source compute, destination compute, instance UUID, instance display name, instance memory (MB), hostname, VM state, instance extra record ID, the system metadata key and value, and both windowed minimum memory values (one ordered by migration ID and one ordered by instance extra ID). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH CompletedShelvedMigrations AS (SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.memory_mb, ism.key, ism.value, MIN(i.memory_mb) OVER ( ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded'), ForgeInstances AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( ORDER BY ie.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge') SELECT csm.status AS migration_status, csm.source_compute, csm.dest_compute, csm.instance_uuid, csm.display_name, csm.memory_mb, fi.hostname, fi.vm_state, fi.instance_extra_id, csm.key AS system_metadata_key, csm.value AS system_metadata_value, csm.window_column AS migration_window_min_memory_mb, fi.window_column AS instance_extra_window_min_memory_mb FROM CompletedShelvedMigrations csm JOIN ForgeInstances fi ON csm.instance_uuid = fi.instance_uuid ORDER BY csm.instance_uuid, fi.instance_extra_id;

question: For instances whose display name is "forge", list the instance ID, UUID, user ID, project ID, hostname, VM state, power state, memory (MB), vCPUs, availability zone, the related instance-info-cache record ID and network info, the minimum memory (MB) within each project, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of memory (MB) for display name "forge" among instances with a non-deleted system metadata entry where KEY = 'image_image_type', and compute the memory-to-project-min ratio (instance memory divided by the project minimum) rounded.
SQL: WITH ForgeInstances AS (SELECT i.ID AS instance_id, i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.USER_ID, i.PROJECT_ID, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, i.POWER_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, c.ID AS info_cache_id, c.NETWORK_INFO, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.PROJECT_ID ORDER BY i.PROJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), MemoryStatsByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND ism.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT fi.instance_id, fi.instance_uuid, fi.USER_ID, fi.PROJECT_ID, fi.HOSTNAME, fi.VM_STATE, fi.POWER_STATE, fi.MEMORY_MB, fi.VCPUS, fi.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, fi.info_cache_id, fi.NETWORK_INFO, fi.window_column AS min_memory_mb_in_project, ms.memory_mb_variance, ms.memory_mb_stddev, ROUND(fi.MEMORY_MB / NULLIF(fi.window_column, 0), 2) AS memory_to_project_min_ratio FROM ForgeInstances fi JOIN MemoryStatsByDisplayName ms ON ms.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ORDER BY memory_to_project_min_ratio DESC;

question: Show a combined list of non-deleted instances that either (a) are in VM state shelved_offloaded and include their UUID, project ID, power state, system metadata key/value, and the max memory over the current and next 2 UUID-ordered rows, or (b) include their instance cache details (display name, VM state, memory in MB, cached network_info JSON, and the dense-rank window column). Also include a “reason” column indicating which condition each row came from. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH InstanceCacheDetails AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.project_id ORDER BY i.project_id) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0), ShelvedOffloadedMetadata AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.PROJECT_ID AS project_id, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (ORDER BY i.UUID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_memory_mb_next_2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded'), CombinedInstanceViews AS (SELECT sm.instance_uuid AS instance_uuid, sm.display_name AS display_name, sm.project_id AS project_id, sm.power_state AS power_state, sm.metadata_key AS metadata_key, sm.metadata_value AS metadata_value, sm.max_memory_mb_next_2 AS max_memory_mb_next_2, icd.vm_state AS vm_state, icd.memory_mb AS memory_mb, icd.network_info AS network_info, icd.window_column AS window_column, 'Shelved Offloaded With Metadata' AS reason FROM ShelvedOffloadedMetadata sm JOIN InstanceCacheDetails icd ON icd.display_name = sm.display_name AND icd.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS instance_uuid, icd.display_name AS display_name, NULL AS project_id, NULL AS power_state, NULL AS metadata_key, NULL AS metadata_value, NULL AS max_memory_mb_next_2, icd.vm_state AS vm_state, icd.memory_mb AS memory_mb, icd.network_info AS network_info, icd.window_column AS window_column, 'Non-deleted Instance Cache Details' AS reason FROM InstanceCacheDetails icd) SELECT * FROM CombinedInstanceViews ORDER BY display_name, reason;

question: List each instance display name that appears in either (a) the non-deleted instances-with-system-metadata memory-size standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) result (only display names with more than 5 rows) or (b) the completed-migrations MEMORY_REMAINING coefficient-of-variation result (only where average MEMORY_REMAINING is greater than 0), and show the metric value along with a reason indicating which calculation produced the row. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH MemoryStddevByDisplayName AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC ), MigrationMemoryRemainingCVByDisplayName AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), CombinedInstanceVariability AS ( SELECT display_name, memory_mb_stddev AS metric_value, 'Instance Memory MB Stddev (non-deleted instances with system metadata; >5 rows)' AS reason FROM MemoryStddevByDisplayName UNION ALL SELECT display_name, coefficient_of_variation AS metric_value, 'Migration MEMORY_REMAINING Coefficient of Variation (completed migrations; avg>0)' AS reason FROM MigrationMemoryRemainingCVByDisplayName ) SELECT display_name, metric_value, reason FROM CombinedInstanceVariability ORDER BY display_name, reason;

question: For security group rules belonging to the security group named "aurum-xenon", and only if that security group is among the top 10 security groups with the most non-deleted rules, show the security group name, the rule protocol, the rule from port, the running sum of from ports within each protocol ordered by from port, the group’s total rule count, and a normalized metric (running sum divided by rule count) rounded to 2 decimals.
SQL: WITH RuleWindow AS ( SELECT sg.NAME AS security_group_name, sgr.PROTOCOL, sgr.FROM_PORT, SUM(sgr.FROM_PORT) OVER ( PARTITION BY sgr.PROTOCOL ORDER BY sgr.FROM_PORT ) AS window_column FROM SECURITY_GROUPS AS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sg.NAME = 'aurum-xenon' ), TopRuleCounts AS ( SELECT sg.NAME AS security_group_name, COUNT(sgr.ID) AS rule_count FROM SECURITY_GROUPS AS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sg.DELETED = 0 AND sgr.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY sg.NAME ORDER BY rule_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT rw.security_group_name, rw.PROTOCOL, rw.FROM_PORT, rw.window_column, trc.rule_count, ROUND(rw.window_column / NULLIF(trc.rule_count, 0), 2) AS normalized_running_from_port_per_rule FROM RuleWindow rw JOIN TopRuleCounts trc ON rw.security_group_name = trc.security_group_name ORDER BY normalized_running_from_port_per_rule DESC, rw.PROTOCOL, rw.FROM_PORT;

question: For each non-deleted instance display name, list the variance of instance memory (MB) across its system metadata entries, the overall memory range (max–min) and variance (MB), and compute the variance-to-range ratio (metadata memory variance divided by memory range), ordered by the ratio descending.
SQL: WITH MemoryVarianceFromMetadata AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), MemoryRangeAndVariance AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC) SELECT mv.DISPLAY_NAME, mv.memory_mb_variance AS metadata_memory_mb_variance, mr.memory_range_mb, mr.memory_variance_mb, ROUND(mv.memory_mb_variance / NULLIF(mr.memory_range_mb, 0), 4) AS variance_to_range_ratio FROM MemoryVarianceFromMetadata mv JOIN MemoryRangeAndVariance mr ON mv.DISPLAY_NAME = mr.display_name ORDER BY variance_to_range_ratio DESC;

question: For completed migrations of instances in the “shelved_offloaded” VM state, show the migration status, source compute, destination compute, instance UUID, instance display name, instance memory (MB), system metadata key and value, and the minimum instance memory (MB) over a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by migration ID; also include (for the same migration status and VM state, considering only instances that have system metadata with key 'image_image_type') the number of migrations and the minimum instance memory (MB). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH ShelvedCompletedMigrations AS ( SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.memory_mb, ism.key, ism.value, MIN(i.memory_mb) OVER ( ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' ), MigrationStatusVmStateStats AS ( SELECT m.status AS migration_status, i.vm_state AS instance_vm_state, COUNT(m.id) AS migration_count, MIN(i.memory_mb) AS min_instance_memory_mb FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY m.status, i.vm_state ) SELECT scm.status, scm.source_compute, scm.dest_compute, scm.instance_uuid, scm.display_name, scm.memory_mb, scm.key, scm.value, scm.window_column, msvs.migration_count, msvs.min_instance_memory_mb FROM ShelvedCompletedMigrations scm JOIN MigrationStatusVmStateStats msvs ON msvs.migration_status = scm.status AND msvs.instance_vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded';

question: For instances in availability zone "flare3" that have a corresponding instance info cache record and are associated with non-deleted migrations, for each migration status return the status, the variance of instance memory (in MB), and how many flare3 instances fall under that status. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH MigrationStatusMemoryVariance AS ( SELECT m.status, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.deleted = 0 GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), Flare3InstancesWithNetworkInfo AS ( SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, c.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB DESC) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' ) SELECT msmv.status, msmv.memory_mb_variance, COUNT(*) AS flare3_instance_count FROM MigrationStatusMemoryVariance AS msmv JOIN migrations AS m ON m.status = msmv.status JOIN Flare3InstancesWithNetworkInfo AS f ON f.UUID = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.deleted = 0 GROUP BY msmv.status, msmv.memory_mb_variance ORDER BY msmv.memory_mb_variance DESC;

question: For instances in availability zone “flare3” that are not deleted, list the instance UUID, display name, VM state, memory in MB, cached network_info JSON, the average memory_mb over a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows partitioned by VM state and ordered by memory_mb, and the dense rank partitioned by the instance’s project_id and ordered by that same project_id. Do not return any rounded answers.
