SQL: WITH AZInstanceWindow AS ( SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, AVG(i.memory_mb) OVER ( PARTITION BY i.vm_state ORDER BY i.memory_mb ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' ORDER BY i.memory_mb ), NotDeletedInstanceDenseRank AS ( SELECT i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.project_id ORDER BY i.project_id) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 ), NotDeletedInstanceDenseRankWithUUID AS ( SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.project_id ORDER BY i.project_id) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 ) SELECT az.uuid, az.display_name, az.vm_state, az.memory_mb, az.network_info, az.window_column AS Avg_MemoryMB_Window_2_Preceding_2_Following_By_VMState, nd.window_column AS Dense_Rank_By_Project FROM AZInstanceWindow az JOIN NotDeletedInstanceDenseRankWithUUID nd ON az.uuid = nd.uuid ORDER BY az.memory_mb;

question: How many instances are both in availability zone 'flare3' (with the max system-metadata ID over the current and next 2 rows when ordered by instance UUID) and in VM state 'shelved_offloaded' (with cached network info and an availability-zone rank)? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH az_instances_with_metadata_window AS ( SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, i.uuid, MAX(ism.id) OVER ( ORDER BY i.uuid ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_metadata_id_next_2 FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' ), shelved_offloaded_instances_with_network_rank AS ( SELECT i.ID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, c.NETWORK_INFO, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ORDER BY i.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS flare3_shelved_offloaded_instances_with_metadata_and_network_count FROM az_instances_with_metadata_window az JOIN shelved_offloaded_instances_with_network_rank so ON az.uuid = ( SELECT i2.uuid FROM instances i2 WHERE i2.id = so.id AND i2.availability_zone = 'flare3' );

question: List a combined report that UNION ALLs (1) per-migration-status instance memory statistics (average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), for instances with a matching migration record and non-NULL memory) and (2) per-VM-state instance root disk statistics (average, range, and variance, for non-deleted instances with an INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA key of 'image_image_type' and a matching INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES row), including a “reason” column indicating which set each row came from. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH MigrationMemoryStats AS (SELECT m.status, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), VMStateRootDiskStats AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, AVG(i.ROOT_GB) AS avg_root_gb, MAX(i.ROOT_GB) - MIN(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_range, VARIANCE(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY root_gb_range DESC), CombinedStats AS ( SELECT status AS category, avg_memory_mb AS avg_value, memory_mb_variance AS variance_value, memory_mb_stddev AS stddev_value, NULL AS range_value, 'Migration Status Memory Stats' AS reason FROM MigrationMemoryStats UNION ALL SELECT vm_state AS category, avg_root_gb AS avg_value, root_gb_variance AS variance_value, NULL AS stddev_value, root_gb_range AS range_value, 'VM State Root Disk Stats' AS reason FROM VMStateRootDiskStats ) SELECT * FROM CombinedStats ORDER BY reason, category;

question: For instances in availability zone 'flare3', list each instance UUID and display name along with its key name, the number of system metadata entries it has, the total vCPUs summed across those metadata rows, and its cached network info with a row number ordered by display name using a window frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH MetadataStats AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name, COUNT(ism.id) AS metadata_entry_count, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus FROM instances i JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name), NetworkWindow AS (SELECT t1.DISPLAY_NAME, t1.UUID AS instance_uuid, t2.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.DISPLAY_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3'), CombinedInstanceDetails AS ( SELECT ms.instance_uuid, ms.display_name, ms.key_name, ms.metadata_entry_count, ms.total_vcpus, nw.NETWORK_INFO, nw.window_column FROM MetadataStats ms JOIN NetworkWindow nw ON ms.instance_uuid = nw.instance_uuid ) SELECT * FROM CombinedInstanceDetails ORDER BY display_name, instance_uuid;

question: For instance display names that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type', list the display name, the average and variance of instance memory (in MB) computed from INSTANCE_EXTRA-linked instances and from MIGRATIONS-linked instances, but only include display names where the INSTANCE_EXTRA-based memory variance is greater than the MIGRATIONS-based memory variance. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH InstanceExtraMemoryStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), MigrationMemoryStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT iems.display_name, iems.avg_memory_mb AS instance_extra_avg_memory_mb, iems.memory_mb_variance AS instance_extra_memory_mb_variance, mms.avg_memory_mb AS migrations_avg_memory_mb, mms.memory_mb_variance AS migrations_memory_mb_variance FROM InstanceExtraMemoryStats iems JOIN MigrationMemoryStats mms ON iems.display_name = mms.display_name WHERE iems.memory_mb_variance > mms.memory_mb_variance ORDER BY iems.memory_mb_variance DESC;

question: For instances with display name 'forge' in availability zone 'flare3', show the instance display name and UUID, each system metadata key/value, the cached network info, and the row numbers computed in each subquery (metadata ordered by metadata key and network info ordered by display name, both using a window frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH ForgeSystemMetadata AS (SELECT i.UUID, ism.KEY, ism.VALUE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ism.KEY ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), Flare3InstanceNetworkInfo AS (SELECT t1.DISPLAY_NAME, t1.UUID AS instance_uuid, t2.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.DISPLAY_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3') SELECT fn.DISPLAY_NAME, fn.instance_uuid, fsm.KEY AS system_metadata_key, fsm.VALUE AS system_metadata_value, fn.NETWORK_INFO, fsm.window_column AS metadata_window_row_number, fn.window_column AS network_window_row_number FROM Flare3InstanceNetworkInfo fn JOIN ForgeSystemMetadata fsm ON fn.instance_uuid = fsm.UUID WHERE fn.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ORDER BY fn.instance_uuid, fsm.KEY;

question: For migrations with status "completed", return the migration ID, the instance display name, the instance system metadata key and value, the row number ordered by the metadata key using a window frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row, and also include (for that same instance display name) the variance of instance memory size in MB considering only instances that have a matching row in INSTANCE_EXTRA. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH CompletedMigrationMetadata AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY ism.KEY ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed'), MemoryVarianceByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT cmm.migration_id, cmm.instance_display_name, cmm.metadata_key, cmm.metadata_value, cmm.window_column, mv.memory_mb_variance FROM CompletedMigrationMetadata AS cmm JOIN MemoryVarianceByDisplayName AS mv ON cmm.instance_display_name = mv.display_name;

question: For instances that have at least 2 completed migrations, list the instance UUID, display name, availability zone, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (MB) across system metadata rows (only for display names with at least 3 system metadata entries), the number of completed migrations, and the total memory processed across those completed migrations. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH InstanceMemoryStddev AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 2 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC), CompletedMigrationStats AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone, COUNT(m.id) AS migration_count, SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM instances i JOIN migrations m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone) SELECT cms.instance_uuid, cms.display_name, cms.availability_zone, ims.memory_mb_stddev, cms.migration_count, cms.total_memory_processed FROM CompletedMigrationStats cms JOIN InstanceMemoryStddev ims ON cms.display_name = ims.display_name WHERE cms.migration_count >= 2 ORDER BY ims.memory_mb_stddev DESC;

question: For availability zone "flare3", list each instance’s UUID, display name, VM state, memory (MB), cached network info, and its row number within the VM state ordered by memory (descending), along with the geometric mean of memory (MB) for that VM state computed over non-deleted instances. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH InstanceDetails AS ( SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, c.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB DESC) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' ), GeometricMeanMemoryByState AS ( SELECT i.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.vm_state ORDER BY geometric_mean DESC ) SELECT id.UUID, id.DISPLAY_NAME, id.VM_STATE, id.MEMORY_MB, id.NETWORK_INFO, id.window_column, gm.geometric_mean FROM InstanceDetails AS id JOIN GeometricMeanMemoryByState AS gm ON id.VM_STATE = gm.vm_state;

question: For migrations with status equal to "completed", list the migration id, migration status, source compute, destination compute, destination host, migration instance UUID, the instance display name, instance VM state, instance memory (MB), instance vCPUs, the system metadata key and value for that instance, and the minimum migration memory remaining within each destination compute group (ordered by destination compute), but only for instances whose display name is among those where the total memory (in MB) across “shelved_offloaded” instances with at least one system metadata entry keyed “image_image_type” exceeds 20000 MB; also include that total memory per display name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH completed_migrations AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, m.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS instance_vcpus, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS migration_memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ORDER BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed'), high_memory_shelved_display_names AS (SELECT i.display_name, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > 20000) SELECT cm.migration_id, cm.migration_status, cm.source_compute, cm.dest_compute, cm.dest_host, cm.instance_uuid, cm.instance_display_name, cm.instance_vm_state, cm.instance_memory_mb, cm.instance_vcpus, cm.metadata_key, cm.metadata_value, cm.migration_memory_remaining, cm.window_column, hmsdn.total_memory_mb FROM completed_migrations cm JOIN high_memory_shelved_display_names hmsdn ON cm.instance_display_name = hmsdn.display_name ORDER BY cm.dest_compute;

question: For instance VM states and display names (considering only instances with more than 8 VCPUs), for display names that also have a non-deleted network info cache and non-deleted system-metadata rows, return the VM state, display name, number of instances, minimum memory (MB), and the range/variance/standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of per-instance system-metadata entry counts, but only for groups where the instance count is greater than 1. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH InstanceStateNameStats AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VCPUS > 8 GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME), DisplayNameMetadataStats AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(meta_entry_count) - MIN(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_range, VARIANCE(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_variance, STDDEV(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN ( SELECT i2.DISPLAY_NAME, i2.UUID, COUNT(*) AS meta_entry_count FROM INSTANCES AS i2 JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i2.UUID WHERE ism.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i2.DISPLAY_NAME, i2.UUID ) AS per_instance_meta ON per_instance_meta.UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE iic.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY metadata_count_range DESC) SELECT isns.VM_STATE, isns.DISPLAY_NAME, isns.instance_count, isns.min_memory_mb, dnms.metadata_count_range, dnms.metadata_count_variance, dnms.metadata_count_stddev FROM InstanceStateNameStats AS isns JOIN DisplayNameMetadataStats AS dnms ON isns.DISPLAY_NAME = dnms.DISPLAY_NAME WHERE isns.instance_count > 1 ORDER BY isns.instance_count DESC, dnms.metadata_count_range DESC;

question: For each non-deleted instance (and non-deleted system metadata row), list the instance UUID, display name, VM state, power state, memory (MB), vCPU count, system metadata key/value, and the maximum INSTANCE_EXTRA row ID over the current row and the next 2 rows when ordered by instance UUID, along with (for that same display name) the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of network-info cache records per instance. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH InstanceMetadataAndExtraWindow AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, MAX(ie.ID) OVER ( ORDER BY i.UUID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_instance_extra_id_next_2 FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.DELETED = 0 ), DisplayNameCacheStats AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(cache_row_count) - MIN(cache_row_count) AS cache_count_range, VARIANCE(cache_row_count) AS cache_count_variance, STDDEV(cache_row_count) AS cache_count_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN ( SELECT iic.INSTANCE_UUID, COUNT(*) AS cache_row_count FROM INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic GROUP BY iic.INSTANCE_UUID, iic.ID ) AS cache_stats ON cache_stats.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY cache_count_range DESC ) SELECT im.instance_uuid, im.display_name, im.vm_state, im.power_state, im.memory_mb, im.vcpus, im.metadata_key, im.metadata_value, im.max_instance_extra_id_next_2, dn.cache_count_range, dn.cache_count_variance, dn.cache_count_stddev FROM InstanceMetadataAndExtraWindow AS im JOIN DisplayNameCacheStats AS dn ON im.display_name = dn.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY dn.cache_count_range DESC, im.instance_uuid;

question: For each migration status, list the migration status along with (1) the average, range, and variance of instance memory (MB) for migrations of type 'resize', and (2) the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (MB) for instances that have at least one system metadata entry with the key 'image_image_type'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH ResizeMigrationMemoryStats AS ( SELECT m.status AS migration_status, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_instance_memory_mb, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS instance_memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS instance_memory_mb_variance FROM instances i JOIN migrations m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.migration_type = 'resize' GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY instance_memory_mb_range DESC ), ImageTypeMetadataMemoryStats AS ( SELECT m.status, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT r.migration_status, r.avg_instance_memory_mb, r.instance_memory_mb_range, r.instance_memory_mb_variance, it.avg_memory_mb AS avg_memory_mb_with_image_image_type_metadata, it.memory_mb_variance AS memory_mb_variance_with_image_image_type_metadata, it.memory_mb_stddev AS memory_mb_stddev_with_image_image_type_metadata FROM ResizeMigrationMemoryStats r JOIN ImageTypeMetadataMemoryStats it ON r.migration_status = it.status ORDER BY r.instance_memory_mb_range DESC;

question: List instance UUID, display name, VM state, power state, memory (MB), vCPU count, system metadata key/value, and the windowed max INSTANCE_EXTRA ID (current row through next 2 by instance UUID) for non-deleted instances with non-deleted system metadata, and also include (as separate UNION ALL rows) any matching instances that have at least one completed migration where the maximum migration MEMORY_TOTAL is greater than 0, showing that max MEMORY_TOTAL and the instance creation timestamp along with a reason indicating which condition produced each row. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH CompletedMigrationMaxMemory AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(m.memory_total) AS max_memory_total, i.created_at FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.display_name, i.created_at, m.status HAVING MAX(m.memory_total) > 0 ), ActiveInstanceMetadataWindow AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, MAX(ie.ID) OVER ( ORDER BY i.UUID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_instance_extra_id_next_2 FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.DELETED = 0 ), CombinedInstanceReport AS ( SELECT aim.instance_uuid, aim.display_name, aim.vm_state, aim.power_state, aim.memory_mb, aim.vcpus, aim.metadata_key, aim.metadata_value, aim.max_instance_extra_id_next_2, cmm.max_memory_total, cmm.created_at AS instance_created_at, 'Has Completed Migration Max Memory' AS reason FROM ActiveInstanceMetadataWindow aim JOIN CompletedMigrationMaxMemory cmm ON aim.display_name = cmm.display_name UNION ALL SELECT aim.instance_uuid, aim.display_name, aim.vm_state, aim.power_state, aim.memory_mb, aim.vcpus, aim.metadata_key, aim.metadata_value, aim.max_instance_extra_id_next_2, NULL AS max_memory_total, NULL AS instance_created_at, 'Active Instance Metadata Window' AS reason FROM ActiveInstanceMetadataWindow aim ) SELECT instance_uuid, display_name, vm_state, power_state, memory_mb, vcpus, metadata_key, metadata_value, max_instance_extra_id_next_2, max_memory_total, instance_created_at, reason FROM CombinedInstanceReport ORDER BY display_name, instance_uuid, metadata_key;

question: For each instance display name that appears in both (a) the set of instances with a non-deleted instance info cache record and (b) the set of instances that are not deleted, show the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of migrations-per-destination-compute counts, along with the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of MEMORY_MB across that instance’s records. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH MigrationStats AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(s.migration_count) - MIN(s.migration_count) AS migration_count_range, VARIANCE(s.migration_count) AS migration_count_variance, STDDEV(s.migration_count) AS migration_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid JOIN ( SELECT m.instance_uuid, COUNT(*) AS migration_count FROM migrations AS m GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.dest_compute ) AS s ON i.uuid = s.instance_uuid WHERE ic.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migration_count_range DESC ), MemoryStats AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC ) SELECT ms.display_name, ms.migration_count_range, ms.migration_count_variance, ms.migration_count_stddev, mem.memory_mb_range, mem.memory_mb_variance, mem.memory_mb_stddev FROM MigrationStats ms JOIN MemoryStats mem ON ms.display_name = mem.display_name ORDER BY ms.migration_count_range DESC, mem.memory_mb_range DESC;

question: For the top 10 instance display names with the most completed migrations (counting migrations by migration ID) among instances with a non-null key name, list the instance display name, the completed migration count, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (MEMORY_MB) computed across instances that have a non-deleted instance info cache record, and compute a normalized ratio (completed migrations divided by memory standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP)) rounded to 2 decimals.
SQL: WITH MemoryStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE ic.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), TopCompletedMigrations AS (SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(m.id) AS completed_migrations FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.key_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY completed_migrations DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT tcm.display_name, tcm.completed_migrations, ms.memory_mb_variance, ms.memory_mb_stddev, ROUND(tcm.completed_migrations / NULLIF(ms.memory_mb_stddev, 0), 2) AS Migrations_Per_MemoryStdDev FROM TopCompletedMigrations tcm JOIN MemoryStats ms ON tcm.display_name = ms.display_name ORDER BY Migrations_Per_MemoryStdDev DESC;

question: For completed migrations, show each migration’s id, status, source compute, destination compute, destination host, instance display name, and instance VM state, along with (1) the maximum instance memory (MB) over the window ordered by migration id from the current row through the next 2 rows, and (2) the instance memory (MB), system metadata key/value, and the average instance memory (MB) over the window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows partitioned by migration status and ordered by migration id. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH MigrationWindowMaxMemory AS ( SELECT m.id AS migration_id, m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.dest_host, i.display_name, i.vm_state, MAX(i.memory_mb) OVER (ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_memory_mb_next_2 FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' ), MigrationMetadataWindowAvgMemory AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.MEMORY_MB, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ) SELECT mwmm.migration_id, mwmm.status, mwmm.source_compute, mwmm.dest_compute, mwmm.dest_host, mwmm.display_name, mwmm.vm_state, mwmm.max_memory_mb_next_2, mmwam.memory_mb, mmwam.metadata_key, mmwam.metadata_value, mmwam.window_column AS avg_memory_mb_status_window_2_pre_2_fol FROM MigrationWindowMaxMemory AS mwmm JOIN MigrationMetadataWindowAvgMemory AS mmwam ON mwmm.migration_id = mmwam.migration_id ORDER BY mwmm.migration_id, mmwam.metadata_key;

question: For instances in VM state "shelved_offloaded" whose display name appears among instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type', show the instance ID, display name, availability zone, cached network info, the instance’s rank within its availability zone ordered by instance ID, and the average and variance of memory (MB) for that display name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH sq1 AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), sq2 AS ( SELECT i.ID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, c.NETWORK_INFO, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ORDER BY i.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' ) SELECT sq2.ID AS instance_id, sq2.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, sq2.AVAILABILITY_ZONE AS availability_zone, sq2.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, sq2.window_column AS rank_within_availability_zone_by_id, sq1.avg_memory_mb, sq1.memory_mb_variance FROM sq2 JOIN sq1 ON sq2.DISPLAY_NAME = sq1.display_name ORDER BY sq2.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, sq2.window_column, sq1.memory_mb_variance DESC;

question: For instances that have a completed migration and also have system metadata with KEY = 'image_image_type', list the instance display name, availability zone, migration status, migration type, instance UUID, the dense-rank value per instance UUID, and the root disk size (ROOT_GB) range and variance for that display name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH CompletedMigrations AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, m.status, m.migration_type, i.uuid, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.uuid ORDER BY i.uuid) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed'), RootGbStatsByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(i.ROOT_GB) - MIN(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_range, VARIANCE(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY root_gb_range DESC) SELECT cm.display_name, cm.availability_zone, cm.status, cm.migration_type, cm.uuid, cm.window_column, rgb.root_gb_range, rgb.root_gb_variance FROM CompletedMigrations AS cm JOIN RootGbStatsByDisplayName AS rgb ON cm.display_name = rgb.display_name ORDER BY rgb.root_gb_range DESC, cm.display_name, cm.uuid;

question: For each migration status that appears among “completed” migrations for instances in availability zone “flare3”, show the migration status, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (in MB) for non-deleted migrations, and the average running-sum of instance memory (MEMORY_MB) within each migration type (ordered by instance memory). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH MigrationStatusMemoryStats AS (SELECT m.status, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_instance_memory_mb, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS instance_memory_mb_stddev FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.deleted = 0 GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY instance_memory_mb_stddev DESC), CompletedFlare3InstanceMemoryRunningSum AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, m.STATUS AS migration_status, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND m.STATUS = 'completed') SELECT msms.status AS migration_status, msms.avg_instance_memory_mb, msms.instance_memory_mb_stddev, AVG(cfis.window_column) AS avg_running_sum_instance_memory_mb_within_migration_type FROM MigrationStatusMemoryStats msms JOIN CompletedFlare3InstanceMemoryRunningSum cfis ON msms.status = cfis.migration_status GROUP BY msms.status, msms.avg_instance_memory_mb, msms.instance_memory_mb_stddev ORDER BY msms.instance_memory_mb_stddev DESC;

question: For completed migrations, list the migration ID, instance display name, the instance’s availability zone and VM state, the number of non-deleted instances in that availability zone and VM state (only keeping groups with at least 2 instances), the earliest creation time in that group, and the instance system metadata key/value with the row number ordered by the metadata key using a window frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH CompletedMigrationInstanceMetadata AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY ism.KEY ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed'), InstanceCountsByAZAndState AS (SELECT ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, ins.VM_STATE, COUNT(ins.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(ins.CREATED_AT) AS earliest_created_at FROM INSTANCES AS ins JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID WHERE ins.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, ins.VM_STATE) SELECT cmim.migration_id, cmim.instance_display_name, icb.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, icb.VM_STATE, icb.instance_count, icb.earliest_created_at, cmim.metadata_key, cmim.metadata_value, cmim.window_column FROM CompletedMigrationInstanceMetadata cmim JOIN INSTANCES i ON i.DISPLAY_NAME = cmim.instance_display_name JOIN InstanceCountsByAZAndState icb ON icb.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE AND icb.VM_STATE = i.VM_STATE WHERE icb.instance_count >= 2 ORDER BY icb.instance_count DESC, cmim.migration_id, cmim.metadata_key;

question: For instances whose display name is "forge", list the instance UUID, hostname, memory in MB, the system metadata key and value, the average memory in MB over a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows partitioned by the metadata key and ordered by memory in MB, and also include the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of memory (in MB) for the "forge" display name computed across instances that have system metadata with key = 'image_image_type'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH forge_instances_window AS ( SELECT i.uuid, i.hostname, i.memory_mb, ism.key, ism.value, AVG(i.memory_mb) OVER ( PARTITION BY ism.key ORDER BY i.memory_mb ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name = 'forge' ), display_name_memory_stats AS ( SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT fiw.uuid, fiw.hostname, fiw.memory_mb, fiw.key, fiw.value, fiw.window_column, dms.memory_mb_variance, dms.memory_mb_stddev FROM forge_instances_window fiw JOIN display_name_memory_stats dms ON dms.display_name = 'forge';

question: For migrations whose status is "completed", list the migration ID, the instance display name, the system metadata key, the running sum of migration IDs within each metadata key group ordered by migration ID, and (for the same instance display name) the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of days between when the instance was created and when it was launched, considering only instances that have a system metadata entry with KEY = 'image_image_type'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH CompletedMigrationMetadata AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, SUM(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ), InstanceLaunchDelayStats AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.launched_at - i.created_at) AS avg_days_to_launch, STDDEV(i.launched_at - i.created_at) AS days_to_launch_stddev FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY days_to_launch_stddev DESC ) SELECT cmm.migration_id, cmm.instance_display_name, cmm.metadata_key, cmm.window_column, ilds.avg_days_to_launch, ilds.days_to_launch_stddev FROM CompletedMigrationMetadata cmm JOIN InstanceLaunchDelayStats ilds ON cmm.instance_display_name = ilds.display_name ORDER BY cmm.metadata_key, cmm.migration_id;

question: For completed migrations, list the migration id, source compute, destination compute, destination host, instance display name, instance memory in MB, the 2-preceding/2-following window average of instance memory (partitioned by migration status and ordered by migration id), and that instance’s coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of migration memory remaining (stddev/avg), but only for instances whose coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is greater than 0.5. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH MigrationWindowedMemory AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.MEMORY_MB, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ORDER BY m.ID), InstanceMigrationMemoryRemainingCV AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT mwm.migration_id, mwm.source_compute, mwm.dest_compute, mwm.dest_host, mwm.display_name, mwm.memory_mb, mwm.window_column AS avg_instance_memory_mb_window_2_preceding_2_following, imcv.coefficient_of_variation AS memory_remaining_coefficient_of_variation_for_instance FROM MigrationWindowedMemory mwm JOIN InstanceMigrationMemoryRemainingCV imcv ON mwm.display_name = imcv.display_name WHERE imcv.coefficient_of_variation > 0.5 ORDER BY imcv.coefficient_of_variation DESC, mwm.migration_id;

question: For each VM state and availability zone, considering only instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type' and only migrations with status = 'completed', return the VM state, availability zone, total instance count, minimum instance memory (MB), and completed migration count for those instances, but only for state/zone groups where completed migrations account for more than 75% of the instances. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH InstanceStateAZStats AS ( SELECT ins.VM_STATE, ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, COUNT(ins.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(ins.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES ins ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON ins.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY ins.VM_STATE, ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ), CompletedMigrationsWithMetadata AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, m.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS instance_vcpus, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS migration_memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ORDER BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ), CompletedMigrationCountsByStateAZ AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, COUNT(m.ID) AS completed_migration_count FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ) SELECT isaz.VM_STATE, isaz.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, isaz.instance_count, isaz.min_memory_mb, cmc.completed_migration_count FROM InstanceStateAZStats isaz JOIN CompletedMigrationCountsByStateAZ cmc ON isaz.VM_STATE = cmc.VM_STATE AND isaz.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = cmc.AVAILABILITY_ZONE WHERE (cmc.completed_migration_count * 1.0 / isaz.instance_count) > 0.75;

question: For each completed migration whose instance is not deleted, list the migration id, instance UUID, migration type, source compute, destination compute, destination host, the instance display name/VM state/memory (MB)/vCPUs and instance extra record id from the migration details, along with the minimum migration MEMORY_TOTAL within each migration type, and also include the instance power state plus the windowed maximum INSTANCE_EXTRA id over the current and next 2 instances when ordered by instance UUID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH CompletedMigrationDetails AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.MIGRATION_TYPE, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, m.MEMORY_TOTAL, MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) OVER (PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed'), NonDeletedInstanceWindowStats AS (SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.power_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, MAX(ie.id) OVER (ORDER BY i.uuid ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_extra_id_next2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0) SELECT cmd.migration_id, cmd.INSTANCE_UUID, cmd.MIGRATION_TYPE, cmd.SOURCE_COMPUTE, cmd.DEST_COMPUTE, cmd.DEST_HOST, cmd.DISPLAY_NAME AS migration_instance_display_name, cmd.VM_STATE AS migration_instance_vm_state, cmd.MEMORY_MB AS migration_instance_memory_mb, cmd.VCPUS AS migration_instance_vcpus, cmd.instance_extra_id AS migration_instance_extra_id, cmd.MEMORY_TOTAL, cmd.window_column AS min_memory_total_within_migration_type, nis.power_state AS nondeleted_instance_power_state, nis.max_instance_extra_id_next2 FROM CompletedMigrationDetails cmd JOIN NonDeletedInstanceWindowStats nis ON cmd.INSTANCE_UUID = nis.uuid ORDER BY cmd.MIGRATION_TYPE, cmd.migration_id;

question: For instances whose display name is 'forge', list the instance UUID, its dense rank when ordering by instance memory (in MB) using a window frame of the current row and the 2 preceding rows, and the instance’s total root disk size in GB for those same instances that have at least one system metadata entry with KEY = 'image_image_type' and whose total ROOT_GB is greater than the overall average ROOT_GB plus one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) (computed across all instances). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH ForgeWindowRanks AS ( SELECT i.uuid, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY i.memory_mb ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name = 'forge' ), HighRootGbInstances AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, SUM(i.ROOT_GB) AS total_root_gb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.UUID HAVING SUM(i.ROOT_GB) > ( SELECT AVG(ROOT_GB) + STDDEV(ROOT_GB) FROM INSTANCES ) ) SELECT fwr.uuid AS instance_uuid, fwr.window_column AS dense_rank_by_memory_window, hri.total_root_gb FROM ForgeWindowRanks fwr JOIN HighRootGbInstances hri ON hri.instance_uuid = fwr.uuid ORDER BY fwr.window_column, fwr.uuid;

question: For each migration status that appears in both resize migrations and non-deleted migrations, show the migration status along with (1) the average, range, and variance of instance memory (MB) for resize migrations and (2) the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (MB) for migrations that are not deleted. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH ResizeMigrationMemoryStats AS (SELECT m.status AS migration_status, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_instance_memory_mb, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS instance_memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS instance_memory_mb_variance FROM instances i JOIN migrations m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.migration_type = 'resize' GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY instance_memory_mb_range DESC), NonDeletedMigrationMemoryStats AS (SELECT m.status, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.deleted = 0 GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT r.migration_status, r.avg_instance_memory_mb AS resize_avg_instance_memory_mb, r.instance_memory_mb_range AS resize_instance_memory_mb_range, r.instance_memory_mb_variance AS resize_instance_memory_mb_variance, n.avg_memory_mb AS nondeleted_avg_memory_mb, n.memory_mb_variance AS nondeleted_memory_mb_variance, n.memory_mb_stddev AS nondeleted_memory_mb_stddev FROM ResizeMigrationMemoryStats r JOIN NonDeletedMigrationMemoryStats n ON r.migration_status = n.status ORDER BY r.instance_memory_mb_range DESC;

question: For instances that are not deleted (DELETED = 0) and are in the availability zone “flare3”, list the instance UUID and display name along with VM state, memory (MB), vCPUs, the extra record’s flavor JSON, a system metadata key and value, and the cached network_info JSON; also include the dense rank by project_id, the 2-preceding/2-following windowed average memory by metadata key, and the memory-per-vCPU ratio (memory_mb divided by vcpus) rounded to 2 decimals.
SQL: WITH InstanceCacheDetails AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.project_id ORDER BY i.project_id) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0), InstanceFlavorAndMetadata AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.FLAVOR AS flavor, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3') SELECT ifm.instance_uuid, ifm.display_name, icd.vm_state, ifm.memory_mb, ifm.vcpus, ifm.flavor, ifm.metadata_key, ifm.metadata_value, icd.network_info, icd.window_column AS project_dense_rank, ifm.window_column AS metadata_key_memory_avg_window, ROUND(ifm.memory_mb / NULLIF(ifm.vcpus, 0), 2) AS memory_mb_per_vcpu FROM InstanceFlavorAndMetadata ifm JOIN InstanceCacheDetails icd ON icd.display_name = ifm.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_per_vcpu DESC;

question: For the top 10 instance display names (in availability zone “flare3”) with the most matching instance-extra records, show each display name’s instance-extra record count and the variance of instance memory (MB) across migrations for instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH TopExtraByDisplayName AS ( SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(ie.id) AS extra_records FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY extra_records DESC LIMIT 10 ), MemoryVarianceByDisplayName AS ( SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT te.display_name, te.extra_records, mv.memory_mb_variance FROM TopExtraByDisplayName te LEFT JOIN MemoryVarianceByDisplayName mv ON te.display_name = mv.display_name ORDER BY te.extra_records DESC;

question: For each completed migration, show the migration id, status, source compute, destination compute, destination host, instance display name, instance VM state, the maximum instance memory (MB) over the current migration and the next 2 migrations (ordered by migration id), along with the instance memory (MB), system metadata key/value, and the average instance memory (MB) over a window of 2 preceding and 2 following migrations (partitioned by migration status and ordered by migration id). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( SELECT m.id AS migration_id, m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.dest_host, i.display_name, i.vm_state, MAX(i.memory_mb) OVER (ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_memory_mb_next_2 FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' ), q2 AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.MEMORY_MB, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ) SELECT q1.migration_id, q1.status, q1.source_compute, q1.dest_compute, q1.dest_host, q1.display_name, q1.vm_state, q1.max_memory_mb_next_2, q2.memory_mb, q2.metadata_key, q2.metadata_value, q2.window_column AS avg_memory_mb_2_pre_2_fol FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.migration_id = q2.migration_id ORDER BY q1.migration_id;

question: For completed migrations, list the migration status, source compute, destination compute, instance display name, instance flavor JSON, and the dense-rank window value, but only for instance display names in availability zone 'flare3' whose memory_mb range across instances is greater than 0; also include that display name’s memory_mb range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH CompletedMigrations AS (SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, i.display_name, ie.flavor, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.status ORDER BY m.status) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed'), DisplayNameMemoryStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC) SELECT cm.status, cm.source_compute, cm.dest_compute, cm.display_name, cm.flavor, cm.window_column, dnms.memory_mb_range, dnms.memory_mb_variance, dnms.memory_mb_stddev FROM CompletedMigrations AS cm JOIN DisplayNameMemoryStats AS dnms ON cm.display_name = dnms.display_name WHERE dnms.memory_mb_range > 0 ORDER BY dnms.memory_mb_range DESC, cm.display_name, cm.source_compute, cm.dest_compute;

question: For each non-deleted security group and rule protocol where the maximum “to” port across its rules is greater than 1000, list the security group name, the protocol, that maximum “to” port, and (for tcp rules) the range and variance of the “from” port values for the same security group. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH MaxToPortByGroupProtocol AS ( SELECT sg.NAME, MAX(sgr.TO_PORT) AS max_to_port, sgr.PROTOCOL FROM SECURITY_GROUPS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sg.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY sg.NAME, sgr.PROTOCOL HAVING MAX(sgr.TO_PORT) > 1000 ), TcpFromPortStatsByGroup AS ( SELECT sg.NAME AS security_group_name, MAX(sgr.FROM_PORT) - MIN(sgr.FROM_PORT) AS from_port_range, VARIANCE(sgr.FROM_PORT) AS from_port_variance FROM SECURITY_GROUPS AS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sgr.PROTOCOL = 'tcp' GROUP BY sg.NAME ORDER BY from_port_range DESC ) SELECT mtp.NAME AS security_group_name, mtp.PROTOCOL, mtp.max_to_port, tfs.from_port_range, tfs.from_port_variance FROM MaxToPortByGroupProtocol mtp JOIN TcpFromPortStatsByGroup tfs ON mtp.NAME = tfs.security_group_name ORDER BY mtp.max_to_port DESC;

question: For each security group that has tcp rules, list the security group ID, name, and description, along with (1) the number of tcp security group rules and the total of their TO_PORT values, and (2) the geometric mean of rule port-range sizes (TO_PORT − FROM_PORT + 1) across its rules where TO_PORT is at least FROM_PORT. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH TcpRuleStats AS ( SELECT sg.ID AS security_group_id, sg.NAME AS security_group_name, sg.DESCRIPTION AS security_group_description, COUNT(sgr.ID) AS rule_count, SUM(sgr.TO_PORT) AS total_to_port FROM SECURITY_GROUPS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sgr.PROTOCOL = 'tcp' GROUP BY sg.ID, sg.NAME, sg.DESCRIPTION ), GeoMeanPortRange AS ( SELECT sg.NAME AS security_group_name, EXP(AVG(LN(sgr.TO_PORT - sgr.FROM_PORT + 1))) AS geometric_mean_port_range_size FROM SECURITY_GROUPS AS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sgr.TO_PORT >= sgr.FROM_PORT GROUP BY sg.NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_port_range_size DESC ), CombinedSecurityGroupMetrics AS ( SELECT t.security_group_id, t.security_group_name, t.security_group_description, t.rule_count, t.total_to_port, g.geometric_mean_port_range_size FROM TcpRuleStats t JOIN GeoMeanPortRange g ON t.security_group_name = g.security_group_name ) SELECT security_group_id, security_group_name, security_group_description, rule_count, total_to_port, geometric_mean_port_range_size FROM CombinedSecurityGroupMetrics ORDER BY security_group_name;

question: For completed migrations, return the migration status, source compute, destination compute, instance display name, and instance system metadata key (with a dense rank per instance UUID), and also include the matching "forge" instance details (instance UUID, hostname, availability zone, cached network_info JSON, and the instance’s rank within its availability zone). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH CompletedMigrations AS (SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, i.display_name, ism.key, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.instance_uuid ORDER BY m.instance_uuid) AS window_column FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed'), ForgeInstances AS (SELECT t0.UUID, t0.HOSTNAME, t0.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, t2.NETWORK_INFO, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ORDER BY t0.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS t0 JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS t1 ON t1.INSTANCE_UUID = t0.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t2.INSTANCE_UUID = t0.UUID WHERE t0.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge') SELECT cm.status AS migration_status, cm.source_compute, cm.dest_compute, cm.display_name, cm.key AS instance_system_metadata_key, cm.window_column AS migration_dense_rank_per_instance_uuid, fi.UUID AS instance_uuid, fi.HOSTNAME, fi.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, fi.NETWORK_INFO, fi.window_column AS instance_rank_within_availability_zone FROM CompletedMigrations cm JOIN ForgeInstances fi ON fi.UUID = ( SELECT i2.uuid FROM instances i2 WHERE i2.display_name = cm.display_name LIMIT 1 );

question: For each non-deleted instance that has system metadata key equal to 'image_image_type', show the instance ID, UUID, user ID, project ID, display name, VM state, memory (MB), vCPUs, instance info cache record ID, the maximum instance ID over the current row and the next 2 rows when ordered by instance ID, plus the instance availability zone, the number of system metadata entries, and the total vCPUs. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH InstanceDetails AS (SELECT i.id AS instance_id, i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.user_id, i.project_id, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, c.id AS info_cache_id, MAX(i.id) OVER (ORDER BY i.id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_id_next_2 FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND c.deleted = 0), InstanceMetadataAgg AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone, COUNT(ism.id) AS metadata_entry_count, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone) SELECT idt.instance_id, idt.instance_uuid, idt.user_id, idt.project_id, idt.display_name, idt.vm_state, idt.memory_mb, idt.vcpus, idt.info_cache_id, idt.max_instance_id_next_2, ima.availability_zone, ima.metadata_entry_count, ima.total_vcpus FROM InstanceDetails idt JOIN InstanceMetadataAgg ima ON idt.instance_uuid = ima.instance_uuid ORDER BY idt.instance_id;

question: For instances in availability zone 'flare3' that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type', show each instance UUID, its display name, the metadata value, the dense rank of the instance when ordering by memory (MB) using a window frame of the current row and the 2 preceding rows, and also the average and variance of memory (MB) for that instance’s display name (computed over instances with the same metadata key). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH InstanceWindowRanks AS ( SELECT t1.UUID AS instance_uuid, t2.VALUE AS metadata_value, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND t2.KEY = 'image_image_type' ), DisplayNameMemoryStats AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT iwr.instance_uuid, i.display_name, iwr.metadata_value, iwr.window_column, dnms.avg_memory_mb, dnms.memory_mb_variance FROM InstanceWindowRanks iwr JOIN instances i ON iwr.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN DisplayNameMemoryStats dnms ON i.display_name = dnms.display_name WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' ORDER BY dnms.memory_mb_variance DESC, iwr.window_column, iwr.instance_uuid;

question: For each instance display name, show the variance of instance memory (in MB) across its system metadata entries, along with the overall memory range (max minus min) and overall memory variance (in MB), considering only instances that are not deleted. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH InstanceMemoryMetadataVariance AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), InstanceMemoryRangeAndVariance AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC) SELECT imv.DISPLAY_NAME, imv.memory_mb_variance AS metadata_memory_mb_variance, imrv.memory_range_mb, imrv.memory_variance_mb FROM InstanceMemoryMetadataVariance imv JOIN InstanceMemoryRangeAndVariance imrv ON imv.DISPLAY_NAME = imrv.display_name ORDER BY imrv.memory_range_mb DESC;

question: For each instance display name that (1) has a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type' and (2) is not deleted and has a non-empty key name, return the display name, the average instance memory (MB) and variance of instance memory (MB) from the image_image_type set, along with the memory range (MB) and variance of instance memory (MB) from the non-deleted/non-empty-key-name set, but only include display names where the image_image_type memory variance is greater than 0. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH ImageTypeMemoryStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), KeyNameNotDeletedMemoryStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_range_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.key_name <> '' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_range_mb DESC) SELECT itms.display_name, itms.avg_memory_mb, itms.memory_mb_variance, kndms.memory_range_mb, kndms.memory_variance_mb FROM ImageTypeMemoryStats itms JOIN KeyNameNotDeletedMemoryStats kndms ON itms.display_name = kndms.display_name WHERE itms.memory_mb_variance > 0 ORDER BY itms.memory_mb_variance DESC;

question: List instance system-metadata rows for instances in availability zone 'flare3' by combining (1) flare3 instances with their VM state, memory, vCPUs, metadata key/value, and a row number per metadata key, and (2) not-deleted (DELETED = 0) flare3 instances with their metadata key/value and a dense-rank per instance; include a “reason” column indicating whether each row came from the availability-zone set or the not-deleted set. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH AZInstances AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3'), NotDeletedInstances AS (SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, ism.key, ism.value, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.uuid ORDER BY i.uuid) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3'), CombinedInstanceMetadata AS ( SELECT instance_uuid, display_name, vm_state, memory_mb, vcpus, metadata_key, metadata_value, window_column, 'Availability Zone flare3' AS reason FROM AZInstances UNION ALL SELECT ndi.uuid AS instance_uuid, ndi.display_name AS display_name, NULL AS vm_state, NULL AS memory_mb, NULL AS vcpus, ndi.key AS metadata_key, ndi.value AS metadata_value, ndi.window_column AS window_column, 'Not Deleted (DELETED = 0)' AS reason FROM NotDeletedInstances ndi ) SELECT * FROM CombinedInstanceMetadata ORDER BY instance_uuid, metadata_key, reason;

question: For destination computes that have at least 2 completed migrations, return the destination compute name, the number of completed migrations, the minimum migration memory remaining within that destination compute group, and whether any of those migrations involve an instance whose display name is one of the “shelved_offloaded” instances (with system metadata key “image_image_type”) whose total memory exceeds 20000 MB. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH CompletedMigrationsWithMetadata AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, m.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS instance_vcpus, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS migration_memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ORDER BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed'), ShelvedOffloadedHighMemoryDisplayNames AS (SELECT i.display_name, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > 20000) SELECT cmwm.DEST_COMPUTE, COUNT(DISTINCT cmwm.migration_id) AS completed_migration_count, MIN(cmwm.window_column) AS min_migration_memory_remaining_in_dest_compute, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT sohdn.display_name) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS Has_Shelved_Offloaded_High_Memory_DisplayName FROM CompletedMigrationsWithMetadata cmwm LEFT JOIN ShelvedOffloadedHighMemoryDisplayNames sohdn ON cmwm.instance_display_name = sohdn.display_name GROUP BY cmwm.DEST_COMPUTE HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cmwm.migration_id) >= 2 ORDER BY completed_migration_count DESC, cmwm.DEST_COMPUTE;

question: For non-deleted instances that also have a completed migration, list the instance ID, UUID, user ID, project ID, display name, VM state, memory (MB), vCPUs, and instance info cache record ID, along with (1) the maximum instance ID over the current row and the next 2 rows when ordered by instance ID, and (2) the migration source compute, destination compute, migration status, and the minimum instance memory (MB) over a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by migration ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( SELECT i.id AS instance_id, i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.user_id, i.project_id, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, c.id AS info_cache_id, MAX(i.id) OVER (ORDER BY i.id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_id_next_2 FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND c.deleted = 0 ), q2 AS ( SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.status, MIN(i.memory_mb) OVER ( ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' ) SELECT q1.instance_id, q1.instance_uuid, q1.user_id, q1.project_id, q1.display_name, q1.vm_state, q1.memory_mb, q1.vcpus, q1.info_cache_id, q1.max_instance_id_next_2, q2.source_compute, q2.dest_compute, q2.status AS migration_status, q2.window_column AS min_instance_memory_mb_window FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.instance_uuid = q2.uuid ORDER BY q1.instance_id;

question: For completed migrations, list the migration id, instance UUID, source compute, destination compute, instance display name, system metadata key and value, and the average migration id within each instance UUID group, but only for instances whose display name appears in the set of instances that have a matching row in INSTANCE_EXTRA; also include the variance of instance memory size (MB) for that display name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH InstanceMemoryVariance AS ( SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), CompletedMigrationMetadata AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, AVG(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ORDER BY m.ID ) SELECT cmm.migration_id, cmm.instance_uuid, cmm.source_compute, cmm.dest_compute, cmm.instance_display_name, cmm.metadata_key, cmm.metadata_value, cmm.window_column, imv.memory_mb_variance FROM CompletedMigrationMetadata AS cmm JOIN InstanceMemoryVariance AS imv ON cmm.instance_display_name = imv.display_name ORDER BY cmm.migration_id;

question: For instances in availability zone "flare3" that have a migration with status "completed", return the instance UUID, instance display name, migration status, the running sum of instance memory (MEMORY_MB) within each migration type ordered by instance memory, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of migration memory remaining for that instance display name (restricted to completed migrations with instance system metadata key "image_image_type"). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH InstanceMigrationWindow AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, m.STATUS AS migration_status, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND m.STATUS = 'completed'), DisplayNameMigrationMemoryCV AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT imw.instance_uuid, imw.instance_display_name, imw.migration_status, imw.window_column, dcv.coefficient_of_variation FROM InstanceMigrationWindow AS imw JOIN DisplayNameMigrationMemoryCV AS dcv ON imw.instance_display_name = dcv.display_name ORDER BY dcv.coefficient_of_variation DESC, imw.instance_display_name, imw.instance_uuid;

question: For completed migrations, list each migration ID along with its instance display name, the instance system metadata key, the running sum of migration IDs within each metadata key group (ordered by migration ID), and also include (for that same instance display name) the average and variance of instance memory in MB across completed migrations. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH MigrationMetadataWindow AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, SUM(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ), InstanceMemoryStats AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT mmw.migration_id, mmw.instance_display_name, mmw.metadata_key, mmw.window_column, ims.avg_memory_mb, ims.memory_mb_variance FROM MigrationMetadataWindow AS mmw JOIN InstanceMemoryStats AS ims ON mmw.instance_display_name = ims.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY mmw.metadata_key, mmw.migration_id;

question: For instances with display name 'forge' that also have migrations with status 'completed', return the migration ID, instance display name, system metadata key, the running sum of migration IDs within each metadata key group (ordered by migration ID), along with the instance UUID, system metadata value, instance extra created_at timestamp, and the row number over metadata keys (using a window frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH CompletedMigrations AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, SUM(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed'), ForgeInstanceMetadataExtra AS (SELECT t1.UUID AS instance_uuid, t2.KEY AS metadata_key, t2.VALUE AS metadata_value, t0.CREATED_AT AS extra_created_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t2.KEY ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), CompletedMigrationsForForge AS ( SELECT cm.migration_id, cm.instance_display_name, cm.metadata_key, cm.window_column AS completed_migrations_running_sum, fime.instance_uuid, fime.metadata_value, fime.extra_created_at, fime.window_column AS forge_metadata_row_number FROM CompletedMigrations cm JOIN INSTANCES i ON i.DISPLAY_NAME = cm.instance_display_name JOIN ForgeInstanceMetadataExtra fime ON fime.instance_uuid = i.UUID AND fime.metadata_key = cm.metadata_key ) SELECT migration_id, instance_display_name, metadata_key, completed_migrations_running_sum, instance_uuid, metadata_value, extra_created_at, forge_metadata_row_number FROM CompletedMigrationsForForge;

question: For security group rules belonging to the security group named "aurum-xenon" (and only if that security group has more than 100 total TCP ports covered), list the security group name, rule protocol, from port, to port, CIDR, the average from port over a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows (partitioned by protocol and ordered by from port), the total TCP ports covered for the security group, and a normalized ratio of the windowed average from port divided by the total TCP ports covered.
SQL: WITH RuleWindow AS ( SELECT sg.NAME AS security_group_name, sgr.PROTOCOL, sgr.FROM_PORT, sgr.TO_PORT, sgr.CIDR, AVG(sgr.FROM_PORT) OVER ( PARTITION BY sgr.PROTOCOL ORDER BY sgr.FROM_PORT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM SECURITY_GROUPS AS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sg.NAME = 'aurum-xenon' ORDER BY sgr.FROM_PORT ), TcpPortCoverage AS ( SELECT sg.NAME AS security_group_name, SUM(sgr.TO_PORT - sgr.FROM_PORT + 1) AS total_ports_covered FROM SECURITY_GROUPS sg JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_RULES sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sgr.PROTOCOL = 'tcp' GROUP BY sg.NAME HAVING SUM(sgr.TO_PORT - sgr.FROM_PORT + 1) > 100 ) SELECT rw.security_group_name, rw.PROTOCOL, rw.FROM_PORT, rw.TO_PORT, rw.CIDR, rw.window_column AS avg_from_port_window_2_pre_2_fol, tpc.total_ports_covered, ROUND(rw.window_column / NULLIF(tpc.total_ports_covered, 0), 6) AS normalized_window_avg_to_total_ports_ratio FROM RuleWindow rw JOIN TcpPortCoverage tpc ON rw.security_group_name = tpc.security_group_name WHERE rw.security_group_name = 'aurum-xenon' ORDER BY normalized_window_avg_to_total_ports_ratio DESC, rw.FROM_PORT;

question: For each instance display name that appears both (a) on host 'blaze8-12' among non-deleted instances with instance_extra metadata and (b) among instances whose display name matches the regular expression 'prime' and that have an instance_system_metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type', show the host 'blaze8-12' memory variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) (MB) alongside the 'prime' image-type average memory and variance (MB), ordered by the host 'blaze8-12' memory variance descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'" "Display 'prime'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'prime'"
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), q2 AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT q1.display_name, q1.memory_mb_variance AS host_blaze8_12_memory_mb_variance, q1.memory_mb_stddev AS host_blaze8_12_memory_mb_stddev, q2.avg_memory_mb AS prime_image_type_avg_memory_mb, q2.memory_mb_variance AS prime_image_type_memory_mb_variance FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.display_name = q2.display_name ORDER BY q1.memory_mb_variance DESC;

question: For completed migrations whose instances are on host 'blaze8-12' (and with non-deleted instance info cache records), which migration types have at least 2 such migrations, and for each of those migration types return the migration type, the total count of completed migrations, and the minimum MEMORY_TOTAL value within that migration type. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
