SQL: WITH MigrationDetails AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.MIGRATION_TYPE, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, m.MEMORY_TOTAL, MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) OVER (PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), MigrationRanks AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND ic.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT md.MIGRATION_TYPE, COUNT(DISTINCT md.migration_id) AS Completed_Migration_Count, MIN(md.window_column) AS Min_Memory_Total_Within_Migration_Type FROM MigrationDetails md JOIN MigrationRanks mr ON md.migration_id = mr.migration_id GROUP BY md.MIGRATION_TYPE HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT md.migration_id) >= 2 ORDER BY Completed_Migration_Count DESC, md.MIGRATION_TYPE;

question: For instances in availability zone "flare3" on host "blaze8-12" that are also non-deleted (and have non-deleted instance info cache records) on host "blaze8-12", how many matching instances are there, what is the average of their running average memory (MB) within the availability zone, and what is the average of their maximum instance ID over the current row and the next 2 rows when ordered by instance ID? Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH az_host_instances AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ie.FLAVOR AS flavor, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB), non_deleted_host_instances AS (SELECT i.id AS instance_id, i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.user_id, i.project_id, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, c.id AS info_cache_id, MAX(i.id) OVER (ORDER BY i.id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_id_next_2 FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND c.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12') SELECT COUNT(*) AS matching_instance_count, AVG(az.window_column) AS avg_running_avg_memory_mb_in_az, AVG(nd.max_instance_id_next_2) AS avg_max_instance_id_next_2 FROM az_host_instances az JOIN non_deleted_host_instances nd ON az.instance_uuid = nd.instance_uuid;

question: For each instance VM state on host 'blaze8-12', list the VM state, the total memory (in MB) across non-deleted instances (only keeping VM states whose total memory is greater than the overall average memory plus one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) for non-deleted instances on that host), and the geometric mean instance memory (in MB) across instances with a system metadata entry where key = 'image_image_type' and memory_mb > 0. SQL: WITH ActiveMigrationsByState AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, m.STATUS AS migration_status, COUNT(i.ID) AS instance_count, MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS min_memory_total FROM INSTANCES i JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.HIDDEN = 0 AND m.STATUS NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, m.STATUS ), HostPrime35InstancesByStateAZ AS ( SELECT ins.VM_STATE, ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, COUNT(ins.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(ins.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES ins ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON ins.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND ins.HOST = 'prime-35' GROUP BY ins.VM_STATE, ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ) SELECT h.VM_STATE, h.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, a.migration_status, h.instance_count AS prime35_instance_count, a.instance_count AS active_migration_instance_count, h.min_memory_mb, a.min_memory_total, ROUND(a.min_memory_total / NULLIF(h.min_memory_mb, 0), 2) AS Min_MigrationMemory_to_Min_InstanceMemory_Ratio FROM HostPrime35InstancesByStateAZ h JOIN ActiveMigrationsByState a ON h.VM_STATE = a.vm_state ORDER BY Min_MigrationMemory_to_Min_InstanceMemory_Ratio DESC;

question: For instances running on host 'blaze8-12' that have system metadata with KEY = 'image_image_type' (and with MEMORY_MB > 0 for the geometric mean calculation), list each VM_STATE along with the variance, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and geometric mean of instance MEMORY_MB, ordered by memory variance descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH MemoryVarianceStddevByState AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), GeometricMeanMemoryByState AS ( SELECT i.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.vm_state ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC ) SELECT mvs.VM_STATE, mvs.memory_mb_variance, mvs.memory_mb_stddev, gmm.geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM MemoryVarianceStddevByState mvs JOIN GeometricMeanMemoryByState gmm ON mvs.VM_STATE = gmm.vm_state ORDER BY mvs.memory_mb_variance DESC;

question: For each non-deleted instance in availability zone “flare3” running on host “blaze8-12”, list the instance UUID, display name, VM state, power state, memory (MB), vCPUs, the instance extra record ID, and the maximum instance ID over the current row and next 2 rows (ordered by instance ID), and also include (when available) the root disk size (ROOT_GB) range and variance computed per display name for instances that have system metadata KEY = 'image_image_type' and are hosted on “prime-35”. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "prime-35" is predicated by "instances.host = 'prime-35'" Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH RootGBStatsByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(i.ROOT_GB) - MIN(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_range, VARIANCE(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'prime-35' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY root_gb_range DESC), InstanceDetailsFlare3Blaze AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MAX(i.ID) OVER (ORDER BY i.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_id_next_2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), CombinedInstanceView AS ( SELECT idfb.instance_uuid, idfb.display_name, idfb.vm_state, idfb.power_state, idfb.memory_mb, idfb.vcpus, idfb.instance_extra_id, idfb.max_instance_id_next_2, rgb.root_gb_range, rgb.root_gb_variance FROM InstanceDetailsFlare3Blaze AS idfb LEFT JOIN RootGBStatsByDisplayName AS rgb ON rgb.DISPLAY_NAME = idfb.display_name ) SELECT * FROM CombinedInstanceView ORDER BY instance_uuid;

question: For non-deleted instances on host "blaze8-12" that also have a non-deleted instance info cache record, find those whose display name is one of the 'prime' display names (matching the pattern 'prime') that appears more than 5 times. For each such instance, return the instance ID, UUID, user ID, project ID, display name, VM state, memory (MB), vCPUs, instance info cache record ID, the maximum instance ID over the current row and the next 2 rows (ordered by instance ID), and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of memory (MB) for that display name. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'" "Display 'prime'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'prime'"
SQL: WITH HostInstanceDetails AS ( SELECT i.id AS instance_id, i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.user_id, i.project_id, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, c.id AS info_cache_id, MAX(i.id) OVER (ORDER BY i.id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_id_next_2 FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND c.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ), PrimeDisplayNameMemoryStddev AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC ) SELECT h.instance_id, h.instance_uuid, h.user_id, h.project_id, h.display_name, h.vm_state, h.memory_mb, h.vcpus, h.info_cache_id, h.max_instance_id_next_2, p.memory_mb_stddev FROM HostInstanceDetails h JOIN PrimeDisplayNameMemoryStddev p ON h.display_name = p.display_name ORDER BY h.instance_id;

question: For instances in availability zone "flare3" whose display name matches the pattern "flare", and whose display name is also a "prime" display name in the same availability zone, show the instance UUID, hostname, memory in MB, instance extra record ID, instance extra created timestamp, the 2-preceding/2-following window average memory (partitioned by VM state and ordered by memory), and the completed-migration average and variance of MEMORY_TOTAL for that instance display name. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "Display 'flare'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'flare'" "Display 'prime'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'prime'"
SQL: WITH FlareZoneInstances AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ie.CREATED_AT AS instance_extra_created_at, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'flare' ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB), PrimeMigrationMemoryStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(m.memory_total) AS avg_memory_total, VARIANCE(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_variance FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_total_variance DESC), FlareZonePrimeDisplayNames AS (SELECT i.display_name FROM instances AS i WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name) SELECT fzi.instance_uuid, fzi.hostname, fzi.memory_mb, fzi.instance_extra_id, fzi.instance_extra_created_at, fzi.window_column, pmms.display_name, pmms.avg_memory_total, pmms.memory_total_variance FROM FlareZoneInstances AS fzi JOIN instances AS i ON i.uuid = fzi.instance_uuid JOIN FlareZonePrimeDisplayNames AS fzpdn ON fzpdn.display_name = i.display_name JOIN PrimeMigrationMemoryStats AS pmms ON pmms.display_name = i.display_name ORDER BY pmms.memory_total_variance DESC, fzi.memory_mb;

question: For instances on host "blaze8-12" that are not deleted and whose display name matches the regular expression 'prime', list the instance UUID, display name, the range and variance of total migration memory across completed migrations for that display name, and each system metadata key/value (including the dense-rank window column), ordering results by the memory total range descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "Display 'prime'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'prime'" Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH MemoryStatsByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(m.memory_total) - MIN(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_range, VARIANCE(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_variance FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_total_range DESC), InstanceMetadataOnHost AS (SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, ism.key, ism.value, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.uuid ORDER BY i.uuid) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12') SELECT imoh.uuid, imoh.display_name, msbdn.memory_total_range, msbdn.memory_total_variance, imoh.key, imoh.value, imoh.window_column FROM InstanceMetadataOnHost imoh JOIN MemoryStatsByDisplayName msbdn ON imoh.display_name = msbdn.display_name WHERE imoh.display_name REGEXP 'prime' ORDER BY msbdn.memory_total_range DESC, imoh.uuid, imoh.key;

question: For host blaze8-12, for each instance display name and VM state (considering only non-deleted instances that have the system metadata key image_image_type), return the distinct instance count and earliest creation time, along with (for availability zone flare3) the number of matching instances, the total number of system metadata entries, and the total vCPUs summed across those instances. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH InstanceStateSummary AS ( SELECT ins.DISPLAY_NAME, ins.VM_STATE, COUNT(DISTINCT ins.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(ins.CREATED_AT) AS earliest_created_at FROM INSTANCES AS ins JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID WHERE ins.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND ins.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY ins.DISPLAY_NAME, ins.VM_STATE ), InstanceMetadataVcpuSummary AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name, COUNT(ism.id) AS metadata_entry_count, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus FROM instances i JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name ) SELECT iss.DISPLAY_NAME, iss.VM_STATE, iss.instance_count, iss.earliest_created_at, COUNT(DISTINCT imvs.instance_uuid) AS flare3_instance_count, SUM(imvs.metadata_entry_count) AS flare3_metadata_entry_count, SUM(imvs.total_vcpus) AS flare3_total_vcpus FROM InstanceStateSummary iss JOIN InstanceMetadataVcpuSummary imvs ON imvs.display_name = iss.DISPLAY_NAME GROUP BY iss.DISPLAY_NAME, iss.VM_STATE, iss.instance_count, iss.earliest_created_at;

question: For the top 10 instance display names matching the pattern 'prime' that have a non-empty key name, show each display name’s total number of completed migrations, along with the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of completed-migration counts per instance (counted per destination compute), but only include display names whose migration-count range is greater than 0. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "Display 'prime'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'prime'"
SQL: WITH InstanceMigrationDispersion AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(migration_count) - MIN(migration_count) AS migration_count_range, VARIANCE(migration_count) AS migration_count_variance, STDDEV(migration_count) AS migration_count_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid JOIN ( SELECT m.instance_uuid, m.dest_compute, COUNT(*) AS migration_count FROM migrations AS m WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.dest_compute ) AS mig_stats ON i.uuid = mig_stats.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migration_count_range DESC), TopCompletedMigrations AS (SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(m.id) AS completed_migrations FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.key_name IS NOT NULL AND i.key_name <> '' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY completed_migrations DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT tcm.display_name, tcm.completed_migrations, imd.migration_count_range, imd.migration_count_variance, imd.migration_count_stddev FROM TopCompletedMigrations tcm JOIN InstanceMigrationDispersion imd ON tcm.display_name = imd.display_name WHERE imd.migration_count_range > 0 ORDER BY tcm.completed_migrations DESC;

question: For instance display names that match the pattern 'prime' (and have at least 3 system metadata rows) and also appear on host 'blaze8-12' with system-metadata key 'image_image_type', return each display name along with (1) the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of MEMORY_MB across its system metadata rows and (2) the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of ROOT_GB across those 'image_image_type' system-metadata rows. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "Display 'prime'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'prime'" Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH MemoryStddevPrime AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 2 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC ), RootGbCoeffVarBlaze AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.root_gb) / NULLIF(AVG(i.root_gb), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(i.root_gb) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT msp.display_name, msp.memory_mb_stddev, rgb.coefficient_of_variation FROM MemoryStddevPrime AS msp JOIN RootGbCoeffVarBlaze AS rgb ON rgb.display_name = msp.display_name ORDER BY msp.memory_mb_stddev DESC, rgb.coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For host 'blaze8-12', find instances that are not deleted (deleted = 0) and whose display name appears among instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type'. For each such instance, return the instance UUID, display name, memory_mb, vcpus, the instance flavor JSON, the dense-rank window column (partitioned by project_id and ordered by project_id), and the display-name-level average and variance of memory_mb, ordered by memory variance descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH InstanceDetails AS ( SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, ie.flavor, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.project_id ORDER BY i.project_id) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ), DisplayNameMemoryStats AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT id.uuid, id.display_name, id.memory_mb, id.vcpus, id.flavor, id.window_column, dms.avg_memory_mb, dms.memory_mb_variance FROM InstanceDetails AS id JOIN DisplayNameMemoryStats AS dms ON id.display_name = dms.display_name ORDER BY dms.memory_mb_variance DESC, id.display_name, id.uuid;

question: For instances running on host 'blaze8-12' that have system metadata with KEY = 'image_image_type' (and are not deleted where applicable), list each instance display name along with its average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of ROOT_GB, plus the instance VM state, memory_mb, cached network_info JSON, and the dense-rank window column partitioned by project_id. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH InstanceRootGbStats AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.root_gb) AS avg_root_gb, STDDEV(i.root_gb) AS root_gb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY root_gb_stddev DESC ), InstanceDetails AS ( SELECT i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.project_id ORDER BY i.project_id) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT irs.display_name, irs.avg_root_gb, irs.root_gb_stddev, id.vm_state, id.memory_mb, id.network_info, id.window_column FROM InstanceRootGbStats irs JOIN InstanceDetails id ON irs.display_name = id.display_name ORDER BY irs.root_gb_stddev DESC;

question: For instances running on host blaze8-12 that are not deleted (and where the maximum instance memory per display name and metadata key is greater than 16000 MB), list the instance UUID, display name, availability zone, system metadata entry count (for key 'image_image_type'), total vCPUs, the metadata key, the maximum memory (MB), the launched timestamp, and compute the vCPUs-per-MB ratio (total vCPUs divided by max memory).
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH MaxMemoryByDisplayAndKey AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) AS max_memory_mb, i.LAUNCHED_AT FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism JOIN INSTANCES i ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME, ism.KEY, i.LAUNCHED_AT HAVING MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) > 16000 ), InstanceAZMetadataAndVcpus AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone, COUNT(ism.id) AS metadata_entry_count, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus FROM instance_extra ie JOIN instances i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone ) SELECT ia.instance_uuid, ia.display_name, ia.availability_zone, ia.metadata_entry_count, ia.total_vcpus, mm.metadata_key, mm.max_memory_mb, mm.launched_at, ROUND(ia.total_vcpus / NULLIF(mm.max_memory_mb, 0), 4) AS vcpus_per_mb_ratio FROM InstanceAZMetadataAndVcpus ia JOIN MaxMemoryByDisplayAndKey mm ON ia.display_name = mm.display_name ORDER BY vcpus_per_mb_ratio DESC, mm.max_memory_mb DESC;

question: For the top 10 instance display names with the most system metadata entries (counting only non-deleted instances hosted on 'prime-35' and only metadata rows where the key is 'image_image_type'), show the matching instances that are in availability zone 'flare3' and hosted on 'blaze8-12', returning the display name, metadata entry count, instance UUID, VM state, memory in MB, cached network info, and the row number within each VM state ordered by memory (descending). Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: Host "prime-35" is predicated by "instances.host = 'prime-35'" Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH sq1 AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(ism.ID) AS metadata_entries FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'prime-35' AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY metadata_entries DESC LIMIT 10 ), sq2 AS ( SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, c.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB DESC) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT sq1.DISPLAY_NAME, sq1.metadata_entries, sq2.UUID, sq2.VM_STATE, sq2.MEMORY_MB, sq2.NETWORK_INFO, sq2.window_column FROM sq1 JOIN sq2 ON sq1.DISPLAY_NAME = sq2.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY sq1.metadata_entries DESC, sq2.VM_STATE, sq2.window_column;

question: For instances in availability zone "flare3" that have a migration with status "completed" and whose display name matches the pattern "flare", show the instance UUID, instance display name, migration status, the running sum of instance memory (MEMORY_MB) within each migration type ordered by instance memory, and (when the same display name also matches "prime" and has at least 3 system metadata entries) the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (in MB) across its system metadata rows. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "Display 'flare'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'flare'" "Display 'prime'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'prime'"
SQL: WITH sq1 AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, m.STATUS AS migration_status, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'flare' ), sq2 AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 2 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC ) SELECT sq1.instance_uuid, sq1.instance_display_name, sq1.migration_status, sq1.window_column, sq2.memory_mb_stddev FROM sq1 JOIN sq2 ON sq1.instance_display_name = sq2.display_name ORDER BY sq2.memory_mb_stddev DESC;

question: For each instance display name matching the regular expression 'prime', among instances that are not deleted and have a non-deleted network info cache record, return the instance’s average memory (MB) and memory variance, and also the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of migration MEMORY_REMAINING across that instance’s completed migrations. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "Display 'prime'" is predicated by "instances.display_name REGEXP 'prime'"
SQL: WITH MigrationMemoryCV AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), InstanceMemoryStats AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND ic.deleted = 0 AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT ims.display_name, ims.avg_memory_mb, ims.memory_mb_variance, mmcv.coefficient_of_variation FROM InstanceMemoryStats AS ims JOIN MigrationMemoryCV AS mmcv ON ims.display_name = mmcv.display_name ORDER BY mmcv.coefficient_of_variation DESC, ims.memory_mb_variance DESC, ims.display_name;

question: For each active migration status (excluding accepted, confirmed, reverted, error, failed, and completed), show the status, the geometric mean of migrated instances’ memory (in MB) for migrations where instance memory is greater than zero, and also the instance-memory range (max minus min) and variance (in MB) for non-deleted migrations whose instances have a non-deleted instance info cache entry. Do not return any rounded answers.
evidence: "Active migrations" is predicated by "migrations.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed')"
SQL: WITH GeometricMeanMemoryByStatus AS ( SELECT m.status, EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geometric_mean_memory_mb FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE i.memory_mb > 0 AND m.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_mb DESC ), MemoryRangeVarianceByStatus AS ( SELECT m.status, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND ic.deleted = 0 AND m.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY m.status ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC ) SELECT g.status, g.geometric_mean_memory_mb, r.memory_mb_range, r.memory_mb_variance FROM GeometricMeanMemoryByStatus g JOIN MemoryRangeVarianceByStatus r ON g.status = r.status ORDER BY r.memory_mb_range DESC;

question: For each non-deleted instance in availability zone “flare3” running on host “blaze8-12”, return the instance UUID, display name, and network_info cache, along with the count of linked instance_extra records and the total memory (MB) across those linked records, plus the instance’s VM state, power state, memory (MB), vCPUs, and the maximum INSTANCE_EXTRA id over a window covering the current instance and the next 2 instances when ordered by instance UUID. SQL: WITH InstanceExtrasByAZHost AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, iic.network_info, COUNT(ie.id) AS extra_record_count, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances i JOIN instance_extra ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, iic.network_info), InstanceWindowMaxExtra AS (SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.power_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, MAX(ie.id) OVER ( ORDER BY i.uuid ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_instance_extra_id_next2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12') SELECT a.instance_uuid, a.display_name, a.network_info, a.extra_record_count, a.total_memory_mb, w.vm_state, w.power_state, w.memory_mb, w.vcpus, w.max_instance_extra_id_next2 FROM InstanceExtrasByAZHost a JOIN InstanceWindowMaxExtra w ON w.uuid = a.instance_uuid;

question: For compute instances on host "blaze8-12" that are not deleted, show each instance’s UUID, display name, VM state, power state, memory (MB), vCPUs, the maximum INSTANCE_EXTRA id over a window covering the current instance and the next 2 instances (ordered by instance UUID), and also the average and variance of memory (MB) for that instance’s display name among instances that have system metadata KEY = 'image_image_type' on the same host. SQL: WITH InstanceDetails AS ( SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.power_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, MAX(ie.id) OVER ( ORDER BY i.uuid ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_instance_extra_id_next2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ), MemoryStatsByDisplayName AS ( SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT id.uuid, id.display_name, id.vm_state, id.power_state, id.memory_mb, id.vcpus, id.max_instance_extra_id_next2, ms.avg_memory_mb, ms.memory_mb_variance FROM InstanceDetails AS id LEFT JOIN MemoryStatsByDisplayName AS ms ON id.display_name = ms.display_name;

question: For migrations with status = "completed" whose instance is on host "blaze8-12", list migration details and include a reason showing whether the row comes from (1) the 2-preceding/2-following window average of instance memory (MB) by migration status ordered by migration id, or (2) the running sum of migration IDs within each instance system metadata key group ordered by migration ID. evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH MemoryWindow AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.MEMORY_MB, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY m.ID ), MetadataRunningSum AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, SUM(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ), CombinedMigrations AS ( SELECT mw.migration_id, mw.SOURCE_COMPUTE, mw.DEST_COMPUTE, mw.DEST_HOST, mw.DISPLAY_NAME, mw.MEMORY_MB, mw.window_column AS avg_memory_mb_window, NULL AS metadata_key, NULL AS running_sum_migration_id_by_key, 'Memory Window Avg' AS reason FROM MemoryWindow mw UNION ALL SELECT mrs.migration_id, NULL AS SOURCE_COMPUTE, NULL AS DEST_COMPUTE, NULL AS DEST_HOST, mrs.instance_display_name AS DISPLAY_NAME, NULL AS MEMORY_MB, NULL AS avg_memory_mb_window, mrs.metadata_key, mrs.window_column AS running_sum_migration_id_by_key, 'Metadata Key Running Sum' AS reason FROM MetadataRunningSum mrs ) SELECT migration_id, SOURCE_COMPUTE, DEST_COMPUTE, DEST_HOST, DISPLAY_NAME, MEMORY_MB, avg_memory_mb_window, metadata_key, running_sum_migration_id_by_key, reason FROM CombinedMigrations ORDER BY migration_id, reason;

question: For host "blaze8-12", for each VM state whose total instance memory (across non-deleted instances) is greater than the host’s overall average instance memory plus one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), list the VM state along with each active (non-hidden) migration status for that VM state, the number of instances involved in those migrations, the minimum migration MEMORY_TOTAL, the total instance memory for the VM state, and the ratio of minimum migration MEMORY_TOTAL to total instance memory.
evidence: "Active migrations" is predicated by "migrations.status NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed')" Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH ActiveMigrationsByState AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, m.STATUS AS migration_status, COUNT(i.ID) AS instance_count, MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS min_memory_total FROM INSTANCES i JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.HIDDEN = 0 AND m.STATUS NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, m.STATUS ), HighMemoryStatesOnHost AS ( SELECT i.vm_state, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.vm_state HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > ( SELECT AVG(i2.memory_mb) + STDDEV(i2.memory_mb) FROM instances AS i2 JOIN instance_extra AS ie2 ON i2.uuid = ie2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.deleted = 0 AND i2.host = 'blaze8-12' ) ) SELECT hm.vm_state, am.migration_status, am.instance_count, am.min_memory_total, hm.total_memory_mb, ROUND(am.min_memory_total / NULLIF(hm.total_memory_mb, 0), 4) AS MinMigrationMemory_to_TotalInstanceMemory_Ratio FROM HighMemoryStatesOnHost hm JOIN ActiveMigrationsByState am ON hm.vm_state = am.vm_state ORDER BY MinMigrationMemory_to_TotalInstanceMemory_Ratio DESC;

question: For instances running on host "blaze8-12" that (a) have a completed migration and (b) have a display name that appears in more than one instance with system metadata KEY = 'image_image_type', list the instance display name, hostname, VM state, memory in MB, vCPU count, instance UUID, migration status, the maximum migration ID over the current row and the next 2 rows when ordered by instance UUID, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of MEMORY_MB for that display name (computed over the KEY = 'image_image_type' instances on "blaze8-12"), ordered by the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) descending. SQL: WITH q1 AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.UUID, m.STATUS, MAX(m.ID) OVER ( ORDER BY i.UUID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_migration_id_next2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ), q2 AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC ) SELECT q1.DISPLAY_NAME, q1.HOSTNAME, q1.VM_STATE, q1.MEMORY_MB, q1.VCPUS, q1.UUID, q1.STATUS AS migration_status, q1.max_migration_id_next2, q2.memory_mb_stddev FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.DISPLAY_NAME = q2.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY q2.memory_mb_stddev DESC, q1.UUID;

question: For instances running on host blaze8-12 that are not deleted (and where the instance has extra metadata and the system metadata key image_image_type), for each instance display name and VM state list the distinct instance count, the earliest creation time, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (MB), and the rounded standard-deviation-to-variance ratio, ordered by that ratio descending.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH MemoryStats AS ( SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), StateCounts AS ( SELECT ins.DISPLAY_NAME, ins.VM_STATE, COUNT(DISTINCT ins.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(ins.CREATED_AT) AS earliest_created_at FROM INSTANCES AS ins JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID WHERE ins.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND ins.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY ins.DISPLAY_NAME, ins.VM_STATE ) SELECT sc.DISPLAY_NAME, sc.VM_STATE, sc.instance_count, sc.earliest_created_at, ms.memory_mb_variance, ms.memory_mb_stddev, ROUND(ms.memory_mb_stddev / NULLIF(ms.memory_mb_variance, 0), 4) AS Stddev_to_Variance_Ratio FROM StateCounts sc JOIN MemoryStats ms ON sc.DISPLAY_NAME = ms.display_name ORDER BY Stddev_to_Variance_Ratio DESC;

question: On host "prime-35", for each instance (UUID, display name, and availability zone) that has completed migrations, show its migration count and total memory processed, and also include (for the same availability zone) the VM state breakdown with the number of non-deleted instances and the earliest instance creation time. question: For each instance VM state on host 'blaze8-12' (considering only instances that have system metadata with KEY = 'image_image_type'), list the average/variance/standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (MB), the average/range/variance of root disk size (GB), and compute the normalized ratio of average memory to average root disk (avg_memory_mb divided by avg_root_gb), ordered by this ratio descending.
evidence: Host "blaze8-12" is predicated by "instances.host = 'blaze8-12'"
SQL: WITH MemoryStatsByState AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), RootDiskStatsByState AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, AVG(i.ROOT_GB) AS avg_root_gb, MAX(i.ROOT_GB) - MIN(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_range, VARIANCE(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_variance FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY root_gb_range DESC ) SELECT ms.VM_STATE, ms.avg_memory_mb, ms.memory_mb_variance, ms.memory_mb_stddev, rd.avg_root_gb, rd.root_gb_range, rd.root_gb_variance, ROUND(ms.avg_memory_mb / NULLIF(rd.avg_root_gb, 0), 2) AS Avg_Memory_MB_Per_Root_GB FROM MemoryStatsByState ms JOIN RootDiskStatsByState rd ON ms.VM_STATE = rd.VM_STATE ORDER BY Avg_Memory_MB_Per_Root_GB DESC;

SQL: WITH HostInstanceMemoryStats AS ( SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ), MigrationInstanceMemoryVariance AS ( SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC ) SELECT hims.display_name, hims.memory_mb_variance AS host_memory_mb_variance, hims.memory_mb_stddev AS host_memory_mb_stddev, mimv.memory_mb_variance AS migration_memory_mb_variance FROM HostInstanceMemoryStats hims JOIN MigrationInstanceMemoryVariance mimv ON hims.display_name = mimv.display_name;

question: For completed migrations where the instance is on host "blaze8-12", list the migration id, migration status, source compute, destination compute, the instance display name, and the instance network info, along with the average migration id within each status group, and also include (per instance display name) the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of migration memory remaining; finally compute the ratio of migration id to that coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) and order by this ratio descending.

SQL: WITH MigrationDetails AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ic.NETWORK_INFO, AVG(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY m.ID), InstanceMemoryVariation AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT md.migration_id, md.migration_status, md.SOURCE_COMPUTE, md.DEST_COMPUTE, md.instance_display_name, md.NETWORK_INFO, md.window_column, imv.coefficient_of_variation, ROUND(md.migration_id / NULLIF(imv.coefficient_of_variation, 0), 2) AS migration_id_to_memory_variation_ratio FROM MigrationDetails md JOIN InstanceMemoryVariation imv ON md.instance_display_name = imv.display_name ORDER BY migration_id_to_memory_variation_ratio DESC;

question: Give the number of instance display names in the top 10 list by completed migrations for instances with a non-empty key name whose display name matches the pattern 'prime', and the number of instance display names with memory range/variance statistics for not-deleted instances whose display name matches the pattern 'flare'. SQL: WITH MetadataStatsByDisplayName AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(meta_entry_count) - MIN(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_range, VARIANCE(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_variance, STDDEV(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_stddev FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN ( SELECT i2.DISPLAY_NAME, i2.UUID, COUNT(*) AS meta_entry_count FROM INSTANCES AS i2 JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i2.UUID WHERE ism.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i2.DISPLAY_NAME, i2.UUID ) AS per_instance_meta ON per_instance_meta.UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE iic.DELETED = 0 AND i.DISPLAY_NAME REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY metadata_count_range DESC ), MemoryStddevByDisplayName AS ( SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC ) SELECT m.DISPLAY_NAME, m.metadata_count_range, m.metadata_count_variance, m.metadata_count_stddev, s.memory_mb_stddev FROM MetadataStatsByDisplayName AS m JOIN MemoryStddevByDisplayName AS s ON m.DISPLAY_NAME = s.display_name ORDER BY m.metadata_count_range DESC;

question: For instances whose display name matches the pattern 'prime' and are not deleted, and restricting to those running on host "blaze8-12" with more than 8 VCPUs, provide the VM state, display name, number of instances, minimum memory (MB), and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the time (in days) between instance creation and the last update of its instance info cache record.
